korende nyuma y’ayio neche emiaka ende etano na ebere y’enchara; na omoigoto oria bwonsi nigo ogochia kwebwa ase ense ya Misiri, ekiagera enchara eria nigo erarie ense eye.
Omoigoto oria tokoinyorwa ase ense eye, ase engencho y’enchara eye erache gocha korwa nyuma yaye, ekiagera nigo erabe endito mono.
Na bono Farao, okorota kwao nigo gwachete eria kabere, aya nigo akoorokia ng’a Nyasae ochikire amang’ana aya, na Nyasae nayaikeranie iga bwango.
“Ase ayio Farao, rigia omonto ore omomanyi na omong’aini, omobeke igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri.
Na bono Farao, aya naro ogwenerete okore: Obeke abateneneri igoro y’ense eye bachoge ensemo ya isano y’endagera ase ense ya Misiri ase emiaka eye etano na ebere y’omoigoto.
Tiga basangererie endagera eye yonsi y’emiaka eye emiya egocha, bayebeke erendwe ase emechie, ase okobua gwa Farao.
Na endagera eye egachwe eche koegwa abanto emiaka eye etano na ebere y’enchara, erache gocha ase ense ya Misiri, abanto tibabaisa gocha gosira ase enchara eyio.”
Amang’ana ayio akagwenera Farao amo nabasomba baye bonsi.
Farao akaboria abasomba baye, “Inee! Ng’ai toranyore omonto onga buna oyo ore n’Omoika o Nyasae ime yaye?”
Erio Farao agatebia Yusufu, “Ekiagera Nyasae okomanyirie amang’ana ayio onsi, onde tari aa omanyete, naende ore na omong’aini buna aye.
Bono naye orabe omoteneneri bw’enka yane, na abanto baane bonsi nabakoigwere buna orabe gokobachika. Ase ekerogo kiane ki’obogambi oka, nao ndabe omonene gokobua.”
Farao agatebia Yusufu, “Rora nakobekire aye igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri.”
Erio Farao akarusia ebonyi yaye ere nekemanyererio korwa ase ekiara kiaye, akamoyebekera Yusufu kiara kiaye, akamobekera na eanga engiya y’egatani, akamobekera ne chisonoi chi’etahabu igoti riaye.
Akamoriinia ase egari yaye ya kabere y’oboruoti. Abanto bagaaka eriogi, bakobora, “Tung’ama inse!” Naboigo akamobeka abe omogambi bw’ense yonsi ya Misiri.
Naende Farao agatebia Yusufu, “Ninche Farao. Otancheti aye, onde takoba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri oraimoke gokora gento.”
Farao akaroka Yusufu Safenati‐Panea; akamonyuomeria omokungu, nere Asenati, omoiseke o Potifera, omokuani bw’Oni. Yusufu akagenda aaria na aaria korigereria ense yonsi ya Misiri.
Agwo Yusufu, ekero asoete gokorera Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato. Na Yusufu akarua ase obosio bwa Farao, agaetanana ase ense yonsi ya Misri.
Emiaka eria etano na ebere y’omoigoto egaika, ense ekaama endagera enyinge,
na Yusufu agasangereria endagera yonsi ase emiaka eria etano na ebere, ase ense ya Misiri, akayegacha ase emechie. Ase kera omochie akagacha endagera yonsi y’emegondo eria yayoetanaine.
Yusufu akagacha endagera ase obonge mono, ekaba enyinge buna omokenye bw’enyancha, goika agatiga koyerenga, ekiagera tiyare konyara korengeka.
Ritang’ani emiaka eria y’enchara etaracha, Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, omokuani bw’Oni, akaiborera Yusufu abana abaisia babere.
Yusufu akaroka omwana oria omotangi Manase, agateba, “Nyasae ogerire inyebe obokong’u bwonsi na abanto b’enka ya tata.”
Na omwana o kabere akamoroka Efraimu, agateba, “Nyasae ong’eire oroiboro ase ense y’emechando yane.”
Emiaka eria etano na ebere y’omoigoto ekaera ase ense ya Misiri,
na emiaka eria etano na ebere y’enchara egachaka gocha, buna Yusufu abanete. Enchara egacha ase chinse chionsi, korende ase ense yonsi ya Misiri endagera yarengeo.
Ekero enchara yariete abanto bonsi ba Misiri, barabwo bakamorera Farao abae endagera; na Farao agatebia Abamisiri bonsi, “Genda ase Yusufu, na rinde rionsi arabatebie, goika morikore.”
Ase igo, ekero enchara yasoete ase ense eria engima, Yusufu akaigora ebiage bionsi, akaooneria Abamisiri endagera, ekiagera enchara nigo yabete endito ase ense ya Misiri.
Abanto be chinse chionsi bagacha Misiri kogora endagera korwa ase Yusufu, ekiagera enchara nigo yarenge endito ase ense engima.
Ekero Yakobo aigwete ng’a endagera nekare ase ense ya Misiri, akaboria abamura baye, “Inaki morigereranetie iga?”
Naende akabatebia, “Naigure ng’a endagera nekare Misiri, tirimboka gochiao, motogorere endagera toche koria, tobe moyo, titokwa.”
Ase igo bamura bamwabo Yusufu ikomi bagatirimboka gochia Misiri kogora endagera.
Korende Benjamin, omwabo Yusufu, Yakobo tamotiga agende amo nabarabwo, ekiagera nigo oboete ng’a aande nabaise gochia konyorwa namabe.
Nabo basinto ba Israeli bakagenda amo nabanto bande abachiete kogora endagera, ekiagera enchara yarenge ase ense ya Kanani.
Yusufu nere orenge gavuna igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri, naende nere orenge kooneria abanto bonsi b’ense eria endagera. Na abamwabo Yusufu, ekero baigete asare, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye.

Yusufu, ekero abarora, akabamanya, korende agekora buna tabamanyeti, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana amakong’u. Akababoria, “Abanto aba, ng’ai mwarure?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Nigo twarure ase ense ya Kanani, twachire kogora endagera.”
Nonya Yusufu omanyete abamwabo, barabwo tibamomanyete ere.
Erio Yusufu akainyora chindoto chiria arenge kobarotera, akabatebia, “Inwe nechirooti more, nigo mwachire koroota ense eye, na korora ase ere bosa etari na getango.”
Bakamokania, “Taibo, omonene, intwe abasomba bao nigo twachire kogora endagera.
Intwe twensi nabana b’omonto oyomo. Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abanto abaronge, titori chirooti.”
Akabakania, “Yaya, nigo mwachire koroota ense, na korora ense ase ere bosa etari na getango.”
Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abamura ikomi na babere, abana b’omonto oyomo, ase ense ya Kanani; na bono omoke ominto tari aa, inka akare ase tata, na oyomo ere takaiyo.”
Korende Yusufu akabatebia “Nabo ere buna konya naikire kobatebia, ng’a inwe nechirooti more.
Ase amang’ana aya nimbateeme: Amaene, buna Farao are moyo, timokorua aa mogende, oria omino omoke ataracha aa.
Toma oyomo oino agende korenta oyio omino, na inwe abande motigare echela. Nabo morateemwe gose namaene mogoteba. Onye taibo, amaene buna Farao are moyo, inwe nechirooti more.”
Erio agasiekera bonsi amo echela ime ase amatuko atato.
Rituko ria gatato Yusufu akabatebia, “Mokore iga buna ndabatebie, nario morabe moyo; naki inche nomonto imoirogete Nyasae.
Onye inwe more abanto abaronge, tiga oyomo oino atigare aa ase echela, na inwe abande moirere abwo mwatigete inka endagera, ase engencho y’enchara;
erio morente oria omino omoke asende. Igo amang’ana aino aenekigwe ng’a namaene are, na inwe timobaisa gokwa. Barabwo bagakora bo.”

Erio bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Amaene, ntwamocherete oyominto. Nigo twaroche ogochandeka kw’omoyo oye, na ekero atosororete titwamoigwete. Ase ayio nakio kiagerire obokong’u obo bwatonyorire.”
Reuben akabairaneria, “Tinabakanetie ng’a timomochera omosae oyo? Korende inwe mokaanga, timwanyigwera. Ase igo bono amanyinga aye aganigwe aakanwe.”
Barabwo tibamanya ng’a Yusufu nayaigwete, ekiagera omonogi narengeo ore komoonchorera.
Erio akarua asebare, akagenda ensemo, akarera amariga; naende akairana, agakwana nabarabwo. Akarusia Simeoni korwa asebare, akamosiba ase amasio abo.
Yusufu agachika abanto baichorie chigunia chiabo endagera, na kera oyomo airanerigwe chibesa chiaye, chibekwe egunia yaye ime, na aegwe endagera agochia koria inchera. Naboigo babakorerete.
Erio bakaberekia chitigere chiabo endagera, bakagenda.
Ekero baigete ase bakorara botuko, oyomo obo agasansora egunia yaye arusie endagera ae etigere yaye, akarora chibesa chiaye igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime,

agatebia abamwabo, “Ayee! Chibesa chiane nigo chiairanetigwe, rigereria, nao chire aa egunia yane ime!” Chinkoro chiabo chikagoyaana, bakarigererania na koiguswa, bagateba, “Inki eke Nyasae atokoreire iga?”
Ekero baigete ase Yakobo ise, ase ense ya Kanani, bakamotebia ayio onsi abanyorete, bakabora,
“Omonto oria omonene bw’ense eria nigo akwanete naintwe amang’ana amakong’u agatoroka ng’a intwe nechirooti, tokoroota ense.
Korende tokamotebia: Intwe nigo tore abanto abaronge, titori chirooti.
Nigo tore abamura ikomi na babere, tata noyomo. Oyomo oito takaiyo, na omoke kegima nere okare ase tata inka, ase ense ya Kanani.

Omonto oyio, omonene bw’ense eria, agatotebia: Ase amang’ana aya naro ndamanyere gose nabanto abaronge more: Tiga oyomo oino aiga asende, inwe abande genda, moire endagera ase engencho y’enchara ekare inka seino.
Genda mondetere oyio omino omoke, erio nario ndamanye ng’a timori chirooti, korende nabanto abaronge. Erio nimbairanerie oyomino, na inwe inamonyore ribaga mobe mokoonchoreria ase ense eye.”
Ekaba ekero baumorete endagera korwa ase chigunia, bakanyora kera oyomo esaro ye chibesa chiaye nao ere egunia yaye ime. Na ekero barabwo amo na ise baroche chisaro chie chibesa chiabo, bakaondoka.
Yakobo ise akabatebia, “Mwang’urire abana baane, Yusufu taiyo, na Simeoni taiyo, na bono morigetie koira Benjamin nere. Amang’ana aya onsi anyorire inche.”
Erio Reuben agatebia ise “Oite abana baane babere abamura onye tinkomoirania gocha asore. Mobeke ase amaboko aane na inche nimoiranie.”

Akamokania, “Omwana one tagotirimboka amo nainwe, ekiagera oyomwabo okure, na oyo nere otigarete bweka. Amabe aise gochia komonyora agwo inchera, nigo moragere ngende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiane inde nomoichano.”
Enchara ekaba enene ase ense.
Na ekero bakoorire endagera eria bagorete korwa Misiri, ise akabatebia, “Irana naende motogorere endagera nke toche koria.”
Korende Yuda akamotebia, “Omonto oria nigo atochigete bokong’u, agatotebia: Timogocha kondora obosio bwane oyio omino atacheti amo nainwe.
Koratoe oyominto agende amo naintwe, rirorio inatotirimboke tokogorere endagera.
Korende onye togotomoa togende komo, rirorio titokogenda, ekiagera omonto oria nigo atotebetie: Timokondora obosio bwane motacheti noyio omino.”
Israeli akababoria, “Ninki mwankorera igo na gonchanda, goika mogatebia omonto oria ng’a mokare noyomino onde inka?”

Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Omonto oria nigo atounetie mono amanye amang’ana aito na ay’eamate yaito, agatoboria: Iso moyo are? Mokare nonde omino? Na intwe tokamoiraneria buna atoboretie. Inee! Ntwamanyete aya agochia gokwana ng’a: Gachie morente oyomino?”
Yuda agatebia Israeli ise, “Mong’e omosae oyo agende amo nainche, erio toimoke togende aroro, erinde egere tobe moyo, titokwa, intwe, naye, amo nabana baito abake.
Nerure imbe intenenera asare: korwa ase okoboko kwane oche komonsaba. Onye tinkomoirania gocha asore, rirorio ontige mbogorie okomocha okwo amatuko onsi ase obosio bwao.
Onye totatebanire nanga twairanire chintunda ibere.”

Israeli ise akabatebia, “Onye naboigo are, bono mokore iga: Mobeke ebinto ebiya bi’ense eye yaito ase chigunia chiaino, moirere omonto oyio buna ebiegwa. Momoirere amaguta okogwenia make, na obooke boke, na ubani, na manemane, na amajozi, na amalozi.
Mobogorie chibesa ara kabere ase amaboko aino, moirane chibesa chiria chiairanetigwe, echio chiabegetwe igoro y’endagera ase chigunia chiaino ime. Aande nigo chiebetwe chikabekwao.
Moire na oyomino, mogende komo, mogende ase omonto oria naende.
Nyasae Omobui abae ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’omonto oyio, erio abasiborere oria omino onde, erinde moirane nere amo na Benjamin. Onye inche ekongwenera nsirerwe nabana baane, tiga abe bo.”
Ase igo abanto abwo bakaimokia ebiegwa, bakaimokia ne chibesa ara kabere; amo na Benjamin bakagenda, bagatirimboka gochia Misiri, bagachia bagatenena ase obosio bwa Yusufu.

Ekero Yusufu aroche Benjamin ore amo nabarabwo agatebia omoteneneri bw’enka yaye, “Barente abanto abwo nyomba, na onyenye emori, oyeroisie, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo bagocha koragera amo nainche endagera ya mobaso.”
Omonto oria agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie, agasoyia abanto abwo nyomba ime.

Korende abanto aba bakaondoka, ekiagera bairetwe nyomba mwa Yusufu, bakabora, “Nigo twarentirwe nyomba ime ase engencho ye chibesa chiria chiabegetwe ase chigunia chiaito engaki eria entang’ani. Na bono nigo ararigie gotosoera, na atoimokere, atobwate, atokore tobe abasomba baye, aire ne chitigere chiaito.”
Ase igo bakamoika ang’e omoteneneri oria bw’enka ya Yusufu, bakaba bagokwana nere gesieri ki’enyomba,
bakamotebia, “Koranche omonene, otoigwe! Engaki eria entang’ani twachete aiga kogora endagera,

ekero twairanete gochia seito, gotwaikire ase twararete botuko, togachia gosansora chigunia chiaito, tokanyora kera omonto chibesa chiaye nao chire igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime, chibesa chionsi pi. Bono chibesa echi chionsi ntwachirentana, naa tochibwate amo naintwe.
Naende ntwarentana chibesa chinde, echi togocha kogora endagera. Titomanyeti gose ning’o ochibegete ase chigunia chiaito ime.”
Akabairaneria “Timoka, motoerere, timoondoka; Nyasae oino, oyore Nyasae o iso, nere obaete enibo eye ase chigunia chiaino; chibesa chiaino inachinyorete.” Erio akarenta Simeoni asebare.
Omonto oria akaira abanto baria nyomba mwa Yusufu, akabaa amache bagesibia amagoro abo, akaa ne chitigere chiabo endagera.
Barabwo bakabeka ebiegwa biabo ang’e, baganye Yusufu kagocha mobaso, ekiagera konya baigure ng’a nao bagocha koragerera endagera ya mobaso.
Na ekero Yusufu achete nyomba ime bakamoirera ebiegwa biria barentete, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye.
Akabakwania, akababoria, “Inee! Iso mbuya are, omogaaka oria mwantebia? Moyo are?”
Bakamoiraneria, “Ee, omosomba oo tata mbuya are. Nabo moyo are.” Barabwo bagatureka emetwe yabo inse.

Yusufu agachia koimokia amaiso aye, akarora Benjamin omwabo, omwana omwabo baruete enda eyemo nere, akababoria, “Oyo nere oria omoke omino, oria mwantebia?” Akaonchokera Benjamin, akamotebia, “Nyasae akoe obuya, omwana one!”
Erio Yusufu akaimoka, agasoa enyomba ende, ekiagera enkoro yaye nigo yare namaiga ase omwana omwabo, aroro ase enyomba eyio akarera amariga.
Erio agesibia obosio, agasoka oremereretie. Naende akabora, “Renta endagera!”
Bakamobekera endagera bweka ao, na abamwabo boka ao, na Abamisiri baria konya bakoragera komo boka ao, ekiagera Abamisiri nigo bagechete Abaibirania, tibari koria amo nabarabwo.
Abamwabo Yusufu bagaikaransigwa ase obosio bwaye, bakaroberigwa gochakera ase oria omonene kogenderera goika ase oria omoke. Bonsi kobaikaransire, bakarigererania, bagakumia.
Bakaegwa endagera korwa ase emesa ya Yusufu, korende Benjamin ere akarenterwa enyinge kobua abwo bande, ebirengo bitano. Naboigo bakanywa, bakagoka amo nere.
Erio Yusufu agachika omoteneneri bw’enka yaye, “Ichoria chigunia chi’abanto aba endagera, koreng’ana buna baranyare kobogoria, obeke ne chibesa chia kera omonto igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime.

Obeke na egekombe kiane keria kiaroisetigwe korwa ase chifeta, okebeke ime ase egunia y’omomura oria omoke kegima, amo ne chibesa chiria achete nachio kogora endagera.” Ere agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie.
Bogachia gokia mambia abanto baria bakaegwa ribaga baimokie chitigere chiabo, bagende sobo.
Ekero bagendire egeka geke korwa ase omochie, Yusufu agatebia omoteneneri bw’enka yaye. “Imoka, obwatie abanto baria! Ekero orabanyore obaborie: Nase ki mogoakana amabe ase amaya?
Inee! Egekombe eke mwaibete, tai kerokio omonene one akonywera? Naende nakio agokorera oboringoria. Mwakorire bobe ase ogokora iga.”
Ekero abaikerete agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana aria aria.
Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Naki aye, omonene oito, ogokwana amang’ana buna ayio?

Taibo, intwe abasomba bao titware gokora bo. Inee! Chibesa chiria twanyorete igoro y’endagera ase chigunia chiaito ime, titwagochiiraneria naende korwa ase ense ya Kanani? Naki tware gokora toibe efeta gose etahabu korwa ase enyomba y’omonene oo?
Oyoranyorekane ore negekombe ekio ase egati yaito intwe abasomba bao, oyio akwe, naintwe boigo rirorio tobe abasomba bao, omonene oito.”
Akabora, “Tiga abe buna mwateba, omonto oranyorekane okebwate nigo arabe omosomba one, korende inwe abande inamobe motari na komocha.”
Erio bagakora bwango, bagaikia kera omonto egunia yaye inse, na koyesansora.
Na omosomba oria agachaka koriga‐rigia, agachakera ase omomura omonene, agachia gokoorera ase omoke, na egekombe gekanyorekana ase egunia ya Benjamin.
Erio bonsi bagatandora chianga chiabo; kera omonto akabekera etigere yaye egurube, bakairana gochia ase omochie.
Yuda na abamwabo, ekero bairanete ase omochie, bakanyora Yusufu nao are nyomba, barabwo bagatung’ama inse bakaumama, ase obosio bwaye.
Yusufu akababoria, “Ing’ana ki eri mwakorire? Timomanyeti ng’a omonto buna inche nigo ndanyare gokora oboringoria imanye?”

Yudaakairaneria, “Ninkitogoteba asore, omonene oito? Ninki togokwana? Gose inatonyare kweenekia ng’a nabaronge tore? Nyasae ororire ebibe biaito intwe abasomba bao; na bono, omonene oito, intwe amo nere, oyo egekombe kianyorekana ase okoboko kwaye, tiga tobe abasomba bao.”
Yusufu akabora, “Yaya, taibo; tingokora bo. Omonto oyo bweka egekombe kianyorekana koboko kwaye, nere orabe omosomba one, korende inwe abande, genda nomorembe seino ase iso.”
Erio Yuda akamoika ang’e, akamotebia, “Koranche, omonene one, ong’e inche, omosomba oo, ribaga ngotebie ring’ana erimo. Tobaisa kombea inche, omosomba oo, naki aye nigo ore buna Farao.
Aye omonene one, nigo gwatoboretie intwe abasomba bao: Inee! Mokare na iso gose onde omino?

Intwe togakoiraneria aye, omonene one: Ee, ntokare na tata, ere ogotire, nakabwate omwana omomura bw’obogotu bwaye, korende momura omwabo nakwete, oyo nere otigarete bweka ase ng’ina, na ise nigo amwanchete mono.
Erio ogatotebia intwe, abasomba bao: Gachie momondetere, ache aa imorore.
Na intwe togakoiraneria aye, omonene one, ng’a omosae oyo takonyara gotiga ise; aise komotiga, ise nigo arakwe.
Naye ogatotebia intwe abasomba bao: Momura omino omoke atatirimbogeti amo nainwe, timogocha ase obosio bwane naende.
“Ekero twairanete ase tata, omosomba oo, tokamotebia amang’ana ao, omonene one.
Na ekero tata atotebetie ng’a toirane tomogorere endagera inke,
tokamoiraneria: Titokonyara gotirimboka gochia ase obosio bw’omonto oria, oyominto omoke atari amo naintwe, korende onye oyominto ogotirimboka amo naintwe, rirorio natogende.
Erio omosomba oo tata agatotebia: Momanyete ng’a omokungu one nigo anyiborerete abana abamura babere boka.
Oyomo nigo ansirerete, na inche ngateba: Tekomocha koba ng’a neching’iti chi’orosana chiamoitete, tinana komorora goika rero iga.
Onye mokoirana oyo nere korwa asende, na amabe achie komonyora, rirorio nigo moragere inkwe ngende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiane, inde nomoichano.
“Na bono kondagende inka ase tata, omosomba oo, ntaireti omosae oyo amo naintwe, oyo tata nigo amwanchete mono, takorora buya.
Ekero ararore ng’a omosae oyo taiyo, nigo arakwe, na intwe, abasomba bao, nigo toragere agende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiaye, ore nomoichano.
Naki inche, omosomba oo, nigo nebegete nkaba intenenera ase omosae oyo ase tata, nkamotebia: Ntamoiraneti asore, nigo ndabe omomochi asore ase obogima bwane bwonsi.
Na bono, omonene one, nagosoroire, ntige imbe omosomba oo ribaga ri’ omosae oyo; ere omotige agende amo nabamwabo inka.
Naki ndakore ing’irane ase tata, omosae oyo atari amo nainche? Tinkoremereria korora emechando enga buna eyio ekomonyora tata.”

Agwo Yusufu agasinywa gotanga okweigwa kwaye, ase obosio bw’abanto bonsi abateneine ang’e nere, agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Barusie aa bonsi ase obosio bwane!” Ase igo monto onde tarengeo ase obosio bwa Yusufu ekero emanyekanetie ase abamwabo,
korende ekero aagete eriogi ase okorera, Abamisiri amo nabanto b’enka ya Farao bakamoigwa.
Yusufu agatebia bamura bamwabo, “Ninche Yusufu. Tata moyo are?” Korende bamura bamwabo tibanyara komoiraneria, ekiagera basoetwe nobwoba obonene.
Erio Yusufu agatebia bamura bamwabo, “Inchuo asende ang’e!” Barabwo bakamoika ang’e. Naende akabatebia, “Ninche Yusufu omino, oyo mwaoonetie gocha aa Misiri.
Korende timoichana, gose timwechanda ase emioyo yaino, ekiagera mwang’oonetie gocha aa. Naki Nyasae nere ontomete mbatang’anere gocha aa, erinde ntoorie obogima bw’abanto.
Omwaka oyo noyo o kabere enchara ere ase ense, naende netigarete emiaka etano abanto batareme gose kogesa.
Nyasae nigo antomete mbatang’anere inwe, erinde motigare ase ense, na koba moyo ase ogotooreka kw’abange.
Ase igo, tari inwe mwantomete gocha aa, korende Nyasae omonyene. Nere ombegete imbe ise Farao, na omonene ase enka yaye yonsi, na omogambi ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.
“Ayerera bwango, moirane gochia ase tata, momotebie iga: Aya naro omwana oo Yusufu agoteba: Nyasae ombekire koba omonene ase ense yonsi ya Misiri; tirimboka gocha asende, totebana.
Aye nigo oramenye ase ensemo ya Goseni, nigo oramenye ang’e nainche, aye amo nabana bao, na abachokoro bao.
Agwo inche ninkoragerie, erinde tobaisa gocha gosoa ase okoremerwa, aye amo nabanto bao, na bionsi ebi ore nabio, ekiagera emiaka etano y’enchara netigarete.
“Na bono imoroche namaiso aino, na Benjamin boigo naroche namaiso aye, ng’a ninche omonyene ngokwana nainwe.
Motebie tata obonene bwonsi mbwate aiga Misiri, na binde bionsi mwarorire. Mokore bwango, momorente gocha aa.”
Erio akaboania Benjamin rigoti, akarera; Benjamin nere akarera kamoboanetie rigoti riaye.
Yusufu akanyunyunta abamwabo bonsi, akarera asebare. Na nyuma y’ayio abamwabo bakagosoria nere.
Ekero chinkuma chiaigwetwe ase enka ya Farao ng’a abamwabo Yusufu bachire, amang’ana ayio akagwenera Farao amo nabasomba baye bonsi.
Farao agatebia Yusufu, “Batebie abamino iga: Berekia ching’iti chiaino chigurube, moimoke mogende ase ense yaino ya Kanani,
Morente iso na abanto b’enka yaye bache asende. Inche nimbae ebire ebiya bi’ense ya Misiri, na inwe namorie obonoru bw’ense eye.
Naende goika obatebie iga, Ira chigari korwa aa Misiri, ase okobogoreria abana baino abake, na abakungu baino, mobogorerie na iso, moche nabarabwo.
Timochandekera ebinto biaino, ebi moratige nyuma, ekiagera bionsi ebire ebiya mono ase ense ya Misiri nebiaino.”
Erio basinto ba Israeli bagakora buna batebetigwe, na Yusufu akabaa chigari buna Farao achigete, amo nendagera bagochia koria inchera.
Akaa kera oyomo eanga agochia koonchoreria, korende Benjamin ere akamoa chisekeli chie chifeta amagana atato amo ne chianga isano, echi agochia koonchoreria.
Agatomera na ise chitigere ikomi chiabogoretie ebinto ebiya mono bia Misiri, ne chitigere chinkungu chiabogoretie endagera, na emegati, na endagera ende agochia koria inchera.
Erio agatigana nabamwabo bagende sobo, akabatebia, “Timobaisa kwomana inchera!”
Barabwo bakarua Misiri, bagaika ense ya Kanani ase Yakobo ise.
Agwo bakamanyia ise amang’ana ng’a Yusufu moyo are, naende nere omogambi ase ense yonsi ya Misiri. Yakobo agachia koyaigwa, akagoyaana ase omoyo oye, tanyara kwegena amang’ana abo.
Korende bakamotebia amang’ana onsi Yusufu abatebetie. Ere agachia korora chigari chiria Yusufu amotomerete chigocha komoimokia, omoyo oye okaba nobogima oboyia.
Israeli akabora, “Ayio aisanire. Yusufu, omwana one, moyo are. Nigo ndagende komorora ritang’ani ntarakwa.”
Ase igo Israeli akaimoka, akagenda, akaira ebinto bionsi ebi abwate, agaika Beeri‐Seba, akaruera Nyasae o Isaka ise ekeng’wanso.
Nyasae akarangeria Israeli ase okorora ekero kia botuko, akabora, “Yakobo! Yakobo!” Ere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa.”
Erio akamotebia, “Inche ninche Nyasae, Nyasae o iso; tobaisa kwoboa gotirimboka gochia Misiri, ekiagera ningokore obe egesaku ekenene aroro.
Inche nintirimboke amo naye goika Misiri, naende tinkomocha gokoirania; na Yusufu nabe okoirania amaiso ao kogwakure.”
Erio Yakobo akaimoka korwa Beeri‐Seba, akagenda. Basinto ba Israeli bakabogoria Yakobo ise, amo nabana babo abake, na abakungu babo ase chigari chiria Farao abatomerete chibabogorie.
Bakaira chitugo chiabo ne chinibo chiabo echi baniberete ase ense ya Kanani. Nabo bagaika Misiri, Yakobo na oroiboro rwaye rwonsi amo nere,
abana baye abamura na abamura babo; na abana baye abaiseke, na abaiseke b’abamura babo. Naboigo akaira oroiboro rwaye rwonsi, akagenda nabarabwo goika Misiri.
Aya naro amarieta Abaisraeli abwo bagendete Misiri: Yakobo na abana baye, nabwo aba: Reuben, nere omotangi o Yakobo.
Abana abamura ba Reuben nabwo aba: Hanoki, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi.
Na abana abamura ba Simeoni nabwo aba: Yemueli, na Yamini, na Ohadi, na Yakini, na Sohari, na Sauli, omwana bw’omokungu Omokanani.
Na abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari.
Na abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Eri, na Onani, na Sela, na Peresu, na Zera; korende Eri na Onani bagakwera ase ense ya Kanani. Na abana ba Peresu nabwo Hezironi na Hamuli.
Na abana abamura ba Isakaru nabwo aba: Tola, na Pua, na Yobu, na Simuroni.
Na abana abamura ba Sabuloni nabwo aba: Seredi na Eloni, na Yaleeli.
Aba nabwo abana abamura Lea aiborerete Yakobo agwo Padan‐Aramu. Na omoiseke oyomo aiborete, nere Dina. Abana baye bonsi amo nabachokoro, abamura na abaiseke, nigo barenge emerongo etato na batato.
Abana abamura ba Gadi nabwo aba: Sifioni, na Hagi, na Suni, na Esiboni, na Eri, na Arodi, na Areli.
Na abana abamura b’Aseri nabwo aba: Imuna, na Isiva, na Isivi, na Beria, na omoiseke omwabo nere Sera. Na abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi na Malikieli.
Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro ba Silpa, oyio Labani aete Lea, omwana oye omosubati. Abwo Silpa aiborerete Yakobo, abanto ikomi na batano nomo.
Abana abamura ba Raeli, moka Yakobo, nabwo Yusufu na Benjamin.
Yusufu akaiborerwa Manase na Efraimu, ase ense ya Misiri. Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, omokuani bw’Oni, akamoiborera abana abwo abamura.
Na abana abamura ba Benjamin nabwo aba: Bela, na Bekeri, na Asibeli, na Gera, na Naamani, na Eki, na Roshi, na Mupimu, na Hupimu, na Aridi.
Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro Raeli aiborerete Yakobo, abanto ikomi na bane.
Omwana omomura o Dani nere Husimu.
Na abana abamura ba Nafutali nabwo aba: Yaseeli, na Guni, na Yaseri, na Silemu.
Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro abamura Bilia aiborerete Yakobo, abanto batano na babere.
Abanto bonsi abagendete amo na Yakobo ase ense ya Misiri, abwo baiboretwe korwa asare, nigo barenge emerongo etano nomo, na batano nomo. Abakungu b’abana abamura ba Yakobo, barabwo tibabariri.
Na abana abamura ba Yusufu, abaiboreretwe agwo Misiri, mbabere barenge. Abanto bonsi ba Yakobo abasoete Misiri nigo barenge emerongo etano na ebere.
Yakobo agatoma Yuda amotang’anere kogenda ase Yusufu, erinde aoroke ase obosio bwaye agwo Goseni, Naboigo bagaika ase ensemo ya Goseni.
Erio Yusufu akabeka egari yaye ang’e, akayeriina, akagenda korotota Israeli aria Goseni. Ekero achia goika asare akamoboania rigoti riaye engaki etari nke.
Israeli agatebia Yusufu, “Bono tiga inkwe, ekiagera nakororire obosio bwao, naende narorire ng’a moyo ore.”
Yusufu agatebia abamwabo na abanto b’enka ya ise, “Nkogenda inde ase Farao imotebie: Abaminto na abanto b’enka ya tata, aba barenge ase ense ya Kanani, bachire asende.
Na abanto abwo nabatugi be chitugo, na bono barentire chitugo chiabo, ching’ondi ne chiombe, na binde bionsi bare nabio.
Bono, Farao karabarangerie na kobaboria meremo ki monarete gokora,

nigo moramoiranerie: Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abatugi be chitugo korwa obwana bwaito goika rero; buna tore igo, nabo ne chisokoro chiaito chiarenge. Na igo namonyore ribaga komenya ase ensemo ya Goseni, ekiagera kera omorisia bwe chitugo nigo are okogechia ase Abamisiri.”

Erio Yusufu akagenda agatebia Farao, “Tata na bamura baminto bachire korwa ase ense ya Kanani, amo ne chitugo chiabo, ching’ondi ne chiombe, na binde bionsi bare nabio; barabwo nao bare ase ensemo ya Goseni.”
Agachora abamwambo batano, akabaira ase obosio bwa Farao.
Farao akababoria, “Emeremo yaino nereri?” Bakamoiraneria, “Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abarisia be chitugo, buna nechisokoro chiaito chiarenge.”

Naende bakamotebia, “Nigo twachire tobe abamenyi b’ense eye, ekiagera intwe, abasomba bao, titori naase tokorisia amaicho aito, ekiagera enchara nenene mono ase ense ya Kanani. Ase igo koranche otoe intwe, abasomba bao, ribaga tomenye ase ensemo ya Goseni.”
Erio Farao agakwana na Yusufu, akamotebia, “Narorire ng’a iso na abamino bagocheire.

Bono ense ya Misiri nigo ere ase obosio bwao; bae iso na bamura bamino ribaga bamenye aase are aagiya. Tiga bamenye ase ensemo ya Goseni, naende onye komanyete bande ase egati yabo abamanyete mono emeremo y’obotugi, obabeke babe abateneneri ase chitugo chiane.”
Erio Yusufu akarenta Yakobo ise, akamoira ase obosio bwa Farao; na Yakobo agasesenia Farao.
Farao akaboria Yakobo, “Inee! Emiaka yao nerenga?”

Yakobo akamoiraneria, “Emiaka yane nakoorire ase ense eye nerigana erimo, na emerongo etato (130). Ase obogima bwane nigo nabeire nobokong’u, naende emiaka yane nemeke, teikereti eye chisokoro chiane bakoorete ase obogima bwabo.”
Yakobo agasesenia Farao naende, akarua ase obosio bwaye.
Yusufu akaa ise amo na bamura bamwabo aase bakomenya, akabaa Ramesesi, orogongo oruya, ensemo engiya mono y’ense eria, buna Farao achigete.
Nere Yusufu akaba okorenda ise amo nabamwabo bonsi, akabaa endagera buna kera omonto abwate abanto baye bang’ana.
Bono ase ense yonsi endagera tiyarengeo; na enchara nigo yarenge endito mono, konya yanyarire abanto ba Misiri na aba Kanani.
Yusufu agasangereria chibesa chionsi echianyorekanete korwa ase ense ya Misiri na eya Kanani ase okooneria abanto endagera, agachibeka ase ekungo ya Farao.

Ekero chibesa chionsi chiaerire ase ense ya Misiri na ase ense ya Kanani, Abamisiri bagachiera Yusufu, bakamosaba, “Toe endagera, titobaisa gokwera ase obosio bwao, ekiagera chibesa chiaito chiaerire.”
Yusufu akabairaneria, “Onye chibesa chiaino chiaerire, ndetera chitugo chiaino, na inche mbae endagera morie.”

Erio bakarentera Yusufu chitugo chiabo, na Yusufu akabaa endagera. Bakarentera Yusufu chibarasi chiabo, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitigere. Igo akaba okobarenda na kobaa endagera ase omwaka oyio oyomo, na barabwo bakamoa chitugo chiabo.

Omwaka oria oyomo okaera. Naende omwaka o kabere bakamochiera, bakamotebia, “Titokonyara gokobisa, omonene oito, ng’a chibesa chiaito chiaerire, ne chitugo chiaito chiabeire echiao. Titotigareti gento kende togokoa, omonene oito, otatiga emebere yaito na amaremo aito.

Nase ki torakwere ase obosio bwao, na amaremo aito asareke? Togore intwe, ogore na amaremo aito, na intwe tobe abasomba ba Farao, na amaremo aito abe ayaye. Toe chimbusuro tosimeke, titokwa, na amaremo aito abe bosa.”
Erio Yusufu akagorera Farao amaremo onsi arenge Misiri, naki Abamisiri nigo baoonetie kera omonto oboremo bwaye, ekiagera enchara yarenge endito mono. Naboigo ense ekaba eya Farao.
Farao akang’anyia abanto abwo bamenye ase emechie, babe abasomba baye, bakore emeremo korwa ensemo eyemo ya Misiri goika eyende.
Korende Yusufu tagorete amaremo ’abakuani, ekiagera abwo konya bachikeirwe endagera baare konyora korwa ase Farao, nero baare koria. Ase igo tibagwenerete koonia amaremo abo.
Yusufu agatebia abanto, “Igwa! Rero nabagorire inwe amo namaremo aino, mobe enibo ya Farao. Bwata chimbusuro chiaino echi, chiire mochisimeke ase emegondo.
Engaki ye rigesa moruserie Farao ensemo ya isano. Chinsemo inye chintigari inachibe echiaino ase chimbusuro na endagera yaino inwe abanyene, na ey’abare ase chinka chiaino, na ey’abana baino.”
Abanto abwo bakamoiraneria, “Gwatooririe obogima bwaito. Onye twanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, omonene oito, tiga tobe abasomba ba Farao.”
Yusufu akabeka ogochika ase ense ya Misiri, ng’a ensemo ya isano ebe eya Farao; na ogochika okwo ngokora kore emeremo nonya ngoika bono. Korende amaremo ’abakuani oka naro atabete aya Farao.
Israeli na abana baye bakaba bakomenya ase ense ya Misiri, ensemo ya Goseni, bakayeira ekaba eyabo, bakamenteka na kobucha mono.
Yakobo akamenya ase ense ya Misiri emiaka ikomi, na etano na ebere. Ase igo agakoora emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, na etano na ebere (147) ase obogima bwaye.

Ekero engaki y’ogokwa gwa Israeli yabete ang’e, ere akarangeria Yusufu, omwana oye, akamotebia, “Onye nkonyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, beka okoboko kwao inse y’ekebono kiane, na ondiere eira, ng’a nonkorere amabera na obwanchani. Tontindeka aa ase ense ya Misiri,
korende ekero ndakwe, tiga ndare ne chisokoro chiane. Ombogorie korwa aa Misiri, ontindeke aase barabwo batindegetwe.” Yusufu akamoiraneria, “Ninkore buna gwantebirie.”
Korende Israeli akamotebia, “Tiana ng’a nonkorere bo.” Ere agatiana. Erio Israeli agetureka ase ogotoorera omotwe borere bwaye.
Ekaba engaki nyuma y’ayio Yusufu agatebigwa ng’a, “Iso nomorwaire.” Erio akaimokia abana baye babere abamura, Manase na Efraimu, bakagenda komorora.
Yakobo nere agatebigwa ng’a, “Yusufu, omwana oo, ngocha are gokorora.” Erio Israeli agekomereria, akaboka, agaikaransa borere igoro.
Yakobo agatebia Yusufu, “Nyasae Omobui nang’orokerete aaria Lusu ase ense ya Kanani, agansesenia,
agantebia: Inche ninkomente, na oroiboro rwao robuche goika robe emeganda y’ebisaku. Ning’ee ororeria rwao rorache korwa nyuma yao ense eye ebe omwando obo kare na kare.
“Bono abana bao abamura babere kwaiborerete ase ense ya Misiri ritang’ani ntaracha aa, barabwo nabaane bararokwe. Efraimu na Manase nigo barabe abaane, buna Reuben na Simeoni bare abaane.
Abana bao bande baiboire nyuma y’aba, barabwo nabao barabe; korende nigo baratorwe ase amarieta ’abamwabo, na komenya ase omwando obo.
Ekero nare korwa Padan‐Aramu, Raeli nyoko agankwera inchera gonkogenda Kanani, ritang’ani ntaraika Efarati. Nkamotindeka agwo enchera ekogenda Efarati, nao Bethlehemu.”
Israeli, ekero aroche abana ba Yusufu, akamoboria, “Aba mbarabi?”
Yusufu akamoiraneria, “Aba nabana baane Nyasae ang’erete aiga.” Erio Israeli akamotebia, “Bandetere aiga asende, mbasesenie.”
Bono amaiso a Israeli konya abeire chinchingori ase engencho y’obogotu, tare korora buya. Igo Yusufu akamorentera abana abwo, na ere akabanyunyunta na kobaboania.
Erio Israeli agatebia Yusufu, “Tinasemeretie ng’a kaa ninche korora obosio bwao naende, na bono Nyasae onyancheire narorire abana bao nabarabwo,”
Yusufu akarusia abana korwa ase amagoro a ise, agatung’ama inse.
Erio Yusufu akabwata bonsi babere, Efraimu ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, akamobeka ensemo y’okobee ya Israeli, na Manase akamobwata ase okoboko kwaye gw’okobee, akamobeka ensemo y’okorio ya Israeli.

Israeli akarambora okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, agakobeka igoro ase omotwe o Efraimu, nonya ere orenge omoke; agakorekania amaboko aye na kobeka okoboko kwaye gw’okobee igoro ase omotwe o Manase, nere orenge omotangi.
Erio agasesenia Yusufu, akabora, “Nyasae o sokoro yane Ibrahimu na o Isaka tata, oyio baare gotaara ase obosio bwaye; Nyasae oyo nere ondisirie ase obogima bwane bwonsi goika rero,

omomalaika oria ontooretie korwa ase amabe onsi, asesenie abamura aba. Abana aba babe bagwatorwa ase erieta riane, na ase erieta ria sokoro yane Ibrahimu, na eria Isaka tata; tiga bakine babe abanto abange ase ense.”
Yusufu agachia korora ng’a ise obekire okoboko kwaye gw’okorio igoro ase omotwe o Efraimu, ayio tayancha. Akabwata okoboko gwa ise akorusie korwa ase omotwe o Efraimu, erio akobeke ase oyo o Manase.
Yusufu agatebia ise, “Taibo, tata, naki oyo nere omotangi; beka okoboko kwao gw’okorio ase omotwe oye.”

Korende ise akaanga, akabora, “Nimanyete, omwana one, nimanyete. Nere boigo nabe egesaku; ere boigo nabe omonene, korende oyomwabo omoke nabe omonene komobua, na oroiboro rwaye narobe egesaku kiabo ao boka.”

Rituko erio akabasesenia, akabora, “Ekero ogosesenigwa kogokwanwa ase Abaisraeli, abanto baatore amarieta aino na goteba: Nyasae abakore mobe buna Efraimu na Manase.” Agwo agwo agatang’ania Efraimu ase obosio bwa Manase.
Erio Israeli agatebia Yusufu, “Rora ng’ang’e inde gokwa. Nyasae nigo arabe amo nainwe, nabairanie gochia ase ense ye chisokoro chiaino.
Inche nakomentire ensemo y’ekenyoro ekeao kobua abamino. Eyio naurete Abaamori nomoro one, na obota bwane.”
Erio Yakobo akarangeria abamura baye, akabatebia, “Sangererekana asende aa, mbatebie amang’ana arabanyore ase amatuko agochi‐gocha.”
“Inchuo montegerere, inwe abana ba Yakobo; montegerere inche Israeli iso.
“Reuben, aye nomwana one omotangi, aye nokobua kwane, na ogotongora gwe chinguru chiane. Noetanetie abamino ase okobua, nobaetanetie ase chinguru.
Aye nkwaberete buna amache; korende togoetania abande, ekiagera nkwararete na moga iso, ase igo okarenta obosooku.
“Simeoni na Lawi naba ng’ina omo, ebirwanero biabo nebi’obotindi.
Omoyo one tosoa ase obobisi bwabo, gose enkoro yane tesanga ase omosangererekano obo; naki ase endamwamu yabo mbaitete abanto, na ase obomwenu bwabo bakanacha chinteng’e chie chintang’ana.
Endamwamu yabo eragererigwe, ekiagera nigo yarenge entindi, na ekeririanda kiabo, ekiagera tikiarenge namabera. Nimbaatanane ase abana ba Yakobo, nimbasiarere ase abana ba Israeli.
“Aye Yuda, abamino inabagotogie; okoboko kwao inakobwate ebigoti bi’ababisa bao; abamura ba iso inabagosike.
Yuda, aye nendo ensae. Omwana one, gokorwa gotwara, nigo oratiire, na korara, na gotimoka buna endo, buna endo eaberi—ning’o orabe noboremu kogotura?
Enyimbo y’obogambi tekorua o Yuda, gose omobeki amachiko ase ororereria rwaye, goika achiche oyo orabogorie obogambi, oyo abanto b’ebisaku bionsi baraigwere.

Nigo arasibe etigere yaye ase omote bw’omosabibu, na emori y’etigere yaye ase chinsagia chi’omosabibu omuya. Nigo arasibie egetambaa kiaye akwambara nedivai, ne chianga chiaye namache amonyinga ’amasabibu.
Amaiso aye nigo arabe amabariri ase okonywa edivai, na amaino aye abe amarabu ase okonywa amabeere.
“Sabuloni nigo aramenye ase enyancha mbarabare, agwo ase chimeeri chigotenenigwa, orobebe rwaye rosinyane norw’Abasidoni.
“Isakaru netigere ere ne chinguru, ekorara obweri bwe chitugo.
Akarora ng’a aase agotimokera naagiya, na ense eria nero ekomogwenera. Ase igo agekumba abogorie egurube, akerua kogenderera nemeremo emekong’u.
“Dani nagambere abanto baye, buna egesaku ekemo ki’Abaisraeli.
Dani nabe eng’iti ekweriba inchera, ring’ere ase oboeto, rikoroma egetingiro ki’ebarasi, goika oyoyeriinete agwe masogota.
Omonene, ninganyete ogotooreka kwao nogosemeria!
“Gadi namigwe nemeganda y’esegi, korende nere nabamige korwa nyuma.
“Aseri natware endagera y’obonoru, narue endagera engiya eragwenere abaruoti.
“Nafutali nengabi esiboire ekominyoka mono, nigo agosokia amang’ana amaya.
“Yusufu nomote omorere okwama ang’e nensoko; chinsagia chiaye nigo chikoranda orobago igoro.
Abaruti emegwe bakomoimokera ase okomochanda bororo, bakomoruta emegwe na komorosia,
korende obota bwaye tibogosukigwa. Amaboko aye nigo are ne chinguru, naende namaango, goetera ase amaboko ’Omonyene Chinguru o Yakobo, oyore Omorisia na Egetare gia Israeli.
Nyasae o iso, nere oragokonye, Nyasae Omonguru, nere oragosesenie nogosesenigwa gokorwa igoro, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa chindiba inse, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa inda na ase chimbeere.

Ogosesenigwa gwa iso nkore ne chinguru ngoetanetie okw’ebitunwa bia kare, na obonene bw’ebigoro bia kare na kare. Ogosesenigwa okwo kobe egutwa y’omotwe o Yusufu, igoro y’egiototeri ki’oyore omogambi ase egati y’abamwabo.
“Benjamin nesese y’orosana ekoria mono, engaki ya mambia yaria ebi’obotwari bwaye, na engaki ya mogoroba bwatanana ebiasakoire.”
Ebi nabio ebisaku bia Israeli ikomi na bibere; naya naro ise abatebetie ekero are kobasesenia na koa kera oyomo ogosesenigwa kwaye.
Erio Israeli akabachika, akabora, “Inche nkoirwa inde gosangererekana amo nabanto baane. Montindeke ase chisokoro chiane chiatindegetwe ase rikuruma ri’oboremo bware bw’Efuroni Omohiti,
rikuruma eri rire ase oboremo agwo Makipela, moocha ya Mamure, ase ense ya Kanani. Oboremo boria Ibrahimu agorete korwa ase Efuroni Omohiti bobe aase ogotindeka.
Agwo nao Ibrahimu atindegetwe ase Sara mokaye ensemo; agwo nao Isaka na Rebeka mokaye batindegetwe, na agwo inche omonyene natindegete Lea.
Oboremo obwo amo ne rikuruma riria nigo biagoretwe korwa ase Abahiti.”
Ekero Yakobo akoorete gochika abamura baye amang’ana aya, akaimokia amagoro aye, akayabeka borere igoro; erio agakwa agasangererekana amo nabanto baye.
Erio Yusufu akamogwera ise obosio bwaye, akarera na komonyunyunta.
Agachika abarwaria abaare komokorera, ng’a baake Israeli ise amariogo, tabaisa kogunda; naboigo abarwaria bamokorerete,
goika amatuko emerongo ene agaikerana. Ase amatuko ang’ana buna ayio naro egetondo kiare goakwa amariogo. Abamisiri bakamoreera Israeli amatuko emerongo etano na ebere.
Ekero amatuko okomoreera Israeli aerete, Yusufu agakwana nabanto b’enka ya Farao, akabora, “Onye nkonyora ogwancherwa ase amaiso aino, komoranche monteberie Farao
ng’a tata nandierete omwando ogoteba: Ng’ang’e inde gokwa, ong’ire ontindeke ase oboina boria naremete ase ense ya Kanani. Momonsabere ribaga ngende gotindeka tata, erio ning’irane.”
Farao akairaneria, “Tiira ochie gotindeka iso, buna akorierete omwando.”
Erio Yusufu agatiira gochia gotindeka ise. Abasomba bonsi ba Farao bakagenda amo nere, na abagaaka bonsi b’enka yaye, na abagaaka bonsi ba Misiri,
na bonsi ab’enka ya Yusufu, amo nabamwabo, na ab’enka ya ise. Abana babo boka bagatigara Goseni amo ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiabo.
Naende Yusufu akaira amo nere chigari na abariini chibarasi; bakaba omoganda omonene mono.
Ekero baigete ase ekeooreri gi’Atadi ng’umbu y’orooche rwa Yorodan, bakaba bakorera ebirero ebinene mono. Agwo Yusufu akagenderera komoreera ise ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

Na Abakanani abamenyete ase ense eria, ekero bachia korora ebirero agwo Atadi ase ekeooreri, bakabora, “Ebirero ebi bi’Abamisiri nebinene mono.” Ase ayio, aase aria ng’umbu ya Yorodan akarokwa Abeli‐Misiri.
Naboigo basinto ba Yakobo bakorete buna ise abachigete.

Bakamoimokia, bakamoira goika ase ense ya Kanani. Erio bakamotindeka ase rikuruma riria riare, ase oboremo agwo Makipela, moocha ya Mamure, oboremo boria Ibrahimu agorete korwa ase Efuroni Omohiti abe aase aye agotindeka abakure.
Yusufu, ekero akoorire gotindeka ise, akairana Misiri amo nabamwabo na bonsi abatiirete amo nere.
Ekero abamwabo Yusufu baroche ng’a ise okure, bagatebania. “Aande Yusufu nigo aratorege, arusie egesiomba ase amabe aria twamokorerete.”
Ase ayio bagatoma abanto ase Yusufu komotebia ng’a, “Iso nigo atebete iga ritang’ani atarakwa.

Motebie Yusufu iga: Nagosabire obaabere abamino amamocho abo na ebibe biabo bagokorerete. Nimanyete ng’a mbagokorerete bobe. Ase igo bono twagosabire, otwabere ebibe biaito, naki intwe nabasomba ba Nyasae o iso.” Yusufu akarera ekero abamwabo bamoboretie amang’ana ayio.
Erio abamwabo bagacha, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye, bakabora, “Intwe iga nabasomba bao tore.”
Korende Yusufu akabatebia, “Timoiroka! Inee! Inche inde ribaga ria Nyasae?
Ekeene, inwe nabo mwarengereretie gonkorera amabe, korende Nyasae akayaonchora akaba amaya, na buna mwarorire rero iga, otooririe obogima bw’abanto abange.
Gaki, bono timoiroka! Nimbaragerie inwe amo nabana baino.” Naboigo akaba okobaremia, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana amaya.
Yusufu akamenya Misiri, ere amo nabanto bamwabo, agakoora emiaka rigana erimo, na ikomi (110).
Agwo akarora abana b’Efraimu na abachokoro baye goika ekiaare kia gatato, akarora na abana ba Makiri, omwana o Manase, baiboreretwe ase Yusufu.

Yusufu agatebia abamwabo, “Ng’ang’e inde gokwa, korende amaene Nyasae nabanyorere enchera y’okobarusia ase ense eye, abatiirie mogende ase ense eria abarierete eira na gotiana, ng’a nae Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo.”
Yusufu agatiania abana ba Israeli agwo, akabora, “Bono, ekero Nyasae arabachere abakonye, goika moire amauga aane; mogende naro.”
Erio Yusufu agakwa gakoorire emiaka rigana erimo na ikomi (110). Bakamoaka amariogo, tabaisa kogunda, bakamobeka ase esanduku ime aaria Misiri.
Aya naro amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli abasoete Misiri amo na Yakobo ise, kera oyomo amo nabanto b’omochie oye:
Reuben na Simeoni, Lawi na Yuda;
Isakaru na Sabuloni, na Benjamin;
Dani na Nafutali, Gadi na Aseri.
Abanto bonsi abaiboire korwa ase Yakobo nigo barenge emerongo etano na ebere. Yusufu ere konya nao amenyete Misiri korwa kare.
Yusufu agakwera aroro, na bamura bamwabo bonsi, na abanto bonsi b’ekegori keria.
Abaisraeli bagasarara na komenteka, bakaba abange mono, bakabucha kegima ase ense eria.
Omoruoti omoyia, oyotamomanyete Yusufu, akaira obogambi bw’ense ya Misiri.
Ere agatebia abanto baye, “Rigereria, Abaisraeli aba babeire abange kobua intwe, naende babeire ne chinguru gotobua.
Torigie nsemi ki tokobakorera tobatange, tibabaisa komenteka. Toise gosoa esegi, barabwo mbabaise kobwatana nababisa baito batorwanie, erio bang’anye korwa ense yaito.”
Ase ayio bakabeka abateneneri abatindi igoro asebare babachande nemeremo emekong’u mono. Agwo Abaisraeli bakaagachera Farao emechie y’okogacha chinibo, nero Pitoni na Ramesesi.
Korende buna Abamisiri bagendererete kobachanda mono, naboigo Abaisraeli bagendererete komenteka na gwesiarera, goika Abamisiri bakabagecha na kobairoka.
Bagakoria Abaisraeli emeremo emekong’u
y’ogotiringa esike na gokora amatabori, na emeremo ende ao ao ase emegondo. Ase emeremo ende yonsi Abaisraeli baare gokora nigo baare gokorigwa ase obotindi.
Omoruoti o Misiri agachika Sifura na Pua, abaiboria b’Abaibirania, akabatebia,
“Ekero mogosaacha abakungu b’Abaibirania kobakoibora, morigererie mwana ki oiborwa; onye nomoisia, momoite, korende onye nomoiseke, momotige abe moyo.”
Korende abaiboria baria nigo bamoirogete Nyasae. Tibakorete buna omoruoti o Misiri abatebetie, korende bagatiga abana abaisia babe moyo.
Omoruoti o Misiri akarangeria abaiboria baria, akababoria, “Nase ki mwakorire iga? Mwatigire abana abaisia bare moyo.”
Abaiboria bakairaneria Farao, “Abakungu b’Abaibirania tibari buna aba Abamisiri; barabwo nabaango ase okoibora, nigo bakoibora ritang’ani omoiboria ataraika.”
Nyasae agakorera abaiboria baria amaya, na abanto bakagenderera komenteka koba abange.
Na ekiagera abakungu baria abaiboria bamoirogete Nyasae, ere akabasesenia, na barabwo bakaibora abana abange.
Erio Farao agachika abanto baye bonsi, akabatebia, “Kera omwana omoisia okoiborwa ase Abaibirania, momotugute ase orooche rwa Naili, korende kera omwana omoiseke momotige abe moyo.”
Omonto oyomo bw’enyomba ya Lawi akanyuoma omoiseke o Lawi.
Omokungu oria akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, na ekero aroche ng’a omwana oria nomuya mono, akamobisa ase engaki y’emetienyi etato.

Ekero aroche ng’a takonyara komobisa goetania agwo, akaimokia ekebaari ki’amauncho, agakeooma esike, erio agaaka eramu korwa isiko. Erio akaareria omwana oria ase ekebaari ime, agakebeka ase amauncho ime y’orooche rwa Naili.
Omoiseke omwabo omwana oria agatenena aare ake amanye egekonyora omwana.
Erio omoiseke o Farao agatirimboka gochia rooche gwesibia, na abasomba baye abaiseke bakaba bakonagotaara ase engegu. Ekero aroche ekebaari keria ase amauncho, agatoma omoiseke oyomo akerente;
agakemumora, akanyora omwana omoke ore imeo. Omwana oria akarera, na omoiseke o Farao akamororera amabeebe, agakwana, “Oyoiga noyomo bw’abana b’Abaibirania.”
Omoiseke omwabo omwana oria akaboria omoiseke o Farao, “Inee! Norigetie ngende nkorangererie omokungu oyomo bw’Abaibirania ache gokomogonkeria?”
Omoiseke o Farao akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda!” Erio akagenda, akarangeria ng’ina omwana oria.
Omoiseke o Farao agatebia omokungu oria, “Moire omwana oyo, omongonkerie, na inche ninkoe eng’eria yao.” Erio omokungu oria akaira omwana, akamorera.
Ekero omwana oria akinire, omokungu oria akamoirania ase omoiseke o Farao koba omwana oye na ere akamoroka Musa, ogoteba, “Ndooche namorusetie.”

Egachia koba ekero Musa abeire omonto omonene, rituko erimo akagenda gokwania Abaibirania bamwabo, akarora buna baare gokorigwa emeremo emekong’u. Agwo akarora Omomisiri ogoaka oyomo bw’Abaibirania bamwabo.
Erio akamaga‐maga chinsemo chionsi, na ekero arora ng’a monto onde tari aande, agaita Omomisiri oria, akabisa omobere oye ase omokenye ime.
Naende akagenda rituko ria kabere, akarora Abaibirania babere bakorwana; akamoboria oria ochegetie oyomwabo, “Nase ki ogoaka oyomino?”

Omonto oria akamoiraneria, “Ning’o okobegete koba omoteneneri na omogayani igoro yaito? Inee! Nigo origetie kong’ita buna gwaita Omomisiri oria?” Aya akagera Musa akoboa. Ere agateba ase omoyo oye ime, “Ndoche ng’a amang’ana aya amanyekanire.”
Ekero Farao achia koigwa amang’ana ayio akarigia goita Musa, korende Musa agatama korwa o Farao gochia komenya Midiani, agaika ase ensoko yare, agaikaransa aroro.
Narengeo omokuani o Midiani obwate abaiseke batano na babere. Barabwo bagacha kobuucha amache; bagaichoria chintuba amache banyoisie riicho ria ise.
Erio abarisia b’aroro bagacha bakabaseria, korende Musa agatenena agakonya abaiseke baria na kobanyoiseria riicho riabo.
Ekero abaiseke baria bairanete ase Reueli ise, ere akababoria, “Nakimwakora rero mwairana bwango iga?”
Bakamoiraneria, “Omomisiri oyomo otokonya korwa ase abarisia baria; amo nayio otobuuchera amache na gotonyoiseria riicho riaito.”
Erio ise akababoria, “Ng’ai are? Naki mwakora mwatiga omonto oyio? Gachie momorangerie ache koragera amo naintwe.”
Musa agancha komenya bw’omonto oria na ere akaa Musa Sipora, omoiseke oye, akaba mokaye.
Omokungu oyio akamoiborera omwana omoisia, na Musa akamoroka Gerisomu, ogoteba, “Nabeire omomenyi ase ense engeni.”
Nyuma y’engaki entambe koyaetire omoruoti o Misiri agakwa. Abaisraeli bakaba bakwerera inse y’obosomba obwo, bakarera bakonywe, na ekerero kiabo kegaika igoro, ase Nyasae.
Nyasae akaigwa ekerero kiabo, akaba okoinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, okwo akorete na Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo;
akarorera Abaisraeli amabeebe na kobechandera.
Musa nigo arenge korisia riicho ria Yetero ise biara, omokuani o Midiani, akariraa gochia bosongo y’erooro, agaika Horebu, egetunwa kia Nyasae.
Agwo omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera ase omogwekano bwe risase ri’omorero riare gwoka korwa ase egetutu gati. Musa akarigereria, akarora ng’a nonya kiare gwoka, tikiare koyia keere.
Musa akarengereria, “Nigo ngoeta korwa moino ndore okorora oko kw’ogokumia, imanye naki egetutu eke getari koyia keere.”
Ekero Omonene aroche ng’a Musa oikire ang’e arore, akamorangeria korwa ase egetutu ime, “Musa! Musa!” Musa agaitaba, “Nao inde aa.”
Nyasae akamotebia, “Tobaisa goika ang’e aa. Rusia ebikoroto biao, ekiagera aase agwo oteneine naachenu.”
Naende akamotebia, “Inche ninche Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiao, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo.” Erio Musa agatuba obosio bwaye, ekiagera nigo airogete korigereria Nyasae.
Omonene akabora, “Amaene narorire emechando y’abanto baane abwo bakare Misiri; naigure buna bakorera ase engencho y’abwo bakobachanda, na inche namanyire kegima obororo bwabo.

Nigo naikire mbatoorie korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri, mbatiirie korwa ase ense eria, mbaire ase ense engiya engare, eyere entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, emenyire n’Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.
Ekerero ki’Abaisraeli giaikire asende, naende narorire buna Abamisiri babachandire.
Ase ayio, inchuo bono, ngotome gochia ase Farao, naye orusie abanto baane Abaisraeli korwa Misiri.”
Korende Musa akamotebia Nyasae, “Inche ninche ng’o, ngende ase Farao ndusie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri?”

Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Inche nimbe amo naye, na eke nakio kerabe ekemanyererio asore ng’a ninche omonyene nagotoma: Ekero orabe kwarusirie abanto abwo korwa Misiri inamobe mogonsasimera inche Nyasae oino ase egetunwa eke.”
Erio Musa agatebia Nyasae, “Kondagende ase Abaisraeli na kobatebia: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino ontomire asemore, amaene, barabwo baramboria: Erieta riaye, nere ng’o? Inaki rende ndabatebie?”
Nyasae akairaneria Musa, “INCHE NINCHE INDE BUNA INDE. Obatebie Abaisraeli: INCHE INDE ontomire asemore.”

Naende Nyasae akamotebia, “Goika otebie Abaisraeli: Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo ontomire asemore; erio nario erieta riane kare na kare; ase erio nigo ndabe nkoinyorwa nebiaare ase ebiaare.

Genda, osangererie abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a: Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo nang’orokera, agantebia ng’a mbatebie: Amaene, narorire aya Abamisiri bakobakorera,

na igo narengereirie kobang’anyia korwa Misiri ase mogochandwa, na kobaira ase ense y’Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke.

“Na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli inabaigwe amang’ana ao. Erio mogende, aye na barabwo, ase omoruoti o Misiri, momotebie: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaibirania, natoorokera; na bono twagosabire, otoe ribaga togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erio toruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ekeng’wanso.
Korende inche omonyene nimanyete ng’a omoruoti o Misiri takobaa ribaga mogende atabetereirie nokoboko kwane gwe chinguru.
Inche nindambore okoboko kwane, ng’ake Abamisiri namaakwa ’ogokumia ndakore ase egati yabo. Erio nyuma babae ribaga mogende.
“Nimbae abanto baane ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’Abamisiri; ekero moragende, timokogenda more namaboko amasa.

Kera omokungu asabe omogisangio oye, na omokungu onde bwensi omenyete nyomba mwaye, ebinto bie chifeta na ebie chitahabu amo ne chianga; mobibekere abana baino, abamura na abaiseke. Ase enchera eyio nero morasakore Abamisiri.”
Erio Musa akairaneria, “Korerende onye barabwo bakwanga konyegena, gose koigwa amang’ana aane, inki rende ndakore? Aande nigo baratebe: Omonene takoorokereti.”
Omonene akamoboria, “Inki ekio obwate koboko kwao?” Musa akairaneria, “Nenyimbo.”
Omonene akamotebia, “Yerute inse!” Na ekero Musa ayeruta inse, ekaonchoka ekaba eng’iti, na Musa agatama korwa asere.
Erio Omonene akamotebia, “Rambora okoboko kwao, oyebwate ekemincha.” Musa akarambora okoboko, akayebwata, na ase okoboko kwaye ekaonchoka, ekaba enyimbo naende.
Na Omonene akamotebia, “Okore igo, na barabwo inabegene ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo nakoorokera.”
Naende Omonene akamotebia, “Soyia okoboko kwao eanga ime ase egekuba kiao.” Musa agakora boigo; na ekero akorusetie akanyora ng’a kwabeire okorabu se ase oborwaire bwa ukoma.
Naende Omonene akamotebia, “Irania okoboko kwao eanga ime ase egekuba kiao.” Musa agakora bo, na ekero akorusetie akanyora ng’a kwabeire buya, buna omobere oye ore.
Omonene akamotebia, “Onye tibakwegena amang’ana ao, gose tibagwancha ase egekone kie ritang’ani, rirorio mbanche ase egia kabere.

Onye tibakwegena nonya nase ebikone ebio bibere, gose gwancha amang’ana ao, goika obuuche amache make korwa ase orooche rwa Naili, oyaitere ase ense enyomo; amache ayio orabuuche korwa ase orooche naonchoke abe amanyinga ase ense enyomo.”

Erio Musa akamotebia, “Koranche, Omonene, inche tindi omonto omanyete gokwana buya, nonya nkorwa kare, gose korwa riria gwachagete gokwana nainche, omosomba oo. Tindi omwango bw’ogokwana, na oromeme rwane nororito.”
Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ning’o oete mwanyabanto omonwa? Ning’o omokorete abe rimama, gose omotino, gose abe okorora, gose omouko? Inee! Tari inche Omonene?
Bono genda! Ninkoe amang’ana ogochia gokwana na gokworokereria aya ogochia goteba.”
Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Omonene, koranche, otome omonto onde omoao oyo oranche.”

Erio Omonene akaba nendamwamu egwoka igoro ya Musa, akamotebia, “Inee! Haroni omino, oria Omolawi, takaiyo? Nimanyete ng’a ere nere omonto omanyete gokwana buya. Naama! Ngocha are gokorotota; ere ekero arakorore nabe nomogoko omonene.
Aye nokwane nere, omotebie aya agochia gokwana. Inche nimbae inwe babere amang’ana mogochia gokwana, na koborokereria aya morakore.
Nere orabe ogokwana nabanto ribaga riao; ere abe omokwani oo, na aye obe ribaga ria Nyasae asare.
Aye obogorie enyimbo eyio koboko kwao, nero orakorere ebikone.”
Musa akairana gochia ase Yetero, ise biara, akamotebia, “Koranche, ong’e ribaga ng’irane Misiri korora abaminto gose moyo bare.” Yetero akamotebia, “Ee, ogende nomorembe.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa aaria Midiani, akamotebia, “Irana gochia Misiri, ekiagera baria bonsi barigetie kogoita bakure.”
Musa akaimokia mokaye na abana baye, akabariinia etigere igoro, na barabwo bakairana gochia ase ense ya Misiri. Ere akabogoria enyimbo ya Nyasae koboko kwaye.

Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Bono ekero orairane Misiri, origererie buya ng’a nokore ase obosio bwa Farao amakumia onsi aya nakoeire okobua gw’okoyakora. Korende ninkong’ie enkoro yaye, na ere tagotiga abanto bagende.
Erio omotebie Farao: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Abaisraeli nomwana one omotangi.
Inche nagotebirie: Moe omwana one ribaga agende gonkorera korende koraange, rirorio nigo ndaite omwana oo omotangi.”
Kobare nchera kogenda, Omonene akaumerana na Musa aase baare gotimokera, akarigia komoita.
Erio Sipora akaimokia rigena riare erioge, agasara omwana oye risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha akarikunia amagoro a Musa, akabora, “Amaene, nigo ore omonyuomi one bw’amanyinga.”
Agwo Omonene agatiga Musa, tamoita. Erio omokungu oyio agateba, “Omonyuomi bw’amanyinga ase engencho y’okwaroka.”
Omonene agatebia Haroni, “Genda gochia ase erooro orotote Musa.” Erio akagenda, akaumerana nere ase egetunwa kia Nyasae, akamonyunyunta.
Musa agatebia Haroni amang’ana onsi Omonene amotebetie, na igoro y’ebikone bionsi amochigete akore.
Musa na Haroni bakagenda, bagasangereria abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli.
Haroni akabatebia amang’ana onsi Omonene atebetie Musa, na ere agakora ebikone biria ase amaiso ’abanto.
Erio abanto bakegena; na ekero baigwete ng’a Omonene bwechandeire Abaisraeli, na ororire emechando yabo, barabwo bagatung ama inse, bakamosasima.
Erio Musa na Haroni bakagenda ase Farao, bakamotebia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende bankorere Rituko Rinene aaria ase erooro.”
Farao akairaneria, “Omonene nere ng’o inyigwe amang’ana aye, na koa Abaisraeli ribaga bagende? Inche timomanyeti Omonene, gose tinkoa Abaisraeli ribaga bagende.”

Barabwo bakamotebia, “Nyasae bw’Abaibirania natoorokera. Koranche, otoe ribaga togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erinde toruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebing’wanso, tabaisa gocha gotoita namarwaire gose nemioro.”
Omoruoti o Misiri akabairaneria, “Musa na Haroni, nase ki mogotenenia abanto korwa ase emeremo yabo? Irana gochia ase emeremo yaino y’obosomba.”
Naende Farao akabora, “Abanto aba babeire abange kobua abanyene ense eye. Naende morigetie kobarusia ase emeremo yabo.”
Ase rituko erio erio Farao agachika abwo abachandi amo nabateneneri, akabatebia,
“Timoa abanto aba naende chimboba ase ogokorera amatabori, buna mware kobaa agwo ritang’ani. Tiga bagende barabwo boka kwerigeria chimboba.
Korende mobabetererie bakore omobaro bw’amatabori oyo baare gokora ritang’ani, batari koyokeyia. Barabwo naboro. Ase ayio nigo bakona‐koboria ng’a: Toe ribaga togende koruera Nyasae oito ekeng’wanso.
Bae abanto abwo emeremo emerito mono, baisaneke nero, na tibabaisa gotegerera amang’ana ’oborimo.”
Abachandi abwo na abateneneri bagasoka bagatebia abanto, “Farao otebire iga: Tinkobaa inwe chimboba naende.
Genda inwe mweka mwerigerie chimboba aande onsi morachinyore; korende goika mokore omobaro bw’amatabori oria o botambe, timokoyokeyia nonya ng’ake.”
Abanto abwo bagesiarera ase ense yonsi ya Misiri na kwerigeria obonyansi ribaga rie chimboba.
Abachandi baria bakagenderera kobabetereria, bagoteba, “Goika mokore kera rituko omobaro bw’amatabori buna konya mogokora ekero mware korenterwa chimboba.”

Abachandi abwo babekire na Farao bakaba bagoaka abateneneri b’Abaisraeli, abwo babegetwe gotenenera emeremo, bakabatebia, “Naki motaikeranetie omobaro oino bw’amatabori igoro na rero, oyio konya mogokora botambe?”
Erio abateneneri b’Abaisraeli bakagenda ase Farao, bagateba, “Inki ogotokorera iga intwe abasomba bao?
Chimboba titori koegwa, korende nigo tokona‐kobetererigwa ng’a tokore amatabori. Na bono intwe, abasomba bao, nigo tokona‐goakwa; korende okomocha nokw’abanto bao.”
Farao akabairaneria, “Inwe naboro mono. Nakio gekogera mogoteba ng’a: Toe ribaga togende toruere Omonene ekeng’wanso.
Irana gochia ase emeremo yaino. Timokorenterwa chimboba, korende goika mokore omobaro bw’amatabori, oria oria mochikire gokora.”
Abateneneri b’Abaisraeli bakarora ng’a basoire ase obokongu ekiagera batebetigwe ng’a. “Goika moikeranie kera rituko omobaro oria oria bw’amatabori.”
Ekero baare korua ase Farao, bakanyora Musa na Haroni agwo nchera babaganyete,
bakabatebia, “Omonene abarigererie na konacha ekina, ekiagera mwatokorire koba rimisu riibe ase Farao na ase abasomba baye. Mwababekeire emioro maboko abo batoite.”
Erio Musa akairana gochia ase Omonene, akamotebia, “Omonene, nase ki ogokorera abanto aba amabe buna aya? Inki rende gwantomera inche?
Naki korwa riria nagendete ase Farao gokwana amang’ana ao omentire gokorera abanto bao bobe mono, na aye torakora kende ase okobatooria.”

Omonene agatebia Musa, “Bono norore aya ndakorere Farao. Naki ase okoboko kwane gwe chinguru nimobetererie abae abanto baane ribaga bagende, ee, ase okoboko kwane gwe chinguru nabetererigwe abaserie korwa ase ense yaye.”
Nyasae agakwana na Musa, akamotebia, “Inche ninche Omonene.
Naorokerete Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo buna Nyasae Omobui. Korende ase erieta riane Yahwe, gose Omonene, tinamanyekanete asebare.
Ninche nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ng’a nimbae ense ya Kanani, ense eria barenge buna abamenyi.
Na bono naigure okwerera kw’Abaisraeli abwo Abamisiri babegete inse y’obosomba, naende ning’inyorete okobwatana koria kwane.

Ase igo otebie Abaisraeli ng’a, Inche ninche Omonene, ndabarusie korwa ase emeremo emerito inse y’Abamisiri. Nimbatoorie korwa ase obosomba bwaino. Ase okoboko kwane koramboire, na goetera ase ebisusuro ebinene, nimbaboorie.
Nimbakore mobe abanto baane, na inche nimbe Nyasae oino. Inwe namomanye ng’a ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyokobarusia korwa ase emeremo emerito inse y’Abamisiri.
Nimbaire goika ense eria nariete eira inyimogetie okoboko kwane koa Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo. Nimbayee ebe omwando oino. Inche ninche Omonene.”
Musa agatebia Abaisraeli amang’ana ayio, korende barabwo tibancha gotegerera, ekiagera tibare konyara koremereria, ase engencho y’emeremo y’obosomba obotindi.
Erio Omonene agakwana na Musa akamotebia,
“Genda okwane na Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, omotebie abae Abaisraeli ribaga bagende, barue ase ense yaye.”
Musa agakwana ase obosio bw’Omonene, agateba. “Onye Abaisraeli baanga konyigwera, naki rende Farao ere arakore anyigwere, inche omonto ebikoba biane bitarokiri.”
Korende Omonene agakwana na Musa na Haroni, akabachika bagende batebie Abaisraeli na Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, ng’a batomirwe barusie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
Abanto aba nabwo barenge emetwe ye chiamate chiabo. Abana abamura ba Reuben, omomura omotangi o Israeli, nabwo aba: Hanoki, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Reuben.
Abana abamura ba Simeoni nabwo aba: Yemueli, na Yamini, na Ohadi, na Yakini, na Sohari, na Sauli, omwana bw’omokungu Omokanani. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Simeoni.
Aya naro amarieta ’abamura ba Lawi, buna batunyaine ase okoiborwa kwabo: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari. Lawi nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etano na ebere (137).
Abana abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Libini na Simei, ne chiamate chiabo.
Na abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli. Kohati nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etato (133).
Na abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Lawi, buna batunyaine ase okoiborwa kwabo.
Amuramu akanyuoma Yokebedi, omoiseke omwabo ise; na ere akamoiborera Haroni na Musa. Amuramu nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etano na ebere (137).
Na abana abamura ba Isari nabwo aba: Kora, na Nefegi, na Sikiri.
Na abana abamura ba Usieli nabwo aba: Mishaeli na Elisafani, na Sitiri.
Haroni akanyuoma Elisheba, omoiseke bw’Aminadabu, omoiseke omwabo Nashoni. Ere akamoiborera Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.
Na abana abamura ba Kora nabwo aba: Asiri, na Elikana, na Abiasafu. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Kora.
Eleazari, omwana o Haroni, akanyuoma omoiseke oyomo bw’abaiseke ba Putieli, na ere akamoiborera Finehasi. Abanto aba nabwo barenge emetwe ye chinyomba chi’Abalawi, eamate ase eamate.
Haroni oria oria amo na Musa nabwo baria Omonene atebetie, “Barusie Abaisraeli ase ense ya Misiri, omoganda ase omoganda.”
Aba nabwo baria batebetie omoruoti o Misiri ng’a barusie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri. Musa na Haroni nabwo baria baria.
Ekero Omonene akwanete na Musa ase ense ya Misiri
akamotebia, “Inche ninche Omonene. Otebie Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, amang’ana onsi nkogotebia.”
Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Inche nomonto ebikoba biane bitarogeti, naki rende Farao arakore anyigwere?”
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rora nagokorire obe buna Nyasae ase Farao, na Haroni akwane nere buna omobani oo.
Goika otebie oyomino Haroni ayio onsi nagochikire, na ere akwane na Farao, amotebie ng’a ae Abaisraeli ribaga barue ase ense yaye.
Korende ninkong’ie enkoro ya Farao; nonya nabo ninkore ebikone ebinge na amakumia amange ase ense ya Misiri.
Korende Farao takobaigwa. Inche nindambore okoboko kwane igoro y’Abamisiri na kobaa ebisusuro ebinene, na nindusie emeganda yane, abanto baane Abaisraeli, korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
Ekero ndarambore okoboko kwane igoro y’Abamisiri, na korusia Abaisraeli korwa asebare, erio nario Abamisiri baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
Musa na Haroni bagakora buna Omonene abachigete.
Ekero keria bakwanete na Farao, Musa nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etano na etato (80), na Haroni emiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etato (83).
Omonene agatebia Musa na Haroni,
“Ekero Farao arababorie ng’a mokore egekone, erio aye Musa otebie Haroni abogorie enyimbo yaye, ayerute inse bosio bwa Farao, na ero neonchoke ebe eng’iti.”
Musa na Haroni bakagenda ase Farao, bagakora buna Omonene abachigete. Haroni akaruta enyimbo yaye bosio bwa Farao na bw’abasomba baye, na ero ekaonchoka ekaba eng’iti.
Erio Farao akarangeria abanto abanyasemi na abaragori, na abwo abaringoria ba Misiri bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo.
Kera oyomo obo akaruta enyimbo yaye inse, na chirochio chikaonchoka, chikaba ching’iti chinene; korende enyimbo ya Haroni ekamera chinyimbo chiabo.
Enkoro ya Farao nigo yarenge enkong’u, na buna Omonene atebete, taigwera Musa na Haroni.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Farao okong’irie enkoro yaye, bwangire koa abanto aba ribaga bagende.
Ankio mambia, ekero Farao aragende rooche, naye ogende otenene ase engegu, omoganye aroro. Enyimbo eria yaonchogete ekaba eng’iti, oyebogorie koboko kwao.
Omotebie ng’a: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abiabirania, ontomire ngotebie ng’a oe abanto baye ribaga bagende komokorera ase erooro. Naye goika bono toraigwa.

Ase igo Omonene otebire iga: Ase ring’ana eri ndakore, nario oramanye ng’a ninche Omonene. Rigereria, ning’ake amache ’orooche rwa Naili nenyimbo eye mbwate koboko kwane, na amache aya naonchoke abe amanyinga.
Ne chinswe chire ase orooche ime inachikwe, chigunde, na orooche narotioke bobe, na Abamisiri nabasinywe konywa amache aria.”

Erio Omonene agatebia Musa amotebie Haroni, “Imokia enyimbo yao, orambore okoboko kwao igoro ase amache onsi ay’Abamisiri, ase chindooche chiabo na ase ebirooche, ase amatibo onsi ne chinsoko. Amache ayio onsi aonchoke abe amanyinga. Naboigo amanyinga abe ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, nonya nase chintuba na ase chinyongo chionsi.”
Musa na Haroni bagakora buna Omonene abachigete. Haroni akaimokia enyimbo yaye, agaaka orooche bosio bwa Farao na bw’abasomba baye, na amache ayare imeo akaonchoka, akaba amanyinga.
Ne chinswe chiare ase orooche chigakwa, na orooche rokagunda na gotioka, na Abamisiri bagasinywa konywa amache aria. Amanyinga akaba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.
Erio abaringoria ba Misiri bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo. Farao akagenderera gokong’ia enkoro yaye, na buna Omonene konya atebire, tabaigwa.
Farao akairana kogenda bwoye, amang’ana aria tayabeka ase omoyo oye.
Abamisiri bonsi bagakunya‐kunya mbarabare y’orooche ase okorigia amache bakonywa, ekiagera tibare konyara konywa amache a rooche.
Amatuko atano na abere akaera korwa riria Omonene aagete orooche rwa Naili.
Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Genda otebie Farao: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende gonkorera.
Korende koraange kobaa ribaga bagende, rirorio inche ning’ake ense yao yonsi ase okorenta ebioto.

Orooche rwa Naili naroichorwe nebioto, na birobio nabitiire korwa aroro, nabisoe nyomba mwao, na enyomba yao y’okorara, amo noborere bwao; nabisoe ne chinyomba chi’abasomba bao na echi’abanto bao, ase amariko ao ase okogekera emegati, na ase ebituba biao bi’ogokonyera obosie.
Ebioto ebio inabikogenderere omobere oo, na ey’abanto bao, na ey’abasomba bao.”
Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Motebie Haroni abwate enyimbo yaye, ayeimokie igoro ye chindooche, na ebirooche, na amatibo, erinde agere ebioto bigende igoro ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.”
Haroni akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’amache onsi a Misiri, na ebioto bigatiira, bigatuba ense eyio yonsi.
Na abaringoria bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo, bakarenta ebioto igoro ase ense ya Misiri.
Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Haroni, akabatebia, “Mosabe Omonene arusie ebioto korwa ase ense na korwa ase abanto baane, na inche ning’ee abanto baye ribaga bagende koruera Omonene ekeng’wanso.”

Musa agatebia Farao, “Ase amasikani ao, naye orantebie ngaki ki ndagosabere aye amo nabasomba bao, na abanto bao, erinde ebioto birue asore na ase chinyomba chiao, bitigare koba ase orooche rwa Naili oka.”
Farao akairaneria, “Ng’ankio.” Musa akamotebia, “Nigo erabe buna gwateba, erinde omanye ng’a onde tari buna Omonene, Nyasae oito.
Ebioto nabirue asore na ase chinyomba chiao, ase abasomba bao na ase abanto bao; binde tibigotigara otatiga ase orooche rwa Naili oka.”
Musa na Haroni bakarua o Farao, na Musa akaboria Omonene arusie ebioto ebio amorenterete Farao.
Omonene agakora buna Musa amoboretie, na ebioto ebio biare ase chinyomba, na ase chigoora, na aande onsi isiko, bigakwa.
Abanto bakabisangereria, bakabibeka chitui chinyinge, na ense yonsi egatioka bobe.
Korende ekero Farao aroche ng’a amang’ana abeire buya, agakong’ia enkoro yaye naende, na buna Omonene atebete, akaanga koigwa Musa na Haroni.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Motebie Haroni aimokie enyimbo yaye aake orotu rwe riroba, na rororwo naroonchoke robe chinsona ase ense ya Misiri.”

Barabwo bagakora bo. Haroni akarambora okoboko kwaye, agaaka riroba nenyimbo yaye, na orotu rokaonchoka rokaba chinsona, na chirochio chikaroma mwanyabanto ne chitugo. Orotu rwonsi rwe riroba rokaonchoka rokaba chinsona.
Abaringoria nabarabwo bagateema korenta chinsona ase oborogi bwabo, korende tibanyara. Chinsona echio chikaba aande onsi, ase mwanyabanto na ase chitugo.
Abaringoria bagatebia Farao, “Eke nekiara kia Nyasae.” Korende Farao agakong’ia enkoro yaye, na buna Omonene atebete, akaanga kobaigwa.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Oche oimoke mambia chuni ekero Farao agochia kogenda rooche, otenene ase obosio bwaye, omotebie: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende bankorere.

Onye tokoa abanto baane ribaga, rirorio nintome chingi chinyinge igoro yao na abasomba bao, na igoro y’abanto bao ne chinyomba chiao. Chinyomba chi’Abamisiri inachiichorwe ne chingi, nonya nense eyio yonsi bamenyete.
Korende ase rituko erio nintige ensemo ya Goseni, ase abanto baane bamenyete; chingi echio tichigochiao, erio nomanye ng’a ninche Omonene bw’ense eye.
Ninkore ogwatananeka egati y’abanto baane na abao. Ankio egekone eke nagekoreke.”
Omonene agakora ayio. Chingi chigacha ase obonge mono ase chinyomba chia Farao, na echi’abasomba baye, na ase ense yonsi ya Misiri. Na ense eria egasarigwa ne chingi chiria.
Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Haroni, akabatebia, “Genda moruere Nyasae oino ekeng’wanso, korende naiga ase ense yaito.”

Musa akamoiraneria, “Titokonyara gokora igo, ekiagera intwe ntoruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ekeng’wanso ekeragechie Abamisiri. Na onye Abamisiri bagotorora tokorua ekeng’wanso buna ekio, Inee, tibagocha gotoaka amagena?
Goika togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erinde toruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ekeng’wanso buna atochigete.”
Farao akabora, “Nimbae ribaga mogende moruere Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekeng’wanso ase erooro, korende timogenda aare, naende monsabere inche.”

Musa akamoiraneria, “Bono buna nkorua asore nimosabe Omonene arusie chingi korwa asore aye Farao, na ase abasomba bao, na ase abanto bao, ankio mambia. Korende aye Farao, tokora obong’ainereria naende, na kwanga koa abanto ribaga bagende baruere Omonene ekeng’wanso.”
Erio Musa akarua o Farao, agasaba Omonene.
Omonene agakora buna Musa atebete, akarusia chingi chiria ase Farao, na ase abasomba baye, na ase abanto baye; tichiatigara nonya neyemo.
Korende Farao agakong’ia enkoro yaye nonya nengaki eyio, taa abanto ribaga bagende.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Genda otebie Farao: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaibirania, agoteba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende, erinde bankorere.
Naki onye gokwanga kobaa ribaga, na kogenderera kobatanga,
erio nario okoboko kw’Omonene koraake chitugo chiao aase chikorisia, ne chibarasi chiao, ne chitigere, ne chingamia, ne chiombe, ne ching’ondi; chirochio chinyore oborwaire obobe mono borachiite.
Korende Omonene nakore ogwatananeka egati ye chitugo chi’Abaisraeli na echi’Abamisiri. Ase echi’Abaisraeli ende tegokwa nonya neyemo.”
Omonene agachora engaki, akabora, “Ankio inche Omonene ninchiche nkore ayio ase ense eye.”
Rituko ria kabere Omonene agakora buna atebete. Chitugo chionsi chi’Abamisiri chigakwa, korende echi’Abaisraeli ende tiyakwa nonya neyemo.

Farao agatoma abanto barigie egiakoregete, na barabwo bakamorentera amang’ana ng’a ase Abaisraeli tugo yabo ende tekweti. Nonya nabo enkoro ya Farao ekagenderera koba enkong’u, taa abanto ribaga bagende.
Omonene agatebia Musa na Haroni, “Genda mobuuche ribu riichire roe korwa riko, na Musa arisiare gochia igoro, ase obosio bwa Farao.
Narirorio rionchoke ribe orotu, roirurukigwe ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, rorente amagumba na amaote amabe, ase mwanyabanto ne chitugo.”
Erio bakabuucha ribu korwa riko, bakagenda ase obosio bwa Farao. Musa akarisiara gochia igoro, na rirorio rikarenta amagumba na amaote amabe ase mwanyabanto ne chitugo.
Na abaringoria tibanyara gotenena ase obosio bwa Musa, ekiagera amagumba konya abariire barabwo buna Abamisiri bande.
Korende Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, na buna Omonene konya atebirie Musa, Farao akaanga koigwa Musa na Haroni.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Oche oimoke mambia chuni, otenene ase obosio bwa Farao, omotebie: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaibirania, agoteba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende, erinde bankorere.
Engaki eye nindete amaakwa aane onsi igoro yao aye omonyene, na igoro y’abasomba bao, na ase abanto bao, erinde omanye ng’a onde tari, nonya noyomo, ore buna inche, ase ense engima.
Naki ase engaki eye nanga narambora okoboko kwane ngoake aye amo nabanto bao namarwaire amabe abaite, aye nanga ngwasira korwa ase ense eye.
Korende nagotigire obe moyo ase engencho eye inyare kworokia okobua kwane, na erieta riane nario rirararigwe ase ense yonsi.
Ekiagera aye nigo ogendererete gotanga abanto baane, na tori kobaa ribaga bagende.
Ankio norore, engaki buna eye, nindete embura y’amagena endito mono, eyio omogwekano oye etana gotwa rinde ase Misiri korwa riria ense eye yachagete goika bono.

Gaki, origererie orore ng’a chitugo chiao chiarenterwe inka, naboigo na kende kiao gionsi kere isiko. Onye abanto bonsi abare isiko tibakorentwa ase chinyomba ime, embura y’amagena nebaite bakwe, ne chitugo chionsi boigo.”
Abande b’abasomba ba Farao, abwo bairogete ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakaayerera korenta abasomba babo ne chitugo chiabo inka.
Korende abwo basiereretie ring’ana ri’Omonene, bagatiga abasomba babo ne chitugo chiabo isiko.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao gochia igoro, erio embura y’amagena etwe ase ense ya Misiri, etwere mwanyabanto ne chitugo, na ebimeri bionsi bi’emegondo ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.”
Musa akaimokereria enyimbo yaye gochia igoro, na Omonene akarenta chinkoba na embura y’amagena, na okomesa gw’enkoba kogaika ase ense. Naboigo Omonene agaitera embura y’amagena igoro ya Misiri.

Embura enene y’amagena egatwa, na okomesa gw’enkoba gokagenderera amo nembura eyio. Na embura y’amagena eria yarenge endito mono, eyio omogwekano oye etana gotwa ase ense ya Misiri korwa ekero egesaku ekio giachagete komenyao.

Ase ense yonsi ya Misiri embura eria y’amagena egaita mwanyabanto bonsi abarenge isiko, amo ne chitugo chionsi. Na embura eria y’amagena egaita na gosaria ebimeri bionsi bi’emegondo, ekabuna na emete yonsi y’orosana.
Ase ensemo ya Goseni yoka, ase Abaisraeli bamenyete, nao embura y’amagena etatwete.
Farao akarangeria Musa na Haroni, akabatebia, “Ase engaki eye inche nakorire ebibe; Omonene nere omonyene oboronge, inche na abanto baane nabamochi tore.
Nsabere ase Omonene. Chinkoba echi amo nembura y’amagena biatonyarire. Nimbae ribaga mogende, timogwenereti mobeere aa goetania.”
Musa akamoiraneria, “Ekero nkorua ase omochie oo ninyimokie amaboko aane nsabe Omonene. Chinkoba echi nachisire, na embura y’amagena tegotwa goetania. Erio aye onyare komanya ng’a ense ney’Omonene.
Korende nimbamanyete inwe, aye na abasomba bao, ng’a timomoirogeti Omonene Nyasae nonya mbono.”
Egatani na esairi bigaakwa, bigasarigwa, naki esairi konya yabekire ebigara, na egatani ngosomoria yare.
Korende chingano tichiasaretigwe, ekiagera konya tichirakina.
Musa akarua o Farao, na ase omochie, akaimokia amaboko aye, agasaba Omonene. Erio chinkoba chiria na embura y’amagena bigatangwa, na embura tiyagenderera gotwa ase ense.
Ekero Farao aroche ng’a embura y’amagena ne chinkoba biatangirwe, akagenderera gokora ebibe, bagakong’ia chinkoro chiabo ere amo nabasomba baye.
Enkoro ya Farao ekagenderera koba enkong’u, na buna Omonene konya akwanire goetera ase Musa, akaanga gotiga Abaisraeli bagende.
Nyuma y’ayio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Genda ase Farao. Nakong’irie enkoro yaye na echi’abasomba baye, erinde inyare koorokia ebikone ebi biane ase egati yabo;
naye nonyare gotebia abana bao na abachokoro bao amang’ana aya nakorire ase egati y’Abamisiri, na ebikone ebi naorokirie ase egati yabo. Erio momanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”

Musa na Haroni bakagenda ase Farao, bakamotebia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaibirania, agoteba: Inee! Ngoika ririri orabe gokwanga gwekeyia ase obosio bwane? Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende bankorere.
Onye gokwanga koa abanto baane ribaga bagende, rigereria ankio nindete chingige ase ense yao.
Ne chingige echio inachitube ense eye yonsi, erio monto tanyara korora riroba, na chirochio inachisirie endagera eria etasaretigwe nembura y’amagena, amo na kera omote ore ase ense yao.

Chinyomba chiaino amo nechi’abasomba bao, na echi’Abamisiri bonsi inachiichorwe ne chingige. Omogwekano bw’echio chisokoro chiao gose chisokororia chitaroche nonya ng’ake korwa ekero bachagete komenya ase ense eye goika rero iga.” Erio Musa akaonchoka, akarua o Farao.
Farao agatebigwa nabasomba baye, “Ngoika ririri omonto oyo aratotege? Batige abanto aba bagende bakorere Omonene, Nyasae obo. Toramanya nonya mbono ng’a ense ya Misiri yasarekire?”
Ase igo Musa na Haroni bakarentwa naende ase Farao. Ere akabatebia, “Genda, mokorere Omonene, Nyasae oino. Korende ning’o nang’o moganetie mogende komo?”
Musa akamoiraneria, “Nigo toragende twensi, abake na abagotu, na abana baito, abamura na abaiseke, ching’ondi ne chitugo chiaito chinde chionsi, ekiagera ntobwate Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene.”
Korende Farao akabatebia, “Haha! Omonene abe amo nainwe onye nkobaa ribaga mogende amo nabana baino. Korende momanye ng’a amabe nabatang’aine ase mokogenda.
Yaya, taibo, genda inwe mweka abasacha, mokorere Omonene. Naki ayio naro konya moganetie.” Erio bagaserigwa korwa ase Farao.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao igoro y’ense ya Misiri, erinde chingige chichiche koria ebimeri binde bionsi ebitasaretigwe nembura y’amagena.”
Agwo Musa akaimokia enyimbo yaye igoro y’ense ya Misiri, na Omonene akarenta omwaga korwa moocha, rituko rigima, omobaso na obotuko. Ekero bwakia omwaga oria korwa moocha konya orentire chingige.
Chingige echio chigacha igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri, chikagwa chinsemo chionsi chi’aroro. Chingige chinyinge buna echio chitana gocha ase amatuko aetire, gose tichigochi‐gocha naende nonya ng’ake.

Chingige echio chigatuba ense eria yonsi goika ekamwama ti, chikaria ebimeri bionsi pi ase ense eria, na amatunda onsi ay’emete, ebio bionsi bitasaretigwe nembura y’amagena. Tigiatigarete kemeri kende gionsi ekebese gose amato ’emete ase ense ya Misiri engima.
