Farao akarangeria Musa na Haroni ase obwango, akabatebia, “Nakorire ebibe ase Omonene. Nyasae oino, na asemore.
Gaki bono nasabire, monyabere ebibe biane ekero eke gioka. Monsabere ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, ng’a anduserie ogoakwa oko tikong’ita.”
Musa akarua o Farao, agasaba Omonene.
Omonene akaonchora omwaga okaba bwe chinguru, okagusa korwa bosongo, okaira chingige chionsi gochia ase Enyancha Embariri. Tiyatigara engige nonya neyemo ase ense ya Misiri engima.
Korende Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, na ere akaanga koa Abaisraeli ribaga bagende.
Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Imokia okoboko kwao gochia igoro, erinde omosunte ekerima onyare koba ase ense ya Misiri, omosunte oranyare gotaba‐tabwa.”
Musa akaimokia okoboko kwaye gochia igoro, na omosunte ekerima okaba ase ense ya Misiri engaki y’amatuko atato.
Abanto tibanyara kororana; ase amatuko atato onde tarenge gosuka kogenda aande. Korende Abaisraeli barabwo mbabwate omobaso aase onsi ase bamenyete.
Farao akarangeria Musa, akamotebia, “Genda mokorere Omonene. Moire abana baino, korende chitugo chiaino chirochio mochitige aiga.”
Musa akamoiraneria, “Yaya, goika otoe ching’iti togochia koruera Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebinde bi’okonyenywa.

Naende ntoire chitugo chiaito chionsi, ende teri eratigare nyuma nonya neyemo. Korwa ase echio nao togochia korusia echi torakorere Omonene, Nyasae oito; intwe titomanyeti buna togochia gokorera Omonene goika toraika aroro.”
Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, na ere tancha kobaa ribaga bagende.
Farao agatebia Musa, “Karue ase obosio bwane! Bwerende, tobaisa gocha kondora naende, naki rituko riria orache korora obosio bwane naende, nigo orakwe.”
Musa akamoiraneria, “Gwakwanire ekeene; inche tingocha korora obosio bwao naende.”
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Ngotigarete ogoakwa okomo ndarente igoro ya Farao na Abamisiri. Nyuma y’okwo nabae ribaga mogende; ee ekero arabae ribaga mogende nigo arabaserie kegima morueo.
Bono genda okwane nabanto aba, ng’a kera oyomo ase abasacha na ase abakungu asabe korwa ase omogisangio oye ebinto bie chifeta, na ebie chitahabu.”
Omonene akaa abanto baye ogwancherwa ase amasio ’Abamisiri; kobua ayio Musa nigo arenge omonto omonene mono ase ense ya Misiri ase amasio ’abasomba ba Farao, na ase abanto baye.
Musa agatebia Farao, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Botuko gati ninche ng’ete egati y’Abamisiri.

Abana abatangi bonsi ase ense ya Misiri mbakwe, amo ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi; omwana omotangi o Farao, oyogoikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obogambi, na omwana omotangi bw’omokungu omosomba ore rogena gosia, ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi.
Erio ebirero ebinene inabibe ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, binde bitana koba bo, gose tibigocha koba bo naende nonya ng’ake.
Korende ase Abaisraeli, nonya nesese tegokogera omonto gose etugo. Erio momanye ng’a Omonene okorire ogwatananeka ase Abamisiri na Abaisraeli.

Na abasomba aba bao bonsi nabatirimboke gocha asende na batung’ameo, bakobora: Genda, karue aa, aye na abanto bao bonsi bakobwatie. Nyuma y’ayio nindue aa!” Erio agwo Musa akarua o Farao ore nekeririanda ekenene.
Omonene agatebia Musa. “Farao takobaigwa inwe. Ase ayio ning’orokie amakumia ande ase ense ya Misiri.”
Musa na Haroni bagakora amakumia ayio onsi ase obosio bwa Farao, korende Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, na ere taa Abaisraeli ribaga barue ase ense yaye.
Omonene agakwana na Musa na Haroni aria ase ense ya Misiri, akabatebia.
“Omotienyi oyo nobe oyo bwe ritang’ani asemore, oyo bw’ogochaka omwaka.
Genda orarerie omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, obatebie: Rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi oyo kera omonto ore na mwaye achore emanwa, erio kera enyomba ebe nemanwa eyemo.

Korende onye abanto b’enyomba eyemo bare abake, batanyare koria emanwa eria bayekoore, rirorio ere na omogisangio oye, oyobasinyaine, basangere emanwa eyemo, koreng’ana buna omobaro bw’abanto bareo. Ase kera emanwa goika mobare abanto abarache koyeria koreng’ana buna kera oyomo aranyare koria.
Mochore emanwa y’omwaka oyomo etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe emingichi gose egoree.
Mochigache goika rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi oyio. Agwo omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bachinyenye mogoroba.
Barabwo goika baimokie amanyinga aria, bayagindie emetobwa ebere ya gesieri na omoribo o igoro bw’emetobwa, ase kera enyomba barayeriere emanwa eria.
Ase obotuko obwo barie chinyama chiria chisambire nomorero, amo nemegati etabekiri memera, ne chinyeni chindoro.
Timoria chinde imbese gose chiyekire ase amache, korende chionsi goika chisambwe nomorero amo nomotwe na ebirenge, ne chinyama chi’enda.
Timotigaria gento kende goika mambia; onye kende kegotigara goika mambia mogesambe nomorero gesire.
Enchera morayerie nero eye: Mweboyie chinkini chiaino, mokong’e, mobeke ebikoroto ase amagoro aino, mobwate chinyimbo maboko aino, moyerie nomoayerero. Naki eyio n’Epasaka y’Omonene.
“Naki ase obotuko obwo ninche ng’ete ense ya Misiri, ing’ite abana abatangi bonsi ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi; ne chinyasae chionsi chia Misiri ninchigambie. Inche ninche Omonene.
Amanyinga ayio abe ekemanyererio ase chinyomba chiria morabe momenyete. Ekero ndarore amanyinga aria ning’ete mbatige inwe, na amaakwa aria takobanyora inwe abasirie, ekero ndaake ense ya Misiri.
Rituko eri inaribe asemore rituko rikoinyorwa, na inwe morirende ribe Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene. Nigo moraribwate ebiaare ase ebiaare, ribe rituko rinene ri’omoyega goika kare na kare.”

“Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere goika morie emegati etabekiri memera. Rituko rie ritang’ani morusie ememera korwa chinyomba chiaino kegima, ekiagera monto onde bwensi orarie omogati obekire ememera korwa rituko rie ritang’ani goika eria gatano na kabere, nigo araatananwe korwa ase obomo bw’Abaisraeli.

Ase rituko rie ritang’ani inamobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima, na ase rituko ria gatano na kabere boigo mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Ase amatuko ayio timokora meremo ende yonsi, otatiga okoroisia endagera ase kera omonto; ayio oka naro morakore.

Goika mobe mokorenda rituko eri rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, ekiagera ase rituko eri nario emeganda yaino yarusetigwe ase ense ya Misiri. Morende rituko erio ebiaare ase ebiaare. Oko nakwo korabe ogochika asemore kogenderera botambe.
“Goika morie emegati etabekiri memera, gochakera omogoroba bwe rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani goika omogoroba bwe rituko ri’emerongo ebere na rimo.

Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere ememera terorekana ase chinyomba chiaino nonya ng’ake; naki onde bwensi orarie egento kebekire ememera naatananwe korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, onye ore omomenyi gose omobiare.
Timoria gento kende gionsi kebekire ememera; mobe mokoria emegati etabekiri memera aande onsi morabe momenyete.”
Musa akarangeria abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli, akabatebia, “Genda mochore chimanwa echirabaisane abanto ba kera enyomba, mochinyenye chibe chimanwa chi’epasaka.

Erio moimokie chinsagia chia hisopo, mochitobeke ase amanyinga are egetaabo ime, mogindie omoriibo bw’emetobwa ya gesieri igoro amo nemetobwa eria ebere. Onde tabaisa gosoka korwa nyomba mwaye goika mambia.

Na ki Omonene nache aete ense ya Misiri aite Abamisiri, korende ekero ararore amanyinga agindirie omoriibo bw’emetobwa ya gesieri igoro na emetobwa eria ebere, nigo araete egesieri ekio, gose tagotiga oria omosiria asoe chinyomba chiaino abaite.
Ring’ana eri goika morirende, ribe ogochika kwaino, aye amo nabana bao kogenderera botambe.
Ekero moraike ase ense eria Omonene arabae, buna abarierete eira, erio namobe mokomoruera ekeng’wanso eke.
Na agwo ekero abana baino barache kobaboria: Engencho y’amang’ana aya ninki?

Inamobairanerie: Eke nekeng’wanso ki’Epasaka y’Omonene, ekiagera naetete chinyomba chi’Abaisraeli aaria Misiri ekero aitete Abamisiri, korende agatiga chinyomba chiaito.” Erio abanto bagatung’ama inse, bagasasima Nyasae.
Abaisraeli bakagenda, bagakora onsi aya Omonene achigete Musa na Haroni.

Bogachia koba botuko gati, Omonene agaita abana abatangi bonsi amo ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi ase ense ya Misiri, gochakera omwana omotangi o Farao oyoikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obogambi, goika omwana omotangi bw’omonto osibire echela, ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi.
Farao akaimoka botuko, ere amo nabasomba baye bonsi, na Abamisiri bonsi. Ebirero ebinene bikaba ase ense ya Misiri, ekiagera nyomba ende tiyatigarete monto atakwete.
Farao akarangeria Musa na Haroni botuko, akabatebia, “Imoka, morue aa ase abanto baane, inwe na Abaisraeli bonsi! Genda mokorere Omonene buna mwabeire mokoboria!
Ira ching’ondi chiaino ne chiombe chiaino buna mwaboririe, morue aa; monsabere, na inche nsesenigwe.”
Abamisiri bagasorora abanto abwo, bakabaayereria barue ase ense yabo; naki nigo batebete ng’a, “Aande nigo torabaise gokwa intwe twensi.”
Abanto abwo bakaimokia amabomba abo ay’obosie ritang’ani atarabekwa memera, bakaboa ebituba biabo, ebi baare gokonyera obosie, ase ebitambaa biabo baare kwambara, bakabibogoria ase amareko abo.
Abaisraeli konya bakorire buna Musa abatebetie; konya basabire korwa ase Abamisiri ebinto bie chifeta na ebie chitahabu amo ne chianga.
Omonene konya oeire abanto abwo ogwancherwa ase Abamisiri, na barabwo bakabaa kende gionsi eki baganetie. Ase enchera eye bagasakora Abamisiri.
Abaisraeli bakamanora korwa Ramesesi, bagaika Sukoti. Nigo barenge abasacha abaare kwegendera koreng’ana chilifu amagana atano na rimo (600,000), abakungu na abana tibabaretwe.
Na omoganda omonene mono bw’abanto b’ebisaku ao ao bakagenda komo, bakairana ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitugo chinde chinyinge mono.

Ase amabomba aria barentanete korwa Misiri bakaroisia emegati etabekiri memera. Ememera tiyarengeo, ekiagera nigo baseretigwe korwa Misiri ase obwango, bataranyora ribaga koroisia endagera bagochia koria.
Abaisraeli konya bamenyire ase ense ya Misiri ase engaki y’emiaka amagana ane, na emerongo etato (430).
Emiaka eyio amagana ane, na emerongo etato, koyaerire, ase rituko erio erio emeganda yonsi y’Omonene ekang’anya korwa ase ense ya Misiri.

Obotuko obwo nigo bwarenge obotuko bw’okorenda, ekero Omonene abeire ang’e ase okong’anyia Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Obwo nobotuko bw’Omonene, bogwenerete korendwa n’Abaisraeli ebiaare ase ebiaare.
Omonene agatebia Musa na Haroni, “Omoroberio bw’Epasaka noro oyo: Omonto omomenyi tabaisa koyeria,
korende omosomba onde bwensi omogorwa chibesa ere ayerie gokwamwarokirie.
Omogeni omenyete asemore, gose omonto orikire tibayeria Epasaka eyio.
Goika erierwe nyomba ime, timobaisa gosokia chinyama chinde isiko; timobuna riuga riaye rinde rionsi.
Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli goika bakore omoyega oyio.

Onye omomenyi omenyete bwoo bwanchete koria Epasaka y’Omonene, ere na abasacha bonsi abare amo nere goika barokigwe. Erio anyare koria Epasaka, na ere abe buna omobiare oino. Korende onde bwensi otarokiri tayeria.
Ogochika nokomo ase omobiare bw’Abaisraeli na omomenyi oyomenyete ase egati yaino.”
Abaisraeli bonsi bagakora buna Omonene achigete Musa na Haroni.
Ase rituko erio erio Omonene akang’anyia emeganda yonsi y’Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
Omonene agatebia Musa,
“Nyatananere kera omwana omotangi bw’Abaisraeli, oyo okoigora enda ya ng’ina, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo. Abwo nabaane, na chirochio nechiane.”

Erio Musa agatebia abanto, “Mobe mokoinyora rituko eri mwang’anyete korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense eyio mwarenge abasomba, ekiagera Omonene abang’anyetie korwa agwo nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru. Omogati obekire ememera toriegwa.
Rituko ria rero ase omotienyi bw’Abibu noro mokong’anya korwa aa.

Omonene nabarierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabae ense y’Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi. Eyio nense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke. Ekero arabaikie agwo goika mobe mokomoruera ekeng’wanso eke ase omotienyi oyio.
Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere mobe mokoria emegati etabekiri memera; ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ribe Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene.
Ase amatuko atano na abere emegati etabekiri memera eriegwe. Emegati ebekire ememera, gose ememera emenyene, tibirorekana ase ense yaino engima.
Aye ase rituko erio otebie omwana oo: Aya nigo nkoyakora ase okoinyora aya Omonene ankorerete ekero ang’anyetie korwa Misiri.

Amang’ana aya abe ekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao, na ase obosio bwao abe ekeinyorio kegokoinyoria, erinde ogenderere gokwana amachiko Omonene, ekiagera Omonene nakong’anyetie korwa Misiri nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru.
Ase ayio ogochika oko goika okorende omwaka ase omwaka ase engaki eyio echikire.”
“Ekero Omonene aragoikie ase ense ya Kanani, buna akorierete eira, aye amo ne chisokoro chiao, na akoyee,
omwatananere kera omwana omoisia omotangi; na kera eng’iti entangi y’eeri, na emingichi, na egoree; echio nigo chirabe echi’Omonene.

Korende kera emori entangi y’etigere goika oyeboorie ase okorua emanwa y’eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso. Onye tibwancheti koyebooria goika oyebune ebigoti. Kera omwana omoisia omotangi o mwanyabanto goika omoboorie.
Engaki erache omwana oo karakoborie: Engencho y’amang’ana aya ninki? Goika omoiranerie: Ase okoboko kwaye gwe chinguru Omonene agatong’anyia korwa Misiri agwo ase twarenge abasomba.

Naki ekero Farao akong’etie enkoro yaye akaanga gotoa ribaga kogenda, Omonene agaita kera omwana omotangi ase ense ya Misiri amo ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi. Nakio gekogera nkoruera Omonene kera eng’iti entangi y’eeri, na emingichi, na egoree, na omwana one omoisia omotangi nigo nkomobooria.
Amang’ana aya goika abe ekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao na ase obosio bwao, ekiagera Omonene natorusetie korwa Misiri nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru.”

Ekero Farao aete abanto ribaga bagende, Nyasae tabaraa baetere ense y’Abafilisti, nonya enchera eyio yarenge omobutokanio. Nyasae nigo arengereretie ng’a aande onye abanto aba bagochia koumera esegi mbabaisa koirana Misiri.
Ase ayio Nyasae akabaraa goetanana ase erooro gochia Enyancha Embariri. Na Abaisraeli bakarua ase ense ya Misiri bare nebirwanero bi’esegi.
Musa akairana amauga a Yusufu, ekiagera Yusufu konya otianirie Abaisraeli, agateba, “Ekero Nyasae arabachere abakonye, goika moire amauga aane, mogende naro.”
Barabwo bakaimoka bakarua Sukoti, bagatoora agwo Etamu aase erooro echakerete.
Omonene akaba okobatang’ana, omobaso ase riire riare buna esiiro aborokie enchera, na botuko ase omorero orenge buna esiiro abae oborabu, erio barore ase bakogenda, omobaso na obotuko.
Riire riria riare kobaraa mobaso, na omorero botuko, tibiare korua ase amasio abo.
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia.
“Batebie Abaisraeli ng’a bairane gochia Pi‐Hahiroti, batoore agwo ase egati ya Migidoli na enyancha kororia Baali‐Sefoni ase enyancha mbarabare.
Farao narengererie ng’a Abaisraeli batantanire enchera bakogenda, na erooro yabatangire tibagenda.

Inche ninkong’ie enkoro ya Farao, ache kobabwatia korwa nyuma yaino, na inche ninyenyorere ogotogigwa ase okobua Farao amo nomoganda oye bwonsi, na Abamisiri bamanye ng’a ninche Omonene.” Abaisraeli bagakora buna batebetigwe.

Ekero Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, atebetigwe ng’a Abaisraeli batamire, ere amo nabasomba baye bakaonchora ebirengererio biabo, bagateba, “Inki eke twakora? Tokaa Abaisraeli ribaga korua aa ase barenge gotokorera.”
Farao akabeka egari yaye y’esegi ang’e, akaira abarwani baye amo nere.
Naende akaira chigari amagana atano na rimo, echi achorete, amo ne chigari chinde chionsi, na abariini chituoni bachiriinete.
Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, na ere akabwatia Abaisraeli korwa nyuma, ekero barabwo bang’anyete bare nobomwenu.

Abamisiri bakababwatia korwa nyuma amo ne chibarasi chionsi, ne chigari chia Farao, na abariini chibarasi chiaye, na abarwani baye bonsi, bakabanyora batoorire enyancha mbarabare, ang’e na Pi‐Hahiroti kororia Baali‐Sefoni.
Ekero Farao abeire ang’e kobaikeera, Abaisraeli bakerigereria, bakarora Abamisiri bakobabwatia korwa nyuma. Erio agwo barabwo bakaba nobwoba obonene, bakarera ase Omonene.
Bagatebia Musa, “Inee! Chimbeera tichiarenge Misiri? Nase ayio ogatorenta toche gokwera aa ase erooro? Igo gwatokorera bobe ekero gwatorusia korwa Misiri!
Titwagotebetie ayio aaria Misiri? Tokagotebia ng’a: Totige tokorere Abamisiri. Naki anga mbuya tware gokorera Abamisiri kobua gokwera aiga ase erooro.”
Musa akairaneria abanto, “Timwoboa, motenene bokong’u! Igo namorore buna Omonene arabatoorie rero; naki Abamisiri aba moroche rero iga, timokobarora naende nonya ng’ake.
Omonene nabarwanere inwe, na inwe mokire‐kiri rioka.”
Omonene akaboria Musa, “Inki okorera asende? Batebie Abaisraeli bagenderere bosio.
Aye imokia enyimbo yao, na orambore okoboko kwao igoro y’enyancha, erinde yaatananeke, Abaisraeli banyare goeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku.

Rora, ninkore chinkoro chi’Abamisiri chibe chinkong’u, barabwo mbababwatie korwa nyuma. Nabo inche inyenyorere ogotogigwa ase okobua Farao amo nemeganda yaye yonsi, ne chigari chiaye, na abariini chibarasi chiaye.
Na Abamisiri nabamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, ekero nkwenyorera ogotogigwa ase okomobua Farao amo ne chigari chiaye na abariini chibarasi chiaye.”
Erio omomalaika bw’Omonene, oyio otang’aine omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, akairana nyuma yabo. Ne riire riria riateneine buna esiiro bosio bwabo rikairana nyuma yabo,

rikabeera gati y’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli na oyo bw’Abamisiri. Agwo riire riria rikabao amo nomosunte; korende ase obotuko riire rikarenta oborabu. Na ase obotuko obogima omoganda oyomo toikanete ang’e noyonde.

Erio Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha; na Omonene agasukia enyancha gochia nyuma ne chinguru chi’omwaga okorwa moocha okagusa obotuko obogima. Naboigo agakora enyancha koba ense enkamoku. Amache agaatananeka,
na Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku. Amache akaba agotenena buna orwaki ensemo ya borio na ensemo ya bomosi asebare.
Na Abamisiri bagasoa na kobabwatia gochia gati y’enyancha amo ne chibarasi chionsi chia Farao, ne chigari chiaye, na abariini chibarasi.
Bwachia koba mambia, Omonene akaba origereretie omoganda bw’Abamisiri korwa ase esiiro y’omorero na eye riire, akabatantania.

Omonene akagokora amagoro e chigari chiabo, goika bagasinywa kogenda bosio. Erio Abamisiri bagateba, “Tiga totame korwa ase Abaisraeli, ekiagera Omonene nkobarwanera are mamincha yaito intwe Abamisiri.”
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao igoro y’enyancha, erinde amache airanerane igoro y’Abamisiri, ne chigari chiabo amo nabariini chibarasi.”

Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha, na ekero bogokiamoka, amache akairana ase konya are botambe. Abamisiri bagachaka gotama, bakamerwa naro. Naboigo Omonene akabasiria ase enyancha gati‐gati.
Amache akairanerana, akamera chigari, na abariini chibarasi amo nomoganda bwonsi bw’abarwani ba Farao, abatunyanete Abaisraeli, gochia ase enyancha. Monto onde tatigara nonya noyomo.
Korende Abaisraeli bakagenderera goeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku, amache akaba ateneine buna orwaki ensemo ya borio na ensemo ya bomosi asebare.
Naboigo ase rituko riria Omonene atooretie Abaisraeli korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri; na Abaisraeli bakarora Abamisiri bakwete bacheng’enenete ase engegu y’enyancha.
Na ekero Abaisraeli baroche buna Omonene aorokirie okobua kwaye okonene igoro y’Abamisiri, bakamoiroka Omonene, bakamwegena Omonene na Musa, omosomba oye.
Erio Musa na Abaisraeli bakamoterera Omonene ogotera oko, bagoteba: “Nimoterere Omonene, ekiagera ere obuire ase okobua okonene; chibarasi amo nabachiriinete obarimeirie ase enyancha ime.”
“Omonene nere chinguru chiane, nimoterere ere, ere nogotooreka kwane. Ere Nyasae one, nimotogie; ere Nyasae o tata, ninterere obonene bwaye.
Omonene nomorwani bwe chisegi, Omonene nario erieta riaye.
Orutire chigari chia Farao amo nomoganda oye ase enyancha ime; abarwani baye abachore obarimeirie ase Enyancha Embariri.
Amache abatubire, barimeire chindiba ime buna rigena rikorutwa.”
“Omonene, okoboko kwao gw’okorio nkore nokobua okonene, Omonene, okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngosenyente ababisa.
Ase okobua kwao okonene nigo okobaiyeria inse abagokoimokera; endamwamu yao egwoka, nigo ekobasamba buna chimboba chinyomo.
Endamwamu yao entindi ekagera amache akaimoka, agatenena buna orwaki, enyancha egakamoka goika inse kegima.”
“Omobisa agateba,” “Nimbabwatie, mbaikeere, mbiatanane ebi ndasakore, omoyo one oisaneke; ninsomore omoyio one o birende, k nimbasirie nokoboko kwane.”
Naboigo ekero aye kwagusete buna omwaga, amache akabamera; bakamerwa buna embunde ekorimera ase amache amange ime, yarika inse.
“Omonene, ning’o onga buna aye ase egati ye chinyasae? Ning’o onga buna aye ore nobonene na obochenu? Naye ogwenerete koirokwa na gotogigwa, aye naye oyogokora amakumia.
Ekero kwaramborete okoboko kwao gw’okorio, ense ekabamera.”
“Ase obwanchani bwao botari koera okaraa abanto aba kwabooretie, ase chinguru chiao okabaikia ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.
Abanto b’ebisaku bakayaigwa, bagatengechigwa ase omoondoko, omoichano na obororo bikabwata abamenyete Bofilisti.
Abagambi b’Edomu bakaondoka, abanto abanene ba Moabu bakabwatwa nomotengecho, na abanto bonsi ba Kanani bakerusia moyo.
Omoondoko na obwoba bikababwata; ase engencho y’okobua gw’okoboko kwao bagatenena, bagakira‐kiri buna amagena, goika abanto bao baetire, ee, Omonene, goika abanto bao kwabooretie baetire.
Nobasoyie na kobabeka ase egetunwa kiao aye omonyene, aase aria kweroiseretie, aye Omonene, obomenyo obochenu kwaagachete namaboko ao.
Omonene nagambe kare na kare.”
Ekero chibarasi chia Farao, amo ne chigari na abariini basoete nyancha ime, Omonene akairania amache igoro yabo, akabatuba; korende Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku.
Na Miriamu omobani, omoiseke omwabo Haroni, akaimokia ekebangarara kiaye, na abakungu bonsi bakamobwatia bakobugia ebibangarara biabo na gotenga.
Miriamu akabaitaberia, na gotera, “Moterere Omonene, ekiagera ere obuire ase okobua okonene, chibarasi amo nabachiriinete obarimeirie ase enyancha ime.”
Musa agatang’ana Abaisraeli kogenda orogendo korwa ase Enyancha Embariri gochia erooro ya Suri. Ase engaki y’amatuko atato bagataara ase erooro, tibanyora amache.
Erio bagaika aase are korokwa Mara, tibanyara konywa amache arengeo, ekiagera arenge amaroro mono. Nakio kiagerete aase aria akarokwa Mara.
Agwo abanto bakemurunganeria Musa, bakamoboria, “Ninki tokonywa?”
Musa akarera ase Omonene, na Omonene akamworokia omote. Omote oyio Musa akayoruta amache ime, na amache aria akaba amaansu. Agwo Omonene akabekera abanto amachiko akobaraa, na agwo akaba okobateema.

Akabora, “Oise koigwera aya inche Omonene Nyasae oo ngokwana, na koyakora ayare boronge ase amaiso aane, na gotegerera amachiko aane, na kobwata emeroberio yane yonsi, rirorio inche tingokobekera amarwaire ande onsi buna aria nabekerete Abamisiri; naki ninche Omonene oo, oyogokogwenia.”
Erio abanto bagaika Elimu; agwo chinsoko nchiarengeo ikomi na ibere, na emekendo emerongo etano na ebere. Bagatoora agwo ang’e namache.

Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bakamanora na koimoka korwa Elimu, na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o kabere nyuma kobarure ense ya Misiri, bagaika ase erooro ya Sini, eyio ere egati y’Elimu na Sinai.
Abaisraeli bonsi bakemurunganeria Musa na Haroni aaria ase erooro,

bakabatebia, “Nanga mbuya onye twakwerete ase amaboko ’Omonene aaria ase ense ya Misiri. Agwo twaikaransete ase chinyongo chie chinyama, tware koria endagera enyinge, twaigota. Korende bono mwatorentire aa ase erooro ase ogotoita intwe twensi nenchara.”

Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rora, nimbatwerie omogati korwa igoro. Kera rituko abanto bagende isiko, basangererie eyekobaisana ase rituko erimo. Naboigo mbateeme gose mbaganetie kobwatia amachiko aane, gose yaya.
Korende rituko ria gatano na rimo goika basangererie na koroisia ara kabere buna bagosangereria amatuko ande.”
Erio Musa na Haroni bagatebia Abaisraeli bonsi, “Mogoroba rero inwe nario moramanye ng’a Omonene nere obarusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri,
na mambia inamorore obonene bw’Omonene, ekiagera ere oigure buna mwamwemurunganeirie. Ee, ere mwamwemurunganeirie, tari intwe. Intwe inki toisaine?”

Naende Musa agateba, “Erio nario moramanye obonene bw’Omonene ekero arabae chinyama morie mogoroba, na mambia abae omogati morie, moigote. Naki Omonene oigure buna mwamwemurunganeirie. Intwe titoisaini gento. Tari intwe mwemurunganeirie, korende n’Omonene.”
Musa agatebia Haroni, “Batebie omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli basuke gocha ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera oigure okwemurungania kwabo.”
Ekaba ekero Haroni arenge gokwana nomoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, barabwo bakeonchora bakarigereria gochia ase erooro, bakarora obonene bw’Omonene bokooroka korwa ase riire.
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Naigure okwemurungania kw’Abaisraeli. Kwana nabarabwo, obatebie ng’a engaki ya mogoroba mbaegwe enyama barie, na mambia inabaigote omogati. Erio bamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.”
Mogoroba chinkware chigacha, chigaichora ase batoorete, na inkio mambia aase onsi aetanaine aase aria akanyorwa atoorire riime.
Na ekero riime riakamokire, bakarora inse aria ase erooro ebinto binga buna amagoocho, bikarorekana buna obosie oborabu.
Ekero Abaisraeli babiroche tibamanyete gose mbinto ki, bagachaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mbinto ki biria?” Musa akabatebia, “Oria nomogati oyo Omonene abaeire morie.
Ring’ana erio nario Omonene achigete: Sangereria endagera eyio, kera oyomo buna agwenerete, ebimunu bibere ase kera omonto. Kera omonto asangererie buna abwate abanto bang’ana ase eema yaye.”
Abaisraeli bagakora bo, bagasangereria abande enyinge, na abande enke.
Korende ekero bayerengete ase ebirengo, oyosangereretie enyinge tatigaria kende, na ere oyosangereretie enke taremeretwe gento. Kera oyomo konya osangereirie buna okoria kwaye kwang’ana.
Musa akabatebia, “Monto onde tatigaria endagera ende goika mambia.”
Korende tibaigwera Musa; abande bagatigaria eyende goika rituko ria kabere, na mambia yaye bakayenyora yagundire na yasoirwe namakonde, na Musa akababea mono.
Ase igo kera emambia bakaba bagosangereria kera oyomo buna okoria kwaye kwang’ana; korende ekero omobaso oyesambire, yanyititoka.
Ase rituko ria gatano na rimo baba bagosangereria endagera eria ekerengo ara kabere, ase kera omonto ebimunu bine. Abagaaka bonsi b’omoganda bakagenda gotebia Musa amang’ana ayio.

Ere akabairaneria, “Ring’ana erio nario Omonene konya atebire: Ankio nerituko richenu ri’ogotimoka, Esabato Enchenu yaatananirwe ase Omonene. Mosambe eki moganetie gosamba, na moiyeke eki moganetie koiyeka, na ebiratigare mobigache goika ankio.”
Na buna Musa abachigete bakagacha endagera eria yatigarete goika rituko ria kabere; ero tiyagunda etioke, gose tiyasogwa namakonde.
Musa akabatebia, “Karie eye rero, ekiagera rero n’Esabato yaatananirwe ase Omonene. Rero timokoyerora isiko ase erooro.
Ase amatuko atano na rimo mobe mokoyesangereria. Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato, endagera eyio tegotoka ase rituko erio.”
Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere abande ase abanto baria bakagenda koyesangereria, tibayenyora.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Ngoika ririri morabe mokwanga ogotebereria kwane na amachiko aane?

Inyora ng’a inche Omonene nabaeire Esabato. Ase rituko ria gatano na rimo nkobaa endagera y’amatuko abere. Ase ayio, ase rituko eri ria gatano na kabere mobeere kera omonto aase aye, onde tabaisa korua inka.”
Naboigo abanto bakaba bagotimoka ase rituko ria gatano na kabere.
Abaisraeli bakaroka endagera eyio mana; ero nigo yare buna chinyeke chi’amaemba enkomba, chindabu, na obwansu bwaye nigo bware buna omogati ore nobooke.

Musa akabatebia, “Ring’ana eri nario Omonene achigete: Ebimunu bibere bi’endagera eye egachwe ase engencho ye chinderia chiaino, erinde banyare gocha korora omogati oyo nabaete mokoria ase erooro, ekero nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
Musa agatebia Haroni, “Imokia ekeguuru, obeke ebimunu bibere bia mana imeo, oyebeke ase obosio bw’Omonene egachwe ase engencho y’ebigori bigochi‐gocha.”
Buna Omonene achigete Musa, naboigo Haroni ayebegete bosio bw’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, ekagachwao.
Abaisraeli bakagenderera koria mana engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika bagaika aase abanto bamenyete; bakayeria goika bagaika orobebe rw’ense ya Kanani.
(Ekerengo ki’ebimunu bibere ekio nensemo ya ikomi y’ekerengo gi’efa.)

Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okaimoka korwa erooro ya Sini. Barabwo bakabwatia orogendo rwabo, bakana‐gotoora buna Omonene abachigete, Bagaika Refidimu, bagatoora aroro, korende mache tarengeo abanto baare konyara konywa.
Erio abanto bakomania Musa, bagoteba, “Toe amache tonywe!” Musa akabatebia, “Nase ki mokonyomania? Nase ki mogoteema Omonene?”
Agwo bakaba nerang’o enene y’amache, bakemurunganeria Musa, bakabora, “Ninki gwatoruseria Misiri gocha aa, amo nabana baito ne chitugo chiaito, togokwa ase erang’o?”
Musa akarera ase Omonene, akabora, “Ninki ngokorera abanto aba? Barabwo nigo bare ang’e kong’aka amagena.”
Omonene akairaneria Musa, akamotebia, “Oire amo naye abagaaka bande b’Abaisraeli, amo nenyimbo yao, eria kwaagete orooche, motang’ane abanto mogende.
Nondore inteneine agwo ase egetare kia Horebu, nkoganyete. Oake egetare, na amache arwe aroro, erinde abanto banyore banywe.” Musa agakora bo ase amasio ’abagaaka b’Abaisraeli.
Akaroka aase aria Masa na Meriba, ase engencho y’eriomana ri’Abaisraeli, naende ekiagera abanto bateemete Omonene, bakobora, “Inee! Omonene nare aa ase egati yaito, gose taiyo?”
Abaameleki bakaoroka korwania Abaisraeli aaria Refidimu.
Erio Musa agatebia Yoshua, “Tochorere abanto bagende korwana n’Abaameleki ankio; inche ninche ntenene ekegoro igoro, na enyimbo ya Nyasae inyebwate koboko kwane.”
Yoshua agakora buna Musa amotebetie, akarwania Abaameleki, na Musa, na Haroni, na Huri bagatiira gochia ekegoro igoro.
Ekaba Musa kaimokirie amaboko aye igoro, rirorio Abaisraeli babua, na kayairanirie inse, Abaameleki babua.

Ekero amaboko a Musa arosire, Haroni na Huri bakaimokia rigena, bakaritereka inse, na Musa akariikaransera. Erio bakaba bagosiira amaboko a Musa, oyomo okoboko okomo, na oyonde okonde. Naboigo bakamosiira goika erioba rikagwa.
Na igo Yoshua akabua Abaameleki kegima, akabaita nemioro.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Yarike amang’ana aya ase ebuku, abe amang’ana ’okoinyorwa, otebie Yoshua ng’a ninkore Abaameleki bebwe kegima, tibabaisa koinyorwa inse y’erioba.”
Musa akaagacha egesasimero agwo, agakeroka “Yahwe Nisi”, engencho yaye, “Omonene nebendera yane y’esegi”,
agateba, “Ninyimokie okoboko kwane igoro, kobe ekemanyererio ki’Omonene, na gotiana ng’a Omonene nigo aragenderere korwania Abaameleki ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
Yetero, omokuani o Midiani, ise biara Musa, akaigwa amang’ana onsi aya Nyasae akoreire Musa na Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na buna Omonene abang’anyetie korwa Misiri.
Erio Yetero agacha, akarentana Sipora, moka Musa. Musa konya omoiranirie ase ise.
Naboigo akarentana Gerisomu na Elieseri, abana abamura babere ba Musa. (Musa nigo atebete, “Nabeire omomenyi ase ense engeni”, na akaroka omwana oyomo Gerisomu.
Naende agateba, “Nyasae o tata obeire omokonyi one, agantooria korwa ase ogoita gwa Farao”, na akaroka oria onde Eliezeri.)
Nabo Yetero, ise biara Musa, amo na moka Musa na abana baye babere, bagacha ase erooro aase Musa konya atoorire ase egetunwa kia Nyasae.
Agatoma amang’ana ase Musa, okomotebia, “Inche Yetero, iso biara, nachire amo na mokao na abana baye babere.”
Erio Musa agasoka komorotota, agatung’ama na komonyunyunta. Ekero bakwananirie bagasoa ase eema.
Musa agatebia ise biara aya onsi Omonene akorerete Farao amo n’Abamisiri ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, na obokong’u bwonsi obwo banyorete inchera, naende buna Omonene abatooretie.
Yetero akagoka ase amaya onsi Nyasae akorerete Abaisraeli ase okobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri,
akabora, “Omonene atogigwe, oyo obatooretie abanto baye korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri, na korwa ase Farao, obatooretie korwa ase obosomba obwo.
Bono namanyire ng’a Omonene nomonene kobua chinyasae chinde chionsi, ekiagera atooririe abanto baye korwa ase Abamisiri abwo babaenenerete.”
Erio Yetero akarentera Nyasae ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde bi’okonyenywa. Haroni amo nabagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagacha bakaragera amo na ise biara Musa, ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
Rituko ria kabere Musa agaikaransa kogamba ebina bi’abanto; na abanto nigo barengeo bamoetanaine korwa mambia goika mogoroba.
Ekero ise biara Musa aroche onsi aya Musa are gokorera abanto, akamoboria. “Inki eke ogokorera abanto? Naki oikaransete aye bweka, na abanto bagoetanaine korwa mambia goika mogoroba?”
Musa akamoiraneria, “Nekiagera abanto bagonchichera, bakorigia oboraai bwa Nyasae.
Ekero bomanire nigo bagocha asende, na inche nabagambera ebina biabo na kobamanyia emeroberio ya Nyasae na amachiko aye.”
Yetero agatebia Musa, “Enchera eye y’okobagambera ebina biabo teri engiya.
Nigo okorosigwa, aye amo nabanto aba bonsi bare aa. Naki emeremo eye nemerito mono asore, tokonyara koyekora aye bweka.
Bono ntegerera, ngotebie chisemi chingiya orakore, na Nyasae nabe amo naye. Aye kabe oyo ogotenenera abanto ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na komoirera amang’ana abo.
Goika oborokererie amachiko na emeroberio, na obatebererie buna ebagwenerete babe na gokora.
Korende ochore abanto abamoirogete Nyasae, abegenwa, abatakorigia riaaki, abaranyare koba abaraai b’abanto b’emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.

Otige barabwo babe bakogambera abanto ebina bia botambe. Ebina ebikong’u birobio bakobirentere, korende ebire ebike babigambe barabwo boka. Ase enchera eyio egurube yao tekoba endito mono, ekiagera barabwo mbayebogorie amo naye.
Korakore igo, buna Nyasae aragochikere, aye nonyore chinguru chi’okogenderera, na abanto aba bonsi nabagende chinka chiabo bare nomorembe.”
Musa agancha amang’ana aya ise biara amosemetie.
Agachora abanto b’Abaisraeli abaranyare gokora emeremo eyio, akababeka babe abaraai b’Abaisraeli, b’emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.
Barabwo bakaba bakogamba ebina bi’abanto botambe. Ebina ebikong’u baba bakobirentera Musa, korende ebire ebike baba bakobigamba abanyene.
Erio Musa agakooba ise biara, akamotiga okogenda ase ense yaye.
Rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatato nyuma Abaisraeli kobarure ase ense ya Misiri, bagaika ase erooro ya Sinai.
Bakamanora korwa Refidimu, bagaika ase erooro ya Sinai, bagatoora kororia egetunwa gia Sinai.
Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro koumerana na Nyasae. Omonene akamorangeria agwo ase egetunwa, akamotebia, “Amang’ana aya naro oratebie abanto b’egesaku kia Yakobo, baria Abaisraeli:
Inwe mwarorire aya nakoreire Abamisiri, na buna nababogoretie inwe buna ensoti ekobogoria amage aye ase chimbaba chiaye, nabarentire aiga asende.
Bono komoranyigwere na kobwata okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, rirorio inamobe abanto baane. Naki ense yonsi neyane, korende inwe inamobe abanto baane abachore kobua abanto b’ebisaku binde.
Inwe inamobe oboruoti bwane, abanto bagonkorera buna abakuani, egesaku kiane egechenu. Amang’ana aya naro oratebie Abaisraeli.”
Erio Musa akagenda akarangeria abagaaka b’Abaisraeli amo, akabatebia amang’ana ayio onsi Omonene amochigete.
Na abanto bonsi amo bakairaneria, bakabora, “Ayio onsi Omonene atebire, inatoyakore.” Musa nere akairera Omonene amang’ana abanto bairaneretie.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Ninchiche asore inde ase riire ririto ime, erio abanto aba baigwe kongokwana naye, na barabwo bakwegene botambe.” Erio Musa agatebia Omonene amang’ana abanto bairaneretie.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Genda ase abanto aba, obachene rero na ankio. Obatebie basibie chianga chiabo,
bebeke ang’e goika rituko ria gatato, ekiagera ase rituko eri inche Omonene ning’ike ase egetunwa gia Sinai, agwo ase abanto bonsi barandore.
Aye goika obekere abanto aba orobebe roetanane egetunwa eke, obatebie: Mwerende, timotiira ase egetunwa igoro, gose timokuna chinsinyo chiaye. Onde bwensi oragekune nigo araitwe akwe.

Okoboko kw’omonto onde tigokuna omonto orakore ayio, korende nigo araakwe amagena gose araswe nemegwe. Aya achikirwe ase mwanyabanto na ase ching’iti, korende ekero egetureri kerabugigwe eriogi ri’ekerondereria, erio nario abanto baratiire gocha ase egetunwa.”
Musa agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa gochia ase abanto, akabachena, na barabwo bagasibia chianga chiabo.
Musa akabatebia, “Mwebeke ang’e goika rituko ria gatato: timobaisa goika abakungu baino ang’e.”
Ase rituko ria gatato ekero kia mambia bikaba enkoba na okomesa, ne riire ririto rigaika ase egetunwa, na eriogi ri’egetureri rikooga mono. Abanto bonsi ase egetwori bakaondoka na koiguswa.
Erio Musa agatang’ana abanto korwa ase egetwori bachie koumerana na Nyasae. Barabwo bagatenena ase egetunwa mbarabare.

Egetunwa gionsi gia Sinai kegatubwa nerioki, ekiagera Omonene aigete aroro ore ase omorero ime; na erioki rigachongororoka gochia igoro buna eri’eriko rinene ri’oboturi, na egetunwa ekegima gekanyegerigwa mono.
Eriogi ri’egetureri rikagenderera kwoga mono kobua. Musa agakwana, na Nyasae akamoiraneria nogoaka gw’enkoba.
Omonene agaika ase egechuria ki’egetunwa gia Sinai, akarangeria Musa agende asare, na Musa agatiira gochiao.
Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Tirimboka gochia inse ase abanto, obakurere tibatamboka orobebe bache kondora. Baise gokora igo, abange babo mbakwe.
Na abakuani barabwo kobagocha asende, inche Omonene, goika bechene, timbaisa kobaa egesusuro.”
Musa agatebia Omonene, “Abanto aba tibakonyara gotiira gocha aa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ekiagera aye omonyene ngwatokania, ogatotebia: Beka orobebe roetanane egetunwa, na ogiatanane kebe egechenu.”
Omonene akamotebia, “Tirimboka gochia inse, orente Haroni, motiire nere gocha aa. Korende abakuani na abanto tibabaisa gotamboka orobebe gocha aa asende, mbaise kobaa egesusuro.”
Erio Musa agatirimboka gochia ase abanto, akabatebia amang’ana ayio.
Nyasae agakwana amang’ana aya onsi, agateba,
“Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oo, oyokorusetie ase ense ya Misiri, ase ense y’obosomba.
“Toba ne chinyasae chinde otatiga inche.
“Tobaisa gwekorera omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, omogwekano o getongwa kende gionsi kere igoro, gose kere ense, gose kere ime ase amache inse y’ense.

Tobaisa gosasima gose gokorera emegwekano ekorire, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oo, Nyasae bwe risemi. Ase engencho y’amabe ’abaibori nigo nkoa abana egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato na egia kane, abwo bangechete.
Korende nigo nkoborokia obwanchani bwane botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu, ase abwo banyanchete na babwatete amachiko aane.
“Toriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oo, ekiagera Omonene tagotiga komoa egesusuro omonto oria okoriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta riaye.
“Riinyore rituko ri’Esabato, orirende ribe richenu.
Amatuko atano na rimo okore emeremo yao yonsi,

korende rituko ria gatano na kabere nerituko ri’Esabato, riatananetwe na Nyasae oo. Ase rituko erio tokora emeremo ende yonsi, aye, gose omwana oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nonya nomosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, gose chitugo chiao, gose omomenyi ore mwao.

Naki ase amatuko atano na rimo naro Omonene atongete igoro na ense, ne chinyancha, na bionsi ebire imeo; agatimoka ase rituko ria gatano na kabere. Ase ayio Omonene agasesenia rituko ri’Esabato, akariatanana ribe richenu.
“Sika iso na nyoko, nario oramenye amatuko amange ase ense eye Omonene, Nyasae oo, akoeire.
“Toita.
“Totomana.
“Toiba.
“Tomotebera omogisangio oo oborimo.

“Tobaisa kogania enyomba y’omogisangio oo. Tobaisa kogania omokungu bw’omogisangio oo, nonya nomosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, gose eng’ombe yaye, gose etigere yaye, gose kende gionsi omogisangio oo abwate.”
Ekero abanto bonsi baroche okomesa, na koigwa enkoba na eriogi ri’egetureri na korora egetunwa gekoimoka erioki, bakaiguswa, bagatenenera aare.
Barabwo bagatebia Musa, “Kwana naintwe aye, na intwe inatotegerere, korende onye Nyasae ogokwana naintwe, nigo torakwe.”
Musa akabairaneria, “Timoondoka! Naki Nyasae nigo achire kobateema inwe, erio agere mogenderere komoiroka, erinde timokora ebibe.”
Ase igo abanto bagatenena aare, ekero Musa agendete ang’e ase riire riria rimwamu, ase Nyasae arenge.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Amang’ana aya naro oratebie Abaisraeli: Inwe abanyene mwarorire ng’a nigo nakwanire nainwe korwa igoro.
Timwekorera chinyasae chinde chie chifeta gose echie chitahabu chi’ogosasimwa; monsasime inche bweka.

Ong’agachere egesasimero ki’amaroba, onduere ebing’wanso igoro yaye, ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, korwa ase ching’ondi chiao, ne chiombe chiao. Kera aase ndatebe onsasimere, ninchiche asore, ngosesenie.
Onye gokong’agachera egesasimero ki’amagena, tokeagacha namagena abaachire; ekiagera onye gokoyabaacha nebikorero biao, rirorio kwayabekire riko.
Naende totiirera ebiriinero igoro, gokogenda ase egesasimero, egetirianda kiao tikebaisa kooroka.”
“Aya naro amachiko orae Abaisraeli:
Koragore omosomba bw’Abaibirania, ere agokorere ase engaki y’emiaka etano nomo, korende omwaka o gatano na kabere nigo ararue bwoo ore omosibore, tagoakana kende.
Onye ochete bwoo tarenge na mokungu, rirorio nabo aragende bweka, korende onye orenge nomokungu, omokungu oye nigo aragende amo nere.
Onye omonene oye omonyuomeretie omokungu, na ere omoiboreire abana, abamura gose abaiseke, omokungu oria na abana baye nigo barabe enibo y’omonene oye; omosacha oria nigo ararueo ere bweka,
Korende omosomba oria karatebe: Nimwanchete omonene one amo na mokane, na abana baane, tinganeti korua ase obosomba bwane,
erio omonene oye amorente ase obosio bwa Nyasae, amoikie ase egesieri gose ase emetobwa ya gesieri na amotuue ogoto kwaye nesindake. Erio omonto oria abe omosomba oye ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
“Omonto karaoonie omwana oye omoiseke koba omosomba, omoiseke oyio tagosiborwa buna abasomba abamura barasiborwe.

Onye omoiseke oyio tagwenereti omonene oye, oyorengereretie komokora abe mokaye, rirorio nigo araboorigwe airane. Omonene oye takoba ne ribaga komoonia ase egesaku ekegeni, ekiagera among’ainereretie.
Onye okomoa omomura oye abe mokaye, rirorio amwanche buna omwana oye omoiseke.
Onye omonto oyio okonyuoma omokungu o kabere, takorina oria omotang’ani endagera yaye, ne chianga chiaye na kende gionsi aganetie buna mokaye.
Atamokorereti amang’ana aya atato, goika aegwe ribaga arue bwoye ataakaneiri embooria.”
“Monto onde bwensi oraake omonto na amoite akwe, nere goika aitwe akwe.
Korende onye tamong’erete otatiga Nyasae omobegete ase amaboko aye, erio ninkworokie aase omoiti oria aratamere.
Korende omonto ogoita oyomwabo mweno ase obong’ainereria, nere goika arusigwe nonya nase egesasimero kiane, aitwe akwe.
“Onde bwensi oraake ise gose ng’ina, nere goika aitwe akwe.
“Onde bwensi oraibe omonto goika aitwe akwe, karabe omoonirie gose omobwate ase amaboko aye.
“Onde bwensi oraragererie ise gose ng’ina, nere goika aitwe akwe.”
“Abanto kobarabe bakorwana, na oyomo aake oyonde rigena, gose enkundi, oyio oakwa go takwa, korende abe okorwara borere,
karabe otimokire, naende asoke isiko gotaara ogwesiirera enyimbo, rirorio oria omoagete nigo aratigwe, otatiga amoakane ase engencho y’eng’eria eria asiririe, na amorende goika agwene kegima.
“Omonto karaake omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, nenyimbo, erinde akwere ase amaboko aye, goika aegwe egesusuro.
Korende omosomba oyio karagenderere koba moyo rituko erimo gose abere, omonto oyio takoegwa egesusuro, ekiagera omosomba oyio nenibo yaye.

“Abanto abasacha kobarabe bakorwana, na kogwera omokungu ore morito, na oborito bwaye bogwe, korende atabeti na bobe bonde, omonto oria omogwerete goika aakane buna omosacha bw’omokungu oria araborie nyuma abagambi kobanachire ekina.
Korende omokungu oria karakwe, rirorio egesusuro kebe obogima ase obogima,
eriso ase eriso, na erino ase erino, okoboko ase okoboko, na okogoro ase okogoro,
ogosambwa ase ogosambwa, na eriote ase eriote, naende ogosionorwa ase ogosionorwa.
“Omonto karaake omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, na komwata eriso, rirorio goika amotige abe omosibore ase engencho y’eriso riaye.
Karamoake amogookore erino, goika amotige abe omosibore ase engencho y’erino riaye.”
“Eng’ombe eise goita omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, ne chingunchara chiaye, goika eakwe amagena ekwe, ne chinyama chiaye tichiriegwa; korende omonyene eng’ombe eyio taegwa egesusuro.

Korende eng’ombe eyio, onye enarete goita abanto, na omonyene eng’ombe okureirwe, na ere tayesibeti, ero keraite omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, nigo eraakwe amagena ekwe, na omonyene nere aitwe akwe.
Onye embooria ekoborigwa korwa asare, goika arue chionsi echi chiraganigwe, chibe embooria ase obogima bwaye.
Onye eng’ombe egoita omomura gose omoiseke ne chingunchara chiaye, ogochika nakwo okwo okomo.
Onye eng’ombe egoita omosomba, omomura gose omoiseke, omonyene eng’ombe nigo araakane omonyene omosomba oria chisekeli chie chifeta emerongo etato, na eng’ombe eria eitwe ase ogoakwa amagena.
“Omonto karatige engoro yasie, gose onye okunyire engoro na tayekuneka, na eng’ombe gose etigere egwe imeo,
rirorio omonyene engoro goika aakane omonyene etugo chibesa. Erio eng’iti eria yakure ebe eyaye.
Eng’ombe y’omonto keraite ey’omonto onde ekwe, erio barabwo baoonie eng’ombe eyio ere moyo, baatanane chibesa echio, baatanane ne chinyama chi’eng’ombe eria yakure boigo.

Korende onye emanyekanete ng’a eng’ombe eria nigo enarete goita abanto, na omonyene tayesibeti, goika aakane omonyene eng’ombe eria yakure ase okomoa eng’ombe eria ere moyo; na eria yakure ebe eyaye.”
“Omonto karaibe eng’ombe gose eng’ondi na koyenyenya, gose ayeoonie, nigo araakane chiombe isano ribaga ri’eng’ombe eyemo, ne ching’ondi inye ribaga ri’eng’ondi eyemo.

Igo emogwenerete aakane chionsi. Onye tabwati gento, ere omonyene goika aoonigwe ase engencho y’oboibi bwaye. Onye etugo eyio aiba ekonyorekana ase amaboko aye ere moyo, aakane ara kabere, onye neng’ombe, gose etigere, gose eng’ondi. “Omoibi karanyorekane ogotagora enyomba ase okoiba, nere aitwe akwe: omonto oria omoita takobarerwa oboiti obwo. Korende onye nigo amoita kobwakiire, rirorio nigo arabarerwe oboiti obwo.

“Omonto kararisie etugo yaye ase omogondo bw’endagera, gose oyo bw’emesabibu, na gotiga riicho riaye ririe endagera y’omonto onde, nere goika aakane endagera enoru korwa ase omogondo oye, gose eyere engiya korwa ase emesabibu yaye.
“Onye omonto ogosamba omorero, na omorero oyio bwesiarere gochia ase amagwa, na emesaima y’endagera ere ase omogondo eyie, omonto oria goika aakane yonsi pi.
“Omonto karae omoiri oye chibesa, gose ebinto binde biaye amogachere, na birobio biibwe korwa nyomba mwaye, omoibi karanyorekane goika aakane ara kabere.
Korende atanyorekaneti, erio oria omonyene enyomba arentwe ase obosio bwa Nyasae, erinde amanywe gose nere obiibete.

“Eriomana rinde rionsi riise gotuboka, onye igoro y’eng’ombe, gose etigere, gose eng’ondi, gose eanga, gose gento kende gionsi kerasire, na omonto oyomo aamererie ng’a nekiaye, ekina ekio ki’abanto abwo babere nigo kerarentwe ase obosio bwa Nyasae. Ere oyo Nyasae araorokie ng’a nomomochi, goika aakane oria onde ara kabere.
“Omonto karae omoiri oye etigere, gose eng’ombe, gose eng’ondi, gose etugo ende yonsi ebe sagare, na etugo eria eitwe gose eakwe, gose eirwe monto tarora,
omoiri oria goika atiane ase Omonene ng’a takuneti enibo aetwe sagare. Omonyene etugo eria goika anche ng’a ayio atianwa namaene, na tagoakanwa.
Korende onye nigo yaibwa korwa asare ere goika aakane omonyene oria.
Onye yariegwa nenyang’au, arente chinyama chintigari chibe kirori, taakana ase eye enyang’au yaitete.
“Omonto karasabe na koegwa etugo sagare korwa ase omoiri oye, na etugo eyio keraakwe gose ekwe, na omonyene tayerochi, omonto oria goika ayeakane.
Onye omonyene oria ore aroro ekero egoakwa gose egokwa, rirorio tagoakanwa. Onye etugo eyio egochia goakanerwa, ogoakanerwa okwo kobe kogoisanera ogosirerwa okwo.”
“Omonto karamogenke na gosaria omoiseke omwekungi otararierwa boko, goika aakane enibo eraisane amonyuome.
Korende onye ise omoiseke okwanga, tamomoa, omonto oyio goika aakane chibesa chireng’aine rigori ri’omoiseke omwekungi.
“Totiga omokungu omorogi abe moyo.
“Omonto orarare neng’iti goika aitwe akwe.
“Omonto oraruere enyasae ende yonsi ekeng’wanso, otatiga Omonene bweka, goika asirigwe kegima.
“Tobaisa gokorera omomenyi bobe, gose komochegia, ekiagera nainwe abanyene mwarenge abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri.
Tochanda omoboraka onde bwensi, gose omwana entakana oyo abaibori baye bakure.
Oise kobachanda abwo, na barabwo kobararere asende, amaene, inche ninyigwe ekerero kiabo.
Endamwamu yane inayoke, na inche mbaite nomoro, na abakungu baino nababe ababoraka, na abana baino babe chintakana batari nabaise.
“Oise komoa singo omonto onde one omotaka ore ase egati yaino, tobaisa gokora buna abwo bakoa abanto singo na koboria ebitoki ebinge; tobaisa komoboria ebitoki.
“Onye kogosaba omonto onde egetambaa kiaye akwambara kebe intenenera, goika omokeiranerie erioba ritaragwa,

ekiagera nakio gioka abwate akwebisia. Eke nakio abwate gekomobekera riberera ase omobere oye. Inee! Otakemoeti, inki rende araraarere? Ere kararere asende, ekeene, nimoigwe, ekiagera inche nomonyamabera.
“Tobaisa korama Nyasae, gose koragereria omogambi bw’abanto bao.”
“Totebana kondetera ogotongora kwao kwe rigesa ri’endagera na eri’emesabibu. Ong’e omwana oo omomura omotangi ase abana bao, abe oyone.
Ong’e boigo chimori chintangi chie chiombe, ne chimanwa chintangi chie ching’ondi. Ochitige chikoore amatuko atano na abere, ko rituko ria gatano na gatato ochindetere.
“Mobe abanto baane abachenu; timobaisa koria eng’iti ende yonsi eyaitirwe nenyang’au ase orosana, motugutere chisese chinyama echio.”
“Tobaisa gosiarera oborimo. Tobaisa gokengera omokori amabe ase okomobera kirori bw’oborimo.
Tobaisa koba ensemo y’abare abange kobarigetie gokora amabe, gose tobaisa kobakorera abwo bare abange ogwanchereria na gotanga oboronge ase okoba kirori bw’okoonchorana oboronge.
Tobaisa gwanchereria omonto omotaka ase ekina kiaye.
“Oise korora eng’ombe y’omobisa oo gose etigere yaye egosira goika omoyeiranerie.
Korarore etigere y’oyo okogechete yagure negurube ebogoretie, tobaisa koyeetania, korende oyekonye.
“Tobaisa korina omonto omotaka oboronge bwaye, ekero ekina kiaye gekogambwa.
Bwetange kegima korwa ase oborimo. Tobaisa kogera omonto omoronge aitwe, ekiagera inche Omonene tingotiga koa omomochi egesusuro.
Tobaisa gwancha oegwe riaaki, ekiagera riaaki nigo rikoukoria omonto erinde takorora ayare boronge; naende nigo rigosaria ekina ki’abanyene oboronge.
“Tobaisa gokorera omomenyi bobe, naki inwe momanyete buna omomenyi akoigwa ase enkoro yaye, ekiagera nainwe abanyene mwarenge abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri.”
“Ase emiaka etano nomo osimeke na kobusura endagera, na ogese ebiamire,

korende omwaka o gatano na kabere otige omogondo otimoke, toremwa. Ebirakine na kwama ase omogondo obitigere abataka, na ebi baratigarie bibe endagera ye ching’iti chi’orosana. Okore boigo nomogondo oo bw’emesabibu na oyo bw’emezeituni.

“Ase amatuko atano na rimo okore emeremo yao, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere otimoke, na eng’ombe yao na etigere yao nachirochio chitimoke; naboigo nomosomba oo omomura oiboreire bwoo, na omomenyi oo, nabarabwo batimoke.”
“Motegerere mono onsi aya nabatebirie na moyabwate. Timwatora amarieta e chinyasae chinde; ayio taigugwa korwa ase emenwa yaino.”
“Kera omwaka nobe kogontwarera Amatuko Amanene ara gatato.

Goika orende Rituko Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera. Na buna nagochigete orie emegati etabekiri memera ase amatuko atano na abere, ase engaki eria yabegetwe ase omotienyi bw’Abibu, ekiagera omotienyi oyio noro kwaruete Misiri. Na monto onde tabaisa gocha ase obosio bwane namaboko amasa.

“Naende goika orende Rituko Rinene rie Rigesa ekero okogesa ogotongora gw’okwama kw’omogondo oo gwasimegete na ogakora emeremo. “Orende boigo Rituko Rinene ri’Ogosangereria Rigesa ri’omoerio bw’omwaka ekero ogosangereria okwama kw’emeremo yao emekong’u gwakorete.
Ara gatato kera omwaka abanto bao abasacha babe bagocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene Nyasae.
“Tobaisa kondetera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso amo nomogati obekire ememera. Ebitinya bie chinyama echi nkoruerwa ekeng’wanso ase rituko riane rinene, tibitigara goika mambia.
“Goika orente ogotongora okore okuya korwa ase omogondo oo, ase enyomba yane inche Omonene Nyasae oo. “Tobaisa koiyekera emanwa y’embori ime y’amabeere ’eng’ina.”
“Nintome omomalaika agotang’ane na gokorenda ase enchera, agoikie aase aria nakoroiseirie.
Mwerende ase obosio bwaye, oigwere aya aragotebie. Tobaisa kwanga komoigwera, ekiagera erieta riane nigo rire ime yaye, ere takomororera amabera oyoramoche koigwera.
Korende koramoigwere ere, na gokora ayio onsi nakwanire inche, rirorio nindwanie ababisa bao, ninchande abwo bakogochanda.
Naki omomalaika one nagotang’ane akoire na kogoikia ase ense y’Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abakanani, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, na inche nimbasirie.
Tosasima chinyasae chiabo, gose gochikorera; na tokora buna abanto abwo bagokora, korende osirie kegima emegwekano yabo y’ogosasimwa na moyaiyerie inse amagena abo onsi are aase bagosasimera.
Momokorere Omonene Nyasae oino, na inche ninsesenie endagera yaino na amache aino, nindusie amarwaire asemore.
Ase ense yaino mokungu onde tari oborito bwaye boragwe, gose onde takoba omogomba; nimbae obogima obotambe.
“Nintang’anie okwoboyia kwane bosio bwao goichanie na gotantania abanto bonsi abwo morabe mokoumerana nabarabwo; ninkore ababisa bao bonsi baonchoke batame korwa asore.
Nintome ebiaramba birase na goseria Abahivi, na Abakanani, na Abahiti, korwa ase Kanani bosio bwao.
Tinkobaseria ase omwaka oyomo, ense ebaise koba bosa, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chimenteke chigochande.
Nigo ndabaserie ng’ora ng’ora goika momenteke moisane komenya ense eyio.

Inche ninkobekere orobebe rwao gochakera Enyancha Embariri goikera Enyancha y’Abafilisti, naende korwa ase erooro goika orooche rwa Eufarati, ekiagera nimbeke ababiare b’ense eyio ase amaboko aino, na inwe mobaserie, batame korwa asemore.
Tobaisa gokora okobwatana konde gwonsi nabarabwo, gose ne chinyasae chiabo.
Barabwo tibamenya ase ense yao, babaise kogera onkorere ebibe. Onye kogokorera chinyasae chiabo, chirochio nachinyare kogotega.”
Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Tiira gocha aa asende, aye amo na Haroni, na Nadabu, na Abihu, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli emerongo etano na ebere. Mobeere aare ake, motung’ame inse monsasime.
Naye Musa bweka orachiche ong’ike ang’e, korende abwo bande tibang’ika ang’e. Na abanto barabwo tibachicha amo naye nonya ng’ake.”
Musa akagenda agatebia abanto amang’ana onsi aya Omonene akwanete, na amachiko aye onsi. Abanto bonsi bakamoiraneria ase eriogi erimo, bakabora, “Amang’ana ayio onsi Omonene akwanire inatoyakore.”
Erio Musa akarika amachiko onsi ay’Omonene. Akaimoka mambia chuni, akaagacha egesasimero egetunwa mbarabare, agatenenia amagena ikomi na abere abe ekeinyorio ki’ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli.
Agatoma abamura b’Abaisraeli barue ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, banyenyere Omonene chieri chi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.
Musa akabogoria ekeng’ese ki’amanyinga aya, akayabeka egetaabo ime, na ekeng’ese kende akanyororokeria egesasimero.
Erio akaimokia ebuku y’okobwatana kw’ogotianania agasomera abanto baigwe. Barabwo bakabora, “Natoyakore onsi aya Omonene akwanire, na tomoigwere.”
Musa akaimokia amanyinga aria arenge egetaabo ime, akanyororokeria abanto, akabora, “Aya namanyinga ’okobwatana okwo Omonene akorire ase ogotianania nainwe ase okobaa amachiko aya onsi.”
Erio Musa, na Haroni, na Nadabu, na Abihu, na abagaaka baria emerongo etano na ebere b’Abaisraeli bagatiira gochia egetunwa igoro,
bakarora Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Inse y’amagoro aye nigo arenge buna amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro, are nobokenonoku buna obore igoro.
Omonene tarambora okoboko kwaye kobakorera bobe abagaaka baria b’Abaisraeli. Barabwo kobarorire Nyasae, bakaria na konywa.
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Tiira gocha aa asende egetunwa igoro, obeere aiga, na inche nkoe chibao chi’amagena chire namachiko onsi aya narikireo, ayio ogochia kworokereria abanto.”
Musa akaimoka amo nomosomba oye Yoshua, agatiira gochia egetunwa kia Nyasae.
Agatebia abagaaka baria, “Motoganye aiga goika ekero torairane asemore. Rora Haroni na Huri nao bare aiga amo nainwe; onye omonto ore nobokong’u bonde, agende ababorie.”
Erio Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, ne riire rikagetuba.
Obonene bw’Omonene bogacha bokabeera igoro y’egetunwa gia Sinai, ne riire rikagetuba ase engaki y’amatuko atano na rimo. Rituko ria gatano na kabere Omonene akarangeria Musa korwa riire ime.
Ase Abaisraeli obonene bokarorekana buna omorero ogosiria, ase egetunwa igoro.
Musa agasoa riire ime, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, akabeera aroro ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko.
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Batebie Abaisraeli ng’a bandetere ebiegwa; aye obisangererie korwa ase kera omonto oyoranche kobirua asende.
Na ebiegwa orasangererie korwa asebare nabio ebi: chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai;
chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri; egatani engiya na amanya e chimbori;
amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, na amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, ne chibao chi’emekonge;
amaguta e chitaya, na ebinto bi’okoroisia amaguta akweakwa, na ebi’okoroisia ubani;
amagena e rigori rinene, buna oiniki na ayande, akobekwa ase egesibao ki’omokuani na ase egesembe kiaye.
Obatebie bandoiserie Obomenyo Obochenu, na inche inyare komenya ase egati yabo.
Mondoiserie Obomenyo na ebinto bionsi ebirabeo, buna ndakworokie.”

“Mondoiserie Esanduku ye chibao chi’omokonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
Oyeoome netahabu echenire ime na isiko, oyeetananie omong’ororia bw’etahabu.
Okore chibonyi inye chie chitahabu chinyititoire, ochibeke ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera rikere.
Obaache emiaro ebere y’emekonge, oyeoome netahabu.
Osoyie emiaro eyio ase chibonyi ime ase okobogoreria Esanduku eria.
Emiaro eyio goika ebe ime ase chibonyi echio, terusigwao.
Ime y’Esanduku eria obeke chibao echi chirikire oborori, echi ndakoe.”
“Oroisie ekemumeko gi’etahabu echenire kebe Oboikaranso bw’Amabera. Obotambe bwaye bobe ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
Naende okore emegwekano y’abakerubi babere ey’etahabu esunyuntire, oyebeke ase chinsinyo ibere chi’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera,
oyomo ase kera ensinyo. Oyekore ebe egento ekemo n’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera.
Abakerubi abwo barambore chimbaba chiabo igoro y’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera, babobekere ekiriri, na amasio abo abe achikaine, na barabwo barigererie Oboikaranso bw’Amabera.
Oterekerere Oboikaranso bw’Amabera igoro y’Esanduku eria. Erio obeke imeo chibao echi chirikire oborori, echi ndakoe.

Agwo ninchiche ng’umerane naye. Korwa igoro y’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera, gati‐gati y’abakerubi aba babere bare igoro y’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, nimbe ngokwana naye igoro y’amachiko aya ngochia koa Abaisraeli goetera asore.”
“Oroisie emesa ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
Oyeoome netahabu echenire, oyeetananie omong’ororia bw’etahabu.
Erio obeke orosingo robe nobogare bong’ana egesanyi gi’okoboko, na oroetananie omong’ororia bw’etahabu.
Okore chibonyi inye chie chitahabu ase emesa eria, ochibeke ase chikoona inye ase amagoro aye,
ang’e norosingo; na emiaro esoigwe imeo, erinde emesa enyare kobogorerigwa.
Obaache emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, oyeoome netahabu, nero emesa erabogorerigwe.
Oroisie chinteru na ebitaabo ase ubani, ne chisani, korwa ase ebio bagocha koumora ebinyugwa ebikoruegwa. Obiroisie bionsi korwa ase chitahabu chichenire.
Ase emesa eyio obeke emegati erabe ekoruegwa asende, imbe nkoyerora botambe.”
“Oroisie ekebekerero gie chitaya gi’etahabu echenire esunyuntire, okeroisie na enterekerero amo ne ritina na emegwekano y’amamumu na ebisicha, bionsi bibe egento ekemo.
Chinsagia isano nemo chibe chigosoka korwa ase ritina, isato korwa ase ensemo eyemo, na isato korwa ase ensemo ende.

Orosagia rwe ritang’ani robe nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo kebe ne rimumu na egesicha, na orosagia rwa kabere boigo robe nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi; ne chinsagia chionsi isano nemo chibe boigo.
Ritina rinyene ri’ekebekerero keria ribe nemegwekano ene y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo kebe ne rimumu na egesicha.
Rimumu erimo ribe inse ya kera chinsagia ibere chigosoka korwa ase ritina. Ase ayio amamumu abe inse ye chinsagia echio isano nemo, chiroisigwe chibe egento ekemo ne ritina.
Amamumu ayio amo ne chinsagia biroisigwe bibe egento ekemo ne ritina, bionsi biroisigwe korwa ase ribomba erimo ri’etahabu echenire esunyuntire.
“Oroisie chitaya isano na ibere, ochibeke igoro y’ekebekerero keria, erinde chimoreke gochia bosio.
Ebinachi ne chindogio chiaye biroisigwe korwa ase chitahabu chichenire.
Okorere chitahabu chichenire chikiro emerongo etano ase okoroisia ekebekerero gie chitaya amo nebikorero biaye.
Origererie buya obikore buna nakworogetie ase egetunwa.”

“Oroisie eema y’Obomenyo nebitambaa ikomi biroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani chisisire amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri. Omoroisia omong’aini abiroisie bibe nemegwekano y’abakerubi.
Obotambe bwa kera egetambaa bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, na atano na atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Ebitambaa ebio bionsi bibe bi’ekerengo ekemo.
Ebitambaa bitano bibwatanigwe bibe rirondia erimo. Naboigo nebitambaa binde bitano.
Okore ebioro bie chiusi chiburu, obibeke ase ensinyo y’egetambaa eke kere ensinyo y’ensemo eyemo ya kera rirondia.
Okore ebioro emerongo etano, obibeke ase egetambaa kegochakera rirondia rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase egetambaa kegokoorera rirondia ria kabere. Ebioro bia kera rirondia bibe bichikaine.
Oture ebigobanio bie chitahabu emerongo etano, obwateranie amarondia ayio abere amo, ebe eema eyemo y’Obomenyo.
“Oroisie amarondia ikomi na rimo ay’amanya e chimbori, abe eema y’ogotuba Obomenyo obwo.
Obotambe bwa kera rirondia bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Amarondia onsi ikomi na rimo abe ay’ekerengo ekemo.
Obwatanie amarondia atano amo, na amarondia ande atano na rimo oyabwateranie ao. Erio oringe erimo rirondia ria gatano na rimo igoro y’egesoero ki’eema.
Okore ebioro emerongo etano, obibeke ase ensinyo ye rirondia rinene rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase rirondia rinene ria kabere rigochakera.
Oture ebigobanio emerongo etano bi’etaai ase ebioro biria, obwatanerie amarondia ayio abere abe eema eyemo engima.
Ekeng’ese kie rirondia riria kementire kebekwe gesung’unane, getube magega y’Obomenyo.
Ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo kie rirondia keringwe, getube Obomenyo ase kera rikere riaye.
“Oroisie rirondia ri’amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, ribe rigotuba eema, ne rirondia rinde ri’amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, ribe rikobekwa igoro ye rirondia rie ritang’ani.
“Oroisie chibao chi’emekonge ase Obomenyo, echio chiratenenigwe.
Obotambe bwa kera ebao bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
Okore chintamang’o ibere ase kera ebao, ase chibao echio chirabwatanerigwe. Naboigo oranyare koroisia chibao chionsi chi’Obomenyo.
Koraroisie chibao echio, oroisie emerongo ebere ase ensemo ya irianyi.
Oroisie ne chinterekerero chie chifeta emerongo ene, chibe ibere ibere ase kera ebao ase okobwaterania chintamang’o chiaye ibere.
Ase ensemo ya sugusu y’Obomenyo oroisie chibao emerongo ebere,
amo ne chinterekerero chie chifeta emerongo ene, ibere ibere ase kera ebao.
Ase ensemo ya nyuma y’Obomenyo eyerochie bosongo, oroisie chibao isano nemo,
naende chibao ibere chie chikoona chi’Obomenyo ensemo ya nyuma.
Kera ebao ase echio ibere ebwatanigwe ne chibao chie chinsinyo, korwa inse goika igoro ase ebonyi entang’ani ere. Ase enchera eyio chibao ibere chibekwe ase chikoona ibere.
Chibao chionsi nigo chirabe isano na isato, ne chinterekerero chiabo chie chifeta ikomi na isano nemo, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.
“Obaache emeriibo ye chibao chi’emekonge, etano ase okoriiba chibao chie rikere erimo ri’Obomenyo,
na etano ase okoriiba chibao chie rikere rinde, na etano y’ensemo ya nyuma, eyerochie bosongo.
Omoriibo o gati‐gati obekwe omogima, oriibe korwa ensinyo eyemo goika eyende.
Oome chibao echio netahabu na okore chibonyi chie chitahabu ase emeriibo erasoigwe, na emeriibo eria oyeoome netahabu.
Otenenie Obomenyo obwo buna nakworogetie ase egetunwa.
“Oroisie etoto ye chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya, chisisire. Omoroisia omong’aini ayeroisie ebe nemegwekano y’abakerubi.
Osunge etoto eria y’egetambaa ase chisiiro inye chi’emekonge chioomire netahabu, chire nebigobanio bie chitahabu, chiratenene ase chinterekerero inye chie chifeta.
Osunge etoto eria inse y’ebigobanio, obeke Esanduku eyere ne chibao chirikire oborori moino y’etoto. Etoto eria yaatanane Aase Aachenu korwa ase Aase Aachenu Mono.
Erio obeke Oboikaranso bw’Amabera igoro y’Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire oborori ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono.
Obeke emesa isiko y’etoto ensemo ya sugusu, na ekebekerero gie chitaya ensemo ya irianyi, ase Obomenyo ime.

Naende ase egesoero ki’eema oroisie egetambaa korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, buna omoroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia.

Naende obaache chisiiro isano chi’emekonge ase ogosunga egetambaa ekio, ochioome netahabu; oture ebigobanio bie chitaai. Okore chinterekerero inye chie chitaai chinyititoire, chibe ase chisiiro echio.”

“Oagache egesasimero gie chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano, nabo chinsemo chionsi inye chibe chireng’aine; na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atato.
Ase chikoona inye chi’egesasimero oroisie emegwekano ye chingunchara inye. Chingunchara echio nigo chirabe egento ekemo negesasimero; oome gionsi netaai.
Okore chindogio chi’okobuucha ribu korwa ase egesasimero. Naende okore ebichiko, na ebitaabo, ne chigami, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero. Ebinto ebi bionsi biroisigwe korwa ase chitaai.
Okore boigo egechungi gi’etaai na obeke chibonyi inye chie chitaai ase chikoona chiaye inye.
Obeke egechungi eke korwa inse y’orosingo geike gochia gati‐gati y’egesasimero.
Obaache emiaro y’emekonge ase egesasimero ekio, oyeoome netaai.
Oyesoyie ase chibonyi echio chie chinsemo ibere chi’egesasimero, ebeo ekero gekobogorigwa.
Egesasimero keagachwe ne chibao, ime getigwe giasaime. Okeroisie buna kworogetigwe ase egetunwa.”
“Oroisie eraaro y’Obomenyo. Ase ensemo ya irianyi oroisie ebitambaa bie chiusi chindabu chi’egatani chisisire, bibe ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, bibe bigokenga eraaro ensemo eyemo.
Chisiiro chikobibwata chibe emerongo ebere chie chitaai, ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai. Ebigobanio bie chisiiro chiria ne chinuga chiabo chibe chie chifeta.

Naboigo ase ensemo ya sugusu oroisie ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, bisiirwe ne chisiiro emerongo ebere, ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai. Ebigobanio amo ne chinuga chiabo bibe bie chifeta.
Ase obogare bw’eraaro ensemo ya bosongo oroisie ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano, ne chisiiro ikomi, amo ne chinterekerero chiabo ikomi.
Obogare bw’ensemo ya bosio, erochie moocha, bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano.
Ase ensemo eyemo y’egesoero bibe ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, bisiirwe ne chisiiro isato ne chinterekerero chiabo isato.
Naboigo nensemo ende y’egesoero bibekwe ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, bisiirwe ne chisiiro isato, amo ne chinterekerero chiaye isato.

Na ase egesoero oroisie egetambaa gi’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, ebe emeremo y’omoroisia omong’aini. Egetambaa ekio gesiirwe ne chisiiro inye ne chinterekerero chiabo inye.
Chisiiro chionsi echietanaine eraaro nigo chirabe ne chinuga na ebigobanio bie chifeta, ne chinterekerero chiabo chibe chie chitaai.

Obotambe bw’eraaro eyio bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano. Egetambaa keria geetanaine eraaro kebe nobotambe gochia igoro bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano na keroisigwe ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire. Chinterekerero chi’eraaro chibe echie chitaai.
Ebikorero bi’Obomenyo ebirabe bigokorerwa ase emeremo ende yonsi, amo nebirochi bi’ebitambaa na ebi’eraaro bionsi, nigo birabe ebie chitaai.”
“Ochike Abaisraeli barente amaguta amaya, amitire korwa ase amazeituni, akobekwa ase chitaya kera rituko, chibe chikogenderera gwoka botambe.

Ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, isiko y’etoto eria ekengete aase chibao chirikire oborori chibekire, Haroni na abamura baye inababe bakorenda chitaya chiria chigwoka korwa mogoroba goika mambia, ase obosio bw’Omonene. Okwo nigo korabe ogochika ase Abaisraeli ebiaare ase ebiaare.”

“Orangerie Haroni, momura omino, amo nabamura baye korwa ase Abaisraeli, bache ase obosio bwao, babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani, ere Haroni amo nabamura baye Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.
Oroiserie Haroni, momura omino, chianga chinchenu chi’obonene na echi’oboseera.
Otebie abaroisia abang’aini, abwo naeire obong’aini ne chisemi, baroiserie Haroni chianga, erinde aatananwe abe ogonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.

Ne chianga baramoroiserie nachio echi: Egesembe ki’obokuani, na egesibao ki’obokuani, na eganchwa, na eganchwa ende erobekanirie egoika inse, na ekegogwa, na orokini. Bakorere Haroni amo nabamura baye chianga chinchenu, erio babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.
Nabwo abaroisia bachiroisie korwa ase chiusi chie chitahabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya.
“Bakore egesibao ki’obokuani korwa ase chiusi chie chitahabu na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire; keroisigwe nomoroisia omong’aini.
Egesibao ekio ki’obokuani kebe nebitwanga bibere bi’amareko, aase gekobwateranigwa.

Orokini rw’okobwataneria egesibao ekio amo robe rw’egetambaa keria ki’egesibao, keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chie chitahabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.
Orente amagena abere a oiniki, na ase amagena ayio omang’ere amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli:
amarieta atano na rimo ase rigena erimo, na atano na rimo ase rigena rinde, ase omoroberio bw’okoiborwa kwabo.
Ase chisemi chi’omoroisia omanyete buya gotura na komang’a ekemanyererio, omang’e amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli ase amagena aria abere. Erio obeke amagena aria ase ebikonde bie chitahabu.

Oyabeke ase ebitwang’a bi’amareko bi’egesibao keria ki’obokuani, abe ase okoinyora abamura ba Israeli. Naboigo Haroni abogorie amarieta abo ase amareko aye abere, abe ekeinyorio ase obosio bw’Omonene botambe.
Oture ebikonde bibere bi’etahabu,
na okore ebichanga bibere bie chitahabu chichenire, bisisire buna engori, bibwatanigwe nebikonde biria.

“Oroisie egesembe gi’ekina ase omokuani. Omoroisia omong’aini akeroisie ase egetambaa kere buna eki’egesibao ki’obokuani, korwa ase chiusi chie chitahabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.
Egesembe keria kebe keringire rimo. Obotambe bwaye bobe chisentimita emerongo ebere, na ibere, na obogare bwaye boigo.
Obeke emeng’ororia ene y’amagena e rigori rinene ase egesembe keria. Ase omong’ororia bwe ritang’ani obeke saridio, na topasio, na sumaridi;
na ase oyo o kabere alimasi, na safiro, na yasipi;
na ase oyo o gatato hiakinto, na agati, na ametisito;
na ase oyo o kane kurusolito, na oiniki, na berulo. Amagena ayio onsi abekwe ase ebikonde bie chitahabu.

Amagena ayio nigo arabe ikomi na abere, abe namarieta ’abamura ba Israeli. Amarieta ayio amang’erwe buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio. Kera rigena ribe nerieta ri’egesaku ekemo ki’ebisaku biabo ikomi na bibere.
Okore ebichanga bie chitahabu chichenire bisisire, bibekwe ase egesembe keria.
Okore boigo chibonyi ibere chi’etahabu, ochibeke ase emego ya igoro y’egesembe keria.
Osiberanie ebichanga ebi bibere bie chitahabu ase chibonyi chi’emego ya igoro y’egesembe keria.
Chinsinyo chinde chi’ebichanga biria bibere ochisiberanie nebikonde biria bibere, naende obibwateranie bionsi ase ebitwanga bi’amareko bire bosio ase egesibao ki’obokuani.
Okore chibonyi chinde ibere chie chitahabu, ochibeke ase egesembe keria ase emego ebere ya inse korwa nyuma, echigete egesibao.
Naende okore chibonyi chinde ibere chie chitahabu, ochibwateranie ase ebitwanga biria bibere bi’amareko bi’egesibao bire bosio, ang’e nomobarero, igoro y’orokini rw’egesibao.
Chibonyi chiria chibekire ase egesembe chibwateranigwe ne chibonyi chi’egesibao neusi eburu; erio egesembe keria kebeere orokini igoro, tigecha gosuka.
Naboigo Haroni arabogorie amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli ase egesembe keria gi’ekina igoro y’enkoro yaye ekero agosoa ime y’Aase Aachenu, ayarente abe ekeinyorio botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.

“Obeke Urimu na Tumimu (engencho yaye omobaso na oboikeranu) ime y’egesembe gi’ekina bibe igoro y’enkoro ya Haroni, ekero akogenda ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ekero Haroni are ase obosio bw’Omonene abogorie ekiorokererio gi’ekina botambe ase engencho y’Abaisraeli.”
“Okore eganchwa korwa ase egetambaa keroisirie ne chiusi chire buru chioka.
Obochore engoro gati gati, ase omotwe ogosoera, oyebeke ekenario buna egi’esati, techa gotandoka.

Okore emegwekano y’amatunda e rikomomanga korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, oyebeke eetanane omoringero o inse. Ase egati ya kera omogwekano bwe rikomomanga obeke chindege chie chitahabu.
Naboigo ebe emegwekano ye rikomomanga bwateranie ne chindege chie chitahabu bietanane omoringero o inse bw’eganchwa.
Haroni goika ayebeke ekero agokora emeremo y’obokuani, na eriogi rie chindege chiria riigweke ekero agosoa Aase Aachenu ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ekero agosoka, tabaisa gokwa.
“Okore ebao y’etahabu echenire, na buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio omang’ere amang’ana ayio:” “Achenirwe ase Omonene”.
Oyesiberanie bosio bw’ekegogwa ne chiusi chire buru.

Haroni ayebogorie ase obosio bwaye igoro. Ase igo abogoreranie na korusia amamocho are nebiegwa ebiraatananwe, ebi Abaisraeli barabe bakoruera Omonene. Haroni nigo arabe okoyebogoria botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
“Oroisie eganchwa entambe amo nekegogwa korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya, na orokini rwe chiusi chire ne chirangi ao ao.
“Erio oroiserie abamura ba Haroni chiganchwa, ne chinkini; naende obaroiserie ebigogwa emechoro bi’ogosika na ebi’oboseera:
Obekere Haroni, momura omino, amo nabamura baye, chianga echio. Erio obaake amaguta, obaatanane na kobachena, babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.
Obaroiserie chisirwari chi’egatani, chigoika amariagati abo, chibe chigotuba obogetirianda bwabo.

Haroni na abamura baye goika bachibeke botambe ekero bagosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano, gose kobakogenda ase egesasimero gokora emeremo y’obokuani Aase Aachenu ime, tibabaisa kwerentera okomocha na gokwa. Oko nogochika koragenderere ase Haroni na ororeria rwaye.”
“Aya naro orakore ase Haroni na abamura baye ase okobaatanana, babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani: Orusie eeri ensae ne chimingichi ibere chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
Orusie boigo emegati etabekiri memera na amaandasi atabekiri memera, biroisirie namaguta, na emegati emeoo eakire amaguta. Emegati eyio yonsi eroisigwe korwa ase obosie obonuke bw’engano.
Oyebeke ase egetonga, oyendetere ebe egetonga ime ekero okondetera ekeng’wanso ki’eeri na egie chimingichi chiria ibere.
“Erio orente Haroni amo nabamura baye ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, obasibie namache.
Oimokie chianga chiria, obekere Haroni: Eganchwa erobekanirie egoika inse, na eganchwa eria ende, na egesibao ki’obokuani na egesembe keria; omoboerie norokini rw’egesibao.
Omobekere na ekegogwa omotwe oye, na ase ekegogwa eke osiberanie ekemanyererio keria egechenu gekoorokia ng’a bwatananirwe.
Erio oimokie amaguta akweakwa, omonyororokerie ase omotwe oye, omoyaake.
“Orente na abamura baye, obabekere chianga.

Obaboerie chinkini ebinema biabo, Haroni na abamura baye, na obabekere ebigogwa emetwe yabo. Ase enchera eyio bwatanane Haroni amo nabamura baye babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani kogenderera botambe.
“Orente eeri bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano; Haroni na abamura baye babeke amaboko abo ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio.
Erio oyenyenyere ase obosio bw’Omonene ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
Oimokie amanyinga make, erinde ogindie nekiara kiao emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero. Na amanyinga amatigari oyaumore inse ase egesasimero.
Orusie ebitinya biria bitubete chinyama chi’enda; naboigo nebi’eriini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, amo nebitinya bichitubete; obisambere ase egesasimero igoro.
Korende chinyama chi’eeri eyio, ne risankwa, na eubi yonsi y’enda obisambere isiko y’egetwori. Ekio nekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe.
“Orente emingichi eyemo ase echio ibere, na Haroni na abamura baye babeke amaboko abo ase omotwe oye.
Erio oyenyenye na oitorore amanyinga aye ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
Onache chinyama chi’emingichi eria chibe ebing’ese; osibie chinyama chi’enda eria amo nebirenge, na obibeke igoro y’ebing’ese biria na omotwe oye.
Osambere chinyama echi chionsi chi’emingichi ase egesasimero igoro. Eke nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene, ekeng’wanso ki’omorero kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
“Erio orente emingichi eria ende, na Haroni na abamura baye babeke amaboko abo ase omotwe oye.

Nyuma y’ayio oyenyenye, orusie amanyinga make, na ase amanyinga ayio ogindie mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kwa Haroni amo na mesia y’amato ’abamura baye; ogindie boigo ebiara ebinene bi’amaboko abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amagoro abo a borio. Oitorore amanyinga amatigari ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.

Orusie amanyinga make ayare ase egesasimero, na amaguta ayio akweakwa, onyororokerie Haroni ne chianga chiaye, na abamura baye, ne chianga chiabo. Naboigo Haroni na abamura baye baatananwe ase emeremo emechenu, amo ne chianga chiabo.

“Orusie ebitinya bi’emingichi eyio, na omokera oye ore omonoru, na ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, na ebi’eriini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete, na ebachwa ya borio, ekiagera emingichi eyio nigo yarurwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu.
Orusie omogati oyomo, ne rindasi erimo riroisirie namaguta, na omogati oyomo omoo, ebio bitabekiri memera, bire ase egetonga ime, bibekire ase obosio bw’Omonene.
Ebi bionsi obibeke ase amaboko a Haroni amo nay’abamura baye, obisungusie bibe okoruegwa ase Omonene.
Erio obirusie ase amaboko abo, obisambere ase egesasimero igoro y’ekeng’wanso keria kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene. Eke nekeng’wanso ki’omorero.
“Obogorie ritaana ri’emingichi eyio yarurwe ase ogwatanana Haroni, orisungusie ribe okoruegwa ase Omonene. Nerio naribe eriao, erigotungetie korwa ase eng’iti eyio.
“Naboigo oraatanane ritaana ri’emingichi eyio yarurwe ekeng’wanso amo nekenama kiaye, ebitari ebio bi’emingichi eyio bibe ebitungetie Haroni amo nabamura baye.
Ebi nigo birabe bitungetie Haroni amo nabamura baye kogenderera botambe korwa ase Abaisraeli, bibe ekeegwa ki’Omonene korwa asebare, ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’omorembe.
“Chianga chiria chinchenu chia Haroni nigo chiraegwe ab’ororeria rwaye nyuma gakure, bachieboyie ekero bagochia goakwa amaguta na gwatananwa.

Omomura o Haroni, oyorabogorie emeremo y’obokuani ase ribaga riaye, goika eboyie chianga echi engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, ekero agochia gosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano na gokora emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu.
“Oire emingichi eria yarurwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu, oiyekere chinyama chiaye aase aatananire.
