Agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, Haroni na abamura baye barie chinyama chi’emingichi eria amo nemegati ere ase egetonga ime.
Barabwo barie ebinto ebi biarurwe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ekero baatananetwe ase emeremo emechenu. Monto onde omoao takoba ne ribaga ri’okobiria, ekiagera ebinto ebi nebichenu.
Onye chinyama gose emegati bigotigara goika mambia, erio obisambe nomorero; tibibaisa koriegwa, ekiagera nebichenu.
“Naboigo orakorere Haroni amo nabamura baye koreng’ana buna nagochikire. Ogwatananwa kwabo kobe gokogenderera ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

Kera rituko orue eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa. Ase okorua ekeng’wanso ase okobwatanigwa nigo orabe kogochena egesasimero. Erio ogeake amaguta na kogiatanana ase emeremo emechenu.
Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere obe gokogenderera gokora okobwatanigwa ase egesasimero na kogechena mono; na kera egento kerabe gekogekuna, nigo kerabe egechenu.”
“Na ebing’wanso orabe gokorua igoro ase egesasimero nabio ebi: Kera rituko botambe, orue chimanwa ibere chie ching’ondi echiakoorire omwaka oyomo.
Emanwa eyemo y’echio oyerue mambia na eria ende mogoroba.

Amo nemanwa eria entang’ani orue ebimunu bibere bi’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta amaya, egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, amitire korwa ase amazeituni. Naende goika orue edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese ebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa.
Emanwa eria ende oyerue mogoroba; oyerue amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa, buna gwakorete mambia, kobe ekeng’wanso ki’omorero kebe ne rimisu rigiya ase Omonene.

Ekeng’wanso eke ki’ogosambwa kebe gekoruegwa ebiaare ase ebiaare botambe agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene. Agwo ndabe nkoumerana nainwe, naende nkwane naye.
Agwo ning’umerane n’Abaisraeli, na aase agwo ning’akore abe aachenu nobonene bwane.
Ninchene Eema y’Omosangererekano amo negesasimero; naboigo ninchene Haroni amo nabamura baye babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.
Inche nimenye ase egati y’Abaisraeli, imbe Nyasae obo.
Barabwo nabamanye ng’a inche ninche Nyasae obo; ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde imbe imenyete ase egati yabo. Inche ninche Nyasae obo.”
“Oroisie egesasimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ubani egosamberwa.

Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo; nabo chinsemo chiaye inye chibe chireng’aine; na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro bobe amaboko abere. Emegwekano yaye ye chingunchara nigo eraroisigwe ebe egento ekemo negesasimero.
Oyeoome netahabu echenire, igoro yaye, ne chinsemo chiaye inye, amo ne chingunchara chiaye; oyeetananie omong’ororia bw’etahabu.
Okore chibonyi ibere chie chitahabu ochibeke inse y’omong’ororia chinsemo ibere, na emiaro esoigwe imeo, erinde egesasimero kenyare kobogorerigwa.
Obaache emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, oyeoome netahabu.
Obeke egesasimero ekio bosio bw’etoto eria ekengete aase aria esanduku egachire, eria ere ne chibao chirikire oborori amo n’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera igoro yaye. Aase agwo ndabe nkoumerana naye.
Kera emambia ekero Haroni akoroisia chitaya nabe ogosambera agwo ubani egotioka buya,
naende ekero arabe ogwokia chitaya engaki ya mogoroba. Ogosambwa okwo kwa ubani nigo koragenderere botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene, ebiaare ase ebiaare.
Timobaisa gosamba ubani eye etachikiri, gose ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose timobaisa koumora okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa igoro yaye.

Ara rimo kera omwaka Haroni akore okobwatanigwa ase emegwekano ye chingunchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasimero. Naboigo ara rimo kera omwaka nakorere egesasimero okobwatanigwa namanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ayio nigo arakorerwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Egesasimero ekio nagiatananwe kebe egechenu mono ase Omonene.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Ekero orabe gokobara Abaisraeli ase okorikwa kwabo, kera omonto arue ekeegwa ase Omonene, kebe embooria ase obogima bwaye, tibabaisa konyora amaakwa ekero bakorikwa.
Ase igo, kera omonto oyorache korikwa goika arue ekeng’ese gi’esekeli ase ekerengo gi’esekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu, ebe ekeegwa ase Omonene. (Esekeli eyemo nechigera emerongo ebere.)
Kera omonto oyorarikwe, engencho yaye oyokoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, goika arue ekeegwa eke ase Omonene.
Oyore omonda takorua goetania ekeng’ese gi’esekeli, gose oyore omotaka takorua inse y’ekio, ekero morarue ekeegwa ekio ase Omonene. Kerokio kebe embooria ase obogima bwaino.

Koranyore chibesa echi Abaisraeli bararue chibe embooria, ochikorere ase emeremo y’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Ase igo Abaisraeli babe bakoinyorwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, naende chibesa echio chibe embooria ase obogima bwabo.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Oroisie egetuba gi’etaai amo nenterekerero yaye y’etaai. Okebeke egati y’Eema y’Omosangererekano na egesasimero, na obeke amache imeo.
Haroni na abamura baye bagwesibia amaboko na amagoro ase amache ayio.
Ekero bagosoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano goika besibie ase amache ayio, tibabaisa gokwa; naboigo ekero bakogenda ase egesasimero ase okoruera Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’omorero
Barabwo babe bagoisaba amaboko, basibie na amagoro, tibabaisa gokwa. Ayio nigo arabe ogochika koragenderere asare na ase ororeria rwaye ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
Naende Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Oimokie ebinto bigotioka buya: Amaguta a manemane chikiro ikomi, na omodalasini ore ne rimisu rigiya chikiro isano, na amanukato are ne rimisu rigiya chikiro isano,
na kasia chikiro ikomi. (Bionsi bibe bi’ekerengo kegokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu). Oimokie na amaguta ’emezeutini ebituba bine.
Ase ebinto ebio oroisie amaguta akweakwa ase chisemi chi’omoroisia omong’aini, abe amaguta amachenu akweakwa.
Oake Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori,
na emesa amo nebinto bireo, na ekebekerero gie chitaya amo nebikorero biaye, na egesasimero ase ubani egosamberwa,
na egesasimero ase ebing’wanso bigosamberwa amo nebikorero biaye, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye.
Naboigo oraatanane ebinto ebi, obikore ebichenu kegima, erio onde bwensi orabikune abe omochenu.
Haroni na abamura baye obaake amaguta na kobaatanana babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.
Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a amaguta aya akweakwa abe amachenu asende egati yaino ebiaare ase ebiaare.
Tabaisa goakwa ase emebere ya mwanyabanto. Timoroisia amaguta ande anga buna ayio. Ayio namachenu, nabe amachenu asemore.
Monto onde bwensi aise koroisia amaguta buna ayio gose koyaaka omonto omoao, oyotari omokuani, nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku kiaye.”

Omonene agatebia Musa, “Oimokie ebinto bigotioka buya: Oborembo bwa nafiti, na amaguta ’amakorogonte na oborembo bwa kalibani, na ebinto binde ebiansu, na ubani engiya; kera egento kebe gi’ekerengo ekemo.
Korwa ase ebinto ebio oroisie amanukato oyaroisie ase chisemi chi’omoroisia omong’aini ebekwe omonyo, abe amarabu achenire.
Orusie bike, erio obiswage bibe obosie. Obeke boke bosio bw’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, aase ndaumerane naye. Amanukato ayio abe amachenu mono asemore.
Timweroiseria amanukato ande onsi y’ogosambwa anga buna ayio. Abe asemore amachenu ase obosio bw’Omonene.
Monto onde bwensi aise koroisia amanukato anga buna ayio ase okwegokeria rimisu riaye nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku ki’abanto b’Omonene.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Rora, nachorire Besaleli, oyore mosinto o Uri, mochokoro o Huri, bw’egesaku kia Yuda.
Inche Nyasae namoichoirie omoika one, namoeire obong’aini ne chisemi amanye gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia,
abe oyomanyete koroberia na koroisia ebinto bie chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai.
Ere abe okobaacha amagena e rigori rinene na koyabeka ase ebikonde, na kobaacha emete, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia.
Nachorire Oholiabu, mosinto bw’Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani amokonye ase emeremo eyio. Nabaeire abaroisia bande bonsi obong’aini, erinde banyare gokora ebinto bionsi ebi nagochikire.
Barabwo baroisie Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Esanduku ebe ne chibao chirikire oborori, na Oboikaranso bw’Amabera, na ebinto bionsi bi’Eema eyio,
emesa na ebinto birabeo, ekebekerero gie chitaya gi’etahabu echenire na ebikorero biaye na egesasimero ase ubani erasamberwe,
egesasimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe na ebikorero biaye, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye,
ne chianga chingiya chinchenu chia Haroni omokuani, na echi’abamura baye, echi barabeke ekero bagokora emeremo y’obokuani,
na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ere ne rimisu rigiya esamberwe Aase Aachenu ime. Ase ogokora ebinto ebi bionsi goika bakore buna nagochikire kegima.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia.
“Kwana n’Abaisraeli obatebie: Goika morende Chisabato chiane, ekiagera echio nekemanyererio egati yane nainwe ebiaare ase ebiaare, erinde momanye ng’a ninche Omonene oyokobachena.

Ase igo morende rituko ri’Esabato, ekiagera ne rituko richenu asemore. Onde bwensi aise korisaria, nigo araitwe akwe. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku ki’abanto b’Omonene.

Mokore emeremo amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato Enchenu, rituko ri’ogotimoka, richenu ase Omonene. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio goika aitwe akwe.
Nabo Abaisraeli goika babwate na korenda rituko ri’Esabato ebiaare ase ebiaare, ekiagera oko nokobwatana koragenderere botambe.

Rituko erio ribe ekemanyererio keragenderere egati yane na Abaisraeli, ekiagera ase amatuko atano na rimo inche Omonene natongete igoro na ense, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ngatiga emeremo yane yonsi, na gotimoka.”
Ekero Omonene akoorire gokwana na Musa agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai, akamoa chibao ibere chi’amagena chirikire oborori nekiara kia Nyasae.

Ekero abanto baroche ng’a Musa otebanire goika korwa ase egetunwa, bagasangererekana amo, bagachiera Haroni, bakamotebia, “Inchuo aa, tokorere enyasae eratotang’ane, ekiagera titomanyeti eki kiamonyorire Musa, oyo otong’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
Haroni akabatebia, “Rusia ebigera bie chitahabu bire ase amato ’abakungu baino, na ase abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, mobindetere.”
Erio abanto bonsi bakarusia ebigera bie chitahabu biare ase amato abo, bakamobiirera Haroni.

Ere akanyora ebinto ebi korwa ase amaboko abo, akanyititora chitahabu chiria. Ekero yabwatanire, akayebomba, ekaba omogwekano bw’emori eeri. Abanto bagateba, “Abaisraeli aba, eye nero enyasae yaino, eyabang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
Ekero Haroni ayeroche, akaagacha egesasimero bosio bw’omogwekano oria. Erio akararia, akabora, “Ankio nigo rirabe Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene.”
Rituko ria kabere abanto bakaimoka mambia chuni, bakarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, bakarenta na ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe. Abanto bagaikaransa, bakaria na konywa, erio bakaimoka gotenga.
Korende Omonene agatebia Musa, “Tirimboka gochia inse, ekiagera abanto abwo bao kwang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri besaririe ase ogokora amabe,

baonchokire bwango, batigire enchera eria nabachigete gotunyana, bekoreire emori eeri y’etahabu. Bayesasimire na koyeruera ekeng’wanso, bagoteba: Abaisraeli aba, eye nero enyasae yaino, eyabang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
Ase igo agatebia Musa, “Narorire abanto aba ng’a nabanyabigoti bikong’u.
Bono tiga endamwamu yane yoke igoro asebare, erinde mbasirie, erio ngokore aye obe egesaku ekenene.”
Korende Musa agasorora Omonene, Nyasae oye, akabora, “Omonene nase ki endamwamu yao egwoka igoro y’abanto bao, abakwang’anyetie korwa Misiri ase okobua okonene, na ase okoboko kwao gwe chinguru?

Inee! Nigo origetie Abamisiri batebe: Igo abarusia aa, oganetie kobaita ase ebitunwa na kobasiria kegima? Ase igo onchoka korwa ase endamwamu yao enene, tokora amabe aya kwarengereirie gokorera abanto bao.

Inyora abasomba bao Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Israeli, na buna kwabarierete eira ase ogwetiania, okabatebia: Nigo ndamente oroiboro rwaino robe oronge buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro. Nimbae ense eye yonsi nabarierete eira ng’a nimbae ebe omwando obo kare na kare.”
Erio Omonene akaonchoka, tabakorera amabe aria konya arengereirie gokorera abanto baye.
Musa akeonchora, agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa igoro, na ase amaboko aye obwate chibao ibere chi’amagena chirikire oborori chinsemo chionsi ibere, bosio na nyuma.
Chibao echio nigo chiaroisetigwe na Nyasae omonyene, na amariko aya nigo arikire na Nyasae, amang’eire ase chibao chiria.
Yoshua akaigwa eriogi ri’abanto bakwoga, agatebia Musa, “Naigure eriogi ase egetwori, eriogi buna eri’esegi.”
Musa akamoiraneria, “Eriogi eri tiriri eri’abanto babuire esegi, gose eri’okorera kw’abanto babuirwe, korende eriogi naigure neri’abanto bagotera.”
Musa gaikire ang’e negetwori akarora emori eria, na buna abanto baare gotenga, akaba nendamwamu enene; agaakera inse chibao chiria abwate maboko aye, chigaateka, chikaba ebisamunye ase egetunwa inse.
Erio akabwata emori eria bakorete, akayesamba na koyesegenyia goika ekaba orotu, akaroitera ase amache ime, na akaa Abaisraeli amache ayio, na barabwo bakanywa.
Agwo Musa akaboria Haroni, “Naki abanto aba bagokorete goika okagera bagakora ebibe ebinene buna ebi?”
Haroni akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, toba nendamwamu entindi, aye nomanyete abanto aba ng’a nababe.
Naki nigo bantebia: Tokorere enyasae eratotang’ane, ekiagera titomanyeti eki kiamonyorire Musa, oyo otong’anyetie korwa Misiri.
Inche: nkabatebia: Onde bwensi obwate etahabu ayerusie. Barabwo bagachirusia, bagaching’a, na inche ngachiruta ase omorero ime, na emori eye ekabao.”
Musa akarora abanto bakoonchobana, na buna Haroni abatigete baonchobane na gosasima omogwekano oria, ase amasio ’ababisa babo.
Agwo Musa agatenena geita ki’egetwori, akabora, “Onde bwensi oyore ensemo y’Omonene ache aa asende.” Abalawi bonsi bagasangererekana asare.

Ere akabatebia, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, otebire iga: Kera oyomo oino abogorie omoyio oye o birende, agende aaria na aaria ase egetwori korwa geita ekemo goika ekende. Kera oyomo aite onde bwensi aranyore, nonya noyomwabo, gose omosani, gose omogisangio.”
Abalawi bagakora buna Musa abatebetie, na abanto chilifu isato bagaitwa ase rituko erio.
Musa akabatebia. “Rero inwe mweatananire ase ogokorera Omonene, ekiagera timwarengereretie abana baino gose abamino; ase igo Omonene obasesenirie rero.”
Rituko ria kabere Musa agatebia abanto, “Mwakorire ebibe ebinene mono. Na bono ngotiira inde gochia ase Omonene, aande nabo ndabanyorere okobwatanigwa, ekiagera mwakorire ebibe.”
Naende Musa akairana gochia ase Omonene, akamotebia, “Abanto aba bakorire ebibe ebinene mono, bekoreire enyasae y’etahabu.
Na bono, koranche, obaabere ebibe biabo. Onye taibo, rirorio otinyie erieta riane korwa ase ebuku eria kwarigete.”
Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Omonto oria onkoreire ebibe, nere ndatinyie erieta riaye korwa ase ebuku yane.
Korende bono genda, oraae abanto abwo goika aase aria nagotebetie; omomalaika one nagotang’ane. Korende rituko ndiche ekero ndabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.”
Omonene akabaa egesusuro, ekiagera bagerete Haroni agakora emori eria, bakayesasima.

Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia, “Imoka korwa aa ogende, aye amo nabanto aba kwang’anyetie korwa Misiri, obaire ase ense eria narierete Ibrahimu na Isaka na Yakobo eira, ngateba: Ning’ee ororeria rwaino ense eye.
Nintome omomalaika agotang’ane, aserie Abakanani, na Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi na Abayebusi.
Nimbaire ase ense ere entenenku y’amabeere na amooke. Inche omonyene tinkogenda amo nainwe, mbaise kobaitera inchera, ekiagera inwe nabanyabigoti bikong’u.”
Ekero abanto baigwete amang’ana ayio amakong’u bagaichana gose onde taba obegete ebinto biaye bi’ogwechabera.

Omonene agatebia Musa “Batebie Abaisraeli: Inwe nabanyabigoti bikong’u. Inse kogenda amo nainwe, nonya netagika eyemo, nigo ndabasirie kegima. Gaki bono rusia ebinto biaino ebi mwechaberete, erio ndore inki ndabakorere.”
Ase igo Abaisraeli bakarusia ebinto biria bechaberete, na tibabibeka korwa ekero batigete egetunwa kia Horebu kobagendererete ase orogendo rwabo.

Musa nigo anarete koira eema na koyetenenia are ake korwa ase egetwori akayeroka “Eema y’Omosangererekano.” Na onde bwensi oganetie koboria Omonene ring’ana, goika agende ase Eema eria, isiko y’egetwori.
Engaki ende yonsi Musa arenge kogenda ase Eema eria, abanto bonsi nigo baare koimoka na gotenena, kera omonto ase egesoero ki’eema yaye, na korigereria Musa goika osoire Eema eria ime.
Ekero Musa asoire Eema eria, riire riare buna esiiro riba rigoika na gotenena ase egesoero ki’Eema eria, na Omonene aba ogokwana na Musa.
Ekero abanto bonsi barorire riire riria rigotenena ase egesoero ki’Eema, baba bakoimoka na gotung’ama inse ase ogosasima, kera omonto ase egesoero ki’eema yaye.

Na Omonene aba ogokwana na Musa obosio ase obosio, buna omonto agokwana nomonto onde. Erio Musa aba okoirana gochia ase egetwori, korende Yoshua, omosomba oye omosae, mosinto o Nuni, tare korua ase Eema eria.

Musa agatebia Omonene, “Rora, aye nigo gwantebetie: Baire abanto aba, korende tigwantebia ng’a ning’o oratome agende amo nainche. Naende ogantebia: Ninkomanyete buya kegima, na buna okorokwa; naye kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwane.

Ase igo, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, nagosabire, onyorokie chinchera chiao, erinde inyare gokomanya na konyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, naende rigereria ng’a abanto b’egesaku eke nabanto bao bare.”
Omonene akamotebia, “Inche omonyene nigo ndagende amo naye, ninkoe obotoereru.”
Musa akamoiraneria, “Onye aye omonyene tokogenda amo naintwe, rirorio totige, tobeere aa.
Naki eramanyekane ng’a inche na abanto bao twanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, onye tokogenda amo naintwe? Koragende amo naintwe, natororekane ng’a twachorirwe korwa ase abanto bande b’ense eye.”
Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Ninkore erio kwamboria, ekiagera kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwane, na inche ninkomanyete buya kegima, na buna okorokwa.”
Musa akamosaba, “Koranche, onyorokie obonene bwao!”

Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ninkore obosiani bwane bwonsi boete ase obosio bwao, na erieta riane, inche Omonene, nindirarie ase obosio bwao. Nimororere amabeebe oyio ndarorere amabeebe, na nimororere amabera oyio ndarorere amabera.”
Naende akamokania, akamotebia, “Tokonyara korora obosio bwane, ekiagera mwanyabanto aise kondora, takonyara koba moyo.”
Naende Omonene akamotebia, “Rora, aase aiga are ang’e nainche, aye oranyare gotenena egetare igoro.
Erio ekero obonene bwane borabe bogoeta, ninkobeke ase omotaro bw’egetare keria, na ngotube nokoboko kwane, goika imbe naetire.
Erio ndusie okoboko kwane, na aye ondore amagega aane, korende obosio bwane tokonyara koborora.”
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Baacha chibao chi’amagena ibere chire buna chiria chie ritang’ani, na inche nindike ase chibao echio amang’ana aria arenge ase chiria chie ritang’ani, echio gwatete.
Oche bwebeke ang’e mambia, otiire gocha ase egetunwa gia Sinai, onganye aroro ase egechuria ki’egetunwa.
Monto onde tatiira amo naye, gose monto onde tarorekana aande onsi ase egetunwa eke, gose ching’ondi ne chiombe tichiba chikorisia ang’e negetunwa eke.”

Erio Musa akabaacha chibao ibere chi’amagena chire buna chiria chie ritang’ani, akaimoka mambia chuni, agatiira gochia ase egetunwa gia Sinai, buna Omonene konya amochikire, obogoretie chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena koboko kwaye.
Omonene agaika ore riire ime, agatenena amo nere, akararia erieta riaye OMONENE.
Omonene agaeta ase obosio bwa Musa, akeraria, “Omonene, Omonene, nere Nyasae omonyene amabera na obuya, tari omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu; nigo are nobwanchani botari koera, na obwegenwa.

Nigo agokorera abanto chilifu obwanchani botari koera; ere nigo akwabera amamocho, na ogosaria, na ebibe, korende tagotiga koa abana na abachokoro egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato na egia kane ase engencho y’amabe ’abaibori babo.”
Erio bwango Musa agatung’ama inse, agasasima,

akabora, “Omonene, ekiagera bono nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, nagosabire ogende amo naintwe. Naki abanto aba nabanyabigoti bikong’u, korende otwabere ogosaria gwaito na ebibe biaito, otwanchere tobe abanto bao.”

Omonene akabora, “Rora, bono ngokora inde nainwe okobwatana kw’ogotianania. Ase amasio ’abanto bao bonsi ninkore ebikone ebio bitana gokoreka ase ense yonsi, gose ase egesaku kende gionsi. Na abanto bonsi abagoetanaine inabarore ogokora kw’Omonene, naki ayio ndagokorere namang’ana ay’okoondokia.
Obwate amachiko ayio ndakoe rero. Norore ase obosio bwao ngoseria Abaamori, na Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.
Bwerende, tobaisa gokora okobwatana nabanyene ense eria ase okogenda, babaise kobatega mogwe.
Inwe motagore ebisasimero biabo, mobiiyerie inse, na gosenyenta chisiiro chi’amagena ase bagosasimera, na emete y’enyasae enkungu Asera moyenache.
“Tobaisa gosasima enyasae ende eng’ao, ekiagera Omonene nigo akorokwa Omonyaisemi, nere Nyasae bwe risemi.
Tobaisa gokora okobwatana nabanyene ense eria, ekiagera ekero bagokora obotomani ase ogosasima chinyasae chiabo na gochiruera ebing’wanso, mbabaise kobarangeria inwe morie ebing’wanso biabo.

Timobaisa konyuomeria abamura baino abaiseke b’abanto abwo, ekiagera abaiseke abwo, ekero baragende gokora obotomani ase ogosasima chinyasae chiabo mbabaise kogera abamura baino basasime chinyasae chiabo.
“Tibwekorera chinyasae korwa ase ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa.

“Orende rituko rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera; na buna nagochigete, orie emegati etabekiri memera ase amatuko atano na abere, ase engaki yachigetwe, y’omotienyi bw’Abibu, naki ase omotienyi oyio oyio noro kwaruete ense ya Misiri.
“Kera omwana omoisia omotangi nabe oyone, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo, chibe chieri gose chimingichi.

Korende emori entangi y’etigere goika oyeboorie ase okorua eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso. Onye tibwancheti koyebooria, goika oyebune ebigoti. Abana bao abaisia abatangi goika obaboorie. Onde tari orabe ogocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, namaboko amasa.
“Okore emeremo ase amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere otimoke, nonya nengaki y’okorema na eye rigesa.
“Orende Rituko Rinene rie Chichuma, ase engencho y’ogotongora kw’engano, ne Rituko Rinene ri’Ogosangereria Rigesa, omoerio bw’omwaka.
“Ara gatato kera omwaka abanto bao bonsi abasacha babe bagocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
Nyuma konaseririe abanto b’ebisaku korwa asore na kogareyia orogongo rwao, onde tari orakoroure ase chingaki echi isato kera omwaka, ekero orabe kogocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Nyasae oo.
“Ekero okondetera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso, tobaisa koyandetera amo nomogati obekire ememera. Tobaisa gotigaria chinyama chinde chi’ekeng’wanso kie rituko rinene ri’Epasaka goika mambia.
“Goika orente ase enyomba yane, inche Omonene Nyasae oo, ogotongora kwao okore okuya korwa ase omogondo oo. “Tobaisa koiyekera emanwa y’embori ime y’amabeere ’eng’ina.”
Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rika amang’ana aya, ekiagera ase amang’ana ayio nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania naye amo n’Abaisraeli.”
Musa akabeera n’Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, tare koria kende, gose konywa, akarika ase chibao echi ibere amang’ana ’okobwatana koria, Amachiko ayio ikomi.

Ekero Musa arenge gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, obwate ase okoboko kwaye chibao chirikire oborori, tamanya ng’a risankwa ri’obosio bwaye nigo riare komeka‐meka, ekiagera konya okwanire n’Omonene.
Haroni na abanto bonsi, ekero baroche buna risankwa ri’obosio bwa Musa riare komeka‐meka, bakoboa komoika ang’e.
Korende Musa akabarangeria, erio Haroni amo nabatang’ani bonsi b’omosangererekano bakairana asare, na Musa agakwana nabarabwo.
Nyuma y’ayio Abaisraeli bonsi bagacha ase Musa, na ere akabaa amachiko onsi aya Omonene konya amoeire ase egetunwa gia Sinai.
Ekero Musa akoorire gokwana nabarabwo, akabeka egietubo ase obosio bwaye.

Ekero kende gionsi Musa are gosoa eema ase obosio bw’Omonene gokwana nere, nigo are korusia egietubo goika osoka korwa aroro. Ekero asokire aba ogotebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi aya achikirwe gokwana,
na barabwo baba bakorora risankwa ri’obosio bwaye rikomeka‐meka. Erio Musa abeka egietubo ase obosio bwaye goika airana naende gokwana n’Omonene.
Musa akarangeria omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli amo, akabatebia, “Aya naro Omonene achikire morakore:

Mokore emeremo ase amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere nigo rirabe richenu asemore, rituko ri’Esabato, riatananwe ase Omonene. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio goika aitwe akwe.
Timobaisa gouta omorero ase rituko ri’Esabato, aande onsi ase momenyete.”
Musa agatebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, “Aya naro Omonene achikire:
Moruere Omonene ebiegwa. Kera omonto oyore nomoyo bw’ogwancha aruere Omonene ebinto ebi: Etahabu, na efeta, na etaai;
chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri; egatani engiya na amanya e chimbori;
amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, na amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, ne chibao chi’emekonge;
amaguta e chitaya, na ebinto bi’okoroisia amaguta akweakwa, na ebi’okoroisia ubani;
amagena e rigori rinene buna oiniki na ayande akobekwa ase egesibao na egesembe ki’obokuani.”
“Abaroisia bonsi abang’aini abare ase egati yaino, tiga bache baroisie ebinto bionsi Omonene achikire,
nabio ebi: Obomenyo na eema yaye, na egietubo kiaye, ebigobanio ne chibao chiaye, na emeriibo, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo;
Esanduku na emiaro yaye, na Oboikaranso bw’Amabera, na etoto eria erabekwe ebokenge;
emesa na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na emegati eria eraruegwe ase Nyasae;
ekebekerero gie chitaya na ebikorero biaye, ne chitaya chiaye amo namaguta e chitaya,
na egesasimero ase ubani egosamberwa amo nemiaro yaye, na amaguta akweakwa, na amanukato are ne rimisu rigiya, na ebitambaa bigosungwa ase egesoero ki’Obomenyo obwo;
na egesasimero aase ebing’wanso bigosamberwa amo negechungi kiaye gi’etaai, na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye;
ebitambaa ebirakenge eraaro, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiaye, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’eraaro,
na ebirochi bi’Obomenyo na ebi’eraaro amo ne chingori chiabo,
ne chianga chiria chinseera chigokorerwa ime y’Aase Aachenu, engencho yaye chianga chia Haroni omokuani, amo nechi’abamura baye, barabe bakobeka ekero bagokora emeremo yabo y’obokuani.”
Erio omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okaruao agwo ase obosio bwa Musa.

Naende bakairana kera oyomo buna enkoro yaye yamosugetie, na buna anchete ere omonyene, bakarentera Omonene ebiegwa biabo ase okoroisia Eema y’Omosangererekano na ebinto bionsi ebiaganeirie, ase emeremo eria na ase chianga chiria chinchenu.

Barabwo bagacha, abasacha na abakungu, na ase ogwancha kwabo bakarenta amameka, na ebigera bi’amato abo, ne chibonyi chi’ebiara, ne chisonoi, na ebinto ao ao bie chitahabu bi’ogwechabera. Kera omonto akarenta ebinto bie chitahabu, ebi aatananete ase ogokorera Omonene.

Naende kera omonto oyo obwate chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na egatani engiya, na amanya e chimbori, na amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, na amasankwa e ching’iti chia rooche, akabirenta.
Bonsi abaare konyara korua chifeta ne chitaai bakabirenta bibe ebiegwa ase Omonene, na bonsi abarenge nemekonge eyere emiya ase emeremo ende yonsi, bakayerenta.
Na abakungu abaroisia abang’aini bagasisa namaboko abo chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na echi’egatani engiya, bagachirenta.
Na abakungu bonsi, abasugetigwe ase emioyo yabo, naende bamanyete emeremo eye, bagasisa amanya e chimbori abe chiusi.
Abatang’ani babo bakarenta amagena e rigori rinene buna oiniki na ayande arabekwe ase egesibao na egesembe ki’obokuani,
naende ebinto bie rimisu rigiya amo namaguta e chitaya, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ere ne rimisu rigiya.
Abaisraeli bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, abarenge nogwancha korenta ebinto bi’emeremo eye Omonene achigete goetera ase Musa, bakarenta ebiegwa biabo ase Omonene.
Musa agatebia Abaisraeli, “Rora, Omonene ochorire Besaleli, oyore mosinto o Uri, mochokoro o Huri bw’egesaku kia Yuda.
Omoichoirie omoika o Nyasae, omoeire obong’aini ne chisemi anyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia,
abe oyomanyete koroberia na koroisia ebinto bie chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai,
abe okobaacha amagena e rigori rinene na koyabeka ase ebikonde, na kobaacha emete, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia.
Omonene omoeire ere amo na Oholiabu, mosinto bw’Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani, obong’aini bw’okworokereria abande oboroisia bwabo.

Obaichoirie obong’aini ase chinkoro chiabo, erinde banyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi buna okomang’a, na okoroberia, na koroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na echi’egatani engiya, na koroisia ebitambaa binde bionsi. Banyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi na bamanye koroberia oboroisia bonde bwonsi.”

“Besaleli na Oholiabu amo nabaroisia bande bonsi, aba Omonene konya aeire obong’aini, abare nogwancha kw’ogokora emeremo ende yonsi egwenerete ase okoagacha Obomenyo Obochenu, goika bakore kera emeremo buna Omonene konya achikire.”
Erio Musa akarangeria Besaleli amo na Oholiabu na abaroisia bande bonsi, aba Omonene aeire obong’aini, abare nogwancha, bache, bachake emeremo eria.
Barabwo bakaegwa korwa ase Musa ebiegwa ebi bionsi Abaisraeli konya barentire ase okoroisia Obomenyo boria Obochenu. Na Abaisraeli bakagenderera korenta ebiegwa biabo kera emambia.
Erio abaroisia baria abang’aini, abarenge gokora emeremo ende yonsi ase Obomenyo boria Obochenu, nyuma kobatigire emeremo eye baare gokora bagacha ase Musa,
bakamotebia, “Abanto barentire ebiegwa ebinge goetania ebiaganeirie ase emeremo eria Omonene achigete ekorwe.”

Ase ayio Musa akarareria abanto bonsi b’egetwori, akabachika, “Onde tabaisa korenta ebiegwa binde goetania ebi konya biasangererigwe ase Obomenyo Obochenu, abe omosacha gose omokungu.” Ase igo abanto bagatiga korenta ebiegwa binde.
Ebi konya barentire nigo biabete ebinge, bigaetania ebiaganeirie ase emeremo eria yare gocha gokorwa.

Abaroisia bonsi abang’aini b’abakori emeremo bakaroisia eema y’Obomenyo. Bakayeroisia nebitambaa ikomi, biroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chimbariri Omoroisia omong’aini akabiroisia, bire nemegwekano y’abakerubi.
Obotambe bwa kera egetambaa nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, na atano na atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane; bionsi nigo biarenge bi’ekerengo ekemo.
Bakabwatania ebitambaa bitano amo, bikaba rirondia erimo. Naboigo nebitambaa binde bitano.
Bagakora ebioro bie chiusi chiburu, bakabibeka ase ensinyo y’egetambaa kere ensinyo y’ensemo ya kera rirondia.
Bagakora ebioro emerongo etano, bakabibeka ase egetambaa kegochakera rirondia rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase egetambaa kegokoorera rirondia ria kabere. Ebioro bia kera rirondia bigachikana.
Bagatura ebigobanio bie chitahabu emerongo etano, na ase ebio bakabwatania amarondia ayio amo, akaba eema eyemo y’Obomenyo.
Erio bakaroisia amarondia ikomi na rimo ay’amanya e chigoree, akaba eema y’ogotuba Obomenyo boria.
Obotambe bwa kera rirondia nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Amarondia onsi aya ikomi na rimo nigo arenge ay’ekerengo ekemo.
Bakabwatania amarondia atano amo, akaba rirondia erimo, naende atano na rimo akaba rirondia erimo.
Bagakora ebioro emerongo etano, bakabibeka ase ensinyo ye rirondia rinene rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase rirondia rinene ria kabere ase rigochakera.
Naende bagakora ebigobanio emerongo etano bie chitaai ase okobwaterania amarondia ayio abere, abe eema engima.
Bagakora rirondia ri’amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, ase ogotuba eema, ne rirondia rinde ri’amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, erirabekwe igoro ye rirondia rie ritang’ani.
Naende bakaroisia chibao chi’emekonge ase Obomenyo, bagachitenenia.
Obotambe bwa kera ebao nigo bware obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
Bagakora chintamang’o ibere ase kera ebao, ase chibao echio chirabwateranigwe. Naboigo baroisetie chibao echi chionsi chi’Obomenyo.
Bakaroisia chibao emerongo ebere ase ensemo ya irianyi.
Bagakora ne chinterekerero chie chifeta emerongo ene, chibe ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao ase chintamang’o chiaye ibere.
Nase ensemo ya kabere, nero ya sugusu y’Obomenyo, bakaroisia chibao emerongo ebere,
ne chinterekerero chiaye chie chifeta emerongo ene, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.
Korende ase ensemo ya nyuma y’Obomenyo, eyerochie bosongo, bakaroisia chibao isano nemo.
Naende bakaroisia chibao ibere chikaba chikoona chi’Obomenyo ensemo ya nyuma.
Kera ebao ase echio ibere ekabwatanigwa ne chibao chie chinsinyo, korwa inse goika igoro ase ebonyi entang’ani ere; naboigo bakorete ase chibao echio ibere echiabegetwe ase chikoona ibere.
Chibao chionsi nigo chiabete isano na isato, ne chinterekerero chiabo chie chifeta ikomi, na isano nemo, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.
Bakabaacha emeriibo etano y’emekonge, eriibe chibao chie rikere erimo ri’Obomenyo,
na etano ase rikere rinde, na etano ase ensemo ya nyuma, eyerochie bosongo.
Bakabaacha omoriibo o gati‐gati omogima, ase okoriiba chibao korwa ensinyo eyemo goika eyende.
Erio bakaooma chibao echio netahabu, bagakora chibonyi chie chitahabu ase emiaro erasoigwe, naende bakaooma emeriibo eria netahabu.
Bakaroisia etoto ye chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire. Omoroisia omong’aini akayeroisia ekaba emegwekano y’abakerubi.
Naende bakabaacha chisiiro inye chi’emekonge, bagachiooma netahabu, na ebigobanio biaye bie chitahabu. Bagakora chinterekerero inye korwa ase efeta enyititoire.
Na ase egesoero ki’Eema bakaroisia egetambaa korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani, keroisirie nomoroisia omong’aini.
Bakabaacha chisiiro isano amo nebigobanio biabo, bakaooma ebisure ne chinuga chiabo netahabu. Chinterekerero chiabo isano nigo chiakorire korwa ase chitaai.

Erio Besaleli akaroisia Esanduku ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo, na ekeng’ese.
Akayeooma netahabu echenire, ime na isiko, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etahabu.
Agakora chibonyi inye korwa ase etahabu enyititoire, agachibeka ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera rikere.
Akabaacha emiaro y’emekonge, akayeooma netahabu.
Agasoyia emiaro eyio ase chibonyi ime ase okobogoreria esanduku eria.
Akaroisia ekemumeko gi’etahabu echenire ebe Oboikaranso bw’Amabera. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
Erio agakora emegwekano y’abakerubi babere ey’etahabu esunyuntire, akayebeka ase chinsinyo ibere chi’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera,
oyomo ase kera ensinyo, akayekora ekaba egento ekemo n’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera.
Abakerubi abwo bakarambora chimbaba chiabo igoro y’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera, bakabobekera ekiriri, na amasio abo agachikana; na barabwo bakarigereria Oboikaranso bw’Amabera.
Akaroisia emesa ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
Akayeoma netahabu echenire, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etahabu.
Erio agakora orosingo rore nobogare bong’ana egesanyi gi’okoboko, na akaroetanania omong’ororia bw’etahabu.
Naende agakora chibonyi inye korwa ase chitahabu, ne chibonyi echio agachibeka ase chikoona inye ase amagoro aye ane.
Chibonyi chiria chikabekwa ang’e norosingo, na emiaro eria egasoigwa imeo, erinde emesa enyare kobogorerigwa.
Akabaacha emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, akayeooma netahabu.
Agakora ebikorero biare kobekwa ase emesa igoro: chinteru na ebitaabo ase ubani, ne chisani, korwa ase ebio bagocha koumora ebinyugwa ebikoruegwa; akabiroisia bionsi korwa ase chitahabu chichenire.
Akaroisia ekebekerero gie chitaya gi’etahabu echenire esunyuntire. Akayeroisia nenterekerero amo ne ritina, na emegwekano y’amamumu na ebisicha; bionsi bikaroisigwa bikaba egento ekemo.
Nigo kiare ne chinsagia isano nemo, chiasogete korwa ase ritina, isato korwa ase ensemo eyemo, na isato korwa ase ensemo ende.

Orosagia rwe ritang’ani rokaba nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo ne rimumu na egesicha, na orosagia rwa kabere boigo rokaba nemegwekano y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi; ne chinsagia chionsi isano nemo chikaba boigo.
Ritina rinyene ri’ekebekerero keria rikaba nemegwekano ene y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi.
Rimumu erimo rikaba inse ya kera chinsagia ibere chigosoka korwa ase ritina. Ase ayio rikaba rimumu erimo inse ya kera orosagia rw’echio isano nemo chiroisirie chikaba egento ekemo ne ritina.
Bionsi bikaroisigwa korwa ase ribomba erimo ri’etahabu echenire esunyuntire.
Naende akaroisia chitaya chiaye isano na ibere, na ebinachi, ne chindogio chiaye chie chitahabu chichenire.
Ekebekerero keria gie chitaya amo nebikorero biaye bionsi bikaroisigwa korwa ase chitahabu chichenire chi’ekerengo gie chikiro emerongo etano.

Akaroisia egesasimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ubani erasamberwe. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko abere. Emegwekano ye chingunchara ekaroisigwa ekaba egento ekemo negesasimero.
Agakeooma netahabu echenire, igoro yaye, ne chinsemo chiaye, amo ne chingunchara chiaye, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etahabu.
Agakora chibonyi ibere chie chitahabu, agachibeka inse y’omong’ororia ase chinsemo ibere. Ase chibonyi echio emiaro egasoigwa, erinde egesasimero kenyare kobogorerigwa.
Na emiaro eria akabaacha korwa ase emekonge, akayeooma netahabu.
Naende akaroisia amaguta amachenu akweakwa, na ubani echenire are ne rimisu rigiya, akayaroisia buna omoroisia, oyomanyete buya, aranyare koyaroisia.

Erio akaagacha egesasimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano; nabo chinsemo chiaye inye chikaba chireng’aine, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atato.
Ase chikoona inye chi’egesasimero akaroisia emegwekano ene ye chingunchara, akayeroisia ekaba egento ekemo negesasimero, akaooma gionsi netaai.

Akaroisia ebikorero bionsi bi’egesasimero nabio ebi: Chindogio chi’okobuucha riibu, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo, ne chigami, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero. Ebinto ebi bionsi akabiroisia korwa ase chitaai.
Agakora egechungi gi’etaai, agakebeka korwa inse y’orosingo, kegaika gochia igoro gati gati y’egesasimero.
Agakora chibonyi inye, agachibeka ase chikoona inye chi’egechungi ekio gi’etaai, ase emiaro egosoigwa.
Akabaacha emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, akayeooma netaai.
Agasoyia emiaro eria ase chibonyi chire chinsemo chi’egesasimero, erinde kenyare kobogorerigwa. Agakeagacha ne chibao, akagetiga giasaime.
Akaroisia egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye korwa ase ebirore bie chitaai bi’abakungu baare gokorera ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
Ase ensemo ya irianyi akaroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chindabu chi’egatani chisisire. Obotambe bwabo nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo.
Chisiiro chiaye emerongo ebere echiare kobibwata nigo chiarenge ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chie chifeta.

Naboigo ase ensemo ya sugusu akaroisia ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo. Chisiiro emerongo ebere echiare kobibwata nigo chiarenge ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chie chifeta.

Ase ensemo ya bosongo bakaroisia ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano, ne chisiiro ikomi amo ne chinterekerero chiabo ikomi, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chie chifeta.
Obogare bw’ensemo ya bosio, erochie moocha, nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano.
Ase ensemo eyemo y’egesoero bakaroisia ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, ne chisiiro isato amo ne chinterekerero chiabo isato.

Naboigo ase ensemo ende bakaroisia ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, ne chisiiro isato amo ne chinterekerero chiabo isato. Ase igo chinsemo chionsi ibere chi’egesoero chikaba chireng’aine.
Ebitambaa bionsi ebieetanaine eraaro eria bikaroisigwa ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire.
Chinterekerero chie chisiiro chiaye nigo chiarenge chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chie chifeta, na ebisure biabo bikaoomwa nefeta.

Egetambaa ki’egesoero bakaroisia korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani chisisire. Obotambe bw’egetambaa keria nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano koreng’ana nobogare bwaye buna ebitambaa binde bi’eraaro.

Chisiiro inye, echiare gokebwata, ne chinterekerero chiabo inye, nigo chiarenge chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio biabo nigo biarenge bie chifeta, na ebisure bie chisiiro bikaoomwa nefeta, ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chie chifeta.
Ebirochi bionsi bi’eema y’Obomenyo na ebi’ebitambaa bi’eraaro nigo biarenge bie chitaai.

Oyo noro omobaro bw’ebinto ebiakoreretwe ase okoroisia Obomenyo, engencho yaye Obomenyo bw’Oborori. Omobaro oyo Musa achigete ogakorwa n’Abalawi inse y’oboraai bwa Itamari, mosinto o Haroni, omokuani.
Besaleli, mosinto o Uri o Huri bw’egesaku kia Yuda, agakora onsi aya Omonene achigete Musa.

Amo nere nigo arenge Oholiabu, omwana o Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani, komokonya. Ere nigo arenge omong’aini bw’okomang’a na kobaacha, na bw’okoroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya.

Etahabu yonsi eyakoreretwe ase emeremo y’okoroisia Obomenyo Obochenu, eyaatananetwe ebe ekerugwa, nigo yarenge chikiro elifu eyemo, na amagana ane, na emerongo etano nomo, na isano (1,465) ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu.
Efeta eyaruetwe nomoganda bw’abwo barigetwe nigo yarenge chikiro chilifu isano, na emerongo etato, na isano (5,035), ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu.

Kera omonto oyorigetwe, oyokoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, akarua ebeka eyemo, engencho yaye ekeng’ese gi’esekeli ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu. Abanto abwo nigo barenge chilifu amagana atano na rimo na isato, na amagana atano, na emerongo etano (603,550).

Chikiro chilifu isano chie chifeta chiria nigo chiakoretwe ase okoroisia chinterekerero chi’Obomenyo Obochenu ne chi’etoto eria; chikiro chilifu isano ase chinterekerero rigana erimo, chikiro emerongo etano ase kera enterekerero.
Ase chifeta chikiro emerongo etato na isano chiatigarete chiakoreretwe ase okoroisia ebigobanio bie chisiiro na ase okooma ebisure biabo, na koroisia chinuga chiabo.
Chitaai chiatananetwe chibe ekerugwa, nigo chiarenge chikiro chilifu isato, na amagana atano, na emerongo ene, na isano (3,545).
Ase chitaai chiria akaroisia chinterekerero chi’egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na egesasimero gi’etaai amo negechungi kiaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi,
ne chinterekerero chie chisiiro chi’eraaro chibe chinsemo chionsi, na echi’egesoero ki’eraaro, na ebirochi bionsi bi’eema y’Obomenyo, na ebi’eraaro chinsemo chionsi.

Korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, bakaroisia chianga chinseera chi’ogokorera emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu. Bakaroisia chianga chinchenu chia Haroni, buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
Bagakora egesibao ki’obokuani korwa ase chiusi chi’etahabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.

Bagasunyunta etahabu ekaba eng’oo, naende bakayeninta ekaba chiusi chinyerere, bagachisang’ania ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, ase okoroisia egetambaa buna omoroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia.
Bakaroisia ebitwanga bi’amareko bi’egesibao keria, bakabibwatania nakerokio, nyuma na bosio; chinsinyo chiaye ibere ibere chikabwatanigwa amo.

Orokini rw’okobwataneria egesibao rokaroisigwa rw’egetambaa keria ki’egesibao keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’etahabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.

Bakabaacha amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa oiniki, bakayabeka ase ebikonde bie chitahabu; na buna omoroisia omong’aini aranyare komanya komang’era ebimanyererio, bakamang’era amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli.
Bakayabeka ase ebitwanga bi’amareko ase egesibao ki’obokuani, abe ase okoinyora abamura ba Israeli. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.

Egesembe ki’obokuani bagakeroisia, buna omoroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia, korwa ase egetambaa kere buna eki’egesibao ki’obokuani, nakio keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’etahabu na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.
Bakaroisia egesembe keria keringire rimo; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge chisentimita emerongo ebere, na ibere, na obogare bwaye boigo. Chinsemo chiaye inye nigo chiarenge chireng’aine.
Bagakebekera emeng’ororia ene y’amagena e rigori. Ase omong’ororia bwe ritang’ani bakabeka saridio, na topasio, na sumaridi;
na ase oyo o kabere alimasi, na safiro, na yasipi;
na ase oyo o gatato hiakinto, na agati, na ametisito;
na ase oyo o kane kurusolito, na oiniki, na berulo. Amagena ayio onsi bakayabeka ase ebikonde bie chitahabu.

Na amagena ayio nigo arenge ikomi na abere, akaba namarieta ’abamura ba Israeli, amang’ekire buna ekemanyererio gekomang’wa. Kera rigena rikaba nerieta ri’egesaku ekemo ki’ebisaku biabo ikomi na bibere.
Bagakora ebichanga bie chitahabu chichenire bisisire, bikabekwa ase egesembe keria.
Bagakora na ebikonde bibere bie chitahabu, ne chibonyi ibere chie chitahabu, na bakabeka chibonyi echi ibere ase emego ebere ya igoro y’egesembe keria.
Bagasiberania ebichanga ebi bibere bie chitahabu ase chibonyi echi ibere ase emego y’egesembe keria.
Naende bakabwaterania chinsinyo chinde ibere chi’ebichanga ase ebikonde biria bibere, na buna biare igo bakabibwaterania nebitwanga bi’amareko bire bosio bw’egesibao ki’obokuani.
Bagakora chibonyi ibere chie chitahabu bagachibeka ase egesembe keria, ase emego ebere ya inse korwa nyuma, echigete egesibao.
Naende bagakora chibonyi chinde chie chitahabu, bagachibeka ase ebitwanga biria bibere bi’amareko bi’egesibao bire bosio, ang’e nomobarero, igoro y’orokini rw’egesibao.
Bagachibwaterania chibonyi chi’egesembe amo nechi’egesibao ki’obokuani neusi eburu; erio egesembe gekabeera orokini igoro, tigecha gosuka. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
Bagakora eganchwa korwa ase egetambaa keroisirie ne chiusi chiburu chioka.
Ase eganchwa eria bakabochora engoro ase omotwe ogosoera, enga buna engoro y’esati. Engoro eria ekabekwa ekenaario buna egi’esati, techa gotandoka.
Bagakora emegwekano y’amatunda e rikomomanga korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, bakayebeka ase omoringero o inse.
Naende bagakora chindege chie chitahabu chichenire, bagachibeka gati y’emegwekano ye rikomomanga chietanane omoringero o inse ase eganchwa.
Ase igo omong’ororia bw’emegwekano ye rikomomanga bwateranirie ne chindege orenge ase omoringero o inse ase eganchwa eria ekobekwa ase obokoreri bw’obokuani. Naboigo buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
Bakaroiseria Haroni amo nabamura baye chiganchwa chi’egatani engiya,
na egetinti amo nebigogwa emechoro bi’oboseera bi’egatani engiya, ne chisirwari chi’egatani engiya,
na orokini rwe chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
Bagatura ebao y’etahabu echenire, na buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio, bakamang’a amang’ana aya: “Achenirwe ase Omonene”.
Bakayesiberania bosio bw’ekegogwa ne chiusi chiburu, buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
Naboigo emeremo y’Obomenyo bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano egaikeranigwa n’Abaisraeli; bagakora onsi buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
Barabwo bakarentera Musa Obomenyo boria, na eema amo nebinto bionsi ebirabeo: ebigobanio, ne chibao, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo,
na egietubo ki’amasankwa e chimingichi, aakire etaago, na egietubo ki’amasankwa e ching’iti chia rooche, na etoto eria ekengete,
na Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, amo nemiaro yaye, na Oboikaranso bw’Amabera,
na emesa amo nebikorero biaye bionsi, na Emegati eyare koruegwa ase Nyasae,
na ekebekerero gie chitaya gi’etahabu echenire, ne chitaya chiare kobekwa aroro amo nebikorero biaye bionsi, na amaguta e chitaya,
na egesasimero gi’etahabu, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ekorua rimisu rigiya, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’Eema,
na egesasimero gi’etaai amo negechungi gi’etaai, na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye,

na ebitambaa bi’eraaro, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’eraaro, ne chingori, na ebirochi, na ebikorero bionsi bi’obokoreri ase Obomenyo ime, ase Eema y’Omosangererekano,
ne chianga chiria chinseera chi’abakuani ase obokoreri bwabo ime y’Aase Aachenu, engencho yaye chianga chia Haroni amo nechi’abamura baye barabe bakobeka ekero bagokora emeremo y’obokuani.
Abaisraeli konya bakorire emeremo yonsi boronge kegima buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
Musa akariga‐rigereria ebinto bionsi ebiakoretwe, akarora ng’a abanto babikorire boronge kegima buna Omonene konya achikire. Erio Musa akabasesenia.
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, otenenie Obomenyo, Eema eria y’Omosangererekano.
Obeke Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori imeo, na oyekenge netoto.
Osoyie emesa, na obeke ebinto biaye igoro yaye; osoyie na ekebekerero gie chitaya, na obeke chitaya igoro yaye.
Erio obeke egesasimero gi’etahabu ase ubani erasamberwe bosio bw’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, na osunge egetambaa kere ase egesoero ki’Obomenyo.
Obeke egesasimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe bosio bw’egesoero ki’Obomenyo, Eema eria y’Omosangererekano.
Obeke egetuba egati y’Eema y’Omosangererekano na egesasimero, obeke na amache imeo.
Otenenie orosenge rw’egetambaa roetanane eraaro, na osunge egetambaa ase egesoero ki’eraaro.
“Oimokie amaguta akweakwa, oake Obomenyo na ebinto bionsi ebire imeo na obwatanane Obomenyo amo nebinto biaye bionsi, erinde bibe ebichenu.
Naende oake amaguta ase egesasimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe, amo nebikorero biaye bionsi. Naboigo ogiatanane, kebe egechenu mono.
Oake egetuba amaguta amo nenterekerero yaye, na kogiatanana.
“Orente Haroni amo nabamura baye ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, obasibie namache.
Erio obekere Haroni chianga chiria chinchenu, omoake amaguta na komwatanana, anyare gonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani,
Orente na abamura baye, obabekere chianga chiabo,
obaake amaguta buna oraake ise, na barabwo nababe abakuani baane. Ogoakwa kw’amaguta kwabo nkobanyorere obokuani boragenderere botambe ase ororeria rwabo, ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
Musa agakora onsi buna Omonene konya amochikire.
Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, omwaka o kabere nyuma kobarure Misiri, Obomenyo boria bogatenenigwa.
Musa agatenenia Obomenyo boria, akabeka chinterekerero aase abo, agatenenia ne chibao chiaye, agasoyia emeriibo, na gotenenia chisiiro.
Akaara eema igoro y’Obomenyo boria, na kobeka egietubo kiaye buna Omonene konya amochikire.
Akaimokia chibao chirikire oborori, agachibeka ase Esanduku ime, agasoyia emiaro ase chibonyi, akamumeka Esanduku eria n’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera.
Akabeka Esanduku eria ime y’Obomenyo, agasunga etoto eria y’egetambaa ase ogokenga Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, buna Omonene konya amochikire.
Akabeka emesa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ime, isiko y’etoto, ensemo ya sugusu,
na akaroberia emegati igoro yaye ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna ere konya amochikire.
Akabeka ekebekerero gie chitaya ase Obomenyo ime, ensemo ya irianyi, kororia ase emesa.
Naende akabeka chitaya igoro y’ekebekerero ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna ere konya amochikire.
Akabeka na egesasimero gi’etahabu ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ime, bosio bw’etoto,
na igoro yaye agasambera ubani ekorua rimisu rigiya, buna Omonene konya amochikire.
Agasunga egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’Obomenyo.
Na egesasimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe akabeka ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Igoro yaye akarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, buna Omonene konya amochikire.
Akabeka egetuba ase egati y’Eema y’Omosangererekano na egesasimero, akabeka amache ogwesibia imeo.
Musa na Haroni bakaba bagoisaba amaboko na gosibia amagoro ase amache ayio.
Ekero baare gosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano, gose goika ang’e ase egesasimero, baba bagwesibia, buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
Agatenenia orosenge rw’eraaro roetanane Obomenyo na egesasimero, na agasunga ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro. Naboigo Musa agakoora emeremo eyio yonsi.
Erio riire rigatuba Eema y’Omosangererekano, na obonene bw’Omonene bogaichora ime ase Obomenyo.
Musa tanyara gosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano, ekiagera riire riria riabete igoro yaye, na obonene bogaichora ime ase Obomenyo.
Na ekero kende gionsi riire riare koimokerera igoro korwa ase Obomenyo obwo, Abaisraeli nigo baare koimoka kogenda orogendo rwabo. Naboigo baare gokora ase orogendo rwabo rwonsi.
Korende onye riire tiriare koimokerera igoro, barabwo tibaare koimoka kogenda goika rituko riria riire riare koimokerera igoro naende.

Naki riire ri’Omonene nigo riare kobeera ase Obomenyo ekero kia mobaso, na ekero kia botuko omorero oba ase riire ime; na agwo Abaisraeli bonsi baba bakorirora aande onsi ase barenge ase orogendo rwabo.
Omonene akarangeria Musa, agakwana nere korwa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, akamotebia,
“Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a ekero omonto onde bwensi korwa ase egati yabo akondetera inche Omonene eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso, ayerusie korwa ase chiombe gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori.
Onye nigo akorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa korwa ase amaicho e chiombe, arue eeri etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ayerente agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, erinde inche mwanchere.
Omonto oria goika abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eng’iti eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, erinde yancherwe ase okobwatania omonto oria na Nyasae.

Erio omonto oria anyenyere eeri eria ensae agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, na abakuani, abamura ba Haroni, barente amanyinga bayasiarere chinsemo chionsi chi’egesasimero kere agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
Naende arusie riiyo ri’eng’iti eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso, ayenachane ebitari,
na abamura ba Haroni omokuani baute omorero ase egesasimero, bachoke chinko ase omorero oyio.
Naende abakuani, abamura ba Haroni, babeke ebitari biria, amo nomotwe na ebitinya, igoro ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero bw’egesasimero.

Korende chinyama chi’enda, amo nebirenge, bisibigwe namache. Omokuani oria otenenerete asambe eng’iti eria yonsi ase egesasimero, ebe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera inche Omonene.
“Onye omonto okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa korwa ase amaicho e ching’ondi, gose chimbori, nigo ararente emingichi, gose egoree, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye.
Erio ayenyenyere ase ensemo ya sugusu y’egesasimero, agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, na abakuani, abamura ba Haroni, basiarere amanyinga aria ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
Naende anachane eng’iti eria ebitari, na omokuani oria otenenerete abichoke buya, amo nomotwe na ebitinya, igoro ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero bw’egesasimero,

korende chinyama chi’enda na ebirenge bisibigwe namache. Erio omokuani arue bionsi na kobisambera ase egesasimero. Ekio nekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera inche Omonene.
“Onye ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa akonduera inche Omonene gekorusigwa ase chinyoni, rirorio arente amaruma gose amage ’amaruma.
Omokuani arente enyoni eyio ase egesasimero, na amine omotwe oye, ayobutore. Erio ayosambe ase egesasimero. Anyititorere amanyinga ase egesasimero ensemo,
korende embochero yaye, amo neubi ere imeo, abitugute ensemo ya moocha y’egesasimero, ase ribu rigotugutwa.

Erio atandorane egekuba, korende tarusia chimbaba, ayesambere ase egesasimero, igoro ye chinko chiria chire ase omorero. Ekio nekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera inche Omonene.
“Ekero omonto akondetera inche Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera, arue obosie obonuke, anyororokerie amaguta ase obosie obwo, abeke na ubani.

Erio arente okoruegwa okwo ase abakuani, abamura ba Haroni. Omokuani otenenerete aimokie obosie boichire roe, amo namaguta, na ubani yonsi, abisambere ase egesasimero bibe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwane inche Omonene. Okwo nokoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
Ekeratigare korwa ase okoruegwa kw’endagera okwo nakobe okwa Haroni na abamura baye. Ekio negechenu mono, ekiagera kiarusigwe korwa ase okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero asende.
“Ekero okorenta okoruegwa kw’endagera esambeire riko nebe emegati etabekiri memera eroisirie korwa ase obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta, gose emegati emeoo eakire amaguta.
“Onye okoruegwa kwao kw’endagera nemegati esambeire orogio, ebe eroisirie korwa ase obosie obonuke amo namaguta, korende ebe etabekiri memera.
Oyesamunyorane, erio oumore amaguta igoro ase ebisamunye biria. Okwo nokoruegwa kw’endagera.
“Onye okoruegwa kwao kw’endagera nemegati ekarangeire esuguria, ebe eroisirie korwa ase obosie obonuke amo namaguta.
Ondetere inche Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera eroisirie ase enchera eyemo y’echio, na ekero okoruegwa okwo kwairirwe ase omokuani nere akorente ase egesasimero.

Omokuani arusie ensemo y’okoruegwa okwo kw’endagera ebe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwane inche Omonene, ayesambere ase egesasimero. Okwo nokoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
Ekeratigare korwa ase okoruegwa okwo kw’endagera nakebe ekia Haroni na abamura baye. Ekio negechenu mono, ekiagera kiarusigwe korwa ase okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero asende.
“Okoruegwa konde gwonsi kw’endagera bakonduera inche Omonene tigokoroiseranigwa nememera. Timobaisa gosamba ememera, gose obooke, bibe okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero asende.
Monyare kondetera ebinto ebio buna ogotongora kw’endagera, korende timobaisa kobisambera ase egesasimero. Moise gokora igo, tigokoba ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
Goika obeke omonyo ase okoruegwa kwao gwonsi kw’endagera. Ase okoruegwa okwo tibweba kobeka omonyo bw’okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania. Omonyo tomocha kobekwa ase kera okoruegwa kwao.
“Aye gokorenta ogotongora kw’endagera asende inche Omonene, goika orente ebigara ebibese bisambire ase omorero, bisenyentire.
Oumore amaguta ase okoruegwa okwo, obeke na ubani; okwo nokoruegwa kw’endagera.

Omokuani asambe ebigara bike bie biria bisenyentire, amo namaguta; abisambe amo na ubani yonsi bibe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwane inche Omonene. Okwo nokoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero asende.
“Omonto kararue ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, nigo ararente eeri gose eng’ombe etari na kemocho ase omobere oye.

Omonto oyio goika abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eng’iti eyio ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso, erio ayenyenyere agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na abakuani, abamura ba Haroni, basiarere amanyinga aria ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.

Korwa ase eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’omorembe arusie ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, na ebitinya binde bionsi bire ase enda ime, amo ne chinyigo chionsi ibere na ebitinya bichitubete; na ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo. Ebinto ebio bionsi abirue bibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene.

Erio abamura ba Haroni babisambere ase egesasimero, igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kebekire ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero. Ekio nekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
“Omonto kararue ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe asende inche Omonene korwa ase riicho rie ching’ondi, gose chimbori, arente eng’iti etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, etuoni gose eaberi.
Onye okorua eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso kiaye, erio ayerue ase obosio bwane.

Ere goika abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eng’ondi eyio akorua ebe ekeng’wanso, erio ayenyenyere agwo bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Abamura ba Haroni basiarere amanyinga aria ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.

Korwa ase ekeng’wanso ekio ki’omorembe arue ebitinya, na omokera bwonsi ayobutore kegima korwa ase riuga ri’omogongo, na ebitinya bitubete chinyama chionsi chi’enda, na ebitinya binde bionsi bire ase enda ime, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, amo nebitinya bichitubete; na ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo. Ebinto ebio bionsi bibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene.
Omokuani otenenerete asambe ebinto ebio bionsi ase egesasimero bibe endagera ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene.
“Onye ekeng’wanso kiaye nembori, ayerue ase obosio bwane,

na omonto oyio goika abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’embori eyio, erio ayenyenyere agwo bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Abamura ba Haroni basiarere amanyinga aye ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.

Erio korwa ase ekeng’wanso ekio arue ebitinya bionsi ebire ase enda ime, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, na ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo. Ebinto ebio bionsi abirue bibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene.
Omokuani abisambere ase egesasimero bibe endagera ekoruegwa egosambwa nomorero, ere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera. Ebitinya bionsi nebiane.
Oyo nigo orabe omoroberio ochikire oragenderere botambe ebiaare ase ebiaare, aande onsi ase morabe mokomenya, ng’a timobaisa koria ebitinya, gose konywa amanyinga.”
Naende Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a monto onde bwensi orakore ebibe mosiabano atancheti, ase amang’ana ande onsi inche Omonene nakanete ng’a takorwa, goika abe okobwatia amachiko aya:

“Onye omokuani oyoakire amaguta ogokora ebibe, na igo arentere abanto bonsi okomocha, goika arue eeri ensae etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ase engencho y’ebibe ebio akorire, ayerue asende ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye.
Arente eeri eria ase obosio bwane agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Erio goika abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eeri eria, na ayenyenyere agwo ase obosio bwane.
Omokuani oyoakire amaguta aimokie amanyinga make ay’eeri eria, ayarente ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
Naende atobeke ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga ayio, ayanyororokerie ara gatano na kabere bosio bw’etoto eyio enachete Obomenyo Obochenu, agwo ase obosio bwane.

Nyuma y’ayio omokuani oria agindie amanyinga make ase emegwekano ye chingunchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasimero ase ubani egosamberwa, kere ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, ase obosio bwane, na amanyinga ’eeri eria agotigara ayaumore inse agwo ase egesasimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
Erio arusie ebitinya bionsi bi’eeri eria y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, na ebitinya binde bionsi bire ase enda ime,
amo ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, na ebitinya bichitubete bire ang’e nomogongo; na ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo,
koreng’ana buna akobirusia korwa ase eng’ombe eria ekonyenywa ebe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe. Erio abisambere ase egesasimero gi’ekeng’wanso.
Korende riiyo ri’eeri eyio amo ne chinyama chionsi, na omotwe, na ebirenge, na enda, na esike,
ebinto ebio bionsi bi’eeri eyio abisokie isiko y’ebitwori, abiire gochia aase achenire, ase ribu rigotugutwa, abisambere ase omorero bwe chinko agwo igoro ase ribu.

“Onye omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okorire ebibe mosiabano otancheti, na amang’ana ayio abe abisekanire asebare, kerabe bakorire kende gionsi eki inche Omonene nakanete ng’a tigekorwa, na igo babeire nokomocha,
agwo ekero ebibe biria birabe biamanyekanire, omosangererekano orue eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe na koyerenta agwo bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
Agwo ase obosio bwane abagaaka b’omoganda oria goika babeke amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio, na ero enyenyerwe agwo ase obosio bwane.
Omokuani oyio oakire amaguta, aire amanyinga make ay’eeri eyio ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ime.
Erio atobeke ekiara kiaye ime ase amanyinga na anyororokererie ara gatano na kabere ase obosio bwane agwo bosio bw’etoto eria y’egetambaa,

agindie amanyinga make ase emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero kere ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, agwo ase obosio bwane, korende amanyinga onsi aya agotigara ayaumore agwo inse ase egesasimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosamba kere ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
Naende ebitinya bionsi bi’eeri eyio abirusie na kobisambera ase egesasimero.
Naboigo arakore eeri eyio buna akorete eeri eria ye ritang’ani y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa asebare, na barabwo nabaaberwe.
Erio aire eeri eyio isiko y’egetwori, ayesambere aroro, buna asambete eeri eria ye ritang’ani. Ekio nekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase engencho y’omoganda bwonsi.
“Omogambi karakore ebibe mosiabano atancheti, na akore amang’ana ande onsi inche Omonene, Nyasae oye, nakanete ng’a takorwa, na igo obeire nokomocha,
agwo ekero ebibe biria akorete birabe biamanyekanire asare, arente egoree etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso kiaye.
Ere goika abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’egoree eyio, ayenyenyere agwo aase abanto bakonyenyera ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene. Ekio nekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

Omokuani atobeke ekiara kiaye ime ase amanyinga ayagindie ase emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, korende amanyinga onsi agotigara ayaumore agwo inse ase egesasimero ekio.

Ebitinya biaye bionsi abisambere ase egesasimero buna ebi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe bigosambwa. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omogambi oria ase engencho y’ebibe biaye, na omogambi oria naaberwe.
“Onye omonto onde bwensi ogokora ebibe mosiabano atancheti, ase amang’ana ande onsi inche Omonene nakanete ng’a takorwa, na igo obeire nokomocha,
agwo ekero ebibe bi’omonto oria birabe biamanyekanire asare arente embori eaberi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye.
Erio abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’embori eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na ayenyenyere agwo ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa bikonyenyerwa.
Omokuani aimokie amanyinga make, atobeke ekiara kiaye agindie emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero ki’ogosambera ebing’wanso; amanyinga aya agotigara ayaumore agwo inse, ase egesasimero ekio.

Erio arusie ebitinya bionsi bi’embori eyio buna ebitinya bi’eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe bikorusigwa, na omokuani asambere ebitinya ebio ase egesasimero bibe rimisu rigiya rikongwenera. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe.
“Omonto oria kararue emanwa y’eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, arente esigiti etari na kemocho ase omobere oye.
Ere abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’emanwa eria, ayenyenyere agwo ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa bikonyenyerwa, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

Omokuani aimokie amanyinga make ay’emanwa eyio, atobeke ekiara kiaye agindie emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero ki’ogosambera ebing’wanso, korende amanyinga ayagotigara ayaumore agwo inse, ase egesasimero ekio.

Erio arusie ebitinya bionsi bi’eng’ondi eyio, buna ebitinya bi’emanwa y’eng’ondi y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe bikorusigwa, na omokuani abisambere ase egesasimero, igoro ase ekeng’wanso kegosamberwa nomorero asende. Ase enchera eyio omokuani nakore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’ebibe biaye, na omonto oria naaberwe.
“Onye omonto okorangerigwa abe kirori na gotiana, anyare koorokia aya aroche, gose aigwete, ko tayaorokia, ere goika abarerwe obobe boria bw’ogotaorokia.

“Onye omonto ogokuna kende gionsi getachenegeti, korabe omobere okwete bw’eng’iti y’orosana etachenegeti, gose oyo bw’eng’iti etugire etachenegeti, gose oyo bw’akang’iti agake gatechenegeti, nonya amang’ana ayio abisekanete, ere nabe oyotachenegeti, abarerwe obobe bwaye.

“Omonto aise gokuna egento kende gionsi kia mwanyabanto getachenegeti, go korabe ogotacheneka gwa kende gionsi keramokore abe oyotachenegeti, nonya amang’ana ayio abisekanete asare, ekero arayamanye, nabe nokomocha.

“Omonto karabe omwango gotiana ase ogokora amabe gose amaya, ogotiana konde gwonsi abanto bakoba abaango gotiana batari korengereria, na ayio abe abisekanete ase omonto oyio, ekero arayamanye, nabe nokomocha ase amang’ana ayio.
“Ekero omonto arabe nokomocha ase amang’ana goika aorokie ebibe ebio akorire.

Naende andetere inche Omonene ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye ase engencho y’ebibe ebio akorire; arente eng’iti eaberi, eng’ondi gose embori, ebe ekeng’wanso ekio ki’ebibe, na omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe ebibe biaye.

“Korende onye omonto oria takonyara konyora eng’ondi, gose embori, rirorio andetere inche Omonene amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, abe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye ase engencho y’ebibe akorire. Erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
Arente amaruma ayio ase omokuani, nere arue ritang’ani riruma erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, amine ebigoti bie riruma erio, korende tabutora omotwe korwa ase ebigoti.
Erio anyororokerie amanyinga make ay’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’ebibe ase egesasimero ensemo. Amanyinga agotigara ayanyititorere agwo inse ase egesasimero. Ekio nekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

Naende arue riruma ria kabere ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, koreng’ana buna achikire. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’ebibe ebi akorire, na omonto oria naaberwe.

“Korende onye omonto oria takonyara konyora amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, rirorio arente obosie obonuke ebimunu bibere bobe okoruegwa kw’ebibe biaye. Tabeka amaguta, gose ubani, ase okoruegwa okwo, ekiagera nokoruegwa kw’ebibe.

Arente obosie obwo ase omokuani, na omokuani aimokie obosie obwo boichire rce bobe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo kwarurwe asende inche Omonene, erio abosambere ase egesasimero, igoro ase ebing’wanso bigosamberwa nomorero asende. Okwo nokoruegwa gw’okorusia ebibe.

Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’ebibe akorire ase ring’ana rinde rionsi ri’ayio, na omonto oria naaberwe. Oboratigare bobe obw’omokuani, buna obw’okoruegwa kw’endagera bokoba obwaye.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,

“Monto onde bwensi karasarie na akore ebibe mosiabano atancheti ase ogotarua ebinto biatananirwe na gochenwa asende, goika andetere emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ayerusie korwa ase riicho riaye ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye. Naye oyekorere rigori rireng’aine eri’esekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

Omonto oria naakane egento keria egechenu ataruete, naende goika amente ensemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio, ayee omokuani. Erio omokuani arue emingichi eyio y’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha na akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe.
“Monto onde bwensi aise gokora gento ase amang’ana ayio inche Omonene nakanete ng’a takorwa, nonya tamanyeti ng’a ayio akorire nokomocha, ere omochire, goika abarerwe okomocha okwo.

Ase ayio arente korwa ase riicho riaye emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha. Naye oyekorere rigori. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’okomocha koria akorire mosiabano atancheti, na omonto oria naaberwe.
Ekio nekeng’wanso gi’okomocha. Omonto oria nigo arenge nokomocha ase obosio bw’Omonene.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,

“Omonto aise gokora ebibe na gosaria asende inche Omonene ase okong’ainereria omogisangio oye ase okwanga koirania ebinto aetwe ase amaboko aye abirende, gose ase okomourereria, gose ase okomoibera ase okomorega,
gose onyorire egento giasirete, naende akane na gotiana ng’a takenyorete, bibe ebibe binde bionsi abanto bagokora,
ekero omonto akorire ebibe buna ebio na obeire nokomocha, nairanie egento keria airete ase obourereria, gose ase okorega, gose egento aetwe korenda, gose egento giasirete agakenyora,
gose egento kende gionsi keria atianete ase okong’ainereria; goika akeiranie gionsi, naende amente ensemo ya isano ase rigori riaye akee omonyene ase rituko riria akorua ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha.

Erio andetere inche Omonene emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye; ayerusie korwa ase riicho riaye rie ching’ondi, ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye; naye oyekorere rigori, na omonto oria ayeirere omokuani.
Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oyio ase obosio bwane, na omonto oyio naaberwe ase kende gionsi akorire na kwerentera okomocha.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,

“Moe Haroni amo nabamura baye ogochika oko igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa; Ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kebeere igoro ase egesasimero obotuko bwonsi goika mambia, na omorero bw’egesasmiero orendwe ogenderere gwoka.
Omokuani abeke eganchwa yaye y’egatani, amo ne chisirwari chi’ogwetuba, erio abuuche ribu korwa ase omorero oria osamberete ekeng’wanso ase egesasimero, aribeke ase egesasimero ensemo.
Nyuma y’ayio arusie chianga chiaye, abeke chianga ching’ao, naende aimokie ribu, arisokie isiko y’egetwori, ariire gochia aase achenire.

Omorero ore ase egesasimero orendwe ogenderere gwoka, torima. Kera emambia omokuani amente chinko ase omorero oyio, naende achoke buya ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa igoro ase chinko echio na asambe ebitinya bi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.
Omorero oyio orendwe ogenderere gwoka botambe, tobaisa korima.
“Oko nakwo ogochika gw’okoruegwa kw’endagera: Abamura ba Haroni babe bakorua okoruegwa kw’endagera ase obosio bw’Omonene, agwo ase egesasimero.

Erio omokuani otenenerete aimokie obosie obonuke boichire roe korwa ase okoruegwa okwo kw’endagera, na amaguta, na ubani yonsi ere igoro yaye, abisambere ase egesasimero, bibe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwane inche Omonene, kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
Haroni na abamura baye goika barie eyegotigara ase okoruegwa okwo etabekiri memera, bayeriere aase achenire, agwo ase eraaro y’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
Tebaisa koroiseranigwa nememera. Inche nabaeire endagera eyio ebe egetari kiabo gi’okoruegwa kwane kogosambwa nomorero. Ekio negechenu mono koreng’ana buna ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe na egi’okomocha bire.

Kera omonto omosacha ase ororeria rwa Haroni nanyare koria endagera eyio. Ekio nkebe egetari kiabo kia botambe gi’okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene, ebiaare ase ebiaare. Monto onde bwensi orakune ebing’wanso ebio nigo arabe omochenu.”
Naende Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,

“Oko nakwo okoruegwa Haroni na abamura baye bararue asende inche Omonene ase rituko riria onde obo araakwe amaguta na gwatananwa: Ebimunu bibere bi’obosie obonuke, buna okoruegwa kw’endagera gwa kera rituko, ekemo mambia na ekende mogoroba.
Okoruegwa okwo gokarangwe namaguta ase orogio, gosamunyorwe, erio kobe okoruegwa kw’endagera kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.

Omokuani, omomura o Haroni, oyo oakire amaguta na gwatananwa ase okomobwatia, nere orarue okoruegwa okwo asende. Okwo nogochika koragenderere botambe. Okoruegwa okwo nagosambwe gwonsi asende inche Omonene.
Kera okoruegwa kw’endagera omokuani akorua goika gosambwe gwonsi, tikobaisa koriegwa.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,

“Moe Haroni amo nabamura baye ogochika oko igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe: Agwo ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gekonyenyerwa nao agwo eki’ebibe keranyenyerwe, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene. Ekeng’wanso ekio negechenu mono.
Omokuani oyio okorua ekeng’wanso ekio nakeriere aase achenire, agwo ase eraaro y’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
Onde bwensi orakune enyama y’ekeng’wanso ekio nabe omochenu; naboigo na kende gionsi kerayekune, na amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ekio aise gotonyera eanga, eyio esiberigwe agwo aase achenire.
Enyongo chinyama echio chiraiyekerwe goika yaatwe, korende onye chikoiyekerwa ase esuguria, rirorio ero esisikigwe na gosibigwa namache.
Kera omonto omosacha ore ase chinka chi’abakuani arie chinyama echio echire chinchenu mono.
Korende ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, ekio amanyinga aye ararentwe ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ime y’Aase Aachenu tigekoriegwa, nigo kerasambwe nomorero.
“Oko nakwo ogochika gw’okorua ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha. Ekio nekeng’wanso egechenu mono.
Aase agwo eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ekonyenyerwa nao eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha eranyenyerwe. Amanyinga aye asiarerwe ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
Ebitinya biaye bionsi birusigwe na koruegwa; omokera na ebitinya bitubetechinyama chi’enda,
ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete bire ang’e nomogongo, na ebitinya bie riini birusigwe amo ne chinyigo.
Omokuani abisambere ase egesasimero, bibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene. Ekio nekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha.
Kera omonto omosacha bw’enka y’omokuani nakeriere agwo aase achenire. Ekio negechenu mono.
“Ogochika gw’okorua ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha nigo kore okomo nogw’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Omokuani oria ogokora okobwatanigwa nakerokio aire chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso eke chibe echiaye.
Omokuani okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosamwa ase engencho y’omonto onde, aire risankwa ri’ekeng’wanso keria ribe eriaye.
Kera okoruegwa kw’endagera okoroiseirie riko, na kende gionsi ekeroiseirie ase orogio, gose ase egetega, okwo nakobe okw’omokuani oria okoruete asende inche Omonene.
Kera okoruegwa kw’endagera gwochoganirie namaguta, gose ogotari namaguta, abamura ba Haroni baegwe, baatananerwe bareng’anerigwe.
“Oko nakwo ogochika gw’okorua ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, ekio omonto ararente ase Omonene.

Onye omonto okorua ekeng’wanso ekio ase ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, rirorio amo nekeng’wanso ekio arue okoruegwa kw’amaandasi atabekiri memera aroisirie namaguta, na emegati emeoo etabekiri memera eakire amaguta, na emegati y’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta.
Amo nekeng’wanso kiaye ki’omorembe ki’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, arente emegati ebekire ememera.
Korwa ase okoruegwa okwo arue omogati oyomo bwa kera egesaku, ebe ekeegwa ase Omonene. Eyio ebe ey’omokuani oyio ogosiarera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso keria ase egesasimero.
Chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’omorembe ki ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono chiriegwe ase rituko riria gekoruegwa; tichibaisa gotigara nonya ne chinsinini goika rituko ria kabere.
“Korende onye omonto okorua ekeng’wanso ase engencho y’eira ariete, gose neki’ogwancha kwaye, nakeriegwe ase rituko riria gekoruegwa, na ekegotigara keriegwe ase rituko ria kabere.
Chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso ekio chigotigara ase rituko ria gatato goika chisambwe nomorero chiyie chiere.

Onye enyama ende yonsi y’ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’omorembe ekoriegwa ase rituko ria gatato, ekeng’wanso ekio tikegwancherwa, gose oyo okeruete takobarerwa ekeng’wanso ekio. Ekio nakebe okogechia, na onde bwensi orarie enyama y’ekeng’wanso ekio nabarerwe obobe bwaye.
Enyama eyio kerakune gento kende gionsi getachenegeti esambwe nomorero, eyie eere. “Onye enyama echenegete, kera omonto ochenekire nare ne ribaga ri’okoyeria,
korende oyotachenegeti takoria enyama y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe gekoruegwa ase Omonene. Aise gokora igo, nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.

“Naende omonto karakune egento getachenegeti, gokerabe egetachenegeti kere ase omonto, gose ase eng’iti, gose okogechia konde gwonsi, na arie enyama y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe gekoruegwa ase Omonene, omonto oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a tibabaisa koria ebitinya binde bionsi, ebi’eng’ombe, gose ebi’eng’ondi, gose ebi’embori.
Ebitinya bi’eng’iti egokwa yoka enyene, na ebi’eng’iti egoitwa neyende, ebio nabikorerwe emeremo emeao, korende tibikoriegwa nonya ng’ake.
