Monto onde bwensi orarie ebitinya bi’eng’iti yarurwe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene, oyio nigo eraatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
Naende timoria amanyinga e chinyoni, gose aye ching’iti aande onsi ase moramenye.
Monto onde bwensi orarie amanyinga ande onsi, oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.”
Naende Omonene agatebia Musa,
“Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a omonto onde bwensi orarue ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, arue korwa ase ekeng’wanso ekio gentungetie inche Omonene.

Arente namaboko aye omonyene ekeng’wanso kiaye kegosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene; arente ebitinya amo ne ritaana, ne ritaana erio risungusigwe ribe ekeng’wanso kegosungusigwa ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.
Omokuani asambere ebitinya ase egesasimero, korende ritaana ribe eria Haroni na abamura baye.
Ekenama kia borio okee omokuani buna ekeegwa korwa ase ebing’wanso biaino bi’omorembe.
Omokuani, omomura o Haroni, oyio orabe okorua amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’omorembe amo nebitinya, nere oraire ekenama keria kia borio kebe egetari kiaye.

Korwa ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe gekoruegwa n’Abaisraeli narusirie ritaana rigosungusigwa amo nekenama kia borio, nabieire Haroni omokuani na abamura baye. Ebio nabio Abaisraeli barabe bakoa abakuani, bibe ebitari biabo botambe.
“Ekio negetari kemotungetie Haroni na abamura baye korwa ase ebing’wanso bigosambwa nomorero asende; nigo kiabete ekiabo korwa rituko riria baatananetwe bakaba abakuani bagonkorera inche Omonene.
Rituko riria baagetwe amaguta inche ngachika ng’a egetari ekio korwa ase Abaisraeli kebe ekiabo kogenderera botambe, ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
Oko nakwo ogochika igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na egi’okorongeyia okomocha, na eki’ogosungusigwa, na eki’omorembe.
Ogochika okwo nakwo Omonene aete Musa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, ase rituko riria achigete Abaisraeli bamoruere Omonene ebing’wanso biabo.
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Ira Haroni na abamura baye amo ne chianga chiabo chi’obokuani, na amaguta akweakwa, na eeri ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, ne chimingichi ibere, na egetonga kere nemegati etabekiri memera.
Naende orangerie omoganda bwonsi osangererekane ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.”
Musa agakora buna Omonene amochigete, na ekero omoganda bwonsi osangererekanete ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano,
Musa akayotebia. “Aya naro Omonene achikire akorwe.”
Musa akarenta Haroni na abamura baye, akabasibia namache.

Akabekera Haroni eganchwa erobekanire eigete inse, na eganchwa eria ende, akamoboeria norokini. Naende akamobekera egesibao ki’obokuani, akamoboeria norokini rw’egesibao roroisirie nomonto omong’aini.
Erio akamobekera egesembe, na ime ase egesembe ekio akabeka Urimu na Tumimu (omobaso na oboikeranu).
Akamobekera ekegogwa ase omotwe oye, na bosio ase ekegogwa ekio agasiberania ekemanyererio egechenu gi’etahabu kiarenge kworokia ng’a bwatananirwe. Ase igo Musa agakora buna Omonene amochigete.
Musa akaimokia amaguta akweakwa, agaaka Obomenyo Obochenu, na kera egento kiarenge imeo, akabiatanana bikaba ebichenu.
Akanyororokeria egesasimero namaguta akweakwa ara gatano na kabere, naende agaaka egesasimero amaguta aria, agaaka nebikorero bionsi, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye ase okobiatanana bibe ebichenu.
Akaumora amaguta akweakwa igoro ase omotwe o Haroni, na akamoaka amaguta ase okomwatanana na komochena.
Naende Musa akarenta abamura ba Haroni, akababekera chiganchwa, akababoeria chinkini na akababekera ebigogwa ebike ase emetwe yabo, buna Omonene amochigete.
Musa akarenta eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, erio Haroni amo nabamura baye bakabeka amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio.

Eeri eyio ekanyenywa, erio Musa agatobeka ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga ’eeri eyio, akayagindia ase emegwekano yonsi ye chingunchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasimero, na agachena egesasimero; na amanyinga aria atigarete akayaumora ase egesasimero inse, akagiatanana na kogechena, na igo akagekorera okobwatanigwa.
Akaimokia ebitinya bionsi biarenge ase chinyama chi’enda, na ebitinya bie riini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete, Erio Musa akabisambera ase egesasimero.
Korende ebiatigarete korwa ase eeri eria, riiyo riaye, ne chinyama, na esike, akabisokia isiko y’egetwori akabisambera aroro, buna Omonene amochigete.
Erio akarenta emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na Haroni amo nabamura baye bakabeka amaboko abo ase omotwe bw’emingichi eyio.
Emingichi eyio ekanyenywa, na Musa agasiara amanyinga ’emingichi eyio ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.

Akanachana chinyama chi’emingichi eyio chikaba ebitari, agasibia chinyama chi’enda na ebirenge namache. Erio agasamba omotwe, na ebitari biria, na ebitinya, ne chinyama chionsi chi’emingichi eyio ase egesasimero. Emingichi eyio ekaba ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene. Naboigo Omonene achigete Musa.
Musa akarenta emingichi ya kabere, eyio yaruetwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu, Haroni na abamura baye bakabeka amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’emingichi eyio.
Emingichi eyio ekanyenywa, na Musa akaimokia amanyinga make, akagindia mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kwa Haroni, na ekiara ekenene gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio, na ekiara ekenene gi’okogoro kwaye kwa borio.

Boigo abamura ba Haroni bakarentwa na Musa akagindia amanyinga mesia y’amato abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amaboko abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amagoro abo a borio. Erio amanyinga aria atigarete akayasiarera ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
Akaimokia ebitinya, na omokera, na ebitinya bionsi bie chinyama chi’enda, na ebitinya bie riini, ne chinyigo ibere, amo nebitinya bichitubete, na ekenama kia borio.

Naende korwa ase egetonga keria kiarenge agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene akarusia omogati oyomo otabekiri memera, ne rindasi erimo, na omogati oyomo omoo, erio akabibeka igoro ase ebitinya ebio na ekenama ekio kia borio.
Akabeka ebinto ebio bionsi ase amaboko a Haroni, na ay’abamura baye, akabisungusia bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene.

Naende Musa akabirusia korwa ase amaboko abo, akabisambera ase egesasimero amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, bibe ekeng’wanso gi’okobaatanana. Eke nekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera.

Erio Musa akaimokia ritaana, akarisungusia ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase Omonene. Nigo riabete egetari kiaye kiarusetiwge korwa ase emingichi eria yaruetwe ase ogwatanana abakuani. Ase igo Musa agakora buna Omonene amochigete.

Musa akaimokia amaguta akweakwa amo namanyinga arenge igoro ase egesasimero, akanyororokeria Haroni amo ne chianga chiaye, akanyororokeria na abamura ba Haroni amo ne chianga chiabo. Naboigo agaatanana Haroni na abamura baye amo ne chianga chiabo ase emeremo emechenu.

Erio Musa agatebia Haroni na abamura baye, “Iyekera enyama eyio agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na moyeriere aroro, moyerie amo nemegati eria ere ime ase egetonga gi’okoruegwa ase ogwatananwa kw’abakuani! Naboigo inche nachigete, ngateba: Haroni amo nabamura baye mbayerie.
Korende enyama amo nemegati biratigare mobisambe nomorero.
Inwe timobaisa gosoka isiko goetania egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, korende mobeereo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, goika amatuko ’ogwatanana kwaino aere.
Buna akorirwe ase rituko ria rero, naboigo Omonene achikire akorwe kogenderera ase ogokora okobwatanigwa asemore, erinde mwaberwe.
Inwe nigo morabeere agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, omobaso na obotuko, ase amatuko atano na abere, mobe mogokora aya Omonene achikire. Motakoreti ayio, inwe nigo morakwe.”
Ase igo Haroni na abamura baye bagakora onsi aya Omonene achigete goetera ase Musa.
Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato Musa akarangeria Haroni amo nabamura baye, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli.
Naende agatebia Haroni, “Chora eeri ensae na emingichi, chionsi ibere chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, ochirue ase Omonene. Eeri eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi ebe eki’ogosambwa.

Naende otebie Abaisraeli ng’a bachore egoree ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emori amo nemanwa y’eng’ondi echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa,
na eng’ombe amo nemingichi chibe ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase obosio bw’Omonene. Naboigo barue okoruegwa kw’endagera gwochoganirie namaguta, ekiagera ase rituko ria rero Omonene nabaorokere.”
Abanto bakarenta ebinto ebio bionsi Musa abachigete, bakabibeka bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na omoganda bwonsi ogaika ang’e, ogatenena agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
Erio Musa agateba, “Eke nakio Omonene abachigete mokore, erio obonene bw’Omonene mbobaorokere.”

Erio Musa agatebia Haroni, “Suka gochia ang’e ase egesasimero, na orue ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ebibe na eki’ogosambwa, okore okobwatanigwa asore aye omonyene, na ase abanto, erinde mwaberwe. Naende orue ekeng’wanso ekio abanto barentire, na okore okobwatanigwa asebare, buna Omonene achigete.”
Ase ayio Haroni agasuka gochia ang’e ase egesasimero, akanyenya emori eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye omonyene,

na abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga ekeng’wanso ekio, ere agatobeka ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga aria, erio akayagindia ase emegwekano ye chingunchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasimero, na amanyinga atigarete akayaumora ase egesasimero inse.
Ebitinya ne chinyigo, na ebitinya bie riini, ebiarusetie ase ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe, akabisambera ase egesasimero, buna Omonene achigete Musa.
Korende chinyama ne riiyo akabisamba nomorero isiko y’egetwori.
Nyuma y’ayio akanyenya eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ekio, nere akayasiarera ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
Abamura baye bakamorentera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, egetari ase egetari, amo nomotwe, na ere akabisambera ase egesasimero.
Agasibia chinyama chi’enda amo nebirenge, erio akabisambera amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase egesasimero.
Erio Haroni akarenta ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe bi’abanto. Akaimokia embori y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe bi’abanto, akayenyenya, akayerua buna aruete eria ye ritang’ani ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene.
Naende akarenta eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, akayerua buna konya achikirwe.
Akarenta okoruegwa kw’endagera, akaimokia obosie boichire roe, akabosambera ase egesasimero amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kia mambia.
Akanyenya boigo eeri amo nemingichi, chikaba ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase engencho y’abanto. Abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga ’ebing’wanso ebio, nere akayasiarera ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
Ebitinya bi’eeri eyio, na omokera bw’emingichi na ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, ne chinyigo, na ebitinya bie riini,
ebitinya ebio bionsi bakabibeka igoro ase amataana, na Haroni akabisambera ase egesasimero,
korende amataana na ebinema bia borio akabisungusia bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase Omonene, buna Musa achigete.
Haroni gakoorire korua ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na eki’ogosambwa, na eki’omorembe, akaimokia amaboko aye igoro ase abanto, akabasesenia, naende agaika gocha inse.
Erio Musa na Haroni bagasoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ime, naende ekero basokire korwa aroro, bagasesenia abanto, na obonene bw’Omonene bokaorokera abanto bonsi.

Omorero ogaika korwa ase Omonene mobosokano, ogasamba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa amo nebitinya biarenge ase egesasimero, na ebinto ebio bikayia bikaera. Ekero abanto bonsi baroche amang’ana ayio bagaaka amariogi, bagatung’ama inse, bakaumama.

Nadabu na Abihu, abamura ba Haroni, kera oyomo akaimokia orogio rwaye, akabeka omorero ase orogio orwo, na akabeka ubani igoro ase omorero oyio, bakarentera Omonene omorero orenge bw’engencho eng’ao, oyio Omonene atabachigete.
Na omorero ogaika korwa ase Omonene, okabasamba, barabwo bakayia, bagakwera agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
Erio Musa agatebia Haroni, “Aya naro Omonene atebire, ng’a ere neorokie koba omochenu ase abanto abwo bakomoika ang’e, na ase amaiso ’abanto bonsi naorokie obonene bwaye.” Haroni agakira‐kiri.

Erio Musa akarangeria Mishaeli na Elisafani, basinto ba Usieli, ise moke Haroni, akabatebia, “Inchuo mobogorie emebere y’abamino, abana ba iso moke, moyerusie korwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu, moyeire isiko y’egetwori.”
Barabwo bagacha, bakabogoria emebere eria eboyirie chiganchwa chiabo, bakayeira isiko y’egetwori, buna Musa abatebetie.

Musa agatebia Haroni amo n’Eleazari na Itamari, abamura ba Haroni, “Timobaisa gotiga chitukia chiaino chitachanoiri, gose timobaisa gotandora chianga chiaino ase okobaichanera. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe, na endamwamu entindi y’Omonene echiche igoro y’omoganda bwonsi. Korende Abaisraeli bamino bonsi barabwo mbabe bakorera ase engencho y’ogosamba ogotindi Omonene arentire.
Timobaisa gosoka isiko goetania egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe, ekiagera mwatananirwe ase ogoakwa amaguta ’Omonene.” Barabwo bagakora buna Musa abatebetie.
Omonene agakwana na Haroni, akamotebia,

“Aye amo nabamura bao timobaisa konywa edivai, gose ekenyugwa kegotindia, ekero mogosoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe. Okwo nogochika koragenderere asemore ebiaare ase ebiaare.
Inwe goika momanye gwatanana egento egechenu kere ekia Nyasae korwa ase ekio getaatananiri koba egechenu, na egento gechenegete korwa ase egetachenegeti.
Mworokererie Abaisraeli amachiko onsi aya inche Omonene nabachikire goetera ase Musa.”

Musa agatebia Haroni na abamura baye abatigarete, Eleazari na Itamari, “Imokia okoruegwa kw’endagera, okwo gotigarete korwa ase okwo gwasambirwe nomorero ase Omonene, mokorie gotabekiri memera, agwo ase egesasimero ensemo, ekiagera okoruegwa okwo nogochenu mono.
Mokoriere agwo aase gete are aachenu. Ekio negetari kiao, na eki’abamura bao, gekorusigwa korwa ase okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero ase Omonene. Ayio naro Omonene anchigete.

Korende ritaana rigosungusigwa, na ekenama gekoruegwa, aye amo nabana bao, abamura na abaiseke, mwaeirwe ribaga kobiriera agwo aase achenire. Ebinto ebio aye na abana bao mwabieirwe korwa ase ebing’wanso bi’omorembe bikoruegwa n’Abaisraeli.

Ekenama gekoruegwa, ne ritaana riria rigosungusigwa, birentwe amo nebitinya bikoruegwa ebing’wanso bigosambwa nomorero, bisungusigwe bibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ebio nabibe egetari kiao amo neki’abamura bao kogenderera botambe, buna Omonene achigete.”

Musa agatuka mono komanyanaki embori y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe yabete, akamanya ng’a embori eria nigo yasambetwe. Ase ayio akaba nendamwamu enene ase Eleasari na Itamari, abamura ba Haroni, baria batigarete, akabatebia.

“Nase ki motarierete ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe agwo aase are aachenu? Ekio negento egechenu mono mwaeirwe, erinde moruserie omoganda ebibe biabo, na gokora okobwatanigwa asebare ase obosio bw’Omonene.
Rora, amanyinga aye tairetwe agwo Aase Aachenu; nigo yabagwenerete mokeriere agwo aase achenire.”

Haroni akairaneria Musa, “Rora, rituko ria rero abanto barure ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’ebibe, na eki’ogosambwa, ase obosio bw’Omonene, korende nonya naboigo nomanyete emechando eye nanyorire. Onye inaria ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe rituko ria rero, Inee, nanga nancherwa ase obosio bw’Omonene?”
Ekero Musa aigwete amang’ana ayio agaisaneka.
Omonene agakwana na Musa na Haroni, akabatebia,
“Kwana n’Abaisraeli, mobatebie: Ase ching’iti chire ase ense, echi nachio morarie chinyama chiabo:
Eng’iti ende yonsi ebwate ebitaago biatananegete kegima, naende ekoria eng’ang’ura, nero morarie.
Korende ase ching’iti chikoria eng’ang’ura gose chibwate ebitaago biatananegete timoria engamia, ekiagera nigo ekoria eng’angu’ra, korende tebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio techenegeti.
Timoria egesengi, ekiagera nigo gekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tikebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio tigechenegeti.
Timoria egesusu, ekiagera nigo gekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tikebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio tigechenegeti.
Naende timoria embeche, ekiagera nigo ebwate ebitaago biatananegete kegima, korende teri koria eng’ang’ura; eyio techenegeti.
Timoria chinyama chie ching’iti echio, gose timokuna emebere yabo ekwete, ekiagera echio tichichenegeti.”
“Monyare koria chinswe chire ase chinyancha ne chindooche ime, echibwate chingondo chinga buna chimbaba, na amagoocho.
Korende ebitongwa binde bionsi bire moyo ime ase chinyancha, gose ase chindooche, bigotaara bire amaicho bitabwati chingondo chinga buna chimbaba, na amagoocho, timobiria; ebio nokogechia asemore.
Ebio nabigenderere koba okogechia asemore, chinyama chiabo timochiria, na echikwete ase echio timochiria, ekiagera echio nokogechia asemore.
Kera egento kere ime ase chinyancha ne chindooche getabwati chingondo chinga buna chimbaba, na amagoocho, ekio nokogechia asemore.”
“Nase chinyoni chirabe okogechia asemore motarie nachio echi: Ekeongo, na ensoti, na obotere;
amakoru na ebisaku biamwabo;
ebigonkoru na ebisaku biamwabo bionsi;
esagero, na omoyaye, na enyakoboko, na ebisaku biamwabo;
enyakweumia, na endubi, na ebarara;
etibibi, na etekere, na ensoti;
riagonga, na omoneke, na ebisaku biamwabo; enteema bobe na egetabora mato.”
“Ebitongwa ebisinini bionsi bire moyo bire ne chimbaba na amagoro ane, ebio mbibe okogechia asemore.
Korende ebitongwa ebio ebisinini bibwate chimbaba na amagoro ane inamorie ebio bigotaroka nebirenge.
Ebisaku bionsi bie chingige, na ebi’amabururu, na ebisase, ebio nabio morarie.
Korende ebinde bionsi ase ebitongwa ebio ebisinini bibwate chimbaba na amagoro ane, ebio mbibe okogechia asemore.”
“Ase ebitongwa ebio nigo moresoyie ase ogotacheneka. Monto onde bwensi orakune ebikwete ase ebio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio,
na onde bwensi oraimokie egekwete korwa ase ebio nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Kera eng’iti ebwate ebitaago, korende tibiatananegeti kegima, naende teri koria eng’ang’ura, eyio nebe eyetachenegeti asemore. Monto onde bwensi orakune ching’iti echio nabe oyotachenegeti.
Ching’iti chiria chikogendera ebisonsogoro ase echio chibwate amagoro ane tichichenegeti asemore. Monto onde bwensi orakune echikwete ase echio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Na monto onde bwensi oraimokie eyekwete ase echio nasibie chianga chiaye, nere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio. Ching’iti echio nachibe chitachenegeti asemore.”
“Ase ching’iti chinke chigoetanana ase ense, echio nchibe chitachenegeti asemore; Ekenyamunyonge, na embeba, na ekiigo ekenene, amo nebisaku biamwabo;
ekiigo egeke, na eng’oina, na esagara, enke na enene, amo nenyambu.
Ase ching’iti echio chinke echio nchibe chitachenegeti asemore. Monto onde bwensi orachikune ekero chiakure nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

Ching’iti echio chiise kogwera egento kende gionsi ekero chiakure, egento ekio nakebe egetachenegeti, onye negento keroisirie korwa ase emete, gose gokerabe eanga, gose risankwa, gose esaro, gose egento kende gionsi kegokorerwa emeremo. Egento ekio kebekwe ime ase amache, naende kebe getachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio; erio nakebe giachenekire.
Onye eyemo ye ching’iti echio ekogwera enyongo, gose gento kende keroisirie korwa ase amaroba, ekere ime yaye nakebe egetachenegeti, na egento ekio goika giatwe.
Endagera ende yonsi ekoriegwa nebe eyetachenegeti onye amache akoumorwa korwa ase enyongo buna eyio akoyekuna, na ekenyugwa kende gionsi kere ime y’enyongo buna eyio nkebe getachenegeti.
Gento kende gionsi keragwerwe neyemo ye ching’iti echio ekwete inakebe getachenegeti; onye ne riko rikoroisia emegati, gose neri’ endagera, erio riatwe, riabeire eritachenegeti asemore.
Ensoko gose aase amache akogachwa nabigenderere koba ebichenegete, korende ebinto binde bionsi ebiaao biise gokuna ching’iti echio chikwete mbibe ebitachenegeti.
Onye eng’iti eyemo y’echio ekwete keragwere embusuro egosimekwa, embusuro eyio negenderere koba echenegete.
Korende onye embusuro eyio yainekirwe ase amache ime, na egwerwe neyemo ye ching’iti echio ekwete, rirorio nebe etachenegeti.”
“Eng’iti ende yonsi yancheire koriegwa kerakwe, na omonto orayekune, rirorio omonto oyio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

Monto onde bwensi orarie enyama y’eng’iti eyio ekwete nasibie chianga chiaye, naende nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio, na onde bwensi oraimokie eng’iti eyio ekwete, nasibie chianga chiaye, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.”
“Ebitongwa ebike bionsi bigoetanana ase ense nigo bire okogechia, tibiriegwa.
Egetongwa kende gionsi egeke kegwekururera enda, gose gekogendera amagoro ane, gose amange, ase ebio bigoetanana ase ense, nigo bire okogechia, timobaisa kobiria.
Timobaisa gwekora okogechia ase engencho y’ebitongwa ebio bigoetanana, gose gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho ya birobio. Moise gokora igo, namobe abatachenegeti.

Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino; ase ayio mweatanane inwe abanyene, mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche nomochenu inde. Timobaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho y’egetongwa kende gionsi egeke ase ebio bigoetanana ase ense.
Inche ninche Omonene, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri imbe Nyasae oino. Ase ayio, mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche nomochenu inde.”
Oko nakwo ogochika gotenenerete ching’iti ne chinyoni, na kera egetongwa kere moyo kegoetanana ase amache ime, na ebitongwa ebisinini bigoetanana ase ense,
na igo momanye gwatanana ebichenegete korwa ase ebitachenegeti, ne ching’iti chire moyo chiancheire koriegwa korwa ase echitancheiri koriegwa.
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Otebie Abaisraeli ng’a omokungu karabe morito na aibore omwana omoisia nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, amatuko ang’ana buna ekero abwate omotienyi abe oyotachenegeti.
Omwana oria omoisia asarwe ase rituko ria gatano na gatato.

Erio omokungu oria aganye ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato na atato, goika amanyinga akame, na ere omonyene nabe oyochenegete. Tabaisa gokuna gento kende goinsi gechenegete, gose gosoa Aase Aachenu, goika amatuko aye ay’ogochenwa aere.

Korende karaibore omwana egesagane, nabe oyotachenegeti ase chichuma ibere, buna ekero abwate omotienyi, naende aganye ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etano nomo, na atano na rimo, goika amanyinga aye akame, na ere omonyene nabe oyochenegete.

“Ekero amatuko ’omokungu oyio ay’ogochenwa aerire, karabe nomwana omoisia aiboire, gose egesagane, omokungu oyio arente eng’ondi yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, ne riige rie riruma, gose riruma, ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Abirente ase omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

Omokuani oria arue eng’ondi eyio, gose riruma erio ase obosio bw’Omonene, na akore okobwatanigwa ase omokungu oyio, na igo nabe ochenekire korwa ase ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye. Oko nakwo ogochika ase omokungu oiborete omwana, omoisia gose egesagane.

“Onye omokungu oria takonyara konyora eng’ondi, rirorio arente amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na erinde eki’ebibe. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omokungu oyio, na omokungu oyio nabe ochenekire.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa na Haroni, akabatebia:

“Ekero omonto abeire negesambo, gose abimbire risankwa ri’omobere oye, gose risankwa riatorekire na koonchoka ribe buna oborwaire bwa ukoma, omonto oyio arentwe ase Haroni omokuani, gose ase oyomo bw’abamura baye ore omokuani.

Omokuani oyio arenge oborwaire obwo buya. Kararore ng’a amarionya are ase egesambo keria aonchokire abeire amarabu, na oborwaire bwakorire engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, rirorio oborwaire obwo nobwa ukoma. Ekero omokuani arengire omonto oria buya, atebe ng’a oyio onyorekanire ng’a tachenegeti.

Onye egesambo keria kere ekerabu, korende tigekoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, na amarionya egesambo keria tabeti amarabu, rirorio omokuani abeke omonto oria ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a oborwaire boria tibwesiarereti ase risankwa, erio amobeke naende ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko ande atano na abere.

Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a egesambo keria giachakire gosira, na oborwaire boria tibwesiarereti ase risankwa erio omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oria ochenekire, namaote oka abwate. Omonto oria asibie chianga chiaye, erio abe oyochenegete kegima.
Korende egesambo keria gokerabe giesiareire ase risankwa nyuma omokuani karorire ng’a ochenekire, omonto oria goika airane ase omokuani naende,
na ere kararore ng’a egesambo keria giesiareire ase risankwa, erio atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma.
“Ekero omonto abwate oborwaire bwa ukoma ararentwe ase omokuani,
na ere amorenge buya. Kararore egesambo ekerabu ase risankwa, na amarionya aonchokire abeire amarabu, naende onye enyama embariri yachakire gokina imeo,

obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma obokoro bogendererete ase engaki entambe ase risankwa ri’omobere bw’omonto oria. Omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti; bono tamobeka ase egesomo, ekiagera tachenegeti.
Onye oborwaire obwo bwa ukoma bwasokire ase risankwa isiko, na omokuani ororire ng’a bwesiareire ase omobere bwonsi korwa omotwe goika amagoro,

erio omokuani amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a oborwaire boria bwatubire omobere bwonsi bw’omonto oria, rirorio atebe ng’a ochenekire. Onye omobere bwonsi obeire omorabu, omonto oria obeire oyochenegete.
Korende onye enyama embariri yachakire gokina imeo, omonto oyio tachenegeti.
Ekero omokuani ararore ng’a enyama eria embariri yasokire, rirorio atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Enyama eria embariri nigo ere eyetachenegeti. Obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma.
Korende onye enyama eria embariri ekoonchoka ebe endabu, erio omonto oyio agende ase omokuani,
na ere amorenge buya, na onye egesambo kiaonchokire na koraba, erio omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio ochenekire.
“Omonto onye orenge ne rigumba ase risankwa riaye, ne rigumba erio koriagwenire,
na aase agwe ase risankwa riarenge obobimbu oborabu bororekane, gose egesambo gekororekana kere nobobariri na oborabu, omonto oria goika agende ase omokuani.

Ere amorenge buya, na kararore ng’a egesambo keria giakorire engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, na amarionya areo aonchokire na koraba, omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oria tachenegeti. Obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma bwaorokeire ase rigumba riria.

Korende omokuani karamorenge na arore ng’a amarionya ’egesambo keria tari amarabu, na tigekoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, naende giachakire gosira, omokuani abeke omonto oria ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
Onye oborwaire obwo bwesiareire ase risankwa, erio omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti, risankwa rianyorire oborwaire.
Korende onye egesambo keria tikeonchogeti na gwesiarera, eyio nenkoru ase rigumba riariete, na omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oria ochenekire.
“Onye omonto ore ne risambo ri’omorero ayiete ase risankwa ri’omobere oye, na enyama embariri ekineteo ebe egesambo ki’obobariri na oborabu, gose kebe ekerabu,

omokuani arenge egesambo ekio. Onye amarionya egesambo ekio aonchokire na koraba, naende egesambo kiabeire engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa ri’omobere oye, obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma bwasokire ase risambo ri’omorero riarenge. Omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma.

Korende omokuani kararenge egesambo keria, na arore ng’a amarionya aria areo taonchogeti abe amarabu, naende egesambo tikerakora engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, korende giachakire gosira, erio omokuani amobeke ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
Rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani amorenge naende. Kararore ng’a egesambo keria giesiareire ase risankwa, erio atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma.

Korende onye egesambo keria tikeonchogeti gose giesiarere ase risankwa, korende giachakire gosira, okwo nokobimba kwe risambo, na omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio ochenekire. Eyio nenkoru ye risankwa ri’omobere.
“Onye omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, obwate egesambo ase omotwe oye, gose ase ekenyonyobu,

omokuani arenge egesambo ekio. Onye gekorete engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, naende onye amarionya areo are monuri na konyererea, erio omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Erio nerichoncho ri’oborwaire bwa ukoma ase omotwe oye, gose ase ekenyonyobu.

Omokuani kararenge richoncho riria na arore ng’a tirikoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, naende amarionya amamwamu tari aroro, erio omokuani amobeke ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani arenge naende oborwaire boria, na onye tibwesiarereti, naende amarionya amonuri tario, naende richoncho tirikoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa,
omonto oyio akigite etukia, korende takigita ase richoncho rire, na omokuani amwatanane, amobeke ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko ande atano na abere.

Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani amorenge naende, na onye richoncho riria tiriesiarereti ase risankwa, na tirikoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio ochenekire, ase igo asibie chianga chiaye, abe oyochenegete kegima.
Korende onye richoncho riria riesiareire ase risankwa nyuma gachenekire,
omokuani amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a richoncho riria riesiareire, takorigia korora gose amarionya are monuri nareo, omonto oyio tachenegeti.
Omokuani kararore ng’a richoncho riria tirionchogeti, na amarionya amamwamu amerire imeo, richoncho riria riagwenire, na omonto oria ochenekire kegima. Omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio ochenekire.
“Onye omosacha gose omokungu obwate ebisambo ebirabu ase risankwa ri’omobere,
omokuani amorenge. Nere kararore ng’a ebisambo bie risankwa ri’omobere nigo bire ebirabu ake, ebisambo ebio tibiri bobe; omonto oyio ochenekire.
“Onye omonto osunyokire etukia, risio riachiire magega, nigo are nyaisio, ere ochenekire,
na onye osunyokire etukia y’omotwe bosio, boigo ere ochenekire.
Korende onye ase risio ri’omotwe oye, magega gose bosio, obwate egesambo kere nobobariri na oborabu, obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma bwasokeire ase risio.

Ase ayio, omokuani karamorenge arore ng’a egesambo kebimbete ase risio riria, magega gose bosio, kere nobobariri na oborabu, na nigo gekororekana buna oborwaire bwa ukoma mbore ase risankwa ri’omobere,
omonto oyio nabwate oborwaire bwa ukoma, ere tachenegeti. Omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti; oborwaire nigo bore ase omotwe oye.
“Omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma abeke chianga amachanchabe, tabaisa gochanoa etukia yaye, atube omonwa oye ase egekoba kia igoro, erio aake eriogi na gokuura: Inche tinchenegeti! Tinchenegeti!
Ere agenderere koba oyotachenegeti ekero are noborwaire boria, aatananwe amenye isiko y’egetwori, ao korwa ase abanto bande.
“Onye ukoma bore ase eanga eroisirie korwa ase amarionya gose egatani,
gose bore ase egetambaa keroisirie ase chingencho ao ao korwa ase egatani, gose ase amarionya, gose ase rirondia rie risankwa, gose ase egento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa,

na onye ekemoa gekororekana kere nekieni buna obonyansi, gose ekebariri, ase eanga, gose ase risankwa, gose ase egetambaa keria, gose ase egento kende keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, obwo noukoma bogwesiarera, na ebinto ebi biorokigwe ase omokuani.
Omokuani arenge egento kere na ukoma, erio akebeke ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani akerenge naende. Kararore ng’a ogosareka koria gwesiareire ase eanga, gose ase egetambaa keroisirie ase chingencho ao ao, gose ase risankwa, gose ase egento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, nigo kiabwatetwe na ukoma obobe mono; egento ekio tigechenegeti.

Ase igo egento ekio gesambwe nomorero, gokerabe eanga, gose egetambaa kende gionsi, keroisirie korwa ase amarionya, gose korwa ase egatani, gose gento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa kere noborwaire obwo ime yaye. Obwo noborwaire obobe bwa ukoma; ebinto ebio goika bisambwe nomorero.
“Omokuani kararenge na arore ng’a ekemoa keria tigieserarereti ase eanga eria, gose ase egetambaa keria, gose ase kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa,
rirorio achike ng’a egento ekio giasarekire, tiga gesibigwe na kebekwe ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko ande atano na abere.

Omokuani arenge ekemoa ase egento keria nyuma kogiasibigwe. Kararore ng’a ekemoa keria tikeraonchoka, egento keria tigechenegeti, nonya ekemoa ekio tigiesiarereti. Egento keria gesambwe nomorero, ekiagera ekemoa keria negi’okoboosia, onye kere isiko gose ime ase egento ekio.

Korende onye omokuani okorenga egento ekio nyuma kogiasibigwe, na arore ng’a ekemoa keria ngosira kere, rirorio atandore aase ekemoa keria kere, akerusie korwa ase eanga eria, gose risankwa, gose egetambaa.

Onye ekemoa gekororekana naende ase eanga eria, gose ase egetambaa keroisirie ase chingencho ao ao, gose ase gento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, igo nekemoa gia ukoma kiaorokeire. Egento keria goika gesambwe nomorero.

Ekemoa gokeranyorekane ng’a giasirire ekero eanga, gose egetambaa keria, gose gento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, giasibigwe, rirorio gesibigwe eria kabere. Bono egento keria nakebe giachenekire.”

Oko nakwo ogochika igoro ase ebinto bire na ukoma, kobirabe chianga chiroisirie korwa ase amarionya gose egatani, gose gokerabe egetambaa keroisirie ase chingencho ao ao, gose gento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa. Ase ogochika okwo egento ekio inagiatorwe ng’a giachenekire, gose tigechenegeti.
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Oko nakwo ogochika ase omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma. Ase rituko riria arabe agochenwa arentwe ase omokuani,
na omokuani agende isiko y’egetwori amorenge. Kararore ng’a omonto oria ogwenire korwa ase oborwaire bwa ukoma bwamoriete,
omokuani achike abanto barente chinyoni ibere chichenegete chire moyo, na oroko rw’omocharake, na eusi embariri, na orosagia rwa hisopo, ase engencho y’omonto oria ogochia gochenwa.
Erio omokuani achike abanto banyenyere enyoni eyemo igoro ase egetega ki’amaroba kere namache amaya a rooche.

Naende aimokie enyoni eria ere moyo amo noroko rw’omocharake, na eusi eyio embariri, na orosagia orwo rwa hisopo, abitobeke ime ase amanyinga ’enyoni eria yanyenyeretwe igoro y’amache aria amaya a rooche.

Anyororokerie amanyinga aria ara gatano na kabere igoro ase omonto oyio ogochia gochenwa ase oborwaire bwa ukoma, atebe ng’a omonto oria ochenekire, na atige enyoni eria ere moyo eiruruke, egende orosana.

Omonto oria ogochia gochenwa goika asibie chianga chiaye, na akigite etukia yaye yonsi, naende esibie omobere namache, erio abe oyochenegete. Nyuma y’ayio asoe ase egetwori, korende abeere isiko y’eema yaye ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere,

Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere naende akigite etukia yaye yonsi y’omotwe, ne chinderu, na ebioge bi’amaiso, na amarionya ande onsi are ase omobere oye. Erio asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, na igo nabe ochenekire.

“Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato arente chimanwa ibere chimingichi chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, na emanwa esigiti yakoorire omwaka oyomo, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, amo nobosie obonuke, ebimunu bitano na ekemo, bwochoganirie namaguta, ebe okoruegwa kw’endagera. Amo nayio arente amaguta egetuba ekemo.
Omokuani otenenerete arente omonto oria ogochia gochenwa amo nokoruegwa okwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
Erio omokuani oria aimokie emanwa eyemo, ayerue ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha, ayerue amo namaguta egetuba ekemo, erio abisungusie agwo ase obosio bwane bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa.
Anyenyere emanwa eria agwo aase achenire, ase ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe na eki’ogosambwa bikonyenyerwa, ekiagera ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha neki’omokuani; ekio negechenu mono.

Omokuani aimokie amanyinga make ay’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha, na agindie mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kw’omonto oria ogochia gochenwa, naende agindie ekiara ekenene gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio, na ekiara ekenene gi’okogoro kwaye kwa borio.
Naende omokuani aimokie amaguta aria ataaere oroe rw’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee,
atobeke ekiara kiaye gi’okoraga gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio ime ase amaguta aria are roe rw’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee, erio ayanyororokerie ara gatano na kabere, agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.

Amaguta make ase ayio agotigara ase oroe rwaye ayagindie mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kw’omonto oria ogochia gochenwa, na ekiara ekenene gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio, na ekiara ekenene gi’okogoro kwaye kwa borio, igoro ase amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha agindirieo.
Naende maguta ayagotigara ase oroe rwaye ayaumore igoro ase omotwe bw’omonto oria ogochia gochenwa. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria agwo ase obosio bwane.
“Erio omokuani arue ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ogochia gochenwa, acheneke korwa ase ogotacheneka kwaye. Nyuma y’ayio anyenye ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa,
akerue amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera ase egesasimero. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria abe oyochenegete.

“Korende onye omonto oria ore omotaka na takonyara konyora ebinge akorua, rirorio arente emanwa emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha kegosungusigwa ase okobwatanigwa kwaye. Boigo arente obosie ebimunu bibere bwochoganirie namaguta, bobe okoruegwa kw’endagera, na amaguta egetuba ekemo.
Boigo arente amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, buna aranyare. Erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde eki’ogosambwa.
Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato arente ebinto ebio bi’ogochenwa kwaye ase omokuani, agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.
Omokuani aimokie emanwa y’eng’ondi eria y’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha, amo namaguta aria egetuba ekemo, abinduere inche Omonene bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa.

Erio anyenye emanwa eria ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha, na omokuani aimokie amanyinga make ay’ekeng’wanso ekio, ayagindie mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kw’omonto oria ogochia gochenwa, na ekiara ekenene gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio, na ekiara ekenene gi’okogoro kwaye kwa borio.
Omokuani ataaere amaguta ase oroe rw’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.
Make ay’amaguta aria are roe rw’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee ayanyororokerie ara gatano na kabere nekiara gi’okoraga gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio, agwo ase obosio bwane.

Naende make ay’amaguta ayio are roe rwaye agindie igoro ase amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha agindire: Mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kw’omonto oria ogochia gochenwa, na ekiara ekenene gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio, na ekiara ekenene gi’okogoro kwaye kwa borio.
Amaguta agotigara ase oroe rwaye ayaumore ase omotwe bw’omonto oria ogochia gochenwa. Ase enchera eyio akore okobwatanigwa asare, agwo ase obosio bwane.
Erio omonto oria arue riruma gose riige rie riruma, koreng’ana buna aranyare koyanyora.
Erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde eki’ogosambwa, ayarue amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase obosio bwane ase omonto oria ogochia gochenwa.”
Oko nakwo ogochika ase omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma, oria otanyare korua ebing’wanso bi’ogochenwa bia botambe bichikire.
Erio Omonene agakwana na Musa na Haroni, akabatebia,
“Ekero moraike ase ense ya Kanani, eyio ndabae ebe eyaino, na kondarente ukoma ase enyomba gete agwo,
omonto omonyene enyomba eria agende atebie omokuani: Yarorekanire ase enyomba yane ng’a ukoma mboreo.

Omokuani achike ng’a ebinto bionsi bire ase enyomba eyio birusigweo ritang’ani atarasoao koborenga. Onye tibagokora bo rirorio ebinto bionsi bire nyomba ime nabibe bitachenegeti. Nyuma y’ayio omokuani asoe ase enyomba eyio koyerenga.
Karayerenge na arore ng’a egetamase nkere ase enyasi y’enyomba eyio kere nekieni buna obonyansi, gose ekebariri, naende giakorire engoro gochia ime goetania rioomo,
erio omokuani asoke korwa ase enyomba eyio, na ayesieke ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani airaneo, ayerenge naende. Kararore ng’a ukoma boria bwesiareire ase enyasi y’enyomba eria,
achike ng’a amagena aria asoirwe na ukoma atagorwe, atugutwe ase eubi egotugutwa, isiko y’omochie.
Nyuma y’ayio chinyasi chionsi chia ime chiomorwe, erio amaoomo atugutwe aase are neubi isiko y’omochie.
Amagena ande arentwe, abekwe ribaga ri’aria atagorwa na gotugutwa, ne chinyasi, chioomwe nesike enyia.
“Ukoma boria koboratuboke naende ase enyomba eria nyuma amagena aria karusigweo, ne rioomo riria koriaoomoirwe, na enyomba eria yaoomirwe naende,
omokuani agende ayerenge naende. Onye egetamase keria giesiareire ase enyomba eria, obwo noukoma, yabeire eyetachenegeti.
Enyomba eria etagorwe, na amagena onsi amo nemete ne rioomo riaye rionsi biimokigwe, bionsi biirwe ase eubi egotugutwa isiko y’omochie.
Monto onde bwensi orasoe ase enyomba eyio, ekero egendererete gosiekwa, nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Monto onde bwensi aise korara ime ase enyomba eyio, gose koragerera aroro, goika asibie chianga chiaye.
“Korende omokuani karachiche ayerenge arore ng’a ukoma boria tibwesiarereti nyuma koyaoomirwe, rirorio ukoma bwaerire, na ere atebe ng’a enyomba eria yachenekire.
Omokuani arente chinyoni ibere amo noroko rw’omocharake, na eusi embariri, na orosagia rwa hisopo, ase ogochenwa kw’enyomba eria.
Erio anyenyere enyoni eyemo igoro ase egetega keroiseirie amaroba kere namache amaya a rooche.

Naende aimokie oroko orwo rw’omocharake, na orosagia rwa hisopo, na eusi eria embariri amo nenyoni eria ere moyo, abitobeke bionsi ime ase amanyinga ’enyoni eria yanyenyetwe, na amache aria amaya a rooche; erio anyororokerie enyomba eria ara gatano na kabere.

Ase enchera eyio omokuani nachene enyomba eyio namanyinga ’enyoni eria, amo namache aria amaya a rooche, na enyoni eria ere moyo, na oroko rw’omocharake, na orosagia rwa hisopo, na eusi eria embariri.
Erio omokuani atige enyoni eria ere moyo eiruruke, egende orosana isiko y’omochie. Ase enchera eyio akore okobwatanigwa ase enyomba eria, na ero ebe yachenekire.”
Oko nakwo ogochika igoro y’oborwaire bwa ukoma, ne richoncho,
na ukoma bore ase chianga, gose ase chinyomba,
naende obobimbu bwe risankwa, na ebisambo, na ebimoa ebirabu.
Ogochika okwo nigo gokworokia onye ebinto tibichenegeti gose mbichenegete. Okwo nogochika gwa ukoma.
Omonene agakwana na Musa na Haroni, akabatebia,
“Kwana n’Abaisraeli, mobatebie ng’a onye omonto omosacha okorua amache anga buna chimengere korwa ase ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha, amache ayio neubi.
Aya naro achikire ase amang’ana ayio: Amache ayio karagenderere korua, gose atigire korua, omonto oyio tachenegeti.
Ebirarero bionsi arararere, gose araikaransere, nigo birabe ebitachenegeti.
Monto onde bwensi aise gokuna ebirarero bi’omonto oyio goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Na onde bwensi oraikaransere egento omonto oria omorwaire aikaranserete, goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Na onde bwensi orakune omonto oyio omorwaire goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Omonto oyio omorwaire karatwere omonto ochenegete amate, nere goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, naende abe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Egeikaransero gekobekerwa eng’iti ekoriinwa, gokeraikaranserwe nomonto oria omorwaire, nakebe egetachenegeti.

Omonto aise gokuna egento kende gionsi kiarenge inse y’omonto oria omorwaire nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio; na onde bwensi oraimokie egento buna ekio nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Onye omonto oria omorwaire ogokuna omonto onde ataraisaba amaboko, oria okunwa goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache naende nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Enyongo ende yonsi omonto oria omorwaire arakune goika yaatwe, na egekorero kende gionsi keroiseirie omote arakune goika gesibigwe namache.

“Omonto oria gachenekire korwa ase okorua kw’amache aria anga buna chimengere goika abare amatuko atano na abere ay’ogocheneka kwaye. Erio asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache amaya a rooche, ere nabe oyochenegete.
Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato aire amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, ayae omokuani.

Omokuani arue erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa. Ase enchera eyio akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase obosio bwane, ase engencho y’okorua kwaye kw’amache anga buna chimengere.
“Onye omonto omosacha ogosokia embusuro yaye y’oroiboro, rirorio esibie omobere namache, na agenderere koba oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Eanga ende yonsi, na ebinto binde bionsi bi’amasankwa, embusuro eyio y’oroiboro eratonyere, goika bisibigwe namache, nabirobio nabibe ebitachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Omonto onye orarire nomokungu, na omobekeire embusuro y’oroiboro, bonsi babere goika besibie emebere yabo namache, nabarabwo nababe abatachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
“Ekero omokungu are nomotienyi nigo arabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Onde bwensi oramokune nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Gento kende gionsi arabe okorarera ekero are nomotienyi, nigo kerabe egetachenegeti, boigo nebinto bionsi araikaransere.
Onde bwensi orakune ebirarero bi’omokungu oyio goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Na onde bwensi orakune egento omokungu oyio aikaranserete, nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache; ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Ase igo kobirabe ebirarero, gose egento omokungu oria aikaranserete, omonto karabikune nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

Omosacha kararare nomokungu ore nomotienyi, ogotacheneka kw’omokungu oyio nakobe asare, ere nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, na gento kende gionsi arararere nakebe egetachenegeti.

“Omokungu karagenderere goiteka amanyinga ase amatuko amange atari ay’omotienyi oye, gose ayagoiteka goetania amatuko aye ay’omotienyi, nigo arabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki eyio yonsi arabe ogoiteka amanyinga; nabe oyotachenegeti buna ekero are nomotienyi.
Ebirarero bionsi are korarera ekero agoiteka amanyinga, nigo birabe ebitachenegeti buna ebi akorarera ekero are nomotienyi, naboigo na kende gionsi araikaransere.
Na onde bwensi orakune ebinto ebio nabe oyotachenegeti; ere asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, naende nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
Ekero ogoiteka kwaye kw’amanyinga gwakamire, abare amatuko atano na abere, erio nabe ochenekire.
Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato aire amaruma abere gose amage ’amaruma abere ase omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

Omokuani arue erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde eki’ogosambwa. Ase enchera eyio nakore okobwatanigwa ase omokungu oria ase obosio bwane, ase engencho y’ogotacheneka kwaye kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga.
“Ase enchera eyio okurere Abaisraeli igoro y’ogotacheneka kwabo, tibabaisa kogera Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bore ase egati yabo bobe obotachenegeti. Baise gokora bo, nigo barakwe.”
Aya naro amachiko ase omonto okorua amache anga buna chimengere, na oyogosokia embusuro yaye y’oroiboro, na koba oyotachenegeti ase engencho eyio,
naboigo nase omokungu ore nomotienyi, na ase onde bwensi, omosacha okorua amache anga buna chimengere, na omokungu ogoiteka amanyinga, naende ase omosacha okorara nomokungu otachenegeti.
Nyuma y’ogokwa kw’abamura baria babere ba Haroni baitetwe n’Omonene, ekero bamorenterete omorero bw’engencho eng’ao, oyio batachigetwe, Omonene agakwana na Musa,

akamotebia, “Tebia Haroni, momura omino, ng’a tabaisa gosoa ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono, moino y’etoto, bosio bw’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera obore ekemumeko gi’Esanduku eria, engaki ende yonsi, ekiagera agwo nao ngochia kooroka ime ye riire igoro y’Oboikaranso obwo bw’Amabera. Aise gokora bo, goika akwe.
Igo arasoe ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono nyuma karentire eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.

“Ritang’ani Haroni atarasoa Aase Aachenu Mono, goika esibie omobere oye namache, amanye kobeka chianga chiria chinchenu: Eganchwa erobekanirie eigete inse, ne chisirwari, na orokini, na ekegogwa, bionsi biroisirie korwa ase egatani.
“Erio Haroni aegwe korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli chigoree ibere chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
Ritang’ani arue eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ase ogokora okobwatanigwa asere omonyene, na ase abanto b’enka yaye, erinde baaberwe.
Naende arente chigoree chiria ibere ase obosio bwane inche Omonene agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
Agwo Haroni aake obomera igoro ye chigoree chiria ibere, obomera obomo asende, na obonde ase Asaseli.
Egoree eria erabe yagwereirwe nobomera asende, Haroni ayerente ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
Na egoree eria erabe yagwereirwe nobomera ase Asaseli ayerente ere moyo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, erinde akore okobwatanigwa asero, na koyetiga esiboire egende ase erooro ase Asaseli.
“Naboigo Haroni arente eeri eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye, akore okobwatanigwa asere omonyene, na ase abanto b’enka yaye, anyenye eeri eria.
Erio aimokie orogio roichire omorero bw’amakara korwa ase egesasimero kere ase obosio bwane, na ubani eichire chindoe ibere, ayerente moino y’etoto eria enachete Obomenyo Obochenu,
ayebeke ase omorero igoro, agwo ase obosio bwane, erinde erioki ria ubani eyio ritube Oboikaranso bw’Amabera obore ekemumeko gi’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori. Atakoreti bo, nigo arakwe.
Aimokie amanyinga make ay’eeri eyio, ayanyororokerie ase Oboikaranso bw’Amabera bosio, na bosio bw’Oboikaranso boria bw’Amabera ara gatano na kabere nekiara kiaye.

“Nyuma y’ayio anyenye embori eria ebe ekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abanto, aire amanyinga ’embori eyio moino y’etoto eria, ayanyororokerie igoro ase Oboikaranso bw’Amabera bosio, na bosio bw’Oboikaranso boria akore buna akorete namanyinga ’eeri eria.

Naboigo akore okobwatanigwa ase Aase Aachenu Mono ase engencho y’ogotacheneka kw’Abaisraeli amo nogosaria kwabo, na ebibe biabo bionsi. Naende akore okobwatanigwa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, eyio ere amo nabarabwo na ase egati y’ogotacheneka kwabo.

Monto onde tatigara ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano korwa ekero Haroni agosoa ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono akore okobwatanigwa goika arueo, gakoorire gokora okobwatanigwa asere omonyene, na ase abanto b’enka yaye, na ase omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisareli.

Erio asoke agende ase egesasimero kere agwo ase obosio bwane, agekorere okobwatanigwa, naende aimokie amanyinga make ay’eeri eyio, ayagindie ase emegwekano yonsi ye chingunchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasimero ekio,
naende anyororokerie egesasimero namanyinga ayio nekiara kiaye ara gatano na kabere. Ase enchera eyio agesibie na kogechena korwa ase ogotacheneka kore ase Abaisraeli.
“Ekero Haroni akoorire gokora okobwatanigwa ase Aase Aachenu Mono, na ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, na ase egesasimero, arente embori eria ere moyo.

Erio goika abeke amaboko aye abere ase omotwe bw’embori eria ere moyo, aorokie igoro ase embori eyio obobe bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli na ogosaria kwabo gwonsi, na ebibe biabo bionsi. Ase enchera eyio ang’anyie ebio bionsi, abibeke igoro ase omotwe bw’embori eyio. Naende embori eyio eirwe ase erooro nomonto obekirwe ang’e.
Naboigo embori eria ebogorie ebibe biabo bionsi, egende nabio gochia ase erooro ase abanto batamanyeti.
“Nyuma y’ayio Haroni asoe Eema y’Omosangererekano, arusie chianga chi’egatani chiria abegete ritang’ani atarasoa Aase Aachenu, achitigeo.

Erio esibie omobere oye namache agwo aase gete are aachenu, naende abeke chianga chiaye chia botambe. Nyuma y’ayio asoke, arue ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase engencho yaye ere omonyene amo nebi’abanto bonsi na akore okobwatanigwa asere omonyene na ase abanto.
Naende asambere ebitinya bi’ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe ase egesasimero.
Omonto oyio oirete embori eria ase erooro ase Asaseli, asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache; nyuma y’ayio amanye gosoa ase egetwori.

Eeri eria amo nembori eria chiaruetwe chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, echio amanyinga abo arentwe ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono akore okobwatanigwa, chiirwe isiko y’egetwori. Riiyo ne risankwa, amo ne chinyama ne chisike chiabo, bisamberwe aroro nomorero.
Omonto oria orasambe ebinto ebio nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache; nyuma y’ayio amanye gosoa ase egetwori.

“Oyo noro omoroberio ochikire asemore moragenderere korenda botambe. Rituko ria ikomi, ase omotienyi o gatano na kabere, inamobe mokweng’ata na gweitia; timokora emeremo ende yonsi, inwe abanyene, gose abamenyi bamenyete ase egati yaino.
Ase rituko erio okobwatanigwa ngokorwe asemore ase okobasibia korwa ase ebibe biaino bionsi, nainwe namocheneke ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.
Rituko erio naribe richenu mono asemore, rituko ri’ogotimoka, na inwe namweng’ate. Oyio nomoroberio ochikirwe oragenderere botambe.
Omokuani oakirwe amaguta na gwatananwa abe omokuani ribaga ria ise, nere orakore okobwatanigwa okwo. Ere nigo arabeke chianga chiria chinchenu chi’egatani,
na akore okobwatanigwa ase Aase Aachenu Mono, na ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, naende akore okobwatanigwa ase abakuani, na ase omosangererekano bw’Abaisraeli.

Omoroberio oyio ochikirwe asemore oragenderere botambe, ng’a okobwatanigwa kobe kogokorerwa ase Abaisraeli ara rimo ase omwaka ase okobachena korwa ase ebibe biabo bionsi.” Musa agakora buna Omonene amochigete.
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Tebia Haroni na abamura baye amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi ng’a inche Omonene nachikire iga:
Onye omonto onde bwensi okonyenyera eng’ombe, gose emanwa y’eng’ondi, gose embori, ase egetwori, gose isiko y’egetwori,

atayerenteti agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano ebe ekeng’wanso asende, bosio bw’Obomenyo bwane, rirorio okomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga nakobarerwe omonto oyio. Ere oiteire amanyinga, ase igo naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.

Bono Abaisraeli tibakonyara gokora buna barenge gokora agwo ritang’ani, tibakonyenyera ching’iti chi’ebing’wanso biabo orosana isiko; goika bachindetere inche Omonene, bachiire ase omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, bachinyenyereo chibe ebing’wanso bi’omorembe asende.
Na omokuani asiarere amanyinga ase egesasimero kiane agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, naende asambe ebitinya bibe rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
Abaisraeli tibabaisa konyenyera ebing’wanso biabo isiko aande na kobirua ase ebirecha, na igo babe abatari abegenwa asende. Oyio nobe omoroberio ochikire oragenderere botambe, ebiaare ase ebiaare.
“Ase igo obatebie ng’a monto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, kararue ekeng’wanso kegosambwa ekegima, gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi,
na omonto oyio atakerenteti ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano na gokerua asende, nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
“Onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, orarie amanyinga ande onsi, inche Omonene nimbe mamincha y’omonto oyio, na inche nimwatanane korwa ase abanto baye.

Obomoyo bwa kera omobere nigo bore ime ase amanyinga; nabaeire amanyinga moyanyororokererie ase egesasimero akore okobwatanigwa ase obomoyo bwaino; amanyinga naro agokora okobwatanigwa, ekiagera obomoyo bore imeo.
Ase ayio natebirie Abaisraeli ng’a monto onde bwensi obo, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, tabaisa koria amanyinga ande onsi.
“Omonto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, oraite eng’iti y’orosana, gose enyoni eyancheire koriegwa, goika aitere amanyinga aye inse, erio ayatube amaroba.

Obomoyo bwa kera omobere nigo bore ase amanyinga. Ase engencho eyio natebirie Abaisraeli ng’a tibaria amanyinga ’eng’iti ende yonsi, ekiagera obomoyo bwa kera omobere nigo bore ase amanyinga aye. Omonto onde bwensi orarie amanyinga nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.

“Omonto onde bwensi, omobiare gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, orarie eng’iti ekwete yoka enyene, gose eyeitire ne ching’iti chinde chi’orosana, goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache; nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio, erio abe ochenekire.
Korende onye tagosibia chianga chiaye na gwesibia omobere, rirorio nabogorie obobe bwaye.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Tebia Abaisraeli ng’a natebire iga: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
Timobaisa gokora buna abanto ba Misiri bagokora, agwo ase mwamenyete, gose buna abanto ba Kanani bagokora, ense eyio nkobaira mochie komenya, gose timobaisa kobwatia chingencho chiabo.
Moigwere amachiko aane, na mokore aya nkobachika. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
Ee, mokore aya nkobachika, na mobwate amachiko aane. Omonto karakore amang’ana ayio nabe moyo. Inche ninche Omonene.
“Monto onde bwensi tabaisa korara nomokungu ore omoamate omwabo. Okwo nokorentera omoamate omwabo obosooku. Inche ninche Omonene.
Tobaisa korara na nyoko. Okwo nokomorentera iso obosooku. Torentera nyoko obosooku.
Tobaisa korara na nyoko moke, moga iso. Okwo nokomorentera iso obosooku.
Tobaisa korara na moiseke omino, omoiseke o iso gose oyo o nyoko, onye moiboire komo ase enyomba eyemo, gose oiboire ase enyomba ende.
Tobaisa korara nomochokoro oo, oyo bw’omwana oo omomura, gose oyo bw’omwana oo omosubati. Ayio nigo arakorentere obosooku.
Tobaisa korara nomoiseke o nyoko moke, moga iso; oyio nomoiseke omino iso aiborete.
Tobaisa korara nomoiseke omwabo iso; oyio nyoko moke, omwabo iso.
Tobaisa korara nomoiseke omwabo nyoko; oyio nyoko moke, omwabo nyoko.
Tobaisa korara na moga iso moke omwabo iso; okwo nokorentera iso moke obosooku, ekiagera omokungu oyio nyoko moke are.
Tobaisa korara na moka momura oo; obwo nobosooku, ekiagera nomokungu bw’omwana oo omomura.
Tobaisa korara na moka momura omino; okwo nokomorentera momura omino obosooku.
Tobaisa korara nomoiseke bw’omokungu kwabeire nere, gose tobaisa gotwara omochokoro oye, omoiseke bw’omwana oye omosubati, gose oyo bw’omomura oye, ekiagera abwo nabanto abamo. Obwo nobonyaka obobe.
Tobaisa koira mokoyoo, omwabo mokao, ekero mokao are moyo; ayio nabaise korenta obobisa.
“Tobaisa korara nomokungu ekero abwate omotienyi, ekiagera ere tachenegeti ase ekero ekio.
Tobaisa korara nomokungu bw’omosacha onde na gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka nere.
Tobaisa korua omwana onde oo abe ekeng’wanso ase enyasae Moleki, ekiagera okwo nokorentera erieta ria Nyasae oo obosooku. Inche ninche Omonene.
Tobaisa korara nomonto omosacha buna okorara nomokungu; obwo nobonyaka obobe bw’okogechia.
Tobaisa korara neng’iti ende yonsi na gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka nero. Na omokungu tabaisa kwerua korara neng’iti ende yonsi. Obwo nobonyaka obobe kegima bw’okogechia.
“Inwe timobaisa gwekora abatachenegeti ase ogokora buna okwo. Ase enchera eyio abanto b’ebisaku mbesoetie ase ogotacheneka, na bono inche Omonene nkobaseria inde babatigere inwe ense eyio.
Ogokora kwabo gokarentera enseeria ogotacheneka, na inche nkayea egesusuro ase engencho y’ogosaria okwo, na ense eyio ekaanga tiyatwara abanto bamenyeteo, korende ekabaseria.

Ase igo inwe mwensi, ababiare gose abamenyi bamenyete ase egati yaino, goika morende amachiko aane na kobwata aya onsi nabachikire, gose timobaisa gokora kende gionsi gi’okogechia okwo abanto b’ebisaku bakorete.
Abanto bamenyete ase ense eria ritang’ani riaino nigo bakorete okogechia okwo gwonsi, na igo ense eria ekaba etachenegeti.
Moise gokora ayio, ense eyio nigo erabaange morue aroro, buna yangete abanto b’ebisaku, abwo babatang’anete komenyao,
ekiagera monto onde bwensi orakore okogechia konde gwonsi buna okwo, oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.

“Ase ayio, moigwere amang’ana aya onsi nabachikire, na moyakore. Timobasia kwenaria chingencho chi’okogechia chiakoretwe nabanto abwo babatang’anete komenya ase ense eyio. Moise gokora igo, inamwesoyie ase ogotacheneka ase chingencho echio. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Tebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli: Mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo inde omochenu,
Kera oyomo oino asike ng’ina na ise, naende morende Chisabato chiane. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
“Timontiga na koonchokera emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, gose timwekorera chinyasae korwa ase ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa. Inche ninche Nyasae oino.
“Onye moganetie korua ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe asende inche Omonene, mobwate emeroberio yachikirwe, erio nario ekeng’wanso ekio kerancherwe.
Chinyama chi’ekengw’anso ekio chiriegwe ase rituko erio erio eng’iti yanyenywa, gose rituko ria kabere, korende echiratigare ase rituko ria gatato chisambwe nomorero.
Chiise koriegwa ase rituko ria gatato, ekeng’wanso ekio inakebe okogechia, tikegwancherwa.
Monto onde bwensi orakerie ekero ekio nabarerwe obobe bwaye, ekiagera okorire egento giatananetwe asende kebe egetari egechenu. Omonto oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
“Ekero mokogesa emegondo yaino, timogesa moikie ase chingito kegima, gose timoirana gochora ebitigari ase emegondo.
Timobaisa gochora amasabibu atigarete, gose agwete inse, ase emegondo yaino y’emesabibu; ayio motigere abataka na abamenyi. Inche ninche Omonene Nyasae oino.
“Timoiba, gose timong’ainana, gose timotebania oborimo.
Timobaisa gotiana ogotiana kw’oborimo ase erieta riane. Moise gokora igo, nigo morarentere erieta riane obosooku. Inche ninche Omonene.
“Tobaisa korianania omogisangio oo, gose komourereria. Tobaisa gotanga eng’eria y’omonto origete okogokorera emeremo, tebeera asore goika mambia.
Tobaisa koragereria omonto omotino, gose kobeka ekegocha bosio bw’omonto omouko, korende omoiroke Nyasae oo. Inche ninche Omonene.
“Timokora ayatari boronge ekero ebina bikogambwa; timobaisa gwanchereria omotaka, gose koiroka omonda, korende monache ebina ebironge ase abagisangio baino.
Tobaisa goeta‐eta ase egati y’abanto bamino gokwana obogenki; tobaisa kogera oyomino aitwe ase okoba kirori bw’oborimo. Inche ninche Omonene.
“Tobaisa kogecha oyomino ime ase enkoro yao, korende omokurere maiso marore, erinde tokora ebibe ase engencho yaye.
Tobaisa kweruseria egesiomba, gose kogenderera kogecha monto onde bwensi ase egesaku kiao, korende ancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete aye omonyene. Inche ninche Omonene.

“Mobwate amachiko aane. Timobaisa gotiga chitugo chiaino chieenane amarieme ne chitari egesaku ekemo. Timobaisa kobusura chimbusuro chi’ebisaku bibere ase omogondo oyomo, timobeka chianga chiroisirie korwa ase chiusi ao ao.

“Omonto aise korara nomoiseke ore omosomba na oriereirwe boko nomonto omoao, na omoiseke oria taraboorigwa, gose taranyora obosibore, barabwo babere nigo baraegwe egesusuro, ko tibagoitwa, ekiagera omoiseke oyio taranyora obosibore.
Omonto oyio arente emingichi eyemo asende inche Omonene, agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha kwaye.
Ase okorua emingichi eria y’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha, omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oyio ase obosio bwane, ase engencho y’ebibe biria akorire, na omonto oyio naaberwe ase ebibe ebio akorire.
“Ekero moraike ase ense ya Kanani na mosimeke emete y’ebisaku ao ao ekwama amatunda, timobaisa koria amatunda ’emete eyio ase engaki y’emiaka etato ye ritang’ani, korende moyebare ng’a nekanire.
Ase omwaka o kane amatunda ’emete eyio aatananwe abe amachenu asende inche Omonene, moyang’e ase okong’iraneria ng’a mbuya mono na gontogia.
Korende ase omwaka o gatano inamorie amatunda ’emete eyio. Komorakore igo, emete inayame amatunda amange asemore. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
“Timobaisa koria enyama ende yonsi ebwate amanyinga ime yaye. Timobaisa gwancha oboragori, gose oborogi bonde bwonsi.
Timobaisa konacha chitukia chiaino, gose chinderu chiaino mesia.
Timobaisa gwesaraga emebere yaino ase okoreera abakure, gose gwesamba kobeka ekemanyererio kende gionsi. Inche ninche Omonene.
“Tobaisa korentera omoiseke oo obosooku ase okomoira abe omotayayi ase chihekalu, ense yonsi nigo erabaise gokora obotayayi na goichorwa nobonyaka.
Morende Chisabato chiane, naende mosike Obomenyo bwane Obochenu. Inche ninche Omonene.

“Timorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase abanto abakoboria amang’ana korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, gose timogenda ase abaragori. Moise gokora igo, nigo morabe abatachenegeti goetera asebare. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
“Otenene ase omonto omogotu ore ne chimbuche, ase okomosika; omoiroke Nyasae oo. Inche ninche Omonene.
“Timobaisa kobakorera bobe abamenyi bamenyete ase ense yaino.

Mokorere abamenyi bamenyete ase egati yaino buna mogokorera ababiare, mobanche buna mweanchete inwe abanyene, ekiagera nainwe nabo mwarenge abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
“Timokorerana oborianania ase ebirengo binde bionsi, ebi’obotambe, gose ebi’oborito, gose ebi’obonge.

Mokorere ekerengo kia boronge; motware amagena ay’okorenga a boronge, na ebimunu bi’okorenga bia boronge, na ebituba bi’okorenga bia boronge. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
Mobwate amachiko aane onsi aya nabachikire. Inche ninche Omonene.”
Omonene agatebia Musa,
“Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie: Monto onde bwensi oino, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, orarue omwana onde oye ase enyasae Moleki, goika aitwe akwe. Omoganda oino bwonsi omoake amagena.

Inche omonyene nimbe nendamwamu ase omonto oyio, ekiagera orure omwana onde oye ase enyasae Moleki. Nimwatanane korwa ase abanto baye, ekiagera ogerire Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bobe obotachenegeti, na orenteire erieta riane richenu obosooku.
Onye abanto b’ense yaino bakoombia, tibaita omonto oyio orure oyomo bw’abana baye ase enyasae Moleki,

erio inche omonyene nimbe nendamwamu ase omonto oyio na eamate yaye. Nimwatanane amo nabanto bonsi bamobwatirie, ekiagera bakoonchokera enyasae eria Moleki, ase okoyesasima, bakaba abatari abegenwa asende; nimbasirie korwa ase abanto baye.

“Onye omonto okorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase abanto bakoboria amang’ana korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, gose kogenda ase abarogi, taba omwegenwa asende, korende abe ogosasima emeika eyio, inche nimbe nendamwamu ase omonto oyio, na imwatanane korwa ase abanto baye.
Eatanane, mwerue mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
Mobwate amachiko aane na koyakora; inche ninche Omonene, nkobachena.
“Kera omonto okoragereria ise gose ng’ina, oyio goika akwe. Ekiagera oragereirie ise na ng’ina, okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye nigo korabe okwaye.
“Onye omonto ogotomana nomokungu bw’omonto onde, abwo babere, omosacha oria amo nomokungu oria, goika baitwe bakwe.
Onye omonto okorara nomokungu ore moga ise, igo orenteire ise obosooku; abwo bonsi babere goika baitwe bakwe. Okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo korabe okwabo.
Onye omonto okorara na moka momura oye, abwo bonsi babere goika baitwe bakwe; bakorire okogechia. Okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo korabe okwabo.
Onye omosacha okorara nomosacha onde buna akorara nomokungu, abwo bonsi babere bakorire okogechia okobe; goika baitwe bakwe, na okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo korabe okwabo.

Onye omonto okonyuoma omokungu aire na ng’ina biara abasang’ananie, obwo nobonyaka obobe. Omosacha oria amo nabakungu baria babere basambwe nomorero bakwe, erinde obonyaka buna obwo tiboba ase egati yaino.
Onye omonto okorara neng’iti, omonto oyio aitwe akwe, na eng’iti eyio eitwe ekwe.
Onye omokungu ogoika eng’iti ende yonsi ang’e, na korara nero, omokungu oyio goika aitwe akwe, na eng’iti eyio eitwe ekwe. Okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyiga abo nigo korabe okwabo.

“Onye omonto okoira omoiseke omwabo, oyo o ise gose o ng’ina, nabwo barorerane bare getirianda, obwo nobosooku obonene. Barabwo goika baatananwe barusigwe ase amasio ’abanto b’egesaku kiabo. Omonto oyio orenteire omoiseke omwabo obosooku. Obobe bw’ogosaria okwo nigo borabe igoro y’omonto oyio.

Onye omonto omosacha okorara nomokungu ekero abwate omotienyi, omonto oyio orenteire omokungu oyio obosooku ase okorora ensoko y’amanyinga aye, nere oorokirie ase amanyinga agoiteka korwa; abwo babere baatananwe korwa ase abanto b’egesaku kiabo.
“Tobaisa korara nomoiseke omwabo nyoko, gose omoiseke omwabo iso; obwo nobonyaka obobe, ekiagera abwo nabanyako moke. Obobe bw’ogosaria okwo nigo borabe igoro yabo.
Onye omonto okorara na moga ise moke, omwabo ise, igo orenteire ise moke obosooku. Egesusuro ki’ogosaria kw’ebibe biabo nigo kerabe ekiabo, na barabwo nigo barakwe bataiboreti bana.
Onye omonto okoira moka momura omwabo, okwo nogosaria, ere orenteire momura omwabo obosooku. Barabwo nigo baragombae.
“Ase ayio mobwate amachiko aane na emeroberio yonsi nabachikire, na moyakore, erio ense eria ase nkobaira mogochia komenya tebaanga gose tebaseria korwa aroro.
Timochia kobwatia chingencho chi’abanto b’egesaku keria ngochia goseria kerue ase amasio aino; barabwo nigo bakorete amang’ana ayio onsi, na ase engencho y’ayio nkagechigwa nabarabwo.
Korende inabarierete inwe eira ng’a nimbae ense yabo ebe omwando oino, ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabaatananire inwe korwa ase ebisaku binde.

Inwe goika momanye gwatanana ching’iti chichenegete korwa ase echitachenegeti, ne chinyoni chichenegete korwa ase echitachenegeti. Timobaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase okoria ching’iti gose chinyoni chitachenegeti, gose timoria ching’iti chinde chionsi chikwagura ase ense, echi naatananire chibe chitachenegeti asemore.
Inwe mobe abachenu baane, ekiagera inche Omonene nigo inde omochenu, nabaatananire korwa ase ebisaku binde, erinde mobe abaane.

“Omosacha, gose omokungu, orarigie ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, gose oyore omorogi, goika aitwe akwe. Abanto abwo baakwe amagena bakwe; okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nakobe okwabo.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia, “Kwana nabakuani, abamura ba Haroni, obatebie ng’a omokuani tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogokuna egetondo ki’omonto okure ase egati y’abanto baye.
Nare ne ribaga gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase abanto aba: Ng’ina na ise, na omwana oye, omomura gose omoiseke, na momura omwabo;
boigo na omoiseke omwabo ore omwekungi, oyo otaraba nomosacha; asare nigo are ne ribaga gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka.
Ekiagera omokuani are omotang’ani ase abanto baye, tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka.
“Omokuani tabaisa kogingira ensemo ende y’etukia y’omotwe oye, gose konacha chinderu chiaye mesia, gose gwesaraga omobere.

Abakuani mbabe abachenu asende inche Nyasae obo, na tibarentera erieta riane obosooku, ekiagera nabwo bakorua okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene. Ase ayio goika babe abachenu.
Omokuani tabaisa konyuoma omokungu omotayayi, gose oyotari omwekungi, gose oyobatiganire nomosacha oye, ekiagera omokuani nigo achenegete ase Nyasae oye.
Goika omobare ng’a nomochenu, ekiagera nere okorua okoruegwa kw’endagera asende inche Nyasae oo; nabe omochenu asore, ekiagera inche Omonene nomochenu inde, ninche nkobachena.
Onye omwana omoiseke bw’omokuani ogwesaria ase okoba omotayayi, igo orenteire ise obosooku; omoiseke oyio goika asambwe nomorero akwe.

“Oyore omokuani omonene ase abamwabo, oyio onyororokeretigwe amaguta akweakwa ase omotwe oye, naende bwatananirwe ase okobeka chianga chi’obokuani, ere tatiga etukia yaye esang’ang’are, gose tatandora chianga chiaye ase okoreera omonto okure.
Tabaisa gosoa enyomba ase abanto babekire omobere bw’omonto okure, gose gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka, naba ise gose ng’ina.

Tasoka korwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu, gose gokora Obomenyo obo Obochenu bwa Nyasae oye bobe obotachenegeti, ekiagera amaguta aagetwe nigo amwatananete ere agenderere koba oyone, inche Nyasae oye. Inche ninche Omonene.
Ere anyuome omoiseke ore omwekungi.
Tabaisa konyuoma omokungu omoboraka, gose oyobatiganire nomosacha oye, gose oyotari omwekungi, gose ore omotayayi, korende anyuome omoiseke omwekungi korwa ase abanto b’egesaku kiaye.
Erio nario abana baye barabe abachenu, tibasareka ase egati y’abanto baye, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa naende, akamotebia,

“Kwana na Haroni, omotebie ng’a onde bwensi ore ekerema tabaisa goika ang’e kondetera inche, Nyasae oye, okoruegwa kw’endagera. Okwo nogochika koragenderere botambe ase ororeria rwaye ebiaare ase ebiaare.
Omonto ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tabaisa goika ang’e, onye ore omouko, gose rigata, gose ore na kemocho ase obosio bwaye, gose ore nekiimo ekemo egetambe goetania ekende,
gose omonto ore na kemocho ase okoboko gose ase okogoro,

gose omonto ore nesukubi ase omogongo oye, gose ore oboengere, gose oyore na kemocho ase eriso, gose oyo obosisa boriete, gose oborwaire bonde ase risankwa, gose omosacha chingetia chiaye chisaregete.

Omonto onde bwensi ase ororeria rwa Haroni omokuani ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tabaisa goika ang’e kondetera inche Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero, ekiagera oyio ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tagoika ang’e andetere inche, Nyasae oye, okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero.
Ere nabe ne ribaga ri’okoria okoruegwa kw’endagera gokoruegwa asende inche Nyasae oye, okoruegwa okore ogochenu, amo nokore ogochenu mono.

Korende ekiagera are na kemocho ase omobere oye, tagoika ang’e netoto enachete Obomenyo Obochenu, gose tagocha aike ang’e negesasimero. Aise goika ang’e, nigo aragere Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bobe botachenegeti. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”
Amang’ana ayio naro Musa atebetie Haroni, amo nabamura ba Haroni, na Abaisraeli bonsi.
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,

“Kwana na Haroni na abamura baye, obatebie ng’a barende na bakore amasikani ase ebinto ebichenu, biria Abaisraeli bagwatanana asende, erio tibabaisa korenta obosooku ase erieta riane richenu. Inche ninche Omonene.

Obatebie ng’a onye omonto onde bwensi ase ororeria rwabo, ekero are oyotachenegeti; aise goika ang’e nebinto ebio Abaisraeli barabe bagwatanana asende inche Omonene, omonto oyio naatananwe korwa ase obosio bwane, tagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani. Inche ninche Omonene.

“Omonto onde bwensi ase ororeria rwa Haroni obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma, gose okorua amache anga buna chimengere, tabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu goika ekero arabe ochenekire; naboigo na onde bwensi orakune egento getachenegeti, buna egetondo, gose omonto ogosokia embusuro yaye y’oroiboro,
na onde bwensi orakune eng’iti ekwagura, eye eramokore abe oyotachenegeti, gose akune omonto oragere abe oyotachenegeti, ogotacheneka kwaye gakorabe okw’engencho ende yonsi.
Omokuani onde bwensi orakune egento buna ekio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio; ere takoria ebinto ebichenu goika ekero arabe bwesibirie omobere oye namache.
Ekero erioba riagure, abe ochenekire, na nyuma y’ayio amanye koria ebinto ebichenu, ekiagera ebinto ebio nabio endagera yaye.
Taria enyama y’eng’iti ekwete yoka enyene, gose eye eitire neng’iti ende y’orosana. Aise koria enyama buna eyio, nigo arabe oyotachenegeti. Inche ninche Omonene.
“Abakuani bonsi goika barende amang’ana aya nachikire. Batayabwateti, nababe abakori ebibe ase ayio, na barabwo mbakwe, ekiagera bagosaria aya nachikire. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.
“Omonto otari bw’eamate y’omokuani tabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu. Omomenyi omenyete amo nomokuani, gose omonto orikire komokorera emeremo, abwo tibabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu.
Omosomba onde bwensi omokuani agorete ne chibesa chiaye omonyene, gose omosomba oiboreire ase enka yaye, abwo nabarie endagera eria omokuani akoegwa.
Omoiseke bw’omokuani karanyuomwe nomonto otari omokuani tabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu bikoruegwa bibe ebing’wanso.

Korende omosubati bw’omokuani osogete otigirwe ore omoboraka, gose batiganire nomosacha oye, na tabwati omwana, na bono oiranire gocha o ise komenyao buna ekero arenge omoke, nanyare koria endagera eria ya ise. Korende omonto otari bw’eamate y’omokuani tabaisa koria endagera eria.

“Omonto onde bwensi otari bw’eamate y’omokuani orarie ebinto biria ebichenu ase ogotamanya, goika airanie egento egechenu ase omokuani, buna keria airete, na amente ensemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio.
Abakuani tibabaisa gokora ebinto ebi ebichenu Abaisraeli bagwatanana na kobirua ase Omonene bibe ebitachenegeti,
na igo bakogera abanto babogorie ebibe biabo, na okomocha kwabo, ase okoria ebinto ebichenu baruete. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,

“Tebia Haroni na abamura baye, na Abaisraeli bonsi, ng’a ekero omonto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, aganetie konduera inche Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, kerabe nase engencho y’eira, gose neki’ogwancha kwaye,
goika arue eeri, gose egoree, gose emingichi, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, erio nario ekeng’wanso kerancherwe.
Timobaisa korua eng’iti ende yonsi ere na kemocho ase omobere oye, naki ase ekeng’wanso buna ekio timogwancherwa.

Ekero omonto onde bwensi akorua ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe asende, ase engencho y’eira ariete, gose eki’ogwancha kwaye, korwa ase chiombe gose ching’ondi, goika ebe eng’iti eng’ikeranu, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, eyio nero erancherwe.
Timobaisa konduera ching’iti chiukorete, gose chire ebisegora, gose ebirema, gose chire namaote akorua amaira, gose chibwate egesuneri, gose amaote, ng’a chibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende.

Eeri gose emanwa y’eng’ondi ebwate ekiimo egetambe goetania ekende, gose ekieng’e mono, nabo oranyare koyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogwancha, korende ase okoyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogoikerania eira kwariete, tegwancherwa nainche.
Eng’iti ende yonsi chingetia chiaye chisaregete ase ogosunyuntwa, gose ase okomiorigwa, gose ase okobutorwa, gose ase okonatwa, timobaisa koyerua ebe ekeng’wanso asende. Timokora igo ase ense yaino.

“Eng’iti ende yonsi ere buna echio moranyore korwa ase omomenyi, timobaisa koyerua ebe okoruegwa kw’endagera asende. Echio nigo chire nebimocho ase emebere yabo, na ase ebing’wanso buna ebio timogwancherwa.”
Naende Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,

“Ekero emori, gose emanwa y’eng’ondi, gose ey’embori, yabiarirwe, etigwe ebe ase eng’ina ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, korende korwa ase rituko ria gatano na gatato yancherwe ebe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende.
Timobaisa konyenya eng’ombe amo nemori yaye ase rituko erimo, gose eng’ondi, gose embori amo ne chimanwa chiabo ase rituko erimo.
Ekero moganetie konduera inche Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, mokerue ase enchera endonge, erinde monyare gwancherwa.
Ekeng’wanso ekio keriegwe keere ase rituko erio erio, tigetigara nonya ngesinini goika rituko ria kabere. Inche ninche Omonene.
“Ase ayio mobwate amachiko aane na koyakora. Inche ninche Omonene,
Timobaisa korentera erieta riane obosooku, korende nincheneke ase Abaisraeli. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.
Ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde imbe Nyasae oino. Inche ninche Omonene.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia
“Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie: Morarie Amatuko Amanene ay’Omonene, na mobe nemesangererekano yaatananirwe ase ogosasima.

Ase amatuko atano na rimo mokore emeremo yaino, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka, rituko ri’omosangererekano bwatananirwe ase ogosasima. Timobaisa gokora meremo ende yonsi. Erio nerituko ri’Esabato ri’Omonene, aande onsi ase moramenye.
“Naende nareo Amatuko ande Amanene ay’Omonene, mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima, moyararie ase engaki yachikire.
“Rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, chinsa chia mogoroba, nario Epasaka y’Omonene.
Na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi oyio ne Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene, rituko ri’Emegati etabekiri memera; inamorie emegati etabekiri memera ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
Ase rituko rie ritang’ani mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima, na timobaisa gokora emeremo ya kera rituko,

korende namorue okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero ase Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere namobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko.”
Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
“Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie: Ekero moraike ase ense eria Omonene arabae, na mokogesa okwama kwaino, morente riboa ri’ogotongora kwe rigesa riaino ase omokuani.
