Abwo ritina riabo riarenge ase ense y’Abaameleki, bagatirimboka korwa ase Efraimu, abanto b’egesaku kia Benjamin bagakobwatia. Abatang’ani b’abarwani bagatirimboka korwa Makiri, na abarenge abariki ase esegi korwa Sabuloni.

Abanene b’Abaisakaru nigo babwatetie Debora, na buna Abaisakaru bakorete, naboigo na Baraki, bagatirimboka gochia ase ense omweya, bakabwatia chimbaratero chiabo. Korende ase chindooche chi’abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben, okogamba na okoroberia okonene nigo biarengeo.

Nase ki moikaransete ase eero ye ching’ondi, mokoigwa abarisia bakobugia ebiroria bakorangeria ching’ondi? Ee, ase chindooche chi’abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben; okogamba na okoroberia okonene nigo biarengeo, nigo kwarenge okoamererania okonene.

Abanto ba Gileadi, moocha ya Yorodan, mbaikaranseteo. Na abanto b’egesaku kia Dani, nase ki babeerete ase chimeeri chiabo? Abanto b’egesaku gi’Aseri bagaikaransa enyancha mbarabare, bagakira‐kiri, bakabeera ase emesomo yabo.
Abasabuloni bakerua nonya ngoika ogokwa, na Abanafutali boigo ase okorwana esegi ase ebitunwa.
Abaruoti bagacha, bakarwana, ee, abaruoti ba Kanani bakarwana ase Taanaki, agwo ase chindooche chia Megido, korende tibasakorete chifeta.
Korwa igoro esegi ekarwana, ching’enang’eni chikarwania Sisera ekero chiare ase orogendo rwabo.
Orooche rwa Kisoni rokabaira, orwo norooche rwa kare rwa Kisoni. Omoyo one, genderera ne chinguru!
Erio chibarasi chiare gotitiria nebitaago biabo, chituoni chiachiriinete chiare gocharara‐charara.
Omomalaika bw’Omonene nigo agoteba, “Ragereria Merosi, ragereria abanto bamenyeteo, ekiagera tibachete gokonya Omonene, komokonya korwania abare ne chinguru.”
Yaeli, moka Heberi Omokeni, nasesenirie kobua abakungu bande, ee, nasesenirie kobua abakungu bande bamenyete ase chiema.
Sisera agasaba amache, erio Yaeli akamoa amabeere, akamoa amaguta amabeere are ase egetaabo ekiya.
Akarambora okoboko kwaye, akaimokia ekerochi ki’eema, na ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio akaimokia ekegogi, agaakera Sisera nakerokio, agakong’onta omotwe oye, akabeta chintakunero chiaye gochia ime.
Sisera akeringa akagwa inse, akagwa inse ase amagoro a Yaeli, akarambereria inse ase amagoro aye, agwo ase agwete agakwa.

Ng’ina Sisera akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, agatengera goetera ase ekebao kiabekire ebitange, akarera, “Nase ki chigari chiaye chiatebanire gocha? Nase ki amagoro e chibarasi chiaye chie chigari chiatebanire koirana?
Abaiseke abang’aini abarenge amo nere bakamoiraneria, na ere omonyene akaba okoiranerera amang’ana aya:”

“Ande, nigo banyorire ebisakorwa bakare gwatanana ase egati yabo, kera omonto aire omoiseke oyomo, gose babere; Sisera ere aire ebitambaa bi’ebieni ebiya, egetambaa keroisirie ekiya, ekemo gose bibere, bibe ebisakorwa ase rigoti riaye.”
“Omonene, tiga ababisa bao bonsi basire buna igo, korende baria bagwanchete babe buna erioba rire ekero rigosoka ne chinguru.” Na ense eria ekaba nobotoereru ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe naende ase obosio bw’Omonene, na Omonene akababeka ase amaboko ’Abamidiani ase engaki y’emiaka etano na ebere.
Abamidiani nigo baengerete Abaisraeli, na ase engencho y’Abamidiani Abaisraeli bakabetererigwa korigia obotamero ase amakuruma na emetaro, na ase chingoro chiakunyire ase ebitunwa.
Kero kende gionsi Abaisraeli barenge kobusura chimbusuro chiabo, Abamimidiani, na Abaameleki, na abanto ba moocha nigo baare gocha kobarwania esegi.

Bakaba bagotoora ase ense y’Abaisraeli, erio basaria chindagera chiabo goika chimbebe chia Gasa. Tibaare gotigareria Abaisraeli ching’ondi, gose chiombe, gose chitigere, nonya ngento kende gionsi Abaisraeli baare koria.
Nigo barenge gocha amo ne chitugo chiabo ne chiema chiabo, abange buna chingige. Barabwo abanyene ne chingamia chiabo, omobaro obo torenge kobareka. Bagasoa ase ense eria, bakagania koyesaria kegima.
Ase ayio Abaisraeli bagachandeka mono ase engencho y’Abamidiani; erio bakarera ase Omonene ng’a abakonye.
Ekero Abaisraeli barerete ase Omonene ase engencho y’Abamidiani,
Omonene akabatomera omobani, na ere akabarentera amang’ana korwa ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akabatebia, “Ninche nabarusetie Miisiri, ense eria ase mwarenge abasomba.
Nkabatooria korwa ase Abamisiri, na korwa ase abanto bonsi babachandete ase ense eye. Nkabaseria, bakarua ase obosio bwaino, erio nkabaa inwe ense yabo.
Nkabatebia: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, timobaisa koiroka chinyasae chi’Abaamori, abwo momenyete ase ense yabo. Korende timwaigwerete amang’ana aane.”

Erio omomalaika bw’Omonene agacha, agaikaransa inse y’omote onga buna omotontera agwo Ofura, oyio orenge o Yoashi, omonto bw’eamate y’Abieseri. Gidioni, omomura oye, nigo arenge koora engano ase ekemitero ki’edivai, erinde Abamidiani tibayenyora.
Omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera agwo, akamotebia, “Omonene nigo are amo naye, aye omonto omoremu ase okorwana esegi!”

Gidioni agakwana nere, agateba, “Aye Omonene one, onye Omonene ore amo naintwe, nase ki rende aya onsi atonyorire? Naende ogokora kwaye gwe chinguru, ng’ai kore, koria chisokoro chiaito chiatotebetie ng’a Omonene nere otorusetie Misiri? Na bono Omonene otwangire na gotobeka ase amaboko ’Abamidiani.”
Erio Omonene akeonchora gochia asare, akamotebia, “Genda ne chinguru echio chiao, otoorie Abaisraeli korwa ase amaboko ’Abamidiani. Inche ninche nkogotoma.”
Gidioni akamoboria, “Omonene one, naki ndakore mbatoorie Abaisraeli? Eamate yane nigo ere enke kobua chiamate chinde ase egesaku kia Manase, na ase enyomba ya tata inche tindi omonto omanyekanete.”
Omonene akamoiraneria, “Inche nimbe amo naye, naye noite Abamidiani buna nigo bare omonto oyomo.”
Gidioni akamotebia, “Omonene, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa asore, inyorokie ekemanyererio ng’a aye naye ogokwana nainche.
Koranche, torua aase aa goika nkorentere okoruegwa kwane kw’endagera.” Omomalaika oria akamoiraneria, “Nimbeere aa, nkoganye goika oirane.”

Erio Gidioni akagenda nyomba mwaye, akanyenya emanwa y’embori, akayeroisia; naende korwa ase obosie bw’ekerengo ki’ebimunu bibere akaroisia emegati etabekiri memera. Akabeka chinyama ase egetonga, na omosori akayoumora ase enyongo, akairera omomalaika oria orenge inse y’omote onga buna omotontera endagera eyio.
Omomalaika oria o Nyasae akamotebia, “Imokia chinyama echi na emegati eye etabekiri memera, obibeke igoro ase egetare eke, naende obiumorere omosori oyio.” Gidioni agakora bo.

Erio omomalaika oria akarambora okoboko kwaye, na ase mesia y’enyimbo yaye agakuna chinyama chiria na emegati eria etabekiri memera. Aroro agwo omorero ogatuboka ogoka korwa ase egetare keria ime, ne chinyama echio amo nemegati eyio bigasambwa bikayia bikaera. Na omomalaika oria bw’Omonene akarua ase Gidioni.
Bono Gidioni akamanya ng’a oria nomomalaika bw’Omonene orenge, akabora, “Ani! Aye Omonene Nyasae! Narorire omomalaika oo obosio ase obosio.”
Korende Omonene akamotebia, “Omorembe obe amo naye! Toiroka! Aye togokwa.”
Erio Gidioni akaagachera Omonene egesasimero aroro agwo, agakeroka “Omonene nere Omorembe.” Egesasimero ekio nigo geteneine agwo Ofura, omochie bw’eamate y’Abieseri, nonya ngoika rero iga.

Ase obotuko boria Omonene agatebia Gidioni, “Imokia eeri ya iso, na eeri eyemo ende ere nemiaka etano na ebere, naende otagore egesasimero gia iso, keria aagacherete Baali, na okeiyerie inse; naende onache emete y’Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, ere ensemo y’egesasimero keria.

Naende ong’agachere inche Omonene, Nyasae oo, egesasimero, ase ogochoka amagena buya igoro ase eburi eye enkong’u. Erio orente eeri eria ya kabere, oyerue ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, oyesambere chinko chi’omote oria bw’Asera ogochia konacha.”
Gidioni akaimoka amo nabasomba baye ikomi, agakora buna Omonene amotebetie. Bono ekiagera arenge nobwoba ase abanto b’eamate yaye, na ab’omochie obo, gokora aya ekero kia mobaso, akayakora botuko.

Rituko ria kabere, ekero abanto babogete mambia chuni, bakanyora ng’a egesasimero kia Baali giatagoirwe amo nomote oria bw’Asera orenge ensemo yaye, naende bakarora ng’a eeri eria ya kabere yarusigwe yakoreirwe ekeng’wanso igoro ase egesasimero keria konya kiaagachirwe.
Barabwo bakaborania, “Ning’o okorete amang’ana aya?” Ekero baare koboria na kouna‐unia, bakanyora ng’a Gidioni, mosinto o Yoashi, nere okorete ayio.
Erio abanto b’omochie oria bagatebia Yoashi, “Morente omomura oyio oo aiga, ere goika aitwe, ekiagera otagoire egesasimero kia Baali, na otagoire omote oria bw’Asera orenge ensemo yaye.”

Korende Yoashi agatebia abwo bonsi bachete koamererania nere, “Inee! Ninwe mokorwanerera Baali? Gose ninwe mokoyekengera? Onde bwensi okoyerwanerera goika aitwe ritang’ani emambia ende etaraika. Onye Baali nenyasae, tiga erwanerere ere bweka omonyene. Egesasimero kiaye nakio giatagoirwe.”
Korwa rituko riria Gidioni akarokwa Yerubi‐Baali, engencho yaye, “Tiga Baali erwanerere ere bweka omonyene”, ekiagera Gidioni atagorete egesasimero kiaye.
Erio Abamidiani na Abaameleki, na abanto ba moocha bagasangererekana amo, na ekero bambokire Yorodan bagatoora ase ense omweremo ya Yesireeli.
Gidioni agasogwa ne chinguru chi’Omoika bw’Omonene. Ere akabugia egetureri gi’esegi, na Abaabieseri bakarangerigwa bakamobwatia.

Naende agatoma abanto ase orogongo rwonsi rw’abanto b’egesaku kia Manase barangerie abanto b’aroro bamobwatie. Naboigo akarangeria abanto b’egesaku gi’Aseri, na egia Sabuloni, na ekia Nafutali; barabwo bakaimoka, bakagenda bakamobwatia.
Gidioni agatebia Nyasae, “Aye gwatebire ng’a norigetie gotooria Abaisraeli goetera ase okoboko kwane. Onye naboigo,

rora, nkobeka nde risankwa rire namarionya e ching’ondi ase ekeooreri gekoorerwa; obotooru bokoba ase risankwa riria rire namarionya oka, korende riroba ribe eriomo, erio nario ndamanye ng’a aye notoorie Abaisraeli goetera ase okoboko kwane, buna gwatebire.”
Ayio akaba boigo. Ekero Gidioni abogete mambia chuni, akamita risankwa riria, akanyititora amache ’obotooru, egetaabo kegaichora.

Gidioni agakwana na Nyasae, akamotebia, “Nyasae, totiga endamwamu yao yoke asende, korende ing’a ribaga nkwane naye rimo naende. Tiga nteeme rimo naende ne risankwa eri. Na bono ekero eke kora iga ng’a risankwa ribe eriomo, korende obotooru bobe ase riroba inse rionsi.”
Na ase obotuko boria Nyasae agakora bo; mambia yaye risankwa nigo riarenge eriomo, korende riroba inse rionsi rikaba rinyiu ase obotooru.
Yerubi‐Baali (nere Gidioni) amo nabanto abarenge komo bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagatoora ang’e nensoko ya Harodi. Abamidiani nigo batoorete ase ense omweya sugusu yabo, ang’e negetunwa kia More.

Omonene agatebia Gidioni, “Abanto abwo bagokobwatia nigo bare abange goetania ntanyare kobeka Abamidiani ase amaboko abo. Aande Abaisraeli nigo barachie gwetogia mamincha yane, na goteba: Amaboko aito intwe abanyene naro atotooretie.

Ase ayio, raria ase abanto, obatebie: Onde bwensi ore nobwoba na omoondoko, airane gochia nka na arue egetunwa kia Gileadi.” Abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, bakairana, bakagenda, na abanto chilifu ikomi bagatigara.

Naende Omonene agatebia Gidioni, “Nonya mbono abanto aba nigo bare abange mono; tiga batirimboke gochia rooche, na inche nkobaatananere aroro. Ase onde bwensi ndagotebie: Omonto oyo nanyare kogenda amo naye, oyio agende; na ase onde bwensi ndagotebie: Omonto oyo takogenda amo naye, oyio takogenda.”

Ase igo Gidioni agatirimbokia abanto baria gochia rooche, na Omonene akamotebia, “Onde bwensi orabe ogosiara amache noromeme gochia monwa oye, buna esese egosiara, omobeke ensemo eyemo; na onde bwensi oratung’ame inse namaru konywa amache, omobeke ensemo eng’ao.”
Abanto baria basiarete amache ase okoyasiara gochia monwa nebiara bi’amaboko abo, nigo barenge amagana atato. Na abatigarete igo batung’amete namaru inse, bakanywa.

Omonene agatebia Gidioni, “Ase abanto aba amagana atato basiara amache gochia monwa nimbatoorie inwe na kobeka Abamidiani ase amaboko ao, korende tiga abanto bande bonsi bairane, kera oyomo ase enka yaye.”
Nabo Gidioni akarusia asebare endagera eye babwate amo nebitureri, agatebia Abaisraeli bonsi, otatiga abwo amagana atato, bairane nka. Egetwori ki’Abamidiani nigo kiarenge maate yabo ase ense omweya.
Ase obotuko boria Omonene agatebia Gidioni, “Imoka, otirimboke gochia ase egetwori kiabo obaumokere, ekiagera nakebekire ase amaboko ao.
Korende onye gokoiroka, tirimboka ritang’ani amo na Pura, omosomba oo.
Aye noigwe amang’ana aya bagokwana, erio ekero kwayaigure onyore oboremu ogende gokeumokera.” Nabo Gidioni amo na Pura, omosomba oye, bagatirimboka goika ase ensinyo y’egetwori keria aase kiarendire.
Abamidiani, na Abaameleki, na abanto ba moocha nigo barenge agwo ase ense omweya abange buna chingige. Nigo barenge ne chingamia chinyinge buna omokenye ore ase engegu y’enyancha chitaare kobareka.

Ekero Gidioni aigeteo, akaigwa omonto oyomo ogotebia omogisangio oye buna arotire, ogoteba, “Nigo narota okorota, narora omogati bw’esairi ogoturunkana gocha aiga ase egetwori giaito, oaka eema, oyeonchorana, oyeiyeria inse.”

Omogisangio bw’omonto oria akairaneria, “Oyio nomoro o Gidioni, oria Omoisraeli, mosinto o Yoashi. Tigekonyara koba gento kende ekeao. Nyasae otobekire intwe Abamidiani, amo nemeganda yaito yonsi y’abarwani, ase amaboko aye.”

Gidioni agachia koigwa okorota okwo, naende buna engencho y’okorota okwo yarenge, agatung’ama inse, agasasima. Erio akairana gochia ase Abaisraeli, akabatebia, “Imoka mogende! Omonene obekire ebitwori bi’abarwani b’Abamidiani ase amaboko aino.”
Agaatanana abanto baria baye amagana atato ase ebiombe bitato, akaa kera oyomo egetureri, na ekeguuru amo nekieri ki’omorero kere imeo.
Akabatebia, “Ndigererie, mokore buna ndakore. Ekero ndaike ase ensinyo y’egetwori, mondigererie buna ndakore nainwe mokore bo.
Ekero inche amo nabanto bonsi tore komo torabugie ebitureri, nainwe mobugie ebitureri biaino ase chinsemo chionsi chi’egetwori, erio moake eriogi rinene, motebe: Ase Omonene na ase Gidioni!”

Bono Gidioni na abanto baria rigana erimo barenge amo nere bagaika ensinyo y’egetwori ki’Abamidiani ase engaki abarendi ba botuko gati bachagete korenda. Erio bakabugia ebitureri biria na bagaata ebiguuru biria babwate ase amaboko abo.

Naboigo abanto bonsi b’ebiombe biria bitato bakabugia ebitureri biabo na bagaata ebiguuru biabo; babwate ebieri bi’omorero ase amaboko abo a bomosi, na ase amaboko a borio babwate ebitureri biabo bi’okobugia, bagaaka eriogi rinene, bakabora, “Omoro ase Omonene na ase Gidioni!”
Kera omonto agatenena aase aye goetanana ase egetwori keria; erio abarwani b’esegi abarenge imeo bagachaka kominyoka gochia aaria na aaria, bagakuura na gotama.

Ekero abanto ba Gidioni babugetie ebitureri biria amagana atato, Omonene akaondokia Abamidiani, kera oyomo akaonchokera goita oyomwabo nomoro ase egetwori keria ekegima, na abarwani bonsi bagatama gochia ensemo ya Serera goikera Beti‐Hasita, na goikera Abeli‐Mehola, ang’e na Tabati.
Erio Abaisraeli korwa egesaku kia Nafutali na egi’Aseri, amo nekia Manase gionsi bakarangerigwa gocha amo kobwatia Abamidiani.

Gidioni agatoma abanto ase ense yonsi y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu batebe, “Tirimboka gochia maate, morwanie Abamidiani; mobwate ebiambokero bie chindooche goikera Beti‐Bara, amo nebia Yorodan.” Ase igo abanto b’Efraimu bagasangererigwa amo, bakabwata ebiambokero goikera Beti‐Bara, na ebia Yorodan boigo.

Bakabwata abagambi babere b’Abamidiani, Orebu na Seebu. Bagaitera Orebu ase Egetare ki’Orebu, na Seebu bakamoitera ase ekemitero ki’edivai gia Seebu, na bakagenderera kobwatia Abamidiani. Omotwe bw’Orebu na oyo o Seebu bakayeirera Gidioni aase arenge, moocha ya Yorodan.
Abanto b’Efraimu bakaboria Gidioni, “Nase ki otatorangeretie ekero kwagendete korwania Abamidiani? Inki eke gwatokoreire?” Naende bakamwomania, bare nobotindi obonge mono.
Ere akabairaneria, “Ngento ki nakorire inche kegwekaine eki mwakorire inwe? Inee! Ogochora kw’amasabibu amatigari kw’Abaefraimu tikori okuya kobua rigesa ri’emesabibu nabanto b’Abieseri?

Nyasae obekire Orebu na Seebu, abagambi b’Abamidiani, ase amaboko aino. Inche ngento ki nakorire kegwekaine eki mwakorire inwe?” Ekero baigwete aya Gidioni akwanete, endamwamu yabo y’okomobea egakenda.
Bono Gidioni amo nabanto baye amagana atato bagacha Yorodan, bakaamboka. Nonya konya bagoyire, bakagenderera kobwatia ababisa babo.
Gidioni agatebia abanto ba Sukoti, “Komoranche moe abanto aba bagontunyana emegati. Barabwo bagoyire, nainche nkobwatia inde Seba na Salimuna, abaruoti b’Abamidiani, mbarwanie.”
Korende abatang’ani ba Sukoti bagateba, “Naki rende torakore tobae abarwani bao emegati? Naye torabua Seba na Salimuna.”
Gidioni akairaneria, “Ekero Omonene arabeke Seba na Salimuna ase amaboko aane, ning’arie chinyama chi’emebere yaino namagwa ’orosana na amageri.”
Erio Gidioni agatiga Sukoti, akagenda gochia Penueli na agwo akaboria abanto amang’ana aria aria, korende abanto ba Penueli bakamoiraneria buna abanto ba Sukoti bamoiraneretie.
Ase igo akabatebia, “Ekero ndachiche naende inde nobobui, nintagore omorobiri oyo.”

Bono Seba na Salimuna nigo barenge agwo Karikori amo nabarwani babo chilifu ikomi na isano. Ase abarwani ba moocha nabwo boka batigarete. Abarwani chilifu rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, abarwanete nemioro, konya baitirwe.
Gidioni agatiirera enchera abagendi banarete goeta, moocha ya Noba na Yogibea, akaumokera omoganda bw’abarwani ekero orenge nobotoereru.
Seba na Salimuna, abaruoti baria babere b’Abamidiani, bagatama, korende Gidioni akababwatia akababwata. Erio akagosa abarwani bonsi na kobaserebania.
Ekero Gidioni, mosinto o Yoashi, airanete korwa ase esegi agaetera ebitirimboko bia Heresi,
akabwata omomura omosae oyomo o Sukoti, akamobora‐boria amang’ana, akamotebia amorikere amarieta ’abanto abanene, na abagaaka ba Sukoti, emerongo etano na ebere, na batano na babere.

Erio Gidioni akagenda ase abanto ba Sukoti, akabatebia, “Rora aiga Seba na Salimuna, baria inwe mwanyomaneretie mogoteba iga: Torabua Seba na Salimuna. Naki rende torakore toe abarwani bao, abwo bagoyire, emegati!”
Akaimokia amagwa ’orosana na amageri akabaaria abagaaka b’omochie oria.
Erio agatagora omorobiri agwo Penueli, na agaita abasacha b’omochie oria.
Erio Gidioni akaboria Seba na Salimuna, “Inee! Abanto baria mwaitete agwo Tabori, nkieni ki barenge?” Bakamoiraneria, “Kera oyomo obo nigo akogwekaine. Nigo barorekanete buna bare abana b’omoruoti.”
Gidioni akabatebia, “Baria nigo barenge bamura baminto, abamura ba baba. Amaene, buna Omonene are moyo, onye mwabatigete babe moyo, inche nanga tinabaita inwe!”
Naende agatebia Yeteri, omwana oye omomura omotangi, “Imoka, obaite!” Korende omwana oyio tang’usa omoyio oye o birende, ekiagera nigo arenge omosae omoke.

Erio Seba na Salimuna bagatebia Gidioni, “Imoka aye omonyene, otoite, ekiagera buna omonto are, naboigo ne chinguru chiaye chire.” Ere akaimoka, agaita Seba na Salimuna; akarusia chisonoi chi’ogwechabera chiarenge ase amagoti e chingamia chiabo.
Nyuma y’ayio Abaisraeli bagatebia Gidioni, “Gwatotooririe korwa ase amaboko ’Abamidiani; ase ayio kabe omogambi oito; na nyuma yao omwana oo na omochokoro oo nabatogambere.”
Gidioni akabairaneria, “Inche tinkobagambera, gose omwana one takobagambera; Omonene nere orabagambere.”

Naende akabatebia, “Nkobasaba nde egento ekemo: Kera omonto asemore ang’e ebigera bire ase amato aye, biria asakorete.” (Abamidiani nigo babegete ebigera bie chitahabu, ekiagera n’Abaisumaeli barenge.)
Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Twanchire gokobia.” Erio bakaara egetambaa inse, na ase egetambaa ekio kera oyomo akabeka ebigera biaye bi’amato ebisakorete.

Oborito bw’e bigera biria asabete aegwe nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiro emerongo ebere. Amo nebio akaira chisonoi, na ebigera, ne chianga chimonyinga, ebinto abaruoti b’Abamidiani barenge kobeka, amo ne chisonoi chiria chiarenge ase amagoti e chingamia chiabo.

Gidioni akaroisia egesibao ki’obokuani korwa ase chitahabu chiria, agakebeka ase omochie oye Ofura; na Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiga koba abegenwa ase Omonene, bagasasima egesibao keria. Kerokio gekaba kegotega Gidioni amo neamate yaye.
Nabo Abamidiani babuetwe n’Abaisraeli, na tibanyara koimoka gokora kende. Na bono ense eria ekaba nobotoereru ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika Gidioni agakwa.
Yerubi‐Baali, mosinto o Yoashi, akairana nka, akamenya ase enyomba yaye omonyene.
Gidioni oyio nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo etano na ebere, ekiagera nigo abwate abakungu abange.
Naboigo nabwate omokungu o sere‐sere, oyomenyete Sekemu; nere akamoiborera omwana omomura, na Gidioni akamoroka Abimeleki.
Gidioni, mosinto o Yoashi, agakwa ore nobogotu obuya, agatindekwa ase embeera ya Yoashi ise yarenge agwo Ofura, omochie bw’egesaku ki’Abieseri.
Nyuma y’ogokwa kwa Gidioni, Abaisraeli bagatiga koba abegenwa ase Omonene, na bagasasima chinyasae chiria Baali. Bagachora Baali‐Beriti ekaba enyasae yabo,
bakeba Omonene, Nyasae obo, oyobatooretie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo babaetanaine.
Tibakorerete abanto b’eamate ya Yerubi‐Baali (nere Gidioni) amaya, ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase amaya onsi akorerete Abaisraeli.
Abimeleki, mosinto o Yerubi‐Baali, akagenda Sekemu, ase abang’ina rome, na ase abanto bonsi b’eamate ya ise ng’ina, akabatebia

ng’a baborie abanto ba Sekemu, “Inki kere ekiya kobua, ng’a abana abamura emerongo etano na ebere ba Yerubi‐Baali babagambere, gose omonto oyomo bweka abagambere? Inyora boigo ng’a Abimeleki nigo are oyomino kegima bw’amanyinga ayamo.”
Ase ayio aba ng’ina rome bagakwana amang’ana ayio ase abanto ba Sekemu ase ogokonya Abimeleki, na bonsi bakang’uswa bakaba ase ensemo yaye, naende bagateba ng’a ere nere orenge oyomwabo.
Abanto bakamoa chisekeli chie chifeta emerongo etano na ebere korwa ase enyomba ya Baali‐Beriti, na ase chibesa echio akarikera abanto abatantanu batechigeti: nabarabwo bakamotunyana.

Nyuma y’ayio akagenda nyomba mwa ise agwo Ofura, na igoro ase rigena erimo agaitera abamura bamwabo aroro, abana ba Yerubi‐Baali, emerongo etano na ebere. Yotamu bweka, omomura omoke kegima o Yerubi‐Baali, nere otigarete ore moyo. Ere konya bwebisire.
Erio abanto bonsi ba Sekemu, na abwo ba Beti‐Milo, bagasangererekana amo agwo Sekemu ase omote oria onga buna omotontera ang’e nekeinyorio giatenenirieo, na agwo bakabeka Abimeleki akaba omoruoti.
Ekero Yotamu atebetigwe amang’ana ayio, akagenda, agatenena ase egetunwa kia Gerisimu igoro, agaaka eriogi rinene agateba, “Inwe abanto ba Sekemu, ntegerera, erinde Nyasae nere abategerere.
Agwo kare ekaba ng’a emete ekagenda gochora eruoti ekoyegambera. Egatebia omozeituni: Togambere!
Omozeituni oria okairaneria: Inee! Igo ngotiga amaguta aane ayakorenta ogosika ase chinyasae na ase mwanyabanto, erinde ngambere emete ende?
Erio emete egatebia omoko: Inchuo aye otogambere!
Korende omoko oria okairaneria: Igo ngotiga obwansu bwane na amatunda aane amaya, erinde ngambere emete ende?
Emete egatebia omosabibu: Inchuo aye otogambere!
Korende omosasibu okairaneria: Igo ngotiga okorua edivai yane, eria ekogokia chinyasae na mwanyabanto, erinde ngambere emete ende?
Erio emete yonsi egatebia egetutu ki’amagwa: Inchuo aye otogambere!

Na egetutu ki’amagwa gekairaneria emete yonsi: Onye ekeene mwanchire gonchora imbe eruoti yaino, inchuo mokenderere inse y’ekiriri kiane, korende onye taibo, tiga omorero osoke korwa ase chinsagia chiane chi’amagwa, osambe emecharake ya Lebanoni.

“Na bono, Inee, nigo mwakorete ayare boronge na ay’obwegenwa ekero mwachorete Abimeleki akaba omoruoti oino? Naende mwakorerete Yerubi‐Baali na ab’enyomba yaye boronge na ayamogwenerete ase ogokora kwaye?
Inyora ng’a nigo arwanete esegi ase engencho yaino. Igo ebegete ang’e ase ogokwa ase okobatooria korwa ase Abamidiani.

Rero inwe mwabeire mamincha y’enyomba ya tata, na mwaiteire abana baye abamura, abanto emerongo etano na ebere, ase rigena erimo igoro, naende mwabekire Abimeleki, omwana bw’omosomba oye omokungu, obeire omoruoti bw’abanto ba Sekemu, ekiagera are momura omino.
Onye rero mwakoreire Yerubi‐Baali amo nab’enyomba yaye ayare boronge na ay’obwegenwa, rirorio gokera Abimeleki, nere tiga abagokere.

Korende onye taibo, tiga omorero osoke korwa ase Abimeleki obasambe inwe abamomenyete Sekemu na Beti‐Milo, obasirie; naende tiga omorero osoke korwa asemore inwe abamomenyete Sekemu na Beti‐Milo, osambe Abimeleki, omosirie.”
Erio Yotamu akaminyoka, agatama gochia Beeri, akamenya agwo, ekiagera airogete Abimeleki momura omwabo.
Abimeleki akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka etato.
Erio Nyasae agatoma omoika omobe ase ogwatanana Abimeleki na abanto ba Sekemu, na abanto aba bagakorera Abimeleki obong’ainereria.

Aya nigo abete bo, erinde obotindi obwo bwakoreretwe abana abamura baria ba Yerubi‐Baali emerongo etano na ebere baakanerwe egesiomba. Ase igo okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga abo kogaakanerwa igoro y’Abimeleki, oyio obaitete, naende igoro y’abanto ba Sekemu, abwo bamobegete chinguru chi’ogokora ayio.
Abanto ba Sekemu bakabeka abanto ase ebitunwa igoro baboere abanto bonsi barenge goeta ase chinchera chiria na kobaura ebinto biabo. Abimeleki agatebigwa amang’ana ayio.
Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi, agacha Sekemu amo nabamura bamwabo, na abanto ba Sekemu bakamwegena na komosemeria.

Barabwo bonsi bakagenda ase emegondo y’emesabibu, bagatora amasabibu, bakayamita, bakaroisia edivai na gokora omoyega omonene. Bagasoa ase enyomba y’enyasae yabo, bakaria na bakanywa, erio bakaragereria Abimeleki.

Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi agateba, “Abimeleki nere ng’o? Naintwe, abanto ba Sekemu, mbanto ki tore? Nase ki togokorera Abimeleki? Ere mosinto o Yerubi‐Baali! Na Sebuli, nere omoteneneri bw’abanto baye! Nase ki rende togokorera Abimeleki? Taibo, tobe abegenwa ase abanto abarwete Hamori, sokoro y’abanto ba Sekemu!
Onye abanto aba nkoba barenge ase oborendi bwane, nanga narusia Abimeleki. Nigo nare komotebia: Menta abarwani bao b’esegi, erio ochiche korwana!”
Ekero Sebuli, omogambi bw’omochie oria, aigwete amang’ana a Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi, akaba nendamwamu enene.
Agatoma abanto gochia ase Abimeleki bobisi bamotebie, “Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi, amo nabamura bamwabo bachire Sekemu, goseegeta abanto b’omochie babe mamincha yao.
Ase ayio, aye amo nabanto bao more komo, genda botuko mwebise, moboe ase ebitii.
Ankio mambia, ekero erioba rigosoka, moimoke bwango, moumokere omochie. Erio ekero Gaali na abanto baria bare komo bakobachera kobarwania, mobakore buna moranyare ekero ekio!”
Abimeleki amo nabanto bonsi barenge komo bakaimoka botuko, bakebisa, bakaboera Sekemu, bare ebiombe bine.
Gaali agasoka, agatenena ase egeita ki’omochie, na erio agwo Abimeleki amo nabanto baye bakaimoka korwa ase baboete.
Ekero Gaali aroche abanto, agatebia Sebuli, “Rigereria, abanto bagotirimboka korwa ebitunwa igoro.” Korende Sebuli agateba, “Ebio nebiriria bi’ebitunwa kwarorire bikororekana buna abanto.”

Gaali agakwana naende, agateba, “Yaya, rigereria, abanto ngotirimboka bare korwa ase esagamu eria gati‐gati, na abanto b’ekeombe kende nigo bagocha ase enchera ekorwa ase omote oria onga buna omotontera, oria bw’abaringoria.”
Erio Sebuli akamotebia, “Ng’ai are amang’ana ao ay’ogwetogia ekero gwatebete: Abimeleki nere ng’o? Nase ki tokomokorera? Aba tibari abanto abagwachayete? Soka bono obarwanie.”
Gaali agatang’ana abanto ba Sekemu, nabarabwo bakagenda bakarwania Abimeleki.
Abimeleki agaseria Gaali, na ere agatama. Abange bagaitwa, bakarambereria inse goika ase egeita ki’omochie.
Abimeleki akairana Aruma, na Sebuli agaseria Gaali na abamura bamwabo, erio tibanyara kogenderera komenya Sekemu.
Rituko ria kabere abanto bagasoka ase egetii aarabu, na Abimeleki agatebigwa amang’ana ayio.
Ere akaimoka nabanto baye, akabaatanana ase ebiombe bitato, barabwo bakebisa na koboa ase egetii. Ekero aroche abanto bagosoka korwa ase omochie, agasoka korwa aase ebisete, akabaumokera na kobaita.

Abimeleki na abanto b’ekeombe kiaye bakaayerera gochia gotenena ase egeita ki’omochie, korende abanto b’ebiombe biria bibere binde bakarindokera na koumokera abanto bonsi abarenge ase egetii, bakabaita.
Na ekero Abimeleki arwanetie omochie rituko riria rigima, akayobwata na agaita abanto abamenyeteo. Erio akayoiyeria na koyoitororera omonyo.
Ekero abanto bonsi b’Omorobiri o Sekemu baigwete amang’ana ayio, bakebisa ime ase ekenunchi kiarenge obotamero obokong’u agwo ase hekalu y’Eli‐Beriti.
Abimeleki agatebigwa ng’a abanto bonsi b’Omorobiri o Sekemu nigo bagasangererekanete amo.

Erio agatiirera egetunwa gia Salimoni amo nabanto baye bonsi, akaimokia egesire, akagecha chinsagia chi’emete, agachibeka ase amareko aye. Naende agatebia abanto baye, “Aya morarore inche ngokora, nainwe mokore boigo, na moyakore bwango!”

Ase igo, kera oyomo ase abanto baria akagecha chinsagia chiaye; erio bagatunyana Abimeleki, bakabeka emete eria ang’e ase obotamero boria obokong’u, na kobotongia omorero, bakabosiria amo nabanto bonsi b’omorobiri oria. Abwo bonsi, abanto koreng’ana elifu eyemo, abasacha na abakungu, bagakwa.
Nyuma y’ayio Abimeleki akagenda Tebesi, akayonaria na koyoira.
Korende omorobiri omokong’u norenge ase omochie oria ime, na abanto bonsi b’omochie, abasacha na abakungu, bagatama gochiao, bagesiekera imeo. Erio bakariina gochia kerama igoro.
Abimeleki agacha koumokera omorobiri oyio, agaika ang’e negesieri kiaye ayosambe nomorero,
na omokungu oyomo akaruta ensio agosera, agaaka Abimeleki omotwe, agasenyenta ekeore kiaye.

Erio Abimeleki akarangeria omosae obogoretie ebirwanero biaye, akamotebia, “Somora omoyio oo o birende, ong’ite, abanto tibabaisa goteba ng’a: Nomokungu omoita.” Erio omosae oria akamobeta omoyio oye, akamoita.
Ekero Abaisraeli baroche ng’a Abimeleki okure, bakairana nka, kera oyomo goika bwoye.
Naboigo ekaba ng’a Nyasae oakanire egesiomba ase engencho y’ebibe biria Abimeleki akorerete ise ase ogoita abana baye, abamura bamwabo omonyene, emerongo etano na ebere.
Nyasae akagera abanto ba Sekemu bakanyora egesusuro ase engencho y’obonyaka babwo. Naboigo okoragereria kwa Yotamu, mosinto o Yerubi‐Baali, kogaikeranigwa igoro yabo.
Nyuma y’Abimeleki Tola, mosinto o Pua o Dodo, omonto bw’egesaku gia Isakaru, akaimoka gotooria Abaisraeli. Ere nigo amenyete Samiri, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu.
Ere akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, na etato. Erio agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Samiri.
Nyuma yaye Yairi Omogileadi akaimoka. Nere akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, na ebere.

Ere nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo etato, baare koriina chitigere emerongo etato. Boigo bakaba bakogambera emechie emerongo etato agwo ase ense ya Gileadi. Emechie eyio nigo ekorokwa Hawoti‐Yairi (Emechie ya Yairi) nonya ngoika rero iga.
Yairi agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Kamoni.

Naende Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe ase obosio bw’Omonene; bagasasima chinyasae chiria chiare korokwa Baali, na echinde chiare korokwa Asitaroti, amo ne chinyasae chi’Abasiiria na Abasidoni, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafilisti; naende bagatiga komokorera Omonene.
Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Abaisraeli, akababeka ase amaboko ’Abafilisti na ay’Abaamoni,

Ase omwaka oria barabwo bagachanda Abaisraeli na kobakorera bobe. Ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi, na etano na etato, bagachanda Abaisraeli bonsi abamenyete moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodan ase ense y’Abaamori ase Gileadi.
Amo nayio Abaamori bakaamboka Yorodan gochia korwania Abayuda, na Ababenjamin, na Abaefraimu, goika Abaisraeli bagachandwa bobe mono.
Erio Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene, bagoteba, “Twakorire ebibe asore, ekiagera twagotigire aye Nyasae oito, na gokorera chinyasae chiria Baali.”
Omonene akabairaneria, “Inee! Tinabatooretie korwa ase Abamisiri, na Abaamori, na Abafilisti?
Boigo Abasidoni, na Abaameleki, na Abaamoni, abwo bonsi mbabachandete; mokarera asende, na inche nkabatooria korwa ase amaboko abo.
Korende bono mwantigire inche na gokorera chinyasae ching’ao; ase ayio tintageti kobatooria naende.
Genda, morere ase chinyasae chiria mogokorera, tiga chirochio chibatoorie bono ekero more ase emechando.”
Erio Abaisraeli bagatebia Omonene, “Twakorire ebibe, na bono tokorere buna oranche aye omonyene; twagosoroire, ototoorie rero, koranche.”
Ase igo bakarusia na gotuguta chinyasae chingeni echiarenge ase egati yabo, bagakorera Omonene. Na bono Omonene tare konyara koremereria naende korora emechando y’Abaisraeli.
Abaamoni bakarangerigwa gocha korwana, bagatoora agwo Gileadi, korende Abaisraeli bagasangererigwa, bagatoora agwo Misipa.
Abanto ba Gileadi na abatang’ani babo bagakwana barabwo ase barabwo, “Ning’o oranche gochaka korwania Abaamoni? Ere oyio nabe omogambi bw’abanto bonsi ba Gileadi.”
Yefta Omogileadi nigo arenge omorwani etuoni. Ere nigo arenge omwana bw’omokungu omotayayi, na ise Yefta nigo arenge korokwa Gileadi.

Omokungu omonyuome o Gileadi nere boigo akamoiborera abana abamura, na ekero barabwo babete abanto abanene bagaseria Yefta korwa inka, bakamotebia, “Aye tokonyara konyora omwando ase enyomba ya tata, ekiagera nigo ore omwana bw’omokungu omoao.”
Erio Yefta agatama korwa ase bamura bamwabo, akagenda ase ense ya Tobu. Agwo agasang’ana nabanto batechigeti, nabarabwo bakana‐gotaara nere.
Engaki egaika, ekero Abaamoni bachagete korwania Abaisraeli.
Ekero keria abagaaka ba Gileadi bakagenda korangeria Yefta korwa ase ense ya Tobu,
bakamotebia, “Inchuo obe omotang’ani oito, erinde tonyare korwania Abaamoni.”
Korende Yefta akabairaneria, “Inwe mwanyangete na moganseria korwa ase enyomba ya tata. Nase ki mwachire asende bono, ekero mwanyorire emechando?”

Abagaaka baria ba Gileadi bakamoiraneria, “Ayio naro agerire twakoiraneire bono: Ntorigetie aye ogende amo naintwe, otokonye korwania Abaamoni, na obe omotang’ani oito, na oyo bw’abanto bonsi ba Gileadi.”
Yefta agatebia abagaaka baria, “Onye mokong’irania inka naende ngende korwania Abaamoni, na Omonene karabeke abanto abwo ase amaboko aane, inche nimbe omotang’ani oino.”
Abagaaka ba Gileadi bakamoiraneria, “Ntokore buna gwatebire. Omonene nabe kirori ase egati yaito.”
Ase igo Yefta akagenda amo nabagaaka ba Gileadi, na abanto babo bakamobeka akaba omogambi na omotang’ani obo. Yefta agakwana amang’ana aye onsi ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo Misipa.
Erio Yefta agatoma abanto ase omoruoti bw’Abaamoni komoboria, “Ndiomana ki obwate asende? Nase ki gwachire korwania ense yane?”

Omoruoti bw’Abaamoni akairaneria abanto abwo batometwe na Yefta, “Ekero Abaisraeli barwete Misiri mbairete ense yane korwa orooche rw’Arinoni goika orwa Yaboki, na goika Yorodan. Ase ayio bono yeiranie nomorembe.”
Naende Yefta agatoma abanto eria kabere ase omoruoti bw’Abaamoni,
bamotebie “Oko nokoiraneria kwa Yefta: Abaisraeli tibairete ense y’Abamoabu, gose ey’Abaamoni,
korende ekero barwete Misiri nigo baetete ase egati y’erooro gochia Enyancha Embariri, bagaika Kadeshi.

Korwa agwo bagatoma abanto gochia ase omoruoti bw’Edomu bamoborie ribaga baetere ense yaye. Korende omoruoti bw’Edomu tanchete gotegerera amang’ana ayio. Naende bagatoma abanto ase omoruoti o Moabu, nere boigo tabaete ribaga. Ase ayio Abaisraeli bagatigara agwo Kadeshi.

Erio bagaeta ase egati y’erooro, bagaetanana ense y’Edomu na ense ya Moabu, bagaika moocha y’ense ya Moabu, goika ng’umbu y’orooche rw’Arinoni. Bagatoora agwo, korende tibaambogete Arinoni, ekiagera oro norobebe rwa Moabu.
Erio Abaisraeli bagatoma abanto gochia ase Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori, agwo Hesiboni bamoborie ribaga baete ase ense yaye, bagende ase ense yabo abanyene.
Korende Sihoni tabegenete Abaisraeli, na tabaete ribaga baete ase ense yaye. Agasangereria abarwani baye, na barabwo bagatoora agwo Yahasi, bakarwania Abaisraeli.
Korende Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akabeka Sihoni amo nabanto baye ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bakababua. Abaiisraeli bakaira ense yonsi y’Abaamori baria bamenyete ase ense eria.
Bakaira ense yonsi y’Abaamori ekaba eyabo, korwa Arinoni goika Yaboki, na korwa erooro goika Yorodan.
Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nere oseretie Abaamori ase engencho y’abanto baye Abaisraeli. Inee! Aye bono nigo oganetie koira ense yabo?
Aye togotwara egento Kemosi, enyasae yao, yakoeire, kebe ekiao? Naboigo naintwe natoire ense y’abanto baria Omonene Nyasae aseretie korwa ase amasio aito.
Bono aye nigo okorengereria ng’a nomuya ore kobua Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, omoruoti bw’Abamoabu? Inee! Ere nomanete n’Abaisraeli nonya ng’ake? Gose narwanete esegi nabarabwo?

Ase engaki y’emiaka amagana atato Abaisraeli nigo bamenyete Hesiboni na Aroeri, amo nebichie bionsi biaetanaine emechie eyio, na emechie yonsi yare ase chingegu chi’Arinoni. Nase ki motairete chinse echio ase engaki eyio yonsi?
Inche ase ayio tindakora ebibe asore; aye nigo ogokora bobe asende ase ogokora esegi nainche. Omonene nere omogayani. Ere nanache ekina rero ase egati y’Abaisraeli na Abaamoni.”
Korende omoruoti bw’Abaamoni taigwerete gose gosika amang’ana aya Yefta amotomerete.
Erio omoika o Nyasae ogacha igoro ya Yefta, na ere agaeta ase egati y’ense ya Gileadi na eya Manase, akagenderera goeta Misipa ase Gileadi, na korwa aroro akagenda, agaika ense y’Abaamoni.
Yefta akamoriera Omonene eira na gotiana, akabora, “Aye korabeke Abaamoni ase amaboko aane,

erio nebe ng’a onde bwensi orasoke korwa ase egesieri ki’enyomba yane abe omotang’ani kondotota ekero ndairane korwa ase Abaamoni inde nobobui, oyio nabe oyoo, Omonene, na inche nimorue abe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa asore.”
Yefta akaamboka gochia ng’umbu, akagenda korwania Abaamoni, na Omonene akababeka ase amaboko aye.
Ere akabaita korwa Aroeri goika chinsemo chia Miniti, akaira emechie emerongo ebere goikera Abeli‐Keramimu, akabaita ogoita okonene. Abaamoni bakabugwa, bakabekwa inse y’obogambi bw’Abaisraeli.

Yefta akairana gochia inka bwoye aaria Misipa, na agwo akarora omoiseke oye ogocha komorotota, okobugia ekebangarara na gotenga. Omoiseke oria, nere bweka Yefta abwate, tabwate mwana onde, omomura gose omoiseke.

Ekero Yefta aroche omoiseke oria, agatandora chianga chiaye, akarera, “Obee! Omoiseke one! Kwagerire enkoro yane yairianyekire. Naende kwandeteire emechando emenene. Inche narierete Omonene eira, ngatiana, na tinkonyara gotiga eira eria nariete.”
Omoiseke oria akamotebia, “Tata, onye kwarierete Omonene eira, inkorere aya gwakwanete, ekiagera Omonene okoruseirie egesiomba ase ababisa bao Abaamoni.”

Naende omoiseke oria akamotebia, “Inkorere egento ekemo gioka! Ing’a ribaga ri’emetienyi ebere, erinde ngende amo nabasani baane ase ebitunwa, na aroro toetanane na korera, ekiagera ningenderere koba omwekungi.”
Ise akamotebia, “Genda!” Akamotoma agende ase engaki y’emetienyi ebere. Igo omoiseke oria akagenda amo nabasani baye gochia ase ebitunwa, na aroro agwo bakareera obwekungi bwaye.
Ekero emetienyi ebere yaerete, omoiseke oria akairana ase ise, nere ise akamokora buna arierete Omonene eira ng’a akore. Omoiseke oria tabete nomosacha. Nyuma y’ayio okaba omogiro ase Abaisraeli,
ng’a abakungu b’Abaisraeli nigo barenge kogenda kobokia amagombo ase okoinyora omoiseke o Yefta, oria Omogileadi, ase engaki y’amatuko ane ase kera omwaka.

Abanto b’Efraimu bagasangererekana amo, bakaamboka gochia Safoni, bagakwana na Yefta, bakamotebia, “Nase ki kwagendete korwania Abaamoni, ko tigwatorangeria togende komo? Bono ntorigetie gosamba enyomba yao, naye boigo togosamberao.”
Yefta akabairaneria, “Inche na abanto baane nigo twabwate eriomana ri’obobisa obonene n’Abaamoni. Inche nabarangeretie, korende timwanchete gontooria korwa ase amaboko abo.
Na ekero naroche ng’a timwanchete gontooria tinaraarete obogima bwane, nkaamboka, nkagenda korwania Abaamoni, na Omonene akababeka ase amaboko aane. Nase ki mwachire gokora esegi nainche?”

Erio Yefta agasangereria abanto bonsi ba Gileadi, bakarwania Abaefraimu, bakababua. Abaefraimu konya batebire, “Inwe Abagileadi, nigo morwete ase Abaefraimu na ase Abamanase, nigo mwatamete korwa ase Abaefraimu.”

Abanto ba Gileadi bakabwata ebiambokero bia Yorodan, bagatanga abanto b’Efraimu. Na ekero Omoefraimu onde bwensi oyorenge gotama are gosaba ribaga kwamboka, abanto ba Gileadi nigo baare komoboria, “Aye n’Omoefraimu ore?” Onye omonto oria orenge gokana oteba, “Yaya”,

nigo baare komoboria atebe “Shibolet”. Onye orenge goteba “Sibolet”, ekiagera tarenge konyara gwatora ring’ana riria boronge, nigo barenge komobwata, bamoitera agwo ase ebiambokero bia Yorodan. Ase engaki eria Abaefraimu chilifu emerongo ene bagaitwa.
Yefta akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka etano nomo. Erio Yefta, Omogileadi, agakwa, agatindekwa ase omochie oye agwo Gileadi.
Nyuma ya Yefta, Ibasani o Bethlehemu akagambera Abaisraeli.

Ere nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo etato, na abaiseke emerongo etato. Agasokia abana baye abaiseke ase abaamate abaao, naende akarenta abaiseke ba isiko emerongo etato, abana baye abamura bakabanyuoma. Ibasani akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka etano na ebere.
Erio Ibasani agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Bethlehemu.
Nyuma ya Ibasani, Eloni, omwa Sabuloni, akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi.
Erio agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Ayaloni, ase orogongo rwa Sabuloni.
Nyuma y’Eloni, Abidoni, mosinto o Hileli, Omopiratori, akagambera Abaisraeli.

Ere nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo ene, na abana abamura abachokoro emerongo etato. Barabwo nigo baare koriina chitigere emerongo etano na ebere. Abidoni akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka etano na etato.
Erio Abidoni, mosinto o Hileli, Omopiratoni, agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Piratoni, ase ense y’Efraimu, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Abaameleki.
Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe naende ase obosio bw’Omonene; ere akabatiga, akababeka ase amaboko ’Abafilisti ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
Ase engaki eria narengeo omonto ore korokwa Manoa. Nigo arenge korwa omochie ore korokwa Sora, omonto bw’egesaku kia Dani. Omokungu oye nigo arenge omogomba, taiborete bana.
Omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera, akamotebia, “Aye nigo ore omogomba, tobwati bana, korende nobe morito, erio oibore omwana omomura.
Ase ayio, bwerite, tobaisa konywa edivai, gose ebinyugwa ebigotindia, na tobaisa koria endagera ende yonsi ere etachenegeti,

ekiagera aye nobe morito, na oibore omwana omomura. Onde tabaisa kogingira etukia y’omotwe oye, ekiagera omwana oria omomura naatananwe ase Nyasae, abe Omwerwa oye korwa ase enda ya ng’ina. Ere nachake gotooria Abaisraeli korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.”

Erio omokungu oria akagenda agatebia omosacha oye, “Omonto o Nyasae nachicha asende: nigo arenge kororekana buna omomalaika o Nyasae, nigo arenge bw’okoondokia mono. Tinamoboretie ase are korwa, nere tantebetie erieta riaye.

Korende nigo antebia ng’a nimbe morito na ing’ibore omwana omoisia, naende ng’a timbaisa konywa edivai, gose ebinyugwa bigotindia, na timbaisa koria endagera ende yonsi etachenegeti, ekiagera omwana oria naatananwe ase Nyasae abe Omwerwa oye korwa okoiborwa kwaye.”
Erio Manoa agasaba Omonene, agateba, “Omonene, nagosabire, tiga omonto oria o Nyasae gwatoma atochere naende, erinde atworokererie aya togwenerete gokora ase omwana oria omomura oraiborwe.”
Nyasae akaigwa ogosaba kwa Manoa, na omomalaika o Nyasae agacha naende ase omokungu oria ekero aikaransete mogondo. Manoa, omosacha oye, tarenge amo nere.
Ase igo omokungu oria akaminyoka bwango akarangeria omosacha oye, akamotebia, “Rora, omonto oria ochicha asende rituko riria ong’orokeire naende.”
Manoa akaimoka, agatunyana mokaye. Erio agacha ase omonto oria, akamoboria, “Inee! Naye omonto oria okwana nomorugi one?” Omomalaika oria akamoiraneria, “Ee, ninche.”
Manoa akamoboria, “Bono ekero amang’ana ao araikerane, naki obogima bw’omwana oria borabe? Meremo ki arakore?”
Omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ayio onsi natebia omorugi oo, goika ayakore.
Tabaisa koria gento kende gionsi gekorwa ase omosabibu, gose tabaisa konywa edivai na ebinyugwa ebigotindia, gose taria endagera ende yonsi ere etachenegeti. Aya onsi namochika, goika ayarende.”
Manoa agatebia omomalaika oria, “Koranche twagotangire, obeere aa, tokonyenyere emanwa y’embori, tokoyeroiserie orie.”

Omomalaika oria bw’Omonene akamoiraneria, “Nonya gwantanga ng’a mbeere aiga, tinkoria endagera yao, korende koraroisie ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, okerue ase Omonene.” (Manoa tamanyete ng’a oria nigo arenge omomalaika bw’Omonene.)
Manoa akabora, “Totebie buna okorokwa, erinde torue amasikani asore, ekero amang’ana ao araikerane!”
Omomalaika oria akamoboria, “Nase ki otagete komanya erieta riane? Erieta riane neri’ogokumia.”
Erio Manoa akaimokia emanwa y’embori amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera, akabibeka ase egetare, akabirua ase Omonene, oyokorete ogokumia ekero Manoa na mokaye barigereretie.
Ekero omorero orenge gwoka gochia igoro korwa ase egesasimero, Omomalaika bw’Omonene agatiirera ime y’omorero oria, na ekero Manoa na mokaye baroche ayio, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.
Korwa ekero keria omomalaika oria taoroka ase Manoa naende, gose ase omorugi oye, Erio Manoa akamanya ng’a oria nigo arenge omomalaika bw’Omonene.
Manoa agatebia mokaye, “Amaene goika tokwe, ekiagera twarorire Nyasae.”

Korende mokaye akamoiraneria, “Onye Omonene nigo aganetie gotoita, nanga tare gwancha ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na okoruegwa kw’endagera korwa ase amaboko aito, gose gotworokia aya onsi atworokia, gose gototebia amang’ana aya twaigure.”
Nyuma y’ayio omokungu oria akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Samison. Omwana oyio agakina, na Omonene akamosesenia.
Omoika bw’Omonene ogachaka gokora emeremo ime yaye ekero arenge ase egetwori kia Dani, agwo gati ya Sora na Esitaoli.
Samison agatirimboka gochia Timuna, na aroro agwo akarora omoiseke oyomo bw’Abafilisti.
Erio akairana nka, akamotebia ise na ng’ina, “Narora omoiseke oyomo Omofilisti agwo Timuna bono monyorere oria, imonyuome abe mokane.”

Korende ise na ng’ina bakamoboria, “Inee! Moiseke tari, nonya noyomo, ase abanto b’egesaku giaito, gose ase eamate yaito yonsi? Nase ki okogenda konyuoma omokungu korwa ase Abafilisti abwo batarogeti?” Korende Samison akairaneria ise, “Monyorere ere oyio, ekiagera ere ongweneire.”
Abaibori baye tibamanyete ng’a omoroberio oyio igo orure ase Omonene. Ere nigo are korigia enchera yare kogera arwanie Abafilisti. Ase engaki eria Abafilisti nigo barenge kogambera Abaisraeli.
Erio Samison agatirimboka amo na ise na ng’ina gochia Timuna. Ekero baigete ase emegondo y’emesabibu agwo Timuna, endo ensae ekamochera ekoruma.

Omoika bw’Omonene ogacha igoro ya Samison, okamobeka chinguru goika agatandora endo eria buna nemanwa y’embori yarenge, nonya tarenge nekerwanero kende gionsi maboko aye. Korende tatebetie abaibori eki akorete.
Samison akagenda agakwana nomoiseke oria, nere akamogokia mono.
Nyuma y’engaki enke akairana gochia komwoyia, akagobera enchera ensemo gochia korora ribego ri’endo eria, akanyora omwereri bwe chinchoke chibwate obooke ime ye ribego riria.
Akarusia obooke boria, akaboimokia, akaba okoboria ekero are kogenda. Akagenda ase ise na ng’ina akabaa obooke, nabarabwo bakaria. Korende Samison tabatebetie ng’a nigo aborusetie ase ribego ri’endo.
Ise Samison akagenda gochia korora omoiseke oria, na Samison agakora omoyega aroro aaria. Nabo yarenge engencho y’abamura gokora.
Ekero abanto bamoroche, bakarangeria abagisangio emerongo etato koba amo nere.

Samison akabatebia, “Tiga mbatebie omobayeno, na inwe montebie engencho yaye. Moise gontebia engencho yaye ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere ay’omoyega oyo, nigo ndabae chianga chi’egatani, ne chianga chinde chi’omoyega emerongo etato.
Korende onye timogontebia engencho yaye, erio inwe namong’e chianga chi’egatani emerongo etato, ne chianga chinde chi’omoyega emerongo etato.” Barabwo bakamotebia, “Kwana omobayeno oo, toyoigwe!”
Samison akabatebia, “Korwa ase eyekoria, endagera y’okoria ekarwao, na korwa ase eyere ne chinguru, egento egiansu gekarwao.” Na ase amatuko atato tibanyara komotebia engencho y’omobayeno oria.

Ase rituko ria kane bagatebia moga Samison, “Ebereria omosacha oo atotebie engencho y’omobayeno oyo. Onye taibo, rirorio nigo tokogosamba nomorero, tosambe nenyomba ya iso boigo. Inee! Inwe nigo mwatorangeretie gocha aa, erinde motourererie ebinto biaito, tobe abataka?”

Moga Samison akagenda asare, akarera akamotebia, “Aye nigo ongechete, tonyancheti, ogatebia abanto baminto omobayeno, korende tontebeti inche engencho y’omobayeno oria.” Samison akamotebia, “Rora, tindatebia tata, gose baba, engencho y’omobayeno oria, naki ndakore ngotebie aye?”

Omokungu oria akana‐kogenderera korera asare ase amatuko aria atano na abere omoyega ogendererete. Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere Samison akamotebia engencho y’omobayeno oria, ekiagera omokungu oria amobetereretie bokong’u. Erio omokungu oria agatebia abanto baria ba sobo engencho yaye.

Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere, ritang’ani erioba ritaragwa, abanto b’omochie oria bagatebia Samison, “Ninki kere egiansu kobua obooke? Ninki kere ne chinguru kobua endo?” Samison akabairaneria, “Onye motaremete ne ritororo riane, timware konyara komanya engencho y’omobayeno one.”

Na omoika bw’Omonene ogacha igoro ya Samison, okamobeka chinguru, na ere agatirimboka gochia Asikeloni, agaita abasacha b’omochie emerongo etato, agasakora ebinto biabo, akaira ne chianga chiabo chi’omoyega, akaa abanto baria batebete engencho y’omobayeno oria. Nyuma y’ayio akairana gochia ase ise ore nekeririanda ekenene.
Erio moga Samison akaegwa omonto oria orenge omong’wansi o Samison, akaba mokaye.

Engaki enke ekaera, na ekero kie rigesa ri’engano kegaika, Samison akagenda gokwania mokaye, akamoirera emanwa y’embori buna ekeegwa, agateba, “Ninganetie gosoa nyomba mwa mokane.” Korende ise biara tamoa ribaga.

Ere agatebia Samison, “Nigo narengereretie ng’a nkwamogechete; ase ayio nkamoa omong’wansi oo, na ere akamonyuoma. Omoiseke omwabo omoke nare aa, ere nigo are omonyakieni kobua oria. Moire oyio ribaga ri’oria.”
Korende Samison agateba, “Engaki eye tinkoba nokomocha igoro y’Abafilisti, ekero ndabakorere amabe.”
Akagenda akabwata ebibwe amagana atato, akabisiberania bibere bibere ase ebimincha biabo, erio agasiberania ebieri bi’omorero ase egati y’ebimincha biria bibere.

Bono agatongia omorero ase ebieri biria, agatiga ebibwe bikominyoka ase emegondo y’Abafilisti, na birobio bigasamba engano yagesire ebekire amo, amo neye konya etarageswa, na emegondo y’emezeituni egasambwa boigo.

Ekero Abafilisti baboretie, “Ning’o okora aya?” Bagatebigwa ng’a Samison, oria onyuomete omoiseke bw’omonto o Timuna, nere okora ayio. Omonto oria o Timuna nigo aimogetie omokungu o Samison, akamoa omong’wansi oye, na ere akamonyuoma. Abafilisti bakagenda, bagasamba omokungu oria nomorero, bagasamba na ise; bonsi babere bagakwa.
Samison agatebia Abafilisti, “Onye mogokora amang’ana anga buna aya, natianire ng’a tingotimoka goika inyeruserie egesiomba igoro yaino.”
Akabasanyorera, akabaaka bobe mono, agaita abange. Erio agatirimboka, akagenda komenya ase rikuruma ri’egetare gi’Etamu.
Erio Abafilisti bagatiira, bagatoora ase ense ya Yuda, bakaumokera omochie o Lei.
Abayuda bakababoria, “Nase ki mwachire gotorwania?” Barabwo bakairaneria, “Nigo twachire gosiba Samison, tomokorere ere buna atokorera intwe.”

Abayuda chilifu isato bagatirimboka gochia ase rikuruma riria ri’egetare gi’Etamu, bakaboria Samison, “Aye tomanyeti ng’a Abafilisti nabwo bagotogambera? Ase ayio, ngento ki eke gwatokoreire?” Ere akabairaneria, “Eke bakorete asende, nakio nainche nabakoreire barabwo.”
Barabwo bakamotebia, “Intwe nigo twachire kogosiba, erio tokobeke ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.” Samison akabatebia, “Tiana asende ng’a inwe abanyene timokong’ita.”
Bakamotebia, “Ee bono, titokogoita, nigo toragosibe rioka, erio tokobeke ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.” Ase ayio bakamosiba ne chingori ibere chinyia, erio bakamorusia korwa ase egetare keria.

Ekero aigete Lei, Abafilisti bakaminyoka gochia asare, bagaaka eriogi bagokuura, na omoika bw’Omonene ogacha igoro asare, okamobeka chinguru, ne chingori echio asiberetwe amaboko chikaba buna chiusi chi’egatani chiabwatirwe nomorero, chigasansoka korwa ase amaboko aye.
Akanyora riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere, akariimokia na ase riuga riria agaitera abanto elifu eyemo.
Erio Samison agakwana, “Ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere naitire abanto elifu eyemo, ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere nababekire chitui.”
Ekero akwanire amang’ana aya agatuguta riuga riria ri’orosea. Aase aria akarokwa Ramati Lei.

Samison akaba nerang’o y’amache enene mono, erio akarangeria Omonene, agateba, “Aye omonyene kwarua obobui goetera asende inche omosomba oo, na bono nigo ndakwe inde nerang’o, naende ngwe ase amaboko ’abanto batarogeti.”

Nyasae akabochora engoro yarenge agwo Lei, na amache agasoka korwa agwo. Samison akanywa amache ayio, na akaigwa obeire buna omonto omoyia, akanyora chinguru. Eke nakio gekogera ensoko eria ya Lei ekarokwa Eni‐Hakore; nabo ekorokwa nonya ngoika rero iga.
Samison akaba omogambi bw’Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, ekero Abafilisti baare kogambera ense eria.
Samison akagenda Gasa, na aroro akarora omokungu omotayayi, akagenda akarara nere.

Ekero abanto ba Gasa baigwete ng’a Samison nao are, bagaetanana aase aria, bakamoboera ase egeita ki’omochie obotuko obogima. Bagakira‐kiri obotuko bwonsi, bagateba, “Tiga toganye goika bokie mambia, erio tomoite.”

Korende Samison akarara goika botuko gati, erio akaimoka, akabwata ebisieri bibere bi’egeita ki’omochie amo nemetobwa yaye ebere; erio akabisimora amo nebioma na ebisiekero, akabibeka ase amareko aye, akabiira igoro ase egetunwa keria kerochie Heburoni.
Naende nyuma y’ayio Samison akaba ogwancha omokungu ore korokwa Delila, omenyete ase ense omweya ya Soreki.

Abanto abatang’ani b’Abafilisti bakagenda ase omokungu oria, bakamotebia, “Gachie omoebererie Samison agotebie obobisi bwe chinguru chiaye, naende buna toranyare komobua; erio tonyare komosiba na komobeka inse asetore. Kera oyomo asetore nakoe chisekeli chie chifeta elifu eyemo ne rigana erimo.”
Ase ayio Delila agatebia Samison, “Koranche, ontebie obobisi bwe chinguru chiao, naende ontebie buna omonto aranyare kogosiba akobue.”
Samison akamoiraneria, “Kabaransibe ne chingori chi’emenyiki isano na ibere chinyia chitaroma, erio nainche nimbe omworo, na imbe buna monto onde bwensi.”
Erio abatang’ani b’Abafilisti bakarentera omokungu oria chingori chi’emenyiki isano na ibere chinyia chitaroma, agasibera Samison nachirochio.

Omokungu oria nabisete abanto baganyete ase akanyomba ka ime. Erio akamorangeria, “Samison! Abafilisti aba bachire gokobwata!” Korende Samison akabutora chingori chiria buna eusi enyororo ekorurwa nomorero. Ase ayio, obobisi bwe chinguru chiaye tibwamanyekanete.
Delila agatebia Samison, “Rora, gwankoreire echeche, naende gwantebirie oborimo. Koranche ontebie buna oranyare gosibwa.”
Samison akamotebia, “Kobaransibe ne chingori chinyia chitarakorerwa emeremo, erio nimbe omworo, na imbe buna monto onde bwensi.”

Erio Delila akaimokia chingori chinyia, akamosibera. Naende akamorangeria, “Samison! Abafilisti aba bachire gokobwata!” Abanto nigo bebisete baganyete ase enyomba ende. Korende Samison akabutora chingori chiria korwa ase amaboko aye buna eusi enyororo.

Naende Delila agatebia Samison, “Goika bono gwankoreire echeche, na gontebia oborimo. Ntebie buna oranyare gosibwa.” Samison akamoiraneria, “Korasiberanie ebikundo biria bitano na bibere bi’etukia yane ase egetambaa keria okoroisia na kobisiba bokong’u nekegobanio, tibikorusigwao, erio nimbe omworo, na imbe buna monto onde bwensi.” Ekero Samison ararete, Delila akabwata ebikundo biria bitano na bibere bi’etukia yaye,

akabisiberania ase egetambaa are koroisia, akabisiba bokong’u nekegobanio. Naende akamorangeria, “Samison! Abafilisti aba bachire gokobwata!” Korende Samison akaboka, akang’usa etukia yaye korwa aase yasiberanetigwe na gokong’igwa.
Omokungu oria akamoboria, “Naki oranyare goteba ng’a nonyanchete, ekero enkoro yao etari amo nainche? Gwankoreire echeche chintunda isato na torantebia obobisi bwe chinguru chiao.”
Na ekero omokungu oria arenge kona‐komoboraboria amang’ana ayio rituko ase rituko, Samison akarosa kegima, goika akerusia moyo.

Ase igo omoerio akamotebia obobisi bwaye bwonsi, akabora, “Onde tana gokigita etukia y’omotwe one, ekiagera inche nigo naatananetwe ase Nyasae buna Omwerwa oye korwa ase enda ya baba. Inse gokigitwa etukia y’omotwe one, chinguru chiane nigo chirarue asende, naende imbe omworo, na imbe buna monto onde bwensi.”

Ekero Delila aroche ng’a Samison omotebirie obobisi bwaye bwonsi, agatoma abanto barangerie abatang’ani b’Abafilisti, babatebie, “Inchuo naende rimo, ekiagera ere ontebirie obobisi bwaye bwonsi.” Erio abatang’ani b’Abafilisti bagacha ase omokungu oria, bakarentana chibesa chiria.

Bono Delila akaareria Samison ase amagoro aye, akarangeria omonto ache agingire ebikundo biria bitano na bibere bi’etukia ya Samison. Erio Delila agachaka komotura, korende chinguru chia Samison konya chiarure asare.

Erio akarangeria, “Samison! Abafilisti aba bachire gokobwata!” Samison akaboka korwa ase chitoro chiaye, akarengereria ng’a “Bono ninyesibore buna botambe, ngende,” ekiagera tamanyete ng’a Omonene omotigire.
Abafilisti bakamobwata, bakamokonora amaiso, naende bakamoira gochia Gasa, bakamosiba ne chingataare chie chitaai. Bakamobeka gosia obosie agwo ase enyomba y’obosibwa.
Korende etukia yaye egachaka komera naende nyuma gakigitirwe.
Abatang’ani b’Afilisti bagasangererekana koruera Dagoni, enyasae yabo, ekeng’wanso ekenene, na gochenga, bagoteba, “Enyasae yaito yabekire omobisa oito Samison ase amaboko aito.”
Na ekero abanto baroche Samison, bagatogia enyasae yabo, bagateba, “Enyasae yaito yabekire omobisa oito ase amaboko aito, omobisa oria osaririe ense yaito na oitire abanto baito abange.”

Na ekero chinkoro chiabo chiabete nomochengo, bagateba, “Torentere Samison atokorere chigosori!” Ase ayio bakarenta Samison korwa enyomba y’obosibwa, ere akabakorera chigosori. Bakamobeka agatenena gati‐gati ye chisiiro.
Samison agatebia omosae oria omobwatete okoboko kwaye, “Ntige ntaba‐tabe, nkune chisiiro chisiirete enyomba, inyesiirere ase chirochio.”

Enyomba nigo yaichire nabanto, abasacha na abakungu, na abatang’ani bonsi b’Abafilisti nao barenge, na igoro ase ekerama mbarengeo abanto koreng’ana chilifu isato, abasacha na abakungu na barabwo nigo basonchete buna Samison agokora chigosori.

Erio Samison akarangeria Omonene, akabora, “Omonene Nyasae, nagosabire, ong’inyore, ong’e chinguru ase engaki eye yoka. Aye Nyasae, erio inyeruserie egesiomba ase amaiso aane abere igoro y’Abafilisti!”
Agwo Samison akaboania chisiiro chiria ibere chia gati‐gati, chiasiirete enyomba, agachibwata bokong’u, esiiro eyemo nokoboko okomo, na eyende nokoboko konde.

Erio agateba, “Tiga nkwe amo n’Abafilisti aba.” Naende agekumba ne chinguru chiaye chionsi, na enyomba eria ekagwera abatang’ani b’Abafilisti amo nabanto bande bonsi abarengeo. Abanto baria Samison aitete ekero akwete omonyene nigo barenge abange kobua baria bonsi abaitete ekero arenge moyo.

Abamura bamwabo amo nabanto bonsi b’eamate yaye bagatirimboka kwoyia omobere oye. Bakamoira, bakamotindeka ase egati ya Sora na Esitaoli, ase embeera ya Manoa ise. Samison konya ogambeire Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere.
Ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu narengeo omonto oyomo ore korokwa Mika.

Ere agatebia ng’ina, “Ekero omonto aibete chisekeli chie chifeta amagana ikomi na rimo naigure ng’a, nkwaragereretie omoibi bwe chifeta chiria. Rora aiga, ninche nchibwate. Ninche nachiirete.” Ngi’na akamotebia, “Omwana one, Nyasae agosesenie.”

Omomura oria akairania chisekeli chiria chie chifeta amagana ikomi na rimo ase ng’ina. Ng’ina agateba, “Naatananire chifeta echi ase Omonene ase engencho y’omwana one. Chifeta echio nachibe echi’okoroisia omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa orabe obaachire na oomire ne chifeta. Ase ayio, omwana one, ningochiiranerie.”

Korende ere akairaneria ng’ina chibesa chiria. Ngi’na akaimokia chifeta amagana abere, agachiirera omoturi bwe chifeta, na ere akaroisia omogwekano obaachire na oomire ne chifeta. Omogwekano oyio okabekwa ase enyomba ya Mika.
Omonto oyio Mika nabwate enyomba yaye aase arenge gosasimera ebinyasae biaye. Akaroisia egesibao ki’obokuani na emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, naende akabeka oyomo bw’abamura baye abe omokuani.
Ase amatuko aria omoruoti tarenge ase Abaisraeli; kera omonto nigo arenge gokora kende gionsi aroche kere ekeronge.
Bono narenge omomura omosae, Omolawi omenyete agwo Bethlehemu o Yuda buna omomenyi.
Omosae oria konya orure Bethlehemu ogendire korigia aase akomenya. Na ase orogendo rwaye agaika ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, ase enyomba ya Mika.
Mika akamoboria, “Ng’ai okorwa?” Ere akairaneria, “Inche n’Omolawi o Bethlehemu o Yuda, naende nigo nkogenda korigia aase nkomenya.”
Mika akamotebia, “Menya aa amo nainche, obe asende tata, na obe omokuani one, na inche nkoe chisekeli chie chifeta ikomi kera omwaka, naende nkoe chianga amo nendagera.”
Omolawi oria agancha komenya amo nomonto oria, na ere akamokora buna oyomo bw’abana baye abamura.
Mika agaatanana omosae oria, nere akaba omokuani oye, akamenya ase enyomba ya Mika.
Mika agateba “Bono namanyire ng’a Omonene nankorere amaya, ekiagera mbwate Omolawi ore omokuani one.”

Ase amatuko aria omoruoti tarenge ase Abaisraeli; na ase engaki eria abanto b’egesaku kia Dani nigo barenge kwerigeria orogongo ase baranyare komenya, ekiagera goika ase engaki eria konya tibaranyora omwando ase egati y’ebisaku binde bi’Abaisraeli.

Ase ayio abanto ba Dani bagachora korwa ase chiamate chiabo abarwani batano, korwa ase omochie o Sora, na obw’Esitaoli, bakabatoma bagende koroota ense, na koyerata. Ekero abanto baria chirooti baigete ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu bakagenda ase enyomba ya Mika, bakarara aroro.
Ekero barenge nyomba mwa Mika, bakaigwa na komanya eriogi ri’omosae oria Omolawi, bakamoira ensemo, bakamoboria, “Ning’o okorenta aiga? Ngento ki ogokora aa? Emeremo yao nereri?”
Ere akabairaneria, “Aya naro Mika ankoreire: Nigo andigete, akong’a eng’eria, na inche nigo inde omokuani oye.”
Abanto baria bakamotebia, “Koranche, oborie Nyasae, erinde tomanye orogendo oro rwaito twachakire gose noruya rorabe!”
Omokuani oria akabairaneria, “Genda nomorembe! Orogendo rwaino nigo rore ase oborendi bw’Omonene.”

Erio abanto baria batano bakarua aroro, bakagenda goika omochie o Laisi. Na agwo bakarora buna abanto bamenyete bare nobogima botari nobwoba, buna abanto ba Sidoni. Nigo barenge abanto abatoereru na ab’omorembe, bataremeiri gento korwa ase riroba. Nigo bamenyete are korwa ase Abasidoni, naende tibarenge gosanga nabanto bande.
Ekero abanto baria batano bairanete ase abamwabo agwo Sora na Esitaoli, barabwo bakababoria, “Mang’ana ki mwanyora?”
Bakairaneria, “Imoka, togende korwania abanto baria, ekiagera ntwarora ense eria, ng’a nengiya mono. Inaki mogoikaransa aa bosa? Timobaisa gotebana kogenda aroro na koira ense eria.
Ekero moragende aroro nigo moranyore abanto tibebegeti ang’e korwana, na ense eria nengare. Ee, Nyasae obekire ense eria ase amaboko aino. Ense eria teremeiri gento kende gionsi gekorwa ase riroba.”
Abanto amagana atano na rimo b’egesaku kia Dani, babogoretie ebirwanero, bakaimoka korwa Sora na Esitaoli, bagatiira,
bagatoora bosongo ya Kiriati‐Yearimu, ase ense ya Yuda. Ase engencho eyio aase aria akarokwa Egetwori kia Dani, naboigo akorokwa nonya ngoika rero iga.
Korwa aroro bakagenda gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, bagaika ase enyomba ya Mika.

Erio abanto baria batano bagendete koroota ense yaetanaine Laisi, bakaboria abanto barenge komo, “Inee! Momanyete ng’a ase enyomba eyemo ase echio nkereo egesibao ki’obokuani? Naende ebinyasae bi’ogosasimwa mbireo, amo nomogwekano obaachire, na oyo onyititoire na kobombwa. Ase ayio rengereria aya mogochia gokora.”
Barabwo bakagenda ase enyomba eria omosae oria Omolawi amenyete ase enka ya Mika, bakamoboria amang’ana aye buna agendererete.
Abanto baria amagana atano na rimo, Abadani, babogoretie ebirwanero bi’esegi, bebegete ang’e, bagatenena ase egeita.

Abanto baria batano, abarootete ense eria ritang’ani, bagasoa enyomba eria, bakaimokia omogwekano oria obaachire, na egesibao keria ki’obokuani, na ebinyasae biria, na omogwekano oria onyititoire na kobombwa, na omokuani oria agatenena ase egeita amo nabanto baria amagana atano na rimo babogoretie ebirwanero bi’esegi.

Ekero abanto baria batano basoete nyomba mwa Mika na korusia omogwekano oria obaachire, na egesibao keria ki’obokuani, na ebinyasae biria, na omogwekano oria onyititoire na kobombwa, omokuani oria akababoria, “Inki eke mogokora?”

Barabwo bakamotebia, “Kirakiri! Tokwana nonya ne ring’ana erimo! Inchuo amo naintwe, obe asetore buna tata, obe omokuani oito! Inee! Inki kere buya kobua asore, koba omokuani ase enyomba y’omonto oyomo, gose ase egesaku ekegima ki’Abaisraeli?”
Amang’ana aya akagokia omokuani oria mono; ere akaimoka akabogoria egesibao keria ki’obokuani, na ebinyasae biria, na omogwekano oria obaachire, akagenda amo nabanto baria.
Abadani bakeonchora, bagachaka kogenda, bagatang’ania abana, ne chitugo, amo ne chinibo chiabo.
Ekero bagendire egeka getari geke korwa ase enka ya Mika, bagaikeerwa nabagisangio ba Mika abarangeretigwe kobabwatia.
Abanto ba Mika bagaaka amariogi na gokuura. Abadani bakeonchora, bakaboria Mika, “Ninki gekogochanda goika ogotobwatia nomoganda ogokuura buna iga?”
Mika akabairaneria, “Mwairire ebinyasae biane neroiseretie, na omokuani one mwamoirire. Ngento ki natigaire nakio? Naki rende moranyare komboria: Ninki gekogochanda?”
Abadani bakamoiraneria “Tobaisa gokwana nonya ne ring’ana erimo naintwe. Abanto aba mbabaise koba nendamwamu na kogoita, aye amo nabanto bao bonsi mosire, mokwe.”
Erio Abadani bakagenderera orogendo rwabo, na ekero Mika aroche ng’a abanto baria nigo barenge ne chinguru komobua, akeonchora akairana nka bwoye.

Ekero Abadani bairete ebinyasae biria Mika aroisetie, amo nomokuani oye, bakagenda koumokera abanto ba Laisi, abanto baria bamenyete ase obotoereru batare na bwoba bonde, bakabaita nemioro, na omochie obo bakayosamba nomorero.

Onde tachete kobatooria, ekiagera Laisi orenge aare korwa Sidoni, naende abanto ba Laisi tibarenge gosanga nabanto bande. Omochie oria nigo orenge ase rikura riare ang’e na Beti‐Rehobu. Abanto ba Dani bakaagacha omochie o Laisi naende, bakamenyao.
Bakaroka omochie oyio Dani, erieta ria Dani sokoro yabo, mosinto o Israeli.

Aroro Abadani bageteneneria omogwekano oria bw’ogosasimwa. Yonathani, mosinto o Gerisomu o Musa, nere orenge omokuani ase Abadani, na abana baye abamura bakaba abakuani babo goika engaki y’ogwoswa kwabo.
Barabwo bagatenenia omogwekano oria bw’ogosasimwa obaachire, oria Mika aroisetie, na omogwekano oria okabeera aroro ase engaki yonsi obomenyo bwa Nyasae bwatenenete agwo Silo.

Ase amatuko aria ekero omoruoti atarenge ase Abaisraeli, narengeo omonto gete Omolawi omenyete buna omomenyi rogoro kegima ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu. Ere agatwara omokungu o sere‐sere korwa Bethlehemu o Yuda.
Omokungu oyio tarenge omwegenwa ase omosacha oye, erio akamotiga, akairana gochia o ise, aaria Bethlehemu, akamenya aroro ase engaki y’emetienyi ene.

Omosacha oria akaimoka ore nomosomba oyomo ne chitigere ibere, akagenda kogamba nere ase obwororo, agateema komoebereria airane nere. Omokungu oria akamosoyia nyomba mwa ise, na ise akamoroisia ase omogoko.
Ise biara akamoboria abeere aroro; erio akaba amo nere amatuko atato, bakaria na konywa, bakarara aroro.
Rituko ria kane bakaboka mambia chuni, na Omolawi oria akebeka ang’e kogenda, korende ise omosubati oria akamotebia, “Kararia endagera onyore chinguru, erio mogende.”
Abanto baria babere bagaikaransa aroro, bakaria na konywa amo. Erio ise omosubati oria agatebia omonto oria, “Koranche, orare aiga naende ase obotuko bwa rero, oigwe buya.”
Ekero omonto oria aimogete naende ng’a agende, ise omosubati oria akamosorora arare agwo naende.

Rituko ria gatano, mambia chuni, akaimoka agachaka kogenda. Korende ise omosubati oria akamotebia, “Karie endagera onyore chinguru. Ganya goika omobaso orakenda.” Ase ayio bakaragera amo bonsi babere.

Ekero omonto oria amo nomokungu oye o sere‐sere, na omosomba oye, baimogete kogenda, ise omosubati oria akamotebia, “Rora bono omobaso oerire, na bwaisire koiira, nagosoroire, beera aiga ase obotuko bwa rero naende, oigwe buya. Ankio oimoke mambia chuni, ochake orogendo, ogende seino.”

Korende omonto oria tancha korara aroro ase obotuko boria. Ase igo akaimoka amo nomokungu oye o sere‐sere, bagachaka orogendo rwabo gochia Yebusi, (noro Yerusalemu), babwate chitigere chiabekire ebiikaransero.
Bagaika ensemo erochie Yebusi, na konya bwairire, omosomba agatebia omonene oye, “Inchuo, togobere gochia ase omochie oyo bw’Abayebusi, erio torare aroro ase obotuko obo.”
Omonene bw’omosomba oria akabora, “Titokogobera kogenda korara ase omochie bw’abanto batari Abaisraeli, korende tobaetanie togende Gibea.”
Naende agatebia omosomba oye, “Eta togende, torore gose ntoike Gibea gose Rama, erio torare aroro ase obotuko obo.”
Bakagenderera orogendo rwabo, na ekero baikire ang’e na Gibea, omochie bw’Ababenjamin, konya bwairiire kegima.
Bakagobera gochia Gibea, barare aroro ase obotuko boria. Kobasoire aroro, bagaikaransa eraaro isiko, ase omochie oria, korende onde tarenge bwanchete kobasoyia nyomba mwaye ase obotuko obwo.

Ekero baikaranseteo, omogaaka oyomo agacha, orenge korwa mogondo. Ere nigo arenge omonto bw’ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na bono nigo arenge omomenyi bw’omochie o Gibea. (Abanto b’aase aria nigo barenge Ababenjamin).
Omogaaka oria akarora omogendi oria ase eraaro eria, akamoboria, “Ng’ai okorwa? Naende ng’ai okogenda?”

Omogendi oria akamoiraneria, “Igo tokorwa Bethlehemu o Yuda, tokogenda rogoro kegima ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, nao seito. Igo nagenda Bethlehemu o Yuda, na bono nkogenda inde ase enyomba ya Nyasae. Onde tari bwanchire gonsoyia nyomba mwaye.

Obonyansi obwomo na endagera ende ye chitigere ntobwate. Naboigo ntobwate omogati na edivai bitoisaine inche na omokungu oyo, omosomba oo, na omosae oyo ore amo naintwe, abasomba bao. Titoremeiri gento kende gionsi.”
Omogaaka oria akamotebia, “Kabe nomorembe! Tiga inche ngokonye ase kende gionsi oremeire. Tokonyara korara isiko aa ase eraaro botuko.”
Erio akabasoyia nyomba mwaye, akaa chitigere endagera. Na ekero besibirie amagoro abo, bakaria na konywa.

Ekero barenge kwegokia igo, abanto bande abanyaka b’omochie oria bagacha mobosokano, bagaetanana enyomba na goaka egesieri, bagatebia omogaaka oria, “Mosokie omonto oria ocha mwao, erinde torare nere tomosarie.”
Omonto oria, omonyene enyomba, agasoka, akabatebia, “Taibo, abaminto, timobaisa gokora obokayayu buna obwo. Omonto oyio nomogeni one. Timobaisa komokorera obonyaka buna obwo.

Rora, nimbwate omoiseke one omwekungi, na omonto oyo nabwate omokungu oye o sere‐sere, tiga mbasokie asemore bono. Mobakorere obonyaka buna moganetie, korende timobaisa gokorera omonto oyo egento buna ekio gi’okogechia.”

Korende abanto baria tibamoigwera. Erio Omolawi oria akabwata omokungu oye o sere‐sere, akamoira isiko asebare. Barabwo bagakora obonyaka nere bakamokorera bobe ase obotuko obogima goika mambia; na ekero bwachia gokiamoka bakamotiga agende.
Ekero bwachia koba mambia, omokungu oria agacha, akagwa inse ase egesieri ki’enyomba y’omonto oria omosacha oye arenge, akarara aroro goika ense egakiamoka na koraba.
Omosacha oye akaimoka mambia, akaigora ebisieri, na ekero are gosoka agenderere orogendo rwaye, akanyora omokungu oye o sere‐sere oraire obwatete omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri ki’enyomba.
Omonto oria akamotebia, “Imoka, tochake orogendo!” Korende omokungu oria tamoiraneria. Erio akamoimokia, akamobeka ase etigere igoro, agachaka orogendo rwaye gochia inka bwoye.

Na ekero aigete inka bwoye, akaimokia omoyio, akabwata omokungu oye o sere‐sere, akamonachana ekiimo ase ekiimo goika ebing’ese ikomi na bibere. Erio agatoma abanto, nabarabwo bakabiira chinsemo chionsi ase ense y’Abaisraeli.

Abanto bonsi abaroche amang’ana ayio nigo bakwanete, “Amang’ana anga buna ayio tana gokorekana, gose kororekana, korwa rituko riria Abaisraeli baruete ense ya Misiri goika rero! Rengereria amang’ana aya! Mogambe inki moranyare gokora!”
Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba, amo nab’ense ya Gileadi bakarua chinka chiabo, bagasangererekana amo, bakabwatana, bakaba buna omonto oyomo ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo Misipa.
Abatang’ani b’abanto bonsi b’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli bagacha ase omosangererekano oria bw’abanto ba Nyasae. Abwo barenge gotaara namagoro babogoretie emioro, nigo barenge chilifu amagana ane.
Bono abanto b’egesaku kia Benjamin bakaigwa ng’a Abaisraeli batiirire gochia Misipa. Abaisraeli bakabora, “Totebie, naki obonyaka obo bwakorete bokaba!”
Omolawi oria, omosacha bw’omokungu oria oitetwe moeneno, akairaneria, agateba, “Nigo nachete Gibea, omochie, bw’Ababenjamin, inche na omokungu one o sere‐sere, erinde torare aroro agwo ase obotuko.
Abanto ba Gibea bagacha kondwania, bagaetanana enyomba ase narenge botuko, bakagania bang’ite; nabarabwo bagakorera omokungu one o sere‐sere obonyaka goika agakwa.

Inche nkabogoria omokungu one o sere‐sere, nkanachana omobere oye ebing’ese, ngatoma abanto, nabarabwo bakaira ebing’ese biria ase ense yonsi y’omwando bw’Abaisraeli, ekiagera Abagibea bakorete ebibe bi’obonyaka ase egati y’Abaisraeli.
Inwe Abaisraeli mwensi, karue amang’ana aino ay’ogosemia igoro ase aya akorekanire!”
Abanto bakaimoka, bakabwatana buna omonto oyomo, bagakwana, “Onde tarua asetore agende mwaye, ase eema yaye gose nyomba mwaye.
Korende aya naro amang’ana torakorere Gibea. Igo togoaka obomera, torore gose mbarabi bagochia koyorwania.

Torusie abanto ikomi korwa ase abanto rigana erimo, na abanto rigana erimo korwa ase abanto elifu eyemo, na abanto elifu eyemo korwa ase abanto chilifu ikomi, korwa ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli. Abanto aba nabasangererie chindagera korwa ase abanto, erinde babarentere baria bagochia korwania Gibea o Benjamin, ekiagera barabwo bakorire ogosaria kw’obosooku ase egati y’Abaisraeli.”
Ase igo Abaisraeli bonsi bagasangererekana, bakabwatana amo buna omonto oyomo, bakarwania omochie oria.
Abanto b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli bagatoma abanto gochia ase chiamate chionsi chia Benjamin, bakabora, “Nobokayayu bore naki, obo bwakorekanire ase egati yaino?
Bono barente abanto baria abanyaka ba Gibea, erinde tobaite, torusie obobe obo borue ase Abaisraeli.” Ababenjamin tibaigwerete Abaisraeli bamwabo,
korende bakarua emechie yabo, bagacha agwo Gibea, erinde barwanie Abaisraeli.

Ababenjamin abwo baroberetigwe korwa ase emechie yabo ase rituko riria nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na isano nemo, abamanyete korwanera emioro. Amo nabwo mbarengeo abanto amagana atano na abere, abachoretwe korwa ase omochie o Gibea.

Ase egati y’abanto aba nigo barenge abanto bachoretwe amagana atano na abere, barenge abanyakebee. Kera omonto obo nigo amanyete koruta rigena nenduruche, erio orenga agatukia akamo, ogaaka, tarenge gokamocha.
Abaisraeli batasang’anaine n’Ababenjamin, bakaroberia abanto chilifu amagana ane babogoretie emioro; abanto aba nigo bamanyete korwana esegi.

Abaisraeli bakaimoka, bakagenda Beteli koboria ogosemia korwa ase Nyasae, bakaboria, “Mbarabi asetore barabe abe ritang’ani gochia korwania Ababenjamin?” Omonene akairaneria, “Abayuda nababe abe ritang’ani”.
Erio Abaisraeli bakaimoka bonsi mambia chuni, bagatoora ang’e nomochie o Gibea,
na abanto babo bagasoka, bakagenda korwania Ababenjamin. Bakaroberia abarwani korwana esegi ase omochie o Gibea,
korende Ababenjamin bagasoka korwa Gibea, bagaita Abaisraeli chilifu fu emerongo ebere na ibere, ase rituko erio.
Ase igo Abaisraeli, bakeremia naende, bakaroberia abarwani barwanie aase aria ase beroberetie rituko rie ritang’ani.

Erio Abaisraeli bagatiira gochia Beteli, bakaba bakorera ase obosio bw’Omonene goika mogoroba, bakamoboria, “Natonyare naende kogenda korwana n’Ababenjamin abanto baminto?” Omonene akairaneria, “Genda, mobarwanie!”
Ase igo Abaisraeli bakagenda korwana n’Ababenjamin rituko ria kabere.
Ase rituko erio Ababenjamin bagasoka korwa Gibea, bakarwana n’Abaisraeli, bagaita abanto chilifu ikomi na isano, abamanyete korwanera emioro.

Erio Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiira gochia Beteli, bakaba bakorera. Bagaikaransa aroro agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakeng’ata rituko riria goika mogoroba, na bakaruera Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe.
Abaisraeli bakarigia ogosemia korwa ase Omonene. (Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatanana kwa Nyasae nao yarenge ase amatuko aria,

na Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari o Haroni nigo arenge gokora emeremo y’obokuani ase Esanduku eria.) Abaisraeli bakaboria Omonene, “Natonyare naende kogenda korwana esegi n’Ababenjamin baminto, gose bono ngotiga tore?” Omonene akairaneria, “Imoka mogende, ekiagera ankio nimbeke abanto abwo ase amaboko aino.”
Abaisraeli bakabeka abarwani bakaboa goetanana omochie o Gibea.
Na ase rituko ria gatato bakagenda korwania Ababenjamin, bakeroberia ase okorwana agwo Gibea, buna chingaki chiria chie ritang’ani.

Ababenjamin bagasoka, bakagenda korwana nabanto abwo, bakang’uswa gochia aare korwa ase omochie oria, na buna chingaki chiria chinde bagachaka goita Abaisraeli ase enchera enene egotiira gochia Beteli, na ase eyende ekogenda Gibea, naboigo naase aarabu. Bagaita Abaisraeli ang’e emerongo etato.
Ababenjamin bagateba, “Twababuire buna chingaki chiria chinde.” Korende Abaisraeli konya barobeirie ng’a babang’use korwa ase omochie oria, erinde bagende gochia ase chinchera chinene.
Abaisraeli bonsi bakaimoka korwa ase barenge, erio bakeroberia agwo Baali‐Tamari, na baria baboete bakaoroka mobosokano korwa ase bebisete, ang’e na Gibea.
Erio abanto chilifu ikomi, abachoretwe korwa ase Abaisraeli bonsi, bakagenda korwania omochie o Gibea, na esegi eria ekaba entindi. Ababenjamin tibamanyete ng’a ogosirigwa kwabo konya gwaikire ang’e.

Omonene akabua Ababenjamin ase obosio bw’Abaisraeli; nabarabwo bagaita Ababenjamin chilifu emerongo ebere na isano, ne rigana erimo, ase rituko riria. Abanto abwo bonsi baitetwe nigo bamanyete korwanera emioro.
Ase igo abanto ba Benjamin bakarora ng’a babuirwe. Abaisraeli bakairana gochia nyuma korwa ase Ababenjamin, ekiagera begenete Abaisraeli baria baboerete omochie o Gibea.
Barabwo bagasoka, bakarindokera omochie oria, bagaita abanto bonsi b’omochie nemioro.

Bono ekemanyererio giancheranetwe ase egati y’ekeombe ekenene ki’abarwani b’Abaisraeli na abanto bebisete baboete nakio eke: Ekero barenge korora rikundesi ri’erioki rigochongororoka korwa ase omochie oria,

erio abarwani b’Abaisraeli bairane nyuma. Ababenjamin konya bachakire goita Abaisraeli, bagaita abanto koreng’ana emerongo etato. Erio bagateba, “Ekeene, Abaisraeli babuirwe ase obosio bwaito, buna chingaki chiria chinde.”

Korende ekero ekemanyererio keria kie rikundesi ri’erioki kiarorekanete korwa ase omochie oria, Ababenjamin bakarigereria magega, bagakumia korora omochie omogima okoyia, na erioki richongororogete gochia igoro.
Erio Abaisraeli bakaonchoka, bakairana, na Ababenjamin bagasogwa nomoondoko, ekiagera nigo baroche ng’a ogosirigwa kwabo kwabacheire ang’e.
Ase ayio bakeonchora, bagatama korwa ase Abaisraeli gochia ensemo y’erooro, korende bakanarigwa nabarwani baria abange, na baria barwete ase omochie, bagaitwa.
Abaisraeli bakagenderera goita abanto ba Benjamin, bakababwatia na kobatiringera inse goikera aase gete moocha ya Gibea.
Abarwani chituoni b’Ababenjamin chilifu ikomi na isano na isato bagaitwa.

Abatigarete bakeonchora, bagatama gochia erooro ase egetare kia Rimoni. Abanto chilifu isano bagaitwa ekero baare ase enchera gotama. Abaisraeli bakabwatia abatigarete naende goika Gidomi, na abanto chilifu ibere bagaitwa.
Ababenjamin abaitetwe ase rituko riria nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere, na isano. Abanto abwo bamanyete korwana esegi y’emioro, naende nigo barenge abakong’u b’esegi.
Korende abanto amagana atano na rimo bagatooreka, bakaonchoka, bagatama gochia ensemo y’erooro, ase egetare kie Rimoni, bakamenya ase egetare keria ase emetienyi ene.
Abaisraeli bakairana naende korwania Ababenjamin bakabaita nemioro, bagaita abanto, ne chitugo, bagasiria ebinto bionsi banyorete aroro. Bagasamba nomorero emechie yonsi yarenge ase ensemo eria.
Bono Abaisraeli konya barire eira na gotiana agwo Misipa ng’a, “Onde tari ase egati yaito oranyare korua omwana oye omoiseke konyuomwa nomonto bw’egesaku kia Benjamin.”
