Abanto bakagenda Beteli, bagaikaransa aroro ase obosio bwa Nyasae goika mogoroba, bagaaka amariogi, bakarera nobororo,
bagakwana, “Ayee! Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nase ki amang’ana aya abeire asetore intwe Abaisraeli ng’a rero egesaku ekemo giasirire korwa asetore?”
Rituko ria kabere abanto bakaimoka mambia chuni bakeagachera egesasimero aroro. Erio bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe.

Abaisraeli bakaboria, “Mbarabi ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli batachicha ase omosangererekano, ase obosio bw’Omonene?” Barabwo konya barire eira na gotiana ng’a omonto onde bwensi otacheti ase Omonene agwo Misipa goika aitwe.
Abaisraeli nigo barorerete Ababenjamin bamwabo amabeebe, bakabora, “Rituko ria rero egesaku ekemo giasirigwe korwa ase Abaisraeli.
Ngento ki torakore tonyorere abwo batigarete abakungu, ekiagera ntwariete eira na gotiana ase obosio bw’Omonene ng’a titokorua nonya noyomo bw’abaiseke baito anyuomwe noyomo obo?”

Naende bakaboria, “Gesaku kende nkereo ki’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli getachicha ase Omonene agwo Misipa?” Bakanyora ng’a onde tari nonya noyomo korwa Yabesi o Gileadi ochete ase omosangererekano oria agwo ase egetwori.
Ekero abanto baare koroberigwa na goitaagwa, bakanyora ng’a onde tacheteo nonya noyomo korwa ase abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi,
omosangererekano ogatoma abanto abaremu mono chilifu ikomi na ibere, bakabachika, “Genda moite abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi nemioro, moite nabakungu na abana abasinini.
Aya naro morakore: Moite kera omonto omosacha, na kera omokungu omenyanire nomosacha, mobasirie kegima.”

Bakanyora abaiseke abekungi, abwo konya bataramenyana nomosacha onde bwensi, amagana ane, ase egati y’abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi, bakabarenta ase batoorete agwo Silo, omochie oria orenge ase ense ya Kanani.
Erio omosangererekano bwonsi bw’abanto bagatoma amang’ana gochia ase abanto ba Benjamin baria barenge ase egetare kia Rimoni, bakabarareria omorembe.
Ababenjamin bakairana ase engaki eria, na Abaisraeli bakaa abaiseke baria korwa Yabesi o Gileadi, bataitetwe babe abakungu babo; korende abwo tibabaisanete abasacha b’Ababenjamin.
Abaisraeli bakarorera Ababenjamin amabeebe, ekiagera Omonene aatanenete ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.
Abagaaka b’omosangererekano oria bakaborania, “Naki torakore tonyorere abasacha baria batigarete abakungu, ekiagera abakungu bonsi baitirwe korwa ase Ababenjamin?”
Naende bagateba, “Ababenjamin abatooregete goika banyorerwe abanyamwando, erinde egesaku ekemo korwa ase Abaisraeli tigesirigwa kegima.

Korende nonya naboigo, intwe titokonyara korua abaiseke baito banyuomwe nabarabwo.” Abaisraeli konya barire eira na gotiana ng’a, “Omonto oria orarue omoiseke oye anyuomwe n’Ababenjamin aragererigwe.”
Erio bagateba, “Rora, ndire Rituko ri’Omonene ria kera omwaka agwo Silo, sugusu ya Beteli, irianyi ya Lebona, moocha y’enchera ere gati ya Beteli na Sekemu.”
Bagachika Ababenjamin, bakabatebia, “Genda mwebise moboe ase emegondo y’emesabibu,

motengere mono ekero abaiseke ba Silo bagosoka gochia gotenga, erio moimoke korwa ase emegondo y’emesabibu, na kera omonto akurure omoiseke oyomo bw’abaiseke baria ba Silo, amoire ase orogongo rwa Benjamin abe mokaye.

Na ekero abaise, gose abamura bamwabo, barache kobasoera asetore, intwe nigo torabatebie: Komoranche mobabatigere, ekiagera titwanyorerete kera omonto omokungu ekero gi’esegi, na ekiagera inwe abanyene timwababaete babe abakungu babo, timori nokomocha kw’ogosaria eira eria twatiananetie.”

Ababenjamin bagakora buna batebetigwe. Kera oyomo akaira omoiseke korwa ase baria baare gotenga agwo Silo, akaba mokaye. Erio bakairana, bakagenda ase emiando yabo, bakaagacha emechie yabo naende na komenya aroro.
Ase engaki eria Abaisraeli bakarua aase agwo, na kera omonto akagenda ase egesaku kiaye na ase eamate yaye, na ase omwando oye.
Ase amatuko aria omoruoti tarenge ase Abaisraeli, kera omonto nigo arenge gokora kende gionsi aroche kere ekeronge asare.

Ase amatuko aria, ekero abagambi ebina barenge kogambera Abaisraeli, enchara enene ekaba ase ense yabo. Ase ayio, omonto oyomo o Bethlehemu, ase ense y’Abayuda, akaimoka amo na mokaye na abamura baye babere, akagenda komenya ase ense y’Abamoabu ase engaki gete.
Omonto oria nigo arenge korokwa Elimeleki, na mokaye Naomi, na abamura baye babere Mahaloni na Kilioni. Barabwo n’Abaefarati barenge. Ekero bamenyete aaria Moabu,
Elimeleki agakwa, agatiga Naomi ore omoboraka, ore nabamura baye babere.
Barabwo bakanyuoma abaiseke b’Abamoabu; oyomo nigo are korokwa Oripa na oyonde Rutu. Nyuma kabamenyire aroro koreng’ana emiaka ikomi,
Mahaloni na Kilioni nabarabwo bagakwa. Igo Naomi agakwerwa omosacha oye na abamura baye babere.
Naomi kare agwo ase ense y’Abamoabu akaigwa ng’a Omonene ororeire abanto baye amabera, obaeire endagera naende; ase ayio akamanora korua ense eria amo na baka bamura baye.
Barabwo bagatiga aase aaria bamenyete, korende ekero barenge kogenda gochia ase ense y’Abayuda,
Naomi agatebia baka bamura baye ng’a bairane, na kera oyomo agende komenya mwa ng’ina. Naende akabora, “Omonene abakorere amaya, buna inwe mwakorerete baria bakwete, mogankorera nainche.
Omonene abanchere kera oyomo oino anyuomwe naende, na anyore mwaye.” Erio Naomi akabanyunyunta ase okobatiga. Korende barabwo bagachaka korera mono,
bakamotebia, “Yaya, titokogotiga! Nigo torigetie kogenda amo naye ase abanto baino.”
Korende Naomi akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Abana baane, irana mogende seino! Nase ki moganetie kogenda amo nainche? Inee! Ninyare naende korwa ase enda yane koibora abana bagochia koba abasacha baino?
Abana baane, irana mogende seino, ekiagera inche nagotire mono, tinkonyuomwa naende. Nonya nare korengereria ng’a ninde nogosemeria, na onye nare konyora omosacha rero, nyibore abana abamura.
Inee, nkoganya mware goika bakine? Gose ngwetanga mware timonyuomwa nabasacha bande? Taibo, abana baane. Omonene ong’onchokeire na kong’a emechando, nainche nabechandeire mono.”
Naende bagachaka korera mono goetania. Erio Oripa akanyunyunta ng’ina biara, akamotiga, korende Rutu akaanga komotiga.
Ase igo Naomi agatebia Rutu, “Naama! Oripa, moka momura omwabo omosacha oo, oiranire ase abanto baye, na ase enyasae yaye. Naye irana, mogende komo!”

Korende Rutu akamoiraneria, “Tagonsorora ng’a ngotige. Tiga ngende amo naye. Aande onsi ase aye ogochia, nainche nao ndachie; na aande onsi ase aye oramenye, nainche nao ndamenye. Abanto bao mbabe abanto baane, na Nyasae oo nabe Nyasae one.
Aase aye orakwere, nainche nao ndakwere, na ntindekwe aroro. Tiga Omonene ang’e egesusuro bono na kogenderera onye gento kende kegochia konyatanana korwa asore, otatiga amakweri oka.”
Ekero Naomi aroche ng’a Rutu otenenire bokong’u ase ebirengererio biaye bi’okogenda amo nere, takwana gento kende.

Ase igo barabwo babere bakagenderera orogendo rwabo, bagaika Bethlehemu. Ekero baigete aroro, abanto bonsi b’omochie bakaeegaeega ase engencho yabo, na abakungu bakaborania, bagoteba, “Inee! Oyo Naomi?”
Naomi akabatebia, “Timondoka Naomi, ndoke Mara, ekiagera Nyasae Omobui ondeteire obororo obonge.
Ekero nagendete nigo narenge omonda, korende Omonene ong’iranirie inde namaboko amasa. Nase ki rende mokondoka Naomi bono, ekero Omonene Omobui ang’onchokeire na ondeteire amaakwa?”
Naboigo Naomi airanete korwa ase ense y’Abamoabu amo na Rutu, oria Omomoabu, moka momura oye. Barabwo bagaika Bethlehemu ekero abanto konya bachakire kogesa esairi, endagera enga buna engano.
Naomi nabwate omoam ate oyomo ore korokwa Boazi, omonto bw’eamate y’Elimeleki, omosacha oye. Ere nigo arenge omonto omonene, naende omonda.
Rutu, oria Omomoabu, agatebia Naomi, “Ntige ngende gochora ebigara ebitigari ase omogondo bw’omonto orang’e ribaga nkore bo.” Naomi akamoiraneria, “Genda, mwana one!”
Ase igo Rutu akagenda ase omogondo gete, akaba ogochora ebigara ebitigari korwa nyuma y’abagesi. Na bono agatoka ng’a omogondo oyio nigo orenge o Boazi, omonto oria bw’eamate y’Elimeleki.
Erio agwo Boazi agacha aroro korwa Bethlehemu, agakwania abagesi, ogoteba, “Omonene abe amo nainwe!” Nabarabwo bakairaneria, “Omonene agosesenie!”
Boazi akaboria omoteneneri bw’abagesi baye, “Inee! Omosubati oyo, noyo ng’o?”
Omoteneneri oyio akamoiraneria, “Oyo nomosubati bw’Abamoabu, oria ochicha na Naomi korwa ase ense yabo.

Nigo aboria ribaga ri’ogochora ebigara ebitigari korwa nyuma y’abagesi, na korwa mambia goika bono nigo agendererete gochora ebigara, taratimoka rinde otatiga bono ase engaki ensinini akendererete ase ekegutu keria.”
Erio Boazi agakwana na Rutu, akamotebia, “Mwana one, ntegerera! Tobaisa kogenda gochora ebigara ebitigari ase omogondo omoao; obeere aa oka, obe gokobwatia abaiseke aba.
Origererie orore ase bakogesa obabwatie korwa nyuma! Nakanirie abanto baane tibakogochanda. Gokorang’a, ogende ase chinsiongo echio baichoirie amache, otaae onywe!”
Rutu agatung’ama inse akaumama, akaboria Boazi, “Naki gwakora kwanyechandera na gonkorera buya iga, na inche nomomenyi inde aa?”

Boazi akamoiraneria, “Natebigwe amang’ana onsi gwakoreire nyoko biara korwa ekero omosacha oye akwete. Namanyire buna gwatigire iso na nyoko, na ense yao kwaiboreretwe, ogacha komenya nabanto otamanyete agwo ritang’ani.
Omonene agoakane ase aya gwakorire; ee, Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyo gwatameire, erinde orendwe inse ye chimbaba chiaye akoe eng’eria eng’ikeranu.”
Rutu akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, kwabeire omuya mono asende, kwandemirie ase ogokwana nobwororo nainche, omosomba oo, nonya tindi oyomo bw’abasomba bao abaiseke.”

Ekero abanto bachete koragera, Boazi agatebia Rutu, “Inchuo aa, orie omogati otongerie ase omosori ore nedivai.” Naboigo Rutu agaikaransa amo nabagesi baria, na Boazi akamoa ebigara bisambire. Rutu akaria, akaigota, naende eyende egatigara.
Na ekero Rutu agendete gochora ebigara naende, Boazi agachika abasomba baye, akabatebia, “Momotige achore ebigara nonya nase egati y’emesaima, timomokania.
Naende momoruserie ebigara korwa ase emesaima, momotigere abichore, timobaisa komotanga.”
Igo Rutu akagenderera gochora ebigara ase omogondo oria goika mogoroba, na ekero abibungete akanyora ng’a biaisanire ebitonga bibere.
Erio agetweka ebitonga biria, akairana omochie, akorokia ng’ina biara eyio achorete. Naende akamoa endagera eria yatigarete ekero ariete akaigota.

Naomi akamoboria, “Ng’ai kware gochora ebigara rero? Nase omogondo o ng’o kware gokora emeremo? Nyasae asesenie omonto oyio ogwechandera kogokonya!” Rutu agatebia Naomi ng’a nigo arenge gokora emeremo ase omogondo bw’omonto ore korokwa Boazi.

Naomi agatebia Rutu, moka momura oye, “Boazi oyio tiga asesenigwe n’Omonene, oyo ogoikerania chiira chiaye ase abwo bare moyo, na ase abwo bakure.” Naende agateba, “Omonto oyio nomonyamwando ominto, oyomo bw’abagwenerete gotorenda.”
Naende Rutu, Omomoabu oria, akamotebia, “Amo nayio ere nigo antebia ng’a mbeere amo nabasomba baye goika bakoore rigesa riaye rionsi.”

Erio Naomi agetebia Rutu, “Ee, omwana one, mbuya mono kobua asore okore emeremo nabaiseke abwo bakomokorera Boazi. Oise kogenda ase omogondo bw’omonto omoao, abanto bare aroro mbabaise kogokorera bobe.”
Ase ayio Rutu agakora emeremo amo nabaiseke baria, akaba ogochora ebigara goika bagakoora rigesa ri’esairi na eri’engano. Korende akagenderera komenya amo na ng’ina biara.
Rituko erimo Naomi agatebia Rutu, moka momura oye, “Narorire ng’a mbuya nkonyorere omosacha, erinde onyore enka yao.
Nomanyete ng’a Boazi, oria ase konya ogokora emeremo nabasomba baye, nigo are omonyamwando ominto? Naama! Ase omogoroba o rero nache abe okoora esairi ase ekeooreri kiaye.
Ase ayio esibie, bweake amaguta agotioka buya, obeke chianga chiao chingiya. Erio otirimboke gochia ase ekeooreri, korende tobaisa kweorokia ase omonto oria goika ekero akoorire koragera na konywa.
Ekero ararire, origererie omanye aase aria. Erio ogende aroro, otubore ekiebisio kiaye korwa ase amagoro aye maate, orareo nere nagotebie aya ogwenerete gokora.”
Rutu akairaneria, “Aya onsi gwantebia ninyakore.”
Ase igo Rutu agatirimboka gochia ase ekeooreri, agakora buna ng’ina biara konya amotebirie.
Boazi kariire na konywa akaigwa buya, akagenda ang’e netui y’esairi, akarara aroro. Erio Rutu agachoba ng’ora‐ng’ora, agatubora ekiebisio korwa ase amagoro a Boazi, akarara aroro.
Na kobwabeire botuko gati, Boazi agataboboka. Ani! Omokungu naraire magoro aye maate.
Boazi akamoboria, “Naye ng’o?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Ninche Rutu omosomba oo, nachire ontuge, ekiagera nigo ore omonyamwando o tata biara.”
Erio Boazi akamotebia, “Mwana one, Omonene agosesenie. Aye bono kworokirie obwegenwa kobua obwo kworogetie ritang’ani ase nyoko biara. Tikware korigia abamura bande, abataka gose abanda.
Ase ayio, mwana one, toiroka, ekiagera abanto bonsi ase omochie oyo nigo bamanyete ng’a aye nomokungu omweriti. Ningokorere ande onsi oraganie.
Nabo nekeene ng’a inche nomonyamwando o iso biara inde, korende nare omonyamwando onde omoao ore ang’e kombua.

Bono beera aa ase obotuko obo goika mambia, torore gose omonyamwando oria onde ore ang’e kombua nanche gokorenda. Karakore igo mbuya. Onye tagwancha, rirorio ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, inche ninkorende. Bono rara aiga goika mambia.”

Ase igo omokungu oria akarara ase amagoro aye maate goika mambia, korende mambia chuni botarakiamoka akaimoka kogenda, erinde monto onde tamorora, ekiagera Boazi tatagete monto onde amanye ng’a omokungu oria nachete ase ekeooreri kiaye.

Naende Boazi akamotebia, “Renta egetambaa ekio bwambarete, okiaare.” Na Rutu agakiaara. Erio Boazi akamorengera esairi eisaine ebitita bitano na ekemo, akamoyetweka. Erio omokungu oria akairana gochia ase omochie.
Ekero Rutu aigete ase ng’ina biara, ere akamoboria, “Mang’ana ki, omwana one?” Rutu akamotebia amang’ana onsi Boazi amokorerete.
Naende agateba, “Boazi nigo antebia ng’a tinkonyara koirana gocha asore namaboko amasa. Ase igo ong’a esairi eye ebitita bitano na ekemo.”
Naomi akamotebia, “Bono omwana one, remereria oganye goika orore aya arabe asore. Boazi tagokira rero goika arore ng’a oroisirie amang’ana ao.”

Boazi akagenda agaikaransa ase etureti agwo ase egeita ki’omochie. Ekaba ng’a omonto oria omonyamwando bw’Elimeleki ore ang’e kobua Boazi, oria Boazi akwanete igoro yaye, ngoeta arenge. Boazi akamorangeria, akamotebia, “Oyominto, gobera gocha aa, oikaranse!” Omonto oria akagobera, agaikaransa.
Naende Boazi akarangeria abagaaka ikomi b’omochie baikaranse aroro. Ase igo bagaikaransa.
Erio Boazi agatebia omonyamwando oria, “Naomi, oria oirana korwa ense y’Abamoabu, nkoonia are oboremo boria bwarenge omwando bw’Elimeleki ominto.

Inche nigo narengereretie gokomanyia amang’ana aya. Bono nonyare kobogora aiga ase amasio ’abagaaka aba, na ase aba bonsi baikaransete igaa. Onye kogwancha kobogora, bogore, korende onye taibo, ntebie imanye, ekiagera naye ore omonyamwando ore ang’e, na nyuma yao ninche.” Omonto oria akairaneria, “Ee, nimbogore.”
Erio Boazi akamotebia, “Korende onye gokogora oboremo korwa ase Naomi, rirorio oire Rutu, Omomoabu oria, moka oria okwete, abe mokao, naye omotenenerie oria okwete egesaku kerarie omwando oye.”
Omonyamwando oria akairaneria, akabora, “Onye naboigo, tinkobogora, mbaise gosiria omwando one. Ribaga riane ri’okobogora, aye riire; tinkonyara kobogora.”

Ase amatuko a kare ase Abaisraeli, ekero enibo yare koboorigwa, gose koonchorerigwa, engencho yabo nigo yarenge ng’a oyomo bw’abwo nigo arenge gosomora egekoroto kiaye ekemo omoa oria onde. Ayio nigo are kogera aria agambwa takoonchoranwa, na ogokora okwo kwaba kirori.
Ase igo omonyamwando oria agatebia Boazi, “Aye bogore”, na akamosomorera egekoroto kiaye.
Erio Boazi agatebia abagaaka baria na abanto bonsi abarengeo, “Inwe mbirori more rero ng’a nagorire korwa ase amaboko a Naomi bionsi ebiarenge ebi’Elimeleki, na ebia Kilioni amo nebia Mahaloni.

Amo nayio Rutu, Omomoabu oria, oyorenge moka Mahaloni, namoirire abe mokane, erinde inyare goteneneria oria okwete egesaku kerarie omwando oye, nario ororeria rwaye rotasire ase abamwabo, gose ase abanto b’omochie oye. Ase amang’ana aya mbirori more rero.”

Abagaaka baria na abanto bande bonsi abarenge ase etureti agwo ase egeita ki’omochie bakairaneria, “Ee, mbirori tore. Tiga Omonene asesenie omokungu oyio orache ase enka yao abe buna Raeli na Lea, abwo baiborerete Israeli abana abange bakaba egesaku. Aye osesenigwe ase egati y’Abaefarati na omanyekane ase Bethlehemu.
Naende enka yao ebe buna eya Peresi, oria Tamari aiborerete Yuda, goetera ase oroiboro roria Omonene arakoe korwa ase omokungu oyio.”
Ase igo Boazi akaira Rutu, na ere akaba mokaye. Erio bakamenyana, na Omonene aganchera Rutu koba morito, na ere akaibora omwana omoisia.
Erio abakungu b’omochie oyio bagatebia Naomi, “Omonene atogigwe! Ere tagotigeti; rero okoeire omonyamwando, oyio erieta riaye riramanyekane ase egati y’Abaisraeli!
Nere oragotimokie, abe chinguru chiao abe ogokorageria ase obogotu bwao. Moka momura oo nigo agwanchete; ere ogokoreire amaya kobua abamura batano na babere, na bono oiboire omwana oyio.”
Naomi akaimokia omwana oria, akamoagata, akaba okomorera.
Abakungu abarenge abagisangio baye bakabora, “Naomi oiboreirwe omwana omochokoro omomura”, bakamoroka Obedi. Obedi oyio nere oiborete Yese, na Yese akaibora Daudi.
Abanto aba nabwo ororeria rwa Peresi: Peresi akaibora Hezironi;
Hezironi akaibora Ramu, na Ramu akaibora Aminadabu;
Aminadabu akaibora Nahesoni, na Nahesoni akaibora Salimoni;
Salimoni akaibora Boazi, na Boazi akaibora Obedi;
Obedi akaibora Yese, na Yese akaibora Daudi.
Narenge omonto ore korokwa Elikana korwa ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, omenyete Ramataimu‐Sofimu, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu. Ere nigo arenge mosinto o Yerohamu bw’Elihu, o Tohu, o Sufu, Omoefraimu.
Elikana nabwate abakungu babere, Hana na Penina. Penina nabwate abana, korende Hana tabwate bana.

Kera omwaka omonto oyio nigo arenge gotiira korwa ase omochie oye, ogenda gosasima na korua ebing’wanso ase Omonene bw’Emeganda agwo Silo. Aroro agwo Ofini na Finehasi, abamura babere ba Eli, nigo barenge abakuani b’Omonene.
Kera engaki Elikana arenge korua ekeng’wanso, nigo arenge koa Penina amo nabana baye, abamura na abaiseke, kera oyomo egetari kiaye.
Korende ase Hana nigo arenge komoa ebitari bibere, ekiagera nigo amwanchete nonya Omonene omotangete koibora abana.
Penina, moibori omwabo, nigo anarete goichania Hana ase okomochaya, ekiagera Omonene konya omotangire koibora.
Nabo agendererete gokora omwaka ase omwaka. Ekero barenge kogenda gosasima ase enyomba y’Omonene, Penina akaba ogoichania Hana, na Hana nigo arenge kona‐korera goika takoria gento.
Erio Elikana akamoboria, “Nase ki okona‐korera? Naki otari koria endagera? Naende oichanete iga? Inee! Inche tindi buya asore goetania abana abamura ikomi?”

Rituko erimo nyuma kobakoorire koragera na konywa aaria Silo, Hana akaimoka, na ase emechando yaye akarera mono ore nobororo, agasaba Omonene. Eli nao aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ang’e nomotobwa bw’egesieri gie Hekalu y’Omonene.

Hana akaria eira, agakwana, “Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, ondigererie inche omosomba oo ase emechando yane! Tonyeba! Korang’e omwana omomura, nigo ndamorue abe oyoo, aye Omonene; ase amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwaye takogingirwa etukia yaye.”
Buna omokungu oyio agendererete gosaba Omonene, Eli akaba origereretie omonwa oye.
Hana nigo arenge gosabera enkoro yaye ime bokiriru; akaba okomonya‐monyia ebikoba biaye rioka, korende riogi tiriare koigweka. Ase ayio Eli agakaga ng’a nigo atindire,
akamotebia, “Ngoika ririri oragenderere gotinda? Tiga ogotinda kwao, otindoke!”

Hana akamoiraneria, “Taibo, omonene one, inche nomokungu inde nobororo ase enkoro yane. Tinyweti edivai gose ekenyugwa kende kegotindia. Nigo nabeire ngosaba na kobeka emechando yane yonsi ase Omonene.
Tokaga ng’a inche, omosomba oo, nomokungu otagwenereti, naki ase engaki eye yonsi nabeire ngokwana ase engencho y’emechando yane na ogoichana kwane.”
Erio Eli akamoiraneria, akamotebia, “Genda nomorembe, na Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli nakoe aya kwamosabire.”
Hana akabora, “Tiga inche, omosomba oo, inyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao.” Erio omokungu oria akarua aase agwo, akagenda koragera, gose taba oichanete naende.

Rituko ria kabere Elikana na abanto baye bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagasasima ase obosio bw’Omonene. Erio bakairana gochia nka sobo agwo Rama. Elikana akaba na Hana mokaye, na Omonene akaba omoinyorete.
Hana akaba morito, na ekero engaki yaigete akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Samweli, agateba, “Nekiagera namosabete korwa ase Omonene.”
Elikana amo nabanto b’enka yaye bakagenda naende koruera Omonene ekeng’wanso gia kera omwaka na goikerania eira bariete.
Korende ase engaki eyio Hana tagendeteo, agatebia omosacha oye, “Ninganye goika ntache omwana, erio nario ndamoire imoorokie ase obosio bw’Omonene, erinde imotige amenye aroro botambe.”
Elikana, omosacha oye, akamotebia, “Kora aya orarore are buya; ganya goika otache omwana. Tiga Omonene aikeranie ring’ana riaye.” Erio omokungu oria agatigara nka korera omwana goika akamotacha.

Ekero omwana oria atachirwe, Hana akamoira ase enyomba y’Omonene agwo Silo, akaira na eeri yakoorire emiaka etato, na obosie ebimunu emerongo ebere, na ekerandi kiaroisirie korwa ase risankwa kere nedivai. Omwana oria omomura nigo arenge omoke.
Erio bakanyenya eeri eria, na bakaa Eli omwana oria.
Hana agatebia Eli, “Omonene one, inyigwa. Amaene, buna ogendererete koba moyo, inche nomokungu oria natenenete aiga ase obosio bwao, narenge gosaba Omonene.
Nigo nasabete ng’a ng’egwe omwana oyo omomura, na Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kwane.
Ase ayio namorentire ase Omonene. Ase obogima bwaye bwonsi abe oyoye.” Erio bagasasima Omonene aroro agwo.
Hana agasaba, agakwana, “Enkoro yane yachengeire Omonene; ase Omonene orogunchara rwane rwaimokereire igoro. Omonwa one nigo ogosekereria ababisa baane; nagokire ase ogotooreka kw’Omonene.
“Onde tari ore omochenu buna Omonene, onde tari buna ere, egetare kende tikeri buna Nyasae oito.
Timogenderera gokwana amang’ana obwerori, oboenenu tiborua ase emenwa yaino. Omonene nigo are Nyasae oyomanyete onsi, ere nigo akorenga aya onsi abanto bagokora.
Amata ’abanto chituoni abunekire, korende abakogochwa babekirwe chinguru.

Abanto ababwate endagera eisaine kare bono berure gokora emeremo, erinde banyore endagera, nabwo barenge nenchara, baigotire bono. Omokungu orenge omogomba oiboire abana batano na babere, korende oria konya obwate abange otigaire ore bosa.
Omonene nigo agoita, naende oirania obogima; ere nigo agotoma abanto gochia aase abakure, naende obabokia.
Omonene nigo agokora omonto oba omotaka, gose omonda, ere nigo agokeyia omonto, gose omoimokereria igoro.

Nigo akoimokia omotaka korwa ase obotaka obweere, na omoremerwa korwa ase ribu, obabeka baikaransa amo nabwo bare nokobua, na kobaa omwando bw’ebirogo bi’obonene. Oboroso bw’ense nobw’Omonene, na igoro y’oboroso obwo oterekereire enseo.
“Narende amagoro ’abegenwa baye, korende abakori amabe nigo barasirigwe ase omosunte, onde tari orabue ase chinguru chiaye ere omonyene.
Abare mamincha y’Omonene nabasenyentwe, Omonene nabaake nenkoba korwa igoro. Ere nanachere ense yonsi ekina. Omonene nae omoruoti oye okobua na aimokererie igoro orogunchara rw’omoakwa amaguta oye.”
Erio Elikana akairana gochia Rama nka bwoye, korende omwana oria Samweli agatigara ogokorera Omonene inse y’oboteneneri bwa Eli omokuani.
Abamura ba Eli nigo barenge abanto ababe batarochi inchera. Tibasigete Omonene,

na tibare gokora buna abakuani bagwenerete gokora ase abanto. Ribaga ri’ayio, ekero omonto arure ekeng’wanso kiaye, omosomba bw’omokuani nigo arenge gocha abwate euma ere namaino atato, na ekero enyama egendererete koiyekwa,

omosomba oria aba ogosoyia euma eria ime ase esuguria, gose enyongo, gose ase gento kende enyama ekoiyekerwa ime yaye, ne chinyama chionsi arenge korusia neuma eria nigo chiarenge koirerwa omokuani. Naboigo abakuani abwo barenge gokorera Abaisraeli bonsi barenge gocha agwo Silo.

Amo nayio, ekero enyama enoru etarayia, omosomba bw’omokuani nigo arenge gocha otebia omonto oria orenge korua ekeng’wanso, “Kae omokuani enyama achie gosamba, ekiagera tagwancha enyama enyiyeke; igo anchete enyama embese.”

Onye omonto oria orenge gotebia omosomba oria, “Tiga tosambe enyama enoru ritang’ani, erio nyuma omanye koira enyama ende yonsi oganetie,” nere igo arenge goteba, “Yaya, taibo, goika oyeng’e bono iga. Onye tokong’a enyama eyio, rirorio nigo nkoyerusia ne chinguru, inyeire.”
Ebibe ebi bi’abamura ba Eli nigo biarenge ebinene mono ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ase enchera eyio abanto nigo beorokereretie gochaya ebing’wanso bi’Omonene.
Samweli akagenderera gokora emeremo ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ere nigo arenge omosae ore kobeka egesibao ki’egatani.
Kera omwaka ng’ina nigo arenge komoroiseria eanga, omoirera ekero arenge kogenda amo nomosacha oye gochia korua ekeng’wanso gia kera omwaka.

Erio Eli nigo arenge koba ogosesenia Elikana na mokaye, atebia Elikana, “Omonene asesenie omokungu oyo akoiborere abana bande babe ribaga ri’omwana oyo gwatananete ase Omonene.” Erio baba bakoirana gochia nka.
Omonene agasesenia Hana, ere akaibora abamura bande batato na abaiseke babere. Omwana oria Samweli akaba ogokina ore ase enyomba y’Omonene.

Bono Eli konya ogotire mono. Ere nigo abete okona‐koigwa amang’ana onsi abamura baye baare gokora ase Abaisraeli bonsi, na buna baare gotomana nabakungu abarenge gokora emeremo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
Erio akabatebia, “Nase ki mogokora amang’ana buna ayio? Abanto bonsi bantebirie amabe aino mogokora.
Abana baane, tiga timokora bo. Chinkuma echio naigure ase egati y’abanto b’Omonene tichiri chingiya.

Omonto karakore ebibe ase omonto onde, Nyasae nabe omobwatania, korende omonto karakore ebibe ase Nyasae, ning’o oranyare koba omobwatania?” Korende barabwo tibaigwerete ise, ekiagera Omonene konya oganirie kobaita.
Bono omwana oria Samweli akagenderera gokina ase omobere, akamogwenera Omonene na mwanyabanto.

Omonto oyomo o Nyasae agacha ase Eli, akamotebia, “Amang’ana aya naro Omonene akwanire: Inee! Inche tineorogetie ase sokororia yao na ase ororeria rwaye, ekero barenge abasomba ba Farao agwo ase ense ya Misiri?

Tinabachorete inwe korwa ase ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli mobe abakuani baane, na morue ebing’wanso ase egesasimero kiane, naende mosambe ubani na mobe mokobeka egesibao ki’obokuani komogocha ase obosio bwane? Tinaete abanto b’ororeria rwa sokororia yao baire ebing’wanso bionsi Abaisraeli baare gosamba nomorero?

Nase ki rende mwabeire mogochaya na koba ne ribero ase ebing’wanso biane, na okoruegwa kwane, nachigete birentwe ase Obomenyo bwane? Aye Eli kwaeire abamura bao ogosika kong’etania ase okobaa ribaga kwenoria ase eyere enoru mono kobua, ase kera ekeng’wanso abanto baane Abaisraeli bakonduera.

Ase engencho eyio, inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, natebire iga: Nigo nariete eira ng’a abanto b’eamate yao, na ab’ororeria rwa sokororia yao mbabe bagokora emeremo y’obokuani ase obosio bwane kogenderera botambe. Korende bono nigo ngoteba ng’a tinyancheti bo, ekiagera abanto bansigete, nainche nimbasike, na baria banchayete, nabarabwo mbachaywe goetania.
Naama! Amatuko ngocha are, ekero ndasirie chinguru chiao ne chinguru chi’abanto b’ororeria rwa sokororia yao, erio tanyorekana omonto omogotu ase eamate yao.
Aye ekero ore nemechando norore obotenenku boraruegwe ase Abaisraeli, na igo aye nobe ne ribero, korende ase eamate yao omonto omogotu tagotokao.
Tinkorusia kera oyomo oino korwa ase egesasimero. Oyo ntarusie korwao nigo arabe okogoukoria amaiso, na goichania enkoro yao, na abanto bonsi b’enyomba yao nigo barakwe bataragota.
Abamura bao babere, Hofini na Finehasi, nigo barakwe ase rituko erimo, na ayio nabe ekemanyererio asore ase aya nakwanire.

Ninyechorere omokuani omwegenwa, oyorabe ogokora ogwancha kwane na onsi aya nganetie. Oyio nere ndae ororeria rwaye rorabe rogotenena bokong’u, na abanto b’ororeria rwaye mbagenderere gokora emeremo y’obokuani ase obosio bw’omoakwa amaguta one.

Nebe ng’a omonto onde bwensi ase eamate yao oratigare ore moyo nagende gotung’ama ase obosio bw’omokuani oyio, amosabe amoe ebesa gose omogati, ogoteba: Nagosabire ombeke nainche nkonye ase emeremo gete y’obokuani, erinde inyore omogati nkoria.”

Omwana oria Samweli akaba ogokora emeremo ase obosio bw’Omonene inse y’oboteneneri bwa Eli. Ase amatuko aria ring’ana ri’Omonene tiriarenge gokwanwa mono na amaroro ’obobani tarenge konyorekana otatiga okomo okomo.
Ase amatuko aria amaiso a Eli konya achakire koba chinchingori, tare korora buya. Ase obotuko obomo ere nigo arenge oraire aase aye a botambe,
na Samweli nigo arenge oraire ime ase Obomenyo Obochenu aase Esanduku ya Nyasae yarenge. Ritang’ani chitaya chia Nyasae chitararima,
Omonene akarangeria Samweli! Ere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa!”
Erio akaminyoka gochia ase Eli, akamotebia, “Nao inde aa! Aye nigo kwandangeria.” Korende Eli akamoiraneria, “Inche tinkorangereti, genda orare.” Erio Samweli akairana gochia korara.
Omonene akarangeria Samweli naende; ere akaimoka akagenda ase Eli, akamotebia, “Nao inde aa. Aye nigo kwandangeria.” Korende Eli akamoiraneria, “Omwana one, tinkorangereti, genda orare.”
Bono Samweli konya taramanyereria eriogi ri’Omonene, ne ring’ana ri’Omonene konya tiriraorokigwa asare.
Omonene akarangeria Samweli eria gatato. Ere akaimoka, akagenda ase Eli, akamotebia, “Nao inde aa. Aye nigo kwandangeria.” Erio Eli akamanya ng’a n’Omonene okorangeria omwana oria.
Ase ayio, agatebia Samweli, “Genda orare, na karakorangerie naende, okwane iga: Omonene kwana, inche omosomba oo ninyigwete.” Erio Samweli akagenda, akarara naende aase aye.
Erio Omonene agacha, agatenena aria, akarangeria buna chingaki chinde, “Samweli! Samweli!” Samweli agaitaba, “Kwana. Inche, omosomba oo, ninyigwete.”
Omonene agatebia Samweli, “Rituko erimo ninkore egento gete ase egati y’Abaisraeli, egento gi’okwoboyia, na kera omonto orakeigwe, amato aye nigo arabe akoeera.
Ase rituko erio ning’ikeranie amang’ana onsi, korwa omochakano goika omoerio, ayio nakwanete ng’a ninyakore ase Eli na ase eamate yaye.
Namotebetie ng’a nabeire ang’e koa eamate yaye egesusuro kogenderera botambe, ekiagera okorire ebibe. Ere nigo amanyete ng’a abamura baye mbabete bakorama erieta riane, korende tabakania batige.
Ase ayio natianire ase eamate ya Eli ng’a okobwatanigwa tigokoba nonya ng’ake ase ebibe biabo ase enchera y’ebing’wanso gose okoruegwa konde gwonsi.”
Samweli akarara goika mambia; erio akaboka, akaigora ebisieri bi’enyomba y’Omonene. Ere akoboa gotebia Eli okorora koria aroche.
Eli akamorangeria, akabora, “Samweli, omwana one!” Nere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa!”
Eli akamoboria, “Ninki Omonene agotebetie? Tobaisa kombisa gento. Korambise gento kende gionsi, nonya ne ring’ana erimo, rirorio Nyasae akoe egesusuro ekenene.”
Erio Samweli akamotebia kera ring’ana, tamobisa rinde rionsi. Eli akabora, “Nere Omonene; tiga akore eri rikomogwenera.”
Samweli akamenta gokina; Omonene akaba nere, erinde tatiga ring’ana riaye nonya nerimo ritaikeranetigwe.
Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba bakamanya ng’a Samweli ekeene bwegenirwe koba omobani bw’Omonene.
Omonene akagenderera kweorokia agwo Silo, akeorokia ase Samweli goetera ase ring’ana riaye. Na ekero Samweli arenge gokwana, Abaisraeli bonsi nigo barenge gotegerera.
Abaisraeli bakagenda korwania Abafilisti. Barabwo bagatoora agwo Ebeni‐Eseri, na Abafilisti agwo Afeki.
Abafilisti bakeroberia korwania Abaisraeli. Esegi egatindia, na Abafilisti bakabua Abaisraeli, bagaita abanto chilifu inye.

Ekero abarwani abatigarete bairanete gocha ase egetwori, abagaaka b’Abaisraeli bagateba, “Nase ki Omonene atotiga twabugwa n’Abafilisti ase rituko ria rero? Togende torente korwa Silo Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’Omonene, erinde eche ebe egati yaito na gototooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baito.”
Erio abanto bagatomwa Silo, bakarenta Esanduku eria y’Omonene bw’Emeganda, oyio omenyete nobonene bwaye igoro y’abakerubi; na Hofini na Finehasi, abamura babere ba Eli, bagacha amo n’Esanduku eria.
Ekero Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene yaigete ase egetwori, Abaisraeli bonsi bagaaka amariogi amanene goika ense ekoga.

Abafilisti bagachia koigwa amariogi aria agoakwa bakaborania, “Ninki engencho y’ogoakwa kw’amariogi ayio amanene ase egetwori ki’Abaibirania?” Ekero banyorete amang’ana ng’a n’Esanduku y’Omonene yarentirwe ase egetwori,
bakaondoka mono, bagakwana, “Enyasae yachire ase egetwori keria.” Naende bagateba, “Obobe nobwaito! Egento kenga buna ekio tikiana gokorekana asetore nonya ng’ake.
Obobe nobwaito! Ning’o oratotoorie korwa ase amaboko e chinyasae echio chire nokobua gotoetania?

Chinyasae echio nachio chiagete Abamisiri namaakwa amange aaria ase erooro. Korende inwe Abafilisti, motenene bokong’u buna abasacha, ede timoa abasomba b’Abaibirania baria, buna barabwo barenge abasomba baino. Ee, motenene buna abasacha, morwane!”

Ase igo Abafilisti bakarwana bokong’u, na Abaisraeli bakabugwa, bagatama kera oyomo gochia ase enka yaye. Okobugwa okwo nigo kwarenge okonene mono. Abarwani b’Abaisraeli chilifu emerongo etato bagaitwa bagakwa.
Esanduku ya Nyasae ekairwa, na Hofini na Finehasi, abamura babere ba Eli, bagaitwa.
Omonto oyomo bw’egesaku kia Benjamin agatama korwa ase esegi, akaminyoka gochia Silo, agaikao rituko erio erio, ore ne chianga chiatandoire, na obegete ebuse ase omotwe oye.

Ekero omonto oria aigeteo, Eli nigo arenge oikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye agwo enchera ensemo otengerete, ekiagera nigo arenge nobwoba ase engencho y’Esanduku eria ya Nyasae. Na ekero omonto oria arentete amang’ana ayio akorekire, abanto bonsi b’omochie bakarera mono.
Erio Eli akaigwa okorera kw’abanto, akaboria, “Eriogi eri ri’okorera okonene neria ki?” Erio omonto oria akaayerera gochia ase Eli komotebia amang’ana ayio.
(Eli konya okoorire emiaka emerongo kianda, na etano na etato; amaiso aye konya aukoire; ase ayio tarenge konyara korora.)
Omonto oria agatebia Eli, “Ninche narua ase esegi, natama korwao ase rituko ria rero.” Erio Eli akamoboria, “Omwana one, naki esegi yagenderera?”
Erio oria orentete amang’ana akamoiraneria, “Abaisraeli batamire korwa ase Abafilisti, abanto abange baitirwe; Hofini na Finehasi, abana bao babere, bakure; boigo Esanduku ya Nyasae yairirwe.”

Ekero omonto oria atorete Esanduku eria ya Nyasae, Eli akagwa gochia magega korwa ase ekerogo, agwo ase egeita ensemo, akabuneka ebigoti agakwa, ekiagera konya ogotire mono, naende nigo arenge omorito. Ere konya ogambeire Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.

Bono moga Finehasi, omomura o Eli, nigo arenge morito; engaki yaye y’okogonkia konya yabereire ang’e. Ekero aigwete amang’ana ng’a ise biara amo nomosacha oye bakure, obororo bw’okobina bokamochera, agatung’ama inse, akagonkia.

Ekero arenge ang’e nogokwa, abakungu abarenge komokonya ase okomoiboria bakamotebia, “Toiroka, ekiagera kwaiboire omwana omomura.” Korende omokungu oria tabairaneria gento, gose tategerera amang’ana abo.

Akaroka omwana oria I‐Kabodi, ogoteba, “Obonene bwarure ase Abaisraeli.” Nigo akwanete igo, ekiagera Esanduku eria ya Nyasae konya yairirwe, boigo ekiagera ise biara konya okure, na omosacha oye konya oitirwe.
Agateba, “Obonene bwarure ase Abaisraeli,” ekiagera Esanduku eria ya Nyasae konya yairirwe.
Ekero Abafilisti bairete Esanduku eria ya Nyasae, bakayebogoria korwa Ebeni‐Eseri, bakayeira goika Asidodi,
bakayesoyia ase hekalu ya Dagoni, bakayebeka ensemo ya Dagoni, enyasae yabo.
Rituko ria kabere mambia chuni, ekero abanto b’Asidodi babogete, bakanyora Dagoni egwete inse maumama bosio bw’Esanduku eria y’Omonene. Bakayegororokia, bakayetenenia aase aye.

Rituko ria gatato bagachia koboka mambia chuni, bakanyora naende Dagoni yagure inse maumama, bosio bw’Esanduku eria y’Omonene. Omotwe o Dagoni, na amaboko aye, konya biabutokire bire agwo ase omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri, ne rieene rioka nario riatigarete.
Ayio naro akogera abakuani ba Dagoni na abanto bonsi baria bagosoa ase hekalu ya Dagoni agwo Asidodi batari gotacha omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri nonya ngoika rero iga.
Okoboko kw’Omonene gokaritoera abanto b’Asidodi. Ere agachanda na kwoboyia abanto bonsi b’Asidodi amo nab’orogongo orwo rwonsi, akabaaka bakariegwa namagumba.

Ekero abanto b’Asidodi baroche amang’ana ayio, bagateba, “Esanduku eye ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tekonyara kobeera aiga amo naintwe, ekiagera okoboko kw’Omonene nokorito igoro asetore, na igoro ase Dagoni, enyasae yaito.”

Bagatoma abanto basangererie amo abanene bonsi b’Abafilisti, bakababoria, “Naki togokora n’Esanduku eye ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli?” Barabwo bakairaneria, “Esanduku eria ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tiga eirwe Gati.” Ase igo bakaira Esanduku eria ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli aroro.
Ekero bayeirireo, Omonene akarenta obotantanu obonene ase abanto b’omochie oria, agaaka abanto bonsi, abanene na abake, ase okobarentera amagumba.

Erio bakaira Esanduku eria ya Nyasae goika omochie bw’Ekironi. Korende ekero yaigete aroro, abanto b’Ekironi bagaaka amariogi, bakabora, “Barentire Esanduku eria ya Nyasae aiga seito, erinde batoite intwe twensi.”

Ase ayio bagatoma abanto basangererie amo abanene bonsi b’Abafilisti, bakabora, “Rusia aiga Esanduku eye ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, moyeiranie gochia aase aye, tebaisa gotoita intwe amo nabana baito.” Obwoba bw’amakweri konya bwasoire ase omochie bwonsi, ekiagera okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge okorito mono aroro.
Abanto baria batakwete bakariegwa namagumba, bakarera, na ekerero kiabo kegaika igoro.
Esanduku eria y’Omonene ekabeera ase ense y’Abafilisti ase engaki y’emetienyi etano na ebere.
Erio Abafilisti bakarangeria abakuani babo na abaringoria, bakababoria, “Ninki togokora ase Esanduku eye y’Omonene? Totebie inchera ki torayeiranie aase aye.”

Barabwo bakabairaneria, “Onye mokoirania Esanduku eyio ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, timobaisa koyeirania bosa etari nebiegwa; goika momoruere okoruegwa ase engencho y’okomocha. Erio namogwene, naende monyare komanya ng’a nase ki Omonene agendererete kobaa egesusuro.”

Bakaboria, “Inee! Okoruegwa okwo gw’okomocha nkoroki torairanie ase Omonene?” Barabwo bakabairaneria, “Emegwekano etano y’amagumba, na etano ye chimbeba, yonsi eroisirie korwa ase etahabu. Moire emegwekano ereng’aine nomobaro bw’abagambi b’Abafilisti, ekiagera amaakwa ayio nigo abete igoro asemore mwensi, na igoro ase abanene baino boigo.

Goika moroisie emegwekano y’amagumba, na eye chimbeba, ebio bigosaria ense yaino; erio motogie Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Ande nabo arakore emechando yaino ebe emegusu asemore, na ase chinyasae chiaino, na ase ense yaino.
Nase ki mogokong’ia chinkoro chiaino buna Abamisiri na Farao bakong’etie echiabo. Inee! Ekero Omonene abaete amaakwa amakong’u tibaete Abaisraeli ribaga bakaruao?
Ase igo roisia egari enyia, morente chiombe ibere chigokamwa, chitana gosiberwa rikorogoto; mosibere chiombe echio egari eyio, korende morusie chimori chiabo korwa ase chirochio, mochitige nka.

Moimokie Esanduku eye y’Omonene ase egari igoro, na emegwekano eria y’etahabu, moyebeke ase esanduku eng’ao ebeere ensemo y’Esanduku eria y’Omonene. Emegwekano eyio moyeirere Omonene ebe okoruegwa ase engencho y’okomocha okwo. Nyuma y’ayio motige Esanduku egende aase aye.

Erio moyerigererie. Onye ekogenda enchera ya boronge gochia ase ense yaye ya Beti‐Semesi, rirorio momanye ng’a n’Omonene otorentera obobe obwo obonene, korende onye taibo, rirorio tomanye ng’a tari okoboko kwaye gwatoaka; ande nigo twanyora emechando eye mosiabano.”
Erio abanto abwo bagakora bo. Bakaimokia chiombe ibere chigokamwa, bagachisibera egari, bagasiekera chimori nka.
Bakabeka Esanduku y’Omonene ase egari, bakabeka na esanduku eria yabekire emegwekano eria ye chimbeba na ey’amagumba eroisirie korwa ase etahabu.

Chiombe chiria chikagenda chikona‐kwana, chikabwatia enchera endonge ekogenda Beti‐Semesi, tichiagobera aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee, na abagambi b’Abafilisti bakaba bagochitunyana korwa nyuma, goika ase orobebe rwa Beti‐Semesi.
Bono abanto ba Beti‐Semesi nkogesa barenge engano yabo agwo ase rikura, na ekero barigereretie, bakarora Esanduku eria, bakagoka mono.

Ekero egari eria yaigete ase omogondo o Yoshua o Beti‐Semesi egatenenao, ase rigena rinene riarenge. Abanto bagaatia chibao chi’egari eria, erio bakarua chiombe chiria chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene.

Abalawi bakarusia Esanduku eria y’Omonene, amo nesanduku eria ende yabekire amo, eyarenge nemegwekano eria y’etahabu, bagachibeka igoro ase rigena riria rinene. Erio ase rituko riria abanto ba Beti‐Semesi bakaruera Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde.
Ekero abagambi baria b’Abafilisti baroche ayio bakairana gochia Ekironi ase rituko riria.

Abafilisti bakarua emegwekano eria y’amagumba, eroisirie korwa ase etahabu, ekaba okoruegwa gw’okomocha ase Omonene, omogwekano oyomo korwa ase kera oyomo bw’emechie eyio: Asidodi, na Gasa, na Askeloni, na Gati, na Ekironi.

Boigo bakarua emegwekano eria ye chimbeba eroisirie korwa ase chitahabu, oyomo korwa ase kera omochie orenge kogamberwa nabanene baria batano b’Abafilisti, emechie eyio yonsi yagiteire chindwaki na ebichie bionsi bitagiteire. Ne rigena riria rinene ase babegete Esanduku eria y’Omonene nigo rire kirori goika rituko ria rero agwo ase omogondo o Yoshua o Beti‐Semesi.

Omonene agaita abanto ba Beti‐Semesi emerongo etano na ebere korwa ase abanto chilifu emerongo etano, ekiagera barigereretie Esanduku eria. Abanto bakaba bakorera na kweumia, ekiagera Omonene aitete abanto abange ase egati yabo.
Erio abanto ba Beti‐Semesi bakabora, “Ning’o oranyare gotenena ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oyo Omochenu? Nase banto ki aragende gakorua asetore?”
Ase igo bagatoma abanto ase baria bemenyete Kiriati‐Yearimu babatebie ng’a, “Abafilisti bairanirie Esanduku eria y’Omonene. Tirimboka gocha moyioyie.”

Abanto ba Kiriati‐Yearimu bagacha, bakaira Esanduku eria y’Omonene, bakayebeka ase enyomba y’Abinadabu, ase ekegoro igoro; bagachora na gwatanana Eleazari, omwana oye omomura, abe okorenda Esanduku eria.
Korwa engaki eyio Esanduku eria y’Omonene ekabeera agwo Kiriati-Yearimu ase engaki entambe, emiaka emerongo ebere. Ase engaki eyio yonsi, Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bakorera ase Omonene ng’a abakonye.

Erio Samweli agatebia Abaisraeli bonsi, “Onye mogochia koonchoka na koirana ase Omonene ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, morusie korwa asemore chinyasae chingeni chionsi, amo n’Asitaroti, mokorere Omonene bweka; erio nario arabatoorie korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.”
Erio Abaisraeli bakarusia korwa asebare chinyasae chiria Baali na Asitaroti, bakamokorera Omonene bweka.
Samweli agateba, “Sangereria Abaisraeli bonsi agwo Misipa, erinde imbasabere aroro ase Omonene.”

Abanto bagasangererekana agwo Misipa, bakabuucha amache, bakayaumora agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakeng’ata ase rituko erio, bagakwana aroro agwo, “Twakorire ebibe ase Omonene.” Erio Samweli akaba okogambera Abaisraeli agwo Misipa.
Ekero Abafilisti baigwete ng’a Abaisraeli basangererekanire agwo Misipa, abanene b’Abafilisti bakagenda gochia kobarwania. Abaisraeli bagachia koigwa amang’ana ayio, bakabairoka,
bagatebia Samweli, “Tobaisa gotiga kogenderera gotosabera ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, ng’a atotoorie korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.”
Erio Samweli akaimokia emanwa y’eng’ondi ekogonka, akayerua ase Omonene ekaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ekegima, agasabera Abaisraeli ase Omonene, na Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kwaye.

Ekero Samweli arenge korua ekeng’wanso keria ki’ogosambwa, Abafilisti bagacha korwania Abaisraeli, korende Omonene akabarentera okogukura okonene gwe chinkoba korwa igoro, akabatantania, na Abaisraeli bakabua Abafilisti.
Abaisraeli bakaimoka korwa agwo Misipa, bakabwatia Abafilisti goika Beti‐Kari, bakabaitera inchera.
Erio Samweli akaimokia rigena, akaritenenia gati ya Misipa na Seni, akariroka Ebeni‐Eseri, akabora, “Omonene otokonyire twaikire aiga.”
Naboigo Abafilisti bakabugwa, tibanyora ribaga naende gosoa ase ense y’Abaisraeli. Okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge mamincha y’Abafilisti ase amatuko onsi Samweli arenge moyo.
Emechie yonsi egati y’Ekironi na Gati, eyio Abafilisti konya baurire Abaisraeli, ekairanigwa amo ne chingongo chiaetanaineo. Agwo boigo omorembe okaba ase egati y’Abaisraeli na Abaamori.
Samweli akaba omogambi ebina bw’Abaisraeli ase amatuko onsi arenge moyo.
Kera omwaka akaba okogenda goika Beteli, na Giligali, na Misipa, akaba okogambera Abaisraeli ebina ase emechie eyio yonsi.
Erio akaba okoirana Rama, ekiagera agwo nao bwoye orenge, na agwo akaba okogamba ebina bi’Abaisraeli, naende akaagachera Omonene egesasimero.
Ekero Samweli konya agotire akabeka abamura baye babe abagambi igoro y’Abaisraeli.
Omomura oye omotangi nigo are korokwa Yoeli, na oyo o kabere Abiya. Barabwo nigo babete abagambi agwo Beeri‐Seba.
Korende abamura ba Samweli tibakorete buna ise arenge gokora ase okobwatia oboronge; bakabotiga na bakerigeria chinibo, bakarigia riaaki na bakaonchorana oboronge.
Erio abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagasangererekana amo, bakagenda ase Samweli agwo Rama,
bakamotebia, “Rora bono aye kwagotire, na abamura bao tibari kobwatia chinchera chiao. Ase ayio tochorere omoruoti oranyare gotogambera buna ebisaku binde bionsi bibwate abaruoti.”
Korende Samweli tancha amang’ana ayio bamotebetie, “Toe omoruoti atogambere.” Ase ayio Samweli agasaba Omonene.
Erio Omonene akamotebia, “Otegerere amang’ana abo baragotebie. Tari aye bangire, korende ninche bangire, timba omoruoti obo.
Korwa ekero keria nabarusetie Misiri goika rero iga bantigire inche, babeire bagokorera chinyasae ching’ao, na bono bagotigire aye buna bantigete inche.
Gaki bono, igwera amang’ana abo, korende obakurere mono, obatebie aya omoruoti orache kobagambera arabe ogokora.”
Ase igo Samweli agatebia abanto baria baganetie omoruoti amang’ana onsi Omonene amotebetie.

Akabatebia, “Aya naro omoruoti oyio orabagambere arabakorere: Naire abana baino abamura, ababeke ase chigari chiaye, na abande ababeke babe abariini be chibarasi chiaye bamokorere. Abande babetererigwe baminyoke bosio bwe chigari chiaye.

Abande babekwe babe abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu, na abande b’emerongo etano. Abande babe bakorema emegondo yaye na kogesa endagera yaye, abande babe bakoroisia ebirwanero bi’esegi na ebikorero bie chigari chiaye.
Naire abaiseke baino bachie koba abaroisia amaguta akweakwa, abande babe bakoruga endagera na koroisia emegati.
Naire na emegondo yaino y’endagera, na ey’emesabibu, na ey’emezeituni eyere emiya mono, ayee abasomba baye.
Narusie ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase rigesa riaino ri’emegondo y’endagera, na ey’emesabibu, ayee abwo bakomorenda, na abasomba baye.
Boigo naire abasomba baino, abamura na abaiseke, na abasae baino abaya, babe bakomokorera, ne chitigere chiaino chibe chikomokorera boigo.
Naende arusie ensemo ya ikomi y’amaicho aino, nainwe abanyene mobe abasomba baye.
Ase engaki eyio namobe mokorera nobororo ase engencho y’omoruoti oino, oyio mwechorerete, korende Omonene takoba ogotegerera okorera kwaino.”
Korende abanto bakaanga gotegerera Samweli, bakabora, “Yaya, taibo! Nigo toganetie omoruoti atogambere.
Ntorigetie koba buna ebisaku binde; ntoganetie omoruoti ogotogambera na gototang’ana, ekero togochia korwana chisegi chiaito.”
Ekero Samweli aigwete amang’ana aya abanto bakwanire, akayaira ase Omonene.
Omonene agatebia Samweli, “Igwera amang’ana abo, obachorere omoruoti.” Erio Samweli agatebia Abaisraeli bairane, kera omonto ase omochie oye.
Ase egesaku kia Benjamin narengeo omonto oyomo ore korokwa Kisi, mosinto bw’Abieli, o Serori, o Bekorati bw’Afia, omonto bw’egesaku kia Benjamin. Kisi nigo arenge omonto omonda.

Nabwate omwana omomura ore korokwa Saulo. Ere nigo arenge omonyakieni mono. Momura onde tarenge ase egati y’Abaisraeli obwate ekieni ekiya komobua. Ere nigo aetanetie abanto bande bonsi ase obotambe bw’omotwe korwa ase amareko gochia igoro.
Bono chitigere chia Kisi, ise Saulo, chigasira. Ase igo Kisi agatebia Saulo, “Imoka oire oyomo bw’abasomba, mogende korigia chitigere.”

Bakagenda, bagaeta ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na ense ya Salisa, korende tibachinyora. Naende bagaeta ase ense ya Saalimu, korende chitigere echio tichiarengeo. Nyuma y’ayio bagaeta ase orogongo rwa Benjamin, nonya naroro tibachinyora.

Ekero baigete ase ense ya Sufu, Saulo agatebia omosomba oria barenge komo, “Bono tiga toirane gochia nka. Ande nigo tata aratige korengereria igoro ye chitigere, ne ribaga ri’ayio abe ogotochandekera intwe.”

Omosomba oria akamoiraneria, “Rora, ase omochie oyo omonto o Nyasae nareo, ere nomonto osikire; amang’ana onsi agokwana nigo agoikerana. Eta togende aroro, ande nabo aratotebie amang’ana igoro y’orogendo rwaito.”

Saulo akaboria omosomba oye, “Onye tokogenda ase omonto oyio, inki tobwate tokomoirera? Endagera twabwate ase ebibekerero biaito yaerire, na keegwa kende titobwati tokoirera omonto oyio o Nyasae. Ninki tobwate?”
Omosomba oria akamoiraneria naende, “Rora, nimbwate aa akang’ese gi’esekeli y’efeta. Eye ning’ee omonto oria o Nyasae, erinde atotebie enchera tokogenda.”

(Agwo kare ase Abaisraeli, ekero omonto arenge kogenda koboria ring’ana korwa ase Nyasae nigo arenge goteba, “Inchuo togende ase omorori.” Omonto okorokwa omobani bono, kare nigo arenge korokwa omorori.)
Saulo agatebia omosomba oye, “Gwatebire buya; inchuo togende.” Ase igo bakagenda ase omochie ase omonto oyio o Nyasae arenge.
Ekero barenge gotiira ekegoro gochia ase omochie, bakaumerana nabaiseke baare kogenda kobuucha amache, bakababoria, “Inee! Omorori nao are aa?”
Abaiseke baria bakabairaneria, “Ee, nao are aa, oyio bosio bwaino. Genda bwango momonyore. Mbono achire ase omochie, ekiagera abanto ngochia bare korua ebing’wanso agwo ase ekegoro igoro.

Ekero mogosoa ase omochie namomonyore ritang’ani ataratiira gochia ase ekegoro koragera. Abanto tibakoragera ritang’ani ataraikao, ekiagera ere goika asesenie ekeng’wanso keria. Erio baria barangeirie banyare gochaka koragera. Ase ayio, genda bwango, ekiagera ase engaki eye nero moramonyore.”
Ase ayio bakagenda ase omochie. Ekero barenge gosoa aroro bakarora Samweli ogocha koumerana nabarabwo, ekero arenge gotiira gochia aase agwo bakoruera ebing’wanso.
Bono rituko erimo, ekero Saulo ataracha aroro, Omonene konya omoorokeirie Samweli na omotebirie,

“Ankio engaki buna eye ninkorentere omonto korwa ase orogongo rwa Benjamin, naye omoake amaguta, erinde abe omonene igoro y’abanto baane Abaisraeli. Nere oratoorie abanto baane korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti, ekiagera narorire emechando y’abanto baane, na ekerero kiabo giaikire asende.”
Ekero Samweli aroche Saulo, Omonene akamotebia, “Omonto oyio nere nagotebia amang’ana aye. Oyo nere orabe okogambera abanto baane.”
Erio Saulo akamochiera Samweli agwo ase egeita, akamotebia, “Koranche ontebie ase omorori amenyete.”

Samweli akamoiraneria, “Ninche omorori oyio. Genda motang’ane gochia aase agwo ebing’wanso bikoruerwa, ekiagera rero namorie endagera aroro amo nainche. Ankio ninkoe ribaga ogende, na inche ngotebie amang’ana onsi are ase ebirengererio biao.

Tochandeka ase engencho ye chitigere chiria chiasirete korwa ase amatuko atato aetire, ekiagera echio chianyorekanire. Inee! Ebinto bionsi ebiya bire ase egati y’Abaisraeli nase ng’o birabe? Nigo birabe asore na ase abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya iso.”

Saulo akairaneria akabora, “Inche nomonto bw’egesaku kia Benjamin egesaku egeke mono ase Abaisraeli, na eamate yane nero nenke mono ase chiamate chionsi chi’egesaku ekio. Nase ki rende gwakwanire asende ring’ana ringa buna erio?”
Erio Samweli akaira Saulo amo nomosomba oye, akabasoyia ase enyomba y’abageni, akabaikaransia aase ay’amasikani, ase egati y’abageni bande emerongo etato.
Samweli agatebia omorugi bwe chindagera, “Renta egetari keria nakoa, nkagotebia ng’a okegache ensemo ao.”

Ase ayio omorugi oria bwe chindagera akaimokia ekenama keria ekiya, agakebeka bosio bwa Saulo. Samweli agatebia Saulo, “Rora egetari eke kiagachetwe, kiabekirwe ase obosio bwao; okerie, ekiagera naye gwakegacheretwe ng’a oche gokeria ase engaki eyio ekero abageni barangerigwe.” Ase igo Saulo akaragera na Samweli ase rituko erio.
Ekero batirimbogete korwa aase aria ase ebing’wanso biare koruerwa, bakagenda mwa Samweli kerama igoro, na aroro agwo Samweli akagosoria na Saulo.
Ekero bwachia gokiamoka, Samweli akarangeria Saulo oyorenge ase ekerama igoro, akabora, “Imoka ngokoobe, ogende ase orogendo rwao.” Saulo akaimoka, na barabwo babere bakagenda bare amo.

Ekero baikire ang’e nensinyo y’omochie, Samweli agatebia Saulo, “Tebia omosomba oo aete atang’ane.” Omosomba oria akagenda bosio, na Samweli agatebia Saulo, “Beera aiga ake igo, na inche ningotebie amang’ana aya Nyasae akwanire.”

Erio Samueli akaimokia echuba y’amaguta, akaumorera Saulo ase omotwe, akamonyunyunta, akamotebia, “Omonene ogoakire amaguta obe omotang’ani bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baye. Aye nogambere abanto b’Omonene na kobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo babaetanaine. Eke nakio kerabe ekemanyererio asore ng’a Omonene ogoakire amaguta ng’a obe omotang’ani igoro ase abanto bare omwando oye:

Ekero okorua aa asende rero noumerane nabanto babere ang’e nembeera ya Raeli, ase orogongo rwa Benjamin ase Selisa. Barabwo nigo baragotebie ng’a chitigere chiria mwagendete korigia chiatokire. Iso otigire gochichandekera, na bono naye achandekerete, ogoteba: Naki ndakore indore omwana one?

Erio norueo, ogenderere orogendo, oike ase omote onga buna omotontera ore agwo Tabori. Aroro agwo noumerane nabanto batato bagotiira gochia gosasima Nyasae agwo Beteli. Oyomo obo nabe obwate chimanwa chie chimbori isato, na oyonde obogoretie emegati etato, na oyonde ekerandi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa kere nedivai.
Barabwo mbagokwanie, bakoe emegati ebere, noyianche, oyebogorie korwa ase amaboko abo.

Nyuma y’ayio nogende gochia ekegoro kia Nyasae agwo Gibea, ase egetwori ki’Abafilisti kere. Agwo ase egesoero ki’omochie noumerane nekeombe ki’ababani bagotirimboka korwa ase ekegoro aase agwo ebing’wanso bikoruerwa, babe bakobugia amakano ne chikonu, na ebiroria, na amakano ’ebirigisa. Barabwo mbabe bakobaboka ase okobana.
Erio Omoika bw’Omonene noche igoro yao ne chinguru; naye nobane amo nabarabwo, na oonchorwe obe kore ne chingencho ching’ao.
Bono ekero ebimanyererio ebio birakoreke asore, okore rinde rionsi orarore, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo naye.

Erio ontang’anere gotirimboka gochia Giligali. Inche ninchiche aroro asore ase okorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe. Onganye aroro ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere goika inchiche asore, nkworokie aya ogwenerete gokora.”
Ekaba ekero Saulo eonchorete gotigana na Samweli, Nyasae akaa Saulo enkoro ere ne chingencho ching’ao, na ebimanyererio biria bionsi bigakoreka ase rituko riria.
Ekero Saulo amo nomosomba oye baigete Gibea, ekeombe ekenene ki’ababani gekaumerana nere. Omoika o Nyasae ogacha igoro asare ne chinguru, nere agachaka kobaboka ase okobana ase egati y’ababani baria.

Abanto bonsi abwo konya bamomanyete agwo ritang’ani, ekero bamoroche okobana amo nababani baria, bagakwana barabwo ase barabwo, “Mang’ana ki aya amonyorire omwana o Kisi? Inee! Saulo nere nabeire oyomo bw’ababani?”
Omonto omenyete aase aria akaboria, “Ise nere ng’o?” Ase engencho eyio amang’ana akaba agokwanwa iga: “Inee! Saulo nere nabeire oyomo bw’ababani?”
Ekero Saulo akoorire kobaboka ase okobana, agatiira gochia ase ekegoro aase ebing’wanso biare koruerwa.
Ise moke Saulo akaboria Saulo na omosomba oye, “Ng’ai mwachiete?” Saulo akairaneria, “Nechitigere twagendete korigia, na ekero totachinyorete, tokagenda ase Samweli.”
Ise moke akamotebia, “Koranche ontebie aya Samweli abatebetie.”
Saulo akamoiraneria, “Nigo atotebetie boronge ng’a chitigere chianyorekanire.” Korende amang’ana aya Samweli akwanete igoro y’oboruoti tamoyatebetie.
Erio Samweli akarangeria Abaisraeli basangererekane amo ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo Misipa,
akabatebia, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, otebire iga: Inche nigo nabang’anyetie korwa Misiri, nkabatooria korwa ase amaboko ’abanto b’amaruoti ande onsi, abwo barenge kobachanda.

Korende bono mwangire Nyasae oino oria obatooretie korwa ase obokong’u bwonsi na ogochandwa, mwatebire ng’a: Tobekere omoruoti atogambere. Gaki bono sangererekana ase obosio bw’Omonene, egesaku ase egesaku, na eamate ase eamate.”
Ase igo Samweli akarenta ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli ang’e, na egesaku kia Benjamin kegachorwa ase ogoakerwa obomera.
Ekero arentire egesaku kia Benjamin ang’e, obomera bokagwera eamate ya Matiri, na ase eamate ya Matiri obomera bokagwera Saulo, omomura o Kisi, korende abanto bagachia komorigia tibamonyora.
Erio naende bakaboria Omonene, “Inee! Omonto oyio nachete aa?” Omonene akairaneria, “Rigereria oyio bwebisete ase ebinto bikogachwa.”
Ase ayio bakaminyoka bakamorusia aroro, na ekero atenenete ase egati y’abanto bamoroche ng’a naetanetie abanto bande bonsi ase obotambe bw’omotwe korwa amareko gochia igoro.

Samweli agatebia abanto bonsi, “Aiga moroche ere oyio Omonene achorire. Monto onde tari aa ase egati y’abanto aba bonsi omoreng’aine.” Erio abanto bonsi bagaaka eriogi, bakabora, “Omoruoti oyo achie kare!”

Erio Samweli agatebia abanto buna oboruoti bogwenerete kogambwa, na akarika emeroberio eyio ase ebuku akayebeka ase obosio bw’Omonene. Nyuma y’ayio Samweli akaa abanto ribaga, kera oyomo agende inka bwoye.
Saulo nere akagenda nka bwoye aria Gibea. Abanto bande abanene, abwo Nyasae konya akwanire ne chinkoro chiabo, bakamotunyana.
Korende abanto bande abarenge ababe bakabora, “Naki oyo arakore atotoorie?” Barabwo bakamochaya, tibamoirera biegwa binde. Korende ere akaba buna taigwete aya bakwanete.
Nahasi Omoamoni akagenda, agaetanana Yabesi ase ense ya Gileadi koyorwania esegi. Abanto bonsi ba Yabesi bakamotebia, “Kora okobwatana naintwe, erio tobe inse asore togokorere.”
Nahasi akabairaneria, “Ninkore okobwatana nainwe komoranche ng’a ndusie eriso ria borio ria kera oyomo oino, erinde ndetere Abaisraeli bonsi obosooku.”
Abagaaka ba Yabesi bakamotebia, “Toe ribaga ri’amatuko atano na abere, erinde totome abanto ase chingongo chionsi chi’Abaisraeli. Onde atatogeti oratotoorie, rirorio twerue asore.”
Abatomwa baria bagaika Gibea ase Saulo amenyete, bagatebia abanto b’aroro amang’ana ayio, na abanto bonsi bakarera mono.
Ase ekero ekio Saulo nigo arenge ogocha korwa mogondo ogotema chiombe chiaye, akaboria, “Inki kiaba abanto aba bakorera iga?” Ase ayio bakamotebia amang’ana aria abanto ba Yabesi barentete.
Ekero Saulo aigwete amang’ana ayio, Omoika o Nyasae ogacha igoro asare, okamobeka chinguru; erio Saulo akaba nendamwamu enene.

Akabwata chiombe ibere, agachinachana ebing’ese, erio akaa abanto ebing’ese biria, nabarabwo bakabiira ase chingongo chionsi chi’Abaisraeli, bagateba amang’ana aye, “Omonto onde bwensi otambwateti inche Saulo amo na Samweli, chiombe chiaye nabo chiranachanwe iga.” Erio omoondoko bw’Omonene okabwata abanto, nabarabwo bagacha amo buna omonto oyomo.
Ekero Saulo abarete Abaisraeli agwo Bezeki, nigo barenge chilifu amagana atato (300,000), na Abayuda chilifu emerongo etato (30,000).

Agatebia abanto baria batometwe, “Motebie abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi: Ankio mobaso gati namonyore obosibore.” Abatomwa baria bakairana, bagatebia abanto ba Yabesi amang’ana ayio, na barabwo bakaba nomogoko omonene,
bagatebia Abaamoni, “Ankio inatwerue asemore, motokorere ande onsi morarore arabe buya asemore.”

Rituko ria kabere Saulo akaroberia abanto baye ase ebiombe bitato, na barabwo bagacha mambia kobogokiamoka, bagasoa ase egetwori ki’Abaamoni, bakabaita kogenderera goika mobaso gati. Abwo batigarete bagesiarera, gose onde tatigara ore nonde amo.
Erio Abaisraeli bagatebia Samweli, “Mbarabi baria bakanete ng’a Saulo takobagambera. Renta abanto abwo, tobaite.”
Korende Saulo agakana, agateba, “Monto onde tari oraitwe ase rituko ria rero, ekiagera Omonene orentire obobui ase Abaisraeli.”
Samweli agatebia abanto, “Inchuo togende Giligali, erinde toirore oboruoti obo tobokore bobe oboyia.”

Ase igo abanto bonsi bakagenda Giligali, na aroro agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene bakabeka Saulo akaba omoruoti. Boigo bakarua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, na Saulo amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba nomogoko omonene mono.
Samweli agatebia Abaisraeli bonsi, “Rora, nabeire nkoigwa amang’ana aino; nakorire aya mwamboria, nabekire omoruoti orabagambere.
Bono omoruoti oino oyio orabaraae. Inche bono nagotire, namerire chimbuche; abamura baane nigo bare amo nainwe. Inche nabeire nkobaraa korwa obosae bwane goika rero iga.

Bono inche nao inde aa. Inwe mobe kirori asende ase obosio bw’Omonene na obw’omoakwa amaguta oye. Inee! Neng’ombe ya ng’o nairete? Gose netigere ya ng’o nairete? Ning’o naureretie, gose nakorerete bobe? Gose nkorwa ase okoboko kwa ng’o naetwe riaaki rikang’ukoria amaiso aane? Onye nakorete ayio, nimbairanerie ebio nairete.”
Abanto bakairaneria, “Aye tigwatoriananetie kende, gose tigwatokorerete bobe, gose tikwairete gento ki’omonto onde bwensi.”

Samweli akabatebia, “Rituko ria rero Omonene nigo are kirori asemore, boigo omoakwa amaguta oye nigo are kirori ng’a inwe timonyoreti gento kende gionsi ase okoboko kwane.” Barabwo bakairaneria, “Ee, Omonene nere kirori.”
Samweli agatebia abanto, “Omonene, oria ochorete Musa na Haroni, naende akarenta chisokoro chiaino korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nere kirori.
Gaki bono tenena, mokire‐kiri, erinde mbasoere ase obosio bw’Omonene ase okobainyoria ogokora gwonsi okoronge, okwo Omonene abakorerete inwe ne chisokoro chiaino.

Ekero Yakobo asoete Misiri, na Abamisiri bakabachanda, chisokoro chiaino chikarera ase Omonene ng’a achikonye, na Omonene agatoma Musa na Haroni. Barabwo bakabang’anyia korwa Misiri, bakabarenta bamenye ase ense eye.

Korende barabwo bakeba Omonene, Nyasae obo. Ase igo ere akababeka ase amaboko a Sisera, omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’omochie o Hazori na ay’Abafilisti, na ay’omoruoti bw’Abamoabu, nabarabwo bakabarwania.

Ase igo bakarera ase Omonene, bakabora; Twakorire ebibe, ekiagera twatigire Omonene; twakoreire chinyasae chiria chikorokwa Baali na Asitaroti. Bono totoorie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baito, naintwe ntogokorere aye.
Erio Omonene agatoma Yeruba‐Baali, na Baraki, na Yefita, na inche Samweli, akabatooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baino babaetanaine, nainwe mokaba mokomenya ase obotoereru.
Korende ekero mwaroche Nahasi, omoruoti bw’Abaamoni, ogocha kobarwania mogantebia: Ntorigetie omoruoti oratogambere, nonya Omonene orenge omoruoti oino.
“Gaki bono morigererie omoruoti oino mwachorire, oyo mwaboria moegwe. Rora, Omonene obekire omoruoti abagambere.
Komoramoiroke Omonene na komokorera, na koigwa eriogi riaye, na timwanga koigwera amachiko aye, naende onye inwe amo nomoruoti oyo okobagambera mokomotunyana Omonene, Nyasae oino, rirorio nebe buya.
Motaigwereti eriogi ri’Omonene, korende mokwanga koigwera amachiko aya, rirorio okoboko kwaye nigo korabe mamincha yaino buna kwarenge mamincha ye chisokoro chiaino.
Bono tenena, mokire‐kiri, morore ring’ana eri rinene Omonene arakore ase amaiso aino.
Inee! Bono tari engaki ye rigesa ri’engano? Nonya nabo nimosabe Omonene arente enkoba na embura, erinde momanye ng’a mwakorire obobe obonene ase okoboria ng’a moegwe omoruoti.”
Ase igo Samweli agasaba Omonene, nere agatoma enkoba na embura ase rituko riria. Abanto bonsi bakoboa Omonene, bakoboa na Samweli.
Bagatebia Samweli, “Tosabere intwe, abasomba bao, ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, erinde titokwa. Twarorire ng’a amo nebibe biaito bionsi twamentire ebibe binde ebiaao bi’okoboria ng’a toegwe omoruoti.”
Samweli akabairaneria, “Timwoboa! Amaene, mwakorire amabe aya onsi, korende nonya nabo, timobaisa koonchoka gochia ensemo na gotiga koigwera Omonene, korende momokorere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi.
Timoonchokera chinyasae chire bosa chitanyare kobakonya gose kobatooria, ekiagera nigo chire bosa.
Ase engencho y’erieta riaye Omonene takobaanga inwe abanto baye, ekiagera nigo anchete kobakora mobe abaye.
Amang’ana ayio abe aare nainche ng’a ninkore ebibe ase Omonene ase ogotiga kobasabera inwe. Ribaga ri’ayio nimborokie enchera ere engiya na endonge.
Moiroke Omonene bweka, momokorere ase obwegenwa bwe chinkoro chiaino chionsi, mobe mokoinyora aya onsi amanene abakoreire.
Korende onye mokogenderera gokora ebibe, rirorio nigo morasirigwe amo nomoruoti oino.”
Saulo konya ogambire omwaka oyomo, na omwaka o kabere ekero agendererete kogambera Abaisraeli,

agachora abanto chilifu isato. Ase abwo abanto chilifu ibere bakaba amo nere agwo Mikimasi na ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Beteli, na abanto elifu eyemo bakaba amo na Yonathani aaria Gibea, ase orogongo rwa Benjamin. Abatigarete akabaa ribaga bakagenda kera omonto nka bwoye.
Yonathani agaita omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’Abafilisti agwo Gibea, na Abafilisti bakaigwa amang’ana ayio. Saulo akabugia egetureri ase ense eria yonsi, agateba, “Tiga Abaibirania baigwe.”

Ase igo Abaisraeli bonsi bakaigwa amang’ana agokwanwa ng’a Saulo oitire omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’Abafilisti, naende ng’a Abaisraeli babeire okogechia ase Abafilisti. Abanto bakarangerigwa babwatane na Saulo bagende Giligali.

Erio Abafilisti bagasangererekana amo barwanie Abaisraeli. Nigo barenge ne chigari chilifu emerongo etato (30,000), na abariini chibarasi chilifu isano nemo (6,000), na abarwani bande abange buna omokenye ore engegu y’enyancha. Barabwo bagacha, bagatoora agwo Mikimasi, moocha ya Beti‐Aveni.
Abaisraeli bagachia korora ng’a bamigirwe nobokong’u, bagatang’ang’a na kwebisa ase amabwago, na ase chinsana na ebitare ime, nonya nase chingoro na ase amakuruma.
Abaibirania bande bakaamboka Yorodan, bakagenda ase ense ya Gadi na Gileadi. Korende Saulo ere nao atigarete agwo Giligali, na abanto bonsi abamotunyanete baare koiguswa ase obwoba.
Saulo akaganya Samweli amatuko atano na abere, buna Samweli konya amotebirie, na ekiagera Samweli atebanete abanto bagachaka goserebekana na gotiga Saulo.
Ase igo Saulo agateba, “Ndetere aa ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na eki’omorembe.” Erio akarua ekeng’wanso keria ki’ogosambwa.
Erio agwo ekero akoorire korua ekeng’wanso keria, Samweli agacha. Saulo akagenda komorotota na komokwania.

Samweli akamoboria, “Inki eke gwakorire?” Saulo akamoiraneria, “Nigo narora ng’a abanto ngotama bare korwa asende, naende naye gwatebana, tocheti ase engaki eria gwatebete ng’a nochiche. Boigo Abafilisti konya basangererekanire agwo Mikimasi.
Erio nkarengereria: Bono Abafilisti mbabaise gocha asende aa Giligali ritang’ani ntaraboria ogwancherwa korwa ase Omonene. Ase igo ayio akambetereria korua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.”

Samweli akamotebia, “Gwakorire egento ki’oboriri. Tikwabwatete ogochika okwo Omonene, Nyasae oo, akoete. Onye nkwaigwerete, Omonene anga nakora oboruoti bwao bobe obokong’u, bogenderere kobao botambe ase Abaisraeli.
Korende bono oboruoti bwao tibokogenderera. Omonene bwerigeirie omonto onde omogokirie ase enkoro yaye, omochikire ng’a abe okogambera abanto baye, ekiagera aye toigwereti aya Omonene agochigete.”
Erio Samweli akaimoka, akarua Giligali, akagenda Gibea ase orogongo rwa Benjamin. Na Saulo akabara abanto abatigarete amo nere, na barabwo nigo barenge koreng’ana amagana atano na rimo.
Saulo, na Yonathani momura oye, amo nabanto barenge amo nabarabwo bakabeera agwo Geba o Benjamin, korende Abafilisti bagatoora agwo Mikimasi.
Ebiombe bitato bi’abarwani bikarua ase egetwori ki’Abafilisti; ekeombe ekemo gekaonchoka gochia Ofura, ase ense ya Sauli,
na egia kabere gekagenda Beti‐Horoni, na ekende gochia ase orobebe rorochie Rikura ria Seboimu na erooro.
Ase engaki eria omoturi ebioma tarenge ase ense yonsi y’Abaisraeli, ekiagera Abafilisti nigo boboete ng’a Abaisraeli mbabaise gweturera emioro gose amatimo.
Korende kera oyomo bw’Abaisraeli, oyo oganetie gotieria obokombe bwaye, gose ekoyo, gose egesire, gose omoyio oye, goika agende ase Abafilisti.
Nigo barenge goakana ekeng’ese gi’esekeli ase ogotiererigwa obokombe na ekoyo, na ebing’ese bibere bi’esekeli, ase ogotiererigwa egesire, na kogechoma ase ogokerambora.
Bono ase rituko ri’esegi onde tarenge ase abarwani ba Saulo na Yonathani, nonya noyomo, obwate omoro gose ritimo. Saulo bweka na Yonathani, momoura oye, nabwo barenge nabio.
Ekeombe ki’abarwani b’Abafilisti kegatomwa korenda enchera egochia ase Mikimasi.

Rituko erimo Yonathani, omomura o Saulo, agatebia omomura oyorenge komobogoreria ebirwanero. “Inchuo togende gochia ase eburi y’abarwani b’Abafilisti korwa ensinyo ngumbu.” Korende tatebetie ise amang’ana ayio.
Saulo nigo arenge otoorete ase orobebe rwa Gibea inse y’omote okorokwa omokomomanga agwo Migironi, na abanto abarenge amo nere nigo barenge koreng’ana amagana atano na rimo (600).

Oyo orenge kobogoria egesibao ki’obokuani nere Ahia, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, momura omwabo Ikabodi. Ahitubu nere orenge mosinto o Finehasi o Eli, omokuani bw’Omonene agwo Silo. Abanto tibamanyete ng’a Yonathani konya ochiire.
Agwo ase Yonathani arigetie goetera ase ogoika eburi y’Abafilisti mbiarengeo ebitare bibere ebioge, ekemo kera ensemo y’oboeto. Ekemo kiarenge korokwa Bosesei na ekende Sene.
Egetare ekemo nigo giachongororogete ensemo ya sugusu kororia Mikimasi, na ekende ensemo ya irianyi kororia Geba.

Yonathani agatebia omomura oria omobogoreretie ebirwanero. “Inchuo togende gochia ng’umbu ase eburi y’abanto aba batarogeti. Ande nabo Omonene arakore egento asetore. Kende tikeri keratange Omonene tatokonya tobue, gatorabe abake gose abange.”
Omomura oria akamoiraneria, “Kora onsi ayare ase ebirengererio biao. Genda, inche nigo inde amo naye, ninkore buna oganetie.”
Erio Yonathani akamotebia, “Twamboke gochia aroro, tweorokie ase abanto aba.
Kobaratotebie: Tenena agwo moganye, intwe tochiche asemore; erio totenene aase aito, titogenda asebare.
Korende kobaratotebie: Inchuo, tiira gocha aa asetore, erio totiire, ekiagera ekio nakio kerabe ekemanyererio asetore ng’a Omonene obabekire ase amaboko aito.”
Ase igo barabwo babere bakeorokia ase Abafilisti abwo barenge ase eburi, na barabwo bagateba, “Rigereria, Abaibirania abwo bagosoka korwa ase chingoro ase bebisete.”

Erio abarendi babo b’eburi bakarangeria Yonathani amo nomobogoreria bw’ebirwanero biaye, bakabatebia, “Inchuo tiira gocha aa asetore, tobatebie ring’ana.” Yonathani agatebia omomura oria, “Mbwatie, totiire gochia aroro, ekiagera Omonene obabekire ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli.”

Bono Yonathani akagura gotiira namaboko na amagoro, na omobogoreria bw’ebirwanero biaye akamobwatia korwa nyuma, Yonathani agaakera Abafilisti inse, na omomura oria orenge komobwatia korwa nyuma, akabaita.

Ase ogoita okwo kwe ritang’ani, okwo Yonathani na omomura oria bakorete, nigo baitete abanto koreng’ana emerongo ebere ase egetii kiarenge keng’ana ekeng’ese ki’omogondo oremire ne chiombe ibere ase rituko erimo.

Omoondoko ogasoa ase abanto bonsi b’egetwori agwo ase egetii. Abanto b’eburi amo nabwo barenge abasakori, bonsi bagatengechigwa nomoondoko; goika nonya nense egatengechigwa. Omoondoko oria omonene nigo orwete ase Omonene.
Abarendi ba Saulo abarendete agwo Gibea ase orogongo rwa Benjamin bakarora Abafilisti baburukanire na goserebekana, bakominyoka gochia aaria na aaria.
Erio Saulo agatebia abanto abwo barenge nere, “Bara abanto morore gose ning’o otari aa asetore.” Na ekero bababarete bakarora ng’a Yonathani na omomura oyorenge komobogoreria ebirwanero tibaiyo.
Saulo agatebia Abiya, “Renta Esanduku ya Nyasae aiga.” (Ase engaki eria Esanduku eria nigo yarenge ase Abaisraeli.)
Ekero Saulo agendererete gokwana nomokuani, eburu‐buru eyarenge ase egetwori ki’Abafilisti ekamentekana kobucha. Ase ayio Saulo akamotebia, “Tiga, tobaisa koboria Omonene.”

Erio Saulo na abanto bonsi abarenge amo nere bagasangererekana amo, bagasoa ase esegi eria. Kobaikire agwo bakarora ng’a Abafilisti baitanire, kera oyomo noyonde nomoro, na eburu‐buru eria ekaba enene inono.
Bono Abaibirania abwo babwataine n’Abafilisti korwa agwo kare na komenya amo nabarabwo ase egetwori kiabo, bakairana bakabwatana n’Abaisraeli abwo barenge gotang’anwa na Saulo na Yonathani.
Boigo Abaisraeli bande, abwo konya bebisire ase ebitunwa bi’ense y’Efraimu, ekero baigwete ng’a Abafilisti batamire, nabarabwo bakababwatia nomokia gochia kobarwania
Esegi eria ekagendererera korwanwa goika ng’umbu ya Beti‐Aveni. Igo Omonene agatooria Abaisraeli ase rituko riria.

Ase rituko riria Abaisraeli bagachandeka mono na kogoya, ekiagera Saulo atianetie abanto, agateba, “Aragererigwe omonto onde bwensi orarie gento omogoroba otaraika na ntarakoora korusia egesiomba ase ababisa baane.” Ase ayio, omonto onde tabete okoria endagera ase rituko riria.
Abanto bonsi bagacha ase rinani, na aroro agwo bakarora obooke bore inse.
Ekero basoete rinani erio bakarora ng’a riaichoire nobooke, onde taboriete, ekiagera nigo bairogete okoragereria koria gwa Saulo.

Korende Yonathani taigwete ekero ise achigete abanto ase okobatiania ng’a tibaria kende. Ase ayio, akarambaria enyimbo yarenge koboko kwaye akayechobia ase eriana rire nobooke ime, akaribwata, akariria. Erio amaiso aye akarora buya.

Korende omonto oyomo akamotebia, “Iso nigo abegete ogochika ogokong’u, agatiania abanto, akabatebia: Aragererigwe omonto onde bwensi orarie endagera ende yonsi ase rituko ria rero.” Na abanto abwo bakaborwa chinguru, bakagoyana ase enchara.
Erio Yonathani akairaneria, akabora, “Tata ochandire ense eye. Rora bono nkorora inde buya, ekiagera naria obooke boke.
Naki nanga yare gocha koba buya rituko ria rero, onye abanto mbabete ne ribaga ri’okoria na koigota ase ebisakorwa basakorete korwa ase ababisa babo. Nanga nigo twabua Abafilisti mono kobua.”
Ase rituko riria Abaisraeli bagaita Abafilisti gochakera korwa Mikimasi goikera Ayaloni. Abaisraeli bakarosa mono ase okogoya, bare nenchara.
Ase ayio bakarindoka na koumokera ebisakorwa, bakaira ching’ondi ne chiombe, ne chimori, bagachinyenya na gochiria chire namanyinga ime yabo.
Ekero Saulo atebetigwe ng’a abanto bakorire ebibe ase Omonene ase okoria chinyama chire namanyinga ime yabo, akabora. “Mwakorire ogosaria. Bono torunkania rigena rinene gocha aiga asende.”

Naende Saulo akabatebia, “Genda mwesiarerere gochia ase abanto, mobatebie ng’a kera omonto obwate eng’ombe gose eng’ondi ayerente ayenyenyere aiga, ariere chinyama echio aiga, tabaisa gokora ebibe ase Omonene ase okoria chinyama chire namanyinga ime yaye.” Ase ayio ase obotuko obwo kera omonto akarenta eng’ombe yaye agwo akayenyenyerao.
Agwo Saulo akaagachera Omonene egesasimero; ekio nakio egesasimero egetang’ani aagacherete Omonene.

Saulo agatebia abanto, “Inchuo, tochiere Abafilisti ase obotuko obo, tobasakore goika mambia kobogokiamoka; titotiga monto onde nonya noyomo abe moyo.” Bakamoiraneria, “Kora aya orarore are buya.” Korende omokuani akabatebia, “Ritang’ani, toike Nyasae ang’e aiga, tomoborie.”
Erio Saulo akaboria Nyasae, “Inee! Ndatirimboka mbwatie Abafilisti? Nobarue obabeke ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli?” Korende Nyasae tamoiraneretie ase rituko erio.
Ase ayio Saulo agatebia abatang’ani bonsi b’abanto, “Suka gocha ang’e aa, morore na komanya ng’a mbibe ki biakorirwe aiga rero.
Ekeene, buna Omonene, are moyo, oyo ogotooria Abaisraeli, neba ng’a Yonathani, omwana one, okorire ebibe ebio, ere goika aitwe akwe.” Korende monto onde tamoiraneretie, nonya noyomo.
Erio Saulo agatebia Abaisraeli bonsi, “Inwe beera ensemo eyemo, na inche amo na Yonathani, omwana one, tobeere ensemo ende.” Abanto bakamoiraneria, “Kora aya orarore are buya.”

Ase igo Saulo akabora, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nase ki kwangire koiraneria omosomba oo rituko ria rero? Onye okomocha okwo nokwane, gose nokwa Yonathani, omwana one, iraneria ase enchera y’obomera bwa Urimu, konye kore okw’Abaisraeli iraneria na Tumimu.” Igo obomera bokagwera Saulo na Yonathani, na abanto bagatooreka.
Saulo agateba, “Aka obomera ase egati yane na Yonathani, omwana one.” Obomera bokagwera Yonathani.

Erio Saulo agatebia Yonathani, “Ntebie amang’ana gwakorire.” Yonathani agateba, “Nigo nachobia mesia y’enyimbo yarenge koboko kwane ase eriana rire nobooke, nkariria; ase ayio, nao inde aa, bono goika nkwe.”
Saulo agateba, “Nyasae ang’e egesusuro ekenene. Ekeene, aye Yonathani goika okwe.”

Erio abanto bagatebia Saulo, “Inee! Yonathani, oyorentire obobui obonene iga, nere igo araitwe akwe? Yaya, taibo. Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, nonya nagatukia akamo k’omotwe oye tigakogwa inse ase riroba, ekiagera ase ogokonywa kwa Nyasae orentire obobui obwo ase rituko ria rero.” Ase igo abanto bagatooria Yonathani, takwa.
Nyuma y’ayio Saulo agatiga kobwatia Abafilisti; bakairana gochia nka sobo.

Ekero Saulo abeire omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, akaba okorwania ababisa baye bonsi abamenyete ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi: Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abaedomu, na abaruoti ba Soba, amo na Abafilisti. Akaba okobua abanto bonsi abwo arwanetie.
Akarwana noboremu, akabua nonya n’Abaameleki, na agatooria Abaisraeli korwa ase amaboko abwo konya babasakoire.
Abana abamura ba Saulo nabwo aba: Yonathani, na Isivi, na Malikisua; na amarieta ’abaiseke baye babere naro aya: omoiseke omotangi Merabu, na oria omoke Mikali.
Moga Saulo nigo arenge korokwa Ahinoamu omosubati bw’Ahimasi. Omochiki bw’abarwani b’esegi nigo arenge korokwa Abineri, mosinto o Neri, oyorenge ise moke Saulo.
Kisi, ise Saulo, na Neri, ise Abineri, nigo barenge basinto b’Abieli.

Ase amatuko onsi Saulo arenge moyo akaba okorwana esegi entindi n’Abafilisti. Aande onsi Saulo arenge korora omonto orenge ne chinguru na orenge omoremu nigo amobegete kobeera amo nabarwani baye b’esegi.
Samweli agatebia Saulo, “Ninche oria Omonene atomete kogoaka amaguta okaba omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, abanto baye. Ase ayio, tegerera bono oigwe amang’ana ’Omonene.
Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Ngochia inde korua egesusuro ase Abaameleki, ekiagera barabwo batangete Abaisraeli, ekero barenge ase orogendo rwabo korwa Misiri.

Ase ayio, genda oite Abaameleki, obasirie kegima, osirie nebinto bionsi babwate. Tobaisa kobatiga babe moyo, korende oite bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, abana na ebing’werere; oite ne chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ne chingamia ne chitigere.”
Erio Saulo akarangeria abanto, akabaroberia agwo Telaimu. Abarwani b’esegi abarenge gotaara namagoro nigo baare chilifu amagana abere (200,000), amo nabwo korwa ase Abayuda chilifu ikomi (10,000).
Saulo akagenda ase omochie bw’Abaameleki, akababoera agwo ase rigoko.

Erio agatebia Abakeni, “Eongore, morue ase Abaameleki timbaisa kobasiria amo nabarabwo. Inwe nigo mwabete abaya ase Abaisraeli, ekero baare korua Misiri.” Ase ayio Abakeni bakeongora, bakarua ase Abaameleki.
Saulo akarwania Abaameleki akababua, gochakera Havila goikera Suri, moocha ya Misiri.
Akabwata Agagi, omoruoti bw’Abaameleki, akamotiga ore moyo, korende abande bonsi pi akabaita nemioro.

Saulo amo nabanto baye bagatiga Agagi ore moyo; boigo bagatiga ching’ondi chingiya, ne chiombe, ne chimori chinoru, ne chimanwa chie ching’ondi, na echi chionsi chiarenge chingiya. Echio chionsi tibanchete gochisiria, korende bagasiria chionsi echio chiarenge chindeu ne chimbe.
Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Samweli, rikamotebia,

“Naichanire ekiagera nabegete Saulo koba omoruoti, ere oonchokire, otigire konyigwera na tabwateti amachiko aane.” Ayio akamoichania Samweli, erinde akaba okorera ase Omonene obotuko obogima ng’a akonywe.
Rituko ria kabere Samweli akaimoka mambia chuni, agachia konyorana na Saulo, agateberigwa agwo ng’a Saulo nachicha Karimeli ase okweroiseria ekeinyorio, naende ogendire Giligali.
Erio Samweli akagenda ase Saulo, na Saulo akamokwania, akamotebia, “Omonene agosesenie. Naikeranirie aya Omonene anchigete.”
Samweli akamoboria, “Inee! Eriogi eri ri’okwana gwe ching’ondi na ogwe chiombe inyigwete namato aane, neriaki?”

Saulo akamoiraneria, “Abanto mbarenta ching’ondi ne chiombe korwa ase Abaameleki; nigo batiga echio chingiya mono chire moyo, erinde bachirue chibe ekeng’wanso ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, korende echinde chionsi nigo twachisiria kegima.”
Erio Samweli akamotebia, “Kirakiri! Ngotebie aya Omonene antebetie ase obotuko obo bwaetete.” Saulo agateba, “Kwana aye!”
Samweli akamotebia, “Nonya kwaroche aye omonyene ng’a toisaini gento, Inee, aye tori omotang’ani ase ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli? Omonene igo akoagete amaguta obe omoruoti ase Abaisraeli.
Omonene nigo agotomete, akagochika ogende, osirie kegima Abaameleki, abanto abwo ababe, obarwanie goika obaite obakoore.
