Nase ki rende otaigwerete aya Omonene agochigete? Nase ki kwarindokerete na koumokera ebisakorwa, ogakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene?”
Saulo akairaneria Samweli, “Ee, naigwera aya Omonene antebetie; nagenda aase antomete, nkarenta Agagi, omoruoti bw’Abaameleki, nigo naita kegima Abaameleki bande bonsi.

Korende abanto mbarenta korwa ase ebisakorwa ching’ondi ne chiombe, echio chingiya mono chiaatananetwe ase ogosirigwa; mbachirenta, erinde bachirue chibe ekeng’wanso agwo Giligali ase Omonene, Nyasae oo.”

Erio Samweli akamotebia, “Inee! Igo okorengereria ng’a Omonene nagokerete ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde kobua okomoigwera? Naama! Okoigwera nokuya kobua ebing’wanso, na ogotegerera nokuya kobua ebitinya bie chimingichi.

Ogosaria kw’ogotaigwera nigo konga buna ebibe bi’oborogi, na oboenenu nigo bonga buna ebibe bi’ogosasima emegwekano. Ekiagera kwangire ring’ana ri’Omonene, nere boigo okwangire, tokogenderera koba omoruoti.”
Erio Saulo agatebia Samweli, “Nakorire ebibe, ekiagera nasaririe ogochika kw’Omonene na amang’ana ao gwantebetie. Nigo nairogete abanto, nkaba nkoigwera okogania kwabo.
Gaki bono nagosabire, onyabere ebibe biane, oirane amo nainche, erinde inyare gosasima Omonene.”
Samweli agakania Saulo, akamotebia, “Tinkonyara koirana amo naye, ekiagera kwangire ring’ana ri’Omonene, na Omonene okwangire, toba omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli.”
Ekero Samweli arenge kweonchora kogenda, Saulo akabwata omokoba bw’eanga yaye y’okwambara, nero egatandoka.
Erio Samweli akamotebia, “Rituko ria rero Omonene otandoire oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli, naborobwo bwarure asore, oboeire omonto omoao ore omuya gokobua.
Nyasae, oyore Obonene bw’Abaisraeli, tagokwana oborimo, gose takweitia. Ere tari mwanyabanto erinde eitie.”
Saulo agateba, “Inche nakorire ebibe, korende bono insike ase amaiso ’abagaaka b’abanto baane, na ase Abaisraeli; irana amo nainche, erio ngende gosasima Omonene, Nyasae oo.”
Erio Samweli akairana, akabwatia Saulo, na Saulo agasasima Omonene.
Samweli akabora, “Ndetera Agagi, omoruoti bw’Abaameleki, aiga.” Agagi agacha asare, ore nomogoko agakwana, “Ekeene, obororo bw’amakweri bwaerire.”

Korende Samweli akamotebia, “Buna omoro oo otigire abakungu bare bosa batari nabana, naboigo nyoko agochia gotigwa bosa atari nomwana ase egati y’abakungu bande.” Na aroro agwo Samweli akanachana Agagi ebing’ese ase obosio bw’Omonene.
Erio Samweli akagenda Rama, na Saulo akagenda bwoye agwo Gibea o Saulo.

Korwa ase engaki eyio Samweli tagendete korora Saulo naende nonya ng’ake, korende akagenderera koba nomoichano ase engencho yaye. Na Omonene agaichana, ekiagera konya abekire Saulo koba omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli.

Omonene agatebia Samweli, “Ngoika ririri oragenderere koba nomoichano ase engencho ya Saulo. Inche namwangire, takogenderera koba omoruoti, bw’Abaisraeli. Ichoria orogunchara rwao amaguta, ngotome ogende o Yese, omonto o Bethlehemu, ekiagera nechoreire oyomo bw’abamura baye abe omoruoti.”
Erio Samweli akamoboria, “Naki ndakore ngende? Saulo aise koigwa amang’ana ayio, nigo arang’ite.” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Bwata ritororo, oriire, otebe ng’a: Nekeng’wanso nachire komoruera Omonene.
Orangerie Yese ache ase ekeng’wanso, nainche ninkworokie aya orakore, erio oake omonto oyo ndagotebie amaguta.”
Samweli agakora ayio Omonene amochigete, akagenda Bethlehemu. Abagaaka b’omochie oria bagacha komorotota bakoiguswa bakamoboria, “Inee! Ngwachire namang’ana ’omorembe?”

Samweli akabairaneria, “Ee, nachire nomorembe. Nigo nachire imoruere Omonene ekeng’wanso. Echene inwe abanyene, moche amo nainche ase ekeng’wanso ekio.” Erio agachena Yese amo nabamura baye na akabarangeria bache ase ekeng’wanso ekio.
Ekero bachete agwo, Samweli akarigereria Eliabu, erio akarengereria, “Ekeene, omonto oyo oteneine aiga ase obosio bw’Omonene, nere omoakwa amaguta oye.”

Korende Omonene agatebia Samweli, “Torigereria ekieni kiaye, gose obotambe na obuya bw’ogokina kwaye; oyio namwangire, ekiagera tindi korigereria buna mwanyabanto akorigereria. Mwanyabanto nigo akorora ekieni gia isiko, korende inche Omonene nigo nkorora ime y’enkoro.”
Erio Yese akarangeria Aminadabu, akamoetia ase obosio bwa Samweli. Samweli agateba, “Nonya noyo, Omonene tamochoreti.”
Yese akarenta Sama. Boigo Samweli agateba, “Omonene tamochoreti oyo.”
Yese akarenta abamura baye batano na babere bagaeta ase obosio bwa Samweli, korende Samweli akamotebia, “Omonene tachoreti onde omo ase aba.”

Naende akaboria Yese, “Inee! Abamura bao bonsi nabwo aba?” Yese akamoiraneria, “Omoke omwabo nagatigarete korisia ching’ondi.” Erio Samweli agatebia Yese, “Toma omonto achie komorenta, titogoikaransa koragera ere ataracha aiga.”

Erio Yese agatoma omonto korenta omwana oria omoke, Omwana oria nigo arenge omobariri, obwate amaiso amaya, naende orenge omonyakieni. Omonene agatebia Samweli. “Omomura oria nere oyio, moake amaguta.”

Ase ayio Samweli akaimokia orogunchara rore namaguta, na agwo ase amasio ’abamura bamwabo agaaka Daudi amaguta. Omoika bw’Omonene ogacha igoro ase Daudi, na korwa rituko riria okabeera asare kogenderera. Erio Samweli akarua agwo, akairana Rama.
Omoika bw’Omonene konya orure ase Saulo, omotigire, na omoika omobe okorwa ase Omonene okaba okomochanda.
Abasomba baye bakamotebia, “Rigereria bono, Omoika omobe okorwa ase Nyasae nkogochanda ore.

Gaki, omonene oito, tochike intwe abasomba bao, tokorigerie omonto omanyete kobugia obokano buya, na ekero omoika oyio omobe okorwa ase Nyasae ogocha igoro asore, omonto oyio nabe okobugia obokano, erinde aye obe buya naende.”
Saulo akabatebia, “Mbuya, mondigerie omonto omanyete kobugia obokano buya momondetere aiga asende.”

Erio oyomo bw’abasomba baye akamotebia, “Yese, omonto o Bethlehemu, nabwate omomura omanyete kobugia obokano buya. Ere nigo are omonto omoremu, omanyete korwana esegi; amo nayio nigo are omonyakieni, omanyete gokwana buya, na Omonene nigo are amo nere.”
Ase ayio Saulo agatoma abanto gotebia Yese, “Ntomere Daudi, omwana oo omomura, oyio okorisia ching’ondi.”
Yese akaimokia etigere, akayeberekia emegati na ekerandi kerosirie korwa ase amasankwa kere nedivai, akaimokia nemanwa y’embori, akaa Daudi, omwana oye ebinto ebio, akamotoma gochia ase Saulo.
Daudi agacha o Saulo, agachaka komokorera. Saulo akaba omwanchete mono, goika Daudi akaba okomobogoreria ebirwanero.
Erio Saulo agatoma amang’ana ase Yese, akamotebia, “Tiga Daudi abeere aiga abe ogonkorera, ekiagera namwanchire mono.”

Ase engaki ende yonsi omoika oria omobe okorwa ase Nyasae ore gocha igoro ase Saulo, Daudi igo are okobugia obokano. Erio omoika oria omobe oba okorua ase Saulo, nere oba ogokanyeka na kweigwa buya naende.
Abafilisti bagasangereria abarwani babo korwana esegi agwo Soko, omochie ore ase orogongo rwa Yuda. Bagatoora aase akorokwa Efesi‐Damimu, egati ya Soko na Aseka.
Saulo amo n’Abaisraeli bagasangererekana, bagatoora ase ense omweremo ekorokwa Ela; nabarabwo bakarobera korwana n’Abafilisti.
Abafilisti bagatenena ase egetunwa ekemo, na Abaisraeli ase ekende, ne rikura ndiarenge ase egati yabo.

Erio agwo omonto ore korokwa Goliato, omonto bw’omochie o Gati, akaoroka korwa ase egetwori ki’Abafilisti. Ere nigo arenge etuoni y’esegi; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano na rimo na ekeng’ese.
Nigo abegete ekegogwa gi’etaai na egoti yaroisirie korwa ase ebioma, na oborito bw’egoti eyio nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiro emerongo etano, na isano na ibere (57).
Ase amagoro aye nigo anaarete ebitange bi’etaai, boigo nabwate esimisi y’etaai abegete ireko.

Orotanga rwe ritimo riaye nigo rware buna omwaro omonene na oborito bw’ensonga ye ritimo riaye nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiro isano na ibere. Omonto ore komobogoreria enguba nigo arenge komotang’ana.

Goliato agacha bosio, agaaka eriogi ase abarwani b’Abaisraeli, akabora, “Nase ki mwachire na korobera ase okorwana esegi? Inee! Inche tindi Omofilisti, nainwe nabasomba ba Saulo? Chora omonto oyomo oino ache aa asende.
Omonto oyio karanyare korwana nainche na kong’ita, rirorio intwe natobe abasomba baino, korende kondamobue na komoita, rirorio inwe mobe abasomba baito, motokorere.”
Omofilisti oria akagenderera gokwana, agateba, “Nachayire emeganda y’abarwani b’Abaisraeli ase rituko ria rero. Ing’a omonto, torwane nere.”
Ekero Saulo amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi baigwete amang’ana ’Omofilisti oria, bagaichana na kwoboa mono.
Daudi nigo arenge omwana o Yese, Omoefarati korwa Bethlehemu ase orogongo rwa Yuda. Yese nigo abwate abamura batano na batato, na ase amatuko aria Saulo arenge omoruoti, Yese konya ogotire mono.
Abamura baye batato abanene konya bachiire korwana esegi amo na Saulo. Omomura oria omotangi nigo are korokwa Eliabu na oyo o kabere Abinadabu, na oyo o gatato Sama.
Daudi nere orenge omoke ase bonsi. Abwo batato abanene bakaba bakomobwatia Saulo.
Korende engaki ase engaki Daudi nigo arenge gotiga Saulo ogenda Bethlehemu korisia ching’ondi chia ise.
Ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, chimambia na emegoroba, Omofilisti oria nigo arenge gocha bosio, otenenao.
Rituko erimo Yese agatebia Daudi, omwana oye, “Imokia ebigara ebi bisambire, ebitonga bibere, oimokie nemegati eye ikomi ogende bwango, obiirere bamura bamino aaria ase egetwori.

Boigo oirere omochiki obo bw’abarwani elifu eyemo amabomba aya ikomi ay’amabeere abwatanire. Orore gose bamura bamino mbuya bare, naende ondetere ekemanyererio gete korwa asebare, erinde imanye buna bagendererete.
Saulo, na bamura bamino, na Abaisraeli bonsi nao bakare ase ense omweremo ya Ela korwana n’Abafilisti.”

Rituko ria kabere, mambia chuni, Daudi agatigera omonto onde okorisia ching’ondi, akaimokia chindagera chiria, akagenda buna Yese konya amochikire. Ekero aigete ensinyo y’egetwori ase chigari chiabekire chigekengerete, akanyora emeganda konya yarobeire gochia korwana esegi yarenge goaka eriogi ri’esegi.
Abaisraeli bakeroberia ase okorwana na Abafilisti boigo, na emeganda eyio ebere nigo yarigereranetie.
Daudi agatiga endagera eyio ase omorendi bw’ebinto bi’esegi, akaminyoka gochia ase abarwani. Gaikireo agakwania abamwabo.

Ekero Daudi arenge gokwana nabarabwo, Goliato, etuoni eria, Omofilisti korwa Gati, akarua aase Abafilisti baroberete, akagenda bosio, agakwana amang’ana aria anarete gokwana botambe, na Daudi akayaigwa.
Ekero Abaisraeli baroche Goliato, bagatama bonsi, bakamwoboa mono.

Abaisraeli bagakwana na gotebania, “Moroche omonto oria ogocha? Nigo agocha gotochaya intwe Abaisraeli. Omoruoti oito naria eira ng’a natenenkie omonto oraite Goliato. Boigo namoe omoiseke oye abe mokaye, naende eamate yaye etigwe, teaka ebango ase egati y’Abaisraeli.”

Erio Daudi agakwana nabanto bateneine ang’e nere, akababoria, “Inee! Omonto oraite Omofilisti oria, na koruseria Abaisraeli ogochaywa okwo, inki araegwe? Omofilisti oyo otarogeti, ninki aisaine goika are noboremu gochaya emeganda y’esegi ya Nyasae ore moyo?”
Abanto bakairaneria, bakamotebia, “Amang’ana aria aria arakorerwe oyo oraite omonto oria.”

Eliabu, omomura omonene omwabo Daudi, akaigwa buna agokwana nabanto. Akaba nendamwamu enene ase Daudi, agateba, “Ninki kiagera gwachicha aa? Ning’o gwatigera riicho riria rike rie ching’ondi chikare nka aaria ase erooro? Nimanyete oboenenu bwao na obobe bore ase enkoro yao. Nigo gwacha aa korora esegi rioka.”
Daudi agateba, “Ninki nakora rende? Nokoboria gwoka naboria.”
Erio Daudi akeonchora gochia ase omonto onde akaboria amang’ana aria konya aboririe, na abanto bakamoiraneria buna konya bamoiraneirie ritang’ani.
Ekero abanto baigwete amang’ana a Daudi, bakagenda bakayatebia Saulo, na Saulo akamorangeria.
Daudi agatebia Saulo, “Monto onde takwa omoyo ase okomwoboa Omofilisti oyio. Inche, omosomba oo, ningende komorwania.”
Saulo agakania Daudi, akamotebia, “Tokonyara korwania Omofilisti oyio. Aye nomoke; ere nigo enaretie korwana esegi korwa obosae bwaye.”
Korende Daudi agatebia Saulo, “Inche, omosomba oo, nabeire nkorisia ching’ondi chia tata, na ekero kende gionsi endo gose edubu yare gocha koira eng’ondi korwa ase riicho,
nigo nare koyeromeng’ana na koyeaka inse, naende natooria eng’ondi eria korwa ase omonwa oye, na onye endo gose edubu yare korindokera, nigo nare koyebwata chinderu, erinde nayeaka nayeita.
Inche, omosomba oo, nabeire ngoita chindo ne chidubu, naboigo buna nakorete ching’iti chiria ninkore n’Omofilisti oria otarogeti, oyochayire emeganda y’esegi ya Nyasae ore moyo.”

Naende Daudi agateba, “Omonene oria ontooretie korwa ase chinchara chi’endo na echi’edubu, nigo arantoorie korwa ase amaboko ’Omofilisti oria.” Saulo akamotebia, “Gaki genda, na Omonene abe amo naye.”
Erio Saulo akaimokia ebirwanero biaye bi’esegi, akabibekera Daudi, akamobekera na ekegogwa gi’etaai omotwe oye, na egoti eroisirie korwa ase ebioma.

Daudi akeboerania ebirwanero ebio amo nomoyio o birende, agateema kogenda, ekiagera konya taranara kweboerania ebinto buna ebio. Erio agatebia Saulo, “Tinkonyara gotaara nyeboeranetie ebinto ebio, ekiagera timbinareti.” Akabirusia na kobitiga.

Erio akaimokia enyimbo yaye ase okoboko kwaye, agachora amagena atano amaterere korwa ase akarooche, akayabeka ase esaro yaye y’oborisia, na enduruche akabogoria koboko kwaye. Na bono agasuka gochia ang’e n’Omofilisti oria.
Omofilisti oria agacha bosio, akamoika Daudi ang’e, na omobogoreria bw’enguba yaye omotang’aine.
Ekero Omofilisti oria aroche Daudi oyorenge omosae omobariri na omonyakieni, akamochaya mono.
Erio agatebia Daudi, “Inee! Nesese inde? Ogonchichera nenyimbo?” Agatiana ase chinyasae chiaye, akaragereria Daudi.
Naende Omofilisti oria agatebia Daudi, “Inchuo aiga asende, nainche ning’ee chinyoni ne ching’iti chi’orosana chinyama chi’omobere oo chichirie.”

Daudi akamoiraneria, “Aye nigo ogonchichera kore nomoro, ne ritimo, na esimisi, korende inche nigo nkogochera ase erieta ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’emeganda y’esegi y’Abaisraeli, oyio gwachayire na komochecheria.

Rituko ria rero Omonene nakobeke ase okoboko kwane. Ninkoiyerie inse, na kobutora omotwe oo; ning’ee chinyoni ne ching’iti chi’orosana emebere ekwete y’abarwani b’Abafilisti; erio abanto b’ense yonsi mbamanye ng’a Abaisraeli nigo bare na Nyasae.
Boigo omoganda oyo bwonsi nomanye ng’a Omonene tari korenta obobui ase enchera y’emioro na amatimo. Esegi nigo ere ey’Omonene, nere nababeke inwe ase amaboko aito.”
Omofilisti oria agachaka kogenda goikera Daudi ang’e, erio Daudi akaminyoka bwango gochia ase abarwani koumerana n’Omofilisti oria.
Daudi agasoyia okoboko kwaye ase esaro, akarusia rigena, akariruta nenduruche, agaaka Omofilisti oria obosio bwaye. Rigena riria rikarimera obosio bwaye ime, na ere akagwa inse maumama, agakwa.
Ase igo Daudi akabua Omofilisti oria, akamoita ne rigena ri’enduruche atari nomoro koboko kwaye.
Erio akaminyoka, agatenena ase omobere oye, agasomora omoyio oye korwa ase ekegocho, akamoita kegima ase okomobutora omotwe. Ekero Abafilisti baroche ng’a etuoni yabo yakure, bagatama.
Erio Abaisraeli na Abayuda bagaaka eriogi bakabwatia Abafilisti goikera Gati na ebiita bi’Ekironi. Abafilisti abaitetwe bakarara ase enchera korwa Saaraimu goikera Gati na Ekironi.
Erio Abaisraeli bakairana korwa ase baseretie Abafilisti bagasakora egetwori kiabo.
Daudi akaimokia omotwe bw’Omofilisti oria akayoira Yerusalemu, korende ebirwanero bia Goliato akabigacha ase eema yaye omonyene.

Ekero Saulo aroche Daudi okogenda korwania Omofilisti oria akaboria Abineri, omochiki bw’emeganda y’abarwani, “Abineri, omosae oyo, noyo ng’o”? Abineri akamoiraneria, “Aye omoruoti, ekeene buna ore moyo, inche timomanyeti.”
Omoruoti agatebia Abineri, “Genda oborie omanye gose omosae oyo noyo ng’o?”
Erio ekero Daudi arenge koirana ase egetwori gaitire Omofilisti oria, Abineri akamoira ase Saulo, Daudi nigo abogoretie omotwe o Goliato koboko kwaye.
Saulo akamoboria, “Omosae oyo, noyo ng’o ore?” Daudi akamoiraneria, “Inche nomwana bw’omosomba oo, Yese o Bethlehemu.”
Ekero Daudi akoorire gokwana na Saulo, Yonathani akang’useka na Daudi akaba okomwancha mono, amwanchete buna eanchete ere omonyene.
Korwa rituko riria Saulo akaa Daudi ribaga komenya asare, gose tamotigete airane gochia nka o ise.
Erio Yonathani agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania na Daudi, ekiagera nigo amwanchete buna eanchete ere omonyene.
Yonathani akarusia egetambaa kiaye gi’okwambara agakea Daudi, akamoa nebirwanero biaye, na omoyio o birende, na obota, na orokini.

Aande onsi ase Saulo arenge gotoma Daudi, Daudi nigo arenge konyora obobui. Ase ayio Saulo akamobeka akaba omotang’ani bw’abarwani. Daudi igo anyorete ogwancherwa kw’abanto bonsi na okw’abasomba ba Saulo.

Ekaba ekero Daudi are koirana, ekero aitire Omofilisti oria, na abarwani b’esegi bakoirana boigo, abakungu bagacha korwa ase emechie yonsi bakana‐gotera na gotenga bare nomogoko, bakobugia ebikonu ne chinchigiri.
Abakungu bakaba bagotera, bakobora, “Saulo oitire chilifu chiaye, korende Daudi oitire chilifu chiaye emerongo na emerongo.”

Ayio akagechia Saulo, goika akaba nendamwamu enene, agateba, “Abakungu aba batebire ng’a Daudi oitire chilifu emerongo na emerongo, korende asende, batebire ng’a ne chilifu rioka. Ninki rende giatigaire batamoeti goika bono otatiga oboruoti?”
Korwa ase rituko riria na kogenderera Saulo akarorera Daudi ribero.

Rituko ria kabere omoika omobe okorwa ase Nyasae ogacha igoro ase Saulo, na ere akaba okobaboka buna ebarimo agwo nyomba mwaye. Daudi nigo arenge kobugia obokano buna anarete kera rituko, na Saulo nabwate ritimo koboko kwaye.
Saulo akarengereria ase enkoro yaye agetebia, “Nigo nkoruta ritimo, mbete Daudi imobwateranie enyasi.” Erio akamoruta Daudi ritimo ara kabere, korende Daudi akebacha.
Saulo akairoka Daudi mono, ekiagera Omonene nigo arenge amo na Daudi, korende konya otigire Saulo.
Ase ayio Saulo akamorusia korwa asare, akamobeka akaba omotang’ani bw’abarwani baye b’esegi elifu eyemo, na Daudi akaba ogotang’ana abanto aande onsi ase baare kogenda na koirana.
Daudi nigo arenge konyora obobui ase chinchera chiaye chionsi, ekiagera Omonene nigo arenge amo nere.
Ekero Saulo aroche ng’a Daudi onyorire obobui, akamwoboa mono kobua.
Korende Abaisraeli na Abayuda bonsi bakamwancha Daudi mono, ekiagera arenge kobatang’ana kogenda aande onsi ase baare kogenda na koirana.

Erio Saulo agatebia Daudi, “Rora, ninkoe Merabu, omoiseke one omotangi, abe mokao, onye kogonkorera buna omonto omoremu, erinde orwane esegi y’Omonene.” Saulo igo arengereretie ng’a Daudi nigo agochia goitwa n’Abafilisti, ng’a ere omonyene tabaisa komoita.
Daudi akairaneria Saulo, “Inche ninki ng’isaine na obogima bwane ninki boisaine, gose eamate ya tata inki eisaine ase egati y’Abaisraeli, erinde aye omoruoti obe tata biara?”
Korende ekero engaki yaigete, Saulo arenge koa Daudi Merabu, omoiseke oye, akaonchora ebirengererio biaye, akaa Adirili Omomehola omoiseke oria akaba mokaye.
Mikali, omoiseke o Saulo, agancha Daudi, na ekero Saulo aigwete amang’ana ayio akagokigwa mono.

Bono Saulo akarengereria iga, “Nigo ndae Daudi omoiseke oyo, nere orabe okomotega, erinde agwe ase amaboko ’Abafilisti, nabarabwo bamoite.” Ase ayio Saulo agatebia Daudi eria kabere, “Bono onyuome omoiseke one, erinde inche imbe iso biara.”

Erio Saulo agachika abasomba baye, akabora, “Kwana na Daudi bobisi, momotebie ng’a inche omoruoti nigo ngokirie nere, na abasomba baane bonsi nigo bamwanchete. Ase ayio bono momotebie ng’a inche imbe ise biara.”

Ase igo abasomba ba Saulo bagatebia Daudi amang’ana ayio bobisi. Nere akabairaneria, “Inee! Inwe nigo moroche ng’a nering’ana rike omoruoti abe tata biara. Inche igo inde omonto omotaka mono, naende tindi na bonene bonde.”
Abasomba abwo bagachia gotebia Saulo aya Daudi akwanete,

na Saulo akabachika batebie Daudi ng’a, “Omoruoti taganeti omoe enibo ende yonsi ase okomonyuomera omoiseke oye, otatiga aganetie omorentere amasankwa a isiko ay’ebiimo bi’obosacha bi’Abafilisti rigana erimo bakwete, na igo omoruserie egesiomba ase ababisa baye.” Ase enchera eyio Saulo nigo arengereretie ng’a Daudi agwe ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.
Ekero abasomba baria batebetie Daudi amang’ana aria Saulo atebete, Daudi akagokigwa naro ng’a omoruoti abe ise biara. Ekero engaki eria konya etaraika,

Daudi akaimoka, akagenda nabanto baye, agaita Abafilisti amagana abere, akabutora amasankwa abo a isiko ay’ebiimo bi’obosacha, akayarenta onsi ase omoruoti, erinde omoruoti abe ise biara. Erio Saulo akaa Daudi Mikali, akaba mokaye.
Saulo akarora na akamanya ng’a Omonene nigo arenge amo na Daudi, naende ng’a Mikali, omoiseke oye, nigo amwanchete Daudi.
Ase ayio Saulo akoboa Daudi mono kobua, naende akaba omobisa oye kogenderera ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
Abanene b’Abafilisti bakaba bagocha korwana esegi, korende ase engaki ende yonsi Daudi akaba okonyora obobui kobua abasomba bonsi ba Saulo. Ase igo erieta riaye rigakuma mono na gotogigwa.
Saulo agakwana na Yonathani, omomura oye, na abasomba baye bonsi ng’a naganetie goita Daudi, korende Yonathani nigo anchete Daudi mono.
Yonathani agatebia Daudi, “Saulo tata nigo aganetie kogoita. Ase ayio bwerende mono ankio mambia; ogende aase are bobisi, bwebise.
Inche ningende ntenene ang’e ase tata ase egetii, aria ase orabeere, nkwane nere igoro yao, kondanyore amang’ana buna are, ningotebie.”

Yonathani agakwana na Saulo ise amang’ana amaya igoro ya Daudi, akamotebia “Aye omoruoti, tobaisa gokorera Daudi, omosomba oo, bobe, ekiagera ere tana gokomochera, korende ase aya onsi abeire ogokora nigo agokonyete mono.

Ere taboraarete obogima bwaye, ekero aitete Omofilisti oria, na Omonene akanyorera Abaisraeli obobui obonene mono. Aye nkwaroche amang’ana ayio, na okagoka ase ayio. Nase ki rende orakore ebibe na goitera amanyinga omonto otari na komocha, ase ogoita Daudi?”
Saulo akaigwera amang’ana a Yonathani, agatiana agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, Daudi tagoitwa.”
Erio Yonathani akarangeria Daudi, akamotebia amang’ana ayio onsi. Nyuma y’ayio akamoira ase Saulo, na Daudi akaba ogokorera Saulo buna agwo ritang’ani.
Esegi egatuboka naende, na Daudi akagenda korwania Abafilisti, akababua obobui obonene mono. Barabwo bagatama korwa asare.
Rituko erimo ekero Saulo aikaransete nyomba mwaye, obwate ritimo ase okoboko kwaye, na Daudi nigo agendererete kobugia obokano, omoika omobe okorwa ase Nyasae ogaika igoro ase Saulo,
Saulo agateema kobeta Daudi ritimo amobwateranie enyasi, korende Daudi akebacha, ne ritimo riria rikabeta enyasi. Daudi agatama, agatooreka ase obotuko obwo.

Ase obotuko obwo Saulo agatoma abanto ase enyomba ya Daudi komoboera, erinde bamoite mambia kagosoka. Korende Mikali, moga Daudi, akamokurera, akamotebia, “Otetooreti ase obotuko obo, mambia goika oche oitwe.”
Erio Mikali agaikeria Daudi goetera ase ekebao, na Daudi agatama agetooria.
Mikali akaimokia omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa orenge nyomba ime, akaywareria borere, akabeka amanya e chimbori asisire ase omotwe bw’omogwekano oria, erio akayobisia egetambaa.
Erio abanto batometwe na Saulo kwoyia Daudi bachete, na Mikali akabatebia, “Orwarire.”
Saulo akabatoma naende ase Daudi, akabatebia, “Momobogorie noborere, momorente asende, erinde imoite.”
Ekero abanto abwo basoete nyomba, bakarora omogwekano oria bw’ogosasimwa ore borere, na amanya e chimbori asisire abekire ase omotwe oye.
Erio Saulo akaboria Mikali, “Nase ki kwang’aina ase enchera buna eye, na ogatiga omobisa one agatama agetooria?” Mikali akamoiraneria, “Ere nigo antebetie: Ntiga ngende, timbaisa kogoita.”
Ekero Daudi atamire na gwetooria, akagenda ase Samweli agwo Rama, akamotebia amang’ana onsi Saulo konya amokoreire. Erio Samweli na Daudi bakagenda Nayoti, bakamenyao.
Saulo agatebigwa ng’a Daudi nigo amenyete Nayoti aria Rama.

Ase ayio Saulo agatoma abanto boyie Daudi. Korende ekero abanto aba baigeteo, bakarora ekeombe ki’ababani bakobaboka ase okobana, na Samweli oteneineo buna omotang’ani obo. Omoika o Nyasae ogaika igoro asebare, nabarabwo boigo bagachaka kobana.
Ekero Saulo aigwete aya abanyorire, agatoma abanto bande, nabarabwo boigo bagachaka kobaboka ase okobana. Na ekero Saulo atomete abanto eria gatato nabwo bagachaka kobana.
Erio Saulo omonyene akagenda Rama, agaika ase ensoko enene y’amache yare agwo Seku, akaboria, “Ng’ai Samweli na Daudi bare?” Agatebigwa ng’a nao bakare Nayoti agwo Rama.
Ase igo akagenda gochia Nayoti agwo Rama. Korende Omoika o Nyasae ogaika nonya nigoro yaye, na ere akaba okobana kagendererete nchera goika Nayoti agwo Rama.

Ere boigo akarusia chianga chiaye akababoka ase okobana ase obosio bwa Samweli, akagwa inse, akarara agwo rituko rigima, omobaso na obotuko, ore getirianda. Ase ayio amang’ana nigo agotebwa: “Inee! Saulo nere nabeire oyomo bw’ababani?”
Daudi agatama korwa Nayoti agwo Rama, akagenda ase Yonathani, akamoboria, “Ninki nakorire? Okomocha kwane, na ebibe biane mbiribi ase obosio bwa iso? Nase ki arigetie kong’ita?”
Yonathani akamoiraneria, “Taibo, togokwa. Tata tari gokora gento kende gionsi, ekenene gose egeke, atantebeti. Nase ki tata arambise ring’ana erio, atamanyia? Ayio takoba bo.”

Daudi akairaneria ase ogotiana, agateba, “Iso igo amanyete buya ng’a aye nonyanchete mono, na ororire ng’a tari buya akomanyie ring’ana erio, ekiagera nigo riragoichanie mono. Korende ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, na buna aye ore moyo, ngetigarete egetambokero ekemo gioka egati yane na amakweri.”
Erio Yonathani akamotebia, “Gento kende gionsi oganetie ningokorere.”

Daudi agatebia Yonathani, “Ankio ne Rituko Rinene ri’Omotienyi Omoyia, nigo embetereretie ng’a ng’ikaranse koragera amo nomoruoti, korende ing’a ribaga ngende kwebisa agwo ase omogondo goika ankio ende mogoroba.
Kerabe ng’a iso tandochi ase omoyega oyio, omotebie: Daudi nigo ansaba ribaga ng’a aminyoke gochia Bethlehemu, omochie oye, ase okorua ekeng’wanso ki’omwaka amo neamate yaye yonsi.
Aise goteba: Ayio mbuya, rirorio inche, omosomba oo, ninyare koba nomorembe, korende karabe nendamwamu ase ayio, rirorio omanye ng’a bwerure gokora amabe.

Gaki onkorere inche, omosomba oo, amaya, ekiagera gwakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania amo nainche ase obosio bw’Omonene. Korende onye okomocha kore asende, rirorio aye omonyene ong’ite? Nase ki okong’ira ase iso, erinde ere ang’ite?”
Yonathani akairaneria, “Taibo! Takoba bo. Onye ndiria imanyete ekeene ng’a tata narengereretie kogokorera bobe, Inee, nanga rirorio tinagotebia amang’ana ayio.”
Daudi akamoboria, “Iso karakoiranerie amang’ana amakong’u, Inee, ning’o orache gontebia ayio?”
Erio Yonathani akamotebia, “Inchuo togende ase egetii.” Bonsi babere bakagendao,

na Yonathani akamotebia Daudi. “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, abe kirori ase aya. Ase chinsa buna echi, ankio gose ankio ende, nindigie komanya ebirengererio bia tata buna bire igoro yao, na kondabimanye, ningotomere amang’ana, erinde obimanye.
Konye tata bwerure kogokorera bobe, rirorio Omonene ang’e inche Yonathani egesusuro onye tinkogotebia okogania gwa tata, na ngotige otame na bwetoorie. Omonene abe amo naye buna arenge na tata.
Onye ngendererete koba moyo, oorokie obwanchani bw’Omonene asende, erinde tinkwa,
gose tobaisa korusia obwanchani obwo korwa ase ororeria rwane nonya ng’ake, nonya nekero Omonene arasirie kera omobisa oo arue ase ense.
Agwo Yonathani agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania neamate ya Daudi, agateba, Omonene nae ababisa ba Daudi egesusuro.”
Erio Yonathani akaboria Daudi arie eira na gotiana naende ng’a namwanche, ekiagera Yonathani nigo anchete Daudi buna eanchete ere omonyene.
Erio Yonathani agatebia Daudi, “Ankio ne Rituko Rinene ri’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ekiagera togochi‐gocha koba ase omoyega, ekerogo kiao nigo keratigare bosa.
Ankio ende otirimboke bwango gochia aase aria kwebisete rituko riria kwaganeirie. Obeere aroro, moino y’etui y’amagena aria.
Nindute emegwe etato gochia ang’e netui eria, buna negento nkorasa.

Erio nintome omosomba one arigie emegwe eria. Kondatebie omosomba oria: Rigereia, emegwe nigo ere magega ao, gocha ensemo yane, genda oyerente, rirorio aye Daudi ochiche, obe nomorembe. Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, togokorerwa bobe bonde.
Korende onye ngotebia omwana oria: Rigereria, emegwe eyio bosio bwao aaria moino, rirorio aye Daudi otame, ekiagera n’Omonene okogotebia ogende.
Nase amang’ana aria twakwanete, inche naye, tiga Omonene abe kirori ase egati yaito kogenderera botambe.”
Ase igo Daudi akebisa mogondo na ekero ki’Omotienyi Omoyia omoruoti agaikaransa koragera.
Omoruoti agaikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye, ang’e nenyasi, buna botambe; na Yonathani agatenena bosio bwaye, na Abineri agaikaransa ensemo ya Saulo. Korende ekerogo gia Daudi kegatigara bosa.
Saulo takwanete gento kende ase rituko riria, ekiagera nigo arengereretie ng’a ring’ana gete riamonyorire Daudi; ande tagachenegeti.

Ase rituko ria kabere ri’omoyega bw’Omotienyi Omoyia, ekerogo gia Daudi nigo kiagendererete gotigara bosa, na Saulo akaboria Yonathani momura oye, “Nase ki momura o Yese atachete koragera igoro gose rero?”
Yonathani akairaneria Saulo, “Daudi nigo amboria ribaga agende Bethlehemu,

agateba: Abanto b’eamate yane ngochia bare korua ekeng’wanso agwo ase omochie, na momura ominto onchikire ng’a imbeo. Ase ayio, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa asore, ing’a ribaga ngende korora abaminto. Aya naro agera atachicha ase endagera yao, aye omoruoti.”

Erio Saulo akaba nendamwamu enene ase Yonathani, akamotebia, “Aye omwana bw’omokungu omosaria, nimanyete ng’a kwabwatanire na mosinto o Yese, ase okwerentera obosooku, na obosooku bw’obogetirianda bwa nyoko.
Nomanyete ng’a ekero mosinto o Yese agendererete koba moyo ase ense, aye tokonyara koba nomorembe, gose oboruoti tibokoba obwao. Ase ayio, toma abanto bamondetere; ere goika akwe.”
Erio Yonathani akamoboria, “Nase ki araitwe akwe? Ngento ki akorire?”
Agwo Saulo akaimokia ritimo akamoruta amobete. Bono Yonathani akamanya ng’a ise narigetie goita Daudi.

Yonathani akaimoka korwa ase emesa ore nendamwamu enene na tariete gento ase rituko erio ria kabere ri’Omotienyi Omoyia. Nigo abete oichanete ase engencho y’obosooku ise amokorerete ase okogania goita Daudi.
Emambia ya kabere, Yonathani amo nomwana oria omomura, bakagenda mogondo, ase engaki konya bachikanire na Daudi.
Agatebia omwana oria, “Minyoka origie emegwe eria nkoruta.” Ekero omwana oria arenge kominyoka, Yonathani akaruta omogwe, noro ogaeta igoro yaye, okagwa bosio bwaye.
Na ekero omwana oria aigete aase omogwe oria ogwete, Yonathani agaaka eriogi, akamotebia, “Omogwe oyio ore bosio bwao, aaria moino.”
Erio Yonathani akarangeria omomura oria, akamotebia, “Minyoka bwango, tobaisa gotebana.” Na omwana oria agasangereria emegwe eria, erio akairana gocha ase omonene oye.
Omwana oria tamanyete ng’a ninki engencho y’amang’ana ayio, korende Yonathani na Daudi mbayamanyete.
Yonathani akaa omosae oria ebirwanero biaye akamotebia, “Genda, obiire ase omochie.”

Ekero omwana oria achiire, Daudi akaoroka korwa ase etui aase ebisete, agatung’ama inse, akaumama na agekumba ara gatato. Erio Daudi na Yonathani bakanyunyuntana na korererana, korende Daudi akamenta korera mono.

Erio Yonathani akamotebia, “Genda nomorembe, na abe buna twatiananirie ase erieta ri’Omonene togateba: Omonene abe kirori ase egati yao nainche, na ase egati y’ororeria rwao na orwane, kogenderera botambe.”
Erio Daudi akaimoka, akarua agwo, akagenda, na Yonathani akairana ase omochie.
Daudi akagenda ase Ahimeleki omokuani agwo Nobu. Ahimeleki agacha komorotota ore nobwoba na okoiguswa, akamoboria, “Nase ki ore aye bweka otari na monto onde?”

Daudi akairaneria Ahimeleki omokuani, “Omoruoti onchikire gokora omoremo gete; ere nigo antebia ng’a timbaisa gotebia monto onde, erinde amanye igoro y’omoremo oyio antomire na gonchika ng’a nkore. Naende onchikire ng’a ng’umerane nabasomba baane aase gete.
Bono endagera ki obwate aa? Ing’a emegati etano, gose kende gionsi obwate aa.”
Omokuani oria akairaneria Daudi, “Timbwati emegati eria ya botambe aiga, korende emegati eria ere emechenu nereo, na nigo ndakoyee onye abamura abwo betangete na kwerita korwa ase abakungu.”

Daudi akairaneria omokuani, akamotebia, “Ekeene, twabeire twetangete korwa ase abakungu ase amatuko atato aerire, buna engencho yaito ere botambe, ekero tokogenda gokora emeremo gete; boigo ebikorero bi’abamura aba nigo bire ebichenu botambe, ekero tokogenda ase orogendo. Onye ayio are bo, naki rende rero ebikorero biabo tibiri ebichenu goetania?”
Ase ayio omokuani akaa Daudi emegati eria emechenu, ekiagera mogati onde torengeo otatiga eria konya yarusigwe korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, erinde eyere iberera ebekweo ase rituko erio.
Bono ase rituko erio omonto oyomo bw’Edomu, okorokwa Doegi, nao arenge ase obosio bw’Omonene osiekeireo. Ere nigo arenge omoteneneri bw’abarisia ba Saulo.

Daudi akaboria Ahimeleki, “Nobwate aa ritimo gose omoro? Inche tinarentanete omoro one, gose ebirwanero binde bionsi, ekiagera omoremo oyio omoruoti anchigete gokora nigo oganetie okorwe ase obwango.”

Omokuani oria akamotebia, “Omoyio o Goliato, Omofilisti oria gwaitete agwo ase ense omweremo ya Ela, nore aa, oboire egetambaa na kogachwa magega y’egesibao ki’obokuani. Onye koyoganetie yoire, ekiagera onde omoao tori aa.” Daudi agateba, “Onde tori onga buna oyio, yong’e”.
Ase rituko erio Daudi akarua agwo, agatama korwa ase Saulo, akagenda ase Akisi, omoruoti o Gati,

Abasomba b’Akisi bakamokwana, “Inee! Oyo tari Daudi Omoruoti? Abakungu tibaterete igoro yaye kobagotenga, bakobora; Saulo oitire chilifu chiaye, korende Daudi oitire chilifu chiaye emerongo na emerongo?”
Ekero Daudi aigwete amang’ana ayio, akayabeka ase ebirengererio biaye, akairoka Akisi, omoruoti o Gati, mono.
Ase igo akaonchora okoba gwe chingencho chiaye ase amasio abo, agekora buna ebarimo na kona‐koara ebisieri biabo; na agatiga amate akana‐konyororoka korwa monwa, agaitekera chinderu chiaye.
Akisi agatebia abasomba baye, “Rora omonto oyo nebarimo. Nase ki mwamorenta asende?
Inee! Inche nigo mborire abanto chibarimo? Ninki kiagera mwarenta ebarimo eye gocha kogosoria obobarimo bwaye ase obosio bwane? Inee! Omonto buna oyo nanyore ribaga asoe nyomba mwane?”
Daudi akarua agwo, agatama gochia ase rikuruma ri’Adulamu. Ekero abamwabo, na eamate yaye bonsi, baigwete ayio, bakagenda agwo ase arenge.
Abanto bachandegete, na abwo babwate chisira, na abwo bataisanegete nobogima bwabo, bakamochera, nere akaba omotang’ani obo. Abanto abasacha abarenge amo nere nigo barenge koreng’ana amagana ane.
Naende Daudi akarua agwo, akagenda Misipa o Moabu; agatebia omoruoti o Moabu, “Koranche oe tata na baba ribaga bache kobeera aa, goika imanye aya Nyasae arankorere.”
Daudi agatiga ise na ng’ina bare agwo ase omoruoti o Moabu; barabwo bakagenderera komenya agwo ase engaki yonsi Daudi abete bwebisete ase rikuruma.
Erio Gadi omobani agatebia Daudi, “Tokogenderera kobeera ase rikuruma eri; karueo, ogende ase ense ya Yuda.” Ase ayio Daudi akaruao akagenda ase rinani ria Hereti.

Rituko erimo Saulo nigo aikaransete inse y’omote onga buna ekerachuoki ase ekegoro agwo Gibea, obwate ritimo ase okoboko kwaye, na abasomba baye nigo bateneine bamoetanaine. Erio agatebigwa ng’a Daudi amo nabanto barenge komo barorekanire.

Saulo agakwana nabasomba baye, akabora, “Igwa inwe Ababenjamin! Inee! Mosinto o Yese nae kera oyomo oino emegondo y’endagera amo ney’emesabibu? Nakore inwe mwensi mobe abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana?

Ayio naro agerire inwe mwensi mwakorire emeroberio ya bobisi ere mamincha yane? Onde tari ogontebia ng’a omwana one okorire okobwatana na mosinto o Yese, gose onde tari okondorera amabera antebie ng’a omwana one oseegetire abasomba baane babeire mamincha yane, erio bamboere buna ere rero iga.”
Erio Doegi Omoedomu, oyo oteneine amo nabasomba ba Saulo, akairaneria, akabora, “Narora mosinto o Yese okogenda ase Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, agwo Nobu.
Ahimeleki akamoboreria ase Omonene, akamoa endagera airane ase orogendo rwaye; boigo akamoa na omoyio oria o Goliato Omofilisti.”
Erio omoruoti agatoma abanto korangeria Ahimeleki omokuani, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, amo nabanto bonsi b’eamate yaye, na abakuani bonsi abarenge agwo Nobu. Abwo bonsi bakagenda ase omoruoti.
Saulo akabora, “Aye mosinto bw’Ahitubu, tegerera, oigwe.” Ere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa, Omonene one.”

Saulo akamoboria, “Nase ki aye na mosinto o Yese mwabeire mamincha yane? Aye nkwamoa endagera, na omoyio o birende naende okaboria Nyasae ase engencho yaye? Ere obeire mamincha yane na okomboera buna ere rero iga.”
Ahimeleki akairaneria omoruoti, “Ning’o ase abasomba bao ore omwegenwa buna Daudi? Naende aye omoruoti igo ore ise biara. Daudi boigo nomoteneneri bw’abarendi bao. Nigo asikire mono ase enyomba yao.

Inee! Eye nengaki entang’ani nabeire nkomoboreria korwa ase Nyasae? Taibo aye omoruoti tobaisa kombarera inche, omosomba oo, gose eamate ya tata bobe bonde, ekiagera timanyeti gento kende gionsi ase ayio, kebe ekenene gose egeke.”
Korende omoruoti agatebia Ahimeleki, “Aye amo nabanto bonsi b’eamate ya iso goika mokwe.”

Erio omoruoti agatebia abarendi abwo bamoetanaine, “Imoka, moite abakuani abwo b’Omonene, ekiagera nigo babwataine na Daudi. Boigo barabwo mbamanyete ng’a otamire na tibantebetie.” Korende abasomba b’omoruoti bakaanga korambora amaboko abo ase ogoita abakuani b’Omonene.

Erio omoruoti agatebia Doegi, “Aye imoka oite abakuani abwo,” na Doegi, Omoedomu, akaimoka, akabaita. Ase rituko erio agaita abanto emerongo etano na etato, na batano, abwo babegete ebisibao bi’egatani.
Boigo Saulo agaita nomoro abanto bonsi barenge agwo Nobu, omochie bw’abakuani. Agaita abasacha, na abakungu, na abana amo nabwo bakogonka, ne chiombe, ne chitigere, ne ching’ondi.
Korende Abiatari bweka ase basinto b’Ahimeleki bw’Ahitubu, nere agatooreka, agatama gochia ase Daudi.
Abiatari agatebia Daudi ng’a Saulo oitire abakuani b’Omonene.
Erio Daudi agatebia Abiatari, “Rituko riria Doegi Omoedomu arenge aaria, inche nabo namanyete ng’a goika atebie Saulo; ase ayio ninche nagerete abanto b’eamate yao bonsi bagaitwa.
Menya aiga amo nainche, tibwoboa. Saulo nigo akorigia obogima bwane, na obwao boigo. Aye koramenye asende, tokonyorwa na bobe bonde.”
Abanto bagatebia Daudi, “Abafilisti nkorwania bakare omochie o Keila, na basakoire chindagera chinyia korwa ase ebiooreri.”
Ase ayio Daudi akaboria Omonene, “Nkogenda nde korwania Abafilisti abwo esegi?” Na Omonene akamotebia, “Genda obarwanie, na otoorie Keila.”
Korende abanto ba Daudi bakamotebia, “Rora ekero tore aiga ase ense ya Yuda nigo tokwoboa. Inee! Naki erabe rende onye tokogenda Keila korwania abarwani b’Abafilisti esegi? Titokwoboa kobua?”
Erio Daudi akaboria Omonene naende, na Omonene akamoiraneria, “Imoka, ogende Keila, ekiagera nimbeke Abafilisti ase okoboko kwao.”
Ase igo Daudi na abanto baye bakagenda Keila, bakarwania Abafilisti, bakababua. Bagaita Abafilisti abange mono, bagoosa chiombe chiabo. Igo Daudi agatooria abanto bamenyete agwo Keila.
Ekero Abiatari, mosinto o Ahimeleki, atamete gochia ase Daudi agwo Keila, nigo arentete egesibao ki’obokuani.
Saulo agatebigwa ng’a Daudi osoire Keila. Erio agateba, “Nyasae obekire Daudi ase okoboko kwane, igo bwebwatire ere bweka, ekiagera osoire ase omochie obwate ebiita na ebisiekero.”
Saulo akarangeria abanto bonsi bagende Keila koboera Daudi amo nabanto baye, na kobarwania esegi.
Daudi agachia komanya ng’a Saulo okorire omoroberio bw’ogocha komosiria, agatebia Abiatari omokuani, “Renta egesibao ekio ki’obokuani aiga.”
Erio Daudi akabora, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, inche, omosomba oo, naigure ng’a Saulo ngocha are aiga Keila gosaria omochie ase engencho yane.

Inee! Abanto ba Keila nigo barandue, bambeke ase amaboko aye? Saulo nachiche buna inche omosomba oo, naigure? Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nagosoroire, koranche ontebie inche omosomba oo ekerabe.” Na Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee, nachiche.”
Naende Daudi akamoboria, “Inee! Abanto ba Keila nigo bagochia kondua inche amo nabanto baane, erinde batobeke ase okoboko gwa Saulo?” Omonene, akamoiraneria, “Ee, nababarue.”
Erio Daudi na abanto baye abarenge koreng’ana amagana atano na rimo, bakaimoka, bakarua agwo Keila, bakana‐koong’anya gochia aande onsi ase baare konyara kogenda.
Ase igo Daudi akagenderera komenya ase amabwago ’ebitunwa ase erooro ya Sifu; na Saulo akagenderera kona‐komorigia kera rituko, korende Omonene tabegete Daudi ase amaboko aye.
Ekero Daudi arenge agwo Horesi, ase erooro ya Sifu, akaigwa ng’a Saulo konya ochire agwo korigia gosiria obogima bwaye.
Yonathani, mosinto o Saulo, akaimoka akagenda ase Daudi, aria Horesi, akamoremia na komobeka chinguru ase Nyasae.
Akamotebia, “Toiroka, ekiagera Saulo tata, tagokonyora agokorere bobe aye nobe omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, nainche nimbe oyo kabere asore. Tata namanyete ayio.”
Erio abwo babere bagakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania ase obosio bw’Omonene. Daudi agatigara omenyete agwo Horesi, na Yonathani akairana gochia nka.
Abanto bande ba Sifu bakagenda ase Saulo agwo Gibea, bakamotebia, “Daudi nigo ebisete ase orogongo rwaito ase amabwago ’ebitunwa bia Horesi, ase ekegoro kia Hakila, irianyi ya Yesimoni.
Ase ayio, aye omoruoti, inchuo erinde okore buna kwaganetie, naintwe ntomobeke ase okoboko kwao.”
Saulo akabairaneria, “Tiga Omonene abasesenie, ekiagera mwandoreire amabera.
Genda morore na koenekia ase amenyete, naende ng’a ning’o omororire oreo. Natebigwe ng’a ere nigo are omwoge mono ase okong’ainereria.

Ase ayio genda momanyererie buya aase onsi obwebiso bore, erio moirane asende montebie amaene, nainche ngende amo nainwe. Onye ore ase orogongo orwo, nimorigie ase egati ye chilifu chionsi chi’Abayuda.”
Barabwo bakaimoka bagatang’anera Saulo, bakagenda Sifu, korende Daudi amo nabanto baye nao barenge ase erooro ya Maoni, agwo ase Ekerubo Ekiomo, irianyi ya Yesimona.

Saulo na abanto baye bakagenda korigia Daudi, korende Daudi agatebigwa amang’ana ayio. Ase ayio akagenda ase egetare kiarenge ase erooro ya Maoni, akabeerao. Ekero Saulo aigwete ng’a Daudi ogendire agwo akamobwatia gochiao.

Saulo akagenda ensemo eyemo y’egetunwa, na Daudi na abanto baye bakagenda ensemo ende. Daudi nigo abete okoayerera gotama Saulo, na Saulo na abanto baye konya bachakire konaaria Daudi na abanto baye, ase okobabwata.
Erio omonto agacha ase Saulo akamotebia, “Irana, ayerera bwango, ekiagera Abafilisti bachire mobosokano korwania ense yaito.”
Ase igo Saulo agatiga kobwatia Daudi, akairana, akagenda korwania Abafilisti. Ase ayio aase agwo akarokwa “Egetare ki’Ogwatananeka.”
Daudi akarua aase agwo, akagenda, akamenya ase amakuruma ime ase ebitare bia Eni‐Gedi.
Ekero Saulo airanete korwa ase okobwatia Abafilisti, agatebigwa ng’a Daudi nao are ase erooro ya Eni‐Gedi.
Erio Saulo akaira abarwani chilifu isato abachoretwe korwa ase Abaisraeli bonsi, akagenda korigia Daudi, na abanto baye ase Ebitare bie Chimori chi’Orosana.
Agaika ase amakuruma e ching’ondi agwo ase enchera, na agwo ase rikuruma erimo agasoa ase ogwekonya. Daudi amo nabanto baye nao baikaransete ime y’ekenunchi kie rikuruma erio.

Abanto ba Daudi bakamotebia, “Rituko eri ndiria Omonene agotebetie ng’a nabeke omobisa oo ase okoboko kwao, naye omokore buna oranche.” Erio Daudi agachoba ng’ora‐ng’ora, akabutora omokoba bw’eganchwa ya Saulo bobisi.
Korende nyuma y’ayio enkoro ya Daudi egachaka komogambia, ekiagera konya abutoire omokoba bw’eanga ya Saulo.
Agatebia abanto baye, “Tiga Omonene antange, timbaisa gokora obobe obwo ase omonene one, ekiagera ere nigo are omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.”
Daudi akaebereria abanto baye ase okobatebia amang’ana ayio, na tabaa ribaga baumokere Saulo. Erio Saulo akaimoka korwa ase rikuruma erio, akagenderera orogendo rwaye.

Daudi nere akaimoka agasoka korwa ase rikuruma riria, akabwatia Saulo, akarangeria neriogi, agateba, “Aye omoruoti, omonene one!” Ekero Saulo eonchorete korigereria, Daudi agatung’ama inse, akaumama, akorokia amasikani.
Erio Daudi akaboria Saulo, “Nase ki okoigwera amang’ana abanto bagoteba ng’a inche Daudi ngokorigia inde ngokore bobe?

Rigereria orore, rituko ria rero, agwo ase rikuruma ime, Omonene nigo akobeka ase okoboko kwane, na abanto bande nigo bambetereria ng’a ngoite, korende inche nagotiga kore moyo. Nigo nateba ng’a tinkorambora okoboko kwane kogokore aye omonene one bobe, ekiagera aye nomoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.

Aye tata, rigereria orore omokoba bw’eanga yao, ore koboko kwane; nigo nayobutora, korende nkagotiga kore moyo, erio nario oramanye ng’a obobe gose ogosaria tibiri asende; inche tindakora ebibe asore, nonya gokorigia kong’ita.
Tiga Omonene arore oyore nokomocha, ninche gose naye. Omonene anduserie egesiomba, korende okoboko kwane tikogokora bobe.
Abanto abakoro nigo bagokwana iga: Obobe nigo bogosoka korwa ase abakori amabe. Ase ayio amaboko aane takogokorera bobe bonde.
Ning’o aye omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli gwachicheire? Ning’o okobwatia? Inee! Nesese ekwete okobwatia, gose nensona.
Tiga Omonene anache ekina ase egati yane naye, erio andwanerere na gontooria korwa ase okoboko kwao.”
Ekero Daudi akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya, Saulo akamoboria, “Eri neriogi riao aye Daudi, omwana one!” Erio Saulo akarera,
agatebia Daudi, “Aye nigo ore omonyaboronge kombua, ekiagera kwang’akanire amaya ase amabe, korende inche nagoakanire amabe ase amaya.
Ase rituko ria rero kwaorokirie buna gwakorire amaya asende, ekiagera otang’ita ekero Omonene ambeka ase okoboko kwao.
Inee! Onye omonto onyorire omobisa oye, nanyare komotiga ore moyo? Ase ayio Omonene tiga akoe eng’eria yao ase amaya aya gwankoreire ase rituko ria rero.
Bono inche namanyire ng’a naye orabe omoruoti, na oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli mbogenderere koba ase okoboko kwao.
Gaki bono tiana ase obosio bw’Omonene ng’a togosiria ororeria rwane, naende ng’a togosiria erieta riane rirue ase enyomba ya tata, riebwe.”
Ase ayio Daudi agatiana buna igo. Erio Saulo akagenda bwoye, na Daudi na abanto baye bakagenda komenya ase amakuruma ’egetare.
Samweli agakwa, na Abaisraeli bagasangererekana, bakagenda komoreera; bakamotindeka ase enka yaye agwo Rama. Erio Daudi akaimoka, agatirimboka gochia ase erooro ya Parani.

Narenge omonto oyomo korwa Maoni obwate amaicho aye agwo Karimeli. Ere nigo arenge omonda mono; nabwate ching’ondi chilifu isato ne chimbori elifu eyemo. Igo arenge koba okonacha ching’ondi chiaye amarionya agwo Karimeli.

Omonto oyio noyo bw’ororeria rwa Kalebu, nigo arenge korokwa Nabali, na mokaye Abigaeli. Omokungu oyio nigo arenge omong’aini mono na omonyakieni, korende omosacha oria nigo arenge omonto omotindi na omonyandamwamu.
Ekero Daudi arenge ase erooro akaigwa ng’a Nabali nkonacha arenge ching’ondi chiaye amarionya.
Erio agatoma abamura ikomi ase Nabali, akabatebia, “Genda ase Nabali agwo Karimeli, momoirere ogokwania kwane,
momotebie amang’ana aya aane: Omorembe obe asore, na ase enyomba yao, na ase binde bionsi obwate.

Naigure ng’a nkonacha ore ching’ondi chiao amarionya. Bono abarisia bao nigo barenge amo naintwe; titwabakorerete bobe bonde. Barabwo tibaiberetwe gento kende gionsi ase engaki yonsi barenge Karimeli.

Boria abasomba bao, nabarabwo mbakoenekerie bo. Ngochia koba tore nomoyega bwe Rituko Rinene; ase ayio tiga abamura abwo natomire asore banyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao. Ase ayio, obae barabwo amo nainche Daudi, omwana oo, gento kende obwate ogotoa.”
Ekero abamura abwo Daudi atomete baigete ase Nabali, bakamotebia amang’ana onsi a Daudi. Erio bakaganya.
Nabali akabairaneria, agateba, “Daudi oyio, nere ng’o? Oyio omwana o Yese, nere ng’o? Ase amatuko aya abasomba abange nigo bagotama korwa ase abanene babo.
Inee! Ninyare koimokia endagera yane, na ekenyugwa kiane, na enyama ye ching’iti chiane nanyenyeire abanto bakonachera ching’ondi amarionya, na kobia abanto ntamanyeti aase bakorua?”
Abamura baria Daudi atomete bakairana gochia asare, bakamotebia amang’ana ayio onsi Nabali abatebetie.

Erio Daudi akabatebia, “Kera omonto eboeranie omoyio oye o birende.” Na kera oyomo akeboerania omoyio oye, na Daudi nere boigo. Abanto amagana aane bagatiira amo na Daudi, na abanto amagana abere bagatigara nyuma korenda ebinto.
Oyomo bw’abasomba ba Nabali agatebia Abigaeli, moka Nabali, amang’ana ng’a, “Daudi natoma abanto korwa ase erooro gocha gokwania omonene oito, korende ere akabatogonyera.
Abanto aba nigo bakorete amaya asetore, titwanyoretwe na bobe bonde. Ekero twarenge amo nabarabwo gotaara ase ebitii titwaiberetwe gento kende gionsi.
Ase engaki yonsi twarenge amo nabarabwo korisia ching’ondi, barabwo nigo barenge asetore buna orwaki, omobaso na obotuko.
Bono omanye amang’ana ayio, na orengererie inki orakore, ekiagera omonene oito ngochia are gokorerwa bobe, amo nabanto b’enka yaye. Ere nomotindi mono, onde tari oranyare gokwana nere.”

Erio agwo Abigaeli agasangereria emegati amagana abere na ebirandi bibere bi’amasankwa biichire nedivai, ne chinyama chie ching’ondi isano chiyekire, na ebigara bisambire ebitita ebinene bitano, na amasabibu amomo amabomba rigana erimo, na amako amomo amabomba amagana abere. Erio akabiberekia chitigere.
Abigaeli agatebia abasomba baye, “Tang’ana mogende, nainche nkobabwatia inde.” Korende tatebetie Nabali, omosacha oye.
Ekaba Abigaeli kariinire etigere yaye na ngoeta arenge ase egekengano kiarenge inse y’egetunwa, Daudi na abanto baye bagacha korwa bosio, ekaba goika aumerane nabarabwo.
Daudi konya otebire ng’a, “Amaene, mbosa narenge korenda enibo y’omonto oyo aiga ase erooro. Ende tiyasira nonya neyemo ase chinibo chiaye chionsi. Na bono ong’akanire amabe ase amaya.
Ekeene, Nyasae ang’e egesusuro bono na kogenderera onye mambia kobogokia tekonyora naitire na gosiria abanto abasacha bonsi bare amo na Nabali.”
Ekero Abigaeli aroche Daudi agaika bwango korwa ase etigere, agekumba inse, akaumama ase obosio bwa Daudi.
Ekero atungaime inse ase amagoro a Daudi agateba, “Omonene one, okomocha okwo tiga kobarwe igoro yane; koranche ontige inche omosomba oo omokungu nkwane, naye otegerere amang’ana aane.

Omonene one, tobaisa kobara Nabali, omonto oyo omobe, ng’a nomonto ogwenerete. Nere okorokwa Nabali, na engencho y’erieta eri noboriri. Naboigo are omonto omoriri. Bono inche, omosomba oo omokungu, tinaroche abanto aba aye, omonene one, gwatomete.

Aye omonene one, Omonene nere ogotangire tigwaitera amanyinga na kweruseria egesiomba nokoboko kwao omonyene. Bono buna Omonene are moyo, na buna aye ore moyo, tiga ababisa bao, abwo bakorigia kogokora bobe, babe buna Nabali.
Na bono, omonene one, ebiegwa ebi inche omosomba oo nakorenteire, tiga biegwe abanto aba bakogotunyana aye omonene one.

Nasabire, onyabere okomocha kwane, inche omosomba oo omokungu. Ekeene, Omonene nakore enyomba yao egenderere kobao, ekiagera aye nigo okorwana esegi yaye; na amabe takonyorekana asore ase obogima bwao bwonsi.

Onye abanto bagokoimokera na korigia obogima bwao kobosiria, Omonene, Nyasae oo, narende obogima bwao, na gokobeka obeere amo nabare moyo, korende natugute obogima bw’ababisa bao buna rigena rikorutwa gochia aare nenduruche.
Omonene one, ekero Omonene agakoreire amaya ayio onsi akorierete eira ng’a nagokorere, naende okobekire obe omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli,

aye, omonene one, tokoba nomoichano gose nenkoro egokogambia, ng’a ngwaiterete amanyinga ’abanto batari na komocha, gose ng’a nkweruseretie egesiomba. Bono kerabe Omonene ogokoreire amaya ayio, ong’inyore inche omosomba oo.”
Erio Daudi agatebia Abigaeli, “Atogigwe Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyio ogotoma gwacha koumerana nainche ase rituko ria rero.
Obong’aini bwao botogigwe, naye boigo otogigwe, ekiagera rituko ria rero gwantangire ting’itera amanyinga na imbe nokomocha gose kweruseria egesiomba inche omonyene.

Ekeene buna Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, are moyo, oyontangire tinakora amabe asore, onye otaimogete bwango na koumerana nainche, monto onde tarenge nonya noyomo bw’abasacha b’enyomba ya Nabali anga ore gocha koba moyo goika mambia kobogokiamoka.”
Erio Daudi agancha ebinto biria omokungu oria amoirerete, akamotebia, “Irana gochia bwoo nomorembe. Rora, naigure amang’ana ao, nanchire okoboria kwao.”

Ekero Abigaeli aigete nka, akanyora Nabali obwate omoyega omonene oyoisaine omoruoti agokora. Nabali nigo arenge nomochengo ase enkoro yaye ime, ekiagera konya otindire mono. Ase ayio Abigaeli tamotebetie gento kende, korende akaganya goika bogakia mambia.
Kobwakiire mambia, na Nabali gatindokire, Abigaeli akamotebia amang’ana ayio. Erio enkoro yaye ekarianyeka, ekoma pa, ekaba buna rigena.
Naende nyuma y’amatuko ikomi kaerire Omonene agaaka Nabali, na ere agakwa.

Ekero Daudi aigwete ng’a Nabali okure, akabora, “Omonene atogigwe, ekiagera onduseirie egesiomba ase Nabali ase amabe onsi aya ere ankoreire; naende ontangire inche, omosomba oye, tinakora ebibe. Omonene oakanire obobe obwo, na kobobeka igoro ase Nabali omonyene.” Erio Daudi agatoma abanto bakwane n’Abigaeli, erinde amonyuome abe mokaye.
Ekero abasomba ba Daudi baigete ase Abigaeli agwo Karimeli, bakamotebia, “Daudi nigo atotomire asore, erinde tokoire obe mokaye.”
Abigaeli akaimoka, agatung’ama inse, akabora, “Rora, inche omosomba oye omokungu nigo inde ang’e gosibia amagoro ’abasomba b’omonene one.”
Abigaeli akebeka ang’e bwango, akaimoka akariina etigere, akagenda amo nabasomba baye abaiseke batano. Bagatunyana abanto abwo Daudi atomete, na omosubati oyio akaba moga Daudi.
Daudi konya onyuomire Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli; ase igo abwo babere bakaba abakungu baye.
Saulo konya orure Mikali, omosubati oye, oyorenge moga Daudi, ase Paliti, mosinto o Laisi bw’omochie o Galimu.
Abanto bande ba Sifu bakagenda ase Saulo agwo Gibea, bakamotebia ng’a Daudi igo akebisete ase ekegoro gia Hakila kororia Yesimoni.
Erio Saulo akaimoka amo n’Abaisraeli bande chilifu isato abachoretwe korigia Daudi ase erooro ya Sifu.
Saulo agatoora ase ekegoro kia Hakila kororia Yesimoni ang’e nenchera, korende Daudi akagenderera kobeera agwo ase erooro, na ekero aigwete ng’a Saulo omobwatirie gocha ase erooro,
agatoma chirooti na igo akamanya na koenekia ng’a Saulo konya oikireo.

Daudi akaimoka, akagenda aase aria Saulo atoorete. Akarora aase aria Saulo araire amo n’Abineri, mosinto o Neri; omochiki bw’abarwani baye. Saulo nigo araire aase chigari chiabekire chikengete, na abarwani bamoetanaine.

Erio Daudi akaboria Ahimeleki Omohiti, na Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, “Ning’o oranche gotirimboka amo nainche gochia ase Saulo ase egetwori kiaye?” Abisai akamoiraneria, “Ninche ndagende amo naye.”

Ase igo ase obotuko obwo Daudi na Abisai bakagenda agwo ase abanto b’egetwori keria, bakanyora Saulo oraire aase chigari chiabekire chikengete. Saulo nigo asimisetie ritimo riaye ang’e nomotwe oye, na Abineri na abarwani bande b’esegi nigo baraire, bamoetanaine.
Abisai agatebia Daudi, “Rora Nyasae obekire omobisa oo ase okoboko kwao, ase ayio ing’a ribaga imobete ritimo erimo rioka, imobwateranie riroba, gose tinkomobeta kabere.”
Daudi agakania Abisai, akamotebia, “Tokomoita, naki ning’o oranyare korambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene amoite, na taegwa egesusuro?”
Naende Daudi akabora, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, Omonene omonyene nere oraite Saulo, gose rituko ri’ogokwa kwaye nariike, gose nagende ase esegi na goitwa akwe.
Korende Omonene antange; tindambora okoboko kwane ase ogoita omoakwa amaguta oye. Imokia ritimo erio rire ang’e ase omotwe oye amo nekerandi keria ki’amache, togende.”

Ase ayio Daudi akaimokia ritimo na ekerandi keria ki’amache korwa ensemo y’omotwe o Saulo. Erio Daudi na Abisai bakagenda. Monto onde taroche aya kagokorekana, gose koyamanya, na onde tatabobogete. Bonsi nigo baraire chitoro chindito, ekiagera Omonene abarenterete chitoro echio chindito.
Erio Daudi akaamboka gochia eng’umbu ende, agatenena aare ase ekegoro keria, bokaba oboare botari boke ase egati yabo.
Daudi akarangeria abarwani abwo b’esegi, na Abineri, mosinto o Neri, akabora, “Abineri, tori goitaba?” Abineri akairaneria, “Naye ng’o okorangeria omoruoti?”
Daudi akaboria Abineri, “Aye tori omonto etuoni? Ning’o ore omoremu buna aye ase egati y’Abaisraeli? Nase ki rende otarendete omonene oo omoruoti? Omonto oyomo nacheteo goita Omonene oo omoruoti.

Eke gwakorire nigo kere ekebe. Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, nigo mogwenerete goitwa, ekiagera mwasinyirwe korenda omonene oino, oyore omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene. Bono ritimo ri’omoruoti, na ekerandi keria ki’amache kiarenge ang’e nomotwe oye, ng’ai bikare?”
Erio Saulo akamanya eriogi ria Daudi, akamoboria, “Naye Daudi, omwana one, eriogi eri neriao?” Daudi akamoiraneria, “Ee omoruoti, omonene one, neriane.”
Naende akabora, “Aye omonene one, nase ki okona‐kondigia inche omosomba oo ng’a ong’ite? Ninki nakorire. Nkomocha ki inde nakwo?

Bono aye omoruoti, omonene one, igwa amang’ana aane, inche omosomba oo. Onye n’Omonene ogoseegetire ondigia ase ogonsiria, rirorio tiga anchere ekeng’wanso ekio, korende onye nabanto bakogoseegeta igoro asende, rirorio Omonene abaragererie, ekiagera rero iga banseririe ng’a tinyora omwando korwa ase Omonene, bagantebia: Genda okorere chinyasae ching’ao.
Gaki bono, totiga amanyinga aane aiteke aare korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene. Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli ochire kondigia inche inde ensona, buna omonto okorigia chinkware ase ebitunwa.”

Erio Saulo akamotebia “Nakorire ebibe! Aye Daudi, omwana one, irana. Tinkogokorera amabe naende, ekiagera rituko ria rero obogima bwane nigo bwaba bw’engencho enene asore. Nakorire ayare oboriri, na igo nakorire okomocha okonene.”
Daudi akamoiraneria, “Aye omoruoti, rora ritimo riao eri, toma omosae oyomo amboke arioyie.

Omonene nigo agoakana kera omonto buna oboronge bwaye bore, na obwegenwa boigo. Ase rituko ria rero Omonene nigo akobegete ase okoboko kwane, korende nkaanga korambora okoboko kwane igoro ase omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.
Ase ayio, buna obogima bwao bwabete obw’engencho enene asende rituko ria rero, naboigo obogima bwane bore ase obosio bw’Omonene; ere nantoorie korwa ase emechando yonsi.”
Erio Saulo agatebia Daudi, “Aye Daudi, omwana one, nosesenigwe. Aye nokore ebinto ebinge mono na kobua.” Daudi akabwatia enchera yaye, na Saulo akairana nka bwoye.

Daudi akarengereria ase enkoro yaye, akabora, “Rituko erimo ning’itwe na Saulo. Egento kerabe ekiya mono asende nogotama korwa aiga na kogenda ase ense y’Abafilisti. Erio nario Saulo ararusie moyo, tana kondigia naende aa ase chingongo chi’Abaisraeli, na nintooreke korwa ase okoboko kwaye.”
Ase igo Daudi akaimoka amo nabanto baye amagana atano na rimo, akagenda ase Akisi, mosinto o Maoki, omoruoti o Gati.

Daudi amo nabanto baye bakamenya amo n’Akisi agwo Gati. Kera omonto nigo amenyete amo nabanto b’eamate yaye, na Daudi amo nabakungu baye babere, Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli, na Abigaeli korwa Karimeli, oyio Nabali atigete ore omoboraka.
Ekero Saulo atebetigwe ng’a Daudi konya otamire gochia Gati, tagendete komorigia.

Erio Daudi agatebia Akisi, “Onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, koranche ong’e aase nkomenya ase omochie ore isiko korwa ase omochie oo. Tari buya asende, omosomba oo, ngenderere komenya ase omochie omonene bw’oboruoti amo naye?”
Ase ayio, ase rituko riria Akisi akaa Daudi Sikilagi. Ase engencho eyio omochie oyio o Sikilagi nigo ore oyo bw’abaruoti b’Abayuda goika rero iga.
Daudi akagenderera komenya ase ense y’Abafilisti ase engaki y’omwaka oyomo na emetienyi ene.

Ase engaki eyio Daudi na abanto baye bakaba bakogenda korwania Abagesuri, na Abagirisi, na Abaameleki. Abwo nigo barenge ababiare b’ense eyio korwa kare; nigo bamenyete goika Suri na goika orobebe rw’ense ya Misiri.
Daudi akaba okorwania ense eyio na goita abanto bonsi pi, abasacha na abakungu; agasakora ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitigere, ne chingamia, akaira ne chianga. Erio aba okoirana gochia ase Akisi.

Ekero Akisi arenge koboria Daudi, “Insemo ki gwachiete korwania rituko ria rero?” “Daudi aba okomoiraneria,” “Ense ya Irianyi ere ey’Abayuda,” gose “Ense ya Irianyi ere eya Yerameeli,” gose “Ense ya Irianyi ere ey’Abakeni,”

Daudi tarenge gotiga nonya nomonto oyomo, omosacha gose omokungu, ore moyo, ekiagera nigo arengereretie ng’a onde tabaisa kogenda Gati atebe ng’a, “Aya naro Daudi agotokorera.” Naboigo yarenge engencho ya Daudi ekero agendererete komenya ase ense y’Abafilisti.
Ase ayio Akisi akegena Daudi mono, akarengereria, “Bono Daudi okorire Abaisraeli bamwabo bamogeche kegima; ase igo ogenderere koba omosomba one botambe.”
Ase engaki eyio Abafilisti bagasangereria abarwani babo amo, erinde barwanie Abaisraeli, na Akisi agatebia Daudi, “Goika omanye ng’a aye amo nabanto bao nigo mogochia kondwanesia esegi.”
Daudi akamoiraneria, “Ayio mbuya kegima; aye nomanye egento inche, omosomba oo, ndakore.” Akisi agatebia Daudi, “Ningokore obe omorendi bw’obogima bwane kogenderera botambe.”

Bono Samweli konya okure, na Abaisraeli bonsi konya bamoreereire, bamotindekire ase omochie oye Rama. Boigo Saulo konya oseririe abanto barenge koboria amang’ana korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakure, amo nabaringoria bonsi.
Abafilisti bagasangererekana, bagatoora agwo Sunemu; Saulo nere agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi amo, nabarabwo bagatoora agwo Giliboa.
Ekero Saulo aroche abarwani b’Abafilisti agasogwa nomoondoko, na enkoro yaye ekaiguswa mono.
Saulo akaboria komanya korwa ase Omonene, korende Omonene tamoiraneretie gento kende, nonya goetera ase chindoto, gose goetera ase Urimu, gose goetera ase ababani.

Erio Saulo agatebia abasomba baye, “Indigererie omokungu okoboria amang’ana korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakure, nimochiere, ndigie ogosemigwa korwa asare.” Abasomba baye bakamoiraneria, “Naama! Agwo Eni‐Dori omokungu buna oyio nareo.”

Erio Saulo agekona, akabeka chianga ching’ao, akagenda amo nabanto bande babere, bagaika ase omokungu oyio botuko. Saulo agatebia omokungu oria, “Indagore ase omoika, ondetere omonto oria ndatore erieta riaye asore.”

Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Amaene, aye nomanyete aya Saulo akorire, buna asiririe korwa ase ense eye abakungu abakoboria emeika y’abanto bakure amo nabaringoria bonsi. Nase ki rende okombeka ase oboreba, mbwatwe na gokwa?”
Erio Saulo agatiana ase engencho y’omokungu oria, agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, aye tokonyora egesusuro ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio.”
Omokungu oria akamoboria, “Ning’o oganetie nkorangererie arorekane?” Saulo akamoiraneria, “Indangererie Samweli.”
Korende ekero omokungu oria aroche Samweli, agakuura neriogi rinene agatebia Saulo, “Nase ki kwang’aina? Aye n’Saulo.”
Omoruoti oria akamotebia, “Tibwoboa! Ninki kwarora?” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Narorire enyasae egotiira korwa riroba inse.”

Saulo akamoboria, “Naki ekerorekana?” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Nomogaaka omogotu bwetubete egetambaa gi’okwambara.” Erio Saulo akamanya ng’a oyio n’Samweli, agatung’ama inse, akaorokia amasikani.

Samweli akaboria Saulo, “Nase ki gwanchandire okondeta korwa ase omotimoko one.” Saulo akairaneria, “Inche nigo nchandegete mono; Abafilisti nkondwania bare esegi, na Nyasae onyangire, tari kong’iraneria, goetera ase ababani, gose ase chindoto. Ase ayio nigo nakorangeirie, erinde ontebie eki ndakore.”
Samweli akairaneria, “Nase ki okomboria inche, onye Omonene okwangire na obeire omobisa oo?
Omonene ogokoreire ayio akwanete goetera asende; okourire oboruoti korwa ase amaboko ao, oboeire omonto omoao, nere Daudi.
Tikwaigwerete eriogi ri’Omonene, gose goikerania egesusuro ki’endamwamu yaye entindi igoro y’Abaameleki. Ekio nakio kiagera Omonene akorire amang’ana ayio asore rero iga.

Boigo Omonene nache abeke Abaisraeli amo naye ase amaboko ’Abafilisti. Ankio aye amo nabamura bao moche kobeera amo nainche, na Omonene nache abeke abarwani b’esegi b’Abaisraeli ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.”
Erio agwo Saulo agaaka inse, akarambereria ore nobwoba obonene ase amang’ana ayio a Samweli. Chinguru chikamoerera kegima, ekiagera tariete kende ase omobaso bwonsi na obotuko boigo.
Erio omokungu oria akamochera Saulo akarora ng’a osoirwe nomoondoko, akamotebia, “Rora inche omosomba oo omokungu nigonakoigwera na tinaegerete obogima bwane, nakora buna kwaganetie.
Gaki bono koranche inyigwe inche omosomba oo omokungu, tiga nkorentere endagera orie, erinde onyore chinguru, ogenderere norogendo rwao.”
Ere akaanga, akabora, “Tinganeti koria,” korende abasomba baye amo nomokungu oria bakamosorora goika akaigwera amang’ana abo. Erio akaimoka korwa inse agwo, agaikaransa borere.
Omokungu oria nabwate emori enoru nka bwoye, akayenyenya bwango. Boigo akaimokia obosie, akabokonya, agakora emegati etabekiri memera, akayegekera.
Erio akarenta endagera eyio ase Saulo na abasomba baye, nabarabwo bakayeria. Nyuma y’ayio bakaimoka, bakagenda ase obotuko obwo.
Abafilisti bagasangereria abarwani babo bonsi b’esegi agwo Afeki, na Abaisraeli bagatoora ang’e nensoko yarenge agwo Yesireeli.
Abanene b’Abafilisti bagacha bagaeta baare nebiombe biabo bi’abanto amagana ne chilifu. Daudi na abanto baye bakaba bakorwa nyuma amo n’Akisi.

Erio abanene baria b’Abafilisti bakaboria, “Ninki Abaibirania aba bagokora aiga?” Akisi akabairaneria, “Oyo n’Daudi, omosomba o Saulo, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli. Oyio obeire omenyete amo nainche goetania omwaka oyomo, tinana korora komocha asare korwa riria achete asende goika rero iga.”

Korende abanene b’Abafilisti bakaba nendamwamu enene ase Akisi, bakamotebia, “Irania omonto oyo agende aase kwamobegete amenye. Ere takogenda amo naintwe korwana esegi. Karaikeo nabo arabaise gotoonchokera, abe omobisa oito. Naki arakore anyore ogwancherwa ase omonene oye otatiga ase ogoita abanto baito.
Inee! Daudi tari ere oria abakungu baterete igoro yaye kobagotenga, bakabora: Saulo oitire chilifu chiaye, korende Daudi oitire chilifu chiaye emerongo na emerongo.”

Erio Akisi akarangeria Daudi, akamotebia, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, nigo ndoche buya ng’a ogende amo nainche ase esegi. Korwa ekero gwachete asende goika rituko ria rero tinana korora okomocha asore, korende nonya naboigo, abanene aba tibagwancheti.
Ase ayio irana ogende nomorembe, erinde tobaisa gokora gento ase okogechia abanene b’Abafilisti.”

Daudi akaboria Akisi, “Ngento ki nakorire? Korwa ekero inche, omosomba oo, nachete aa kogokorera, goika rituko ria rero, mbobe ki kwarorire asende bokogera tingenda korwania ababisa bao, aye omoruoti, omonene one?”

Akisi akamoiraneria, “Inche nimanyete buya ng’a nigo ore omoronge asende buna omomalaika bw’Omonene. Korende nonya nabo abanene b’Abafilisti bakanire ng’a aye Daudi tobaisa kogenda amo naintwe ase esegi.
Ase ayio, aye amo nabasomba bande b’Omonene oo baria bachete amo naye, moche moimoke mambia chuni erio mochake kogenda kobogokiamoka.”
Ase igo Daudi amo nabanto baye bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagachaka orogendo rwabo, bakairana ase ense y’Abafilisti, korende Abafilisti bakagenda gochia Yesireeli.
Ase rituko ria gatato Daudi na abanto baye bagaika Sikilagi. Abaameleki konya bachakire esegi agwo Negebu na Sikilagi. Na bono konya babuire Sikilagi na koyosamba nomorero,
boosire abakungu na bonsi abarengeo, abake na abanene. Tibaitete monto onde, korende nigo babairete, bakagenda nabarabwo.
Ekero Daudi na abanto baye bachete ase omochie oyio, bakanyora ng’a osambirwe, na abakungu babo amo nabamura na abaiseke babo bairirwe ase obosomba.
Erio Daudi na abanto baria barenge komo bagaaka amariogi abo, bakarera mono goika chinguru chikabaerera.
Abakungu ba Daudi bonsi babere, Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli, na Abigaeli, oyotigetwe omoboraka orenge moka Nabali o Karimeli, konya bairirwe ase obosomba nabarabwo.

Daudi akaba nemechando emenene, ekiagera abanto nigo barengereretie komoaka amagena bamoite. Barabwo nigo barenge nobororo obonge ase engencho y’abana babo abamura na abaiseke. Korende Daudi akanyora chinguru korwa ase Omonene Nyasae oye.
Daudi agatebia Abiatari omokuani, mosinto bw’Ahimeleki, “Ndetere egesibao ki’obokuani.” Abiatari akarentera Daudi egesibao keria.
Daudi akaboria Omonene, akabora, “Inee! Ndabwatia omoganda oyo bw’abauri? Nimbaikere gose?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Babwatie! Nobatoorie abanto boosirwe.”
Erio Daudi amo nabanto baye amagana atano na rimo bakagenda, bagaika ase akarooche ka Besori. Agwo abanto bande bagatigara nyuma.
Daudi amo nabanto amagana ane bakagenderera kobwatia ababisa baria. Abanto baria bande amagana abere bakarosa mono, bagasinywa kwamboka; ase igo bagatigara ase akarooche karia Besori.
Abanto baria ba Daudi bakanyora omomura omosae bw’Abamisiri agwo ase arenge aarabu, bakamorenta ase Daudi, bakamoa omogati akaria, na amache akanywa,
naende bakamoa amako amomo, na amabomba abere ay’amasabibu amomo, na ekero arire, akanyora chinguru. Ase engaki y’amatuko atato konya atana koria gento, gose konywa.

Daudi akamoboria, “Noyo ng’o ore? Seino ng’ai?” Omosae oria akairaneria, “Inche nigo inde omomura bw’Abamisiri na omosomba bw’omonto oyomo Omoameleki. Bono amatuko atato aerire korwa ekero omonene one antigete, ekiagera nabete omorwaire.
Intwe nigo twasanyorera Negebu aase Abakereti bamenyete, na ensemo ere ey’Abayuda na ey’abanto ba Kalebu. Boigo togasamba Sikilagi nomorero.”

Daudi akamoboria, “Inee! Nonyare kong’ira na konyorokia aase abauri abwo bare?” Omomura oria akairaneria, “Tiana ase Nyasae ng’a tokong’ita, gose tokombeka ase okoboko kw’omonene one; rirorio ninkoire nkwoorokie aase omoganda oria ore.”
Erio akaraa Daudi gochiao. Abauri abwo nigo baserebekanete aande onsi bakoria, bakonywa na kwegokia, ekiagera konya banyorire ebisakorwa ebinge korwa ase ense y’Abafilisti na ense ya Yuda.
Daudi akabarwania korwa mogoroba kobokomura‐mura goika mogoroba rituko ria kabere. Agaita abanto bonsi otatiga abamura amagana ane abariinete chingamia batamete.
Daudi akairania ebinto bionsi, na abanto bonsi, aba Abaameleki konya bairire, amo nabakungu baye babere.
Onde tasirete nonya noyomo, omoke gose omonene. Kera omwana, omomura gose omoiseke, o kera omonto nigo atooretigwe, na ebinto bionsi boigo. Daudi akairania abanto bonsi, na ebinto bionsi pi.
Boigo Daudi akairania ching’ondi, ne chimbori, ne chiombe. Abanto baye bagachitang’ania bosio bwaye, bagateba, “Ebi nebisakorwa bia Daudi.”

Erio Daudi akairana gochia ase abanto baria amagana abere konya barosire batigarete agwo ase akarooche ka Besori. Ekero aigete ang’e, barabwo bagacha komorotota, ere na abanto baria barenge komo. Daudi akabachiera, akabakwania.

Korende abanto bande ababe abatagwenerete ase abwo bagendete na Daudi bakabora, “Ekiagera abanto aba tibagendete amo naintwe, titokobaa gento kende gionsi ase ebi twasakoire, otatiga kera omonto araegwe mokaye na abana baye, aire bwoye.”
Korende Daudi akabatebia, “Abaminto, timobaisa gokora igo nebinto ebi Omonene atoiraneirie. Ere ototooririe, obekire ase amaboko aito abanto baria abauri abwo batoumokerete.

Ning’o oranyare kobaigwera ase amang’ana buna ayio? Yaya, buna abanto abwo bagendete korwana esegi bakoegwa ebisakorwa, naboigo nabwo batigarete nyuma korenda ebinto baraegwe. Nigo baragaberwe bareng’anie.”
Korwa ase rituko erio Daudi agakora ring’ana erio rikaba ogochika ase Abaisraeli. Naboigo rire nonya ngoika rero iga.
Ekero Daudi aigete Sikilagi, agatoma ebiegwa ase abagaaka b’Abayuda abwo barenge abasani baye, akabora, “Ebiegwa ebi nebisakorwa korwa ase ababisa b’Omonene.”
Naboigo abitomerete abagaaka ba Beteli na Ramoti agwo Negebu, na abwo b’emechie ya Yatiri,
na Aroeri, na Sifamoti, na Esitemoa,
na Rakali; abwo b’emechie y’Abayerameli, na Abakeni,
abwo ba Horima, na Bori‐Asani, na Ataki,
na Heburoni. Agatoma ebiegwa ase chinsemo echio chionsi ase arenge kona‐gotaarera amo nabanto baye.
Abafilisti bakarwania Abaisraeli, na Abaisraeli bagatama korwa asebare, bagaiterwa ase egetunwa kia Giliboa
Abafilisti bakabwatia Saulo mono, na abamura baye, bagaita Yonathani, na Aminadabu, na Maliki‐Sua, abamura ba Saulo.
Esegi ekaba entindi mono igoro ya Saulo; abaruti emegwe bakamoromereria mono; ere akabwatwa nomoondoko omonene ase engencho ya barabwo.

Erio Saulo agatebia omonto oria omobogoreretie ebirwanero, “Somora omoyio, ombete nkwe, erinde abanto aba batarogeti tibabaisa kong’ita na gonchecheria.” Korende omonto oria akaanga, ekiagera abete nobwoba obonene. Erio Saulo agasomora omoyio oye omonyene, akegweria ase omoyio oyio bweka omonyene.
Ekero omobogoria ebirwanero aroche ayio, nere akegweria ase omoyio oye, agakwa amo na Saulo.
Nabo Saulo, na abamura baye batato, na omobogoria ebirwanero, amo nabanto baye bonsi, baitetwe ase rituko erio erimo.

Ekero Abaisraeli abwo barenge ensemo ende ase ense omweremo, na abwo narenge moocha ya Yorodan baigwete ng’a Abaisraeli konya batamire, na ng’a Saulo na abamura baye bakure, bagatiga emechie yabo bagatama. Erio Abafilisti bakagenda bakamenya ase emechie eyio.
Rituko ria kabere ekero Abafilisti bachete konuura ebinto korwa ase emebere y’abanto bakwete, bakanyora Saulo na abamura baye batato bakwete agwo ase egetunwa kia Giliboa.
Abafilisti bakabutora omotwe o Saulo, bakaira na ebirwanero biaye, erio bagatoma abanto bararie amang’ana ayio ase ense yonsi y’Abafilisti, ase hekalu y’emegwekano yabo bagosasima, na ase abanto.
Erio bakabeka ebirwanero biaye ase enyomba y’Asitaroti, enyasae yabo enkungu, na omobere oye bakayotonga ase orwaki rwa Beti‐Sani.
Ekero abanto bamenyete Yabesi o Gileadi baigwete aya Abafilisti bakorete ase Saulo,
abanto bonsi chituoni bakaimoka, bakagenda ase obotuko obogima, bakarusia omobere o Saulo, na ey’abamura baye, korwa ase orwaki rwa Beti‐Sani, bakayerenta Yabesi, bakayesambera aroro.
Erio bakabogoria amauga abo, bakayatindeka inse y’omote onga buna ekerachuoki agwo Yabesi, bakeng’ata ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
Nyuma Saulo gakure, Daudi akairana korwa ase ogoita Abaameleki, akabeera agwo Sikilagi ase engaki y’amatuko abere.

Ase rituko ria gatato omonto agacha korwa ase egetwori gia Saulo; chianga chiaye nigo chiatandoire, na amaroba are ase omotwe oye. Ekero aigete ase Daudi, agekumba gochia inse ase okoorokia amasikani.
Daudi akamoboria, “Ng’ai okorwa?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Nigo natoorekire korwa ase egetwori ki’Abaisraeli.”

Naende Daudi akamoboria, “Naki esegi egendererete? Nagosabire ontebie.” Omonto oria akamoiraneria, “Abanto abange batamire korwa ase esegi eria, na abande abange mono baitirwe bakure. Boigo Saulo amo na Yonathani, momura oye, baitirwe bakure.”
Daudi akaboria omomura oria, “Naki gwakorete okamanya ng’a Saulo na Yonathani, momura oye, bakure?”

Omomura oria akamoiraneria, “Nigo yaba ng’a nao nare ase egetunwa kia Giliboa, na aroro nkarora Saulo osigamerete ritimo riaye; chigari konya chiamoikereire ang’e, na abanto bariinete chibarasi bakomominyokia.
Agachia korigereria nyuma, akandora, akandangeria, na inche ngaitaba: Nao inde aa.
Erio akamboria: Naye ng’o? Nkamoiraneria ng’a n’Omoamelekiinde.
Ere agantebia: Koranche, ong’ike ang’e ong’ite, ekiagera nonya ngendererete koba moyo, nigo inde nobororo bw’ogokwa.

Ase ayio nkamoika ang’e, nkamoita, ekiagrea nigo namanyete ng’a tare koba moyo nyuma kagure. Nkamorusia egutwa y’obogambi yare motwe oye na egetange kiarenge koboko kwaye, narentire ebinto ebio aa asore, aye omonene one.”
Erio Daudi akabwata chianga chiaye, agachitandora, na abanto bonsi abarenge amo nere bagakora bo.
Bakarera na kweumia, na kweng’ata goika mogoroba ase engencho ya Saulo na Yonathani, omwana oye, na ase engencho y’abanto b’Omonene na ey’Abaisraeli, ekiagera barabwo konya baitirwe nemioro.
Daudi akaboria omomura oria omotebia amang’ana ayio, “Aye noyo o arari ore?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Inche nigo inde omwana bw’Omoameleki ore omomenyi aa.”
Daudi akamoboria, “Naki yabete otairogete korambora okoboko kwao ase ogoita omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene?”
Erio Daudi akarangeria omomura oyomo, akamotebia, “Inchuo omoite!” Omomura oria agaaka Omoameleki oria, akamoita,

ekiagera Daudi konya otebirie Omoameleki oria, “Okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ao, tiga kobarwe igoro yao, ekiagera kwebereire kirori aye omonyene, ekero gwateba ng’a gwaitire omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.”
Daudi akoreera Saulo na Yonathani, momura o Saulo, nogotera oko gw’okweumia.
Agachika ng’a abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda borokererigwe ogotera okwo kw’obota korikire ase Ebuku ya Yashari.
“Inwe Abaisraeli, obonene bwaino bwasireire igoro ase ebigoro biaino! Chituoni chi’esegi chiaitirwe.
Timoteba amang’ana aya ase Gati, timoyararia ase chinchera chi’Askeloni. Timotiga abaiseke b’Abafilisti bachenge; timotiga abaiseke b’abanto baria batarogeti bagoke!”

“Inwe ebigoro bia Giliboa, ogotoora kwe riime tikoba igoro asemore, gose embura tetwa, gose emegondo teba ekwama endagera ekoruegwa ase Omonene, ekiagera aroro agwo nao chinguba chie chituoni chiasareretigwe, na enguba ya Saulo etaagetwe amaguta naende.
Obota bwa Yonathani nigo bwaitete abanto abange, nigo bwaiterete amanyinga, bogaita abanto chituoni abarenge abanoru; naboigo omoro o Saulo torenge koirana bosa.”
“Saulo na Yonathani barenge abanchwa baito, barenge gotogokia. Ase obogima na ase amakweri tibaatananetwe. Barabwo nigo barenge abaango kobua chinsoti, nigo barenge ne chinguru kobua chindo.”
“Inwe abakungu b’Abaisraeli, reerera Saulo, nere obaboyetie chianga chie rigori rinene, chianga chimbariri chi’okwegokeria, agachichabera ebinto bi’etahabu.”
“Chituoni chiaitirwe ase esegi! Yonathani nao araire ase ebigoro igoro, oitire.”
“Aye Yonathani ominto, nigo inde nomoichano omonene ase engencho yao, aye nigo konya ongogetie mono. Obwanchani bwao nigo bwarenge bongogetie kobua obwanchani bw’abakungu.”
“Chituoni chiaitirwe, na ebirwanero bi’esegi biasirigwe!”
Nyuma y’ayio Daudi akaboria Omonene, “Inee! Ndagenda ase omochie onde bw’Abayuda inyoire?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda.” Naende Daudi akamoboria, “Norori?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Heburoni.”
Ase igo Daudi agatiira gochiao amo nabakungu baye babere, Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli, na Abigaeli, oyotigetwe omoboraka, orenge moka Nabali o Karimeli.
Boigo akairana abanto baye bonsi amo ne chiamate chiabo komenya ase emechie ya Heburoni.
Abayuda bagacha Heburoni, bagaaka Daudi amaguta akaba omoruoti igoro y’abanto b’egesaku kiabo. Ekero Daudi atebetigwe ng’a abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi nabwo batindegete Saulo,
agatoma amang’ana gochia Yabesi o Gileadi gotebia abanto b’aroro, “Omonene abasesenie, ekiagera mwaorogetie obuya bwaino ase Saulo, omonene oino, ase okomotindeka.
Omonene abaorokerie obwanchani bwaye botari koera, na obwegenwa bwaye. Nainche boigo nimbakorere amaya, ekiagera mwakora ring’ana erio.
Ase ayio bono motenene bokong’u, mobe abaremu. Saulo, omonene oino, okure, na Abayuda bang’akire amaguta imbe omoruoti obo.”
Bono Abineri, mosinto o Neri, orenge omotang’ani bw’abarwani ba Saulo. Ere konya oirire Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, gochia Mahanaimu,
akamobeka koba omoruoti igoro ase abanto ba Gileadi, na Asuri, na Yesireeli, na Efraimu, na Benjamin, na igoro ase Abaisraeli bonsi.

Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, konya okoorire emiaka emerongo ene ekero abegetwe koba omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli; akagamba ase engaki y’emiaka ebere. Korende abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda bakaba bakobwatia Daudi.
Ere akabagambera Abayuda agwo Heburoni ase engaki y’emiaka etano na ebere, na emetienyi etano nomo.
Abineri, mosinto o Neri, na abasomba ba Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, bakarua Mahanaimu, bakagenda ase omochie o Gibeoni.
Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, na abanto ba Daudi bakagenda, bakaumerana nabarabwo ase ritibo ria Gibeoni. Abanto aba bakabeera ensemo eyemo ye ritibo riria, na abwo bande ensemo ende.
Abineri agatebia Yoabu, “Tiga abamura baimoke bagosorie ase amasio aito.” Yoabu agateba, “Tiga baimoke.”
Erio bakaimoka, bakaroberia abanto ikomi na babere abatenenerete egesaku kia Benjamin na Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, na abanto ikomi na babere abatenenerete Daudi.
Kera oyomo akabwata omotwe bw’oyo riare koamererania, na komobeta omoyio ase rikere; bonsi bakagwa inse bagakwa. Ase ayio, aase aria a Gibeoni akarokwa Helikati‐Hasurimu.
Esegi ekaba entindi mono ase rituko erio, na Abineri na Abaisraeli bakabugwa nabanto ba Daudi.
Abamura batato b’omokungu Seruya, Yoabu na Abisai, na Asaeli, nao barenge. Asaeli nigo arenge omominyoki mono buna egesia.
Ere agachaka kobwatia Abineri, na ekero arenge komobwatia taonchogete gochia aande, ensemo ya borio gose eya bomosi.
Abineri akeonchora, akamoboria, “Naye Asaeli?” Ere akairaneria, “Ee, ninche.”
Abineri akamotebia, “Gobera gochia ensemo ende, eya borio gose eya bomosi, obwatie omomura oyomo bw’abwo, oire ebirwanero biaye.” Korende Asaeli tancha koonchoka amotige.
Abineri akamotebia eria kabere, “Gobera, tiga kombwatia. Nigo orabaise kogera ngoake nkobwateranie inse. Igo naki ndakore ng’oroke ase obosio bwa Yoabu omino?”
