Korende Asaeli akaanga kogobera. Ase igo Abineri akamobeta enda nesimisi y’orotanga rwe ritimo, na rirorio rigasokera omogongo oye. Asaeli agaaka inse, agakwera agwo aase arenge, Abanto bonsi abachete agwo ase Asaeli akwerete, bagatenenao.
Korenge Yoabu na Abisai bakabwatia Abineri. Ekero erioba rigochia kogwa bagaika ekegoro ki’Ama, kerochie Gia, ase enchera ekogenda erooro ya Gibeoni.
Abanto b’egesaku kia Benjamin bagasangerererkana amo ase okoegera Abineri, bakagenda ase ekegoro igoro, bagatenenao.

Erio Abineri akarangeria Yoabu, akamoboria, “Inee! Nigo oganetie omoro oite abanto kogenderera botambe? Tomanyeti ng’a omoerio nobororo borabe? Nengaki eng’ana naki oraganye goika omanye gokania abanto bao tibabwatia abamwabo?”
Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, buna Nyasae are moyo, onye otakwana, abanto baane anga nigo barenge kobabwatia goika mambia.”
Ase igo Yoabu akabugia egetureri, na abanto bonsi bagatenena, bagatiga kobwatia Abaisraeli, tibaba bakobarwania naende.
Abineri na abanto baye bakagenda ase obotuko boria obogima goetera ase Ekerubo Ekiomo; bakaamboka orooche rwa Yorodan, bagaeta egati ya Bitironi, bagaika Mahanaimu.
Yoabu akairana korwa ase okobwatia Abineri; na ekero asangereretie abanto bonsi amo, bakanyora ng’a abasomba ba Daudi ikomi na kianda tibaiyo; boigo Asaeli taiyo.
Korende abanto ba Daudi konya baitire abanto b’egesaku kia Benjamin amagana atato, na emerongo etano nomo, abwo barenge amo n’Abineri.

Abanto bakaimokia omobere bw’Asaeli, bakayoira bakayotindeka ase embeera ya ise agwo Bethlehemu. Erio Yoabu na abanto baye bakaba bare ase orogendo ase obotuko obogima, na ekero baikire Heburoni bokabakiera aroro.
Esegi ase egati y’eamate ya Saulo na eya Daudi ekaba ekogenderera ase engaki entambe. Daudi akagenderera komenteka chinguru chiaye, korende abanto b’eamate ya Saulo bakagenderera koba aboro goetania.
Aba nabwo abamura Daudi aiboreretwe agwo Heburoni: Aminoni nere orenge omwana oye omotangi, omwana bw’Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli.
Oyo o kabere Kileabu, omwana bw’Abigaeli, oyotigetwe omoboraka, orenge moka Nabali o Karimeli; na oyo o gatato Abisalomu o Maaka, mosubati o Talimai, omoruoti o Gesuri.
Oyo o kane Adonia o Hagiti, na oyo o gatano Sefatia bw’Abitali;
na oyo o gatano na rimo Iteramu bw’Egila, moga Daudi. Abamura aba nabwo Daudi aiboreretwe agwo Heburoni.
Ekero esegi eyio yagendererete ase egati y’eamate ya Saulo na eya Daudi, Abineri akagenderera kwenyorera chinguru chinyinge ase egati y’eamate ya Saulo.
Saulo nabwate omokungu o sere‐sere ore korokwa Risipa, mosubati bw’Aya. Isi‐Boseti akaboria Abineri, “Nase ki mwamenyanire nomokungu o sere‐sere o tata?”

Erio Abineri akaba nendamwamu enene ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio a Isi‐Boseti, akabora, “Inee! Inche nigo inde omotwe bw’esese korwa ase ense ya Yuda? Goika rituko ria rero ngendererete koba omwegenwa ase abanto b’eamate ya Saulo iso, na ase abamwabo, na ase abasani baye, ko tinakobeka ase okoboko gwa Daudi, na bono aye gwansoeire na gonkora koba nokomocha ase engencho y’omokungu oyo.
Nyasae ang’e egesusuro ekenene onye tingoikeraneria Daudi aya Omonene amorierete eira amokore:
Arusie oboruoti korwa ase enyomba ya Saulo, abobeke ase Daudi, na Daudi abe omoruoti, agambere Abaisraeli na Abayuda korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba.”
Na Isi‐Boseti tanyara koiraneria Abineri ring’ana nonya nerimo, ekiagera amoirogete.
Abineri agatoma abanto ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, akabora, “Ense eye neya ng’o? Kora okobwatana nainche, erio ngokonye na nkorentere Abaisraeli bonsi babwatane naye.”
Daudi agatoma amairanerio, agateba, “Ayio namaya, ninkore bo. Korende ninganetie onkorere egento ekemo. Kogocha aa ondetere Mikali, mosubati o Saulo. Onye togokora bo, rirorio tokonyara kondora.”

Erio Daudi agatoma abanto ase Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, akabora, “Ing’iranerie Mikali mokane, oyio narierete boko, na ngaakana rigori ri’amasankwa a isiko ay’ebiimo bi’obosacha ay’Abafilisti rigana erimo, erinde imonyuome.”
Erio Isi‐Boseti agatoma abanto barusie omokungu oria korwa ase Palitieli, omosacha oye, mosinto o Laisi.
Korende omosacha oye akamotunyana goika Bahurimu okona‐korera. Erio Abineri akamotebia, “Irana!” Ere akairana.
Agwo Abineri agakwana nabagaaka b’Abaisraeli, akabora, “Korwa ase chingaki chinde chiaetire mwabeire mokogania ng’a Daudi abe omoruoti oino.

Gaki bono, kora bo, ekiagera Omonene nariete eira igoro ya Daudi, agateba: Nintoorie Abaisraeli, abanto baane, goetera ase okoboko gwa Daudi, omosomba one. Nimbarusie korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti, na korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo bande bonsi.”
Abineri agakwana nabanto b’egesaku kia Benjamin boigo. Erio akagenda Heburoni, agatebia Daudi amang’ana ayio Abaisraeli na Ababenjamin bonsi banchete gokora asare.
Ekero Abineri amo nabanto bande emerongo ebere baigete Heburoni ase Daudi, ere akabakorera omoyega.

Abineri agatebia Daudi, “Nkogenda inde nsangererie Abaisraeli bonsi ase ensemo yao, aye omoruoti, omonene one, erio bakore okobwatana amo naye, erinde onyore eki kwaganetie, obagambere bonsi pi.” Ase igo Daudi akaa Abineri ribaga, na Abineri akagenda nomorembe.

Kobachiire, Yoabu agacha korwa ase achiete gosakora amo nabasomba ba Daudi, nabarabwo mbabwate ebisakorwa ebinge. Korende Abineri konya ochiire, tarenge amo na Daudi agwo Heburoni, ekiagera Daudi konya omoeire ribaga, nere ogendire nomorembe.
Ekero Yoabu aigete amo nabarwani baye bonsi, ere agatebigwa ng’a Abineri, mosinto o Neri, nao arenge ase omoruoti, na omoruoti omoeire ribaga, ochiire ore nomorembe.
Erio Yoabu akagenda ase omoruoti, akamoboria, “Ninki eke gwakorire? Naigwa ng’a Abineri nacha aiga asore. Naki gwakora kwamoa ribaga ogenda?
Tomanyeti Abineri, mosinto o Neri? Ere igo acha aa gokong’aina, naende amanye chinsemo ase okogenda na ebinto ebi ogokora.”
Yoabu karure ase Daudi agatoma abanto babwatie Abineri bamwoyie korwa ase engoro y’amache ya Sira, korende Daudi tamanyete amang’ana ayio.

Ekero Abineri airanire Heburoni, Yoabu akamoira ensemo gati‐gati y’egeita, buna nigo arigetie gokwana nere bobisi, na agwo akamobeta ritimo enda goika agakwa. Nabo Abineri agaitwa ekiagera aitete Asaeli omwabo Yoabu.
Ekero Daudi aigwete amang’ana ayio, akabora, “Omonene namanyete ng’a inche na abanto baane titori na komocha ase obosio bwaye ase ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ’Abineri, mosinto o Neri.

Tiga okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga aye kobe igoro ya Yoabu, na igoro ase abanto b’eamate yaye: naende enyomba ya Yoabu teborwa omonto ogoiteka amache anga buna chimengere, gose oyore noborwaire bwa ukoma, gose oyo ogwesiirera enyimbo, gose oyo oraitwe nemioro, gose oyore omoremerwa bw’endagera.”
Naboigo Yoabu na Abisai omwabo baitete Abineri, ekiagera ere aitete Asaeli omwabo ase esegi eria barwanete aaria Gibeoni.
Erio Daudi agachika Yoabu amo nabanto bonsi barenge amo nere batandore chianga chiabo na beboyie chigunia, erinde bareere Abineri. Omoruoti Daudi nere omonyene agatunyana oborere kobobogoirie.
Erio bagatindeka Abineri agwo Heburoni. Omoruoti akarera neriogi rinene agwo ase oboina bw’Abineri; na abanto bonsi bakarera.
Omoruoti akaba okweumia igoro y’Abineri, okobora, “Inee! Nabo Abineri agwenerete gokwa buna omonto omoriri?
Aye Abineri, amaboko ao tasibetwe, gose amagoro ao tare kobekwa chingataare. Nigo kwagwa buna omonto ogoitwa nabakayayu.” Naende abanto bonsi bakagenderera komoreera.
Abanto bonsi bagacha koebereria Daudi arie endagera, korende Daudi agatiana, ogoteba, “Nyasae ang’e egesusuru bono na kogenderera onye nkoria endagera erioba ritaragwa.”
Abanto bonsi bakarora ng’a ayio nigo abagweneire buna amang’ana onsi omoruoti are gokora abagwenerete.
Ase rituko riria Abaisraeli bonsi bakamanya ng’a omoruoti tarenge na komocha ase ogoitwa kw’Abineri, mosinto o Neri.
Erio omoruoti agatebia abasomba baye, “Timomanyeti ng’a rero omonto omonene, omogambi bw’Abaisraeli, okure?
Nonya naagetwe amaguta nkaba omoruoti nachandekire, tindi na nguru. Abamura aba b’omokungu Seruya nabatindi, tinkobanyara. Omonene naakane egesiomba koreng’ana nobobe bwabo!”
Ekero Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, aigwete ng’a Abineri oitirwe agwo Heburoni, akerusia moyo, na Abaisraeli bonsi bagaichana na gokumia.

Mosinto oria o Saulo nabwate abanto babere abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi, abarenge abasakori. Oyomo nigo are korokwa Baana, na oria onde Rekabu. Barabwo nigo barenge basinto ba Rimoni o Beeroti, omochie bw’orogongo rwa Benjamin. (Beeroti nigo obaretwe koba bw’orogongo rwa Benjamin.)
Abanto ba Beeroti konya batamire gochia Gitaimu, agwo nao bamenyete goika rero iga.

Yonathani, mosinto o Saulo, nabwate omwana oremarete amagoro. Omwana oyio konya okoorire emiaka etano ekero amang’ana ’ogokwa gwa Saulo na okwa Yonathani arentetwe korwa Yesireeli. Omoreri akaimokia omwana oria, na ekero arenge gotama, omwana oria agaakera inse, na igo akaba ekerema. Omwana oria nigo are korokwa Mefiboseti.
Rekabu na Baana, basinto ba Rimoni Omobeeroti, bagachaka orogendo rwabo, na ekero kia mobaso gati bagaika ase enyomba ya Isi‐Boseti, bakamonyora otimogete nyomba mwaye okendererete.
Barabwo bagekora buna nengano bagochia kwoyia. Ekero baigete nyomba ime, bakabeta Isi‐Boseti omoyio enda. Erio Rekabu na Baana omwabo bagatama.

Naboigo banyorete Isi‐Boseti oraire borere bwaye agwo ase akanyomba g’okorara bakamoika ang’e bakamoita, bakamobutora omotwe bakayoira; erio bakagenda ase obotuko bwonsi goetera ase enchera y’Ekerubo Ekiomo.

Bakaira omotwe oyio o Isi‐Boseti ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, bakamotebia, “Rora, oyo nomotwe o Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, omobisa oo, oyo orenge korigia obogima bwao. Rero Omonene okoruseirie aye, omonene oito, egesiomba igoro ya Saulo na igoro y’ororeria rwaye.”
Korende Daudi akairaneria Rekabu na Baana omwabo, abarenge basinto ba Rimoni Omobeeroti, akabora, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oyo ontooretie korwa ase emechando emenge,
ekero omonto antebetie igoro y’ogokwa gwa Saulo, na okagete ng’a igo andeteire amang’ana amaya, inche nigo namobwatete nkamoita aaria Sikilagi. Oko nakwo ogoakana namoete ase amang’ana aye.
Inee! Tari bobe mono kobua, ekero abanto ababe baitire omonto omoronge karaire borere nyomba mwaye? Tinkomoruseria egesiomba na gosiria abwo bamoitire korwa ase ense?”

Erio Daudi agachika abanto baye, barabwo bagaita Rekabu na Baana, bakababutora amaboko na amagoro, bakabasunga ang’e ne ritibo agwo Heburoni. Korende omotwe o Isi‐Boseti bakayoira, bakayotindeka ase embeera y’Abineri agwo Heburoni.
Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli bakagenda ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, bakamotebia, “Naama! Intwe nigo tore abamo naye, aba amanyinga ayamo na omobere oyomo.

Ase engaki yaetire, ekero Saulo arenge omoruoti igoro yaito, naye kwarenge gotang’ana Abaisraeli kobakogenda korwana esegi, naende kobakoirana. Omonene konya ogotebirie ng’a naye orabe omorisia bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na obe omogambi igoro yabo.”
Ase igo abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagacha ase Daudi omoruoti agwo Heburoni; ere agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo Heburoni.
Daudi konya okoorire emiaka emerongo etato ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka emerongo ene.

Agwo Heburoni akagambera Abayuda ase engaki y’emiaka etano na ebere, na emetienyi etano nomo, naende agwo Yerusalemu akagambera Abaisraeli bonsi amo n’Abayuda ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etato, na atato.

Erio Daudi omoruoti na abanto baye bakagenda Yerusalemu, erinde barwanie Abayebusi, abanyene ense eria. Barabwo bagatebia Daudi. “Aye tokonyara gocha aiga nonya ng’ake; emeuko na ebirema nabwo baranyare kogoseria kegima.” Abayebusi nigo barengereretie ng’a Daudi takonyara gosoa aroro.
Korende Daudi akabua eburi ya Sayoni, oyo noro Omochie o Daudi.

Daudi agakwana ase rituko riria, “Onde bwensi otagete goita Abayebusi, tiga atiire gochia ase omotarobw’amache, aite emeuko eyio na ebirema ebio inche Daudi ngechete.” Ase ayio abanto nigo bagoteba, “Emeuko na ebirema tibakonyara gosoa ase enyomba.”
Daudi akamenya ase eburi eyio, akayeroka “Omochie o Daudi.” Agwo Daudi akaagacha omochie oyeetanaine, gochakera korwa Milo na goikera ime ase eburi yarenge.
Daudi akamentekana mono koba ne chinguru, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, arenge amo nere.
Hiramu, omoruoti o Turo, agatoma abanto ase Daudi. Abwo bakamoirera emete y’emecharake. Boigo agatoma ababaachi, na abaagachi, na barabwo bakamoagachera enyomba.
Erio Daudi akamanya ng’a Omonene omokong’irie ase okoba omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, na oimokereirie igoro oboruoti bwaye ase engencho y’abanto baye Abaisraeli.
Nyuma karure Heburoni, Daudi akamenta koira abakungu ba sere‐sere na abakungu bande korwa Yerusalemu; akaiborerwa abana bande abange, abamura na abaiseke.
Aya naro amarieta ’abana abwo baiboretwe asare agwo Yerusalemu; Samua na Sobabu, Nathani na Sulemani;
Ibuhari na Elisua, Nefegi na Yafia;
Elisama, na Eliada, na Elifeleti.
Ekero Abafilisti baigwete ng’a Daudi oakirwe amaguta koba omoruoti igoro y’Abaisraeli bonsi, bagatiira gochia komorigia. Daudi kaigure ayio, agatirimboka gochia ase eburi ime,
na Abafilisti bagacha bagesiarera ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.
Erio Daudi akaboria Omonene, “Inee! Ndagenda korwania Abafilisti? Nobabeke ase amaboko aane gose?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee genda, nimbabeke ase amaboko ao.”
Daudi agacha Baali‐Perasimu, akababua agwo. Erio akabora, “Omonene okoroorire ababisa baane buna chiooro chi’amache are nemerindo.” Ase igo aase aria akarokwa Baali‐Perasimu.
Abafilisti bagatiga emegwekano yabo y’ogosasimwa aroro, na Daudi na abanto baye bakayerusiao na koyeira.
Naende Abafilisti bakagendao eria kabere, bagesiarera ase rikura ri’Abarefai.
Naende Daudi akaboria Omonene, nere akamokania, akamotebia, “Tobaumokera korwa aa, korende ogende obanaarie korwa nyuma, erio obatubokere korwa ase emete ereo ekorokwa balisamu.
Ekero oraigwe eriogi ri’ebititiro bigoeta igoro ase emete eyio, erio bwebeke ang’e, omanye ng’a inche Omonene nasokire, nagotang’anire kobua abarwani b’Abafilisti.”
Daudi agakora buna Omonene amotebetie, agaita Abafilisti korwa Geba goika Geseri.
Naende Daudi agasangereria abanto bonsi abachoretwe korwa ase Abaisraeli, chilifu emerongo etato (30,000).
Ere na abanto abwo bonsi barenge komo bakagenda Baala‐Yuda kwoyia Esanduku ya Nyasae, eyio ekorokwa ase erieta ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda, oyomenyete nobonene igoro y’abakerubi.
Korwa ase enyomba y’Abinadabu, agwo ekegoro igoro, bakarusia Esanduku eria, bakayebeka igoro ase egari enyia. Usa na Ahiyo, basinto b’Abinadabu, bakaba bakoraa Esanduku eyio ya Nyasae.
Kobayerusirie korwa ase enyomba y’Abinadabu agwo ekegoro igoro, Ahiyo nere oyetang’aine.
Daudi na Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bagochenga na gotera ase ogotogia Omonene; bakabugia amakano, na ebibangarara, ne chindege, na ebinto binde bi’ogochengera.
Ekero barabwo baikire ase ekeooreri kia Nakoni, chiombe chiarenge kong’usa egari eria chikarichanigwa. Ase igo Usa akarambora okoboko kwaye gosiira Esanduku eyio ya Nyasae.
Erio Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Usa, akamoaka, ekiagera akunete Esanduku eria ya Nyasae, na Usa agakwera agwo agwo.
Daudi akagechigwa mono, ekiagera Omonene aitete Usa, na igo akaroka aase aria Peresi‐Usa; naboigo akorokwa nonya ngoika rero iga.
Ase rituko riria Daudi akoboa Omonene, akaboria, “Naki rende ndakore imbe noboremu ndete Esanduku y’Omonene bwone?”
Ase igo Daudi tancha koira Esanduku eria y’Omonene ase omochie okorokwa Omochie o Daudi, korende akayebogoria na koyebeka nyomba mwa’Obedi‐Edomu o Gati.
Ekabeera ase enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu ase engaki y’emetienyi etato, na Omonene agasesenia Obedi‐Edomu na abanto bonsi b’enyomba yaye.

Daudi agatebigwa ng’a, ase engencho y’Esanduku eria ya Nyasae Omonene osesenirie abanto b’enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu, amo nebinto bionsi abwate. Erio akagenda akoyia Esanduku eria korwa ase enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu, akayerenta ase omochie oye ore nomochengo omonene.
Ekero abanto abwo babogoretie Esanduku eria y’Omonene bagendire ebitambokero bitano na ekemo, Daudi akanyenya eng’ombe eyemo, na emori eyemo enoru, chikaba ebing’wanso.
Daudi akaba ogotenga ne chinguru chiaye chionsi ase obosio bw’Omonene, obegete egesibao kiaroisirie korwa ase egatani.
Naboigo Daudi na Abaisraeli bonsi bakarenta Esanduku y’Omonene, bakaba bagoaka amariogi ’omogoko na kobugia egetureri.

Ekaba ekero Esanduku eria y’Omonene yare korentwa ase Omochie o Daudi, Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, akarora Daudi omoruoti ogocharoka‐charoka na gotenga ase obosio bw’Omonene, akamochaya ase omoyo oye ime.

Abanto baria baare korenta Esanduku eria y’Omonene, bakayebeka aase aye eema ime, eema eria Daudi ayeteneneretie. Erio Daudi akarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
Na ekero Daudi akoorire korua ebing’wanso biria, agasesenia abanto ase erieta ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda.
Erio akagaba endagera ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, abasacha na abakungu; kera oyomo akaegwa omogati oyomo, na akanyama gake, na amasabibu amomo. Erio kera omonto akarua agwo, akagenda bwoye.

Ekero Daudi airanete inka bwoye gosesenia abanto baye, Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, agasoka korotota Daudi, akabora, “Mbonene ki omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akwenyorera rero ekero aorokirie obogetirianda bwaye ase abaiseke b’abasomba baye buna omonto omoriri.”

Daudi akairaneria Mikali, “Nigo narenge gotenga na kogoka ase obosio bw’Omonene, oyo onchorete inche ribaga ria iso, na enyomba yaye yonsi, nkaba omogambi igoro y’Abaisraeli, abanto baye. Ase ayio, goika ngenderere gochenga ase Omonene.
Naende ninganetie nyekeyie goetania buna nakora aiga rero, imbe omoitongo. Nonya aye kogonchaya, abaiseke abwo b’abasomba gwakwana, barawo mbansike mono.”
Na Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, taiborete mwana nonya noyomo goika ogokwa kwaye.
Bono omoruoti Daudi nigo amenyete ase enyomba yaye, na Omonene konya omoeire obotoereru korwa ase ababisa baye bonsi, abwo bamoetanaine.
Erio agatebia Nathani, omobani, “Rora, inche nigo imenyete ase enyomba eagachire nemecharake korende Esanduku ya Nyasae ero nigo emenyete ime ase eema.”
Nathani agatebia omoruoti, “Genda okore ande onsi ayare ase ebirengererio biao, ekiagera Omonene nigo are amo naye.”
Korende ase obotuko obwo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Nathani, rikamotebia,
“Genda otebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Inee! Nong’agachere enyomba ndamenye imeo?
Korwa engaki eria nang’anyetie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri goika rituko ria rero inche tinana komenya ime ase enyomba, korende nabeire nkogenda aande onsi imenyete ase eema.
Aase aande onsi nabeire nkona‐kogenda amo n’Abaisraeli, tinana koboria mogambi onde bw’Abaisraeli, oyo nabegete akaba omorisia bw’abanto baane, nase ki otang’agachereti obomenyo bw’emecharake.

“Gaki bono naende kwana nomosomba one Daudi, omotebie amang’ana aya: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Nigo nakorusetie korwa ase oborisia aase kware gotunyana ching’ondi, ngakobeka okaba omogambi bw’abanto baane Abaisraeli.
Nigo nare kogenda amo naye aande onsi ase kware kogenda na kobaseria gochia aare ababisa bao korwa ase obosio bwao. Ninkore erieta riao ribe rinene, buna amarieta ’abanto bande bare abanene ase ense.
Ninyorere abanto baane Abaisraeli aase ndababeke bamenye ase obotoereru. Abanto ababe tibakobachanda naende, buna babachandete kare.
Korwa engaki eria nachorete abagambi bagambere abanto baane Abaisraeli. Ninkoe obotoereru korwa ase ababisa bao bonsi. Kobua ayio onsi, inche Omonene nigo nkogotebia ng’a ninkoroiserie enyomba.
Ekero amatuko ao ay’ogokwa araike, na orare ase chisokoro chiao, nimbeke oyomo bw’oroiboro rwao abe omoruoti, ninkore oboruoti bwaye bobe ne chinguru.
Ere naagachere erieta riane enyomba, nainche ninkong’ie oboruoti bwaye bobe ne chinguru kogenderera botambe.
Inche nimbe ise, nere nabe omwana one. Ekero arakore ebibe nimoe egesusuro nenyimbo na amaakwa aya mwanyabanto bakoegwa.
Korende obwanchani bwane botari koera tinkoborusia asare buna naborusetie ase Saulo oyio natigeretie korwa ase obosio bwao.
Enyomba yao na oboruoti bwao nigo birakong’igwe bibe ne chinguru ase obosio bwane kare na kare, na ekerogo kiao ki’oboruoti nigo keratenene bokong’u kare na kare.”
Nathani agatebia Daudi amang’ana ayio onsi buna ayaigwete na koyarora.
Erio Daudi omoruoti agasoa akabeera ase obosio bw’Omonene, akabora, “Aye Omonene Nyasae, inche inki ng’isaine, na eamate yane inki eisaine, ng’a aye gwankoreire amang’ana amaya iga?

Naende ring’ana eri tiriisaini kende asore, aye Omonene Nyasae. Boigo gwakwanire igoro y’ororeria rwane, inche omosomba oo, na igoro y’ebiaare bigochi‐gocha. Ee, aye Omonene Nyasae, amang’ana ayio igo kwayakwanire ase mwanyabanto.
Inche Daudi, inki ndagotebie naende kobua ayio? Aye Omonene Nyasae, nigo omanyete inche, omosomba oo.
Ase engencho y’eira yao na koreng’ana nogwancha kwao, aye Omonene, gwakorire amanene ayio onsi, naende kwayamanyekanirie asende, inche omosomba oo.
Ase ayio, igo ore omonene, aye Omonene Nyasae! Onde tari onga buna aye, gose Nyasae onde tari, otatiga aye bweka, koreng’ana buna ayio konya twaigure namato aito.

Naende mbanto ba gesaku ki bare ase ense bare buna Abaisraeli bao, abwo aye Nyasae kwabooretie babe abanto bao, na igo gwakorire erieta riao rimanyekane. Ogakorera abanto bao abwo kwebooreretie korwa Misiri amang’ana amanene, na ay’ogokumia, ekiagera nigo gwaseretie korwa asebare abanto b’ebisaku amo ne chinyasae chiabo.
Aye gwekoreire abanto bao Abaisraeli babe abanto bao kare na kare, naye Omonene kwabeire Nyasae obo.
“Gaki bono, Omonene Nyasae, ikerania onsi aya kwariete eira igoro yane na ase ororeria rwane, na okore aya gwatebete ng’a nokore,

erinde erieta riao ritogigwe kare na kare. Erio abanto bariatore botambe, bagoteba: Omonene bw’Emeganda, nere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Ase enchera eyio enyomba y’omosomba oo, inche Daudi, ekong’igwe ase obosio bwao.

Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, kwang’orokeirie inche, omosomba oo, aya onsi, kogoteba: Ninkoagachere enyomba. Ase ayio inche, omosomba oo, nabeire noboremu ase enkoro yane kogosaba ogosaba oko.
“Na bono, aye Omonene, aye naye Nyasae, na amang’ana ao naro ekeene, na kwandiereire inche, omosomba oo, eira ng’a onkorere ring’ana eri rigiya.

Gaki bono, koranche osesenie enyomba yane, inche omosomba oo, erinde egenderere kare na kare ase obosio bwao. Aye Omonene Nyasae, kwariete eira eyio. Ase igo enyomba yane, inche omosomba oo, esesenigwe kare na kare nogosesenigwa kwao.”
Nyuma y’ayio Daudi akarwania Abafilisti, akababua, akabua nomochie obo omonene akayobeka inse y’obogambi bwaye.

Naende akabua Abamoabu. Akabachika barare inse ase chindwaro. Erio akarenga chindwaro ibere chi’abanto, agachika abwo baitwe bakwe, na abanto b’orwaro oromo agachika batigwe babe moyo. Bono Abamoabu bakaba abasomba ba Daudi bakaba bakomo rentera ebango.
Naende Daudi akabua Hadadeseri mosinto o Rehobu, omoruoti o Soba, ekero ere agendete kogareyia obogambi bwaye gochia ase orooche rw’Eufarati.

Daudi agoosa abariini chibarasi elifu eyemo, na amagana atano na abere (1,700), na abarwani abaare kogendera amagoro chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000). Erio akabutora chibarasi chinteng’e, korende agatiga chibarasi rigana erimo chibe chikong’usa chigari.
Na ekero Abasiiria ba Damesiki bachete gokonya Hadadeseri, omoruoti o Soba, Daudi akabarwania, agaita abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000).
Erio akabeka abarwani ase egati y’Abasiiria agwo Damesiki, na Abasiiria abwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi bakaba bakomorentera ebango. Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase are kogenda korwana.
Daudi agasakora chinguba chie chitahabu, echio abasomba ba Hadadeseri babogoretie, agachiira Yerusalemu.
Naende omoruoti Daudi akaira chitaai chinyinge mono korwa Bera na Berotai, emechie Hadadeseri arenge kogambera.
Toi, omoruoti o Hamati, agachia koigwa ng’a Daudi obuire abarwani bonsi ba Hadadeseri,

agatoma Yoramu, momura oye, ase omoruoti Daudi amokwanie na komosesenia, ekiagera ere konya arwanirie Hadadeseri omobuirie. Hadadeseri nigo abete okona‐korwania Toi. Boigo Yoramu akairera Daudi ebinto bi’etahabu, na ebi’efeta, na ebi’etaai.
Ebinto ebio omoruoti Daudi akabiatananera Omonene, buna akorete ne chitaai ne chitahabu chiria arusetie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku biria abuete:
Abaedomu, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafilisti, na Abaameleki. Boigo agaatananera Omonene ebisakorwa arusetie korwa ase Hadadeseri, mosinto o Rehobu, omoruoti o Soba.
Daudi akenyorera erieta rinene ekero arenge koirana, gaitire Abaedomu chilifu ikomi na isano na isato (18,000) ase Riranya ri’Omonyo.
Daudi akabeka abarwani aande onsi ase egati y’Abaedomu, na barabwo bonsi bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, na Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogenda korwana.
Bono Daudi akaba okogambera Abaisraeli bonsi, akaba ogokorera abanto baye bonsi oboronge na ekeene.
Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, nere orenge omochiki bw’emeganda y’abarwani, na Yehosafati, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.
Zadoki, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, nabwo barenge abakuani, na Seraya nere orenge omoriki;
Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere orenge omoteneneri bw’Abakereti, na Abapeleti, na basinto ba Daudi nabwo barenge abakuani.
Rituko erimo Daudi akaboria, “Inee! Monto onde natigarete ase enka ya Saulo inyare komokorera amaya ase engencho ya Yonathani?”
Narengeo omosomba oyomo bw’enyomba ya Saulo, orenge korokwa Siba. Abanto bakamorangeria agende ase Daudi. Omoruoti akamoboria, “Naye Siba?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Ee, ninche omosomba oo.”
Naende omoruoti akamoboria, “Inee! Monto onde natigarete ase enka ya Saulo inyare komokorera obuya bwa Nyasae?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Ee, nareo omonto oyomo, mosinto o Yonathani, ore ekerema.”
Omoruoti akamoboria, “Ng’ai akare?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Nigo akare o Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, aaria Lo‐Debari.”
Erio omoruoti agatoma abanto bagachia komwoyia korwa o Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, aaria Lo‐Debari.
Ekero Mefiboseti, mosinto o Yonathani o Saulo, achete ase Daudi, agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase okoorokia amasikani. Daudi akabora, “Mefiboseti.” Ere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa, inche omosomba oo!”
Daudi akamotebia, “Toondoka, ekiagera ningokorere amaya ase engencho ya Yonathani iso. Ninkoiranerie emegondo yonsi ya Saulo, sokoro yao, naye nobe gokoragera ase emesa yane botambe.”
Mefiboseti agatung’ama inse naende, akabora, “Inche inde buna esese ekwete. Ninki ing’isaine orankorere amaya buna ayio?”
Erio omoruoti akarangeria Siba, omosomba o Saulo, akamotebia, “Ebinto bionsi ebiarenge bia Saulo, na bionsi ebia nyomba mwaye, nabieire omochokoro bw’omonene oo.

Aye, amo nabana bao na abasomba bao mobe mokomoremera emegondo. Norentere omochokoro bw’omonene oo okwama korwa mogondo, erinde anyore endagera, korende Mefiboseti omonyene, omochokoro bw’omonene oo, nigo arabe okoragera ase emesa yane botambe.” Siba nigo abwate abamura ikomi na batano na abasomba emerongo ebere.
Erio Siba akairaneria omoruoti, “Inche omosomba oo ninkore ayio onsi gwachikire.” Ase igo Mefiboseti akaba okoragera ase emesa ya Daudi, akaba buna oyomo bw’abana b’omoruoti.
Mefiboseti nabwate omwana omomura ore korokwa Mika. Abanto bonsi abarenge o Siba bakaba abasomba ba Mefiboseti.
Mefiboseti akaba okomenya Yerusalemu, ekiagera nigo arenge koragera ase emesa y’omoruoti. Ere nigo aremarete amagoro aye onsi abere.
Nyuma y’ayio omoruoti bw’Abaamoni agakwa, na Hanuni, omomura oye, akaba omoruoti ribaga riaye.

Daudi akabora, “Goika imokorere Hanuni, omomura o Nahasi, amaya, buna ise arenge gonkorera amaya.” Ase igo Daudi agatoma abanto bagende komoremia ase engencho y’ogokwa gwa ise. Ekero abasomba ba Daudi baigete ase ense y’Abaamoni,
Abaamoni bakaboria Hanuni, omonene obo, “Inee! Igo okagete ng’a Daudi nigo asigete iso ase ogotoma abanto gocha gokoremia? Taibo. Nigo abatomire bache koroota omochie na koyosaria.”
Ase igo Hanuni akabwata abasomba abwo ba Daudi, akagingira chinderu chiabo ensemo eyemo, na akanacha chianga chiabo agachiikia ebinema, akabaseria bagende.

Abasomba abwo bakarora obosooku obonene mono, na ekero Daudi atebetigwe buna bakoretwe, agatoma abanto bachie kobarotota babatebie, “Omoruoti otebire ng’a mobeere agwo Yeriko goika chinderu chiaino chimere, erio monyare koirana nka.”

Abaamoni bakamanya ng’a bagechirie Daudi. Ase igo bagasaba Abasiiria ba Beti‐Rehobu na Soba babae abarwani babo chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000), na omoruoti o Maaka ache amo nabarwani baye elifu eyemo (1,000); naende bagasaba baegwe abarwani chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000) korwa Tobu.
Ekero Daudi aigwete ayio, agatoma Yoabu amo ne chituoni chionsi chi’esegi.
Abaamoni bakagenda bakarobera ase egeita ki’omochie; Abasiiria ba Soba, na abwo ba Rehobu, amo nabanto korwa Tobu na Maaka, barabwo bakarobera ao boka ase egetii.
Ekero Yoabu aroche ng’a esegi nigo ere bosio bwaye na nyuma, agachora abanto abakong’u abamanyete korwana esegi, akabaroberia barwane n’Abasiiria.
Abanto bande abatigari akababeka inse y’oboteneneri bw’Abisai, momura omwabo, akabaroberia barwane n’Abaamoni.
Erio agatebia Abisai, “Onye Abasiiria bakombua, rirorio oche onkonye; korende onye Abaamoni bagokobua, rirorio inche ninchiche ngokonye.
Otenene bokong’u obe omoremu! Torwanerere abanto baito na emechie ya Nyasae oito. Tiga Omonene akore ayaroche are amaya.”
Agwo Yoabu na abanto barenge amo nere bagasuka gochia korwana n’Abasiiria, na barabwo bagatama korwa asare.
Abaamoni bagachia korora ng’a Abasiiria batamire, na barabwo boigo bagatama korwa ase Abisai, bagasoa omochie ime. Erio Yoabu agatiga korwana n’Abaamoni, akairana Yerusalemu.
Ekero Abasiiria baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagasangererekana bonsi amo.
Hadadeseri agatoma abanto barente Abasiiria abwo barenge moocha y’orooche rw’Eufarati. Barawo bagacha Helamu, na Sobaki, omotang’ani bw’abarwani ba Hadadeseri, akabatang’ana.
Ekero Daudi atebetigwe amang’ana ayio agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi, akaamboka Yorodani, akagenda Helamu. Aroro Abasiiria bakeroberia korwania Daudi esegi.

Abasiiria bagatama korwa ase amasio ’Abaisraeli, na Daudi agaita Abasiiria abagendia chigari amagana atano na abere (700), na abariini chibarasi chilifu emerongo ene (40,000), naende agaaka Sobaki, omotang’ani bw’abarwani, goika agakwerao.
Ekero abarwani bonsi abwo barenge inse ya Hadadeseri baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagakora omorembe nabarabwo na kwebeka inse yabo. Ase ayio Abasiiria bakoboa gokonya Abaamoni naende.

Ase engaki y’ogosimeka, ekero abaruoti baare koba bakogenda korwana esegi, Daudi agatoma Yoabu na abasomba baye, amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi. Barabwo bagaita Abaamoni, bakanaaria omochie o Raba. Korende Daudi akabeera agwo Yerusalemu.

Ekaba ase rituko erimo chinsa chia mogoroba, Daudi akaimoka korwa borere bwaye, akariina kerama igoro, ase enyomba yaye y’oboruoti. Ekero arenge gotaarao, akarora omokungu ogwesibia, na omokungu oyio nigo arenge omonyakieni mono.
Erio agatoma omonto amanye ng’a omokungu oyo noyo ng’o. Agatebigwa ng’a, “Oria Bati‐Seba nomosubati o Eliamu, moka Uria Omohiti.”
Erio Daudi agatoma abanto bamwoyie. Ere agacha ase Daudi, na Daudi akarara nere. Batiseba gakoorire gwechena korwa ase ogotechena kwaye, akaimoka, akairana mwaye.
Omokungu oria akaba morito; agatoma amang’ana ase Daudi, akabora, “Nabeire morito.”
Erio Daudi agatoma amang’ana ase Yoabu akamotebia, “Toma Uria oyio Omohiti ache asende,” na Yoabu akamotoma ase Daudi.
Ekero Uria achete, Daudi akamoboria amang’ana igoro ya Yoabu buna are gokora, na amang’ana ’abanto, na buna esegi egendererete.
Naende agatebia Uria, “Genda bwoo, bwesibie amagoro otimoke.” Uria akarua nyomba mw’omoruoti, na Daudi akamotunyaneria ekeegwa.
Korende Uria akarara gesieri ki’enyomba y’omoruoti amo nabasomba bonsi b’omonene oye, tatirimboka gochia bwoye.
Abanto bagatebia Daudi ng’a Uria tagendete bwoye. Daudi akamoboria, “Inee! Tikwarwete ase orogendo? Nase ki otagendete bwoo?”

Uria akamoiraneria, “Esanduku y’Omonene, na Abaisraeli amo n’Abayuda nigo bamenyete ase ebigutu isiko. Yoabu, omonene one, na abasomba baye nigo bagatoorete isiko ase egetii. Inee! Inche ngende nyomba mwane koria na konywa, na korara na mokane? Ekeene, buna aye ore moyo, na omoika oo ore moyo, inche tingokora ring’ana buna erio.”
Daudi agatebia Uria, “Beera aiga rero naende, ankio nkoe ribaga ogende.” Ase igo Uria akabeera Yerusalemu ase rituko riria, ne rituko ria kabere boigo.
Daudi akamorangeria ache mwaye koragera na konywa amo nere, na igo akagera Uria agatinda. Ekero kia mogoroba Uria akagenda korara borere bwaye amo nabasomba b’omonene oye, korende tagenda bwoye.
Bogakia mambia, Daudi akarikera Yoabu rirube, akaa Uria amoirere.
Ase rirube erio nigo arigete iga: “Otang’anie Uria bosio bw’abarwani aase esegi ere entindi Erio morueo, momotige aroro aitwe akwe.”
Ekero Yoabu anaaretie omochie, akabeka Uria aase amanyete ng’a naumerane nabarwani abatindi.
Abanto b’omochie oria bagasoka korwana na Yoabu, na abanto bande ase abasomba ba Daudi bagaitwa, na Uria Omohiti nere agaitwa.
Yoabu agatoma amang’ana onsi ase Daudi, buna esegi egendererete.
Agatebereria omotomwa oria, “Ekero gwatebirie omoruoti amang’ana onsi ay’esegi,
ande nabo arabe nendamwamu, akoborie: Naki mwakorete mokagenda ang’e nomochie? Inee! Timwamanyete ng’a abanto nigo bakoruta emegwe korwa ase orwaki?

Ning’o oitete Abimeleki, mosinto o Yerubi‐Beseti? Tari omokungu orutete ensio korwa orwaki igoro, akamoita aaria Tebesi? Naki mwakorete mogaika orwaki ang’e igo? Omoruoti karakoberie igo, omotebie: Omosomba oo Uria Omohiti nere oitirwe boigo.”
Erio omotomwa oria akagenda, agatebia Daudi amang’ana onsi aya Yoabu amotomete akwane.
Omonto oria agatebia Daudi, “Abanto baria nigo barenge ne chinguru chinyinge gotobua, bagatotubokera agwo ase egetii aarabu. Nonya naboigo ntwababua, tokabairania gochia ase egeita ki’omochie.
Abaruti emegwe bagatorasa intwe, abasomba bao, korwa orwaki igoro; abande b’abasomba bao bakure, na Uria Omohiti, omosomba oo, nere okure.”

Daudi agatebia omotomwa oria, “Genda otebie Yoabu ng’a amang’ana ayio tabaisa komochanda, ekiagera omoro nigo ogoita oyo, oita noyonde. Omotebie ng’a abe ne chinguru, arwanie omochie oyio na koyosaria.”
Ekero moka Uria aigwete ng’a omosacha oye okure, akaba okomoreera,
na ekero omokungu oria akoorire korera Daudi agatoma omonto komwoyia. Batiseba akaba moga Daudi, na nyuma y’ayio akamoiborera omwana omoisia. Korende amang’ana ayio Daudi akorete akagechia Omonene.
Erio Omonene agatoma Nathani ase Daudi. Nathani akagenda asare, akamotebia, “Abanto babere mbamenyete ase omochie gete, oyomo obo igo arenge omonda, na oria onde nomotaka.
Oria omonda nigo abwate ching’ondi ne chiombe chinyinge mono.

Korende oria omotaka tarenge na gento, otatiga abwate akamanwa agasigiti, akwo agorete ng’a atuge. Akamanwa akwo gakaba gakomenya inka amo nabana baye, gakaba gakoria endagera abwate na konywera korwa ase egekombe kiaye. Nigo kanarete korara ase egekuba kiaye, gakaba asare buna omwana oye omoiseke.

Omogeni agacha bw’omonto oria omonda, na ere tanchete komonyenyera embori gose eng’ondi korwa ase riicho riaye, korende akaira akamanwa karia k’eng’ondi k’omotaka oria, erio agakanyenyerao mogeni oye.”
Bono Daudi akaba nendamwamu enene ase engencho y’omonda oria, agatebia Nathani, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, omonto oyio okorete amang’ana ayio goika akwe.
Ere goika amoiranerie akamanwa karia ara kane, ekiagera akora ring’ana erio, na ekiagera atabwate amabera.”
Agwo Nathani agatebia Daudi, “Naye omonto oria. Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo agoteba iga: Inche nakoagete amaguta okaba omoruoti igoro y’Abaisraeli, nkagotooria korwa ase okoboko gwa Saulo.
Ngakoa abanto bonsi b’omonene oo, nkabeka abakungu baye ase amaboko ao. Ngakoa n’Abaisraeli na Abayuda. Onye ayio namake arenge, nabo naare gokomenta ayande amange kobua.
Nase ki gwachayire ring’ana riane inche Omonene, na gwakorire amabe ase obosio bwane? Gwaitire Uria Omohiti; okamorua, na Abaamoni bakamoita nomoro, naende kwairire mokaye koba mokao.
Bono omoro tokorua ase ororeria rwao, ekiagera gwanchayire, kwairire moka Uria akaba mokao.
Ee, Omonene otebire iga: Ningotubokerie obobe korwa ase enyomba yao; nkoure abakungu bao, mbae omonto omoao, nere arare nabarabwo maiso marore.
Aye nigo gwakorire ebibe ebio bobisi, korende inche nigo ndakoe egesusuro ekio maiso marore ase Abaisraeli bonsi baroche.”
Daudi agatebia Nathani, “Nakoreire Omonene ebibe.” Nathani akamoiraneria, “Omonene okwabeire ebibe biao; togokwa.
Korende ekiagera gwakorire ayio kwagerire ababisa b’Omonene bamochaye, omwana oria oraiborwe goika akwe.”
Erio Nathani akagenda bwoye. Omonene akarenta oborwaire ase omwana oria moka Uria aiborerete Daudi, na omwana oria akanyareka mono.
Agwo Daudi agasaba Nyasae ng’a omwana agwene, akeng’ata, akagenda nyomba akarara inse ase obotuko obogima.
Na abagaaka b’enyomba yaye bagacha bamoimokie korwa agwo inse, korende ere tancha, nonya nokoragera, taria amo nabarabwo.

Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omwana oria agakwa. Abasomba ba Daudi bakoboa komotebia ng’a omwana okure, naki nigo batebete, “Ekero omwana arenge moyo, togachia gokwana nere, korende tanchete gotoigwa. Naki rende toranyare komotebia ng’a omwana okure? Nigo arabaise gwekora bobe.”
Korende Daudi akarora abasomba baye bakona‐komonyererana, akamanya ng’a omwana okure. Ase igo Daudi akababoria, “Inee! Omwana nakure?” Bakamoiraneria, “Ee, okure.”
Daudi akaimoka korwa inse agesibia, ageaka amaguta, akaonchoreria chianga chiaye; agasoa ase enyomba y’Omonene agasasima. Erio akairana bwoye, akaboria endagera, akaegwa akaria.
Abasomba baye bakamotebia, “Ing’ana ki eri gwakora? Ekero omwana arenge moyo okeng’ata na korera korende bono omwana gakure, kwaimokire kwarageire.”
Akabairaneria, “Ee, ekero omwana arenge moyo, nabo neng’atete na korera, nigo narengereretie ng’a ande Omonene nandorere amabera, erinde omwana abe moyo.
Korende bono okure, nase ki rende ndeng’ate? Inee! Ninyare komoirania abe moyo? Ninche ndagende aase agenda, korende ere takoirana asende.”
Erio Daudi akaba okoremia Batiseba mokaye; akaba nere, na ere akaibora omwana omoisia, na Daudi akamoroka Sulemani. Na Omonene akaba bwanchete omwana oria,
agatoma amang’ana ase Nathani omobani, na ere akaroka omwana oria Yedidia, ase engencho y’Omonene.
Yoabu akarwania Raba bw’Abaamoni, akaira ensemo y’omochie eyarenge y’omoruoti.
Erio Yoabu agatoma abanto gochia ase Daudi komotebia, “Narwanirie Raba, nabwatire ensemo y’omochie ase amache aochaine.
“Gaki bono sangereria abanto abwo batigarete oetanane omochie, aye omonyene oyoire, inche timbaisa koyoira na igo orokwe ase erieta riane.”
Ase igo Daudi agasangereria abanto bonsi, akagenda Raba, akayorwania, akayobua na koyoira.

Erio akarusia egutwa y’etahabu korwa ase omotwe bw’omoruoti bw’aroro. Oborito bw’egutwa eria nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiro emerongo etato na inye naende nigo yachabeire amagena e rigori rinene. Egutwa eyio ekabekerwa Daudi ase omotwe oye igoro. Ere agasakora ebinto ebinge mono bi’omochie oria:

agasokia abanto barenge ase omochie ime, akabanachana ne chinseke, amo nebikombe bi’ebioma na ebisire, akabaetia ase amariko are gosamba amatabori. Naboigo akorete abanto b’emechie yonsi y’Abaamoni. Erio Daudi akairana Yerusalemu amo nabanto bonsi.
Bono Abisalomu, mosinto o Daudi, narenge nomoiseke omwabo ore korokwa Tamari. Tamari nigo arenge omonyakieni mono. Omomura onde o Daudi ore korokwa Amunoni akaba omwanchete Tamari.
Amunoni agachandeka mono ase okomogania Tamari, omoiseke omwabo, goika agekora buna nomorwaire are. Omoiseke oria nigo arenge omwekungi; Amunoni agasinywa komokorera buna aganetie.
Korende ere nabwate omosani oyomo ore korokwa Yonadabu, mosinto o Simea, momura omwabo Daudi. Yonadabunigo arenge omong’aini mono bw’obong’ainereria.

Ere akaboria Amunoni, “Aye omwana bw’omoruoti, naki okana‐korea iga nomoichano, rituko ase rituko? Togontebia rende?” Amunoni akamoiraneria, “Nigo imwanchete Tamari, omoiseke omwabo Abisalomu, momura ominto.”

Yonadabu akamotebia, “Genda orare borere, bwekore buna nomorwaire ore. Na ekero iso arache gokorora, omotebie; Koranche otebie Tamari ominto ache andoiserie endagera aa ase ndoche, erinde andagerie nokoboko kwaye.”

Agwo Amunoni akarara, agekora buna nomorwaire are. Ekero omoruoti achete korora Amunoni, nere akamotebia, “Koranche otebie Tamari ominto ache andoiserie emegati ebere aa ase ndoche, indie korwa ase okoboko kwaye.”
Erio Daudi akarangeria Tamari korwa nyomba mwabo, akamotebia, “Genda nyomba mw’Amunoni, momura omino, omoroiserie endagera.”
Tamari akagenda nyomba mw’Amunoni omwabo, na ere igo arenge oraire. Tamari akaimokia obosie, akabokonya, agakora emegati agwo ase Amunoni amorigereretie, akayesamba.
Naende akaimokia esani ere nemegati eria, akayeterekera Amunoni, korende ere akaanga koria. Amunoni agateba, “Tiga abanto bonsi barue aa asende.” Ase igo kera omonto agasoka isiko.
Amunoni agatebia Tamari, “Ndetere emegati eyio aa, inyerie korwa ase okoboko kwao.” Tamari akaimokia emegati eyio aroisetie, akayeirera Amunoni, momura omwabo, ase akanyomba ime.
Ekero amoirerete emegati eyio ang’e ng’a arie, Amunoni akamobwata, akamotebia, “Inchuo torare komo, moiseke ominto.”
Tamari akamokania, akamotebia, “Yaya taibo, omwana ominto, tagonkorera obosooku buna iga. Amang’ana buna aya tagokoreka ase Abaisraeli. Tobaisa gokora obonyaka buna obo.
Ng’ai ngochia goeta nobosooku obo? Naye nigo orabe buna oyomo, bw’abakayayu bare ase Abaisraeli. Bono, koranche oborie omoruoti akoe ribaga onyuome.”
Korende Amunoni tancha komoigwa. Ere akamobua chinguru, akamokorera obosooku ase okorara nere.
Nyuma y’ayio Amunoni akagecha Tamari okogecha okonene, na okogecha okwo amogecha gokaba okonene kobua obwanchani boria amwanchete ritang’ani. Amunoni akamotebia, “Imoka, orue aa!”
Tamari akamoiraneria, “Yaya taibo, oyominto. Bono ogoseria oko ogonseria nigo kore okobe kobua amang’ana aya gwankoreire.” Korende Amunoni akaanga gotegerera amang’ana aye.
Amunoni akarangeria omomura ore komokorera, akamotebia, “Rusia omokungu oyo aa asende, omoire isiko, osieke egesieri bokung’u.”
Omosomba agasokia Tamari, oria agasieka egesieri. Tamari nigo abegete eganchwa entambe, ekiagera chiganchwa buna echio nachio abaiseke abekungi b’omoruoti barenge kobeka.
Tamari ageaka ribu ase omotwe oye, agatandora eganchwa eria entambe abegete, akabeka amaboko motwe, akagenda okona‐korera ase eriogi rinene.

Erio Abisalomu omwabo akamoboria, “Inee! Amunoni omino nagokoreire amang’ana ’obosooku? Aye moiseke ominto, kirakiri; oyio noyomino, toichana ase enkoro yao. Tamari akamenya bw’Abisalomu omwabo, akaba otang’ang’ete na goichana mono.”
Ekero omoruoti Daudi aigwete amang’ana ayio, akaba nekeririanda ekenene.
Abisalomu tarenge gokwana n’Amunoni nonya ne ring’ana erimo; nigo amogechete ekiagera ere akorerete Tamari, omoiseke omwabo, obosooku.
Nyuma y’emiaka ebere koyaerire, Abisalomu akaba nabanto baare konacha ching’ondi chiaye amarionya, aaria Baali‐Hasori, ang’e norogongo rwa Efraimu, agachika abamura bonsi b’omoruoti bagende aroro.
Abisalomu akagenda ase omoruoti, akamotebia, “Rora bono, inche, omosomba oo, nimbwate abanto bakonacha ching’ondi chiane amarionya. Koranche, aye omoruoti, ochiche amo nabasomba bao.”

Korende omoruoti akamokania, akamotebia, “Yaya taibo, omwana one, titokogenda twensi. Toise kogenda twensi nigo torakobuchere.” Abisalomu akamosorora mono, korende omoruoti tancha kogenda, otatiga amosesenetie.
Erio Abisalomu akamoboria, “Onye togocha, koranche ong’e Amunoni ominto agende naintwe.” Omoruoti akamoboria, “Nase ki ere aragende nainwe?”
Abisalomu agasorora omoruoti mono goika ere akamwanchera Amunoni amo nabamura bande bonsi baye bagende nere.

Abisalomu agachika abasomba baye, akabatebia, “Morigererie ekero Amunoni anyure atindire, na moigwe ekero ndabatebie ng’a moake Amunoni. Erio agwo momoake kegima, momoite akwe. Timwoboa! Inche nabachika ng’a mokore bo. Mobe abakong’u na abaremu.”
Ase igo abasomba b’Abisalomu bagakora Amunoni buna Abisalomu abachigete. Nyuma y’ayio abamura bonsi b’omoruoti bakaimoka, bakariina, kera omonto eyombo yaye, bagatama.
Ekaba kobare inchera kogenda sobo, Daudi agatebigwa ng’a, “Abisalomu oitire abamura bao bonsi, onde tatigareti nonya noyomo.”
Erio omoruoti akaimoka, agatandora chianga chiaye, akarara inse ase amaroba, na abasomba baye abateneineo bagatandora chianga chiabo.

Korende Yonadabu, mosinto o Simea omwabo Daudi, akabora, “Omonene one, tokaga ng’a mbonsi baitirwe; Amunoni nere bweka oitwa okwa. Aya igo Abisalomu ayaroberetie ase ebirengererio biaye korwa rituko riria Amunoni akorerete Tamari, omoiseke omwabo, amang’ana ’obosooku.
Gaki aye omoruoti, omonene one, tobaisa kwegena amang’ana ayio ng’a abamura bao bonsi mbaitire; Amunoni bweka nere okure.”
Bono Abisalomu konya otamire. Omomura omorendi orenge otengerete agachia korigereria, akarora abanto abange mono bagotirimboka korwa ekegoro ensemo, magega yaye.
Yonadabu agatebia omoruoti, “Rigereria, abamura bao abwo bagocha, buna inche, omosomba oo, nagotebia.”
Ekero akoorire gokwana, abamura b’omoruoti bakaoroka, bagaaka amariogi abo bakorera; na omoruoti boigo akarera, na abasomba baye bonsi bakarera ekerero ekenene.
Korende Abisalomu agatama, akagenda ase Talimai, mosinto bw’Amihudi, omoruoti bw’Abagesuri. Daudi akaba okoreera omwana oye rituko ase rituko.
Ekero Abisalomu atamete, akagenda akamenya Gesuri ase engaki y’emiaka etato.
Ekero omoruoti konya aremigwe nyuma y’ogokwa kw’Amunoni, akaba namaiga korora Abisalomu.
Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, akamanya ng’a omoruoti nigo aganetie Abisalomu mono.

Ase igo agatoma abanto bagende Tekoa kwoyia omokungu gete omong’aini korwao. Ekero achire Yoabu akamotebia, “Aye bwekore ng’a nigo okwereire; obeke chianga chi’ogokwerwa, tibweaka amaguta, bwekore buna omokungu obeire okweumia amatuko amange ekiagera akwereirwe.
Erio ogende ase omoruoti, omotebie amang’ana ndagotebie,” na Yoabu akamotebia aya agochia gokwana.
Omokungu oria o Tekoa, ekero aigete ase omoruoti, agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase okomosika, akabora, “Aye omoruoti, koranche onkonye.”
Omoruoti akamoboria, “Emechando yao nereri?” Akamoiraneria, “Inche nomoboraka; omosacha one nigo akwete.
Inche, omosomba oo omokungu, nigo nabwate abana abamura babere, nabarabwo bagachaka kwomana kobare mogondo, gose onde tarengeo ore kobatoorania, na oyomo agaita oria, onde omwabo.

Abaamate baane bonsi banyimokeire inche, omosomba oo, bagontebia ng’a indue omomura oyio one bamoite, ekiagera aita oyomwabo. Baise komoita nigo ndabe tindi nomonyamwando. Naboigo bakare korigia korimia omorero one otigarete, tibatigera omosacha one erieta riaye riatorwe, gose onde oye atigare ase ense.”
Omoruoti agatebia omokungu oria “Genda bwoo, ninkoroiserie amang’ana ayio.”
Erio omokungu oria akamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, omonene one, tiga inche na eamate ya tata tobogorie okomocha kw’ebibe ebio. Asore omoruoti, gose ase ekerogo kiao ki’obogambi, komocha tikobao.”
Omoruoti akamoiraneria, “Onde bwensi aise kogotebia amang’ana are mamincha yao, omorente asende, nere takogokuna naende.”

Erio omokungu oria agateba, “Aye omoruoti, koranche oinyore Omonene, Nyasae oo, erinde omorusia egesiomba ki’amanyinga tamenta gosaria na goita omwana one.” Akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, nonya nagatukia akamo k’omwana oo tigakogwa inse.”
Omokungu oria akabora, “Aye omoruoti, omonene one, ing’a inche, omosomba oo, ribaga nkwane ring’ana erimo asore.” Akamotebia, “Aye kwana.”

Ase igo omokungu oria akabora, “Naki aye kwarobeirie amang’ana buna ayio are mamincha y’abanto ba Nyasae? Ase ogokwana ring’ana eri, aye omoruoti kwegambirie aye omonyene, ekiagera toeti omwana oo, oria otamete, ribaga airane nka.
Intwe twensi goika tokwe; nigo tore buna amache aitekire inse atanyare kobuuchwa naende. Nyasae tari gosiria obogima. Nigo akoroberia ng’a oria otamete taserigwa na gwatananwa korwa asare.

Bono nigo nacha gokwana aya asore, aye omonene one, ekiagera abanto banyoboirie. Ase igo inche omokungu, omosomba oo, nkarengereria ng’a nkwane naye omoruoti. Ande aye nonkorere aya inche, omosomba oo, nkoboria.
Ee, omoruoti, nonyigwe na ontoorie inche, omosomba oo, korwa ase okoboko kw’omonto oyo origetie gonsiria inche amo nomwana one na gotorusia korwa ase omwando o Nyasae.

Inche, omosomba oo, nkarengereria ng’a nonyare kong’a obotoereru, ekiagera aye, omoruoti one, nigo ore buna omomalaika o Nyasae ase okomanya gwatanana ayare amaya na ayare amabe. Omonene Nyasae abe amo naye!”
Erio omoruoti agatebia omokungu oria, “Tobaisa kombisa gento kende gionsi ndakoborie.” Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Aye omonene one omoruoti, mboria.”

Omoruoti akamoboria, “Inee! Yoabu takari amo naye ase aya onsi?” Omokungu oria akairaneria, akabora, “Ekeene, buna aye, omonene one omoruoti, ore moyo, monto onde tari oranyare gokana gose kwanga gokoiraneria amaborio ao na gotama gochia aande, ensemo ya borio gose eya bomosi. Ekeene, Yoabu, omosomba oo, nere omboretie inche, omosomba oo, ng’a nkwane amang’ana aya onsi.

Omosomba oo Yoabu nigo akorire aya, erinde akoonchorerie goetera ase ring’ana eri, korende aye, omonene one, nigo ore ne chisemi buna echi’abamalaika ba Nyasae; nomanyete amang’ana onsi ayare ase ense.”
Nyuma y’ayio omoruoti agatebia Yoabu, “Naama! Nakoeire ribaga eri. Genda orente omosae oria Abisalomu.”

Yoabu agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase omoruoti ase okomosika na komosesenia. Naende akabora, “Rero inche, omosomba oo, namanyire ng’a nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, aye omoruoti, omonene one, ekiagera kwang’ikeraneirie okogania kwane.”
Yoabu akaimoka, akagenda Gesuri, akarenta Abisalomu,
na omoruoti agateba, “Tiga amenye ao ase enka yaye omonyene; tabaisa gocha ase obosio bwane.” Ase igo Abisalomu akamenya bwoye oka, taba okororana nomoruoti.

Bono ase egati y’Abaisraeli bonsi monto onde tarenge orenge nogotogigwa ase ekieni kiaye buna Abisalomu. Nigo arenge omonyakieni mono; korwa ebisanyi bi’amagoro goika omotwe oye tarenge na kemocho kende.

Ere nigo arenge konacha etukia yaye omoerio o kera omwaka, ekiagera yare koba endito mono. Oborito bw’etukia yaye nigo bwarenge chikiro ibere na ekeng’ese, koreng’ana ekerengo kiare gokorerwa ase omoruoti.
Abisalomu nigo aiboreretwe abamura batato, na omoiseke oyomo ore korokwa Tamari. Ere nigo arenge omoiseke omonyakieni.
Abisalomu akamenya Yerusalemu emiaka ebere atana gochia kororana nomoruoti.
Erio Abisalomu akarangeria Yoabu, erinde amotome ase omoruoti, korende Yoabu akaanga gocha asare. Naende akamorangeria eria kabere, korende boigo akaanga, tacha.
Ase igo Abisalomu agatebia abasomba baye, “Rora omogondo o Yoabu nigo osinyaine noyone, noro bwamire esairi, genda motongie omorero esairi eria eyie.” Bakagenda, bakayetongia omorero ekayia.
Na bono Yoabu akaimoka, akagenda bw’Abisalomu, akamoboria, “Nase ki abasomba bao basambire esairi yane iga?”

Abisalomu akamoiraneria, “Rigereria, ngatoma abanto asore ng’a oche ogende ase omoruoti, omotebie amang’ana aane. Inki rende narwerete Gesuri? Nanga mbuya nare komenya aroro goika rero iga. Bono ninganetie korora omoruoti. Onye obobe bore asende ang’ite.”

Ase igo Yoabu akagenda ase omoruoti, akamotebia amang’ana ayio. Erio omoruoti akarangeria Abisalomu; na ere akagenda ase omoruoti, agatung’ama inse akaumama ase obosio bwaye, na omoruoti akamonyunyunta.
Nyuma y’ayio Abisalomu akenyorera egari, ne chibarasi, na abanto emerongo etano barabe bakominyoka bosio bwaye.

Ase kera rituko Abisalomu nigo anarete koimoka mambia chuni, otenena enchera ensemo ase egeita ki’omochie. Na ekero omonto onde bwensi are gocha ore ne ring’ana akoira ase omoruoti agamberwe, Abisalomu omorangeria gocha asare, omoboria, “Aye mochie ki kwarwa?” Ekero omonto oyio amoiraneirie nase gesaku ki ki’Abaisraeli arwa,
Abisalomu omotebia, “Rora, amang’ana ao namaya, naende amaronge, korende monto onde tari aa omoruoti abegete orakoigwere.”
Naende Abisalomu obora, “Onye nabekwa imbe omogambi ase ense eye, kera omonto ore ne ring’ana gose ekina gete anga nacha asende, nainche anga namokonya na komonyorera oboronge.”
Omonto arenge goika asare na gotung’ama ase okoorokia amasikani, Abisalomu nigo arenge korambora okoboko kwaye obwata omonto oyio na komonyunyunta.
Naboigo Abisalomu akorete Abaisraeli bonsi abwo barenge gocha ase omoruoti ase okogamberwa ebina biabo. Ase enchera eyio Abisalomu akang’usa Abaisraeli bonsi bakamwancha.
Ekaba nyuma y’emiaka ene koyaerire, Abisalomu agatebia omoruoti, “Koranche ong’e ribaga ngende Heburoni goikerania eira yane narierete Omonene.
Naki inche, omosomba oo, ekero narenge imenyete Gesuri ya Siiria, nigo narierete Omonene eira ng’a karang’iranie Yerusalemu, erio nimbe nkomokorera agwo Heburoni.”
Omoruoti akamotebia, “Genda nomorembe.” Ase igo Abisalomu akaimoka, akagenda Heburoni.
Korende Abisalomu agatoma abanto bobisi ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli babitebie, “Ekero moraigwe eriogi ri’egetureri, erio moake eriogi motebe: Bono Abisalomu obeire omoruoti o Heburoni!”
Abanto amagana abere korwa Yerusalemu bakagenda amo n’Abisalomu. Abwo bachigetwe koba abageni, bakagenda batari na komocha, ekiagera tibamanyete amang’ana agochia gokorwa.

Ekero Abisalomu arenge korua ebing’wanso, agatoma abanto korangeria Ahitofali, omosemia bw’omoruoti Daudi, korwa ase omochie o Gilo. Obobe bwabo bw’okoba mamincha ya Daudi bokabucha, bokaba ne chinguru, na abanto abwo bakabwatana n’Abisalomu bakamentekana, bakaba abange.
Abanto bakairera Daudi amang’ana, bakamotebia, “Abaisraeli babwatanire n’Abisalomu bamoigwereire.”

Erio Daudi agatebia abasomba baye bonsi, abwo barenge nere agwo Yerusalemu, “Imoka totame, onye torigetie gwetooria korwa ase Abisalomu. Ayerera bwango, Abisalomu tabaisa gocha gotoumokera na gotorentera amabe, gose aite abanto b’omochie nomoro.”
Abasomba b’omoruoti bakamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, intwe abasomba bao nigo twebegete ang’e gokora rinde rionsi oratotebie.”
Ase igo omoruoti akagenda, na abanto bonsi b’omochie oye bakamotunyana. Omoruoti agatiga abakungu baye ba sere‐sere ikomi bakorenda enyomba yaye.
Omoruoti akagenderera gotama, na abanto bonsi bakamotunyana korwa nyuma; bakaratenena ake ase enyomba yarenge ensinyo.
Abasomba baye bonsi bagaetera ensemo, bakamoetania, amo n’Abakereti bonsi, na Abapeleti bonsi, na Abagiti amagana atano na rimo, abwo bamobwatetie korwa Gati; bonsi bagaetania omoruoti.
Omoruoti akaboria Itai Omogiti, “Nase ki naye okogenda amo naintwe? Irana obeere nomoruoti oyio omoyia; aye nomomenyi ore, naende nigo gwaserigwa korwa seino.

Nigoro gwacha aa. Nase ki ndagotige ontunyane na kona‐koong’anya amo nainche, nainche timanyeti nonya naase ngochia? Irana amo nabamino, na Omonene akoorokerie obwanchani bwaye botari koera na obwegenwa bwaye.”

Korende Itai akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, na buna aye omoruoti, omonene one, ore moyo, aande onsi ase ogochia, onye nase ogokwa, gose ase okoba moyo, agwo nao nainche, omosomba oo, ndabe.”
Erio Daudi agatebia Itai, “Gaki eta, ogende bosio.” Itai Omogiti agaeta gochia bosio amo nabanto baye bonsi, na abana abake bonsi, abarenge amo nere.
Abanto b’ense eria bakarera namariogi amanene ekero abanto bonsi baare goeta, na omoruoti akaamboka akarooche ga Kidironi; abanto bonsi bakaamboka bakagenda ase enchera y’erooro.

Zadoki nao arenge na Abalawi bonsi. Barabwo babogoretie Esanduku ya Nyasae ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania. Abiatari nere agachao. Ababogoretie Esanduku eria ba kayetoora inse goika abanto bonsi bakaba barure ase omochie.
Erio omoruoti agatebia Zadoki, “Bogoria Esanduku ya Nyasae, oyeiranie ase omochie ime. Onye nkonyora ogwancherwa ase Omonene, ere nang’iranie, ayenyorokie naende amo n’Obomenyo bwaye omonyene.
Korende karantebie ng’a timogwenereti, inche nao inde aa, ankorere aya ararore are amaya asare.”
Naende omoruoti agatebia Zadoki omokuani, “Aye nomorori. Irana ase omochie nomorembe. Oirane n’Ahimasi, omwana oo, na Yonathani, omwana o Abiatari, abana abwo babere baino.
Naama! Inche nigo nkoganyera ase ebiambokero bi’orooche aiga ase erooro goika inyore amang’ana korwa asemore.”
Ase igo Zadoki na Abiatari bakabogoria Esanduku ya Nyasae; bakayeirania Yerusalemu, nabarabwo bakabeera aroro.
Daudi agatiira gochia ase Egetunwa ki’Emezeituni igoro okona‐korera otubete omotwe oye, tabegete bikoroto; na abanto abarenge amo nere bagetuba emetwe yabo bakorera kobagotiira.
Ekero Daudi atebetigwe ng’a Ahitofeli nere nao akare ase abwo babwatanire n’Abisalomu, agasaba, “Omonene, onchora omoroberio bw’Ahitofeli obe bosa.”
Ekero Daudi aigete ekegoro igoro, ase Nyasae are gosasimerwa, Husai Omoariki agacha komorotota; eganchwa yaye nigo yatandoire, na ebuse ere ase omotwe oye.
Daudi akamotebia, “Oise kogenda amo nainche nigo orabe egurube asende.

Korende oise koirana ase omochie na gotebia Abisalomu: Aye omoruoti, nigo ndabe omosomba oo buna narenge omosomba o iso agwo ritang’ani, naboigo bono ndabe omosomba oo, erio nario orankonye tosarie omoroberio bw’Ahitofeli.
Inee! Zadoki na Abiatari abakuani tibakari aroro? Gaki ing’ana rinde rionsi oraigwe ase enyomba y’omoruoti oribatebie.
Barabwo mbakabwate abana babo babere, Ahimasi, omwana o Zadoki, na Yonathani, omwana bw’Abiatari. Mobe mokobatoma bandetere kera ring’ana moraigwe.”
Husai, omosani o Daudi, agasoa omochie o Yerusalemu ekero Abisalomu nere asoeteo.

Ekero Daudi agendire ake goetania egetunwa igoro, akaumerana na Siba, omosomba o Mefiboseti, ore ne chitigere ibere chibogoretie emegati amagana abere, na amabomba ’amasabibu amomo rigana erimo, na amabomba ’amako rigana erimo, amo nekerandi ekemo keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, kere nedivai.

Omoruoti akaboria Siba, “Naki gwakora kwarenta ebinto ebi?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Chitigere nechi ’abanto b’omoruoti bagochia koriina, na emegati na amatunda nebi’abamura abwo bagochia koria, na edivai baegwe banywe kobarosire ase erooro.”
Omoruoti akamoboria, “Ng’ai omochokoro bw’omonene oo akare?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Yerusalemu akare. Nigo ateba ng’a rero Abaisraeli bamoiraneirie oboruoti bwa sokoro yaye.”
Erio omoruoti agatebia Siba, “Rigereria, kera egento ekiarenge ekia Mefiboseti nebiao.” Siba akamotebia, “Nebekire inse asore. Koranche inyore ogwancherwa asore, aye omoruoti, omonene one.”
Ekero omoruoti Daudi aigete Bahurimu, omonto bw’eamate ya Saulo ore korokwa Simei, mosinto o Gera, agasoka korwa ase omochie. Ere kagocha akana‐koragereria Daudi.
Akaba okoruta amagena ase Daudi omoruoti na ase abasomba baye bonsi, nonya abanto bonsi, amo nabaria chituoni, bamoetanaine, ase ensemo ya borio na eya bomosi.
Simei gakoragereria, akabora, “Karue aa! Karue aa! Aye omoiteri amanyinga! Aye omosaria!

Aye nigo kwairete oboruoti korwa ase Saulo, na bono Omonene nkoruseria are abanto b’enyomba ya Saulo abwo gwaitete egesiomba. Bono Omonene obekire oboruoti ase okoboko kw’Aibsalomu, omwana oo. Rigereria, obobe bwao bwakoiraneire, aye omoiteri amanyinga.”
Erio Abisai, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, agatebia omoruoti, “Naki esese eria ekwete egokoragereria iga, aye omoruoti, omonene one? Tiga ngende mbutore omotwe oye.”
Omoruoti akabora, “Inki inde nainwe abamura b’omokungu Seruya? Onye okoragereria, ekiagera Omonene amotebirie ng’a andagererie inche Daudi, ning’o oranyare komoboria; Ninki kiagera ogokora iga?”

Daudi agatebia Abisai na abasomba baye bonsi, “Rigereria, omwana one ndusetie ase enda yane, nere okondigia ang’ite. Bono omonto oyo bw’egesaku kia Benjamin, Inee, takondigia goetania? Motige andame. Omonene nere omotebirie ng’a andame.
Ande Omonene ororire amabe anyorete, nere ang’akane amaya ribaga ri’okoragererigwa okwo kwanyorire rero.”
Daudi na abanto baye bakaba bagendererete enchera yabo, na Simei nere okona‐goeta ensemo y’egetunwa, okoragereria; akamoruta amagena, na komosiarera ebuse.
Omoruoti na abanto baye bonsi konya barosire ekero baigete aase gete. Ase igo bakaba bagotimokera aroro.
Abisalomu na abanto abwo bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagaika Yerusalemu, na Ahitofeli nigo arenge amo nere.
Ekero Husai Omoariki, omosani o Daudi, aigete ase Abisalomu, akamotebia, “Omoruoti, ochie kare! Omoruoti, ochie kare!”
Abisalomu akaboria Husai, “Inee! Obo nabwo obwegenwa ore nabwo ase Daudi, omosani oo? Naki otatunyanete omosani oo?”
Husai akamoiraneria, “Yaya, taibo. Korende oyo Omonene achorire, na abanto abwo, na Abaisraeli bonsi, bachorire, inche nimbe oyoye, mbeere asare.
Naende ning’o ngwenerete nkorere? Tengwenereti nkorere aye, omwana oye? Ee, buna narenge gokorera iso, naboigo naye ndagokorere.”
Erio Abisalomu agatebia Ahitofeli, “Bono buna tore aa, tosemie eki togwenerete gokora.”

Ahitofeli akairaneria Abisalomu, “Soa nyomba, momenyane nabakungu ba sere‐sere abwo iso atiga bakorenda enyomba. Igo Abaisraeli bonsi bakoigwa ng’a kwagechigwe na iso, na abwo bonsi bagokobwatia nigo barabekwe chinguru.”
Ase igo barabwo bagateneneria Abisalomu eema kerama igoro, na ere akarara nabakungu ba sere‐sere ba ise maiso marore ase Abaisraeli bonsi.
Ase engaki eria ogosemia kw’Ahitofeli gokaba ase abanto buna amairanerio omonto akonyora korwa ase Nyasae. Naboigo ogosemia kw’Ahitofeli kwabete ase Daudi na ase Abisalomu.
Nyuma y’ayio Ahitofeli agatebia Abisalomu, “Tiga nchore abanto chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000), erinde mbwatie Daudi ase obotuko obo.
Inche imochiere mobosokano imogose ekero arosire na erusirie moyo. Abanto abwo bonsi bare komo mbatame, nainche ninyare goita omoruoti kare bweka.
Erio mbarente abanto bonsi asore, buna omoriakari akorentwa ase omosacha oye. Aye nomonto oyomo origetie oite; naende abanto bonsi babe nomorembe.”
Ogosemia okwo gokagwenera Abisalomu na abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli.
Erio Abisalomu akabora, “Rangeria Husai Omoariki, toigwe nere, buna agototebia.”
Na ekero Husai achete ase Abisalomu, Abisalomu akamotebia, “Aya naro Ahitofeli atosemirie. Naro tokobwatia gose? Onye taibo, aye totebie aya togokora.”
Husai akairaneria Abisalomu, “Ogosemia okwo Ahitofeli abaeire tikori okuya ase ekero eke.”

Naende Husai akamotebia, “Nomanyete iso na abanto baye, ng’a nabanto chituoni chi’esegi, bare abakong’u, naende nigo bare abatindi buna edubu yaurirwe chimanwa chiaye ase orosana. Iso nomonto omanyete korwana esegi, takorara botuko, ere nabanto baye.

Ande nonya mbono nigo ebisete ase engoro gete, gose ase ribwago. Kerabe ng’a abanto mbaitwe ekero esegi egochaka, onde bwensi karaigwe amang’ana ayio nigo aratebe ng’a abanto bare kobwatia Abisalomu babuirwe.
Igo nonya noyore omoremu buna endo, nigo arairianyeke kegima, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi mbamanyete ng’a iso nigo are etuoni y’esegi, na abanto baye nabatindi ase esegi.
Ase ayio ogosemia kwane noko: Orente Abaisraeli bonsi amo korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba babe abange buna omokenye ore engegu y’enyancha; naye omonyene ogende amo nabarabwo ase esegi.
Erio toorokere Daudi aande onsi aranyorekane, tomogwere buna riime rikogwa igoro ase riroba, gose titotiga onde bwensi abe moyo, ere gose monto onde bwensi bare komo.
Aise gosoa ase omochie onde bwensi, Abaisraeli bonsi nigo bararente chingori bachietananie omochie oyio, bayokurure gochia rooche ime, gose igena rinde tirigotigara nonya nerimo.”

Abisalomu na Abaisraeli bonsi bakabora, “Ogosemia kwa Husai Omoariki nokuya kobua koria kw’Ahitofeli.” Omonene nere ochigete ogosemia okwo okuya kw’Ahitofeli kwangwe, erinde arentere Abisalomu emechando.
Husai agatebia Zadoki na Abiatari, abakuani, “Ahitofeli osemirie Abisalomu na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli amang’ana aya na aya, korende inche nabasemia iga na iga.
Bono toma amang’ana bwango, mokurere Daudi ng’a tabaisa korara ase obotuko obo ase ebiambokero agwo ase erooro, korende goika amboke orooche, erinde tabaisa gosirigwa amo nabanto baye bonsi.”

Bono Yonathani na Ahimasi nigo barenge baganyete ase ensoko y’Eni‐Rogeli, ekiagera boboete gosoa omochie ime babaise kororwa. Omoiseke omosomba oyomo nigo arenge okona‐kobairera amang’ana, nabarabwo bayairera omoruoti Daudi.

Korende rituko erimo omosae oyomo akabarora, agatebia Abisalomu amang’ana ayio. Ase ayio Yonathani na Ahimasi bakagenda ase enka y’omonto gete aaria Bahurimu. Omonto oyio nabwate engoro y’amache ase omochie oye, nabarabwo bakebisa imeo,
na omokungu bw’omonto oria akaimokia egekuneko, akayekuneka, akanekera endagera yaye igoro aroro; gose omonto onde tamanyete amang’ana ayio.

Ekero abasomba b’Abisalomu bachete ase omokungu oria nyomba ime, bakamoboria, “Ng’ai Yonathani na Ahimasi bare?” Omokungu oria akabatebia, “Bambokire orooche orwo, bachiire.” Ekero abanto baria babarigetie tibabarora, bakairana Yerusalemu.

Nyuma barabwo kobachiire, baria babere bagasoka korwa ase engoro eria, bakaamboka orooche bwango, bakagenda ase omoruoti Daudi bakamotebia, “Imoka mwamboke orooche bwango, morue aa, naki aya na aya naro Ahitofeli arobeirie mamincha yaino.”
Erio Daudi na abanto bonsi barenge komo bakaimoka, bakaamboka Yorodan. Bogachia gokia, bonsi konya bambokire; onde tatigarete otambogete.

Ekero Ahitofeli aroche ng’a ogosemia kwaye kwangirwe, akariina etigere yaye, akagenda omochie oye, na karobeirie amang’ana ’enyomba yaye, akagenda agesunga, agakwa. Gakure agatindekwa ase oboina bwa ise.
Daudi konya oikire Mahanaimu ekero Abisalomu ambogete Yorodan amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi barenge komo.

Abisalomu konya obekire Amasa koba omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’esegi ribaga ria Yoabu. Amasa nigo arenge mosinto o Yitira Omoisumaeli. Yitira nere omenyanete n’Abigaeli, omoiseke o Nahasi, mosubati omwabo Seruya, oyorenge ng’ina Yoabu.
Abisalomu amo n’Abaisraeli bagatoora ase ense ya Gileadi.
Ekaba Daudi gaikire Mahanaimu, akanyorana na Sobi, mosinto o Nahasi, korwa Raba, ase ense y’Abaamoni, na Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, korwa Lo‐Debari, na Barisilai Omogileadi korwa Rogelimu.
Barabwo bakarenta ebirarero, ne chisani, na ebikorero biroisirie korwa ase amaroba. Boigo bakarenta engano, na esairi, na obosie, na ebigara bisambire, ne ching’ende ao ao,

na obooke, na amaguta, ne ching’ondi, na amabomba ’amabeere e chiombe abwatanirie bibe endagera ase Daudi amo nabanto barenge komo. Abwo babirentete nigo batebete, “Abanto aba enchara yabanyarire, naende barang’ire na barosire aiga ase erooro.”
Omoruoti Daudi akaroberia abanto baye, akabaatanana ase ebiombe bi’elifu elifu, na ebie rigana rigana, akababekera abatang’ani

Erio agatoma abarwani bagende korwana esegi, bare ebiombe bitato, ekemo inse y’oboraai bwa Yoabu, ne egia kabere inse y’oboraai bw’Abisai, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, oyorenge ng’ina Yoabu boigo, na egia gatato inse y’oboraai bwa Itai korwa Gati. Omoruoti agatebia abanto baye, “Nigo nkogenda amo nainwe inche omonyene.”

Korende abanto bakamoiraneria, “Aye tobaisa kogenda amo naintwe. Naki gatoratame, barabwo tibagotoraara. Nonya abanto baito nabaisa goitwa ekeng’ese ki’omobaro, tobagotoraara. Aye nigo ore bw’engencho enene asetore kobua abanto baito chilifu ikomi. Ase ayio igo erabe buya obeere ase omochie na gotokonya korwa aroro.”
Omoruoti akabairaneria, “Aya mwarora ng’a namaya naro ngokora.” Ase ayio omoruoti agatenena geita ensemo ekero abarwani baare gosoka gochia isiko ase ebiombe bi’amagana ne chilifu.

Omoruoti agachika Yoabu, na Abisai, na Itai, akabatebia, “Ase engencho yane timokorera omosae oyio Abisalomu bobe.” Na abanto bonsi mbaigwete ekero omoruoti akoa abatang’ani abwo ogochika okwo igoro y’Abisalomu.
Abarwani ba Daudi bakagenda orosana korwania Abaisraeli, na esegi ekarwanerwa ase rinani ri’Efraimu.
Abaisraeli bakabugwa nabarwani ba Daudi. Ogoitwa okwo gokaba okonene, na ase rituko riria abanto chilifu emerongo ebere bagaitwa.
Esegi nigo yesiarerete ase orosana rwonsi rw’aase aria, na ase rituko riria abanto abange bagakwera ase rinani ime kobua abwo baitetwe nemioro.

Abisalomu akaumerana nabasomba ba Daudi mobosokano. Nigo ariinete eyombo yaye, nero egaeta inse y’omote onga buna omotontera ore ne chinsagia chinetu, na omotwe bw’Abisalomu okaaga ase omote oria igoro, nere agatigara osung’unaneteo, na eyombo yaye egaeta akaminyoka.
Omonto gete akamorora, akagenda ase Yoabu akamotebia, “Narora Abisalomu osung’unaine agwo moino ase omote onga buna omotontera.”
Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Onye kwamorora, ninki kiaba tikwamoita ara rimo? Inche anga naba nomogoko inkoe chibesa chisekeli chie chifeta ikomi, amo norokini.”

Omonto oria agatebia Yoabu, “Nonya kware kong’a chisekeli chie chifeta elifu eyemo, tinare korambora okoboko kwane igoro y’omwana bw’omoruoti, naki twensi ntwaigwete ekero omoruoti agochigete aye, na Abisai, na Itai, ogoteba: Ase engencho yane orende omosae oyio Abisalomu.
Onye nanga tinyigwera omoruoti, korende ing’ite omwana oye, ere anga naigwa amang’ana ayio, ekiagera nigo are komanya kera ring’ana. Inee! Aye omonyene ngonkengera kware?”

Erio Yoabu akabora, “Tinkora gosaria chingaki gokwana naye boire.” Akaimokia amatimo atato, akabeta Abisalomu egekuba igoro, agachia konacha enkoro, ekero Abisalomu asung’unanete ase omote igoro ore moyo.
Erio abamura ikomi ababogoreretie Yoabu ebirwanero, bagaetanana Abisalomu, bakamoaka na komoita.
Nyuma y’ayio Yoabu akabugia egetureri ase ogotanga esegi, na abanto bakairana bagatiga kobwatia Abaisraeli.
Abanto bakaimokia omobere bw’Abisalomu, bakayoruta ase engoro entambe, agwo ase rinani, bakayotuba amagena akaba etui enene, na Abaisraeli bonsi bagatama kera omonto gochia bwoye.

Ekero Abisalomu arenge moyo konya bweagacheire egento buna esiiro, agakebeka agwo ase Ense Omweya y’Omoruoti gekaba ekeinyorio ki’erieta riaye; akarengereria ng’a tari na monyamwando. Akayeroka ase erieta riaye omonyene; na goika rero iga nigo ekorokwa Ekeinyorio ki’Abisalomu.
Ahimasi, mosinto o Zadoki, agatebia Yoabu, “Tiga iminyoke ntebie omoruoti amang’ana, buna Omonene amotooririe korwa ase ababisa baye.”
Yoabu akamokania, akamotebia, “Yaya, rero tokonyara koba omonto okoira amang’ana amaya. Rituko rinde nonyare koira amang’ana amaya, korende tari rero, ekiagera omwana bw’omoruoti okure.”
Erio Yoabu agatebia Omoetiopia oyomo, “Genda otebie omoruoti aya kwarora.” Na Omoetiopia oria agekumba inse ase obosio bwa Yoabu, akaminyoka kogenda.

Ahimasi, mosinto o Zadoki, agatebia Yoabu eria kabere. “Ande onsi arabe, koranche ong’e ribaga iminyoke korwa nyuma y’Omoetiopia oria ng’irere omoruoti amang’ana.” Yoabu akamoboria, “Omwana one, gokominyoka, ninki orachie konyora? Ayio tari amang’ana amaya airwa.”
Ahimasi akamoiraneria, “Ayio tari mang’ana, ing’a ribaga ngende.” Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Minyoka rende.” Erio Ahimasi akaminyoka agaetania Omoetiopia oria agwo ase ense omweya ya Yorodan.

Bono Daudi nigo aikaransete egati y’ebiita bibere bi’omochie, egia isiko na ekia ime. Omorendi akariina gochia kerama igoro y’ebiita, ang’e norwaki. Na ekero arigereretie akarora omonto oyomo okominyoka gocha ore bweka.
Omorendi akarangeria gochia inse, agatebia omoruoti amang’ana ayio. Na omoruoti akamotebia, “Onye ore bweka nigo abwate amang’ana amaya.” Omonto oria akaba ogoika ang’e kobua.

Naende omorendi akarora omonto onde okominyoka gocha ore bweka. Erio akarangeria omorendi bw’egesieri, akamotebia, “Omonto onde oyio gocha ore bweka!” Omoruoti agateba, “Nere boigo namang’ana amaya abwate.”
Omorendi agateba, “Nigo ndoche ng’a omominyoki oria bwe ritang’ani nigo anga buna Ahimasi, mosinto o Zadoki.” Erio omoruoti agateba, “Ere nomonto omuya, nigo akorenta amang’ana amaya.”

Ahimasi agaaka eriogi, agatebia omoruoti, “Nomorembe!” Naende agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase obosio bw’omoruoti, akabora, “Omonene, Nyasae oo, atogigwe, oyo obarusirieo abanto aba konya baimokirie amaboko abo igoro yao, aye omoruoti, omonene one.”
Omoruoti akamoboria, “Inee! Omosae oria Abisalomu mbuya are?” Ahimasi akamoiraneria, “Ekero Yoabu antoma, inche, omosomba oo, nigo naigwa egetitiro ekenene, korende tinamanya engencho yaye.”
Omoruoti akamotebia, “Tigera, otenene agwo ensemo,” na Ahimasi agatigera, agatenena ensemo.
Omoetiopia nere agacha, agatebia omoruoti, “Nakorenteire amang’ana amaya, aye omonene one. Rero Omonene okoruseirie egesiomba ase baria bakoimokera gokorwania.”

Omoruoti akaboria Omoetiopia oria, “Inee! Omosae oria Abisalomu mbuya are?” Omoetiopia oria akamoiraneria, “Nigo nare kogania ng’a aya amonyora omosae oria, abanyore nababisa bao bonsi; boigo anyore nabaria bagokoimokera kogokorera bobe.”

Omoruoti agachandeka mono, akariina gochia akanyomba karenge ase egeita igoro, akarera nobororo, akaba ogotaara‐taara na goteba, “Abisalomu, omwana one! Obee! Omwana one! Abisalomu, ntare gokwa ribaga riao! Abisalomu, omwana one!”
Yoabu agatebigwa ng’a omoruoti Daudi nkorera are na kweumia ase engencho y’Abisalomu.
Ase igo omogoko bw’obobui okaonchoka okaba omoichano ase abanto bonsi ba Daudi, ekiagera ase rituko riria abanto nigo baigwete ng’a Daudi nkona‐korera are ase engencho y’omwana oye.
Ase rituko riria abanto bakaba bagochoba gosoa ase omochie ime buna abanto bagotama korwa ase esegi bare nobosooku ase engencho y’ayio.
Omoruoti agetuba obosio bwaye, akarera ase eriogi rinene, “Obee! Abisalomu, omwana one! Obee! Abisalomu, omwana one, omwana one!”

Erio Yoabu agacha nyomba ase omoruoti, akamotebia, “Rero aye gwakorire abasomba bao bonsi barorire obosooku, abanto aba konya batooririe obogima bwao, na obw’abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, na obw’abakungu bao, na abakungu bao ba sere‐sere.

Nigo bwanchete abwo bakogechete na kogecha abwo bagwanchete. Naki rero kworokirie maiso marore ng’a abatang’ani na abasomba bao barabwo mbosa bare asore. Rero nario namanya ng’a onye Abisalomu moyo arenge, na intwe twensi tobe twakure, erio nanga nigo kwaigwa buya.

Gaki bono koranche, oimoke osoke isiko, okwane nabasomba bao, oremie chinkoro chiabo. Ase igo natianire ase Omonene ng’a otasogeti, monto onde tagotigara orabe amo naye goika mambia, na amang’ana ayio nigo arabe amabe kobua ayakonyorete korwa ekero kwarenge omosae goika rero iga.”

Erio omoruoti agasoka, agaikaransa ase egeita ki’omochie. Abanto bonsi bagatebigwa ng’a omoruoti nao are ase egeita; na igo bakagenda asare. Abaisraeli bonsi konya batamire, kera omonto gochia inka bwoye.
Bakaba bakoamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakabora, “Omoruoti nigo atotooretie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baito, na korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti, na bono otamire Abisalomu, otigire ense eye.
Abisalomu, oyo twaaka amaguta akaba omoruoti oito, okure ase esegi. Na bono, naki motari goteba ng’a moiranie Daudi abe omoruoti naende?”

Daudi omoruoti agatoma abanto gochia ase Zadoki na Abiatari, abakuani, agateba, “Kwana nabagaaka b’Abayuda, mobamborerie: Naki rende mokoba abanto b’omoerio ase okong’irania inche omoruoti inka bwone, bono ekero amang’ana onsi aya Abaisraeli bakwanete aikerete nyomba mwane?
Inwe nabanto baminto ab’amanyinga aane ne chinyama chiane. Naki rende morigetie koba ab’omoerio ase okong’irania inche omoruoti inka?
Naende motebie Amasa: Inee! Aye tori amanyinga aane ne chinyama chiane? Nyasae ang’e egesusuro bono na kogenderera onye aye tokoba omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’esegi botambe ribaga ria Yoabu.”
Abayuda bonsi bagancha amang’ana a Daudi mono, bakamotomera amang’ana ng’a airane amo nabasomba baye bonsi.
Ekero omoruoti are koirana gaikire Yorodan, akanyora Abayuda bachire Giligali komorotota na komwambokia Yorodan.
Na Simei, mosinto o Gera, Omobenjamin korwa Bahurimu, akaayerera amo n’Abayuda gochia korotota omoruoti Daudi.

Simei nigo arenge amo nabanto elifu eyemo b’egesaku kia Benjamin. Na Siba, omosomba o Saulo, na abamura baye ikomi na batano, na abasomba baye emerongo ebere, bakaayerera gochia ase Yorodan, bagaikao omoruoti ataraika.

Barabwo bakaamboka orooche gochia kwambokia abanto b’enka y’omoruoti na gokora ande onsi omoruoti aganetie. Ekero omoruoti abeire ang’e kwamboka Yorodan, Simei, mosinto o Gera, agatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye,
akamotebia, “Omonene one, tombarera obobe, gose toinyora aria nagokorerete ase rituko riria kwaruete Yerusalemu.
Inche, omosomba oo, namanyire ng’a nakorete ebibe ekero keria, ayio naro agera naba oyo bwe ritang’ani korwa ase enyomba ya Yusufu gocha gokorotota aye omoruoti aiga rero.”
Abisai, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, akabora, “Inee! Simei tagoitwa akwe, ekiagera amoragereretie omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene?”
Korende Daudi akamotebia, “Ninki inde nainwe, abana b’omokungu Seruya? Nigo moganetie koba mamincha yane. Bono ninche inde omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, na onde tari ase Abaisraeli oraitwe rero.”
Na omoruoti agatebia Simei, “Togoitwa.” Naende agatiana ase ayio.

Erio Mefiboseti, omochokoro o Saulo, agatirimboka gochia korotota omoruoti. Korwa ekero keria omoruoti aruete Yerusalemu, Mefiboseti konya tana gwesibia amagoro aye, gose konacha chinderu, gose gosibia chianga chiaye, goika rituko riria omoruoti airanete nomorembe.
Ekero Mefiboseti achete korwa Yerusalemu gochia korotota omoruoti, omoruoti akamoboria, “Mefiboseti, naki otagendete amo nainche?”
Mefiboseti akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, nomanyete ng’a nekerema inde. Nigo natebetie omosomba one, ng’a abekere etigere yane egeikaransero, nainche ndiine ngende nomoruoti, korende ere akang’aina.
Boigo agantebera oborimo asore aye omonene one, korende aye igo onga buna omomalaika o Nyasae: gaki kora aya oroche arabe amaya.

Abaamate ba tata bonsi pi nigo barenge asore buna abagwenerete gokwa, korende okambeka inche, omosomba oo, ase egati y’abwo bakoragera mwao. Bono aye omoruoti, mboronge ki kobua ayio ngokoboria na korera asore?”
Omoruoti akamoiraneria, “Naki okona‐komenta gokwana amang’ana ayio ao? Inche natebire ng’a aye na Siba mwatanane amaremo a Saulo.”
Mefiboseti akamoiraneria, “Omoruoti, tiga Siba ayaire onsi, inche naisanekire ng’a aye, omonene one, kwairanire inka buya.”
Bono Barisilai Omogileadi nere konya ochire korwa Rogelimu gokooba omoruoti gochia Yorodan amboke amo nere.
Barisilai nigo arenge omogotu mono, konya okoorire emiaka emerongo etano na etato. Ere nigo arenge omonda mono, akaba okorageria omoruoti ekero ere arenge agwo Mahanaimu.
Omoruoti agatebia Barisilai, “Inchuo ogende amo nainche, nimbe ngokorageria aaria Yerusalemu.”
Korende Barisilai akamoiraneria, “Emiaka yane nerenga etigarete ngochia koba moyo, ng’a ngende amo naye Yerusalemu komenyao?

Nakoorire emiaka emerongo etano na etato, Inee, ninyare gwatanana ayare ay’okogokia na ayatari ay’okogokia? Ninyare koigwa obwansu bw’eki nkoria na eki nkonywa? Ninyare koigwa na kogokera eriogi ri’abateri, abasacha gose abakungu? Nase ki inche, omosomba oo, ngochia gokoraarereria aye, omonene one, omoruoti?
Ninki rende aye omoruoti ogochia konduera eng’eria buna eyio. Tiga inche, omosomba oo, nyamboke Yorodan oka.

Nagosabire ontige inche, omosomba oo, ing’irane, erinde nkwere ase omochie one, ang’e nembeera ya tata na baba. Korende omosomba oo Kimuhamu, nao are aa, tiga amboke amo naye, omonene one, na omokorere aya orarore are amaya.”
Omoruoti akamoiraneria, “Kimuhamu nagende amo nainche, nimokorere kende gionsi aye oraganie. Na ande onsi oramborie ningokorere aye.”
Erio abanto bonsi bakaamboka Yorodan, omoruoti nere akaamboka; erio omoruoti akanyunyunta Barisilai na komosesenia, ere akairana gochia inka bwoye.
Omoruoti akagenda agaika Giligali na Kimuhamu akagenda amo nere. Abayuda bonsi, na abanto ekeng’ese ki’Abaisraeli nabarabwo bakagenda amo nere.
Erio Abaisraeli bonsi bagachiera omoruoti, bakamoboria, “Nase ki Abayuda baminto bakoibete aye na eamate yao, na abanto bao bonsi, na kobaambokia Yorodan?”

Abayuda bonsi bakairaneria Abaisraeli, “Nigo twakorete igo, ekiagera omoruoti nigo are bw’eamate yaito. Nase ki rende mokobeea ase amang’ana ayio? Inee! Twarire gento kende ki’omoruoti? Gose otoeire keegwa kende?”

Abaisraeli bakairaneria Abayuda, bakabora, “Omoruoti noyoito ara ikomi kobua buna are oyoino. Ase ayio, oyio Daudi noyoito bori. Nase ki mogotochaya? Inee! Titwarenge abe ritang’ani gokwana igoro y’okoirania omoruoti oito.” Korende amang’ana ’Abayuda nigo arenge amakong’u kobua ay’Abaisraeli.

Ekaba ng’a narenge agwo Giligali omonto omoomboganu, ore korokwa Seba, mosinto o Bikiri bw’egesaku kia Benjamin. Ere akabugia egetureri, akabora, “Ngetari ki tobwate ase Daudi? Titori nomwando na mosinto o Yese! Inwe Abaisraeli, genda kera omonto bwoye!”
Ase igo Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiga Daudi, bakabwatia Seba, mosinto o Bikiri; korende Abayuda bakabwatia omoruoti obo korwa Yorodan goika Yerusalemu.

Ekero Daudi aigete inka bwoye agwo Yerusalemu, akaira abakungu baye ikomi ba sere‐sere, abwo atigete bakorenda enyomba, akababeka aase baranyare korendwa, akaba okobarageria, korende tachiete koba nabarabwo.
