Barabwo bakaba basiekeire aase agwo ase amatuko onsi barenge moyo, bakaba bakomenya buna ababoraka.
Omoruoti agatebia Amasa, “Rangeria Abayuda bache asende ekero amatuko atato ataraera; naye obe aiga ase engaki eyio.”
Amasa akagenda kobarangeria, korende agateba na, tairana ase engaki eria omoruoti, amobekerete.

Daudi agatebia Abisai, “Bono Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, nigo agochia gotorentera emechando kobua eria Abisalomu atorenterete. Ira abasomba baane momobwatie, erinde tabaisa kwenyorera emechie ye chindwaki na gotokora bobe mono kobua.”
Erio abanto ba Yoabu, na Abakereti, na Abapeleti, ne chituoni chionsi, bagatunyana Abisai, bakarua Yerusalemu bakabwatia Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, bachie komobwata.

Ekero baigete ase rigena rinene agwo Gibeoni, Amasa agachia kobarotota. Yoabu nigo abegete chianga chiaye chi’esegi, na nigo eboeranetie omoyio o birende ase orokini. Ekero are gocha, omoyio oria okagwa inse.
Yoabu agakwania Amasa, “Mbuya ore oyominto?” Erio akamobwata chinderu nokoboko gw’okorio buna nigo arigetie komonyunyunta.

Amasa teritete korwa ase omoyio oria Yoabu abwate koboko kwaye. Ase igo Yoabu akamobeta omoyio oria enda, na amara akagwa inse. Erio agwo Amasa agakwa, na Yoabu tamoaka eria kabere. Nyuma y’ayio Yoabu na Abisai, momura omwabo, bakabwatia Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, gochia komoita.
Oyomo bw’abasomba ba Yoabu agatenena ang’e nomobere bw’Amasa akabora, “Oyo omwanchete Yoabu na oyore o Daudi, tiga atunyane Yoabu.”

Na Amasa igo arenge kogara‐gara ase amanyinga, gati‐gati y’enchera enene. Ekero omosomba oria aroche ng’a abanto bonsi batenenire, akaimokia omobere bw’Amasa korwa inchera, akayoruta mogondo ime, akayobisia egetambaa.
Ekero arusetigwe inchera, abanto bonsi bagaeta, bagatunyana Yoabu, erinde babwatie Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, gochia komoita.
Seba agaeta egati ye chingongo chi’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, agaika omochie o Abeli Beti‐Maaka, na Ababeri bonsi bagasangererekana amo, bakamotunyana.
Abanto bonsi abarenge na Yoabu bagacha Abeli Beti‐Maaka, bakamonaaria, bakaagacha eburi bosio bw’omochie kororia orwaki, na abanto bagachaka gotagora orwaki ng’a baroiyerie inse.
Erio omokungu gete omong’aini akarangeria korwa ase orwaki rw’omochie, agateba, “Tegerera, tegerera! Tebia Yoabu ache aiga ang’e, nkwane nere.”

Yoabu agasuka gochia ang’e asare, na omokungu oria akamoboria, “Naye Yoabu?” Akairaneria, “Ee, ninche.” Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Tegerera amang’ana aane, inche omosomba oo omokungu.” Yoabu akairaneria, “Nintegererete.”
Erio omokungu oria akamotebia, “Agwo kare abanto nigo banarete goteba: Genda Abeli, omochie oyio, erinde onyore ogosemigwa; ayio naro arenge gokoora amang’ana abo.
Intwe nigo tore abanto b’omorembe na abegenwa ase Abaisraeli. Inee! Aye nigo origetie gosiria omochie oyo ore ng’ina ase egati y’Abaisraeli? Nase ki oganetie gosaria omwando bw’Omonene?”
Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Ayio tiga abe are nainche; timbaisa gosaria omochie na koyosiria.

Oyio tari oro omoroberio oito, korende omonto oyomo bw’ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, oimokire koba mamincha y’omoruoti Daudi. Mosokie, nainche indue aa ase omochie oyo!” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Rigereria, noruterwe omotwe oye ase orwaki igoro.”

Erio omokungu oria akaebereria abanto bonsi ase chisemi, na barabwo bakabutora Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, omotwe, bakayoruta gochia isiko ase Yoabu. Erio Yoabu akabugia egetureri, na abanto bonsi bagaserebekana; kera omonto akagenda bwoye. Na Yoabu akairana Yerusalemu ase omoruoti.
Yoabu nigo arenge omochiki bw’abarwani bonsi b’esegi ase Abaisraeli, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere igo arenge igoro y’Abakereti na Abapeleti.
Adorama nigo abegetwe koba omoteneneri bw’emeremo ende yonsi. Yehosafati mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nigo arenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.
Sheva nomoriki orenge, na Zadoki na Abiatari nabakuani barenge.
Amo nayio Ira Omoyairi nigo arenge omokuani ase Daudi.

Ase engaki y’obogambi bwa Daudi enchara nigo yarenge koba omwaka ase omwaka, ase engaki y’emiaka etato, na Daudi akaboria Omonene igoro y’ayio. Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ayio igo agokoreka ase engencho ya Saulo na enyomba yaye, ekiagera baiterete amanyinga ’abanto; ere naitete Abagibeoni.”

Daudi akarangeria Abagibeoni. (Barabwo tibarenge Abaisraeli; nigo barenge ekeombe giatigarete korwa ase Abaamori, na Abaisraeli konya babariereire eira ng’a babatige babe moyo, korende Saulo akarigia kobaita ase omokia oye, ase engencho y’Abaisraeli na Abayuda.)
Daudi akaboria Abagibeoni, “Ninki nkobakorera? Nindigetie gokora okobwatanigwa ase engencho y’obobe mwakoreretwe, erinde mosesenie abanto b’Omonene.”

Abagibeoni bakamoiraneria, “Titorigeti chifeta gose chitahabu korwa ase Saulo, gose korwa ase eamate yaye; intwe titorigeti goita omonto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli.” Daudi akababoria, “Ninki rende nkobakorera?”
Barabwo bakairaneria omoruoti, “Omonto oria akarigia gotosiria kegima ng’a titomenya ase Abaisraeli.
Ase ayio, tiga toegwe abamura batano na babere b’ororeria rwaye, erinde tobasunge ase obosio bw’Omonene aiga Gibea aase Saulo, omochore bw’Omonene, amenyete.” Omoruoti akabairaneria, “Nimbarue.”
Omoruoti agatiga Mefiboseti, mosinto o Yonathani o Saulo, ase engencho y’eira Daudi na Yonathani barierereranete ase Omonene,

korende akairera Arimoni na Mefiboseti, abana abamura babere abwo Risipa, omosubati o Aya aiborerete Saulo. Naende akairera abamura batano, aba Mikali, omosubati o Saulo, aiborerete Adirieli, mosinto o Barisilai Omomehola.

Akababeka ase amaboko ’Abagibeoni, na barabwo bakabasunga ase egetunwa igoro, ase obosio bw’Omonene. Bonsi batano na babere bagaiterwa amo. Bagaitwa ase amatuko amatang’ani e rigesa, ekero bachakire kogesa endagera ekorokwa esairi.

Erio Risipa, mosubati o Aya, akaira chianga chie chigunia agachiaara ase egetare keria, akabeerao korwa omochakano bwe rigesa goika embura ekorwa igoro egachaka gotwera emebere y’abwo basungetwe, gose tatigete chinyoni chigwe ase emebere eyio mobaso, gose ching’iti chi’orosana chichicheo botuko.
Ekero Daudi atebetigwe ayio Risipa, mosubati o Aya, omokungu o sere‐sere o Saulo akorete,

akagenda akoyia amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, momura o Saulo, korwa ase abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi. (Abanto abwo konya baibire emebere eyio korwa ase ekeooreri agwo Bati‐Sani aase Abafilisti babasungete, aase rituko riria baitete Saulo aaria Giliboa.)
Daudi akarenta amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, momura o Saulo; boigo agasangereria amauga ’abanto baria batano na babere konya batongirwe.

Erio bagatindeka amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, omwana oye, ase ense ya Benjamin, aaria Zela, ase embeera ya Kisi ise. Barabwo bagakora onsi aya omoruoti achigete. Nyuma y’ayio Nyasae akaigwa aya basaberete ense eria.
Esegi ekaba naende ase egati y’Abafilisti na Abaisraeli, na Daudi agatirimboka amo nabarwani baye korwania Abafilisti. Daudi akaba orosire,
na Isi‐Benobu, oyomo bw’amamonto, nabwate ritimo riare noborito bwe chikiro isato na ekeng’ese, naende nabwate omoro omoyia; ere akarigia goita Daudi.

Korende Abisai, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, akamotooria, agaita Omofilisti oria. Erio abanto ba Daudi bagakania Daudi na gotiana ng’a, “Aye bono togosoka na kogenda ase esegi amo naintwe; aye nigo ore etaya y’Abaisraeli, toyerimia.”
Nyuma y’ayio esegi yarenge n’Abafilisti aria Gobu, na Sibekai Omohusa agaita Safu, oyomo bw’amamonto.
Esegi ende yarenge n’Abafilisti agwo Gobu. Elihanani, mosinto o Yaare‐Oregimu korwa Bethlehemu, agaita Goliato korwa Gati. Orotanga rwe ritimo ria Goliato nigo rwarenge buna omwaro omonene.

Naende esegi yarenge Gati. Omonto omotambe narengeo. Nigo arenge nebiara bitano na ekemo ase kera okoboko, na bitano na ekemo ase kera okogoro; bionsi nigo biarenge emerongo ebere na bine. Ere boigo noyomo bw’amamonto orenge.
Ere akarama Abaisraeli, na Yonathani, momura o Simea omwabo Daudi, akamoita.
Abanto abwo bane nigo barenge ab’ororeria rw’amamonto korwa Gati. Barabwo nigo baitetwe na Daudi na abanto baye.
Oko nogotera Daudi atererete Omonene, ekero Omonene amotooretie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baye na aya Saulo.
Agateba: “Omonene nere egetare kiane na eburi yane enkong’u; nere Omotooria one.

Nyasae one nere egetare kiane, asare nao nyebisete, ere nenguba yane enkengerete, na orogunchara rwane rwandeterete ogotooreka, naende nere eburi yane enkong’u, na obotamero bwane. Ere n’Omotooria one, oyogontooria korwa ase obotindi.
Nindangerie Omonene, oyo ogwenerete gotogigwa, nigo arantoorie korwa ase ababisa baane.”
“Emerindo y’amakweri konya yang’etananire, chiooro chi’obobe chikandetera obwoba.
Obobe bw’amakweri nigo bwang’etananete, emeeto y’amakweri egantega na kombwata.
Ase emechando yane nkarangeria Omonene; nkarera ase Nyasae one. Korwa ase Hekalu yaye akaigwa eriogi riane, ekerero kiane gekamoikera, ere agakeigwa.”
“Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, amaroso a igoro agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene arenge nendamwamu.
Erioki rigasoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, na omorero ogosamba korwa ase omonwa oye: ee, omorero bw’amakara ogasoka korwa asare.
Akang’usa igoro gocha inse aa, nere agacha, riire rimwamu rikaba inse y’amagoro aye.
Akariina omokerubi, akairuruka; akarorekana igoro ye chimbaba chi’embeo.
Agetuba ere omonyene nomosunte, na amare amarito aichire amache.
Korwa ase obomeka‐meku obwo bwarenge bosio bwaye okomesa gokaruta ebibemberi bi’omorero.”
“Omonene agaaka enkoba korwa igoro, na eriogi ri’Oyore Igoro Mono rikaigugwa.
Akaruta emegwe, agaserebania ababisa baye, akabaaka nokomesa.
Erio ebiambokero bi’enyancha bikarorekana, na oboroso bw’ense bokaorokigwa aarabu, ekero Omonene abatogonyerete ase okwoga kw’omoika bwe chimioro chiaye.”
“Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa igoro, akambwata, akandusia ase amache amange.
Agantooria korwa ase ababisa baane bare ne chinguru, na korwa ase abwo bangechete; barabwo nigo barenge ne chinguru kombua.
Ekero narenge nemechando bakandwania, korende Omonene akaba egekengero kiane.
Akang’ira aase arenge aagare, agantooria, ekiagera namogogetie.”
“Omonene nigo ang’ete eng’eria y’obuya, ekiagera inde omoronge; nigo ansesenetie, ekiagera inde namaboko atari na komocha.
Inche nabeire nkobwatia chinchera chi’Omonene, tintigeti Nyasae one ase ogokora amabe.
Nabeire nkorenda amachiko aye onsi, na timbeti ngotiga emeroberio yaye echikire.
Nigo narenge omoikeranu asare, nkerenda korwa ase obobe.
Omonene ong’akanire, ekiagera ngokora ayare boronge, na ekiagera aroche ng’a nomochenu inde.
Aye Omonene nigo ore omwegenwa ase abwo bare abegenwa; nigo okweorokia ng’a nomoikeranu ore ase abwo bare abaikeranu.
Aye nigo ore omochenu ase abwo bare abachenu, nigo okwanga abwo bare abakorekanu.
Aye nigo ogotooria abanto bare abaitongo, korende amaiso ao nigo arigereretie abare abaenenu ase okobairania inse.”
“Aye Omonene nigo ore etaya yane; Omonene one, nigo okoonchora omosunte one oba omobaso.
Konde amo naye, nigo ndasirie omoganda bw’esegi, na ekero inde na Nyasae one nincharoke chindwaki igoro.”
“Enchera ya Nyasae neng’ikeranu; amang’ana aye ateemirwe na gotenena. Ere nenguba ase bonsi abakomotamera.
Inee! Ning’o ore Nyasae, otatiga Omonene? Ning’o ore egetare, otatiga Nyasae oito?
Nyasae nere eburi yane ye chinguru, nigo akoraa omonto omoronge ase enchera agoeta.
Ere okorire amagoro aane abeire buna ay’egesia, onkong’irie na gontenenia ase ebitunwa.
Ere bworokereirie amaboko aane korwana esegi, erinde amaboko aane anyare gokumba obota bw’etaai.”
“Aye kwang’eire enguba yao ase ogontooria, na ogokonywa kwao gwankorire nabeire omonene.
Kwang’eire aase aagare ngotaara, na amagoro aane tagotererigwa.
Nkabwatia ababisa baane, nkabasiria, gose tinairanete goika nkabakoora.
Nkabaaka inse nkabasenyenta, tibanyara koimoka, bakagwa inse y’amagoro aane, bakabugwa.
Aye nigo kwambegete chinguru chi’okorwana esegi; okabeka ababisa baane inse y’amagoro aane.
Ogaseria ababisa baane bagatama korwa asende, abangechete nkabasiria kegima.
Barabwo bakarigereria, korende onde tarenge obatooretie; bakarangeria Omonene, korende ere tabaigwa.
Nkabasunyunta bakaba ebuse ye riroba, nkabamionogora na kobatiringa buna esike ere ase chinchera.”
“Aye gwantooririe korwa ase okoamererania nabanto baane, kwandendire nabeire omogambi bw’abanto b’ebisaku; abanto ntamanyete, bono babeire abasomba baane.
Abamenyi nigo bebegete inse yane, na ekero baigure chinkuma chiane, banyigwera.
Abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao berusirie moyo, kobagosoka korwa ase chiburi chiabo, nigo bakoiguswa.”
“Omonene nigo are moyo! Ere oyore egetare kiane atogigwe! Nyasae, egetare ki’ogotooreka kwane, aimokererigwe igoro.
Nyasae nigo akonduseria egesiomba, nabeke abanto b’ebisaku inse yane.
Ere nigo antooretie korwa ase ababisa baane, akanyimokereria igoro ase abare mamincha yane, naende agantooria korwa ase abanto abatindi.”
“Aye Omonene, ase ayio ningotogie ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, ninterere erieta riao ase okoritogia.
Nyasae ong’eire inche, omoruoti oye, obobui obonene, oorokirie obwanchani botari koera asende, inche omoakwa amaguta oye, inche Daudi, na ororeria rwane, goika kare na kare.”
Aya naro amang’ana ’omoerio a Daudi, mosinto o Yese, omonto oyo oimokereretigwe igoro, omoakwa amaguta o Nyasae o Yakobo, omoteri bw’amatera agwansa ase Abaisraeli:
“Omoika bw’Omonene ogokwana goetera asende, ring’ana riaye nigo rire ase omonwa one.
Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli okwanire, ere oyore egetare ki’Abaisraeli ontebirie: Oyo okogambera abanto ase oboronge, oyo okogambera ase okoiroka Nyasae,
nigo anga buna omobaso o mambia asebare, buna erioba rikobara emambia etari namare. Nigo anga buna obonyansi bogokina nyuma embura koyature.”
“Inee! Ororeria rwane tirori boronge ase Nyasae? Takorete nainche okobwatana gwa kare na kare, okwo korobeirie gotari koonchoka? Inee! Nyasae tagonsesenia na gontooria, naende ang’e aya nganetie?
Korende abanto ababe nigo bare buna amagwa atugutire, atari gokunwa namaboko.
Omonto takoyakuna otatiga abe obwate ebioma na orotanga rwe ritimo, barabwo nabasambwe nomorero aroro agwo.”

Aya naro amarieta ’abarwani chituoni Daudi abwate: Yosebe‐Basebeti korwa Takemoni. Ere nigo arenge omonene bw’Abwo Batato, chituoni chi’abarwani. Ere agaita abanto amagana atano na atato ase engaki eyemo, ase okona‐kong’wana‐ng’wania ne ritimo riaye.

Na oyo o kabere bw’Abwo Batato n’Eleazari, mosinto o Dodai bw’eamate y’Ahohi. Ere nigo arenge na Daudi ekero baramete Abafilisti aase basangererekanete amo barwane esegi, na Abaisraeli bakairana nyuma.

Korende ere agatenena, agaita Abafilisti goika okoboko kwaye gokarosa gokananterera ase omoro. Omonene akabanyorera obobui obonene mono ase rituko riria. Erio abanto bakairana bagatunyana Eleazari, bagasakora ebisakorwa.

Na oyo o gatato ase abwo nere Sama, mosinto bw’Agee korwa Harari. Abafilisti konya basangererekanire agwo, Lehi, ase omogondo orenge oichire ne ching’ende chi’egatani. Abaisraeli bagatama korwa ase Abafilisti,
korende Sama agatenena ase omogondo gati, akayorwanerera, agaita Abafilisti, na Omonene akarenta obobui obonene mono.
Rituko erimo, ekero kie rigesa, abanto batato ase abwo abanene emerongo etato bakagenda ase Daudi maate ase rikuruma ri’Adulamu, na Abafilisti konya batoorire ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.
Ase engaki eyio Daudi nigo arenge ase eburi ime, na abarwani b’Abafilisti nigo barenge agwo Bethlehemu.
Daudi akaba okogania amache anywe, akabora, “Ntare konyora omonto andetere amache inywe korwa ase ensoko eyio ere ase egeita kia Bethlehemu!”

Erio abanto baria batato bakabinya‐binyia egati y’Abafilisti aase batoorete, bakabuucha amache korwa ase ensoko eria yarenge ase egeita kia Bethlehemu, bakayairera Daudi. Korende Daudi tayanywa, otatiga ayaiterete koba ekeng’wanso gi’ekenyugwa ase Omonene,
akabora, “Omonene antange tinkora bo. Inee! Inywe amanyinga ’abanto bataegerete obogima bwabo?” Ase ayio akaanga, tayanywa. Ayio naro abanto Abwo Batato chituoni bakorete.
Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu bw’omokungu Seruya ere nigo amanyekanete ase Baria Batato; akarwania abanto amagana atato, akababeta ne ritimo riaye, akabaita, akaba nerieta rinene ase Baria Batato.
Ase Baria Batato ere nigo abwate ogosikwa okuya goetania abande, akaba omoraai obo, korende tareng’anetie na Baria Batato be ritang’ani.

Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nigo arenge omonto etuoni korwa Kabuseli. Ere agakora emeremo emenene, agaita abanto babere chituoni b’Abamoabu. Engaki ende, ekero ki’obokendu, na amagena ’embura yatwete, agasoa engoro agaita endo aroro.
Boigo agaita Omomisiri orenge omonene obwate ritimo. Akamochiera nenyimbo, akamoura ritimo riare koboko kwaye, akamoitera neritimo riria riaye omonyene.
Amang’ana aya naro Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akorete; nere akaba nerieta rinene buna abanto Baria Batato chituoni.
Akanyora ogosikwa okuya ase egati ya baria emerongo etato, korende tareng’anetie na Baria Batato be ritang’ani. Daudi akamobeka akaba omorendi bw’obogima bwaye.
Abande ba baria emerongo etato nabwo aba: Asaeli, momura omwabo Yoabu, na Elihanani, mosinto o Dodo korwa Bethlehemu;
Sama na Elika korwa Harodi;
Helesi korwa Peleti, na Ira, mosinto o Ikesi, korwa Tekoa;
Abieseri korwa Anatoti, na Mebunai korwa Husa;
Salimoni korwa Ahohi, na Maharai korwa Netofa;
Helebu, mosinto o Baana, korwa Netofa, na Itai, mosinto o Ribai, korwa Gibea, bw’egesaku kia Benjamin.
Benaya korwa Piratoni, na Hidai korwa ase amagoko ang’e na Gaasi;
Abi‐Aliboni korwa Araba na Asimaweti korwa Bahurimu;
Eliaba korwa Saalaboni, na basinto ba Yaseni, na Yonathani;
Sama korwa Harari na Ahiamu, mosinto o Sharari, korwa Harari;
Elifeleti, mosinto bw’Ahasibai, omonto korwa Maaka; Eliamu, mosinto bw’Ahitofeli, korwa Gilo;
Hesiro korwa Karimeli na Paarai korwa Ariba;
Igali, mosinto o Nathani, korwa Soba na Bani korwa Gadi;
Seleki korwa Amoni na Naharai korwa Beroti, omobogoria ebirwanero bia Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya;
Ira na Garebu korwa Itiri;
na Uria Omohiti. Bonsi nigo barenge emerongo etato, na batano na babere.
Naende Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene igoro y’Abaisraeli, agasukia enkoro ya Daudi akamotebia, “Genda obare Abaisraeli na Abayuda.”

Ase igo omoruoti agatebia Yoabu, omotang’ani bw’emeganda yaye y’abarwani, “Bono etanana ase egati y’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba, mobare abanto, erinde imanye omobaro obo.”

Korende Yoabu akairaneria omoruoti, “Omonene, Nyasae oo, amente abanto ara amagana atakobareka, na aye omonene one omoruoti obe moyo goika oyarore. Korende naki ring’ana eri riakogwenera aye omonene one omoruoti?”
Korende ring’ana ri’omoruoti rikaba ne chinguru igoro ya Yoabu na abatang’ani b’abarwani. Ase igo Yoabu na abatang’ani bande bakarua ase omoruoti, bakagenda kobara Abaisraeli.
Barabwo bakaamboka Yorodan, bagatoora Aroeri, na korwa ase omochie oyio agwo ase egati ye rikura bakagenda Gadi, naende gochia Yeseri,
Erio bakagenda Gileadi na ase ense ya Tatimu‐Hodisi. Naende bakagenda Dani, na korwa Dani bagaetanana bagaika Sidoni.
Bakagenda Turo, omochie ore ne chindwaki, na ase emechie yonsi y’Abahivi, na ey’Abakanani. Nyuma y’ayio bakagenda Beeri‐Seba ase ense y’Abayuda, ensemo ya sugusu.
Nyuma y’emetienyi kianda na amatuko emerongo ebere, ekero baetananire ense yonsi, bakairana Yerusalemu.

Yoabu akaa omoruoti omobaro bw’abanto abaare konyara korwana esegi nemioro. Ase Abaisraeli nigo barenge abanto chilifu amagana atano na atato (800,000), na ase Abayuda chilifu amagana atano (500,000).

Ekero Daudi akoorire kobara abanto, enkoro yaye ekamogambia. Erio agatebia Omonene, “Nakorire ebibe ebinene ase aya nakorire; korende bono Omonene, nagosabire onyabere inche omosomba oo, naki nigo nakorire egento ki’oboriri mono.”
Ekero Daudi abogete mambia, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigachera Gadi, omobani, oyorenge omorori o Daudi, rikamotebia,
“Genda okwane na Daudi, omotebie ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Nabekire asore amang’ana atato; ase ayio chora erimo, eri ndagokorere.”

Erio Gadi akagenda ase Daudi, akamomanyia amang’ana ayio, akamotebia, “Nigo origetie enchara eche ase ense yao emiaka etato? Gose nigo origetie otame korwa ase ababisa bao emetienyi etato? Gose nigo origetie oborwaire obobe bw’ogoita abanto bosoe ense yao amatuko atato? Bono rengereria mono na ong’e amairanerio imoirere oyio ontomete.”
Daudi akairaneria Gadi, “Inche nasoire ase emechando emenene. Gaki, bono, tiga togwe ase okoboko kw’Omonene, ekiagera amabera aye namanene; korende ase amaboko a mwanyabanto tintageti ingweo.”
Erio Omonene akarentera Abaisraeli oborwaire obobe, na borobwo bogaita abanto korwa mambia goika engaki yaragetwe; abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) bagakwa korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba.

Ekero omomalaika aramborete okoboko kwaye asirie Yerusalemu, Omonene akaonchora ebirengererio biaye ase amabe ayio, agatebia omomalaika oria orenge gosiria abanto, “Bono aisanire, ororobia okoboko kwao.” Omomalaika konya oikire ang’e nekeooreri ki’Arauna Omoyebusi.

Ekero Daudi aroche omomalaika oria orenge goita abanto, agatebia Omonene, “Rora, ninche inde omonyabibe, ninche nakorire obobe obo, korende ching’ondi echi chiane, inki chiakorete? Okoboko kwao tiga kobe igoro yane, na igoro y’enyomba ya tata.”
Ase rituko erio Gadi akagenda ase Daudi, akamotebia, “Imoka oagachere Omonene egesasimero agwo ase ekeooreri ki’Arauna Omoyebusi.”
Ase igo Daudi akaigwera amang’ana aya Omonene achigete goetera ase Gadi.
Arauna agachia korigereria akarora omoruoti na abasomba baye bagotiira gocha asare. Erio agasoka, agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase obosio bw’omoruoti.

Arauna akamoboria, “Omonene one, naki gwachire aa asende inche omosomba oo?” Daudi akamoiraneria, “Nigo nachire ngore ekeooreri kiao, ing’agachere Omonene egesasimero aiga, erinde amaakwa atangwe korwa ase abanto.”

Erio Arauna akairaneria Daudi, “Omonene one omoruoti, ira eki oraganie ase ekeng’wanso. Rora chiombe echi ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na ebikorero ebi bi’okoora amo namakorogoto bibe chinko okogesambera.”
Arauna akaa omoruoti ebinto ebio bionsi, akamotebia, “Tiga Omonene Nyasae oo agwanchere.”

Korende omoruoti akairaneria Arauna, “Yaya taibo, korende nigo nkobigora korwa asore ase rigori bikoonigwa: tinkoruera Omonene Nyasae ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa nebinto ntagoreti ase rigori.” Igo Daudi akagora ekeooreri ekio amo ne chiombe ase chibesa, chisekeli chie chifeta emerongo etano.
Na Daudi akaagachera Omonene egesasimero, akarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na eki’omorembe. Ase ayio Omonene akaigwa ogosaba gw’ense eria, na amarwaire agatangwa korwa ase Abaisraeli.
Bono omoruoti Daudi konya ogotire mono, okoorire emiaka emenge; nonya ore kobisigwa amarangeti amange, tarenge koigwa riberera.
Ase igo abasomba baye bakamotebia, “Tiga aye omonene oito omoruoti origerigwe omoiseke omwekungi; ere abe ogokorenda na kogokorera. Boigo abe ogokorarisia, akobekere riberera.”
Ase ayio bakarigia ase ense yonsi y’Abaisraeli, banyore omoiseke omwekungi omonyakieni. Bakanyora Abisagi Omosunemu, bakamorenta ase omoruoti.
Omoiseke oria nigo arenge omonyakieni mono: ere akaba omokoreri bw’omoruoti, korende omoruoti tamenyanete nere.

Adonia, omwana omomura bwa Hagiti, moga Daudi, akeimokereria igoro omonyene, ogoteba, “Ninche ndabe omoruoti.” Akenyorera chigari na abanto abariini chibarasi, na abanto emerongo etano barabe bagotang’ana bosio bwaye.
Ise konya tana komotogonyera nonya ng’ake ase okomoboria, “Nase ki gwakora aya na aya?” Boigo Adonia nigo arenge omonto omonyakieni; ere nigo aiboretwe nyuma Abisalomu kaiboirwe.
Adonia agakwana na Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, na Abiatari omokuani; barabwo bagancherana komokonya.
Korende Zadoki omokuani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Nathani omobani, na Simei, na Rei, na abarwani chituoni ba Daudi, barabwo tibabwatanete n’Adonia.

Adonia akanyenya ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chimori chinoru, chikaba ekeng’wanso agwo ang’e n’Egetare gie Ching’iti kere ase ensoko y’Eni‐Rogeli, akarangeria abamura bamwabo bonsi, abwo abamura b’omoruoti, na abanto bonsi abanene b’obogambi bwa Yuda.
Korende tarangeretie Nathani omobani, gose Benaya, gose abanto baria barenge abarwani chituoni, gose Sulemani, momura omwabo.
Nathani akagenda ase Batiseba, akamotebia, “Inee! Aye toraigwa ng’a Adonia, omwana o Hagiti, obeire omoruoti, na Daudi, omonene oito, taramanya amang’ana ayio?
Ase ayio, bono tiga ngosemie, erinde otoorie obogima bwao obonyene, na obw’omwana oo Sulemani.

Bono genda, osoe ara rimo ase omoruoti Daudi, omoborie: Inee! Aye omonene one omoruoti, tikwandierete inche, omosomba oo, eira y’ogotiana, ogateba: Sulemani, omwana oo omomura, nere oragambe nyuma yane; ere naikaranse ase ekerogo kiane ki’oboruoti? Nase ki rende Adonia abeire omoruoti?
Bono nebe ekero aye ogendererete gokwana nomoruoti, nainche boigo ninsoe mbeke amang’ana ao chinguru ase okoenekia ng’a nekeene.”
Batiseba akagenda ase omoruoti, agasoa akanyomba k’omoruoti. (Bono omoruoti konya obeire omogotu mono, na Abisagi, Omosunemu, nere orenge omokoreri oye.)
Batiseba agatung’ama inse ase okoorokia amasikani ase omoruoti, na omoruoti akamoboria, “Ninki oganetie?”

Batiseba akamotebia, “Omonene one, nkwandierete inche, omosomba oo, eira y’ogotiana ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, ogateba: Sulemani, omwana oo omomura, nere oragambe nyuma yane, nere oraikaranse ase ekerogo kiane ki’oboruoti.
Na bono rora, Adonia bweeire oboruoti, na aye omonene one omoruoti, tomanyeti amang’ana ayio.

Okorire ekeng’wanso, onyenyire chiombe, ne chimori chinoru; ne ching’ondi, ase obonge; naende orangeirie abana abamura bonsi b’omoruoti, na Abiatari omokuani, na Yoabu, omochiki bw’abarwani b’esegi, korende tarangereti Sulemani, omosomba oo.
Na bono, omonene one omoruoti, amaiso ’abanto bonsi b’Abaisraeli naye arigereretie, obatebie ng’a ning’o oraikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki’oboruoti, aye omoruoti one, nyuma gokwarureo.
Onye taibo, nebe ekero aye, omonene one omoruoti, gwakure na korarare ase chisokoro chiao chiararete, inche na omwana one Sulemani toche kobarwa koba abamochi abanene.”
Ekero omokungu oria agendererete gokwana nomoruoti, Nathani omobani agacha aroro agwo.
Omoruoti agatebigwa, “Nathani omobani, oyo aiga.” Na ekero achete ase obosio bw’omoruoti, agatung’ama inse akaumama.
Nathani agakwana, akamoboria, “Omonene one omoruoti, Inee, nabo gwatebete ng’a, Adonia nere oragambe nyuma yao, aikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki’oboruoti?

Rero ere otirimbokire, onyenyire chiombe, ne chimori chinoru, ne ching’ondi, ase obonge, naende orangeirie abana abamura bonsi b’omoruoti, na abachiki b’abarwani esegi, na Abiatari omokuani; na rora, igo bakoria na konywa ase obosio bwaye bagoteba: Adonia omoruoti ochie kare!
Korende inche, omosomba oo, na Zadoki omokuani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Sulemani, omosomba oo, intwe tatorangereti.
Inee! Ring’ana eri igo riakorirwe, naye omonene one omoruoti toratotebia intwe abasomba bao ng’a ning’o oraikaranse ase ekerogo kiao abe omoruoti nyuma yao?”
Omoruoti Daudi akairaneria, “Rangeria Batiseba achiche asende.” Ase ayio Batiseba agacha ase obosio bw’omoruoti, agatenenao.
Na omoruoti akaria eira y’ogotiana, agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oria otooretie obogima bwane korwa ase emechando yonsi,
buna nakorierete eira y’ogotiana ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ngateba: Sulemani omwana oo, nere oragambe nyuma yane, na rero boigo ngokoriera inde eira eyio eyio.”
Erio Batiseba agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase okoorokia amasikani ase omoruoti, agakwana, “Tiga aye omonene one, omoruoti Daudi, ochie kare!”
Omoruoti agateba, “Indangererie Zadoki omokuani, na Nathani omobani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada.” Erio abanto abwo bagacha ase obosio bw’omoruoti.
Ere akabatebia, “Imoka mogende nabasomba baane, moriinie Sulemani, omwana one, ase eyombo yane, erio momotirimbokie gochia Gihoni.
Aroro agwo Zadoki omokuani na Nathani omobani bamoake amaguta ase okomwatanana abe omoruoti okogambera Abaisraeli. Erio mobugie ebitureri bi’omochengo, motebe: Sulemani omoruoti ochie kare!
Nyuma y’ayio momokoobe gocha aiga nka asende, nere aikaranse ase ekerogo kiane ki’oboruoti, ekiagera nere orabe omoruoti ase ribaga riane; nere nachorire agambere Abaisraeli na Abayuda.”
Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akairaneria omoruoti, “Amina. Tiga Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one omoruoti, anchere ayio.
Buna koreng’ana Omonene abeire amo naye, omonene one, naboigo abe amo na Sulemani, erio akore ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti kebe ekenene goetania ekerogo kiao aye omoruoti Daudi, omonene one.”
Ase ayio, Zadoki omokuani, na Nathani omobani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Abakereti, na Abapeleti bagatirimboka, bakariinia Sulemani ase eyombo y’omoruoti, erio bakamoira Gihoni.

Aroro agwo Zadoki omokuani akabogoria orogunchara rw’amaguta korwa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, agaaka Sulemani amaguta ayio ase okomwatanana. Erio bakabugia egetureri, na abanto bonsi bagateba, “Omoruoti Sulemani ochie kare!”
Abanto bonsi bagatiira bakamotunyana, bakobugia ebiroria, bakaba nomochengo omonene mono, goika riroba rigatitira ase amariogi abo.

Adonia na abageni bonsi baria barenge amo nere, ekero bakoorire omoyega obo, bakaigwa amariogi aria. Na ekero Yoabu ayaigwete amo nebiroria, akaboria, “Ninki engencho y’amariogi aya amanene are ase omochie?”
Ekero agendererete gokwana, rora, Yonathani, mosinto bw’Abiatari omokuani, agacha agwo. Adonia akamotebia, “Inchuo aiga ime, ekiagera aye nomonto bw’amasikani ore, okorenta amang’ana amaya.”
Yonathani akairaneria Adonia, “Taibo, amang’ana tari amaya, ekiagera omonene oito, omoruoti Daudi, obekire Sulemani obeire omoruoti.
Omoruoti otomire amo nere Zadoki omokuani, na Nathani omobani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Abakereti, na Abapeleti, nabarabwo bariinirie Sulemani ase eyombo y’omoruoti.

Zadoki omokuani na Nathani omobani bamoakire amaguta agwo Gihoni, nere obeire omoruoti. Barabwo batiirire korwa agwo, bagochenga, goika omochie bwonsi obeire namariogi amanene ay’omochengo; nayio naro kwaigure.
Sulemani nere oikaransire ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti.

Nonya naboigo, abasomba b’omoruoti nigo bacha kogokera omonene oito, omoruoti Daudi, bagoteba: Nyasae oo akore erieta ria Sulemani rimanyekane mono kobua eriao, naende akore ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia Sulemani kebue ekiao. Ere omoruoti nigo asasimete kare borere bwaye,
agateba: Atogigwe Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyo oeire oyomo ase oroiboro rwane ribaga goikaransa ase ekerogo kiane ki’oboruoti rituko ria rero, nainche neroreire ayio namaiso aane.”
Erio abageni bonsi b’Adonia bakaiguswa ase omoondoko, bakaimoka, na kera omonto akagenda enchera yaye.
Adonia akoboa Sulemani mono, akaimoka, akagenda kobwata emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero.

Sulemani agatebigwa ng’a Adonia omoirokire na obwatire emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero, ogoteba: “Ritang’ani tiga omoruoti Sulemani andiere eira y’ogotiana ng’a takong’ita inche, omosomba oye, nomoro.”
Sulemani agateba, “Karanyorekane ore omonto bw’ekeene, nonya nagatukia akamo k’omotwe oye tigakogwa inse; korende obobe koboranyorekane asare, goika akwe.”

Erio omoruoti Sulemani agatoma abanto nabarabwo bakamorusia agwo ase egesasimero, bakamorenta. Ere agacha agatung’ama, akaumama ase okoorokia amasikani ase omoruoti Sulemani, na Sulemani akamotebia, “Genda nka bwoo.”
Ekero engaki y’ogokwa gwa Daudi yaigete ang’e, agachika Sulemani, omwana oye, akamotebia,
“Inche nabeire ang’e kogenda enchera eria abanto bonsi b’ense bakogenda. Obe omokong’u, bweorokie obe omonto oteneine boronge.

Obwate onsi aya Omonene, Nyasae oo, agochikire, otaare ase chinchera chiaye, na orende amachiko aye, na emeroberio yaye yonsi, orende noborori bwaye, buna arikire ase amachiko a Musa, erio nario orasesenigwe ase kende gionsi ogokora, na aande onsi ase okogenda.

Erio Omonene naikeranie ring’ana riaye, riria akwanete asende, agateba: Abana bao kobararende chinchera chiabo, na bataare ase obosio bwane ase obwegenwa ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi, na ase emioyo yabo yonsi, rirorio omonto takobora korwa ase ororeria rwao oyoraikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli.

“Aye nomanyete eki Yoabu, omwana bw’omokungu Seruya, akorete asende, ase ogoita abachiki baria babere b’abarwani esegi b’Abaisraeli: Abineri, mosinto o Neri, na Amasa, mosinto o Yeteri. Noinyorete buna aiterete amanyinga ase engaki y’omorembe buna nigo yarenge engaki y’esegi. Akabeka amanyinga atari na komocha ase orokini rwaye na ase ebikoroto bi’amagoro aye.
Aye okore onsi koreng’ana nobong’aini bwao, korende tobaisa komotiga agende ne chimbuche chiaye aase abakure ore nomorembe.

“Korende okorere abana ba Barisilai, Omogileadi, amaya, babe ase egati ya baria bakoragera amo naye, ekiagera ase obosani obo obuya, barabwo nabo bankorerete, ekero narenge gotoma korwa ase Abisalomu, momura omino.

“Naende boigo nare aroro Simei, mosinto o Gera, omonto bw’egesaku kia Benjamin, korwa Bahurimu. Ere nandagereretie okoragereria okobe ase rituko riria nagendete Mahanaimu; korende ekero achete Yorodani koumerana nainche, nigo namorierete eira y’ogotiana ase Omonene, ngateba: Tinkogoita nomoro.

Ase ayio bono, tobaisa komobara ng’a tari na komocha, ekiagera aye nomonto omong’aini; nomanye aye omonyene eki ogwenerete gokora asare, motige agende aase abakure ore ne chimbuche, ase engencho y’okomocha kwaye kw’ogoitera amanyinga.”
Daudi akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, erio agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi.
Engaki Daudi agamberete Abaisraeli nigo yarenge emiaka emerongo ene; akagamba emiaka etano na ebere agwo Heburoni, na agwo Yerusalemu emiaka emerongo etato, na etato.
Ase ayio, Sulemani agaikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia Daudi ise, na oboruoti bwaye bokaba ne chinguru chinene mono.
Adonia, omomura o Hagiti, akagenda ase Batiseba, ng’ina Sulemani. Omokungu oria akamoboria, “Igo gwachire nomorembe?” Adonia akairaneria, “Ee, nachire nomorembe.”
Naende akamotebia, “Nimbwate egento ngokwana naye.” Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Kwana.”

Adonia akamotebia, “Nomanyete ng’a oboruoti nobwane bwarenge, na Abaisraeli bonsi igo baganetie mbagambere, korende nonya naboigo, oboruoti bokaonchoka bokaba obwa momura ominto, ekiagera igo bwaba obwaye ase ogwancha kw’Omonene.
Na bono nimbwate okoboria okomo ngokoboria, tonkania.” Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Boria.”
Adonia agakwana, “Nagosabire, genda oborie omoruoti Sulemani ang’e Abisagi, Omosunemu oria, abe mokaane. Nimanyete ng’a takogokania.”
Batiseba akamoiraneria, “Ayio mbuya; ninkwane nomoruoti ase engencho yao.”

Ase ayio Batiseba akagenda ase omoruoti Sulemani akwane nere ase engencho y’Adonia. Omoruoti agatenena korotota ng’ina, agatung’ama, akamworokia amasikani; erio agaikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti, agachika ng’ina arenterwe ekerogo, na ng’ina agaikaransa ase ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’omoruoti.
Erio ng’ina akamotebia, “Nimbwate okoboria goke igo nkorenta asore, tobaisa kwanga.” Omoruoti akamotebia, “Boria okoboria kwao, baba; tinkwanga aya okoboria.”
Ng’ina agateba, “Tiga Abisagi, Omosunemu oria, aegwe Adonia, momura omino, abe mokaye.”

Omoruoti Sulemani akairaneria ng’ina, “Nase ki okoboria ng’a Abisagi, Omosunemu oria, aegwe Adonia abe mokaye? Moborerie aegwe noboruoti boigo, ekiagera ere momura ominto omonene; na Abiatari omokuani, na Yoabu, omwana bw’omokungu Seruya, babwatanire nere.”
Erio omoruoti Sulemani agatiana ase Omonene, agateba, “Nyasae ang’e egesusuro ekenene onye ring’ana eri riaye aboririe tirigochia kogera asirie obogima bwaye.
Bono, ekeene buna Omonene are moyo, oria ombekire ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia Daudi tata, na gonkong’ia, naende ong’eire oroiboro buna ariete eira, Adonia goika aitwe ase rituko ria rero.”
Omoruoti Sulemani agatoma Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, aite Adonia. Benaya akamoita agakwa.

Omoruoti agatebia Abiatari omokuani, “Genda Anatoti ase oboremu bwao: aye igo ogwenerete okwe, korende inche tinkogoita ase engaki eye, ekiagera aye nkwabogoretie Esanduku y’Omonene Nyasae bosio bwa Daudi tata, naende ngwachandegete amo na tata ase emechando yaye yonsi.”
Ase ayio Sulemani agaseria Abiatari taba omokuani ase Omonene. Igo ring’ana riria Omonene konya akwanire agwo Silo igoro ase enyomba ya Eli rigaikeranigwa.

Ekero Yoabu aigwete amang’ana ayio, agatama gochia ase Eema y’Omonene, akabwaterera emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero. Ere igo abwatanete n’Adonia ase okomokonya, korende tabwatanete n’Abisalomu.
Omoruoti Sulemani agatebigwa, “Yoabu otamire gochia ase Eema y’Omonene, na rora, nao are ase egesasimero.” Erio agatoma Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akamotebia, “Genda oake Yoabu, omoite.”

Benaya akagenda ase Eema y’Omonene, agatebia Yoabu, “Omoruoti ogochikire osoke isiko.” Korende Yoabu agakana, “Yaya, aa nao ngokwera.” Benaya akagenda ase omoruoti, akamotebia amang’ana Yoabu atebete.

Omoruoti akamotebia, “Kora buna atebire, gachie omoake, omoite na komotindeka. Ase enchera eye onduserie inche na enyomba ya tata egesiomba ase engencho y’amanyinga atari na komocha aria Yoabu aiterete.

Omonene naite Yoabu ase okomocha kwaye kw’ogoitera amanyinga, ogokora okwo Daudi tata atamanyete. Yoabu nigo aitete nomoro Abineri mosinto o Neri, omochiki bw’abarwani esegi b’Abaisraeli, na Amasa mosinto o Yeteri, omochiki bw’abarwani esegi b’Abayuda. Abanto abwo babere nigo barenge abaronge, naende abaya komobua.

Ase ayio, egesusuro gi’okomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga nkebe igoro ase Yoabu, naende kebe igoro ase ororeria rwaye goika kare na kare. Korende ase Daudi, na ororeria rwaye, na enyomba yaye, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, omorembe okorwa ase Omonene nobeo kare na kare.”
Erio Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akagenda, agaaka Yoabu, akamoita. Nere Yoabu agatindekwa ase enka yaye agwo ase erooro.
Omoruoti akabeka Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akaba omochiki bw’abarwani esegi ribaga ria Yoabu, na Zadoki omokuani akabekwa ribaga ri’Abiatari.
Naende Omoruoti akarangeria Simei, akamotebia, “Eagachere enyomba ime ya Yerusalemu omenyeo, tobaisa korua aroro ogende aande onsi nonya ng’ake.
Ekiagera ekero kende gionsi orasoke korwa aroro, bwamboke akarooche ga Kidironi, omanye ng’a gioka okwe; okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ao nigo korabe okwao.”
Simei agatebia omoruoti, “Egento gwatebire nekiya; buna aye omonene one omoruoti gwatebire, naboigo inche, omosomba oo, ndakore.” Ase ayio, Simei akamenya ase Yerusalemu amatuko amange.
Korende ekaba ase omoerio bw’omwaka o gatato abasomba babere ba Simei bagatama, bakagenda ase Akisi, mosinto o Maaka, omoruoti o Gati. Simei agatebigwa ng’a abasomba baye nao bakare agwo Gati.
Ase igo akaimoka akabekera etigere yaye egeikaransero, akariina igoro asere, akagenda Gati ase Akisi korigia abasomba baye; akabanyora, akabairania inka.
Ekero Sulemani atebetigwe ng’a Simei narua Yerusalemu, akagenda Gati, naende akairana,

akamorangeria, akamotebia, “Inche nigo nagotebetie ng’a orie eira y’ogotiana ase Omonene ng’a tobaisa korua Yerusalemu. Naende nkagokurera mono ngateba: Rituko orasoke korwa aroro agwo, na ogende aande onsi, goika okwe. Inee! Tigwanchete ng’a nonyigwere na okore bo?
Naki otarenda eira yao y’ogotiana ase Omonene amo naya nagochigete?”
Boigo omoruoti agatebia Simei, “Nomanyete aye omonyene ase enkoro yao ime obobe bwonsi boria gwakorete ase Daudi tata. Omonene nakoiranerie obobe bwao.
Korende inche omoruoti Sulemani ninsesenigwe, na ekerogo ki’obonene gia Daudi nagekorwe kebe ne chinguru kegenderere botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.”
Omoruoti agachika Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na ere akagenda agaaka Simei, akamoita. Ase ayio oboruoti bokabekwa chinguru ase okoboko gwa Sulemani.

Sulemani agakora oboamate na Farao, omoruoti o Misiri. Akanyuoma omoiseke o Farao, akamorenta ase Omochie o Daudi akamenya aroro goika ekero akoorete koagacha enyomba yaye omonyene amo nenyomba y’Omonene ne chindwaki chiaetanaine Yerusalemu.
Abanto nigo barenge koruera ebing’wanso ase ebisasimero biarenge aase aimokererete igoro, ekiagera nyomba ende yonsi konya teraagachwa ase baranyare gosasima erieta ri’Omonene.
Sulemani nigo anchete Omonene, akabwatia emeroberio Daudi achigete, korende nigo aruete ebing’wanso na gosamba ubani agwo aase aimokererete igoro.
Omoruoti akagenda Gibeoni gochia korua ekeng’wanso aroro, ekiagera nao arenge aase aimokererete igoro mono; akarua aroro ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa elifu eyemo.
Agwo Gibeoni Omonene akaorokera Sulemani ase chindoto botuko, Nyasae akamotebia, “Boria egento oganetie nkoe.”

Sulemani agateba, “Aye kworokirie obwanchani obonene botari koera ase omosomba oo Daudi tata, ekiagera igo ataarete ase obosio bwao ase obwegenwa, na oboronge, na ekeene gi’enkoro yaye. Naye kwagendereire komworokia obwanchani obonene botari koera, kwamoeire omwana omomura aikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti, buna ere rero iga.
Na bono, Omonene, Nyasae one, aye gwankorire inche, omosomba oo, nabeire omoruoti ribaga ria Daudi tata, nonya inde omwana omoke. Timanyeti buna nkogamba na koraa.
Inche omosomba oo nigo inde ase egati y’abanto bao, aba gwachorire, abanto abange batanyare kobareka ase engencho y’obonge bwabo.
Ase ayio, ing’a inche, omosomba oo, okomanya kw’obong’aini gw’okogambera abanto bao, erio nario ndamanye gwatanana amaya na amabe. Naki ning’o oranyare kogambera abanto aba bao abange?”
Omonene akagokigwa namang’ana ayio Sulemani aboretie.

Nyasae akamotebia, “Ekiagera kwaboririe ring’ana eri, na tibweborereti aye omonyene oegwe obogima obotambe, gose obonda obonge, gose ogosirigwa kw’obogima bw’ababisa bao, korende kwaboririe ng’a oegwe okomanya kw’obong’aini ase okomanyereria ayare amaronge,
rora, ninkore koreng’ana buna kwamboria. Ninkoe enkoro y’okomanya okonene kw’obong’aini, okwo monto onde atana koba nakwo, gose oyorache nyuma yao takoba nakwo.
Naende ninkoe boigo ebinto binde otaboria; ninkoe obotenenku obonge na obonene bw’ogosikwa, na omoruoti onde tari orareng’anigwe naye ase amatuko ao onsi.
Na korarende chinchera chiane, na emeroberio yane echikire, na amachiko aane amachenu, buna Daudi iso akorete, erio ningokore obe moyo amatuko amange.”

Sulemani akaboka, akamanya ng’a omaanoreirwe ayio goetera ase chindoto. Erio akagenda Yerusalemu, agatenena bosio bw’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’Omonene, akaruera Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na eki’omorembe. Nyuma y’ayio agakorera abasomba baye bonsi omoyega.
Erio abakungu abatayayi babere bagacha ase obosio bw’omoruoti, bagatenena aroro.
Omokungu oyomo agakwana, agateba, “Aye omonene one, inche amo nomokungu oyo nigo tomenyete ase enyomba eyemo; nkaibora omwana ekero ere arenge ase enyomba eria.
Erio rituko ria gatato nyuma inche konaiboire, omokungu oyo nere akaibora; nintwe tweka babere twarengeo, monto onde omoao tarenge ase enyomba eria.
Na omwana bw’omokungu oyo agakwa botuko, ekiagera igo amorarerete.

Erio akaboka botuko gati, akabogoria omwana one omoisia korwa ase rikere riane ensemo, ekero inche, omosomba oo, naraire chitoro, erio akaareria omwana one ase rikere riaye, na akarenta omwana oria oye okwete, akamwareria ase rikere riane.
Ekero nabogete mambia ngonkie omwana one, nkanyora ng’a okure, korende ekero narigereretie omwana oria buya ase emambia eyio, nkarora ng’a oyo tari omwana oria naiborete.”

Korende omokungu oria o kabere agakana, “Yaya taibo, omwana oyo ore moyo, nere oyone, na omwana oria okwete nere oyoo.” Omokungu oria omotang’ani akabora, “Yaya, omwana oria okwete, nere oyoo, na omwana oyo ore moyo, nere oyone.” Naboigo bakwanete, bakoamererania ase obosio bw’omoruoti.
Erio omoruoti agateba, “Oyomo nigo agoteba: Omwana oyo ore moyo, nere oyone, na omwana oria okwete, nere oyoo; na oyonde igo agokana: Yaya, omwana oo, nere okwete, na omwana one, nere ore moyo.”
Ase igo akaboria aegwe omoro. Na ekero arenteirwe omoro,
agateba, “Butorane omwana oyo ore moyo ebing’ese bibere, ekeng’ese ekemo keegwe omokungu oyomo, na ekende keegwe oyonde.”

Erio omokungu oria omwana oye arenge moyo, ekiagera anchete omwana oye mono, agatebia omoruoti, “Aye omoruoti, tobaisa goita omwana, kae omokungu oyo omwana oyo ore moyo.” Korende oria onde agateba, “Omwana takoba oyone, gose oyoo; tiga anachanwe.”
Omoruoti akairaneria, agateba, “Omwana oyo ore moyo, kae omokungu oyo bwe ritang’ani, timobaisa konachana omwana oyo; omokungu oyo nere ng’ina.”
Abaisraeli bonsi bakaigwa chinkuma chi’ekina ekio omoruoti agambete; erio bakairoka omoruoti, ekiagera nigo baroche ng’a obong’aini bwa Nyasae nigo bwarenge ime yaye ase okogamba kw’oboronge.
Omoruoti Sulemani igo agamberete Abaisraeli bonsi,
na abanene abarenge komokonya nabwo aba: Asaria, mosinto o Zadoki, nere orenge omokuani;
Elihorefu na Ahiya, basinto ba Sisa, nabwo barenge abariki; Yehosafati, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka;
Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere orenge omochiki bw’abarwani esegi; Zadoki na Abiatari, nabwo barenge abakuani;
Asaria, mosinto o Nathani, nere orenge omoteneneri igoro ase abanene baria; Zabudi, mosinto o Nathani, nere orenge omokuani, naende nigo arenge omosani bw’omoruoti;
Ahisari, nere otenenerete enyomba y’obogambi; Adoniramu, mosinto o Abuda, nere otenenerete emeremo yagwenerete gokorwa.

Sulemani nachorete abanto abanene ikomi na babere abarenge gosangereria endagera na koyerentera omoruoti amo nab’enyomba yaye. Kera oyomo ase aba ikomi na babere nigo arenge korenta endagera eisaine koriegwa ase omotienyi oyomo ase omwaka.
Aya naro amarieta ’abanto abwo: Beni‐Huri agatenenera ense y’ebigoro y’Efraimu;
Beni‐Dekeri agatenenera emechie ya Makasi, na Shaalabimu, na Beti‐Semesi, na Eloni, na Beti‐Hanani.
Beni‐Hesedi agatenenera emechie y’Aruboti na Soko, na ense yonsi ya Hefa;
Beni‐Abinadab agatenenera Nafati‐Dori yonsi (nere onyuomete Tafati, omoiseke o Sulemani);

Baana, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, agatenenera emechie ya Taanaki na Megido, na Beti‐Sehani yonsi, eyio eikerete Saretani, irianyi ya Yesireeli, na korwa Beti‐Sehani goika Abeli‐Mehola, na ng’umbu ya Yoki‐Meamu.

Beni‐Geberi agatenenera Ramoti o Gileadi, na Emechie ya Yairi Omomanase agwo Gileadi, na orogongo rw’Arigobu agwo Basani. Igo atenenerete emechie emerongo etano nomo emenene yagiteire chindwaki, na ebiita biabo nigo biarenge nemekorogoto.
Ahinadabu, mosinto o Ido, agatenenera orogongo rwa Mahanaimu;
Ahimasi agatenenera orogongo rwa Nafutali (nere onyuomete Basemati, omoiseke o Sulemani);
Baana, mosinto o Husai, agatenenera orogongo rw’Aseri na omochie o Bealoti;
Yehosafati, mosinto o Parua, agatenenera orogongo rwa Isakaru;
Simei, mosinto bwa Ela, agatenenera orogongo rwa Benjamin;
Geberi, mosinto bwa Uri, agatenenera ense ya Gileadi yarenge kogamberwa na Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori, na Ogi, omoruoti o Basani. Nigo arenge omoteneneri oyomo bweka ase ense eyio yonsi.
Abayuda na Abaisraeli nigo barenge abange mono, buna omokenye o nyancha; barabwo bakaria na konywa, bakaba bakwegokia.

Sulemani akaba okogambera amaruoti onsi, gochakera orooche rw’Eufarati na goikera ense y’Abafilisti, na goikera orobebe rwa Misiri. Abanto bonsi b’oboruoti bwaye nigo barenge komorentera ebango na bakaba bakomokorera ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
Endagera Sulemani arenge korenterwa ase rituko erimo nigo yarenge: obosie obonuke, ebitonga amagana atato, na obosie bonde, ebitonga amagana atano na rimo,
ne chiombe ikomi chinoru chiare gotugerwa nyomba, ne chiombe chiare korisia getii, emerongo ebere, na ching’ondi rigana erimo, ne chinsune, ne chingabi, na amang’o, ne chinyoni chinoru.

Sulemani nigo arenge kogambera chinse chionsi chiare bosongo y’Eufarati, korwa Tifusa goika Gasa. Ase igo nigo arenge kogambera abaruoti bonsi abarenge bosongo y’Eufarati, nigo arenge nomorembe ne chinse chionsi chiamoetanaine.
Abayuda na Abaisraeli nigo bamenyete nomorembe korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba; kera omonto nigo arenge nemezeituni yaye na emeko yaye, ase emiaka yonsi Sulemani abagamberete.
Sulemani nabwate ameri e chibarasi chilifu emerongo ene chiarenge kong’usa chigari, ne chibarasi chiare koriinwa, chilifu ikomi na ibere.

Abateneneri baria abanene nigo barenge korenta chindagera ase omoruoti Sulemani na ase abanto bonsi abarenge koragera bwoye. Kera oyomo obo nigo are korenta endagera eisaine koriegwa ase omotienyi oyomo ase omwaka, endagera tiyarenge kobora.
Kera omonto nigo arenge korenta esairi na obonyansi aase biaganeirie ase chibarasi chiare kong’usa chigari amo ne chibarasi chinde.
Nyasae akaa Sulemani obong’aini ne chisemi goetania ekerengo; okomanya kwaye nigo kwarenge okonge, koreng’ana buna obonge bw’omokenye ore ase engegu y’enyancha.
Obong’aini bwa Sulemani nigo bwabuete obw’abanto bonsi ba Moocha na obw’Abamisiri bonsi.
Igo arenge omong’aini kobua abanto bonsi, kobua Etani Omoezara, na Hemani, na Kalikoli, na Darida, basinto ba Maholi; ne chinkuma chiaye chikagenda goika ase ebisaku bionsi biamoetanaine.
Boigo nakwanete emereng’anio chilifu isato; na amatera aye nigo arenge elifu eyemo, na atano.

Ere nigo arenge goteba igoro y’emete yonsi, emenene buna emecharake ya Lebanoni na ebimeri ebike buna hisopo eyekomera ase chindwaki. Boigo agateba igoro ye ching’iti, ne chinyoni, ne ching’iti chikwagura, ne chinswe.
Abanto bakarwa ase chinse chionsi, bagacha koigwa obong’aini bwa Sulemani, na abaruoti bonsi b’ense bagatoma abanto bagachia komoigwa.
Hiramu, omoruoti o Turo ekero aigwete ng’a Sulemani oakirwe amaguta na obeire omoruoti ribaga ria ise, agatoma abasomba baye asare, ekiagera Hiramu botambe igo anchete Daudi.
Na Sulemani agatoma amang’ana ase Hiramu, akabora,

“Nomanyete ng’a Daudi tata tanyarete koagacha enyomba ase ogosasimera erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye, ekiagera ababisa nigo barenge komorwania chisegi chinsemo chionsi, goika ekero Omonene ababegete inse ase obogambi bwa Daudi.
Korende bono Omonene, Nyasae one, ong’eire obotoereru korwa ase kera ensemo; ababisa tibari aande, gose amabe ande onsi.

Omonene nigo atebetie Daudi tata: Omwana oo oria ndabeke abe ase ekerogo kiao ki’obonene nyuma yao, nere orang’agachere enyomba aase mogosasimera erieta riane. Ase ayio, naganirie koagacha enyomba aase togosasimera erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae one.

Na bono aye, chika abanto bangechere emete emecharake ya Lebanoni. Abasomba baane mbabwatane nabasomba bao ase emeremo eyio, na inche ning’akane abasomba bao eng’eria ende yonsi orabeke. Nomanyete ng’a abanto baane tibamanyeti kogecha emete buna abanto ba Sidoni.”
Ekero Hiramu aigwete amang’ana a Sulemani, akaba nomogoko omonene, akabora, “Omonene atogigwe rituko ria rero, oyo oeire Daudi omwana omomura omong’aini agambere abanto aba abange.”
Erio agatoma amang’ana ase Sulemani, agateba, “Naigure amang’ana gwatomire asende; igo inde ang’e gokora onsi aya oganetie ase amang’ana ’emete emecharake na emetarakwa.

Abasomba baane mbayetirimbokie korwa ase Lebanoni gochia ase enyancha, nainche ninyebeke amo inyesibe, eirwe nenyancha echeng’enenete, goika aase oganetie. “Aase agwo nao erasansorerwe, na aye oyerusieo. Erio ong’isanekerie okogania kwane ase okobaa abanto baane endagera yabo.”
Hiramu akaa Sulemani emete, emecharake na emetarakwa buna Sulemani aganetie.

Sulemani akaa Hiramu obosie bw’engano ebitonga chilifu amagana abere (200,000) koba endagera ase abanto b’enyomba yaye, na amaguta amitire korwa ase amazeituni chilita chilifu isano na ibere, na amagana abere (7,200). Ebinto ebio Sulemani akaba okoa Hiramu ase kera omwaka.
Omonene akaa Sulemani obong’aini buna amorierete eira. Omorembe okaba ase egati ya Hiramu na Sulemani, na aba babere bagakora okobwatana gw’okoigwana.
Omoruoti Sulemani agakora omoroberio bw’abanto chilifu emerongo etato (30,000) korwa ase Abaisraeli bonsi, akababeka bakore emeremo yagwenerete gokorwa.

Agaatanana abanto aba ase ebiombe bitato, kera ekeombe gekaba abanto chilifu ikomi. Kera ekeombe gekaba kegokora emeremo agwo Lebanoni ase omotienyi oyomo na kobeera inka ase emetienyi ebere. Adoniramu akabekwa gotenenera emeremo eyio yagwenerete gokorwa.
Boigo Sulemani nabwate abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) abarenge kobogoria chigurube, na abanto chilifu emerongo etano na etato (80,000) abarenge kobaacha amagena agwo ase ebitunwa.
Naende Sulemani nabwate abanto chilifu isato na amagana atato (3,300) batenenerete abanto barenge gokora emeremo.
Omoruoti akabachika babaache amagena amanene aye rigori rinene, erinde oboroso bw’enyomba bobekwe amagena abaachire buya.
Naboigo abaagachi ba Sulemani, na aba Hiramu amo nabanto b’omochie o Gebali bagakora emeremo y’okobaacha na gosenia amagena na koroisia chibao ase oboagacho boria.

Ase omwaka bw’amagana ane, na emerongo etano na etato, nyuma Abaisraeli kobarure ense ya Misiri, noro omwaka o kane bw’okogamba gwa Sulemani igoro y’Abaisraeli, ase omotienyi o Sivu, omotienyi o kabere, Sulemani agachaka koagacha enyomba y’Omonene.

Enyomba eria omoruoti Sulemani aagacherete Omonene nigo yarenge iga: Obotambe bwaye nobw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato.

Enyomba eria yaagachetwe bosio bwe Hekalu enyene nigo yarenge iga: Obotambe bwaye gochia ime nobw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere, nigo bwareng’aine nobogare bwe Hekalu.
Sulemani akaroisia ase enyomba eria ebibao bi’emete; ebibao ebio tibiarenge koigorwa.
Naende akaagacha chinyomba chinde inse, chinyasi chiaye chichomeranirie ne chinyasi chi’enyomba enyene ase amakere na nyuma, akanachana ebinyomba imeo.

Obogare bw’ebinyomba bia inse nigo bwarenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na ebie rirongo ria kabere amaboko atano na rimo, na ebie rirongo ria gatato amaboko atano na abere. Nigo akorete ebitambokero bikabwatana nenyasi ye Hekalu ase kera rirongo, erinde emeriibo egosiira kera rirongo etoorere ase ebitambokero ebio, etari gosoigwa ase enyasi.

Ekero enyomba yaagachetwe, igo yaagachetwe namagena aseneirie agwo aase arenge kobaacherwa, erinde eriogi ri’enyundo, gose eri’egesire, gose eri’egekorero kende gionsi gi’ekioma tikeigugwa ase Hekalu ekero yaagachetwe.

Egesoero kegosoera ebinyomba bia inse nigo kiarenge ensemo ya sugusu ye Hekalu na goetera ase ebiriinero abanto nigo barenge koriina gochia ase rirongo ria kabere, na korwa aroro bariina gochia ase rirongo ria gatato.
Naboigo Sulemani akaagacha Hekalu, akayekoora. Akaroisia risang’ina ri’enyomba ne chibao chi’emecharake.

Oboagacho bw’enyomba inse nigo bwatunyaine Hekalu, na kera rirongo nigo riarenge nobotambe gochia igoro ekerengo ki’amaboko atano. Oboagacho obwo nigo bwabwateranetigwe ne Hekalu ne chibao chi’emecharake.
Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Sulemani, rikamotebia,

“Amang’ana igoro y’enyomba eye okong’agachera bono nigo arabe iga: Korabwatie emeroberio yane echikire na koigwera amachiko aane onsi na koyakora, erio nainche ning’ikeranie ring’ana riane asore, riria nakwanete na Daudi iso:
Inche nigo ndamenye aroro ase egati y’Abaisraeli, tingotiga abanto baane Abaisraeli.”
Sulemani akaagacha enyomba eria na akayekoora buna iga:
Agatuba chinyasi chia ime y’enyomba yonsi korwa inse goika igoro ne chibao chi’emecharake, na inse y’enyomba akayetuba ne chibao chi’emetarakwa.

Akaagacha akanyomba ka ime bosio kegima ase Hekalu ime, kabe Aase Aachenu Mono. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere; akanyomba karia akagatuba ne chibao chi’emecharake, korwa inse goika igoro.
Ensemo y’enyomba yarenge Hekalu enyene nigo yarenge y’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ene.
Chibao chi’emecharake chiatubete enyomba ime nigo chiarenge nemegwekano y’ebirandi, na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio. Yonsi nigo yatubetwe nemecharake, na igena rinde tiriarorekanete.
Ime ye Hekalu bosio kegima nigo aroisetie akanyomba aase Esanduku y’Okobwatana y’Omonene yarenge kobekwa.

Obotambe bw’akanyomba karia ka ime nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere; naboigo obogare bwaye na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro, naende nigo kaoomire netahabu echenire. Bosio bw’akanyomba karia egesasimero gekaroisigwa, kegatubwa ne chibao chi’emecharake.
Sulemani akaooma Hekalu ime netahabu engiya. Chingataare chiaoomire netahabu chikabekwa ase egesieri bosio bw’akanyomba ka ime.
Nabo akaooma enyomba yonsi kegima netahabu; boigo akaooma egesasimero gi’Aase Aachenu netahabu.
Sulemani akaroisia emegwekano y’abakerubi babere korwa ase emete y’emezeituni, akayebeka agwo ase akanyomba ka ime.
Obotambe bwa kera orobaba rwa kera oyomo nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano; korwa ensinyo y’orobaba oromo goika ey’oronde nigo bwarenge obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi.
Omokerubi oria onde boigo nigo arenge bw’ekerengo ekio ekio. Abakerubi bonsi babere nigo barenge bareng’aine kegima ase ekerengo na bagwekaine ase ekieni.
Obotambe bwa kera omokerubi nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ikomi.

Abakerubi abwo bakabekwa ase akanyomba karia bosio ime ye Hekalu. Chimbaba chiabo nigo chiaramboire; orobaba oromo rw’omokerubi oyomo rogaika enyasi ensemo eyemo, na oromo rw’oyonde rogaika enyasi ensemo ende; gati‐gati y’enyomba orobaba ronde rwa kera omokerubi rogakunana.
Abakerubi bonsi babere bakaoomwa netahabu.
Sulemani agachabera chinyasi chionsi chie Hekalu, na echi’akanyomba ka ime, nemegwekano y’abakerubi, na ey’emekendo, na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio.
Inse ase ebinyomba ebio bibere akaooma netahabu.
Ebisieri bibere bikaroisigwa korwa ase chibao chi’emezeituni bikabekwa ase egesoero gi’akanyomba ka ime. Emetobwa nigo yatenenirie ensemo eyemo ya isano y’enyasi.

Ebisieri ebio bionsi bibere bi’emezeituni bigachaberwa nemegwekano y’abakerubi, na ey’emekendo, na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio. Akaooma bionsi netahabu; boigo agasiarera abakerubi amo ne chibao chi’emekendo netahabu.
Naende emetobwa y’egesieri gie Hekalu enyene ekaroisigwa korwa ase chibao chi’emezeituni ere ne chikoona inye,
na ebisieri bibere bi’emetarakwa; kera egesieri nigo kiarenge ebing’ese bibere biare konyara koigorwa biaringanigwa.
Ebisieri ebio bigachaberwa nemegwekano y’abakerubi, na ey’emekendo na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio, bikaoomwa buya netahabu igoro y’emegwekano eyio.
Naende Sulemani akaagacha chindwaki chi’eraaro ya ime. Chindwaro isato chie chindwaki echio agachiagacha namagena abaachire, na orwaro oromo akaroagacha ne chibao chi’emecharake.
Oboroso bwe Hekalu bokabekwa ase omotienyi o Sivu, ase omwaka o kane bw’okogamba gwa Sulemani.

Na ase omotienyi o gatano na gatato, omotienyi o Bulu, ase omwaka o ikomi nomo, oboagacho bwe Hekalu bokaera buna yaroberetigwe. Ase igo Sulemani akaira emiaka etano na ebere ase okoagacha enyomba eria.
Sulemani akaira emiaka ikomi na etato ase okoagacha enyomba yaye omonyene na koyekoora.

Akaagacha enyomba ekorokwa Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko rigana erimo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato. Ero nigo yaagachetwe amo ne chisiiro chi’emecharake chindwaro inye. Igoro ase chisiiro echio emiamba y’emecharake yabaachetwe ekabekwa.
Enyomba nigo yarenge nekerama ki’emecharake igoro y’emiamba yabegetwe ase chisiiro chiria emerongo ene na isano, ikomi na isano ase kera orwaro.
Enyomba eyio nigo yarenge nebibao bire ase chindwaro isato, kera ekebao kerigereretie ekende.
Ebisoero bionsi na ebibao nigo biarenge ne chikoona inye, na ebibao nigo biarigerereranetie bire ase chindwaro isato.

Boigo akaagacha omwaraache bwe chisiiro. Obotambe bwaye nobw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etato. Bosio bw’enyomba eyio akaagacha egesona, na bosio aroro chisiiro chire nekerama.
Naende akaagacha Enyomba y’Ekerogo ki’Oboruoti, eye ekarokwa naende Enyomba y’Ekegambero aase arenge kogambera ebina. Eye nigo yatubetwe ne chibao chi’emecharake korwa inse goika igoro.
Naboigo enyomba yaye y’okomenya yaagachetwe magega y’enyomba eria y’ebina, egwekaine neyio. Naende Sulemani akaagachera mokaye, mosubati o Farao, enyomba egwekaine eria yaye.

Echio chionsi nigo chiagachetwe namagena amaya e rigori rinene, abaachetwe koreng’ana nekerengo, akanachwa nemesumeno chinsemo chionsi korwa oboroso goika rigasio ri’enyasi. Amagena onsi nigo aroisetigwe bo, nonya naya e risiko amo nay’orwaki rw’eraaro y’enyomba y’Omonene.
Amagena ’oboroso nigo arenge aye rigori rinene, amagena amanene na amarito, ayande ay’obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi, na ayande ay’amaboko atano na atato.
Igoro y’oboroso narengeo amagena ande e rigori rinene, abaachetwe koreng’ana nekerengo, amo nemeriibo y’emecharake.

Orwaki rw’eraaro enene igo rwaagachetwe namagena abaachire, abekire chindwaro isato gochia igoro, ne chibao chi’emecharake orwaro oromo. Naboigo norwaki rw’eraaro ya ime y’enyomba y’Omonene amo nenyomba yarenge bosio bw’aroro.
Omoruoti Sulemani akarangeria Hiramu achiche korwa Turo.

Hiramu nigo arenge omwana bw’omokungu omoboraka bw’egesaku kia Nafutali, na ise nigo arenge omonto o Turo, omoturi bwe chitaai. Hiramu omonyene nigo arenge nobong’aini obonge amo ne chisemi, omanyete gotura ebinto binde bionsi bie chitaai. Ere agacha ase Sulemani, akamokorera emeremo yaye yonsi.
Hiramu akaroisia chisiiro ibere chi’etaai; obotambe bwa kera esiiro eyemo nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ikomi na atato, na engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi na abere egaetanana kera esiiro.
Naende akaroisia ebisure bibere bi’etaai enyititoire na kobombwa, akabibeka igoro ye chisiiro; obotambe gochia igoro bwa kera egesure nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano.
Kera egesure igoro ye chisiiro nigo giachabeire nebichanga bitano na bibere biasisire goetanana.
Akarosia emegwekano y’amakomomanga, akayebeka ase chindwaro ibere igoro y’ebichanga biarenge ase ebisure biria.
Ebisure igoro ye chisiiro chiarenge ime y’enyomba ya bosio, nigo biabombire bigwekaine ebisicha; obotambe bwabo nobw’amaboko ane.
Ebisure ebio nigo biarenge igoro ase chisiiro chiria ibere na igoro ye chinsemo chiatambeete gochia isiko. Emegwekano y’amakomomanga amagana abere yarenge ase chindwaro ibere ase kera egesure.
Hiramu akabeka chisiiro chiria ase enyomba bosio bwe Hekalu; esiiro yabegetwe ensemo ya borio akayeroka Yakini, na eyabegetwe ensemo ya bomosi akayeroka Boasi.
Ebisure nigo biabombire buna ebisicha nigo biarenge igoro ase chisiiro. Na igo emeremo ye chisiiro ekaera.

Hiramu akaroisia egetuba ekenene korwa ase etaai enyititoire na kobombwa, ekaba egesingo. Ekerengo korwa ensemo eyemo goika eyende nigo kiarenge eki’amaboko ikomi. Obotambe gochia igoro nigo bwarenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano. Engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko emerongo etato ekanyara goetanana egetuba ekio.

Ang’e nomogo emegwekano y’amasosa iyarengeo, ikomi ase kera ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, yarandete ekeringero ekegima. Emegwekano eyio nigo yarenge chindwaro ibere, yabombire ase egento ekemo negetuba keria.

Egetuba keria giaterekereretwe igoro y’emegwekano ye chiombe ikomi na ibere. Chiombe isato chikarigereria gochia sugusu, na isato gochia bosongo, na isato gochia irianyi, na isato gochia moocha; chinsemo chiabo chia nyuma chikarigereria gochia gati‐gati inse y’egetuba keria.

Obonetu bw’etaai yaroiseretigwe egetubwa keria, nigo bwarenge obw’obogare bw’egesanyi gi’okoboko, na omogo okaroisigwa buna oyo bw’egekombe, gose obw’egesicha. Egetuba keria nigo kiarenge kobekwa amache aisaine ang’e chilita chilifu emerongo etano (50,000).

Naende Hiramu akaroisia ebibekerero ikomi bi’ebituba korwa ase chitaai. Obotambe bwa kera ekebekerero nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ane, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko atato.
Ebibekerero biria nigo biakoretwe iga: Chinsingo nchiarenge ase chinsemo chiabo ase egati ye chinsingo chie chikoona.

Ase chinsingo echio yarengeo emegwekano ye chindo, na eye chieri, na ey’abakerubi; naboigo nase chinsingo chie chikoona igoro. Igoro na inse y’emegwekano eyio nigo yarenge emegwekano y’ebisicha biaroisirie chingata.

Kera ekebekerero nigo kiarenge namagoro ane aroisetigwe korwa ase etaai. Ase chikoona chi’ekebekerero ebisiirero mbiarengeo. Ebisiirero ebio nigo biabombire nemegwekano y’ebisicha biaroisetigwe chingata ase kera ekemo.

Omonwa bw’ekebekerero nigo orenge igoro ime y’orosingo rw’obotambe gochia igoro okoboko okomo. Omonwa oyio orenge egesingo otambeete gochia inse, obotambe bw’okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, nao ebiechabero biarenge. Emetobwa yaye nigo yarenge ne chikoona, tiyarenge egesingo.
Amagoro aye ane nigo abegetwe inse ye chinsingo chiaye, ne rinyongo riaye nigo ribwateranirie nekebekerero. Obotambe bwa kera okogoro nigo bwarenge obw’okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
Amagoro ayio nigo aroisetigwe buna aye chigari. Amagoro amagima nigo aroisetigwe korwa ase etaai yanyititoire na kobombwa. Boigo amanyongo, ne chingata, na ebitingiro biaroisetigwe.
Ebisiirero bine mbiarenge ase kera ekebekerero ase chikoona chiaye; biaroisetigwe bikaba egento ekemo nekebekerero.

Igoro kegima ase kera ekebekerero nigo kiarenge orosingo rw’obogare bw’ekeng’ese gi’okoboko okomo; na igoro ase orosingo orwo nigo biarenge ebisiirero amo ne chinsingo chie chinsemo. Bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe bikaba egento ekemo nebisiirero.
Ase ebisiirero na ase chinsingo emegwekano y’abakerubi, na eye chindo, na ey’emekendo, amo ney’ebisicha, ekamang’wa, buna ribaga riarenge ase kera ensemo.
Naboigo akaroisia ebibekerero bionsi ikomi. Bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase etaai enyititoire na kobombwa; nigo biareng’aine na nigo biagwekaine.

Hiramu akaroisia na ebituba ikomi bie chitaai. Obogare bwa kera egetuba nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ane, na nigo kiare koira amache aisaine ang’e ne chilita amagana kianda. Naboigo aroisetie ebituba ikomi, ekemo ase kera ekebekerero.
Akabeka ebibekerero bitano ensemo ya irianyi ye Hekalu, na bitano ensemo ya sugusu, na egetuba keria ekenene agakebeka ensemo ya irianyi ya moocha.
Hiramu akaroisia ebituba, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo. Naboigo agakoora emeremo yonsi eyaetwe na Sulemani ng’a akore ase enyomba y’Omonene.
Akaroisia chisiiro ibere, na ebisure bibere biabegetwe igoro ye chisiiro, na ebichanga bisisire biaetanaine, bigatuba chinsemo chi’ebisure echiatambeete gochia isiko,
na emegwekano y’amakomomanga amagana ane eyabegetwe igoro y’ebichanga ebio, chindwaro ibere ase kera egesure kiarenge igoro ye chisiiro, erinde ensemo y’ebisure biria yatambeete etubwe.
Naende akaroisia ebibekerero bi’ebituba amo nebituba ikomi biaterekereireo,
na egetuba ekenene ekemo amo nemegwekano ye chiombe ikomi na ibere ekabekwa inse y’egetuba keria,

ne chindogio, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo. Ebinto ebio bionsi biaatoire nigo biare ebibekerero bi’enyomba y’Omonene, Hiramu aroisereretie omoruoti Sulemani. Bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase chitaai chisibirie buya.
Ebinto ebio omoruoti akabibomba korwa ase etaai enyititoire, ime ase esike ebombire agwo egati ya Sukoti na Saretani ase Riranya ria Yorodan.
Sulemani agatiga korenga ebinto ebi bionsi, ekiagera biarenge ebinge mono. Oborito bw’etaai eria tibwamanyekanete buna bwang’ana.
Boigo Sulemani akaroisia ebinto binde bionsi biare kobekwa ase enyomba y’Omonene; egesasimero gi’etahabu, na emesa y’etahabu ase emegati yare koruegwa ase Nyasae yare kobekwa.
Ebibekerero bie chitaya bitano biare kobekwa ensemo y’okorio, na bitano ensemo y’okobee, bosio bw’Aase Aachenu Mono; na emegwekano y’ebisicha, ne chitaya, amo nebinachi biakorire korwa ase chitahabu.

Naende akaroisia chisani ne chigami, na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero, ne chimbata chi’ebisieri bi’akanyomba ka ime, Aase Aachenu Mono, na echi’ebisieri bie Hekalu enyene. Ebinto ebio bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase chitahabu chichenire.

Naboigo emeremo eye yonsi omoruoti Sulemani akorete ase enyomba y’Omonene ekaera. Na Sulemani agasoyia aroro ebinto ebi Daudi ise aatananete koba ebichenu: chifeta, ne chitahabu, na ebikorero; akabigacha ase chikungo chi’enyomba y’Omonene.

Sulemani agasangereria amo abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, na abatang’ani bonsi b’ebisaku biabo, na baria qarenge abaraai be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bache ase obosio bwaye agwo Yerusalemu, erinde bagende Sayoni, Omochie o Daudi, kwoyia Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’Omonene.
Igo Abaisraeli bonsi bagacha ase omoruoti Sulemani ase Amatuko Amanene ase omotienyi bw’Etanimu, noro omotienyi o gatano na kabere.
Ekero abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bachete, abakuani bakaimokia Esanduku y’Omonene,
bakayerenta amo n’Eema y’Omosangererekano na ebikorero bionsi ebichenu biarenge ime ase Eema eria. Abakuani na Abalawi nabwo barentete ebinto ebio.

Omoruoti Sulemani amo nomoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, baria basangererekanete amo nere bagatenena bosio bw’Esanduku eria, bakaruera aroro ebing’wanso bie ching’ondi ne chiombe chinyinge mono chitaare konyara kobareka.
Erio abakuani bakarenta Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, bakayesoyia aase aye ase akanyomba ka ime, agwo Aase Aachenu Mono, bakayebeka inse ye chimbaba chi’abakerubi.
Abakerubi abwo nigo baramborete chimbaba chiabo igoro y’aase aria Esanduku eria yarenge, bagatuba Esanduku eria amo nemiaro yaye yare kobogorerigwa.

Emiaro eria nigo yarenge emetambe, ne chinsinyo chiabo chikarorekana korwa Aase Aachenu ase oyo oteneine bosio bw’Aase Aachenu Mono, korende tiyarenge kororekana korwa isiko; nero nao ere agwo goika rero iga.

Egento kende ekeao tikiarenge ime ase Esanduku eria, otatiga chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena, chiria Musa abegete imeo, agwo Horebu ase Omonene akorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania n’Abaisraeli ekero barwete ase ense ya Misiri.
Ekero abakuani barenge gosoka korwa ase Aase Aachenu, riire rigaichora enyomba y’Omonene,
na igo abakuani tibarenge konyara kogenderera nobokoreri bwabo ase engencho ye riire riria, ekiagera obonene bw’Omonene bwaichorete ase enyomba y’Omonene.
Erio Sulemani akabora, “Omonene obekire erioba igoro, korende otebire ng’a narigetie komenya ase omosunte ekerima.
Bono nakoagacheire enyomba ebe obomenyo bwao, aase oramenye kogenderera botambe.”
Erio omoruoti akeonchora akarigereria abanto, agasesenia omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli ekero oteneine,
agateba, “Atogigwe Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ere oyoikeranirie nokoboko kwaye aya arierete Daudi tata eira nomonwa oye, ogoteba:

Korwa rituko riria nang’anyetie abanto baane Abaisraeli korwa Misiri, tinachorete omochie onde bwonsi ase egati y’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli agwo ase nare koagacha enyomba, erinde erieta riane ribe aroro, korende nachorete Daudi agambere abanto baane Abaisraeli.”
Naende Sulemani agateba, “Igo kwarenge okogania gwa Daudi tata koagachera erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyomba.
Korende Omonene akamotebia: Buna kwarengereretie koagachera erieta riane enyomba, nigo gwakorete buya, okabeka amang’ana ayio ime ase enkoro yao.
Korende nonya naboigo, aye tokonyara koagacha enyomba eyio, otatiga omwana oo omomura oria oraiborwe korwa ase enda yao, nere oraagachere erieta riane enyomba.

“Bono Omonene oikeranirie eira eria ariete, ekiagera inche natenenire ribaga ria Daudi tata, na ngoikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli, buna Omonene ariete eira, naende naagacheire erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyomba.

Naende aroro agwo naroisirie aase Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’Omonene ekobeera. Okobwatana koria Omonene akorete ne chisokoro chiaito, ekero aching’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
Erio Sulemani agatenena bosio bw’egesasimero ki’Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, akarambora amaboko aye gochia igoro,

agakwana, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, Nyasae ande tari akogwekaine, igoro nonya ninse aa ase ense, aye bweka nigo okorenda okobwatana kw’ogotianania, naende nigo okoorokia obwanchani botari koera ase abasomba bao baria bare abegenwa asore ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi.
Aye gwaikeranirie eira eria kwarierete omosomba oo Daudi tata. Aria gwakwanete nomonwa oo kwayaikeranirie nokoboko kwao rituko ria rero.

Ase ayio aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ikerania bono aya kwarierete omosomba oo Daudi tata eira, ogateba; Takobora nonya ng’ake omonto korwa ase ororeria rwao oraikaranse ase obosio bwane ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti ki’Abaisraeli, onye abana bao bagochia korenda chinchera chiabo, erinde babwatie chinchera chiane, buna aye gwachibwatetie.
Ase ayio, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, tiga ring’ana riao riria gwatebetie omosomba oo Daudi tata riikeranigwe.
“Inee! Nekeene ng’a aye Nyasae nonyare komenya aa ase ense eye? Rora, igoro na igoro aare mono tekogoisana omenye, naki rende enyomba eye inche nakoagacheire eragoisane?
Korende aye Omonene, Nyasae one, koranche oigwe ogosaba kwane inche omosomba oo, na okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo, na oigwe ekerero na ogosaba oko inche omosomba oo nkogosaba bono iga.

Tiga amaiso ao arigererie enyomba eye obotuko na omobaso aase aiga aye gwatebete igoro yaye: Erieta riane naribeere aroro. Ase ayio oigwe ogosaba oko inche, omosomba oo, ngosaba ndigereretie aase aiga.

Naende aye oigwe okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo inche, omosomba oo, na okw’abanto bao Abaisraeli ekero bagosaba barigereretie aase aiga. Ee, oigwe aye korwa igoro ase obomenyo bwao bore, na ekero okoigwa bwabere.
“Omonto karakorere omonto onde bobe na aborigwe koria emuma, erio achiche arie emuma eria bosio bw’egesasimero kiao ase enyomba eye,
aye oigwe korwa agwo igoro, okore ogokora kwao, onachere abasomba bao ekina kia boronge. Tiga oria ore omomochi abogorie egesusuro gi’okomocha kwaye, na oria ore omoronge aegwe oboronge bwaye.

“Ekero abanto bao Abaisraeli barabe babuirwe nababisa babo, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asore korende bagokoiranera naende na gotogia erieta riao, na ase enyomba eye bakogosaba na gokoboria ase oboitongo,
rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi’abanto bao Abaisraeli, naende obarente gocha ase ense eye kwaete chisokoro chiabo.
“Ekero igoro erabe esiekire na embura tetwa, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asore, kobarasabe barigereretie aase aiga, naende batogie erieta riao na baonchoke batige ebibe biabo, ekero aye orabae egesusuro,

rirorio aye oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi’abasomba bao Abaisraeli, okoborokereria enchera engiya bagwenerete kobwatia. Naende otwerie ense yao embura, ense eria kwaeire abanto bao ekaba omwando obo.

“Kerabe enchara erache ase ense, gose oborwaire obobe bogoita, gose oborwaire bw’enyagetabo ase chindagera, gose obw’ogochirigisia, gose chingige, gose amakonde, gose ababisa bakoboera ase omochie onde bwonsi ase emechie yabo, gose obobe bonde bwonsi, gose oborwaire bonde bwonsi,

oigwe ogosaba kwabo. Omonto onde bwensi, gose abanto bao bonsi Abaisraeli kobaragosabe na gokoboria ase oboitongo, kera oyomo omanyete emechando ere ase enkoro yaye, naende barambore amaboko abo gochia ase enyomba eye,
obaigwe korwa agwo igoro ase obomenyo bwao bore. Bwabere, okore ogokora kwao, okorere kera oyomo koreng’ana nogokora kwaye, (ekiagera naye bweka omanyete chinkoro chia mwanyabanto bonsi,)
erinde banyare gokoiroka amatuko onsi bamenyete ase ense eria kwaete chisokoro chiaito.
“Boigo onye omogeni korwa ase ense y’aare, oria otari bw’abanto bao Abaisraeli, okoigwa chinkuma chi’erieta riao rinene,
(ekiagera abanto inabaigwe igoro y’erieta riao rinene, naende baigwe igoro y’okoboko kwao kore ne chinguru koramboire,) onye omogeni oyio ogocha aa kogosaba origereretie enyomba eye,

oigwe korwa igoro agwo aase obomenyo bwao bore. Okorere omogeni oria amang’ana onsi akoboria, erinde abanto bonsi b’ense bamanye erieta riao, naende bakoiroke buna abanto bao Abaisraeli bakomanyete na bakoirogete, naende bamanye ng’a enyomba eye naagachire nigo ekorokwa ase erieta riao.

“Abanto bao kobaragende ase esegi korwania ababisa babo ase enchera ende yonsi aye orabatome gochia, na kobaragosabe aye Omonene barigereretie omochie oyio gwachorire, na enyomba eye naagacheire erieta riao,
rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro ogosaba kwabo, na okoboria kwabo kw’oboitongo, na obae oboronge bwabo.

“Omonto tari otagokora ebibe. Ase ayio baise kogokorera ebibe, na aye korabe nendamwamu asebare na kobabeka ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na abwo baboose na kobaira ase ense y’ababisa ere aare gose ang’e, obaigwe.
Kobararore okomocha kwabo ekero bare ase ense eria boosirwe gochia, beitie na koonchoka, naende bakogosaba ase oboitongo na koorokia ng’a bakorire ebibe na obokayayu, obaigwe.

Onye bagweitia na koonchoka ase ebirengererio biabo bionsi na ase chinkoro chiabo chionsi, ekero bare ase ense eria y’ababisa babo, baria baboosete, na aroro bagosabe barigereretie gochia ase ense yabo, eria kwaete chisokoro chiabo, na barigererie omochie oyo gwachorire na enyomba eye naagachire ase ogosasima erieta riao,
rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro ase obomenyo bwao bore ogosaba kwabo na okoboria kwabo kw’oboitongo, obae oboronge bwabo.
Bwabere abanto bao bakorire ebibe asore. Bwabere ogosaria kwabo gwonsi bakorire asore; okore ababisa babo, abwo baboosire babarorere amabeebe.
Abanto aba nabanto bao, na omwando oo, oria kwarusetie korwa Misiri, ense eria yarenge buna eriko ri’ekebemberi ki’omorero.
“Tiga amaiso ao abe atorigereretie namabera, inche omosomba oo amo nabanto bao Abaisraeli, otoigwe ekero kende gionsi togokorangeria ase oboitongo.
Aye Omonene Nyasae, nigo kwabaatananete korwa ase egati y’abanto bonsi b’ense babe omwando oo, buna gwatebete goetera ase Musa, omosomba oo, ekero keria kwarusetie chisokoro chiaito korwa Misiri.”
Bono ekero Sulemani akoorete ogosaba oko gwonsi na okoboria Omonene ase oboitongo, akaimoka korwa ase egesasimero ki’Omonene aase atung’amete namaru aye inse oramborete amaboko aye gochia igoro,
agatenena agasesenia omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, agakwana neriogi rinene, akabora,
“Atogigwe Omonene oria oeire abanto baye Abaisraeli obotoereru buna abarierete eira! Nonya ne ring’ana erimo tiriri ritaikeranetigwe ase eira yaye yonsi engiya ariete goetera ase Musa, omosomba oye.
Omonene, Nyasae oito, abe naintwe buna abete ne chisokoro chiaito; tabaisa gototiga gose gotwanga,
korende aonchore chinkoro chiaito gochia asare, tonyare kobwatia chinchera chiaye, na kobwata amachiko aye na emeroberio yaye echikire, na onsi aya achigete chisokoro chiaito.

Amang’ana aya aane nasabire ase oboitongo, tiga Omonene, Nyasae oito, abe okoyainyora omobaso na obotuko, naende ae abanto baye Abaisraeli oboronge bwabo koreng’ana buna okogania gwa kera rituko kore.
Erio abanto b’ense yonsi banyare komanya ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae, naende enyasae ende teri.
Ase ayio, tiga chinkoro chiaino chionsi chibe echi’ekeene ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, mobwatie emeroberio yaye echikire na mobwate amachiko aye buna mwakorire ase rituko ria rero.”
Erio omoruoti na abanto bonsi amo nere bakarua ekeng’wanso ase obosio bw’Omonene.

Sulemani akarua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase Omonene, chiombe chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, ne chingondi chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere. Naboigo omoruoti amo nabanto bonsi bagaatanana enyomba y’Omonene.

Ase rituko riria omoruoti agaatanana na gochena obogati‐gati bw’eraaro eria yarenge bosio bw’enyomba y’Omonene. Agwo nao aruerete ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, ekiagera egesasimero gi’etaai ekiarenge ase obosio bw’Omonene nigo kiarenge egeke mono, tikiare goisana koira ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe.

Ase ayio Sulemani amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi mbabwate Amatuko Amanene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, naende ase amatuko ande atano na abere, amatuko onsi nikomi na ane. Omosangererekano omonene nigo orenge gosangerereka korwa egesoero kia Hamati goika akarooche ka Misiri.

Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato agatiga abanto bakagenda, na barabwo bagasesenia omoruoti, bakagenda chinka chiabo bare nomogoko na omosasoko ase chinkoro chiabo ase engencho y’obuya bwonsi boria Omonene akorerete Daudi, omosomba oye, na Abaisraeli, abanto baye.
Ekero Sulemani konya akoorire koagacha enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba y’oboruoti, na aande onsi ase anchete koagacha,
Omonene akamoorokera eria kabere buna amoorokerete agwo Gibeoni ritang’ani.

Omonene akamotebia, “Naigure ogosaba kwao na okoboria kwao kw’oboitongo. Naatananire na gochena enyomba eye kwaagachire, nabekire erieta riane ribe aroro kare na kare. Amaiso aane na enkoro yane mbibe aroro ase chingaki chionsi.
Korabwatie chinchera chiane, buna Daudi iso achibwatetie, ase enkoro endonge na ase obwegenwa; na onye kogokora onsi aya nagochikire, na kobwata emeroberio yonsi echikire;

rirorio inche ninkong’ie ekerogo kiao ki’oboruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli kare na kare, buna narierete Daudi iso eira, ngateba: Takobora nonya ng’ake korwa ase ororeria rwao omonto oraikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti ki’Abaisraeli.
