Korende inwe na abanto be chinderia chiaino komoreonchore na montige, naende timorenda amachiko aane na emeroberio yane nabaeire, korende mogende gokorera chinyasae chinde na gochisasima,

rirorio ninsirie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense eria nabaeire, na enyomba eye naatananire na koyechena ase engencho y’erieta riane ninyetige, tinkoyerigereria namaiso aane. Abaisraeli nababe omorabaaro ne ring’ana rigokwanwa nabanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
Enyomba eye nebe rituuri riatagokire, na kera omonto ogoeta aase agwo naichanigwe na gokumia, na ekero monto onde akoboria: Nase ki Omonene akorire aya iga ase ense eye na ase enyomba eye?

Nigo barairanerie: Nekiagera barabwo batigete Omonene, Nyasae obo, oria orusetie chisokoro chiabo korwa ase ense ya Misiri, naende bakabwatana ne chinyasae ching’ao, bagachisasima na gochikorera. Amang’ana ayio agerire Omonene orentire amabe aya onsi igoro asebare.”
Sulemani akaira emiaka emerongo ebere ase okoagacha chinyomba chiria ibere, enyomba y’Omonene na ey’oboruoti.

Hiramu, omoruoti o Turo, konya oeire Sulemani chibao chi’emecharake, na echi’emetarakwa, amo ne chitahabu ase ekerengo aganetie. Nyuma y’ayio omoruoti Sulemani akaa Hiramu emechie emerongo ebere yarenge ase ense ya Galili.
Korende ekero Hiramu achete korwa Turo korora emechie eria, tiyamogogetie.
Akabora, “Emechie eye kwang’eire, oyominto, naki ere?” Ase eyio igo ekorokwa ense ya Kabuli goika rero iga.
Hiramu konya otomeire omoruoti chitahabu chikiro chilifu inye (4,000).

Oyo noro omoroberio bw’emeremo Sulemani abetereretie abanto bakore: Akababeka koagacha enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba yaye omonyene, na Milo, na orwaki rwaetanaine Yerusalemu, na emechie ya Hasori, na Megido, na Geseri,

(Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, konya ochire korwania Geseri na koyosakora, naende akayosamba nomorero. Agaita abanto ba Kanani baria bamenyete aroro, na koyorua buna ekeegwa ki’ogosokia omoiseke oye abe moga Sulemani.
Bono Sulemani akaagacha Geseri naende). Boigo akaagacha Beti‐Horoni ya maate,
na Baalati, na Tamari ore ase erooro, ase ense eria,

na emechie yonsi ye chikungo, eria Sulemani abwate, na emechie ye chigari chiaye, na eye chibarasi, na oboagacho bonde bwonsi Sulemani aganetie koagacha agwo Yerusalemu, na agwo Lebanoni na ase ense yonsi y’oboruoti bwaye.

Abanto aba Sulemani abetereretie gokora emeremo, nigo barenge abe chinderia chi’abanto b’ense ya Kanani, abwo Abaisraeli batanyarete kobua na gosiria kegima. Abanto abwo tibarenge Abaisraeli. Nigo barenge Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi. Abanto abwo bakagenderera koba abasomba, nabo bare goika rero iga.

Korende Sulemani takorete Abaisraeli bakaba abasomba. Barabwo nigo barenge abarwani b’esegi, na abakonyi b’oboruoti, na abachiki baye b’abarwani, na abatang’ani b’abarwani, na abachiki baye be chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa.
Abateneneri abanene igoro y’emeremo ya Sulemani nigo barenge abanto amagana atano, na emerongo etano; abwo nigo batenenerete abanto barenge gokora emeremo eria.
Korende mosubati o Farao akarua ase Omochie o Daudi, agatiira gochia komenya ase enyomba yaye eria Sulemani konya amoagacheire; nyuma y’ayio Sulemani akaagacha Milo.

Ara gatato ase omwaka Sulemani nigo arenge korua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase egesasimero keria aagacherete Omonene. Boigo aba ogosamba ubani ase Omonene. Ase igo agakoora emeremo y’okoagacha enyomba y’Omonene.
Omoruoti Sulemani akaroisia chimeeri agwo Esioni‐Geberi ere ang’e na Eloti, ase omosomo bw’Enyancha Embariri, ase ense ya Edomu.
Hiramu agatoma abanto baye baria bamanyete emeremo ye chinyancha, bagasang’ana nabanto ba Sulemani.
Barabwo bakagenda goika Ofiri, bakarenta korwa aroro chitahabu, chikiro chilifu ikomi na inye, na amagana atano (14,500), bakairera omoruoti Sulemani.
Ekero eting’ana ya Seba aigwete chinkuma chia Sulemani igoro y’ayio akorete ase engencho y’erieta ri’Omonene, agacha komoteema ase okomoboria amang’ana amakong’u.

Agacha Yerusalemu amo nabasomba baye abange barenge kogenda komo; boigo nabwate chingamia chiabogoretie ebinsari ne chitahabu chinyinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene. Na ekero aigete ase Sulemani, akamotebia amang’ana onsi arenge ase ebirengererio biaye.
Sulemani akamoiraneria amaborio aye onsi; nonya ne ring’ana erimo tiriabisekanete ase omoruoti, igo amanyete onsi na komoyorokia.
Na ekero eting’ana eria ya Seba akoorire korora obong’aini bwonsi bwa Sulemani, na enyomba eria aagachete,

na endagera yarenge korentwa ase emesa yaye, na buna abakonyi baye bamenyete, na buna abasomba baye baare komokorera, ne chianga chiabo babegete, na buna ababogoria babogoretie ebikombe, naende akarora buna omoruoti arenge gosamba ebing’wanso biaye ase enyomba y’Omonene, agakumia na koumata.
Eting’ana eria egatebia omoruoti, “Chinkuma nabeire nkoigwa ekero narenge ase ense yane igoro y’emeremo yao, na obong’aini bwao, nechi’ekeene bori.

Korende tinegenete amang’ana ayio nare koigwa goika ekero nachicha aa na kwerorera namaiso aane inche omonyene. Bono narorire ng’a tinatebetigwe nonya nekeng’ese ki’amang’ana aya. Obong’aini bwao, na obotenenku bwao biaetanirie amang’ana konya nkoigwa.
Abanto bao na abasomba bao aba bagotenena botambe ase obosio bwao na obong’aini bwao, mbare negesio ekenene.

Omonene, Nyasae oo, atogigwe, oria ogokigwe asore na okobekire ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti ki’Abaisraeli. Ekiagera Omonene anchete Abaisraeli botambe, agakobeka okaba omoruoti, erinde onyare konacha ekeene na oboronge.”

Erio eting’ana eria akaa omoruoti ebiegwa ebio arentete: Chitahabu chikiro chilifu isano (5,000), na ebinsari ebinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene. Naende ebinsari tibiarentetwe kero kende gionsi ebinge koreng’ana buna biria eting’ana ya Seba yarenterete omoruoti Sulemani.
Chimeeri chia Hiramu, chiria chiarentete chitahabu korwa Ofiri, chikarenta naende korwa aroro chibao chi’emete ekorokwa alumugu chinyinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene.

Korwa ase chibao chi’alumugu omoruoti akaroisia ebinto bi’enyomba y’Omonene, na ebi’enyomba y’omoruoti, naende akaroisia amakano na ebinto binde bikobugigwa nabateri. Chibao chi’emete buna eyio tichiana kororekana naende nonya ng’ake ase ense eye.

Omoruoti Sulemani akaa eting’ana ya Seba ebinto bionsi aganetie na aboretie aegwe. Amo nebinto ebio Sulemani akamoa ebinto binde ebinge buna omoruoti anarete korua ebiegwa. Erio eting’ana eria akairana, akagenda ase ense yaye amo nabasomba baye.
Etahabu yare korentwa ase Sulemani kera omwaka nigo yarenge goetania chikiro chilifu emerongo ebere na isato (23,000).

Boigo chitahabu chikarentwa korwa ase abaonchoreria b’ebinto, na baria barenge korenta ebinto korwa ase chinse chia isiko, na korwa ase abaruoti bonsi b’Arabia na abagambi bande barenge goakana ebango ase omoruoti.
Omoruoti Sulemani akagoncha ching’aya amagana abere, agachiooma ne chitahabu chisunyuntire, na kera eng’aya nigo yarenge koira chitahabu chikiro isato na ekeng’ese.

Naende akagoncha chinguba amagana atato agachiooma ne chitahabu chisunyuntire, na kera enguba nigo yarenge koira chitahabu ang’e chikiro ibere. Omoruoti agachibeka ime ase Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni.
Omoruoti akaroisia ekerogo ki’oboruoti, akagechabera amaino e chinchogu na agakeooma netahabu echenire.

Ekerogo keria ki’oboruoti nigo kiabwate ekeriinero kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na ekemo; ensemo ya nyuma ekerogo keria nigo kiamurumuntire igoro. Kera ensemo y’ekerogo mbiarengeo ebisiirero ase arenge gotoorera amaboko, na emegwekano ye chindo ebere yatenenirieo, oyomo ase kera ensemo.
Na emegwekano ye chindo ikomi na ebere yatenenirie aroro, oyomo ase kera ensemo ya kera egetambokero. Omogwekano bw’ekerogo buna ekio tona koroisigwa ase obogambi bonde bwonsi.

Ebikombe bionsi bi’okonywera bi’omoruoti Sulemani nigo biarenge ebie chitahabu, na ebikorero bionsi bi’Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni nigo biarenge bie chitahabu chichenire; binde tibiarenge bie chifeta. Ase amatuko a Sulemani efeta tiyabarire ng’a negento kie rigori.

Omoruoti nabwate chimeeri chiaye chia Tarisisi chiarenge goeta chinyancha amo ne chimeeri chia Hiramu. Ara rimo ase emiaka etato chimeeri chia Tarisisi nigo chiarenge gocha chiarenta chitahabu ne chifeta, na amaino e chinchogu, ne chingoge amo ne chinyoni chi’ebieni ebiya.
Ase igo omoruoti Sulemani akaba omonene kobua abaruoti bonsi b’ense ase obonda na obong’aini.
Abanto korwa ase chinse chionsi bagacha ase Sulemani, erinde baigwe obong’aini boria Nyasae abegete ime yaye.
Kera oyomo obo akaba okorenta ebiegwa biaye, ebinto bie chifeta, na ebie chitahabu, ne chianga, na ebirwanero, na ebinsari, ne chibarasi, ne chiyombo, ebinto ebinge mono, omwaka ase omwaka.

Omoruoti Sulemani agasangereria amo chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa; nigo abwate chigari elifu eyemo, na amagana ane (1,400) ne chibarasi chikoriinwa chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000). Echinde ase echio nigo chiabegetwe ase emechie ye chigari, ne chinde chikabekwa Yerusalemu ang’e ase omoruoti amenyete.
Omoruoti akarenta chifeta chinyinge agwo Yerusalemu, chikabucha buna amagena, ne chibao chi’emecharake chiarenge chinyinge buna echi’emeko yarenge ase ense omweya.
Sulemani nigo arenge korenterwa chibarasi korwa Misiri na Kue; na abaonchoreria baye igo barenge gochirenta korwa agwo ase ogoakana rigori gete.

Kera egari yarenge korentwa korwa Misiri nigo yarenge goakanerwa rigori rie chisekeli chie chifeta amagana atano na rimo, na ebarasi nigo yarenge goakanerwa chisekeli rigana erimo, na emerongo etano. Na goetera ase abaonchoreria b’omoruoti abaruoti bonsi b’Abahiti na ab’Abasiiria nigo barenge kogora chigari ne chibarasi.

Omoruoti Sulemani nigo anchete abakungu abange b’abanto b’ebisaku bitamomanyete Nyasae. Amo nomosubati o Farao naende nigo anchete abakungu b’Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abaedomu, na Abasidoni, na Abahiti,

abanto b’ebisakubiria Omonene akanetie Abaisraeli, akabatebia, “Timobaisa konyuomerana nabarabwo, ekiagera ekeene, nigo baraonchore chinkoro chiaino, erinde mogwe na koonchokera chinyasae chiabo.” Sulemani akabwatana nabarabwo, akabancha.
Igo anyuomete abakungu amagana atano na abere, naende nabwate abakungu ba sere‐sere amagana atato. Abakungu baria baye bakaonchora enkoro yaye, erinde agatiga Omonene.
Ee, ekero Sulemani konya agotire, abakungu baye bakaonchora enkoro yaye gochia ase chinyasae chinde, na ere tabete omwegenwa ase Omonene, Nyasae oye, buna Daudi ise arenge nenkoro y’obwegenwa.
Sulemani igo atunyanete na gokorera Asitaroti, enyasae enkungu y’Abasidoni, na Milikomu, okogechia kw’Abaamoni.
Sulemani agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, tamotunyanete ase obwegenwa, buna Daudi ise arenge gokora.
Moocha ya Yerusalemu Sulemani akaroisia aase aimokererete igoro ase Kemosi, okogechia kw’Abamoabu, na ase Moleki, okogechia kw’Abaamoni, chinyasae chiria, chiarenge agosasimerwa.
Naboigo aroiseretie abakungu baye bonsi baria anyuomete korwa ase ebisaku ebiaao; barabwo bagasamba ubani na bakarua ebing’wanso ase chinyasae chiabo.
Omonene akaba nendamwamu ase Sulemani, ekiagera enkoro yaye yaonchogete korwa asare ere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oria omoorokerete ara kabere,
naende konya amochikire ase ring’ana erio, ng’a tabaisa gotunyana chinyasae chinde. Korende Sulemani tarenda amang’ana ayio Omonene amochigete.

Ase ayio Omonene agatebia Sulemani, “Ekiagera gwakorire ayio, na tikwabwatete okobwatana kw’ogotianania, gose amachiko aane aya nagochigete, goika ntandorane na ndusie oboruoti korwa asore, imboe omosomba oo.
Korende ase engencho ya Daudi ise tingokora ayio ase amatuko ao, korende nigo ndabotandorane korwa ase okoboko kw’omwana oo.
Nonya naboigo, tinkorusia oboruoti bwonsi korwa ase omwana oo, nimoe egesaku ekemo, ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, naende ase engencho ya Yerusalemu, omochie oria nachorete.”
Omonene akarentera Sulemani omobisa, na omobisa oyio nere Hadadi, omonto bw’enyomba y’oboruoti bwa Edomu.

Ase engaki Daudi arenge agwo Edomu, Yoabu, omochiki bw’emeganda y’esegi, akagenda gotindeka baria baitetwe. Ere na Abaisraeli bonsi barenge komo bagatigara agwo Edomu ase engaki y’emetienyi etano nomo, bagaita na gosiria kegima kera omosacha bw’aroro.
Korende Hadadi agatama gochia Misiri amo nabanto bande b’Edomu, abasomba ba ise. Na ekero keria Hadadi nigo arenge omosae omoke.

Bakarua Midiani, bakagenda bagaika Parani, naende bakagenda amo nabanto bande korwa Parani, bagaika Misiri. Aroro bakagenda ase Farao, omoruoti o Misiri. Ere akamoa enyomba, naende akamochikera endagera arenge koba okonyora botambe; boigo akamoa oboremo.
Hadadi akanyora ogwancherwa okonene ase obosio bwa Farao, na Farao akamonyuomeria mokoyoye, omoiseke omwabo Tapenesi mokaye, oyio orenge eting’ana.
Na omoiseke omwabo Tapenesi akaiborera Hadadi Genubati, omwana omomura. Tapenesi agatacha omwana oyio agwo ase enyomba ya Farao, na Genubati akabeera ase enyomba ya Farao amo nabana abamura ba Farao.

Hadadi, ekero arenge ase ense ya Misiri, akaigwa ng’a Daudi orarire ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, naende ng’a Yoabu, omochiki bw’emeganda y’esegi, nere okure, agatebia Farao, “Ing’a ribaga ngende ase ense yane.”
Korende Farao akamoboria, “Ngento ki kwaremeirwe aiga asende ekiagera okoboria ribaga ogende ase ense yao?” Hadadi akamoiraneria, “Aye ntiga rioka, ngende.”
Naende Nyasae akarentera Sulemani omobisa onde, na omobisa oyio nere Resoni, mosinto bw’Eliada, oria konya otamire korwa ase omonene oye Hadadeseri, omoruoti o Soba.

Agwo kare ekero Daudi akoorire ogoita koria okonene ase egati yabo, oyio Resoni agasangereria abanto asare, na akaba omotang’ani bw’ekeombe keria ki’abaomboganu. Barabwo bakagenda Damesiki, bakaba bakogambera abanto b’aroro.
Resoni nigo abete omobisa bw’Abaisraeli ase amatuko onsi aya Sulemani arenge kogamba, agakora ogosaria okonene buna Hadadi akorete; akagechia Abaisraeli, akaba okogambera Abasiiria.
Oyomo bw’abasomba ba Sulemani nigo arenge korokwa Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, Omoefarati o Sereda. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Serua, ere nigo arenge omoboraka. Yeroboamu akaanga koigwera omoruoti.
Aya naro agerete Yeroboamu akaba mamincha y’omoruoti. Sulemani nigo aagachete Milo, na agaticha egetongo kiarenge ase Omochie o Daudi ise.

Omonto oria Yeroboamu nigo arenge omonto ore nomokia mono, na ekero Sulemani amoroche ng’a nigo arenge omokong’u ase emeremo yaye, akamobeka akaba omoteneneri igoro ase emeremo eria abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu barenge kobetererigwa gokora.

Na ase engaki eria, ekero Yeroboamu agendete isiko korwa Yerusalemu, omobani Ahiya korwa Silo akanyorana nere inchera. Ahiya igo ambarete egetambaa ekeyia; bono abanto aba babere bakaba boka aase aarabu.
Ahiya akabwata egetambaa keria ekeyia ambarete, akagetandora ebing’ese ikomi na bibere,

agatebia Yeroboamu, “Eimokerie aye omonyene ebing’ese ebi ikomi, ekiagera aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atebire: Rora inche igo inde ang’e gotandorana oboruoti mborusie korwa ase okoboko gwa Sulemani, nkoe ebisaku ikomi.
Korende Sulemani ere atware egesaku ekemo, ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, na ase engencho ya Yerusalemu, omochie oria nachorete korwa ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli.

Aya nigo arakoreke, ekiagera bantigire na basasimire Asitaroti, enyasae enkungu y’Abasidoni, na Kemosi, enyasae y’Abamoabu, na Milikomu, enyasae y’Abaamoni, gose tibabwateti chinchera chiane na tibakorete ayare amaronge ase obosio bwane ase okorenda emeroberio yane echikire na amachiko aane, buna Daudi ise akorete.

Nonya naboigo tinkorusia oboruoti bwonsi korwa ase okoboko gwa Sulemani, korende nimobeke abe omogambi ase engaki y’amatuko aye onsi are moyo. Aya ninkore ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, oria nachorete, oria orendete amachiko aane amachenu na emeroberio yane echikire.
Nindusie oboruoti korwa ase okoboko kw’omwana oye; aye noegwe ebisaku ikomi,
korende omwana oye nimoe egesaku ekemo, erio Daudi, omosomba one, botambe atware etaya ekomoreka ase obosio bwane agwo Yerusalemu, omochie nachorire mbeke erieta riane aroro.
Ninkobeke ogambe igoro ase bionsi buna omoyo oo oganetie, naye nobe omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli.

Koranyigwere na okore onsi aya nagochikire na obwatie chinchera chiane, na okore ayare amaronge ase amaiso aane ase okorenda emeroberio yane na amachiko aane buna Daudi, omosomba one, akorete, rirorio nimbe amo naye. Naende ningotenenerie egesaku kegendererete, buna nateneneretie Daudi, ninkobeke ogambere Abaisraeli.
Ase enchera eyio ninchande abanto b’ororeria rwa Daudi, korende tekoba igo kogenderera botambe.”
Sulemani akarigia goita Yeroboamu, korende Yeroboamu akaimoka, agatama gochia Misiri, ase Sisaki, omoruoti o Misiri, akamenya agwo Misiri goika ekero Sulemani akwete.
Bono amang’ana onsi igoro ya Sulemani, na aya onsi akorete, na obong’aini bwaye bwonsi nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora gwa Sulemani.
Engaki Sulemani agambete agwo Yerusalemu igoro ase Abaisraeli nemiaka emerongo ene.
Erio Sulemani akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi ise, na Rehoboamu, omomura oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga ria ise.
Rehoboamu akagenda Sekemu, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi konya bachiire aroro komobeka abe omoruoti.

Na ekero Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, aigwete amang’ana ayio, akairana korwa Misiri aaria ase atamete gochia korwa ase omoruoti Sulemani. Abanto bakarangeria Yeroboamu, na ere amo nomosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bakagenda, bagatebia Rehoboamu,
“Iso igo akorete rikorogoto riaito rikaba ririto. Ase ayio bono aye orikore ribe rigusu, bwororobie emeremo eria emekong’u iso atobekerete, naintwe natogokorere.”
Rehoboamu akabatebia, “Genda inwe, na nyuma y’amatuko atato moirane gocha aa asende.” Ase ayio abanto bakagenda.
Erio omoruoti Rehoboamu akaboria ogosemia korwa ase abagaaka baria barenge gosemia Sulemani ise, ekero arenge moyo, akababoria, “Ngosemia ki mokong’a, erinde imbairanerie abanto aba?”
Abagaaka bakamoiraneria, “Onye koganetie gokorera abanto aba bono, oigwe okoboria kwabo na okwane amang’ana amaya asebare, erio barabwo nababe bakogokorera botambe.”
Korende Rehoboamu akaanga ogosemia kw’abagaaka baria na akarigia ogosemia korwa ase abamura baria bakinete komo, na bono barenge komokorera.
Akababoria, “Ngosemia ki morang’e? Ninki ndairanerie abanto aba bamboretie ng’a inyororobie chigurube chiria tata ababekerete?”

Abamura baria bakinete komo bakamotebia, “Aya naro oratebie abanto abwo bakoboretie ng’a bwororobie rikorogoto riria iso akorete ririto: Ekiara gi’okoboko kwane nigo kere ekenetu kobua ekebono gia tata.

Na bono rikorogoto riria rikong’u tata ababekerete, inche nigo ndarimente ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabe nkobang’wania ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi mesia.”
Yeroboamu amo nabanto bonsi bagacha ase Rehoboamu rituko ria gatato, buna omoruoti abatebetie ng’a bakore.
Omoruoti akairaneria abanto baria amang’ana ase obotindi, akaanga ogosemia kw’abagaaka baria.

Agakwana nabarabwo buna abamura baria bamosemetie, agateba, “Tata nigo akorete rikorogoto riaino rikaba ririto, korende inche nimbamentere ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabang’wanie ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi mesia.”

Ase ayio omoruoti taigwerete amang’ana ’abanto. Ayio nigo akorekanete n’Omonene, erinde ere anyare goikerania ring’ana riaye riria akwanete ase Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, goetera ase Ahiya, omobani oria korwa Silo.

Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baroche ng’a omoruoti nigo aangete kobaigwera, bakamoiraneria, bakamotebia, “Ngetari ki intwe tobwate ase Daudi? Titori nomwando na mosinto o Yese. Inwe Abaisraeli, genda kera omonto bwoye! Inwe abanto ba Daudi, erende inwe abanyene!” Ase igo Abaisraeli bakarua aroro agwo, bakagenda ase chinka chiabo.
Rehoboamu agatigwa okogambera Abaisraeli baria bamenyete ase emechie y’Abayuda yoka.

Erio omoruoti Rehoboamu agatoma Adorama, oria otenenerete emeremo y’okobetererigwa, gochia ase Abaisraeli, na barabwo bonsi bakamoaka amagena, agakwa; na Rehoboamu akaimoka bwango, akariina egari yaye, agatama gochia Yerusalemu.
Ase ayio Abaisraeli babeire bare mamincha na gosaria igoro ase enyomba ya Daudi goika rero iga.

Na ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baigwete ng’a Yeroboamu oiranire, bagatoma abanto bamorangerie ache ase omosangererekano, bakamobeka akaba omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli. Omonto onde tari otunyanete abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, otatiga abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda boka.

Ekero Rehoboamu achete Yerusalemu, agasangereria abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya Yuda, na egesaku kia Benjamin, abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato, abamanyete korwana esegi, bagende korwania Abaisraeli na bairanie oboruoti ase Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani.
Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae rigacha ase Semaya, omonto o Nyasae,
rikamotebia, “Tebia Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, otebie nabanto bonsi b’enyomba ya Yuda, na aba eya Benjamin, na abanto bande abatigari ng’a:

Aya naro Omonene atebire: Inwe timogenda korwania abanto bamino Abaisraeli. Irana kera omonto nka bwoye, ekiagera aya akorekire nigo akoretwe nainche.” Ase ayio abanto bakaigwera ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakairana gochia chinka chiabo, buna abatebetie.
Erio Yeroboamu akaagacha omochie Sekemu ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, akamenya aroro, naende akarua agwo, akagenda akaagacha Penueli.
Yeroboamu akarengereria ase enkoro yaye ime, “Bono oboruoti igo borabaise koirana bogende ase enyomba ya Daudi.

Abanto aba baise kona kogenda korua ebing’wanso ase enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu, chinkoro chiabo nigo chiramoiranere omonene obo Rehoboamu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, na kobaramoiranere nigo barang’ite.”

Ekero omoruoti arengereretie amang’ana ayio, akaroisia korwa ase etahabu emegwekano ebere ye chimori, agatebia abanto, “Igo mogochandeka mono kona kogenda Yerusalemu. Inwe Abaisraeli, rora aiga chinyasae chiaino, echi chiabarusetie ase ense ya Misiri.”
Akabeka eyemo Beteli na eya kabere agwo Dani.
Egento eke gekagera bagakora ebibe, ekiagera abanto igo bagendete nonya ngoika Dani gosasima enyasae eyemo y’echio.
Naende Yeroboamu akaroisia aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, agachora abakuani korwa ase egati y’abanto bonsi abwo batarenge Abalawi.

Yeroboamu agachika Rituko Rinene ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o gatano na gatato, buna omogwekano bwe Rituko Rinene ase Abayuda. Ase egesasimero agwo Beteli ere omonyene akarua ebing’wanso ase emegwekano eria ye chimori aroisetie. Naende agwo Beteli akabeka abakuani b’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa konya aroisirie.

Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano, ase omotienyi o gatano na gatato, omotienyi achorete ere omonyene, akagenda ase egesasimero aroisetie, agatwara Rituko Rinene ase Abaisraeli na akariina ase egesasimero gosamba ubani.
Ase ogochika kw’Omonene omonto o Nyasae akarua ase ense ya Yuda. Ere agacha Beteli ekero Yeroboamu ateneine ase egesasimero gosamba ubani.

Na ase ogochika kw’Omonene omonto oria agaaka eriogi, akarera mamincha y’egesasimero, agateba, “Obee! Aye egesasimero, aye egesasimero! Omonene otebire iga: Rora, omwana omomura naiborwe ase enyomba ya Daudi, erieta riaye Yosia; ere nang’wansere igoro yao aye egesasimero, abakuani b’aase aimokererete igoro, baria bagosambera ubani igoro yao na amauga ’abanto nasamberwe igoro yao.”
Omonto oria o Nyasae akarua ekemanyererio ase rituko riria, agateba, “Eke nakio ekemanyererio Omonene akwanire: Rora, egesasimero eke nagetandoke, ne ribu riria rire igoro yaye riiteke.”

Ekero omoruoti Yeroboamu aigwete ogokwana okwo kw’omonto oria o Nyasae, koria arentete maminncha y’egesasimero agwo Beteli, akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa ase egesasimero, agateba, “Bwata omonto oyo!” Okoboko koria kwaye aramborete gochia ase omonto oria gokooma pa, goika tanyarete naende gokoringa.
Egesasimero boigo kegatandoka, ne ribu rigaiteka koreng’ana buna ekemanyererio keria giatebetwe nomonto oria o Nyasae ase ogochika kw’Omonene.

Omoruoti agatebia omonto oria o Nyasae, “Sorora Omonene na onsabere inyore ogwancherwa, erinde okoboko kwane kogwene.” Na omonto oria o Nyasae agasorora Omonene, na okoboko kw’omoruoti gokaba buna kwarenge ritang’ani.
Erio omoruoti agatebia omonto oria o Nyasae, “Inchuo togende nyomba mwane, otimokere aroro, onyore chinguru naende, nainche ninkoe ekeegwa.”
Omonto oria o Nyasae akairaneria omoruoti, “Noisa kong’a ekeng’ese ki’obotenenku bwao, tinkogenda amo naye, gose tinkoria endagera gose konywa amache aase aiga.
Naboigo nachikwa n’Omonene goetera ase ring’ana riaye. Ere agantebia: Tobaisa koria endagera ende yonsi, gose konywa amache, gose tobaisa koiranera ase enchera eria gwachiereteo.”
Ase ayio agaetera enchera eng’ao, tairanera ase enchera eria acherete agwo Beteli.

Narenge omobani omogotu oyomo omenyete agwo Beteli. Abana baye abamura bagacha, bakamotebia amang’ana onsi omonto oria o Nyasae akorete ase rituko riria agwo Beteli, bakamotebia na amang’ana akwanete nomoruoti.
Ise abamura baria akababoria “Nchera ki agenda?” Na abamura baye bakamworokia enchera omonto oria o Nyasae orwete ense ya Yuda agendete.
Omobani oria omogotu agatebia abamura baye, “Imbekere etigere egeikaransero.” Erio bakabekera etigere egeikaransero, na omobani oria akariina etigere eria,
akabwatia omonto oria o Nyasae, akamonyora oikaransete inse y’omote onga buna omotontera, akamoboria, “Naye omonto oria o Nyasae ochicha korwa ense ya Yuda?” Omoto oria akairaneria, “Ee, ninche.”
Omobani oria omogotu agatebia omonto oria o Nyasae, “Inchuo togende nka bwone, torie endagera.”
Korende omobani oria orwete ense ya Yuda akamoiraneria, “Tinkoirana amo naye, gose tingwancha ondoisie nyomba mwao; tinkoria endagera amo naye gose konywa amache aase aiga.
Naboigo nachikwa n’Omonene goetera ase ring’ana riaye, agantebia: Tobaisa koria endagera gose konywa amache aase aria, gose tobaisa koirana enchera gwachiereteo.”

Omobani oria omogotu akamotebia, “Nainche igo inde omobani buna aye, na omomalaika nigo achigetwe n’Omonene agantebia: Genda omoiranie ache amo naye goika nyomba mwao, arie endagera na konywa amache.” Korende igo amotebetie oborimo.
Ase ayio omonto oria o Nyasae akairana amo nomobani oria omogotu, akaria endagera na konywa amache ase enyomba yaye.
Na ekero barenge baikaransete ase emesa, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase omobani oria omogotu, oria omoiranetie;

ere agaaka eriogi, akarera ase omonto oria o Nyasae orwete ense ya Yuda, akabora, “Omonene otebire ng’a kwangire koigwera ring’ana riaye, naende torendeti ogochika koria Omonene, Nyasae oo, agochigete.

Ribaga ri’ayio kwairanire, naende kwarire endagera na kwanyure amache aase aiga. Aya Omonene agokanetie ng’a tokora igo. Ekiagera gwakorire igo, omobere oo gokwete tokonyara kobekwa ase chimbeera chie chisokoro chiao.”
Ekero omobani oria omogotu akoorire koria na konywa, akabekera etigere egeikaransero ase omobani oria airanetie araikaranse.

Na ekero omobani oria orwete ense ya Yuda arenge ase orogendo inchera, akaumerana nendo, ero ekamoita agakwa. Omobere oye ogatugutwa ase enchera, na etigere na endo chigatenena mbarabare ase omobere oria.

Abanto bagaeta aase aria, bakarora omobere otugutire ase enchera, na endo eteneine mbarabare ase omobere oria. Barabwo bakagenda bagateba amang’ana ayio ase abanto b’omochie, agwo ase omobani oria omogotu amenyete.

Na ekero omobani oria omoiranetie korwa inchera, aigwete amang’ana ayio, agateba, “Oyio nomonto oria o Nyasae bwangete koigwera ring’ana ri’Omonene; ase ayio, n’Omonene omorua ase endo, nero yamotandoire na komoita, koreng’ana buna Omonene amotebetie.”
Erio agatebia abamura baye, “Imbekere etigere egeikaransero.” Nabarabwo bagakora bo.
Ere akagenda, akanyora omobere otugutire ase enchera, na etigere na endo chiteneine mbarabare ase omobere oria. Endo tiyariete omobere oria, gose tiyaitete etigere eria, gose koyetandora.
Omobani oria akaimokia omobere oria bw’omonto o Nyasae, akayobeka ase etigere igoro, erio akayoirania gochia ase omochie oye omonyene, akamoreera na akamotindeka.
Ere akabeka omobere oria ase embeera yaye omonyene, na barabwo bakamoreera, na kera oyomo agateba, “Obee! Momura ominto!”
Ekero akoorire komotindeka agatebia abamura baye, “Ekero nainche ndakwe, montindeke ime ase embeera eyio ase omonto o Nyasae atindekire; mwarerie amauga aane mbarabare ase amauga aye.
Ekeene, amang’ana aria araretie buna achigetwe n’Omonene, agasoera egesasimero agwo Beteli, naende agasoera aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa aria ase emechie ya Samaria, goika aikeranigwe.”

Nonya ayio onsi abete, Yeroboamu taonchogete korwa ase chinchera chiaye chimbe, korende akagenderera kobeka abakuani b’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa korwa ase egati y’abanto bande bonsi. Omonto onde bwensi arigetie, nigo amwatananete koba omokuani bw’aase aria aimokererete igoro.
Amang’ana ayio nigo abete ebibe ase enyomba ya Yeroboamu, na akagera ekanachwa na egasirigwa kegima korwa ase ense.
Ase engaki eria Abiya, omomura o Yeroboamu akarwara.

Ase ayio Yeroboamu agatebia mokaye, “Imoka, bwekone ase ogwetuba, erinde tomanyekana ng’a aye moka Yeroboamu; ogende Silo. Ahiya omobani nao akare, oria ontebetie ng’a nimbe omoruoti igoro ase abanto aba.
Oire amo naye emegati ikomi, na amaandasi, na obooke egetono ekemo, ogende asare; ere nagotebie egento kegochia gokororekana ase omwana.”
Moka Yeroboamu akaimoka akagenda Silo, agacha ase enyomba y’Ahiya. Bono Ahiya tarenge korora, ekiagera amaiso aye konya oukoire ase engencho y’obogotu.

Omonene agakwana n’Ahiya, akamotebia, “Rora, moka Yeroboamu ngocha are gokoboria amanye igoro y’omwana oye ore omorwaire. Aya na aya naro oramotebie.” Ekero omokungu oria achete asare agekora buna omokungu omoao.

Korende ekero Ahiya aigwete eriogi ri’amagoro aye agotitiria, na ekero omokungu oria arenge gocha ase egesieri, Ahiya akamotebia, “Inchuo soa nyomba, aye moka Yeroboamu! Nase ki ogwekora koba buna omokungu omoao? Nachikirwe kogotebia amang’ana amakong’u.
Genda otebie Yeroboamu: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Nakoimokereretie igoro korwa ase egati y’abanto, naende ngakobeka okaba omoraai bw’abanto baane Abaisraeli.

Naende ngatandorana oboruoti, nkaborusia korwa ase enyomba ya Daudi, ngakoboa aye, korende aye tobeti buna Daudi, omosomba one arenge, oria orendete amachiko aane, na agantunyana nenkoro yaye yonsi. Ere agakora onsi ayare amaronge ase amaiso aane.

Korende aye gwakorire ayare amabe goetania baria bonsi bagotang’anerete. Naende gwekoreire chinyasae ching’ao, na kweroiseirie emegwekano enyititoire na kobombwa, na igo kwangechirie goika nabeire nendamwamu kwangire na konyeba.

Ase ayio, rora, nindete obobe igoro ase enyomba yao aye Yeroboamu, ninsirie kegima kera omonto omosacha korwa ase enyomba yao, abasomba amo nabatari abasomba, ase egati y’Abaisraeli. Ninsirie kegima enyomba yao aye Yeroboamu, buna omonto akwabusa obonyira bwarua, kegima.

Omonto onde bwensi bw’enyomba ya Yeroboamu orakwere ase omochie ime, chisese nachimorie, na onde bwensi orakwere isiko aarabu, chinyoni chia igoro nachimorie, ekiagera Omonene nere okwanire ring’ana eri.
“Ase ayio, genda nka bwoo. Ekero amagoro ao agosoa ase omochie omwana oria nakwe.

Abaisraeli bonsi mbamoreere na komotindeka. Omwana oria bweka ase eamate ya Yeroboamu, nere oratindekwe ase embeera ime, ekiagera asere oyio Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ororire egento kiamogokirie korwa ase enyomba ya Yeroboamu.
Korende Omonene nechorere omoruoti oragambere Abaisraeli, na omoruoti oyio nasirie kegima enyomba ya Yeroboamu, na ayio nakoreke korwa bono.

Omonene naake Abaisraeli abanyegerie buna egetonto gekonyegerigwa ime ase amache, nabasimore barue ase ense eye engiya aete chisokoro chiabo, abasiarere gochia ng’umbu y’Eufarati, ekiagera barabwo bakorire emete y’Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, na igo bagechirie Omonene obeire nendamwamu.
Ere natige Abaisraeli ase engencho y’ebibe ebi Yeroboamu akorete, akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.”
Erio moka Yeroboamu akaimoka, akagenda Tirisa, na ekero agotamboka omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri ki’enyomba omwana oria agakwa.
Na Abaisraeli bonsi bakamotindeka na komoreera, koreng’ana buna ring’ana riria Omonene akwanete goetera ase omobani Ahiya, omosomba oye.
Bono amang’ana ande onsi Yeroboamu akorete, buna arwanete chisegi, na buna agambete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
Yeroboamu akaba okogamba ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, na ebere. Erio akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, na Nadabu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

Bono Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani, akagambera Abayuda. Ekero achagete kogamba konya okoorire emiaka emerongo ene nomo, akaba okogamba ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi, na etano na ebere, agwo Yerusalemu, omochie oria Omonene achorete korwa ase egati y’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, erinde abeke erieta riaye aroro. Ng’ina Rehoboamu nigo arenge korokwa Naama, omosubati bw’Abaamoni.
Abayuda bagakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakagera akaba nendamwamu ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bakorete ebinge goetania ebi bionsi chisokoro chiabo chiakorete.
Barabwo bakeagachera aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, ne chisiiro, na emete y’Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, igoro ase ebigoro bionsi na inse ya kera omote omobese.
Mbarenge aroro ase ense eria abasacha abanyaka bakarigania ase obosooku. Abanto abwo bagakora okogechia konde gwonsi okwo abanto b’ebisaku biria Omonene aseretie korwa ase Abaisraeli barenge gokora.
Ase omwaka o gatano bw’okogamba kwa Rehoboamu, Sisaki, omoruoti o Misiri, agacha, akarwania Yerusalemu.
Akaira chikungo chionsi chi’enyomba y’Omonene na echi’enyomba y’omoruoti, akaira kera egento. Boigo akaira chinguba chionsi chi’etahabu, chiria Sulemani aroisetie.
Erio Rehoboamu omoruoti akagoncha chinguba chi’etaai ribaga rie chinguba chiria chi’etahabu, agachibeka ase amaboko ’abanene b’oborendi, baria barenge korenda egesieri ki’enyomba y’omoruoti.
Botambe ekero omoruoti arenge gosoa ase enyomba y’Omonene, abarendi nigo barenge gochibogoria, naende bachiirania ase enyomba y’oborendi.
Na bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Rehoboamu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
Esegi nigo yagendererete botambe ase egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.

Rehoboamu akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa aase chiatindegetwe, ase omochie o Daudi. Ng’ina Rehoboamu nigo arenge korokwa Naama, omosubati bw’Abaamoni. Abiyamu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na gatato bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, Abiyamu agachaka kogambera Abayuda,
akaba okogamba ase engaki y’emiaka etato agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Maaka, omosubati bw’Abisalomu.
Abiyamu akabwatia chingencho chia ise ase ogokora ebibe, na tarenge nobwegenwa bw’enkoro ase Omonene, Nyasae oye, buna Daudi, sokororia yaye arenge.
Korende nonya naboigo, ase engencho ya Daudi Omonene, Nyasae oye, akamoa etaya agwo Yerusalemu ase ogotenenia omwana oye agambe, naende agakong’ia Yerusalemu.

Aya igo akoregete, ekiagera Daudi nigo akorete ayare amaronge ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ase obogima bwaye bwonsi, tamochete gokora kende gionsi Omonene amochigete, otatiga ase amang’ana a Uria Omohiti oka amochete.
Esegi nigo yagendererete koba egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu ase obogima bwonsi bwa Rehoboamu.
Amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Abiyamu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda. Na esegi nigo yarenge ase egati y’Abiyamu na Yeroboamu.
Abiyamu akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi, na Asa, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere bw’okogamba kwa Yeroboamu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, Asa agachaka kogambera Abayuda.
Ere akaba okogamba ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, nomo, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina Asa nigo are korokwa Maaka, mosubati bw’Abisalomu.
Asa agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, buna Daudi, sokororia yaye, akorete.
Agasiria korwa ase ense eria abasacha baria abanyaka barenge korigania ase obosooku, naende akarusia aroro emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, eria chisokoro chiaye chiaroisetie.

Boigo Asa akarusia Maaka ng’ina taba eting’ana, ekiagera nabwate omogwekano orenge okogechia oroiseretigwe Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, akabutora na akaiyeria inse omogwekano oria ng’ina abwate, akayosambera agwo ase akarooche ga Kidironi.
Korende aase aimokererete igoro tarusetigweo. Nonya naboigo, ase obogima bwaye bwonsi Asa nigo arenge nenkoro y’obwegenwa ase Omonene.
Akarenta ase enyomba y’Omonene ebiegwa ebi ise na ere omonyene baatananete bikaba ebichenu, chifeta, ne chitahabu, na ebikorero.
Esegi nigo yagendererete koba egati y’Asa na Baasa, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, ase amatuko abo onsi.

Baasa, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akagenda korwania Abayuda, akagitera omochie o Rama chindwaki, ng’a nario ribaga ritabaisa gotoka ase omonto onde bwensi gosoka gose gosoa kogenda ase Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda.

Erio Asa akarusia chifeta chionsi, ne chitahabu chionsi, echio chiatigarete ase chikungo chi’enyomba y’Omonene, na echi’enyomba y’omoruoti, agachibeka ase amaboko ’abasomba baye. Erio agatoma ebinto ebio gochia ase Damesiki ase Beni‐Hadadi, mosinto o Tabirimoni, o Hesioni, omoruoti o Siiria, amenyete, agateba,

“Tiga okobwatana kw’ogotianania kobe ase egati yane naye, buna kwarenge ase egati ya tata na iso. Rora nagotomeire ekeegwa gie chifeta ne chitahabu. Genda osarie okobwatana okwo kwao gwakorete na Baasa, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, erinde arue ase ense yane antigane.”

Beni‐Hadadi akaigwera Asa omoruoti, agatoma abatang’ani b’abarwani baye, bakagenda bakarwania emechie y’Abaisraeli, bakabua Iyoni na Dani, na Abeli‐Beti‐Maaka, na Kinereti, yonsi, amo nense yonsi ya Nafutali.
Na ekero Baasa aigwete amang’ana ayio, agatiga kogitera omochie o Rama, akagenda komenya agwo Tirisa.

Erio omoruoti Asa akarua okoraria ase Abayuda bonsi, nonya nomonnto oyomo tatigetwe otakonye koira amagena a Rama, amo ne chibao chiarengeo, ebinto ebio bionsi Baasa arenge kogitera omochie oria; na ase ebinto ebio omoruoti Asa akagitera Geba ase orogongo rwa Benjamin amo na Misipa.
Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Asa, okobua kwaye na onsi aya akorete na emechie aagachete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda. Korende ekero ki’obogotu bwaye akarwara amagoro.
Asa akarara, ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase omochie o Daudi, sokororia yaye, na Yehosafati, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
Nadabu, mosinto o Yeroboamu, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli ase omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akagamba ase engaki y’emiaka ebere.
Ere agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, akabwatia chinchera chia ise ase ogokora ebibe ebio bikagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.

Baasa, mosinto bw’Ahiya, omonto bw’enyomba ya Isakaru, agakora omoroberio bw’ogoita Nadabu, akamoaka, akamoitera agwo Gibetoni, omochie bw’Abafilisti. Nadabu na Abaisraeli bonsi nigo bebisete baboerete Gibetoni.
Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, noro Baasa, akamoita, naende akaba okogamba ribaga riaye.

Na obwango boria abete omoruoti, agaita abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya Yeroboamu, tatigaretie nonya nomonto oyomo ore moyo ase abanto baye, korende akabasiria kegima, koreng’ana ne ring’ana riria Omonene akwanete goetera ase omosomba oye Ahiya, omonto korwa Silo.
Aya nigo akoregete ase engencho y’ebibe bia Yeroboamu biria akorete, naende akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe, na ase engencho y’ayio Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akaba nendamwamu.
Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Nadabu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
Esegi nigo yagendererete koba egati y’Asa na Baasa, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, ase obogima bwabo bwonsi.
Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Baasa, mosinto bw’Ahiya, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli bonsi agwo Tirisa, na akagamba ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere na ene.
Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, akabwatia chinchera chia Yeroboamu ase ogokora ebibe ebio bikagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yehu, mosinto o Hanani, rigakwana mamincha ya Baasa, rigateba,

“Nigo nakoimokereretie igoro korwa ase orotu, ngakobeka okaba omoraai bw’abanto baane Abaisraeli, na bono aye kwabwatirie chinchera chia Yeroboamu, naende kwagerire abanto baane Abaisraeli bakorire ebibe na bangechirie goika nabeire nendamwamu ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.
Ase ayio ningosirie kegima, aye Baasa amo nabanto b’enyomba yao ebe buna enyomba ya Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati.
Omonto onde bwensi ore bw’enyomba ya Baasa orakwere ase omochie ime, chisese nachimorie, na onde bwensi orakwere isiko aarabu, chinyoni chia igoro nachimorie.”
Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Baasa, na aya onsi akorete, na okobua kwaye, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
Baasa akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete agatindekwa agwo Tirisa, na Ela omwana oye omomura akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

Naboigo ring’ana ri’Omonene rikarentwa nomobani Yehu, mosinto o Hanani, igoro ya Baasa na abanto b’enyomba yaye, ase engencho y’amabe onsi akorete ase amaiso ’Omonene. Omonene akagechigwa goika akaba nendamwamu ase engencho y’ayio onsi Baasa akorete ase okoba buna abanto b’enyomba ya Yeroboamu; boigo ekiagera asiretie abanto abwo.
Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere na etano nomo bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Ela, mosinto o Baasa, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli agwo Tirisa, akagamba emiaka ebere.

Korende omosomba oye Simuri, omochiki bw’ekeng’ese gie chigari chiaye, agakora omoroberio bw’okomoita. Ekero Ela arenge agwo Tirisa okonywa na gotinda ase enyomba y’Arisa, oria otenenerete enyomba y’oboruoti aroro,

Simuri agasoa nyomba, akamoaka, akamoiyeria inse na komoita. Ayio igo akorete ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere, bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda. Nyuma y’ayio Simuri akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

Ekero achagete kogamba, ase obwango boria ere ebegete omonyene goikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti, agaita abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya Baasa, tatigaretie omonto omosacha nonya noyomo ase eamate yaye gose ase abasani baye.
Ase ayio Simuri agasiria kegima enyomba yonsi ya Baasa, koreng’ana buna ring’ana riria Omonene akwanete mamincha ya Baasa goetera ase Yehu omobani.

Ayio nigo akoregete ase engencho y’ebibe bionsi bia Baasa, na ebia Ela, omwana oye. Barabwo bakagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe bikagechia Omonene bw’Abaisraeli, erinde akaba nendamwamu ase engencho y’emegwekano yabo bagosasima.
Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Ela, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ime ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.

Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere, bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Simuri akagamba ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere agwo Tirisa. Emeganda y’esegi egatoora korwania Gibetoni, omochie bw’Abafilisti.

Abanto baria batoorete aria bakaigwa ng’a Simuri okorire omoroberio bw’ogoita omoruoti. Ase ayio, ekero Abaisraeli bonsi barenge ase egetwori ase rituko riria bakabeka Omuri, omochiki bw’emeganda y’esegi, akaba omoruoti obo.
Bono Omuri akaimoka korwa Gibetoni amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi, bakagenda koboera Tirisa.
Ekero Simuri aroche ng’a omochie obwatirwe, agasoa ase eburi y’enyomba y’omoruoti, agasamba enyomba y’omoruoti, na Simuri omonyene agesamberao.
Ayio igo akoregete ase engencho y’ebibe akorete ase obosio bw’Omonene, ase okobwatia chinchera chia Yeroboamu, na ase ebibe akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Simuri, na omoroberio bw’ogoita akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
Bono Abaisraeli bagaatananeka chinsemo ibere, ekeng’ese ki’abanto bagatunyana Tibuni, mosinto o Ginati, baganetie komobeka abe omoruoti, na ekeng’ese kende bagatunyana Omuri.
Abanto abatunyanete Omuri bakabua abanto batunyanete Tibuni, mosinto o Ginati; na ekero Tibuni akure, Omuri akaba omoruoti.
Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato nomo bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Omuri agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli, akagamba emiaka ikomi na ebere; akagamba agwo Tirisa ase engaki y’emiaka etano nomo.

Akagora egetunwa gia Samaria korwa ase Semeri ase rigori rie chitalanta ibere chie chifeta, akaagacha omochie igoro yaye, akayogitera chindwaki, akaroka omochie oria aagachete Samaria, erieta ria Semeri, oyio orenge omonyene egetunwa keria.
Omuri agakora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, agakora amabe goetania baria barengeo ritang’ani riaye.

Ere nigo abwatetie chinchera chia Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, agakora ebibe buna ebiaye, boigo akagera Abaisraeli bakabikora. Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akagechigwa, akaba nendamwamu ase engencho y’emegwekano yabo bagosasima.
Bono amang’ana ande onsi Omuri akorete, na okobua okwo aorogetie, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
Omuri akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete agatindekwa agwo Samaria, na Ahabu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na gatano na gatato bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Ahabu, mosinto bw’Omuri, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli, agwo Samaria; ere akagamba emiaka emerongo ebere na ebere.
Ahabu, mosinto bw’Omuri, agakora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene goetania bonsi abamotang’anerete.

Ere akarora ng’a namang’ana amagusu kobwatia chingencho chia Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, na agakora ebibe buna ebiaye; amo nayio akanyuoma Yesebeli, omoiseke bw’Etabali, omoruoti bw’Abasidoni. Boigo agakorera enyasae Baali na koyesasima.
Agatenenia egesasimero kia Baali ime ase enyomba ya Baali, eria aagachete agwo Samaria.
Ahabu akaroisia omote bw’Asera, enyasae enkungu; agakora bobe mono goetania abaruoti bonsi baria bamotang’anerete, akagechia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, goika akaba nendamwamu.

Ase amatuko ’okogamba kwaye, Hieli o Beteli akaagacha Yeriko. Ekero abegete oboroso bw’omochie oyio, Abiiramu omwana oye omomura omotangi, agakwa; naende ekero atenenetie ebiita, Segubu, omwana oye omomura omokogoti, agakwa. Ayio igo akoregete koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene, riria riakwanetwe na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.

Elija, Omotisibi, omomenyi okorwa Gileadi, agatebia Ahabu, “Ekeene, buna Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, are moyo, ere oria ase obosio bwaye nteneine, riime gose embura tibikoba ase emiaka eye, otatiga ase ring’ana riane rioka.”
Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija, rikamotebia,
“Karue aase aiga, oonchoke gochia moocha, bwebise aroro ase akarooche ga Keriti, akwo kare moocha ya Yorodan.
Nonywe amache korwa ase akarooche karia, inche nachikire ebigonkoru bikorentere endagera aroro.”
Ase ayio Elija akagenda, agakora buna ring’ana ri’Omonene riamochigete; akagenda akamenya agwo ase akarooche ga Keriti, moocha ya Yorodan.
Ebigonkoru biria bikaba bikomorentera omogati na enyama, mambia na mogoroba; na Elija akaba okonywa amache korwa ase akarooche karia.
Nyuma y’engaki enke akarooche karia kagakama, ekiagera embura tiyarenge gotwa ase ense.
Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija rikamotebia,
“Imoka, ogende goika Sarefata, omochie o Sidoni omenye aroro. Rora nachikire omokungu omoboraka aroro orakoragerie.”

Ase ayio, akaimoka, akagenda Sarefata. Ekero aigete ang’e negeita ki’omochie, akarora omokungu omoboraka narengeo ogochora chinko. Elija akamorangeria, akamotebia, “Koranche ndetere amache make negetoono, inywe.”
Ekero omokungu oria arenge kogenda korenta amache, akamorangeria naende, akamotebia, “Ondetere negesamunye ki’omogati.”

Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, akamotebia, “Ekeene, buna Omonene, Nyasae oo, are moyo, timbwati gento kende keroisirie, otatiga mbwate obosie boisaine oroe oromo rwoka bore ekegancha, na amaguta amasinini oka are ase echuba. Bono inche nigo ngochora ebite ebi bike, erinde ndoiserie endagera asende na ase omwana one, erio torie toche tokwe.”
Elija agatebia omokungu oria, “Toiroka! Genda okore buna gwatebire, korende ritang’ani ondoiserie omogati omoke korwa ase obosio obwo, ondetere, erio nyuma yaye oroisie oyoo na oyo bw’omwana oo,
ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, otebire iga: Obosie bore ase ekegancha kiao tibokoera, na amaguta are ase echuba yao takoera, goika rituko riria Omonene aratome embura ase ense.”
Omokungu oria akagenda, agakora buna Elija amotebetie, na omokungu oria, na Elija, na abanto bonsi b’enyomba y’omokungu oria bakaba bakonyora endagera eisaine ase amatuko amange.
Obosie bwarenge ase ekegancha keria tibwaerete, gose amaguta arenge ase echuba eria taerete, koreng’ana buna ring’ana ri’Omonene, riria riakwanetwe n’Elija.
Nyuma y’ayio omwana omomura bw’omokungu oria omoboraka, omwarigania bw’Elija, akarwara. Oborwaire bw’omwana oria bokaba obonene goika bokamoita,
Omokungu oria agatebia Elija, “Aye omonto o Nyasae, mbobe ki obwate asende? Igo gwacha asende, erinde ebibe biane biinyorwe na okarenta ogokwa ase omwana one?”

Elija agatebia omokungu oria, “Renta omwana oyio oo asende.” Akaimokia omwana oria korwa ase egekuba kiaye, akamoira goika ase akanyomba ka irongo ase amenyete, akaareria omwana oria ase oborere bwaye.
Erio akarera ase Omonene, akabora, “Omonene, Nyasae one, Inee, aye nigo kwarentire amaakwa igoro ase omokungu oyo omoboraka, imenyete mwaye, ase ogoita omwana oye?
Erio akaramamera omwana oria ara gatato, naende akarera ase Omonene,” “Aye Omonene Nyasae one, tiga obomoyo bw’omwana oyo bomoiranere naende.”
Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kw’Elija, na obomoyo bw’omwana oria bokamoiranera, ere agacha moyo.
Elija akabogoria omwana oria, agatirimboka nere korwa ase akanyomba ka irongo, akamorenta enyomba ya inse, erio akamomoa ng’ina, akamotebia, “Rora omwana oo moyo are.”
Omokungu oria agatebia Elija, “Bono namanyire ng’a aye nomonto o Nyasae, naende ng’a ring’ana ri’Omonene rire ase omonwa oo neri’ekeene.”
Nyuma y’amatuko amange kaerire, ase omwaka o gatato, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija rikamotebia, “Genda bweorokie ase Ahabu, na inche nintome embura etwe igoro ase ense.”
Ase ayio Elija akagenda kweorokia ase Ahabu. Engaki eria enchara nigo yarenge endoro se agwo Samaria.
Ahabu akarangeria Obadia, oria orenge omoteneneri igoro ase enyomba yaye. (Obadia nigo asigete Omonene mono.

Ekero Yesebeli aitete ababani b’Omonene, Obadia nigo airete ababani rigana erimo, akabaatanana ebiombe bibere, kera ekeombe nigo kiabwate abanto emerongo etano, akababisa ase rikuruma, akaba okobarageria na kobaa amache bakonywa.)

Ahabu agatebia Obadia, “Togende toete ase ense yonsi na ase chinsoko chi’amache, na ase amagooko onsi; ande nabo torabaise konyora obonyansi, erinde totoorie chibarasi ne chiyombo chibe moyo, na titobaisa gosiria chitugo chinde.”
Erio bagaatanana ense eria ase egati yabo, bayetaare. Ahabu akagenda ensemo eyemo ere bweka, na Obadia ensemo ende ere bweka.
Ekero Obadia arenge inchera kogenda, rora, Elija akaumerana nere. Obadia akamomanya, agatung’ama inse, akaumama, agateba, “Inee! Oyo naye Elija, omonene one?”
Elija akamoiraneria, “Ee, ninche. Genda otebie omonene oo ng’a inche Elija nao inde aiga.”
Obadia akamoiraneria, “Mbibe ki nakorire goika ondue inche, omosomba oo, na okombeka ase okoboko kw’Ahabu, ang’ite?

Ekeene, buna Omonene, Nyasae oo, are moyo, gesaku kende tikeri, gose oboruoti, aase omonene one ataratoma abanto gochia gokorigia. Na ekero abanto b’aroro baare gokana bagoteba: Ere tari aiga, omoruoti nigo are kobaboria barie emuma y’ogwetiania, ng’a ekeene tibana gokorora.
Na bono aye nigo ogoteba ng’a ngende ntebie omonene one ng’a aye Elija nao ore aiga.

Naende nebe ase obwango ekero narure asore, Omoika bw’Omonene nogotaborie okoire aase inche ntamanyeti. Ekero nagendire gotebia Ahabu, nere ache takonyora, nigo arang’ite, nonya inche, omosomba oo, nabeire inyirogete Omonene korwa obosae bwane.

Inee! Aye omonene one tikwana gotebigwa eke nakorete ekero Yesebeli aitete ababani b’Omonene, buna nabisete ababani b’Omonene rigana erimo ase ebiombe bi’emerongo etano etano ase rikuruma ime, naende nkaba nkobarageria na kobaa amache?
Na bono aye nigo ogoteba ng’a ngende ntebie omonene one ng’a aye Elija nao ore aiga. Ere nigo arang’ite.”
Elija akairaneria, agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene bw’Emeganda are moyo, oria inche inteneine ase obosio bwaye, rero goika inyeorokie ase Ahabu.”
Ase igo Obadia akagenda, agatebia Ahabu amang’ana ayio; erio Ahabu akagenda korotota Elija.
Ekero Ahabu aroche Elija, akamoboria, “Inee! Naye oyo gwachandire Abaisraeli?”
Elija akamoiraneria, “Inche tinchandeti Abaisraeli, korende naye kwabachandire, aye amo nenyomba ya iso, ekiagera mwatigire amachiko ’Omonene na mwabwatirie chinyasae chikorokwa Baali.

Bono toma amang’ana, orangerie Abaisraeli bonsi, erinde baumerane nainche igoro ase egetunwa gia Karimeli. Orangerie na ababani ba Baali amagana ane, na emerongo etano, na ababani b’Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, amagana ane, abwo bakoragera amo na Yesebeli.”
Ase igo Ahabu agatoma abanto bagasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi na ababani bonsi ba Baali amo, agwo ase egetunwa gia Karimeli.

Elija agaika abanto bonsi ang’e, agakwana, “Ngoika ririri mogochia koba ne chitang’utang’u more nebirengererio bire ara kabere? Onye Omonene nere Nyasae, momobwatie, korende onye Baali, mobwatie ere.” Abanto bagakira kiri, tibamoiraneria nonya ne ring’ana erimo.
Erio Elija agatebia abanto, “Inche ninche bweka natigaire omobani bw’Omonene, korende ababani ba Baali namagana ane, na emerongo etano.

Renta chieri ibere motoe. Tiga ababani abwo bechorere eeri eyemo, bayenachane ebitari, babibeke igoro ase chinko, korende tibabaisa gouta omorero aroro. Inche omonyene nindoisie eeri eyio ende, inyebeke igoro ase chinko, korende ting’uta omorero.

Erio mosabe ase erieta ri’enyasae yaino na inche nsabe ase erieta ri’Omonene one; na Nyasae oria oriaranerie ase okorenta omorero, oyio nere Nyasae.” Abanto bonsi bakairaneria, “Ayio naro amang’ana amaya gwakwanire.”
Erio Elija agatebia ababani ba Baali, “Echorere eeri eyemo, erio moyeroisie ritang’ani, ekiagera inwe nabange more; mosabe ase erieta ri’enyasae yaino, korende timobaisa gouta omorero aroro.”

Bakaimokia eeri eria baetwe, bakayeroisia, bagasaba Baali ase okorangeria erieta riaye, korwa mambia goika mobaso gati bagaaka eriogi, bagoteba, “Aye Baali, toigwe, toiranerie!” Korende nonya neriogi rioka tiriarengeo, onde tabairaneretie. Bagachara‐charoka goetanana egesasimero keria baagachete.

Bwachia koba mobaso gati, Elija akabachecheria, akabatebia, “Aka eriogi rinene kobua, ekiagera ere nenyasae. Ande nigo akare namang’ana akorengereria, gose ngotimoka akare, gose norogendo akare, gose nigo araire, goika aturwe.”
Ase ayio bagaaka eriogi rinene, bagekebia emeyio ne chinsara chi’amatimo, buna engencho yabo yarenge, goika amanyinga agacharara korwa ase emebere yabo.
Korigochia kogoroba bakaba bakobaboka goikera omogoroba oyio ekero okoruegwa kw’endagera kware koruegwa, korende riogi tiriaigwetwe, onde tabairaneretie gose kobaigwa.
Erio Elija agatebia abanto bonsi, “Inchuo ang’e asende.” Na abanto bonsi bagacha ang’e asare. Ere akaroisia egesasimero ki’Omonene, keria konya giatagoirwe kiaiyerigwe inse.
Elija akabogoria amagena ikomi na abere, koreng’ana nomobaro bw’ebisaku bi’abamura ba Yakobo, oyio ring’ana ri’Omonene riachete asare rigateba, “Israeli nario rirabe erieta riao.”

Na ase amagena aria akaagachera egesasimero ase erieta ri’Omonene; naende akarema omotaro goetanana egesasimero keria. Omotaro oria nigo orenge nobogare bware goisana kobusurwa ebiee bibere bie chimbusuro.
Agachoka chinko, akanachana eeri eria ebitari, akabibeka igoro ase chinko. Erio akabatebia, “Ichoria chinyongo inye namache, na moyaumore igoro ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na igoro ase chinko.”
Naende akabatebia, “Kora boigo eria kabere.” Barabwo bagakora boigo eria kabere. Naende akabatebia, “Kora boigo eria gatato.” Barabwo bagakora boigo eria gatato.
Amache akaminyoka agaetanana egesasimero gionsi, na omotaro bwonsi ogaichora amache.

Ase engaki y’okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba, Elija omobani agacha ang’e, agasaba, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Israeli, tiga emanyekane ase rituko ria rero ng’a aye naye Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, naende ng’a inche nigo inde omosomba oo, naende ng’a nigo ngokora amang’ana aya onsi ase ring’ana riao.
Ing’iranerie, aye Omonene, ing’iranerie, erio abanto aba bamanye ng’a naye Omonene ore Nyasae, oranyare koonchora chinkoro chiabo chikoiranere.”
Erio omorero bw’Omonene okagwa korwa igoro, ogasamba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, ne chinko chiria, na amagena, na amaroba, ogakamia amache aria arenge ase omotaro.
Ekero abanto bonsi baroche ayio, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama, bagateba, “Omonene nere Nyasae! Omonene nere Nyasae!”
Erio Elija agatebia abanto, “Bwata ababani aba ba Baali, timotiga nonya noyomo atame.” Na abanto bakababwata, na Elija akabatirimbokia gochia ase akarooche ga Kisoni, akabaitera aroro agwo.
Elija agatebia Ahabu, “Imoka, orie na onywe, ekiagera eriogi ri’embura riaigurwe rikogukura.”
Ase ayio Ahabu akaimoka, akaria na akanywa, korende Elija agatiira gochia ase egetunwa gia Karimeli igoro, agatung’ama inse akaumama, akabeka obosio bwaye gati‐gati y’amaru aye.

Nyuma y’ayio Elija agatebia omosomba oye, “Tiira gochia igoro, origererie gochia ase enyancha.” Omosomba oye agatiira, akarigereria, akamotebia, “Tindochi gento kende.” Ase chintunda isano na ibere Elija akamotebia, “Genda origererie!”

Na ase entunda ya gatano na kabere omosomba oria agateba, “Narorire riire rike buna egesanyi gi’okoboko kw’omonto rikoimoka korwa ase enyancha.” Erio Elija akamotebia, “Genda otebie Ahabu abeke egari yaye ang’e, atirimboke, embura tebaisa komotanga.”
Engaki enke egaeta, na amare akamwamia igoro, na omwaga okagusa; embura egatwa enyinge mono. Ahabu akariina egari yaye, akagenda Yesireeli.
Okoboko kw’Omonene gokaba amo n’Elija, ere agesiba ekenema norokini rwaye, akaminyoka agatang’ana bosio bw’Ahabu goika akagenda ase omochie o Yesireeli.
Ahabu agatebia Yesebeli amang’ana onsi Elija akorete, buna aitete ababani bonsi nomoro.

Erio Yesebeli agatoma omonto ase Elija, akamotebia, “Tiga chinyasae ching’e egesusuro ekenene, na goetania ekio, onye ankio ase engaki enga buna eye tingokora obogima bwao bobe buna obw’oyomo bw’abwo gwaitete.
Elija akoboa, akaimoka agatama ase ogotooria obogima bwaye, agaika Beeri‐Seba ase ense ya Yuda. Agatiga omosomba oye aroro,

na ere omonyene akagenda ase erooro orogendo rwe rituko erimo, agaikaransa inse y’omote okorokwa omoretemu, agesabera ng’a akwe, akabora,” “Bono Omonene, aya aisanire, ira obogima bwane, ekiagera inche tindi omuya kobua chisokoro chiane.”
Ase obotuko obwo Elija akarara inse ase omote oria omoretemu, na aroro omomalaika agacha akamokuna akamotebia, “Boka orie!”
Ere akarigereria, akarora ang’e nase omotwe oye omogati ogekeire igoro ase omorero bw’amakara na amache are ase egetoono. Akaria na akanywa, erio akarara.
Naende omomalaika oria bw’Omonene agacha eria kabere, akamokuna, akamotebia, “Imoka orie, ekiagera orogendo norotambe okogenda.”
Elija akaboka, akaria, akanywa, na ase chinguru chi’endagera eyio akayegendera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, agaika Horebu, egetunwa kia Nyasae.
Aroro agasoa rikuruma ime, akararao ase obotuko boria. Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asare, rikamoboria, “Elija, ninki ogokora ime aa?”

Akairaneria, “Nabeire ne risemi asore aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ekiagera Abaisraeli batigire okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania, batagoire ebisasimero biao, naende baitire ababani bao nemioro. Inche bweka natigaire; na bono nigo bakorigia basirie obogima bwane.”

Omonene akamotebia, “Soka ogende, otenene ase egetunwa igoro agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene!” Erio Omonene agaeta agwo, na omwaga ore ne chinguru ogatandora ebitunwa na gwata amagena ’ebitare agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, korende Omonene tarenge ime ase omwaga oria. Na ekero omwaga oerire, omotengecho bw’ense ogacha, korende Omonene tarenge ase omotengecho oria.
Na ekero omotengecho oerire, omorero ogoka, korende Omonene tarenge ime ase omorero oria, na nyuma y’ayio eriogi rike ri’obotoereru rigacha.

Na ekero Elija aigwete eriogi riria, agatuba obosio bwaye negetambaa kiaye gi’okwambara, agasoka isiko, agatenena ase egesoero kie rikuruma riria; na agwo eriogi rigacha asare, rigakwana, rikamoboria, “Elija, ninki ogokora aiga?”

Akairaneria, “Nabeire ne risemi asore aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ekiagera Abaisraeli batigire okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania, batagoire ebisasimero biao, na baitire ababani bao nomoro, na inche bweka natigaire, nabarabwo igo bakorigia obogima bwane babosirie.”
Omonene akamotebia, “Irana, ogende enchera yao goika ase erooro ya Damesiki; na ekero oraike aroro, oake Hasaeli amaguta, omobeke abe omoruoti igoro y’Abasiiria.
Naende Yehu, mosinto o Nimusi, omoake amaguta, omobeke abe omoruoti igoro y’Abaisraeli; na Elisha, mosinto o Safati, korwa Abeli‐Mehola omoake amaguta, abe omobani ase ribaga riao.
Na onde bwensi oratame atooreke korwa ase omoro bwa Hasaeli naitwe na Yehu; na onde bwensi oratame atooreke korwa ase omoro o Yehu naitwe n’Elisha.
Korende nonya naboigo, nintigare nabanto chilifu isano na ibere b’Abaisraeli bonsi, baria batabegete amaru abo inse ase ogosasima Baali, gose koyenyunyunta.”

Ase ayio akarua agwo, akagenda akanyora Elisha, mosinto o Safati, okoremia chiombe; ebisangio bie chiombe ikomi na bibere nigo biarenge bosio bwaye. Ere omonyene nigo arenge negesangio gia ikomi na kabere. Elija agaeta agwo, akarutera Elisha egetambaa kiaye ambarete

Elisha agatiga chiombe chiria, akaminyoka gochia ase Elija, akamotebia, “Tiga ngende konyunyunta tata na baba ase okobatiga, erio nkobwatie.” Elija akamotebia, “Irana ogende, nomanyete aya nagokoreire.”

Erio agatiga Elija, akairana, akanyenya chiombe chiaye ibere, akaiyeka chinyama ase omorero bw’amakorogoto aria, akaa abanto chinyama chiria, nabarabwo bakaria. Erio akaimoka akabwatia Elija, akaba okomokorera.

Beni‐Hadadi, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, agasangereria abarwani baye b’esegi amo. Abaruoti emerongo etato na babere boigo barenge amo nere, ne chibarasi ne chigari. Barabwo bakagenda bakaboera omochie o Samaria, bakayorwania esegi.
Beni‐Hadadi agatoma abanto gochia ase omochie ase Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akamotebia, “Aya naro inche Beni‐Hadadi ngoteba:
Chifeta chiao ne chitahabu chiao nechiane; boigo abakungu bao abanyakieni, na abana bao nabaane.”
Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akairaneria, “Buna gwatebire aye omonene one, aye omoruoti, inche noyoo inde, na ebinto bionsi imbwate nebiao.”
Abanto baria batometwe bakairana naende, bagateba, “Aya naro Beni‐Hadadi agoteba: Natoma amang’ana asore ng’a ong’e chifeta chiao, ne chitahabu chiao, na abakungu bao, na abana bao.
Nonya naboigo, nintome abasomba baane ankio, ase engaki buna eye, bariga‐rigie nyomba mwao, ne chinyomba chi’abasomba bao, erio baire kera egento ekerabagokie.”

Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akarangeria abagaaka bonsi b’ense yaye, akabatebia, “Rora bono buna omonto oyo akorigia korenta emechando, igo atoma abanto, akagania imoe abakungu baane, na abana baane, ne chifeta, ne chitahabu, nainche timorineti.”
Erio abagaaka na abanto bonsi bakamotebia, “Tobaisa koigwa amang’ana ayio gose koyancha.”

Ase igo Ahabu agatebia abanto baria Beni‐Hadadi atomete, “Motebie omonene one omoruoti ng’a ayio onsi aganetie ase engaki entang’ani ninyakore, korende aya a nyuma tinkoyakora.” Abanto baria Beni‐Hadadi atomete bakairana, bakamoirera amang’ana ayio.
Beni‐Hadadi agatoma amang’ana asare naende agateba, “Chinyasae ching’e egesusuro ekenene, na goetania, onye orotu rwa Samaria ndogoisana chinsanyi chi’abanto bonsi bagontunyana.”
Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akairaneria, akabora, “Momotebie ng’a oyo okweboyia ebirwanero biaye tabaisa gwetogia buna oyo okobirusia.”
Ekero Beni‐Hadadi aigwete ring’ana erio, ekero arenge konywa amo nabaruoti bande ase chiema, agatebia abanto baye, “Eroberie!” Barabwo bakeroberia gochia korwania omochie oria.

Na rora, omobani agacha ase Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akamotebia, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Inee! Kwarorire omoganda oyo omonene bw’esegi? Rora, ninyobeke ase okoboko kwao ase rituko ria rero; naye nomanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”

Ahabu akaboria, “Ngoetera ase ng’o?” Omobani oria akamoiraneria, agateba, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ngoetera ase abasomba abamura b’abagambi be chingongo chiabo.” Naende Ahabu akaboria, “Ning’o orachake esegi?” Omobani oria akairaneria, “Naye.”

Erio Ahabu akaroberia abasomba baria abamura b’abagambi be chingongo, amagana abere, na emerongo etato, na babere (232); naende nyuma y’ayio akaroberia Abaisraeli bonsi, na barabwo nigo barenge chilifu isano na ibere (7,000).
Mobaso gati, ekero Beni‐Hadadi amo nabaruoti baria emerongo etato na babere barenge komokonya banyure na gotinda agwo ase chiema, Abaisraeli bagachaka esegi.
Abasomba baria abamura b’abagambi be chingongo bakagenda ritang’ani, na Beni‐Hadadi agatoma abatuki b’amang’ana; barabwo bakarenta amang’ana, bakamotebia, “Abanto ngocha bare korwa Samaria.”
Nere akabatebia, “Onye igo bachire nomorembe, mobabwate, mobatige babe moyo; gose onye igo bachire korwana esegi, mobabwate, mobatige babe moyo.”
Korende abasomba baria abamura b’abagambi be chingongo amo nomoganda bw’esegi okobabwatia bakarua ase omochie, bakagenda,
na kera oyomo orenge goita omobisa oye. Abasiiria bagatama, na Abaisraeli bakababwatia, korende Beni‐Hadadi, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, akariina ebarasi, agatama amo nabanto bande abariini be chibarasi.
Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akagenda agaita chibarasi agasaria chigari, agaita n’Abasiiria ase ogoita okonene.

Naende omobani oria agacha ase omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akamotebia, “Inchuo otimoke onyore chinguru, rengereria mono egento ogwenerete gokora, ekiagera ekero ebimeri bigochaka gosomoria, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria nagochere gokorwania.”

Abasomba b’omoruoti bw’Abasiiria bakamotebia, “Chinyasae chiabo nigo chire chinyasae chi’ebitunwa, na ase ayio nigo chiaba ne chinguru gotobua; korende togende torwane nabanto abwo ase ense omweya, ekeene, goika tobe ne chinguru kobabua.
Kora iga: Rusia abaruoti, kera oyomo ase emeremo yaye, na ase amabaga abo obeke abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi.

Naende roberia abarwani b’esegi bang’ana buna abwo baitwa, ne chibarasi ne chigari ching’ana buna echio chiasirigwa, erio tobarwanie ase ense omweya; ekeene, goika tobe ne chinguru kobabua.” Omoruoti agancha amang’ana abo, naende agakora buna bamotebetie.
Ekero ebimeri bigochaka gosomoria, Beni‐Hadadi akaroberia Abasiiria, akagenda Afeki korwania Abaisraeli.

Abaisraeli bakaroberigwa na koariganerigwa chindagera, bakagenda korwania Abasiiria. Abaisraeli bagatoora korigererania n’Abasiiria, bakarorekana buna amaicho abere amake e chimbori, korende Abasiiria bagaichora aase aria.

Omonto oria o Nyasae agacha ase omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akamotebia, “Aya naro Omonene atebire: Abasiiria batebire ng’a Omonene nigo are enyasae y’ebitunwa, korende tari enyasae y’ense omweya. Ase ayio, nimbeke omoganda oyo omonene bwonsi ase okoboko kwao, naye nomanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”

Ase igo abarwani bonsi bagatoora bakarigererania ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Erio ase rituko riria ria gatano na kabere bagachakana esegi, na ase rituko erimo Abaisraeli bagaita abarwani b’Abasiiria abaare gotaara namagoro, chilifu rigana erimo (100,000).

Abatigari b’Abasiiria bagatama gochia ase omochie o Afeki. Chindwaki chi’omochie oria chikagwera abanto abwo batigarete, chilifu emerongo ebere na isano na ibere (27,000). Beni‐Hadadi boigo agatama, agasoa ase akanyomba ka ime ase omochie.

Abasomba baye bakamotebia, “Bono twaigure ng’a abaruoti b’enyomba y’Abaisraeli nigo bare namabera, tiga tweboyie chianga chie chigunia, na tonaarie chingori ase amagoti aito, erio tosoke, togende ase omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli; ande nabo arabaise gototiga tobe moyo.”

Ase ayio bakeboyia chigunia, naende bakanaara chingori ase amagoti abo, erio bakagenda ase omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, bagateba, “Omosomba oo Beni‐Hadadi nigo agosaba ng’a omotige abe moyo.” Ahabu akabora, “Inee! Nonya mbono moyo are? Ere momura ominto.”

Abanto baria nigo barenge barigereretie banyore ekemanyererio, na ekero baigwete ring’ana “Oyominto” bakairaneria bwango, “Ee, momura omino Beni‐Hadadi.” Erio omoruoti akabatebia, “Genda momorente!” Beni‐Hadadi agacha ase omoruoti, na omoruoti akamochika ariine egari yaye.

Beni‐Hadadi akamotebia, “Emechie tata airete korwa ase iso ninkoyeiranerie; naye bweroiserie chinchera chi’oboonchoreria agwo Damesiki, buna tata akorete agwo Samaria.” Ahabu akamoiraneria, “Ase amang’ana ayio ningotige ogende.” Erio Ahabu agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nere, akamotiga agende.
Omonto oyomo bw’aborokigwa b’ababani agatebia omogisangio oye ase ogochikwa kw’Omonene, “Nagosabire, ing’ake ong’ite!” Korende omonto oria akaanga komoaka.

Erio omobani oria akamotebia, “Ekiagera kwangire koigwera eriogi ri’Omonene, rora, ase obwango obo okorua aa asende, endo negoite.” Erio kegima, ekero omonto oria aruete asare, akaumerana nendo ekamoita.
Naende omobani oria akanyora omonto onde, akamotebia, “Nagosabire, ing’ake ong’ite?” Omonto oria akamoaka bokong’u, akamoniarora omobere.
Omobani oria akagenda, akaganya omoruoti agwo ase enchera, agetuba negetambaa ase amaiso aye.

Ekero omoruoti arenge goeta ase enchera eria, omobani oria akarera asare, akamotebia, “Inche omosomba oo nagendete ase esegi, na rora, omorwani bw’esegi agacha akarentana omonto asende, agantebia: Renda omonto oyo, aise gosira ase enchera ende yonsi, obogima bwao nabobe ribaga ri’obwaye, gose oakane rigori ri’etalanta eyemo y’efeta.

Na buna inche omosomba oo nabwate emeremo emenge narenge gokora aa na aaria, omonto oria akagenda.” Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akamotebia, “Naboigo okonachwa gw’ekina kiao kerabe; aye omonyene gwakenachire.”
Erio bwango akarusia egetambaa ase amaiso aye, na omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akamanya ng’a ere noyomo bw’ababani.

Omobani oria agatebia omoruoti, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ekiagera gwatigire omonto orure ase okoboko kwao, oria naruete ase ogosirigwa, bono obogima bwao nabobe ribaga ri’obwaye, na abanto bao nababe ribaga ri’abanto baye.”
Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akagenda bwoye ore nomoichano na obororo bw’endamwamu, agaika Samaria.
Naboti Omoyesireeli nabwate omogondo bw’emesabibu agwo Yesireeli, ang’e nenyomba y’Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abasamaria.

Ahabu agatebia Naboti, “Ing’a omogondo oyo oo bw’emesabibu, erinde nsimeke chinyeni, ekiagera nigo ore ang’e na mwane, nainche ninkoe omogondo onde omuya mono ribaga riaye, gose onye gokorora ng’a mbuya, ninkoe chibesa.”
Korende Naboti akamotebia, “Tiga Omonene atange amang’ana ayio, timbaisa gokoa omwando one naetwe ne chisokoro chiane.”

Ahabu akagenda inka bwoye nenkoro y’obororo, naende akagechigwa mono, ekiagera Naboti, Omoyesireeli oria, akanire ng’a takomoa omwando oye aetwe ne chisokoro chiaye. Ahabu akarara borere bwaye, akaonchora obosio bwaye gochia ase enyasi, akaba taria gento.
Korende Yesebeli mokaye agacha asare, akamoboria, “Nase ki enkoro yao ere nomoichano goika nonya nendagera otari koria?”

Ere akairaneria mokaye, “Nekiagera nakwana na Naboti Omoyesireeli, nkamoteiba ng’a ang’e omogondo oye bw’emesabibu, na inche imoe omogondo onde bw’emesabibu ribaga ri’oyoye, gose onye ogwancha imoe chibesa, korende akaanga, tancha kong’a omogondo oye bw’emesabibu.”
Yesebeli mokaye akamotebia, “Inee! Naye okogambera Abaisraeli, gose tari aye? Imoka! Orie endagera, tiga enkoro yao ebe nomosasoko; ninkonyorere omogondo bw’emesabibu o Naboti Omoyesireeli.”
Ase ayio omokungu oria akarika amarube, akabeka erieta ri’Ahabu na ekemanyererio kiaye ase amarube ayio, akayatoma gochia ase abagaaka, na ase abanene baria bamenyete amo na Naboti ase omochie oye.
Omokungu oria akarika ase amarube aria, “Raria okweng’ata gokorwe, na mobeke Naboti ase amasio ’abanto ase okomoa amasikani.
Naende mobeke abanto babere abatagwenereti, bamosoere oborimo, batebe ng’a oragereirie Nyasae na omoruoti. Erio momosokie isiko, momoake amagena goika akwe.”
Na abanto b’omochie, na abagaaka, na abanene b’omochie oyio, bagakora buna Yesebeli abatebetie. Buna koreng’ana arikire ase amarube aria atomete asebare,
bakararia okweng’ata, na bakabeka Naboti ase amasio ’abanto ase okomoa amasikani.

Abanto babere abatagwenereti bagacha, bagaikaransa kororia asare, bakamosoera ase amasio ’abanto, bagateba, “Naboti oragerere Nyasae na omoruoti.” Ase igo abanto bakamosokia isiko y’omochie, bakamoaka amagena goika agakwa.
Erio bagatoma amang’ana ase Yesebeli, bagateba, “Naboti oakirwe amagena okure.”

Ase obwango ekero Yesebeli aigwete ng’a Naboti oakirwe amagena okure, agatebia Ahabu, “Imoka, oire omogondo bw’emesabibu o Naboti, Omoyesireeli, oria angete gokoa omoe chibesa, ekiagera bono tari moyo, okure.”
Erio kegima, ekero Ahabu aigwete ng’a Naboti okure, akaimoka akagenda ase omogondo oria bw’emesabibu o Naboti Omoyesireeli, akayoira okaba oyoye.
Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija, Omotisibi, rikamotebia,
“Imoka, otirimboke oumerane n’Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, oyio omenyete Samaria. Rora nao are ase omogondo bw’emesabibu o Naboti, agwo ogendire koyoira obe oyoye.

Omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene atebire: Aye nigo gwaita Naboti, naende kwairire omogondo oria obeire oyoo. Naende omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene atebire: Aase agwo chisese chiamenerete amanyinga a Naboti, nao chiramenere nayao.”
Ahabu agatebia Elija, “Inee! Aye omobisa one, nkwanyorire.” Elija akairaneria, “Ee, nakonyorire, ekiagera aye kweoonirie aye omonyene gokora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
Rora, inche nindete amabe igoro yao; ningosirie kegima orueo, ninsirie korwa asore Ahabu kera omonto omosacha, omosomba na oyotari omosomba.

Ninkore enyomba yao ebe buna eya Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, naende ebe buna enyomba ya Baasa, mosinto bw’Ahiya, ekiagera kwangechirie goika nabeire nendamwamu, naende kwagerire Abaisraeli bakorire ebibe.
Omonene otebire boigo igoro ya Yesebeli; Chisese inachiriere Yesebeli agwo ase oboremo bwa Yesireeli.
Omonto onde bwensi bw’enyomba y’Ahabu orakwere ase omochie ime, chisese nachimorie; na onde bwensi orakwere isiko aarabu, chinyoni chia igoro nchimorie.”
Omonto tari nonya noyomo orenge buna Ahabu, ere oyio bweoonetie ere omonyene gokora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekero Yesebeli mokaye amoseegetete.
Agakora kera okogechia ase ogotunyana emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, buna Abaamori bakorete, baria Omonene aseretie korwa ase amasio ’Abaisraeli.
Ekero Ahabu aigwete amang’ana aria, agatandora chianga chiaye, na akeboyia chigunia, na kweng’ata. Akararera chigunia, akaba omokanyeku ore nomoichano.
Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija, Omotisibi, rigateba,

“Kwarorire buna Ahabu ekanyire ere omonyene, na obeire omoitongo ase obosio bwane? Ekiagera akorire igo, tinkorenta amabe ayio ase amatuko aye, korende nase amatuko ’omwana oye omomura ndarente amabe ayio ase enyomba yaye.”
Abasiiria na Abaisraeli bakagenderera ase emiaka etato batarenge nesegi barabwo ase barabwo.
Korende ase omwaka o gatato Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akagenda ase omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agatebia abasomba baye, “Inwe momanyete ng’a Ramoti o Gileadi noyoito. Inee! Naki rende twakirire‐kiri, totarayoirania korwa ase amaboko ’omoruoti bw’Abasiiria?”

Erio akaboria Yehosafati, “Nogende amo nainche, torwanie Ramoti o Gileadi?” Yehosafati akamoiraneria, “Ee, ningende amo naye, na abanto baane amo nabanto bao, ne chibarasi chiane amo ne chibarasi chiao.”
Naende akamotebia, “Ritang’ani tiga toborie Omonene igoro y’amang’ana ayio.”

Erio omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agasangerereria ababani ang’e amagana ane amo, akababoria, “Nkogenda nde korwania Ramoti o Gileadi, gose yaya?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria “Genda, ekiagera Omonene nabeke omochie oyio ase okoboko kwao aye omoruoti.”
Korende Yehosafati akaboria, “Inee! Omobani onde bw’Omonene tari aiga, tonyare koboria goetera asare?”

Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akairaneria Yehosafati, “Omonto oyomo natigarete toranyare koboria Omonene goetera asare, nere Mikaya, mosinto o Imula, korende inche nigo imogechete, ekiagera ere tari kobana amang’ana amaya igoro yane, korende namabe oka.” Yehosafati akamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, tobaisa gokwana igo.”
Erio omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akarangeria omosomba oye oyomo, akamochika, “Genda bwango orente Mikaya, mosinto o Imula!”

Bono omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli na Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, nigo baikaransete ase ebirogo biabo bi’oboruoti agwo ase ekeooreri ang’e negeita gia Samaria, babegete chianga chiabo chi’obonene, na ababani baria bonsi nigo barenge korua obobani bwabo ase amasio ’abaruoti baria.
Zedekia, mosinto o Kenaana, akeroiseria chingunchara chi’ebioma, agakwana, “Aya naro Omonene atebire: Ase chingunchara echi nobetere Abasiiria goika basirigwe kegima.”
Ababani baria bonsi bakabana amang’ana ayio ayio, bagateba, “Genda Ramoti o Gileadi, noyobue. Omonene nayobeke ase okoboko kwao aye omoruoti.”

Omonto oria otometwe gochia korangeria Mikaya akagenda akamotebia, “Rora, amang’ana ’ababani bande nigo are ayamo, akoria eira y’egesio ekiya ase omoruoti; tiga ring’ana riao ribe erimo namang’ana abo; naye boigo okwane amang’ana okoria eira y’egesio ekiya ase omoruoti.”
Korende Mikaya agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, ring’ana Omonene arantebie, nario ndakwane.”

Ekero achete ase omoruoti, omoruoti akamoboria, “Inee! Mikaya, nkogenda tore korwania Ramoti o Gileadi, gose totige?” Nere akamoiraneria, “Genda, obue! Omonene nabeke Ramoti o Gileadi ase okoboko kwao aye omoruoti.”
Omoruoti akamotebia, “Ng’ara karenga nkogotebia bwetianie ng’a ontebie ekeene gioka ase erieta ri’Omonene.”

Mikaya akairaneria, “Narora Abaisraeli bonsi besiarerete igoro y’ebitunwa buna ching’ondi chitabwati omorisia, na Omonene agantebia: Aba tibabwati omoraai obo, tiga kera oyomo airane, agende nka bwoye ore nomorembe.”
Na omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agatebia Yehosafati, “Tinagotebia ng’a ere takobana amang’ana amaya igoro asende, korende namabe oka?”

Naende Mikaya akagenderera gokwana, agateba, “Ase ayio, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene. Inarora Omonene oikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, na emeganda yonsi y’abamalaika eteneine ensemo yaye y’okorio na ey’okobee.
Na Omonene akaboria: Ning’o ogochia koebereria Ahabu, erinde agende Ramoti o Gileadi abuerwe aroro? Oyomo agakwana egento ekemo, na oyonde egento kende.
Erio omoika ogacha ogatenena bosio bw’Omonene ogateba: Ninche ndamoebererie.

Omonene akaboria omoika oria: Nase enchera ere naki oramoebererie? Omoika oria okairaneria: Igo nkoimoka ngende, imbe omoika bw’obong’ainereria ase emenwa y’ababani bonsi b’Ahabu. Omonene akayotebia: Genda omoebererie ase enchera eyio. Nobue.
“Ase ayio, rora bono, Omonene obekire omoika bw’obong’ainereria ase omonwa bw’ababani abwo bonsi, ekiagera ochikire ng’a nonyore egesio ekebe.”
Erio Zedekia, mosinto o Kenaana, agaika ang’e ase Mikaya, akamoaka oroe ase orosea, akamoboria, “Naki omoika bw’Omonene okora orua asende, erinde okwana naye?”
Mikaya akamoiraneria, “Aye norore rituko riria oratame na gosoa ase ekenunchi bwebisa.”
Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agateba, “Bwata Mikaya momoiranie ase Amoni omonene bw’omochie na ase Yoashi, omwana bw’omoruoti,
mobatebie ng’a omoruoti otebire: Beka omonto oyio ime ase echela, momong’ate endagera na amache goika ing’irane ase omorembe.”
Mikaya akamoiraneria, “Onye gokoirana kore nomorembe, rirorio Omonene takwanete goetera asende,” Naende agateba, “Inwe abanto bonsi, igwa amang’ana aya.”
Bono omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli na Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, bakagenda korwania Ramoti o Gileadi.

Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agatebia Yehosafati, “Inche nigo ngwekona ase ogwetuba timanyekana, erio ngende ase esegi, korende aye obeke chianga chiao chi’oboruoti.” Na omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agekona ase ogwetuba tamanyekana, akagenda ase esegi.

Bono omoruoti bw’Abasiiria konya ochikire abateneneri baye emerongo etato, na babere, be chigari, akabatebia, “Timobaisa korwana na monto onde bwensi, abe omoke gose omonene, korende morwane nomoruoti bw’Abaisraeli bweka.”
Ekero abateneneri be chigari baroche Yehosafati, bagateba, “Ere ekeene nomoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.” Ase ayio bakaonchoka bakarwana nere, na Yehosafati akarera rimo.
Na ekero abateneneri be chigari baroche ng’a ere tarenge omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, bakaonchoka, bagatiga komobwatia.
