Erio Hilikia agatebia Safani omoriki, “Nanyorire Ebuku y’Amachiko ime ase enyomba y’Omonene,” akaa Safani ebuku eria.
Safani akaira ebuku eria ase omoruoti, naende akamotebia, “Emeremo yonsi kwaete abasomba bao nkoyekora bare.
Bairire chibesa chionsi chianyorekanete ase enyomba y’Omonene, na bachibekire ase amaboko ’abateneneri b’emeremo amo nabakori emeremo.”
Erio Safani omoriki agatebia omoruoti, “Hilikia omokuani ong’eire ebuku eye.” Erio akayesoma agwo ase obosio bw’omoruoti.
Ekero omoruoti aigwete amang’ana ’amachiko aria, agatandora chianga chiaye.
Agachika Hilikia, na Ahikamu, mosinto o Safani, na Abidoni, mosinto o Mika, na Safani omoriki, na Asaia, omosomba bw’omoruoti, akabatebia,

“Genda, moborie momanye korwa ase Omonene igoro yane na igoro y’abatigari b’Abaisraeli na ab’Abayuda, tomanye amang’ana are ase ebuku eye yanyorekanire. Endamwamu y’Omonene nentindi mono asetore, ekiagera chisokoro chiaito tichiaigwerete ring’ana ri’Omonene, naende tichiakorete onsi aya arikire ase ebuku eye.”

Hilikia amo nabanto omoruoti atomete bakagenda ase Hulda, omokungu omobani moka Salumu, mosinto o Tokihati o Hasira. Salumu nere orenge omorendi bwe rigachero rie chianga agwo Hekalu. (Ase ekero ekio Hulda nigo amenyete agwo Yerusalemu ase ensemo enyia.) Abanto abwo bagatebia omokungu oria amang’ana aria aria.
Omokungu oria akabatebia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Mogende ase omonto oria obatomete gocha asende, momotebie:
Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Rora, nindete igoro y’aase aiga, na igoro y’abanto b’aiga okoragererigwa gwonsi korikire ase ebuku eye yasomwa ase omoruoti bw’Abayuda.

Barabwo bantigire inche, na basambire ubani ase chinyasae ching’ao, na bangechirie nabeire nendamwamu ase engencho y’emeremo yonsi bakorire namaboko abo. Ase ayio endamwamu yane neiterwe igoro y’aase aiga, tegokendigwa.
Korende ase omoruoti bw’Abayuda, oria obatoma, erinde amanye korwa asende inche Omonene, aya naro moramotebie: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli agoteba: Ekero kwaigwa amang’ana aria,

aye ogekanya okaba omoitongo ase obosio bwane inche Nyasae, naende ekero kwaigwa amang’ana igoro y’aase aiga, na igoro y’abanto bareo, ogatandora chianga chiao, naende okarera ase obosio bwane. Naboigo inche Omonene nkogotebia, ng’a nakoigure.

Rora, ningosangererie ase chisokoro chiao chiachiete; aye nobekwe ase embeera yao kore nomorembe, na amaiso ao takorora obobe boria bwonsi ndarete igoro y’aase aiga, na igoro y’abanto bareo.” Ase igo barabwo bakairera omoruoti amang’ana ayio.
Erio omoruoti agatoma amang’ana, agasangereria amo abagaaka b’Abayuda na aba Yerusalemu,

na agatiira gochia ase enyomba y’Omonene, amo n’Abayuda bonsi na bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, na abakuani, na Abalawi, ee, abanto bonsi, abanene na abake. Na aroro omoruoti akabasomera amang’ana onsi arikire ase Ebuku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Ogotianania, yanyorekanete ime ase enyomba y’Omonene.

Omoruoti agatenena aase aye, agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania ase obosio bw’Omonene ng’a nabwatie Omonene, na abwate amachiko aye, na oborori bwaye, na emeroberio yaye echikire, nayakore nenkoro yaye yonsi na omoyo oye bwonsi, nakore amang’ana onsi aganeirie nokobwatana okwo kw’ogotianania, ayarikire ase ebuku eye.

Agachika abanto bonsi abarenge agwo Yerusalemu na aba ase orogongo rwa Benjamin babwatane nokobwatana okwo kw’ogotianania, na abanto ba Yerusalemu bagakora koreng’ana nokobwatana koria kwa Nyasae ore Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo.

Yosia akarusia okogechia gwonsi korwa ase orogongo rw’Abaisraeli, agachika Abaisraeli bonsi bakorere Omonene, Nyasae obo. Abanto tibaonchogete korwa ase Omonene bwe chisokoro chiabo ase obogima bwonsi bwa Yosia.

Nyuma y’ayio Yosia akaba okorenda Rituko Rinene ri‐Epasaka ase Omonene, agwo Yerusalemu, na abanto bakanyenya chimanwa chie ching’ondi chi’Epasaka ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani.
Akabeka abakuani ase emeremo yabo na akabaseegeta bakore emeremo y’enyomba y’Omonene.

Agatebereria Abalawi baria barenge aborokia b’Abaisraeli, naende baatananetwe ase Omonene, akabora, “Beka Esanduku eyio enchenu ase enyomba eyio Sulemani, mosinto o Daudi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, aagachete. Korwa bono timogwenereti koyebogoria igoro ase amareko aino. Bono mokorere Omonene, Nyasae oino, mobakorere na abanto baye Abaisraeli.
Inwe ebeke ang’e, kera eamate ase ekeombe kiaye, koreng’ana nomoreberio o Daudi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli na oyo o Sulemani, omomura oye.
Motenene agwo aase are aachenu buna abateneneri b’ebiombe bie chiamate chi’Abaisraeli bamino batari abakuani. Abalawi babekwe ase kera ekeombe.
Monyenye ching’ondi chi’Epasaka, naende mwechene abanyene na moroisie ching’ondi echio ase engencho y’abanto bamino, erinde mokore koreng’ana ne ring’ana riria Omonene akwanete goetera ase Musa.”

Erio Yosia akaa abanto barenge agwo ching’iti chi’ebing’wanso bi’Epasaka. Akarusia korwa ase amaicho aye omonyene chimanwa chie ching’ondi, na echie chimbori, chilifu emerongu etato (30,000), ne chiombe chilifo isato (3,000).

Abagambi abarenge amo nomoruoti bagancha koa abanto, na abakuani, na Abalawi, ching’iti chi’ebing’wanso. Hilikia na Zakaria, na Yehieli, abateneneri b’enyomba ya Nyasae, bakaa abakuani chimanwa chie ching’ondi chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na rimo (2,600), ne chiombe amagana atato (300), chibe ebing’wanso bi’Epasaka.

Konania, amo na Semaya na Netaneli, abamura bamwabo, na Hasabia, na Yeieli, na Yosabadi, abanene b’Abalawi, bakaa Abalawi chimanwa chie ching’ondi, na echie chimbori, chilifu isano (5,000), chibe ebing’wanso bi’Epasaka, ne chiombe amagana atano (500).
Ekero konya okwebeka ang’e gwakorirwe, abakuani bagatenena aase abo, na Abalawi ase ebiombe biabo, koreng’ana buna omoruoti achigete.
Bakanyenya chimanwa chie ching’ondi chi’Epasaka, erio abakuani bakaegwa amanyinga e chimanwa chiria, bakayanyororokia ekero Abalawi bagendererete korusia amasankwa.

Bagaatanana chinyama chie ching’iti chi’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase abanto ba kera eamate, erinde barabwo banyare gochirua ase Omonene, buna arikire ase Ebuku ya Musa. Naboigo bakorete ne chiombe chiria.

Bagasamba chinyama chie chimanwa chi’Epasaka ase omorero buna achikire, korende echi’ebing’wanso binde ebichenu bagachiyekera chinyongo, na ebitega, ne chisuguria; erio bwango bagachiirera abanto bonsi.

Nyuma y’ayio Abalawi bakeroiseria chinyama, boigo bagachiroiseria na abakuani ab’ororeria rwa Haroni, ekiagera abakuani aba nigo barenge nemeremo emenge y’okorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa amo nebitinya bi’ebio goika botuko. Naboigo Abalawi beroiseretie chinyama, bakaroiseria nabakuani ab’ororeria rwa Haroni.

Na abateri, abanto b’eamate y’Asafu, nigo babeerete aase abo buna Daudi, na Asafu, na Hemani, na Yedutuni, omorori bw’omoruoti, bachigete. Abarendi b’ebiita bakabeera aase abo ase kera egeita. Tibatigete emeremo yabo, ekiagera Abalawi bamwabo mbabaroiseretie ebing’wanso biabo.
Igo aya onsi ay’okomokorera Omonene nigo akoretwe ase rituko riria; nigo barendete Epasaka bakarua okoruegwa kw’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase egesasimero ki’Omonene, buna Yosia omoruoti achigete.
Abaisraeli abarenge aroro bakarenda Epasaka ase engaki eria, naende bakagenderera korenda Rituko Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

Epasaka enga buna eyio konya tiyana korendwa ase egati y’Abaisraeli korwa amatuko a Samweli omobani. Moruoti onde bw’Abaisraeli konya tana korenda Epasaka buna eria Yosia arendete, ere amo nabakuani, na Abalawi, na Abayuda bonsi, na Abaisraeli abarengeo, na abanto ba Yerusalemu.
Epasaka eyio enene nigo yarendetwe ase omwaka o ikomi, na gatano na gatato, bw’okogamba kwa Yosia.
Nyuma y’ayio onsi, ekero Yosia konya aroisirie Hekalu, Neko, omoruoti o Misiri, agatiira kogenda korwana esegi agwo Karikemisi ase orooche rw’Eufarati, na Yosia akagenda korwana nere.

Omoruoti o Misiri agatoma abanto ase Yosia, agateba, “Aye omoruoti bw’Abayuda, inki inche naye togokorerana? Rituko ria rero tindi gocha korwana esegi naye, korende nobogambi nkorwania, inde nesegi naborobwo, na Nyasae ochikire ngende bwango. Aye tiga koamererania na Nyasae, oria ore amo nainche, nabaise kogoita.”
Korende Yosia tanchete koonchoka korwa ase Neko. Agekona ase ogwetuba ng’a tamanyekana, akagenda korwana na Neko agwo ase ense omweya ya Megido, taigwete amang’ana aye ayaruete ase Nyasae.
Abarwani baria bakabwata amata, bakarasa Yosia omoruoti. Erio omoruoti oria agatebia abasomba baye, “Indusie aiga, ekiagera nabetirwe bobe.”
Abasomba baye bakamobeka ase egari yaye ende, bakamoira Yerusalemu. Agakwera aroro, na agatindekwa ase chimbeera chie chisokoro chiaye. Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bonsi bakaba bakomoreera.

Yeremia akaroisia ogotera kw’amagombo igoro ya Yosia, na abateri bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, babeire bagwatora Yosia ase amatera abo ay’amagombo nonya ngoika rero iga. Ayio akaba engencho Abaisraeli benaretie. Ogotera okwo nigo korikire ase Ebuku y’Amatera ’Amagombo.
Bono amang’ana ande onsi ay’ogokora kwa Yosia, na amaya aya akorete koreng’ana naya arikire ase amachiko ’Omonene,
na ogokora kwaye kwe ritang’ani goika okw’omoerio nigo korikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli na ab’Abayuda.
Abanto b’ense eria bakabeka Yehoahasi, mosinto o Yosia, akaba omoruoti agwo Yerusalemu ase ribaga ria ise.
Yehoahasi nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na etato, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emetienyi etato agwo Yerusalemu.
Omoruoti o Misiri agacha Yerusalemu akarusia Yehoahasi ase oboruoti, erio akabekera abanto b’ense eria ebango ye chitalanta rigana erimo chie chifeta, na etalanta eyemo y’etahabu.

Neko, omoruoti oyio o Misiri, akabeka Eliakimu, momura omwabo omoruoti oria arusetie, akaba omoruoti igoro ase Abayuda, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, na akaonchora erieta riaye, akamoroka Yehoyakimu. Neko akaira Yehoahasi, omomura omwabo Eliakimu, Misiri.
Yehoyakimu nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere, na etano, ekero achagete kogamba, akagamba emiaka ikomi nomo, agwo Yerusalemu. Nere agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oye.
Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, agacha akarwana nere, akamobwata akamosiba ne chingataare, akamoira Babeli.
Nebukadinesaro boigo akaira ebikorero binde bi’enyomba y’Omonene goika Babeli, akabibeka ase hekalu yaye agwo Babeli.

Bono amang’ana ande onsi Yehoyakimu akorete, na okogechia akorete, na okomocha kwanyorekanete asare, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli na ab’Abayuda, na Yehoyakini, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
Yehoyakini nigo arenge nemiaka etano na etato ekero achagete kogamba; akagamba emetienyi etato na amatuko ikomi, agwo Yerusalemu. Nere agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene.

Ekero ki’ogoseboka kw’ebimeri, Nebukadinesaro omoruoti agatoma abanto bakamoira Babeli; akaira nebikorero bie rigori rinene bi’enyomba y’Omonene, erio akabeka Zedekia, omomura omwabo Yehoyakini, akaba omoruoti igoro ase Abayuda na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu.
Zedekia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere nomo, ekero achagete kogamba; akagamba emiaka ikomi nomo agwo Yerusalemu.
Nere agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oye, ekiagera tekeetie abe omoitongo ase obosio bwa Yeremia omobani, oria okwanete aya Omonene atebete.

Zedekia akaanga koigwera Nebukadinesaro omoruoti, oria omoboretie gotiana ase erieta ria Nyasae. Agekora omonyabigoti bikong’u, na enkoro yaye ekaenena, tancha komoiranera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

Abakuani bonsi baria barenge abatang’ani babo, na abanto boigo bagasaria mono, tibaba abegenwa, bakabwatia okogechia gwonsi kw’abanto b’ebisaku, na enyomba y’Omonene eyio akorete ekaba enchenu agwo Yerusalemu, bakayekora ekaba eyetachenegeti.
Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, akagenderera kobatomera amang’ana ay’okobakurera goetera ase abatomwa baye, ekiagera arorerete abanto baye, na obomenyo bwaye, amabera.

Korende bakagenderera gochecheria abatomwa ba Nyasae, bagachaya amang’ana aye, na bagachecheria ababani baye. Ase igo endamwamu y’Omonene ekaba enene igoro ase abanto baye, na gotooreka tikwanyorekana asebare.

Ase ayio Omonene akarenta omoruoti bw’Abakalidayo oyobarwanetie, agaita abana babo abamura nomoro, agwo ase Hekalu yabo Enchenu, na tabete namabera ase onde bwensi, abamura gose abaiseke abekungi, ase abagotu gose abare ne chinguru. Bonsi bakabekwa ase amaboko ’omoruoti bw’Abakalidayo.

Ebikorero bionsi bi’enyomba ya Nyasae, ebinene na ebike, ne chinibo chionsi chiarenge ase enyomba y’Omonene na ase enyomba y’omoruoti, na ase echi’abagambi barenge amo nere, ebinto ebio bionsi akabiira Babeli.
Agasamba enyomba ya Nyasae na agatagora chindwaki chia Yerusalemu, agasamba ne chinyomba chionsi chi’oboruoti na agasaria ebikorero bionsi bie rigori rinene biarengeo.
Abanto baria batooregete bataitetwe nemioro akabang’anyia gochia Babeli, barabwo bakaba abasomba asare na ase abanto b’ororeria rwaye, goika ekero oboruoti bw’Abaayemi bwabete ne chinguru.

Igo ring’ana riria Omonene akwanete goetera ase Yeremia rigaikeranigwa, na ense eria nigo yatimogete. Ekero ense eria yatigarete ere amatongo, nigo yarendete Esabato, goika emiaka emerongo etano na ebere ekaera.

Ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba gwa Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, Omonene agaikerania ayakwanete goetera ase Yeremia. Agaseegeta na koberora omoika o Koresi, omoruoti oria, akamosukia arike ring’ana na koriraria ase chinsemo chionsi chi’oboruoti bwaye, ogoteba:

“Amang’ana aya naro inche Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, ngoteba: Omonene, Nyasae o igoro, ong’eire amaruoti onsi are ase ense. Ere onchikire imoagachere enyomba aaria Yerusalemu, omochie ore ase ense y’Abayuda. Onde bwensi ore ase egati yaino, ore bw’abanto baye, tiga atiire agende aroro, na Omonene, Nyasae oye, abe amo nere.”

Ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba gwa Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, Omonene agaikerania ayakwanete goetera ase Yeremia. Agaseegeta na koberora omoika bw’omoruoti oria, akamosukia arike ring’ana na koriraria ase chinsemo chionsi chi’oboruoti bwaye, ogoteba:

“Amang’ana aya naro inche Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, ngoteba: Omonene, Nyasae o igoro, ong’eire amaruoti onsi are ase ense. Ere onchikire imoaagachere enyomba aaria Yerusalemu, omochie ore ase ense y’Abayuda.

Onde bwensi ore ase egati yaino, ore bw’abanto baye, tiga atiire gochia Yerusalemu, aaria ase ense y’Abayuda, erinde aagache enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, na Nyasae oye abe amo nere. Ere nere Nyasae omenyete Yerusalemu.
Aande onsi onde obo atigarete ore omomenyi, abanto b’aase agwo bamokonye chifeta, ne chitahabu, na ebinto binde, ne chitugo, amo nebiegwa bi’ogwancha ase enyomba ya Nyasae aaria Yerusalemu.”

Erio abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abayuda na Ababenjamin amo nabakuani na Abalawi, kera omonto oyo Nyasae akunire omoika oye ng’a atiire, erinde aagache naende enyomba y’Omonene aaria Yerusalemu, bakebeka ang’e.
Abanto bonsi abamenyete amo nabarabwo bakabakonya ase okobaa ebikorero bie chifeta, na ebie chitahabu na ebinto binde, ne chitugo, na ebinto bie rigori rinene, amo nebinto baruete ase ogwancha.
Boigo omoruoti Koresi akairania ebikorero bi’enyomba y’Omonene, biria Nebukadinesaro arusetie Yerusalemu na akabigacha ase enyomba ye chinyasae chiaye.
Ebikorero ebio Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, akabia Mitiredati, omoteneneri bwe chikungo. Mitiredati akabibara, akabia Sesibasari, omogambi bw’Abayuda.

Oyo noro omobaro bw’ebinto ebio: Chisani chiroisirie korwa ase chitahabu, emerongo etato (30), ne chisani chiroisirie korwa ase chifeta, elifu eyemo (1,000), na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, emerongo ebere na kianda (29);
chibakuri chiroisirie korwa ase chitahabu, emerongo etato (30), na echiroisirie korwa ase chifeta, amagana ane, na ikomi (410), naende ebikorero binde, elifu eyemo (1,000).

Ebikorero bionsi biaroisirie korwa ase chitahabu ne chifeta nigo biarenge chilifu isano, na amagana ane (5,400). Ebio bionsi Sesibasari akabiira Yerusalemu; ekero abanto baria barenge ase obosomba baruete Babeli, bakagenda Yerusalemu.

Aba nabwo abanto b’orogongo rwa Yuda, baria Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, airete Babeli ase obosomba, bairanete gocha Yerusalemu na ase ense y’Abayuda. (Kera oyomo akagenda komenya ase omochie oye
amo nabarenge kobaraa: Serubabeli na Yesua, Nehemia na Seraya, Reelaya na Moredekai, Bilisani na Misipari, Bigiwai na Rehumu, na Baana). Omobaro bw’abasacha baria b’Abaisraeli noro oyo:
Abanto b’ororeria rwa Parosi: chilifu ibere, ne rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na ebere, na babere (2,172);
aba orwa Sefatia: amagana atato, na emerongo etano na ebere, na babere (372);
aba orwa Ara: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batano (775);
aba orwa Pahati‐Moabu be chiamate chia Yesua na Yoabu: chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na atato, na ikomi na babere (2,812);
aba orwa Elamu: elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo etano, na bane (1,254);
aba orwa Satu: amagana kianda, na emerongo ene, na batano (945);
aba orwa Sakai: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano nomo (760);
aba orwa Bani: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ene, na babere (642);
aba orwa Bebai: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ebere, na batato (623);
aba orwa Asigadi: elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo ebere, na babere (1,222);
aba orw’Adonikamu: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano nomo, na batano nomo (666);
aba orwa Bigiwai: chilifu ibere, na emerongo etano, na batano nomo (2,056);
aba orw’Adini: amagana ane, na emerongo etano, na bane (454);
aba orw’Ateri b’eamate ya Hezekia: emerongo kianda, na batano na batato (98);
aba orwa Besai: amagana atato, na emerongo ebere, na batato (323);
aba orwa Yora: rigana erimo, na ikomi na babere (112);
aba orwa Hasumu: amagana abere, na emerongo ebere, na batato (223);
aba orwa Gibari: emerongo kianda, na batano (95).
Abanto ba Bethlehemu: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batato (123);
abanto ba Netofa: emerongo etano, na batano nomo (56);
abanto b’Anatoti: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (128);
abanto b’Asimaweti: emerongo ene, na babere (42);
abanto ba Kiriati‐Arimu, na Kefira, na Beroti: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ene, na batato (743);
abanto ba Rama na Geba: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ebere, na oyomo (621);
abanto ba Mikimasi: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na babere (122);
abanto ba Beteli na Ai: amagana abere, na emerongo ebere, na batato (223);
abanto ba Nebo: emerongo etano, na babere (52);
abanto ba Magibisi: rigana erimo, na emerongo etano, na batano nomo (156);
abanto ba Elamu o kabere: elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo etano, na bane (1,254);
abanto ba Harimu: amagana atato, na emerongo ebere (320);
abanto ba Lodi, na Hadidi, na Ono: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ebere, na batano (725);
abanto ba Yeriko: amagana atato, na emerongo ene, na batano (345);
abanto ba Sanaa: chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etato (3,630).
Omobaro bw’abakuani noro oyo: Abwo b’ororeria rwa Yedaya be chiamate chia Yesua: amagana kianda, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batato (973);
aba orwa Imeri: elifu eyemo, na emerongo etano, na babere (1,052);
aba orwa Pasuri: elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo ene, na batano na babere (1,247);
aba orwa Harimu: elifu eyemo, na ikomi na batano na babere (1,017);
Abalawi nabwo aba: Abe chiamate chia Yesua na Kadimeli, ab’ororeria rwa Hodawia: emerongo etano na ebere, na bane (74).
Abateri nabwo abanto b’ororeria rw’Asafu: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (128).
Abarendi b’ebiita nabwo abe chiamate chia Salumu, na Ateri, na Talimoni, na Akubu, na Hatita, na Sobai; bonsi nigo barenge rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na kianda (139).
Abakori emeremo be Hekalu nabwo aba: Abanto be chiamate chia Siha, na Hasufa, na Tabaoti;
Kerosi, na Sia, na Padoni;
Lebana, na Hagaba, na Akubu;
Hagabu, na Salimai na Hanani;
Gideli, na Gahari, na Reaya:
Resini, na Nekoda, na Gasamu;
Usa, na Pasea, na Besai;
Asina, na Meunimu, na Nefusimu;
Bakubuki, na Hakufa, na Harihuri;
Basiluti, na Mehida, na Harisa;
Barikosi, na Sisera, na Tema;
Nesia na Hatifa.
Abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba ba Sulemani: Chiamate chia Sotai, na Hasofereti, na Peruda;
Yaala, na Darikoni, na Gideli;
Sefatia na Hatili, Pokereti‐Hasebaimu na Ami.
Abakori emeremo bonsi be Hekalu, amo nabanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba ba Sulemani nigo barenge amagana atato, na emerongo kianda; na babere (392).

Aba nabwo abanto bachete korwa Teli‐Mela, na Teli‐Harisa, na Kerubu, na Adani, na Imeri, korende tibanyarete koorokia ase okomanyereria chiamate chiabo, nonya ne chinderia chiabo, gose ekeene ng’a n’Abaisraeli bare:
Abanto be chiamate chia Delaya, na Tobia, na Nekoda, bonsi namagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano na babere (652).
Boigo nase abakuani: Abanto be chiamate chia Habaya, na Hakosi, na Barisilai, oyio onyuomete oyomo bw’abaiseke ba Barisilai Omogileadi, na akarokwa ase erieta riaye.

Abwo bakariga‐rigia korwa ase emeroberio ye chinderia gose mbanyore chisokoro chiabo, korende tichianyoretwe chirikire aroro. Ase ayio bakaangwa tibaba abakuani, ekiagera nigo babaretwe koba abatachenegeti.
Omogambi akabakania ng’a tibabaisa koria endagera yarenge enchenu mono, goika engaki omokuani arenge gochia koboria Nyasae goetera ase Urimu na Tumimu.
Omoganda bwonsi bw’abanto oiranete nigo orenge chilifu emerongo ene na ibere, na amagana atato, na emerongo etano nomo (42,360),
amo nabasomba babo, abasacha na abakungu, chilifu isano na ibere, na amagana atato, na emerongo etato, na batano na babere (7,337). Boigo mbabwate abateri, abasacha na abakungu, amagana abere (200).
Naende mbabwate chibarasi amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etato, na isano nemo (736), ne chiyombo amagana abere, na emerongo ene na isano (245),
ne chingamia amagana ane, na emerongo etato, na isano (435), ne chitigere chilifu isano nemo, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ebere (6,720).
Na abateneneri bande be chiamate chiria ekero bachete ase enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu, bakarua ebiegwa bi’ogwancha ase okoagachera enyomba ya Nyasae aase aye.

Bakarua buna barenge konyara, bakabeka ase ekungo y’ogokorerwa emeremo ebisamunye bie chitahabu bikorokwa chidariki, chilifu emerongo etano nomo na eyemo (61,000), na ebie chifeta bikorokwa chimina, chilifu isano (5,000), ne chianga chi’abakuani, rigana erimo (100).

Abakuani, na Abalawi, na abanto bande, bakaba bakomenya ase emechie yabo. Abateri, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, nabarabwo bakaba bakomenya ase emechie yabo, na Abaisraeli bonsi ase emechie yabo.
Ekero omotienyi o gatano na kabere oigete, na Abaisraeli bamenyete ase emechando yabo, bonsi bagasangererekana ase obomo agwo Yerusalemu.

Erio Yesua, mosinto o Yosadaki, amo nabakuani bamwabo, na Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na abanto bamwabo, bakaimoka koagacha egesasimero kia Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, bamoruere ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase kerokio, buna arikire ase amachiko a Musa, omonto o Nyasae.
Bakaagacha egesasimero keria aase aye, erinde bamoruere Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa mambia na morogoba, ekiagera nigo bairogete abanto bamenyete ase ense eria.
Barabwo bakaba bakorenda Rituko Rinene ri’Ebigutu, koreng’ana buna riachigetwe, na kera rituko bakaba bakorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase omobaro ochikire o kera rituko.

Amo nayio bakaba bakorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa bia botambe, na ebi’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ebi’Amatuko ande Amanene aatananetwe ase Omonene, amo nebing’wanso bi’ogwancha, ebio omonto arenge korua ase Omonene.
Abanto bagachaka korua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Omonene ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, korende oboroso bwe Hekalu y’Omonene konya tiborabekwa.

Abanto bakarua chibesa, bakaa abaagacheri b’amagena, na abasenia be chibao, naende bakarua chindagera, na ebinyugwa, na amaguta ’amazeituni, ase Abasidoni na Abaturo, erinde barente emecharake korwa Lebanoni goetera ase enyancha goika Yopa, koreng’ana buna Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi abaete ribaga.

Ase omotienyi o kabere, omwaka o kabere, nyuma abanto kobairanire gocha ase enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu, emeremo egachakwa. Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yesua, mosinto o Yosadaki, bagachaka emeremo amo nabanto bamwabo, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na bonsi abachete Yerusalemu korwa ase obosomba. Abalawi bonsi abarenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na goetania bagachorwa gotenenera emeremo y’enyomba y’Omonene.

Yesua na abamura baye amo nabamwabo, na Kadimeli na abamura baye, abanto b’ororeria rwa Hodawia, bakaba bagotenenera abakori emeremo b’enyomba ya Nyasae. Barabwo bakaba bagokonywa nabanto b’eamate ya Henadadi na abana babo, abarenge Abalawi.

Ekero abaagachi bachagete kobeka oboroso bwe Hekalu y’Omonene, abakuani babegete chianga chi’obokuani bagacha nebirombeta, na Abalawi abarenge b’ororeria rw’Asafu babwate chisani chigoakanigwa kwoga, ase okomotogia Omonene, koreng’ana buna Daudi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, achigete.

Bakaba bagotera na goitabererania, bagotogia Omonene na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, bagoteba, “Omonene nomuya, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye ase Abaisraeli nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.” Abanto bonsi bagaaka amariogi amanene komotogia Omonene, ekiagera oboroso bw’enyomba y’Omonene konya bwabekirwe.

Abange ase abakuani, na Abalawi, na abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, baria barenge abagotu, abaroche enyomba eria ye ritang’ani, bono ekero baroche oboroso bw’eyio enyia bwabekirwe, bakarera na koiyeria amariga. Korende abange bagaaka amariogi amanene ay’omogoko.
Abanto tibanyarete gwatanana amariogi ’omogoko are goakwa korwa ase aria ay’okorera. Nigo baagete amariogi amanene mono akaigweka gochia aare mono.
Bono ekero ababisa b’Abayuda, na ab’Ababenjamin baigwete ng’a abanto baria bairanire korwa ase obosomba naende ng’a nkoagachera bare Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, Hekalu,

bakagenda ase Serubabeli, na ase abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, bakabatebia, “Tiga tobaagachisie, naintwe nabo togosasima Nyasae oino buna inwe mogokora, na ase chingaki korwa kare gese Esari‐Hadoni, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, oria otorentete aiga, twabeire tokorwa ebing’wanso ase Nyasae oyo.”

Korende Serubabeli, na Yesua, na abateneneri bande be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bakabakania, bakabatebia, “Inwe timogwenereti motoagachisie enyomba ya Nyasae oito, korende nintwe tweka toraagachere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyomba, buna Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi atochigete.”
Erio abanto b’ense eria bagaita Abayuda emioyo, bakaboboyia ng’a tibagenderera koagacha.

Abanto abwo bakarenta abasemia baare goakanerwa, nabwo bakaba bakorua ogosemia okobe gosaria emeroberio yabo, bakaba bagokora igo korwa amatuko ’okogamba gwa Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, goikera ay’okogamba kwa Dario, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi.
Ase omochakano bw’okogamba kw’Ahaswero, ababisa baria bakarika amang’ana ay’ogosoera abanto bamenyete ase orogongo rw’Abayuda, na ase Yerusalemu.

Naende ase amatuko ’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, Bisilamu, na Mitiredati, na Tabeeli, na abanto bande babwataine komo, bakarikera Aritasasita rirube ase chinuguta chi’Ekearamaiki na ase omonwa oyio.
Boigo Rehumu, omosemia omonene, na Simusai omoriki, bakarikera Aritasasita rirube bagosoera Yerusalemu.

Erio Rehemu, omosemia omonene, na Simusai omoriki, na abande babwataine nabarabwo: abagambi ebina, na abagavuna, na abanene b’oboruoti, na Abaayemi, na Abaereki, na Abababeli, na Abasusa korwa ase ense y’Abaelamu,

na abanto b’ebisaku binde biria Osinapari, oyorenge omonene naende osikire, arentete, akababeka komenya ase emechie ya Samaria na ase chinsemo chinde chi’orogongo roria, bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, bakarika rirube.
Aya naro amang’ana e rirube riria riarigetwe: “Ase Aritasasita omoruoti. Intwe abasomba bao aba tomenyete aiga bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, twagokwanirie.

“Aye omoruoti, bono manya ng’a Abayahudi aba barua asore, bagacha asetore aiga Yerusalemu, bachakire koagacha omochie oria oichire nogosaria na obobe. Nigo bare ang’e gokoora chindwaki chiaye na koroisia amaroso aye.

Aye omoruoti, manya ng’a onye omochie oyo okoagachwa naende, ne chindwaki chiere koagachwa, rirorio abanto aba tibakorua ebango, gose echogo y’ebinto babwate, gose ebango ye chinchera, na ebitoki bi’omoruoti nigo birakee.
Na ekiagera intwe tokonyora omonyo oito korwa ase enyomba yao, aye omoruoti, titogwancha korora aye gokorenterwa ogochaywa buna okwo. Ase ayio twatomire amang’ana ayio asore, aye omoruoti,

erinde obotuki bokorwe ase chibuku aase amang’ana e chisokoro chiao arikire. Nonyore korwa ase amang’ana arigetwe ase chibuku chiria ng’a omochie oyo noyo bw’obobe na ogotaigwera, obeire okorenta emechando ase abaruoti, na ase chingongo chionsi, naende ng’a eburu‐buru na ogosaria nigo biarengeo korwa kare. Ayio agerete omochie oyio ogasarigwa.
Intwe nigo togokomanyia, aye omoruoti, ng’a omochie oyo oise koagachwa naende, ne chindwaki chiaye chiagachwe chiere, rirorio orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati tirokoba orwao.”

Omoruoti agatoma amairanerio aya: “Ase Rehemu, omosemia omonene, na Simusai omoriki, na ase abanto baria bande babwataine nabarabwo bamenyete Samaria, boigo nase baria barenge ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, nabakwanirie.
“Rirube mwatoma gocha asetore riasomirwe buya asende, nariigure.
Nachika, na obotuki bogakorwa na amang’ana akanyorekana ng’a omochie oyio korwa kare obeire okorwania abaruoti, na ogotaigwera, na eburu‐buru amo namariomana mbiarenge imeo.
Abaruoti barenge nokobua babeire bakogambera Yerusalemu na orogongo rwonsi rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, na abwo babeire bakorenterwa ebango na echogo y’ebinto na eye chinchera.
Ase ayio inwe karue ogochika ng’a abanto abwo batangwe batige gokora emeremo, erinde omochie oyio otigwe, toagachwa naende goika ekero inche ndarue ogochika.
Timobaisa gotebana ase amang’ana aya. Nase ki inche omoruoti ndanyore emechando?”

Erio ekero rirube ri’omoruoti Aritasasita riasometwe ase Rehumu, na ase Simusai omoriki, na ase abanto abwo babwatanete nabarabwo, barabwo bakagenda Yerusalemu bwango kegima ase Abayahudi, na ase chinguru bakababetereria ng’a tibagenderera koagacha.
Bono emeremo yare gokorwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu egasiekwa kegima na ekaba egendererete gosiekwa goika omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kwa Dario, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi.
Bono ekaba ng’a ase erieta ria Nyasae, oyore Omonene obo, ababani Hagai na Zakaria bw’ororeria rwa Ido mbabanete ase Abayahudi abamenyete ase ense ya Yuda na Yerusalemu.
Erio Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yesua, mosinto o Yosadaki, bagachaka koagacha naende enyomba ya Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu, na ababani ba Nyasae mbarengeo amo nabarabwo ase okobakonya.

Ase engaki eyio Tatenai, omogavuna bw’orogongo orwo rwa bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abande babwataine nabwo, bagacha, bakababoria, “Ning’o obaa ribaga mokoagacha enyomba eye na gokoora koagacha orwaki orwo?”
Naende bakaboria iga, “Abaagachi b’oboagacho obo, naki bakorokwa?”

Korende eriso ria Nyasae obo nigo riarenge ririgereretie abagaaka b’Abayahudi, na abanto baria tibabatangete goika amang’ana aria amoikere Dario. Nyuma y’ayio bairanerigwe ase rirube igoro y’amang’ana ayio.
Ase igo Tatenai, omogavuna bw’orogongo orwo rwa bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abagavuna bande baare kogamba amo nabarabwo ase orogongo orwo bagatoma rirube ase Dario omoruoti.
Bakamotomera amang’ana arikire iga: “Ase Dario omoruoti, omorembe bwonsi obe asore!

“Nigo togokomanyia aye omoruoti ng’a intwe ntwagenda ase orogongo orwo rw’Abayuda, ase enyomba ya Nyasae oyore omonene. Nigo egendererete koagacherwa amagena amanene mono, ne chibao chibekire ase chinyasi. Ekeene, emeremo eye nigo egokorwa ase okwerwa okonene, na nigo esesenirie ase amaboko abo.
“Agwo ntwakwana nabagaaka baria, tokababoria iga: Ning’o obaa ribaga mokoagacha enyomba eye na gokoora koagacha orwaki oro?
Naende ntwababoria amarieta abo, erinde tokorikere amarieta ’abatang’ani abwo babo.

“Amang’ana aya naro batotebia: Intwe nigo tore abasomba ba Nyasae o igoro na ense, na nigo tokoagacha naende enyomba eria omoruoti omonene bw’Abaisraeli aagachete na akayekoora ase emiaka emenge yaetire.

Korende ekiagera chisokoro chiaito chiagerete Nyasae o igoro akaba nendamwamu, ere akabeka abanto baria ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro Omokalidayo, omoruoti o Babeli, oria osaretie enyomba eye na akaira abanto Babeli.
Korende ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba gwa Koresi, omoruoti o Babeli, ere Koresi naruete ogochika ng’a enyomba eye eagachwe naende.

Na ebikorero bi’enyomba ya Nyasae biaroisirie korwa ase chitahabu ne chifeta, ebio Nebukadinesaro arusetie korwa ase Hekalu yarenge aiga Yerusalemu, akabiira akabibeka ase hekalu yare Babeli. Ebikorero ebio omoruoti Koresi akabirusia ase hekalu ya Babeli, akabia omonto okorokwa Sesibasari oyo abegete koba omogavuna,
akamotebia ng’a arente ebikorero ebio, abibeke ime ase Hekalu ere aiga Yerusalemu, naende atige enyomba ya Nyasae eagachwe aase yarenge.
Bono Sesibasari nere ochagete kobeka oboroso bw’enyomba ya Nyasae ere aiga Yerusalemu, na korwa engaki eyio goika rero iga, enyomba eye nigo egendererete koagachwa, teraera.

“Gaki bono, aye omoruoti, onye amang’ana aya agokogwenera, ochike obotuki bokorwe ase amagachero e chibuku chi’oboruoti bwa Babeli, omanye gose Koresi omoruoti naruete ogochika ng’a enyomba ya Nyasae ere Yerusalemu eagachwe naende. Aye omoruoti ototomere aya orengereretie igoro y’amang’ana aya.”
Omoruoti Dario agachika, na obotuki bogakorwa ase chibuku chiagachire agwo Babeli ase amagachero ay’oboruoti.
Na agwo Ekibatana, omochie omonene ase orogongo rw’Abamedia, ebuku ekanyorekana erikire amang’ana aya:

“Ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Koresi, ere akarua ogochika okwo: Enyomba ya Nyasae ere Yerusalemu, tiga eagachwe naende, na oboroso bwaye bokong’igwe, erinde ebing’wanso bionsi, amo na biria bi’ogosambwa, birentwe aroro na koruegwa. Obotambe bw’enyomba eyio gochia igoro bobe obw’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na obogare bobe obw’amaboko emerongo etano nomo.
Amagena aagachwe ase chindwaro isato, na orwaro oromo roagachwe ne chibao. Chibesa chiraakanerwe chirwe ase ekungo y’oboruoti.

Naende ebikorero bi’enyomba ya Nyasae biroisirie korwa ase chitahabu ne chifeta, biria Nebukadinesaro arusetie korwa ase Hekalu yare Yerusalemu, akabiira Babeli, bionsi biiranigwe bibekwe naende ime ase Hekalu ere Yerusalemu; mobibeke ime ase enyomba ya Nyasae, kera ekemo aase aye.”

Ase ayio Dario akarika rirube iga: “Bono aye Tatenai, omogavuna bw’orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abagavuna bande abwo mokogamba komo agwo ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche roria, inwe beera aare kegima.
Inwe tiga emeremo egokorwa ase enyomba eyio ya Nyasae egenderere; tiga omogavuna bw’Abayahudi, na abagaaka babo bagenderere koagacha naende enyomba ya Nyasae aase yarenge.

Amo nayio nachikire amang’ana morakorere abagaaka abwo b’Abayahudi ase okoagacha enyomba eyio ya Nyasae naende. Emeremo yonsi nigo eraakanerwe korwa ase chibesa chi’ekungo y’oboruoti, echikorwa ase ebango eria ekorusigwa korwa ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati; mobe mokobaakana motari gotebana.

Na kende gionsi abakuani bare agwo Yerusalemu baraganie baegwe. Kera rituko nigo baraegwe chieri chinsae, ne chimingichi gose ching’ondi, chibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Nyasae o igoro. Boigo baegwe engano, na omonyo, na edivai, na amaguta ’amasabibu. Baegwe ebinto ebio, tibamocha kobiegwa.
Igo mbanyare komoruera Nyasae o igoro ebing’wanso bikomogwenera, na gosabera obogima bwane, inche omoruoti, na obw’abamura baane.
Boigo nachikire ng’a, monto onde bwensi oraonchore ring’ana eri, omwamba osomorwe korwa ase enyomba yaye, na ere omonyene atongwe ase oro, na enyomba yaye ekorwe ebe etui y’eubi.

Tiga Nyasae, oyo obekire erieta riaye ribeere aroro, aonchore na koiyeria inse omoruoti onde bwensi, gose abanto, barateeme koonchora ogochika oko, gose gosaria enyomba eye ya Nyasae ere Yerusalemu. Inche Dario narure ogochika okwo, tiga koigwerwe kegima.”
Bono Tatenai, omogavuna bw’orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche roria, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abarenge kogamba komo, bagakora ase okwerwa amang’ana ayio onsi Dario omoruoti konya achikire.

Abagaaka b’Abayahudi bakagenderera koagacha na konyora ogosesenigwa goetera ase obobani bwa Hagai na Zakaria bw’ororeria rwa Ido. Igo abanto bagakoora emeremo y’oboagacho obwo buna bachigetwe na Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, na buna Koresi, na Dario, na Aritasasita, abaruoti b’Abaayemi bachigete.
Enyomba eria ekaagachwa ekaera ase rituko ria gatato ri’omotienyi okorokwa Adari, ase omwaka o gatano na rimo bw’okogamba kwa Dario, omoruoti.
Bono Abaisraeli: abakuani, na Abalawi, na abanto bande abwo bairanete korwa ase obosomba, bagakora omoyega omonene bw’omogoko ase ogwatanana enyomba eria ya Nyasae na koyechena.

Na ase ogwatanana enyomba eye na koyechena, bakarua chieri rigana erimo, ne chimingichi amagana abere, ne chimanwa chimingichi chie ching’ondi amagana ane, chikaba ebing’wanso. Boigo bakarua chigoree ikomi na ibere chikaba ebing’wanso bi’ebibe ase engencho y’Abaisraeli. Echio nigo chiaruetwe koreng’ana nomobaro bw’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.
Boigo bakabeka abakuani ase ebiombe biabo, na Abalawi ase emeremo yabo, ase okomokorera Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu, koreng’ana buna erikire ase ebuku ya Musa.
Ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, abanto baria bairanete korwa ase obosomba bakarenda Epasaka.

Abakuani na Abalawi konya bechenire; bono bonsi nigo barenge abachenegete. Ase ayio bakanyenya chimanwa chiria chie ching’ondi chi’Epasaka ase engencho y’abwo bonsi bairanete korwa ase obosomba, na ase abakuani bamwabo, na ase barabwo abanyene.

Chinyama chie chimanwa chiria nigo chiarietwe n’Abaisraeli baria bairanete korwa ase obosomba, boigo na kera omonto bweatananete korwa ase ogosaria kw’abanto b’ebisaku b’ense eria na kobwatana n’Abaisraeli ase ogosasima Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere bakaba barendete Rituko riria Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera bare nomogoko. Omonene nigo abarenterete omogoko oyio ase okoonchora enkoro y’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, erinde akabancha akabakonya mono ase emeremo y’enyomba ya Nyasae oyore Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
Nyuma y’amang’ana aria kaerire ase engaki y’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, omoruoti bw’ense y’Ayemi, narengeo omonto okorokwa Ezara, mosinto o Seraya, bw’Asaria, o Hilikia,
o Salumu, o Zadoki, bw’Ahitubu,
bw’Amaria, bw’Asaria, o Merayoti,
o Seraya, o Usi, o Buki,
bw’Abisua, o Finehasi, bw’Eleazari, o Haroni, omokuani omonene.

Ezara oyio akarua Babeli. Ere nigo arenge omworokia bw’amariko; nigo orokereretigwe na omanyete mono amachiko a Musa, ayio Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aruete; na ekiagera okoboko kw’Omonene, Nyasae oye, kwarenge amo nere, omoruoti akamoa gento kende gionsi aboretie.
Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere bw’okogamba kw’Aritasasita omoruoti, abande b’Abaisraeli, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abateri, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, bakagenda Yerusalemu.
Bono ase omwaka o gatano na kabere, omotienyi o gatano, bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti oria, Ezara agaika Yerusalemu.

Nigo achagete orogendo rwaye korwa Babeli ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, na agaika Yerusalemu rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano, ekiagera okoboko kwa Nyasae oye kwarenge amo nere ase okomokonya.
Ezara konya orure enkoro yaye kweorokereria amachiko ’Omonene na koyakora, naende nigo arenge kworokereria Abaisraeli emeroberio yaye, na okogamba kwaye kwa boronge.

Amang’ana aya naro arikire ase rirube riria omoruoti Aritasasita aete Ezara, omokuani na omworokia bw’amariko, oyo bworokereretigwe na omanyete mono amachiko ’Omonene na emeroberio yaye echikire ase Abaisraeli:
“Inche Aritasasita, omoruoti bw’abaruoti, ngokorikera inde aye Ezara omokuani, aye kwegerete amachiko a Nyasae o igoro. Amakwania amo nayakobwatia ayio.
“Nachikire ng’a monto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli, gose oyo bw’abakuani babo, gose oyo bw’Abalawi, oyomenyete ase oboruoti bwane, karanche kogenda Yerusalemu amo naye, tiga agende.
“Inche omoruoti, amo nabasemia baane batano na babere, twagotomire ogende komanya amang’ana ’ense y’Abayuda, na aya Yerusalemu, kobwatekana namachiko a Nyasae oo, ayio obwate ase okoboko kwao.
Naende oire chifeta ne chitahabu chiria inche omoruoti, na abasemia baane, twarure nogwancha ase Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyio obomenyo bwaye bore Yerusalemu.
Boigo oire chifeta ne chitahabu chionsi, echio oranyore korwa ase ense yonsi ya Babeli, oire nokoruegwa kw’ogwancha okwo abanto na abakuani bararue ase enyomba ya Nyasae obo ere Yerusalemu.

“Obe omwegenwa, na ase chibesa echio ogore chieri, ne chimingichi, ne chimanwa chie ching’ondi, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa bikoruegwa amo nebing’wanso ebio. Orue ebinto ebio ase egesasimero ki’enyomba ya Nyasae oo ere agwo Yerusalemu.
Emeremo ende yonsi aye amo nabanto bamino morarore ere buya, chibesa chiratigare mochiyekorere, korende mokore igo kobwatekana nogwancha kwa Nyasae oino.
Ebikorero ebio kwaeirwe gokorera emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae oo, obiire bionsi, obibeke ase obosio bwa Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu.
Ebinto binde bionsi biganeirie ase enyomba ya Nyasae oo, ebio ogwenerete korenta aroro, obigore ne chibesa chikorwa ase ekungo y’omoruoti.

“Naende inche omoruoti Aritasasita narure ogochika ase abagachi bonsi be chikungo bare ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati ng’a, gento kende gionsi Ezara omokuani oyo bwegerete amachiko a Nyasae o igoro araganie korwa asemore, mogekorere ase oboronge.

Momoe goikera chifeta chitalanta rigana erimo (100), na engano ebitonga elifu eyemo (1,000), na edivai chilita chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600), na amaguta ’amazeituni chilita chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600), na momoe omonyo otari na kerengo.

Gento kende gionsi Nyasae o igoro arachike ng’a gekorwe, ekio gekorwe boronge ase engencho y’enyomba ya Nyasae o igoro, erinde endamwamu ya Nyasae tebaisa koba igoro y’oboruoti bwane, na abamura baane.

Naende nigo tokobamanyia ng’a timobaisa kobeka ebango gose ogochoga ase onde bwensi bw’abakuani, gose Abalawi, gose abateri, gose abarendi b’ebiita, gose abakori emeremo be Hekalu, gose abakori emeremo bande b’enyomba ya Nyasae.

“Bono aye Ezara kwaeirwe obong’aini na Nyasae oo. Obokorere emeremo ase ogochora abagambi ebina na abamanyi b’amachiko, erinde babe bakogamba ebina bi’abanto bonsi ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, aba bonsi bamanyete amachiko a Nyasae oo; na abatayamanyeti oborokererie bayamanye.
Monto onde bwensi oraange koigwera amachiko a Nyasae oo, na ay’omoruoti, oyio anacherwe ekina kia boronge, kebe eki’ogokwa, gose eki’ogoserigwa, gose kourwa ebinto biaye, gose asibwe.”
Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, atogigwe, oria obegete ring’ana eri ime ase enkoro y’omoruoti, oyobwanchire gokora enyomba y’Omonene ere Yerusalemu ebe ensiani mono.

Ere Omonene oorokirie asende obwanchani bwaye botari koera ase obosio bw’omoruoti, na ase abasemia baye, na abanene bonsi bare gokonya omoruoti bare nokobua. Inche nkaba noboremu, ekiagera okoboko kw’Omonene, Nyasae one, kwarenge amo nainche, na igo ngasangereria abatang’ani b’Abaisraeli batiire amo nainche.
Abanto aba nabwo abateneneri be chiamate echio chiaruete Babeli, chigatiira amo nainche, ekero Aritasasita arenge kogamba, na oyo nomoroberio bwe chinderia chiabo:
Korwa ase ororeria rwa Finehasi, Gerisomu; korwa ase orwa Itamari, Danieli; korwa ase orwa Daudi, Hatusi
orwa Sekania; korwa ase orwa Parosi, Zakaria, amo nabwo barigetwe amo nere, abasacha rigana erimo, na emerongo etano (150);
korwa ase orwa Pahati‐Moabu, Eliehoenai, mosinto o Seraya, na amo nere abasacha amagana abere (200);
korwa ase orwa Satu, Sekania, mosinto o Yahasieli, na amo nere abasacha amagana atato (300);
korwa ase orw’Adini, Ebedi, mosinto o Yonathani, na amo nere abasacha emerongo etano (50);
korwa ase orw’Elamu, Yesaia, mosinto bw’Atalia, na amo nere abasacha emerongo etano na ebere (70);
korwa ase orwa Sefatia, Sebadia, mosinto o Mikaeli, na amo nere abasacha emerongo etano na etato (80);
korwa ase orwa Yoabu, Obadia, mosinto o Yehieli, na amo nere abasacha amagana abere, na ikomi na batano na batato (218);
korwa ase orwa Bani, Selomiti, mosinto o Yosifia, na amo nere abasacha rigana erimo, na emerongo etano nomo (160);
korwa ase orwa Bebai, Zakaria, mosinto o Bebai, na amo nere abasacha emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (28);
korwa ase orw’Asigadi, Yohanani, mosinto o Hakatani, na amo nere abasacha rigana erimo, na ikomi (110);
korwa ase orw’Adonikamu, abachete nyuma y’abande nabwo aba: Elifeleti, na Yeueli, na Semaya, na amo nabarabwo abasacha emerongo etano nomo (60);
korwa ase orwa Bigiwai, Utai na Sabudi, na amo nabarabwo abasacha emerongo etano na ebere (70).

Bono ngasangereria abanto abwo ase orooche rogotirimbokera gochia ase Ahawa, na agwo togatoora, tokabeera aroro ase amatuko atato. Ekero naitaaete abanto amo nabakuani, tinanyorete Abalawi aroro nonya noyomo.

Erio ngatoma abanto korangeria Eliezeri na Arieli, Semaya na Elinatani, Yaribu na Elinatani, Nathani na Zakaria, na Mesualmu, abwo barenge abaraai b’abanto; boigo nkarangeria Yoyaribu na Elinatani, abarenge abanto abanyasemi.

Ngatoma abanto abwo gochia ase Ido, omotang’ani bw’aase akorokwa Kasifa, bamotebie ere amo nabanto bamwabo, abarenge abakori emeremo be Hekalu abamenyete aroro ng’a batotomere abanto bache gokorera Nyasae oito ase enyomba yaye.

Nyasae oito nigo atokonyete nokoboko kwaye okuya, bagatotomera Serebia orenge omonto omong’aini bw’ororeria rwa Mali, mosinto o Lawi o Israeli, amo nabamura baye na abamwabo, bonsi abanto ikomi na batano na batato.
Boigo bagatoma Hasabia na Yesaia bw’ororeria rwa Merari, na abamwabo, na abana babo, bonsi nabanto emerongo ebere.

Naende bagatoma abakori emeremo be Hekalu amagana abere, na emerongo ebere (220), ekeombe kere buna Daudi na abakonyi baye bachorete gokonya Abalawi ase emeremo yabo. Abwo bonsi nigo batoretwe ase amarieta abo.

Erio agwo ase orooche rw’Ahawa, nkarareria abanto, nkabatebia ng’a tweng’ate, naende twekeyie tobe abaitongo ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito na korigia korwa asare oborendi obuya ase orogendo rwaito, intwe na abana baito, na ebinto biaito bionsi.

Nigo nabete nobosooku kobooria omoruoti atoe ekeombe ki’abarwani esegi, na eki’abariini chibarasi ng’a bache gotorenda ase orogendo rwaito, ng’a titokorerwa bobe nababisa baito, ekiagera konya namotebirie ng’a okoboko kwa Nyasae oito nigo gokorenta amaya ase abwo bonsi bakomorigia, naende ng’a endamwamu yaye ere nokobua nigo ekoba igoro y’abwo bonsi bakomotiga.
Ase engencho y’ayio tokeng’ata na koboria Nyasae oito, nere akaigwa okoboria gwaito kw’ogosorora.
Erio ngachora abakuani ikomi na babere, abarenge abatang’ani: Serebia na Hasabia, amo nabakuani bande bamwabo ikomi.
Bono nkabarengera chifeta, ne chitahabu; na ebikorero, ebio omoruoti, na abasemia baye, na abagambi bare komokonya, na Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge agwo, konya barure ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

Ebi nabio nabaete: Chitalanta chie chifeta amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano (650), na ebikorero biaroisirie korwa ase chifeta bie rigori rie chitalanta rigana erimo (100), ne chitahabu chitalanta rigana erimo (100),

ne chibakuri emerongo ebere chiaroisirie korwa ase chitahabu chire chie rigori buna erie chidariki elifu eyemo, na ebikorero bibere biaroisirie korwa ase chitaai chichenire bire bie rigori buna erie chitahabu.

Ngatebia abakuani, “Inwe nigo more abachenekire ase Omonene, na ebikorero nabirobio biachenekire. Chifeta ne chitahabu echio nigo chiarurwe chire ebiegwa bi’ogwancha ase Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito.
Chigache na gochirenda goika ekero morachirenge ase obosio bw’abakuani abanene na Abalawi, na ase abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bare Yerusalemu ime ase ebinyomba bi’enyomba y’Omonene.”
Ase ayio abakuani na Abalawi bakaimokia chifeta ne chitahabu echio barengerete amo nebikorero, erinde baire ebinto ebio Yerusalemu, ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito.

Bono ase rituko ria ikomi na kabere ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani tokarua agwo ase orooche rw’Ahawa kogenda Yerusalemu. Okoboko kwa Nyasae oito nigo kwarenge amo naintwe gototooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baito, na korwa ase abanto barenge gotoboera inchera.
Ekero twaigete Yerusalemu, tokabeera aroro ase obotoereru amatuko atato.

Ase rituko ria kane togasoa ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito; erio chifeta, ne chitahabu, na ebikorero biria, bikarengwa bikabekwa ase amaboko a Meremoti omokuani, mosinto o Uria, oyorenge amo na Eleazari, mosinto o Finehasi, na ase Abalawi aba: Yosabadi, mosinto o Yesua, na Noadia, mosinto o Binui.
Ebinto ebio bionsi bikabarwa bikarengwa oborito bwabo, na oborito bwa kera egento bokarikwa.

Abanto abwo bairanete korwa ase obosomba bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli; bakarua chieri ikomi na ibere ase engencho y’Abaisraeli bonsi, naende bakarua chimingichi emerongo kianda na isano nemo (96), ne chimanwa chie ching’ondi emerongo etano na ebere, na isano na ibere (77). Naende bakarua chigoree ikomi na ibere chikaba ebing’wanso bi’ebibe. Ching’iti echio chionsi nigo chiaruetwe chikaba ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Omonene.

Abanto abwo bakarenta amang’ana arigetwe nomoruoti, bakayaa abagambi abanene ase oboruoti, na abagavuna b’orogongo rwa bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, barabwo bonsi bakaba bagokonya abanto, bagakonya nenyomba ya Nyasae.

Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio onsi kaerire, abatang’ani bagacha asende, bagantebia, “Abaisraeli, amo n’abakuani, na Abalawi, tibeatananeti korwa ase abanto abamenyete ase chinse echio. Nigo bagokora okogechia okwo Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abayebusi, na Abaamoni, na Abamoabu, na Abamisiri, na Abaamori bagokora.

Barabwo banyuomire abaiseke b’abanto abwo, naende banyuomeirie abamura babo abaiseke b’abanto abwo. Bono egesaku eke egechenu giochoganire nabanto be chinse echi. Abagambi na abatang’ani b’abanto nabwo bare abe ritang’ani ase ogokora okwo kw’ogotegenwa.”
Ekero naigwete amang’ana ayio, nigo natandorete chianga chiane na eganchwa yane, ngasunyora etukia yane, ne chinderu chiane, erio ngaikaransa ngaichana.

Abanto bonsi abaigusetwe ase engencho y’amang’ana aria Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli akwanete igoro y’ogotegenwa kw’abanto baria bairanete korwa ase obosomba, bagasangererekana asende agwo ase naikaransete ing’ichanete goika engaki y’okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba.

Na ekero engaki y’okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba yaigete, nkaimoka korwa aase aria naikaransete inyekeetie, imbegete chianga na omwambaro one otandogete, erio ngatung’ama inse nkaumama, nkarambora amaboko aane gochia ase Omonene, Nyasae one,

ngasaba, “Aye Nyasae one, nabeire nobosooku, na obosio bwane bwabeire nomoichano; tinkonyara gokorigereria aye Nyasae one. Ebibe biaito biabuchire gotoetania goika igoro, na okomocha gwaito gwaikire agwo igoro.

Korwa amatuko e chisokoro chiaito goika rero iga twabeire tore nokomocha okonene, na ase engencho y’ebibe biaito intwe, na abaruoti baito, twabeire tokobekwa ase amaboko ’abaruoti be chinse, na goitwa nemioro, na gwoswa, naende togasakorwa na twabeire tokonyora obosooku, buna ere goika rero iga.

Omonene Nyasae oito ase engaki enke kwaorokirie obuya bw’amabera asetore, gwatotigire abatigari abatwatoorekire; gwatonyoreire obotamero ime y’Aase ao Aachenu. Nigo kwamorekeire amaiso aito ase engaki, erinde totimoke na tobe abayia ase obosibwa bwaito.

Intwe nigo tore abasibwa; nonya naboigo, aye Nyasae oito toratotiga ase obosibwa bwaito. Aye gwatoorokeirie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na kwagerire twanyorire ogwancherwa ase abaruoti b’Abaayemi. Barabwo batoeire ribaga koagacha naende enyomba yao, eria yatagoretwe, aye Nyasae oito, na twaeirwe eburi egotokengera aiga ase ense y’Abayuda na ase Yerusalemu.
“Na bono, aye Nyasae oito, ninki toranyare gokwana nyuma y’amang’ana aya onsi? Intwe twatigire kobwata amachiko ao,

ayio gwachigete goetera ase abasomba bao ababani ogateba: Ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino nigo ere eyetachenegeti, ekiagera abanto b’aroro bayekorire yabeire enyaka ase okoyeichoria nogokora kwabo gw’okogechia korwa ensinyo eyemo goika eyende.

Ase ayio, timobaisa gosokia abaiseke baino ase abamura babo, gose timobaisa kobarigeria omorembe gose ogosesenigwa. Mobe abakong’u na morie amaya ay’ense eye na moyetigere abana baino ebe omwando obo kogenderera botambe.

Na bono nonya amang’ana aya onsi aikire gotonyora ase engencho y’ogokora gwaito okobe, na okomocha gwaito okonene, twarorire ng’a aye, Nyasae oito, totoeti egesusuro buna ebibe biaito bigwenerete, korende gwatotigeire abatigari buna aba iga.

Inee! Ntosarie naende amachiko ao na tonyuomerane nabanto aba bagokora okogechia oko? Inee! Igo aye tokoba nendamwamu asetore na otosirie kegima, erinde abatigari tibanyorekana, gose monto onde atooreke?

Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo ore omonyene oboronge, korende gwatotigairie intwe tore abake boka abatwatoorekire, buna tore aiga rero. Rora, nigo tore aa ase obosio bwao tokoorokia okomocha gwaito, na monto tari oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwao ase engencho y’okomocha buna oko.”

Bono ekero Ezara agendererete gosaba na koorokia amamocho, okorera na oramaime inse bosio bw’enyomba ya Nyasae, omosangererekano omonene mono bw’Abaisraeli, abasacha na abakungu, na abana, bagacha asare. Abanto abwo bonsi nigo babete bakorera bare nobororo obonge.

Erio Sekania, mosinto o Yehieli, oyo bw’eamate ya Elamu, agakwana na Ezara, akamotebia, “Intwe titori abegenwa ase Nyasae oito, ekiagera twanyuomire abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao bi’abanto b’ense eye. Nonya nabo, ogosemeria ngotigarete koba ase Abaisraeli.

Bono tokore okobwatana kw’ogotianania na Nyasae oito, erinde toserie abakungu abwo bonsi amo nabana babo. Tokore igo ase okobwatia ogosemia kwao, aye omonene one, na okw’abanto abwo babeire nobwoba na koiguswa ase engencho y’amachiko a Nyasae oito. Tiga ring’ana erio rikorwe koreng’ana namachiko.
Imoka, ekiagera emeremo eye naye echigete, na intwe nigo tore amo naye; kabe omoremu oyekore.”
Erio Ezara akaimoka, akaboria abakuani abarenge abatang’ani, na Abalawi, na Abaisraeli bonsi, koria eira na gotiana ng’a mbakore buna batebetigwe. Ase ayio bakaria eira, bagatiana.

Ezara akarua agwo ase enyomba ya Nyasae, akagenda ase akanyomba ka Yehohanani, mosinto bw’Eliasibu, akabeera aroro; taria kende gose konywa, korende nigo abete okorera, ekiagera abanto baria barenge ase obosomba tibabete abegenwa.
Erio amang’ana akararigwa ase ense yonsi y’Abayuda, na ase Yerusalemu, ng’a abanto abwo bairanete korwa ase obosomba basangererekane agwo Yerusalemu.

Naende akararigwa ng’a monto onde bwensi orenge kwanga, tacha ase engaki y’amatuko atato, buna abatang’ani na abagaaka bachigete, oyio aurwe ebinto biaye, naende arusananigwe tabaisa koba oyomo bw’omoganda bw’abanto abwo barwete ase obosomba.

Ase engaki eyio y’amatuko atato Abayuda bonsi na Ababenjamin bagasangererekana agwo Yerusalemu. Erio nigo riarenge rituko ri’emerongo ebere ri’omotienyi o kianda. Abanto abwo bonsi bagaikaransa ase eraaro isiko, bosio bw’enyomba ya Nyasae, bakaba bakoiguswa ase engencho ye ring’ana riria, naende ekiagera embura yarenge enyinge.
Agwo Ezara omokuani agatenena, akabatebia, “Inwe timobeti abegenwa, mwanyuomire abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao; ase igo mwagerire amamocho ’Abaisraeli amentekanire.
Gaki bono oorokia okomocha okwo ase Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, naende mokore ogwancha kwaye. Mweatanane korwa ase abanto b’ense eye na motige abakungu abwo b’ebisaku ebiao.”
Erio omosangererekano bwonsi okairaneria ase eriogi rinene, ogateba, “Amang’ana ayio nabo are, goika tokore buna gwatebire.

Korende abanto aba nabange mono, na engaki eye ney’embura enyinge, titokonyara kogenderera gotenena aa isiko ase eraaro. Emeremo eye teri eye rituko erimo, gose ey’amatuko abere, ekiagera twamochire mono ase ring’ana eri.

Gaki tiga abatang’ani baito batenenere omoganda bwonsi. Erio abanto bonsi bare ase emechie yaito banyuomire abakungu abwo b’ebisaku ebiao bache ase chingaki barachikwe; bachiche bare amo nabagaaka na abagambi ebina ba kera omochie. Ase enchera eyio nabakendie endamwamu ya Nyasae oito igoro ye ring’ana eri, erinde ebe yaonchokire etotige.”
Yonathani, mosinto bw’Asaeli, na Yaseya, mosinto o Tikiwa, barabwo tibanchete amang’ana aria, na Mesulamu na Sabetai Omolawi bakababwatisia.

Abanto abairanete korwa ase obosomba bagakora buna batebetigwe. Ezara omokuani agachora abanto abarenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, oyomo oyomo korwa ase kera eamate, na bonsi bakarikwa amarieta abo. Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o ikomi, barabwo bagachaka gotuka amang’ana aria,
na ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani bagakoora obotuki igoro y’abasacha bonsi aba konya banyuomire abakungu korwa ase ebisaku ebiao.
Abanto be chiamate chi’abakuani konya banyuomire abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao nabwo aba: Ab’eamate ya Yesua, mosinto o Yosadaki, na abamwabo: Maaseya, na Eliezeri, na Yaribu, na Gedalia.
Abwo bakaria eira goseria abakungu baria babo na barue kera oyomo emingichi eyemo korwa ase riicho riaye ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha kwabo.
Ab’eamate ya Imeri: Hanani na Sebadia;
ab’eamate ya Harimu: Maaseya na Elija, Semaya na Yehieli, na Usia;
ab’eamate ya Pasuri: Elioenai na Maaseya, Isumaeli na Netaneli, Yosabadi na Elasa.
Abalawi nabwo aba: Yosabadi na Simei, Kelaya (nere Kelita) na Petahia, Yuda na Eliezeri.
Oyo bw’abateri: Eliasibu, Abwo b’abarendi b’ebiita: Salumu, na Telemu, na Uri.
Abaisraeli bande: Ab’eamate ya Parosi: Ramia na Isia, Malikia na Miyamini, Eleazari na Malikia na Benaya;
ab’eamate ya Elamu: Matania na Zakaria, Yehieli na Abidi, Yeremoti na Elija;
ab’eamate ya Satu: Elioenai na Eliasibu, Matania na Yeremoti, Sabadi na Asisa;
ab’eamate ya Bebai; Yehohanani na Hanania, Sabai na Atilai;
ab’eamate ya Bani: Mesulamu na Maluku, Adaya na Yasubu, Seali na Yeremoti;
ab’eamate ya Pahati‐Moabu: Adina na Kelali, Benaya na Maaseya, Matania na Besaleli, Binui na Manase;
ab’eamate ya Harimu: Eliezeri na Isia, Malikia na Semaya, Simeoni
na Benjamin, Maluku na Semaria;
ab’eamate ya Hasumu; Matenai na Matata, Sabadi na Elifeleti, Yeremia na Manase, na Simei;
ab’eamate ya Bani: Maadai na Amuramu, Ueli
na Benaya, Bedeya na Keluhi,
Wania na Maremoti, Eliasibu
na Matania, Matenai na Yaasu;
ab’eamate ya Binui: Simei
na Selemia, Nathani na Adaya,
Makinadebai na Sasai, Sarai
na Asareli, Selemia na Semaria,
Salumu na Amaria, na Yusufu;
ab’eamate ya Nebo: Yeieli na Matitia, Sabadi na Sebina, Yadai na Yoeli, na Benaya.
Abanto aba bonsi konya banyuomire abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao, na abande b’abwo konya baiboire abana.
Aya namang’ana a Nehemia, mosinto o Hakalia. Ase omotienyi o Kisilewi, omwaka bw’emerengo ebere, ekero narenge ase eburi agwo Susa, omochie omonene,

Hanani, oyomo bw’abaminto, agacha amo nabanto bande korwa ase ense y’Abayuda. Nkababoria igoro y’Abayahudi bande batigarete aroro bare moyo, abwo konya batoorekire korwa ase obosomba, naende nkababoria amang’ana igoro ya Yerusalemu.

Bakang’iraneria, bagantebia, “Abatigari baria batooretigwe korwa ase obosomba bare ase orogongo rwabo, nigo bare ase emechando emenene na ogochaywa okonene Orwaki rwa Yerusalemu rwatagoirwe, na ebiita biaye biasambirwe.”
Ekero naigwete amang’ana ayio, ngaikaransa inse, nkarera. Ase amatuko atai make nkaba nkobokia amagombo na kweng’ata amo nogosaba ase obosio bwa Nyasae ore igoro,
ngateba, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae ore igoro, Nyasae Omonene bw’okoirokia, aye bwanchete na korenda okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania na kobaa obuya abwo bagwanchete na babwatete amachiko ao.

Ndigererie oigwe ogosaba kwane, inche omosomba oo. Nigo ngosaba ase obosio bwao omobaso na obotuko, ase engencho y’abasomba bao Abaisraeli, na koorokia ebibe intwe Abaisraeli twakorire asore. Ee, ekeene, nonya ninche amo nabanto b’eamate ya tata twakorire ebibe.
Twakorire ogosaria okobe mono asore, twatigire kobwata amachiko na emeroberio echikire, ebio gwachigete Musa, omosomba oo.
Bono inyora amang’ana aria gwachigete Musa, omosomba oo, okamotebia: Inwe motabeti abegenwa, goika imbasiarere gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku ebiao.
Korende komorang’iranere na kobwata amachiko aane, nonya mwaserigwe gochia ase chinsinyo chi’ense, nigo ndabasangererie korwa aase agwo, mbarente aase nachorire kobeka erieta riane ribeereo.
“Omonene, aba nigo bare abasomba bao na abanto bao. Naye kwababooretie nokobua kwao okonene goetera ase okoboko kwao kore ne chinguru.

Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane, inche omosomba oo, amo nogosaba kw’abasomba bao, abwo bare nomogoko ase okoiroka erieta riao. Insesenia inche, omosomba oo, rituko ria rero, inyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’omonto oyo.” Ase engaki eyio nigo narenge omobogoria bw’ebinyugwa bi’omoruoti.

Ase rituko erimo, ase omotienyi o Nisani, omwaka bw’emerongo ebere bw’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, edivai ekarentwa asare, na inche nkayeimokia, nkamoyea. Inche konya tinana koba nomoichano ase obosio bwaye ase engaki ende yonsi.

Ase ayio omoruoti akamboria, “Nase ki okororekana kore nomoichano iga, naye tori omorwaire? Ekio tikeri egento ekeao otatiga obororo bore ase enkoro yao.” Ekero akwanete igo, nkaba nobwoba obonene mono,

nkamoiraneria, “Aye omoruoti ochie kare! Inki keragere tindorekana inde nomoichano ekero omochie oria, aase chimbeera ohie chisokoro chiane chire, ogendererete koba ritombe, na ebiita biaye biasarigwe nomorero?”
Erio omoruoti akamboria, “Ngento ki oganetie okorerwe?” Inche nkagenderera gosaba Nyasae o igoro.

Erio ngatebia omoruoti, “Onye yakogweneire aye omoruoti, na inche, omosomba oo, nanyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, ong’e ribaga ngende ase ense y’Abayuda, ase omochie oria ase chisokoro chiane chiatindegetwe, erinde nyoagache naende.”

Ekero eting’ana mokaye yaikaransete agwo, omoruoti akamboria, “Nengaki eng’ana naki oganetie kogenda, naende indi orairane?” Ekero naroche ng’a omoruoti bwanchire kong’a ribaga, nkamotebia engaki eisaine.
Naende ngatebia omoruoti, “Onye kwanyancheire, indikere amarube ng’irere abagambi b’orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, erinde bang’e ribaga ng’eteo ngende ase ense y’Abayuda.

Naende orike rirube rinde ase Asafu, omorendi bwe rinani ri’omoruoti, erinde ang’e emete ngochia koroiseria emetobwa y’ebiita bi’eburi ere ase Hekalu, na ey’okoagachera orwaki rw’omochie, boigo ney’okoagachera enyomba yane ase nkomenya.” Omoruoti agankorera ayio onsi namoboretie, ekiagera okoboko okuya kwa Nyasae one nigo kwarenge amo nainche.
Erio omoruoti agatoma amo nainche abarwani esegi, na abariini chibarasi, akang’a rirube nkairera abagambi abarenge bosongo y’orooche roria, nkabaria.
Korende ekero Sanibalati korwa Beti-Horoni, na Tobia, omonene bw’orogongo rw’Abaamoni, baigwete ng’a omonto gete ochire gokorera Abaisraeli amaya, bakagechigwa bakaba nekeririanda ekenene mono.
Ase igo ngacha Yerusalemu, nkabeerao ase engaki y’amatuko atato.

Erio nkaimoka botuko amo nabanto bande bake. Tinatebetie monto onde amang’ana Nyasae konya abekire ime ase enkoro yane, ayio narenge gochia gokorera Yerusalemu. N’giti ende yonsi tiyarenge nainche otatiga eria nariinete ekero nachete.

Ase obotuko obwo ngaetera ase Egeita kie Rikura, gochia ase Ensoko y’Enchoka, ngaika ase Egeita ki’Eubi, nkarata chindwaki chia Yerusalemu, echio chiatagoretwe, na ebiita biaye biria biasaretigwe nomorero.
Naende ngaeta gochia ase Egeita gi’Ensoko na ase Ritibo ri’Omoruoti, korende aase akabora ase eng’iti eria nariinete egoetera.
Ase obotuko obwo nkagenda ase rikura, nkarata orwaki, erio nkairanera aase naeterete, ase Egeita kie Rikura, erio nkairana gochia aase narenge.

Abanene b’ensemo eria tibamanyete ase nagendete, gose eki narenge gokora, ekiagera konya tindatebia Abayahudi gento, gose abakuani, gose abanto basikire, gose abanene, gose abanto bande bonsi abaare gocha gokora emeremo.

Korende bono nkabatebia, “Mwarorire emechando yatonyorire aa: Yerusalemu otagoirwe, na ebiita biaye biasambirwe. Inchuo toagache naende orwaki rwa Yerusalemu, erinde titobaisa kogenderera koba nobosooku bw’ogochaywa.”

Naende nkabatebia ng’a okoboko kwa Nyasae one nigo kwarenge amo nainche gonkorera amaya, boigo nkabatebia amang’ana ’Aritasasita omoruoti antebetie. Barabwo bakabora, “Tochake koagacha omochie naende.” Ase ayio bakabekana chinguru gokora emeremo eyio emiya.

Korende ekero Sanibalati korwa Beti-Horoni, na Tobia, omonene bw’orogongo rw’Abaamoni, na Gesemu Omoarabu, baigwete amang’ana ayio, bagatosekerera na gotochecheria, bakaboria, “Ngento ki eke mogokora? Nigo mogochia kwanga timoigwera omoruoti?”

Erio nkairaneria, nkabatebia, “Nyasae o igoro natosesenie togenderere ase obuya; ase ayio intwe, abasomba baye, nkoagacha tore omochie oyo naende; korende inwe timobwati egetari kende gionsi aiga, gose timobwati oboronge gose okoinyorwa konde gwonsi ase Yerusalemu.”

Erio Eliasibu, omokuani omonene, amo nabakuani bande bamwabo, bakaagacha Egeita gie Ching’ondi, bakagiatanana ase okogechena, bakabeka ebisieri biaye. Bagaatanana orwaki goikera ase Omorobiri bwe Rigana, naende goikera ase Omorobiri o Hananeli, bakarochena.
Abanto ba Yeriko bakamobwatia, bakaagacha ensemo ende; na oyobwatetie abanto aba, n’Sakuri, mosinto o Imuri.
Basinto ba Hasena bakaagacha Egeita gie Chinswe, bagakebekera emetobwa na ebisieri, na ebisiekero, na emekorogoto.
Oyobwatetie abwo koagacha, i’Meremoti, mosinto o Uria o Hakosi. Oyobwatetie ere koagacha, i’Mesulamu, mosinto o Berekia o Meshesabeli. Oyo obwatetie ere n’Zadoki, mosinto o Baana.
Abanto ba Tekoa bakabwatia abwo koagacha, korende abanene babo abasikire tibakumbete emegongo yabo ase ogokora emeremo y’Omonene obo.
Yehoyada, mosinto o Pasea, na Mesulamu, mosinto o Besodeya, bakaagacha Egeita Egekoro, bagakebekera emetobwa, na ebisieri, na ebisiekero, na emekorogoto.
Ababwatetie abwo koagacha, i’Melatia Omogibeoni, na Yadoni Omomeroni, na abanto ba Gibeoni, na aba Misipa, abwo barenge inse y’obogambi bw’omogavuna bw’orogongo rwa bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati.

Oyobwatetie abwo koagacha, nere Usieli, mosinto o Harahaya, oyomo bw’abaturi be chifeta. Oyo omobwatetie koagacha nere Hanania, oyomo bw’abaroisia amaguta akweakwa, agotioka buya. Abwo bakaagacha Yerusalemu goikera aase are korokwa Orwaki Oronetu.
Oyo obwatetie abwo koagacha, n’Refaya, mosinto o Huri, omogambi bw’ekeng’ese ki’orogongo rore rwa Yerusalemu.
Oyo obwatetie abwo koagacha, n’Yedaya, mosinto o Harumafu: ere akaagacha orwaki rwarochie mwaye. Oyomobwatetie koagacha, nere Hatusi, mosinto o Hasabineya.
Malikia, mosinto o Harimu, na Hasubu, mosinto o Pahati-Moabu, bakaagacha ensemo ende; boigo bakaagacha Omorobiri bw’Eriko.
Oyo omobwatetie koagacha, n’Salumu, mosinto o Halohesi, omogambi bw’ekeng’ese ki’orogongo rwa Yerusalemu. Abaiseke baye bakamokonya.

Hanuni amo nabanto bamenyete Sanoa bakaroisia Egeita kie Rikura, bagakebekera ebisieri, na ebisiekero, na emekorogoto. Boigo bakaagacha orwaki ase obotambe bw’amaboko elifu eyemo, goika ase Egeita ki’Eubi.
Malikia, mosinto o Rekabu, omogambi bw’orogongo rwa Beti-Hakeremu, akaagacha naende Egeita ki’Eubi, agakebekera ebisieri, na ebisiekero, na emekorogoto.

Salumu mosinto o Koli-Hose, omogambi bw’orogongo rwa Misipa, akaagacha naende Egeita gi’Ensoko, agakeagachera ekerama na gokebekera ebisieri, na ebisiekero, na emekorogoto. Boigo akaagacha orwaki rwe Ritibo ria Siloa, eriarenge ang’e nomogondo bw’omoruoti, goikera ase ebiriinero biare gotirimbokerwa korwa ase Omochie o Daudi.

Oyobwatetie oyio, Nehemia, mosinto bw’Asubuki, omogambi bw’ekeng’ese ki’orogongo rwa Beti-Suri, akaagacha orwaki goikera ensemo yarochie chimbeera chia Daudi chiarenge ase ritibo riaremetwe, na goikera ase enyomba y’abanto abarenge nokobua.
Ababwatetie Nehemia koagacha n’Abalawi inse y’oboteneneri bwa Rehemu, mosinto o Bani. Oyo omobwatetie, nere Hasabia, omogambi bw’ekeng’ese ki’orogongo rwa Keila; ere akaagacha ase orogongo rwaye.
Nyuma yaye abamwabo bakaagacha, bare inse y’oboteneneri bwa Bawai, mosinto o Henadadi, omogambi bw’ekeng’ese ki’orogongo rwa Keila.
Oyobwatetie oyio, n’Eseri, mosinto o Yesua, omogambi o Misipa; ere akaagacha korwa ensemo ende yarochie egetiiro gochia aase ebirwanero biarenge kogachwa goikera ase Chinsanganio.
Oyobwatetie oyio, m’Baruki, mosinto o Sabai; ere agakora omokia akaagacha ensemo ende, gochakera ase Chinsanganio goikera ase egesieri ki’enyomba y’Eliasibu, omokuani omonene.
Oyobwatetie oyio, i’Meremoti, mosinto o Uria o Hakosi; ere akaagacha ensemo ende, gochakera ase egesieri ki’enyomba y’Eliasibu goikera ase ensinyo y’enyomba eria.
Ababwatetie Meremoti koagacha nabakuani abamenyete ase ense omweya.
Nyuma y’abwo Benjamin na Hasubu bakaagacha ensemo y’enyomba yabo. Oyobwatetie abwo, n’Asaria, mosinto o Maaseya bw’Anania; ere akaagacha ensemo y’enyomba yaye.
Oyobwatetie oyio, m’Binui, mosinto o Henadadi; ere akaagacha ensemo ende gochakera korwa ase enyomba y’Asaria goikera ase Chinsanganio naende oikera ase Ekoona.

Oyobwatetie oyio, nere Paali, mosinto o Usai; ere akaagacha ensemo yarochie Chinsanganio na omorobiri ochongororogete korwa ase enyomba ya rogoro y’omoruoti, eyio yarenge ang’e neraaro y’echela. Oyobwatetie oyio, nere Pedaya, mosinto o Parosi.

Ere akaagacha ensemo ende ya moocha, ang’e n’Egeita ki’Amache, na ase omorobiri ochongororogete gochia igoro. (Aase agwo nigo arenge ang’e n’Ofeli, ensemo y’omochie aase abakori emeremo be Hekalu bamenyete.’)
Abanto korwa Tekoa bakabwatia abwo, bakaagacha ensemo yarochie omorobiri oria omotambe, bagaikera orwaki rw’Ofeli.
Korwa ase Egeita gie Chibarasi na kogenderera abakuani bakaagacha, kera oyomo ensemo yarenge ang’e nenyomba yaye.
Oyobwatetie abwo, n’Zadoki, mosinto o Imeri; ere akaagacha ensemo yarenge ang’e nenyomba yaye, na nyuma yaye, Semaya, mosinto o Sekania, omorendi bw’Egeita kia Moocha.

Hanania, mosinto o Selemia, na Hanuni, omomura o gatano na rimo o Salafu, abwo bakaagacha ensemo ende. Oyobwatetie abwo, i’Mesulamu, mosinto o Berekia; ere akaagacha ensemo ende yarenge ang’e nakanyomba kaye.

Nyuma yaye, Malikia, oyomo bw’abaturi chifeta, akaagacha ensemo ende goikera ase enyomba y’abakori emeremo be Hekalu, na ey’abaonchoreria, agwo ang’e n’Egeita gi’Okorobera, na kogenderera goika ase akanyomba ka irongo agwo ase Ekoona.
Ase egati y’akanyomba ka irongo agwo ase Ekoona na Egeita gie Ching’ondi, abaturi be chifeta na abaonchoreria bakaagacha aroro.
Ekero Sanibalati aigwete ng’a intwe Abayahudi konya twachakire koagacha orwaki rw’omochie naende, akaba nekeririanda ekenene, agachaka gotochecheria.

Agakwana ase amasio ’abanto bamwabo na ase abarwani esegi b’Abasamaria, agateba, “Ngento ki eke Abayahudi aba aboro abagundo bagokora? Inee! Mbanyare kweagachera naende omochie oyio? Mbarue ebing’wanso aase aa naende? Mbanyare gokoora emeremo eyio ase rituko erimo? Gose mbanyare koremora korwa ase chitui chi’amagena aya asambetwe bayakore abe amayia?”
Tobia Omoamoni, oyorenge ang’e nere, agateba, “Nabaagacha orwaki orwo naki, ekebwe geise koriina igoro nigo keraroiyerie rogwe inse.”
Ngasaba, “Aye Nyasae oito, igwa buna twachayirwe. Tiga ogochaya kwabo kobairanere, baurwe ebinto biabo, nabarabwo abanyene boswe bairwe ase obosomba.
Tobaisa gotuba ebibe biabo, gose kobitinyia korwa ase obosio bwao, ekiagera bagerire kwabeire nendamwamu asetore intwe abaagachi.”
Ase igo tokagenderera koagacha orwaki roria goika rokabwatanigwa, rogaikera ekeng’ese ki’obotambe bwaye gochia igoro, ekigaera abanto nigo babwate chinkoro chire morero ase ogokora emeremo eyio.

Korende ekero Sanibalati, na Tobia, na Abaarabu, na Abaamoni, na Abaasidodi baigwete ng’a oboagacho bwe chindwaki chia Yerusalemu nigo bogendererete buya, naende ng’a aase abochogete nkoiranerigwa are, bakaba nendamwamu enene.
Bakabwatana amo bakabekana omokia, erinde bagende bonsi amo ase okorwania Yerusalemu na koburukania abakori emeremo.
Korende intwe togasaba Nyasae oito, tokabeka abanto barenge gotorenda omobaso na obotuko, ase engencho y’abanto abwo.
Erio Abayahudi bagateba, “Chinguru chi’abakobogoria chigurube chiorobire, na amaoomo namange mono ase okogokomora, goika twasinyirwe gokora emeremo y’okoagacha orwaki.”
Ababisa baito nigo bateba, “Abayahudi tibagotoigwa gose gotorora, goika tobabosokane, tobaite totange emeremo eyio.”
Korende Abayahudi abamenyete ang’e nababisa baito, bakaba bagocha gotokurera nonya ngoika ara ikomi, ng’a ababisa abwo nigo barachiche korwa ase chinsemo chionsi batorwanie.
Ase igo nkabeka abanto maate, magega y’orwaki, aase aasie; nkababeka eamate ase eamate, bare nebirwanero biabo: emioro, na amatimo, na amata.

Nkarigereria nkamanya buna amang’ana arenge, Erio ngakwana nabanene basikire, na abatang’ani, na abanto bande bonsi, nkabatebia, “Timobaisa kwoboa ababisa abwo; moinyore Omonene, oyore nokobua, naende oyo bw’okoondokia, morwanere abanto bamino, na abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, na abakungu baino, ne chinka chiaino.”
Ekero ababisa baito baigwete ng’a twamanyire emeroberio yabo, naende ng’a Nyasae oyesaririe, tokairana twensi ase okoagacha, na kera omonto agakora emeremo aetwe gokora.

Ekaba korwa ase engaki eyio na kogenderera ng’a ekeng’ese ki’abasomba baane bakagenderera koagacha, na ekeng’ese kende bakabeka chianga chi’ebioma, babogoretie amatimo, ne chinguba, na amata; na abatang’ani bagatenenera Abayuda bonsi,
abwo barenge koagacha orwaki. Abanto abwo barenge kobogoria chigurube, nigo barenge gokora emeremo nokoboko okomo, na okonde kobogoretie ekerwanero.
Kera oyomo bw’abaagachi nigo eboeranetie omoyio oye o birende kenema kiaye ekero agendererete koagacha; na omobugia egetureri nigo ateneine ang’e nainche.

Erio ngatebia abanene baria basikire, na abatang’ani, na abanto bande, “Emeremo nigo ere emenene, naende egareete, na intwe nigo twesiarerete ase orwaki rwonsi, na kera omonto nigo are aare korwa ase oyonde.
Agwo aase ore koraigwe eriogi ri’egetureri, oche aa asetore; Nyasae oito natorwanere.”
Ase ayio tokagenderera gokora emeremo emekong’u. Korwa mambia chuni, goika obotuko, ekero ching’enang’eni chiaorokire, ekeng’ese ki’abanto nigo bagendererete kobogoria amatimo abo.
Boigo ngatebia abanto ng’a kera omonto amo nomosomba oye babeere aiga Yerusalemu, babe bakorenda botuko, na mobaso babe bagokora emeremo y’okoagacha.

Ase igo inche, gose abaminto, gose abasomba baane, gose abarendi abarenge amo nainche, onde tarenge korusia chianga chia mobere; kera oyomo nigo abwate ekerwanero kiaye nonya nekero akogenda kobuucha amache.
Abanto bande, abasacha na abakungu babo, bakarera na kwemurungania ase Abayahudi bamwabo.
Abande bagateba, “Intwe amo nabana baito, abamura na abaiseke, nigo tore abange, ntoganetie tonyore endagera torie, erinde togenderere koba moyo.”
Boigo abande bagateba, “Intwe nkobeka tore amaremo aito, na emegondo yaito y’emesabibu, ne chinyomba chiaito, bionsi bibe intenenera; bono otoe endagera, ekiagera tore nenchara.”
Na abande bagateba, “Twasabire chibesa singo igoro y’amaremo aito, na emegondo yaito y’emesabibu, ase ogoakana ebango ase omoruoti.

Bono emebere yaito nabo ere nengencho enene buna ey’abaminto, na abana baito nigo bare nengencho enene buna ababo, ko bono rora, yatobetereirie kobeka abana baito, abamura na abaiseke, ase obosomba. Abaiseke baito bande baikire koba abasomba, korende intwe titobwati okobua kw’ogotanga ring’ana erio tiriba bo, ekiagera abanto abaao nabwo babwate amaremo aito amo nemegondo yaito y’emesabibu.”
Ekero naigwete amang’ana ’ebirero biabo nkaba nendamwamu enene;

Nkarengereria inche omonyene gokora egento ase engencho y’ayio. Ngasoera abanto basikire na abatang’ani, nkabatebia, “Inwe nigo mokwenyorera ebitoki korwa ase abamino.” Erio nkarangeria omoganda omonene gocha kogamba igoro y’amang’ana ayio,

nkayotebia, “Intwe ase okonyara gwaito twabooririe Abayahudi baminto tokabairania korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku ebio ase baoonetigwe gochia, korende inwe nigo mokoonia abanto bamino, erinde intwe tobaboorie korwa asemore tobairanie.” Abanene baria tibabwate nonya nering’ana erimo baare kobairaneria, korende nigo bakirete-kiri.
Erio naende nkabatebia, “Amang’ana aya mogokora tari amaya. Inee! Tebagwenereti momoiroke Nyasae oito ase orogendo rwaino, erio nario abanto b’ebisaku, ababisa baito, batabe nengencho y’ogotochaya?
Inche omonyene amo nabaminto, na abasomba baane, twarure chibesa na endagera singo; bono totige koboria ebinto ebio, titoakanwa.
Bono rituko ria rero bairanerie ebio bionsi baboreretigwe baakane: amaremo abo, na emegondo y’emesabibu na ey’emezeituni, ne chinyomba amo nebitoki bie chibesa mwabeire mokoboria.”

Erio abatang’ani abwo bakairaneria, bagateba, “Goika toiranie ebinto ebio, gose titoboria ebitoki korwa asebare; ntokore buna gwatebire.” Agwo nkarangeria abakuani batianie abatang’ani abwo barie eira ng’a bakore buna batebetigwe.

Erio ngasamunsa omoringo bw’omwambaro one, ngateba, “Naboigo kera oyomo oyotaikerania eira yaye, Nyasae amosamunse korwa ase abanto b’enyomba yaye, na korwa ase ebinto babwate. Ee, asamunswe abe bosa.” Omoganda bwonsi okairaneria, ogateba, “Amina,” na bakamotogia Omonene. Abanto baria bagakora buna bariete eira ng’a mbakore.

Ase engaki eria yonsi y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, ekero narenge omogambi bw’ense ya Yuda, korwa omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, goika omwaka bw’emerongo etato na ebere, bw’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, inche gose abanto baminto titwariete endagera omogambi agwenerete koegwa.

Kera omogambi ontang’anerete kogamba nigo arenge kobeka egurube endito igoro ase abanto na kobaboria barue endagera, na edivai, amo ne chibesa chisekeli chie chifeta emerongo ene. Nonya nabasomba babo nabo bakorerete abanto. Inche tinakorete buna abagambi abwo, ekiagera nigo namoirogete Nyasae.
Inche nigo nakorete omokia, nkagenderera koagacha orwaki, gose titwagorete oboremo bonde, na abasomba baane nigo babete amo nainche ase ogokora emeremo eria.

Abayahudi amo nabatang’ani babo abarenge koragera amo nainche nigo barenge rigana erimo, na emerongo etano. Naende abanto b’ebisaku binde abamenyete ase chinsemo chiaito chionsi nigo barenge gocha baragera amo nainche.

Kera rituko endagera narenge korua neng’ombe eyemo, ne ching’ondi chinoru isano nemo, amo ne chingoko; na kera rituko ria ikomi nigo narenge korua ebirandi ebinge biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, bire nedivai. Ase ebinto ebio bionsi tinarenge gosaba endagera eria abagambi bagwenerete koegwa, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo babogoretie egurube endito.
Aye Nyasae one, ong’inyore ong’e amaya koreng’ana buna amaya nakoreire abanto aba.

Sanibalati, na Tobia, na Gesemu Omoarabu, amo nababisa bande baito, batebetigwe ng’a naagachire orwaki roria, naende ng’a konya naribirie aase onsi atagoretwe. (Nonya ase engaki eria konya tindabeka ebisieri ase ebiita.)
Erio Sanibalati na Gesemu bagatoma abanto gocha kondangeria, bagoteba, “Inchuo toumerane aiga ase oyomo bw’emechie ere ase ense omweya ya Ono.” Korende nigo barengereretie gochia gonkorera amabe.
Erio ngatoma abanto asebare, nkabatebia, “Nigo ngokora emeremo ere emenene mono; tinkonyara gotirimboka gocha agwo. Nase ki ndatige emeremo etenene, ntirimboke gocha asemore?”
Bagatoma abanto asende chintunda inye, bagokwana amang’ana aria aria, na inche nkaba nkobairaneria amang’ana aria aria konya nabatebirie ritang’ani.
Naende ase entunda ya gatano, Sanibalati agatoma omosomba oye asende obwate rirube ritamumekeirie

Nigo riarikire iga: “Abanto b’ebisaku amo na Gesemu batebire ng’a aye amo n’Abayahudi bande nigo moganetie kwanga koigwera; naende ng’a nakio gekogera mokoagacha orwaki; na koreng’ana namang’ana ayio, aye noganetie koba omoruoti obo.
Tari ayio oka, korende kwabekire ababani bakoraria agwo Yerusalemu ng’a naye omoruoti bw’Abayuda. Na bono omoruoti ngochia gotebigwa are amang’ana ayio; ase ayio inchuo toumerane naye tokwane komo.”
Erio ngatoma amang’ana gochia asare, nkamoiraneria, “Amang’ana buna ayio tari ay’ekeene, ayio namang’ana ao aye omonyene okorengereria korwa ase enkoro yao na koyaroisia boigo.”

Abanto baria bonsi nigo baganetie gotwoboyia, bakorengereria ng’a nigo bagochia gotoita emioyo, toborwe chinguru chi’ogokora emeremo eyio, erinde etenene. Korende ngasaba, “Aye Nyasae, ing’a chinguru na oboremu.”
