Erio Omonene akaboria Saitani, “Naye ng’ai okorwa?” Saitani akamoiraneria, “Nigo nkorwa ase etaaro yane, nkona‐goetanana ase ense yonsi, naende nabo nkonagotiira na gotirimboka aroro.”

Agwo Omonene akaboria Saitani, “N’Ayubu, omosomba one, kwarorire buna are? Monto onde tari ase ense onga buna ere; nigo are omwegenwa na obwate enkoro endonge; ere nigo anyirogete inche Nyasae, naende nigo etangete korwa ase ogokora amabe. Nonya kwang’ebereretie komochanda ngencho ende etaiyo, ere nigo agendererete koba omwegenwa.”
Erio Saitani akairaneria Omonene, akamotebia, “Risankwa ase risankwa; omonto nigo ararue gento kende gionsi abwate ase ogotooria obogima bwaye.
Bono aye rambora okoboko kwao, okune amauga ’omobere oye, amo ne chinyama, omokore bobe, ekeene, ere nigo arakoragereria agwo ase obosio bwao.”
Naende Omonene agatebia Saitani, “Rora, Ayubu nigo are inse y’okobua kwao, korende omotige abe moyo.”
Erio Saitani akarua agwo ase Omonene, akagenda, akarentera Ayubu amagumba, gochakera chimbaratero goikera ase omotwe igoro.
Ayubu akaba ogoikaransa ase ribu, akaimokia orogio, akana‐kwearera amaote aye.
Erio mokaye akamoboria, “Inee, nonya ngoika bono nigo ogendererete koba omwegenwa ase Omonene? Ragereria Nyasae, erio okwe!”

Korende Ayubu akairaneria mokaye, akamotebia, “Aye nigo ogokwana buna omokungu omoriri agokwana. Onye tokonyora amaya korwa ase Nyasae, Inee, titokonyora amabe naro korwa asare?” Ase amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu takorete ebibe ase ogokwana kwaye.

Ayubu nabwate abasani batato: Elifasi korwa Temani, na Bilidadi korwa Sua, na Sofari korwa Naama. Ekero barabwo baigwete igoro y’emechando eria Ayubu anyorete, bagachikana ng’a kera oyomo arue bwoye, baumerane amo, bagende komwechandera na komoremia.
Bagachia komorora korwa aare, tibanyara komomanya gose nere. Bagachaka goaka amariogi bakorera; bagatandora chianga chiabo, bagesiarera ebuse gochia igoro na ase emetwe yabo.

Abanto abwo bagaikaransa inse agwo amo nere ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, omobaso na obotuko; agwo onde tabete ogokwana ing’ana rinde rionsi ase Ayubu, ekiagera baroche ng’a emechando yaye nigo yarenge emenene mono.
Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu agachaka gokwana, akaragereria rituko riria aiboretwe.
Ayubu agateba,
“Rituko riria naiboretwe, tiga risire riebwe kegima, boigo obotuko boria amang’ana aya akwanetwe: Omwana omoisia otongirwe enda ime.
Tiga rituko riria ribe omosunte; Nyasae ore igoro tabaisa koriechandera, gose omobaso tobaisa koribarera.
Tiga omosunte na ekiriri ekemwamu biritube. Tiga amare aritube, na kende gionsi egekorenta obomwamu ase rituko kerioboyie.
Omosunte ekerima otube obotuko boria, tibobaisa kobarwa amo namatuko ande ay’omwaka, gose kobarwa amo namatuko ande ay’emetienyi.
Ee, obotuko boria tiga bogombae; eriogi ri’omogoko tiribaisa koigugwa ase borobwo.
Boragererigwe nabwo bamanyete koragereria amatuko, abwo baganyete korenta Leviatani eng’iti enene y’okwoboyia.
Ching’enang’eni chiaye chia ituko ria mambia chibe omosunte; obotuko tiga bochie koganya ng’a bokie, korende tibokia rinde, gose tibobaisa korora ogokiamoka kwa mambia,
ekiagera borobwo tibwatangete baba tanyibora, gose tibwatangete emechando korwa ase amaiso aane.”
“Ninki kiagerete tinakwera inda ya baba? Ninki kiagerete tinakwa ekero keria nasogete korwao?
Ninki kiagerete baba akaang’agata? Ninki kiagerete akangonkia amabeere aye?
Onye nakwete, anga nindaire ntoererete, anga nindaire chitoro ntimogete,
buna abaruoti b’ense amo nabasemia babo bakaraire, abwo beagacherete amaagacho ’obosareku.
Inche anga nigo inde buna abanene batenengete ne chitahabu, baichoretie chinyomba chiabo ne chifeta.
Nigo nanga nabete buna enda erekeire egatindekwa, na buna abana bataroche omobaso.
Aroro agwo abakori amabe tibari gochanda abande, boigo abarosire kobaikire aroro, nigo bagotimoka.
Ekero abasibwa baikire aroro, nigo bakoba bagotimoka amo, tibari koigwa amariogi ’abarendi babo bakobabetereria nobotindi.
Abanto batasikiri na abasikire nigo bareng’anetie aroro; omosomba nigo are omosibore korwa ase oyorenge omonene oye.”
“Nase ki oyochandegete akoegwa korora omobaso? Nase ki oria obwate obororo ase enkoro akoegwa obogima?
Abwo baganyete amakweri, korende tibari koyanyora; nigo bakoyarigia kobua korigia chinibo chibisire.
Abanto abwo bakogoka mono na gochenga, ee, nabo bakogoka kobabeire ang’e kogenda ase chimbeera.
Nase ki omobaso oorokire ase omonto chinchera chiaye chibisire, oyio Nyasae agiteire chinsemo chionsi?
Obororo bw’emechando yane bwabeire buna endagera nkoria, na ebirero biane nigo bigoiteka buna amache.
Naki ring’ana riria inyoboete rianchicheire, na riria rikoondokia rianyorire.
Inche timbwati omorembe gose botoereru bonde; timbwati ogotimoka, korende emechando nigo egendererete konagocha.”
Bono Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:
“Inee! Omonto arateema gokwana naye, nogechigwe nere? Nonya naboigo, monto ki oranyare gokira‐kiri takwana?
Rora, aye kworokereirie abanto abange, na amaboko atabwate chinguru kwayakong’irie.
Amang’ana ao abeire akoremia oyo konya osinyirwe kogenderera, na aye gwakong’irie amaru aye arenge koiguswa.
Bono naye emechando yacheire, na tori noboremu bonde bwonsi, yagokunire na aye kwegosire.
Aye buna omoirogete Nyasae, tori noboremu? Naende buna chinchera chiao chire chindonge, tori nogosemeria?
Bono rengereria, indi yabete ng’a omonto omoikeranu nasiretigwe? Naende indi yabete ng’a abanto abaronge mbatugutetwe?
Aya naroche naya: Baria bakorema obosareku, na baria bagosimeka emechando, nabagese ayio ayio.
Nyasae nigo akobaeyanera basira, na ase okogusa kw’endamwamu yaye baerigwa.
Nonya bakoruma buna endo ere entindi, bakirigwe, na amaino e chindo chinsae nigo akobunwa.
Endo engotu nekwe ase okoborwa chinyama ekoria. Ne chimanwa chi’endo eaberi nigo chigoserebekana.”
“Ring’ana ndire rianchicherete bobisi, nigo nariigwete rikomonyerera.
Ekero abanto bararire chitoro chindito na inche narenge nebirengererio na korora amaroro,
obwoba bokambwata amo nokoiguswa, na amauga onsi ay’omobere one agachaka gotengechigwa.
Embeo egaeta ase obosio bwane, na amarionya ’omobere one agatenena.
Omogwekano bw’egento gete ogatenena ase obosio bwane, korende tinanyarete komanya ng’a ngento ki gose nkieni ki; erio nkaigwa eriogi eriororo rigoteba:
Inee! Mwanyabanto nanyare koba omoronge kobua Nyasae? Nanyare koba oyochenegete kobua Omotongi oye?
Rora, Nyasae tari gosemeria nonya nabasomba baye; ere nigo akobabekera abamalaika baye obobe.
Onye naboigo, naki rende arasemerie abwo bamenyete ase chinyomba chi’amaroba, abwo amaroso abo abekire ase riroba? Barabwo nigo bagoakwa na komionogorwa buna ebigwankwa.
Abanto nabo baranyare koba moyo ase engaki ya mambia, korende omogoroba otaraika, kwanyora baitirwe, basirire goika kare na kare, na onde tari okobechandera.
Bionsi ebi abanto abwo basemeretie nigo bigosira kegima. Nigo bagokwa bataraikera komanya obong’aini bonde bwonsi.”
“Bono rangeria! Inee! Onde nareo oragoitabere? Ase abwo abachenu, ning’o oraonchokere?
Ekeene, ogwechanda nigo kogoita omoriri, na emoko nigo egoita oyo otari omong’aini.
Nabeire nkorora omonto omoriri okogenderera bokon’gu, korende mobosokano nkaragereria enka yaye.
Abana baye tibakonyora ogokonywa, nigo bakomionogorerwa geita, gose monto onde tari okobatooria.
Abanto bare nenchara nabwo bakoria endagera eye omonto oria akogesa, abwo nigo bakoyerusia nonya egiteire namagwa; abasaneri nigo bagosanera obotenenku bwaye.
Obobe tibori korwa ase riroba, gose emechando teri korwa inse ase riroba,
korende mwanyabanto nigo akoiborwa ase okonyora emechando, buna chinsase chi’omorero chigotaroka gochia igoro.”
“Yare koba ng’a ninche nanga nigo narigia Nyasae, nere bweka nare gotebia amang’ana aane.
Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana amanene atari komanyekana buna are, boigo namakumia atanyare kobareka.
Nigo akorua embura yatwa igoro ase ense, na emegondo yanyora amache.
Ere nigo akoimokereria abanto abaitongo igoro, na abwo bachandegete bakorera, nigo akobabeka ase oborendi obuya.
Nyasae nigo agosaria emeroberio y’abang’ainereria, erinde emeremo bagokora namaboko abo tegoikerana buna baganetie.
Ere nigo akobwata abare nobong’aini ase obong’ainereria bwabo, emeroberio yabo y’ogotega nigo egosirigwa bwango.
Abanto abwo nigo bakobwatwa nomosunte mobaso gati, bataba‐taba mobaso gati buna nobotuko bore.
Korende Nyasae nigo agotooria abataka korwa ase emenwa egoita, na abaremeire korwa ase abwo bare ne chinguru.
Ase ayio abaremerwa mbabe nogosemeria, korende abakori amabe nigo barakirigwe‐kiri.”
“Nasesenirie omonto oyio Nyasae akoa egesusuro ase okomorongeyia; ase ayio tobaisa gochaya ogoaka, gw’okorongeyia kw’oyore Omonguru.
Omonene nigo akorenta amaote, naende oyaboa; ere nigo agoaka chingoma, naende okoboko kwaye kwagwenia.
Ere nagotoorie korwa ase emechando etano nomo, ee, nonya nkorwa ase etano na ebere, na amabe tagokonyora.
Ekero ki’enchara nagotoorie korwa ase amakweri, na ekero gi’esegi korwa ase abwo bagoita nemioro.
Ekero abanto bakogokwana bobe nobiswe, na ekero amabe agoita arache, toyoboa.
Ekero ogosiria na enchara birache, aye nobe gokobisekerera, gose tokwoboa ching’iti chintindi chire ase ense.
Nonya namagena are mogondo, nobwatane naro, ne ching’iti chi’orosana nobe nomorembe nachirochio.
Erio nonyare korora ng’a obomenyo bwao mborendire buya, na ekero orabe gokorata ase ameri e chitugo chiao, nonyore ng’a ende tesireti korwao.
Norore buna abana bao babeire abange, na ororeria rwao ndobuche robe oronge buna obonyansi bore ase ense.
Nogende ase embeera kore nobogotu obuya, buna emesaima y’endagera ekorentwa ekero engaki yabo yaikire.”
“Naama! Twabeire togokora obotuki ase amang’ana ayio; naro nay’ekeene. Ase ayio bono igwa amang’ana ayio, oyagache ase omoyo oo.”
Erio Ayubu akairaneria, agateba:
“Onye ndiria obororo bwane bwarenge korengwa, na emechando yane yonsi ebekwe ase ekerengo erengwe!
Ebio nigo biare ebirito kobua omokenye ore ase enyancha; ase ayio nabeire omwango ase ogokwana ayio.
Nyasae Omonguru ombetire emegwe yaye, na omoika one ong’usire obosongo bwabo; okogosa kwa Nyasae kwarobeire kondwania.
Inee! Etigere y’orosana nkwana ere, ekero egotakuna obonyansi? Gose eng’ombe nkwana ere, ekero egendererete korisia?
Onye endagera tebekiri omonyo okoyiansia, neriegwe? Inee! Omochununu bwe rigena ri’engoko nobwate obwansu?
Chindagera echio omoyo one ochiangire, chiabeire chindagera chikongechia.”
“Naki nanga yaba buya onye nanyora aya nkoboria, onye Nyasae nanchera aya nganetie!
Nigo nganetie Nyasae anche ang’ake ansegenye, arambore okoboko kwaye ang’ite nkwe!
Ayio nigo are kogera ndemigwe; nigo narenge kogoka ntari koigwa obororo bw’okoromwa oko okonene. Ekiagera tinkaneti amang’ana a Nyasae ore Omochenu.
Chinguru chiane inki chiisaine imbe nokoganya kore nogosemeria? Na omoerio one naki ogochia koba, ngenderere koremereria?
Inee! Chinguru chiane nigo chire chinkong’u buna echi’amagena? Gose omobere one nigo ore omokong’u buna etaai?
Ekeene gokonywa konde gwonsi tikori ime yane, amagenderero nabwate naurirwe.”
“Omosani nigo agwenerete kororera omonto bwerusirie moyo amabera, onye taibo, rirorio otigire koiroka Omonguru.
Abaminto bakorire obong’ainereria babeire buna chintuboka chi’amache, na buna chiooro chi’emegoko chigoeta chiaera.
Barabwo nigo banga buna chindooche chiamerire amache ’obokendu abwataine, na amagena ’embura are imeo.
Ekero ki’omobaso chiasunkera chiakea; na omorakera ogocha chiasira kegima korwa aase abo.
Abagendi babwate chitugo chiabo nigo bakogobera korigia amache, tibakoyanyora; ase igo bakwera ase erooro.
Abagendi ba Tema nigo bakoriga‐rigia amache, naboigo abaonchoreria ba Seba basemeria koyanyora.
Abwo nigo bagoichana, ekiagera tibanyorete eki basemeretie; ekero bachete aase agwo, bakanyora ng’a nigo bang’ainetwe.
Nabogio nainwe mwabeire asende buna chintuboka chiria; mwarorire emechando yane, mwakumirie na kwoboa.
Inee! Inche natebirie onde ng’a andetere ekeegwa? Gose naboririe onde ng’a arue embooria korwa ase chinibo chiaye?
Gose natebirie onde ng’a antoorie korwa ase okoboko kw’omobisa one? Gose natebirie onde ng’a amboorie korwa ase amaboko ’abachandi baane?”
“Inyorokererie, na inche ninkire‐kiri imanyie amamocho nakorire.
Naki amang’ana ’ekeene agwansa! Korende amang’ana ayio aino ay’obong’ainereria, inki agokonya?
Inee! Nigo mokorengereria ng’a amagn’ana ’omonto bwerusirie moyo nigo anga buna omwaga?
Onye naboigo, rirorio monyare goaka obomera igoro ye chintakana, monyare gokorera abasani baino amagori amake ase okobaoonia.
Bono, komoranche mondigererie; ninde nobomaene kegima, tingokwana oborimo asemore.
Nabasoroire, irana, timobaisa gokora ing’ana rinde riibe. Bono irana naende, ekiagera ring’ana riane neri’oboronge.
Inee! Amang’ana aane ngokwana nay’oborimo? Inee! Tinkonyara gokwana inyatanane ayare amabe?”
“Ekero omonto are ase ense, nigo abwate obogima buna obw’oyokorwana esegi. Amatuko ’obogima bwaye nigo anga buna ay’omorikwa emeremo.
Buna koreng’ana omosomba akogania anyore aase agokenderera, na buna koreng’ana omonto orikire emeremo akogania aegwe eng’eria yaye,
naboigo nainche ngendererete koba nobobe omotienyi ase omotienyi, na obotuko ase obotuko nigo inde ase emechando.
Ekero nararire nigo nkoboria: Indi bogocha gokia mboke? Obotuko bwatambeire mono. Agwo naba nkona‐kweonchaonchora bokia goika mambia.
Amakonde ne riko biatubire omobere one; omobere one nigo okona‐gosaboka amasabo, erio otandoka, na obogundo bwaruao.
Amatuko ’obogima bwane nigo agoeta bwango kobua egekorero gi’okoroisia egetambaa, nigo akoera ntabwati gosemeria konde.
“Manya ng’a obogima bwane nigo bore buna embeo bosa; amaiso aane takorora amaya naende.
Omonto ondoche bono takondora naende nonya ng’ake, bono aye nondoche, korende bwango nimbe tindio.
Buna koreng’ana riire rigokubakubana riasira, naboigo noyokogenda aase abakure atakoirana korwao.
Oyio takoirana gocha mwaye, na aase aye taakomonyora naende.
Ase ayio, tinkonyara gokira tinkwana, nimbe ngokwana emechando y’omoyo one na kwemurungania nobororo ase omoyo one.
“Nase ki obegete oborendi igoro yane? Inche nenyancha inde, gose neng’iti enene mono ya nyancha?
Ekero nkorengereria ng’a oborere bwane mbonyare kondemia, na ebirengererio biane mbinyare gonkeaneria obororo bwane,
erio aye nigo okongosa ase ogontomera chindoto na kong’a obwoba goetera ase amaroro.
Ase igo nachorire ng’a ng’entwe inkwe, ekiagera amakweri namaya kobua obororo bore ase omobere one.
Nagechire obogima bwane; tinganeti kogenderera koba moyo. Takondosia namange; amatuko aane nigo are buna embeo bosa.
“Inee! Omonto ninki aisaine, goika okomokora koba oyo bw’engencho enene, naende oba komorengereretie mono?
Nigo okomorigereria kera emambia, naende nigo okomorenga kera engaki.
Inee! Nengaki eng’ana naki ogochia koba gokona‐kondigereria? Naki otagontiga, erinde inyore obosibore imere amate?
Aye omorigereria bw’abanto, onye ngokora ebibe, ninki nagokoreire? Nase ki gwankorire nabeire ekerenga kiao? Nase ki nabeire buna egurube endito asore?
Nase ki otakonyabera ogosaria kwane, erinde otige ebibe biane kegima? Bono inche nkogenda inde korara ime ye riroba; aye nigo orabe gokondigia, korende tokonyora aande.”
Erio Bilidadi Omosua akairaneria, akabora:
“Ngoika ririri orabe kogokwana amang’ana aya, na amang’ana ’omonwa oo abe buna omwaga omonene?
Inee! Nyasae nanyare koonchorana ekeene? Gose Omonguru naonchorane ayare ay’oboronge?
Onye abana bao bakorete ebibe asare, ere obaeire egesusuro ase engencho y’okomocha kwabo.
Korende aye korarigie Nyasae na gosaba ase oboitongo ere oyore Omonguru,
korabe oyochenegete na ore nenkoro endonge, ekeene, rirorio ere nagochandekere, nakoroiserie obomenyo, na oboronge bogenderere kobao.
Eki kwabwate ritang’ani kerorekane kere egeke, koreng’anigwa neki oramenterwe nyuma.
“Korende boria omanye ay’ebigori bia kare, bweigwere aya chisokoro chiao chianyorete.
Intwe nigo tonga buna abaiborwa igoro totamanyeti kende, naki amatuko aito tomenyete ase ense nigo anga buna omorengari ogosira.
Inee! Amang’ana ’obong’aini chisokoro chiria chiakwanete, takonyara gokworokereria, erinde bwegere?
“Inee! Amauncho nanyare komera ase entente etari? Gose ebitonto nabimere ase amache atari?
Ekero bigendererete gosicha, engaki y’okobitema etaraika, nigo birasusane bitige ebimeri binde.
Naboigo nabanto bonsi abebire Nyasae bakoba, ogosemeria kw’omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae nagosire.
Aya asemeretie nasirigwe kegima, na aya egenete nigo are buna enyomba y’oronyambobe.
Ere nigo agwesiirera ase enyomba yaye, korende tekogenderera gotenena, nigo ayesemeretie, korende tekogenderera kobao.
“Nabo akoreereta buna ekemeri kere ase omobaso, ekio gekoranda ase omogondo bwonsi;
emeri yaye nigo egwesiserania ase etui y’amagena; buna eyekwemigereria ase egati y’amagena ’egetare.
Geise gosirigwa korwa aase aye, aase aria nigo aragekanie ng’a tana gokerora.
Ee, oyio noro omogoko ere abwate ase obogima bwaye, naende abande mbache babe ase ribaga riaye.
“Rora, Nyasae takonyara kwanga na gotiga omonto omoikeranu; gose tagokonya abakori amabe.
Ekeene, nagoichorie namaseko, na omonwa oo otere nomochengo.
Abanto abakogechete mbarenterwe obosooku, na obomenyo bw’abakori amabe tibokogenderera kobao.”
Erio Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:
“Ekeene, namanyire ng’a ayio nabo are, korende naki omonto aranyare koba omonyaboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae?
Omonene karaamereranie nomonto amang’ana elifu eyemo, omonto takonyara komoiraneria nonya nerimo.
Omonene nigo are nobong’aini ase enkoro yaye, na omonyene chinguru, monto ki oratoorigwe onye takomoigwera?
Ekero Omonene akoba nendamwamu nigo akoonchorana ebitunwa, obitigeria korwa aase abo, na abanto tibari komanya ayio.
Nigo agotengechia ense yarwa aase aye, erio chintenenero chiaye chianyegerigwa.
Nigo agochika erioba tirigosoka; ne ching’enang’eni ochibeka ekemanyererio.
Nere bweka oramborete igoro chionsi, agachiaara, nere ogotaara igoro ase emerindo y’enyancha.
Nyasae nere otongete egetuse gie ching’enang’eni gekorokwa Edubu. Na ekende gekorokwa Orioni, na ekende gekorokwa Abaiseke batano na babere bamwabo, na ebinde Amakundia a irianyi.
Nigo agokora amang’ana amanene aetanetie obomanyi bwonsi, na amakumia amange atari kobareka.
“Rora! Ere nigo akong’ika ang’e oeta, tinkomorora; nigo akong’etania, tinkomomanyereria.
Ere nigo akoira eki aganetie. Ning’o oranyare komotanga? Ning’o oranyare komoboria ng’a ninki ekio agokora?
Nyasae tari gotigeria endamwamu yaye, abanto abagokonya Rahabu, nigo bagotung’ama inse asare baumama.
Naki rende ndakore imanye gochora amang’ana agwenerete, erinde inyare koiraneria Omonene.
Nonya inche nare koba tindi nokomocha, tinarenge komoiraneria; nigo narenge gosaba amabera korwa ase omonsoeri.
Onye narenge komorangeria, na ere ang’itabere, rirorio tinarenge kwegena ng’a nategererete eriogi riane.
Ere ong’akire nomwaga ore nomoubera, na omentire amaote aane ngencho ende etaiyo.
Tang’eti ribaga nkoeyanera, korende omenteire obororo obonge mono.
Onye namang’ana e chinguru, rora ere nigo are ne chinguru. Onye igoro y’oboronge, monto ki oranyare koamererania nere?
Nonya nare koba omonyaboronge, amang’ana ngokwana nigo are kongambia; nonya nare koba ng’a tindi na komocha, aya nigo are kombera kirori ng’a nomokori amabe inde.
Inche tindi na komocha. Tingochandekera obogima bwane; tinkobara obogima bwane ng’a negento.
Mang’ana taiyo. Ase ayio nigo ngoteba: Ere nigo agosiria omonyaboronge na omokori amabe amo.
Ekero ebiku bikorenta amakweri a mobosokano, na abanto batari na komocha banyorwe namaakwa, ere nigo akobachecheria.
Ense nigo ebekire inse y’amaboko ’abakori amabe, Nyasae otubire amasio ’abagambi ebina. Onye tari ere, ning’o rende okorire ayio?
“Amatuko aane nigo agoeta bwango kobua omominyoki okominyoka; nigo akoera bwango, tari korora maya ande.
Ee, nigo agoeta bwango buna obwato obonyerere bw’ebirigisa, buna ensoti egotaboria ebiekoria biaye.
Inse goteba ng’a nyebe ogwechanda kwane, na ntige omoichano one inyeremie,
nigo ndabe nobwoba igoro y’emechando yane yonsi, ekiagera nimanyete ng’a aye goika ombare ng’a nomomochi inde.
Inche goika mbarwe ng’a nomokori amabe inde. Nase ki rende ngwechanda nemeremo ere bosa?
Ninsa gwesibia namache arabete buna amagena ’embura, na goisaba nesabuni,
nigo orantugute ime ase engoro, ne chianga chiane chigechigwe ase engencho yane.
Nyasae tari omonto buna inche, erinde imoiranerie, na ngende nere ase ekegambero.
Monto onde tari orabe omogayani oito, oyio oratogambie inche nere.
Tiga ere arusie enyimbo yaye korwa asende; okogosa kwaye tikobaisa kong’ondokia.
Erio inyare gokwana ntari nobwoba ase engencho yaye, nimanyete ng’a tindi nokomocha.”
“Omoyo one ogechire obogima bwane; nimbe nobosibore gokwana na kwemurungania, ninkwane nobororo bore ase omoyo one.
Ninkwane, ntebie Nyasae: Tobaisa kongambia; imanyie egekogera aye okondwania iga.
Inee! Nigo ogokirie ase ogonchanda na gochaya emeremo y’amaboko ao, na gwanchera ogosemania kw’abakori amabe?
Inee! Amaiso ao naya mwanyabanto are? Gose nigo okorora buna mwanyabanto akorora?
Inee! Amatuko ao nabo ang’ana buna aya mwanyabanto, gose emiaka yao buna ey’omonto,
goika okona‐gotuka okomocha kwane na korigia ebibe biane?
Nonya nabo nomanyete ng’a inche tindi nokomocha, na onde tari orantoorie korwa ase okoboko kwao?
“Amaboko ao naro ambombete, akandoisia; na bono kwang’onchokeire na gonsiria.
Inyora ng’a naye kwambombete buna esike. Inee! Nigo okong’irania imbe orotu naende?
Inee! Tari aye kwang’umorete buna amabeere, na okambomba buna amabeere abwatanire?
Aye okaboyia omobere one risankwa okayobekera chinyama, okayobwatania namauga na emeki.
Aye kwang’eire obogima na konyorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera; na oborendi bwao nigo borendete omoika one.
Nonya nabo nigo obisete amang’ana ayio ase enkoro yao, nimanyete ng’a oko nakwo kwarenge okogania kwao.
Inse gokora ebibe, aye nigo ondigereretie, na totiga kong’a egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biane.
Obobe nobwane onye inde omokori amabe; na onye inde omonyaboronge tinkonyara gwetogia; nigo ing’ichire nobosooku, ase ayio aye origererie emechando yane.
Kondaimokererie omotwe one igoro, aye nigo okondigia buna endo egotwara orotwari, erinde ogenderere koorokia amakumia ao igoro yane.
Aye nigo okomenta oborori bwao igoro yane, na kwamentera ekeririanda igoro yane. Nigo okona‐kondetera ababisa bakondwania.
“Nase ki kwandusetie ase enda ya baba? Naki anga yare koba buya onye nakwete ekero monto onde atarandora,
imbe buna tinarengeo, anga nigo narusetigwe ase enda ya baba ntindekwe.
Inee! Amatuko ’obogima bwane tari amake? Intige, imbe nobotoereru ase engaki eye enke,
ekero ntaragenda aase ntanyare koirana korwao rinde, ense eria y’omosunte ekerima na ey’ekiriri ki’amakweri,
ense emwamu ti buna omosunte ekerima; naende ey’ekiriri ki’amakweri na obotantanu, agwo oborabu bwaye bore obomwamu ti buna obw’obotuko gati.”
Erio Sofari Omonaama agakwana, akabora:
“Inee! Amang’ana aya amange natigwe tairanerigwa? Na omonto obwate amang’ana amange buna iga nabarerwe oboronge?
Inee! Amang’ana ao atari nengencho nagere abanto bakire‐kiri? Na ekero ogokwana amang’ana ay’ogochecheria, monto onde takogosookia?
Aye nigo ogoteba ng’a amang’ana ogokwana nay’ekeene, naende ng’a nigo ochenegete ase amaiso a Nyasae.
Korende onye ndiria Nyasae are gokwana na akoorokie buna ore,
erinde akomaanorere orore obobisi bw’obong’aini! Ere nigo abwate obomanyi botari korengeka. Ase ayio manya ng’a nigo akoeire egesusuro egeke, tari buna okomocha kwao kogwenerete.
“Inee! Nonyare komanya ebinto bia Nyasae bibisekanete? Nonyare komanya oboikeranu bw’Omonguru?
Onye bore obonene gochia igoro, inki oranyare gokora? Onye bore obotambe inse gochia aase abakure, inki oranyare komanya?
Obotambe bwaye nigo boetanetie obw’ense, na obogare bwaye mboetanetie obw’enyancha.
Karaete asibe abanto, gose kobagambia, ning’o oramotange?
Ere nigo amanyete abanto batagwenereti. Ekero akorora amabe agokorwa, Inee, takorengereria igoro y’ayio?
Onye omoriri okonyara koba omong’aini, rirorio emori y’etigere y’orosana nenyare koiborwa ebe omonto.
“Oise kwebeka ang’e ase enkoro yao gokora amaronge, na orambore amaboko ao gochia ase Nyasae;
onye kogotuguta ebibe bire ase amaboko ao, na togotiga obobe bomenye ase eema yao,
amaene, rirorio norigererie otari na komocha, naende norendwe buya tokoba nobwoba.
Nigo orebe emechando yao, buna amache aetire, takoinyorwa naende.
Na obogima bwao nigo borarabe se kobua erioba ria mobaso gati; omosunte oye nigo oraonchoke obe buna ekero bogokia mambia.
Aye nomenye kore noboremu, ekiagera ogosemeria nkoreo; norendwe na gotimoka ase obotoereru.
Ekero okorara, monto onde tagokwoboyia; abanto abange mbache asore bagosorore ng’a banyore ogwancherwa.
Korende abakori amabe mbabe bakouna‐una ase omosunte, tibakorora omobaso. Tibagotooreka nonya ng’ake; ogosemeria kwabo ngosire pi.”
Erio Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:
“Ekeene, inwe ninwe abanto bori, ekero morakwe, na obong’aini mbosire.
Korende nainche nabo inde nokomanya buna inwe, gose timombueti. Ning’o otamanyeti amang’ana buna ayio?
Abasani baane nigo bagonchecheria, inche oyo narenge korangeria Nyasae, na ere akaba okong’iraneria, inche omonyakeene ntari na komocha, bono nigo ngochecherigwa.
Omonto otari na mechando ende, nigo agochaya emechando, nigo are ang’e gotachera inse abwo batererigwe.
Chinka chi’abauri nigo chigendererete koba nomorembe, na abwo bagechete Nyasae nigo barendire buya, na enyasae yabo nigo ere ase amaboko abo.”
“Bono boria ching’iti, nchikworokererie; boria chinyoni chia igoro chigotebie amang’ana;
gose kwana ne riroba, ndikworokererie, ne chinswe chia nyancha, nchikorarerie.
Ning’o otamanyeti amang’ana aya onsi ng’a okoboko kw’Omonene nakwo gwakorire aya?
Obogima bwa kera egetongwa kere moyo na omoika o mwanyabanto, nigo bire ase okoboko kwaye.
Inee! Amang’ana ogoto gokoigwa, tikori koyateema buna oromeme rokomena rwaigwa endagera?”
“Obong’aini nigo bore ase abanto abanene, na okomenya emiaka emenge nakwo okomanya.
Nyasae nigo are nobong’aini na okobua, boigo nare nogosemia na obomanyi.
Ere aise gotagora, onde tari oraagache naende; aise gosiekera omonto, onde tari oramoigorere.
Aise gotanga amache, ense igo erome pa, na ekero akoyarenta nigo akoonchorana ense.”
“Chinguru na obong’aini nigo bikorwa asare. Abwo bakong’aineka na abakong’ainereria nigo bare ase okoboko kwaye.
Omonene nigo akoombogania abare abasemia obatiga getirianda, nigo agokora abagambi ebina baba abariri.
Nigo agosibora chinkini chi’abaruoti, erio obaboyia ebibarachi.
Ere nigo akoombogania abakuani, obatiga getirianda, na oonchorana abanto bare nokobua.
Abanto abwo basemeirie nigo akobaura amang’ana bagokwana, na oura abanto abagotu ogosemia.
Omonene nigo akorentera abagambi ogochaywa, na abanto bare nokobua nigo akobaura chinguru.
Ere nigo akoorokia obobisi ase omosunte, erio okora obobisi boria bore ase omosunte bwaba oborabu.
Nigo agokinia ebisaku, naende obisiria; nigo akobikora biabucha, naende obing’anyia.
Ere nigo akorusia obong’aini ase abatang’ani b’abanto bare ase ense, erio obatiga bakoombogana erooro bosa.
Abanto abwo nigo bagotaba‐taba ase omosunte borabu botaiyo, na ogera baong’anya buna omonto otindire.”
“Naama! Amang’ana aya onsi nayarorire neriso riane, nayaigure nogoto kwane, nayamanyire.
Aya momanyete, nainche ninyamanyete; inwe timombueti kende.
Korende nigo nganetie nkwane n’Omonguru; mbeke amang’ana aane ase Nyasae, erinde ng’amereranie nere,
Korende inwe nabatongi oborimo, inwe mwensi nabarwaria bare bosa, motari kogwenia.
Onye ndiria mware gokira‐kiri! Okwo nanga nigo kwaba obong’aini bwaino.
“Bono tegerera moigwe amang’ana ngwekwanera, naende tegerera moigwe ogosorora gokorwa ase omonwa one.
Inee! Inwe nigo mokorwanerera Nyasae ase ogokwana aya atari a boronge? Naende mokomorwanerera ase obong’ainereria?
Inee! Inwe nigo more nogwanchereria asare? Nigo moganetie korwanerera Nyasae?
Inee! Amang’ana nabe amaya asemore Omonene karabarenge abamanye buna more? Gose mokagete ng’a nigo moramong’aine buna abanto bakong’ainana?
Onye mogokora ogwanchereria ekero more ase obobisi, Omonene goika abatogonyere.
Inee! Obonene bwaye tibokoboboyia, na okogosa kwaye kobaondokie?
Emereng’anio y’obong’aini bwaino nigo ere bosa buna ribu, ne chiburi chiaino nigo chigiteire esike.
Inwe kira‐kiri, montige nkwane, na kende gionsi kegochia konyora, tiga kenyore.
“Nase ki ndabeke enyama y’omobere one ase amaino aane? Ting’egereti obogima bwane.
Omonene naisa kong’ita, ningenderere komosemeria, nonya nabo goika ndete amang’ana aane ase obosio bwaye.
Ayio nabe ogotooreka kwane ng’a omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae tagocha ase obosio bwaye.
Tegerera onyigwe, tiga ogotebereria kwane gosoe ase amato aino.
Rora, naroisirie amang’ana aane, namanyire ng’a nimbarerwe oboronge.
“Nyasae, ning’o oreo ogochia koamererania nainche? Onye oreo, rirorio inche nigo ndakire‐kiri inkwe.
Bono nigo ngokoboria onkorere ebinto bibere, nario ntebise korwa ase obosio bwao:
Rusia okoboko kwao korwa asende, na okogosa kwao tikogenderera konyoboyia.
“Erio aye ondangerie, na inche ng’itabe, gose ing’a ribaga nkwane, naye ong’iranerie.
Amamocho aane, na ebibe biane, mbirenga bire? Imanyie ogosaria kwane, na ebibe biane.
“Nase ki okobisa obosio bwao na kombara ng’a nomobisa oo inde?
Inee! Nigo orasegenyie rito eriomo rikona‐koirwa nembeo? Gose aye nigo ogochia gotunya omoiriro korwa nyuma?
“Ekiagera gwanchikeire amang’ana ’obororo, naende kwang’akanire amabe ’obosae bwane.
Aye gwasoirie amagoro aane ase rikorogoto, nigo origereretie orogendo rwane rwonsi; aye kwabekire orobebe ase chimbaratero chiane chigotacha.
Omonto nigo agosira oruao buna egento ekegundo, na buna eanga yarirwe nebigwankwa.”
“Mwanyabanto okoiborwa nomokungu, amatuko aye namake; ere nigo aichire nemechando.
Ere nigo akororekana buna egesicha giasichire na giasira bwango, nigo agoeta bwango buna omorengari, tari kogenderera kobao.
Inee! Aye nigo okorigereria omonto buna oyio? Nigo okondeta ase obosio bwao na kongambia ekina?
Ning’o oranyare korenta egento gechenegete korwa ase egetachenegeti? Onde taiyo, nonya noyomo.
Omonto nigo abareire amatuko aye, na omobaro bw’emetienyi yaye naye kwayochikire, naende kwamobekeire chimbebe atanyare goetania.
Tiga komorigereria, motige anyore obotoereru, erinde agokere amatuko aye buna omonto orikire emeremo.
“Ogosemeria nkoreo ase omote, ekero ogechirwe noseboke naende, na emeseboko eyio tegosira.
Emeri y’omote oyio neisa kogota ime ase riroba, na egetugi kiaye nkegote gesire ime ase riroba,
nonya naboigo, ekero embura eratwe, nigo keraseboke na gosokia ebisebo buna ekemeri ekeyia.
Korende omonto nigo agokwa, bwarerigwa riroba inse; omonto nigo agotweka mo, ng’ai agochia?
“Buna koreng’ana amache e chinyancha agosira pi, naboigo naye chindooche agokama chioma pa,
naboigo na mwanyabanto kararire, tagotenena naende; tagoturwa goika ekero igoro na ense bitabeo; tagotaboborwa korwa ase chitoro chiaye.
“Naki anga yaba buya, onye nkwambisa agwo aase abakure; onye kwandenda aase are bobisi, goika endamwamu yao ebe yaetire, onye gwanchikera engaki na kong’inyora!
Inee! Omonto gakure, nairane koba moyo naende? Inche ase amatuko aane onsi inchikeire, nimbe nganyete, goika ogosiborwa kwane goche.
Aye korandangerie, na inche ningoitabere, ekiagera noganie emeremo y’amaboko ao.
Bono aye nigo okobara amatambokero aane, gose tori korigereria ebibe biane.
Ogosaria kwane kware komumekerigwa egunia ime, aye nigo kware gotuba ebibe biane.
“Buna egetunwa gekogwa na giasamunyokana, na egetare giasukigwa korwa aase aye;
buna amache agwata amagena asamunyokana, ne chiooro chiaira amaroba aera, naboigo aye ogosiria ogosemeria kwa mwanyabanto.
Aye nigo ogendererete kobua omonto, na ere nigo agoeta osira, nigo okoonchora ekieni kiaye kwamosiria.
Abana baye nigo bakoegwa ogosikwa, korende ere tari komanya ayio; nigo bakourwa ogosikwa kwabo na gokeeigwa, korende ere tari komanya ayio.
Ere nigo akoigwa obororo ase omobere oye, na oba okona‐kwereera omonyene.”
Erio Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:
“Inee! Omonto omong’aini nagwenerete airanerie amang’ana are buna omwaga okogusa, na goichoria enda yaye nomwaga okogusa korwa moocha?
Inee! Nemogwenerete koamererania ne chinkwana chitari nengencho, gose amang’ana atari korenta buya bonde?
Aye nigo ogosiria okomoiroka Nyasae, naende gwatanga ogosaba ase obosio bwaye.
Ebibe biao biorokereirie omonwa oo amang’ana ogokwana, aye gwachorire gokwana amang’ana ’obong’ainereria.
Tari inche ngokonachera ekina, korende amang’ana aya ogokwana, ee, aya ogokwana nomonwa oo akobereire kirori.
“Inee! Naye ore omonto bwe ritang’ani koiborwa? Gose naye gwatongetwe ritang’ani ebitunwa bitarabao?
Inee! Kwana koigwa emeroberio y’obobisi bwa Nyasae? Aye nigo kwenyoreire obong’aini aye bweka?
Inee! Aye ninki omanyete intwe totamanyeti? Mbong’aini ki omanyete intwe totamanyeti?
Abanto bamerire chimbuche amo nabakoorire emiaka emenge nao bare aa amo naintwe, barabwo mbabuete iso ase emiaka.
“Inee! Okoremia koria Nyasae akoeire tikogoisaini? Gose ring’ana ri’oboitongo agokwana naye nigo rire bosa asore?
Nase ki enkoro yao ere morero, na amaiso ao akomogora,
goika omoyo oo obeire mamincha ya Nyasae, na bono aye ngosokia ore amang’ana aya korwa ase omonwa oo?
Inee! Mwanyabanto ninki are goika anyare koba oyochenegete? Gose ere oyio oiboire nomokungu ng’a anyare koba omonyaboronge?
Rora, Nyasae tari gosemeria nonya nabachenu baye, na igoro chionsi tichichenegeti ase obosio bwaye.
Onye nabo, naki rende ase omonto oyio ogokora ay’okogechia na gosaria, oyio okonywa ebibe buna amache?
“Integerera oigwe, na inche nkworokie; amang’ana narorire ninyararie.
Ayio abanto abang’aini batebetigwe ne chisokoro chiabo, nabarabwo tibayabisete.
Barabwo bakaegwa ense eria, na abanto b’ense engeni tibaetete aroro.
“Omokori amabe nigo akogenderera gochandeka nobororo ase amatuko aye onsi, na omochandi boigo ase emiaka ere achikeretwe.
Amariogi ay’okwoboyia nigo agosoa ase amato aye; na ekero are nobotoereru, oyo ogosiria nigo akomochera.
Ere tari koba nogosemeria ng’a gose narue ase omosunte naende, ekiagera omoro nigo omoganetie.
Omonto oyio nigo akoba okoombogana korigia endagera, oboria: Ng’ai ere? Nigo amanyete ng’a rituko ri’omosunte riamoikeire ang’e.
Emechando na obwoba nigo bikomoondokia. Ebio nigo bikomorwania na komobua, ne chinguru buna echi’omoruoti bwebekire ang’e korwana esegi.
“Ere oramboire okoboko kwaye mamincha ya Nyasae, naende oba nomokia gokora ay’oboenenu ase obosio bw’Omonguru.
Oyio nigo akobogoria ching’aya chiaye chikumbire, ominyoka ore nebigoti ebikong’u ochia korwania Omonene.
Nigo atubire obosio bwaye namaguta ’obonoru, naende onorire ase ebibono biaye.
“Oyio obeire omenyete ase emechie yasaretigwe agwo ase chinyomba chitamenyiri nonde, echio konya chiarurwe ase ogosarigwa chibe amatombe.
Omonto oyio takoba omonda, obotenenku bwaye tibokogenderera kobao, gose tibokobucha ase ense.
Tagotooreka korwa ase omosunte; omorero mbwomie emeseboka egoseboka, ere omonyene nasire ase omoika bw’Omonene.
Tabaisa kweng’aina ase ogosemeria amang’ana a bosa, ekiagera obosa obwo nabwo borabe eng’eria yaye.
Naakanwe obosa obwo ritang’ani engaki yaye etaraika, na nigo arabe buna orosagia rwaye rotarasicha.
Oyio nigo arabe buna omosabibu okoarora amasabibu ataratoba, na buna omozeituni okoarora ebisicha biaye.
Ebiombe bi’abatamoirogete Nyasae nigo biragombae, na omorero nosambe emechie y’abanchete amaaki.
Abanto abwo nigo bakoroberia amabe, barenta ogosaria; okwama kwabo bakorenta nokw’obong’ainereria.”
Erio Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:
“Inche naigure amang’ana amange buna ayio, inwe mwensi nigo more abaremia mogonchanda.
Inee! Amang’ana ayio anga buna omwaga okogusa aerire? Gose nkere egekogoseegeta oiranerie ayande?
Onye ndiria obogima bwaino bware koba ribaga ri’obwane, nanga nigo nakwana buna inwe; nigo nare gokwana amang’ana amange mamincha yaino na gosingisia omotwe one ase okobachaya.
Amang’ana nare ngokwana korwa ase omonwa one, nigo are kobabeka chinguru; ee, amabeebe ay’ebikoba igoro nigo are kobaremia.
Ninsa koba ngokwana, obororo bwane tibogokea; na ninsa koremereria nkire, emechando yane tegokea nonya ng’ake.
Ekeene, Nyasae okoorire chinguru chiane, na osiririe abanto bonsi b’enka yane.
Ere okorire omobere one obeire nemenia, na eyio yambereire kirori; oboreu bwane bwaorokeire ase obosio bwane kombera kirori.
“Omonene obeire nendamwamu asende, ontandoranire, naende ongechire; oromananirie amaino aye asende; omochandi one omogoreirie inche amaiso bobe.
Abanto nigo banyasameretie emenwa yabo, bang’akire chindoe ase chinsea, bakondama; nigo bagosangererekana amo ng’a bankore bobe.
Nyasae ondure ase abanto batamoirogeti, ombekire ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.
Inche nigo narenge inde nobotoereru, korende ere agansenyenta, ee, Nyasae akambwata ebigoti, akambutorana ebing’ese, bono onkorire nabeire ekerenga kiaye gekoraswa.
Abaruti emegwe baye bang’etananire aande onsi, ombetire chinyigo chiane, tandorereti amabera; oumoire amache ’endorwe yane igoro ase riroba.
Ong’akire amaakwa igoro ase amaakwa ande; nigo akondindokera buna omorwani esegi ore ne chinguru.
“Bono natubire omobere one negunia, ne chinguru chiane nachitugutire ime ase orotu.
Amaiso aane abariirire ase obosio bwane, na ekiriri kiarorekanire ase obosio bwane,
nonya tindakora bobe bonde namaboko aane, na ogosaba kwane kore ogoikeranu.
“Aye riroba, tobaisa gotuba amanyinga aane, na ekerero kiane tikenyora ase kegotimokera.
Rora, Kirori one igoro are nonya mbono, ee, Oyokondwanerera igoro are.
Nonya nabasani baane nigo bagonsekerera, inche nigo nkoiyeria amariga ndigererete Nyasae.
Kirori one nansororere ase Nyasae, buna omonto agosororera omonto onde.
Emiaka emeke netigarete, inche mbwatie enchera ekogenda aase ntanyare koirana korwao naende.”
“Omoika ong’ereire, amatuko aane aikeire omoerio; oboina mbonganyete.
Ekeene, abachecheria bang’etananire, na amaiso aane nigo agendererete korora okogechia kwabo.
Aye omonyene obe ntenenera asende, imbe asore. Inee! Ning’o rende oranyare kwerua abe ntenenera asende?
Aye gwasiekire ebirengererio biabo tibiba nokomanya, ase ayio tokobaimokereria igoro na kobaa okobua.
Omonto ogosigaana abasani ase okwenyorera chinibo chiabo, abana baye amaiso abo nigo araukore.
Omonene onkorire nabeire ring’ana abanto bakorabaara, nabeire oyo abanto bagochaya ase ogotwa amate.
Emechando yagerire amaiso aane abeire orotutu, na ebiimo biane bionsi biabeire buna omorengari bosa.
Abanto abaronge bakumirie amang’ana aya, ee, omonto otari na komocha oimokire gokorera bobe oria otamoirogeti Nyasae.
Korende omonyene oboronge nabwaterere enchera yaye, na oyio obwate amaboko achenegete nagenderere koba ne chinguru.
Korende inwe mwensi, moirane gocha; tinkonyara konyora nonya nomonto oyomo ase egati yaino ore omong’aini.
Amatuko aane aetire, emeroberio yane yasarekire, nonya nokogania gw’enkoro yane.
Abanto abwo baonchoire obotuko bwabeire omobaso; nigo bagoteba ng’a omobaso nigo ore ang’e, korende omosunte noreo.
Nonya inde nogosemeria, aase abakure nao obomenyo bwane, nindambore oborere bwane ase omosunte ime.
Nintebie oboina: Naye tata. Nintebie amakonde: Ninwe baba na abaiseke baminto.
Inee! Ng’ai rende ogosemeria kwane kore? Ning’o oranyare gokorora?
Ogosemeria okwo nigo koragende gochia aase abakure. Nintirimboke amo nakorokwo gochia gotimoka ase riroba ime.”
Bilidadi Omosua akairaneria, akabora:
“Inee! Ngoika ririri ogochia korigia amang’ana agokwanwa? Yarengererie, nyuma yaye naintwe tokwane.
Nase ki tokobarwa koba buna ching’iti? Nase ki tokobarwa koba abanto batamanyeti gento kende?
Inee! Aye nigo ogwetandora ase engencho y’endamwamu yao, ense nigo egochia gotigwa bosa ase engencho yao? Gose egetare ngetigerigwe korwa aase aye?
“Amaene, omobaso bw’omokori amabe norime, gose amasase aye takobara.
Oborabu bore ase obomenyo bwaye nigo borabe omosunte, na etaya yaye ere asare nerimigwe.
Amatambokero aye are ne chinguru nakeeigwe, na emeroberio yaye emoiyerie inse.
Amagoro aye nabwatwe noboreba, abe ogotaara ase egati ye chiirima.
Oboreba mbomobwate ase egetingiro na omoeto nomobwate omong’userere bokong’u.
Engori y’ogotegerwa nebiswe ase riroba ase agotacha, na oboreba botegwe ase enchera agoeta.
Nabe okogoswa na kwoboyigwa korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, nkomoseria atame namagoro.
Enchara nemorie goika chinguru chiaye chiere, na emechando nemobeere ang’e komoiyeria.
Oborwaire mbokoore risankwa ri’omobere oye, oborwaire obotang’ani bw’amakweri mbogundie ebiimo biaye.
Nataboranwa ne chinguru korwa ase obomenyo konya asemeretie, erio airwe ase omoruoti bw’okwoboyia okonge.
Abanto abaao mbabe bakomenya ase eema yaye; amagena ’omorero nasiarerwe ase enka yaye.
Emeri yaye iyome inse ye riroba, ne chinsagia chiaye nachisusane.
Oyio takoinyorwa ase ense nonya ng’ake, gose nonya nerieta riaye tirikogenderera koinyorwa agwo ase enchera.
Ere narusigwe korwa ase oborabu arutwe gochia ase omosunte; naende aserigwe korwa ase ense.
Takoba nomwana gose abanto b’ororeria rwaye ase egati y’abanto bamwabo, gose monto onde oye tagotigara ore moyo agwo ase amenyete.
Abanto bamenyete bosongo mbakumie igoro ye rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwaye, na abamenyete moocha mbaondokigwe namang’ana ayio.
Ekeene, obomenyo bw’abatamoirogeti Nyasae nabo bore igo, na aase ay’abataganeti komomanya Nyasae nabo are igo.”
Erio Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:
“Inee! Ngoika ririri morabe mokogechia omoyo one na mogonsenyenta namang’ana aino?
Mwabeire mogonchecheria ara ikomi. Inee! Timori korora obosooku gonkorera bobe iga?
Ee, nonya ekeene nakorire okomocha, okomocha okwo nokwane.
Inwe onye mogwetogia ng’a nabaya more kombua na kong’enekeria igo kobwatekana nogochaywa kwane,
rirorio momanye ng’a Nyasae orentire amabe aya asende, na ontegire noboreba bwaye.
Rora, nigo nkorera mono ngoteba: Nakoreirwe bobe, korende tindi koiranerigwa; nigo nkorangeria neriogi rinene ng’a nkonywe, korende ekeene, oboronge tibori gokorwa.
Nyasae oagachire orwaki aase ngoeta, obekire omosunte ase ebinchera ngoeta.
Ong’urire obonene bwane. Orusirie egutwa korwa ase omotwe one.
Korwa ase chinsemo chionsi ong’iyeirie, bono inche nasirigwe; osimoire ogosemeria kwane buna omote ogosimorwa.
Obeire nekeririanda ekenene asende, na ombarire ng’a nomobisa oye inde.
Ebiombe bi’abarwani baye b’esegi nigo bigocha bire amo, biabekire eburi ase ngoetera; biatoorire biang’etananire ase chinsemo chionsi chi’obomenyo bwane.
“Nyasae ogerire abaminto bantigire, bambeereire aare, na abanto twamanyaine bantigire, babeire buna tibamanyeti.
Abanto baminto bantigire, na abasani twanchaine mono banyebire.
Abanto bamenyete mwane banyebire; na abasomba baane abaiseke bambarire buna omoeti; nabeire omomenyi ase amaiso abo.
Ekero nkorangeria omosomba one, ere tari kong’itabera, otatiga ekero namosoroire, nario rioka agocha.
Omoika okorwa ase omonwa one nigo ogotiokera omokungu one bobe; nigo inde okogechia ase abamura baminto torwete enda eyemo.
Nonya nabana abake banchayire; ekero ngotenena nigo bagonkwana bobe.
Abasani abagisangio banyinyerire na kogechigwa nainche; nabwo nanchete bang’onchokeire na gonkora bobe.
Amauga ’omobere one atongororire ase risankwa ne chinyama, natigeirwe egesabo getubete amaino gioka.
Inwe abasani baane, ndorera amabeebe, ndorera amabeebe, ekiagera okoboko kwa Nyasae kwang’akire!
Nase ki nainwe mogonchanda buna Nyasae anchandire? Inee! Timoisanegeti ase ogonchanda omobere one?
“Naki yare koba buya onye amang’ana aane narikwa bono! Yare koba buya arikwe ase ebuku,
ee, arikwe nekaramu eroisirie korwa ase risasi, ekioma egekong’u, amang’erwe ase egetare abeo kare na kare.
“Korende nimanyete ng’a Omobooria one moyo are, omoerio nigo aratenene igoro ye riroba.
Nyuma risankwa ri’omobere one korirabe riasarekire, erio nindore Nyasae ntari ase omobere one.
Nimwerorere inche omonyene; amaiso aane namorigererie, ayane, tari ay’omonto omoao. “Nimoganetie mono ase enkoro yane ime.
Moise goteba: Nase nchera ki tokomochanda? Nigo mokorengereria ng’a ninche nagerire amabe onsi anyorire?
Inwe iroka ogoitwa nomoro, ekiagera oyore nekeririanda nigo akoegwa egesusuro ki’ogoitwa nemioro; erio monyare komanya ng’a okogambigwa nkoreo.”
Erio Sofari Omonaama akairaneria, akabora:
“Bono ebirengererio bire ime yane bianchandire, ase ayio biagerire imbe omwango koiraneria.
Naigure ogokurerwa gw’okonyomania ng’a inche nomomochi, korende omoika bw’okomanya ore ime yane ogerire ing’iranerie.
Inee! Aye tikwana komanya ng’a korwa kare, ekero mwanyabanto babegetwe ase ense,
omochengo bw’abakori amabe noyo bw’engaki enke, na omogoko bw’abatamoirogeti Nyasae nomweng’e?
Ere naisa koba nobonene boigete igoro, na omotwe oye oike ase amare,
goika asire kare na kare, buna obonyira bwaye bogosira. Abwo bamoroche mbaborie; Omonto oria, ng’ai are?
Nigo arasire buna chindoto, takonyorekana, ee, nigo aragikerigwe buna chindoto.
Eriso riarenge komorora, tirikomorora naende, gose aase aye tiaakomorigereria naende.
Abana baye mbabe bagosaberera korwa ase abataka, na amaboko aye nairanie obotenenku bwaye bwonsi.
Amauga aye nigo aichire ne chinguru chi’oboke bwaye, korende chinguru echio nigo chirarare nere ase riroba.
“Nonya obobe bore obwansu ase omonwa oye ime, na abobise inse y’oromeme rwaye,
nonya obwatererete obobe obwo bokong’u, takobotiga, korende nabogache ase omonwa oye ime,
endagera eyio nigo erarore se ase enda yaye, ebe buna obosongo bw’eng’iti engenda inse ime yaye.
Ere nigo akomera chinibo, naende ochiroka; Nyasae nigo agochiseria korwao.
Omonto oyio nigo aranyunyunte obosongo bw’eng’iti nomonwa, na obosongo bokorwa ase oromeme rw’eng’iti eria mbomoite.
Ere takwegokia ase okorora chindooche, chindooche chiichire namooke na amaguta ’amabeere.
Ebinto akoreire emeremo emekong’u nabiiranie, takobimera, gose takonyara kwegokeria ebitoki biria anyorire.
Ekiagera obeire ogokorera abataka bobe na kobatiga bare bosa, naende obeire okoira ne chinguru enyomba ende yonsi ere ataagachete.
Ekeene, ribero ri’omonto oyio riagerire taba nobotoereru, takonyara kogacha gento kende gekomogokia.
Ekero arageire tari gotigaria kende, ase ayio obotenenku bwaye tibokogenderera.
Nebe ekero agendererete gotenenka mono nachandwe, na obokong’u obonge mbomochere.
Nebe ng’a ekero aisire koigota, Nyasae namotomere ekeririanda gi’okogechigwa kwaye; egesusuro ekio nigo keramochere ekero agendererete koragera.
Nabe ogotama korwa ase ekerwanero gi’ekioma, abetwe nensara y’etaai.
Ensara eyio eng’uswe korwa ase omobere oye, ee, ensonga ekomesa nesokere ase endorwe yaye, erio ekeondogo ki’amakweri nakemosoe.
Omosunte ekerima nigo ogacheire chinibo chiaye; omorero otautiri nonde nomosirie, na ebitigarete ase obomenyo bwaye mbisambwe biere.
Igoro neorokie ebibe biaye maiso marore, na ense nemoimokere komorwania.
Ebinto asangereretie ase enyomba yaye mbiirwe; bionsi nigo birairwe ase rituko ri’endamwamu ya Nyasae.
“Eke nakio egetari ki’omokori amabe gekorwa ase Nyasae, naende oyio noro omwando oye Nyasae amochikerete.”
Bono Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:
“Tegerera mono moigwe amang’ana aane, ayio naro arabe okoremia kwaino asende.
Remereria, erinde nkwane; na ngokoora gokwana, mogenderere gonchecheria.
“Inee! Inche mwanyabanto nkwemurunganeria? Nase ki rende ndaremererie tinyemurungania?
Indigererie na moichanigwe; erio motube emenwa yaino namaboko, mokire.
Ekero nkoinyora amang’ana aya, obwoba nigo bogonsoa, na omobere one oiguswa.
“Nase ki abakori amabe bakogenderera koba moyo na kwegotera bare ne chinguru na okobua?
Abana babo nigo bakoba nokogenderera okuya amo nabarabwo, na ororeria rwabo boigo.
Chinka chiabo nigo chire buya, bwoba tiboiyo, gose Nyasae tari kobaa egesusuro.
Chiombe chiabo nigo chikonyora amarieme buya, naende chiabiara chitari korekera.
Abana babo nigo bagotomwa isiko banga buna amaicho, nigo bakoba bagotenga na gocharacharara.
Nigo bagotera bakobugia chinchigiri na amakano, naende bagokera amariogi ’ebiroria.
Nigo bakogenderera kwegokia nobotenenku bwabo; bakwa bagenda aase abakure bare nomorembe.
“Abwo nigo bagotebia Nyasae: Karue aa asetore! Titoganeti komanya chinchera chiao.
Oria Omonguru ninki are goika tomokorere? Mbitoki ki toranyore ase okomosaba?
Rora, ogosesenigwa kwabo tikori ase amaboko abo; ogosemia kw’abakori amabe nigo kore aare nainche.
“Inee! Ng’ara karenga chitaya chi’abakori amabe chikorimigwa? Ng’ara karenga emechando ekobachera? Inee! Nyasae nkobaa are emechando ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye?
Gose barabwo nkoirurukigwa bare buna chimboba, na buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga?
“Inwe nigo mogoteba ng’a Nyasae nigo akogachera abana ebibe bi’abaise. Tiga Omonene aakane abanto abanyene ebibe biabo, erio nario baranyare kobimanya.
Tiga barore ogosirigwa kwabo namaiso abo, naende banyoosigwe endamwamu y’Omonguru.
Ekero emetienyi yabo yaerire na bakure, Inee, mbabe bagwechandera chinka chiabo?
Onde nare oranyare kworokereria Nyasae obong’aini, ere oria okogambia abwo bare igoro mono?
“Omonto oyomo nigo agokwa ore nobotenenku obonge, ore nobotoereru bwonsi na orendire buya,
ebirandi biaye biichire namabeere, na amauga ’omobere oye aichire nemeseto.
Omonto onde igo agokwa ore nobororo bw’omoyo oye, atana konyora amaya nonya ng’ake.
Abwo bonsi nigo bakobekwa ase riroba bareng’anetie, bagunda, na amakonde abatuba.
“Rora, nimanyete ebirengererio biaino, na emeroberio yaino y’ogonkora bobe.
Inwe nigo mokoboria: Ng’ai enyomba y’omochandi oria ere? Naende: Ng’ai obomenyo bw’abakori amabe bore?
“Inee! Inwe timori koboria abaeti chinchera, naende mwanchera oborori bwabo,
ng’a omokori amabe nigo akorendwa ekero emechando yachire, naende atoorigwe ase rituko ri’endamwamu?
Ning’o oranyare koorokeria omokori amabe chinchera chiaye? Ning’o oramoakane amabe ayio akorire?
Ekero arabekwe ase oboina, oboina boria nigo borarendwe.
Amaroba e rigoko nabe amansu asare; abanto bonsi mbamotunyane korwa nyuma, na omobaro bw’abamotang’anerete tori kobareka.
“Nase ki rende mokondemia namang’ana a bosa? Ayatigaire ase amairanerio aino nigo are oborimo bwoka.”
Erio Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:
“Inee! Nenyarekane ng’a omonto abe nengencho ase Nyasae? Ekeene, omonto oria ore nobong’aini nigo akwegwenera ere bweka omonyene.
Inee! Omogoko onde nore ase Omonguru ng’a nomonyaboronge ore? Gose inki aranyore onye aye kogokora chinchera chiao chibe ching’ikeranu?
Inee! Nigo okagete ng’a nekiagera omoirogete, nakio gekogera agokoa egesusuro na gokorenta ase ekina?
Inee! Amabe gwakorire tari amanene? Ekeene, ebibe biao tibiri nomoerio.
Aye kwairire bosa ebinto abamino baruete bibe ntenenera, naende kwabachaboire chianga, kwabatigire gesobono.
Oyo konya orosire tomoeti amache anywe, na oyo orenge nenchara okamorina endagera.
Omonto obwate okobua nigo akoira ense yaba eyaye, na oyio oeirwe ogosikwa nere okoyemenya.
Aye kwabeire kogoseria ababoraka bare namaboko amasa na kobuna amaboko e chintakana.
Ase ayio emeeto yagoetananire, na obwoba bwa mobosokano nkogochanda bore.
Oborabu bwao bwabekirwe omosunte, goika tori korora, na amache amange agotubire.
“Inee! Nyasae tari aaria igoro mono? Rigereria ching’enang’eni chia igoro buna chire aare mono!
Ase engencho eyio aye nigo ogoteba: Inki Nyasae amanyete? Nanyare konacha ekina goetera ase omosunte ekerima?
Amare amarito nigo amotubete, takonyara korora, naende nigo agotaara ase obokumbe bwa igoro.
“Inee! Nenchera enkoro ogochia kobwatia, eria abakori amabe babwatetie?
Abwo nigo bataboretigwe engaki yabo konya etaraika; na oboroso bwabo bokairwa buna omogoko okoira.
Barabwo nigo batebetie Nyasae: Karue asetore! Naende bakabora: Inee! Ngento ki Omonguru oyio aratokorere?
Nonya naboigo Nyasae konya oichoirie chinyomba chiabo nebinto ebiya. Ogosemia kw’abakori amabe tiga kobe aare nainche.
Ekero abanyaboronge bakorora ayio, nigo bakogoka; ee, abwo batari na komocha nigo bagosekerera abakori amabe na kobachecheria,
bateba: Amaene, ababisa baito basirigwe kegima, na ebinto biabo biatigarete biasambirwe nomorero.
“Obwatane na Nyasae, nario orabe nomorembe; korakore igo, nonyore amaya.
Ancha amorokererio akorwa ase omonwa oye; gacha amang’ana aye ime ase enkoro yao.
Korairanere Omonguru, noiranerigwe amaya ao; korende oserie obobe korwa ase obomenyo bwao.
Otugute chitahabu chiao ime ase amaroba, ne chitahabu chikorwa Ofiri ochibeke ase egati y’amagena ’ebirooche,
erinde Omonguru bweka abe etahabu yao, na efeta yao ere nengencho enene.
Rirorio nobe gokwegokia ase Omonguru oria, onyare korigereria Nyasae.
Na ekero orabe gokomosaba, nakoigwe; naye nonyare goakana chiira chiao chi’ogotiana.
Erio ekero orabe gokoroberia gokora gento kende gionsi, ekio nkebe bo, na oborabu mbomoreke chinchera chiao.
Nyasae nigo agokeyia abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo obatooria.
Ere nigo agotooria omonto ore nokomocha, omonto buna oyio nigo aratoorigwe goetera ase amaboko ao achenegete.”
Ayubu akairaneria, akabora,
“Nonya ngoika rero okwemurungania kwane nigo kore okororo se; ogoakwa kwane nigo kore okorito kobua okweng’ereria kwane.
Onye ndiria nare komanya aase ndamonyore, rirorio nigo nare kogenda goika ase obomenyo bwaye bore.
Nigo narenge komotebia amang’ana aane, ing’ichorie omonwa one namang’ana nkoamererania nere.
Igo nigo nare komanya eki akong’iraneria, na komanya ayarenge gontebia.
Inee! Nyasae nkoamererania arenge nainche ase okobua kwaye kore okonene? Yaya, nigo arenge gontegerera.
Agwo omonto omonyaboronge nigo are konyara koamererania nere, rirorio nigo nare gotigwa kegima noyokongambia.
“Rora, nabeire nkogenda gochia bosio, korende ere taiyo; naende nabeire nkoirana gochia nyuma, korende tindi komorora.
Nigo nkomorigeria ensemo y’okobee, korende tindi komorora; naonchoka gochia ase ensemo y’okorio, korende tindi komorora.
Korende ere namanyete chinchera chiane ngoetera. Ekero arakoore gonteema, nimbioke buna etahabu ekobioka korwa riko.
Inche natachire bokong’u ase amabarato aye, nabeire ndendete chinchera chiaye, gose tindi koonchoka nchitige.
Tinana gotiga kobwata amachiko akwanete; nimbwatetie amang’ana ere akwanete, gose tari aya naroberetie inche omonyene.
“Korende ere tari koonchoka, ning’o oranyare komoonchorana? Egento aganirie gokora, nigo akogekora.
Aya achikire igoro yane, goika ayaikeranie, na amange buna ayio nigo agachire ase ebirengererio biaye.
Ase ayio nabeire nobwoba koba ase obosio bwaye, na ekero nkoyarengereria nigo nkomwoboa.
Nyasae ogoyirie omoyo one, ee, Omonguru ongosire,
ere tantigete ase omosunte nsire, nonya noria ekerima otubete obosio bwane.”
“Nase ki Omonguru atabegeti chingaki chi’ekina? Naende nase ki baria bamwanchete batararora rituko riria riaye?
“Abanto nigo bagotigeria chimbebe, baira amaicho e chitugo nechinguru, bachia koyarisia aba ayabo.
Abwo nigo bakoira chitigere chie chintakana, baira chiombe chi’ababoraka koba intenenera.
Nigo bagotwoma abaremeire korwa inchera, bagera abataka bonsi b’ense eyio bachia kwebisa amo.
“Rora, abataka abwo babeire buna chitigere chi’orosana chire ase erooro; nigo bagokora emeremo emekong’u ase okonyora ebi bakoria. Ase ekerubo ekiomo nao bakorigeria abana babo endagera.
Nigo bakogesera omonto onde chindagera chie chitugo chiaye, naende basangereria amasabibu agotigwa ase omogondo bw’omokori amabe.
Nigo bakorara gesobono ase obotuko bwonsi, batabwati eki bakwebisia, gose tibabwati eki bakobeka ekero ki’embeo.
Emebere yabo nigo enyiete nembura egotwa ase ebitunwa, erio bamigererania ase chingako chi’ebitare koigama aroro.
“Abande nigo bagotaboria chintakana korwa ase chimbeere chi’abang’ina, na baira abana ebing’werere b’abataka babe intenenera.
Abataka baria bakona‐koong’anya bare getirianda, nigo bakobogoria emesaima bare nenchara.
Nigo bakomitera abakori amabe amaguta ’amazeituni, korende nonya naboigo nigo bare nerang’o.
Abanto bachandegete ase omochie nigo bakweumia, abanto baakire chingoma nigo bakorera, nonya naboigo Nyasae tari gotegerera ogosaba kwabo.
“Abanto bande bangire oborabu, nonya ne chinchera chi’oborabu tibachimanyeti, gose tibari kobwatia chinchera chi’oborabu obwo.
Omoiti nigo akoboa mambia chuni ng’a aite abataka na abachandegete, na ase obotuko bwekora omoibi.
Eriso ri’omotomani nigo rikoganya kobwairire, ere oteba: Onde tari ondoche, erio otuba obosio bwaye bwekona.
Omosunte gosoire, abaibi nigo bakobochora chinyomba basoa ime. Barabwo mobaso nigo bagwesiekerera bebisa; tibancheti oborabu.
Omosunte ekerima nigo onga buna emambia asebare; barabwo nigo bare abasani b’okwoboyia kw’omosunte.
“Inwe nigo mogoteba: Omokori amabe nigo akoirwa bwango ne chiooro, na egetari kiaye ase ense eye nigo keragereirie, ere takonyara koirana ase emegondo yaye y’emesabibu.
Buna koreng’ana egurugura ne riberera bigokoora amache ’amagena ’embura, naboigo nabanto bakorire ebibe barairwe gochia aase abakure.
Chinda chi’abaiborete nchibebe pi; amakonde nabarie baere, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake; igo oyogokora amabe nabunwe buna omote.
Omokori amabe nigo akoibera omokungu omogomba; gose tari gokorera omoboraka amaya.
Nonya naboigo Nyasae ase okobua kwaye nigo akoa omokori amabe chinguru; ekero erusirie moyo, nigo agotenena naende.
Nabo Nyasae akomorenda buya na komokonya, na nigo akoba origereretie mono chinchera chiaye.
Ase engaki enke nabo abakori amabe bagokinigwa, erio bwango basirigwa; nigo bakogwa inse, bakwa buna abande, babutorwa buna ebigara bikobutorwa ekero bikogeswa.
Onye amang’ana ayio tari bo, ning’o oranyare kong’enekia ng’a nomorimo inde, naende aorokie ng’a amang’ana nakwanire nigo are bosa?”
Bilidadi Omosua akairaneria, akabora:
“Obonene na okoirokia nigo bire ase Nyasae, nigo agokora omorembe aaria igoro mono.
Inee! Ning’o oranyare kobara emeganda yaye? Ning’o omobaso oye otari kobarera?
Naki rende omonto aranyare koba omonyaboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae? Naki omonto oiboire nomokungu aranyare koba oyochenegete?
Rora, nonya nomotienyi tori noborabu asare, gose ching’enang’eni tichiikeraneti ase amaiso aye.
Onye nabo, naki rende ase omonto oyio onga buna rikonde; na mwanyabanto oyio onga buna enyongore?”
Erio Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:
“Naki ere buya aye gwakonyire omonto otari nokobua! Ee, aye gwatooririe omonto omoreu otari ne chinguru.
Naki ere buya gwasemirie omonto otari nobong’aini, na gwakwanire amang’ana aichire ne chisemi chingiya!
Nase chinguru chia ng’o gwakwanire amang’ana buna aya? Na ngoetera ase omoika o ng’o kwayakwanire?
“Emeika y’abanto bakwete nigo ekoiguswa; boigo namache na ebimenyete imeo.
Aase ’abakure nigo aasie ase obosio bwa Nyasae; ee, aase agwo ogosiria tabwati kemumeko.
Nyasae nigo aramborete ensemo ya sugusu aase arenge bosa, nigo asungete ense aase bosa etabwateti aande.
Ere nigo aochanetie amache amo, akayaboerania amare amanetu ime; na amare ayio tari gotandoka.
Nigo atubete ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, akagetuba namare aye.
Ong’ororirie ekeringerera kere orobebe rw’amache ase ogwatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte.
Chisiiro chia igoro nigo chigotengecha, chiakumia ase ogotogonyera kwaye.
Ere ase okobua kwaye nigo agoturubania enyancha, na ase chisemi chiaye akanachana Rahabu, eng’iti enene y’enyancha.
Nyasae nigo akoeyana, na omoika oye omecheeria igoro, ere nigo aitete nokoboko kwaye engiti eria yare gotama.
Naama! Echi nechinsinyo chie chinchera chiaye, aya tokoiwga nokomonyerera ogosinini. Korende ning’o oranyare komanya okobua kwaye konga buna enkoba egoaka?”
Ayubu akagenderera gokwana emerabaaro yaye akabora:
“Ekeene, buna Nyasae are moyo, oyo ong’urire ebiantungetie, na buna Omonguru aeire omoyo one obororo,
naende omoika bw’obomoyo ogendererete koba ime yane, na omoika o Nyasae ore ase chimioro chiane,
omonwa one togokwana aya atari a boronge, gose oromeme rwane ay’obong’ainereria.
Abe aare korwa asende kobabara ng’a nabanyaboronge more; goika ogokwa kwane ningenderere goteba ng’a tindi nokomocha.
Nimbwaterere bokong’u oboronge bwane, tinkobotiga, enkoro yane tekongambia ase amatuko ande inde moyo.”
“Tiga omobisa one abarwe buna omokori amabe, na oyore mamincha yane buna oyotari omonyaboronge.
Ngosemeria ki omonto otamoirogete Nyasae abwate, ekero arakwe, ekero Nyasae aramoure obogima.
Ekero emechando eramochere na ere arere ase Nyasae, Inee, namoigwe gose?
Omonto oyio nagokigwe ase Omonguru? Nabe okorangeria Nyasae ase chingaki chionsi?”
“Nimborokererie igoro y’okobua kwa Nyasae; amang’ana onsi igoro y’Omonguru tinkoyabisa.
Rora, inwe mwensi mweroreire ayio; bono, nase ki rende mogokwana amang’ana a bosa?”
“Ekio nakio egetari Nyasae akoa omokori amabe, na omwando Omonguru akoa abwo bagochanda abanto.
Abana b’omokori amabe nabaisa komentekana, nigo bareo ase ogocha goitwa nomoro, abanto b’ororeria rwaye tibakonyora endagera eisaine.
Abatigari baye nigo oborwaire borabaite, na abakungu baratigwe bare ababoraka, tibakonyara kobareera.
Omonto oyio naisa gosangereria chifeta chinyinge, naende atumbe chianga chibe chindwenyi buna esike;
nonya ochitumbire igo, nomonto omoronge orachibeke, na abatari na komocha baatanane chifeta chiaye.
Enyomba omonto oyio araagache nigo erabe buna ey’oronyambobe, na buna ekegutu omorendi akoagacha.
Omonto oyio nigo akogenda korara ore omonda, korende takoba bo rende; ekero akoramokia amaiso kabokire anyore obotenenku bwaye bwasirire.
Obwoba obonene bonga buna eooro nigo bokomochera; erio ekembugu‐mbugu kiamochera botuko kiamoira.
Omwaga okorwa moocha nigo okomoirurukia; omorusia aase aye, omosiria kegima.
Nyasae nigo akomoruta emegwe atari namabera, nere otama bokong’u korua ase okoboko kwaye.
Abanto nigo bagoaka chinkobi igoro yaye, bamoseria neriogi ri’okomwogerera, orua aase aye.”
“Ekeene, ribwago ase chifeta chigokunywa korwa ndire, na aase abanto bagosiberia chitahabu nare.
Ebioma nigo bigokunywa korwa riroba inse, ne chitaai nigo chikonyorwa ase amagena ’ebitare anyititorwa.
Abanto nigo bagotongia chitaya ime aaria, basiria omosunte; erio baba bakoriga‐rigia amagena ase ebinunchi bire ase omosunte ekerima.
Abanto nigo bagokunya chingoro chintambe gochia inse. Abwo nigo bakoba bebirwe nabanto bagotaara igoro ye riroba, nigo bagotirimbokigwa basung’unaine bairwa aare korwa ase abanto.
Ase riroba igoro nao endagera ekwama ime y’ense inse aroro aonchoranwa aba buna omorero ogosamba oonchorana.
Aroro agwo nao are amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro, amo namagena e chitahabu.
Enchera ekogenda aase agwo enyoni ende yonsi egotwara orotwari teyemanyeti, gose ekebaki tikiana koyerora.
Eng’iti y’orosana eng’enenu tiyana koyetacha, gose endo tiyana goetera aroro.
“Mwanyabanto nigo agokunya egetare ekiomo pa, erio osensema ebitunwa korwa inse obionchorana.
Nigo akorema emetaro ime ase ebitare, na amaiso aye arora aroro kera egento kie rigori rinene.
Nigo akogita chindooche, oochania amache tagoeta, erio egento kebisekanete ime, okerenta aase aarabu.
Korende ng’ai obong’aini boranyorekane? Na ng’ai okomanya komenyete?
“Mwanyabanto tamanyeti rigori ri’obong’aini; borobwo tibori konyorekana ase ense emenyire nabare moyo.
Chindiba nigo chigokana chiateba: Tibori asende aa, na enyancha nigo egoteba: Tibori aiga asende.
Tibokogorwa chitahabu, gose chifeta tichikorengwa koba rigori riaye.
Tibokoreng’anigwa ne chitahabu chikorwa Ofiri, gose namagena e rigori rinene akorokwa oiniki na safiro.
Chitahabu na ebirore ebiya tibikoreng’anigwa naborobwo, gose tibokoonchorerigwa nebinto bi’ogwechabera, biroisirie korwa ase chitahabu chichenire.
Amakorongote na ebirore bichenire tibigwatorwa. Rigori ri’obong’aini nigo rire rinene kobua eri’amagena e rigori rinene rikomeka‐meka.
Topasio, rigena rie rigori rinene rikorwa Etiopia, tirikoboreng’anigwa, gose tibokoreng’anigwa netahabu echenire.
“Bono rende, obong’aini ng’ai bokorwa? Na ng’ai okomanya komenyete?
Nigo bobisire korwa ase amaiso ’ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo; ee, nigo botubire chinyoni tichiborora.
Aase ay’obosareku na amakweri nigo bigoteba: Intwe twaigure chinkuma chiaye.
“Nyasae bweka namanyete enchera y’obong’aini, namanyete aase aye.
Ere nigo arigereretie goika chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense, aroche kera egento kere inse y’erioba.
Ekero Nyasae arengete chinguru chi’omwaga, na akarenga obonge bw’amache,
ekero abegete ogochika ase embura, na akaroisia enchera y’okomesa gw’enkoba,
nario aroche obong’aini naende akaboraria; akaboikerania na koboenekia ase abanto.
“Erio Nyasae agatebia mwanyabanto: Naama! Okomoiroka Omonene, okwo nakwo obong’aini; na ogweatanana korwa ase ebibe, okwo nakwo okomanya.”
Erio Ayubu akagenderera gokwana emerabaaro yaye, akabora:
“Onye ndiria obogima bwane bware koba buna bwarenge ase amatuko a kare, amatuko aria Nyasae andendete!
Engaki eria etaya yaye yarenge komorekera omotwe one, na ase oborabu bwaye nkaba ngotaara ase omosunte.
Ase amatuko aria nakinete inde ne chinguru, na obosani bwa Nyasae bwagendererete kobeera ase obomenyo bwane.
Engaki eria Omonguru nigo arenge amo nainche, na abana baane nigo bang’etanaine;
nigo narenge gwesibia amagoro aane namabeere, emezeituni ekamera ase egetare, nkanyora chindooche chi’amaguta ’amazeituni.
Ekero narenge kogenda ase egeita ki’omochie, goikaransa ase ekerogo kiane agwo ase ekeraario,
abasae abaare kondora nigo barenge kogobera, na abanto abagotu batenena konyorokia amasikani.
Abagambi b’abanto nigo baare gokira tibagokwana, batuba emenwa yabo namaboko.
Amariogi ’abagambi nigo arenge gokea, chimeme chiabo chiabwatana namang’ang’ura abo.
“Ekero abanto barenge konyigwa, nigo barenge kondoka oyosesenirie, ekero baare kondora, baba birori asende,
ekiagera nigo nabete ngotooria abataka abwo barenge korera, ne chintakana chitabwate onde ogochikonya.
Ogosesenigwa kw’omonto konya obeire ang’e gosira nigo gwanchicherete, nkagera ababoraka bagatera nechinkoro chire nomogoko.
Nigo neboyetie oboronge, naborobwo bogantuba; ekeene kiane nigo kiarenge buna omwambaro na ekegogwa.
Ninche narenge eriso ase emeuko, na okogoro ase ebirema.
Ninche narenge ise bw’abataka: na omonto ochandegete ntamanyete, nigo namwechanderete.
Nigo nabunete chinsea chi’abatari abanyaboronge, ngatooria korwa ase emenwa yabo abwo konya babwatirwe.
“Erio nkaba nkorengereria ng’a amatuko aane nigo arabe amange buna omokenye, erio ngokwa imbe ase egeswa kiane.
Nigo narenge buna omote emeri yaye ekoranda yaika ase chindooche; chinsagia chiane chikagenderera gotoora riime ase obotuko bwonsi;
obonene bwane nigo bwarenge kona‐koba oboyia asende, na obota bwane bokona‐konyora chinguru chinyia ase amaboko aane.
Ekero narenge korua ogosemia, abanto nigo barenge gontegerera, bakira‐kiri.
Ekero nakoorire gokwana, monto onde tarenge komenta ing’ana rinde, ekiagera amang’ana aane nigo arenge kobagwera buna amatoima ’embura.
Nigo barenge koba banganyete buna embura ekoganywa; bakaba bagwasamia emenwa yabo buna embura y’okwamia endagera egwasamerwa.
Ekero konya berusirie moyo nigo narenge kobasekera; obwasioku bw’obosio bwane tibabosieereretie.

Inche nigo nachorete enchera bagwenerete kobwatia, naende nkabeera egati yabo buna omogambi; nigo namenyete asebare buna omoruoti akomenya nabarwani baye b’esegi, naende buna omonto okoremia baria bakorera.”
“Korende bono abanto bare abake asende, nigo bagonsekerera, abwo abaise babo batagwenereti kende, anga ntababegete nonya nase egati ye chisese chikorenda amaicho aane.
Abanto abwo chinguru chiabo chiaerire ase obogotu, ngokonywa ki ndanyore korwa ase amaboko abo?
Ase engencho y’okoremerwa na enchara babeire ebigonkobe, nigo bakona‐kogokona namaino abo riroba eriomo pa, erio riasaregete.
Nigo bakona‐gosangereria ebimeri bie chinsana, na baremora emeri y’emete enga buna ebisanka.
Abwo nigo bagoserigwa korwa ase egati y’abanto, baakerwa amariogi korwa nyuma na kwogererwa buna abaibi.
Ase igo bagenda komenya ase amakuruma are ase amagoko, na ase chingoro inse y’ense, na ase ebitare.
Ime ase ebitutu nigo bakwogererana, inse y’amasa akorura nao bagosangererekana amo.
Barabwo nabana b’abanto abariri na ab’abakayayu; nigo baseretigwe nemecharichi barue ase ense.
Na bono inche nabeire engero egoterwa asebare, ee, nabeire asebare ring’ana rikorabaarwa.
Barabwo nigo bangechete, bantamire; tibetangeti gontwera amate obosio bwane.
Nyasae ong’urire chinguru, naende onkorire koba omoitongo, na abanto abwo babeire abaremu ase ogonkorera bobe.
Abasae abwo abasaria nigo bagontubokera korwa ensemo yane ya borio, erio baminyokia gonseria; nigo bagokora emeroberio emenge y’ogonsiria.
Basaririe enchera yane ngoetera; abwo batabwate gokonyeka konde abanyene, nigo bagokonya abande ase ogonsiria.
Nigo bakobagora aase aagare banchichera ne chinguru, erio bang’umokera goetera ase omogwa oyio babagoire.
Okogoswa gwanchicheire; ogosikwa kwane gwasirigwe buna omwaga ogosiria, na obotenenku bwane bwasirire pi buna amare agosira.
Na bono omoyo one oberire ime yane; amatuko ’emechando ambwatereire bokong’u.
Amauga ’omobere one nigo akonyatia botuko bokia, na obororo bokondia tibori gokenda.
Oborwaire bwane bwabeire ne chinguru bwaonchoire risankwa ri’omobere one, bono nigo ring’usererete buna rigoti ri’eanga yane.
Nyasae ontugutire ase etintira ime, nabeire buna orotu ne ribu.
“Nigo nkorera asore, korende aye tori kong’iraneria; nigo nteneine asore, korende aye nigo onsonchete rioka.
Aye kwabeire omotindi asende; nigo okondwania nokoboko kwao kore ne chinguru.
Aye nigo onyimokereretie igoro kwambekire ase omwaga na kondiinia igoro yaye. Aye nigo okona‐konuchania gochia aaria na aaria, naba bosa ase omwaga omotindi.
Ee, namanyire ng’a nong’ire aase abakure, ase enyomba eria echikeire abare moyo bonsi.
Inee! Omonto karagwe takorambora okoboko kwaye, na ase emechando yaye arere akonywe?
Inee! Tinarerete ase engencho y’abwo barenge ase emechando? Omoyo one tochandekerete abataka?
Korende ekero nasemeretie konyora amaya, amabe agacha, na ekero nabete nsemeretie konyora oborabu, omosunte ogacha.
Enkoro yane nigo ere nemechando mono, teri nobotoereru, amatuko ’emechando anchicheire.
Nigo nkona‐koong’anya inde nemechando ntarochi omobaso; nigo ngotenena ase omosangererekano, narera ng’a nkonywe.
Inche nabeire oyomwabo chisese chi’orosana, na omogisangio bwe chisagero.
Risankwa riane riaonchokire riamwamire ti, na nigo rikona‐kobutoka, na amauga aane nigo akoyia buna omorero.
Obokano bwane bw’ebirigisa nigo bokominwa bwaba obw’ebirero, na ekeroria kiane kiaonchoiwe kobugigwa ase abanto bakorera.”
“Inche nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania namaiso aane ng’a tinkorigereria omoiseke omwekungi ase okomogania.
Naki rende egetari kiane gekorwa ase Nyasae o igoro kerabe? Na omwando one okorwa ase Omonguru ore igoro, naki orabe?
Inee! Emechando teri konyora abatari abanyaboronge, na ogosirigwa gwachera abagokora ebibe?
Inee! Nyasae tarochi chinchera chiane chionsi na kobara amatambokero aane onsi?”
“Inee! Nabeire ngotaara ase chinchera chi’obong’ainereria, gose amagoro aane naminyokeire ay’oborimo?
Tiga ndengwe ase ekerengo ekeronge, na Nyasae amanye oboikeranu bwane.
Onye nagobeire korwa ase enchera, na enkoro yane yabeire ekobwatia okogania kw’amaiso aane, na onye komocha konde kwabwatereire amaboko aane,
rirorio inche nsimeke endagera, na omonto omoao ayeire, na kende gionsi kiane keramere gesimorwe.”
“Onye omoyo one obeire okoebererigwa na gwancha omokungu omoao, na igo nabeire nkoboera omonto onde ase egesieri kiaye imosirie,
rirorio tiga omokungu one abe ogosera omonto omoao obosie, naende abasacha bande babe bakoba nere.
Okwo nigo kware koba ogosaria okobe mono goetania, na kware koegwa egesusuro nabagambi ebina bonsi.
Boigo nigo kware koba omorero ogosamba gochia aase ay’ogosiria na koria ebinto biane bionsi kobikoora.”
“Inse kwanga koroisia amang’ana ’omosomba one, omosacha gose omokungu, ekero baremurunganie igoro yane,
ninki ndakore ekero Nyasae aranyimokere? Ninki ndamoiranerie ekero arabe okorua egesusuro ki’ebibe biane?
Inee! Oyio ontongete ase enda ya baba, tari ere otongete oyio boigo? Tari ere oyomo otobombete ase enda ime?”
“Inche tinarinete omotaka egento aganetie, gose tinatigete omoboraka kwerusia moyo;
tinarenge koria endagera yane inche bweka, nigo naete nentakana nero, ekayeria.
Oyio inche nabete ise korwa obosae bwaye, na korwa okoiborwa kwaye nkaba nkomorera na komoraa.”
“Inee! Monto onde nare ochandegete ase okoborwa chianga, gose omotaka otabwati ekiebisio, ntakonyete?
Barabwo nigo bansesenetie, ekiagera nabaete chingobo chi’amarionya e ching’ondi chikorwa ase amaicho aane.”
“Onye nakorerete entakana bobe ekiagera namanyete ng’a ekegambero agwo ase egeita ngenkonye,
rirorio tiga amareko aane ongoke agwe inse, ne chinengo chi’amaboko aane chinsomoke.
Nigo nare kocha kwoboigwa nemechando korwa ase Nyasae; na tinare konyara gotenena bosio bw’obonene bwaye.”
“Tinasemeretie etahabu, nonya netahabu echenire;
tinagokerete gose gochengera obotenenku bwane obonge, gose ebinto nenyorerete namaboko aane.
Tinarigereretie erioba ekero riabarete, gose omotienyi ekero omesete,
goika enkoro yane ekaebererigwa bobisi ase okobisasima, gose tinanyunyuntete okoboko kwane ase okobisika.
Onye nakorete ayio nigo nare koegwa egesusuro nabagambi ebina, ekiagera ayio nokomokana Nyasae ore igoro.”
“Inee! Nagokerete ogosirigwa kw’omobisa one? Gose netogetie ekero amabe amocherete?
Yaya, tinatigete omonwa one okore ebibe ase okomoragereria na komoganeria amakweri.
Abanto bonsi bamenyete aa bwone babeire birori ng’a kera omonto obeire oisanegete nendagera nkomoa.
Nigo narenge koigorera abaeti ebisieri biane basoa; gose onde tabete okorara isiko botuko.
Tinatubete ogosaria kwane buna engencho ya mwanyabanto ere, gose ebibe biane ase egekuba kiane ime.
Tinairogete omoganda omonene bw’abanto, gose kwoboa abaamate abwo barenge gonchaya, erinde imbe nkirete na kobeera nyomba ime.”
“Naki yare koba buya onye nanyora omonto okonyigwa. Inche nakoorire amang’ana aane! Oria Omonguru nang’iranerie! Ninganetie ndore amang’ana omobisa one andikerete ase okonyomania.
Ekeene, nigo nare koyabogoria igoro ase amareko aane; nanga nigo nayesiberania abe buna egutwa asende.
Nanga namotebia igoro y’orogendo rwane rwonsi; nigo nare komochiera inde buna omogambi.”
“Inee! Oboremo bwane bwanakondeera gose emeng’ororia ye chintinde yana‐korererana?
Onye nabeire nkoria okwama kwaye ntari goakana na kogera abanyene bakwe,
rirorio tiga amagwa amereo ribaga ri’engano, na amabanchore ribaga ri’esairi.” Amang’ana ’Ayubu aereire aa.
Bono ekiagera Ayubu arenge omonyaboronge ase amaiso aye ere omonyene, abanto baria batato bagatiga komoiraneria.
Erio Elihu akaba nendamwamu ase Ayubu, ekiagera ekorete omonyakeene kobua Nyasae. Elihu oyio nigo arenge mosinto o Barakeli Omobusi, na oyo bw’eamate ya Ramu.
Boigo akaba nendamwamu ase abasani baria batato b’Ayubu, ekiagera batanyorete amang’ana bakoiraneria, nonya batebete ng’a Ayubu nomomochi.
Elihu akaba okoganya baria batato barakwana n’Ayubu, ekiagera ere arenge omoke ase emiaka.
Na ekero aroche ng’a baria batato tibabwate ing’ana baare koiraneria, akaba nendamwamu.

Elihu oyio, mosinto o Barakeli Omobusi, agateba: “Inche nigo inde omoke ase emiaka, korende inwe nabakoro more; ayio naro agerete nkaba nobwoba, ngakira‐kiri, na tinakwana ay’ebirengererio biane asemore.
Korende ngateba: Tiga abanto b’amatuko amange bakwane, abanyamiaka menge borokererie obong’aini.
Korende omoika nore ime ase mwanyabanto, omoika oyio bw’Omonguru noro okobaa okomanya.
Bono tari ng’a nabanto b’emiaka emenge bare abang’aini, gose tari ng’a nabagotu bamanyete ayare boronge.
Nigo nkoboria, montegerere, erinde nkwane ayare ase ebirengererio biane.
“Naama! Nigo nategererete mono ekero mwarenge gokwana; nkaba ndemereretie koigwa chinkwana chiaino chi’obong’aini, ekero mwarenge koriga‐rigia ng’a mang’ana ki mwagwenerete gokwana.
Ee, nigo nabategererete mono, korende onde tarenge asemore obuete Ayubu, gose onde tanyarete koiraneria amang’ana aye.
Inwe erende mono, timobaisa goteba: Intwe twanyorire obong’aini. Nyasae nere orabue Ayubu na amoiyerie, tari mwanyabanto.
Ayubu takwanete nainche amang’ana ande ay’okweegerera, na inche tinkomoiraneria buna inwe.
“Bono batang’ang’ire, tibakonyara kong’iraneria nonya ng’ake; tibabwati ring’ana bagokwana.
Inee! Nainche nigo nkogenderera koganya, ekiagera tibari gokwana, na ekiagera bateneine agwo batari koiraneria?
Inche ngokwana inde ayane, erinde ng’orokie ayare ase ebirengererio biane.
Inche nimbwate amang’ana amange nganetie gokwana, ekiagera omoika ore ime yane onsukirie.
Rora, enda yane nigo enga buna edivai ekunekire mono, buna ebirandi biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa amayia bire ang’e kworeka.
Goika nkwane, erio nario ndanyore obotoereru; goika imaanore omonwa nkwane, ing’iranerie.
Inche tinkonyara gwanchereria monto onde bwensi, gose gokwana amang’ana ay’okweansia.’
Inche timanyeti gokwana amang’ana ’okweansia, inse gokora bo, Omotongi one nigo aransirie bwango.”
“Aye Ayubu, bono inyigwe, ntegerera ase onsi aya ngokwana.
Rora, bono namumoire omonwa one, na oromeme rwane rwachakire gokwana.
Amang’ana aane nigo akoorokia oboronge bore ime ase enkoro yane, na ase omonwa one nigo ngokwana aya imanyete.
Omoika o Nyasae noro ontongete, na omoika bw’obomoyo bw’Omonguru noro okong’a obogima.”
“Bono ing’iranerie onye gokonyara; beka amang’ana ao ang’e, otenene bokong’u!
Rora, inche nigo inde buna aye ase obosio bwa Nyasae; inche boigo nigo natongetwe korwa ase riroba.
Rora, inche tindi kende ogwenerete konyoboa; gose tindi gochia koba buna egurube endito asore.”
“Ekeene, gwakwanire ase ntegererete, na inche naigure amang’ana ao.
Aye nigo ogoteba iga: Inche nigo nchenegete, tindi nogosaria konde, na bibe tibiri ime yane.
Naama! Nyasae onyorire amasoero asende, na ombarire ng’a nomobisa oye inde.
Osoirie amagoro aane ase rikorogoto, na nigo akoba ondigereretie ase oboeto bwane bwonsi.”
“Naama! Nigo ngokoiraneria ng’a ase amang’ana aya tokwaneti ekeene; Nyasae nigo are omonene goetania mwanyabanto.
Nase ki okoamererania nere kogoteba ng’a ere takoiraneria amang’ana aya nonya nerimo?
Ekeene, Nyasae nigo agokwana ase enchera eyemo, gose ibere; nonya nabo monto onde tari okomotegerera.
Nigo agokwana ase chindoto na amaroro a botuko, na ekero abanto bararire chitoro chindito, na ekero basundokire ase amarere abo.
Erio agwo otinora amato ’abanto, na obarentera ogokurera gw’okoondokia
ng’a anyare koonchora omonto atige ogokora kwaye okobe, na atange oboenenu bw’omonto.
Nigo agotanga omonto tagenda ase oboina, naende orenda obogima bwaye tibosirigwa nomoro.
Omonto nigo akonyora egesusuro gi’okomorongeyia, ekero are nobororo ase oborere bwaye, na amauga aye agendererete komwatia.
Omoyo oye ogecha endagera, nonya endagera ere engiya mono.
Chinyama chi’omobere oye nigo chikoera, tichikororekana, na amauga aye atongorora.
Ere omonyene nigo agosuka gochia ang’e noboina, na obogima bwaye gochia ase abagosiria obogima.”
“Onye omomalaika nkoba arenge asare, oyomo bwa baria chilifu bagokora okobwatania asare, erinde amworokie ayare ay’oboronge,
erio amororere amabera, atebe: Tooria omonto oyo tabaisa gotirimboka gochia ase oboina, ekiagera inche namonyoreire embooria.
Omobere oye oiranigwe obe buna oyo bw’obosae bwaye, naende aonchorwe abe buna ekero arenge ne chinguru.
Ekero arabe ogosaba Nyasae, nere namororere amabera; omonto oyio nachiche ase obosio bwaye ore nomogoko, na Nyasae nairanie oboronge bw’omonto oyio.
Omonto oyio natere ase amasio ’abanto, atebe: Nigo nakorete ebibe, nkaonchorana aya arenge amaronge, gose tinanyorete egesusuro buna nagwenerete.
Ere obooririe omoyo one togenda ase oboina, bono obogima bwane mborore oborabu.
Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana ayio onsi ase omonto ara kabere, gose ara gatato,
erinde amoiranie korwa ase oboina, ng’a oyio anyare komorekerwa noborabu bw’obogima.”
“Aye Ayubu, ntegerera, okire‐kiri, inche nkwane.
Onye kobwate ing’ana rinde okong’iraneria, kwana, ekiagera nigo nganetie gokoa oboronge bwao.
Onye tobwati kende, kira‐kiri ontegerere, na inche ninkworokererie obong’aini.”
Erio Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora:
“Inwe abanto abang’aini, igwa amang’ana aane! Inwe abamanyi chisemi, ntegerera!
Amang’ana amato akoigwa, nigo akoyateema, buna oromeme rokomena endagera.
Tochore ayare amaronge; intwe amo toteeme komanya ayare amaronge.
Ayubu nigo agoteba: Inche nomonyene oboronge, korende Nyasae ong’urire oboronge bwane.
Nonya inde omonyene oboronge, nabarirwe ng’a nomonyaborimo inde; amaote aane takonyara kogwena, nonya gosaria konde tikori ime asende.
“Inee! Monto ki onga buna Ayubu, oyio okonywa ogochaywa, ogokomera buna amache?
Ere oyio ogosanga nabanyabibe na gotaara nabakori amabe.
Naende ere otebire ng’a kobwatana na Nyasae, ayio tari komokonya gento kende.
