“Ase ayio, inwe abanto abamore nokomanya, inyigwa! Nyasae tabaisa gokagerwa ng’a nakore amabe. Inee! Ere Omonguru nakore ebibe?
Ere nigo agoakana omonto koreng’ana buna emeremo yaye ere; nabo akoa omonto eng’eria buna orogendo rwaye rore.
Ekeene, Nyasae tagokora ayare amabe; ee, ere Omonguru tari gosaria ayare ay’ekeene.
Ning’o oete Nyasae okobua gw’okogambera ense? Ning’o obegete ense yonsi koba eyaye?
Ere aise koirania omoika oye, ee, airanie gochia asare omoika bw’obogima,
mwanyabanto bonsi pi goika bakwe, bairane ase amaroba.
“Onye more nokomanya, igwa aya; tegerera moigwe aya ngoteba:
Inee! Omonto ogechete ekeene nanyare kogamba? Nonachere ekina omonyene oboronge oyore nokobua?
Nonyare gotebia omoruoti: Aye nigo ore omonto bosa, gose notebie abanene basikire: Inwe nabakori amabe?
Nyasae tari gwanchereria abagambi, gose tari kobara abanda ng’a mbare nengencho enene kobua abataka, ekiagera abwo bonsi nigo bare emeremo y’amaboko aye.
Abanto nigo bagokwa ara rimo; nigo bakonyegerigwa botuko gati, basira kegima, baria bare nokobua nigo bagosirigwa ko tari namaboko a mwanyabanto.
Nyasae nigo arigereretie chinchera chi’omonto; ere nigo aroche amatambokero aye onsi.
Aase aamwamu tari, gose omosunte ekerima, ase omokori amabe aranyare kwebisa.
Nyasae taganeti engaki entambe korigereria, goika abeke omonto ase ekina.
Ere nigo agosenyenta abare nokobua atari kona‐kouna‐unia, erio abeke abande aase abo.
Ekiagera ere namanyete emeremo yabo, nigo akobaonchorana botuko baitwa kegima.
Nyasae nigo akobaita maiso marore, ase engencho y’ebibe biabo,
na ekiagera baonchokire na gotiga komobwatia, gose tibari korengereria igoro ye chinchera chiaye nonya ng’ake.
Abwo bagerire ekerero ki’abataka giaikire asare, nere oigure ekerero ki’abagokorerwa bobe.
“Inee! Nyasae karakire‐kiri ning’o oramonachere ekina? Karabise obosio bwaye, ning’o oranyare komorigereria, gokerabe egesaku gete gose omonto gete,
ekero ararusie okogamba korwa ase abatamoirogeti na abatange tibaba amareba ase abanto?
“Inee! Monto onde nare otebirie Nyasae: Inche naremereirie egesusuro gi’okondongeyia, nonya tinkorereti monto onde bobe.
Bono inyorokererie aya ntamanyeti, na onye nakorire ebibe, tingwancha kobikora naende.
Nigo okagete ng’a Nyasae nigo aragoakane buna oranche, ekiagera gwakanire ande onsi? Aye goika ochore, gose tari inche; ase ayio, kwana aya omanyete.
“Abanto abare nokomanya, na kera omonto omong’aini orabe okonyigwa, nigo barantebie:
Ayubu nigo agokwana atari na semi; na amang’ana aye tari ay’obong’aini.
Nigo yagwenerete Ayubu ateemwe goika omoerio, ekiagera nigo akoiraneria buna abakori amabe bakoiraneria.
Ere nigo akomenta ogosaria ase ebibe biaye, naende nigo agotoakera chinkobi ase ogotochaya na gokwana amang’ana amange are mamincha ya Nyasae.”
Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora:
“Aye Ayubu, nigo okorengereria ng’a ayio nekeene? Gose nigo ogoteba ng’a nomonyaboronge ore ase obosio bwa Nyasae?
Naende gokoboria ng’a mbuya ki oboronge bokogokorera kobua ogokora ebibe?
Bono ngokoiraneria nde aye amo nabasani bao abamore komo.”
“Rigereria gochia igoro, orore; rora amare buna are igoro mono kogoetania.
Aye noisa gokora ebibe, ninki ayio arakore ase Nyasae? Na ogosaria nagoisa komentekana mono, ninki okwo koramokorere?
Onye kore omonyene oboronge, ngento ki okoa Nyasae, gose ninki akonyora korwa ase okoboko kwao?
Amabe ao ogokora nigo akorenta emechando ase omonto onde onga buna aye, na oboronge bwao nabo boragere omonto onde anyore ayare amaya.”
“Ekiagera ogokorerwa bobe kwabuchire, abanto nigo bakorera mono ng’a bakonywe; nigo bakorangeria bakonywe korwa ase amaboko ay’abare nokobua.
Korende monto onde tari okoboria: Ng’ai Nyasae, oria ontongete, are, oyio okogera amatera ay’ogotogia aterwa botuko?
Ere nigo agotworokereria kobua ching’iti chi’ense, na otokora twaba nobong’aini kobua chinyoni.
Abanto nigo bakorera, korende Nyasae tari koiraneria, ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo okobe kw’oboenenu.
Ekeene, Nyasae tari koigwa okorera gotari ogw’ekeene, gose ere Omonguru takogwechandera.”
“Nonya kogoteba ng’a tori komorora, ere tagokoigwa; ekina kiao nigo kere ase obosio bwaye, bono nigo omoganyete nogosemeria.
Korende bono nigo okorengereria ng’a Nyasae tari korua egesusuro ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye, naende ng’a ere tari gwechandera ogosaria.
Ayio naro akogera aye Ayubu ogokwana amang’ana atari nengencho, nigo okomenta gokwana amang’ana atari ay’obong’aini.”
Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora,
“Indemereria ake igo, inche nkworokie amang’ana; nimbwate ring’ana ngokwana korwa ase Nyasae.
Inche nindusie chisemi chiane korwa aare, ing’orokie ng’a Omotongi one nere omonyene oboronge.
Ekeene, amang’ana aane tari ay’oborimo; inche oyo nteneine aiga amo naye nomoikeranu inde ase okomanya.”
“Rora, Nyasae nigo are Omonguru, ere tachayeti onde; nigo are nokobua ase chinguru na obong’aini.
Ere tagotiga omokori amabe agenderere koba moyo, korende nigo akoa abachandire oboronge bwabo.
Tari gotiga korigereria abanyene oboronge, korende nigo akobabeka amo nabaruoti ase ebirogo bi’obonene. Ee, nigo akobakinia bagenderera kobeera aroro,
na onye bagosibwa chingataare na baba bare ase emechando, gose kobwatwa ase emeeto y’emechando,
Nyasae nigo akobaorokeria aya bakorire, na ogosaria kwabo, naende ng’a nigo bare abaenenu.
Nigo agotinora amato abo baigwa ogokurerwa, na obachika baonchoke, batige gokora amabe.
Kobaraigwere na komokorera, rirorio mbabe bagoseseneka ase amatuko abo onsi, naende babe bakwegokia ase obogima bwabo.
Korende onye tibakoigwera, nigo baraitwe nemioro, erio bakwe batamanyeti kende.”
“Abatamoirogete Nyasae nigo bagachete endamwamu ime ase chinkoro chiabo; barabwo tibari korera barigie bakonywe, ekero Nyasae akobaa egesusuro.
Barabwo nigo bagokwa ekero bare abake, obogima bwabo nigo bogosirigwa buna obw’abanyaka.
Nyasae nigo agotooria abataka goetera ase emechando yabo, otinora amato abo goetera ase ogokorerwa bobe kwabo.
Ee, nigo akoebereretie, agakorusia korwa ase chimbanderana, agakorenta aase aagare, ase komigwa gotaiyo; boigo chindagera kwabekeretwe emesa nigo chiarenge chinoru.
Korende bono aye nigo okonacherwa ekina buna eki’abakori amabe, ekina na ayare ay’ekeene mbikonyore.
Bono erende, endamwamu tebaisa gokoebereria na kogokora obe omochecheria, tobaisa gwancha obonge bw’embooria bogosirie.
Inee! Obotenenku bwao mbonyare kogotanga korwa ase emechando? Gose okobua kwao ne chinguru chiao mbinyare?
Tobaisa kogania ng’a obotuko boria boche, obwo abanto baraitwe basirigwe.
Bwerende, tobaisa koirana gokora amabe, ekiagera nigo gwanchire gokora ayio kobua konyora emechando.”
“Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amanene ase okobua kwaye. Inee! Ning’o okworokereria buna ere?
Ning’o ochikeire Nyasae enchera yaye? Gose ning’o oranyare komotebia: Aye gwakorire bobe?
Inyora gotogia emeremo yaye, eyio abanto babeire bagotera na koyetogia.
Abanto bonsi bayerorire, ee, mwanyabanto mbayerigereretie korwa aare.
Rora, Nyasae nigo are omonene mono, na intwe titomomanyeti; omobaro bw’emiaka yaye tomanyekaneti.”
“Ere nigo akong’usa chintonyi chi’amache gochia igoro, na chirochio chiatwa buna embura chiaba riime.
Embura eyio nigo egotwa gocha ase ense, yatwera mwanyabanto ase obonge.
Inee! Monto onde nanyare komanya buna amare agwesiarera, gose buna okogukura gw’enkoba gokorua ase obomenyo bwa Nyasae?
Rora, nigo agosiarera okomesa kwamoetanana, naende otuba enkori y’enyancha.
Ase enchera eyio nigo akonachera abanto ekina; naende nigo akobaa chindagera ase obonge.
Ere nigo amumegete amaboko aye ase okomesa, erio ochika goake ase ekerenga kere.
Ekerundo gi’okomesa nigo gekoraria igoro ya Nyasae, nonya ne ching’iti nigo chikomanya ng’a ekerundo ngocha kere.”
“Ayio nigo akogera enkoro yane yaiguswa, yatuma gocha ase omoyo.
Tegerera oigwe okogukura kw’eriogi riaye, na okoruma gokorwa ase omonwa oye.
Nigo agotoma okoruma okwo korwa igoro gocha ase ense yonsi; okomesa kwaye gwe chinkoba nigo kogochera chinsinyo chi’ense.
Erio eriogi riaye rikoruma, ere nigo akogukura neriogi ri’obonene, gose tari gotanga okomesa ekero eriogi riaye ri’okogukura riaigurwe.
Nyasae nigo akogukura neriogi riaye ase enchera y’ogokumia mono, nigo agokora amang’ana amanene, ayio totanyare komanya.
Ere nigo agotebia amagena ’embura: Kagwe igoro ase ense; na otoma omonyirira na embura enene ere ne chinguru.
Nyasae nigo agotanga emeremo y’amaboko a kera omonto, erinde abanto bonsi banyare komanya emeremo yaye.
Erio ching’iti chi’orosana chiagenda kwebisa, chiagenderera kobeera ase amakuruma abo.
Ekembugu‐mbugu nigo kegosoka korwa ase chiero chiaye agwo irianyi, na omwaga ore nobokendu orua sugusu oseria amare.
Nyasae nigo akorua omoika bw’obokeng’entu obwatania amache, na amache oyarenta abwatana oma pa.
Nigo agoichoria amare amarito namache, amare nigo agosiarera chinkoba chiaye.
Amare nigo agoetanana gochia aaria na aaria, akoraawga nere, goikerania aya onsi ere achikire akore ase ense.
Nyasae nigo agokora ayio aba bo, ase okorua ebisusuro bi’okorongeyia, gose ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye.
Aye Ayubu, igwa aya; karategerera, orengererie igoro y’emeremo y’ogokumia ya Nyasae.
Inee! Nomanyete buna Nyasae agokora ochika ayio, naende buna agokora okomesa kwamoreka goetera ase amare,
Inee! Nomanyete buna areng’anetie amare, eyio ere emeremo y’ogokumia y’oria ore nobong’aini oboikeranu?
Inee! Nomanyete egekogera chianga chiao chigosamba ne riberera, ekero ense egotoererigwa nomwaga okogusa korwa irianyi?
Inee! Nonyare korambora igoro buna ere ayeramborete, igoro eria ere enkong’u buna ekerore gi’ekioma?
Tworokererie aya togochia gokwana asare; titokonyara konyora amang’ana togochia gokwana, ekiagera tore ase omosunte.
Inee! Nyasae nigo agochia gotebigwa ng’a inche ninganetie gokwana? Onde nare oganetie ere amosirie?
“Abanto tibakonyara korigereria amasase ’erioba, kabarire igoro ekero amare abusirwe nomwaga.
Oborabu bokomeka‐meka nigo bokorwa sugusu; ee, Nyasae nigo eboetie nobonene bw’ogosikwa gw’okoondokia.
Oyio Omonguru, intwe titokonyara komorora buna are; nigo abwate okobua okonene, naende nigo are omonyene ekeene, ere nigo are omonyene oboronge mono, takorega onde.
Ase ayio mwanyabanto nigo bamoirogete; ere tari gosika oyokwerengereria ng’a nomong’aini are.”
Omonene akairaneria Ayubu korwa ase ekembugu‐mbugu ime, akamotebia:
“Aye naye ng’o okorenta omosunte ase ogosemia ase ogokwana amang’ana atari ay’obong’aini?
Tenena okong’e buna omosacha, inche ninkoborie, naye ong’iranerie.
Ng’ai kwarenge ekero nabegete oboroso bw’ense? Ntebie onye aye kore omong’aini.
Ning’o obegete ebirengo biaye? Ntebie onye komanyete. Gose ning’o oramborete engori y’okoyerenga?
Ng’ai amaroso aye aterekereretwe? Gose ning’o obegete rigena riaye ri’ekoona,
ekero ching’enang’eni chia mambia chiaterete amo, na abana bonsi ba Nyasae baagete eriogi ri’omogoko?
“Ning’o osiegete ebisieri bi’enyancha, ekero yarindoretie buna ndiria yarenge ime ase enda y’ense?
Ekero keria naroisetie amare abe chianga chiaye, na nkayeboyia omosunte ekerima,
naende nkabekera enyancha chimbebe chiaye, boigo nkayebekera emekorogoto na ebisieri,
ngateba: Aa nao oraikere, korende togoetania, naiga nao emerindo yao eimokererete igoro eratangerwe.
Inee! Ase obogima bwao bwonsi kwana gochika emambia ebeo? Kwana kworokia amasase a mambia aase akomoreka,
erinde ense yonsi ekiamoke, ebwatwe ase chinsinyo chiaye, na abakori amabe banyegerigwe barueo?
Ense nigo ekoonchorwa yarorekana buna amaroba abeire inse y’ebonyi ere nekemanyererio, na ebinto bionsi nigo bikororekana buna chianga chire nebieni ao ao.
Oborabu nigo bogotangwa korwa ase abakori amabe, ne chinguru chiabo chi’okweenenia nigo chikobunwa chiasirigwa.
“Inee! Kwana gosoa ime ase chinsoko chi’enyancha, gose kwana gotaara ase enkoro ye chindiba?
Kwana kworokigwa ebiita bi’amakweri, gose korora ebisieri bi’ekiriri ki’amakweri?
Kwana korengereria igoro y’obogare bw’ense? Onye komanyete ayio onsi, yararie!
“Enchera ekogenda ase oborabu bore, ng’ai ere? Nomanyete ase omosunte omenyete,
erinde ogende oyoire ase ribebe riaye? Naende nomanyete ebinchera bigochia ase enyomba yaye?
Ee, aye nomanyete, ekiagera nigo kwaiboretwe kare, na emiaka yao nemenge.
“Inee! Kwana gosoa ime ase ebigachero bi’obokeng’entu, gose ebigachero bi’amagena ’embura?
Amagena ayio ngachete goika ase engaki y’emechando, amatuko aria arabe ay’esegi na okorwana konde.
Inchera ki ekogenda aase oborabu bokoruerwa, gose ekogenda aase omwaga okorwa moocha bwesiarera ense yonsi?
“Ning’o oremete omotaro ase chiooro chi’embura chigoeta, gose enchera ase chinkoba chikogukura goeta,
echio chikogera embura yatwa aase monto atamenyeti, ase erooro monto ataiyo?
Embura eyio nigo ekoigotia ense ere bosa etamenyiri, yagera yamera obonyansi.
Inee! Embura nebwate ise? Gose ning’o okoibora amatoima e riime?
Nkorwa ase enda ya ng’o obokeng’entu bokorwa? Ning’o okoibora obokendu bokorwa igoro?
Amache nigo akobwatana oma pa buna rigena, ne chinyancha chioma pa chiaba buna egetare.
“Inee! Nonyare gosiberania egetuse gie ching’enang’eni gekorokwa Abaiseke batano na babere bamwabo? Gose bwororobie egetuse keria gekorokwa Orioni?
Nonyare koraa ching’enang’eni chioroke ase chingaki chiabo? Gose nonyare koraa egetuse gie ching’enang’eni gekorokwa Edubu ne chimanwa chiaye?
Nomanyete emeroberio ya igoro echikire? Nonyare koroberia okogamba kwabo igoro ase ense?
“Nonyare goaka eriogi riao riike ase amare ogere embura enyinge egotwere?
Nonyare gotoma chinkoba chigende aase gete, erio chigotebie: Ee, nao tore aa?
Ning’o okobeka obong’aini ase enkoro ime, gose okomanya ase omoyo ime?
Ning’o oranyare koba nobong’aini abare amare? Gose ning’o oranyare koberereka chinyongo chi’amache chia igoro,
ekero riroba riabwatanire riomire pa, na amagakara abwatanire amo.
“Inee! Nonyare gotwarera endo ebi ekoria, gose koigotia chindo chinsae chiganetie endagera,
ekero chire ase amakuruma abo chieringanetie ase okoboera, gose gochiramaime agwo ase chiebisete?
Ning’o okoa ekegonkoru endagera yaye, ekero amage aye akorera ase Nyasae na goetanana onsi korigia endagera?”
“Inee! Nomanyete chingaki ekero chimbori chi’orosana chikobiara? Gose ekero chinsune chikobiara?
Nonyare komanya omobaro bw’emetienyi chigokoora, naende nomanyete chingaki chikobiara?
Nigo chigwekumba chiabiara chimanwa chiabo, na ekero chiabiarire, obororo bw’okobina bwasira.
Chimanwa chiabo nigo chikoba ne chinguru chiakinera ase orosana. Nigo chikogenda kegima, tichiri koirana.
“Ning’o otigire etigere y’orosana esiboire? Gose ning’o bwororobirie ebisibo bi’etigere ere enyango?
Inche nayeeire ekerubo ekiomo kebe enka yaye, na ense ere nomonyo, emenyeo.
Ero nigo egochaya eriogi rire ase omochie, teri koigwa okwoga kw’omotemi onde bwensi.
Nigo ekona‐kogenda aaria na aaria ase ebitunwa ekorisia, yaba ekorigia kera ekemeri ekebese.
“Inee! Eng’era nayanche egokorere emeremo? Nenyare korara ase obweri bwao botuko?
Inee! Nonyare koyesiba ne chingori eete ase emeng’ororia ye chintinde? Gose ebutorane chintinde ase rikura riao?
Inee! Noyesemerie ekiagera ere ne chinguru chinyinge? Nonyare gotiga emeremo yao, ng’a ero ekoyekorere?
Inee! Nigo oyiegenete ng’a neirane na ekorentere endagera ase ekeooreri kiao?
“Esagero nigo egosamunsa chimbaba chiaye chioga; korende, Inee, chimbaba echio nchibwate obwanchani?
Esagero eaberi nigo egotiga amagena aye ase amaroba ime anyora riberera korwao.
Ero nigo ekoyeba, tekomanya ng’a naatwe namagoro, naende ng’a gose eng’iti y’orosana neyatache.
Nigo ere entindi mono ase ebichuchu biaye, yabikorera biaba buna mbitari ebiaye; teri gwechandera oroiboro rwaye,
ekiagera Nyasae nigo ayerinete obong’aini, gose tayeete okomanya.
Ekero ekoimokerera igoro, egwesamunsa eminyoke, nigo egosekerera ebarasi na oyo oyeriinete.
“Inee! Naye okoa ebarasi chinguru? Naye oboetie ebigoti biaye namanya?
Naye oyeete chinguru egocharokera buna engige? Eriogi egochuria nigo rire ri’okoirokia.
Nigo egokura‐kura riroba ase ense omweya, yagokera chinguru chiaye. Erio yaminyoka koumerana nabare nebirwanero bi’esegi.
Ero nigo egosekerera obwoba, teri koondokigwa na kende; gose teri koonchoka etame korwa ase emioro.
Chinsara nigo chikorutwa chiaba chikwoga goeta igoro yaye, na amatimo akomesa, ne chisimisi boigo.
Nigo egotitiria riroba ere nobotindi na ekeririanda, gose teri gotegerera ekire, ekero egetureri gekobugigwa.
Ekero egetureri gekobugigwa, nigo ekwana eriogi riaye ri’okoega‐ega. Nigo ekoigwa omonyonko bw’esegi korwa aare, na buna abachiki b’esegi bagochika, na okwoga gw’esegi.
“Inee! Nobong’aini bwao bokogera ekebaki kiairuruka igoro, naende kiarambora chimbaba chiaye koiruruka gochia irianyi?
Inee! Naye ogochika ekeongo kiairuruka gochia igoro, kiaagacha egeswa kiaye aase a igoro mono?
Ekeongo nigo gekomenya ase egetare; ase omwenya bw’egetare, aase gekonyora oborendi obuya.
Korwa aaria igoro nigo kegotengera ebi kegotwara, amaiso aye nigo akobirora korwa aare.
Amage aye nigo akonywa amanyinga, na aase emebere ekwete ere, nao ekeongo kere.”
Naende Omonene akagenderera gokwana, agatebia Ayubu,
“Inee! Omonto okona‐korigia amamocho naamereranie n’Omonguru? Aye okona‐koamererania na Nyasae, iraneria rende!”
Erio Ayubu akairaneria Omonene, agateba:
“Naama! Inche ting’isaini kende, ngento ki ndanyare gokoiraneria? Natubire omonwa one nokoboko kwane.
Inche nakwanire rimo, tinkomenta gento; ee, nakwanire kabere, korende tinkogenderera goetania ayio.”
Erio korwa ase ekembugu‐mbugu ime Omonene akairaneria Ayubu, akamotebia:
“Tenena okong’e buna omosacha, inche ngokoboria nde, naye ong’iranerie.
Inee! Nonyare kombara ng’a nomomochi inde? Norigetie kongambia inche, erinde obarerwe oboronge?
Aye nobwate okoboko buna okwane inche Nyasae? Nonyare kogukura neriogi riao buna inche nkogukura?
Aye echabere nobonene na obwari, eboyie ogosikwa na okobua.
Siara ekeririanda gi’okogechigwa kwao, erio origererie kera omonto ore omoenenu, omokeyie.
Ee, rigereria oyio ore omoenenu, omokeyie, na abakori amabe obatindachere inse agwo ase bateneine.
Abwo bonsi babise ime ase amaroba; obwateranie bokong’u amasio abo ime y’ense inse.
Igo inche ninyancherane naye, ng’a okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngokoe okobua.
“Rigereria engubo! Eyio natongete buna nagotongete aye. Nigo ekorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe.
Rora, chinguru chiaye nigo chire ase ekenema kiaye, na okobua kwaye nigo kore ase chinyama chi’enda yaye.
Ekemincha kiaye nigo kere egekong’u pa buna omocharake, na emeki y’amariagati aye nigo esisekaine amo.
Amauga aye nigo are amakong’u buna emebirangwa eroisirie korwa ase etaai; ee, amauga ’omobere oye nigo anga buna emeriibo y’ebioma.
“Ero negetongwa ki’ogokumia inche Nyasae natongete; inche nayetongete, nayeete amaino anga buna emioro.
Endagera ekoria nigo ekwama ase ebitunwa igoro, agwo ase ching’iti chi’orosana chikogosoreria.
Nigo ekorara ase ekiriri ki’omote okorokwa lotusi, yebisa na gokenderera ime ase ebitonto bire ase etente.
Omote oyio noro ore ekiriri kiaye; ee, emete enga buna emesobeti nigo eyeetanaine.
Rora, nonya orooche rore nemerindo, ero teri kwoboa; nonya orooche rwa Yorodan rokominyoka gocha ase omonwa oye, nigo ere noboremu.
Inee! Omonto nanyare koyebwata ekero ere ase riraro riaye? Gose nabochore chimioro chiaye ayesibe nengori?”
“Inee! Aye nonyare kong’usa Leviatani, eng’iti enene y’okwoboyia, korwa rooche nendobio. Gose nonyare gosiba oromeme rwaye nengori?
Nonyare gosoyia engori ime ase chimioro chiaye, gose kobochora orosea rwaye nendobio?
Inee! Nenyare gokoboria amang’ana amange ase oboitongo? Gose nenyare gokwana naye amang’ana amororo?
Ero nekore okobwatana amo naye, ng’a ebe omosomba oo kogendera botambe?
Inee! Nokore egosori nero buna orakore nenyoni? Gose oyebeke ekorere abasomba bao abaiseke egosori?
Inee! Abaoonia mbakorerane rigori igoro yaye, gose bayebutorane ase okoyeoonerania?
Nonyare kobochora riiyo riaye ne ritimo rikobeta chinswe? Gose ritimo erio ndibete omotwe oye riyobochore?
Rambora okoboko kwao oyebwate, erio oteeme gokora esegi nero. Tokoiranera eria kabere.”
“Ekero omonto agoteema igo, nigo ogosemeria kwaye kogosira kegima; nonya nase okoyerora rioka, omonto nigo akwerusia moyo.
Onde tari ore omotindi oraremererie ayechegie. Ning’o rende oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwane?
Ning’o ong’eire egento ritang’ani ng’a nainche imogeakane? Gento kende gionsi kere inse y’erioba nekiane.”
“Inche tingotiga ting’orokia buna ebiimo biaye bire, naende buna okobua ne chinguru chiaye bire, na buna amauga ’omobere oye aagachegete buya.
Ning’o oranyare koyiaboria risankwa riaye? Ning’o oranyare gosoyia okoboko kwaye gati‐gati y’amaino aye?
Ning’o oraasamie omonwa oye? Amaino aye nigo are ay’okwoboyia mono.
Obonene bwaye namagonko aye anga buna chinguba, achokaine chindwaro; nigo abwataine amo amo, buna ayanantirie.
Rigonko erimo nigo risoaine nerinde ang’e kegima, nonya nembeo tekonyara gosoera gati yabo.
Nigo erinde ribwatanirie nerinde; naro nigo asoaine, takonyara gwatananwa.
Ekero egwasimora, chinsase nigo chigosoka chiamoreka, amaiso aye nigo anga buna amasase agosakia mambia.
Chinsase chi’omorero nigo chikorwa ase omonwa oye; ee, chinsase nigo chigotaroka korwa asere.
Erioki nigo rigosoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, buna enyongo ekobera egosokia omooki bw’amache.
Omoika bw’omonwa oye nigo ogosoka buna ekebemberi ki’omorero, na omorero nigo ogosoka korwa ase omonwa oye,
Rigoti riaye nigo ribwate chinguru, na okoondokia nigo kore bosio bwaye.
Emenia y’omobere oye nigo ekinyaine amo; nigo yesibete bokong’u ase omobere oye, tekonyarwa kobwatokanigwa.
Enkoro yaye nenkong’u buna rigena, ee, nenkong’u buna orogena rogosia.
Ekero ekoimoka gotenena, abanto chituoni nigo bakwoboa mono; ekero ekorindoka gocha nigo bagotang’ang’a.
Nerutwa omoro oyegwere, tori koyekorera kende, nonya ne ritimo, gose ensara, gose esimisi.
Ekioma nigo kenga risakwe asere, na etaai nigo enga omote ogundire.
Ensara tekoyioboyia etame; amagena ’enduruche akorutwa nigo anga buna amasakwe.
Chinungu nigo chinga buna amasakwe asere; ekero amatimo akwoga gocha nigo egoseka.
Ase enda yaye nigo ebwate ebigionkorio ebioge; nigo egotiga ebimanyerererio buna ebi’egari y’okoorera egokurura ase etintira.
Nigo egoserokia amache korwa ase chindiba inse, nigo egokora amache ’enyancha aba buna amaguta aburukanirie.
Enchera yaeteire nigo ekogenderera komesa, enyancha inse nigo egokagwa ng’a nechimbuche.
Getongwa kende tikeri igoro ase ense kenga ero, ekio giatongetwe getari kwoboa.
Nigo ekorigereria kera egento kere igoro mono etari gokioboa, nigo ere omoruoti bw’ebitongwa bionsi bire noboenenu.”
Erio Ayubu akairaneria Omonene, akabora:
“Nimanyete ng’a aye nonyare gokora ebinto bionsi, naende ng’a aya kwaganirie gokora takonyara gotangwa taba.
Ninche ng’o mbwate ogosemia gotari nobong’aini? Ase ayio nakwanire aya ntamanyeti, amang’ana ’ogokumia ansinyire komanya.
Koranche, ontegerere nkwane, nkoborie, naye ontebie buna are.
Nabeire nkoigwa igoro yao ase okoigwa namato rioka, korende bono amaiso aane akororire.
Ase ayio nechayire inche omonyene, naende neakire orotu ne ribu ase ogweitia na koonchoka.”

Omonene gakwanire amang’ana ayio n’Ayubu, agakwana n’Elifasi Omotemani, akamotebia, “Nabeire nendamwamu asore na ase abasani bao baria babere, ekiagera inwe timokwaneti ayare ay’oboronge igoro yane buna Ayubu, omosomba one, akwanete.

Ase igo bono ira ase Ayubu, omosomba one, chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi isano na ibere; mochirue chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase engencho yaino inwe abanyene. Ayubu, omosomba one, nabasabere, ekiagera inche nigo ndanchere ogosaba kwaye ase engencho yaino, timbaisa kobakorera buna oboriri bwaino bore. Inwe timokwaneti igoro yane amang’ana are ay’oboronge buna Ayubu, omosomba one, akwanete.”
Ase igo Elifasi Omotemani, na Bilidadi Omosua, na Sofari Omonama, bakagenda bagakora buna Omonene abachigete, na Omonene aganchera ogosaba kw’Ayubu.
Erio nyuma Ayubu gasabeire abasani baria baye, Omonene akairaneria Ayubu amaya aye, akamoa ebinto ara kabere kobua ebi abwate ritang’ani.

Erio abamura bamwabo Ayubu, na abasubati bamwabo, na abasani baye bonsi abamomanyete agwo ritang’ani, bagacha asare, bakaragera amo nere nyomba mwaye. Bakamororera amabeebe na komoremia ase engencho y’amabe aria onsi Omonene amorerenterete, na kera oyomo akamoa chibesa na ebonyi eroisirie korwa ase etahabu.

Omonene agasesenia amatuko a nyuma ay’Ayubu kobua aye ritang’ani. Boigo Ayubu akanyora ching’ondi chilifu ikomi na inye, ne chingamia chilifu isano nemo, ne chiombe chilifu ibere, ne chitigere chiaberi elifu eyemo.
Boigo akaegwa abamura batano na babere, na abaiseke batato.
Akaroka omoiseke omotang’ani Yemima, na oyo o kabere Kesia, na oyo o gatato Kereni‐Hapuki.
Ase ense eyio yonsi bakungu bande tibarengeo baare abanyabieni buna abaiseke b’Ayubu, na ise akabaa omwando amo nabamura bamwabo.
Na nyuma y’ayio Ayubu akagenderera koba moyo ase engaki y’emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, akarora abana baye, na abachokoro, na abachokororia, goika ekiaare gia kane.
Na Ayubu agakwa kabeire omogotu mono.
Nasesenirie omonto oria otari gotunyana chingencho chi’abakori amabe, gose tari kobwatia chinchera chi’abanyabibe, gose tari gosanga amo nabagochecheria Nyasae,
korende amachiko ’Omonene naro akomogokia mono, na amachiko ayio nigo akoyairanerera omobaso na obotuko.
Ere nigo anga buna omote osimekire rooche mbarabare, oyokwama okwama kwaye ekero engaki yaye egoika, na amato aye tari kwoma, na rinde rionsi agokora nigo agosesenigwa.
Abakori amabe tibari bo, korende nigo banga buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga.
Ase ayio, abakori amabe tibagocha gwekengera ase rituko ri’ekina, gose abanyabibe ase omosangererekano bw’abanyene oboronge.
Omonene namanyete enchera y’abanyene oboronge, korende enchera y’abakori amabe nesire.
Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku bagokora riroroche? Nase ki abanto bagokora emeroberio ere bosa?
Abaruoti b’ense bebekire ang’e, na abagambi nigo bakogamba amo ase okwanga Omonene na Omoakwa Amaguta oye.
Nigo bagotebania, “Tobutore ebisibo biabo, totugute chingori chiabo batosiberete!”
Omonene oria oikaransete aaria igoro, nigo agoseka na kobakorera echeche.
Erio nakwane nabarabwo ase endamwamu yaye, abagose ase ekeririanda kiaye, ogoteba,
“Nabekire omoruoti one ase Sayoni, egetunwa kiane egechenu.”
Omoruoti otebire, “Nindarie amang’ana Omonene aroberetie. Ere agantebia: Aye naye Omwana one, rero nakoiboire.
Omborie, na inche ninkoe ebisaku bionsi bibe omwando oo, ne chinsemo chionsi chi’ense nchibe echiao.
Aye nobabutore nenyimbo y’ekioma, obasegenyie babe buna enyongo yaatirwe.”
Ase ayio, inwe abaruoti, mobe abang’aini, inwe abagambi b’ense, igwera ogokurerwa oko:
Mokorere Omonene more nobwoba na okoiguswa.

Tung’ama inse na koorokia amasikani ase Omwana oye. Motakoreti bo, nigo arabe nendamwamu, abasirie ase chinchera chiaino, ekiagera endamwamu yaye nigo egwoka bwango. Mbasesenirie abanto bonsi bakomotamera.
Aye Omonene, ababisa baane nigo bare abange; abange mono banyimokeire gonkora bobe.
Abange nigo bagokwana igoro yane, bateba: Nyasae tancheti komotooria.
Korende aye Omonene, naye enguba yane, naye obonene bwane, nigo okong’iraneria oboremu.
Nigo nkorera ase Omonene ng’a ankonye, nere nigo akong’iraneria korwa ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu.
Nigo ngwetoora na korara chitoro, erio naboka naende, ekiagera Omonene nigo agendererete kondenda.
Tindi koiroka ababisa chilifu chinyinge, abwo bakonyimokera ase chinsemo chiane chionsi.
Aye Omonene, inchuo! Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie! Aye gwaakire ababisa baane bonsi ase chinsea, kwabunire amaino ’abakori amabe.
Ogotooreka nigo gokorwa asore aye Omonene; ase ayio, sesenia abanto bao.
Aye Nyasae, aye okong’a oboronge, ong’iranerie ekero ngokorangeria! Ekero narenge nkomiga‐migwa nobokong’u nigo kwang’ete ribaga rigare. Indorera amabera, na oigwe ogosaba kwane!
Inwe mwanyabanto, ngoika ririri moragenderere korentera obonene bwane echayo? Ngoika ririri moragenderere gwancha amang’ana a bosa na korigia ay’oborimo?
Manya ng’a Omonene bwechoreire omonyene oboronge. Omonene nigo akonyigwa ekero nkomosaba.
Mobee, korende timokora ebibe; morengereria mono amang’ana ayio ekero mokorara ase amarere aino, na mobe abatoereru.
Karue ebing’wanso bi’oboronge, na mosemerie Omonene.
Mbare abanto abange bagokwana: “Naki yare koba buya onye ntwanyora ayare amaya.” Aye Omonene, tiga omobaso bw’obosio bwao otomorekere.
Omosasoko oyo kwang’eire ase enkoro yane ime nigo are omuya kobua oyo abanto bande bakonyora, abwo bare nobonge bw’endagera na edivai.
Ekero ngochia gwetoora, nigo nkorara chitoro inde nomorembe, ekiagera aye Omonene, naye okogera imenye ase okorendwa okuya.
Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane; orengererie mono amang’ana ayio ankong’erete.
Aye omoruoti one, Nyasae one, tegerera oigwe amang’ana ’okorera kwane, ekiagera naye ngosaba.
Omonene, aye nigo okoigwa ogosaba kwane ase engaki ya mambia; kobogokiamoka nigo nkobeka okogania kwane ase obosio bwao, erio naganya ndendete.
Aye tori Nyasae bwanchete ogokora okobe. Oyogokora ebibe takonyara komenya amo naye.
Abanto abaenenu tibakonyara gotenena ase obosio bwao, nigo ogechete abakori amabe bonsi.
Aye nigo orasirie abanyaborimo bonsi; aye Omonene nigo ogechete abaiteri amanyinga na abang’ainereria.
Korende ase engencho y’obonge bw’obwanchani bwao botari koera ninsoe ase enyomba yao; nigo ndasasime ndigereretie Hekalu yao Enchenu imbe ngokoiroka.
Aye Omonene, nigo mbwate ababisa abange, ase ayio, ondaae ase oboronge bwao; roisia enchera yao ase ngoetera ebe endonge.
Amang’ana ababisa baane bagokwana nay’oborimo, chinkoro chiabo nigo chire nemeroberio y’ogosiria kegima; emioyo yabo noboina bwasie, chimeme chiabo nigo chigokwana amang’ana amansu ay’ogosiria.
Aye Nyasae, obae egesusuro ase ebibe biabo: emeroberio eyio bakorire tiga egere bagwe. Obaserie, ekiagera basaririe asore, na ekiagera bangire gokoigwera.
Abanto bonsi abakogotamera mbabe nomogoko, barabwo mbatere kogenderera botambe na gochenga. Aye igo orakengere abwo banchete erieta riao, erio banyare koba nomogoko omonene ase engencho yao.
Aye Omonene nigo ogosesenia omonyene oboronge na komotuba nobuya bwao bw’amabera bonga buna enguba.
Omonene, tontogonyera ekero ore nendamwamu; tong’a egesusuro gi’okondongeyia ekero ore nekeririanda.
Omonene, ndorera amabera, ekiagera inde omonyanyuru. Aye Omonene, ingwenie, ekiagera amauga aane nigo akonyegerigwa.
Omoyo one ochandekire nomoondoko. Omonene, ngoika ririri oraganye otarankonya?
Aye Omonene, ing’iranere omboorie! Ontoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera.
Ase abwo bakure onde tari oranyare gokoinyora. Inee! Ning’o oranyare kogotogia korwa aase abakure?
Nanyarekire ase okwerera kwane kw’obororo, kera obotuko nigo ngoteremia oborere bwane namariga, ebirarero biane biaichoirwe namariga.
Obosio bwane bwomire pa ase engencho y’emechando, bwareeire ase engencho y’ababisa baane bonsi.
Inwe mwensi abakori amabe, karue asende, ekiagera Omonene oigure okorera kwane.
Omonene oigure okoboria kwane gw’okonyora amabera, ere bwancheire ogosaba kwane.
Ababisa baane bonsi mbarore obosooku, bagoswe na koondokigwa mono, mbairane gochia nyuma bwango bare nobosooku.
Omonene, Nyasae one, naye ngotamera, intoorie korwa ase abachandi baane, nkonye!
Onye taibo, nigo barantaborane bare buna chindo, bankurure gochia aase omonto onde atache gontooria.
Omonene, Nyasae one, onye nakorire amang’ana aya, onye nakorire amabe namaboko aane,
onye naakanire omosani one amabe, gose nasakoire ebinto bi’omobisa one engencho ende etaiyo,
rirorio tiga omobisa one ambwatie na kombwata, erio antiringere inse asirie obogima bwane, ansarerie amasikani.
Aye Omonene, imoka kore nendamwamu yao, imokerera igoro orwanie ekeririanda ki’ababisa baane! Inchuo onkonye! Aye gwachikire ekina.
Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi tiga basangererekane bagoetanane, obagambere korwa ase ekerogo kiao ki’obonene aaria igoro.
Omonene, naye okonachera abanto bonsi ekina. Aye Omonene, onachere inche ekina koreng’ana noboronge bwane, na buna ntari na komocha.
Tiga ebibe bi’abakori amabe biere, korende omonto omoronge omotenenie bokong’u. Aye Nyasae omonyene oboronge nigo okorenga chinkoro na emioyo.
Nyasae nere enguba yane, ere nigo agotooria abare ne chinkoro chindonge.
Nyasae nigo are omogambi omoronge, na kera rituko nigo akoba nekeririanda ase abakori amabe.
Omonto karaange gweitia, Nyasae natierie omoro oye, natinge obota bwaye na abobeke ang’e.
Oroisirie ebirwanero biaye ase ogoita omonto oyio, akore emegwe yaye esambe buna omorero.
Omonyabibe nigo aichire nobobe, nigo are inda nogosaria na koibora oborimo.
Omonto oyio nigo agokunya eirima entambe, erio ogwa ere omonyene ase eirima eyio.
Emechando yaye nigo ekomoiranera; na ogokora kwaye okobe nigo gokomogwera omonyene.
Ning’akere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’oboronge bwaye; nintere ogotera kw’ogotogia erieta ri’Omonene, oyore Igoro Mono.
Aye Omonene, aye Omonene oito, erieta riao naki rire nobonene obonge ase ense yonsi! Obonene bwao nigo bogotogigwa nonya ngoika igoro.
Ase emenwa y’abana na ey’abakogonka nigo kweagacheire eburi bosio bw’ababisa bao, erinde okoiyeria inse ababisa bao na abakorusia egesiomba.
Ekero nkorigereria gochia igoro, na korora emeremo gwakorete namaboko ao, omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni, ebi kwabegete aase abo;
omonto inki aisaine aye ogendererete komorengereria? Mwanyabanto ninki aisaine aye okomorenda?
Kwamokorire koba inse ake asore aye omonyene, Nyasae; kwamoboirie obonene na amasikani.
Kwamobekire kogambera ebinto bionsi gwatongete; kwabekire ebitongwa bionsi inse y’amagoro aye:
ching’ondi chionsi ne chiombe, amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana,
ne chinyoni chikoiruruka amo ne chinswe chi’enyancha, na kende gionsi kegoetanana ase chindiba chie chinyancha.
Aye Omonene, aye Omonene oito, erieta riao naki rire nobonene ase ense yonsi!
Aye Omonene, ningoakere ng’a mbuya mono nenkoro yane yonsi. Nindarie emeremo yao yonsi y’ogokumia.
Ningoke na gochenga mono ase engencho yao, nintere na gotogia erieta riao, aye Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.
Ababisa baane nigo bakoirana nyuma, bagwe inse na gosirigwa ase obosio bwao.
Aye kwanachire ekina kiane ase oboronge; noikaransete ase ekerogo kiao ki’obonene kore omonachi ebina omoronge.
Aye gwatogonyeire abanto b’ebisaku na gosiria abakori amabe, gwasiririe amarieta abo, tibakoinyorwa kare na kare.
Ababisa baerire, basirigwe kegima, gwatagoire emechie yabo, barabwo bebirwe, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake.
Korende Omonene nigo are omoruoti o kare na kare, obekire ang’e ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, erinde anache ekina.
Nigo aragambie ense ase oboronge na konachera abanto ekina gi’ekeene atari gwanchereria.
Omonene nigo are obotamero ase abwo bagokorerwa bobe, nere obotamero ase chingaki chi’emechando.
Abwo bonsi bamanyete erieta riao, nigo bagosemeretie, ekiagera aye Omonene togotiga abwo bagokorigia.
Tera amatera ase ogotogia Omonene oyomenyete Sayoni! Tebia ebisaku bionsi ogokora kwaye okonene!
Ere oyo okorusia egesiomba ase okomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga na koinyora abaichanete, tari kweba ekerero ki’abwo bagokorerwa bobe.
Aye Omonene ndorere amabera! Rigereria orore emechando eye abanto bangechete bakondetera. Aye kwandusirie korwa ase ebiita bi’amakweri,
erinde intenene ase abanto ba Sayoni, mbatebie ase ebiita biabo amang’ana onsi agerire nkogotogia; ningokere ogotooreka kwao.
Abanto b’ebisaku bagure ase eirima bakunyete, na ase oboreba babisete babwatirwe abanyene.
Omonene bwemanyekanirie ase okonacha ebina bia boronge; abakori amabe babwatirwe ase ogokora kwabo abanyene.
Abakori amabe nigo bakogenda gochia aase abakure, naboigo nabanto bonsi b’ebisaku abwo bebire Nyasae.
Abanto abaremerwa tibakwebwa kogenderera botambe, na ogosemeria kw’abagokorerwa bobe tikogosira nonya ng’ake.
Omonene, inchuo! Totiga abanto babue, tiga abanto b’Ebisaku banacherwe ekina ase obosio bwao.
Omonene, obaondokie! Tiga bamanye ng’a barabwo mwanyabanto bare rioka.
Omonene, naki gwateneneire aare iga? Naki okwebisa, otari kororekana ase chingaki chi’emechando?
Abakori amabe baenenire na gokorera abaremerwa bobe. Tiga babwatwe abanyene ase emeroberio yabo y’obobe.
Omonto omokori ebibe nigo agwetogeria okogania okobe gw’enkoro yaye; na omonto ore ne ribero nigo akoragereria Omonene na komochaya.
Omokori amabe ase oboenenu bwaye nigo agoteba ng’a Nyasae takomoa egesusuro. Nigo akorengereria ng’a Nyasae tari.
Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera gokina ase chinchera chiaye. Ebina biao okonacha nigo bire igoro mono, takobimanya; nigo agochaya ababisa baye bonsi.
Nigo akorengereria ase enkoro yaye ime: “Tinkwoboa gento kende, tinkonyorwa na bobe bonde nonya ng’ake.”
Aya agokwana nigo aichire okoragereria, na obong’ainereria, na ogokorera abande bobe; oromeme rwaye nigo robwate amang’ana ’obobe na ogosaria.
Nigo akwebisa ase emechie oboera abanto, oganya agwo ase ogoita abanto batari na komocha. Nigo agotengera konyora abatari na gokonywa konde,
nigo akwebisa aase are bobisi, buna endo ere ase egetutu eboete, oganya ase okobwata abaremerwa; nigo akobabwata ekero akobakurura ase omoeto oye.
Nigo akoramama buna endo kobaboera, erio obwata namaboko aye omonto otari na gokonywa konde.
Igo akorengereria ase enkoro yaye ime, “Nyasae tagwechandera kende, obisire obosio bwaye ng’a tayarora nonya ng’ake.”
Omonene, inchuo! Nyasae rambora okoboko kwao, na tibweba abanto bachandegete!
Aye Nyasae, nase ki omonto omokori amabe akogochaya, na korengereria ng’a aye tokomoa egesusuro.
Aye nigo okorora abachandekire na komanya okwerera kwabo, amang’ana ayio nigo oyabegete ase amaboko ao. Omonto otari na gokonywa konde nigo akwerua asore, ekiagera naye botambe ogokonya chintakana.
Saria chinguru chi’abanto abakori amabe na abanyabibe, obae egesusuro ase amabe onsi bagokora goika toyarora naende.
Omonene nigo are omoruoti o kare na kare; abanto b’Ebisaku batamomanyeti basirigwe ase ense yaye.
Aye Omonene, nigo ogotegerera abanto abaitongo abagokogania; nigo okobaigwa na kobeka chinkoro chiabo chinguru.
Igo okoa chintakana na abachandegete oboronge bwabo, erinde monto onde bw’ense tagenderera korenta okogosa naende.
Omonene nere obotamero bwane. Nase ki rende mogontebia: “Iruruka buna enyoni gochia ase ebitunwa?
Rigereria abakori amabe buna bagotinga amata abo, babeka chinsara chiabo ang’e ase chingori chi’amata, erinde barase abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge.
Onye amaroso atagoirwe, ngento ki omonto omoronge aranyare gokora?”
Omonene nigo are ase Hekalu yaye enchenu, ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene naaria igoro kere. Amaiso aye nigo amongerete, nigo arigereretie ase okorenga mwanyabanto.
Omonene nigo akorenga abare abaronge na abakori amabe, korende omoyo oye nogechete abakori amabe na abagokorera abande obotindi.
Natwerie abakori amabe omorero bw’amakara, amagena agosamba na omwaga ore ne riberera ritindi, nigo birabe egesusuro kiabo.
Omonene nomonyene oboronge, nigo anchete ogokora kw’oboronge; abanto abare ne chinkoro chindonge mbarore obosio bwaye.
Omonene, totoorie! Abakoirogete aye Nyasae baerire, abegenwa tibari konyorekana ase mwanyabanto.
Abanto bonsi nigo bagotebania amang’ana ’oborimo; nigo bare okong’o nyamenwa ebere na gokwana amang’ana ay’okweansia.
Omonene okirie emenwa y’abwo bagokwana amang’ana ’okweansia, ne chimeme chi’abwo bagwetogia ase amang’ana ’oboenenu.
Barabwo nigo bagoteba, “Ase amang’ana ’emenwa yaito ntore ne chinguru, aya togokwana nigo agotokonya. Ning’o ore omonene gotobua?”
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Bono ninchiche, ekiagera abataka baregirwe na abaremerwa nkorera bare. Ning’ee oborendi obuya ase abwo basemeretie kobonyora.”
Amang’ana ’Omonene nigo are ay’obwegenwa na amachenu, nigo agwekaine efeta yasambirwe ase riera ri’omorero na koumorwa inse, yachenirwe ara gatano na kabere.
Aye Omonene, otorende! Otokengere botambe korwa ase obobe bw’ekegori eke.
Abakori amabe nigo bagoetanana chinsemo chionsi, na obonyaka bonde bwonsi bogotogigwa ase egati ya mwanyabanto.
Omonene, ngoika ririri oragenderere konyeba? Ngoika kare na kare? Ngoika ririri orabe kobisete obosio bwao ng’a tondora?
Ngoika ririri ndabe ndemereretie emechando ase omoyo one, imbe nobororo ase enkoro yane rituko ase rituko? Ngoika ririri omobisa one arabe okogokera emechando yane?
Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, ondigererie, ong’iranerie ase ogosaba kwane! Ondamokie amaiso aane, timbaisa korara chitoro chi’amakweri.
Totiga omobisa one atebe ng’a ombuire, na ababisa baane bonsi bachengere okogwa kwane.
Ninsemerie obwanchani bwao botari koera, enkoro yane negokere ogotooreka gokorwa asore.
Ningoterere aye Omonene, ekiagera gwankoreire amaya amange.
Abanto abariri nigo bagoteba ase chinkoro chiabo ime, “Nyasae tari.” Barabwo nabasareku, bagokora amang’ana ay’okogechia; onde tari ogokora ayare amaya, nonya noyomo.
Omonene nigo arigereretie mwanyabanto korwa igoro, arore gose monto onde nareo ore omong’aini, oyokomorigia Nyasae.
Abanto bonsi basirire enchera, bonsi amo bagundire; onde tari ogokora amaya, nonya noyomo.
Inee! Abanto aba bonsi abakori amabe tibari nokomanya? Nigo bakoria abanto baane ase okobaurereria buna bakoria endagera yabo; tibari korangeria Omonene abakonye.
Erio agwo abanto abwo mbasogwe nomoondoko omonene mono, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo nabanto abaronge.
Inwe abakori amabe nigo mogochaya omoroberio bw’omonto otari na nguru, korende Omonene nere obotamero bwaye.
Naki yare koba buya onye ogotooreka ngwachera Abaisraeli korwa Sayoni! Ekero Omonene arairanerie abanto baye amaya abo, abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo mbachenge, ee, Abaisraeli mbabe nomogoko.
Omonene, monto ki oranyare komenya ase obomenyo bwao? Ning’o oranyare komenya ase egetunwa kiao egechenu?
Nomonto oria orogendo rwaye rore oroikeranu, oria ogokora kwaye kore okuya, na amang’ana agokwana korwa ase enkoro yaye nay’ekeene,
naende ere tari omogenki, omonto oyio tari gokorera monto onde bobe, gose tari gokwana onde bobe.
Ere nigo agochaya oyobwangirwe na Nyasae, korende osika abwo bamoirogete Omonene. Karire eira na gotiana tari koonchoka, nonya egochia komorentera obokong’u.

Ekero akorua chibesa chiaye singo tari kogania ebitoki, omonto oyio tari koira riaaki kogera omonto otari nokomocha agambigwe. Omonto ogokora oboronge ase amang’ana ayio onsi namenye ase obotoereru kare na kare.
Aye Nyasae, ondende, ekiagera naye ngotamera.
Nigo ngotebia Omonene, “Aye naye Omonene one, obuya bwonsi inde nabwo nigo bokorwa asore.”
Abanto abachenu bare ase ense nigo bare nobonene obonene; abwo nabwo bangogetie mono.
Abwo bakominyokera chinyasae ching’ao, nigo bakwementera emechando. Tinkoumora okoruegwa kw’amanyinga okwo bakorua, gose tingwatora amarieta abo nebikoba biane.
Omonene nere egetare kiane; nere akong’a onsi aya ngwenerete konyora; ere igo arendete aya antungetie.
Ebintungetie biangwereire agwo aase are aagiya, ee, omwando one nigo ore omuya mono.
Nigo ngotogia Omonene oyo ogonsemia, ase obotuko enkoro yane nigo egontebereria gokora igo.
Botambe nigo ndigereretie Omonene; ere nigo are ensemo yane y’okorio, tinkwoboa.
Ase igo enkoro yane nigo ere nomosasoko amo nomoyo one; nonya nomobere one nigo omenyete ase oborendi obuya.
Aye togontiga agwo aase abakure, gose togotiga omochenu oo arore ogosareka.
Aye nomanyie enchera ekogenda ase obogima; ase obosio bwao noreo omogoko omonge; ase ensemo yao y’okorio mboreo obwansu obuya goika kare na kare.
Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe okogania kwane kw’ogokorerwa oboronge, igwa okorera kwane na ogosaba kwane, omonwa one tori gokwana obong’ainereria.
Aye omonyene onachere ekina gi’okong’a oboronge, amaiso ao nigo akorora ayare ay’ekeene.
Aye kwarengire enkoro yane, nonya nase obotuko nigo ogonteema, kwauna‐unirie na tonyoreti gento, amabe are ase enkoro yane tinkoyakwana.
Ande onsi abanto bagokora, na koreng’ana namang’ana ao natigire kobwatia chinchera chi’abasaria.
Nabeire nkobwatia chinchera chiao botambe; amagoro aane tana‐gotererigwa.
Nyasae, nigo ngokorangeria ng’a onkonye, ekiagera aye nong’itabere; tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane ngokoboria.
Aye Omotooria bw’abagotamera okoboko kwao kwa borio korwa ase ababisa babo, oorokia obwanchani bwao bw’ogokumia.
Indende buna orendete endorero y’eriso riao; intube ase ekiriri gie chimbaba chiao;
mbise korwa ase abakori amabe, abarigetie gonsiria, korwa ase ababisa bang’etanaine bang’ite.
Abanto abwo bare ne chinkoro chitari namabera nigo bagokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu.
Bono bang’etananire ase chinsemo chionsi; banaaririe, erinde bambwate na konyiyeria inse.
Barabwo nigo banga buna endo eganetie orotwari; buna endo ensae eboete ase egesarara.
Omonene, imoka! Orwanie ababisa baane obabue! Ntoorie korwa ase abakori amabe ase okobarwania nomoro oo;

ee, Omonene, ntoorie nokoboko kwao korwa ase abanto abwo. Barabwo nabanto b’ense eye, egetari kiabo neki’obogima obo. Chinda chiabo chiisaneke nebinto ebio kwabagacheire, biisane nase abana babo, naende abachokoro babo batigerwe ebiatigaire.
Korende inche nindore obosio bwao inde noboronge; ekero ndabokigwe ning’isaneke ase ogokorora.
Aye Omonene chinguru chiane, ningwanchete mono!

Omonene nere egetare kiane na eburi yane enkong’u, nere Omotooria one, na Nyasae one, Nyasae one nere egetare kiane ndatamere; nere enguba egonkengera, na Omotooria one bwe chinguru, oyo ogonkengera bokong’u.
Nindangerie Omonene, oyo ogwenerete gotogigwa, nigo arantoorie korwa ase ababisa baane.
Obororo bw’amakweri bokong’etanana, chiooro chi’obobe chikandetera obwoba.
Obobe bw’amakweri nigo bwang’etananete, emeeto y’amakweri egantega na kombwata.
Ase emechando yane nkarangeria Omonene, nkarera ase Nyasae one ng’a ankonye. Korwa ase Hekalu yaye akaigwa eriogi riane, ekerero kiane gekamoikera, ere agakeigwa.
Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, na amaroso ’ebitunwa agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene arenge nendamwamu.
Erioki rigasoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, na omorero ogosamba ogasoka korwa ase omonwa oye; ee, omorero bw’amakara ogasoka korwa asare.
Akang’usa igoro gocha inse aa, agacha; riire rimwamu rikaba inse y’amagoro aye.
Akariina omokerubi, akairuruka, agacha ng’ora igoro ye chimbaba chi’embeo.
Agetuba ere omonyenye nomosunte, na amare amarito aichire amache.
Korwa ase obomeka‐meku obwo bwarenge bosio bwaye amagena ’embura na omorero bw’amakara bigasoka goetera ase amare aye.
Omonene agaaka enkoba korwa igoro; na eriogi ri’Oyore Igoro Mono rikaigugwa; amagena ’embura na omorero bw’amakara bigacha.
Akaruta emegwe yaye, agaserebania ababisa baye; akamesia chinkoba, akabatantania.
Erio ebiambokero bi’enyancha bikarorekana, na amaroso ’ense akaorokigwa aarabu, ekero Omonene abatogonyerete ase ogwoka kw’omoika bwe chimioro chiaye.
Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa igoro, akambwata, akandusia ase amache amange.
Agantooria korwa ase omobisa one ore ne chinguru, na korwa ase abwo bangechete; barabwo nigo barenge ne chinguru kombua.
Ekero narenge nemechando bakandwania, korende Omonene akaba egekengero kiane.
Akang’ira aase arenge aagare; agantooria, ekiagera namogogetie.
Omonene nigo ang’ete eng’eria y’obuya, ekiagera inde omoronge, nigo ansesenetie, ekiagera inde namaboko atari na komocha.
Inche nabeire nkobwatia chinchera chi’Omonene, tintigeti Nyasae one ase ogokora obonyaka.
Nabeire nkorenda amachiko aye onsi, na timbeti ngotiga emeroberio yaye echikire.
Nigo narenge omoikeranu asare, nkerenda korwa ase obobe.
Omonene ong’akanire, ekiagera ngokora ayare boronge, na ekiagera aroche ng’a amaboko aane achenekire.
Aye Omonene, nigo ore omwegenwa ase abwo bare abegenwa, nigo okweorokia ng’a nomoikeranu ore ase abwo bare abaikeranu.
Aye nigo ore omochenu ase abwo bare abachenu; nigo okwanga abwo bare abakorekanu.
Aye nigo ogotooria abanto bare abaitongo, korende abwo bare namaiso ’oboenenu nigo okobairania inse.
Ee, naye ogontongeria etaya yane; Omonene, Nyasae one, nigo akomoreka omosunte ore asende oba oborabu.
Konde amo naye, nigo ndasirie omoganda bw’esegi; na ekero inde na Nyasae one nincharoke chindwaki igoro.
Enchera ya Nyasae neng’ikeranu, amang’ana aye ateemirwe na gotenena. Ere nenguba ase bonsi abakomotamera.
Inee! Ning’o ore Nyasae, otatiga Omonene? Ning’o ore egetare, otatiga Nyasae oito?
Nyasae nere okomboyia chinguru na kondenda ase enchera yane.
Ere okorire amagoro aane abeire buna ey’egesia, onkong’irie na gontenenia ase ebitunwa.
Ere bworokereirie amaboko aane korwana esegi, erinde amaboko aane anyare gotinga obota bw’etaai.
Aye kwang’eire enguba yao ase ogontooria, okoboko kwao gw’okorio kogansiira; na ogokonywa kwao gwankorire nabeire omonene.
Kwang’eire aase aagare ngotaara, na amagoro aane tagotererigwa.
Nkabwatia ababisa baane, nkabaikeera inchera; gose tinairanete goika nkabakoora.
Nkabaaka inse nkabasenyenta, tibanyara koimoka, bakagwa inse y’amagoro aane, bakabugwa.
Aye nigo kwambegete chinguru chi’okorwana esegi; okabeka ababisa baane inse y’amagoro aane.
Ogakora ababisa baane bagatama korwa asende; abangechete nkabasiria kegima.
Abanto aba bakarera ng’a bakonywe, korende onde tarenge obatooretie, bakarangeria Omonene, korende ere tabaigwa.
Nkabasunyunta bakaba ebuse ekoirurukigwa nomwaga; nkabatuguta buna ngotuguta esike ase enchera.
Aye gwantooririe korwa ase okoamererania nabanto, kwambekire nabeire omogambi bw’abanto b’ebisaku; abanto ntamanyete, bono babeire abasomba baane.
Ekero baigure chinkuma chiane nigo bakonyigwera; abamenyi nigo bagocha bebeka inse yane.
Abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao berusirie moyo kobagosoka korwa ase chiburi chiabo, nigo bakoiguswa.
Omonene nigo are moyo! Ere oyore egetare kiane atogigwe! Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane aimokererigwe igoro.
Nyasae nigo akonduseria egesiomba, nabeke abanto b’ebisaku inse yane.
Ere nigo antooretie korwa ase ababisa baane, akanyimokereria igoro ase abare mamincha yane, naende agantooria korwa ase abanto abatindi.
Aye Omonene, ase ayio ningotogie ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, ninterere erieta riao ase okoritogia.
Nyasae ong’eire inche, omoruoti oye, obobui obonene, oorokirie obwanchani botari koera asende, inche omoakwa amaguta oye. Inche Daudi, na ororeria rwane, goika kare na kare.
Igoro nigo chikoorokia obonene bwa Nyasae; na eaanga ya igoro eraria emeremo y’amaboko aye.
Rituko erimo riatebia erinde obonene obo, na obotuko obomo bwarareria obotuko bonde ayio ayio.
Chinkwana chinde tichiri aroro, gose omonwa onde ogokwanwa tori, na eriogi riabo tiriri koigugwa.
Eriogi riabo riagendire, riesiareire ase ense engima, na amang’ana abo aikire chinsinyo chi’ense. Nyasae okorire igoro koba obomenyo bw’erioba.
Erioba nigo rigosoka buna omonyuomi ogosoka korwa mwaye, na riagoka buna omogosoria omokong’u okominyoka chimbero.
Nigo rigosoka korwa ensemo eyemo ya igoro, naende riekumba riagenda gochia ensemo ende; gento kende tikeri gekobisekana korwa ase riberera riaye.
Amachiko ’Omonene namaikeranu, nigo agokora omoyo oba omoyia. Oborori bw’Omonene nobw’ekeene, nigo akong’ainiyia oyotamanyeti amange.
Amachiko ’Omonene namaronge, nigo akogokia enkoro; ring’ana Omonene achikire nerironge, nigo rikorenta oborabu ase amaiso.
Okomoiroka Omonene nering’ana richenegete, okwo koragenderere kare na kare; okogamba kw’Omonene nogw’ekeene, na okw’oboronge.
Ayio onsi nigo are amaya kobua etahabu, ee, kobua etahabu echenire na amansu kobua obooke, ee, kobua richoe ri’obooke.
Amo nayio nigo ogokurera omosomba oo; oyio okoyarenda nigo akoegwa eng’eria enene y’obuya.
Ning’o oranyare komanya amamocho aye? Omonene, nchene korwa ase amamocho aane abisekanete.
Ontange inche, omosomba oo, tinkora ebibe bi’obomwenu; tobitiga ebio bingambere! Rirorio nimbe ntari na komocha, nimbe omosibore korwa ase ogosaria okonene.
Aye Omonene, Egetare kiane na Omobooria one, anchera amang’ana aane na ebirengererio bire ase enkoro yane.
Tiga Omonene aigwe ogosaba kwao ase engaki y’emechando. Erieta ria Nyasae o Yakobo rikorende.
Ere nagotomere ogokonywa korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, na akoe chinguru korwa ase Sayoni.
Tiga ainyore okorua kwao gwonsi, anche na kogokera ebing’wanso biao bionsi bi’ogosambwa.
Tiga akoe ogokania gw’enkoro yao, na aikeranie emeroberio yao yonsi.
Erio toake amariogi ’omogoko ase engencho y’obobui bwao, toimokererie igoro ebendera y’erieta ria Nyasae oito! Tiga Omonene aikeranie okoboria kwao kw’oboitongo.
Bono namanyire ng’a Omonene nae omoakwa amaguta oye obobui, namoiranerie korwa aase aye aachenu aaria igoro, namoe obobui goetera ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio.
Abanto bande nigo basemeretie chigari chi’esegi, na abande chibarasi chi’esegi, korende intwe nigo tosemeretie erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oito.
Barabwo nigo baragochwe bagwe inse korende intwe nigo toragororoke totenene boronge.
Aye Omonene, kae omoruoti oo gwachorire obobui; otoiranerie ekero togokorangeria!
Aye Omonene, omoruoti nigo agokerete chinguru chiao, na gochengera obobui kwamoeire.
Kwamoeire okogania gw’enkoro yaye; na totangeti aya aboretie korwa asore.
Aye kwamorenteire ogosesenigwa okuya; kwamobekeire egutwa y’etahabu echenire ase omotwe oye.
Akagosaba ng’a omoe obogima, naye okabomoa; okamoa amatuko amange amenye kogenderera botambe.
Amasikani ’omoruoti nigo are amanene, ekiagera aye kwamokonyire; kwamoeire obonene obonge na ogosika okonene.
Ee, kwamokorire koba ogoseseneka gwa kare na kare, kwamogokeire, ekiagera ore amo nere botambe.
Omoruoti nigo asemeretie Omonene, na ase engencho y’obwanchani bw’Omonene Ore Igoro bogendererete botambe ere takonyara kwoboa.
Aye Omoruoti, noikeere ababisa bao bonsi; nobwate nokoboko kwao gw’okorio abwo bakogechete.
Ekero orabaorokere nobakore booke buna omorero ekebemberi. Omonene nabasirie nendamwamu yaye enene; omorero nobasambe, bayie baere.
Aye noite abana babo, obasirie korwa ase ense, na ororeria rwabo orosirie kegima korwa ase mwanyabanto.
Kobarabe bagokora emeroberio y’ogokora bobe, gose korengereria chinchera chi’okorenta emechando, tibakobua,
ekiagera nobaserie batame, nobarenge emegwe ase amasio abo.
Aye Omonene otogigwe ase engencho ye chinguru chiao, intwe ntobe togotera ogotera kw’ogotogia okobua kwao.
Nyasae one, Nyasae one, naki gwantigire? Nabeire nkorera ng’a ontoorie, korende kwambeereire aare.
Aye Nyasae one! Nigo nkorera ase omobaso, korende tori kong’iraneria; nase obotuko boigo, korende tindi konyora ogotimoka.
Nonya naboigo, aye nigo ore omochenu; aye obwate obonene, Abaisraeli nkogotogia bare.
Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiagosemeretie, ee, nigo chiagosemeretie, naye ogachitooria.
Barabwo nigo barerete asore, bakanyora ogotooreka, nigo babete bagosemeretie, na tibasoogetigwe.
Inche nerikonde, tindi omonto, nigo ngochecherigwa nabanto na gochaywa.
Abanto bonsi abakondora nigo bagonchecheria na gonsekerera; nigo bagoaka amariogi asende na gosinga‐singisia emetwe yabo,
bagoteba, “Omonto oyo nigo asemeretie Omonene ng’a namotoorie, tiga amotoorie, ekiagera agokirie nere!”
Omonene, naye kwandusetie ase enda ya baba; naye kwabete gokondenda buya ase amaboko a baba.
Nigo narutetwe asore korwa ase okoiborwa kwane, na korwa ekero narenge ase enda ya baba naye kwarenge Nyasae one.
Tobaisa kobeera aare korwa asende, ekiagera emechando nigo ere ange, na monto onde tari orankonye.
Chieri chinyinge nching’etanaine, ee, chieri chiria chia Basani chire ne chinguru nigo ching’etanaine.
Baasamirie emenwa yabo gocha asende, yabeire buna chindo chikoronya na koruma.
Nabeire buna amache aiteirwe inse; amauga onsi ay’omobere one achoga‐chogire; enkoro yane yabeire buna obochoe, yanyititokire ime yane.
Chinguru chiane chiang’ereire, nabeire buna ekegionkorio ekiomo pa, oromeme rwane rwabwatanire namang’ang’ura; aye kwanyareirie ase amaroba nkwete.
Chisese nigo ching’etanaine aande onsi, ee, ekeombe ki’abakori amabe nigo kere chinsemo chionsi; bambetire ebisanyi bi’amaboko, na ebi’amagoro boigo.
Amauga ’omobere one atongororire ninyare koyabara; abanto nigo bakondigereria na kogokera obobe bwane.
Baatananire chianga chiane ase egati yabo; baakeire eganchwa yaane obomera.
Korende aye Omonene, tobeera aare korwa asende; aye ore chinguru chiane, ayerera onkonye!
Ntoorie korwa ase ogoitwa nomoro, tooria obogima bwane korwa ase okobua gwe chisese chiria!
Ntoorie, ondusie ase emenwa ye chindo chiria; nkonya korwa ase chingunchara chie ching’era!
Nindarie erieta riao ase abaminto, ase egati y’omosangererekano ningotogie.
Inwe aba momoirogete Omonene, motogie! Inwe mwensi ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, togia obonene bwaye! Inwe Abaisraeli bonsi, moiroke!
Ere tari gochaya emechando y’abwo bachandegete, gose koyegecha, tabisete obosio bwaye asebare; ekero bamorangeretie nigo abaigwete.
Ekero inde ase omosangererekano omonene ningotogie. Chiira nariete ning’ikerane agwo ase obosio bw’abanto bamoirogete Omonene.
Abwo bare abaitongo mbanyore endagera barie baigote. Abanto bakorigia Omonene mbabe bakomotogia, ne chinkoro chiaino nchigenderere koba moyo goika kare na kare.
Abanto be chinsemo chionsi chi’ense mbainyore Omonene, bamoonchokere; chiamate chionsi chi’ebisaku nchimosasime.
Obogambi nobw’Omonene, nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku bionsi.

Ee, abanto abatenenku bonsi bare ase ense goika batung’ame ase obosio bw’Omonene, abwo bonsi bakogenda ase chimbeera ime mbatung’ame ase obosio bwaye; naboigo nabwo batanyare korenda obogima bwabo bogenderere.
Abanto b’ororeria rwaye mbabe bakomokorera; mbabe bagokwana igoro y’Omonene ase ebiaare bigochi‐gocha.
Oboronge bwaye mbobe bokorarigwa ase abanto bataraiborwa, ng’a ere oikeranirie onsi.
Omonene nomorisia one, tinkoremerwa kende,
Nigo agontimokeria ase obonyansi obobese na kondaa gochia ase amache amakenonoku akwongora ng’ora.
Ere nigo agokora omoyo one koba omoyia na kondaa ase chinchera chiaye chia boronge, ase engencho y’erieta riaye.
Ninsa goeta ase omwenya bw’ekiriri ki’amakweri, tinkoiroka bobe bonde, ekiagera aye Omonene nigo ore amo nainche, enyimbo yao na enungu yao nabindemie.
Kwambekeire endagera ase amasio ’ababisa baane; kwang’akire amaguta omotwe one ase okonyarigania, gwaichoirie egekombe kiane, ngoiteka kere.
Ekeene, obuya na obwanchani botari koera nabintunyane amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwane; nainche nimenye ase enyomba y’Omonene goika kare na kare.
Ense na ebinto bire aroro nebi’Omonene; oboiko bwonsi nobwaye, amo nabanto bamenyeteo.
Nigo abegete oboroso bwaye igoro ase chinyancha, akabokong’ia igoro ase chindooche.
Ning’o oragwenere gotiira ase egetunwa ki’Omonene? Ning’o oragwenere gotenena aase aye aachenu?
Nomonto oria obwate amaboko atari na komocha, na enkoro echenegete, noria otari gosasima chinyasae chi’oborimo, gose gotiana ase obong’ainereria.
Omonto oyio nonyore ogosesenigwa korwa ase Omonene; boigo nanyore oboronge korwa ase Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwaye.
Naboigo ekegori ki’abakomorigia kere; abwo bakorigia barore obosio bwa Nyasae o Yakobo.
Inwe ebiita, imokereria emekorogoto yaino igoro! Inwe ebiita bia kare, igoka, erinde Omoruoti bw’obonene asoe ime!
Inee! Omoruoti oyio bw’obonene nere ng’o? Ere n’Omonene ore ne chinguru na okobua, ere n’Omonene Omobui ase chisegi.
Inwe ebiita, imokereria emetwe yaino igoro! Inwe ebiita bia kare, igoka, erinde Omoruoti bw’obonene asoe ime!
Inee! Omoruoti oyio bw’obonene nere ng’o? Ere n’Omonene bw’Emeganda; ere n’Omoruoti bw’Obonene.
Aye Omonene, ngocha nde asore nomoyo one bwonsi.
Aye Nyasae one, naye nsemeretie, tontiga nsookigwe; totiga ababisa baane bagokere okobugwa kwane.
Monto onde bwensi ogosemeretie totiga asookigwe; korende abwo batigire obwegenwa engencho ende etaiyo basookigwe.
Omonene, imanyie chinchera chiao; inyorokererie oboeto bwao.
Ondaae ase ekeene kiao na onyorokererie, ekiagera aye Nyasae nogotooreka kwane, aye nigo ngosemeretie.
Omonene, inyora amabera ao na obwanchani bwao botari koera, ekiagera nao biarenge korwa kare.
Aye Omonene, tobaisa koinyora ebibe na ogosaria bi’obosae bwane; ong’inyore ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na ase engencho y’obuya bwao.
Omonene nigo are omuya na omonyene oboronge, ase ayio nigo akworokereria abanyabibe enchera bagwenerete kobwatia.
Ere nigo akoraa abanto bare abaitongo ase enchera endonge, naende aborokereria komanya enchera yaye.
Chinchera chionsi chi’Omonene nigo chire echi’obwanchani, na echi’obwegenwa, ase abwo barendete okobwatana kwaye na oborori bwaye.
Omonene, ase engencho y’erieta riao onyabere ogosaria kwane, ekiagera nokonene.
Kera omonto omoirogete Omonene, oyio Omonene nigo akomworokereria enchera agwenerete gochora.
Omonto oyio nagenderera gosesenigwa, na ororeria rwaye ndoire ense.
Omonene nigo are omosani bw’abanto bamoirogete, nigo akobamanyia okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.
Botambe nigo nkoba imorigeretie Omonene, nere orarusie amagoro aane ase oboreba.
Aye omonene, ing’iranere ondorere amabera, ekiagera nigo inde inche bweka, naende nchandegete.
Omoichano nigo oichire ase enkoro yane, ndusie ase obokong’u bwane,
ndigererie orore obororo bwane na ogochandwa kwane, na onyabere ebibe biane bionsi.
Rora ababisa baane bonsi buna bare abange; na buna bangechete nobotindi obonge.
Renda omoyo one na ontoorie; naye ngotamera tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe.
Tiga obwegenwa na oboronge bindende, ekiagera naye nsemeretie.
Aye Nyasae, booria Abaisraeli korwa ase emechando yabo yonsi.
Aye Omonene, ing’a oboronge bwane; ekiagera nabeire ntari na komocha; naboigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene ntari ne chitang’u‐tang’u.
Omonene, inteeme na ondenge; orenge enkoro yane na ebirengererio biane.
Nigo ndigereretie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe na gotaara ase obwegenwa bwao.
Tindi gosanga nabanyaborimo, gose tindi kogosoria nabang’ainereria.
Inche nigo ngechete gosanga nabanto bagokora amabe, na tingwancha goikaransa amo nabanto abakayayu.
Nigo ngoisaba amaboko aane ase okoorokia ng’a tindi na komocha, erio naetanana egesasimero kiao, aye Omonene,
imba ngotera neriogi rinene gokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono na koraria ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.
Aye Omonene, inche nigo nyanchete obomenyo bwao, aase obonene bwao bore.
Tosiria omoyo one ekero ogosiria abanyabibe; gose obogima bwane ekero ogosiria abaiti.
Abanto abwo bagokora emeroberio y’obonyaka, na amaboko abo a borio nigo aichire namaaki.
Inche nigo inde norogendo rotari na komocha; indorere amabera na omboorie.
Amagoro aane nigo agotenena aase aateremu; nintogie Omonene ase egati y’omosangererekano omonene.
Omonene nere omobaso one, na ogotooreka kwane, ning’o ndanyare koiroka? Omonene nere eburi ekengerete obogima bwane, monto ki ndanyare kwoboa?
Ekero abakori amabe bakong’umokera ng’a bamere, ababisa baane abwo bangechete nigo baragochwe na kogwa.
Neba omoganda omonene bw’esegi ong’etananire, enkoro yane tekoba nobwoba; gose abanto nabachicha kondwania esegi, inche nigo ndagenderere koba noboremu.
Nasabire ring’ana erimo korwa ase Omonene. Erio nario nganetie: Imenye ase enyomba y’Omonene ase amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwane, erinde ndore oboseera bw’Omonene na kona‐koboiranerera ase Hekalu yaye.
Ase engaki y’emechando nantube ase ekiriri kiaye; nambise ase eema yaye ime, Nanyimokie ambeke ase egetare igoro.
Ninyimokererigwa igoro ase ababisa baane bang’etanaine. Ase eema yaye ime nindue ebing’wanso inde nomochengo; ninterere Omonene na komotogia.
Aye Omonene, oigwe okorera kwane, indorere amabera na oiranerie ogosaba kwane.
Aye gwatebire, “Indigie ondore obosio bwane.” Na enkoro yane nigo ekogotebia, “Omonene, inche igo nkorigia obosio bwao.”
Aye Nyasae one ore ogotooreka kwane, tobisa obosio bwao korwa asende; tontiga kore nendamwamu. Aye kwabeire kogonkonya botambe, tontuguta gose tontiga.
Onye tata na baba baraba bagontiga, Omonene nang’ire imbe oyoye.
Aye Omonene, inyorokererie enchera yao; indaae ong’eterie aase aateremu, ntooreke korwa ase ababisa baane.
Tobaisa kondua ase ababisa baane bankore buna banchete; birori b’oborimo banyimokeire, bagontianera nobotindi.
Naenekirie ng’a nindore obuya bw’Omonene; ase ense y’abanto bare moyo.
Remereria oganye Omonene, kabe omoremu, tokwa omoyo; ee, remereria oganye Omonene!
Aye Omonene, egetare kiane, naye nkorangeria, tibwanga konyigwa. Oise gokira, inche nigo ndabe oyomo bw’abakogenda ase chimbeera.
Igwa eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane, ekero nkorera asore onkonye, ekero ndamborete amaboko aane igoro gocha ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.
Tobaisa gonsiria amo nabakori amabe na abasaria, abanto abagokwana amang’ana ’omorembe nabanto bande, korende ime ase chinkoro chiabo nigo babagechete.
Bae egesusuro koreng’ana nogokora kwabo na ebibe biabo, obaakane koreng’ana nemeremo y’amaboko abo, obae eki bagwenerete konyora.
Abanto abwo tibari kobara ng’a ogokora kw’Omonene, gose emeremo y’amaboko aye, negento; ase ayio nabaiyerie inse, takobaimokia naende.
Omonene atogigwe! Ere oigure okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo.
Omonene nere chinguru chiane na enguba yane; nere nsemeretie ase enkoro yane, ere nankonyete. Ase ayio ninde nomosasoko ase enkoro yane; nimbe nkomoterera na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
Omonene nigo are chinguru ase abanto baye, na obotamero bw’ogotooreka ase omoakwa amaguta oye.
Aye Omonene, tooria abanto bao abare omwando oo, obe omorisia obo, obabogorie goika kare na kare.
Inwe abana ba Nyasae, motogie Omonene, atora obonene bw’Omonene ne chinguru chiaye.
Togia erieta ri’Omonene rire nobonene obonge; mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu.
Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikoigweka ase chinyancha igoro; Nyasae bw’obonene nigo agoaka enkoba, Omonene nigo akogukura igoro ye chinyancha chinyinge.
Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikoigweka rire nokobua; eriogi ri’Omonene nigo riichire nobonene.
Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikobuna emete emecharake, ee, nigo rikobuna emecharake ya Lebanoni.
Nigo agotira‐tiria emete eyio buna emori egotiria, na ebitunwa bia Lebanoni na Sirioni buna eng’era ensae.
Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikomesia chinsase chi’omorero.
Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rigotengechia erooro; ee, nigo rigotengechia erooro ya Kadeshi.
Eriogi erio ri’Omonene nigo rikorekeria chingabi, nigo rigosabora emete y’amanani yaba bosa. Ase Hekalu yaye ebitongwa bionsi biatogia obonene bwaye.
Omonene nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene kogambera chioora; Omonene nere omoruoti ase ekerogo kiaye kare na kare.
Omonene nae abanto baye chinguru, naende abasesenie ase okobaa omorembe.
Aye Omonene, ningotogie, ekiagera kwanyimokirie korwa inse, tigwatigete ababisa baane betogie igoro yane.
Aye, Omonene, Nyasae one, nigo narerete asore ng’a onkonye, na bono kwangwenirie.
Omonene, gwatooririe omoyo one korwa aase abakure, kwang’iraneirie obogima tingenda ase oboina ime.
Inwe abachenu baye, tera amatera ay’okobaka Omonene, iraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riaye richenu.

Omonene nigo akoba nendamwamu ase engaki ensinini yoka, korende obuya bwaye nigo bokoba ase obogima bw’omonto. Ekerero nabo keranyare kobao ase omogoroba, korende mambia omogoko na omochengo nigo bigocha.
Ekero amang’ana onsi arenge amaya asende, ngateba ng’a tinkobugwa.
Aye Omonene, ase engencho y’obuya bwao ogakora egetunwa kiane kegatenena bokong’u, korende ekero kwabisete obosio bwao nkaba nobwoba.
Erio nkarera asore, aye Omonene, ngakoboria ase oboitongo:
Mbitoki ki aye oranyore onye ngokwa na gosoa ase oboina ime? Inee! Orotu rw’amaroba ndonyare kogotogia? Ndonyare koraria obwegenwa bwao?
Aye Omonene, inyigwe, ondorere amabera! Omonene, inkonye!
Aye kwaonchoire omoichano one okaba omochengo; kwandusirie eanga y’emechando, kwambekeire ey’omogoko.
Ase ayio, omoyo one nogenderere kogotogia, togokira. Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, ninkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono kogenderera kare na kare.
Aye Omonene, naye ngotamera, tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe; ntoorie goetera ase oboronge bwao!
Tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane, obe omwango gontooria. Kabe egetare kiane ngotamera, na eburi yane enkong’u, na ontoorie!
Aye naye egetare kiane na eburi yane; ase engencho y’erieta riao ondaae na kondenda.
Indusie korwa ase oboreba bobisire bombwate, aye naye egekengero kiane.
Aye Omonene, Nyasae omwegenwa, naye kwambooririe.
Nigo ngechete abanto bagosasima emegwekano ere bosa, korende nigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene.
Ningoke na gochenga ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera; aye igo ogwechandera emechando yane, na kondengereria mono ase ogochandwa kwane.
Tombegeti ase amaboko ’omobisa one; korende gwatenenirie amagoro aane aase are aagare.
Aye Omonene, ndorere amabera, ekiagera nigo mbwate emechando; amaiso aane arimeire ime ase engencho y’obororo, omoyo one ogoyire, naboigo nomobere one.
Ase obogima bwane bwonsi nabeire inde nemechando; na ase emiaka yane yonsi nabeire inde nomoichano; chinguru chiane chiaerire ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane; amauga ’omobere one omire pa.
Ababisa baane bonsi nigo bagonchecheria, na abasani baane boigo. Abanto baamanyete banyoboire; bonsi abakondora ase enchera nigo bagontama.
Abanto banyebire buna bakweba omonto okure; nabeire buna enyongo yatekire.
Nigo nkoigwa ababisa baane bakomonyererana; okogosa nigo kong’etanaine. Abwo nigo bagosangererekana amo kogamba, bagokora omoroberio bw’okong’ita.
Korende inche nigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene. Nigo ngoteba, “Aye naye Nyasae one.”
Obogima bwane nigo bore ase amaboko ao; ntoorie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baane na ay’abachandi baane.
Ing’onchorere obosio bwao, inche omosomba oo, ontoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.
Aye Omonene, tontiga nsookigwe, ekiagera nigo ngokorangeria. Tiga abakori amabe basookigwe, bagende aase abakure babe amamama.
Kiria emenwa y’abwo bagokwana amang’ana ’oborimo, abwo bagokwana amang’ana amabe igoro y’oyore omoronge, na gokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu na ay’ogochaya.
Naki obuya bwao bore obonge na obw’ogokumigwa, obwo kwagacheire abanto abakoirogete, ase amasio a mwanyabanto nigo okoboorokia ase abakogotamera.
Nigo okobabisa agwo asore, ase okobarenda korwa ase emeroberio emebe y’abanto; nigo okobarenda ase ekiriri kiao korwa ase abanto abang’achi.
Omonene atogigwe! Nigo anyorogetie obwanchani bwaye bw’ogokumia; akandenda ase omochie omokong’u.
Ekero narenge nobwoba nigo narengereretie, ngateba; “Bono naserigwe gochia aare korwa ase obosio bwao!” Korende nigo kwaigwete okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo, ekero narerete asore ng’a onkonye.
Mwanche Omonene, inwe abachenu baye mwensi! Omonene nigo akobarenda buya abanto bare abegenwa, korende nigo akorua egesusuro ase oyore omomwenu.
Inwe mwensi aba momosemeretie Omonene, kabe ne chinguru, mobe abaremu!
Nasesenirie omonto oyo bwabeirwe ogosaria kwaye, na ebibe biaye biatubirwe.
Nasesenirie omonto oyo Omonene atabarereti okomocha kwaye, oyo otari nobong’ainereria ase omoyo oye ime.
Ekero konya ntaraorokia ebibe biane, omobere one okoma pa ase okwerera omobaso boira.
Omobaso na obotuko okoboko kwao gokanditoera negesusuro; chinguru chiane chikaera buna amache akoera ekero ki’egurugura.
Erio ngakoorokeria ebibe biane, gose tinakobisete okomocha kwane, ngateba, “Nimoorokerie Omonene ogosaria kwane,” erio okanyabera ebibe biane bionsi.
Ase ayio, kera omonto oyokoirogete tiga agosabe ase engaki y’emechando. Ekero amache amange agotirimboka gocha bwango, tabaisa komoikera.
Aye naye obwebiso bwane, nondendete korwa ase emechando, nimbe nomogoko na omochengo, ekiagera gwantooririe.
Ninkworokererie na gokoraa ase enchera ogwenerete kogenda; ningosemie, na amaiso aane nakorigererie.
Timoba buna chibarasi ne chiyombo chitari nobong’aini, echigwenerete chibekerwe chinkini na ebigobanio bi’ogochigambera.
Omokori amabe nare namaakwa amange, korende oyomosemeretie Omonene, Omonene nigo amoetananeretie nobwanchani botari koera.
Inwe abanyene oboronge, mogokere Omonene na komochengera; inwe mwensi abamore ne chinkoro chindonge, aka eriogi nomogoko.
Inwe abanto abaronge, mochengere Omonene! Inwe abamore ne chinkoro chindonge goika motogie Omonene!
Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase okobugia amakano ’ebirigisa, motogie ase okobugia amakano are ne chinga ikomi!
Moterere ogotera okoyia, na kobugia ase eriogi rireng’aine buya na komochengera!
Naki ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rire boronge, na ogokora kwaye gwonsi nigo agokora ase obwegenwa.
Ere nigo anchete ayare boronge na ekeene, na ense nigo eichire nobwanchani bw’Omonene botari koera.
Ase chinguru chie ring’ana ri’Omonene igoro egatongwa, na ase okobua kwe ring’ana riaye erioba na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni bigatongwa.
Igo agosangereria amache ’enyancha, buna amache are enyongo ime, obeka chindiba aase abo.
Ense yonsi neiroke Omonene, na bonsi abamenyete ase ense bamwoboe.
Naki ere agakwana, na ayio agakoreka; agachika, na ayio akabao.
Omonene nigo akoonchorana emeroberio y’abanto b’ebisaku, na gosaria okogamba kwa mwanyabanto kwaba bosa.
Okogamba kw’Omonene nigo goteneine kare na kare; emeroberio yaye nigo egendererete ebiaare ase ebiaare.
Ngesesenirie egesaku eke Omonene are Nyasae obo, abanto aba achorete babe omwando oye.
Omonene nigo arigereretie korwa igoro, oroche mwanyabanto bonsi.
Korwa agwo ase aikaransete, nigo akobagambera bonsi abamenyete ase ense.
Nere otongete chinkoro chi’abanto bonsi, namanyete korenga ogokora kwabo gwonsi.
Omoruoti tari orabue nomoganda oye omonene bw’abarwani, gose etuoni teri eratoorigwe ne chinguru chiaye chinyinge.
Gosemeria chibarasi chi’esegi, ayio mbosa, tichikonyara kobua, chinguru chiabo chinyinge tichigotooria omonto.
Rora amaiso ’Omonene nigo abarigereretie abwo bamoirogete, abwo basemeretie obwanchani bwaye botari koera.
Omonene natoorie emioyo yabo korwa ase amakweri, tibakwa ekero gi’enchara.
Emioyo yaito nigo emoganyete Omonene, ere nere ogokonywa gwaito, na enguba yaito.
Ee, chinkoro chiaito nchimogokerete, ekiagera tosemeretie erieta riaye richenu.
Omonene, obwanchani bwao botari koera bobe amo naintwe, ekiagera naye togosemeretie.
Nimbake Omonene chingaki chionsi, ase omonwa one nimotogie botambe.
Ase omoyo one ninyetogerie Omonene, abwo bachayire tiga bayaigwe bagoke.
Raria obonene bw’Omonene amo nainche toimokererie erieta riaye igoro twensi amo.
Nkarangeria Omonene, nere akang’iraneria, akandusia korwa ase obwoba bwane bwonsi.
Abwo bamorigereretie nigo bakomeka‐meka bare nomogoko, gose amasio abo takororekana are nobosooku.
Omonto omotaka nigo akorera, na Omonene omoigwa, omotooria korwa ase emechando yaye yonsi.
Omomalaika bw’Omonene nigo akorenda na goetanana abwo bamoirogete Omonene na kobatooria.
Moteeme Omonene, morore ng’a nomuya. Nasesenirie omonto oria omotameire.
Moiroke Omonene, inwe abachenu baye, naki abwo bamoirogete tibakoremerwa kende.
Chindo chinsae nachinyare koremerwa na koba nenchara, korende abwo bakomorigia Omonene tibakoremerwa kende gionsi kere ekiya.
Abana baane, inchuo montegerere, mborokererie buna moramoiroke Omonene.
Inee! Aye nomonto bwanchete obogima? Oganetie obe moyo amatuko amange, na korora amaya?
Rirorio tanga oromeme rwao tirokwana amabe, na ebikoba biao tibikwana obong’ainereria.
Otige amabe, okore amaya; origie omorembe na koyobwata mono.
Amaiso ’Omonene nigo arigereretie abanyene oboronge, na amato aye nigo akoigwa ebirero biabo.
Obosio bw’Omonene nigo bore mamincha y’abwo bagokora amabe, nabasirie korwa ase ense, tibainyorwa.
Ekero abanyene oboronge bakorera ng’a bakonywe, Omonene nigo akobaigwa na kobatooria korwa ase emechando yabo yonsi.
Omonene nigo are ang’e nabwo chinkoro chiabo chiabunekire, nigo akobatooria abwo berusirie moyo.
Omonyene oboronge nigo akonyora emechando emenge, korende Omonene namotoorie korwa ase eyio yonsi;
nigo akorenda amauga aye onsi, rinde tiribunwa nonya nerimo.
Obobe nigo boraite omokori amabe, na abwo bagechete omonyene oboronge nabagambigwe, banyore egesusuro.
Omonene nigo akobooria emioyo y’abasomba baye, gose onde tari ase abwo bakomotamera orache kogambigwa.
Aye Omonene, engereria abanto abwo bakoengererania nainche, rwania abwo bakondwania!
Bogoria enguba na eng’aya, imoka onkonye!
Aye orute abanto abwo bakombwatia ritimo na esimisi! Ontebie ase omoyo one, “Ninche Omotooria oo.”
Abanto abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwane, tiga babugwe na gosookigwa. Abwo bagokora emeroberio emebe y’okong’ita, tiga bairanigwe babe nobosooku.
Barabwo tiga babe buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga, na omomalaika bw’Omonene abe okobaiyeria.
Omosunte na oboterere bibe ase enchera bagoetera, na omomalaika bw’Omonene abe okobabwata abasirie.
Abanto abwo bambekeire oboreba bobisi engencho ende etaiyo, na bakunyire eirima ng’a basirie obogima bwane.
Ogosirigwa tiga kobanyore mobosokano; oboreba obwo bantegeire tiga bobabwate barabwo abanyene, tiga bagwe imeo abanyene na gosirigwa.
Omoyo one nogoke ase Omonene na gochenga ase engencho y’ogotooreka kwaye.

Amauga onsi ay’omobere one natebe, “Aye Omonene, ning’o onga buna aye? Aye ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru korwa ase oyore ne chinguru komobua, ee, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru naende omoremerwa, korwa ase oyo okomochanda.”
Birori bi’oborimo nigo bakonyimokera, bakomboria ase amang’ana ntamanyeti.
Abanto abwo nigo bakong’akana amabe ase amaya, nerusirie moyo.
Ekero abanto abwo barwarete nigo neboyetie eanga y’okweumia na goichana; ngechanda ase okweng’ata, ngasaba nturegete omotwe.
Nkabechandera buna nigo barenge abasani baane gose abaminto; nigo nabegete eanga y’okweumia, nturegete omotwe buna omonto okweumia ekero ng’ina akure.
Korende ekero narenge ase emechando, nigo basangererekanete amo bakagoka. Abanto batagwenerete, aba ntamanyeti bakaba bagonchecheria batari gotiga.
Abatamoirogeti Omonene nigo banchayete na gonchecheria, bakangecha bakaba bakondiananeria amaino.
Omonene, ngoika ririri orabe koyarigereretie rioka? Intaborie korwa ase ogosiria barobeirie, tooria obogima bwane korwa ase chindo echio!
Erio ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono agwo ase omosangererekano omonene, ningotogie ase omoganda omonene bw’abanto.
Totiga ababisa baane bagoke igoro yane engencho ende etaiyo; totiga abwo bangechete bosa bagosimanera amaiso bankore bobe.
Abanto abwo tibari gokwana amang’ana akorenta omorembe; nigo bakona‐korigia amang’ana ’obong’ainereria igoro y’abanto abwo bare abatoereru ase ense.
Abwo nigo bagwasamia emenwa yabo bateba: “Ahaa! Ahaa! Ntwayarora namaiso aito.”
Aye Omonene, kwarorire amang’ana ayio, tokira‐kiri. Omonene, tobaisa kobeera aare korwa asende!
Nyasae one ore Omonene one, tabobora, oimokerere igoro, erinde orwanerere oboronge bwane na amang’ana aane.
Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, nacha ekina kiane koreng’ana noboronge bwao, tobaisa gotiga ababisa baane bagoke igoro yane.
Tobatiga batebe, “Bono twamonyorire buna twaganetie.” Tobatiga batebe, “Bono twamobuire.”
Abanto abwo bakogokera emechando yane, tiga basookigwe na batantanigwe; abwo bagwetogia igoro yane, tiga baboigwe obosooku na ogochaywa.
Abanto abwo banchete ng’a ng’egwe oboronge bwane, tiga baake eriogi ri’omogoko na omochengo, bagenderere goteba, “Omonene noyo bw’obonene! Ee, nigo agokirie namaya omosomba oye akonyora!”
Erio oromeme rwane ndogenderere koraria oboronge bwao, na ogotogigwa kwao, omobaso boira.
Ebibe nigo bigokwana nomonto omokori amabe ase enkoro yaye ime; okomoiroka Nyasae tikori ase obosio bwaye.
Omonto oyo nigo akweremia omonyene ase okweng’aina, ng’a ebibe biaye tibikomanyekana bigechwe.
Amang’ana omonto oyio agokwana nigo are ay’ogosaria na obong’ainereria; ere otigire gokora amang’ana ’obong’aini na ayare amaya.
Ekero araire borere bwaye nigo agokora emeroberio y’amabe, na kobwatia chinchera chitari chingiya, tari kwanga obobe bonde bwonsi.
Aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao botari koera nigo bogoika aaria igoro, na obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete ase amare igoro.
Aye Nyasae, oboronge bwao nigo boteneine bokong’u buna ebitunwa biao. Okogamba kwao nigo kore buna chindiba chintambe, aye nigo orendete mwanyabanto ne ching’iti boigo.
Nyasae, naki obwanchani bwao bwa botambe bore obonene! Mwanyabanto nigo bagotamera ekiriri gie chimbaba chiao.
Nigo bagoisanekigwa nobonoru bokorwa ase enyomba yao, aye nobae banywe korwa ase orooche rwao rw’okogokia.
Naye ore ensoko y’obogima, na ase omobaso oo nigo tokorora omobaso.
Genderera koorokia obwanchani bwao obonene ase abwo bakomanyete, na oboronge bwao ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.
Totiga amagoro ’abaenenu ang’ike ang’e kondwania, gose amaboko ’abakori amabe anserie.
Rora aase abakori amabe bagure inse, baiyerigwe tibakonyara koboka naende.
Togechigwa ase engencho y’abakori amabe, toba ne ribero ase abakori amabe.
Barabwo mbasirigwe bwango, basire buna obonyansi basusane buna ebimeri ebibese.
Mosemerie Omonene okore ayare amaya, erio nario oramenye ase ense, obe korendire buya.
Goka ase Omonene, ere nakoe okogania gw’enkoro yao.
Erue ase Omonene mosemerie, nere nagokonye.
Omonene naorokie oboronge bwao buna akoorokia oborabu, na ekeene kiao buna amasase a mobaso gati.
Obe nobotoereru ase obosio bw’Omonene, omoganye noboremereria. Togechigwa nomonto okogenderera buya ase enchera yaye, omonto oyio okoroberia ogosaria.
