Aye Nyasae, abanto batakomanyeti bachire basoire ase omwando oo, barabwo bakorire Hekalu yao Enchenu yabeire eyetachenegeti, bakorire Yerusalemu obeire chitui chi’amagena.
Baeire chinyoni emebere y’abasomba bao chiyerie, ee, chinyama chi’emebere y’abachenu bao ase ching’iti chi’orosana.
Baiteire amanyinga abo buna amache ase chinsemo chionsi chia Yerusalemu, abakobatindeka baborire.
Intwe twabeire okogechia ase abanto bamenyete ang’e naintwe, abanto batoetanaine nigo bagotochecheria na gotosekerera.
Aye Omonene ngoika ririri oragenderere koba nendamwamu asetore? Inee! Ribero riao, ngoika ririri rigochia gwoka buna omorero?
Umora endamwamu yao igoro ase abanto b’ebisaku batakomanyeti, na igoro ase amagambi ayio atari gokorangeria oyakonye.
Naki abanto abwo basiririe abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, naende basaririe aase bamenyete.
Tobaisa gotoa intwe egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe bie chisokoro chiaito; otorotote namabera ao bwango, ekiagera twabeire bosa kegima.
Aye Nyasae ore ogotooreka gwaito, ase engencho y’obonene bw’erieta riao, tokonye; naende ase engencho y’erieta riao otoboorie, otwabere ebibe biaito!
Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku bakoboria, “Ng’ai Nyasae oyio obo are?” Ase amasio aito tiga abanto b’ebisaku bamanye buna okorusia egesiomba ase engencho y’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ’abasomba bao.
Tiga ekerero ki’abasibire geike ase obosio bwao; tooria abanto abwo banacheirwe ekina bakwe, ekiagera aye nobwate okobua okonene.
Aye Omonene, abanto abwo bamenyete ang’e bagochecheirie na kogochaya, obairanerie amabe ayio abo ara gatano na kabere.
Erio intwe, abanto bao, aba tore abe riicho ri’oborisia bwao, natokoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono kogenderera botambe, na ebiaare ase ebiaare natobe tokogotogia.
Aye omorisia bw’Abaisraeli, tegerera oigwe, aye okoraa abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu buna riicho rikoraagwa! Aye oyore ase oboikaranso bw’obonene igoro y’abakerubi, tomorekere!
Orokia chinguru chiao ase abanto b’Efraimu, na aba Benjamin, na aba Manase, na oche ototoorie!
Aye Nyasae, otokore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.
Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ngoika ririri orabe gokogechigwa nogosaba kw’abanto bao?
Aye gwakorire amariga ’omoichano koba endagera yabo, kwabanyoisirie amariga amange mono.
Aye gwatokorire twabeire abakwomanerwa ase egati y’abanto bare ang’e naintwe, na ababisa baito nigo bagendererete gotochecheria.
Aye Nyasae bw’Emeganda, otoonchore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.
Aye Omonene nigo kwarentete omosabibu korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erio ogaseria abanto b’ebisaku korwa aase abo, okayosimeka aroro.
Aye nigo kwayoraberetie aase na koaroisia, noro ogakina okaira emeri inse, okaranda ase ense eyio engima.
Ekiriri ki’omosabibu oyio nigo giatubete ebitunwa, ne chinsagia chiaye chikaranda gochia aase emecharake ya Nyasae ere.
Chinsagia echio chikaranda chigaikeera Enyancha Enene, na emeseboka yaye gochia ase orooche rw’Eufarati.
Nase ki rende aye gwatagoire chindwaki chiaye, erinde bonsi abagoeta ase enchera batabora amasabibu aye?
Chimbeche chie rinani nigo chigosaria omosabibu oyio, ne ching’iti chi’orosana nigo chikoyotakuna.
Aye Nyasae bw’Emeganda, yoiranere naende, rigereria korwa agwo igoro orore; bwechandere omosabibu oyio.
Renda omote oyo gwasimegete nokoboko kwao gw’okorio, orosagia orwo gwechoreire na korobeka chinguru.
Abanto bayosambire nomorero na koyogecha. Osirie abanto abwo ase okobea kwao!
Orende nokoboko kwao omonto oyio gwachorire nokoboko kwao gw’okorio, mwanyabanto abwo aye gwechoreire.
Erio titokoonchoka togotige; torende togenderere koba moyo, na intwe ntobe togotogia erieta riao.
Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, tokore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.
Moterere Nyasae neriogi rinene, ekiagera nere chinguru chiaito, aka eriogi ri’omogoko ase Nyasae o Yakobo.
Tera ogotera kw’ogotogia, mobugie chinchigiri amo namakano ’ebirigisa, na amakano ande.
Mobugie egetureri ase rituko ri’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ekero oorokire omogima, ase ogosika rituko riaito ri’omoyega richikire.
Oyio nigo ore omoroberio ochikire ase Abaisraeli, na aya Nyasae o Yakobo achikire.
Ekero Omonene aetete ense ya Misiri, agachika omoroberio oyio ase abanto ba Yusufu. Nkaigwa enkwana y’omonwa ntamanyete egoteba:
“Ninche narusetie chigurube korwa ase amareko aino, na ngasibora amaboko aino korwa ase ebitonga bi’okobogoria chigurube.
Ekero mwarenge nemechando nigo mwandangeretie, na inche nkabatooria, nigo nabairaneretie korwa ime y’enkoba ase nebisete, nkabateema agwo ase amache a Meriba.
Inwe abanto baane, igwa ekero nkobakurera! Inwe Abaisraeli, onye ndiria mware konyigwera!
Timoba nenyasae ende eng’ao ase egati yaino, timotung’amera na gosasima enyasae engeni.
Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Ase ayio, asamia emenwa yaino ebe yasie, na inche imbaragerie.
“Korende abanto baane tibaigwete eriogi riane; Abaisraeli abwo nigo bangete kegima konyigwera.
Ase ayio nkabatiga babwatie obomwenu bwe chinkoro chiabo, erinde bakore buna koreng’ana konya barobeirie abanyene.
Onye ndiria abanto abwo baane bantegererete! Onye Abaisraeli mbabwatetie chinchera chiane!
Rirorio nanga nabuete ababisa babo bwango, na okoboko kwane nkoba kware mamincha yabo.
Abwo bangechete inche Omonene, nigo baare gocha gotung’ama asende bare nobwoba, na amatuko abo nagenderere kobao kare na kare.
Korende inwe nigo narenge gocha kobaa engano enoru, na kobaisanekia nobooke korwa ase egetare.”
Nyasae nigo agotenena ase omosangererekano oye omochenu, ase egati ye chinyasae nigo akonacha ekina.
“Inee! Ngoika ririri moragenderere konacha ebina bitari noboronge? Ngoika ririri moragenderere gwanchereria abanto ababe?
Kae abataka ne chintakana oboronge bwabo; boigo nabwo bagokorerwa bobe, na abaremeire.
Tooria abatari na nguru, na aba tabwati kende, basibore korwa ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.”
Abanto abwo tibamanyeti gento, tibari nobong’aini, nigo bagotaara bakona‐kouna‐una ime ase omosunte; amaroso ’ense anyegerigwe.
Natebire ng’a: “Inwe nechinyasae; inwe mwensi nabana b’Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.
Korende nigo morakwe buna mwanyabanto bande, na obogima bwaino boere buna obw’abanene b’ense.”
Aye Nyasae, imoka, ogambie ense ekina, ekiagera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nabao.
Aye Nyasae, tokira‐kiri! Nyasae, totoerera na gotimoka.
Rora, ababisa bao buna bagokora riroroche; abwo bakogechete baimokereirie emetwe igoro ase oboenenu.
Nigo bagokora emeroberio y’obong’ainereria igoro y’abanto bao; abwo nigo bagosemania kobakorera bobe abanto bao abwo orendete.
Nigo bagotebania: “Inchuo tobasirie tibaba egesaku naende, tiga erieta ri’Abaisraeli riebwe kegima!”
Abanto abagambire ase omoyo oyomo na bakorire okobwatana mamincha yao nabwo aba;
abanto bamenyete ase chiema chi’Edomu na Abaisumaeli; Abamoabu na Abahagari;
Abagebali, na Abaamoni, na Abaamaleki; Abafilisti amo nabamenyete Turo.
Boigo Abaasuri babwatanire nabwo ase ogokonya abanto b’ororeria rwa Loti.
Omonene, obakore buna gwakorete Abamidiani, na buna gwakorete Sisera na Yabini agwo ase orooche rwa Kisoni.
Abwo nigo baiteretwe agwo Eni Dori; bakaba esike ase riroba.
Okore abanto babo basikire buna gwakorete Orebu na Seebu, na abanene babo babe buna Seba na Salimuna,
ekiagera batebete, “Inchuo toire amarisio a Nyasae abe ayaito.”
Aye Nyasae one, tiga abanto abwo bairurukigwe buna orotu, ee, buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga.
Buna omorero ogokoora rinani, na buna ekebemberi ki’omorero kegosamba ebitunwa,
naboigo batunyanerie omwaga oo bw’omoubera, na obaondokie nekembugu‐mbugu kiao.
Aye Omonene, kora amasio abo abe nobosooku obonene, erinde babe bakorigia erieta riao.
Abanto abwo tiga babe nobosooku na omoichano goika kare na kare; ee, tiga basookigwe na basire kegima.
Abanto abwo tiga bamanye ng’a naye bweka okorokwa Omonene, nigo ore Oyore Igoro Mono igoro y’ense yonsi.
Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, naki obomenyo bwao bore oboseera!
Omoyo one nore namaiga amange kobeera ase chigoora chi’Omonene; enkoro yane na omobere one nigo bigoterera Nyasae ore moyo nomogoko omonene.
Enchiro nigo ekonyora obomenyo, na egesingororo nigo gekwenyorera egeswa ase amage aye akobeera, agwo ase egesasimero kiao, aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, aye Omoruoti one, na Nyasae one.
Mbasesenirie abanto abwo bamenyete ase enyomba yao, abwo bakona‐gotera botambe ase okogotogia.
Mbasesenirie abanto abwo bakonyora chinguru chiabo korwa asore; abwo chinkoro chiabo chiganetie kogenda Sayoni.
Ekero abanto abwo bagoeta ase Rigoko ria Baka, nigo bakorikora riaba aase e chinsoko chi’amache; na embura ye ritang’ani nigo ekorirentera ogosesenigwa okonge.
Barabwo mbabe bakomenta koba ne chinguru kogenderera botambe, mbarore Nyasae ayobuete chinyasae agwo Sayoni.
Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, igwa ogosaba kwane, tegerera onyigwe, aye Nyasae o Yakobo.
Aye Nyasae ore enguba yaito, origererie obosio bw’omoakwa amaguta oo.

Mbuya kobeera ase enyomba yao rituko erimo rioka kobua kobeera amatuko chilifu chinyinge aande onsi; mbuya koba omorendi bw’egesieri ki’enyomba yao aye Nyasae one, kobua kobeera ase obomenyo bw’abakori amabe.
Omonene Nyasae nigo are erioba na enguba, ere nigo agotoa amabera na obonene; ere takorina abare ne chinkoro chindonge gento kende gionsi kere ekiya.
Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, nasesenirie omonto okwegenete.
Omonene, kare nigo kwarenge namabera ase ense yao, nigo kwairaneretie abanto ba Yakobo amaya abo.
Aye nigo kwaberete abanto bao obobe bwabo, nigo gwatubete ebibe biabo bionsi.
Boigo ngwatigete koba nekeririanda, ngwatigete kegima kogechigwa nabarabwo.
Aye Nyasae, Omotooria oito, otoiranere, rusia ekeririanda kiao korwa asetore.
Inee! Nigo ogochia koba nendamwamu asetore kogenderera botambe? Inee! Endamwamu yao nigo egendererete koba ase ebiaare bionsi?
Inee! Togotokora abayia naende, erinde intwe abanto bao tobe nomogoko asore?
Aye Omonene, otoorokerie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na otoe ogotooreka kwao.
Nimbe nkoigwa amang’ana Omonene Nyasae agokwana; ere nigo agokwana amang’ana ’omorembe ase abanto baye abachenu, tobatiga baonchokere oboriri naende.
Ekeene, ogotooreka kwaye nigo kore ang’e ase abanto bairogete Omonene; obonene mbobe bomenyete ase ense yaito.
Aase agwo obwanchani bogendererete botambe na ekeene mbiumerane, boigo oboronge na omorembe mbinyunyuntane.
Aase agwo obwegenwa mbooroke ase ense, na oboronge mborigererie korwa igoro.
Ekeene, Omonene narue ayare amaya, na orogongo rwaito rorue okwama kwaye.
Oboronge mbotang’ane bosio bwaye, naende bobwatie ase aetete.
Aye Omonene, integerera, onyigwe na ong’iranerie, ekiagera nigo inde omotaka na omoremerwa.
Orende omoyo one, ekiagera nigo nkoirogete; aye Nyasae one, intoorie inche omosomba oo, ekiagera nigo ngosemeretie.
Aye Omonene, indorera amabera, ekiagera nigo nkorera asore omobaso boira.
Gokia omoyo one inche omosomba oo, ekiagera narentire omoyo one asore aye Omonene.
Omonene, aye nigo ore omuya na oyo okwabera; nigo okoorokia obwanchani obonge ase abagokorangeria obakonye.
Omonene, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane, igwa ekerero ki’ogosorora kwane.
Ekero inde nemechando nigo ngokorangeria, ekiagera aye nigo okonyigwa na kong’iraneria.
Omonene, enyasae teri enga buna aye, gose emeremo ende teri enga buna eyao.
Ebisaku bionsi gwatongete mbichiche, bitung’ame ase obosio bwao kogosasima, mbitogie erieta riao, aye Omonene.
Aye naye ore omonene, nigo ogokora amakumia; aye naye bweka ore Nyasae.
Aye Omonene, inyorokererie enchera yao, nigo nganetie kobwatia ekeene kiao; renda enkoro yane, erinde inyiroke erieta riao.
Aye Omonene Nyasae one, nigo nkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono nenkoro yane yonsi, nindarie obonene bw’erieta riao goika kare na kare.
Naki obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obonene asende; aye kwabooririe omoyo one korwa aase abakure.
Nyasae, abanto abaenenu banyimokeire kondwania esegi; ekeombe ki’abanto abatindi nigo bakorigia basirie obogima bwane, abwo tibakoirogeti nonya ng’ake.
Korende aye Omonene nigo ore Nyasae bw’amabera na obuya; tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, nigo ore nobwanchani botari koera, na obwegenwa.
Ing’iranerie na ondorere amabera, ong’e inche omosomba oo chinguru chiao, intoorie inche omwana bw’omosomba oo omokungu.
Inyorokie ekemanyererio ki’obuya bwao, erinde abanto bangechete bakerore na gosookigwa, ekiagera aye Omonene gwankonyire na kondemia.
Omochie oria obegetwe oboroso n’Omonene nigo oteneine igoro ase ebitunwa ebichenu.
Omonene nigo anchete ebiita bia Sayoni kobua aande onsi ase abanto ba Yakobo bamenyete.
Aye omochie o Nyasae, amang’ana ’obonene nigo agokwanwa igoro yao.
Ase abanto abwo bamanyete inche ninyatore Rahabu, na Abababeli, na Abafilisti, na Abaturo, amo nabanto b’Etiopia, na goteba, “Oyo na oyo nao baiboreretwe ime aaria.”
Igoro ya Sayoni amang’ana aya nakwanwe. “Omonto oyo na oria nao baiboreretwe ime yaye,” na Omonene ore Igoro Mono nere orabe okoyokong’ia.
Ekero Omonene arakore omobaro bw’abanto, nigo ararike, “Oyo na oyo nao baiboreretwe ime aaria.”
Ekero bagotera na bagotenga nigo bagoteba, “Chinsoko chiaito chionsi nigo chire ime yao.”
Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’ogotooreka kwane, omobaso na obotuko nigo nkorera asore ng’a onkonye.
Ogosaba kwane tiga goike ase obosio bwao, tegerera oigwe okorera kwane.
Omoyo one nigo oichire nemechando, na obogima bwane bwaikire ang’e kogenda aase abakure.
Inche nabareranigwe amo nabwo bakogenda ase embeera, chinguru chiang’ereire.
Natigirwe inde buna oyomo bw’abakure, buna abwo baitetwe, bono bare ase chimbeera ime. Nabeire buna abwo aye otainyoreti nonya ng’ake, kwabaatananire korwa ase okoboko kwao.
Kwambekire inse kegima ase embeera ime; agwo aase are omosunte na aatambe gochia inse.
Egesusuro kiao nigo kere ekerito igoro yane, kwambagoreire emerindo yao yonsi yantubire kegima.
Kwabekire aare abagisangio baane twamanyaine, gwankorire nabeire okogechia asebare; nasiekereirwe, tinkonyara gosoka.
Amaiso aane amwamire ase okweumia; Aye Omonene, kera rituko nigo ngokorangeria, ndamborete amaboko aane gocha asore.
Inee! Abakure nkobakorera ore amakumia? Inee! Abwo nkoimoka bare na kogotogia?
Inee! Obwanchani bwao ngokwanwa bore ime ase chimbeera, gose obwegenwa bwao agwo aase aasareku?
Inee! Amang’ana ao ay’ogokumia namanyire agwo ase omosunte ime? Gose oboronge bwao mbomanyire agwo ase ense y’okwebwa?
Aye Omonene, nigo nkorera asore, onkonye, nonya nemambia ogosaba kwane nigo kogoika asore.
Omonene, nase ki gwatugutire omoyo one? Nase ki kwabisire obosio bwao korwa asende?
Korwa obwana bwane nabeire inde nemechando, nabeire ang’e nogokwa, ndemereretie okogosa kwao, tindi nogokonywa konde nonya nogoke.
Endamwamu yao entindi yantubire kegima, amaakwa ao ansiririe.
Nigo ang’etanaine buna amache omobaso boira; abwatanire amo, na amigire inche.
Aye gwatananire omwanchwa one na omosani one bambeereire aare, na omosunte obeire omogisangio one.
Aye Omonene, goika kare na kare ninterere obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, nindarie obwegenwa bwao ase ebiaare bionsi.
Ninkwane ng’a obwanchani bwao mbogendererete botambe bwakorirwe kobao goika kare na kare; aaria igoro nigo okong’etie obwegenwa bwao.
Aye nigo gwatebete, “Nakorire okobwatana nomochore one, narire eira y’ogotiana ase Daudi omosomba one.
Ninkore oroiboro rwao rogenderere koba ne chinguru botambe, nintenenie ekerogo kiao ki’obonene kebe ase ebiaare bionsi.”
Aye Omonene, igoro nchitogie emeremo yao y’ogokumia, naende obwegenwa bwao boigo ase omosangererekano bw’abachenu bao.
Inee! Ning’o ore agwo igoro oranyare koreng’anigwa n’Omonene? Nkereki ase ebitongwa bia Nyasae kenga buna ere?
Ere nigo are Nyasae oirokire ase ekegambero ki’abachenu, bonsi abamoetanaine nigo bamoirogete.
Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ning’o obwate okobua buna okwao? Ee, Omonene, obwegenwa bwao nigo bogoetanaine.
Aye nigo okogambera enyancha ekoimokerera igoro; ekero emerindo yaye ekoimokerera igoro, aye nigo okoyotoereria.
Aye nigo gwasenyentete enchoka eria Rahabu ekaba buna egetondo, nokoboko kwao kore ne chinguru ogasiarera ababisa bao.
Igoro neyao, na ense neyao, ense na ebinto bionsi bireo naye kwabitongete.
Naye gwatongete sugusu na irianyi; egetunwa gia Tabori, na ekia Herimoni, nigo bigotogia erieta riao nomogoko.
Okoboko kwao nigo kore nokobua, ee, nigo kore ne chinguru; okoboko kwao gw’okorio nigo koimokererete igoro.
Oboronge na ekeene nabio bire oboroso bw’okogamba kwao, obwanchani bwa kare na kare, na obwegenwa, nigo bitang’aine bosio bwao.
Mbasesenirie abanto abwo bamanyete goaka eriogi ri’omogoko asore, abwo bagotaara ase oborabu bokorwa ase obosio bwao aye Omonene.
Abwo nigo bagochengera erieta riao omobaso boira; na goetera ase oboronge bwao nigo bakoimokererigwa igoro.
Aye nigo ore obonene bwabo ne chinguru chiabo; ase engencho y’ogwancherwa kwao chingunchara chiaito chiakinire.
Oyore enguba yaito noyo bw’Omonene, ee, omoruoti oito noyo bw’Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
Kare ngwakwanete nabegenwa bao ase okorora, okabatebia, “Narentire ogokonywa goetera ase oyomo ore nokobua, naimokereirie igoro oyomo nachorire korwa ase egati y’abanto.
Nanyorire Daudi, omosomba one, namoakire amaguta aane amachenu ase okomwatanana asende.
Okoboko kwane nkobe amo nere botambe, ee, okoboko kwane nkomobeke chinguru.
Ababisa tibakomobwata mobosokano, na abakori amabe tibakomochanda.
Ninsenyente ababisa baye ase obosio bwaye, abwo bamogechete nimbae amaakwa.
Obwegenwa na obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe mbibe amo nere; ase erieta riane orogunchara rwaye ndokine.
Nimbeke enyancha inse y’okoboko kwaye, ne chindooche nchibe inse y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio.
Ere nabe okorera asende na goteba; Aye naye Tata, naye Nyasae one, na Egetare kiane ki’ogotooreka.
Erio inche nimokore abe omwana one omotangi, abe omoruoti ore omonene kobua abaruoti bande bonsi b’ense.
Obwanchani bwane botari koera nimoborendere kare na kare, na okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nkorete nere ngotenene bokong’u.
Ninkore oroiboro rwaye rogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nkegenderere kobao buna igoro erabe ereo.
“Onye abanto b’ororeria rwaye bagochia gotiga amachiko aane, baange koigwera emeroberio yane echikire,
na onye bagochia gosaria aya nachikire. Baange kobwata amachiko aane,
rirorio nimbae egesusuro, mbaake nenyimbo ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo, na mbang’wanie ebiranya ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.
Korende obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe tinkoborusia asare, tingotiga koba omwegenwa asare.
Tinkonyara gosaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, gose tinkoonchora ring’ana nakwanire nomonwa one.
“Ase obochenu bwane natianire rimo ng’a tingokwana oborimo ase Daudi.
Oroiboro rwaye ndogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nkegenderere kobao, buna erioba rirabe rireo ase obosio bwane.
Nkegenderere kobao buna omotienyi, oborori obwo bwa igoro nigo bore obwegenwa.”
Korende bono, aye Omonene kwangire omoakwa amaguta oo, kwabeire nendamwamu enene asare.
Bono gwatigire okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania gwakorete nomosomba oo, kwarutire egutwa yaye y’obogambi inse kwayemwamirie.
Gwatagoire chindwaki chiaye chionsi gwatagoire amaagacho aye onsi are amakong’u abeire amatombe.
Abanto bonsi bagoetera aase agwo nigo bakomosakora, abamenyete ang’e nere nigo bakomochecheria.
Abwo bakomochanda aye kwabaeire chinguru chinyinge, na kwagerire ababisa baye bonsi bagoke.
Kwairanirie omoro oye bw’esegi, tori komoa chinguru chi’okorwana esegi.
Kwamourire obonene bwaye, gwaakeire inse ekerogo kiaye ki’obogambi.
Kwanachire amatuko aye ay’obosae abeire ameng’e, boigo kwamotubire nobosooku obonge mono.
Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri oragenderere kwebisete? Inee! Ngoika ririri endamwamu yao eragenderere gwoka buna omorero?
Aye Omonene, inyora buna obogima bwane bore obweng’e, nigo gwatongete mwanyabanto bonsi bakwe igo.
Monto ki orabe moyo otakwe? Ning’o oranyare gotooria omoyo oye korwa ase chinguru chi’amakweri?
Omonene, ng’ai obwanchani bwao bwa kare na kare bore, obwo ase obwegenwa bwao kwarierete Daudi eira?
Aye Omonene, ing’inyore inche omosomba oo buna ingokorerwa echeche; nigo ndemereretie emerumi y’abanto abange.
Omonene, ababisa bao nigo bagonchecheria, ee, nigo bagochecheria amabarato ’omoakwa amaguta oo.
Omonene atogigwe kare na kare! Amina. Amina.
Omonene, aye nigo ore obotamero bwaito ebiaare ase ebiaare.
Ritang’ani ebigoro bitarabao, gose konya otaratonga ense, korwa kare na kare aye naye Nyasae.
Aye nigo okoonchorana abanto bairana, baba amaroba naende, gwateba, “Inwe mwanyabanto, irana!”
Asore aye, emiaka elifu eyemo nigo ere buna rituko ria igoro koriaetire, buna engaki enke y’okorenda botuko.
Nigo ogokorobanania mwanyabanto buna eooro, baeta bwango buna chindoto. Barabwo nigo bare buna obonyansi bokomera mambia;
mambia nigo bogokina bwasicha, mogoroba bwanachwa bwoma.
Intwe nigo togosirigwa nendamwamu yao, twaondokigwa nekeririanda kiao.
Amabe aya twakorire nigo oyabegete ase obosio bwao, na ebibe biaito bia bobisi nigo bire maiso marore asore.
Obogima bwaito bwonsi nigo bokoera bwango inse y’ekeririanda kiao, nigo togokoora emiaka yaito buna ogoita egekoe

Emiaka y’obogima bwaito nemerongo etano na ebere; onye tore ne chinguru, eba emerongo etano na etato; na obogima obo nigo boichire nobokong’u na emechando, nigo bogoeta bwango, na intwe tweiruruka twasira.
Ning’o omanyete okobua kw’endamwamu yao, na ogw’ekeririanda kiao, erinde akoiroke?
Tworokererie, tomanye obweng’e bw’obogima bwaito, erinde chinkoro chiaito chibe nobong’aini.
Omonene, irana asetore! Ngoika ririri orabe kogotebana? Otororere intwe, abasomba bao, amabera!
Kobogokia mambia, otoisanekie nobwanchani bwao botari koera, erinde tochenge na kogoka amatuko aito onsi.
Otogokie amatuko ang’ana buna ayio twachandegete, na emiaka eng’ana buna eria twanyorete amabe.
Tworokie intwe, abasomba bao, ogokora kwao, na abana baito oborokie obonene bwao.
Obosiani bw’Omonene, Nyasae oito, bobe igoro yaito, na emeremo y’amaboko aito oyesesenie asetore, ee, osesenie emeremo y’amaboko aito!
Ere oyomenyete inse y’oborendi bw’Oyore Igoro Mono, na otimogete ase ekiriri ki’oyore Omobui,
oyio nigo aranyare goteba, “Omonene nere obotamero bwane, na orwaki rwane, nere Nyasae one oyo nsemeretie.”
Ere nagotoorie korwa ase omoeto bw’omotegi, na korwa ase amarwaire amabe agoita.
Ere nagotube namarionya aye, ase chimbaba chiaye ime nonyore obotamero. Obwegenwa bwaye nenguba na eng’aya asore.
Tokwoboa okogoswa ekero kia botuko, gose omogwe okorutwa mobaso,
nonya namarwaire amabe agoeta ase omosunte, gose amabe ande onsi agoita mobaso.
Abanto elifu eyemo nabaisa kogwa ase rikere riao, gose chilifu ikomi ase ensemo yao ya borio, korende ayio tagokonyora aye.
Norigererie namaiso ao, orore buna abakori amabe bakoegwa egesusuro.
Ekiagera kwabekire Omonene obeire egekengano kiao, na Oyore Igoro Mono obotamero bwao,
amabe ande onsi tagokonyora, na amaakwa ande onsi tagocha ase enka yao.
Naki Nyasae nagochikere abamalaika baye bakorende ase chinchera chiao chionsi.
Barabwo nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde togochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.
Notache chindo na amarubi, notiringe chindo chinsae ne chinchoka.
Naki oyo obwatanire nainche ase obwanchani nimotoorie, nimorende, ekiagera namanyete erieta riane.
Ekero arandangerie, inche nimoitabere, inche nigo inde amo nere ase engaki y’emechando. Nimotoorie, naende nimoe ogosika.
Nimoisanekie nobogima obotambe na komworokia ogotooreka kwane.
Nigo ere buya gokoakera aye Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, na gotera ase ogotogia erieta riao, aye Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.
Kera emambia nigo ere buya koraria obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na kera obotuko koraria obwegenwa bwao,
ase okobugia obokano bore ne chinga ikomi, na amakano ande are namariogi amaya.
Aye Omonene, ogokora kwao nigo kongogetie; ninchenge ase engencho y’emeremo y’amaboko ao.
Aye Omonene, emeremo yao nigo ere emenene mono, na ebirengererio biao nigo bire ebia ime mono.
Omonto omoriri takonyara kobimanya, na oyo otari nobong’aini takonyara komanya amang’ana buna ayio.
Abakori amabe nabaisa koreereta buna obonyansi, na abakori ebibe bonsi babe bagosicha buya, korende omoerio obo nogosirigwa goika kare na kare.
Aye Omonene, nigo ore omonene mono kare na kare.
Aye Omonene, Naama! Ababisa bao mbasirigwe; na abakori ebibe bonsi mbasiarerwe gochia aande onsi.
Gwakinirie orogunchara rwane rwabeire buna orw’eng’era, kwang’umoreire amaguta amayia.
Narorire namaiso aane ababisa baane bakobugwa, naigure namato aane igoro y’abakori amabe abanyimokerete.
Omonyene oboronge naseboke buna omokendo, nakine buna omocharake o Lebanoni.
Abwo basimekire ase enyomba y’Omonene, nigo baragenderere koreereta ase chigoora chia Nyasae oito.
Abwo nigo bakogenderera goseboka nonya bagotire, nigo baragenderere kobesea.
Ayio nigo akworokia ng’a Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge, ere nere egetare kiane, na obokorekanu tibori ime yaye.
Omonene nere okogamba, nigo eboetie obonene. Omonene nigo asiberanetie chinguru. Ase ayio ense nigo eteneine bokong’u tekonyegerigwa.
Ekerogo kiao ki’obonene nigo kiabekire aroro korwa kare, ekiagera aye nao kwarenge korwa kare.
Aye Omonene, amache aimokereire igoro, amache nkoeera are neriogi, ee, aimokereirie emerindo yaye igoro.
Omonene nere obwate okobua okonene aria igoro; okobua kwaye nigo kobuete okoruma kw’amache, ee, okw’amache amange na okw’emerindo y’enyancha.
Aye Omonene, oborori bwao nigo boteneine bokong’u. Obochenu nabwo bore ogochaberwa kw’enyomba yao goika kare na kare.
Aye Omonene Nyasae ogoakana egesiomba, aye Nyasae ogoakana egesiomba, oorokia oborabu bwao.
Aye omonachi ebina bw’ense, imoka oe abanto abaenenu eng’eria koreng’ana buna ogokora kwabo kore!
Omonene, ngoika ririri abanyabibe barag nderere gwetogia? Ngoika ririri?
Abakori amabe bonsi nigo bagwetogia, nigo bagokwana‐kwana amang’ana amabe.
Aye Omonene, abwo nigo bagosamunyorana abanto bao, na gochanda abanto bare omwando oo.
Nigo bagoita ababoraka na abamenyi, ne chintakana nigo bagochiita;
erio bateba, “Omonene tari korora amang’ana ayio, Nyasae o Yakobo tari komanya ayio.”
Inwe aba motamanyeti gento, kabe nokomanya! Inwe abariri, ndiriri morabe abang’aini?
Inee! Oyo otongete amato, tari koigwa? Ere oyo otongete amaiso, tari korora?
Oyo okorongeyia ebisaku, tari korua ebisusuro? Ere nigo akworokereria mwanyabanto bamanye obong’aini.
Omonene nigo amanyete ebirengererio bia mwanyabanto, ng’a nigo bire bosa.
Nasesenirie omonto oyio aye Omonene okorongeyia na komworokereria amachiko ao,
naende kwamoa ogotimoka ase amatuko ’emechando, goika ekero abakori amabe bararemerwe chimbeera chiabo.
Omonene tagotuguta abanto baye, takonyara gotiga abwo bare omwado oye.
Ebina mbinachwe ase oboronge naende, na abanto bonsi bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbabobwatie.
Ning’o oratenene andwanerie abakori amabe? Ning’o oratenene ankonye korwa ase abakori ebibe?
Onye Omonene atankonyete, omoyo one nigo orenge gocha kobeera ase obokiriru bw’amakweri bwango.
Ekero naroche ng’a natererigwe, aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao bwa botambe nigo bwansiirete tinagwa.
Ekero enkoro yane ere nogwechanda okonge, okoremia kwao okonge nigo gokogokia omoyo one.
Inee! Abanto b’ekegambero egekorekanu mbabwatane naye? Abwo nigo bakorenta obokong’u ase okoonchorana amachiko.
Nigo bakoumokera amo omoyo bw’oyore omonyaboronge, banachera oyotari nokomocha ekina ki’ogokwa.
Korende Omonene obeire egekengero kiane egekong’u, ee, Nyasae one negetare ngotamera.
Ere nabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, na abasirie ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo; ee, Omonene, Nyasae oito, nabasirie kegima.
Inchuo, tomoterere Omonene nomogoko, inchuo, tomochengere oyore egetare ki’ogotooreka gwaito!
Inchuo, togende ase obosio bwaye ase okomoakera ng’a mbuya mono, tomochengere namatera ay’ogotogia!
Naki Omonene nere Nyasae ore omonene, nere Omoruoti omonene obuete chinyasae chionsi.
Ere nigo abwatete amakura ’ense ase okoboko kwaye, naboigo nebitunwa ebitambe bire ebiaye.
Enyancha neyaye, ekiagera nere oyetongete, okoboko kwaye nakwo kwabombete ense enyomo.
Inchuo, twekumbe ase obosio bw’Omonene, totung’ame asare, ekiagera nere ototongete.
Ere nere Nyasae oito, na intwe nigo tore abanto b’oborisia bwaye, nigo tore ching’ondi chire ase oborendi bwaye. Naki yare koba buya onye rituko ria rero mwategerera eriogi riaye!
Timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino, buna abakoro bakorete aaria Meriba; na buna bakorete ase rituko riria aaria Masa agwo ase erooro.
Aaria chisokoro chiaino nigo chianteemete, nonya chiaroche emeremo yane nigo chiandengete.
Ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, nigo nagechetigwe nekiaare keria, ngateba, “Abanto aba nabasareku ase chinkoro chiabo ime, tibaraareti chinchera chiane.”
Ase ayio ngatiana ase endamwamu yane ng’a tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane.
Moterere Omonene ogotera okoyia, aye ense yonsi, moterere Omonene!
Moterere Omonene, motogie erieta riaye, mobe mokoraria ogotooreka kwaye rituko ase rituko.
Raria obonene bwaye ase egati y’ebisaku, na ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia ase abanto bonsi!
Omonene nigo are omonene mono, goika atogigwe, goika airokwe goetania chinyasae chinde.
Chinyasae chionsi chi’abanto b’ebisaku nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa rioka, korende Omonene nere otongete igoro chionsi.
Ogosikwa na obonene nigo bire ase obosio bwaye, chinguru na oboseera nigo bire ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu.
Inwe abe chiamate chi’abanto, togia Omonene! Motogie ase obonene bwaye na okobua kwaye.
Mobake Omonene ase obonene bw’erieta riaye, moche ase chigoora chiaye, morentane ebiegwa.
Mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu! Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, mobe mokoiguswa ase obosio bwaye.
Tebia abanto bonsi b’ebisaku, “Omonene nere okogamba. Ense nigo eteneine bokong’u, tekonyegerigwa. Omonene nanachere abanto ekina atari gwanchereria.”
Tiga igoro chibe nomogoko, tiga enyancha echenge ase okoeera, amo na bionsi ebire ime yaye!
Emegondo echenge amo nebinto bionsi bire ime yabo! Erio emete yonsi ye rinani netere nomogoko
ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ngocha are, ee, ngocha are konachera ense ekina. Nigo aranachere ense ekina ase oboronge, na anachere abanto ekina ase obwegenwa.
Omonene nere omoruoti. Aye ense, goka! Na inwe ebisinka ebinge, chenga!
Amare na omosunte ekerima nigo bimoetanaine; oboronge na ekeene nabio bire oboroso bw’ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.
Omorero nigo otang’aine bosio bwaye, oro nigo ogosamba ababisa baye abwo bamoetanaine.
Okomesa kwaye gwe chinkoba nigo gokomoreka ense eye; ense nigo ekorora okomesa okwo yatengechigwa.
Ebitunwa nigo bikonyititoka buna obochoe ase obosio bw’Omonene, ee, ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’ense yonsi.
Igoro chionsi nigo chikoraria oboronge bwaye, na abanto bonsi barora obonene bwaye.
Abanto bonsi abagosasima emegwekano nigo bagosookigwa, ee, abwo bagwetogeria emegwekano y’ogosasimwa ere bosa; inwe chinyasae chionsi, tung’ama ase obosio bwaye.
Abanto ba Sayoni nigo bakoigwa ayio bagoka, na ab’emechie ya Yuda bachenga, ekiagera aye Nyasae kwanachire ebina.
Aye Omonene, naye ore omonene goetania ense yonsi, aye kwaimokererigwe igoro kobua chinyasae chionsi.
Inwe abamwanchete Omonene, gecha obobe! Ere nigo akorenda emioyo y’abachenu baye; nigo akobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.
Oborabu nigo bokomochera oyore omoronge, na omogoko obachera abare ne chinkoro chindonge.
Inwe mwensi abamore abaronge, goka ase Omonene, moake ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riaye richenu.
Moterere Omonene ogotera okoyia, ekiagera okorire amang’ana ay’ogokumia; obuire nokoboko kwaye gw’okorio, ee, nokoboko kwaye ogochenu.
Omonene okorire ogotooreka kwaye komanyekane, oorokirie oboronge bwaye ase amasio ’abanto b’ebisaku;
oinyoire obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe, na obwegenwa bwaye, obwo aorogetie ase Abaisraeli. Chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense chiarorire ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito.
Aye ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omogoko ase Omonene, tera ogotera kw’omogoko na motogie ase amariogi amanene.
Terera Omonene ase okobugia amakano, ee, ase okobugia amakano tera namariogi amaya.
Moake amariogi ’omogoko ase Omonene ore omoruoti ase okobugia ebirombeta na ebitureri.
Tiga enyancha ebe ekoruma amo nebinto bionsi bire ime yaye, boigo nense na abanto bonsi bamenyeteo.
Chindooche tiga chiake chinkobi, na ebitunwa tiga bitere nomogoko amo,
ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ngocha are konachera ense ekina. Ere nanachere ense ekina ase oboronge, na abanto nabanachere ekina atari gwanchereria.
Omonene nere okogamba! Ase ayio, abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakoiguswa. Omonene nigo amenyete nobonene bwaye igoro y’abakerubi, na ense nigo egotengechigwa.
Omonene nigo are omonene ase Sayoni, oimokererigwe igoro kobua abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
Abanto bonsi tiga batogie erieta riaye rinene na eri’okoirokia. Ere nigo are omochenu.
Aye omoruoti ore nokobua, nigo bwanchete ekeene, aye gwakorire oboronge botenene bokong’u, nigo okonacha ebina bi’ekeene na oboronge ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo.
Moimokererie Omonene, Nyasae oito, igoro, mosasime agwo ase egeteni kiaye ki’amagoro! Ere nigo are omochenu.
Musa na Haroni nigo barenge abamo b’abakuani b’Omonene, boigo Samweli nigo arenge oyomo bw’abanto barenge korangeria erieta riaye. Abanto abwo nigo barangeretie Omonene ng’a abakonye, nere akabaigwa.
Nigo akwanete nabarabwo, ore ime ase riire. Abanto abwo nigo babwatete oborori bwaye, na amachiko abaete.
Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo kwaigwete abanto baria, nigo kwarenge Nyasae, kwarenge kobaabera, nonya naboigo nigo kwarenge kobaa egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo okobe.
Moimokererie Omonene, Nyasae oito, igoro! Inchuo mosasimere ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo are omochenu.
Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, moterere Omonene more nomochengo!
Mokorere Omonene more nomogoko, moche ase obosio bwaye na komoterera amatera ’omochengo!
Manya ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae. Nere ototongete, na intwe nabaye tore; nigo tore abanto baye, ne ching’ondi chie riicho riaye.
Soa ase ebiita biaye na komoakera ng’a mbuya mono, soa ase chigoora chiaye na komotogia! Moakere ng’a mbuya mono, motogie erieta riaye!
Naki Omonene nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nobwa kare na kare, na obwegenwa bwaye nigo bogendererete ebiaare ase ebiaare.
Nintere igoro y’amabera ao na oboronge bwao; ningoterere aye Omonene.
Nigo nganetie na korenda enchera y’oboronge. Inee! Ndiriri orache asende? Nigo nganetie imbe norogendo ororonge ase enyomba yane imenyete.
Tinkobeka ase obosio bwane ing’ana rinde rionsi ri’obobe; nigo ngechete ogokora kw’abanto bagotiga obwegenwa, tinkonyara kobwatwa ne chingencho chiabo.
Nimbeere aare korwa ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chi’obokorekanu, ring’ana rinde rionsi ri’obobe ribe aare nainche.
Ninsirie omonto okona‐gokwana bobe omonto onde bobisi, tinkoremereria omonto omoenenu na omweanchi.
Amaiso aane narigereretie abegenwa bare ase ense, abwo mbamenye amo nainche. Omonto okobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge, oyio nabe ogonkorera.
Omonto okwenaria obong’ainereria takomenya ase enyomba yane, oyo ogoteba oborimo takobeera ase obosio bwane.
Kera emambia nimbe ngosiria abakori amabe bonsi abare ase ense, nindusie abakori ebibe bonsi korwa ase omochie bw’Omonene.
Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane; ekerero kiane tiga geike asore.
Tobaisa kobisa obosio bwao korwa asende ase engaki inde nemechando, integerere onyigwe, ong’iranerie bwango ase rituko ngokorangeria.
Amatuko ’obogima bwane nigo agoeta bwango na gosira buna erioki, amauga ’omobere one nigo akoyia buna omorero bw’amakara.
Enkoro yane yaakirwe yabeire buna obonyansi bwagekirwe na kwoma; nigo nkweba koria endagera yane,
ekiagera nigo ngendererete korera na kweumia, amauga ’omobere one abwatanire ne chinyama chi’omobere one.
Inche nigo inga buna etekere ere ase erooro, gose buna enyakweumia etigarete komenya aase amaturi.
Tindi korara chitoro; nigo inga buna enyoni etigarete yoka kerama igoro.
Ababisa baane nigo bagonchecheria omobaso boira; abwo bangechete, kobakoragereria nigo bagwatora erieta riane.
Nigo nkoria ribu buna nkoria endagera, na ekenyugwa kiane nigo ngokeburukania namariga,
ekiagera kwabeire nekeririanda na endamwamu asende. Aye kwambwatire na gwantugutire gochia aare.
Amatuko aane nigo agoeta buna omorengari o mogoroba; nasusanire buna obonyansi.
Korende aye Omonene nigo ore omogambi goika kare na kare; erieta riao nigo rigendererete ase ebiaare bionsi.
Aye noimokerere igoro ororere Sayoni amabera; ekiagera eye nero engaki y’okoywancha; ee, engaki eria yachigetwe yaikire.
Abasomba bao nigo banchete amagena aye, na nigo bare namabeebe ase orotu rwaye.
Ebisaku bionsi mbiiroke erieta ri’Omonene, na abaruoti bonsi b’ense mbairoke obonene bwaye.
Omonene naagache Sayoni naende, nere orarorekane aroro ore ase obonene bwaye.
Nabe okoigwa ogosaba kw’abanto batigirwe bosa, tagochaya ogosorora kwabo.
Amang’ana ayio tiga arikwe agachwe ase engencho y’ekiaare kegochi‐gocha, erinde abanto abwo bataraiborwa, nabarabwo bache gotogia Omonene.
Korwa aaria igoro aase aye aachenu Omonene nigo arigereretie gocha aa, ee, nigo arigereretie gocha ase ense,
erinde aigwe okweumia kw’abasibwa, na gosibora abwo konya banacheirwe ekina ki’ogokwa.
Erio abanto banyare koraria erieta ri’Omonene ase Sayoni, na ogotogigwa kwaye agwo Yerusalemu,
ekero ekio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi mbasangererekane amo namaruoti ase ogosasima Omonene.
Ere okeeirie chinguru chiane konde ase orogendo, bweng’eirie amatuko aane.
Nigo ngoteba, “Aye Nyasae one, takondusia aiga ekero inde ase egati‐gati y’obogima bwane. “Omonene, aye nigo oreo kare na kare, ase ebiaare bionsi.
Agwo kare nigo kwabegete oboroso bw’ense, na igoro chionsi nigo chire emeremo y’amaboko ao.
Echio chionsi nchisirigwe, korende aye nigo oreo kare na kare, echio chionsi nchigote buna eanga, ekiagera aye nigo ogochionchoreria buna eanga ekoonchorerigwa, ee, nigo chirasirigwe kegima.
Korende aye naye oria oria, na emiaka yao tekoba nomoerio.
Abana b’abasomba bao mbamenye ase oborendi obuya, ne chinderia chiabo chigenderere komenya ase obosio bwao.”
Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, na bionsi ebire ime yane bitogie erieta riaye richenu.
Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, tobaisa kweba obuya bwaye bwonsi agokoreire.
Nere ogokwabera ebibe biao bionsi, na kogwenia amarwaire ao onsi.
Nigo akobooria obogima bwao korwa ase embeera na gokobekera egutwa y’obwanchani bogendererete botambe amo namabera.
Ere nigo agoisanekia okogania kwao namaya, erinde otigara koba omosae buna ekeongo kegwekerora.
Omonene nere okorua oboronge na ekeene ase abwo bonsi bagokorerwa bobe.
Nere omanyekanetie chinchera chiaye ase Musa, naboigo nogokora kwaye ase Abaisraeli.
Omonene nigo are omonyene amabera na obuya, tari omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, nigo are nobwanchani botari koera.
Ere tari kona‐gotogonyera ase chingaki chionsi, gose takogenderera kogacha endamwamu yaye botambe.
Omonene tari gotokorera aya togwenerete ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, gose tari gotoa egesusuro koreng’ana nobobe bwaito.
Koreng’ana buna igoro ere aare mono korwa ase ense, naboigo obwanchani bwaye bore obonene ase abanto bamoirogete.
Naende koreng’ana buna moocha ere aare mono korwa bosongo, naboigo Omonene akorusia ebibe biaito korwa asetore biabeera aare.
Koreng’ana buna ise abana akoba namabera asebare, naboigo n’Omonene akoba namabera ase abwo bamoirogete.
Ere nigo amanyete buna totongire, nigo akoinyora ng’a nigo tore orotu bosa.
Amatuko ’omonto nigo anga buna obonyansi, omonto nigo akoba buna egesicha gekoreereta ase omogondo;
ekero omwaga ogocha, okerusiao giasira pi, aase aye tari komanya ng’a nkiarengeo.
Korwa kare goika kare na kare obwanchani bw’Omonene nigo bore ase abwo bamoirogete, na oboronge bwaye nigo borabe ase chinderia chiabo
ase abwo bakobwata okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, naende bakoinyora amachiko aye na koyaigwera.
Omonene nigo abegete ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene aaria igoro, na oboruoti bwaye nigo bokogambera onsi.
Inwe abamalaika b’Omonene, motogie; inwe abamore ne chinguru chinene na mogokora aya agochika ekero mwaigure eriogi rie ring’ana riaye.
Togia Omonene, inwe emeganda yaye yonsi, na inwe abasomba baye, aba mogokora ogwancha kwaye!
Togia Omonene, inwe ebitongwa biaye bionsi, motogie aande onsi ase akogamba. Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene!
Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene! Omonene, Nyasae one, aye nigo ore omonene mono; nigo bweboetie ogosikwa na obonene.
Aye nigo bwetubete oborabu buna ogwetuba egetambaa gi’okwambara, kwaramboire igoro buna eema eramboire.
Aye nigo bwarete emiaro y’obomenyo bwao ase amache, gwakorire amare abeire egari yao, nigo ogoeta kore ase chimbaba chi’embeo.
Gwakorire abamalaika bao babeire chimbeo, na abasomba bao babeire ebibemberi bi’omorero.
Aye nigo otenenetie ense bokong’u igoro ase amaroso aye, tebaisa konyegerigwa nonya ng’ake.
Nigo kwayetubete chindiba buna eanga egotuba, amache akabeera igoro ase ebitunwa.
Ekero gwatogonyerete amache ayio, nigo atamete, na ekero aigwete eriogi riao ri’okogukura, nigo aayererete agatama.
Agatiira gochia ebitunwa igoro, na agatirimboka gochia ase amakura inse, agaika aase kwayachikerete.
Nigo kwabegete chimbebe aase amache atanyare goetania, erinde tabaisa gotuba ense yonsi naende.
Nigo ogotubokia chinsoko ase amagoko, amache aba agoeta ase egati y’ebitunwa.
Chinsoko echio nigo chikoa ching’iti chionsi amache chianywa, ne chitigere chi’orosana nigo chikoyanywa, na erang’o yasira.
Chinyoni nigo chikomenya ang’e na chirochio, nigo chikoba chigotera ekero chigwete ase chinsagia chi’emete.
Korwa agwo igoro ase omenyete, nigo ogotweria ebitunwa embura, na ense nigo egoisaneka nokwama kw’emeremo yao.
Nigo okomeria obonyansi ching’iti chikorisia, naende kwanyorera abanto ebimeri bagokorera, na igo kwabanyorera chindagera korwa ase riroba.
Abanto nigo bakonywa edivai na baba nomogoko; nigo bakweaka amaguta, bagirigenta amasio abo, naende baria endagera, erinde emebere yabo yanyora chinguru.
Emete y’Omonene nigo egoisaneka namache, ee, emecharake ya Lebanoni, eyio Omonene asimegete.
Chinyoni nigo chikoagacha ebiswa biabo ase emete eyio, amaagonga nigo akoagacha ebiswa biabo aroro ase emetarakwa.
Ebitunwa ebitambe nabio bire obomenyo bwe chimbori chi’orosana, emienya y’ebitare nero obotamero bw’ebisengi.
Aye kwabekire omotienyi obeire ekemanyererio gie chingaki, na erioba nigo rimanyete boronge ekero rigwenerete kogwa.
Aye nigo okorenta omosunte bwaba botuko, erio ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana chiachaka gotaara.
Chindo chinsae nigo chikoronya ekero chigotwara, chiarigia endagera yabo korwa ase Nyasae.
Ekero erioba rigochia kooroka chiairana, chiagenda korara ase amakuruma abo.
Mwanyabanto nigo bakogenda ase emeremo yabo, bayekora goika mogoroba.
Aye Omonene, naki ogokora kwao kore okonene! Okwo gwonsi nigo okogokora nobong’aini, ense nigo eichire nebitongwa biao.
Enyancha nero enene naende engare; nigo eichire nebitongwa bire moyo bitari kobareka, ebike na ebinene.
Chimeeri nao chigoeta, na Leviatani, eng’iti eria enene y’okwoboyia gwatongete, ekonagoswenenao.
Ebitongwa ebio bionsi naye bisemeretie, erio oe kera ekemo endagera yaye ase engaki egwenerete.
Ekero kwabieire endagera, nigo bikoyesangereria; ekero kwaramboire okoboko kwao, nigo bigoisaneka nebinto bire ebiya.
Ekero kwabisire obosio bwao, nigo bikoba nobwoba obonene; na ekero okobiura omoika obo, nigo bigokwa, biairana ase amaroba ime.
Ekero ogotoma omoika oo, nigo bigotongwa, naende gwakora ense yaba enyia.
Tiga obonene bw’Omonene bogenderere kobao kare na kare; Omonene tiga agokere emeremo yaye.
Ere nigo akorigereria ense, nero yatengecha, nigo agokuna ebitunwa, na birobio biasokia erioki.
Ninterere Omonene ase obogima bwane bwonsi, nimbe ngotera ase ogotogia Nyasae one ekero inde moyo.
Tiga Omonene agokigwe nebirengererio ebio biane, ekiagera inche nigo ngogete asare.
Abanyabibe tiga basirigwe korwa ase ense, abakori amabe tibabaisa kobao. Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, Motogie Omonene!
Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, rangeria erieta riaye ase ogokonywa, tebia abanto b’ebisaku ogokora kwaye.
Terera Omonene, moterere amatera ay’okomotogia, raria ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia!
Etogerie erieta riaye richenu, abanto bonsi abakorigia Omonene basasoke ase chinkoro chiabo.
Rigia Omonene amo ne chinguru chiaye, morigie obosio bwaye botambe.
Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Ibrahimu, omosomba bw’Omonene, ee, inwe abanto ba Yakobo, abachore b’Omonene, inyora emeremo y’ogokumia, eria akorire, inyora ebikone biaye, na ebina biaye bi’ekeene arure.
Ere nere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebina biaye nigo bire ase ense yonsi.
Botambe nigo akoinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, boigo goika ebiare elifu eyemo nigo akoinyora ring’ana achigete,
na okobwatana koria gw’ogotianania akorete na Ibrahimu, na eira yaye y’ogotianania amorierete Isaka.
Okobwatana okwo akagokong’ia gokaba ogochika ase Yakobo, ee, ase Israeli okobwatana gwa kare na kare,
akamotebia, “Ninkoe ense ya Kanani ebe egetari oraire kebe omwando oo.”
Ase engaki eria nigo barenge abanto abake ase omobaro, bakabarwa ng’a tibaisaini gento; nigo barenge abaeti ase ense eyio.
Bakaba bagoetanana korwa ase egesaku ekemo gochia ase ekende, na korwa ase oboruoti obomo gochia ase obonde.
Nyasae tatigete abanto bande babachande; agatogonyera abaruoti ase engencho yabo,
agateba, “Timobaisa gokuna abaakwa amaguta baane, gose timokorera ababani baane bobe.”
Ekero Omonene arentete enchara ase ense, na asiretie chindagera chiabo chionsi,
konya otomire omonto agwo ritang’ani, nere Yusufu konya oonigwe obeire omosomba.
Nigo asibetwe chingatare chigasionora amagoro aye, naende akabekerwa eteyo y’ekioma ase rigoti riaye,
goika ayabanete agaikerana. Ase ayio ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaenekia ng’a Yusufu nomoronge.
Omoruoti agatoma abanto bakamosibora, ee, oyorenge omogambi bw’abanto akamosibora.
Akamobeka akaba omoteneneri bw’enyomba yaye, amo nebinto bionsi abwate,
erinde abe ogotebereria abanene b’oboruoti boria buna anchete, na kworokereria abagaaka baye b’oboruoti chisemi.
Erio Abaisraeli bagacha Misiri; Yakobo akaba omomenyi ase ense ya Hamu.
Omonene agasesenia abanto abwo bakabucha mono, naende bakaba ne chinguru chinyinge kobua abachandi babo.
Omonene akaonchora chinkoro chi’Abamisiri, erinde bakagecha abanto baye, erio bagakorera abasomba b’Omonene amabe ay’obong’ainereria.
Omonene agatoma Musa, omosomba oye, na Haroni, oyio konya achorire.
Barabwo bakaorokia ebimanyererio ase egati y’abanto, bagakora ebikone agwo ase ense ya Hamu.
Omonene agatoma omosunte, na ense eria ekamwama ti. Barabwo tibangete koigwera amang’ana aye.
Akaonchora amache abo akaba amanyinga, na ayio akagera chinswe chiabo chigakwa.
Ebioro bigacha bigaichora ase ense yabo nonya nase ebinyomba bi’okorara bi’abagambi babo.
Omonene agakwana, ne chingi chinyinge mono chigacha, ne chinsona boigo ase ense eria yonsi.
Akarenta amagena ’embura ribaga ri’embura, chinkoba chikamesa aande onsi ase ense eria.
Agasaria emesabibu na emeko yabo, emete y’ense eria ekabunwa.
Agakwana, ne chingige chigacha, chirochio chikabiara chikaba chinyinge,
chikaria chigakoora ebimeri bi’ense eria, boigo chikaria okwama kwe riroba riabo.
Omonene agaita abana abatangi bonsi ase ense eria, ne ching’iti chintangi, ogotongora gwe chinguru chiabo chionsi.
Erio Omonene akang’anyia Abaisraeli korwa aroro bare ne chifeta ne chitahabu, monto onde tarenge ase abanto baye oborire chinguru.
Abamisiri nigo babete nomogoko ekero Abaisraeli bang’anyete, ekiagera obwoba konya bwabagwereire ase engencho y’Abaisraeli.
Omonene akarambora riire rigatuba abanto baye, na omorero okaba okobamorekera botuko.
Ekero baboretie eki bakoria, ere agatoma chinkware, boigo akabaigotia nendagera korwa igoro.
Akabochora egetare, na amache agasoka korwao, akaminyoka ase erooro buna orooche.
Omonene akainyora eira eria enchenu ariete, boigo akainyora Ibrahimu, omosomba oye.
Ase igo akang’anyia abanto baye korwa ase ense eria bakaba bagochenga, abanto abwo baye achorete bakaba bagotera nomogoko.
Akabaa chinse chi’abanto b’ebisaku chikaba echiabo, akabaa nebinto abanto abwo konya bechandeire.
Ayio nigo akoregete, erinde Abaisraeli baigwere emeroberio yaye echikire, naende barende amachiko aye. Motogie Omonene!
Motogie Omonene! Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ning’o oranyare goteba ogokora okonene kw’Omonene, gose koraria obonene bwaye bwonsi?
Mbasesenirie abanto abwo bagokora ekeene, abwo bagokora oboronge ase chingaki chionsi.
Omonene, ong’inyore ekero okororera abanto bao amabera, onchichere, ontoorie!
Erio inyare korora amaya abanto bao abachore baranyore, na inche inyare kogokera omogoko bw’abanto bao, naende inyare gwetogia amo nabanto bare omwando oo.
Intwe twakorire ebibe buna chisokoro chiaito chiakorete; twakorire ayare amabe mono, ee, twakorire ayare amabe.

Ekero chisokoro chiaito chiarenge Misiri, tichiarengereretie igoro y’emeremo yao y’ogokumia; tichiainyorete obwanchani bwao obonge bogendererete botambe, korende chigasaria asore aaria ase Enyancha Embariri.
Nonya naboigo Omonene akabatooria ase engencho y’erieta riaye, ng’a anyare komanyekania okobua kwaye okonene.
Nigo atogonyerete Enyancha eria Embariri egakamoka, erio agaetia Abaisraeli aroro buna nase ense enyomo.
Naboigo Omonene akabatooria korwa ase amaboko ay’ababagechete na kobabooria korwa ase chinguru chi’ababisa babo.
Amache akamera kegima abachandi baria babo; onde tatigarete ore moyo nonya noyomo.
Erio bakegena ring’ana ri’Omonene, agwo bagatera ase okomotogia.
Korende ase obwango bakeba ogokora kwaye, tibaganyete Omonene abasemie.
Barabwo nigo babete nobotoonu bw’okogania endagera. Bagateema Nyasae agwo ase erooro.
Ere akabaa egento baboretie baegwe, korende akabatomera oborwaire bw’okobareyia.
Ekero abanto b’egetwori babete ne ribero ase Musa, na ase Haroni, oyio orenge omochenu o Nyasae,
riroba rikabwereka rikamera Datani, na rikamumekeria abanto b’ekeombe ki’Abiiramu.
Boigo omorero ogatuboka agwo ase egati y’ekeombe kiabo, ekebemberi ki’omorero kegasamba abakori amabe baria.
Abanto bakaroisia omogwekano bw’emori agwo Horebu, erio bagasasima omogwekano oria obombire.
Barabwo bakaonchoreria oyorenge obonene bwabo, bakaonchokera omogwekano bw’eng’ombe ekorisia obonyansi.
Bakeba Nyasae, Omotooria obo, oria okorete amang’ana amanene aaria Misiri;
oria okorete ogokora kw’ogokumia ase ense ya Hamu, naende agakora amang’ana ay’okoondokia aaria ase Enyancha Embariri.
Ase ayio Omonene akarengereria ng’a abasirie, korende Musa, omochore oye, agatenena ase obosio bwaye buna omobwatania, ase ogotanga endamwamu yaye teita abanto.
Abanto bagachaya ense eria yarenge engiya, ekiagera tibegenete eira y’Omonene.
Ekero barenge ase chiema chiabo ime nigo bemurunganetie, tibaigwera eriogi ri’Omonene.
Ase ayio akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro yabo, agatiana ng’a abatige bakwere agwo ase erooro,
naende ng’a asiarere abanto b’ororeria rwabo, bagende komenya ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ase chinse ao ao.
Abaisraeli bakabwatana na Baali, enyasae ya Peori, bakaria ebing’wanso biarenge koruegwa ase chinyasae chitari moyo.
Ase igo ogokora okwo kwabo gokagechia Omonene goika akaba nendamwamu, na oborwaire bogoita bogatuboka ase egati yabo.
Erio Finehasi agatenena agaakanera amabe ayio akoretwe, na oborwaire boria bogatiga goita abanto.
Ase engencho y’ogokora okwo Finehasi akabarwa ng’a nomonyene oboronge aare, ebiaare ase ebiaare kogenderera botambe.
Abanto bakagechia Omonene agwo ase amache a Meriba, na ase engencho yabo Musa agasoa ase emechando.
Nigo bagechetie enkoro ya Musa, goika agakwana amang’ana nobororo, ase ogotarengereria buya.
Abaisraeli tibaitete basirie kegima abanto b’ebisaku, buna Omonene konya achikire.
Korende nigo basang’ananete nabanto abwo bakeorokereria ogokora kwabo.
Nigo bakorerete emegwekano yabo baare gosasima, na eyio ekaba amareba asebare.
Barabwo nigo baruete abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, bakaba ebing’wanso ase ebirecha.

Bagaitera amanyinga ’abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, abatari na komocha, abwo baruete bakaba ebing’wanso ase emegwekano bagasasima ase ense ya Kanani; na ense eria ekaba eyetachenegeti ase engencho y’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ayio.
Ase ayio abanto abwo bagesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo, bagakora obonyaka tibaba abegenwa.
Erio Omonene akaba nendamwamu ase abanto baye, na akagechigwa nabanto bare omwando oye.
Akababeka ase amaboko ’abanto b’ebisaku, erinde abanto abwo babagechete bakaba bakobagambera.
Ababisa babo bakabakorera bobe, bakababua bakababeka inse y’obogambi bwabo.
Ase chingaki chinyinge Omonene nigo arenge kobatooria, korende ase ogosemania kwabo bagachora gosaria asare: ase igo bakaba bagochandeka mono ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.
Nonya naboigo nabechanderete ase emechando yabo, akaigwa ekerero kiabo.
Ase engencho yabo nigo ainyorete okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, akabarorera amabeebe, ekiagera are nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.
Nigo agerete abwo babagoosete bakabarorera amabera.
Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, totoorie; tosangererie amo, otorusie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, erio tonyare gotogia erieta riao richenu, na gochengera obonene bwao.
Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe korwa kare goika kare na kare; na abanto bonsi pi batebe, “Amina.” Togia Omonene!
Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Abanto abwo Omonene abooretie tiga bakwane igo, abwo abooririe korwa ase okoboko kw’omochandi.
Obasangereirie obarentire korwa ase chinse ao ao, korwa moocha na bosongo, na korwa sugusu na irianyi.
Abanto abwo nigo babete bakonagoetanana ase erooro enyomo, tibanyorete mochie onde ase baare komenya.
Nigo babete nenchara na erang’o goika bakerusia moyo.
Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.
Akabaraa ase enchera endonge, goika akabaikia ase omochie banyarete komenya.
Tiga abanto baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akobakorera mwanyabanto.
Omonene nigo agoisanekia oyore nerang’o, na oyore nenchara omoigotia namaya.
Abanto nigo bamenyete ase omosunte na ase ekiriri ki’amakweri, nigo basibire ase emechando, basibeire chingataare,
ekiagera bangete koigwera ring’ana ria Nyasae, bagachaya ogosemia kw’Oyore Igoro Mono.
Agakanya chinkoro chiabo ase okobaa obokong’u, bakaiyerigwa inse, na monto onde tarengeo okobakonya.
Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.
Akabarusia korwa ase omosunte ekerima, akabutora chingataare basibeire.
Tiga baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe, na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akoreire mwanyabanto.
Ere nigo abunete ebisiekero bie chitaai, na akabuna emekorogoto y’ebioma ekaba ebing’ese.
Abande bakaririeka, ekiagera babwatetie enchera y’ogosareka, na bakaba bagochandeka ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.
Kera endagera ekaba engundo asebare, bakaba ang’e gosoa ase ebiita bi’amakweri.
Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.
Akabatomera ring’ana riaye, akabagwenia, akabatooria korwa ase chimbeera.
Tiga baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe, na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akoreire mwanyabanto.
Tiga barue ebing’wanso bi’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende bararie ogokora kwaye ase ogotera nomogoko.
Abwo bagendete ne chimeeri ase enyancha, bagakora oboonchoreria ase chinyancha chinene,
mbaaroche ogokora kw’Omonene, ee, ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia ime ase chindiba.
Ere agachika ekembugu‐mbugu gekaimoka, kerokio gekaimokereria igoro emerindo y’enyancha,
Emerindo eyio ekaimokerera igoro, naende ekairana inse, na ase ayio abanto bakerusia moyo ase omoichano.
Bakaba bakoong’anya na gotabataba buna abanto batindire, na obong’aini bwabo bwonsi bokabaerera.
Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yabo, nere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.
Agachika ekembugu‐mbugu keria, kegakira‐kiri, na emerindo y’enyancha egatoerera.
Erio bakaba nomogoko, ekiagera banyorete obotoereru, na Omonene akabaikia ase ekiambokero keria baganetie.
Tiga baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe, na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akoreire mwanyabanto.
Tiga babake Omonene agwo ase omosangererekano bw’abanto, bamotogie nase abagaaka bagoikaransa kogamba.
Omonene akaonchora chindooche chikaba erooro, ne chinsoko chikaba ense enyomo.
Akaonchora na ense ere entobu ekaba ekerubo ki’omonyo, ase engencho y’obobe bw’abanto bamenyeteo.
Boigo akaonchora erooro ekaba ritibo riichire amache, na ense enyomo egatuboka chinsoko chi’amache.
Aroro agwo nigo arentete abanto bare nenchara; barabwo bakaagacha omochie aroro bakamenyao.
Barabwo nigo bakobusura emegondo, naende basimeka emesabibu, bakanyora okwama okonene mono.
Omonene akabasesenia bakabucha mono, tatigete omobaro bwe chitugo chiabo okee.
Ekero bakeetigwe na kworoba ase engencho y’ogokorerwa bobe na gochandwa,
Omonene agachaya abanene baria babachandete, bakaba bakoong’anya ase chirooro chitari ne chinchera.
Korende ere nigo akorusia abaremeire korwa ase emechando, na obuchia chiamate chiabo chiaba buna amaicho.
Abanyaboronge nigo bakorora amang’ana ayio na bagoka mono; korende abakori amabe nigo bagokira‐kiri baumata.
Omonto onde bwensi ore omong’aini, tiga aigwe amang’ana aya, tiga arengererie mono amanye obwanchani bw’Omonene bogendererete botambe.
Aye Nyasae, enkoro yane nigo ere noboremu! Nintere na gochenga! Omoyo one bwonsi, boka!
Inwe amakano aane onsi, boka! Nainche nimboke mambia chuni.
Aye Omonene, ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono ase egati y’abanto, nimbe ngotera amatera ay’okogotogia ase egati y’ebisaku.
Amabera ao nigo are amanene aigete aaria igoro, obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete igoro ase amare.
Aye Nyasae, oorokie ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi. Tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.
Intoorie nokoboko kwao gw’okorio na oigwe aya nkogosaba.
Nyasae orire eira korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, ogoteba, “Ase omochengo ninyatanane Sekemu, na ense omweya ya Sukoti inyiate chincherere.
Gileadi neyane, na Manase neyane; Efraimu nekegogwa kiane gi’ekioma, na Yuda nenyimbo yane y’obogambi.
Moabu negetaabo kiane ngoisabera, nindute egekoroto kiane igoro ase Edomu, ning’ake eriogi ri’okobua igoro y’ense y’Abafilisti.”
Ning’o orandaae ansoyie ase omochie ogiteire chindwaki? Ning’o orantang’ane gochia Edomu?
Aye Nyasae, Inee, ngwatotigire kegima? Aye tori kogenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.
Tokonye, torwanie ababisa baito tobabue, ekiagera ogokonywa gokorwa ase mwanyabanto mbosa.
Ekero tore amo na Nyasae, inatokore amang’ana amanene, nere orabue ababisa baito na kobatiringera inse.
Aye Nyasae ningotogie, tobaisa gokira‐kiri.
Abakori amabe abare abang’ainereria nigo bagokwana igoro yane, ee, nigo bagokwana oborimo igoro yane.
Bang’etananire bagokwana amang’ana ’obogechi, nigo bakondwania engencho ende etaiyo.
Nonya inche mbanchete, barabwo nigo bangechete, ee, nonya ngendererete kobasabera.
Nigo bakong’akana amabe ase amaya aane na kongecha ase obwanchani bwane.
Chora omonto omobe agambere omobisa one, na tiga oria omosoeri atenene ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio amosoere.
Ekero agambigwe ekina, tiga abarerwe okomocha, nonya nogosaba kwaye kobarwe ng’a nebibe.
Amatuko aye tiga abe amake, na oboteneneri bwaye omoao aboire.
Tiga abana baye batigwe bare chintakana, na omokungu oye atigwe ore omoboraka.
Abana baye babe bakoombogana na kona‐gosaberera, bagende kona‐korigia endagera aare korwa ase amaturi bamenyete.
Tiga abamoete ebinto singo bache baire ebinto biaye bionsi; abanto abaao bache basakore ebi bakorerete emeremo emekong’u.
Monto onde tabaisa koba omuya asare, gose onde taba namabera ase abana baye bare chintakana.
Tiga ororeria rwaye rosirigwe, na erieta riaye riebwe kegima ase ekiare gia kabere.
Ebibe bie chisokoro chiaye biinyorwe ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ebibe bia ng’ina tibibaisa gotinyigwa.
Ebibe biabo tiga bigenderere kobeera ase obosio bw’Omonene botambe; na barabwo tibabaisa koinyorwa ase ense nonya ng’ake.
Omonto oyio tainyorete koorokia amabera, korende abataka, na abaremerwa, na abasionoire chinkoro chiabo, nigo abachandete goika ogokwa kwabo.
Ere nigo anchete koragereria, bono tiga okoragereria okwo komoiranere. Ere tanchete gosesenia, ase ayio ogosesenigwa kobe aare asare.
Nigo ambarerete okoragererigwa buna egoti yaye akwambara; bono tiga konywere ase omobere oye buna amache akonywera ase omobere, na buna amaguta akweakwa akonywera aika ase amauga aye.
Tiga okoragererigwa okwo kobe buna egetambaa akwambara, naende kobe buna orokini akweboeria botambe.
Tiga Omonene abaakane igo abwo bagonsoera, abwo bagokwana bobe igoro y’obogima bwane.
Korende aye Nyasae, Omonene one, ondwanerere ase engencho y’erieta riao, intoorie, ekiagera obwanchani bwao bwa botambe nigo bore obuya.
Inche nigo inde omotaka oremeire mono, na nigo inde nobororo ase enkoro yane ime.
Nigo ngoeta buna omorengari o mogoroba, nigo nkoirurukigwa buna chingige.
Amaru aborirwe chinguru ase engencho y’okweng’ata, na omobere one oreeire mono.
Nabeire omonto ogosekererwa nabansoeri; ekero bakondora, nigo bagokumia basingisia emetwe yabo.
Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, inkonye! Intoorie, ekiagera aye nigo obwate amabera amange!
Tiga abansoeri abwo bamanye ng’a aya nigo arure ase okoboko kwao. Aye Omonene, naye gwakorire aya.
Barabwo tiga bandagererie, korende aye onsesenie. Tiga abwo bagonkorera bobe barore obosooku, korende inche, omosomba oo, imbe nomogoko.
Tiga abansoeri baboigwe ogochaywa, tiga obosooku obwo bobatube buna egetambaa gi’okwambara.
Ning’iranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono kegima nomonwa one, nimbe nkona‐komotogia ase egati y’abanto abange.
Omonene nateneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’omotaka, ase okomotooria korwa ase abwo bakomonachera ekina ki’ogokwa.
Omonene agatebia Omonene one, “Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao.”
Korwa Sayoni Omonene narambore enyimbo yao y’obogambi ere nokobua, atebe, “Gamba ase egati y’ababisa bao.”
Abanto bao mberue nogwancha kwabo, ekero orasangererie abarwani bao b’esegi. Abamura bao mbache asore beboetie oboseera obochenu, buna riime ria mambia.
Omonene otianire, takoonchora ebirengererio biaye: “Aye nigo ore omokuani goika kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”
Omonene nigo ateneine ase ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio; ere nasenyente abaruoti ase rituko ri’endamwamu yaye.
Nanachere abanto b’ebisaku ekina, ense neichore nebitondo; nasenyente emetwe y’abagambi b’ense engima.
Nabe okonywa amache ’ensoko ekero are ase orogendo rwaye, ase ayio naimokererie omotwe oye igoro kabuire.
Togia Omonene! Ning’ake ng’a mbuya mono ase Omonene nenkoro yane yonsi, agwo ase omosangererekano bw’abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge.
Ogokora kw’Omonene nigo kore okonene, Abwo bagokogokera nigo bagokweorokereria erinde bakomanye.
Ogokora kw’Omonene nigo kore okw’ogosikwa okonene na obonene, na oboronge bwaye nigo bogendererete kobao goika kare na kare.
Omonene okorire ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia kobe gokoinyorwa, ere nigo are nobuya na amabera.
Nigo akoa abanto abwo bamoirogete endagera; nabe ogendererete koinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania goika kare na kare.
Oorokeirie abanto baye okobua kw’ogokora kwaye ase okobaa emiando y’abanto b’ebisaku.
Ogokora kw’amaboko aye nigo kore okw’obwegenwa na okw’oboronge, na amachiko aye onsi nay’obwegenwa.
Amachiko ayio nigo ateneine bokong’u kare na kare, aikeranigwe ase ekeene na oboronge.
Ere otomeire abanto baye okoboorigwa, na ochikire okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania kobeo goika kare na kare. Erieta riaye nigo rire richenu na eri’okoirokwa.
Okomoiroka Omonene, oyio noro omochakano bw’obong’aini, bonsi abagokora ayio nigo bare nokomanya okuya. Ogotogigwa kwaye nogwa kare na kare.
Togia Omonene! Nasesenirie omonto oyio omoirogete Omonene, na ogokirie mono koigwera amachiko aye.
Oroiboro rwaye ndobe nokobua ase ense; ekiaare ki’abare ne chinkoro chindonge ngesesenigwe.
Obotenenku na obonda mbibe ase enyomba yaye, na oboronge bwaye mbogenderere kobao botambe.
Omonene nigo ogochera abanyaboronge buna omobaso okobara ase omosunte, ore nobuya, na amabera, na oboronge.
Nasesenirie omonto ore namabera na okorua ebinto singo, boigo ogokora amang’ana aye onsi ase oboronge.
Omonyaboronge takonyegerigwa nonya ng’ake, nabe okoinyorwa kare na kare.
Takwoboa amang’ana amabe akoigwa, enkoro yaye nigo ere endemu esemeretie Omonene.
Enkoro yaye teri koirianyeka gose kwoboa, ere nigo akoremereria goika abamochandi babugwe.
Ere nigo akoa abataka ebiegwa ore nomoyo omorabu; oboronge bwaye mbogenderere kobao kare na kare; orogunchara rwaye ndokine ase ogosikwa.
Ekero omonto omonyabibe akorora ayio, nigo agoichana ogechigwa, oriania amaino aye, orea osira. Okogania kw’omonyabibe nigo kogosira.
Togia Omonene! Inwe abasomba b’Omonene, motogie, ee, togia erieta riaye!
Erieta ri’Omonene ritogigwe korwa bono goika kare na kare!
Erieta ri’Omonene ribe rigotogigwa korwa ekero erioba rikooroka goika ekero rikogwa!
Omonene nigo are omonene igoro ase ebisaku bionsi, na obonene bwaye nigo boetanaine igoro chionsi.
Ning’o onga buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, oria omenyete aaria igoro mono,
na origereretie gocha inse aa arore igoro na ense.
Nigo akoimokia omotaka korwa ase obotaka obwere, na koimokia omoremerwa korwa ase ribu,
obabeka baikaransa amo nabwo bare nokobua, baria bakogambera abanto baye.
Nigo akoa omokungu omogomba chinguru chi’okoibora, oba nomogoko ase enka yaye. Omonene atogigwe!
Ekero Abaisraeli barwete Misiri, ee, ekero abanto ba Yakobo barwete ase abanto barenge gokwana omonwa omoao,
Abayuda bakaba aase aachenu ay’Omonene, na Abaisraeli bakaba ab’obogambi bwaye.
Enyancha ekarora ayio egatama, na orooche rwa Yorodan rokanacheka, rokairana nyuma.
Ebitunwa bigachara‐charara buna chimingichi, na ebigoro buna chimanwa chie ching’ondi.
Aye enyancha, ninki kwaroche, erinde ogatama? Aye Yorodani, ninki kiabete asore, erinde okanacheka okairana nyuma?
Inwe ebitunwa, ninki kiagerete mogachara‐charara buna chimingichi, nainwe ebigoro boigo buna chimanwa chie ching’ondi?
Aye ense, tengechigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, ee, ase obosio bwa Nyasae o Yakobo.
Oyio oonchorete egetare gekaba ritibo ri’amache, ne rigena rikong’u rikaba ensoko y’amache.
Aye Omonene, intwe titobaisa gotogigwa, korende erieta riao rioka ritogigwe, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, na ase obwegenwa bwao.
Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku batakomanyeti baraborie, “Ng’ai Nyasae oyio obo are?”
Nyasae oito nigo are igoro, na nigo agokora rinde rionsi agwancha.
Emegwekano abanto abwo bagosasima nigo eroisirie korwa ase chifeta ne chitahabu, nigo ere emeremo y’amaboko a mwanyabanto.
Nigo ebwate emenwa, korende teri gokwana, nebwate amaiso, korende teri korora.
Nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, nebwate chimioro, korende teri konyonka eigwe rimisu.
Nebwate amaboko, korende teri kobwata gento, nebwate amagoro, korende teri gotaara; gose tebwati eriogi ri’ogokwana.
Abakoroisia emegwekano eyio nabo barabe buna ero ere; naboigo na baria bayiegenete.
Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.
Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Haroni, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.
Inwe abamoirogete Omonene, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.
Omonene obeire ogotoinyora, natosesenie; nasesenie Abaisraeli, nasesenie nab’ororeria rwa Haroni.
Ere nasesenie bonsi abamoirogete, nasesenie abake na abanene.
Tiga Omonene abamentekanie, inwe amo ne chinderia chiaino.
Mosesenigwe n’Omonene, oria otongete igoro na ense.
Igoro chionsi nechi’Omonene, korende ense ero oyeire mwanyabanto.
Abakure tibari gotogia Omonene, na ase abwo bagendire aase aakiriru onde tari okomotogia.
Korende intwe ntogenderere gotogia Omonene, korwa bono goika kare na kare. Motogie Omonene!
Nigo inyanchete Omonene, ekiagera oigure eriogi riane na ogosaba kwane.
Ere ontegereire onyigure, ase ayio, ekero inde moyo nimbe nkona‐komorangeria ng’a ankonye.
Ebisibo bi’amakweri nigo biang’etananete; ogoichanigwa gw’aase abakure gokambwata; nigo nabete nemechando na omoichano.
Erio nkarangeria erieta ri’Omonene, ngasaba, “Aye Omonene, tooria omoyo one.”
Omonene nigo are nobuya na oboronge; Nyasae oito nigo are omonyene amabera.
Ere nigo akorenda abanto abakanyeku; ekero nabete nemechando, nigo antooretie.
Aye omoyo one, irana obe nobotoereru, ekiagera Omonene ogokoreire amaya amange.
Aye Omonene kwarusirie omoyo one ase amakweri, gwatinyirie amariga korwa ase amaiso aane, kwarendire amagoro aane tingochiri ingwe.
Nimbe ngotaara ase obosio bw’Omonene, inde ase ense y’abanto bare moyo.
Nigo negenete, na ase engencho eyio ngakwana, “Inche nigo nchandegete mono”
na ase ogochandeka kwane ngateba, “Mwanyabanto bonsi nabanyaborimo.”
Ngento ki ndarue ing’iranerie Omonene ase engencho y’amaya aya ankoreire?
Ninyimokie egekombe ki’ogotooreka, ndangerie erieta ri’Omonene.
Ning’ikeranie chiira chiane ase Omonene agwo ase amasio ’abanto baye bonsi.
Ekero abanto abachenu b’Omonene bagokwa, amakweri ayio nigo are ay’engencho enene asare.
Omonene, inche nigo inde omosomba oo; nigo inde omosomba oo, omwana bw’omokungu ore omosomba oo. Aye gwasiboire chingataare chiansibete.
Ase ayio nindue asore ekeng’wanso ki’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende ndangerie erieta ri’Omonene nkonywe.
Ning’ikeranie chiira chiane ase Omonene agwo ase amasio ’abanto baye bonsi.
Ninchiikeranie ase chigoora chi’enyomba y’Omonene gati‐gati yao aye Yerusalemu. Omonene atogigwe!
Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, motogie Omonene! Inwe abanto bonsi, mobake!
Obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe nigo bore obonene asetore, na obwegenwa bwaye nigo bogenderete goika kare na kare. Motogie Omonene!
Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Tiga Abaisraeli batebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”

Omonene nakorende korwa ase amabe onsi, narende omoyo oo.
Omonene nakorende kogosoka na kogosoa, korwa bono na goika kare na kare.
Nigo nabete nomogoko ekero abanto bantebetie, “Inchuo, togende ase enyomba y’Omonene!”
Aye Yerusalemu, bono amagoro aito nigo ateneine aa ase ebiita biao.
Aye Yerusalemu kwaagachirwe naende, aye nomochie obwateranirie amo.
Agwo nao ebisaku bigotiira gochia, ebio bire ebisaku bi’Omonene. Abaisraeli abwo nigo bachigetwe ng’a babe bakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta ri’Omonene.
Agwo nao ebirogo bi’okonacherwa ekina bire, ebirogo bi’obonene bi’enyomba ya Daudi.
Sabera Yerusalemu, erinde obe nomorembe! Abanto abwo bagwanchete basesenigwe.
Omorembe obe ase chindwaki chiao ime, na ogosesenigwa kobe ase chinyomba chiao chi’oboruoti.
Ase engencho y’abaminto na abagisangio baane, nigo ngokoganeria omorembe.
Ase engencho y’enyomba y’Omonene Nyasae oito ninkorigerie amaya.
Ninyimokererie amaiso aane gocha asore, agwo igoro ase omenyete.
Rora buna abasomba basemeretie omonene obo, na abasomba abaiseke basemeretie omokungu ore omonene obo; naboigo naintwe tosemeretie Omonene, Nyasae oito, goika abe otororeire amabera.
Aye Omonene, otororere amabera, koranche otororere amabera, ekiagera twabeire togochecherigwa mono goetania.
Twaichoirwe necheche y’abwo beisanekerete, na ogochaywa kw’abamwenu.
Inee! Naki yare gocha koba onye Omonene atabete ase ensemo yaito? Tiga Abaisraeli bairanerie.
Onye Omonene atabete ase ensemo yaito, ekero abanto batoumokerete gotorwania,
nanga nigo batomerete gatore moyo, ekiagera babete nendamwamu enene asetore;
naende eooro nigo yarenge gocha gotokorobanania, amache nigo arenge gocha goeta igoro yaito;
ee, amache aichoreranete nigo arenge gocha gotomera kegima.
Omonene atogigwe, ekiagera tatoruete totaboranwe namaino ’abanto abwo.
Emioyo yaito yatoorekire buna enyoni egotooreka korwa ase egesugunia ki’omotegi. Egesugunia kiabutokire, naintwe twaminchoirie na gotama.
Ogokonywa gwaito nigo gokorwa ase erieta ri’Omonene, oyio otongete igoro na ense.
Abwo bamosemeretie Omonene nigo banga buna egetunwa gia Sayoni getari konyegerigwa, korende nigo kegendererete kobao botambe.
Buna ebitunwa bietanaine Yerusalemu, naboigo n’Omonene aetanaine abanto baye korwa bono na goika kare na kare.
Enyimbo y’obogambi bw’abakori amabe tekogenderera kogambera omwando bw’abanto abaronge; abwo babaise korambora amaboko abo ase ogokora amabe.
Omonene, bakorere amaya abanto abwo bare abaya, abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge!
Korende abwo bakogobera gochia ase chinchera chiabo chi’obosiru, Omonene nabarusieo amo nabagokora amabe. Omorembe obe ase Abaisraeli!
Ekero Omonene atoiraneretie intwe aba Sayoni amaya aito, nigo twabete buna nkorota tore.
Erio emenwa yaito egaichorwa namaseko, ne chimeme chiaito chigatera nomogoko. Erio abanto b’ebisaku bagatebania, “Omonene okoreire abanto abwo amang’ana amanene.”
Ee, Omonene otokoreire amang’ana amanene; ase ayio ntore nomogoko.
Aye Omonene, toiranerie amaya aito, buna okoirania chindooche ase Ense ya Irianyi.
Abwo bakobusura bare namariga mbagese bare nomochengo.
Nigo bagosoka bakoiyeria amariga, babogoretie chimbusuro gochia kobusura mbairane bare nomochengo, babogoretie emesaima yabo bagesire.
Onye Omonene takoagacha enyomba, abwo bakoyeagacha nigo bagokora emeremo ya bosa. Onye Omonene takorenda omochie omonto oyio okoyorenda nigo akorenda bosa.

Nigo ere bosa asemore koboka mambia chuni na gokora emeremo emekong’u ase okonyora endagera, naende mwanyorwa gochia korara. Korende Omonene nigo agwechandera abanto baye anchete, nonya nekero baraire chitoro.
Rora, abana nigo bare omwando okorwa ase Omonene, ekiagera oroiboro rokorwa ase enda nigo rore ekeegwa.
Abana omonto akonyora kare ne chinguru chi’oboke bwaye, nigo banga buna chinsara chire koboko kw’omorwani etuoni.
Nasesenirie omonto oyo oichoretie esaro yaye ne chinsara echio. Oyio takobugwa ekero arabe okogamberana nababisa baye agwo ase egeita.
Nasesenirie kera omonto omoirogete Omonene, naende obwatete chinchera chiaye.
Aye nobe gokonyora okwama kw’emeremo y’amaboko ao; nosesenigwe, na amang’ana onsi nigo arabe buya asore.
Mokao nabe ase enyomba yao buna omosabibu okwama amasabibu; abana bao nigo barabe buna ebisebo bi’omozeituni, baikaranse baetanane emesa yao.
Rora, naboigo omonto oria omoirogete Omonene arasesenigwe.
Omonene agosesenie korwa Sayoni! Erio orore obuya bwa Yerusalemu ase amatuko onsi ore moyo,
naende orore abachokoro bao. Omorembe obe ase Abaisraeli!
“Ababisa nigo batochandete korwa oboke bwaito.” Nabo Abaisraeli bagoteba.
“Ee, barabwo nigo batochandete korwa oboke bwaito, korende tibana‐gotobua.
Abaremi bakang’ororia emegongo yaito, bagakora emeng’ororia yabo emetambe.”
Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge, ere obutoire chingori chi’abakori amabe.
Abwo bonsi bagechete Sayoni, tiga basookigwe na koonchorwa gochia nyuma.
Barabwo tiga babe buna obonyansi bore kerama igoro, bogosusana botarakina;
tibori goichora okoboko kw’omosangereria, gose kobogwa omosaima okoboko.
Abanto bagoeta inchera tibakonyara goteba, “Omonene abasesenie!” Gose goteba, “Nkobasesenia tore inwe ase erieta ri’Omonene!”
Aye Omonene, nigo nkorera asore, korwa ase chindiba ime.
Omonene, igwa eriogi riane; tegerera oigwe eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane.
Aye Omonene, onye kware gokora omobaro bw’ebibe, ning’o ore konyara gotenena ase obosio bwao?
Korende aye nigo ore omwaberi, erinde onyare koirokwa.
Inche nigo nganyete Omonene, ee, omoyo one nigo omoganyete; nigo nsemeretie ring’ana riaye.
Omoyo one nigo oganyete Omonene, kobua abarendi baganyete ng’a bokie, ee, kobua abarendi baganyete ng’a bokie.
Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene, ekiagera Omonene nigo are nobwanchani bogendererete botambe, na ogotooreka okonge nigo gokorwa asare.
Ere naboorie Abaisraeli korwa ase ebibe biabo bionsi.
Omonene, ase enkoro yane tindi kweimokereria igoro, gose tindi omwerori. Inche tinyechandeti kwerigeria amang’ana amanene, gose ayare amakong’u mono asende.
Korende inche nigo intoereretie omoyo one; buna omwana otigire okogonka oagatire koboko kwa ng’ina, ee, naboigo omoyo one ore ime yane.
Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene korwa bono na goika kare na kare.
Aye Omonene, oinyore Daudi, ase engencho y’obokong’u bwonsi bwamonyorete.
Oinyore buna ariete eira na gotiana asore aye Omonene ore Chinguru chia Yakobo, agateba,
“Tingosoa nyomba mwane, gose tinkoriina borere korara;
tingwancha korara chitoro, gose gosundoka,
goika inyore aase, agwo arabe obomenyo bw’Oyore Chinguru chia Yakobo.”
Naama! Agwo Efarata tokaigwa amang’ana igoro y’Esanduku y’Okobwatana, tokayenyora aaria ase orosana rwa Yearimu.
“Inchuo togende ase obomenyo bw’Omonene, tosasime agwo ase egeteni kiaye ki’amagoro!”
Aye Omonene, imoka ochiche aase ao ogotimokera, aye amo n’Esanduku eria ekworokia okobua kwao.
Tiga abakuani bao beboyie oboronge, na abanto bao abachenu babe bagoaka amariogi ’omogoko.
Ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba oo, tobaisa kwanga korigereria omoakwa amaguta oo.
Aye Omonene, tokonyara gotiga eira eyio kwarierete Daudi ase ogotiana, ogateba: “Oyomo bw’oroiboro rwao nimobeke aikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki’obogambi.
Abana bao kobarabwate okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, na oborori bwane ndaborokererie, rirorio abana babo boigo mbabe bagoikaransa ase ekerogo kiao ki’obogambi kogenderera botambe.”
Omonene ochorire Sayoni; nigo aganetie obe obomenyo bwaye, otebire,
“Aase aa nao obotimokero bwane bwa botambe, aa nao ndabe nkomenya, ekiagera naanchire.
Ninsesenie omochie oyo obe nebinto bionsi biganeirie, abaremeire endagera nimbaigotie.
Nimboyie abakuani b’omochie oyo nogotooreka, na abachenu baye mbabe bagoaka amariogi ’omogoko.
Aroro agwo nimererie Daudi orogunchara, ekiagera naroiseirie omoakwa amaguta one etaya ekomoreka.
Ninsookie ababisa baye kegima, korende egutwa y’omotwe oye omonyene negenderere komekameka.”
Rora buna ere buya na okogokia okonene ekero abanto abamo bakomenya amo, baigwanaine.
Amang’ana ayio nigo anga buna amaguta akweakwa are amaya mono, akonyororoka gochia ase chinderu chia Haroni, aitekera omokoba bwe rigoti ri’eganchwa yaye.
Naende nigo anga buna riime ria Herimoni, rigotonya igoro y’ebitunwa bia Sayoni. Aroro agwo Omonene ochikire ogosesenigwa na obogima botari nomoerio.
Inchuo motogie Omonene, inwe abasomba baye mwensi, inwe abamokomokorera ase enyomba yaye botuko.
Rambora amaboko aino gochia Aase Aachenu, motogie Omonene!
Omonene, oria otongete igoro na ense, agosesenie korwa Sayoni!
Motogie Omonene! Togia erieta ri’Omonene! Inwe abasomba b’Omonene, motogie!
Inwe aba mogotenena ase enyomba y’Omonene, agwo ase chigoora chi’enyomba ya Nyasae oito, motogie!
Motogie Omonene, ekiagera ere nigo are omuya, terera erieta riaye, ekiagera nigo rire eriansu.
Omonene bwechoreire Yakobo, bwechoreire Abaisraeli koba abaye bori.
Inche nigo imanyete ng’a Omonene nigo are omonene; ee, Omonene oito nigo are igoro ye chinyasae chionsi.
Kende gionsi Omonene agwancha gokora nigo akogekora; gokerabe ase ense, gose igoro, gose ase enyancha, gose ase chindiba.
Nere okorenta amare korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense; nere okorenta chinkoba chire nembura, na omwaga okogusa korwa ase ebigancha biaye.
Nere oitete abana abatangi ba Misiri, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo.
Nere okorete ebikone na amakumia ase egati yao, aye Misiri, na ase Farao amo nabasomba baye.
Omonene nigo asiretie ebisaku ebinge, na agaita abaruoti barenge ne chinguru;
Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori, na Ogi, omoruoti o Basani; boigo agasiria amaruoti onsi a Kanani.
Ense y’Ebisaku ebio akayea Abaisraeli, abanto baye, ekaba omwando obo.
Aye Omonene, erieta riao nigo rigendererete kobao goika kare na kare. Nobe gokoinyorwa nebiaare bionsi.
Omonene narwanerere abanto baye, narorere abasomba baye amabera.
Emegwekano egosasimwa nabanto b’ebisaku nigo eroisirie korwa ase chifeta ne chitahabu; nigo ere emeremo y’amaboko a mwanyabanto.
Nigo ebwate emenwa, korende teri gokwana, nebwate amaiso, korende teri korora,
nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, gose tebwati omoika bw’okoeyana.
Abakoroisia emegwekano eyio nigo banga buna ero, ee, naboigo abwo bonsi bayiegenete.
Inwe Abaisraeli, togia Omonene! Nainwe ab’ororeria rwa Haroni, togia Omonene!
Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Lawi, togia Omonene! Nainwe aba momoirogete Omonene, motogie!
Omonene tiga atogigwe korwa Sayoni, Omonene oria omenyete Yerusalemu. Motogie Omonene!
Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Moakere Nyasae, oyobuete chinyasae, ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
