Moakere Omonene bw’abanene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Nere bweka okorete amakumia amanene, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ere ase obong’aini bwaye nigo atongete igoro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ere oramborete ense, akayiaara ase amache, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ere okorete emebaso eria emenene, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Akabeka erioba rigambe mobaso, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Akabeka omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni bigambe botuko, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ere nigo aitete abana abatangi ba Misiri, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Erio akang’anyia Abaisraeli korwa ase Abamisiri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Akabarusia aroro nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru koramboire, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ere nigo aatananete Enyancha Embariri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Erio akaambokeria Abaisraeli aroro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ere akarimeria Farao amo nemeganda yaye ase Enyancha Embariri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ere nigo araaete abanto baye goetera ase erooro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ere nigo aitete abaruoti barenge ne chinguru, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ere nigo aitete abaruoti abakumete, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Agaita Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamoni, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Agaita na Ogi, omoruoti o Basani, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Akabaura chinse chiabo chikaba omwando bw’abanto baye, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Chinse echio chikaba omwando bw’Abaisraeli, abasomba baye, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ere nigo atoinyorete ekero twarenge aboro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ere nigo atotooretie korwa ase ababisa baito, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Ere nigo akorua endagera oa ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Moakere Nyasae o igoro ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
Nigo twarenge goikaransa ase chingegu chie chindooche chia Babeli, twaba tokorera ekero twarenge koinyora Sayoni.
Aroro agwo nigo twasungete amakano aito ase emete enga buna emesobeti.
Abanto baria batwosete bakagania tobaterere, abachandi abwo baito bakagania tobagokie, bagateba, “Toterere ogotera gwa Sayoni.”
Naki torakore totere ogotera kw’Omonene ase ense engeni?
Aye Yerusalemu, inse gokweba, rirorio okoboko kwane gw’okorio kogatae.
Onye tingokoinyora aye Yerusalemu, erinde obe omogoko one omonene mono, rirorio tiga oromeme rwane robwatane namang’ang’ura.
Aye Omonene, inyora amabe aya abanto b’Edomu bakorete ase rituko riria Yerusalemu obwatetwe; buna batebete, “Yotagore kegima! Yotagore amo noboroso bwaye!”
Inwe abanto ba Babeli nigo mogochia gosirigwa. Nabe negesio oyio ogochia kobaakana amabe aya mwabeire mogotokorera.
Nabe negesio omonto oyio ogochia koira abana baino abake na kobaakera ase amagena ’Ebitare.
Aye Omonene, nigo nkogoakera ng’a mbuya mono nenkoro yane yonsi, ningoterere na kogotogia ase obosio bwe chinyasae.

Nigo ngosasima ndigereretie gochia ase Hekalu yao Enchenu, naaka ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, na ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na ase obwegenwa bwao. Aye gwakorire eira yao koba enene goetania onsi aya erieta riao riatotebetie.
Ase rituko riria nakorangeretie, nigo kwanyigwete, okaremia omoyo one, okambeka chinguru.
Aye Omonene, abaruoti bonsi b’ense mbagotogie, ekero baraigwe amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa oo;
mbabe bagotera igoro y’ogokora kwao, aye Omonene, ekiagera obonene bwao nigo bore obonene mono.
Nonya Omonene ore igoro aare, nigo aroche abanto abaitongo, korende abare abaenenu nigo akobamanya kobare aare.
Nimba ngoeta ase egati y’emechando, aye nigo ondendete ngenderere koba moyo; aye nigo okorambora okoboko kwao igoro y’ababisa baane bare nendamwamu, na okoboko kwao gw’okorio gwantooria.
Aye Omonene nonyare goikerania aya kwandierete eira, ekiagera obwanchani bwao nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare. Tobaisa kweba emeremo y’amaboko ao.
Aye Omonene kwariga‐rigirie ime yane, kwamanyire inche.
Aye nigo omanyete ekero ing’ikaransete, na ekero inkoimoka. Nigo omanyete ebirengererio biane bionsi kore aare.
Ekero ngotaara gose kondaire nigo omanyete; aye nigo omanyete chinchera chiane chionsi.
Nonya nekero ntarakwana ring’ana rinde rionsi, Naama, aye Omonene nigo orimanyete kegima.
Aye nigo ong’etanaine ase chinsemo chionsi, na nigo obegete okoboko kwao igoro yane ondendete.
Okomanya okwo nigo kore okw’ogokumia asende; nigo kore okonene mono, tinkonyara gokomanya.
Ng’ai ndagende, erinde ntigane n’Omoika oo? Gose ng’ai ndatame gochia, indue ase obosio bwao?
Ninsa koriina gochia igoro, aye nao ore; ninsa kwara ekerarero kiane agwo aase abakure, aye nao ore.
Ninsa koirurukigwa namasase a mambia, ingende komenya ase chinsinyo chi’enyancha,
nonya naroro okoboko kwao nkondaae, ee, okoboko kwao gw’okorio nkombwate.
Ninsa goteba, “Tiga omosunte ontube kegima, na oborabu bong’etanaine boonchoke bobe omosunte”,
nonya nomosunte tori omosunte asore, obotuko nigo bokoraba se, bwaba buna omobaso, asore omusunte na oborabu nigo bigwekaine.
Naye gwatongete ebire ase enda yane ime, nigo kwambwatanetie amo ase enda ya baba.
Nigo nkogotogia, ekiagera natongetwe ase enchera y’ogokumia, na ey’ogoichania. Ogokora kwao nigo kore okuya kw’ogokumia! Igo nimanyete amang’ana ayio buya ase omoyo one.
Amauga ’omobere one tabisekanete asore, ekero natongetwe bobisi, ekero nabombetwe ase ense ime.
Amaiso ao nigo andoche ekero narenge enche ase enda ya baba ime, amatuko aane onsi nigo arigetwe ase ebuku yao, na akaroberigwa ritang’ani rituko rinde ritaraika.
Aye Nyasae, ebirengererio biao nigo bire ebikong’u asende kobimanya, naende nebinge mono bitanyare kobareka.
Inse kobibara, nigo bire ebinge goetania omokenye. Ekero nkoboka, nigo ngendererete kobeera amo naye.
Aye Nyasae, naki yare gocha koba buya onye ngwaita abakori amabe, onye abagoitera amanyinga mbarua asende.
Abwo nigo bagokwana bobe igoro yao; nigo bare abaenenu bagokora ebibe asore.
Omonene, Inee, tingecheti abwo bakogechete? Tinkonyinyeera abwo bagosaria asore?
Abwo nigo mbagechete mono mono, nigo mbabarete ng’a nababisa baane.
Aye Nyasae, ndiga‐rigie omanye enkoro yane. Nteeme omanye ebirengererio biane.
Origererie timbwatia enchera y’obosiru, na ondaae ase enchera ya kare na kare.
Aye Omonene, ntoorie korwa ase abanto ababe; indende korwa ase abanto abatindi!
Abanto abwo nigo bakoroberia amabe ase chinkoro chiabo ime, baba bakona‐korwana esegi botambe.
Chimeme chiabo nigo chire chinyoge buna echie ching’iti chingenda inse; obosongo bw’amarubi nigo bore ase ebikoba bi’emenwa yabo.
Aye Omonene, indende korwa ase amaboko ’abakori amabe; intoorie korwa ase abanto abatindi, abwo barobeirie kobeka ebigocha ase ngoeta.
Abanto abaenenu babekire oboreba bobisi ase ngoetera, bantegeire ebichanga bimbwate, babekire emeeto ase oboeto bwane bwonsi.
Natebirie Omonene: Aye Nyasae one, aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane.
Aye Nyasae, Omonene one, Omotooria one omokong’u, aye nigo ogotuba omotwe one ase engaki y’esegi.
Omonene, tobaisa koa abakori amabe aya baganetie; tobaisa gosesenia emeroberio yabo emebe, babaise gwetogia.
Totiga ababisa abwo bang’etananire babue, tiga obobe bw’amang’ana bagokwana bobairanere abanyene.
Tiga omorero bw’amakara obagwere, barabwo batugutwe ase omorero, barutwe ase chingoro chintambe tibaruao.
Totiga abagenki bagenderere koba ase ense. Obobe nigo bogotwara abanto abatindi ase omoayerero bwabasiria.
Nimanyete ng’a Omonene narwanerere abagokorerwa bobe, nae abataka oboronge bwabo.
Ekeene, abanyene oboronge mbaake ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, abare ne chinkoro chindonge mbamenye ase obosio bwao.
Omonene, nigo ngokorangeria, ayerera oche bwango! Tegerera oigwe eriogi riane ekero ngokorangeria.
Bwanchere ogosaba kwane buna ubani, na amaboko aane aimokereirie igoro oyanchere buna ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba!
Aye Omonene, beka omorendi ase omonwa one, abe okorenda ebikoba biane.
Totiga enkoro yane egobere yanche amang’ana amabe. Tontiga inare gokora ayare amabe amo nabwo bagokora ebibe; tingosanga amo nabarabwo ase emeyega.
Tiga oyore omonyaboronge ang’ake na antogonyere ase obwanchani, okwo nigo konga buna amaguta akweakwa, na omotwe one toyaanga. Botambe nigo ogosaba kwane kore mamincha y’abakori amabe.
Ekero abagambi babo baraturunkanigwe ase egetare, abanto mbanche amang’ana aane ng’a namaya.
Amauga aito nigo asiareire ase omogo bw’embeera, buna ebisamunye bie chinko, gose ebi’amagena bigosiarerwa ase riroba igoro.
Korende amaiso aane nigo arigereretie gocha asore, aye Omonene; naye ngotamera, tibwanga omoyo one.
Indende korwa ase emeeto bantegeire; na korwa ase amareba ’abakori amabe.
Tiga abakori amabe abwo bagwe ase ebichanga biabo abanyene, korende inche ntooreke.
Nigo nkorera neriogi ase okorangeria Omonene, naaka eriogi ase okomosaba amabera.
Nigo nkorenta obokong’u bwane ase obosio bwaye na komotebia emechando yane.
Ekero nkoba buna oyo okogireka, aye nomanyete ase ngoetera. Agwo ase ngoeta ababisa bambekeire amareba.
Ekero nkorigereria ase ensemo yane y’okorio, tindi korora monto aroro ogonkonya; gose tindi korora aase ndatamere, monto onde tari okonyechandera.
Aye Omonene, nigo nkorera asore; nigo ngoteba: Naye ore obotamero bwane, na egetare kiane aiga ase ense y’abanto bare moyo.
Tegerera oigwe ekerero kiane, ekiagera nachandekire mono! Ntoorie korwa ase abanto abwo bagonchanda, ekiagera nigo babwate chinguru kombua.
Osibore omoyo one korwa ase obosibwa, erinde imbe ngotogia erieta riao. Abanyene oboronge mbang’etanane, ekiagera gwankoreire amaya.
Aye Omonene, oigwe ogosaba kwane; ase engencho y’oboronge bwao otegerere ogosorora kwane, ong’iranerie ase engencho y’obwegenwa bwao.
Tobaisa kong’ira inche omosomba oo ase ekegambero, ekiagera ase abwo bare moyo onde tari ore omoronge asore.
Omobisa one obeire okorigia omoyo one; obeire ogontiringera inse ase amaroba, ong’ikaransirie ase omosunte, nabeire buna omonto okwete kare.
Ase ayio omoika ore ime yane oborirwe chinguru, na enkoro yane yairianyekire.
Nigo nkoinyora amatuko a kare, na korengereria igoro y’ogokora kwao gwonsi, naba nkona‐koiranerera emeremo y’amaboko ao.
Nigo nkorambora amaboko aane gocha asore, omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore, buna riro ba rirang’ete embura.
Aye Omonene, ing’iranerie bwango! Omoika nkong’erera ore! Tombisa obosio bwao mbaise koba buna abwo bakogenda ase chimbeera.
Kera emambia omanyie obwanchani bwao bogenderere botambe, ekiagera naye nyegenete. Inyorokererie enchera ngwenerete kobwatia, ekiagera narure omoyo one asore.
Aye Omonene, ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane; nagotameire ombise.
Inyorokererie imanye gokora ogwancha kwao, ekiagera naye ore Nyasae one! Tiga Omoika oo omuya ondaae ase enchera ere endonge.
Aye Omonene, ing’a obogima oboyia ase engencho y’erieta riao; na ase engencho y’oboronge bwao rusia omoyo one korwa ase emechando.
Ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, siria ababisa baane; siria kegima abwo bonsi bagochanda omoyo one, ekiagera inche nigo inde omosomba oo.
Atogigwe Omonene, oyore egetare kiane; bworokereirie amaboko aane amanye korwana esegi, ne ebiara bimanye korwana.
Ere nigo are nobwanchani asende, naende orwaki rwane, obwebiso bwane obokong’u na Omobooria one. Ere nenguba yane, nere ngotamera, ekiagera nabeke abanto baane inse yane banyigwere.
Aye Omonene, omonto ninki aisaine goika okomwechandera, gose mwanyabanto ninki are, aye okomorengereria?
Omonto nigo are buna omooki, amatuko aye nigo anga buna omorengari ogoeta.
Omonene, kumba igoro chiao ochiche inse aa! Kuna ebitunwa, erinde bisokie erioki.
Mesia chinkoba chiao oserebanie ababisa, ruta chinsara chiao obasirie kegima!
Rambora okoboko kwao korwa agwo igoro, ondusie na ontoorie korwa ase amache aya amange, na korwa ase amaboko ’abanto be chinse chingeni,
abwo bagokwana oborimo nemenwa yabo, na amaboko abo a borio agokora ay’obong’ainereria.
Aye Nyasae, ningoterere ogotera okoyia, ninkobugerie obokano bore ne chinga ikomi.
Aye nigo okoa abaruoti obobui, naye gwatooretie Daudi, omosomba oo, korwa ase omoro bw’obobe.
Ondusie na ontoorie korwa ase amaboko ’abanto be chinse chingeni, abwo bagokwana oborimo nemenwa yabo, na amaboko abo a borio agokora ay’obong’ainereria.
Tiga abamura baito ase oboke bwabo babe buna ebimeri biakinire bire ne chinguru, na abaiseke baito babe buna ebisigisa bie chikoona bibaachire buya bikogwenera chinyomba chi’oboruoti.
Tiga ebiage biaito biichore chindagera, bigaache chindagera ao ao, ne ching’ondi chiaito chire ase ebitii chibiare chilifu ne chilifu.
Tiga chiombe chiaito chibe ne chinguru, ende tebaisa korekera, gose gochia bogima. Ekerero kende gionsi tikeba ase chinchera chiaito.
Mbasesenirie abanto bakonyora ogosesenigwa okwo. Ee, mbasesenirie abanto abwo Nyasae are Omonene obo.
Aye Nyasae one na omoruoti one, ninkobake, nimbe ngotogia erieta riao goika kare na kare.
Kera rituko nimbe nkogotogia, nintogie erieta riao goika kare na kare.
Omonene nigo are omonene, nagwenerete atogigwe mono; obonene bwaye tibokomanyekana buna bore.
Emeremo yao netogigwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Mbirarie ogokora kwao kore okonene.
Nimbe nkorengereria mono igoro y’obonene bwao bw’ogosikwa okonene, na igoro y’emeremo yao y’ogokumia.
Abanto mbabe bakoraria ogokora kwao okonene gw’okoirokia, nainche nimbe nkoraria obonene bwao.
Mbararie chinkuma chi’obuya bwao obonge, babe bagotera namariogi amanene gotogia oboronge bwao.
Omonene nigo are nobwanchani obonge, na amabera amange; tari omwango ase okoba nendamwamu, nigo aichire nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.
Omonene nigo are omuya ase abanto bonsi, naende nigo are namabera ase ebitongwa biaye bionsi.
Aye Omonene, ebitongwa biao bionsi nigo bikogoakere ng’a mbuya mono, na abachenu bao bonsi mbagotogie.
Mbabe bakoraria obonene bw’oboruoti bwao, naende babe bagokwana igoro y’okobua kwao,
bamanyie mwanyabanto ogokora kwao okonene, na obonene bw’ogosikwa kw’oboruoti bwao.
Oboruoti bwao nobwa kare na kare, na okogambera kwao nigo kogendererete ase ebiaare bionsi. Omonene nigo are omwegenwa ase amang’ana aye onsi, na oichire nobuya ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.
Omonene nigo akobwata bonsi abakogwa, nigo akogororokia abwo bakumbirwe gochia inse.
Amaiso ’ebitongwa bionsi nigo akorigereretie nogosemeria, naye nigo okobia chindagera chiabo ase chingaki chigwenerete.
Aye nigo okomaanora okoboko kwao, kwarua amaya na goisanekia kera egetongwa kere moyo.
Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge ase chinchera chiaye chionsi, na omuya ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.
Omonene nigo are ang’e ase abanto abwo bakomorangeria; abwo bonsi bakomorangeria ase ekeene.
Omonene nigo agoikeraneria abamoirogete okogania kwabo; boigo nigo akoigwa ekerero kiabo na kobatooria.
Omonene nigo arendete bonsi abamwanchete; korende nasirie abakori amabe bonsi.
Omonwa one nobe ogokwana ogotogigwa kw’Omonene; tiga ebitongwa bionsi bitogie erieta riaye richenu bono na goika kare na kare.
Togia Omonene! Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene!
Nimbe ngotogia Omonene kongendererete koba moyo, ninterere Nyasae one ase okomotogia kondagenderere kobao.
Timobaisa gosemeria abagambi, gose mwanyabanto abwo batanyare gokonya kende.
Ekero omoika orure ase omonto, ere nigo akoirana ase amaroba, ase arwete. Ase rituko erio erio emeroberio yaye nigo egosira.
Nasesenirie omonto oyio Nyasae o Yakobo are ogokonywa kwaye, oyio osemeretie Omonene, Nyasae oye,
Nyasae oria otongete igoro na ense, na enyancha, na ebinto bionsi bire imeo. Ere nigo agendererete koba omwegenwa goika kare na kare.
Omonene nigo akoa abwo bagokorerwa bobe oboronge bwabo, na abare nenchara nigo akobaa endagera. Omonene nigo agosibora abwo basibire.
Omonene nigo akoramokia emeuko amaiso na kogororokia abwo bakumbirwe gochia inse. Omonene nigo anchete abanyaboronge.
Omonene nigo akorenda abanto abageni, nigo akoa chintakana na ababoraka ogosemeria, korende chinchera chi’abakori amabe nigo agochisiria.
Omonene nagambe goika kare na kare; aye Sayoni, Nyasae oo nagambere ebiaare bionsi.
Motogie Omonene! Nigo ere buya komoterera Nyasae oito ase okomotogia, ayio naro amaya mono na atogwenerete.
Omonene naagache Yerusalemu naende, nasangererie amo Abaisraeli abwo baserebanetigwe.
Nigo akogwenia abwo chinkoro chiabo chiasionoirwe, na koboa amaote abo.
Nigo amanyete omobaro bwe ching’enang’eni chionsi; boigo kera eyemo nigo ayerogete erieta.
Omonene oito nigo are omonene mono, ne chinguru chiaye nechinyinge; obong’aini bwaye tibokorengeka.
Omonene nigo akoimokereria abanto abaitongo igoro, korende abakori amabe nigo akobaiyeria inse.
Moterere Omonene na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono; bugeria Nyasae oito amakano namariogi amaya!
Omonene nigo agotuba igoro namare, bwariganeria ense embura, nigo akomeria obonyansi ase ebitunwa.
Nere okoa ching’iti chionsi endagera yabo, naende orageria amage ’ebigonkoru ekero akorera.
Omonene tagokiri ne chinguru chie chibarasi, gose ase omoayerero bw’omonto,
korende nigo agokirie nabanto abwo bamoirogete, abwo basemeretie obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe.
Aye Yerusalemu, togia Omonene! Aye Sayoni, togia Nyasae oo!
Ere nigo agokong’ia emekorogoto y’ebiita biaino; nigo agosesenia abana bamenyete ime yao.
Omonene nigo akobeka omorembe oba ase chimbebe chiao, naende nigo agoichoria engano ere engiya mono.
Nigo agotoma amachiko aye gocha ase ense, ne ring’ana riaye riaranda bwango.
Ere nigo akorenta amagena ’embura agwekaine amarionya amarabu, oyasiarera buna agosiara ribu.
Nigo agosiarera amagena ayio buna amaemba enkomba. Ning’o oraremererie obokendu bwaye?
Nigo agotoma ring’ana riaye, na amagena ayio amakendu anyititoke. Erio ogusia embeo amache agenda.
Ere nigo akomanyia abanto ba Yakobo ring’ana riaye, ee, Abaisraeli emeroberio yaye na amachiko aye.
Omonene tana‐gokorera abanto b’ebisaku binde amang’ana buna ayio, barabwo tibamanyeti amachiko aye. Motogie Omonene!
Motogie Omonene! Motogie Omonene korwa agwo igoro! Momotogie agwo igoro mono!
Inwe abamalaika baye mwensi, motogie, nainwe emeganda yaye yonsi, motogie!
Aye erioba, na aye omotienyi, motogie, nainwe ching’enang’eni chionsi chikobara, motogie.
Inwe igoro ya igoro chionsi, motogie Nainwe amache are igoro ya igoro, motogie!
Ebinto ebio bionsi tiga bitogie erieta ri’Omonene, ekiagera nere ochigete, na ebio bigatongwa,
Omonene obibekire bigenderere kobao goika kare na kare; nigo abibekerete ogochika okwo gotaetanigwe.
Motogie Omonene korwa ase ense, nainwe ebitongwa bie chinyancha ne chindiba chionsi!
Motogie, inwe omorero na amagena ’embura, na obokeng’entu, na amare, na aye omwaga omotindi ogoikerania aya achigete!
Motogie Omonene, inwe ebitunwa na ebigoro bionsi, nainwe emete ekwama amatunda, na emecharake yonsi,
nainwe ching’iti chi’orosana na echitugire chionsi, nainwe echikwagura amo ne chinyoni chionsi!
Motogie inwe abaruoti b’ense na abanto bonsi, nainwe abagambi na abanachi ebina mwensi,
nainwe abamura na abaiseke mwensi, nainwe abanto abagotu na abana.
Inwe mwensi, togia erieta ri’Omonene, ekiagera erieta riaye nario rioka rire rinene rikobakwa; obonene bwaye nigo boetanaine ense na igoro.
Omonene omeririe abanto baye chingunchara, erinde abachenu baye bonsi bamotogie; ee, Abaisraeli abwo bare ang’e nere bamotogie! Motogie Omonene!
Motogie Omonene! Terera Omonene ogotera okoyia, motogie ase omosangererekano bw’abanto abegenwa.
Tiga Abaisraeli bagokere Omotongi obo; abanto ba Sayoni tiga bachengere Omoruoti obo!
Batogie erieta riaye ase ogotenga, babe bakobugia chinchigiri na amakano.
Omonene nigo agokirie nabanto baye; abwo bare abaitongo nigo akobachabera ogotooreka.
Tiga abegenwa bachenge ase obonene, babe bagotera nomogoko kobare ase amarere abo.
Tiga ogotogigwa okonene kwa Nyasae kobe ase emenwa yabo, na ase amaboko abo babogorie emeyio ya birende ere nobwoge chinsemo ibere,
erinde barusie egesiomba ase egesaku, na bae abanto egesusuro.
Boigo banyare gosiba abaruoti babo nebinyuri, na abanene babo ne chingataare chi’ekioma,
erinde babanachere ekina kerikire. Obo nabwo obonene bw’abegenwa bonsi b’Omonene. Motogie Omonene!
Motogie Omonene! Motogie Nyasae agwo ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, motogie agwo igoro eyio yatongetwe ase okobua kwaye!
Motogie ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye okonene; motogie koreng’ana nobonene bwaye bore ne chinguru chinyinge goetania!
Motogie ase okobugia ebitureri; motogie ase okobugia amakano onsi!
Motogie ase okobugia chinchigiri na gotenga; motogie ase okobugia amakano na ebiroria!
Motogie ase ogoakania chisani chikwoga amariogi are inse; motogie ase ogoakania chisani chikwoga amariogi are igoro!
Tiga ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo bitogie Omonene! Motogie Omonene!
Eye nero emereng’anio ya Sulemani mosinto o Daudi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
Emereng’anio eyio eragere abanto bamanye obong’aini na amorokererio ay’okorongeyia, naende bamanye amang’ana are nengencho.
Korwa ase ero abanto mbanyore amorokererio akorenta obong’aini, na oboronge, na ekeene, na ogokora kw’oboronge.
Emereng’anio eyio nigo erae abatamanyeti amange bamanye chisemi, naende nigo erorokererie ekegori egeke getware okomanya na emeroberio emiya.
Ase okoigwa emereng’anio eyio omonto omong’aini nigo akong’aiinia goetania, na oyore nokomanya bwenyorera ogosemigwa okuya.
Korwa ase emereng’anio eyio abanto mbanyare kweorokereria emereng’anio na eki egoteba; boigo mbamanye amang’ana ’abanto abang’aini na emebayeno yabo.
Okomoiroka Omonene, noro omochakano bwe chisemi. Abariri nigo bagochaya obong’aini na amorokererio.
Omwana one, igwera amorokererio a iso, na tobaisa gotiga aya nyoko akogochika.
Ayio nigo arabe buna egetinti gechabeire ase omotwe oo, na buna chisonoi chingiya chire ase rigoti riao.
Omwana one, abanyabibe kobarakoebererie ng’a mobwatane nabarabwo, tobaisa gwancha.
Baise kogotebia, “Inchuo ogende amo naintwe; toboere abanto tobaite, toumokere onde bwensi otari na komocha.
Inchuo tobamere kobare moyo, buna aase abakure akomera, bagende abagima ase embeera.
Erio tonyore chinibo chionsi chie rigori rinene, toichorie chinyomba chiaito nebisakorwa ebio.
Inchuo obwatane amo naintwe; tobe nekegancha ekemo.”
Omwana one, tobaisa gotaara amo nabarabwo. Otange okogoro kwao tikobaisa gotacha ase bagoeta,
ekiagera amagoro abo nigo akominyoka gochia ase ogokora amabe, na nigo bare abaango ase ogoitera amanyinga.
Nigo ere bosa gotegera chinyoni ebisugunia ekero chibiroche.
Abanto abwo nigo bakoboera goitera amanyinga abo abanyene, baumokera obogima bwabo abanyene.
Naboigo omoerio bwe chinchera chiabo ore, baria baganetie konyora chinibo ase ribero. Chinibo chiria nigo chigosiria obogima bw’abwo bagochinyora.
Obong’aini nigo bogoaka eriogi rinene ase chinchera, boigo nase chichiiro.
Nigo bogoaka eriogi rinene ase emseangererekano emenene y’abanto, naende ase ebiita bi’emechie, bwateba:
“Ngoika ririri inwe abamotamanyeti amange moranche ogotamanya kwaino? Ngoika ririri abachecheria baregokie nogochecheria kwabo, na abariri bageche chisemi?
Moise koonchoka moigwe ogokurera kwane, rirorio nimbaiterere omoika one, mbamanyie amang’ana aane.
Nabeire nkobarangeria, korende mwangire konyigwera; nabeire nkorambora okoboko kwane, korende monto onde tari okorigereirie.
Mwachayire ogosemia kwane gwonsi, gose onde tari oigwerete ogokurera kwane.
Ase ayio inche nimbasekerere ekero emechando erabachere. Nimbachecherie ekero obwoba borabachere;
ee, ekero obwoba borabachere buna ekembugu‐mbugu, na emechando buna ekerambauti, boigo ekero obokong’u na omoichano birabachere.
Erio barabwo mbandangerie, korende tinkobaigwa; mbandigie, korende tibakonyora inche.
Barabwo nigo bagechete chisemi tibancheti komoiroka Omonene.
Tibancheti koigwera ring’ana riane ri’okobasemia nonya nerimo; nigo bachayete ogokurera kwane gwonsi.
Ase ayio mbarie okwama kw’ogokora kwabo, baisaneke nemeroberio yabo abanyene
Okoirana nyuma kw’abwo batamanyeti amange nkobaite, na ogoisaneka kw’abariri nkobasirie barabwo abanyene.
Korende monto onde bwensi oranyigwere namenye ase omorembe, ere nabe nobotoereru na takoiroka bobe bonde.”
Omwana one, ancha amang’ana aane, ogache amachiko aane ase enkoro yao,
erinde oigwe obong’aini, naende orue enkoro yao ebe nokomanya.
Obe gokorangeria korigia chisemi, naende osorore onyore okomanya.
Origie obong’aini buna okorigia chifeta, obogira‐girie buna okoriga‐rigia chinibo chibisire.
Oise gokora bo, rirorio nomanye komoiroka Omonene, naende nigo oranyare komomanya Nyasae.
Omonene nere okoa abanto obong’aini; chisemi na okomanya nigo bikorwa ase omonwa oye.
Abare ne chinkoro chindonge Omonene nigo abagacherete obong’aini oboikeranu. Ere nigo are enguba ase abanto abwo bagotaara ase oboronge.
Nigo arendete chinchera chi’abagokora ekeene, naende orenda chinchera chi’abamoirogete.
Koranyigwere, rirorio nomanye ayare boronge na ekeene, na ayagwenerete: ee, nomanye chinchera chionsi chire chingiya,
na obong’aini mbosoe ase nekoro yao, ne chisemi nigo chiragokie omoyo oo.
Emeroberio y’ebirengererio ebiya nekorende, na okomanya okuya ngokorende boigo.
Obong’aini mbokorusie korwa ase chinchera chi’obobe na korwa ase abanto bagokwana amang’ana ’obosiru.
Abanto abwo nigo bagotiga chinchera chi’oboronge, babwatia chinchera chi’omosunte.
Nigo bakogokera ase ogokora amabe, naende bagokera chingencho chionsi chi’obobe.
Chinchera chiabo nigo chire chinkorekanu, nigo bagotaara ase chinchera chire borogochi.
Obong’aini obwo mbogotoorie korwa ase omokungu onde bwensi omotayayi, oyio ogokwana amang’ana okweansia korwa ase omonwa oye,
oyio otigire omwanchi bw’oboke bwaye, naende bwebire okobwatana kw’ogotianania kwa Nyasae oye.
Ere amo nab’enyomba yaye nigo bagotirimboka gochia ase amakweri, ne chinchera chiaye nigo chikobaraa gochia aase abakure.
Monto onde bwensi ogochiera omokungu oyio tari koirana naende, takoiranera chinchera chi’obogima.
Ase ayio, obwatie enchera y’abanto abaya, na otaare ase oboeto bw’abanyaboronge.
Ekiagera abare ne chinkoro chindonge mbamenye ase ense, na abaikeranu mbagenderere komenya aroro.
Korende abakori amabe mbaitwe barue ase ense, na abasaria mbasirigwe kegima.
Omwana one, tobaisa kweba amorokererio aane, korende tiga enkoro yao ebwate amachiko aane.
Ayio nagere omenye amatuko amange, na emiaka emenge, naende ogendererete koba nomorembe.
Totiga obuya na ekeene birue asore; obisibe ase rigoti riao, na obirike ase enkoro yao.
Igo nario oranyore ogwancherwa na okomanya okuya ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase mwanyabanto.
Osemerie Omonene nenkoro yao yonsi; tobaisa gosemeria okomanya kwao.
Orengererie Omonene, omoorokie ase chinchera chiao chionsi, nere narongeyie oboeto bwao.
Tobaisa gwekora omong’aini ase okorora kwao omonyene; omoiroke Omonene na bweatanane korwa ase amabe.
Korakore igo, ayio nagwenie omobere oo abeke emeseto y’amauga ao chinguru.
Osike Omonene ne chinibo chiao chionsi na ogotongora kwao gwonsi kw’endagera.
Erio ebiage biao mbiichore nendagera enyinge na ebimitero biao biichore nedivai engiya.
Omwana one, tobaisa kwanga gose gochaya ogoaka kw’Omonene kw’ogokorongeyia.
Omonto onde bwensi Omonene anchete nigo akomorongeyia, buna ise omwana akorongeyia omwana oria agokirie nere.
Nare nomogoko omonto oyio onyorire obong’aini naende ore nokomanya.
Obong’aini nigo bobwate ebitoki ebinge kobua ebie chifeta na ebie chitahabu.
Nigo bore nengencho enene kobua amagena akomeka‐meka e rigori rinene, gose tokoboreng’ania na kende gionsi oganetie.
Obong’aini nigo bobwate obogima bw’amatuko amange ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na ase okoboko kwaye gw’okobee nigo bobwate obonda obonge amo nogosikwa.
Chinchera chiaye nigo chire echi’omogoko, na oboeto bwaye bwonsi nigo bore obw’omorembe.
Nigo bore omote bw’obogima ase abwo babobwatererete; na kera omonto ogendererete kobobwata bokong’u nasesenirie.
Omonene nigo abegete oboroso bw’ense nobong’aini bwaye, na agakong’ia igoro nokomanya kwaye.
Ase obong’aini bwaye chindiba nigo chikobochoria, na amare atonyia riime.
Omwana one, bwata bokong’u obong’aini obuya na okomanya; tobaisa gotiga ebio birue ase obosio bwao.
Igo ebio mbibe obogima ase omoyo oo, na ogwechabera okuya ase rigoti riao.
Erio notaare ase enchera yao kore noborendi obuya, gose tokogochwa okogoro kwao.
Ekero ogochia korara, toba nobwoba, koraire nonyore chitoro chingiya.
Tobaisa kwoboa okogosa kogocha mobosokano, gose ogosirigwa kw’abanyabibe kogocha buna omoubera.
Omonene nabe ogosemeria kwao, ere narende okogoro kwao tikobaisa kobwatwa ase oboreba.
Tobaisa korina abaremerwa amaya aya bagwenerete konyora, onye ayio are ase okobua kwao kobak onya.
Ekero obwate egento ase engaki eyio kware koa omonto omino, tobaisa komotebia, “Genda ochiche ankio, nario ndagekoe.”
Tobaisa gokora emeroberio gokorera omonto omino bobe; oyio omenyete amo naye, ogosemeretie ng’a anyore oborendi obuya.
Tobaisa koamererania na monto onde engencho ende etaiyo, onye taragokorera bobe bonde.
Tobaisa koba ne ribero ase omonto otari gokora ay’oboronge, gose tobaisa kwega chinchera chiaye,
ekiagera abanto abasareku nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, korende obobisi bwaye nigo bore ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.
Okoragereria kw’Omonene nigo kore ase chinyomba chi’abakori amabe, korende nigo agosesenia chinka chi’abanyene oboronge.
Omonene nigo agochecheria abwo bagochecheria, korende abaitongo nigo akobaa obuya na amabera.
Abanto abang’aini mbanyore omwando bw’obonene, korende abariri mbabogorie obosooku.
Inwe abana baane, igwa amorokererio aane inche iso; tegerera mono, erinde monyare koba nokomanya.
Inche nigo nkobaa amorokererio amaya; timotiga aya nabachikeire.
Nigo narenge omwana, narenge na tata; nigo narenge omwororo nanchire na baba, ekiagera nigo narenge omomoima.
Tata akanyorokereria, agantebia, “Tiga amang’ana aane abeere ase enkoro yao ime; orende amachiko aane, erio nario orabe moyo.”
Enyorere obong’aini na okomanya, tobaisa kobieba! Tibwanga koigwera amang’ana ngokwana korwa ase omonwa one.
Tobaisa gotiga obong’aini, ekiagera borobwo mbokorende. Obwanche, na borobwo mbogere ogenderere koba buya.
Obong’aini nigo bore obw’engencho enene. Ase ayio, enyorere obong’aini, na kende gionsi okorigia, rigia obe nokomanya.
Obobare koba nengencho enene, naborobwo mbogokinie; koraboboanie nigo borakorentere ogosikwa.
Mbobeke ase omotwe oo ekiore gechabeire, naende bokoe egutwa y’obonene.
Aye omwana one, igwa amang’ana aane, oyaanche, igo nario emiaka y’obogima bwao erabe emenge.
Inche nakworokereirie enchera y’obong’aini; nakoraaire ase oboeto bore oboronge.
Ekero orabe kogotaara, togotererigwa, na ekero orabe gokominyoka, tokogochwa.
Bwata amorokererio bokong’u, toyatiga arue asore; yarende, ekiagera naro obogima bwao.
Tobaisa kobwatia enchera y’abakori amabe, gose tobwatia chinchera chi’abanto ababe.
Bweatanane korwa ase enchera eyio, toyebwatia, korende ogobere oetere ensemo, ogende bosio.
Abanto abwo tibari korara goika barore ng’a bakorire amabe. Onye tibarakorera omonto amabe, tibari korara chitoro.
Endagera yabo bakoria nogokora amabe, na edivai yabo bakonywa nobotindi.
Korende enchera y’abanyene oboronge nigo enga buna amasase a mambia; ayio akogenderera koraba goetania goika bwakia se.
Enchera y’abakori amabe nigo enga buna omosunte ekerima; tibari komanya ebinto bikobagocha.
Omwana one, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane! Igwera amang’ana nkogotebia.
Amang’ana ayio tabaisa korua ase amaiso ao. Yagache ime ase enkoro yao.
Ayio nigo are obogima ase oyio oyanyorire, naende nigo akogwenia omobere oye bwonsi.
Renda enkoro yao kobua ande onsi orendete, ekiagera nao chinsoko chi’obogima chikorua.
Tuguta chinkwana chi’obokorekanu korwa ase omonwa oo, na amang’ana ’obong’ainereria korwa ase ebikoba biao.
Tiga amaiso ao arigererie gochia bosio, na ebioge bi’amaiso ao biramokigwe boronge.
Rongeyia oboeto bw’amagoro ao, ne chinchera chiao chionsi chibe chindonge.
Togobera gochia aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee. Rusia okogoro kwao korwa ase ebibe.
Omwana one, tegerera oigwe obong’aini bwane! Igwera okomanya kwane!
Erio nario oramanye korenda ebirengererio biao, na ebikoba biao birende chisemi.
Ebikoba bi’omokungu omonyaka nigo bigotonyia ayare amansu buna obooke, na omonwa oye nigo ore omoterere kobua amaguta akweakwa.
Korende omoerio bw’omokungu oyio nigo ore omororo buna ekemeri ekeroro, na omwoge buna omoyio o birende otieririe chinsemo chionsi ibere.
Amagoro aye nigo akoraa gochia ase amakweri, na amatambokero aye araa gochia aase abakure.
Ere tari gotaara enchera ekogenda ase obogima; orogendo rwaye nigo rokona‐koonchaonchoka, ere tamanyeti ayio.
Ase ayio, inwe abana baane, ntegerere; timobaisa gotiga amang’ana aane.
Erende obeere aare korwa ase omokungu oyio; tobaisa goika ang’e negesieri ki’enyomba yaye.
Oise gokora bo, nigo orae abanto abaao amasikani ao, na emiaka yao ebaise konachwa nabanto batari namabera.
Naende abanto abaao nigo baraire chinibo chiao chionsi, na bionsi ebi gwakoreire emeremo biirwe nabanto abwo.
Omoerio oye norere, obokie amagombo ekero chinyama chi’omobere oo chiaerire,
notebe, “Naki nakorete nkagecha ogokurerwa, na enkoro yane egachaya okorongeigwa!
Tinaigwerete amorokererio ’aborokia baane, gose tinategererete koigwera abarenge konyorokereria.
Nigo nabete ang’e gosira kegima ase egati y’omoganda osangererekanete.”
Kanywe amache okobucha korwa ase egesima kiao, na aya agosoka korwa ase ensoko yao.
Inee! Chinsoko chiao nchigwenerete gwesiarera gochia aare, ne chindooche chiao chi’amache ase chinchera?
Tiga chinsoko echio chibe echiao aye bweka na tari echi’abanto abaao.
Tiga ensoko yao esesenigwe, naye ogokere omokungu bw’oboke bwao,
oyore buna ensune eyanchire na buna engabi ensiani. Tiga obosiani bwaye bokong’use, na ogokigwe nere chingaki chionsi. Obwanchani bwaye tiga bokogokie kogenderera.
Omwana one, nase ki okogokigwa nomokungu omonyaka? Nase ki okoboania omokungu bw’omonto omoao?
Chinchera chi’omonto nigo chirorekanete maiso marore ase Omonene, na Omonene nigo arigereretie ogokora kwaye gwonsi.
Ebibe bi’omokori amabe nigo bikomobwata omonyene; nasibwe ne chingori chire ebibe biaye.
Omonto oyio nigo arakwe, ekiagera angete ogokurerwa, na ase engencho y’oboriri bwaye obonene nasire.
Omwana one, ande kwerure koba intenenera ase omonto omino, na kwarire eira ase omonto omoao na kobwatana nere amaboko.
Bono amang’ana gwakwanete korwa ase omonwa oo akobwatire buna oboreba.
Ase ayio omwana one, bono nigo ore inse y’okobua kw’omonto oyio, na onye korigetie gwetooria korwa asare okore iga: Kabe omoitongo, ogende asare omosorore, erinde agosibore korwa ase eira eyio.
Tobaisa korara gose gosundoka;
minyoka buna engabi egotama erue ase omotwari, na buna enyoni egotama erue ase omotegi.
Aye ore omworo, genda ase amage, origererie orore buna agokora emeremo nomokia onyore obong’aini.
Ayio tabwati omogambi, gose omoteneneri, gose omoraai,
korende nigo agosangereria chindagera chiabo ekero chikonyorekana, achigacha goika ekero ki’eguru‐gura.
Aye omworo, ngoika ririri oragenderere korara? Ndiriri oraboke korwa ase chitoro chiao?
Orare ake igo, bwegondie ake igo; oringanie amaboko otimoke,
erio obotaka mbogochere buna omouri agocha, na oboremerwa boche buna omonto obwate ebirwanero agocha.
Omonto otagwenereti kende ore omokori amabe nigo agoeta‐eta, ogokwana oborimo korwa ase omonwa oye.
Nigo agosimera ebioge bi’amaiso aye, naende nigo agosimera amagoro, na okworokia ebimanyererio namaboko aye.
Ogoitania abanto nigo goichire ase enkoro yaye, botambe nigo akoroberia korenta amabe; nigo agosimeka chimbusuro chi’amariomana.
Ase engencho eyio emechando nemochere mobosokano; nigo arasirigwe mobosokano atanyare gotoorigwa.
Mbire ebinto bitano na ekemo Omonene agechete, ee, mbire bitano na bibere bire okogecha asare, nabio ebi:
Okorigereria kw’oboenenu, na oromeme rogokwana oborimo, na amaboko agoitera amanyinga atari na komocha;
enkoro ekoroberia ebirengererio bi’amabe, na amagoro akominyoka gochia gokora amabe;
kirori bw’oborimo, ogokwana oborimo, na omonto ogosimeka chimbusuro chi’ogoitania ase egati y’abanto abamo.
Omwana one, igwera aya inche iso nkogochika, na totiga amorokererio a nyoko.
Yasibe, agenderere kobeera botambe ase enkoro yao, naende oyasibe ase rigoti riao.
Ekero orabe kogotaara, ayio nakoraae; ekero orabe koraire, nakorende, na ekero orabe gokoboka, ayio nakwane naye.
Amachiko nigo are etaya, na amorokererio nigo are oborabu; ogokurera gw’okorongeigwa nigo kore enchera y’obogima.
Nigo korakorende korwa ase omokungu omonyaka, na korwa ase amang’ana ’oromeme rwaye oroterere rokoebereria.
Tobaisa komogania ase enkoro yao ime ase engencho y’ekieni kiaye ekiya; amaiso aye tabaisa gokong’usa.
Ase engencho y’omokungu omotayayi omonto nigo akoremerwa oborwa nonya negesamunye ki’omogati, na omokungu bw’omonto omoao nigo akorigia obogima bw’omonto obosaria.
Inee! Omonto nabogorie omorero ayobeke ase egekuba kiaye, ne chianga chiaye tichiyia?
Gose nataare ase rieera ri’omorero, na amagoro aye tayia?
Naboigo erabe ase omonto ogotomana nomokungu bw’omonto onde; onde bwensi okoba nomokungu oyio goika aegwe egesusuro.
Abanto tibari gochaya omoibi onye ore koiba endagera ekiagera are nenchara.
Nonya naboigo omoibi oria kanyorirwe, goika airanie ara gatano na kabere; nigo araakane ebinto bionsi abwate nyomba mwaye.
Omonto ogotomana nomokungu onde bwensi, oyio tabwati chisemi; oyo ogokora ayio nigo agwesaria ere omonyene.
Omonto oyio nigo arabe namaakwa naende asirie amasikani onsi, obosooku bwaye tibogotinyigwa boeere.
Risemi nigo rigokora omosacha oba nekeririanda, na takoba namabera ekero akorusia egesiomba.
Ere tagwancha embooria ende yonsi, naegwa ebiegwa ebinge takobiancha.
Omwana one, renda amang’ana aane, na obeke amachiko aane abeere ime yao.
Bwata amachiko aane, erinde obe moyo; orende amorokererio aane buna orendete endorero y’eriso riao.
Oyasibe ase ebiara bi’amaboko ao, na oyarike oyabeke ase enkoro yao.
Tebia obong’aini, “Aye naye mosubati ominto”, na obomanyi oboroke omosani oo momanyaine,
erinde bikorende korwa ase omokungu omonyaka ogokwana amang’ana ay’okoebereria.
Nigo narigereretie isiko goetera ase ekebao ki’enyomba yaane na ebichanga bi’aroro.
Ase egati y’abanto batamanyeti amange, nkarora omomura ore ase egati y’abamura bande otabwati chisemi.
Oyio nigo arenge goeta ase enchera yarenge ang’e nekoona agwo ase omokungu oria omonyaka amenyete agechoba‐chobania gochia ase enyomba yaye
mogoroba kobokomura‐mura, ekero ki’omosunte bw’obotuko.
Rora, omokungu agacha akaumerana nomomura oria. Omokungu oria nigo abegete chianga chi’obotayayi orenge omong’ainereria ase enkoro yaye.
Nigo arenge omonyariogi otari kogoma nyomba mwaye.
Nigo agosioma‐siomia aande onsi ase chinchera na ase chichiiro, na ase kera amatabekania oba oganyete.
Erio omokungu oria akaboania omomura oria na komonyunyunta, akomorigereria namaiso, atari nobosooku, akomotebia,
“Nariete eira korua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe; rituko ria rero nayeikeranirie.
Ayio naro agera nacha gokorotota, nigo nakorigirie nomokia ng’a nkorore, na bono nakonyorire.
Naarire oborere bwane nebirarero ebiya, na ebitambaa bimatonto bikorwa Misiri.
Naboumoreire manemane, na amaguta ’omogaka, na ay’omodalasini botioke buya.
Inchuo togokanie ase obotuko bwonsi goika mambia; inchuo twegokie nobwanchani.
Omosacha one taiyo, ochiire orogendo orotambe.
Nigo aira chibesa chire omobuko na nigo arairane omotienyi kobeire omonene,”
Omokungu oria akaebereria omomura oria namang’ana amansu ao ao, na ase amang’ana ’ebikoba ebiterere akamobua.
Ase obwango obwo omomura oria agatunyana omokungu oria buna eng’ombe ekoirwa konyenywa, gose buna omosibwa obwatirwe ogochia kobekwa chingataare.
Ee, akamotunyana goika ensara ekamobeta egaika riini ime. Nigo abete buna enyoni ekoayerera gochia ase ebisugunia na tamanyete ng’a ayio nobogima bwaye agosiria.
Inwe abana baane, ntegerera morengererie mono amang’ana nkobatebia.
Chinkoro chiaino tichibaisa koonchorwa na kobwatia chingencho chi’omokungu buna oyio; gose orogendo rwaye tirobaisa gosiria obogima bwaino.
Omokungu oyio oiyeirie abanto abange, ee, oitire omoganda omonene.
Enyomba yaye nero enchera ekogenda aase abakure; ee, enchera eyio nigo ekogenda ase chiero chi’amakweri.
Inee! Obong’aini tibori korangeria? Okomanya tikori goaka eriogi rinene?
Obong’aini nigo bogotenena aase aimokererete igoro, ang’e nenchera engendi, nigo bokobeera ase amatabekania e chinchera.
Mbarabare ase ebiita bosio bw’omochie ase ebisoero bi’ebiita nigo bogokwana neriogi rinene, bwateba;
“Inwe abanto, ninwe nkorangeria; eriogi riane nigo rigochera mwanyabanto.
Inwe aba motamanyeti amange, egera obong’aini; na inwe abariri, egera okomanya.
Tegerera moigwe, ekiagera nigo ndakwane amang’ana amaya mono; amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa one nay’oboronge.
Amang’ana ngokwana nay’ekeene; amang’ana ’obobe nigo are okogechia ase ebikoba biane.
Amang’ana aane onsi ngokwana nigo are ay’oboronge, ande tari are ay’oborimo, gose ay’obokorekanu.
Nigo akoigweka buya ase omonto oyio okoyamanya, naende namaronge ase abwo banyorire chisemi.
Ancha amorokererio aane kobua efeta, ne chisemi kobua etahabu echenire.
Obong’aini nigo bore obuya kobua amagena akomeka‐meka aye rigori rinene, tibokoreng’anigwa nebinto bionsi bire ebiya biganeirie.
Inche obong’aini nakorire okomanya kwabeire obomenyo bwane, nigo inde ne chisemi, naende nimanyete kogamba buya.
Okomoiroka Omonene nokogecha obobe; nigo ngechete oboenenu, na obwerori, na orogendo orobe, boigo namang’ana ’obong’ainereria.
Inche nigo nkorua ogosemia na obong’aini bw’ekeene; nigo inde nokomanya na okobua.
Ase obokonyi bwane abaruoti nigo bakogamba, na abagambi nigo bakobeka amachiko ay’ekeene.
Ase obokonyi bwane abagambi nigo bakogamba, boigo nabanene na abanachi ebina bonsi.
Nigo nyanchete abwo banyanchete; na abwo bakondigia nomokia mbanyore.
Ninche nkorua obonda na ogosikwa, amo nobotenenku na oboronge bitari koera.
Okwama nkorua nigo kore okuya kobua etahabu, ee, kobua etahabu engiya, na ebitoki nkorua mbibuete efeta enchore.
Nigo nkobwatia enchera y’oboronge, naba ngotaara ase oboeto bw’ekeene.
Nigo nkoa abwo banyanchete obotenenku na goichoria chikungo chiabo.
Omonene nigo arenge nainche korwa omochakano bwe chinchera chiaye, agwo kare konya ataratonga kende gionsi;
nao narenge korwa agwo kare na kare, nonya nense konya etarabao.
Inche nigo naiboretwe chindiba chitarabao, nonya ne chinsoko chi’amache.
Nigo naiboretwe oboroso bw’ebitunwa botarabekwa, na ebigoro bitarabao,
ekero ataratonga ense ne riroba riaye, nonya norotu.
Ekero atongete igoro chionsi nao narenge, boigo nekero abekerete amache chimbebe.
Ekero abegete igoro ekabao, na ekero abegete chinsoko chigosokia amache korwa ase chindiba ne chinguru,
na ekero abekerete chinyancha chimbebe, amache tabaisa goetania ogochika kwaye; na ekero abegete amaroso ’ense nao narenge.
Inche nigo narenge amo nere buna oyomanyete emeremo eyio buya. Kera rituko nigo arenge kogokigwa nainche, na inche nkaba inde nomogoko ase obosio bwaye botambe.
Nigo nagokerete ense yaye emenyire nabanto, na nkaba nsasokerete mwanyabanto.
“Na bono, inwe abana baane, ntegerere moigwe, mbasesenirie abwo barendete chinchera chiane,
Igwera amorokererio! Ancha obong’aini, timobwanga!
Nasesenirie omonto oyio okonyigwera; oyio okorenda ase ebiita biane kera rituko, oganyete ase ebisieri biane.
Omonto onyorire inche, oyio onyorire obogima; naende nancherwe n’Omonene.
Korende oyio otari nainche nigo akwenachera ekina ere omonyene. Bonsi abangechete nigo banchete amakweri.”
Obong’aini nigo bweagacherete enyomba. Nigo bwebaacherete chisiiro isano na ibere.
Bwanyenyire ching’iti chiaye; bwochoganirie edivai yaye, bwariganirie emesa yaye.
Bwatomire abasomba baye abaiseke gochia aase aimokererete igoro mono a omochie korangeria abanto, bogoteba:
“Oyo otamanyeti amange, tiga ache aa!” Na ase oyore omoriri bwateba:
“Inchuo orie endagera yane, na onywe edivai nochoganirie!
Tiga oboriri bwao, erinde obe moyo! Obwatie enchera y’okonyora okomanya!”
Omonto ogokurera omonyacheche, nigo akwenyorera obororo; na oyogotogonyera omonto omokori amabe nigo akwenyorera ogochaywa.
Tobaisa gokurera omonto omochayi; oyio nigo arakogeche. Kurera omonto omong’aini, oyio nigo aragwanche.
Orokereria omonto omong’aini, oyio nigo aragenderere koba omong’aini goetania. Orokereria omonto omoronge, oyio namente koba ne chisemi.
Okomoiroka Omonene, oyio noro omochakano bw’obong’aini, na okomomanya Oyore Omochenu nabwo obomanyi.
Ase ogokonywa kwane amatuko ao nabe amange, na emiaka y’obogima bwao nementwe.
Korabe nobong’aini, borobwo mbogokonye; korende korabe omochayi, obochayi obwo mbokoiranere.
Omokungu omoriri nigo are omonyariogi. Ere nigo are bosa, na tamanyeti ring’ana rinde.
Nigo agoikaransera ekerogo ase egesieri ki’enyomba yaye, agwo aase aimokererete igoro ase omochie,
aba okorangeria abaeti bare ase orogendo rwabo,
oteba, “Onde bwensi otamanyeti amange, tiga ache aa!” Na ase oyore omoriri oteba,
“Amache aibire nigo are amansu, na omogati okorierwa aase a bobisi nigo okogokia.”
Korende oyio ogosoa aroro tamanyeti ng’a amakweri nareo, naende ng’a abageni b’omokungu oyio nigo bare agwo aase abakure.
Eye nemereng’anio ya Sulemani. Omwana omomura omong’aini nigo akogokia ise, korende oyore omoriri nigo akorentera ng’ina omoichano.
Chinibo chi’ogokora okobe tichiri gokonya kende, korende oboronge nigo bogotooria korwa ase amakweri.
Omonene tari gotiga omonyene oboronge abe nenchara; korende nigo akwanga okogania kw’abakori amabe.
Omonto ogokora emeremo namaboko amoro nigo akoba omotaka, korende amaboko are nomokia nigo akorenta obotenenku.
Omwana omomura ogosangereria chindagera engaki ye rigesa nigo are omong’aini, korende oyo okorara engaki eyio nigo akorenta obosooku.
Ogosesenigwa nigo gokobeera ase omotwe bw’omonyene oboronge, korende obochege nigo boichire ase emenwa y’abakori amabe.
Okoinyorwa kw’omonyene oboronge nigo gokorenta ogosesenigwa, korende erieta ri’omokori amabe nigo riragunde.
Omonto ore omong’aini ase enkoro yaye nigo anchete amachiko, korende oyogokwana amang’ana atagwenereti nigo arasirigwe,
Omonto okobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge nigo ararendwe buya, korende oyo okobwatia chinchera chimbe nigo aramanyekane.
Omonto ogosimera amaiso ase okogenka nigo akorenta emechando, na oyogokwana amang’ana atagwenereti nigo arasirigwe.
Omonwa bw’omonyene oboronge nigo onga buna ensoko y’obogima, korende obochege nigo boichire ase emenwa y’abakori amabe.
Obogechi nigo bokorenta eriomana, korende obwanchani nigo bogotuba ebibe bionsi.
Obong’aini nigo bokonyorekana ase omonwa bw’omonto omomanyi, korende oyo otari nokomanya nigo agwenerete aakwe enyimbo ase omogongo oye.
Abanto abang’aini nigo bakogacha chisemi, korende omonwa bw’omonto omoriri nigo okorenta ogosirigwa ang’e.
Obotenenku bw’omonto omonda nigo bore asare buna omochie ogiteire chindwaki, korende obotaka nabwo ogosirigwa kw’abataka.
Ogokora kw’omonyene oboronge nigo gokomoraa gochia ase obogima, korende okonyora kw’omokori amabe nigo gokomoraa gochia ase ebibe.
Omonto okoigwera ogokurerwa nigo abwatetie enchera egochia ase obogima, korende oyo okwanga koigwera ogokurerwa nigo agosira.
Omonto obisete okogecha ime yaye nigo agokwana oborimo korwa ase omonwa oye, na oyo ogotaaria obogenki nigo are omoriri.
Omonto ogokwana amang’ana amange tari komocha korenta ogosaria, korende oyo orendete omonwa oye nigo are omong’aini.
Oromeme rw’omonyene oboronge nigo ronga buna efeta echorire korende ebirengererio bi’omokori amabe tibigwenereti kende.
Ebikoba bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bikorenta amaya ase abanto abange, korende abariri nigo bagokwa, ekiagera baborirwe okomanya.
Ogosesenigwa kw’Omonene nigo gokorenta obotenenku, na ere tari komenta obororo ase ogosesenigwa okwo.
Omonto omoriri nigo agokora ebibe buna egosori, korende omonto ore nokomanya nigo agokora ayare ay’obong’aini.
Aya omokori amabe airogete namochere, korende aya omonyene oboronge aganetie naikeranigwe.
Ekero omwaga ekembugu‐mbugu egoeta, omokori amabe nigo agosira, korende omonyene oboronge nigo are oboroso boteneine bokong’u kare na kare.
Buna obokang’iti bokoba ase amaino na erioki rikoba ase amaiso, naboigo omonto omworo akoba ase abwo bakomotoma abakorere emeremo.
Okomoiroka Omonene nigo gokomenta amatuko amange ase obogima, korende emiaka y’omokori amabe nigo erakeeigwe.
Ogosemeria kw’abanyene oboronge nigo koraikeranigwe ase omogoko, korende okw’abakori amabe nigo korasire.
Enchera y’Omonene nigo ere egekengero egekong’u ase abanyene oboronge, korende nigo erasirie abagokora ebibe.
Omonyene oboronge takonyegerigwa, korende omokori amabe takogenderera komenya ase ense.
Omonwa bw’omonyene oboronge nigo ogokwana ay’obong’aini, korende oromeme rokong’ainereria ndosirigwe.
Ebikoba bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bimanyete gokwana amang’ana agwanchwa, korende omonwa bw’omokori amabe nigo ogokwana ayatagwenereti.
Ekerengero ki’oborito ki’obong’ainereria nigo kere okogechia ase Omonene, korende egi’ekeene nigo gekomogokia.
Ekero oboenenu bwachire, nobosooku nario bogocha, korende obong’aini nigo bokonyorekana ase abanto abaitongo.
Obwegenwa bw’abanyene oboronge nigo bokobaraa, korende obokorekanu bw’abatari abegenwa nigo bokobasiria.
Chinibo tichiri gokonya kende ase rituko ri’endamwamu, korende oboronge nigo boratoorie korwa ase amakweri.
Oboronge bw’omonto omoikeranu nigo borarongeyie chinchera chiaye, korende omokori amabe, obobe bwaye mbomoiyerie.
Oboronge bw’abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbobatoorie, korende abasaria nigo barabwatwe nokogania kwabo okobe.
Ekero omokori amabe agokwa, ogosemeria kwaye nigo kogokwa amo nere, ee, aya abwo batamoirogeti Nyasae basemeretie nigo agosira.
Omonyene oboronge nigo akorusigwa ase emechando, erio omokori amabe osoa ase emechando ribaga riaye.
Oyo otamoirogeti Nyasae nigo agosiria abanto bande namang’ana agokwana korwa ase omonwa oye, korende goetera ase obong’aini abanyene oboronge mbatoorigwe.
Ekero abanyene oboronge bagendererete koba buya, abanto b’omochie nigo bakogoka, na ekero abakori amabe bagosira nigo bagoaka amariogi ’omochengo.
Goetera ase ogosesenia kw’abanyene oboronge omochie nigo okoimokererigwa igoro, korende goetera ase chinkwana chi’abakori amabe nigo okoiyerigwa.
Omonto ogochaya omonto onde, oyio nigo aborire obong’aini, korende omonto omong’aini nigo agokira‐kiri.
Omonto okona‐goeta‐etia obogenki nigo akoorokia obobisi, korende oyobwate omoika bw’obwegenwa tari koorokia obobisi.
Ase ogosemia okuya gotari, egesaku nigo gekogwa, korende ase abasemia abange abaya bare, oborendi obuya mboreo.
Omonto okwerua koba intenenera ase omonto omoao nigo agwesoyia ase emechando, korende oyo okwanga koba intenenera nigo erendete buya.
Omokungu omwesiki nigo akogenderera gosikwa botambe, korende abanto abaurereria abatindi nigo bakonyora chinibo ase chinguru.
Omonto ore namabera nigo akwerentera amaya, korende omonto omotindi nigo agwechanda ere omonyene.
Omokori amabe nigo akwenyorera eng’eria y’obong’ainereria, korende oyo ogosimeka oboronge nigo akwenyorera eng’eria y’ekeene.
Omonto ore omwegenwa ase oboronge bwaye nabe moyo, korende oyo okorigia obobe na kobobwatia nakwe.
Abanto abakorekanu ase chinkoro chiabo nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, korende abare norogendo ororonge nigo bakomogokia.
Ekeene, Omonto omobe goika anyore egesusuro, korende oroiboro rw’abanyene oboronge ndotoorigwe.
Omokungu omonyakieni tari na semi nigo anga buna ebonyi y’etahabu ere ase chimioro chi’embeche.
Okogania kw’abanyene oboronge nigo gokorenta amaya, korende okw’abakori amabe nigo gokobarentera egesusuro.
Nare omonto okorua ebinto ebinge, ere nigo akomenteranigwa ebinge goetania, na nare oyonde ore omogoko otari korua, ere nigo akogenderera kona‐koremerwa.
Omonto okorua nomoyo bw’ogwancha natenenkigwe; nere oyokorua amache agokendia erang’o, nere naegwe amache agokendia erang’o yaye.
Omonto oria okwegachera endagera ase obong’iti, nigo akoragererigwa nabanto, korende ogosesenigwa nigo kore igoro ase omotwe bw’oria okoyeoonia.
Omonto ogokora omokia korigia ayare amaya, oyio nigo akonyora ayare amaya, korende oyokorigia ay’obobe, obobe nigo bokomonyora.
Omonto osemeretie chinibo chiaye nigo aragwe, korende abanyene oboronge mbareerete buna amato ’emete.
Omonto okorenta emechando ase enyomba yaye nigo aranyore ayare buna embeo bosa; oyore omoriri nigo arabe omosomba bw’omonto ore nenkoro y’obong’aini.
Okwama kw’omonyaboronge nigo kore omote bw’obogima, na omonto omong’aini nigo akong’usa emioyo y’abanto obakonya.
Onye omonyene oboronge okonyora eng’eria yaye aiga ase ense, Inee, omokori amabe na omonyabibe, abwo tibakoegwa eng’eria yabo goetania?
Onde bwensi bwanchete amorokererio akomorongeyia, oyio nigo anchete chisemi, korende oyo ogechete ogokurerwa tabwati ebirengererio.
Omonto omuya nigo akonyora ogwancherwa korwa ase Omonene, korende oyogokora emeroberio y’obobe nigo akonacherwa ekina n’Omonene.
Ogotamoiroka Nyasae tigokoagacha omonto na komokong’ia, korende omori bw’omonyaboronge tokonyegerigwa.
Omokungu omuya nigo are egutwa y’omosacha oye, korende omokungu okorenta obosooku nigo are buna obogundo ase amauga ’omosacha oye.
Ebirengererio bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bire ebi’ekeene, korende ogosemia kw’abakori amabe nigo kore okw’obong’ainereria.
Amang’ana abakori amabe nigo akoboera na goitera amanyinga, korende aya abanyene oboronge bagokwana nigo agotooria abanto.
Abakori amabe nigo bagosirigwa, tibakobao naende, korende enyomba y’omonyene oboronge netenene bokong’u.
Omonto nigo agotogigwa buna obong’aini bwaye bore, korende oyore nebirengererio ebikorekanu nigo agochaywa.
Omonto omoitongo ogwekorera emeremo yaye omonyene nigo are omuya kobua omonto ogwekora koba omonene, korende tabwati endagera.
Omonyene oboronge nigo agochandekera obogima bwe chitugo chiaye, korende enkoro y’omokori amabe nigo ere entindi.
Omonto ogokora emeremo ase omogondo oye nanyore endagera enyinge, korende oyo okobwatia amang’ana atagwenereti, oyio tamanyeti kende.
Omokori amabe nigo akogania ebionga bi’abanto ababe, korende omori bw’omonyene oboronge nigo ogoseboka bwama.
Omonto omobe nigo agotegwa nogosaria gokorwa ase ebikoba biaye, korende omonyene oboronge natooreke korwa ase emechando.
Okwama kw’amang’ana omonto agokwana nigo gokomorentera amaya akomoisanekia, na emeremo y’amaboko ’omonto nigo ekomoiranera.
Enchera y’omonto omoriri nigo ekororekana ase amaiso aye ng’a nendonge, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akoigwera ogosemigwa.
Okobeea kw’omonto omoriri nigo gokomanyekana rimo rioka, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akoombia otuba obobe.
Omonto bwanchete gokwana ekeene nigo akoorokia oboronge, korende kirori bw’oborimo nigo agokwana ay’obong’ainereria.
Omonto nare otari korengereria aya agokwana, na amang’ana aye nigo anga buna omoro ogokeba, korende oromeme rw’omonto omong’aini nigo rokorenta amang’ana akogwenia.
Ebikoba bigokwana ekeene mbigenderere kobao botambe, korende oromeme rogokwana oborimo nigo rokobao ase engaki enke yoka.
Obong’ainereria nigo bore ase chinkoro chi’abwo bakoroberia amabe, korende abwo bakoroberia ay’omorembe nigo bakogera omogoko oba.
Amabe takobanyora abanyene oboronge, korende abakori amabe mbanyorwe namabe amange.
Ebikoba bigokwana oborimo nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, korende abare abegenwa ase ogokora kwabo nigo bakomogokia.
Omonto omong’aini nigo akobisa aya amanyete, korende abariri nigo bakoraria oboriri korwa ase chinkoro chiabo.
Okoboko kw’omonto omonyamokia nkogambe, korende oyore omworo nabetererigwe akore emeremo emekong’u.
Ogoichana kore ase enkoro y’omonto nigo gokomoiyeria, korende ring’ana rigiya nigo rikomorentera omogoko.
Omonyene oboronge nigo are omoraai omuya bw’omogisangio oye, korende chinchera chi’abakori amabe nigo chikobatang’ana chiabasiria.
Omonto omworo tari koiyeka nonya neki arusirie ase orotwari, korende omokia nigo ore enibo ere nengencho enene ase omonto.
Ase enchera y’oboronge obogima mboreo, na amakweri tari ase enchera eyio.
Omwana omong’aini nigo akoigwera amorokererio a ise, korende oyore omochayi tari gwancha ogokurerwa.
Okwama kw’amang’ana omonto agokwana nigo gokomorentera amaya, korende okogania kw’abatari abegenwa nigo kore okw’obotindi.
Omonto orendete omonwa oye, oyio nigo arendete obogima bwaye, korende oyogokwana amang’ana ateriteti, goika asirigwe.
Omonto omworo nigo are omosaneri, korende takonyora kende, korende oyore nomokia nigo agoisanekigwa.
Omonyene oboronge nigo agechete oborimo, korende omokori amabe nigo agokora ay’okogechia na ay’obosooku.
Oboronge nigo bokorenda oyore norogendo ororonge, korende ebibe nigo bikomosiria omokori amabe.
Omonto nare ogwekora ng’a nomonda are, korende nigo are omotaka, na oyonde bwekora ng’a nomotaka are, korende nigo are omonda mono.
Embooria y’obogima bw’omonto omonda nechinibo chiaye, korende omonto omotaka tari kogoswa nonde.
Oborabu bw’abanyene oboronge nigo bokomoreka nomogoko, korende etaya y’abakori amabe nerime.
Oboenenu nigo bokorenta okoamererania, korende baria bakoigwera ogosemigwa nigo bakoba nobong’aini.
Enibo enyorire ase obwango ase enchera y’obobe nigo egosira, korende ey’ekonyorekana ase okoyekorera emeremo nementekane.
Egesemeirie kogiatebanire nigo gekogera enkoro yarwara, korende ogosemeria kogwaikeranigwe nigo kore omote bw’obogima.
Omonto ogochaya Ring’ana nigo arasirigwe narirorio, korende oyokoiroka ogochika nanyore eng’eria y’obuya.
Amorokererio ’omonto omong’aini nigo are ensoko y’obogima, ekiagera nigo agokonya omonto tabwatwa noboreba bw’amakweri.
Okomanya okuya nigo gokorenta ogwancherwa, korende enchera y’abatari abegenwa nigo ekoraa gochia ase obosiru.
Omonto omong’aini nigo agokora emeremo yaye ne chisemi, korende omonto omoriri nigo akoraria oboriri bwaye.
Omotomwa otari omwegenwa nigo akogwa ase emechando, korende oyore omwegenwa nigo akogwenia.
Omonto okwanga koigwera amorokererio akomorongeyia, obotaka na obosooku nigo biramonyore, korende oyokoigwera ogokurerwa nanyore amasikani.
Okogania gwaikeranigwe nigo kore ogwansu ase omoyo, korende okoonchoka gotiga amabe, okwo nigo kore okogechigwa ase abariri.
Omonto ogotaara nabanto abang’aini nigo arabe omong’aini, korende oyo ogosanga nabariri nanyorwe namabe.
Amang’ana amabe nigo agotunyana abanyene ebibe, korende abanyene oboronge nabaegwe amaya.
Omonto omuya nigo agotiga omwando ase abana baye, na ase abachokoro baye, korende obotenenku bw’abanyene ebibe nigo bogacheire abanyene oboronge.
Oboremo oboyia bw’omonto omotaka nigo bokwama endagera enyinge, korende enyinge nigo egosiara‐siarerwa yasira ase engencho y’obobe.
Omonto okorina omwana oye ekeranya nigo amogechete, korende oyo omwanchete tari gotebana okomorongeyia.
Omonyene oboronge nigo abwate endagera ekomoisanekia, korende enda y’omokori amabe nigo ekogenderera kogania.
Omokungu omong’aini nigo akoagacha mwaye, korende oyore omoriri nigo agotagora mwaye na maboko aye.
Omonto omoirogete Omonene nigo akobwatia enchera y’oboronge, korende oyo omochayete nigo are omokorekanu ase chinchera chiaye.
Aya omoriri agokwana nigo are enyimbo y’oboenenu, korende aya abang’aini bagokwana nigo akobarenda.
Ase chiombe chi’okorema chitari, ebiage nigo bikoba bosa, korende ase chinguru chie chiombe chire, endagera enyinge nigo ekonyorekana.
Kirori ore omwegenwa tari gokwana oborimo, korende oyotari omwegenwa nigo agokwana oborimo bwoka.
Omonto ore omochecheria narigia obong’aini, takobonyora, korende chisemi nigo chikonyorekana ase omonto ore omwango ase okomanya.
Karue ase omonto omoriri, ekiagera tokonyora obong’aini korwa ase aya agokwana.
Obong’aini bw’omonto ore nokomanya nigo bokomokonya omanya buna chinchera chiaye chire, korende oboriri bw’abanto abariri nigo bokobang’aina.
Abanto abariri nigo bagokora echeche nebibe, korende abanyene oboronge nigo bagwancherana barabwo ase barabwo.
Enkoro enyene nigo emanyete obororo bwaye, na omonto omoao takonyara gwatanerwa omogoko bw’enkoro eyio.
Enyomba y’omokori amabe nesirigwe, korende ekegutu ki’omonyene oboronge nkegenderere gosesenigwa.
Enchera nere ekororekana ase omonto ng’a nendonge, korende omoerio bw’enchera eyio namakweri.
Nonya omonto ogoseka, enkoro yaye nabo eranyare koba nomoichano, na omoerio bw’omogoko oyio nobororo.
Omonto ogure korwa ase okwegena kwaye, nabo araisaneke nokwama gwe chinchera chiaye, na omonto omuya nigo agoisaneka ase omoyo oye.
Oyotamanyeti amange nigo akwegena kera ring’ana, korende oyomanyete nigo akorigereria aase agochia.
Omonto omong’aini nigo akwoboa na kwerenda korwa ase amabe, korende omoriri nigo akoba omoremu ase ogokora amabe.
Omonto okogechigwa bwango nigo agokora ay’oboriri, na omonto okoroberia ay’obobe nigo akogechwa.
Abatamanyeti amange, oboriri nigo bokoba omwando obo, korende abare nokomanya nigo bakoegwa chisemi chiaba egutwa yabo.
Abanto ababe goika bekumbe ase amasio ’abanto abaya, na abakori amabe bekumbe ase ebiita bi’abanyene oboronge.
Omonto omotaka nigo agechire nonya nase abanto bamwabo, korende omonda nigo abwate abasani abange.
Omonto ogochaya omonto onde nigo agokora ebibe, korende oyokororera abachandegete amabera nasesenigwe.
Inee! Abwo bakoroberia ayare amabe tibari gosira? Na abwo bakoroberia amaya, Inee, tibari konyora amabera na ekeene?
Ebitoki nigo bikonyorekana korwa ase emeremo ende yonsi, korende ogokwana amang’ana amasa, okwo nigo gokorenta okoremerwa.
Obonda nigo bore egutwa y’abanto abang’aini, korende oboriri bw’abanto abariri nigo bore oboriri bwoka.
Kirori ogokwana ekeene nigo agotooria obogima, korende oyogokwana oborimo nigo are omosigaani.
Oyo okomoiroka Omonene nigo are nogosemeria gw’okorendwa bokong’u, na abana baye mbanyore aase bagotamera.
Okomoiroka Omonene nakwo ensoko y’obogima eragere omonto eatanane korwa ase amareba ’amakweri.
Obonge bw’abanto nabwo bore obonene bw’omoruoti, korende ase abanto bare abake omogambi obo nigo agosirigwa.
Omonto otari kogechigwa bwango nigo abwate okomanya okonene, korende oyo okoberoroka bwango nigo agokinia oboriri bwaye.
Enkoro y’omogoko nigo ere obogima bw’omobere, korende ribero nigo rire obogundo bw’amauga.
Omonto ogokorera omotaka bore nigo agochaya Omotongi bw’omotaka oyio, korende oyore omwororo ase oria oremeire nigo asigete Omotongi.
Omokori amabe nigo agotugutwa riarua ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye okobe, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agokwa ore nogosemeria.
Obong’aini nigo bomenyete ase enkoro y’omonto ore nokomanya, korende ase enkoro y’omoriri nigo bwemanyekanetie obonyene.
Oboronge nigo bogokinia egesaku, korende ebibe nigo bire obosooku ase abanto bande bonsi.
Omosomba ogokora emeremo nobong’aini nigo agwancherwa nomoruoti, korende endamwamu y’omoruoti nigo ekoba igoro ase oria okomorentera obosooku.
Okoiraneria kw’obwororo nigo kogokendia endamwamu, korende amang’ana ’obotindi nigo agoseegeta endamwamu.
Oromeme rw’omonto omong’aini nigo rogokwana aye chisemi chingiya, korende emenwa y’abariri nigo ekoumora ay’oboriri.
Amaiso ’Omonene nigo aroche ande onsi, nigo arigereretie ababe amo nabaya.
Oromeme rw’obokanyeku nigo rore omote bw’obogima, korende orw’obokorekanu nigo rogotandora enkoro.
Omoriri nigo agochaya amorokererio a ise akomorongeyia, korende oyokoigwera ogokurerwa nigo akong’ainia.
Enyomba y’omonyene oboronge nigo ere enene, korende ebitoki bi’abakori amabe nigo biichire nemechando.
Ebikoba bi’abang’aini nigo bikoraria chisemi, korende chinkoro chi’abariri tichiri gokora bo.
Ekeng’wanso ki’abakori amabe nigo kere okogechia ase Omonene, korende ogosaba kw’abare ne chinkoro chindonge nigo gokomogokia.
Enchera y’omokori amabe nigo ere okogechia ase Omonene, korende nigo anchete oyo okobwatia oboronge.
Egesusuro ekenene nkemonyore oyotigire enchera y’oboronge, na oyo ogechete ogokurerwa goika akwe.
Aase abakure ne chioora chi’obosiru nigo bire maiso marore ase Omonene. Inee! Tari mono kobua chinkoro chia mwanyabanto?
Omonyacheche tancheti omonto okomokurera, tagwancha kogenda ase abang’aini.
Enkoro ere nomosasoko nigo ekorenta omogoko ase obosio, korende onye enkoro ere nomoichano, omoyo nigo okoba nobororo.
Enkoro y’omonto ore nokomanya nigo ekorigia chisemi, korende emenwa y’abariri nigo ekwerageria oboriri.
Amatuko onsi ay’omonto ochandegete nigo are amabe, korende oyore nenkoro y’omosasoko nigo akogenderera koba nomoyega o botambe.
Mbuya koba nebinto ebike amo nokomoiroka Omonene, kobua koba ne chinibo chinyinge amo nemechando.
Mbuya koria chinyeni more nobwanchani, kobua koria chinyama chie chiombe chinoru na mogechaine.
Omonto ore nenkoro ekoberoroka bwango nigo agoseegeta eriomana, korende oyore omwororo nigo agokanya eriomana.
Enchera y’omonto omworo nigo enga buna orobago rw’amagwa, korende ey’abanyene oboronge nigo ere enene erongeete.
Omwana omong’aini nigo akogokia ise, korende oyore omoriri nigo agochaya ng’ina.
Oboriri nigo bore omogoko ase omonto otabwati okomanya, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge.
Ase ogosemania gotari, emeroberio nigo egosareka, korende ase abaesmia abange abaya bare nigo egokinigwa.
Omonto nigo akogokera okoiraneria okuya gokorua ase omonwa oye, ne ring’ana rigokwanwa ase engaki egwenerete, nigo rire rigiya mono.
Enchera y’omonto omong’aini nigo egotiira gochia ase obogima, erinde omonto oyio tabaisa kogenda inse agwo aase abakure.
Omonene nigo agotagora enyomba y’omonto omoenenu, korende arenda chimbebe chi’omoboraka.
Ebirengererio ebibe nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, korende amang’ana amaya nigo akomogokia.
Omonto ore ne ribero ase okorigia ebitoki ase enchera etari endonge nigo akorenta emechando ase enyomba yaye, korende oyo ogechete riaaki nabe moyo.
Enkoro y’omonyene oboronge nigo ekorengereria aya ekoiraneria, korende emenwa y’abakori amabe nigo ekoumora ayare amabe.
Omonene nigo are aare korwa ase abakori amabe, korende nigo akoigwa ogosaba kw’abanyene oboronge.
Amaiso are nomosasoko nigo akogokia enkoro, na amang’ana amaya akorentwa nigo akogokia amauga.
Omonto ogotegerera na koigwera ogokurerwa gokorenta obogima namenye amo nabanto abang’aini.
Omonto okwanga ogokurera, oyio nigo agochaya obogima bwaye omonyene, korende oyokoigwera ogokurerwa nigo akoba nokomanya.
Okomoiroka Omonene, nakwo amorokererio akorenta obong’aini, na oboitongo nigo bogotang’anera ogosikwa.
Mwanyabanto nigo agokora emeroberio ase enkoro yaye, korende aya oromeme rokoiraneria nigo akorwa ase Omonene.
Chinchera chionsi chi’omonto nigo chikororekana asare omonyene ng’a neching’ikeranu, korende Omonene nigo akorenga omoika o mwanyabanto.
Motweke Omonene emeremo yao, na emeroberio yao nesesenigwe.
Omonene okorire kera egento ase engencho gete, nonya nabakori amabe ase engencho ye rituko ri’emechando.
Kera omonto ore omoenenu nigo are okogechia ase Omonene; omonto oyio goika aegwe egesusuro.
Ase amabera, na obwegenwa, embooria yaakanirwe ase engencho y’ebibe, na ase okomoiroka Omonene omonto nigo akweatanana korwa ase amabe.
Ekero chinchera chi’omonto chiagokirie Omonene, Omonene nigo agokora nonya nababisa b’omonto oyio babwatana nere.
Mbuya koba nebinto ebike amo noboronge kobua koba ne chinibo chinyinge chikonyorwa ase oborianania.
Ase enkoro yaye ime omonto nigo akoroberia chinchera chiaye, korende Omonene nere okoraa amatambokero aye.
Chinkwana chinchenu nchigwenerete koba ase ebikoba bi’omoruoti, na omonwa oye tomocha ekero akonacha ebina.
Ekerengero ki’oborito gi’ekeene nigo gekorwa ase Omonene, na ebirengero bionsi bire ase chisaro nigo bire ogokora kwaye.
Ekero abaruoti bagokora amabe nigo bakorenta ay’okogechia, ekiagera goetera ase oboronge ekerogo ki’obogambi nigo kegokong’igwa.
Amang’ana amaronge agokwanwa nigo akogokia omoruoti, nere nigo abanchete abwo bagokwana ay’oboronge.
Endamwamu y’omoruoti nigo enga buna abatomwa bakorenta amakweri, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akoyekanya.
Omosasoko ore ase obosio bw’omoruoti nigo ore obogima, na ogwancherwa kwaye nigo konga buna amare agotwa embura y’okwamia endagera.
Konyora obong’aini, ayio namaya kobua konyora etahabu, na okoba nobomanyi nigo kogwenerete kobua koba nefeta.
Ogweatanana korwa ase amabe, eyio nero enchera enene y’abanyene oboronge; na omonto orendete enchera yaye, nigo arendete obogima bwaye.
Oboenenu nigo bogotang’anera ogosirigwa, na omoika bw’obomwenu nigo ogotang’anera okogwa.
Nigo ere buya koba nomoyo bw’oboitongo na komenya amo nabataka kobua gwatanana ebisakorwa amo nabaenenu.
Omonto okoigwera Ring’ana nanyore amaya, na oyo okomosemeria Omonene nasesenirie.
Omonto ore omong’aini ase enkoro yaye narokwe omomanyi, ne chinkwana chingiya nigo chikomenta chisemi.
Obong’aini nigo bore ensoko y’obogima ase omong’aini, korende oboriri nigo bore egesusuro ase oboriri.
Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekworokereria omonwa oye ong’aiinie, naende yamenta chisemi ase ebikoba biaye.
Amang’ana akogokia nigo anga obooke bokorwa ase richoe, nigo are amansu ase omoyo naende nigo akogwenia omobere.
Enchera nere ekororekana ase omonto ng’a nendonge, korende omoerio bw’enchera eyio namakweri.
Okogania kw’omonto nigo gokomobetereria gokora emeremo, ekiagera nigo aganetie gweisanekia ere omonyene.
Omonto otagwenereti kende nigo akona‐koremora amabe, ne chinkwana chiaye nigo chinga omorero ogosamba.
Omonto omonyaborimo nigo akona‐gotaara‐taaria amang’ana akorenta eriomana, na omogenki nigo akorenta obobisa ase abanto banchaine.
Omonto omotindi nigo akoebereria omonto onde omoraa gochia ase enchera embe.
Omonto ogosimera ebioge bi’amaiso aye nigo akoroberia amabe, na oyo ogotakuna omonwa oye nigo agoikerania amabe.
Chimbuche chire ase omotwe negutwa y’obonene, eyio nigo ekonyorekana ase enchera y’oboronge.
Omonto otari omwango ase okogechigwa nigo abuete omorwani etuoni, na oyomanyete kogambera enkoro yaye nigo abuete oyo okobua omochie na koyoira.
Obomera nigo bokorutwa ase esaro ime, korende Omonene nere ogochora oyo bokogwera.
Nigo ere buya konyora ritonge eriomo ri’obokima na koba nobotoereru kobua kobeera ase enyomba eichire endagera y’omoyega ere neriomana.
Omosomba omong’aini nagambere omwana bw’omonene oye, oyio ogokora amang’ana ’obosooku, naende naatananerwe omwando amo nabana b’omonene oye.
Efeta nigo egoteemerwa ase enyongo ekoyenyititora, na etahabu yateemerwa ase omorero ekebemberi, korende Omonene nere okorenga chinkoro.
Omokori amabe nigo agotegerera oigwera amang’ana ’obokorekanu, na omonyaborimo nigo akoigwera chinkwana chi’ogosiria.
Omonto ogochecheria omotaka nigo agochaya Omotongi bw’omotaka oyio, na oyokogokera emechando yanyorire abande, takomocha konyora egesusuro.
Abachokoro nigo bare egutwa ye chisokoro chiabo, na obonene bw’abana nigo bore abaibori babo.
Amang’ana amaya tagwenereti omoriri, ne chinkwana chi’oborimo tichigwenereti omogambi nonya ng’ake.
Riaaki nigo ringa buna rigena rikomeka‐meka ase amaiso ’omonto oria okoriegwa, ekiagera nigo akorengereria ng’a kende gionsi ararikorere nigo riramorentere ebisio.
Omonto okwabera aya akomocherwa nigo akorigia obwanchani, korende oria okona‐koinyora nigo agosarania abasani.
Omonto ore nobomanyi nigo akweorokereria korwa ase ogotogonyerwa okomo, kobua omonto omoriri otari kweorokereria korwa ase ogoakwa ebiranya rigana erimo.
Omonto omosaria nigo akonakorigia gokora amabe oka, natomerwe omonto omotindi amoe egesusuro.
Mbuya omonto aumerane neng’iti entindi ekorokwa edubu yaurirwe chimanwa chiaye, kobua koumerana nomonto omoriri ase oboriri bwaye.
Omonto ogoakana amabe ase amaya, obobe tibokorua ase enyomba yaye.
Ogochaka eriomana nigo konga buna amache aigoreirwe, ase ayio tiga amang’ana ’eriomana atarabucha.
Omonto ogwanchera omokori amabe ng’a nomonyakeene, na oria okonachera omonyakeene ekina, abwo bonsi nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene.
Inee! Chibesa omonto omoriri abwate ase okoboko kwaye agochia kogora obong’aini nechia ki, na ere tari nokomanya?
Omosani nigo akoba nobwanchani ase chingaki chionsi, na oyomino nigo aiboire akonye ase engaki y’emechando.
Omonto oremeire chisemi nigo akobwatana amaboko na kwerua koba intenenera ase omonto onde.
Omonto bwanchete eriomana nigo anchete ogosaria, na oyokoimokereria egesieri kiaye igoro nigo akwerigeria ogosirigwa.
Omonto ore omokorekanu ase enkoro yaye tari goseseneka, na oyobwate oromeme rw’ogosiria nigo akonyorwa nemechando.
Oyo oiboire omwana omoriri nigo akoba nomoichano, na ise omwana oyio tari koba nomogoko.
Enkoro ere nomogoko nigo ekogwenia buna eriogo, korende omoichano ore ase enkoro nigo okwomia emeseto y’amauga.
Omokori amabe nigo akoegwa riaaki bobisi, erinde asarie chinchera chi’ekina.
Omonto ore nokomanya nigo akorigereria gochia ase obong’aini, korende omonto omoriri nigo akorigereria gochia ase chinsinyo chi’ense.
Omwana omomura omoriri nigo agoichania ise, naende nigo akorenta obororo ase ngina omoiborete.
Tari buya korua egesusuro ase omonto omoronge, boigo tari buya goaka abanto abasike ase engencho y’oboronge bwabo.
Omonto omong’aini nigo akwerita ase amang’ana agokwana, na omonto ore nokomanya nigo abwate omoika bw’oboremereria.
Nonya nomonto omoriri, ekero agokira, nigo akobarwa ng’a nomong’aini are; gakomumeka omonwa oye nigo akorokwa omong’aini.
Omonto bweanchete omonyene, nigo akweganeria ayaye oka; nigo akwanga otindia nonya nase onsi ayare amaya.
Omoriri tari kogokigwa nay’obong’aini, korende nigo anchete gokwana ayare ase enkoro yaye omonyene.
Ekero omokori amabe agocha, ogochaywa nigo kogocha boigo, na ogochaywa okwo nigo gokorenta obosooku.
Amang’ana akorua ase omonwa bw’omonto nigo anga buna amache e chindiba, ensoko y’obong’aini nigo enga buna amache ’orooche akominyoka.
Tari buya gwanchereria omokori amabe na gosaria ekina ki’omonyene oboronge.
Chinkwana chi’omoriri nigo chikorenta eriomana, na omonwa oye nigo okorangeria ogoakwa.
Omonwa bw’omoriri nigo okomorentera ogosirigwa, ne chinkwana chiaye nigo chikoba omoeto asare.
Amang’ana ’omogenki nigo are buna endagera enyansu; naro nigo agotirimboka gochia ase enkoro ime.
Omonto ogokora emeremo yaye nobworo nigo are oyomwabo omosaria.
Erieta ri’Omonene nigo rire orwaki orokong’u; omonyene oboronge nigo akorotamera oba orendire buya.
Omonto omonda nigo akorengereria ng’a obotenenku bwaye nigo bonga buna omochie omokong’u, naende buna orwaki orotambe gochia igoro rokomorenda.
Oboenenu bw’enkoro y’omonto nigo bogotang’anera ogosirigwa, na oboitongo nigo bogotang’anera ogosikwa.
Omonto okoiraneria ring’ana atarariigwa buya, obwo noboriri asare, na nigo akonyora obosooku.
Omoika bw’oboremu nigo okogera omonto oremereria ogochandeka, korende omoika ore nomoichano ning’o orayoremererie.
Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekonyora chisemi, na ogoto kwaye nigo kogochirigia.
Ebiegwa bi’omonto nigo bikomoigorera enchera na komobeka amo nabanto abanene.
Omonto gekwaneire ritang’ani nigo akororekana ng’a nekeene agokwana, korende omonto omoao gachire, nigo akoorokia amang’ana ayio buna are.
Obomera nabwo bogokoora okoamererania na gwatanana abanene abwo bakoamererania.
Nigo ere aakong’u koirania ase obosani omonto omocheirwe, kobua koirania omochie omokong’u, na eriomana nigo ringa buna emekorogoto y’ebiita bi’orwaki orokong’u.
Omonto nigo agoisanekia enda yaye nogokwana kw’omonwa oye, akoigotigwa nokwama kw’omonwa oye.
Amakweri na obogima nigo bire ase chinguru chi’oromeme, na abwo banchete korokorera emeremo mbanyore okwama kwaye.
Omonto onyorire omokungu omuya, oyio onyorire ekeegwa ekiya na ay’ogwancherwa korwa ase Omonene.
Ekero omonto omotaka agokwana nigo agosorora, korende omonda nigo akoiraneria ase obotindi.
Omonto obwate abasani abange nigo akwerentera emechando, korende nare omosani bw’ekeene baigwanaine kobua oyomwabo.
Omonto omotaka ore omwegenwa nigo are omuya kobua oyore omong’ainereria ase chinkwana chiaye naende omoriri.
Tari buya omonto aborwe okomanya ase omoyo oye, na oyore namagoro amaango, nigo agosira.
Oboriri bw’omonto nigo bokomosiria ase enchera yaye, erio enkoro y’omonto oyio yagechigwa ase Omonene.
Omonto omonda nigo akonyora abasani abange, korende omotaka nigo akwangwa nomosani oye.
Kirori bw’oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro, na omonto ogokwana oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro kiaye.
Abanto abange nigo bakorigia ogwancherwa korwa ase abanene b’obogambi, na abange nigo bakoba abasani b’omonto okorua ebiegwa nomoyo omorabu.
Omonto omotaka nigo akogechwa nabanto bamwabo bonsi, gose tikori ogokumia ng’a abasani baye bamotigire. Nigo egenete amang’ana abo, ko aba bosa asare.
Omonto okonyora obong’aini, oyio nere obwanchire obogima bwaye, na oyo okorenda obomanyi bwaye nanyore amaya.
Kirori bw’oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro, na oyo ogokwana oborimo goika asire.
Tari buya omonto omoriri amenye ase obogima bw’okwegokia; onye ere bo, tari buya omosomba agambere abagambi nonya ng’ake.
Obong’aini bw’omonto nigo bokogera oremereria okogechigwa, na okoombia okomocha nigo kore obonene bwaye.
Ekero omoruoti abeire nekeririanda nigo anga buna endo ekoruma, korende ogwancherwa kwaye nigo konga buna riime rire ase obonyansi.
Omwana omomura omoriri nigo akorentera ise amabe, na omokungu okona‐kwomana nigo anga buna amatoima ’embura akona‐gotonya.
Chinyomba ne chinibo nigo chire omwando abana bakonyora korwa ase abaise korende omokungu omong’aini nigo are ekeegwa korwa ase Omonene.
Obworo nigo bokorentera omonto chitoro chindito, na omonto buna oyio goika abe nenchara.
Omonto orendete amachiko, oyio nigo arendete obogima bwaye, korende oyo otari korenda chinchera chiaye nigo arakwe.
Omonto okororera omotaka amabera, oyio nigo akorua singo ase Omonene, na Omonene namoakane ase ogokora okwo kwaye.
Orokereria omwana oo omomura ase okomorongeyia ekero ogosemeria koreo, gose tobaisa komoganeria amakweri.
Omonto ore nekeririanda, ekeene goika anyore egesusuro; oise komotanga kagokora bobe nigo okomoseegeta.
Igwera ogosemigwa naende bwanche okworokererigwa, igo nario oranyore obong’aini boragokonye ase chingaki chire bosio.
Emeroberio emenge nere ase enkoro y’omonto, korende nonya naboigo emeroberio y’Omonene nero eratenene.
Okogania kw’omonto nigo gokworokia obuya bwaye, na omonto omotaka nigo are omuya mono kobua omonyaborimo.
Okomoiroka Omonene nigo gokorenta obogima, na omonto ore nokoiroka okwo nigo agoisaneka, gose amabe takomonyora.
Omonto omworo nigo akobeka okoboko kwaye ase esani y’endagera, gose tagokoimokia gocha ase omonwa oye.
Aka omonto omonyacheche, na abanto batamanyeti amange mbeorokererie korwa ase ayio; togonyera omonto ore nokomanya, ere nigo aranyore chisemi.
Omwana ore omotindi ase ise na ogoseria ng’ina, nigo akorenta obosooku na ogochaya.
Omwana one, onye tokoigwera amorokererio nigo orasire korwa ase amang’ana akorenta chisemi.
Kirori omobe nigo agochecheria oboronge, na omonwa bw’omokori amabe nigo ogworerete ebibe.
Ekina ki’abanyacheche nigo kenachire, na abariri mbang’wanigwe ebiranya ase emegongo yabo.
Edivai nigo ekorenta echeche, ekenyugwa egetindi nigo gekorenta eriomana; na onde bwensi otari gokianga nigo akoborwa obong’aini.
Okogosa kw’omoruoti nigo konga buna okoruma kw’endo, na oyo okomogechia oba nendamwamu, oyio nigo akogera obogima bwaye bosirigwe.
Nigo are amasikani ase omonto ogwetanga korwa ase eriomana, korende kera omonto ore omoriri nigo akona‐kwomana.
Omonto omworo tari korema ase engaki egwenerete, na ekero rigesa riaikire, nigo akogenda gosuma, takonyora gento.
Emeroberio ere ase enkoro y’omonto nigo enga buna amache are ase endiba, korende omonto ore nokomanya nigo akoyabucha korwa aroro.
Abanto abange nigo bakweraria ng’a nabaya bare, korende ning’o oranyare konyora omonto omwegenwa bori?
Omonto omonyene oboronge obwatetie chinchera chindonge, abana baye mbasesenigwe korwa nyuma yaye.
Omoruoti ogoikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye gi’ekegambero nigo agoserebania amabe onsi namaiso aye.
Ning’o oranyare goteba, “Nasibekire ase enkoro yane; nachenekire korwa ase ebibe biane”?
Ebirengero bi’oborito, na ebi’obonge, bire ara kabere, nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene.
