Nonya nomwana nigo amanyekanete ase ogokora kwaye, gose orogendo rwaye nigo rorabe ororonge na orw’ekeene.
Ogoto gokoigwa, na eriso rikorora, bionsi bibere n’Omonene obikorete.
Tobaisa gwancha chitoro, obaise koba omotaka; ramokia amaiso ao, naye nonyore endagera enyinge.
Omogori egento nigo agoteba: “Eke tigeisaini gento”, na ekero akeirire bwetogia.
Etahabu nere, na amagena amange e rigori rinene, korende ebikoba bigokwana ay’obong’aini nigo binga buna amagena e rigori rinene akomeka‐meka.
Ira eanga y’omonto oyo bwerure koba intenenera ase omonto omoao, ira ebi abwate, ekiagera bwerure ase engencho y’omonto otamanyekaneti.
Endagera ekonyorwa ase enchera y’obong’ainereria, nigo ekoba enyansu ase omonto, korende nyuma yaye omonwa bw’omonto oyio nigo ogoichorwa nomokenye.
Emeroberio nigo egoikeranigwa goetera ase ogosemia okuya na gokorwana esegi, oyerwanie nogosemania okuya.
Omonto okona‐goeta‐etia obogenki nigo akoorokia obobisi, ase ayio tobaisa kobwatana nomonto otari kwerita ase amang’ana aye.
Omonto oraragererie ise, gose ng’ina, oyio etaya yaye nerimigwe ekero ki’omosunte ekerima.
Oise koba ne ribero ase okonyora omwando bwango korwa omochakano, omoerio oye tori gosesenigwa.
Tobaisa goteba, “Goika ng’akane amabe nakoreirwe.” Oganye Omonene, nere oragokonye.
Ebirengo bi’oborito bire ara kabere nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, na ekerengero gi’okoreng’anania ki’oborimo nigo kere ekebe.
Omonene nere okoraa chinchera chi’omonto, ase ayio naki omonto aranyare komanya chinchera chiaye?
Nigo ekoba omoeto ase omonto karabe omwango ase ogwatanana egento kebe egechenu, na nyuma yaye oba okorengereria aya arierete eira.
Omoruoti ore omong’aini nigo akomanya abakori amabe obaatanana, erio obatiringera inse namagoro e chigari.
Omoika ore ase omonto, noro etaya y’Omonene; nigo ekomoreka na komanya amang’ana onsi are ime y’enkoro y’omonto.
Obuya na obwegenwa, nabio bikorenda omoruoti, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obogambi nigo kegokong’igwa namabera.
Chinguru nachio chire obonene bw’abamura, korende chimbuche nigo chire obwari bw’abanto abagotu.
Obororo bw’ogoakwa nenyimbo nigo bogosibia ebibe, boigo ogoakwa kw’ebiranya nigo kogosoa ase enkoro ime kwayesibia.
Enkoro y’omoruoti nigo enga buna orooche rore ase okoboko kw’Omonene; na Omonene nigo akomoraa gochia aande onsi buna aganetie.
Kera enchera y’omonto nigo ekororekana ng’a neya boronge asare, korende Omonene nigo akorenga chinkoro.
Ogokora oboronge na ekeene, ayio naro Omonene agwancha kobua ebing’wanso.
Amaiso are noboenenu, na enkoro y’obomwenu, ebio nigo bire etaya y’abakori amabe, bikobaraa bakora ebibe.
Emeroberio y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekomorentera ebitoki ebinge, korende omonto okoayerera nigo akogenderera koremerwa.
Chinibo chikonyorwa ase oromeme rw’obong’ainereria, nigo chire buna omooki okoera bwango, na buna amareba akorenta amakweri.
Obourereria bw’abakori amabe mbobasirie barueo, ekiagera bangire gokora ayare ay’oboronge.
Enchera y’omomochi nigo ere enkorekanu, korende ogokora kw’oyore nenkoro endonge nigo kore okoronge.
Mbuya komenya ase ekenunchi kia irongo, kobua komenya ase enyomba amo nomokungu omonyariomana.
Omoyo bw’omokori amabe nigo okogania gokora ebibe, na omonto oyio tari kororera omonto onde amabera.
Ekero omonto omonyacheche akonyora egesusuro, oria otamanyeti amange nigo akoba omong’aini; na ekero omonto omong’aini akworokererigwa nigo akonyora chisemi.
Omonyene oboronge nigo akorigereria enyomba y’omokori amabe; ere nigo akoiyeria abakori amabe inse basire.
Omonto oria ogosieka amato aye ng’a taigwa ekerero ki’omotaka, nere ekero ararere takoigugwa.
Ekeegwa gekoruegwa bobisi nigo kegokendia endamwamu, ne riaaki ribisire ase eanga ime nigo rigokendia ekeririanda.
Ekero ekeene giakorirwe, ayio nigo akoba omogoko bw’abanyene oboronge, korende ase abakori amabe nomoichano.
Omonto ogotiga enchera y’obomanyi, oyio nabeere ase omosangererekano bw’abanto bakwete.
Omonto bwanchete emegoko goika abe omotaka; na oyobwanchete kwegokia nedivai na amaguta takoba omonda.
Omokori amabe nigo agosoa ase emechando y’omonyene oboronge, oba embooria yaye, na oyo otari omwegenwa oba embooria y’oyore nenkoro endonge.
Mbuya komenya ase ense y’erooro, kobua komenya nomokungu omonyariomana, naende omonyandamwamu.
Omonto omong’aini nigo akorenda chinibo chi’engencho enene amo namaguta ase enka yaye, korende omoriri nigo agochiria bobe chiaera.
Omonto okorigia oboronge na obwororo, oyio nanyore obogima, na amasikani, na oboronge.
Omonto omong’aini nigo akoumokera omochie ore nabarwani esegi chituoni oyobua, erio otagora chindwaki chiria abanto abwo basemeretie.
Omonto orendete omonwa oye, na oromeme rwaye, oyio nigo etangerete emechando.
Omonto ore omoenenu na omwerori, na ogokora kwaye kore okw’obomwenu, nigo akorokwa “Omonyacheche”.
Okogania kw’omonto omworo nigo gokomoita okwa, ekiagera nigo akwanga gokora emeremo namaboko aye.
Omonto omong’iti nigo akweganeria kera egento botambe, korende omonyene oboronge nigo akorua na tari kong’itia.
Ekeng’wanso ki’omokori amabe nigo kere okogechia, Inee, tari bobe mono goetania ekero agokerua nebirengererio ebibe?
Kirori bw’oborimo nasire, korende omonto ogotegerera nagenderere gokwana.
Omokori amabe nigo agokong’ia obosio bwaye, korende oyore nenkoro endonge nigo akorenda orogendo rwaye.
Obong’aini tibori, gose okomanya, gose ogosemia, biranyare koamererania n’Omonene.
Chibarasi nigo chikobekwa ang’e kogenda korwana esegi, korende obobui nigo bokorua ase Omonene.
Erieta rigiya nigo rigwenerete gochorwa kobua chinibo chinyinge, na okomanyekana okuya nigo kobuete efeta na etahabu.
Omonda na omotaka nigo bamenyete ase obogima obomo; Omonene nere omotongi o bonsi.
Omonto omong’aini nigo akororera emechando korwa aare, bwebisa, korende oyotamanyeti amange nigo akogenderera gochia bosio, oumerana nero, erio ochandeka.
Abare abaitongo bamoirogete Omonene nigo bakonyora obotenenku, na ogosikwa, na obogima.
Amagwa na emeeto nigo bitegire ase chinchera chi’abanto abakorekanu, korende oyo orendete omoyo oye goika eatanane korwa ase birobio.
Orokereria omwana abwatie enchera egwenerete, na ekero abeire omogotu takoyetiga.
Omonto omonda nigo akogambera omotaka; na omonto ogosaba aegwe singo nigo akoba omosomba bw’oria omoa singo.
Oyogosimeka obobe, nagese ogosareka, na enyimbo y’endamwamu yaye nigo erasire bosa.
Omonto obwate eriso ri’amabera nasesenigwe, ekiagera bwatananeire omotaka endagera.
Seria omonyacheche, na eriomana ndiere, ee, eriomana na ogochaya mbisire.
Omonto bwanchete enkoro echenegete, na ebikoba biaye bigokwana ayare ay’obuya, omoruoti nabe omosani oye.
Amaiso ’Omonene nigo arigereretie na korenda oyore nokomanya, korende nigo akoonchorana na gosaria amang’ana ’abatari abegenwa.
Omonto omworo nigo agoteba, “Endo nere isiko! Nigo ndabaise gochia goiterwa ase chinchera.”
Omonwa bw’omokungu omotayayi nigo ore eirima entambe, na omonto onde bwensi Omonene agechigwe nere goika agwe ase eirima eyio.
Oboriri nigo bosiberanirie ime ase enkoro y’omwana, korende ekeranya gekorongeyia amamocho nigo gekoborusieo.
Ere oyo ogokorera abataka bobe ase ogwetenenkia ere omonyene, gose okorua ebiegwa ase abanda, goika aremerwe.
Tega ogoto kwao oigwe amang’ana abanto abang’aini bagokwana, na obeke amorokererio aane ime ase enkoro yao.
Nigo erabe buya korayarende ime yao, erinde abe ang’e ase ebikoba biao koyakwana.
Rituko ria rero nakoyamanyirie, ee, nakoyamanyirie, erinde omosemerie Omonene.
Inee! Tinkorikereti amang’ana amanene ay’ogosemia na ay’amorokererio?
Ayio nakworokererie ayare ay’oboronge na ay’ekeene, erinde okwane ay’oboronge na ekeene ase abwo bagotomete.
Tobaisa koura omotaka ekiaye, ekiagera are omotaka, gose agwo ase egeita tobaisa gokorera bobe omonto ochandegete.
Omonene narwanerere abataka, na abwo bakobaurereria Omonene nabasirie.
Tobaisa gokora obosani nomonto ore omwango ase okobeea gose tobaisa kogenda amo nomonto ore nekeririanda.
Oise kobwatana noyio, nigo orenarie chinchera chiaye, erio obwatwe ase oboreba.
Tobaisa koba oyomo bw’abanto abwo bakobwatana amaboko, gose bakwerua koba intenenera ase chisira chi’abanto bande.
Nobaise kourwa oborere bwao okorarera, ekiagera tobwati gento ogoakana.
Tobaisa gotumana orobebe orokoro orwo chisokoro chiao chiabegete.
Oise korora omonto omanyete emeremo yaye buya, oyio natenene ase amasio ’abaruoti, tagokorera abanto bande bonsi emeremo.
Ekero ogoikaransa koria endagera amo nomogambi, orengererie mono ng’a ning’o ore ase obosio bwao.
Onye kore nenchara, obeke omoyio ase ring’orong’oche riao.
Tobaisa kogania chindagera chiaye chinyansu, ekiagera nigo chire echi’obong’ainereria.
Tobaisa gwechanda mono ng’a obe omonda; tobaisa gosemeria obong’aini bwao omonyene.
Tobaisa korigereria ebio bire bosa, ekiagera obonda nigo bogochoma chimbaba, bwairuruka buna ensoti ekoiruruka yarimera igoro.
Tobaisa koria endagera y’omonto ogokomogorera, gose tobaisa kogania chindagera chiaye chinyansu.
Buna omonto akorengereria ime ase enkoro yaye, naboigo are. Nigo akogotebia, “Karie na konywa”, korende enkoro yaye tegwancheti.
Ayio nigo aragere oroke endagera eria kwaria, naende amang’ana ao amaya asire bosa.
Tobaisa gokwana amang’ana ao ase omonto omoriri aigwete, ekiagera nigo arachaye obong’aini bw’amang’ana ao.
Tobaisa gotumana orobebe orokoro, gose totumana osoe ase emegondo ye chintakana,
ekiagera Omobooria obo nigo are ne chinguru, ere nachirwanerere akorwanie aye.
Karue enkoro yao oigwe amorokererio, na amato ao aigwe amang’ana e chisemi.
Tobaisa gotiga korongeyia omwana oo; koramoake ekeranya, tagochia gokwa.
Ee, koramoake ekeranya nigo oratoorie obogima bwaye korwa aase abakure.
Omwana one, onye enkoro yao ekoba nobong’aini, rirorio enkoro yane nigo eragoke.
Ekero ebikoba biao birakwane amang’ana amaronge, nigo ndabe nomogoko ime yane.
Enkoro yao tebaisa koba ne ribero ase abanyene ebibe, korende aye ogenderere komoiroka Omonene kera rituko.
Ekeene, eng’eria nekare bosio, na ogosemeria kwao tikogosira bosa.
Aye omwana one, igwa na obe nobong’aini, naende orende enkoro yao ebwatie enchera endonge.
Tobaisa koba ase egati y’abagotinda nedivai, gose ase egati y’abakoria chinyama bobe,
ekiagera abagotinda, na abaria bobe, mbabe abataka; na obogondereria bwe chitoro nigo boraboyie omonto amachanchabe.
Igwera iso okoiborete, na tobaisa gochaya nyoko ekero agotire.
Gora ekeene, na tobaisa gokeoonia; boigo gora obong’aini, na amorokererio, na obomanyi.
Ise bw’omonto ore omonyene oboronge nigo akoba nomogoko omonene. Ere oyoiboire omwana omomura omong’aini nagokigwe nere.
Bagokie iso na nyoko, tiga oria okoiborete akogokere.
Omwana one, ing’a enkoro yao, na amaiso ao tiga agokere chinchera chiane.
Omokungu omotayayi nigo anga engoro entambe gochia inse, na omokungu bw’omonto onde nigo anga egesima ekenyerere.
Ee, omokungu oyio nigo akoboera buna omouri, nigo akomentekania abasaria ase egati ya mwanyabanto.
Ning’o oyio ore nobobe? Ning’o oyio oichanete? Ning’o oyio okorwana na kwerera? Ning’o oyio oakirwe chingoma chitagwenerete aakwe? Ning’o oyio obariiretie amaiso?
Nabanto abwo bakona‐konywa edivai ase chingaki chintambe, na abwo bakona‐korigia konywa edivai yochoganirie neyende.
Tobaisa korigereria edivai koyabariirire, ekero ekobera ase egekombe na koirana inse ng’ora ng’ora.
Omoerio nigo ekoroma buna eng’iti na korasa buna rirubi.
Amaiso ao nigo ararore amang’ana amageni, na ebirengererio biao mbibe ebikorekanu.
Nigo orabe buna omonto oraire ase egati‐gati y’enyancha, gose buna omonto ore ase omote omotambe igoro okoirwa esiororia.
Aye nigo oratebe, “Nigo bang’agete bororo, korende tinyigweti bobe; nigo bang’wanetie bokong’u, korende tinyigweti kende. Indi ngocha koboka? Ngende korigia eyende.”
Aye tobaisa koba ne ribero ase abakori amabe, gose togania koba amo nabarabwo,
ekiagera ebirengererio biabo nigo bikoroberia ay’ogosiria, na ebikoba biabo nigo bigokwama ayakorenta emechando.
Enyomba nigo ekoagachwa nobong’aini na yakong’igwa goetera ase okomanya.
Ase chisemi chire, chiero chi’enyomba eyio nigo chigoichorigwa nebinto ao ao bi’engencho enene, na ebi’okogokia.
Omonto omong’aini nigo are ne chinguru, na oyore nokomanya nigo akoorokia okobua okonene.
Ase ogosemia kw’obong’aini kore, nonyare korwana esegi, na ase abasemia abange abaya bare, obobui nigo bokonyorekanao.
Obong’aini nigo bore egento kere aare korwa ase omonto omoriri; ere tari komaanora omonwa oye agwo ase egeita.
Ere oyokoroberia gokora amabe narokwe omonto okorenta emechando.
Ebirengererio bi’oboriri nebibe, na omonyacheche nigo are okogechia ase abanto.
Korarose na gotang’ang’a ase engaki y’obokong’u rirorio aye nigo ore omoreu otari na nguru.
Tooria abwo bakoirwa gochia gokwa; irania abwo bakoirwa gochia goitwa.
Oise goteba, “Intwe titwamanyete amang’ana aya”, Inee, oyio okorenga chinkoro tamanyeti ayio? Oyio origereretie omoyo oo nigo amanyete ayio, na nigo araakane kera omonto buna ogokora kwaye kore.
Aye omwana one, karie obooke, ekiagera nobuya; obooke bogotonya korwa ase eriana nigo bore obwansu asore.
Manya ng’a obong’aini buna obwo mboganeirie ase omoyo oo, korabonyore, rirorio nonyore amaya ase amatuko agochi‐gocha, na ogosemeria kwao tikogosira bosa.
Aye omokori amabe, tobaisa koboera omonyene oboronge ase amenyete, tosaria aase aye agotimokera.
Omonyene oboronge nigo akogwa ara gatano na kabere, naende oboka, korende abakori amabe nigo bagosira ekero banyorire emechando.
Tobaisa kogoka ekero omobisa oo agure, na enkoro yao tebaisa gosasoka ekero agochirwe.
Omonene nigo ararore okogoka okwo agechigwe, erio aonchore endamwamu yaye erue ase omobisa oo.
Aye togechigwa ase engencho y’abagokora amabe, gose tobaisa koba ne ribero ase abakori amabe.
Abagokora amabe tibakonyora amaya ase amatuko agochi‐gocha; etaya y’abakori amabe nerimigwe.
Aye omwana one, omoiroke Omonene, oiroke na omoruoti, tobaisa gosang’anana nabasaria.
Abwo nigo baranyore emechando ya mobosokano, na ning’o oranyare komanya ogosirigwa kwabo?
Amang’ana aya boigo nay’abang’aini. Tari buya gwanchereria abanto ekero ebina bikonachwa.
Oyo ogotebia omonto omomochi, “Aye tori nokomocha”, oyio abanto mbamoragererie, na abanto b’ebisaku nigo baramogeche.
Korende abwo bakoa omomochi egesusuro mbanyore amaya amo nogosesenigwa okuya.
Omonto okoiraneria amairanerio amaronge nigo anga okonyunyuntwa kw’ebikoba.
Roisia emeremo yao isiko onsi, naende kora emeremo yao ya mogondo eere, na nyuma y’ayio oagache enyomba yao.
Tobaisa koba kirori o bosa mamincha y’omonto onde, na tobaisa kong’ainereria nebikoba biao.
Tobaisa goteba, “Goika nainche imokorere buna ankorera; goika imoakane buna ogokora kwaye kore.”
Ngaeta ase omogondo bw’omonto omworo, na ase omogondo bw’emesabibu bw’omonto otari nobong’aini.
Nkarora omogondo oyio omerire amagwa, na amasa ayotubire, na amagena aagacheire chindwaki chiaye konya atagokire.
Nkayorigereria na korengereria mono igoro y’omogondo oyio, nkanyora amorokererio aya:
Okorara ake, na ogosundoka ake, na okoringania amaboko ake,
goika obotaka bogochere buna omouri, na okoremerwa kogochere buna omorwani esegi.
Eye nero emereng’anio ya Sulemani, eyio abanto ba Hezekia omoruoti bw’Abayuda, basangereretie.
Nigo bore obonene bwa Nyasae kobisa amang’ana; korende nobonene bw’abaruoti gokora obotuki ase amang’ana.
Buna koreng’ana igoro ere aare mono etatukwe emanywe, na ayare ase ense inse boigo, ne chinkoro chi’abaruoti tichigotukwa chimanywe.
Rusia amabiria korwa ase efeta, na omoturi nanyore efeta akoroiseria egekorero ekiya.
Rusia abakori amabe korwa ase obosio bw’omoruoti, erio ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nigo keragenderere gokong’igwa noboronge.
Tobaisa gwetang’anania ase obosio bw’omoruoti, gose tobaisa kwebeka aase abanene bare.
Nigo erabe buya mono ekero oratebigwe, “Inchuo gocha aa”, kobua gokoiranigwa gochia goikaransa nyuma ribaga ri’abanto abasike.
Toba omwango kogenda ase ekegambero. Inee! Inki orakore ase omoerio, ekero omonto oyio gwasoerete arakobue nobe nobosooku?
Onye aye omonyene kobwate amang’ana nomonto onde, kwana nere, korende tobaisa koorokia obobisi bw’omonto omoao.
Oise koboorokia, na omonto onde aise koigwa ayio, nigo aragosookie, na erieta riao risareke kogenderera botambe.
Ring’ana rigokwanwa ase enchera egwenerete nigo ringa buna amatunda amororo amaya mono abekire ase egekabu keroisirie korwa ase efeta.
Omonto omong’aini ogokurera oyokoigwera nigo are buna ebonyi ne chisonoi biroseirie chitahabu.
Omotomwa ore omwegenwa nigo are ase abwo bakomotoma buna amache amakendu ase engaki ye rigesa, ekiagera nigo akogera emioyo yabo yaba emeyia.
Omonto ogwetogia ng’a nare nomoyo omorabu, ko tari korua ebiegwa, nigo anga amare na omwaga bitari korenta embura.
Oboremereria nigo bokwororobia omogambi, na oromeme rw’obwororo nigo rokobuna riuga.
Onye kwanyorire obooke, karie ekerengo kegoisaine; oise kogeetania nigo oraboroke.
Amagoro ao tanara kona‐kogenda ase enyomba y’omosani oo, nigo arabaise korosa naye, erinde akogeche.
Omonto okoba kirori bw’oborimo ase omonto onde nigo anga buna enungu y’esegi, gose omoro, gose ensara enyonge.
Ogosemeria omonto otari omwegenwa ase engaki y’emechando, nigo enga buna erino ribunegete gose okogoro goteng’eretie.
Omonto ogotera amatera ’omogoko ase omonto obwate enkoro ere nobororo nigo anga buna okorusia eanga ase engaki y’obokendu gose kobeka egento ekeroro ase eriote.
Onye omobisa oo ore nenchara, moe endagera arie; onye ore nerang’o, moe amache anywe.
Igo nobeke omorero bw’amakara ase omotwe oye, na Omonene nakoe eng’eria yao.
Omwaga okogusa korwa sugusu nigo okorenta embura, naboigo nomonto omogenki akorenta okobeeana.
Mbuya komenya ase ekenunchi kia irongo igoro, kobua komenya ase enyomba amo nomokungu omonyariomana.
Amang’ana amaya akorentwa korwa ase ense y’aare nigo anga buna amache amakendu ase omonto ore nerang’o.
Omonyene oboronge okorua ribaga ase omokori amabe nigo anga buna orooche rore netintira na buna ensoko yasarekire.
Tari buya koria obooke obonge, na abwo bakwerigeria obonene, obonene bwabo nigo borabe bosa.
Omonto otamanyeti kwegambera omonyene nigo anga buna omochie chindwaki chiaye chiatagoirwe.
Buna koreng’ana obokendu bogocha ase engaki y’egurugura, gose embura egotwa ase engaki ye rigesa, naboigo ere bobe omonto omoriri konyora amasikani.
Buna enchiro ekona‐koong’anya, na buna egesingororo gekoiruruka, naboigo na okoragereria gotari nengencho gotaikerere oria oragererigwe.
Ekeranya nigo kere ase ogoaka ebarasi, na ekeokio ase okoraa etigere, naboigo nenyimbo ere ase ogoaka omogongo bw’omonto omoriri.
Tobaisa koiraneria omonto omoriri buna oboriri bwaye bore, nigo orabaise koba omoriri buna are.
Moiranerie omonto omoriri buna oboriri bwaye bore, tabaisa gwekaga ng’a nomong’aini are.
Omonto ogotoma amang’ana ase okoboko kw’omonto omoriri, oyio nigo akobutora amaboko aye omonyene bwerentera emechando.
Omoreng’anio ogokwanwa nomonwa bw’omoriri nigo onga buna omonto egesegora, okogoro kwaye gotari gokora emeremo.
Omonto okoa omoriri amasikani, nigo anga buna oyokoruta omobuko ore nebinto bie rigori rinene ase etui y’amagena.
Omoreng’anio okorwa ase omonwa bw’omonto omoriri nigo onga buna rigwa rikobeta okoboko kw’omonto otindire amarwa.
Omonto omanyete emeremo nigo agwekorera emeremo emiya, korende oyore omoriri nigo akorika onde bwensi ogoeta, na emeremo yasareka.
Omonto omoriri okoiranera gokora oboriri bwaye nigo anga esese ekoiranera amaroki aye enyene.
Oise korora omonto ogwekora omong’aini, ogosemeria nkore ase omonto omoriri kobua ase oyio.
Omonto omworo nigo agoteba, “Endo nere isiko, ee, endo nere ase chinchera chi’omochie.”
Omonto omworo nigo akonakweoncha‐onchora buna egesieri gekona‐koonchorwa ase chimbata gesibeire.
Omonto omworo nigo akobeka okoboko kwaye ase esani y’endagera, orosa gokobogoria gocha ase omonwa oye.
Omonto omworo nigo akwerora ng’a nomong’aini are abuete abanto batano na babere barakwane amang’ana are nengencho.
Omonto orenge goeta na gwesoyia ase eriomana ritarenge eriaye nigo anga buna oyo okobwata amato ’esese.
Omonto okong’aina omonto onde, na nyuma yaye omotebia, “Negosori yoka nare gokora asore,” oyio nigo anga buna ebarimo ekoruta ebigenga bi’omorero, ne chinsara, na amakweri.
Ase chinko chitari, omorero nigo okorima, naboigo nase omogenki atari, eriomana nigo rigosira.
Omonyariomana ogoseegeta amariomana nigo anga buna amakara akogenderera koyia, gose chinko chikogera omorero ogenderera gwoka.
Amang’ana omonto omoitania nigo are buna endagera enyansu egotirimboka gochia ase enda inse.
Omonto obwate amang’ana amansu ase ebikoba biaye, korende ore nobobe ase enkoro yaye, nigo anga buna egekorero ki’amaroba giatekire keoomire nefeta.
Omonto omogechi nigo akobisa ase ebikoba biaye, obong’ainereria bore ase enkoro yaye.
Ekero agokwana amang’ana are amansu, tobaisa komwegena, ekiagera nabwate ay’okogechia atano na abere, ase enkoro yaye ime.
Naisa gotuba okogecha kwaye nobong’ainereria, obokayayu bwaye goika bomanyekane nomosangererekano bwonsi.
Omonto okorema eirima, nere omonyene oragwe imeo; na omonto ogoturunkania rigena, nere omonyene rirairanere rimogwere.
Omonto ore noromeme rogokwana oborimo, nigo akogecha abanto abwo amang’ana aye achandire bobe, na omonwa ogokwana amang’ana ay’okweansia nigo okorenta ogosirigwa.
Tobaisa gwetogeria rituko ri’ankio, ekiagera tomanyeti aya rituko rikorenta.
Aye omonyene tobaisa gwetogia, korende tiga omonto onde agotogie; tiga omonto omoao agotogie, korende tari ebikoba biao omonyene.
Rigena neririto na omokenye nomorito, korende okogechigwa kw’omonto omoriri nigo kore okorito kobua ebinto ebio bibere.
Endamwamu nentindi, na ekeririanda nigo kegosiria, korende ning’o oranyare koremereria ribero?
Ogotogonyera kwa maiso marore nigo kore okuya kobua obwanchani bobisegete.
Ogoakwa gokorwa ase omosani nigo kore okw’obwegenwa, korende okonyunyunta kw’omobisa nigo kore okw’obong’ainereria.
Omonto oigotete nigo agochaya nonya nobooke, korende oyore nenchara nonya nendagera ere endoro nigo ekomwansera.
Omonto ogotama korwa bwoye nigo anga buna enyoni ekong’anya korwa ase egeswa kiaye.
Amaguta akweakwa na amanukato nigo bikogokia enkoro, naboigo bore obwororo bw’omosani oyo okorua ogosemia okuya.
Tobaisa kweba omosani oo, na omosani o iso; rituko kwanyorire emechando togenda ase enka y’oyomino. Mbuya koba nomogisangio ase engaki eyio, kobua koba noyominto omenyete aare.
Omwana one, kabe nobong’aini na ogokie enkoro yane, erio nario ndanyore ring’ana nkoiraneria omonto ogonchaya.
Omonto omong’aini nigo akororera emechando aare bwebisa, korende oyotamanyeti amange nigo akogenderera gochia bosio oumerana nero, erio ochandeka.
Ira eanga y’omonto oyo bwerure koba intenenera ase omonto omoao, ira ebi abwate, ekiagera bwerure ase engencho y’omonto otamanyekaneti.
Omonto okoboka mambia chuni oaka eriogi gosesenia omogisangio oye, oyio nabarerwe okoragererigwa.
Omokungu omonyariomana nigo anga buna amatoima ’embura akona‐gotonya.
Omonto ogotanga omokungu buna oyio, okwo nigo konga ogotangwa kw’omwaga gose okobwata amaguta nokoboko gw’okorio.
Ekioma nigo kegotieria ekioma kende, naboigo nomonto agotieria omonto onde.
Omonto okorenda omoko narie okwama kw’omoko oyio, na oyio okorenda omonene oye, oyio nanyore ogosikwa.
Ekero okorigereria ase amache ime nigo okorora obosio bwao, naboigo nebirengererio bi’enkoro y’omonto bikororekana ase omonto onde.
Buna aase abakure na embeera bitari goisaneka, naboigo namaiso a mwanyabanto atari goisaneka.
Buna koreng’ana efeta egoteemerwa ase enyongo ekonyititora, na etahabu ase omorero ekebemberi, naboigo omonto agoteemwa na komanyekana ase ogosikwa kwaye.
Omonto omoriri nomobekerania ase ekonu ime, omoswageranie amo nobori, oboriri bwaye tibogosira.
Manya buya chingencho chie ching’ondi ne chimbori chiao, na orende riicho riao buya.
Obonda tibori kogenderera kobao botambe, na egutwa y’obogambi teri kogenderera kobao ekiaare ase ekiaare.
Ekero obonyansi obokoro bwasirire, na oboyia nigo bokomera, na ebimeri bi’ebitunwa biasangererigwa,
ching’ondi nigo chikonachwa amarionya akoroisigwa chianga, ne chimbori chiaoonigwa ase okogora omogondo.
Erio nonyore amabeere e chimbori agoisaine aye na abanto b’enka yao, boigo nase abasomba bao abaiseke.
Abakori amabe nigo bagotama nonya onde tari kobabwatia, korende abanyaboronge nigo bare abaremu buna chindo chinsae.
Ekero ense yasaririe nigo ekoba nabagambi abange, korende eye ebwate abanto bare nobong’aini na okomanya, obogambi nigo bokogenderera gotenena bokong’u.
Omonto omotaka ore nokobua ogokorera abataka bande bobe ase okobaurereria, nigo anga buna embura enyinge egosaria chindagera.
Abanto batigire amachiko nigo bagotogia abakori amabe, korende abarendete amachiko nigo bakoamererania nabwo.
Abakori amabe tibamanyeti ayare amaronge, korende abwo bakomorigia Omonene nigo bamanyete onsi.
Omonto omotaka okobwatia oboronge nigo are omuya kobua omonda ore omokorekanu.
Omwana orendete amachiko nigo are omong’aini, korende oyore omogisangio bw’abaria bobe nigo akorenta obosooku ase ise.
Omonto okomenta chinibo chiaye ase enchera etari ey’ekeene ase okogania ebitoki, oyio nigo agochisangereria chibe echi’omonto okororera abataka amabera.
Omonto okoonchora ogoto kwaye taigwera amachiko, nonya nogosaba kwaye nigo kore okogechia.
Omonto ogosiria abare ne chinkoro chindonge, na kobaraa ase enchera ende, oyio nagwe ase eirima eria aremire ere omonyene, korende abwo batari na komocha mbanyore omwando omuya.
Omonto omonda nigo akwerengereria ng’a nomong’aini are, korende omonto omotaka ore nokomanya nigo aramotuke amomanye.
Ekero abanyene oboronge babuire, obonene obonge nigo bokobao, korende ekero abakori amabe bakogamba, abanto nigo bakwebisa.
Omonto okobisa ebibe biaye tagosesenigwa, korende oyo okobiorokia na kobitiga narorerwe amabera.
Nasesenirie omonto omoirogete Omonene botambe, korende oyo okong’etie enkoro yaye nanyore emechando eramosirie.
Omogambi omokayayu okogambera abanto abataka nigo anga buna endo ekoruma, gose edubu yagechigwe.
Omogambi otari nobong’aini nigo are omochandi omotindi, korende oria ogechete konyora ebitoki bitari bi’oboronge, nigo akogenderera kogamba ase amatuko amange.
Onye omonto oritoeirwe nokomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga ’omonto onde, tiga abe okona‐gotama goika akwe, na onde tagokonya omonto oyio.
Omonto otari na komocha ase chinchera chiaye natoorigwe; korende oyore omokorekanu ase chinchera chiaye nasire ase eyemo y’echio.
Omonto ogokora emeremo ase omogondo oye nanyore endagera enyinge, korende oyokobwatia emeroberio etagwenereti nigo arabe omotaka omorabu se.
Omonto ore nenkoro endonge nanyore ogosesenigwa okonge, korende oyo okoayerera ase okoba omonda takomocha konyora egesusuro.
Tari buya gokora ogwanchereria ase abanto, korende ase engencho y’agasamunye k’omogati omonto nigo agwekora koba omosaria.
Omonto obwate ribero nigo akoayerera koba omonda, gose tari korengereria ng’a obotaka mbomonyore.
Omonto ogotogonyera oyo oiranire nyuma ase okomorongeyia nanyore ogwancherwa kobua oria okomong’aina namang’ana amansu.
Omonto okoura ise gose ng’ina enibo yabo, erio oteba, “Ebi tibiri ebibe,” oyio nigo are omogisangio bw’oyogosiria.
Omonto ore ne ribero nigo agoseegeta eriomana, korende oyosemeretie Omonene natenenkigwe.
Oyobwesemeretie ere omonyene, oyio nomoriri, korende oyo okobwatia obong’aini natoorigwe.
Omonto ogokonya abataka takoremerwa, korende oyo ogotuba amaiso aye ng’a tarora abataka nanyore okoragererigwa okonge.
Ekero abakori amabe bakogamba, abanto nigo bakwebisa, korende ekero basirigwe, abanyaboronge nigo bakomentekana.
Omonto okona‐gokurerwa botambe ase okorongeigwa, korende okong’ia ebigoti, oyio nasirigwe mobosokano, tagokonywa.
Ekero abanyene oboronge bakogamba, abanto nigo bakoba nomogoko, korende ekero abakori amabe bakogamba, abanto nigo bagochandeka na korera.
Oyo bwanchete obong’aini nigo akomogokia ise, korende oyogotaara amo nabakungu abatayayi nigo agosiria chinibo chiaye.
Omoruoti ogokora ay’oboronge nigo akogera ense yaye yagenderera gotenena bokong’u, korende oyo okorigia amaaki nigo akoyeiyeria.
Omonto okong’aina omonto onde namang’ana amansu, oyio nigo agwetegera oboreba ase amagoro aye.
Omonto omonyabibe nigo agotegwa nobosareku bwaye, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agotera nomogoko na gochenga.
Omonyene oboronge nigo agwechandera oboronge bw’abataka, korende omokori amabe tamanyeti kende.
Abanyacheche nigo bakoburukania omochie, korende abanto abang’aini nigo bagokendia endamwamu.
Ekero omonto omong’aini akoamererania nomoriri, oria omoriri nigo akogechigwa na goseka, tari gokirakiri.
Abanto bare nerang’o y’ogoitera amanyinga nigo bakogecha oyo otari na komocha, korende abare ne chinkoro chindonge nigo bakomorenda.
Omonto omoriri nigo agosokia endamwamu yaye yonsi, korende oyore omong’aini nigo akoyetanga otoerera.
Omogambi aise gwancha amang’ana ’oborimo, abasomba baye bonsi nigo barabe abakori amabe.
Omotaka na omochandi nigo bamenyete amo; Omonene nere okobaa bonsi babere oborabu bw’amaiso.
Omoruoti okogambera abataka ase oboronge, obogambi bwaye mbogenderere gotenena bokong’u.
Ekeranya na ogotogonyera ase okorongeyia nigo bikorenta obong’aini, korende omwana ogotigwa okora buna anchete, nigo akorentera ng’ina obosooku.
Ekero abakori amabe bakomentekana, ogosaria nigo gokomentekana, korende abanyene oboronge mbarore okogwa kw’abwo.
Rongeyia omwana oo omomura, ere nakorentere ogotimoka, nigo ararente omosasoko omonge ase enkoro yao.
Ase okomaanorerwa kw’amang’ana gotari, abanto tibari gwetanga gokora amabe, korende nasesenirie oyo obwatete amachiko.
Amang’ana oka amasa takorongeyia omosomba, ekiagera naba oyamanyete, takoyaigwera.
Oise korora omonto ore omwango ase ogokwana, ogosemeria nkore ase omonto omoriri kobua ase oyio.
Omonto ogotuga omosomba oye na omoa ebinto bionsi aganetie korwa obwana bwaye, omosomba oyio nabo araire omwando oye.
Omonto obwate endamwamu nigo agoseegeta eriomana, na oyo okogechigwa nigo akorenta ogosaria okonge.
Oboenenu bw’omonto nigo bokomokeeyia, korende oyore nomoika bw’oboitongo nigo akonyora ogosikwa okonene.
Omonto ore omogisangio bw’omoibi nigo agechete obogima bwaye obonyene; nigo akoigwa ogotianerwa gw’okoragereria, korende okira takoorokia gento.
Okobairoka mwanyabanto nigo gokoba oboreba, korende omonto omosemeretie Omonene nigo arendire buya.
Abanto abange nigo bakorigia ogwancherwa gokorwa ase omogambi, korende kera omonto nigo akonyora oboronge korwa ase Omonene.
Omonto otari omoronge nigo are okogechia ase oyo ore omoronge, na oyore nenkoro endonge nigo are okogechia ase omokori amabe.
Aya naro amang’ana ’Aguri, mosinto o Yake o Masa. Omonto oyio agatebia Itieli na Ukali:
“Ekeene, inche nigo inde omoriri otagwenereti korokwa omonto, gose timbwati obomanyi bwa mwanyabanto.
Inche tineorokereretie obong’aini, erinde imomanye oyore Omochenu.

Ning’o oriinete gochia igoro na goika gocha aa inse? Ning’o osangereirie omwaga ase enkundi yaye? Ning’o obwatire amache na koyaboa ase eanga yaye? Ning’o okong’etie chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense? Naki oyio akorokwa, na omwana oye naki akorokwa? Ntebia onye koyamanyete!
“Kera ring’ana ria Nyasae nigo rienekirie ng’a neri’ekeene. Ere nenguba ase abwo bakomotamera, barendwe.
Tobaisa komenta kende ase amang’ana aye, nigo arabaise kogotogonyera, naye obe omonyaborimo.”
Amang’ana abere naro nagosabire, toyandina ntarakwa.
Orusie korwa asende ayare a bosa na oborimo. Tobaisa kong’a obotaka gose obotenenku, korende ong’e endagera engwenerete.
Oise konyigotia mono, nigo ndakwange ntebe, “Omonene nere ng’o?” Gose inse koba omotaka nigo ndabaisa koiba na ndetere erieta ria Nyasae one obosooku.
Tobaisa kogenka omosomba ase omonene oye, nigo arakoragererie, erinde obe nokomocha.
Ekegori nkere gekoragereria abaise na tikeri gosesenia abang’ina.
Abanto mbare bakwerora ng’a nabaikeranu bare, korende tibachenegeti korwa ase obobe bwabo.
Abanto mbare bagwekaga ng’a nabaya bare na korigereria namaiso aichire nobomwenu.
Abanto mbare babwate amaino anga emioro, ne chintakunero chi’amaino abo nigo chinga emeyio; barabwo nigo bakoria na gosiria abataka bare ase ense; nigo bakoura abaremeire bare ase abanto.
Rikorominyo ndibwate abaiseke babere; barabwo nigo bakorangeria, “Toe, toe!” Mbire ebinto bitato bitari goisaneka; ee, mbire bine bitari goteba ng’a biaisanekire, nabio ebi;
aase abakure, na enda engomba, ne riroba rirang’ete amache, na omorero. Ebio tibiana goteba, “Twaisanekire.”
Eriso ri’omonto ogochecheria ise na gochaya ng’ina ndirusigwe nebigonkoru bie rigoko na ririegwe namage e chinsoti.
Ebinto mbire bitato bire bi’ogokumia asende; ee, mbire bine ebio ntamanyeti, nabio ebi:
enchera y’ensoti igoro, na ey’eng’iti igoro ase egetare, na ey’emeeri igoro ase amache ’enyancha, na enchera y’omosacha gochia ase omoiseke.
Eyio nenchera y’omokungu omotomani: Nigo akoria na otinyia omonwa oye, erio oteba, “Inche tindakora obonyaka bonde.”
Nare amang’ana atato akonyegeria ense, ee, nare ane etanyare koyaremereria, naro aya:
Ekero omosomba akoba omoruoti, na omonto omoriri akoigota endagera,
na ekero omoiseke otanchiri akonyuomwa, na omoiseke omosomba akoba ribaga ri’omokungu oria agokorera emeremo.
Mbire ebinto bine ebisinini mono ase ense, korende bire nobong’aini obonge, nabio ebi:
Amage nigo are ebitongwa bitari ne chinguru, korende nigo akogacha endagera yabo agocha koria engaki y’egurugura.
Ebisengi tibibwati chinguru, korende nigo bikoroisia ase bikomenya ase ebitare ime.
Chingige tichibwati omoruoti, korende nigo chikogendera amo emeganda emeganda.
Esagara nabo erabogorigwe nokoboko kw’omonto, korende nabo ekomenya ase chinyomba chi’abaruoti.
Mbire ebinto bitato bikogokia ase ogotaara kwabo, ee, mbire bine bire nogotaara okuya, nabio ebi:
Endo ere ne chinguru chinyinge kobua ching’iti chinde, na teri kwoboigwa na ng’iti ende,
na etuoni egwesigoria, na egoree, na omoruoti okoraa abarwani baye b’esegi.
Onye kwabeire omoriri na kweimokereirie igoro, gose onye kwabeire gokorengereria amabe, beka okoboko kwao ass omonwa oo, oyotube.
Amabeere agotundwa nigo akorua amaguta, na okomintontoria emioro, amanyinga nigo ararueo. Naboigo ogoseegeta na koba nendamwamu, ayio nigo akorenta okorwana.
Amang’ana aya naro Lemweli omoruoti orokereretigwe na ng’ina:
Naki aye omwana one? Naki aye omwana bw’enda yane? Ninki ndagotebie, aye omwana bw’eira yane nariete?
Tobaisa gosireria chinguru chiao ase abakungu, gose chinchera chiao ase barabwo, ekiagera nigo bagosiria abaruoti.
Aye Lemweli, okonywa edivai tikogwenereti abaruoti, gose abagambi tibabaisa kogania ebinyugwa bigotindia.
Baise konywa, nigo barebe amachiko, na baonchorane oboronge bwa bonsi abachandegete.
Oyo ogochia gosira moe ekenyugwa kegotindia, na edivai ase oyo oichanete ase omoyo oye.
Tiga banywe, erinde beebe obotaka bwabo, na tibabaisa kona‐koinyora emechando yabo.
Maanora omonwa oo, okwanere rimama, orwanerere oboronge bw’abwo batigirwe bachandegete.
Maanora omonwa oo, ogambe ebina bi’ekeene, orwanerere oboronge bw’abataka na obaremeire.
Ning’o oranyare konyora omokungu omuya? Omokungu omuya nigo are nengencho enene kobua amagena e rigori rinene.
Enkoro y’omosacha oye nigo emwegenete, gose omosacha oyio takoremerwa konyora ebitoki.
Ase obogima bwaye bwonsi omokungu oyio nigo agokorera omosacha oye amaya, gose tari korenta amabe asare.
Omokungu oyio nigo akorigia amarionya e ching’ondi ne chiusi chi’egatani, okora emeremo namaboko aye ore nomoyo omuya.
Nigo anga chimeeri chi’abaonchoreria; nigo akorenta endagera korwa ase ense y’aare.
Nigo akoboka kobore botuko, oroiseria abanto b’enyomba yaye endagera, na oa abasomba baye abaiseke eyebatungetie.
Nigo akorigia omogondo oyogora, na korwa ase ebitoki bi’emeremo y’amaboko aye nigo agosimeka emesabibu.
Nigo akweboyia chinguru buna orokini, okora emeremo emekong’u namaboko aye.
Nigo akorora ng’a emeremo yaye nigo ekorenta ebitoki, na etaya yaye teri korima nyomba mwaye botuko.
Nigo abwate egekorero akoroiseria chiusi namaboko aye na egete agochiranderera nebiara biaye.
Nigo akorambora okoboko kwaye okonya abataka, ee, nabaremeire nigo akobaramborera amaboko aye.
Ere tari kwoboa chingaki chi’obokendu, ekiagera abanto bonsi b’enyomba yaye nigo babwate chianga chie riberera chiroisirie korwa ase chiusi chimonyinga.
Omokungu oyio nigo akweroiseria ebirarero; chianga chiaye nigo chiroisirie korwa ase egatani engiya ne chiusi chimbariri.
Omosacha bw’omokungu oyio nigo amanyekanete ase ebiita bi’omochie, agwo ase agoikaransa ogamba ebina amo nabagaaka b’ense eyio.
Omokungu oyio nigo akoroisia chianga chi’egatani engiya, ochioonia; naende nigo akoroisia chinkini, ochiooneria abaonchoreria bande.
Nigo akweboyia chinguru na amasikani, na igo nabe nomogoko ase chingaki chigochi‐gocha.
Amorokererio akorua ase omonwa oye nigo are ay’obong’aini, na obwororo nigo bore ase oromeme rwaye.
Nigo akoroberia buya amang’ana ’enyomba yaye, gose tari koria endagera atari gokorera emeremo.
Abana baye nigo bakoboka bamoroka “Oyosesenirie”, naboigo nomosacha oye nigo akomotogia, oteba:
“Abakungu abange bakorire ayare amaya mono, korende aye kwababuire bonsi.”
Obonyakieni nigo bokong’ainereria, na ekieni ekiya nigo kere bosa, korende omokungu omoirogete Omonene, oyio nere oranyare gotogigwa.
Kae omokungu oyio okwama kw’emeremo y’amaboko aye, na tiga atogigwe agwo ase ebiita ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.
Aya naro amang’ana ’omorandia mosinto o Daudi, omoruoti o Yerusalemu.
Omorandia nigo agoteba: Mbosa na bosa kegima, mbosa, bosa. Amang’ana onsi mbosa.
Mbitoki ki omonto akonyora ase okwerosia gokora emeremo emekong’u aiga inse y’erioba?
Ekegori ekemo nigo kegoeta, na ekende giacha, korende ense nigo egendererete kobao.
Erioba nigo rigosoka naende riarimera, erio riaayerera gochia aase rigosoka korwa.
Embeo nigo ekogusa gochia irianyi, naende yaonchoka yagusa gochia sugusu; nigo ekona‐goetanana yagenderera kogusa, naende yagenderera goetanana naende naende.
Chindooche chionsi nigo chikogenda ase enyancha, korende tiyana goichora. Amache ayio nigo akoirana gochia ase chindooche echio chiachakerete, naende agenderera kogenda.
Amang’ana onsi agokorwa nigo akorenta omoroso otanyare gokwaneka. Amaiso tari goisaneka naya akorora, na amato tari goisaneka naya akoigwa.
Aya arengeo kare, naro agochia kobao naende. Aya akoregete kare, naro agochia gokoreka naende. Ande tari are amayia inse y’erioba.
Inee! Ing’ana rinde ndireo rigokwanwa ng’a neriyia? Yaya. Kera ring’ana nao riarenge korwa kare, intwe konya totarabao.
Amang’ana aetire takoinyorwa, gose ayagochi‐gocha takoinyorwa nabwo bakorwa nyuma.
Inche omorandia nigo narenge omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, agwo Yerusalemu.
Nkerua nenkoro yane korigia na komanya ase obong’aini amang’ana onsi agokoreka inse y’erioba. Nigo ere emeremo etari y’omogoko Nyasae aeire mwanyabanto bechande ase okoyekora.
Narigereirie kera egento kegokorwa inse y’erioba, narorire ng’a bionsi nigo bire bosa; ebi omonto akominyokera konyora nigo bire buna embeo bosa.
Egento giachiire bogeka tigekorongeigwa, na ekiaremire tigekobareka.
Nkerengereria inche omonyene, “Nenyoreire obong’aini obonge kobua abwo bonsi bantang’anerete kogamba agwo Yerusalemu. Enkoro yane yanyorire obong’aini obonge na okomanya okonge.”
Naende nkerua nenkoro yane komanya obong’aini, na obobarimo, na oboriri, korende nigo nanyorete ng’a ayio onsi akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
Ekiagera ase obong’aini obonge bore, nao omoichano omonge ore, na omonto okomenta chisemi, nigo akomenta obororo.
Ngakwana nenkoro yane, ngateba, “Bono ninteeme ndore naki omogoko ore, imbe nkwegokia omonyene.” Korende nonya nayio onsi nigo arenge bosa.
Nkanyora ng’a amaseko nigo are obobarimo, na omogoko tori gokora gento kende ekiya.

Ekero ebirengererio biane biarenge koraagwa nobong’aini, nkagania kogokia omobere one nekenyugwa ki’edivai, nkarigia kobwatia oboriri obwo, erinde ndore ayare amaya agwenerete mwanyabanto bakore inse y’erioba, ase amatuko ayio amake bagendererete koba moyo.
Ngakora emeremo emenene; nkeagachera chinyomba na gwesimekera emesabibu ase emegondo.
Nkeroiseria emegondo na emegondo ende y’amatunda, erio ngasimeka emete y’amatunda ao ao.
Nkeroiseria amatibo ase nare korusia amache nasiarera emete egokina ase rinani.

Nkagora abasomba, abasacha na abakungu; abwo bakanyiborera abasomba bande ase enka yane; nigo nabwate amaicho amange e chiombe, ne chimbori, ne ching’ondi, nkabua abwo bonsi bantang’anerete kogamba agwo Yerusalemu.

Boigo ngasangereria chifeta ne chitahabu, amo ne chimonga chi’abaruoti na echie chingongo chi’oboruoti bwane; ngatwara abateri, abasacha na abakungu, naende ngatwara abakungu abange mwanyabanto bagosanera.
Ase ayio nkaba omonto bw’amasikani amanene, nkabua abwo bantang’anerete kogamba agwo Yerusalemu; boigo obong’aini bwane bokagenderera kobeera ime yane.

Egento kende gionsi narenge korora na gokegania tinare gwetanga gokenyora, gose tinarinete enkoro yane omogoko onde bwensi, ekiagera enkoro yane nigo yagokerete aya onsi nechanderete, na omogoko oyio noro orenge eng’eria yane y’emeremo yonsi nechanderete.

Nyuma y’ayio nkarengereria igoro y’emeremo eyio nakorete namaboko aane, na buna nayiechanderete. Naama! Ayio onsi nigo arenge bosa, na aya naminyokerete konyora nigo are buna embeo bosa, gose bitoki binde tibiri konyorekana inse y’erioba.

Nkaonchora ebirengererio biane korigereria obong’aini na obobarimo, na oboriri. Omonto oyio okobekwa oboruoti ribaga ri’oyio orengeo, ninki arakore? Tagokora kende otatiga keria oyio omotang’ani akorete.
Erio nkamanya ng’a obong’aini nigo bobuete oboriri, buna oborabu bobuete omosunte.
Omonto omong’aini nigo abwate amaiso ase omotwe oye, korende omonto omoriri nigo agotaara ase omosunte; nonya nabeigo, nkarora ng’a bonsi nigo bakonyorwa negento ekemo.
Erio nkeboria, “Ande, amang’ana akomonyora omoriri naro aranyore nainche, nase ki rende inche nabeire nobong’aini obonge?” Ase ayio ngetebia ng’a aya boigo mbosa.

Buna ere ase omonto omong’aini, naboigo ere nase omoriri, onde takogenderera koinyorwa; bonsi nigo barabe bebirwe kegima ase amatuko agochi‐gocha. Inee! Omonto omong’aini tagokwa buna oria omoriri agokwa?
Ase ayio nkagecha obogima, ekiagera emeremo egokorwa inse y’erioba, nigo ekorenta obororo asende. Ayio onsi mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
Nkagecha emeremo yonsi, eyio nabete ngwechandera inse y’erioba, ekiagera goika ntigere omonto orambwatie ebinto ebio nakorire.
Ning’o omanyete gose omonto oyio nigo arabe omong’aini, gose nigo arabe omoriri? Korende oyio goika aire ebinto ebio bionsi nechandeire inde nobong’aini kobinyora inse y’erioba. Ayio boigo mbosa.
Ase ayio ngachaka goichana na gokwa omoyo ase engencho y’emeremo yonsi nechanderete inse y’erioba.

Omonto nigo agokora emeremo emekong’u nobong’aini bwaye, ne chisemi, na okomanya kwaye, konyora ebinto, korende nyuma yaye atigera omonto omoao otabiechanderete okwegokia nabirobio. Ayio boigo mbosa, naende mbobe mono.
Ngento ki omonto aranyore ekero akorire emeremo emekong’u na kwerosia mono inse y’erioba?
Nigo akoba nobokong’u ase amatuko aye onsi are moyo, na emeremo yaye emekong’u nigo ere ey’omoichano; nonya nase obotuko obogima ebirengererio biaye tibiri gotimoka. Ayio boigo mbosa.
Egento ekiya omonto aranyare gokora nokoria na konywa, na kogokera ebinto ebio echandeire kobinyora. Nkamanya ng’a nonya nayio nigo akorwa ase okoboko kwa Nyasae.
Ning’o oranyare koria, gose konyora omogoko, onye tari amo n’Omonene?

Nyasae nigo akoa omonto oyo okomogokia obong’aini, naende omoa okomanya, na omogoko, korende nigo akoa omonyabibe emeremo y’ogosangereria ebinto na kobigacha, korende omonto oria abie oria ogogetie Nyasae. Ayio boigo mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
Kera egento nkere nekero kiaye, na aiga inse y’erioba kera ekegokorekana nkere nengaki yaye.
Nere engaki y’okoiborwa, na ey’ogokwa; engaki y’ogosimeka, na ey’ogosimora ekio giasimegetwe;
engaki y’ogoita, na ey’okogwenia; engaki y’ogotagora, na ey’okoagacha;
engaki y’okorera, na ey’ogoseka; engaki y’okobokia amagombo, na ey’ogotenga;
engaki y’ogosiarera amagena, na ey’okoyasangereria; engaki y’okoboania, na ey’ogotaboania;
engaki y’okorigia, na ey’ogosiria; engaki y’okogacha, na ey’ogotuguta;
engaki y’ogotandora, na ey’okobareera; engaki y’ogokira, na ey’ogokwana;
engaki y’ogwanchana, na ey’okogechana; engaki y’esegi, na ey’omorembe.
Inee! Mbitoki ki omonto akonyora ase emeremo yonsi agwechandera?
Narorire obokong’u obwo Nyasae aeire mwanyabanto bechande naborobwo.

Okorire kera egento kiabeire egeseera ase engaki yaye, naende obekire ime ase chinkoro chia mwanyabanto engaki etabe nomoerio. Korende nonya naboigo tibakonyara komanya aya Nyasae akorete korwa omochakano goika omoerio.
Namanyire ng’a gento kende tikeri kere ekiya kerabagwenere otatiga babe nomogoko, naende bakore ayare amaya ekero bare moyo.
Omonto kararie na konywa, naende egokie ase ebio echandeire, ekio nekeegwa kia Nyasae.

Namanyire ng’a gento kende gionsi Nyasae agokora nigo gekogenderera kobao kare na kare; gento kende tigekomentwa ase ekio, gose kende tigekorusigwa korwa ase ekio. Nyasae nere okorire igo, erinde mwanyabanto bamoiroke.
Amang’ana areo bono, nao arenge korwa kare; na ayio agochia koba, boigo nao arenge korwa kare. Nyasae nigo akorigia ayio aetire.
Naende nkarora aiga inse y’erioba ng’a aase ekeene kegwenerete koba, nao obobe bore, na aase oboronge bogwenerete koba, nao boigo obobe bore.
Erio ngateba ase enkoro yane ime ng’a Nyasae nanachere abanyaboronge ekina, na abanyabibe boigo, ekiagera obekire engaki ase kera ring’ana, na ase kera emeremo.
Naende ngateba ase enkoro yane ime ng’a Nyasae nigo agoteema mwanyabanto kobaenekia ng’a barabwo nigo banga buna ching’iti.

Amang’ana akonyora ching’iti naro ayio akobanyora mwanyabanto; buna ching’iti chigokwa, naboigo na mwanyabanto bagokwa. Omoika noyomo ore ase ching’iti na ase mwanyabanto; mwanyabanto tabueti ching’iti kende. Amang’ana onsi mbosa.
Mwanyabanto nigo bakogenda aase ching’iti chikogenda; mwanyabanto nigo baruete ase amaroba, ne ching’iti naboigo; nigo bakoirana ase amaroba, naboigo na chirochio.
Ning’o omanyete gose omoika o mwanyabanto nigoro ogochia, na oyo bwe ching’iti ogenda inse y’ense?
Ase ayio nkarora ng’a gento kende tikeri kere ekiya, otatiga omonto agokere emeremo yaye; ekio nakio egetari kiaye. Ning’o orachie komoirania ache korora na komanya ayakoregete nyuma yaye?

Naende nkarigereria nkarora ogokora okobe kware gokorwa inse y’erioba. Nkarora abwo bagokorerwa bobe bakorera, na monto onde tarengeo okobaremia, ekiagera abwo barenge kobakorera bobe nigo barenge nokobua, na onde tarengeo okobaremia.
Nkarora ng’a nigo ere buya ase abakure kobua ase abare moyo.
Korende ase oyo otaraiborwa, oyio otararora ogokora okobe kore aiga inse y’erioba, nigo ere buya asare kobua ase abwo bonsi bare moyo na abakure.

Nkarora emeremo eye emekong’u egokorwa, na omokia bwonsi bw’ogwechanda ase ogokora emeremo, ayio nigo agokorwa, ekiagera omonto akoba ne ribero ng’a abue oyonde. Ayio boigo mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
Omoriri nigo agwetumata, na bweria omobere oye orea.
Mbuya koba negento geichire oroe oromo na koba nomorembe, kobua koba nebinto biichire chindoe ibere na koba nogwechanda na kominyokera konyora ebire buna embeo bosa.
Naende nkarora obosa kegima bore inse y’erioba:

Nare omonto otabwate omwana gose omwabo; ere nigo agendererete gwechanda gokora emeremo emekong’u, na amaiso aye tari goisaneka ne chinibo; omonto oyio tana kweboria, “Ning’o ngochandekera gokorera na kwerina omogoko bwonsi?” Aya naro mbosa, na ogwechanda gotari nomogoko.
Nigo ere buya koba babere kobua oyomo, ekiagera mbanyore eng’eria engiya ase emeremo yabo bagokora.
Oyomo karagwe, oyonde namogororokie; korende obobe nobwaye oria ore bweka ekero aragwe, na onde tari oramogororokie.
Abanto babere kobararare amo mbaigwe riberera korende naki oyomo arakore aigwe riberera kare bweka?
Omonto aise korwania oyomo ore bweka, namobue, korende onye bare babere, takobabua. Engori esisire nemegoye etato teri kobutoka bwango.
Omwana omosae omotaka ore nobong’aini nigo’are omuya kobua omoruoti omogotu ore omoriri, otari gwancha gosemigwa;
neba ng’a omosae oria nigo aruete echela akabekwa oboruoti, gose nigo aiboretwe ore omotaka ase obogambi bw’omoruoti oria.
Nkarora abanto bonsi abamenyete inse y’erioba bakobwatia omosae oria ogochia kobekwa oboruoti ribaga ri’oria orengeo.
Abanto abwo arenge koraa tibare kobareka. Nonya naboigo abwo barachiche nyuma y’abwo tibakomogokera. Ekeene, aya naro mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
Orende amagoro ao ekero ogosoa ase enyomba ya Nyasae; mbuya kogenda aroro ase ogotegerera kobua korua ebing’wanso ebi abariri bakorua, ekiagera abwo tibamanyeti ng’a nigo bagokora ebibe.

Tobaisa koba omwango ase ogokwana amang’ana, gose enkoro yao teba enyango gokwana ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ekiagera ere nigo are igoro, naye nigo ore inse aa ase ense; ase ayio tiga amang’ana ogokwana abe amake.
Chindoto nigo chigocha korwa ase ogwechanda okonge, ne chinkwana chinyinge nigo chikorenta amang’ana ’oboriri.
Ekero kwarire eira ase Nyasae, tobaisa gotebana koyeikerania, ekiagera ere tari kogokigwa nabanto abariri. Ikerania eira kwariete.
Mbuya toria eira kobua koria eira na toyeikerania.

Tobaisa gotiga amang’ana ’omonwa oo agere okore ebibe, gose tobaisa gotebia omomalaika o Nyasae ng’a oko nokomocha gwakora. Nase ki oragere Nyasae agechigwe nogokwana kwao, na asarie emeremo y’amaboko ao?
Ekero amang’ana atari nengencho amentekanire, ne chindoto chiamentekanire, obobe nigo bokoba obonge; korende aye omoiroke Nyasae.

Korarore agwo ase obogambi abataka bagokorerwa bobe, na ekeene na oboronge biarusigweo ase enchera y’obotindi, amang’ana ayio tagoichania; omonene oyio okogamba nigo arigereirie noria ore omonene komobua, naende mbare abwo bare abanene kobua abagambi abwo babere.
Mbuya ase ense ere nomoruoti okogamba buya na korigereria ng’a abanto nkorema bare emegondo yabo.
Omonto bwanchete chibesa, tagoisaneka nachirochio; gose oyobwanchete obotenenku, tagoisaneka nebitoki biaye. Ayio boigo mbosa.
Ekero obotenenku bokomentekana, boigo nabwo bakoboria nigo bakomentekana; bono mbuya ki oria omonyene akonyora, otatiga akoborora namaiso rioka?
Chitoro chi’omokori emeremo nigo chire chingiya mono, neba ng’a nigo abwate egento egeke akoria, gose ebinge; korende obotenenku bw’omonto omonda tibokomotiga arare chitoro.
Obobe obore obobe mono narorire inse y’erioba nabwo obo: chinibo chinyinge chikogachwa nigo chiranyare gosiria omonto ochigachete.
Chinibo echio nigo chigosira ase egesio ekebe, na ekero omonto oyio aiboire omwana omomura nigo akonyorekana ore bosa, tabwati kende akomoa.
Buna aiboretwe ore getirianda korwa ase enda ya ng’ina, naboigo aragende ore getirianda buna achete, gose takoira kende ase ebio echandeire mono kobinyora.
Obo boigo nobobe bw’obororo; onye okorua ase ense ogenda buna achete, mbitoki ki abwate ase ogwechanda gokora emeremo emekong’u y’okominyokia aya are buna embeo bosa?
Ase obogima bwaye bwonsi nigo abeire okoria endagera ore ase omosunte, obeire ogwechanda ore nobororo na okogechigwa.

Naama! Aya narorire are amaya na agwenerete nokoria na konywa na koba nomogoko ase ebinto ebio bionsi omonto echandeire aiga inse y’erioba, ase engaki y’amatuko amake Nyasae amoeire; ekio nakio egetari kiaye.

Onye Nyasae oeire omonto obotenenku ne chinibo, naende omoeire okobua gw’okwegokia ase ebinto ebio na kobikorera ase obuya bwaye, boigo koba nomogoko ase emeremo yaye, ayio onsi nigo are ebiegwa bia Nyasae.
Omonto oyio takogenderera koinyora amatuko aetire ay’obogima bwaye, ekiagera Nyasae nigo akomoa omogoko ase enkoro yaye.
Mbore obobe narorie aiga inse y’erioba boritoerete mwanyabanto. Obobe obwo nabwo obo:

Nyasae oeire omonto obotenenku, ne chinibo, na ogosikwa, na omonto oyio taremeiri gento kende ase ebio bionsi aganetie, korende Nyasae tamoeti okobua gw’okwegokia ase ebinto ebio; omonto omoao nigo akobiira bwegokia nabirobio. Ayio naro mbosa, naende nogwechanda okobe.

Onye omonto oiboire abana rigana erimo, na abe moyo ase engaki y’emiaka emenge, ee, nonya amatuko ’obogima bwaye abeire amange, korende tegogetie ase ebinto ebiya bi’obogima obwo, na tatindekwa ase amasikani, nigo ngoteba ng’a omwana okwerete enda ya ng’ina nigo are buya kobua omonto oyio.
Omwana oyio okwete nigo achete egento bosa, naende nigo akogenda gochia ase omosunte, na omosunte oyio otuba erieta riaye.
Omwana oria taroche erioba, gose tamanyete gento kende, korende nonya naboigo nigo akonyora omotimoko kobua omonto oria,
nonya omonto oria ogochia komenya emiaka chilifu ibere, korende tanyora omogoko ase obogima bwaye. Inee! Abwo bonsi babere tibakogenda aase amo?
Emeremo yonsi omonto akwerosia gokora nokonyora egento akoria, korende nonya naboigo tari koigota.
Mbuya ki omonto omong’aini abwate kobua oyore omoriri? Gose ninki omonto omotaka akonyora, oria omanyete buna akwerenda ase abare moyo?
Eki amaiso aroche nigo kere buya kobua eki okogania ng’a okenyore. Ayio boigo mbosa, na okominyokia aya are buna embeo bosa.
Gento kende gionsi kereo nigo kiarogetwe erieta korwa kare, naende nigo yamanyekanete eki omonto are gocha koba. Mwanyabanto takonyara koamererania noria ore ne chinguru komobua.
Ogokwana okonge nigo gokorenta amang’ana amange are bosa. Inee! Ayio mbuya ki akorenta ase mwanyabanto?

Ning’o omanyete egento kere ekiya ase omonto, ekero amenyete amatuko amake ase obogima bore bosa, agoeta buna omorengari? Ning’o oranyare gotebia omonto amang’ana arabe korwa nyuma yaye aiga inse y’erioba?
Erieta rigiya nigo ribuete amaguta amaya akweakwa, ne rituko ri’ogokwa nigo rire rigiya kobua eri’okoiborwa.
Mbuya kogenda ase enyomba y’ebirero kobua kogenda ase enyomba y’omoyega bw’okwegokia, ekiagera oyio noro omoerio o kera omonto, na abare moyo mbabeke amang’ana aya ase chinkoro chiabo.
Omoichano nigo ore omuya kobua amaseko, ekiagera omoichano okororekana ase obosio nigo ogokora enkoro yaba nomogoko.
Chinkoro chi’abanto abang’aini nigo chikoba ase enyomba y’ebirero, korende chinkoro chi’abariri nigo chire ase enyomba y’okwegokia.
Mbuya omonto gotegerera ogotogonyerwa kw’omonto omong’aini kobua gotegerera ogotera kw’abariri.
Ogoseka kw’abariri nigo konga amagwa akoyia atoreka inse y’enyongo ere riko. Ayio boigo mbosa.
Ekeene, emoko nigo ekoonchora omonto omong’aini oba omoriri, ne riaaki nigo rigosaria ebirengererio.
Omoerio bw’egento nigo ore omuya kobua omochakano oye; na omonto omoremereria nigo are omuya koba omonto omoenenu.
Tobaisa koba omwango ase okogechigwa, ekiagera okogechigwa nigo komenyete ase chinkoro chi’abariri.
Tobaisa goteba, “Nase ki amatuko a kare arenge amaya kobua aya bono?” Okoboria okwo tikori okw’obong’aini.
Obong’aini nigo bore obuya buna omwando, na nigo bogokonya abwo baroche erioba.
Obong’aini nigo bogotokonya buna chibesa chigotokonya, korende obuya bw’omonyasemi mboria ng’a obong’aini nigo bokorenda obogima bw’oyio ong’ainiire.
Rengereria emeremo ya Nyasae! Ning’o oranyare korongeyia egento Omonene akorire borogochi?
Ekero amatuko ao are amaya kabe nomogoko, na ekero are amabe rengereria ng’a Nyasae nere okorire ayio onsi abere, erinde omonto tabaisa komanya erirache komobwatia korwa nyuma yaye.
Ase obogima obo bwane obore bosa narorire kera egento; narorire omonto omonyaboronge ogosira ore ase oboronge bwaye, na omonyabibe okogenderera koba moyo amatuko amange ore ase ebibe biaye.
Tobaisa koba omoronge goetania, gose koba omong’aini goetania. Nase ki okweita aye omonyene?
Tobaisa koba omobe goetania, gose tobaisa koba omoriri. Nase ki oganetie gokwa engaki yao etaraika?
Nigo ere buya ng’a obwate ring’ana eri erimo, na totiga neria kabere, ekiagera omonto omoirogete Nyasae namanye eki agokora ase kera ring’ana.
Obong’aini nigo bogokora abare abang’aini koba ne chinguru chibuete echi’abagambi ikomi bare ase omochie oyomo.
Ekeene, omonto tari aiga ase ense ore omoronge ogokora amaya otari gokora ebibe.
Tobaisa gotegerera amang’ana onsi abanto bagokwana, nigo orabaise koigwa omosomba oo ogokoragereria.
Aye omonyene nomanyete ase enkoro yao ng’a ase chingaki chinyinge kwabeire gokoragereria abanto bande.
Aya onsi ngateema koyaenekia ase enchera y’obong’aini, ngateba, “Goika imbe nobong’aini.” Korende obong’aini obwo bokabeera aare korwa asende.
Amang’ana aria nigo akare aare mono, naende akare aatambe gochia inse, aatambe mono, ning’o oranyare koyatuka?
Erio ngachaka korengereria imanye, na gotuka, na korigia obong’aini, na komanya buna ebinto bionsi bire; naende nkagania komanya obobe bw’oboriri, na oboriri obore obobarimo.

Erio nkanyora egento ekeroro kebuete amakweri. Egento ekio nakio omokungu enkoro yaye yarenge egesugunia na omoeto, naende amaboko aye are chingataare. Omonto ogogetie Nyasae tari kobwatwa nomokungu oyio, korende omonyabibe ere nigo akobwatwa.
Omorandia nigo agoteba iga: Naama! Amang’ana ayio nkayamanya, ekero nabekeranetie ring’ana erimo ase erinde koyamanya onsi.
Aya nabeire nkona‐koyairanerera korigia komanya buna are, korende tindayamanya. Ase abanto elifu eyemo nkanyora omosacha oyomo, korende ase abwo bonsi tinanyorete omokungu nonya noyomo.
Naama! Egento gioka narigirie nanyorire neke: Nyasae nigo atongete mwanyabanto bare abaikeranu, korende barabwo batukire chinchera chinyinge chi’okobaisanekia.
Ning’o onga buna omonto omong’aini? Ning’o omanyete engencho y’amang’ana? Obong’aini nigo bogokora obosio bw’omonto bwagirigenta, nigo bokoonchora obokong’u bw’okororekana kwaye.
Inche nigo nkogosemia: Oigwere amang’ana omoruoti achikire, ekiagera nkwarierete Nyasae eira.
Toayerera gotiga obokoreri ase obosio bwaye, na tobwatana nogokora okobe, ekiagera ere nigo agokora onsi ayanchete.
Ring’ana ri’omoruoti nigo rire nokobua. Ning’o oranyare komotebia, “Aye ngento ki eke ogokora?”
Omonto okoigwera amachiko takonyorwa namabe, na enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekomanya engaki na enchera y’okonacha boronge.
Kera ring’ana ndibwate engaki yaye na enchera yaye y’okonacha boronge, na emechando y’omonto nigo ekomoritoera.
Omonto tamanyeti ayagochia koba, na ning’o oranyare komotebia buna amang’ana arabe?
Monto onde tari obwate okobua igoro y’omoika, gose igoro ye rituko ri’ogokwa kwaye; ogotooreka tikori ase esegi, gose obobe tibogotooria abwo bakobokora.
Ayio onsi nigo nayaroche ekero nabegete ebirengererio biane kwegera aya onsi agokorwa aiga inse y’erioba, ekero omonto oyomo akogambera omonto onde na komokorera bobe ase okomochanda.
Nkarora abakori amabe batindekirwe batimogete, na abwo baare gokora ayare boronge barure ase Obomenyo bw’Oyore Omochenu, bakebwa ase omochie. Ayio boigo mbosa.
Mwanyabanto nigo bakwerua ase chinkoro chiabo gokora ayare amabe, ekiagera ebibe tibiri konacherwa ekina bwango.
Omonyabibe nakora ebibe ara rigana, naende agenderere koba moyo ase engaki entambe; nonya naboigo, nimanyete ng’a nigo erabe buya ase abwo bamoirogete Nyasae, ekiagera bamoirogete.
Korende abakori amabe tibakonyora amaya ayio, gose obogima bwabo tibokoba obotambe. Nigo banga buna omorengari ogoeta, ekiagera tibamoirogete Nyasae.

Nare amang’ana a bosa kegima agokorekana aiga ase ense; mbareo abanto abanyaboronge bakonyorwa negesusuro ki’ogokora kw’abanyabibe, na boigo abanyabibe banyora obuya bw’ogokora kw’abanyaboronge. Ase ayio ngateba, “Ayio boigo mbosa.”

Ngatogia omogoko, na nkarora ng’a mwanyabanto tabwati gento kende kere ekiya aiga inse y’erioba, otatiga arie na anywe, na kwegokia nayio. Ayio naro aranyare kobeera asare ekero agendererete gokora emeremo emekong’u ase obogima obo are moyo, obo Nyasae amoeire aiga inse y’erioba.
Ekero nabegete ebirengererio biane komanya obong’aini na korora emeremo emekong’u abanto bagokora aiga ase ense, batari korara chitoro omobaso gose obotuko.

Erio nkarora ng’a omonto takonyara komanya emeremo ende yonsi ya Nyasae egokorekana aiga inse y’erioba. Omonto naisa gwechanda mono ase okorigia koyemanya, takonyara koyemanya. Nonya omonto omong’aini ogoteba ng’a namanyete, takonyara koyemanya.

Nkarengereria igoro y’amang’ana aya onsi, ngateema komanya buna abanyene oboronge na abare nobong’aini bare ase okoboko kwa Nyasae, amo nogokora kwabo, gokorabe okw’obwanchani gose okw’okogecha. Monto onde tamanyeti amang’ana are bosio.

Egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi, omonyene oboronge na omonyabibe, oyore omuya na ochenegete na oyo otachenegeti, oyo okorua ebing’wanso na oyo otari kobirua. Buna ekoba ase omonto omuya, naboigo ekoba nase omonyabibe; buna ekoba ase oria okoria eira y’ogotiana, naboigo ekoba nase oria otari koria eira y’ogotiana.

Obo nabwo obobe ase aya onsi agokorekana aiga inse y’erioba, ng’a egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi; chinkoro chia mwanyabanto nigo chiichire obobe na obobarimo ekero bare moyo, na nyuma y’ayio nigo bakogenda ase abakure.
Korende omonto ore ase egati y’abare moyo nare nogosemeria, na esese ere moyo nigo ekonyora amaya kobua endo ekwete.
Ee, abare moyo mbamanyete ng’a mbakwe, korende abakure tibamanyeti gento kende, na tibagenderereti konyora eng’eria; tibakoinyorwa nonya ndinde.
Obwanchani bwabo, na okogecha, ne ribero, bionsi ebio nigo biasirete amo nabarabwo. Tibabwati nonya ng’ake egetari kende ase ayio agokorwa aiga inse y’erioba.
Aye bono genda, orie endagera yao nomogoko, na onywe edivai yao kore nomosasoko ase enkoro yao, ekiagera Nyasae bwanchire emeremo yao.
Tiga chianga chiao chibe chindabu botambe, na amaguta okweakwa tamocha ase omotwe oo.

Ase amatuko onsi ay’obogima obo bore bosa, obo Nyasae akoeire omenye aiga inse y’erioba, omenye nomogoko amo nomokungu oo bwanchete. Okomenya nomogoko, nakio egetari kiao ase obogima obo, ekero ogendererete gwechanda ase emeremo emekong’u inse y’erioba.
Gento kende gionsi okoboko kwao koranyare gokora, gekore ne chinguru chiao chionsi; ekiagera agwo aase abakure ase oragende, meremo ende tekaiyo, gose okorengereria, gose chisemi, gose obong’aini.

Nkarora aiga inse y’erioba ng’a tari abwo bakominyoka bwango bakobua, gose ababwate chinguru tari barabwo bakobua esegi, gose abare nobong’aini tari barabwo bakonyora endagera, gose abare nokomanya tari barabwo babwate chinibo, gose abanyasemi tari barabwo bakonyora ogwancherwa; korende kera omonto nigo akonyorwa nengaki yaye na egesio kiaye.

Amo nayio mwanyabanto onde tamanyeti engaki yaye. Buna koreng’ana chinswe chikobwatwa ase ekeonga ase egesio ekebe, ne chinyoni ase obosugunia, naboigo na mwanyabanto bakonyorwa nengaki embe, babwatwa mobosokano.
Amang’ana aya naro naroche igoro y’obong’aini aiga inse y’erioba, naro akarorekana asende ng’a namanene;
Norenge omochie omoke omenyire nabanto abake; omoruoti orenge omonene mono agacha koyorwania esegi; akayonaaria, akaagacha chiburi chinene chi’ogwekengera ase okoyorwania.
Korende ase omochie oyio akanyorekana aroro omonto omotaka orenge omong’aini, na ase obong’aini bwaye agatooria omochie oria. Nonya naboigo, monto onde tari oinyorete omotaka oria.
Erio ngateba, “Obong’aini nigo bore obuya mbobuete chinguru, nonya obong’aini bw’omonto oria omotaka bwachayetwe, na amang’ana aye tarenge koigwerwa.”
Nigo ere buya gotegerera amang’ana omonto omong’aini agokwana ase obotoereru kobua gotegerera amang’ana ’omogambi ogoaka eriogi ase egati y’abanto abariri.
Obong’aini nigo bore obuya kobua ebirwanero bi’esegi; korende omonyabibe oyomo nigo agosaria amaya amange.
Chingi chikwete nigo chikogundia amaguta akweakwa atioka bobe; naboigo na oboriri obosinini bokobua obong’aini na amasikani.
Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekomoraa gochia borio, korende ey’omoriri nigo ekomoraa gochia bomosi.
Ekero omonto omoriri agotaara inchera nigo akoborwa okomanya, na igo omanyia kera omonto ng’a ere nomoriri.
Omogambi karabe nendamwamu asore, tobaisa gotiga emeremo yao, ekiagera oboremereria nigo boragere ebibe ebinene biaberwe.
Aiga inse y’erioba narorire obobe, na obobe obo nigo bokorentwa nabagambi:
Omoriri nigo akoegwa amasikani amanene, ekero abanto abanda bagendererete goikaransa aase a inse.
Narorire abasomba bariinete chibarasi, na abagambi bagotaara namagoro buna abasomba.
Omonto ogokunya eirima, nere oragwe imeo, na oyo okobochora enyasi, eng’iti engenda inse nemorome.
Oyo ogwatia amagena nigo araakwe naro, na oyo ogwatia emete, ande nanyore obokong’u asero.
Onye omonto tagotieria ekioma ekero giatuire, rirorio goika abeke chinguru chinyinge ase ogokora emeremo nakerokio, korende obong’aini nigo bogokonya omonto abue.
Omoebia ching’iti chingenda inse aise gotiga eng’iti emorome ritang’ani atarayeebia, rirorio omoebia oyio nigo arabe bosa.
Amang’ana akorua ase omonto omong’aini nigo akogera bwanchwa, korende aya akorua ase ebikoba bi’omoriri nigo akomosiria.
Oyio omoriri nigo agochaka gokwana amang’ana ’oboriri, naende oyakoora nobobarimo.
Omoriri nigo are omonyamang’ana mange. Monto onde tamanyeti aya agochia koba. Ning’o oranyare komotebia ekegochia koba korwa nyuma yaye.
Emeremo y’omoriri nigo ekomorosia, goika osinywa komanya enchera ekogenda ase omochie.
Obobe nobwao, aye ense, ekero omoruoti oo are omwana, na abagambi bao bakobeera ase emeyega y’okwegokia ase chingaki chia mambia.
Nosesenirie aye ense, ekero omoruoti oo are omonto omosike na omosibore; na abagambi bao bakoragera ase engaki egwenerete, ase okonyora chinguru, korende tari ase ogotinda.
Ekero omonto are omworo ekerama ki’enyomba yaye nigo gekogwa, na ase engencho y’obworo obwo embura nigo egotwa imeo.
Emeyega ye chindagera nigo ekorenta omogoko, na edivai nigo egokora omonto bweigwa buya, na ase chibesa nonyare kogora ebinto bionsi.

Tobaisa koragereria omoruoti nonya nase ebirengererio biao, gose tobaisa koragereria omonto omonda ekero ore ase akanyomba kao g’okorara. Oise gokora bo, enyoni nebaise koira amang’ana ao, gose egetongwa kere ne chimbaba ngetebe amang’ana ayio.
Eteria endagera yao igoro ye chinyancha, na nyuma y’amatuko amange noyenyore.
Atanana ebi obwate oe abanto batano na babere, gose batano na batato, ekiagera tomanyeti amabe agochia konyora ense.
Amare gaichoire nembura, nigo embura eyio egotwa igoro ase ense, na omote koragwe ororie ensemo ya irianyi gose eya sugusu, nigo oragenderere kobeera inse agwo ase ogwete.
Omonto okona‐korigereria komanya igoro y’embeo tagosimeka, na oyo okona‐korigereria amare buna are takogesa.
Buna otamanyeti ase embeo ekogusa gochia, gose buna amauga ’omwana ore ase enda ya ng’ina agokina, naboigo tokonyara komanya emeremo ya Nyasae oyio ogokora amang’ana onsi.
Busura embusuro yao mambia, nonya mogoroba totiga koyebusura, ekiagera tomanyeti eye erame, neye gose neria, gose nchionsi amo chirame buya.
Omobaso nigo ore omwansu, na amaiso nigo akogokigwa korora erioba.
Omonto karagenderere koba moyo ase engaki y’emiaka emenge, tiga agokere engaki eyio yonsi, korende goika ainyore ng’a amatuko ’omosunte nabe amange mono. Onsi aya agochi‐gocha nigo are bosa.

Aye omosae, gokera engaki y’obosae bwao, tiga enkoro yao ekorentere omogoko ase amatuko ’obosae bwao; bwatia chinchera chi’okogania gw’enkoro yao, na aya amaiso ao akorora. Korende oinyore ng’a ase ayio onsi Nyasae nakorangerie ase ekina.
Ase ayio tiga aya akogochanda arue ase enkoro yao, na aya akorenta obororo ase omobere oo arue boigo, ekiagera obosae na obuya bw’obogima nigo bore bosa.
Inyora Omotongi oo ekero ore omosae, ekero amatuko amabe ataracha, na emiaka eyio emebe etaraika ang’e ekero oratebe, “Tindi nomogoko koba moyo ase engaki buna eye!”
Omoinyore ekero erioba, na omobaso, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, bitarabekwa omosunte, gose amare atarairanerana embura koyature.
Engaki eyio abarendi b’enyomba mbaiguswe, na abasacha bare ne chinguru bekumbe, na abagosia batige gosia ekiagera bare abake ase omobaro, na abwo batengerete korwa ase ebibao, batubwe norotutu.
Ebisieri birochie ase chinchera mbisiekwe, na amariogi ay’ogosia nakee; amariogi e chinyoni natabobore omonto korwa ase chitoro, na amariogi ’abaiseke bagotera nakee.

Abanto nigo barabe nobwoba ase ebitiiro, na okogoswa kobe ase chinchera. Emelozi nesiche, na ebisase bibe bikwagura ng’ora ng’ora, na okogania gwonsi ngosire. Eyio nengaki mwanyabanto aragende ase obomenyo bwaye bwa kare na kare; abakona‐korera mbabe bakomochiera ekero ase ekero.
Engori eroisirie korwa ase efeta nebutorwe, na egetaabo keroisirie korwa ase etahabu ngiatwe, na enyongo yatwe agwo ase ensoko y’amache, na ekebara‐bara nkebunwe agwo ase egesima ki’amache.
Erio orotu ndoirane, ase riroba buna rwarenge, na omoika oirane gochia ase Nyasae oria oyoruete.
Ase ayio omorandia nigo agoteba. Aya mbosa, bosa; onsi mbosa kegima.
Ekiagera omorandia oria arenge omong’aini, akagenderera kworokereria abanto chisemi na korua ogosemia okuya. Agasangereria na gotuka, naende akaroisia emereng’anio emenge.
Akarigia konyora amang’ana arenge kogokia, akarika amang’ana ’ekeene ase oboronge.
Amang’ana abanto abang’aini bagokwana nigo anga buna chimbambo chinyoge, na aya basangereirie anga buna emesumari eakeire bokong’u. Ayio onsi nebiegwa korwa ase Omorisia oyomo.
Aye omwana one, kobua ase aya onsi, igwera ogokurerwa oko. Okorika ebitabu ebinge tikori nomoerio; ogosoma okonge nigo gokorosia omobere.
Amang’ana onsi aigurwe, Omoerio bw’amang’ana onsi noyo: Omoiroke Nyasae na obwate amachiko aye, ekiagera ayio naro abanto bonsi bagwenerete bakore.
Nyasae narente kera ogokora ase ekina ekero aranachere obobisi bwonsi ekina, karabe amaya gose amabe.
Ogotera okuya gwa Sulemani.
Tiga anyunyunte nokonyunyunta kw’omonwa oye. Obwanchani bwao nobuya kobua edivai.
Amaguta ao akweakwa nigo are ne rimisu rigiya; erieta riao nigo ringa buna amaguta aumoirwe, ase ayio abaiseke abekungi nigo bagwanchete.
Ing’use nkobwatie, tominyoke kogenda. Omoruoti ondetire ase chiero chiaye. Ntokogokere na kogochengera, ntotogie obwanchani bwao kobua edivai. Ekeene, nigo bagwanchete bori.
Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, inche nigo inde omomwamu ti, nonya naboigo nigo inde oyo bw’okogokia. Nigo inga buna chiema chia Kedari, naende buna ebitambaa bi’ogosungwa bia Sulemani.
Timobaisa kondigereria, ekiagera inde omomwamu ti; nomobaso bw’erioba onsambire. Abamura ba baba nigo bambeete, bakambeka korenda emegondo y’emesabibu, korende omogondo one bw’emesabibu tinarendete.
Aye omwanchi bw’omoyo one, ntebie ng’ai okorisia riicho riao. Ng’ai okoriira riakenderera mobaso gati? Nase ki ndabe nkona‐gotayaya ase egati y’amaicho ’abagisangio bao?
Aye ore omoseera kobua abakungu bonsi; onye tomanyeti, bwatia amabarato e riicho, obe gokorisia chimanwa chiao chie chimbori ang’e ne chiema chi’abarisia.
Aye omwanchi one, nigo ngokoreng’ania nebarasi eaberi ekong’usa egari ya Farao.
Chinsea chiao nechinseera, chichabeire nebinto bi’oboseera, ne rigoti riao nigo richabeire ne chisonoi.
Intwe ntokoroiserie ebinyuri bie chitahabu bi’ogwechabera, ebitonire ne chifeta.
Ekero omoruoti arenge aase aye agotimokera, amaguta aane akorokwa narada agatioka rimisu rigiya.
Omwanchi one nigo are asende buna omobuko o manemane, oyo nkobeka ase egekuba kiane.
Omwanchi one nigo are asende buna egesago ki’ebisicha bikorokwa hena, bire ase emegondo y’emesabibu y’Eni‐Gedi.
Naama! Aye omwanchi one, naki ore omoseera mono! Ee, nabo ore omoseera mono. Ekieni ki’amaiso ao nigo kenga eki’amaruma.
Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omoseera. Ee, aye nigo ore oyo bw’okogokia, oborere bwaito togotimokera nigo bonga obonyansi obwororo.
Ebisigisa bi’enyomba yaito nebi’emecharake, ne chindote nechi’emetarakwa.
Inche nigo inga egesicha gia Saroni gekorokwa rosi, naende egesicha ekiya kie rikura.
Ee, koreng’ana buna egesicha ekiya kere ase egati y’amagwa, naboigo omwanchi one are ase egati y’abaiseke.
Koreng’ana buna omote bw’amapera osimekire ase egati y’emete y’orosana, naboigo omwanchi one are ase egati y’abamura. Nigo naikaransete ase ekiriri kiaye inde nomogoko, na amatunda aye akanyansera.
Ere akang’ira ase enyomba y’omoyega, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bore buna ebendera igoro yane.
Ong’e amasabibu amomo indie imbe nobogima oboyia, ong’e na amapera imbe ne chinguru, ekiagera amaiga ’obwanchani anyarire.
Okoboko kwaye kwa bomosi nigo kore inse y’omotwe one, na okwa borio nigo komboanetie.
Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora, nkobatiania ase chingabi ne chinsune chi’orosana ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwanchani, gose koboichania, goika bobe bwancheranire obonyene.
Tegerera moigwe eriogi ri’omwanchi one! Rora oyio ogocha! Nigo agocharoka‐charoka igoro ase ebitunwa, na gocharara ase ebigoro.
Omwanchi one nigo anga engabi gose ensune ensae. Rora, bono nigo ateneine magega y’enyasi y’enyomba yaito. Origereretie gocha ime goetera ase chitirisa, goetera ase ekebao kiabekire ebitange.
Omwanchi ngokwana are na gontebia: “Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omuya, imoka, inchuo togende,
ekiagera bono engaki y’obokendu yaerire, boigo engaki y’embura yaerire.
Ebisicha biasichire ase ense, engaki y’amatera yaikire, ee, eriogi ri’amatera ’amaruma riaigurwe ase ense yaito.
Emeko yachakire kwama amako, na emesabibu yachakire gosicha, nigo egotioka rimisu rigiya. Aye omosani one omuya, imoka togende!
Aye riruma riane ore ase omwenya bw’egetare, agwo ase obwebiso bw’egetare, tiga indore obosio bwao, naende inyigwe eriogi riao, ekiagera eriogi riao neriansu, na obosio bwao noboseera.
“Tobwatere ebibwe, ebibwe biria ebike, ebio bigosaria emegondo y’emesabibu, korwa ekero emesabibu yaito yasichete.”
Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, nere noyone; nigo akorisia riicho riaye ase egati y’ebisicha ebiya.
Ekero rigochia kogoroba na emerengari egochia gosira, aye omwanchi one, onchoka gocha asende, ominyoke buna engabi, gose buna ensune ensae igoro ase egetunwa kere chinchwara.
Botuko ekero naraire borere bwane, nkamorigia oria omoyo one bwanchete, nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora.
“Bono nigo nkoimoka ngende ase omochie, ng’ete ase chinchera chiaye na ase ebiooreri biaye, ndigie omwanchi bw’omoyo one.” Nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora.
Ekero abarendi barenge goetanana omochie koyorata, bakanyora inche, na inche nkababoria, “Mwarora omwanchi bw’omoyo one?”
Ase obwango obwo naruete ase abarendi abwo, nkanyora omwanchi bw’omoyo one. Nkamotarera tinamotiga agende; nigo namorentete mwa baba, nkamosoyia gochia ase eero y’oyio onyiborete.
Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora, nkobatiania ase chingabi na ase chinsune chi’orosana ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwa’nchani gose koboichania, goika bobe bwancheranire obonyene.
Ning’o oria ogocha korwa ase erooro onga buna rikundesi ri’erioki? Nigo eagete amaguta a manemane na ubani, na ebinto bisiire bigotioka buya.
Rora aaria, ekerogo gi’okobogoreria Sulemani, geetananire nabanto emerongo etano nomo, abare chituoni chi’Abaisraeli.
Abwo bonsi nigo beboeranetie emeyio ya birende, na nigo bare abanto bamanyete korwana esegi. Kera oyomo nigo eboeranetie omoyio kenema, orendete ase okogoswa kwa botuko.
Omoruoti Sulemani nigo eroiseretie ekerogo keria korwa ase emete ya Lebanoni.

Amatenenerio aye nigo aroiseirie chifeta, na ekiegeko kiaye nigo kiaroiseirie chitahabu; egeikaransero kiaye nigo giatubire negetambaa kemonyinga. Abakungu ba Yerusalemu nigo bagechaberete ime, bare nomoyo bw’ogwancha.
Inwe abakungu ba Sayoni, inchuo morore Sulemani omoruoti obegete ekiore keria ng’ina amobekerete ase rituko riria Sulemani akoreretwe enyangi, rituko riria ri’omogoko bw’enkoro yaye.

Aye omwanchi one, naki ore omoseera! Naama! Nigo ore omoseera! Korwa ime y’egietubo kiao ekieni ki’amaiso ao nigo kenga eki’amaruma; etukia yao nigo enga buna riicho rie chimbori, nigo chigotirimboka ase ebitirimboko bia Gileadi.
Amaino ao nigo anga ching’ondi chiaberi chianachirwe amarionya, chiarure gosibigwa chiarabire se, chionsi nigo chikobiara chisare, na manwa ende teri gokwa.
Ebikoba biao nigo binga eusi embariri, omonwa oo nigo ore oyo bw’okogokia, chinsea chiao chitubire ime ase egietubo kiao; nigo chinga buna ebing’ese bie ritunda rikomomanga.
Rigoti riao nigo ringa buna omorobiri o Daudi, oyio oagachetwe koba rigachero ri’ebirwanero. Agwo nao ching’aya elifu eyemo chisungire, chionsi nigo chire echi’abarwani esegi bare chituoni.
Chimbeere chiao nigo chinga buna chimanwa ibere buna chisare chi’engabi chikorisia agwo ase egati y’ebisicha ebiya.
Ekero rigochia kogoroba na emerengari egochia gosira, ningende ase egetunwa ase manemane ekoruerwa na ase ekegoro ki’ogosambera ubani.
Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omoseera bori, tori na kemoa kende!

Aye omoriakari one, togende torue aa Lebanoni, torue Lebanoni, togende komo. Otirimboke korwa ase egechuria ki’egetunwa ki’Amana, na ekia Seniri na Herimoni. Orue ase amakuruma e chindo, na ase ebitunwa chingo chimenyete.
Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, kwang’usire enkoro yane na kwangokirie, okorigereria kw’amaiso ao kwang’usire enkoro yane, ee, esonoi eyemo yoka ye chisonoi chia igoti riao yang’usire.
Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, obwanchani bwao naki bore obuya mono! Naki bore obuya mono kobua edivai! Ne rimisu ri’amaguta ao ogweaka nigo ribuete ebinsari bionsi!
Aye omoriakari one, ebikoba biao nigo bikonyororokia obooke; obooke na amabeere nigo bire inse y’oromeme rwao. Rimisu rie chianga chiao nigo ringa eria Lebanoni.
Moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, naye omogondo ogiteire, naye ensoko y’amache egiteire, na entuboka emumekire na ebekire ekemanyererio.
Buna omogondo ore namakomomanga aye nigo okwama amatunda amaya mono, na ebisicha bikorokwa hena mbireo, na ebimeri bikorokwa narada,
na ebimeri bigosegwa safarani; boigo kalamusi, na omodalasini, na emete yonsi ya ubani, na manemane, na omogaka, amo nebinsari ebiya mono.
Aye nigo onga buna ensoko y’amache are moyo ere mogondo, naende nigo onga buna chindooche chikorwa Lebanoni.

Aye embeo ekorwa sugusu, imoka! Na aye eyekorwa irianyi, inchuo! Gusa igoro y’omogondo one, tiga rimisu riaye rigiya rirurukigwe rirande. Tiga omwanchi one ache ase omogondo oye, arie amatunda are amaya mono.

Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, nasoire ase omogondo one, ngosangereria inde manemane amo nebinsari biane bigotioka buya; nkoria inde eriana amo nobooke bwane, nkonywa inde edivai yane amo namabeere aane. Inwe abasani, ragera na monywe! Inwe abanchani, kanywe mono!

Inche nigo narenge indaire, korende enkoro yane nigo yategesetie. Igwa! Omwanchi one oyio ogontura. Moiseke ominto, omwanchi one, riruma riane na omoikeranu one, inyigorere! Inyigorere, ekiagera omotwe one otoorire riime, na etukia yane yanyiire nembura ya botuko.
Narusirie eanga, inee, inyebeke naende? Nesibirie amagoro, inee, inyabeke eubi naende?
Erio omwanchi one akabeka okoboko kwaye ase ekebao, erio nkaba nomosasoko omonene ime ase enkoro yane.
Nkaimoka gochia koigorera omwanchi one, amaboko aane akanyororokia manemane, na ebiara biane bigatonyia manemane ase obobwato bw’egesiekero.
Ngachia koigorera omwanchi one, korende nkanyora ng’a ochiire. Omoyo one okairianyeka ekero akwanete. Nkaba nkomorigia, korende tinamonyorete. Nkamorangeria, korende taitabete.
Ekero abarendi barenge goetanana omochie koyorata, bakanyora inche, bakang’aka chingoma; bakang’ura egetambaa gi’okwambara, abarendi baria barendete chindwaki.
Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora ng’a mokonyora omwanchi one, momotebie ng’a amaiga ’obwanchani anyarire.
Aye ore omoseera kobua abakungu bonsi, inee, omwanchi oyio oo, naki abuete abanchi bande? Ee, omwanchi oyio oo, naki abuete abanchi bande, goika gwatosoroire iga?
Omwanchi one nigo are omorabu se okomeka‐meka, naende omobariri; nigo are nogwatananekana korwa ase abanto chilifu ikomi.
Omotwe oye nigo ore omuya onga etahabu echenire, etukia yaye nigo ere omosamugoku bw’obwari; nigo ere emwamu ti buna amarionya ’ekegonkoru.
Amaiso aye nigo agwekaine amaruma are ase chindooche, ee, nigo anga amaruma asibigwe namabeere, naende nigo anga amagena akomeka‐meka achokire buya.
Chinsea chiaye nigo chinga buna ebigondo bi’ebimeri bi’ebinsari, bigotioka rimisu rigiya. Ebikoba biaye nigo binga buna ebisicha ebiya, nigo bigotonyia manemane.
Amaboko aye nigo anga buna etahabu ebombire buya, echabeire amagena akomeka‐meka. Omobere oye nigo onga buna amaino e chinchogu aroisirie buya, na gochaberwa namagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro.

Amagoro aye nigo anga chisiiro chi’amagena amarabu se akomeka‐meka, abekire ase chinterekerero chie chitaabu chingiya. Okororekana kwaye nigo konga buna okwa Lebanoni, ekieni kiaye nigo kere ekiya buna eki’emecharake,
