Chinkwana chiaye nigo chire chinyansu mono, chingencho chiaye chionsi nigo chire echi’ogosanerwa mono. Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, naboigo omwanchi one are, oyio ore omosani one.
Aye ore omoseera kobua abakungu bonsi, ng’ai omwanchi oo achiire? Omwanchi oyio oo, ng’ai aonchokire gochia? Togende amo naye tomorigie.
Omwanchi one mogondo agenda, ogendire ase ebigondo bi’ebimeri bi’ebinsari. Ogendire korisia riicho riaye ase emegondo, naende nao akare kona‐gosangereria ebisicha ebiya.
Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, nere nigo are oyone; nigo akorisia riicho riaye agwo ase ebisicha ebiya bire.
Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omoseera buna omochie o Tirisa; nigo ore bw’okogokia buna Yerusalemu, na oyo bw’okoirokia buna abarwani esegi babogoretie ebendera.
Onchora amaiso ao otige kondigereria, ekiagera ambuire; etukia yao nigo enga buna riicho rie chimbori, chigotirimboka ase ebitirimboko bia Gileadi.
Amaino ao nigo anga riicho rie ching’ondi chiaberi chianachirwe amarionya, chiarure gosibigwa chiarabire se, chionsi nigo chikobiara chisare, na manwa ende teri egokwa.
Chinsea chiao nigo chitubire ime ase egietubo kiao, nigo chinga buna chimbaara chie ritunda rikomomanga.
Mbareo abakungu chiting’ana chi’omoruoti emerongo etano nomo, na abakungu ba sere‐sere emerongo etano na etato, boigo mbareo abaiseke abekungi abange batari kobareka.

Korende oyomo bweka nere omwanchi one, nere riruma riane omoikeranu. Ere nigo are omwana omomoima ng’ina abwate, oyo omoiborete nigo amwanchete. Abaiseke abwo bakamorora, bakamoroka oyosesenirie; abakungu baria chiting’ana na baria ba sere‐sere boigo bakamorora, bakamotogia.

Ning’o oyio okorigereria buna erioba rigotonga mambia? Ning’o oyio ore omuya buna omotienyi, na okomeka‐meka buna erioba? Ere nigo are oyo bw’okoirokia buna abarwani esegi babogoretie chibendera chiabo.

Inche nigo natirimbogete gochia ase omogondo bw’emete enga buna emelozi; nkagenda ase rikura korora ebimeri ebiya buna bikoreereta, na korora gose emesabibu yachakire goseboka. Na emekomomanga gose yachakire gosicha.
Ekero konya ntaramanya, omoyo one okang’ira, okambeka ase egari y’omogambi bw’abanto baane.
Irana! Irana, aye Omosulamiti! Irana! Irana, erinde tokorigererie! Nase ki mokondi gereria inche Omosulamiti, buna mokorigereria ogotenga kw’ebiombe bibere bi’abarwani esegi?
Aye omoiseke bw’omogambi, naki ebisanyi bi’amagoro ao bire ebiya ase ebikoroto ime! Naki amariagati ao amerete buya, are buna emeremo y’omoroisia omong’aini.
Ekenyobu kiao nigo keborongosire buya buna egetaabo getari koererwa edivai yochoganirie. Enda yao nigo ere buna etui y’engano, eetananeirie ebisicha ebiya.
Chimbeere chiao nigo chinga buna chimanwa ibere chire chisare chi’engabi.

Rigoti riao nigo ringa buna omorobiri oroiseirie amaino e chinchogu, amaiso ao nigo anga buna amatibo a Hesiboni, ang’e negeita kia Bati‐Rabimu. Emioro yao nigo enga buna omorobiri o Lebanoni orochie Damesiki.
Omotwe oo nigo osongoire buna egetunwa gia Karimeli. Etukia y’omotwe oo ekona‐gosanyoka nigo ere ekieni kemonyinga; eyio yang’usire omoruoti.
Naki aye ore omoseera naende oyo bw’okogokia mono! Aye omwanchi bw’okogokia!
Aye nigo okinete buna omokendo, ne chimbeere chiao nigo chire buna ebisago bi’amasabibu.
Nkarengereria: Nkoriina inde omokendo oyo, imbwaterere chinsagia chiaye. Naki yare koba buya onye chimbeere chiao nchiaba buna ebisago bi’amasabibu, ne rimisu ri’omonwa oo ribe buna eri’amapera,
na omonwa oo obe buna edivai ere engiya mono. Ee, edivai eyio nigo egetirimboka gochia ime y’omwanchi one, naende yanyororoka ng’ora ng’ora, yakuna ebikoba bi’abwo baraire.
Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, ere nigo are namaiga asende.
Aye omwanchi one, inchuo togende ase amaremo aito, tobeere ase emechie botuko,

toimoke mambia chuni togende ase emegondo y’emesabibu, torore gose yachakire goseboka, naende gose amasabibu amanokire na gosicha, boigo gose amakomomanga asichire. Aroro agwo ninkoboanie nobwanchani bwane.
Aye omwanchi one, amatunda amansu nigo agotioka rimisu rigiya mono, na igoro y’ebisieri biaito nareo amatunda ao ao are amaya mono, amakoro na amayia; ayio nasangereirie ase ogokogachera.
Onye ndiria kwarenge koba momura ominto, kwagongete orobeere rwa baba! Onye ndiria naumeranete naye isiko, nanga nigo nare gokonyunyunta, na onde tare gonchaya.
Nigo nanga nakorentete mwa baba, obe gokonyorokereria. Nigo nare gocha gokoa onywe edivai yochoganirie ebinsari, naende nkoe amache amitire korwa ase amakomomanga aane.
Okoboko kwaye kwa bomosi nigo kore inse y’omotwe one, na okwa borio komboanetie.
Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora na kobatiania ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwanchani na koboichania, goika bobe bwancheranire obonyene.

Monto ki oria ogotiira gocha aa korwa ase erooro, oyio bweegegete omwanchi oye? Agwo inse y’omote bw’amapera inche nigo nagoturete oboke. Aroro agwo nyoko nigo arenge nobororo bw’okobina akoibore, ee, agwo nao nyoko akoiborerete ore nobororo.

Imbeke ase enkoro yao imbe buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio, ee, buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao. Obwanchani nigo bore ne chinguru buna amakweri, ne ribero nigo rire ritindi buna embeera. Ogwoka kw’obwanchani nigo konga ebibemberi bi’omorero, ee, nekebemberi gekorwa ase Omonene.
Amache are amange mono takonyara gokendia obwanchani, gose chindooche tichikonyara koboiranana. Omonto naisa korua obotenenku bwonsi bw’enyomba yaye konyora obwanchani, oyio nigo arachaywe.
Intwe ntobwate omoiseke ominto ore omoke, korende taracha chimbeere; ekero engaki yaye erache akorigigwa anyuomwe, ninki torakorere omoiseke oyio ominto?
Ere karabe orwaki, ntoagache igoro yaye omorobiri oroiseirie efeta, korende karabe egesieri, rirorio ntomosiekere ne chibao chi’emecharake.
Inche nigo inde orwaki, ne chimbeere chiane nigo chinga buna emerobiri; ase ayio nkaba ase amaiso aye buna oyo onyorire omorembe.
Sulemani nabwate omogondo bw’emesabibu agwo Baali‐Hamoni, akayotigera abarendi, na kera omorendi nigo arenge korenta chibesa chie chifeta elifu eyemo goakanera amatunda.
Korende omogondo bw’emesabibu oyore oyone bori ninche omonyene nyorendete. Aye Sulemani, ira chilifu chiao, na abarendi b’amatunda baire amagana abere.
Aye oria omenyete ase emegondo, abagisangio baane nigo bategererete baigwe eriogi riao, tiga nainche indiigwe.
Aye omwanchi one, minyoka bwango, obe buna engabi gose ensune ensae ekominyoka igoro ase ebitunwa bire nebimeri bigotioka buya.
Aya namaroro Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, aroche igoro y’ense y’Abayuda na omochie o Yerusalemu ekero Usia, na Yotamu, na Ahasi, na Hezekia, barenge abaruoti ase ense y’Abayuda.
Inwe igoro, na aye ense, tegerera moigwe, ekiagera Omonene okwanire, ogoteba: “Abana nabeire nkorera na kobakinia basaririe asende.
Eng’ombe nigo emanyete omonyene, na etigere nigo emanyete aase omonene oye akoyeera endagera, korende Abaisraeli tibamanyeti kende, ee, amaene, abanto baane tibamanyeti kende gionsi.”

Obobe nobwaino inwe egesaku kere nebibe ebinge, inwe abanto moritoeire nobobe, inwe oroiboro rw’abasaria, abanto abakorekanu, mogokora ogosaria. Mwangire Omonene, mwachayire Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, mwairanire nyuma na mwamotigire kegima.
Nase ki mogendererete gosaria? Nigo moganetie konyora egesusuro goetania? Omotwe bwonsi orwarire, na enkoro yanyarekire.
Korwa egesanyi gi’okogoro inse goika omotwe igoro, aande tari are buya. Chingoma nchireo, na obobimbu, na amaote akorua amaira. Amaote ayio tasibiri na kobogwa, gose taakiri amaguta ororobe.
Ense yaino yasarigwe yatigaire ere bosa, emechie yaino yasambirwe nomorero; abanto b’egesaku ekeao barire okwama kw’emegondo yaino ase amaiso aino. Ense yasarigwe na koonchoranwa nabarabwo.
Omoiseke oria Sayoni otigirwe buna egesa gi’okorendera kere ase omogondo bw’emesabibu giatigirwe bosa; nigo anga buna ekegutu kere ase omogondo bw’amasosa, na buna omochie oboeire.
Onye Omonene bw’Emeganda atatotigerete abatigari bake, nanga nigo twabete buna Sodomu na Gomora.
Inwe abagambi ba Sodomu, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene! Inwe abanto ba Gomora, tegerera moigwe amorokererio a Nyasae oito!

Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ebing’wanso biaino ebinge mokorua asende, ninki ndakore nabirobio? Nigo narosire nebing’wannso bi’ogosambwa bie chimingichi, na ebitinya bie ching’iti chinoru. Tingokiri namanyinga e chieri, gose aye chimanwa chie ching’ondi, gose aye chigoree.
Ning’o okobaboria ng’a morentane ebinto ebio bionsi ekero mogocha ase obosio bwane na gotaara‐taara ase chiraaro chiane?

Tiga korenta asende ebing’wanso bi’obong’ainereria; ogosambwa kwa ubani kwabeire okogechia asende, naboigo nemeyega y’Emetienyi Emeyia, ne Chisabato, na emesangererekano mokorangeria. Tinkonyara koremereria emesangererekano buna eyio yasarigwe nebibe.
Inche nigo ngechete emeyega y’Amatuko Amanene na ey’Emetienyi Emeyia; eyio yabeire egurube endito asende, narosire ase okona‐koyeremereria.
“Ekero morarambore amaboko aino ase ogosaba, inche nigo ndatube amaiso aane timbarora, na ekero morabe mogosaba mono, tinkobaigwa ekiagera amaboko aino nigo aichire amanyinga.
Esibie na mwechene; rusia ogokora kwaino okobe korwa ase amaiso aane; tiga gokora ayare amabe.
Mweorokererie gokora ayare amaya, rigia ay’oboronge; bakonye abwo bagokorerwa bobe; rwanerera chintakana, na monyorere ababoraka oboronge bwabo.”

Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Inchuo togamberane nonya ebibe biaino biabariirire, mbisibigwe birabe se, bibe buna amagena ’embura; nonya biabeire ebibariri burure, mbirabe se bibe buna amarionya amarabu e ching’ondi.
Komoranche koigwera, rirorio morie amaya ay’ense,
korende komoraange koigwera naende komorasarie, goika moitwe nemioro. Nabo inche Omonene natebire nomonwa one.”
Omochie oyio orenge omwegenwa obeire buna omokungu omotayayi. Agwo kare nigo orenge konacha ebina bia boronge, na oboronge nigo bwarenge ime yaye, korende bono abanto baye babeire abaiti.
Chifeta chiao chiabeire bosa buna amabiria, na edivai yao yochoganigwe namache.

Abatang’ani bao nigo bare abasaria, naende babeire abagisangio b’abaibi. Kera oyomo obo nigo anchete riaaki, na nigo are omwango kwerigeria ebitoki. Tibari korwanerera chintakana, nigo bakwanga koigwa amang’ana ’ababoraka.
Ase ayio Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, ore Omobui ase egati y’Abaisraeli, otebire iga: “Naama! Ning’itere endamwamu yane ase ababisa baane, naende inche omonyene ninyeruserie egesiomba asebare.
Ning’onchore okoboko kwane kobe igoro yao, konyititore, korusie amabiria ao buna ogosisikerigwa kwe ribu na korusia ayatakogwenereti.
Nimbae naende abagambi ebina buna baria be ritang’ani, na abasemia buna baria ba kare. Nyuma y’ayio norokwe Omochie bw’Oboronge, na Omochie bw’Obwegenwa.”
Omochie o Sayoni nigo oraboorigwe goetera ase ekina kia boronge na abaonchokire ime yaye mbaboorigwe goetera ase oboronge.
Korende abasaria na abanyabibe nigo barasirigwe amo; na abwo batigire Omonene mbasirigwe boigo.
Inwe namobe nobosooku ase emete eyio enga emetontera mwagokerete, na ase emegondo eyio mwachorete.
Inwe namobe buna omotontera oyo amato aye omire, na buna omogondo oborirwe amache.
Abanto bare ne chinguru nababe buna amasakwe amomo, na emeremo yabo ebe buna chinsase chi’omorero, abwo mbasambwe bayiere amo, na onde tari orarimie omorero oyio.
Ring’ana eri nario Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, aroche igoro y’Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu:
Nebe ase amatuko ’omoerio, ng’a egetunwa ki’enyomba y’Omonene ngekong’igwe kebe eki’engencho enene kobua ebinde; naende keimokererigwe igoro geetanie ebigoro, na ebisaku bionsi mbiendoke gochiao.

Ee, abanto abange mbagendeo batebanie: “Inchuo, totiire gochia ase egetunwa ki’Omonene, togende ase enyomba ya Nyasae o Yakobo, erinde atworokererie chinchera chiaye, na intwe tonyare kobwatia oboeto bwaye.” Amachiko ’Omonene nasoke korwa Sayoni, ne ring’ana riaye ndirue Yerusalemu.

Erio Omonene nanache ekina ase egati y’ebisaku, nae abanto abange oboronge bwabo, barabwo mbature emioro yabo ebe amakombe akorema, na amatimo abo abe emeyio chinkuro; egesaku tigekoimokera egesaku kende nemioro, gose abanto tibakweorokereria korwana esegi naende.
Inwe abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo inchuo totaare ase omobaso bw’Omonene.

Aye Omonene kwangire abanto bao, abwo bare ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, ekiagera barabwo baichoirwe ne chingencho chi’abanto ba moocha, na nigo bagokora oboringoria buna obw’Abafilisti; boigo babwatanire nabanto be chinse chingeni.
Ense yabo nigo eichire ne chifeta ne chitahabu, ne chinibo chiabo tichiri nomoerio. Ense yabo nigo eichire ne chibarasi, ne chigari chiabo tichikoera.
Ense yabo nigo eichire nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa, nigo bagotung’ama inse basasima emeremo y’amaboko abo, eyio bakorire nebiara biabo abanyene.
Ase enchera eyio abanto nigo barakeeigwe, ee, abanene babo nigo barairanigwe inse; tobaisa kobaabera.
Inwe soa ase egetare ime, moreme chingoro mwebiseo, motame korwa ase okoirokia kw’Omonene, na korwa ase obonene bwaye bore obonene.
Okorigereria kw’obomwenu bwa mwanyabanto nkoiranigwe inse, na oboenenu bwabo mbokeeigwe, na ase rituko erio Omonene bweka naimokererigwe igoro.
Omonene bw’Emeganda ochikire rituko erimo arasirie abwo bonsi bare abaenenu na abamwenu, na bonsi abakweimokereria igoro mbairanigwe inse.
Rituko erio ndisirie emecharake yonsi ya Lebanoni ere emetambe echongororogete gochia igoro mono; boigo ndiikere nemete yonsi ya Basani enga buna emetontera,
na ebitunwa bionsi ebitambe, na ebigoro bionsi biimokererete igoro,
na emerobiri yonsi emetambe, ne chindwaki chinkong’u,
ne chimeeri chionsi chia Tarisisi, na ebinto ebiya biroisirie ase obong’aini.
Obomwenu bwa mwanyabanto mbokeeigwe, na oboenenu bwabo mboiranigwe inse, na ase rituko erio Omonene bweka naimokererigwe igoro.
Emegwekano yonsi egosasimwa nesirigwe kegima.
Abanto mbasoe ase amakuruma ’ebitare, na ase chingoro chire ase riroba; mbatame korwa ase okoirokia kw’Omonene, na korwa ase obonene bwaye bore obonene, ekero araimoke kwoboyia ense.
Ase rituko erio abanto mbatugute emegwekano yabo ye chifeta na eye chitahabu, ebinto ebio beroiseretie ase okobisasima, mbabitugutere ching’uko na ebitabora mato.
Erio basoe ase emienya y’ebitare, na ase obotandoku bw’aroro, mbatame korwa ase okoirokia kw’Omonene, na korwa ase obonene bwaye bore obonene mono, ekero araimoke kwoboyia ense.
Ase ayio, batige mwanyabanto, abwo okoeyana kwabo gwe chimioro kore embeo bosa. Omonto, ninki aisaine?
Naama! Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, narusie korwa ase Yerusalemu, na korwa ase Abayuda, kera egento basemeretie na ebi begenete; narusieo endagera yonsi, na amache onsi.
Narusie korwao abanto bare chituoni na abarwani bande b’esegi, na abagambi ebina, na ababani, na abaringoria, na abagaaka,
na abatang’ani b’abarwani emerongo etano, na abanto abasike, na abasemia, na abaroisia abang’aini, na abaragori bamanyete oborogi mono.
Nigo agoteba: “Nimbeke abasae babe abanene babo, na abataraisana kogamba babagambere.”
Abanto mbachandane, kera omonto nabe ogochanda oyonde, na kera omonto nabe ogochanda omogisangio oye; omwana omoke naenenere omonto omogotu, na omonto otarochi nchera nachaye omonto osikire.
Engaki eyio omonto nabwate oyomwabo baiboire komo amotebie, “Aye nobwate chianga okobeka, ase ayio kabe omogambi oito, otenenere obogambi obo bwanyegerigwe.”
Korende ase rituko erio oyio nakane bokong’u, atebe, “Inche tinkonyara koba omogwenia; ase enyomba yane endagera teiyo, gose eanga, ase ayio timokonyara kombeka imbe omoraai bw’abanto.”
Yerusalemu otagoirwe, na Abayuda bagure, ekiagera chinkwana chiabo na ogokora kwabo biabeire mamincha y’Omonene, na ase engencho eyio bagechirie amaiso ’Omonene ore nobonene.
Okororekana kw’amaiso abo kwababereire kirori; nigo bakoraria ebibe biabo buna Abasodomu bakorete, tibari kobibisa. Obobe nobwabo! Barabwo abanyene berenteire obobe obwo.
Tebia abanyene oboronge ng’a amang’ana nabe amaya asebare, barabwo mbarie okwama kw’ogokora kwabo.
Obobe nobwabo abakori amabe! Amang’ana nabe amabe asebare, ekiagera aya amaboko abo abeire agokora, naro barakorerwe abanyene.
Abanto baane nigo bagochandwa nabana, na abakungu nabwo bakobagambera. Inwe abanto baane, abaraai baino babatantanirie enchera, babasiririe ase enchera mogoeta.
Omonene obeire ang’e korenta ekina, otenenire konachera ebisaku ekina.
Omonene nachake kogambia abagaaka na abagambi b’abanto baye, atebe, “Ninwe mwarire omogondo one bw’emesabibu, na ebisakorwa bi’abataka nigo bire ase chinyomba chiaino.
Omonene Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nigo akoboria iga: Ninki mokorengereria goika mwasunyuntire abanto baane na gosia amasio ’abataka?”

Omonene nigo agoteba, “Abakungu ba Sayoni nigo bare aberori, nigo bagotaara basongorete amagoti, na bagoaka‐akania amaiso are nokogania okobe; nigo bagotira‐tiria kobakogenda na kwogia chinchigiri chire amagoro abo.
Ase ayio Omonene nae abakungu ba Sayoni oborwaire bw’ogosunyora chitukia chiabo, naende abaasiorie chianga abatige bare getirianda.”
Ase rituko erio Omonene nabaure ebinto bionsi bechaberete: ebitange bi’amagoro, na ebitinti, ne chisonoi chi’amagoti,
na ebigera bi’amato, ne chitaai chi’amaboko, na ebiechabero bia metwe,
na ebinyuri bi’amagoro, ne chinkini chi’okweboeria, ne chichuba chire namaguta agotioka, na ebite bi’ogwekong’era,
ne chibonyi chire nebimanyererio, na ebigera bie chimioro,
ne chiganchwa chi’emeyega, ne chigoti chi’okwambara, na ebiambaro bi’amareko, na emebuko ya koboko,
na ebirore, ne chianga chi’egatani chie rigori rinene, na ebigogwa, na ebietubo.

Ribaga ri’ogotioka okuya nobogundo borabeo, ne ribaga ri’orokini nengori erabeo, ne ribaga ri’etukia eroisirie buya nerisio rirabeo, ne ribaga ri’okobeka chiganchwa chi’emeyega mweboyie chigunia, ne ribaga ri’oboseera mbabe namasambo are ekemanyererio gi’okobugwa.
Abanto baino mbaitwe nemioro, na abarwani baino chituoni mbakwere ase esegi.
Ebiita bi’omochie oyio mbirere na kobokia amagombo; nigo oraikaranse inse obe otigarete bosa.

Ase engaki eyio abakungu batano na babere mbabwate omosacha oyomo, bamotebie, “Intwe abanyene ntwenyorere endagera tokoria ne chianga tokobeka, korende tiga rioka torokwe abakungu bao, erinde otoruserie obosooku.”
Ase engaki eyio Omoseboka bw’Omonene noseboke ore omoseera na ore nobonene, na okwama gw’ense nkobe obonene na obosiani bw’Abaisraeli abaratooreke.
Erio nebe ng’a kera omonto otigarete ase Sayoni, na ase Yerusalemu, narokwe omochenu, kera oyomo oyorikire ase egati y’abwo bare moyo ase Yerusalemu.
Ase omoika bw’okonacha ekina na gochena, Omonene nasibie obobe bw’abakungu ba Sayoni, naende achene abanto ba Yerusalemu korwa ase okomocha kwabo kw’ogoitera amanyinga.

Igoro y’Egetunwa gia Sayoni gionsi, na igoro y’abanto bonsi basangererekaneteo, Omonene natonge riire na erioki bibeo mobaso, na omorero okomesa obeo botuko; na igoro y’obonene obwo bwonsi egietubo gi’okorenda nkebekweo.
Ekiriri nkebeo ki’ogokenderera korwa ase omobaso, naende kebe obotamero na oborendi bw’ogwekengera korwa ase embura y’omoubera.
Bono nimoterere omwanchi one, nintere igoro y’omwanchi one na igoro y’omogondo oye bw’emesabibu. Omwanchi one nabwate omogondo bw’emesabibu ase ekegoro egetobu.

Akayorema, agachora amagena ase okoyobonga, akarigia emesabibu emiya akayesi meka aroro; ase egati yaye akaagacha omorobiri bw’okoyorendera, agakunya egeteera gi’okomitera amasabibu. Erio akaganya ore nogosemeria ng’a omogondo mbwame amasabibu amaya, korende okama amasabibu amegarori.
Ase ayio bono, inwe abanto momenyete Yerusalemu, na inwe Abayuda, nababoririe monache ekina ase egati yane na omogondo one.
Inee! Ngento ki nanga nayokorerete goetania, ekio ntakorete? Ekero nasemeretie ng’a mbwame amasabibu amaya, Inee, nase ki bwamete amasabibu amegarori?
Bono nkobatebia inde eki ngochia gokora ase omogondo oyio one bw’emesabibu: Nintagore orobago rwaye, ntagore na orwaki rwaye, na omogondo oyio obe okorisigwa na gotiringwa.
Ninyotige ogenderere gosareka; emesabibu tegososwa gose koburugerwa; amageri na amagwa mbikineo na koyotuba; boigo ninchike amare tayotweria embura.

Abaisraeli nabwo omogondo bw’emesabibu bw’Omonene bw’Emeganda, na Abayuda nabwo ekemeri kiaye asimegete na gokegokera. Ekero asemeretie arore ogokora kw’oboronge, akarora abande bagokorerwa bobe, na ekero asemeretie arore oboronge, akaigwa ebirero.
Obobe nobwabo abwo bakwementera enyomba ase enyomba, naende bementera oboremo ase oboremo, goika bakoora aase onsi, erinde ng’a barabwo boka bamenye ase ense eyio engima.
Omonene bw’Emeganda otianire ase inche inyigwete ogoteba, “Ekeene, chinyomba chinyinge, chinene ne chingiya, goika chitigare bosa chitamenyiri nabanto.
Omogondo bw’emesabibu ore chieka ikomi nigo orame amasabibu akomitwa aisaine egetonga ekemo gioka, na embusuro eichire ebitonga ikomi nigo erame eyeisaine egetonga ekemo gioka.”
Obobe nobwabo abwo bakoimoka mambia chuni, baminyoka gochia konywa ebinyugwa bigotindia, abwo bakogenderera kobeera agwo goika obotuko bokia, erinde edivai eyio yabasamba na kobaonchorana.
Ase emeyega yabo nigo bakoba bare namakano ao ao, ne chinchigiri, na ebiroria, na edivai, korende tibari korengereria ogokora kw’Omonene, gose tibari korora emeremo y’amaboko aye.
Ase ayio, abanto baane nigo bagwoswa na koirwa ase obosomba ase ogotaba nobong’aini; abanene babo abasike nigo bagokwa nenchara, na omoganda obo ore neburu‐buru orang’ire mono ase okoborwa amache.

Ase ayio, aase abakure atoonire na gwasamia omonwa oye goetania ekerengo, na abare nobonene ase omochie oyio, na emeganda ere aroro, na ebiombe bire neburu‐buru, na bonsi abagochenga ime yaye, mbatirimboke gochia aase agwo.
Mwanyabanto onde bwensi nigo arakumbwe, na abanto abanene bakeeigwe gocha inse, na amaiso ’obomwenu nigo arakanywe.
Korende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo akoimokererigwa igoro goetera ase ekina gi’ekeene, na Nyasae ore Omochenu bweorokia ng’a nomochenu are ase oboronge bwaye.
Aase agwo nao ching’ondi chirabe chikorisia abe buna oborisia bwabo, na amatuuri atigirwe nabanda nairwe nabarisia bakonakong’anya‐ng’anya.
Obobe nobwabo abwo bakweng’usera obobe ne chingori chi’obong’ainereria, abwo bakweng’usera ebibe buna ne chingori chie chigari,
bateba, “Tiga Omonene ache bwango, aayererie emeremo yaye, erinde toyerore. Tiga aya Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli aroberetie asuke gocha ang’e aikerane, erio nario toranyare koyamanya.”

Obobe nobwabo abwo bakoroka ayare amabe amaya, na ayare amaya amabe, na babeka omosunte ase oborabu bore, na oborabu ase omosunte ore, na babeka obororo ribaga ri’obwansu, na obwansu ribaga ri’obororo.
Obobe nobwabo abwo bagwekora abang’aini, naende bagwekora abamanyi.
Obobe nobwabo abwo bare chituoni ase okonywa edivai, naende bare abaremu ase ogwochogania amo ebinyugwa bigotindia,
abwo bakoegwa riaaki baa oyore nokomocha oboronge, erio barina omonyene oboronge oboronge bwaye.

Ase ayio, buna koreng’ana chimeme chi’omorero chigosamba amasakwe, na buna obonyansi obwomo bokoyia bwasira, naboigo na omori bw’abanto abwo oragunde, na ebisicha biabo birurukigwe buna orotu, ekiagera bangire amachiko ’Omonene bw’Emeganda, na bachayire ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Abaisraeli.

Ase ayio endamwamu y’Omonene yokire ase abanto baye, na ere oramboire okoboko kwaye asebare obaakire. Ebitunwa biatengechigwe, na emebere y’abanto bakwete nebe buna eubi ase chinchera. Nonya ayio onsi agochia koba igo, endamwamu yaye tekoera; okoboko kwaye nigo koragenderere korua egesururo.
Omonene natenenie ekemanyererio gi’okorangeria egesaku kemenyete aare, nabugie omororia akerangerie geche korwa ensinyo y’ense, na rora, nkeminyoke geche bwango.
Ase abanto abwo onde takorosa, gose kogochwa, gose gosundoka, gose korara chitoro, gose orokini rwa kenema tirokonyanyoka, gose chinuga chi’ebikoroto tichikobutoka.
Emegwe yabo nigo ere emioge, na amata abo nigo atingire; ebitaago bie chibarasi chiabo nigo binga buna amagena amakong’u, na amagoro e chigari chiabo nigo akominyoka buna ekerambauti.
Ooruma kwabo nigo konga buna okw’endo, nigo bakoruma buna chindo chinsae na koronya; nigo bakobwata na koira ebisakore na abooswa, na onde tari oranyare gotooria.
Ee, ase rituko erio nigo bararumere abanto buna enyancha ekoruma. Omonto kararigererie ense, nigo ararore omosunte na emechando, na oborabu mbotubwe nomosunte.
Ase omwaka oria omoruoti Usia akwete, nkarora Omonene oikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene kiaimokererete igoro. Egesicho kiaye nigo kiarenge kegokurura inse nigo giaichorete ase Hekalu yonsi.

Goetanana ase Omonene, abaserafi mbateneine aroro; kera oyomo obo nigo abwate chimbaba isano nemo, na kera oyomo nigo atubete obosio bwaye ne chimbaba ibere, na amagoro aye ne chimbaba ibere, na akairurukera chimbaba chinde ibere.
Bakarangerania, bagateba, “Omochenu, Omochenu, Omochenu, nere Omonene bw’Emeganda; obonene bwaye bwaichoire ase ense engima.”
Amariogi ay’okorangerania koria agatengechia oboroso bw’emetobwa ya inse y’ebisieri bie Hekalu, na erioki rigaichora ime ase enyomba eria.

Erio ngateba, “Obobe nobwane, ekiagera nasirire! Inche nigo mbwate ebikoba bitachenegeti, na nigo imenyete ase egati y’abanto babwate ebikoba bitachenegeti; naende amaiso aane arorire Omoruoti, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda.”
Erio omoserafi oyomo akairuruka gocha asende, obogoretie ase okoboko kwaye rikara rire nomorero, erio arusetie ne rigami korwa ase egesasimero.
Erio agakuna omonwa one ne rikara riria, agateba, “Rora, rikara eri ri’omorero riakunire ebikoba biao; ogosaria kwao kwarusigweo, na ebibe biao biaabeirwe.”
Nyuma y’ayio nkaigwa Omonene okoboria, “Ning’o ngotoma, na ning’o oranyare koba omotomwa oito?” Nkairaneria ngateba, “Nao inde aa, ntome.”
Omonene agantebia, “Genda otebie abanto aba: Okoigwa, nkoigwa more, korende timori komanya gento, na okorora, nkorora more, korende timori korengereria.

Okore chinkoro chi’abanto aba chibe chinkong’u, na amato abo abe amarito ase okoigwa, na amaiso abo aukore, erinde tibabaisa korora namaiso abo, gose koigwa namato abo, gose komanya ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke, bagwenigwe.”

Erio nkaboria, “Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri amang’ana ayio arabe igo?” Nere akairaneria, agantebia, “Ngoika ekero emechie erabe yasarigwe etamenyiri nabanto, ne chinyomba chiatigirwe bosa, na ense ebe yasarigwe kegima na yabeire amatongo.
Inche Omonene ning’anyie abanto abwo korwa ase ense eyio bagende aare, na aase agwo aratigwe are bosa, nabe aange mono ase ense eyio.
Nebe ng’a ensemo eyemo ya ikomi yatigaire ere aroro, barabwo boigo mbasirigwe, buna koreng’ana omote onga omotontera otemirwe, egesike giatigaireo.” Egesike ekio nigo kerabe embusuro enchenu.

Ekero Ahasi, mosinto o Yotamu mosinto o Usia, arenge omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Resini, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, na Peka, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, mosinto o Remalia, abwo babere bagatiira gochia Yerusalemu koyorwania, korende tibanyarete koyobua.
Ekero amang’ana aigete ase abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi ng’a Abasiiria babwatanire n’Abaefraimu, enkoro y’omoruoti amo nechi’abanto baye chikanyegerigwa buna emete ye rinani ekonyegerigwa nomwaga.

Erio Omonene agatebia Isaya, “Genda amo na Seari‐Yasuba, momura oo, morotote Ahasi agwo ase omotaro bw’amache e ritibo ria rogoro ase enchera ekogenda egetii ki’omosibia ebitambaa bikoroisigwa chianga,
omotebie: Erende, kabe nobotoereru toiroka. Tokwa omoyo ase engencho y’endamwamu enene ya Resini oyio ore amo n’Abasiiria, na eya mosinto o Remalia, abwo bare buna ebigenga bibere bikoimokia erioki.
Abasiiria amo n’Abaefraimu, na mosinto o Remalia, bakorire emeroberio emebe igoro yao bagoteba:
Inchuo togende torwanie ense y’Abayuda toyioboyie, toyebue ebe eyaito, erinde tobeke mosinto o Tabeeli abe omoruoti aroro.”
“Korende aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ayio tagokorekana, gose tagoikeranigwa,

ekiagera Damesiki noro omochie omonene bw’Abasiiria, na Resini nere omogambi o Damesiki; na ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano, Abaefraimu mbasenyentwe basirigwe kegima, tibagenderera koba egesaku.
Samaria noro omochie omonene bw’Abaefraimu, na mosinto o Remalia nere omogambi o Samaria. “Onye timori nokwegena timokogenderera kobao.”
Omonene agakwana na Ahasi naende, akamotebia,
“Boria Omonene, Nyasae oo, akoe ekemanyererio; tiga kerwe aase abakure inse, gose kerwe igoro mono.”
Korende Ahasi akairaneria, “Tinkonyara koboria, na tinkonyara komoteema Omonene.”
Erio Isaya agateba, “Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Daudi, igwa bono! Inee! Namang’ana amasinini mono asemore korosia abanto, na bono mwamorosirie na Nyasae one boigo?
Ase ayio Omonene omonyene nabae ekemanyererio eke: Naama! Omoiseke omwekungi nabe morito, erio aibore omwana omoisia, namoroke erieta riaye Imanueli.
Ekero omwana oyio arabe omanyire kwanga amabe na gochora amaya, nabe okoria amaguta ’amabeere na obooke.
Ekero omwana oria ataramanya kwanga amabe, na gochora amaya, ense y’abaruoti abwo babere bagokogechia nebe yatigirwe bosa.

“Omonene narente amatuko amabe igoro asore, na ase abanto bao, na ase abanto b’ororeria rwa iso, amatuko buna ayio atana koba bo rinde korwa ekero Abaefraimu beatananete korwa ase Abayuda; narente omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.”
Ase engaki eye Omonene nabugie omororia, arangerie chingi echio chimenyete ase omochakano bw’ebirooche bia Misiri, naende arangerie chinchoke chire ase ense y’Abaasuri.
Echio chionsi nchiche chimenye ase amagoko, na ase chingako chi’ebitare, na ase ebitutu bi’amagwa, na ase ebitii bionsi.
Ase engaki eyio Omonene narente omoyio o tukia korwa ng’umbu y’orooche rw’Eufarati, noro omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, akigitere chitukia chi’emetwe yabo, na agingire amarionya ’amagoro ne chinderu chiabo.
Ase engaki eyio omonto nabe otugete ritororo erimo, ne ching’ondi ibere;
echio nchikamwe amabeere amange, nere abe okonyora amaguta amange, na kera omonto orabe otigaire ore moyo ase ense eyio nabe okoria amaguta na obooke.
Ase amatuko ayio, aase arenge kwama emesabibu elifu eyemo, aisanete chisekeli chie chifeta elifu eyemo, namere amageri na amagwa.
Abanto mbache agwo babwate amata ne chinsara, ekiagera orogongo orwo rwonsi rwamerire amageri na amagwa.
Ase ebigoro bionsi mwarenge korema namakombe, timokogendao korema naende, ekiagera nigo morairoke amageri na amagwa; aase agwo nabe ase chiombe chigochwarwa ne ching’ondi chiaatiringe.
Omonene agantebia, “Imokia ebao enene ekorikwa, orike amariko aya mwanyabanto baranyare gosoma buya, orike: Maheri‐Salali Hasi‐Basi.”
Inche nkerigeria abanto abegenwa babe birori, nabwo Uria omokuani, na Zakaria, mosinto o Yeberekia.
Erio nkaba nomokungu one orenge omobani, na ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, na Omonene agantebia, “Moroke Maheri‐Salali Hasi‐Basi.
Nebe ekero omwana oyio ataramanya gwatora Tata gose Baba, nonyore ng’a obotenenku bwonsi bwa Damesiki, na ebisakorwa bia Samaria, biaikire koirwa ase omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.”
Omonene agakwana eria kabere, agantebia,
“Abanto aba bangire amache a Silo akwongora ng’ora, bagokire na kobwatana na Resini, naende na mosinto o Remalia.

Ase ayio, rora inche Omonene nkorenta inde igoro y’abanto abwo amache ’orooche are amange, naende are ne chinguru, ayio naro omoruoti bw’Abaasuri amo nobonene bwaye bwonsi. Amache ayio naichore aete chingegu igoro, aiteke gochia aande onsi.
Aro naminyoke ne chinguru igoro y’ense y’Abayuda, aichore, agenderere gochia bosio aike ase rigoti.” Ee, aye Imanueli, amache ayio nigo ararambore chimbaba chiaye atube obogare bw’ense yao.
Inwe abanto aba, kora eburu‐buru, nonya naboigo goika mosenyentwe! Ee, inwe mwensi abamore ase chinse chi’aare, igwa ayio! Eboyie mokong’e, goika mosenyentwe! Ee, eboyie goika mosenyentwe!
Inchuo amo mosemanie, korende nigo korabe bosa; kwana ring’ana riaino, korende tirikoba, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo naintwe.
Omonene akabeka igoro asende okoboko kwaye kore ne chinguru, agakwana nainche, agankurera ng’a timbaisa kobwatia chinchera chi’abanto aba, agateba,
“Timobaisa koroka emeroberio ng’a nemebe, eyio abanto aba bakoroka ng’a nemebe, gose timobaisa kwoboa amang’ana boboete, gose kende tikebaondokia inwe.
Korende inwe tiga inche Omonene bw’Emeganda imbe nchenegete asemore; ninche bweka morairoke na konyoboa.
Ere nabe aase aino aachenu, korende ase ebisaku ebi bibere bi’Abaisraeli nabe rigena rikogocha, na egetare gekoiyeria inse, naende abe omoeto na oboreba ase abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu.
Abanto abange mbagochwe na kogwa, mbasenyentwe, mbategwe na kobwatwa.”
Eboeranie oborori, na obeke amachiko aane ekemanyererio, ime ase chinkoro chi’aborokigwa baane.
Nimoganyete Omonene, oyio otubire obosio bwaye korwa ase ororeria rwa Yakobo; nimbe imosemeretie.
Naama! Inche amo nabana aba Omonene ang’eire nigo tore ebimanyererio na emegwekano ase egati y’Abaisraeli, ebio bikorwa ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, oyio omenyete ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni.

Ekero abanto barabatebie, “Genda moborie abwo bakorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakure, naende moborie abaragori, abwo bakomonyererana na komumura,” inwe mobairanerie iga: “Inee! Tegwenereti abanto komorigia Nyasae obo? Naki erabe ng’a toborie emeika y’abakure ase engencho y’abanto bare moyo?”
Moiranere amachiko na oborori! Abanto batari gokwana koreng’ana namang’ana ayio, ekeene, omobaso o mambia torababarera.

Abanto mbaetanane ase ense yonsi, bare nemechando emenene mono, na enchara, na ekero babeire nenchara mbabe nekeririanda ekenene, baragererie omoruoti obo na Nyasae obo. Mbaonchore amasio abo barigererie gochia igoro,
naende baonchoke barigererie ense inse, korende nigo bararore obororo, na omosunte, na ogoichanigwa okonene, erio basoigwe ase omosunte ekerima.

Omosunte tokogenderera koba ase ogochandeka kore bono. Amatuko a kare Omonene nigo atigete ense ya Sabuloni, na eya Nafutali, na chirochio chigachaywa, korende ase amatuko agochi‐gocha narente obonene bw’ogosikwa ase ense ere ang’e nenchera ekogenda ase enyancha, ng’umbu ya Yorodan, nero Galili, ense y’abanto b’ebisaku.
Abanto abwo barenge gotaara ase omosunte, bono barorire omobaso omonene; abwo bamenyete ase ense y’ekiriri ki’amakweri omobaso obabareire.

Aye Omonene gwasesenirie egesaku, na kerokio kiabuchire, kwarure omogoko, na oro obeire omonge; abanto abwo nigo bare nomochengo ase obosio bwao, buna abanto bakoba nomochengo ase engaki ye rigesa, na buna bakogoka ekero bagwatanana ebisakorwa.
Aye kwabunire rikorogoto riarenge ririto asebare, kwabunire enyimbo eria yarenge goaka amareko abo, enyimbo eyio yarenge ey’abachandi babo, buna gwakorete ase engaki y’Abamidiani.
Ebikoroto bi’abarwani esegi bagotitiria ase esegi, ne chianga chionsi chiaakirwe amanyinga, ebio bionsi mbisambwe nomorero.

Omwana oiboirwe ase engencho yaito, intwe twaeirwe omwana omomura; obogambi mbobe ase amareko aye, ere nigo ararokwe: “Omosemia bw’Ogokumia, Nyasae bw’Okobua, Tata o Kare na Kare, Omogambi bw’Omorembe.”

Obogambi bwaye nigo borabe obonene, na omorembe oye tokoba nomoerio igoro ase ekerogo ki’obonene gia Daudi na ase oboruoti bwaye. Obwo nigo borakong’igwe ase ekeene na oboronge, korwa bono na goika kare na kare. Risemi ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda ndikore amang’ana ayio.
Omonene otomire ring’ana kogambia ororeria rwa Yakobo, narirorio ndibaikere Abaisraeli.
Abanto bonsi mbarimanye, nonya nabamenyete ase ense y’Abaefraimu, na ey’Abasamaria, abwo bagokwana noboenenu na obomwenu bwe chinkoro, bateba,
“Amaagacho ’amatabori agure inse, korende nigo torayaagache namagena abaachire. Emeko yagechirwe, korende ntosimeke emecharake ribaga ri’eyio.”
Omonene oseegetire na korenta ababisa ba Resini bache kobarwania.

Abasiiria bamenyete moocha, na Abafilisti bamenyete bosongo, baasamirie emenwa yabo bamere Abaisraeli. Nonya ayio are bo, Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.
Abanto tibamoiranerete oria obaete egesusuro, gose tibamorigetie Omonene bw’Emeganda.
Ase ayio ase rituko erimo rioka Omonene nanache omotwe bw’Abaisraeli na ekemincha, boigo nanache orosagia rw’omokendo na esaka.
Omogaaka bw’amasikani nere omotwe, na omobani okworokereria oborimo nere ekemincha.
Abwo bakoraa abanto aba mbabasirie, na abwo bakoraagwa nabanto abwo mbasirigwe.

Ase ayio Omonene tari nomogoko ase abasae babo, na tari namabera ase chintakana na ababoraka babo, ekiagera kera omonto nomosaria ase Nyasae, na omokori amabe, na kera oyomo nigo agokwana ay’oboriri. Ase engencho y’ayio onsi Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.
Obobe nigo bogosamba buna omorero; noro nigo ogosamba amageri na amagwa, nigo ogosamba rinani rinoru, riaerera ase erioki richongororogete gochia igoro.
Endamwamu y’Omonene bw’Emeganda yasambire ense; abanto nigo banga buna chinko chigwokia omorero, na monto onde takororera oyomwabo amabera.

Abanto abwo nigo bakona‐gotaboria ebinto ase ensemo ya borio, korende nigo bagendererete koba nenchara; nigo bakwenyorera ebinto korwa ase ensemo ya bomosi, korende tibari koigota. Kera oyomo nigo akoria chinyama chi’omobere bw’oyomwabo.

Abanto ba Manase mbarie aba Efraimu, na aba Efraimu mbarie aba Manase, na abwo amo mbaonchokere Abayuda. Ase engencho y’ayio Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.
Obobe nobwabo abwo bakobeka amachiko atari aya boronge, na abariki abakona‐korika amang’ana ay’ogokorera abande bobe.
Barabwo nigo bakoonchorana ebina bi’abaremeire na koura abataka b’abanto baane oboronge bwabo, erinde ababoraka babe ebisakorwa biabo, ne chintakana chiaurererigwa.
Ngento ki morakore ase rituko riria egesusuro kegocha? Ninki morakore ekero ekembugu‐mbugu kerache korwa aare? Ning’o moratamere abakonye? Ning’o moratigere obotenenku bwaino?

Kende tikegotigara otatiga moragwe inse, mweringanie ase egati y’abasibwa, gose mogwe ase egati y’ebitondo. Nonya ayio are bo, Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.
“Obobe nobw’Abaasuri, abwo bare enyimbo y’endamwamu yane; okogechigwa kwane nigo kore enungu ase amaboko abo.

Nimbatome gochia korwania egesaku ekio giasaririe ase Nyasae, ee, nimbachike bagende korwania abanto abwo nabeire nendamwamu asebare, mbasakore ebinto bi’abanto abwo bibe ebiabo, naende mbabatiringere inse buna esike ere ase chinchera.
“Korende omoruoti bw’Abaasuri takagerete ayio, gose tayarengereretie. Ere nigo aganetie goita na gosiria ebisaku ebinge.
Ere nigo agoteba iga: Inee! Abachiki baane bonsi tibari abaruoti?
Inee! Omochie o Kalino tobuetwe buna Kari‐Kemisi, na Hamati buna Aripadi, na Samaria buna Damesiki?
Onye okoboko kwane kwaigete ase amaruoti arenge gosasima emegwekano, emegwekano eyio yabombire yarenge emenene kobua eya Yerusalemu na Samaria.
Inee, tingokora ase Yerusalemu, na ase emegwekano yaye egosasimwa, buna nakorete ase Samaria na ase emegwekano yaye?”

Ekero Omonene arabe okoorire gokora emeremo yaye yonsi ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ase Yerusalemu, nae omoruoti bw’Abaasuri egesusuro ase engencho y’ogwetogia kwaye, na oboenenu bw’okweimokereria igoro.

Omoruoti oyio nigo agoteba: “Ase chinguru chi’amaboko aane nakorire ayio, boigo nase obong’aini bwane, ekiagera nimbwate okomanya. Nasukirie chimbebe chi’abanto na kobaura chinibo chiabo, na ase chinguru chiane chire buna echi’eeri nabeire nkoiyeria abagambi korwa ase ebirogo biabo.

Okoboko kwane nigo kwairete chinibo chi’abanto buna ebiswa bie chinyoni bikoirwa. Nigo nkobongania ense yonsi buna amagena e chinyoni atigirwe akobonganigwa; onde tanyegeretie orobaba rwaye, gose komaanora omonwa oye, gose kwemunyia.”

Inee! Egesire nkenyare gwetogia igoro y’oyio okogekorera emeremo? Gose omosumeno mbwekore koba nengencho enene kobua oyio okonacha noro? Aise koba bo, nanga nigo are gotebwa ng’a enyimbo nebogorie oyio oyebogoretie, gose egete nkebogorie oyio otari omote.
Ase ayio Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, natome oborwaire bw’okoreeyia abanto abanoru, na obonene bw’omoruoti oyio botongigwe boyie buna omorero.
Oborabu bw’Abaisraeli mboonchoke bobe omorero, na oyore Omochenu obo nabe ekebemberi ki’omorero. Omorero oyio nosambe na gosiria amagwa na amageri ase rituko erimo.
Buna koreng’ana oborwaire bokoria omobere bw’omonto bwayokoora, naboigo obonene bwe rinani ri’Abaisraeli amo nemegondo yabo ekwama birasirigwe kegima. Omonene nigo arasirie omoyo amo nomobere.
Emete ye rinani riaye eratigare, nigo erabe emeke mono, eyio nonya nomwana aranyare kobara na koyerika.

Nebe ase amatuko ayio abatigari b’Abaisraeli na abwo b’ororeria rwa Yakobo baratooreke, tibakogenderera kweegeka ase egesaku ekio kiabaagete, korende ase obwegenwa nigo bareegeke ase Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
Abatigari, abwo bare b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, mbamoiranere Nyasae Omobui.
Nonya Abaisraeli bare abange buna omokenye ore nyancha, abatigari boka nabwo barairane. Ogosirigwa gwachikirwe ogokong’u nigo korache buna eooro kore noboronge.
Omonene oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, narente ogosirigwa ase ense yonsi, buna achikire.
Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, agoteba: “Inwe abanto baane momenyete Sayoni, timoiroka Abaasuri nonya bakobaaka nenyimbo na koyeimokereria igoro, buna Abamisiri bakorete.
Engaki enke yatigaire, endamwamu yane asemore eere, erio eonchoke gosiria Abaasuri.

Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ninyimokererie omocharichi one igoro, ng’wanie barabwo, buna nang’wanetie Abamidiani agwo ase egetare ki’Orebu. Ninyimokererie enyimbo yaane igoro y’enyancha, buna nakorete igoro y’Abamisiri.
Ase engaki eyio chigurube Abaasuri babegete ase amareko aino nchirusigweo, na amakorogoto babegete ase amagoti aino nabunwe ase obonetu bwaino.”
Ababisa bachire Ayati, baetire ase egati ya Migironi; babekire ebinto biabo Mikimasi.
Baeteire ase ekiambokero, batoorire agwo Geba babeere aroro ase obotuko obwo; abanto ba Rama babeire nobwoba, na aba Gibea, omochie o Saulo, batamire.
Inwe abanto ba Galimu, rera neriogi rinene! Inwe aba Laisa, tegerera moigwe! Obee! Inwe ab’Anatoti abaremerwa!
Abanto ba Madimena nigo bagendererete gotama, na abamenyete Gebimu ngotama bare ase ogwetooria.
Rituko erio ababisa mbabeere agwo Nobu, barambore amaboko abo na koyasungusia igoro y’egetunwa ki’abanto ba Sayoni, ekio kere egetunwa kia Yerusalemu.
Rora, Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, nabutore chinsagia ne chinguru chi’okwoboyia; emete ere emetambe mono negechwe egwe inse, na eyechongororogete gochia igoro nekumbwe gochia inse.
Naimokie egesire agechere emete ye rinani rire rinoru, na Lebanoni amo nemete ereo neiyerigwe inse ne chinguru chi’Oyore Omobui.
Omoseboka norue ase ritina ria Yese riabutoretwe, na egesebo keramere korwa ase emeri yaye, nkiame amatunda.
Omoika bw’Omonene nobeere igoro asare; omoika bw’obong’aini na okomanya, omoika bw’ogosemia na okobua; omoika bwe chisemi na okomoiroka Omonene.
Omogoko oye nobe ase okomoiroka Omonene. Ere takogamba ebina buna amaiso aye ararore, gose takonacha ebina buna araigwe namato aye.
Korende nigo arabae abataka oboronge bwabo ase okonacha ebina, tagokora ogwanchereria ase abaitongo b’ense. Naake ense nenyimbo y’omonwa oye, naite abakori amabe nomoika bw’omonwa oye.
Oboronge nabwo borabe orokini rw’ekenema kiaye, na obwegenwa bobe orokini rw’okweboeria.
Esese y’orosana nemenye amo nemanwa y’eng’ondi, na engo nerare amo nemanwa y’embori; emori, na endo, na eng’ombe enoru nachibe chikogosoria amo, na omwana omoke nabe ogochiraa.
Eng’ombe na edubu nchiriserie amo, emori y’eng’ombe na emanwa y’edubu nchirare amo. Endo nebe ekorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe.
Omwana okogonka nabe okogosoria ase engoro ye rirubi, boigo omwana omotache nabe ogosoyia okoboko kwaye ase engoro ye ring’ere.
Aase onsi ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, ayare amabe, gose ayagosiria tagokorekana aroro; ekiagera ense neichorwe nabanto bamomanyete Omonene, buna amache aichire ase enyancha.
Ase engaki eyio Oyore Egesebo kie ritina ria Yese natenene abe ekemanyererio ase abanto; abanto b’ebisaku mbamorigie, na obomenyo bwaye mbobe nobonene obonge.

Nebe ase engaki eyio Omonene narambore okoboko kwaye eria kabere koirania abatigari b’abanto baye korwa Asuri, na Misiri, na Patirosi, na Etiopia, na Elamu, na Shinari, na Hamati, na korwa ase ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha.
Natenenie ekemanyererio ase abanto b’ebisaku, na asangererie Abaisraeli abwo baseretigwe, naende asangererie Abayuda bonsi besiarerete ase chinsinyo inye chi’ense.
Ribero Abaefraimu babwate ndisire, na abwo bakwoboyia Abayuda mbasirigwe; Abaefraimu tibakogenderera koba ne ribero ase Abayuda, na Abayuda tibakogenderera kwoboyia Abaefraimu.
Abayuda na Abaefraimu mbaumokere Abafilisti korwa ensemo ya bosongo, naende mbasakore abanto ba moocha. Erio barwanie Abaedomu na Abamoabu; Abaamoni mbabe bakoaigwera.

Omonene nasarie kegima omosomo bw’enyancha ya Misiri; nasungusie okoboko kwaye arente omwaga oguse igoro ase Orooche rwa Eufarati, erio arwatanane robe ebiambokero bitano na bibere, erinde abanto bambokere aroro buna ase ense enyomo.
Enchera enene neroiserigwe abatigari b’abanto baye abatoorigwe korwa Asuri. Enchera eyio nebe buna eria Abaisraeli baeterete kobakorua Misiri.
Ase rituko erio notebe: “Aye Omonene, ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono, nonya kwarenge nendamwamu asende, bono endamwamu eyio yantigire, na aye kwandemirie.
Rora, Nyasae nere ogotooreka kwane; nimosemerie, tinkwoboa. Omonene Nyasae nere chinguru chiane, ere nimoterere; ere obeire ogotooreka kwane.”
Inwe mobuuche amache korwa ase chinsoko chire nogotooreka, more nomogoko.
Ase rituko riria motebe: “Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, rangeria erieta riaye; raria ogokora kwaye ase egati y’ebisaku, raria ng’a erieta riaye nerinene mono.”
“Tera amatera ay’okomotogia Omonene, ekiagera okorire ayare amaya mono. Amang’ana ayio tiga amanyekane ase ense yonsi.
Inwe abamomenyete Sayoni, aka eriogi, motere nomogoko, ekiagera ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli nigo are omonene ase egati yaino.”
Aya naro amang’ana Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, aroche igoro ya Babeli:
Tenenia ebendera igoro ase egetunwa getari na mete; aka eriogi rinene ase abarwani esegi, basime namaboko basoe ase ebiita bi’abanto abasike.
Inche omonyene nachikire aba neatananeire koba abachenu, narangeirie abanto baane bare chituoni baikeranie aya nachikire ase endamwamu yane. Abanto abwo bagokerete obobui bwane.

Tegerera moigwe amariogi ’emeganda y’abanto bakwoga igoro ase ebitunwa! Tegerera moigwe amariogi ay’okomumura kw’amaruoti ’ebisaku asangererekanire amo. Omonene bw’Emeganda nkoroberia are emeganda y’esegi.
Omonene ngocha are amo nebirwanero bi’endamwamu yaye korwa ense y’aare, ase chinsinyo chia igoro, erinde asirie ense yonsi.
Inwe rera nobororo, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene riabereire ang’e; nigo rirachiche buna ogosiria gokorwa ase Omonene Omobui.
Ase ayio, amaboko ’abanto bonsi nigo araborwe chinguru, ne chinkoro chiabo chirianyeke ase obwoba.
Abanto mbabe nobwoba obonene; inababe nomoichano na obororo. Ee, mbabe nobororo buna obw’omokungu okobina agonkie, mbarigereranie bare nogokumia na omoichano na amaiso abo amwame ti.
Rora, rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire; nigo rire ritindi ri’ekeririanda na endamwamu egwoka, ndisarie ense ebe bosa na gosiria kegima abanyabibe bamenyeteo.
Ching’enang’eni chire igoro, na ebiombe biamwabo, tichikorua oborabu bwabo; erioba naribe omosunte ekero rigosoka mambia, na omotienyi tokobara.
Inche Omonene ning’ee ense egesusuro ase engencho y’obobe bwaye, na abanyabibe ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo. Ninsirie obomwenu bw’abwo bare abatindi, ninkeyie oboenenu bw’abaichire nobochege.
Ninkore omobaro o mwanyabanto obe omoke kobua oyo bw’etahabu echenire, ee, omobaro obo nobe omoke kobua oyo bw’etahabu ekorwa Ofiri.
Ase rituko ri’ekeririanda kiane inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nintengechie igoro chionsi na inyegerie ense erue aase aye goetera ase endamwamu yane egwoka.
Kera omonto nabe buna engabi egoserigwa, na buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia; kera oyomo nairane ase abanto baye, na kera oyomo natame gochia ase ense yaye.
Onde bwensi oranyorwe, nabetwe ritimo, na onde bwensi orabwatwe, naitwe nomoro.
Abana babo ebing’werere mbasenyentwe ase amasio ’abaibori babo, chinyomba chiabo nchisakorwe, na abakungu babo mbakorerwe ay’obosooku.
Rora, inche Omonene ninseegete Abamedi abwo batabare chifeta ne chitahabu koba nengencho enene.
Barabwo mbaite abamura b’abwo ase okobabeta chinsara, tibakororera abana bare inda, gose abana bande, amabera.
Babeli oyio ore obonene bw’amaruoti, na obwari na obonene bw’Abakalidayo, nobe buna Sodomu na Gomora, ekero Nyasae konya ayosaririe.
Babeli tokomenywa nonya ng’ake nebiaare binde bionsi, nonya n’Omoarabu tagotenenia eema yaye agwo, gose abarisia tibakorenta ching’ondi ne chimbori chitimokereo.
Ching’iti chi’orosana nchimenyeo, ne chinyakweumia nchiichore ase chinyomba chireo, chisagero nchibe chimenyeteo, na amarengari nabe akona‐gotenga aroro.
Chinyang’au nchibe chikwamuma ase emerobiri yabo, ne chisese chi’orosana nchibe chikorera ase chinyomba chiabo chi’obonene. Engaki yaye yaikire ang’e; amatuko aye tagotambeeigwa.
Omonene narorere ororeria rwa Yakobo amabera, nachore Abaisraeli abwo naende, abarente bamenye ase ense yabo. Abanto abaao mbabwatane nab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, bamenye amo nabarabwo.

Ebisaku binde mbikonye Abaisraeli koirana ase ense yabo, na Abaisraeli mbabakore babe abasomba babo, abasacha na abakungu, mbabe bakobakorera agwo ase ense y’Omonene. Abaisraeli mboose abwo baboosete kare, na bagambere abwo barenge kobakorera bobe.
Nebe ekero Omonene abaeire ogotimoka korwa ase emechando yaino, na obokong’u, na emeremo emekong’u mwarenge gokorigwa,
erio mokwane amang’ana aya y’ogochecheria omoruoti o Babeli, motebe: “Naki omochandi oria akirigwe! Obotindi bw’ogochandwa gwaito bwaerire!
Omonene obunire enyimbo y’abakori amabe, enyimbo eyio y’abagambi,
abwo baagete abanto nendamwamu, na bakaba bakobaaka batari gotiga. Nigo bagamberete ebisaku nendamwamu, bakaba bakobichanda batari namabera.
Bono ense engima nigo etimogete na gotoerera. Abanto bagokire na gotera.
Nonya nemetarakwa nigo egokerete okobugwa kwao, na emecharake ya Lebanoni nigo egoteba: Gese gwakaiyeretigwe inse, omotemi emete onde tana gotochera.

“Aase abakure abeire nomoegaego gocha gokorotota ekero okogenda aroro; emerengari y’abakure yaturirwe ase engencho yao, ee, abwo bonsi barenge abatang’ani b’ense. Abwo bonsi barenge abaruoti b’ebisaku batenenigwe barue ase ebirogo biabo.
Abwo bonsi mbakwane, bagotebie: Bono naye kwaurirwe chinguru buna intwe, gwatogwekanire.
Obonene bwao amo namariogi ’amakano ao biarentirwe aiga aase abakure; ebinyegera nabio ekerarero kiao na amakonde naro ekiebisio kiao.
“Aye eng’enang’eni ya mambia, omwana bw’ogokiamoka, naki kwagure korwa igoro! Aye oria kwaiyeretie ebisaku, naki gwatugutetwe gocha inse?

Nigo gwatebete ase enkoro yao ime: Inche nintiire gochia igoro aaria, ngende ng’etanie ching’enang’eni chia Nyasae, nimbeke ekerogo kiane ki’obonene aaria igoro. Ning’ikaranse ase egetunwa ki’omosangererekano aaria sugusu aare.
Nintiire ngende ng’etanie amare are igoro mono, ninyekore imbe buna Oyore Igoro Mono.
Korende bono aye kwairirwe gochia aase abakure ase engoro entambe.
“Abanto abwo barakorore mbakorigererie baasamie emenwa yabo bakumie, mbabe bakorengereria igoro yao, batebe: Inee! Omonto oyo nere oria otengechetie ense, oria onyegeretie amaruoti?
Nere oyio osaretie ense ekaba erooro, naende akaonchorana emechie y’ense, oria otarenge gosibora abasibwa baye bagende ase chinka chiabo?
“Abaruoti bonsi b’ebisaku nigo baraire nobonene bwabo, kera oyomo ase embeera yaye,
korende aye totindekiri; nigo otugutire buna orosagia rotanchiri. Nigo oraire ase egati y’abanto baitetwe nemioro, bagatugutwa ase chingoro chi’amagena buna ebitondo bigotachwa namagoro.
Aye togotindekwa buna abaruoti bande, ekiagera gwasaririe ense yao, naende gwaitire abanto bao. Ororeria rw’abakori amabe tirogwatorwa nonya ng’ake.
Beka abanto ang’e, baite abamura b’omoruoti oyio; abana abwo nigo baraitwe ase engencho y’okomocha gwa chisokoro chiabo, tibabaisa koimokerera igoro baire ense na koyeichoria nemechie.”

Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Nimbaimokere, nsarie Babeli kegima, ninsirie erieta riaye na abatigari bare aroro. Tingotiga abana aroro gose abachokoro. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda natebire ayio.
Ninkore Babeli obe obomenyo bw’ebirongo, naende obe ne chitente chi’amache. Ninyoabusere ekiabuso ki’ogosiria. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda natebire ayio.”
Omonene bw’Emeganda otianire, ogoteba, “Ekeene, buna narobeirie, nabo arabe, na buna nachikire, goika aikerane.

Ninsenyente Abaasuri aiga ase ense yane, nimbatiringere inse agwo ase ebitunwa biane. Ase enchera eyio amakorogoto abo narusigwe ase amagoti ’Abaisraeli, ne chigurube chiabo chirusigwe ase amareko abo.”
Aya naro achikirwe igoro y’ense yonsi, na oko nakwo okoboko koramboire igoro ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
Omonene bw’Emeganda ochikire gokora amang’ana ayio, ning’o oranyare koyatanga taba? Oramboire okoboko kwaye, ning’o oranyare gokoringa?
Ase omwaka oria Ahasi omoruoti akwete, amang’ana aya naro araretigwe:
Inwe Abafilisti mwensi, timobaisa kogoka ng’a enyimbo eria yabaagete yabunirwe; korwa ase ritina ri’eng’iti eria ende ere nobosongo obotindi nesoke, na korwa ase eyio enchoka ekoiruruka netuboke.
Abare abataka mono mbaragerigwe, na abaremeire bamenye nobotoereru. Korende abare ritina riaino mbaite nenchara, na abatigari baino nimbaite.
Aye egeita, eumie! Aye omochie, rera! Inwe Abafilisti mwensi, ichana ase obwoba! Erioki nkorwa rire sugusu, na ase egati yabo onde tari oranyorwe.
Mang’ana ki omonto arabairanerie abatomwa b’egesaku keria? Obairanerie ng’a Omonene obekire oboroso bwa Sayoni, na abanto baye abachandire mbanyore obotamero aroro.
Aya naro amang’ana igoro y’ense ya Moabu: Ari o Moabu nosarigwe ase obotuko obomo, nosirigwe kegima! Ee, na Kiri o Moabu osarigwe ase obotuko obomo, osirigwe kegima!
Abanto ba Diboni batiirire gochia aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, barereo. Nigo bakweumia ase engencho ya Nebo na Medeba; kera omonto okigitire etukia yaye, ogingire ne chinderu.
Abanto nigo beboyetie chigunia baichanete agwo ase chinchera, abande nigo bariinete ebirama igoro, na abande bare ase ebiraario; kera omonto nigo akweumia na koiyeria amariga.
Abanto ba Hesiboni na Eleale nigo bakorera neriogi rinene. Eriogi riabo nigo rikoigweka goikera Yahasi. Ase ayio abarwani esegi ba Moabu bakorera neriogi rinene; chinkoro chiabo chiaondokire.

Enkoro yane nkoreera ere ense ya Moabu. Abanto baye ngotamera bare Soari na Egilati‐Selisia; nigo bagotiira gochia Luhiti bakorera. Nigo bagoaka amariogi ay’okorera kw’ogosirigwa agwo ase enchera ekogenda Horonaimu.
Orooche rwa Nimurimu rwakamire amache; obonyansi bwomire, na bonde tibori komera, ekemeri kende ekebese tikeri aroro.
Ebinto ebinge konya benyoreire, ne chinibo chionsi babeire bagachete mbabibogorie bamboke nabirobio ase Orooche rw’Emesobeti.
Eriogi ri’okorera kwabo riaichoire ase ense ya Moabu; ekerero ekio giaikire Egilaimu na Beeri‐Elimu.
Nonya nechindooche chia Dimoni chiaichoire namanyinga, ningenderere korenta amabe ande ase Dimoni. Nindete endo eite Abamoabu, abwo bagotama na abwo batigarete ase ense yabo.
Tomera omogambi bw’ense ebango ye chimanwa chie ching’ondi korwa ase omochie o Sela, goetera ase erooro, gochia ase egetunwa ki’omochie o Sayoni.
Abanto b’emechie ya Moabu mbabe bakonakoong’anya gochia ase chingegu chi’orooche rw’Arinoni, babe buna chinyoni chikoiruruka chiaserigwe korwa ase ebiswa biabo.
Barabwo nigo bagoteba: “Tosemie, tokorere ay’oboronge, tokendererie inse y’ekiriri kiaino mobaso gati. Tobise intwe abatwaserigwe, timobaisa gotorua intwe abatwatamire.

Tiga Abamoabu, abanto baito, abwo baserigwe bamenye amo nainwe; kabe obotamero bwabo korwa ase abwo bakogania kobasiria, goika abachandi babo babe basirire, na abwo barenge kobatiringera inse babe basirigwe korwa ase ense eyio.

Erio ekerogo ki’obonene ngetenenigwe ase obwanchani bogendererete botambe. Oyomo ore omwegenwa naikaransere ekerogo ekio, oyomo korwa ase obomenyo bwa Daudi. Ere nabe okogamba ase ekeene, na gokora ayare ay’oboronge.”
Twaigure buna Abamoabu bare abetogia, barabwo nigo bare aberori mono, na abamwenu, na abaenenu, na abanyandamwamu, korende ogwetogia kwabo nigo kore okw’obong’ainereria.
Ase ayio Abamoabu mbarere; kera omonto tiga areere ense ya Moabu. Eng’ererie moichane, ekiagera mwaborirwe amabomba ’amasabibu amomo akwama Kiri‐Hareseti.

Emegondo ere Hesiboni yasusanire amo nemesabibu ere Sibuma. Abanene b’ebisaku babutoire chinsagia chi’emesabibu, echio chiarandete chigaika Yaeseri, na chikagenderera goika ase erooro. Emerande yaye nigo yarandete, ekaamboka enyancha.

Ase ayio nkorera ase engencho y’emesabibu ya Sibuma, buna aba Yaeseri bakoyereera. Inwe aba Hesiboni na ab’Eleale, nigo nkobaiyereria amariga amange, ekiagera ekero mogotora amatunda na kogesa endagera, eriogi ri’esegi riabachera.

Omogoko na omochengo biasirigwe korwa ase emegondo ekwama mono; bono amatera tari goterwa ase emegondo y’emesabibu, amariogi ’omogoko tari goakwa aroro; monto onde tari okomita amasabibu ase ebiteera bi’okomitera. Nasiririe amariogi ’omochengo e rigesa.
Ase ayio, enkoro yane nigo ekoreera Abamoabu neriogi buna eri’obokano, nkoreera nde aba Kiri‐Heresi ase omoyo one ime.
Nonya Abamoabu bagwechanda na kwerosia gotiira gochia aase aimokererete igoro bagosasima, gose babe bakogenda ase chihekalu chiabo gosaba, tibakonyara konyora ogokonywa konde gwonsi.
Ring’ana erio nario Omonene akwanete igoro y’ense ya Moabu agwo kare.

Korende bono Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase engaki y’emiaka etato, emiaka buna ey’omorikwa emeremo, nonyore ng’a obonene bw’Abamoabu bwachayirwe amo nemegada yabo emenene boigo. Abatigari babo nigo barabe abake mono abataisanere gento kende.”
Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Damesiki: “Naama! Damesiki tokogenderera koba omochie; nosarigwe, otumbwe amo obe chitui.
Emechie y’Aroeri neng’anywe etigwe ere bosa. Nigo erabe amarisio. Chitugo nchibe chikorara aroro, na onde tari orachioboyie.
Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Chiburi chi’Efraimu nchisarigwe kegima, na oboruoti bwa Damesiki mbosirigwe; na abatigari b’Abasiiria mbaurwe obonene bwabo buna Abaisraeli bauretwe.
“Ase engaki eyio obonene bw’abanto ba Yakobo mbokeeigwe kegima, na obonetu bw’emebere yabo mboree.
Nigo erabe buna ekero omogesi akogesa namaboko aye ebigara bi’endagera eteneine, na buna ekero omonto agochora ebigara bi’endagera ase ense omweremu y’Abarefai.

Ee, abanto abake mono mbatigareo, banga buna ekero omote bw’emezeituni okonyegerigwa, amazeituni abere, gose atato, atigare ase omote igoro, na ane, gose atano, atigare ase chinsagia. Nabo Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba.”
Ase engaki eyio abanto mbarigie ogokonywa korwa ase Omotongi obo, mbabe namasikani ase Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
Tibagosemeria ebisasimero ebire emeremo y’amaboko abo, gose tibakorigereria emete eteneneirie Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, gose ebisasimero bi’ogosambera ubani, ebi baroisirie nebiara biabo.
Ase engaki eyio emechie yabo egiteire chindwaki nebe buna amatombe are ase amanani na ase ebitunwa igoro, ayio atigetwe ekero Abaisraeli bachete aroro. Emechie eyio nesarigwe etigare ere bosa.
Inwe mwebire Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwaino, na timori koinyora Egetare kere obotamero bwaino. Ase ayio nigo mokoroisia emegondo emiya, mwasimeka emesabibu emiegarori.
Nonya yare koba ng’a ase rituko erio okoyesimeka noyegitere orobago, na mambia yaye esiche, okwama kwaye nigo korasirigwe ekero rituko ri’emechando rirache, rire nobororo botari gokwaneka.
Obee! Okwogana okwo kw’abanto abange nogwa ki? Nigo bakwogana buna amache ’enyancha. Okomumura okwo kw’ebisaku nogwa ki? Nigo bakomumura buna amache are ne chinguru.

Abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakomumura buna amache amange, korende Omonene nabatogonyere, nabarabwo batame gochia aare: mbaserigwe, babe buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga igoro ase ebitunwa, na buna orotu rokoirurukigwa nekembugu‐mbugu.
Ekero kia mogoroba, rora, obwoba mboreo, na mambia botarakiamoka, abakwoboyia tibaiyo. Eke nakio egetari ki’abachandi baito, abwo bagotosakora.
Obobe nobw’ense eyio ogoakanigwa gwe chimbaba gokoigweka, ense ere ng’umbu ye chindooche chi’Etiopia,

eyio egotoma abatomwa goetera ase orooche rwa Naili bariinete amaato aroisirie korwa ase amauncho! Inwe abatomwa more abaango, genda ase abanto b’egesaku bare abatambe babwate emebere emeterere ekomeka‐meka, bairokire nabanto bare ang’e, na abare aare. Egesaku ekio nigo kere ne chinguru, naende gekona‐kobua, na ense yabo chindooche chinachete.
Inwe mwensi ababiare b’ense, inwe abamomenyeteo, ekero ebendera ekoimokererigwa ase egetunwa igoro, morigererie! Ekero egetureri gekobugigwa, motegerere!

Aya naro Omonene antebetie: “Nintegerere korwa aiga ase obomenyo bwane inde nobotoereru, imoreke buna amasase ’erioba akomoreka. Nigo ndabe buna riire rigotonya riime ase engaki y’omobaso omororo bwe rigesa.”
Ekero chindagera chiakoorire gosicha ne rigesa ritaraika, na amasabibu achakire kwama, Omonene nasose chinsagia nomoyio enkuro, na ebisebo bigokina abirusieo.
Chinsagia echio chionsi nchitigerwe chinyoni chi’ebitunwa ne ching’iti chi’ense. Chinyoni chintindi nchimenyeo ase engaki y’omobaso, ne ching’iti chionsi chi’ense ase engaki y’obokendu.

Ase engaki eyio Omonene bw’Emeganda narenterwe ebiegwa nabanto abwo bare abatambe babwate emebere emeterere ekomeka‐meka, abwo bairokire nabanto bare ang’e na abare aare. Egesaku ekio nigo kere ne chinguru, naende nigo gekona‐kobua, na ense yabo nigo ere ne chindooche chinyinge. Ebiegwa ebio nigo birarentwe ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, agwo ase erieta ri’Omonene rimenyete.

Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Misiri: Rora, Omonene nigo ariinete riire rikominyoka bwango ogocha Misiri. Erio agwo emegwekano egosasimwa y’Abamisiri nenyegerigwe ase obosio bwaye, ne chinkoro chi’Abamisiri nigo chirairianyeke.

“Inche Omonene ninseegete Abamisiri baitane boka abanyene; kera omonto nigo ararwane noyomwabo, na kera omoamate arwane nomoamate omwabo. Ninseegete abanto b’omochie oyomo barwane nab’omochie onde, na oboruoti borwane noboruoti bonde.

Nindusie omoika bw’Abamisiri orue asebare, ninsarie emeroberio yabo; barabwo mbabe bakogenda korigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emegwekano egosasimwa, na korwa ase abaragori, na korwa ase abwo bakorangeria emeika y’abakure, na korwa ase abarogi.
Nimbeke Abamisiri ase amaboko ’omonene ore omotindi; omoruoti bw’okobaondokia nabagambere.” Nabo Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, atebire.
Amache ’orooche rwa Naili nakame pi, na orooche orwo ndokame kegima.
Chindooche chigochiao nigo chiragunde chitioke, na amache ’emetaro agwo Misiri nakee aere; ebitonto na amauncho mbiome.
Amaranya amo nemegondo ere mbarabare y’orooche rwa Naili mbiome bisareke kegima.
Abanto bakoruba ne chindobio ase orooche rwa Naili mbarere na kobokia amagombo, na abwo bakoruta ebionga aroro mbaumate.
Abwo bakoroisia chiusi chi’egatani, na abakoroisia ebitambaa bi’ebamba, mberusie moyo.
Abwo bare chisiiro chi’abanto b’ense mbasenyentwe, na bonsi abarikire gokora emeremo mbaichane.
Abagambi ba Soani nigo bare abariri kegima; na abasemia abang’aini ba Farao nigo bagosemia ay’oboriri. Naki moranyare gotebia Farao: “Intwe nabana b’abanto abang’aini, abana b’abaruoti abakoro?”
Ng’ai abanto bao abang’aini bare? Onye bareo, tiga bagotebie na gokomanyia aya Omonene bw’Emeganda arobeirie igoro ya Misiri.
Abagambi ba Soani babeire abariri, na aba Memifisi bang’ainirwe. Abwo bare buna amagena e chikoona ase ebisaku biabo batantanirie ense ya Misiri.

Omonene obekire omoika bw’obotantanu ase egati y’abanto b’aroro, nabarabwo bakorire ense ya Misiri yatindire ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi, nigo ekogaragara, buna omonto otindire okwegaragaria ase amaroki aye.
Ense ya Misiri tegosesenigwa ase ogokora konde gwonsi, kobe ogokora kw’omotwe gose ogw’ekemincha, okw’orosagia rw’omokendo gose orw’egetonto.
Ase engaki eyio Abamisiri mbabe buna abakungu, baiguswe bare nobwoba ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’Emeganda, ekero ararambore okoboko kwaye agosungusie igoro yabo.
Abamisiri mbabe bakoiroka abanto b’ense y’Abayuda; ekero Omomisiri araigwe ense y’Abayuda egwatorwa nabe nobwoba obonene, ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda okorire omoroberio ore mamincha y’Abamisiri.

Ase engaki eyio abanto b’emechie etano y’ense ya Misiri mbabe bagokwana omonwa bw’Abakanani, naende babe bakobwatana n’Omonene bw’Emeganda na gotiana ase erieta riaye. Oyomo bw’emechie eyio nigo orarokwe Omochie bw’Erioba.
Ase engaki eyio egesasimero nkeagacherwe Omonene agwo ase egatigati ya Misiri, boigo rigena rire buna esiiro nditenenerigwe Omonene agwo ase ribebe ri’ense eyio.

Ebinto ebio mbibe ekemanyererio na kirori ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, agwo ase ense ya Misiri. Ekero abanto ba Misiri barabe bakorera ase Omonene kobagokorerwa bobe, ere nabatomere omotooria abarwanerere abatoorie.

Omonene nemanyekanie ase Abamisiri; na Abamisiri mbabe bakomomanya Omonene ase amatuko ayio. Mbabe bakomosasima na komoruera ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, naende mbabe bakoriera Omonene chiira na gochiikerania.
Omonene naake ense ya Misiri, nayeake na koyegwenia, na abanto b’aroro mbamoiranere Omonene, ere naigwe ogosaba kwabo abagwenie.
Ase engaki eyio enchera enene nebeo ekorwa Misiri goika Asuri. Abaasuri mbabe bakogenda Misiri, na Abamisiri babe bakogenda Asuri; Abamisiri na Abaasuri mbabe bagosasimera amo.
Ase engaki eyio Abaisraeli mbabwatane n’Abamisiri na Abaasuri, na ebisaku ebio bitato mbibe ogosesenigwa ase ense engima,
ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nabasesenie, atebe: “Imosesenirie inwe Abamisiri, abamore abanto baane, nainwe Abaasuri, abamore emeremo y’amaboko aane, nainwe Abaisraeli, abamore omwando one.”
Ase omwaka oria Taritani, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani b’Abaasuri, atometwe na Sarigoni, omoruoti obo, agende ase omochie bw’Asidodi; ere akayorwania esegi, akayobua.

Ase engaki eyio Omonene agakwana na Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, akamotebia, “Genda orusie egunia obegete ase omobere oo, na ebikoroto obegete ase amagoro ao.” Isaya agakora bo, akaba ogotaara getirianda, na tabegete ebikoroto.

Erio Omonene agateba, “Buna koreng’ana Isaya, omosomba one, abeire okona‐gotaara goetanana aaria na aaria ase emiaka etato yaetire, ore getirianda na atabegeti bikoroto, obeire ekemanyererio na omogwekano bw’amang’ana arabe ase Abamisiri na ase Abaetiopia,

naboigo omoruoti bw’Abaasuri araire abasomba korwa Misiri, naire na Abaetiopia abooswa. Nigo baraire abanto abake na abanene bare getirianda na batabegeti bikoroto, gose batatubeti chinyonga chiabo, na igo ense y’Abamisiri erenterwe obosooku.
Abanto abwo basemeretie Abamisiri na betogeretie Abaetiopia mbabe baichanete na gosooka.

Ase engaki eyio abanto bamenyete ase ense ere ang’e nenyancha mbakwane, batebe: Rora amang’ana abanyorire abanto abwo intwe twasemeretie na kobatamera ng’a batokonye korwa ase omoruoti bw’Abaasuri! Bono, naki intwe toranyare gotooreka?”
Aya naro amang’ana igoro y’erooro ere ang’e nenyancha. Koreng’ana buna ekembugu‐mbugu gekobongia ase ense ya irianyi naboigo na obobe bokorwa ase erooro, ense eyio ekoondokia mono.

Inche norokigwe okorora kore ogokong’u mono; abaurereria nigo bagendererete kourereria, na abasaria bagendererete gosaria. Inwe Abaelamu, genda morwane! Inwe Abamedia, genda moboere! Ninsirie obororo bwonsi bwarentirwe n’Abababeli.
Ase ayio chibachwa chiane chianyegerigwe, obororo bwansoire, obororo buna obw’omokungu okobina aibore; naichanire mono, tindi koigwa; nabeire nobwoba obonene, tindi korora.
Enkoro yane nigo egotiesana, omoondoko ombwatire; engaki ya mogoroba eyio naganyete yang’onchokeire na kondetera obwoba.
Abanto nigo bakwarigania endagera bayebeka ase emesa, babeka abarendi bakorenda, naende baria na konywa. Bono inwe abagambi, imoka, moake chinguba chiaino ebitinya.
Amang’ana aya naro Omonene antebetie, “Genda mobeke omorendi atengere, nere oyio nabararerie abatebie amang’ana ararore.
Omonto oyio kararore abariini chibarasi bagocha babere babere, na abariini chitigere, na abe chingamia, tiga ategerere mono, ee, ategerere buya kegima.”
Omonto oyio ontengerete akarangeria neriogi buna eri’endo, “Aye Omonene, nigo ngotenena igoro ase egetengero omobaso boira; nigo inde ase emeremo yane ase obotuko bwonsi.

“Bono abariini chibarasi ngocha bare babere babere.” Na omotengeri oria agaaka eriogi riaye naende, agateba, “Babeli ogure! Ogure kegima! Emegwekano yaye yonsi y’ogosasimwa yasenyentirwe na gotiringerwa inse.”
Inwe abanto baane, aba mwaoorirwe ase ekeooreri buna obori na koirurwa, amang’ana naigure korwa ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, naro nkobarareria.
Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Edomu. Omonto nkondangeria are korwa Seiri, okoboria, “Omorendi, mang’ana ki igoro y’obotuko? Omorendi, mang’ana ki igoro y’obotuko?”
Omorendi nigo akoiraneria: “Emambia yachire, nonya naboigo obotuko nao bore. Onye moganetie koboria erinde momanye, boria; moirane moche naende.”
Aya naro amang’ana igoro y’Abaarabu. Inwe abagendi b’ense ya Dedani, mobe mokorara ase amanani ’ense y’Arabia.
Inwe abanto momenyete ase ense ya Tema, abwo bare nerang’o, bae amache, na abwo bagotama, bae endagera.
Abanto abwo nigo batamire korwa ase ogoitwa nemioro, na korwa ase emeyio yasomoirwe, na korwa ase amata atingirwe, na korwa ase emechando y’esegi.
Ase ayio Omonene ontebirie iga: “Ekero omwaka oyomo otaraera omwaka onga buna oyo bw’omorikwa, obonene bwonsi bwa Kedari mbosirigwe boere.
Abanto chituoni b’Abakedari, abamanyete koruta chinsara, nigo baratigare abake mono. Inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, natebire amang’ana ayio.”
Aya naro amang’ana igoro ye Rikura ri’Amaroro. Mang’ana ki abeire inwe mwensi mwariinire gochia birama igoro?
Aye omochie oichire neburu‐buru na okwogana, aye ore nomochengo bw’obobe, abanto bao abaitirwe tibaitiri nemioro, gose tibakweti ase esegi.
Abagambi bao bonsi batamire bare amo, nigo babwatirwe batararaswa chinsara. Abanto bao bonsi banyoretwe nigo babwatetwe, nonya konya batamire gochia aare.
Ase ayio inche ngateba, “Tobaisa kondigereria, ntige ndere nobororo ing’iyerie amariga; tobaisa gwechanda kondemia ase engencho y’ogosarigwa kw’omochie bw’abanto baane.”

Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ochorire engaki ere nobotantanu, na ogotiringerwa inse, na omoichano, na engaki eyio nigo erache igoro ye Rikura ri’Amaroro. Ase engaki eyio chindwaki nchitagorwe chigwe inse, na ebirero mbiigweke gochia ase ebitunwa.
Abaelamu nigo babogoretie chinsara, bagacha amo nabariini chigari na abe chibarasi; na abanto ba Kiri bagasokia chinguba chiabo.
Amakura aino are amaya mono aichoirwe ne chigari, na abariini chibarasi mbateneine ase ebiita.
Egekengero ki’Abayuda nigo kiarusetigweo kegima. Ase engaki eyio mokarigia ebirwanero biarenge kogachwa ase Enyomba ye Rinani.
Erio mokanyora ng’a obotandoku bwe chindwaki chi’omochie o Daudi bwabeire obonge; inwe mogatanga amache tarua ase Ritibo ria Maate.
Mokabara chinyomba chia Yerusalemu, na mogachitagora ase okoroisia orwaki robe orokong’u.

Mokaagacha etangi y’amache agwo ase egati ye chindwaki chiria ibere, erinde monyore amache akorwa ase ritibo rikoro, korende timwamorigeretie Oyio okorete ayio, gose timwamorengereretie Oyio okorete omoroberio oyio agwo kare.
Ase engaki eyio Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nigo abatebetie ng’a morere na kobokia amagombo, na mokigite chitukia chi’emetwe yaino, na kweboyia chigunia.
Ribaga ri’ogokora igo mokagoka na gochenga; mokanyenya chiombe ne ching’ondi, mokaba mokoria chinyama na konywa edivai, mogateba, “Tiga torie na konywa, ekiagera ankio natokwe.”
Omonene bw’Emeganda nere onyorokirie amang’ana ayio na gontebia, “Ekeene, timokwaberwa ebibe ebio nonya ng’ake.” Omonene bw’Emeganda otebire ayio.
Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, agoteba: “Inchuo ogende ase Sebuna, oyio ore omogachi na omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’obogambi, omotebie:
Aye ninki ogokora aiga, na monto ki obwate aa? Nase ki ogwekunyera oboina aase are igoro mono? Inee! Nigo okwebaachera oboina aiga ase egetare bobe obomenyo bwao?
Aye nonya kore omonto bwe chinguru, Naama, Omonene nakobwate bokong’u, akorute gochia aare mono.

Nigo arakoborongose buna omopira, akorute gochia ase ense ere engare; agwo nao orakwere. Naende nao chigari chiao chi’obonene chirabe, ekiagera aye kwabeire omonto bw’obosooku ase enyomba y’omonene oo.
Inche Omonene ninkorusie orue ase emeremo yao, naende nkoiyerie korwa aase ao.
“Ase engaki eyio nindangerie omosomba one Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia,
imobekere eganchwa yao y’obogambi, naende imoboerie orokini rwao. Nimbeke obogambi bwao ase okoboko kwaye, ere nabe ise bw’abanto ba Yerusalemu na Abayuda.
Nimbeke ekeigorero ki’enyomba ya Daudi ase amareko aye; ere nabe okoigora, na onde tari oranyare gosieka; nabe ogosieka na onde tari oranyare koigora.
Nimokong’ontere akong’e buna omosumari okong’onteire ase enyasi enkong’u, na ere nabe ekerogo ki’amasikani ase enyomba ya ise.
“Abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya ise, na abana baye, ne chinderia chiabo, mbabe bakomosemeria abakonye. Ebikorero bionsi, ebisinini na ebinene, mbimosung’unane.
Korende ase engaki eyio omosumari oria okong’onteretwe ase enyasi enkong’u nosimorwe korwao ogwe inse, ne chigurube chiasungireo nchigwe, chisamunyokane.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.
Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Turo. Inwe abe chimeeri chia Tarisisi, rera, ekiagera Turo osarigwe, chinyomba tichiyo, gose ekiambokero. Abanto b’ense ya Kuporo babamanyirie amang’ana ayio.
Inwe abamomenyete ase egesinka, tegerera mokire‐kiri! Abaonchoreria ba Sidoni, abwo bagotaara ne chimeeri, kare nigo baichorete ase ense yaino.
Nigo bataarete ase chinyancha chinene, na ebitoki biaino nigo biarenge chimbusuro chia Sihori, na okwama kwe riranya ri’Orooche rwa Naili. Ninwe mwarenge abaonchoreria b’ebisaku bionsi.
Aye Sidoni, rora obosooku; enyancha ere neburi enkong’u y’enyancha yatebire iga: “Inche tinana kobina, gose koibora, tinana korera abana abamura, gose gokinia abaiseke abekungi.”
Ekero Abamisiri baraigwe amang’ana ayio igoro ya Turo, nigo baraichane mono.
Inwe abamomenyete ase egesinka, amboka, mogende Tarisisi, morere!
Inee! Oyo nomochie oria oino oichire nomogoko, omochie oyio oagachetwe ase chingaki chia kare, oyio amagoro ’abanto baye abogoretie gochia komenya ase chinse chi’aare?
Ning’o oroberetie amang’ana aya onsi mamincha ya Turo? Omochie oyio orenge kobekera abaruoti chigutwa, na abaonchoreria baye nigo barenge abagambi, na abaoonia baye nigo basikire ase ense.
Omonene bw’Emeganda nere oroberetie ayio ase okoiyeria inse oboenenu bw’obonene na gochaya abanene bonsi b’ense.
Inwe abanto ba Tarisisi, menteka, moichore ase ense yaino, mobe buna amache ’orooche rwa Naili; kende tikeri kerabatange.
Omonene oramboire okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha, onyegeirie amaruoti; orure ogochika igoro ya Kanani ng’a chiburi chiaye chitagorwe.
Ere agateba, “Aye omochie o Sidoni orenge buna omoiseke omwekungi, korende bono gwakoreirwe bobe, tokonyara koba nomogoko naende. Imoka ogende Kuporo, nonya naroro tokonyara gotimoka.”

Rigereria ense y’Abakalidayo! Abanto aba tibarenge egesaku. Abaasuri nabwo barentete ching’iti chi’orosana komenya aroro. Abwo bakaagacha chindwaki chi’okoboera, bakaonchorana chinyomba chi’obogambi chi’omochie oyio, bakayotagora okaba etui.
Inwe abe chimeeri chia Tarisisi rera, ekiagera chiburi chiaino chiatagoirwe.

Ase amatuko ayio omochie o Turo mbwebwe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere, emiaka ereng’aine ey’obogima bw’omoruoti oyomo. Emiaka eyio emerongo etano na ebere ekoera, nebe ase Turo buna arikire ase ogotera kw’omotayayi;
“Aye omokungu omotayayi konya kwebirwe, imokia obokano, oetanane ase omochie bwonsi, otere neriogi rigiya, otere amatera amange, erio nario orainyorwe.”
Emiaka eyio emerongo etano na ebere koyaerire, Omonene nachiche korora omochie o Turo; omochie oyio noiranere chingencho chiaye chinkoro, ochake gokora obonyaka amo namaruoti onsi are ase ense.

Ebikonyorekana korwa ase oboonchoreria bwaye, na ebitoki bi’ogokora kwaye kw’obonyaka mbiatananwe ase Omonene, tibigosangererigwa na kogachwa. Ebio banyorire ase oboonchoreria nigo biranyorere abanto abwo bamenyete ase obosio bw’Omonene endagera eisaine, ne chianga chingiya chikobekwa.
Naama! Omonene nasarie ense, ayetige ere bosa; nayeonchorane ayeumamie, na abanto bamenyeteo abasiarere gochia aaria na aaria.

Amang’ana nayamo arabanyorere abanto bonsi; buna arabe ase abanto, naboigo arabe ase abakuani; buna arabe ase omosomba, naboigo arabe ase omonene oye; buna arabe ase omosomba omokungu, naboigo arabe ase omokungu ore omonene oye; buna arabe ase oyokogora, naboigo arabe ase oyokoonia; buna arabe ase oyokorua singo, naboigo arabe ase oyokoegwa singo; buna arabe ase oyogotura esira, naboigo arabe ase oyogoturwa esira.
Ense nesarigwe kegima ebe bosa, ekiagera n’Omonene otebire ring’ana erio.
Ense nigo ekweumia na kogenderera gosira; oboiko bwonsi bwagoyire, ngochia gosira bore, na abare abanene b’ense baereirwe chinguru.
Ense yasarigwe nabanto bamenyeteo; barabwo basaririe amachiko, bangire koigwera emeroberio echikire, naende basaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwa kare na kare.
Ase ayio okoragererigwa nkogendererete gosiria ense; abanto bamenyeteo nigo bachandegete ase engencho y’okomocha kwabo kw’ebibe, basambirwe, na abanto abake boka batigaireo.
Edivai enyia nigo ekobokia amagombo, na emesabibu yasusanire, na abanto bonsi barenge nomogoko bw’enkoro nigo baichanete.
Omogoko bw’eriogi rie chinchigiri oerire, na eriogi ri’abwo bagochenga riaerire, na omogoko bw’eriogi ri’amakano oerire.
Bono abanto tibagenderereti gotera ekero bakonywa edivai; ebinyugwa bigotindia biabeire ebiroro ase abwo bakobinywa.
Omochie oyio obwate eburu‐buru otagoirwe; kera enyomba ereo yasiekirwe, monto onde tari ogosoa aroro.
Okorera okonene kwaigwekanire ase chinchera, ekiagera edivai teiyo; omogoko bwonsi oerire, na omochengo bw’ense osirire.
Omochie osarigwe kegima; ebiita biatagoirwe na konacha‐nachanwa.
Amang’ana ayio naro arabinyore ebisaku bire ase ense; ense nebe buna ekero emezeituni ekonyegerigwa ase okoarora amatunda, na buna ogochorwa kw’amazeituni amatigari.
Erio abanto mbaake amariogi batere nomogoko, mbaake amariogi korwa ase enyancha, batogie obonene bw’Omonene.
Ase ayio inwe abamore moocha, motogie Omonene; abamore ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, togia erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

Korwa chinsinyo chi’ense twaigure amatera ay’ogotogia obonene bw’Oyore Omonyene Oboronge. Korende nigo ngoteba, “Naki nachandekire! Naki nachandekire! Obobe nobwane! Abakorekanu nigo bagendererete gokorekania, ee, nigo bagendererete gokorekania mono.”
Inwe abamomenyete ase ense, obwoba, na eirima, na omoeto, nigo bibaganyete.
Nebe ng’a oyogotama kaigure eriogi ri’okogosa nagwe ase eirima, na oyo orasoke korwa ase eirima eyio nabwatwe nomoeto, ekiagera chitirisa chia igoro chiaigoirwe, oboroso bw’ense bwanyegerigwe.
Ense yabwerekire, ee, yabwerekire kegima, yatandoirwe ebing’ese; ense yatengechigwe ne chinguru chintindi.
Ense yatindire buna oyotindire amarwa; nigo ekorunda‐rundigwa buna oborunda‐rundia bw’omote. Ogosaria kwaye kwayeritoereire, negwe, tekonyara koboka naende.
Ase engaki eyio Omonene narue egesusuro ase emeganda ere igoro, aaria igoro, narue egesusuro ase abaruoti b’ense, aiga ase ense.
Barabwo mbasangererigwe amo buna abasibwa, babekwe ase engoro eyemo; mbasiekerwe buna abasibwa, na ekero amatuko amange aerire mbaegwe egesusuro.
Erio omotienyi tokorua oborabu bwaye, na erioba tirikobara, ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nabe okogamba ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ase Yerusalemu, na ase abagaaka b’aroro naorokie obonene bwaye.
Aye Omonene, naye Nyasae one; ninkoimokererie igoro, nintogie erieta riao; aye gwakorire amang’ana ’ogokumia emeroberio yao korwa kare nigo ere ey’obwegenwa na ekeene.
Aye gwatagoire omochie, kwayokorire obeire etui y’amagena, omochie oyio konya ogiteire chindwaki obeire ritongo. Gwasaririe chinyomba chinene chi’omochie bw’abamenyi, omochie oyio tokoagachwa naende.
Ase ayio, abanto bare ne chinguru mbagotogie, emechie y’ebisaku ebitindi nekoiroke.

Aye kwabeire egekengero egekong’u ase abataka, ee, kwabeire egekengero ase abaremeire ekero bare nemechando; kwabeire obotamero ase engaki y’embura omoubera, na ekiriri ekero ki’omobaso omororo. Okogosa kw’abanto abatindi nigo konga embura omoubera egotwoma enyasi,
na buna omobaso bw’eguru‐gura. Aye gwakiririe amariogi ’ababisa; buna omobaso omororo ogokendigwa ne riire, naboigo namatera ’abanto abwo abatindi arakendigwe.
