Aiga ase egetunwa eke Omonene bw’Emeganda naroiserie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi omoyega bw’ebinto ebinoru, omoyega bw’edivai engiya mono, ee, oyo bw’ebinto ebinoru biichire emeseto, na edivai engiya ekenonoire.
Aiga ase egetunwa eke Omonene nasarie na korusia egietubo getubete abanto bonsi, ee, egietubo ekio keramboire igoro y’ebisaku bionsi.
Omonene Nyasae nasirie amakweri goika kare na kare, natinyie amariga korwa ase amaiso ’abanto bonsi, nasirie ogochaywa kw’abanto baye korwa ase ense yonsi. Nabo Omonene atebire.
Ase rituko erio mbatebe iga: “Rora, oyo nere Nyasae oito; oyo nere twakaganyire, erinde anyare gototooria. Oyo nere Omonene, twakaganyire; tiga togoke na gochenga, ekiagera otorenteire ogotooreka.”
Okoboko kw’Omonene nkobeere igoro y’egetunwa eke, korende Abamoabu mbatiringerwe inse aase abo buna obonyansi obwomo bogotiringeranigwa ase engoro y’esike.
Barabwo mbarambore amaboko abo buna omonto akorambora amaboko aye ase ogoaka entimbu, korende Omonene nasirie oboenenu bwabo amo nobong’ainereria bw’emeremo y’amaboko abo.
Natagore emerobiri emetambe y’ogwekengera ere ase chindwaki chiabo, nayeiyerie inse kegima, ee, negwe inse ase riroba.
Ase rituko erio ogotera oko ngoterwe ase ense y’Abayuda; “Intwe nigo tomenyete ase omochie omokong’u. Omonene otoeire ogotooreka kobe chindwaki ne chiburi chiaito.
Igora ebiita bi’omochie oyio, erinde egesaku kere noboronge na obwegenwa kenyare gosoa imeo.
Omonto ore nebirengererio ebironge asore, aye Omonene nigo okomoa omorembe omoikeranu, ekiagera agosemeretie.
Mosemerie Omonene botambe, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae nere egetare gia kare na kare.
Ere okeeirie abanto abwo beimokereretie igoro, otagoire omochie oria ochongororogete gochia igoro, oyoiyeirie inse kegima, ee, oyoiyeirie inse ase riroba.
Amagoro ’abanto abataka nayotiringere inse, na ay’abaremerwa nayotache.”
Enchera y’abanyene oboronge nenteremu; naye okoyekora yaba enteremu.
Aye Omonene, intwe nigo tokoganyete kogocha konacha ebina biao; okona‐koinyora erieta riao nakwo kore okogania kw’emioyo yaito.
Omoyo one nigo ogokogania ase obotuko, omoika ore ime yane nigo ogokorigia kobogokiamoka. Ekero orarente ebina biao igoro ase ense, abanto bamenyeteo nigo bakweorokereria oboronge.
Omokori amabe naisa gwanchererigwa, takweorokereria oboronge; ekero are ase ense egokora oboronge nigo arakore ay’obokorekanu, takorora obonene bw’Omonene.
Aye Omonene kwaramboire okoboko kwao, korende barabwo tibagokorora. Tiga barore risemi obwate ase abanto bao, erinde basooke; omorero osambete ababisa bao, tiga obasambe nabarabwo.
Aye Omonene, notorentere omorembe, ekiagera emeremo twabeire togokora, naye kwabeire gokoyetokorera.
Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, abanene bande babeire bagotogambera, korende erieta riao rioka nario tomanyete.
Barabwo bakure, tibakoba moyo naende, babeire amarengari, tibakoboka; ase ayio kwabaeire egesusuro na kobasiria, kwabasiririe, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake.
Aye Omonene, gwakorire egesaku eke kementekane; ee, gwakementekanirie; ase ayio aye gwatogigwe, kwagareeirie ense y’egesaku eke.
Aye Omonene, ekero barenge nemechando nigo bakorigetie, ekero kwabaete egesusuro, nigo bagosabete mono.
Aye Omonene, nigo twabete asore buna omokungu ore morito, okobina aibore, ekero engaki yaye yaikire, nigo akoromwa nobororo.
Intwe twabeire tore barito, twabeire tokobina na kweganchorana, korende ekero twaiborete tokaibora embeo bosa. Titorenteti ogotooreka konde ase ense, gose abanto tibaiboretwe ase ense.
Abanto baino bakwete mbabe moyo naende; emebere y’abakwete neboke. Inwe abwo moraire ase amaroba ime, boka, motere nomogoko! Riime riao nigo rire eri’oborabu; riroba ndibairanie abakwete.
Inwe abanto baane, inchuo mosoe ase chiero chiaino mwesiekere aroro; mwebise aroro ase engaki enke, goika endamwamu eyio ebe yaetire.

Rora, Omonene ngosoka are korwa aase aye, ae abanto bamenyete ase ense egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo. Okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ase ense nkobe maiso marore, na ense tekogenderera kobisa abanto abwo baitetwe.

Ase engaki eyio Omonene nae Leviatani, eng’iti eria y’okwoboyia, enyango ekwemiina, egesusuro. Nayeite nomoro oye ore omokong’u na omonene, na ore ne chinguru; boigo naite enchoka eria ere ime ase enyancha.
Ase engaki eyio omogondo bw’emesabibu ore nedivai enyinge nobeo. Notererwe ogotera oko:
“Inche Omonene, ninche inde omorendi bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu, nigo nkoyoitororera amache kera engaki; nigo inyorendete obotuko na omobaso, erinde onde tabaisa koyosaria.
Inche tindi nendamwamu. Nonya amagwa na amageri are gocha kondwania nigo nare koyarwania na koyasambera amo.
Tiga abanto babwaterere oborendi bwane mbarende ne chinguru chiane; tiga bakore omorembe nainche, ee, barabwo mbabe nomorembe nainche.”
Ase amatuko agochi‐gocha Omonene nae abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo ribaga baseboke, ee, Abaisraeli mbasokie ebisicha na ebisebo, mbaame amatunda aichore ase ense yonsi.
Inee! Omonene naagete Abaisraeli buna aagete ababisa babo? Gose Abaisraeli mbaitetwe buna ababisa babo baitetwe?
Aye nigo kwaamereranetie nabarabwo okabaa egesusuro ase ekerengo, okarenta omwaga omotindi korwa moocha, okabaseria.

Ase ayio, abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo mbachenwe korwa ase ogosaria kwabo, na okorusigwa okwo kw’ebibe nkorente okwama ogoikeranu, ekero amagena onsi ay’ebisasimero arasenyentwe buna amagena ’echooka, na emete y’Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, na ebisasimero bi’ogosambera ubani, biratagorwe bionsi.
Omochie ogiteire chindwaki ong’anyirwe, otamirwe na gotigwa bosa, obeire buna erooro; agwo nao chimori chikorisia na korara, chiaba chikoria amato e chinsagia chireo.

Ekero chinsagia chiomire, nigo chikobuneka, abakungu bacha bachiira bachiutera omorero. Abanto b’egesaku eke tibari nobong’aini, ase ayio oria obatongete takobarorera amabeebe, gose kobarorera amabera.
Ase engaki eyio Omonene nabaswage inwe Abaisraeli buna chinyeke chi’endagera na kobachora oyomo oyomo. Nigo arachakere ase orooche rwa Eufarati na goikera ase akarooche ka Misiri.

Ekero engaki eyio eraike, engoma nebugigwe, na abanto abwo basirerete ase ense y’Abaasuri, na baria baseretigwe gochia ase ense ya Misiri, mbache gosasima Omonene ase egetunwa egechenu agwo Yerusalemu.

Obobe nobwao aye ore egutwa y’oboenenu bw’abanto ba Efraimu batindire. Nigo ore buna egesicha giasusanire, obwari bw’obonene bwao bwasirire. Nigo ore ase egetunwa igoro, igoro ye rikura ritobu ri’abwo babuirwe nedivai.

Rora, Omonene nabwate oyomo ore nokobua ne chinguru; oyio nigo anga buna embura y’amagena, na buna omwaga omotindi ogosaria, na buna omoubera ore nembura enyinge oraiyerie ebinto bionsi inse ne chinguru.
Egutwa y’oboenenu y’abanto b’Efraimu batindire netiringwe namagoro;

na egesicha giasusanire kere obwari bw’obonene bwaye, ekio kere ase egetunwa igoro agwo ase rikura ritobu nkebe buna ogotongorwa kw’amako agotang’anera rigesa, ayio omonto akorora oyatwa, na ekero ayabekire koboko oyaria.
Ase engaki eyio Omonene bw’Emeganda nabe egutwa y’obonene, na ekiore ki’obwari ase abanto baye abatigari,
naende nabe omoika bw’ogokora ayare ay’ekeene ase abwo bakogamba ekina, naende nabe chinguru chiabo abwo bagoseria ababisa agwo ase egeita.

Abanto aba nabarabwo batindire edivai; nigo bakoong’anya ase okonywa ebinyugwa bigotindia; abakuani na ababani batindire nebinyugwa bigotindia, na ekero bakorora amaroro nigo bakomocha, nigo bagotantana ekero bakonacha ebina.
Chimesa chiabo chionsi chiaichoire namaroki, na aase ande tari atari nobonyinyeri.
Nigo bagoteba: “Ning’o Isaya aganetie kworokereria obong’aini, na ning’o ere aranyare komanyia amang’ana aye amaya? Inee! Nabana abake abwo batachirwe, abwo batigigwe kogonka?
Nigo agotoa ogochika igoro ase ogochika, ee, ogochika igoro ase ogochika; ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana, ee, ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana; aiga make, na aaria make.”
Ekeene, Omonene nakwane nabanto aba goetera ase abanto b’ebisaku ebiao, abwo bagokwana omonwa omogeni.
Omonene nigo atebetie abanto abwo: “Aiga naase agotimokerwa, tiga abwo barosire batimokere aiga, erinde banyore chinguru naende.” Korende abanto abwo tibaigwerete.

Ase ayio ring’ana ri’Omonene asebare nigo rirabe iga: “Ogochika igoro ase ogochika, ee, ogochika igoro ase ogochika; ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana, ee, ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana; aiga make, na aaria make,” erinde kobagotaara babe bakogwa kenyuma‐nyuma, babutokane, babe bagotegwa na kobwatwa.
Ase ayio, inwe abachecheria aba mokogambera abanto ba Yerusalemu, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.

Inwe nigo mogoteba, “Intwe twakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania namakweri, na twabwatanire naase abakure; ekero emechando eyio emebe erache tegotoika ang’e, ekiagera twakorire oborimo bwabeire obotamero bwaito, na obong’ainereria bwabeire egekengero giaito.”

Ase ayio Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: “Rora inche nkobeka nde rigena ri’oboroso ase Sayoni, rigena rikong’u riateemirwe, rigena ri’ekoona ri’engencho enene rire oboroso obokong’u; na onde bwensi orariegene, takorua aroro.
Ninkore ekeene kebe ekerengo gi’okorenga, na oboronge bobe ekebiro gekorenga. “Nindete embura y’amagena yabuse kegima oborimo bore obotamero bwaino, na emegoko ebonganie obwebiso bwaino.”
Erio okobwatana kw’ogotianania koria mwakorete namakweri ngosarigwe, na okobwatana kwaino mwakorete naase abakure tigokogenderera kobao; ekero emechando eyio emebe erache, goika motiringerwe inse

Buna koreng’ana emechando eyio erabe ekona‐gocha nebanyore inwe, nebe ekona‐gocha emambia ase emambia, ee, omobaso na obotuko. Nigo erabe emechando emebe y’okoondokia ase okoigwa amang’ana ayio atomirwe.
Oborere nigo bore obweng’e omonto agosinywa kwerambora igoro ase borobwo, na ekiebisio nigo kere ekenyerere mono omonto atanyare kwebisia.
Omonene naimoke akore buna akorete ase egetunwa gia Perasimu; nabe nendamwamu buna abete ase Rikura ria Gibeoni; nakore ogokora kwaye kore okogeni, nakore emeremo yaye ere ey’ogokumia.
Ase ayio, bono timogenderera gochecheria, ebisibo biaino tibibaisa gokong’igwa, ekiagera naigure korwa ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ogochika kw’ogosirigwa gw’ense engima, okwo gotanyare gotigwa.
Tegerera moigwe eriogi riane; igwera amang’ana aane ngokwana!
Inee! Omonto okorema ng’a asimeke chimbusuro nigo akogenderera kona‐korema rioka? Inee! Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera kona‐koboosa rioka?
Omonto oyio ekero akoorire koroisia riroba, Inee, tari kobusura obotu bw’ebinsari bikorokwa dili na komini; naende obusura engano ase chindwaro, na esairi aase aye, na engano ende ase chingito?
Nyasae oye nigo akomworokereria enchera engiya y’ogokora emeremo eyio.
Dili teri koorerwa nekeoorero gi’ekioma, gose komini teri koorwa namagoro e chigari, korende bionsi bibere nigo bigosusurerwa omote.
Ekero omonto akoora engano, Inee, nkoyesunyunta are? Yaya, tari kogenderera koyeoora naende naende, nigo arabaise koyesenyenta namagoro ’egari ekong’uswa ne chibarasi chiaye.
Amorokererio ayio nigo akorwa ase Omonene bw’Emeganda; ere nigo are omosemia bw’ogokumia, na obong’aini bwaye nobonene mono.
Obobe nobwao aye Arieli, Arieli, omochie ase Daudi arenge gotoora. Omwaka ase omwaka imogenderere korenda Amatuko aino Amanene, na emeyega yaino.
Inche Omonene nindete emechando asore Arieli, okorera na okweumia mbibe ime yao, na aye omochie nobe asende Arieli bori.
Nintoore asore ngoetanane, ng’agache chiburi chi’okoboera na gokorwania.

Erio abanto bamenyete ime yao mbaiyerigwe inse, babe bagokwana korwa riroba inse, na amang’ana abo naigweke korwa ase orotu ime ng’ora ng’ora, ee, amariogi abo narwe inse ye riroba buna eriogi ri’ekerecha, nigo barabe bakomonya korwa ase orotu ime.

Korende ababisa bao bare omoganda omonene mbairurukigwe buna orotu; na omoganda bw’abare abatindi noirurukigwe buna omoiriro gochia aare. Amang’ana ayio nigo arabe mobosokano, ee, nigo arabe mobosokano mono.
Omonene bw’Emeganda naake abanto bao ne chinkoba, na omotengecho bw’ense, na egeturi ekenene, na ekerambauti, na embura omoubera, na amasaria ’omorero ogosamba.

Abanto abange b’ebisaku bionsi abwo bakorwania Arieli, ee, bonsi abakorwania omochie oyio, na gotagora chiburi chiaye, na koyorentera emechando, nigo barasirigwe, beebwe buna okorota gokwebwa, ee, buna okorora kwa botuko gokwebwa.

Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, abwo bakorwania Egetunwa gia Sayoni, nigo barabe buna omonto ore nenchara akorota ng’a nkoragera are, korende gakoboka bwenyora ore nenchara, gose buna oyore nerang’o akorota ng’a nkonywa are amache, korende gakoboka bwenyora ore nerang’o.
Tenena mokumie, ee, mokumie! Ekore mobe emeuko, mogenderere goukora! Etindie, korende tari ase okonywa edivai; ong’anya, korende tari ase okonywa ekenyugwa kegotindia.
Omonene obaitereire inwe omoika bw’okorara chitoro chindito; oukoirie amaiso ’ababani, abwo bare amaiso aino, na otubire emetwe y’abarori, abwo bare emetwe yaino.

Amaroro ayio onsi ay’obobani ebei re asemore buna amang’ana ’ebuku emumekeirie na kobekwa ekemanyererio. Ekero abanto bakoira ebuku eyio ase omonto omanyete gosoma, bamotebia: “Soma amang’ana ’ebuku eye,” ere nigo agokana oteba: “Tinkonyara, ekiagera amang’ana aya nigo abeire buna ay’ebuku emumekeire ebekire ekemanyererio.”
Naende bayea oyotamanyeti gosoma, bamotebia: “Soma amang’ana ’ebuku eye,” nere nigo agokana, oteba, “Timanyeti gosoma.”

Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Abanto aba nigo bakong’ika ang’e ase ogokwana nemenwa yabo na gonsika nebikoba biabo, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare korwa asende, na okonyiroka kwabo nigo kore amachiko mwanyabanto borokereretie.

Ase ayio, rora, ningenderere gokora amang’ana ay’ogokumia ase abanto aba, ee, amang’ana ayio nigo arabe ay’ogokumigwa na goichanwa; obong’aini bw’abanto babo bare abang’aini mbosire, na okomanya kw’abamanyete mono nkobiswe.”

Obobe nobw’abanto abwo bagokora emeroberio yabo erio bayebisa aase aatambe ng’a Omonene tayerora. Abanto abwo nigo bagokora ogokora kwabo ase chinchera chi’omosunte, erio bateba, “Ning’o otoroche? Ning’o otomanyete?”

Inwe nigo mokoonchorana amang’ana bobe. Inee! Omokori chinyongo nareng’anigwe nesike? Egento keroisirie ngetebie oyokeroisetie, “Tari aye kwandoisetie”; gose egento omonto abombete nkemotebie, “Tomanyeti kende”?
Engaki netigarete enke, erio rinani ria Lebanoni riraonchorwe ribe omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge; na omogondo oria orenge kwama chindagera chinyinge oonchorwe obe rinani.
Ase engaki eyio emetino nebe ekoigwa amang’ana arikire ase ebuku, na emeuko yarenge ekorora buna rikongori na omosunte, nerore buya namaiso abo.
Erio abanto abaitongo nabanyore omogoko omoyia kobare ime ase Omonene, na abataka bare ase mwanyabanto mbagokere Omonene ore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
Abakoirokia abande mbasirigwe, na abachecheria tibakobao; abwo bonsi bakorigia gokora amabe mbaitwe tibabao.
Omonene nasirie abanto abwo bagosiria abande namang’ana abo, abwo bakobeka omoeto ase oyo okogamba ebina agwo ase egeita, bakwana oborimo na koonchorana oboronge bw’omonto ore omoronge.
Ase ayio Omonene, oria obooretie Ibrahimu, okwanire amang’ana aya igoro y’ororeria rwa Yakobo, “Abanto ba Yakobo tibakogenderera koba nobosooku; amasio abo takoirura nonya ng’ake naende.

Ekero abana babo bararore emeremo y’amaboko aane, eye nakorete ase egati yabo, mbachene erieta riane ime yabo, naende banche ng’a inche n’Omochenu o Yakobo inde, mbabe bateneine banyirogete inche Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
Erio abwo basirire ase omoika mbaegwe okomanya, na abwo bakwemurungania mbanche amorokererio.”

Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Obobe nobwaino inwe abana baane abamore abasaria, aba mogokora emeroberio etari eyane, nigo mogokora okobwatana okwo gotari okw’omoika one, na mwamenta ebibe igoro ase ebibe binde.
Inwe nigo mokogenda ase Misiri korigia ogokonywa korwa ase Farao, korende timori korigia ogosemigwa korwa asende. Nigo mokorigia obotamero ase ekiriri kia Misiri.
Ase ayio chinguru chia Farao nchionchoke chibe obosooku bwaino; na obotamero bwaino ase ekiriri kia Misiri mbobarentere ogochaywa.
Nonya abagambi baino bare ase omochie o Soani, na abatomirwe baikire ase omochie o Hanesi,
kera oyomo nasooke, ekiagera mosemeretie abanto b’egesaku batanyare kobaa ebitoki binde, korende nobosooku na ogochaywa.”

Aya naro amang’ana igoro ye ching’iti chia Irianyi. Abanto abwo nigo bagoeta ase ense ere nemechando na omoichano, ase chindo chiaberi ne chindo chinde chimenyete amo namarubi, ne chinchoka chikoiruruka. Nigo bakobeerekia chitigere chinibo chiabo, ne chikungo chiabo bachibeka ase chisukubi chie chingamia, bagenda ase abanto batabae bitoki binde.
Ogokonywa kwa Misiri nigo kore bosa; ase ayio narokire ense eyio “Rahabu etari gokora gento.”
Bono genda, orike amang’ana ayio ase ebao agwo ase amasio abo, na oyarike ime ase ebuku, erinde abe kirori ase amatuko agochi‐gocha goika kare na kare.
Abanto aba nigo bare abasaria, abana abanyaborimo, abana batari koigwera amachiko ’Omonene.
Nigo bagotebia abarori b’amaroro: “Timobaisa korora amang’ana,” na batebia ababani: “Timobaisa gotobanera amang’ana amaronge; totebie amang’ana amororo aya agotwansera, motobanere ay’obong’ainereria.
Karue inchera, gobera korwa ase oboeto, morusie asetore Oyio ore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.”
Ase ayio, Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli otebire iga: “Inwe mwachayire ring’ana eri, mwanchire amang’ana ’obobe na obong’ainereria, naro mosemeretie.
Ase ayio, okomocha oko kw’ebibe nkobe asemore buna obotandoku bore ase orwaki orotambe rwekumbire, rore ang’e kogwa, na okogwa kwaye nigo korache bwango mobosokano.
Okogwa okwo nkobe buna ogwatwa kw’enyongo y’omokori chinyongo egotinerwa inse, nonya norogio oromo rw’enyongo eyio tirori gotoka omonto araancharere omorero, gose arabuchere amache korwa ase ensoko.”
Aya naro Omonene Nyasae, Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli agoteba: “Komorang’iranere mobe abatoereru imotooreke; ase oboremereria na ogosemeria monyore chinguru.” Korende inwe mwangire gokora bo.
Nigo mogoteba ng’a moriine chibarasi chikominyoka mono, motame. Ee, goika motame. Inwe moganetie gotama ne chibarasi chinyango, korende ababisa baino abwo bakobabwatia nigo bare abaminyoki kobabua.

Abanto baino elifu eyemo mbaserigwe ase okogoswa nomonto oyomo, gose nabanto batano, goika abatigari baino babe buna omoenga oyomo ore ase egetunwa igoro, na buna ekemanyererio keimokereirie ase ekerogo igoro.

Ase ayio Omonene nigo aganyete ng’a anyare kobakorera amaya; na ase ayio, neimokererie igoro mono goika abe okobarorera amabera, ekiagera Omonene nigo are Nyasae bw’oboronge. Mbasesenirie abanto bonsi abamoganyete.
Inwe abanto momenyete Sayoni agwo Yerusalemu, timokogenderera korera naende. Ekeene, Omonene nabakorere amaya ekero mokorera asare; ekero araigwe eriogi ri’okorera kwaino nabairanerie.
Nonya Omonene ogochia kobaa inwe omogati ekero more nemechando, na amache ekero more nobororo, aborokia baino tibakogenderera kwebisa, korende mobe mokobarora namaiso aino.
Komorabe mwagobeire korwa ase enchera gochia ensemo y’okorio, gose ey’okobee, inwe namoigwe korwa nyuma yaino amang’ana aya: “Enchera neye, yebwatie.”
Ase engaki eyio moimokie emegwekano yaino mogosasima, eyio ebachire na koomwa ne chifeta, na eyende ebombire na koomwa netahabu, moyetugute buna ebinto bitachenegeti, moyetebie: “Karue aa asetore!”

Erio ekero morabe mogosimeka chimbusuro chiaino, Omonene nachitwerie embura, erinde chindagera chiaino chiame, nainwe monyore chindagera chinyinge chingiya. Ekero ekio chitugo chiaino nchinyore amarisio amagare.
Chiombe ne chitigere chiaino, echio mokoremia ase emegondo yaino, nchinyore chindagera chingiya chisongire noroteru na goswagwa, chiochoganirie nomonyo, chirie.
Ase rituko erio ekero ogoitwa okonene korabe, ne chindwaki chinkong’u chiraiyerigwe, chindooche nchituboke korwa ase ebitunwa ebitambe bionsi na ebigoro biimokererete igoro.

Oborabu bw’omotienyi mborabe se buna omobaso bw’erioba, na omobaso bw’erioba nobare ara gatano na kabere, buna okobara kw’amatuko atano na abere. Amang’ana ayio nigo arakorekane ekero Omonene araboe chingoma na agwenie amaakwa aagete abanto baye.

Rora, erieta ri’Omonene ngocha rire korwa aare. Nigo agocha ore nendamwamu egwoka, ne rikundesi rinene ri’erioki; amang’ana ’ebikoba biaye nigo aichire nekeririanda, na oromeme rwaye nigo rore buna omorero ogosiria.
Omoika bw’Omonene oye nigo onga orooche roichire goika ebigoti. Nasonge abanto b’ebisaku negesongero ki’ogosiria; ase emenwa yabo nigo arabeke ebinto ase emenwa yabo bi’okobatantania.

Inwe motere ogotera buna nokw’omoyega omochenu bw’obotuko; chinkoro chiaino nchibe nomogoko buna ekero abanto bakobugia ebiroria kobagotiira gochia ase egetunwa ki’Omonene, ere oyore Egetare ki’Abaisraeli.

Omonene naake eriogi riaye ri’obonene na abanto bariigwe, na ogoaka kw’endamwamu gokorwa ase okoboko kwaye kororekane. Nigo araake goetera ase omorero ogosamba na gosiria, na omwaga bwe chinguru, na embura y’omoubera, na amagena ’embura.
Ase eriogi ri’Omonene, na ase ogoaka nenyimbo yaye, Abaasuri mbaondoke mono.
Omonene naimokie enyimbo yaye abae egesusuro, na ekero arabe ogoaka abanto abwo, abanto baye mbabe bakobugia chinchigiri na amakano. Omonene omonyene nere orabarwanie esegi aande onsi.

Aase ogosambera ebing’wanso bi’okogechia nigo aroisetigwe kare; ee aase agwo nigo aroiseretigwe omoruoti. Aase agwo nigo are aatambe na aagare, aichorigwe chinko na omorero. Omoika bw’omonwa bw’Omonene, onga buna omorero bw’amagena akoyia, noro orayouterere.

Obobe nobwabo abwo bagotirimboka gochia Misiri korigia ogokonywa, abwo basemeretie chibarasi ne chigari, ekiagera chire chinyinge, na abariini chibarasi, ekiagera bare ne chinguru, korende tibari korigia Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, gose korigia ogosesenigwa korwa ase Omonene oyio.
Ere nigo are omong’aini na nigo akorenta obobe gose tari koonchora amang’ana aye. Nae eamate y’abakori amabe egesusuro, boigo nae abakonyi b’abagokora amabe egesusuro.

Abamisiri nigo bare mwanyabanto, tibari Nyasae; chibarasi chiabo nigo chire emebere, tichiri emeika. Ekero Omonene ararambore okoboko kwaye, abwo bagokonya mbagochwe, na abwo bagokonywa bagwe; bonsi nigo barasirigwe amo.

Aya naro Omonene antebetie; “Buna koreng’ana endo ensae ekoronya ase eng’iti yaitire, na teri kogoswa namariogi ’omoganda bw’abarisia, gose teri kwoboa egeturi kiabo, naboigo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ndache korwana ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ase ekegoro kiaye.
Buna koreng’ana chinyoni chikorambora chimbaba chiabo, naboigo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ndaegere Yerusalemu; ninyorende na koyobooria; ninyororere amabera na koyotooria.”
Inwe Abaisraeli, moiranere oria mwasaretie asare mokamotiga.
Engaki ngocha ere kera omonto aratugute emegwekano yaye agosasima eroisirie korwa ase chifeta ne chitahabu, eyio mwaroisetie namaboko aino, na igo mogakora ebibe.

“Abaasuri mbaitwe nemioro, korende tari eya mwanyabanto, ee, emioro etari eya mwanyabanto nebasirie. Abanto abwo mbatame korwa ase esegi, na abamura babo mbairwe ase obosomba, bakore emeremo ase okobetererigwa.

Oyore egetare kiabo natame ore nomoondoko omonge; na abakogamba amo nere mbatame ase okogoswa ekero bararore ebendera y’esegi.” Omonene, oyio omorero oye ore ase Sayoni, na ekebemberi kiaye ki’omorero kere Yerusalemu, otebire amang’ana ayio.
Rora, omoruoti naoroke oragambe ase oboronge, na abagambi b’obogambi mbagambe bakore ay’ekeene.

Kera oyomo obo nabe buna obwebiso ekero omwaga okogusa, na buna ekeigamero ekero embura y’omoubera egotwa; boigo mbabe buna chindooche chire ase ense enyomo, na buna ekiriri ki’egetare ekenene ase ense etari namache.
Erio amaiso ’abanto abwo bakorora tagoukora, na amato ’abanto abwo bakoigwa naigwe.
Erio abanto abwo batarenge ne chinkoro chi’oboremereria mbabe nebirengererio bi’okomanya, na abwo barenge gotutura mbamanye gokwana buya na koigugwa buya.
Ase engaki eyio omonto omoriri takorokwa omosike, gose omong’ainereria takorokwa omonto omwegenwa.

Omonto omoriri nigo agokwana amang’ana ’oboriri; ebirengererio biaye nigo bigokora emeroberio y’ogokora ebibe; nigo akwenaria gokora aya atari e chingencho chinchenu; nigo agokwana bobe igoro y’Omonene, na otiga korageria abare nenchara, na orina abare nerang’o amache.
Ebirwanero bi’omong’ainereria nigo bire ebi’obobe; ere nigo agokora emeroberio y’obosooku gosiria abachandegete ase okobatebera oborimo, nonya nekero barabwo bagokwana ay’oboronge bwabo.
Korende omonto omosike nigo akoroberia ay’obosike, na nigo agotenena ase ay’obosike.
Inwe abakungu mweisanegetie, imoka, montegerere! Inwe abaiseke motechandereti kende, tegerera, moigwe amang’ana ngokwana!
Inwe abakungu motechandereti kende, ekero amatuko aetanetie omwaka aerire mobe mogochandeka, ekiagera emesabibu tekwama, ne rigesa rie chindagera tirikoba.
Ase ayio inwe abakungu motechandereti kende, iguswa, mwechabore chianga chiaino mobe getirianda, erio mweboyie chigunia.
Moake‐ake ebikuba biaino, ekiagera emegondo yaino emiya, na emesabibu yaino ekwama mono, yasarigwe,
na ekiagera amagwa na amageri biamerire ase ense y’abanto baane, mweake‐ake ase engencho ye chinyomba chi’emegoko chire ase omochie oyio oichire nomochengo.

Chinyomba chi’oboruoti nchitigwe chire bosa, omochie oichire nabanto nong’anywe, eburi na emerobiri y’obotengerero mbibe amakuruma kare na kare; agwo nao chitigere chi’orosana chiregokerie, na omochie oyio obe oborisia bw’amaicho e ching’iti.
Nyuma y’ayio ntoitererwe Omoika korwa igoro, na aase arenge erooro abe omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge, na omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge noonchorwe obe rinani.
Erio ekeene ngekorwe ase ense y’erooro, na oboronge bokorwe ase omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge.
Ayaratoke korwa ase oboronge nomorembe, na okwama kw’oboronge nobotoereru na ogosemeria kwa botambe.
Abanto baane mbamenye ase chinyomba chire nomorembe babe barendire buya, mbabe batimogete ase obotoereru.
Ekero embura y’amagena erabe egotwa neiyerie emete ye rinani, na omochie oino noiranigwe inse mono.
Imosesenirie inwe aba mogosimeka chimbusuro mbarabare ase amache onsi, mogotiga chiombe ne chitigere chiagenda aande onsi.

Obobe nobwaino inwe aba mogosiria, ko inwe timwana gosirigwa! Obobe nobwaino inwe abaurereria, ko inwe timwana kourererigwa! Ekero morabe mwakoorire gosiria, nainwe mosirigwe, na ekero morabe mwakoorire kourereria, nainwe mourererigwe.
Aye Omonene, tororere amabera; twabeire togosemeretie. Kabe chinguru chiaito kera rituko, na ototoorie ase engaki y’emechando.
Ekero aye gwakanire neriogi ringa buna eri’okogukura, abanto b’ebisaku nigo bagotama, na ekero kwaimokereire igoro, barabwo nigo bagoserebekana.
Abanto nigo bagocha babasakora buna chingeeti chigosakora, na buna chingige chikoumokera, nabarabwo nabo bakobaumokera.
Omonene nigo aimokererete igoro, ekiagera nigo amenyete igoro mono; naichorie Sayoni nekeene na oboronge.
Ase chingaki chiaino Omonene nabae oborendi obuya, na obonge bw’ogotooreka, na obong’aini, na okomanya; okomoiroka Omonene nakwo korabe enibo yaino.
Igwa, abanto abwo bare chituoni nigo bakorera mono agwo isiko, na abwo batomirwe bare namang’ana ’omorembe nigo bakorera bare nobororo.
Chinchera chinene chiasarekire, omoeti tari ogoeta aroro. Okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwasarigwe; emechie yachayirwe, na abanto tibasikiri.
Ense nigo ekweumia, yaereirwe chinguru; rinani ria Lebanoni riasookire na gosusana; rikura ria Saroni riabeire buna Ekerubo Ekiomo, na emete ya Basani na Karimeli yaarorokire amato.
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Bono ningororoke ntenene, bono ninyimokerere igoro inyetogie.
Inwe nigo morabe barito bw’obonyansi obwomo, moibore amasakwe. Omoika oino bw’okoeyana noro omorero orabasambe moere.
Abanto mbasambwe bayie babe ribu, na buna amagwa akobutorwa asambwa nomorero.”
Inwe abamomenyete aare, igwa aya nakorire; nainwe abamomenyete ang’e ancha na koorokia okobua kwane.

Abanyabibe bare Sayoni basoirwe nobwoba; omoondoko obabwatire abwo batamoirogeti Nyasae. “Monto ki oito oranyare koremereria amenye nomorero ogosiria? Ning’o ore asetore oranyare komenya ime ase omorero oyio ogendererete gwoka kare na kare?”

Omonto okobwatia oboronge na gokwana amang’ana ’oboronge, oyio ogechete okonyora kw’ogokorera abande bobe na otangete amaboko aye tabwata riaaki, oyio otichete amato aye tabaisa koigwa amang’ana igoro y’ogoitera amanyinga, naende otari korigereria amang’ana ’obobe,
oyio nere oramenye aase are igoro. Ebitare ebikong’u mbibe ebikengero biaye; naegwe endagera yaye, na amache aye tagosira.
Amaiso aino arore omoruoti ore ase obwari bwaye; narore ense ere engare mono.
Chinkoro chiaino nchirengererie igoro y’obwoba boria na goteba: “Inee! Oria orenge kobeka ebango, ng’ai are? Oria orenge korusia ebango, ng’ai are? Oria orenge kobara emerobiri, ng’ai are?”
Timokorora abanto baria abatindi naende, abanto babwate ogokwana ogokong’u motari komanya, abwo bagokwana emenwa emeao ase okong’ung’ura motari komanya.

Rigereria Sayoni, omochie oyio ase togosangererekana ase Amatuko aito Amanene! Erio amaiso ao narore Yerusalemu, obomenyo bw’obotoereru, eema etari kona‐kong’anya‐ng’anyigwa; eyio ebirochi biaye bitari gosimorwa, gose chingori chiaye chitari kobutoka.
Aroro agwo Omonene natoorokere ore nobonene, nabe asetore buna chindooche na ebirooche, ase amaato agosukigwa nemegango ataete, gose chimeeri chinene chitaete.
Omonene nere omonachi ebina oito, nere omogambi oito. Omonene nere omoruoti oito, natotoorie.

Chingori chi’omoenga bw’emeeri chianyega‐nyegire, tichikonyara gosiberania omoenga bokong’u aase aye, gose korambora ebitambaa. Erio ebinto ebinge mbisakorwe biatananwe, nonya nebisegora mbisakore ebinto.
Onde tari bw’omochie oyio oratebe: “Inche nigo nindwarete”, ekiagera abanto abamenyete aroro mbabe baabeirwe obobe bwabo.
Inwe abanto b’ebisaku, inchuo ang’e, motegerere moigwe; inwe abanto, igwera! Tiga ense etegerere amo na bionsi ebireo, ee, oboiko bwonsi na ebigosoka korwao.
Omonene obeire nendamwamu enene ase ebisaku bionsi, na obeire nekeririanda ase emeganda yabo yonsi y’esegi; obanacheire ekina gi’okobasiria, obarure baitwe.
Emebere y’abanto baraitwe nigo eratugutwe isiko, na ogotioka kw’obogundo bw’ebitondo ebio nigo koratioke aande onsi; amanyinga ’emebere eyio natirimboke korwa ase ebitunwa igoro.
Erioba, na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni mbisirigwe; igoro neringwe buna amakaratasi, ee, ebitongwa ebio bia igoro mbiiyerigwe inse buna amato amomo ay’emesabibu na ay’emeko akogwa.
Omoro one onyure na koigota aiga igoro; rora, ngotirimboka ore oe Abaedomu egesusuro, abanto abwo nanacheire ekina.

Omoro bw’Omonene oichoirwe namanyinga, otubirwe nebitinya, ee, oichoirwe namanyinga e chimanwa chie ching’ondi, na aye chimbori, na otubirwe nebitinya bie chinyigo chie chimingichi. Omonene ngokora are ekeng’wanso agwo Bosira, na ogoitwa okonene nkobe ase ense y’Abaedomu.
Ching’era nachirochio nchiiyerigwe inse, ne chieri chinene ne chinke boigo. Ense yabo nenyiigwe namanyinga, ne riroba riabo rinore nebitinya, ekiagera
erio nerituko ri’Omonene ri’ogoakana egesiomba, ee, oyio nomwaka bw’ogoakana amabe akoretwe ase Sayoni.
Amache e chindooche chia Edomu naonchoke abe buna eramu, ne riroba ri’ense eyio ndibe buna eramu ekoyia omorero.

Omorero oyio nogenderere koyia obotuko na omobaso, tokorimigwa; erioki riaye ndichongororoke gochia igoro kogenderera botambe. Ense eyio nebe esaregete ekiaare ase ekiaare; monto onde tari oraete ase egati y’ense eyio nonya ndinde.
Chinsoti na ebirongo mbimenye aroro; ense eyio nebe eye chinyakweumia na ebigonkoru. Omonene narambore igoro yaye ekerengero gi’okoyetantania na ekebiro gi’okoyerentera obosiru.
Abanto abasike tibagotokao baranyare kobekwa bagambe; abagambi babo bonsi nigo barasire.
Amagwa namere ase chinyomba chi’oboruoti, amasa na amageri mbimere ase chiburi chi’aroro. Nabe obomenyo bwe chisese chi’orosana ne chisagero.
Aase agwo ching’iti chi’orosana nchiumeraneo ne chinyang’au ase obotuko amarengari nabe akorangerania, na ekerecha gete ngeche aroro kenyore aase kegotimokera.

Aase agwo chinyakweumia nchiagache ebiswa biabo, chibiare amagena na goturagia ebichuchu, na chibisangererie ase ekiriri gie chimbaba chiabo ime; ee agwo amakoru nasangererekaneo, kera erimo neriamwabo.
Rigia korwa ase ebuku y’Omonene, mosome: Nonya nekemo ki’ebitongwa ebio tigekobora kobeera aroro, kera ekemo goika kebe nekiamwabo. Omonene ochikire amang’ana ayio, na Omoika oye nobisangererieo.
Omonene oakeire ebitongwa ebio obomera, na okoboko kwaye kwabiatananeire ense nekerengero, ebe eyabo kogenderera botambe, mbigenderere komenya aroro ekiaare ase ekiaare.
Erooro na ense enyomo nchibe nomogoko; ee, erooro nechenge na gosicha buna ebisicha ebiya.

Nigo erasiche ebisicha ebinge, erio echenge na gotera nomogoko. Neegwe obonene buna obw’ebitunwa bia Lebanoni, na obwari buna obwa Karimeli na Saroni. Abanto mbarore obonene bw’Omonene, ee, mbarore obonene bwa Nyasae oito na obonguru bwaye.
Amaboko are amoro yabeke chinguru; kong’ia amaru arosire.
Tebia abanto abwo babwate chinkoro chinyoba: “Mobe abaremu, timwoboa! Naama! Nyasae oino nache korusia egesiomba. Rora, Nyasae nache kobaruseria egesiomba. Ere nache kobatooria.”
Erio amaiso ’emeuko aramokigwe, na amato ’emetino atinorwe.
Ebisegora mbichara‐charoke buna chinsune, ne chimeme chi’amamama nchitere nomogoko. Chindooche nchisoke ase erooro, na ebirooche ase ekerubo ekiomo.
Ense y’omokenye ogosamba nebe ritibo ri’amache, na ase ense enyomo chinsoko chi’amache nchitubokeo; aase chisese chi’orosana chiamenyete, obonyansi, na ebitonto, na amauncho mbimereo.
Enchera enene eroisirie buya nebeo; eyio nigo erarokwe “Enchera Enchenu”. Abanto batachenegeti tibagoetao; enchera eyio nigo erabe ey’abanto aba boka. Abagoeta aroro, nonya bare abariri, tibagosira.
Endo tekobao ase enchera eyio, gose eng’iti ende y’orosana tegochao, chirochio tichikonyorekana aroro, korende abanto baboorigwe nabwo barataare ase enchera eyio.
Abanto abwo Omonene abooririe mbairane, baike Sayoni bagotera; omogoko o kare na kare nobe igoro ase emetwe yabo buna egutwa; mbabe nomogoko na omochengo, obororo na omoichano mbiere kegima asebare.
Ase omwaka o ikomi na kane bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Hezekia, Senakeribu, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, akagenda, akarwania emechie yonsi y’Abayuda yagiteire chindwaki, akayebua.

Erio omoruoti oyio bw’Abaasuri agatoma Rabi‐Sake korwa Lakisi amo nabarwani esegi abange agende ase Hezekia agwo Yerusalemu. Rabi‐Sake agatenena ase omotaro bwe ritibo ria rogoro ase enchera ekogenda ase egetii ki’omosibia bw’ebitambaa bikoroisigwa chianga.
Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia, omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, na Sebuna omoriki, na Yoa mosinto bw’Asafu, oyorenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka, bagacha aroro.
Rabi‐Sake akabatebia ng’a batebie Hezekia iga: “Aya naro omoruoti omonene, oria bw’Abaasuri, agokwana: Nigoro yang’o obegete ogosemeria kwao?
Nigo okorengereria ng’a ogokwana kw’amang’ana gwoka nakwo koganeirie ase okomanya korwana esegi na koyebua? Ning’o osemeretie oragokonye goika kwangire konyingwera inche?

Rora bono, aye nigo osemeretie ense y’Abamisiri, eyio enga buna egetonto kebunegete. Omonto onde bwensi okogiesiirera, ekio nigo keramokebe okoboko. Naboigo Farao omoruoti o Misiri are ase abanto bonsi abwo bamosemeretie.

“Inee! Inwe nigo mogontebia ng’a nigo mosemeretie Omonene, Nyasae oino? Tari ere oria aase aye aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa amo nebisasimero biaye Hezekia atagoire, agatebia Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu: Mobe mogosasima bosio bw’egesasimero eke!
Inchuo moigwane mobeke rigori nomonene one, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri. Nimbae chibarasi chilifu ibere komoranyare konyora abariini be chibarasi echio.
Naki moranyare kobua omoteneneri oyomo ore omoke ase egati y’abasomba b’omonene one, ekero mosemeretie ense ya Misiri ase okonyora chigari na abariini chibarasi?
Inee! Nigo mokagete ng’a inche nigo nachire korwania ense eye na koyesaria Omonene atancheti? Taibo; Omonene nere ontebia: Genda orwanie ense eria oyesarie!”

Erio Eliakimu, na Sebuna, na Yoa, bagatebia Rabi‐Sake, “Koranche okwane naintwe, abasomba bao, ase omonwa bw’Ekearamaiki, ekiagera ntoyomanyete; tobaisa gokwana naintwe ase omonwa bw’Ekeyuda ekero abanto bare ase orwaki igoro bategererete.”

Rabi‐Sake agateba, “Inee! Omonene one nigo antoma nkwane amang’ana aya ase omonene oino na asemore mweka? Yaya, tantomete ase inwe mweka, korende nase abanto baikaransete ase orwaki igoro, abwo banacheirwe ekina amo nainwe bagochia koria obonyira bwabo na konywa amasinyoro abo bagoitera.”
Erio Rabi‐Sake agatenena, agaaka eriogi rinene ase omonwa bw’Ekeyuda, agateba, “Igwa ring’ana ri’omoruoti omonene, ore omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.
Aya naro omoruoti agokwana: Timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abang’aine, ekiagera ere takonyara kobatooria.
Timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abasirie ng’a mosemerie Omonene ekero agoteba: Ekeene, Omonene natotoorie, na omochie oyo tokobekwa ase okoboko kw’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.

Timobaisa gotegerera amang’ana a Hezekia. Aya naro omoruoti bw’Abaasuri agoteba: Kora omorembe nainche, moche asende. Erio kera omonto asemore narie okwama kw’emesabibu na okw’emeko yaye omonyene, na kera oyomo oino nanywe amache ’ensoko yaye omonyene,
goika inchiche imbarusie agwo mbaire ase ense egwekaine buna ense eyio yaino, ense ere ne chindagera, na edivai, ense ere nemegati na emegondo y’emesabibu.
Morende mono, ekero Hezekia akobang’aina, ogoteba: Omonene natotoorie. Inee! Enyasae ende yonsi y’ebisaku yatooririe ense yaye korwa ase okoboko kwane inche omoruoti bw’Abaasuri?
Ng’ai chinyasae chia Hamati na Aripadi chire? Inee! Chinyasae chia Sefariwaimu, ng’ai chire? Chiatooririe ense ya Samaria korwa ase okoboko kwane?
Nereri ase egati ye chinyasae chionsi chie chinse echio yatooririe ense yaye korwa ase okoboko kwane? Nainwe nigo mokorengereria ng’a Omonene natoorie Yerusalemu korwa ase okoboko kwane?”
Korende abanto bagakira‐kiri, tibamoiraneria nonya ne ring’ana erimo, ekiagera omoruoti konya ochikire iga: “Timobaisa komoiraneria.”

Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia, oria orenge omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, na Sebuna omoriki, na Yoa mosinto bw’Asafu, omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka, bagacha ase Hezekia bare ne chianga chitandogete, bakamotebia amang’ana ayio Rabi‐Sake akwanete.
Ekero omoruoti Hezekia aigwete amang’ana ayio, agatandora chianga chiaye, akeboyia chianga chie chigunia, erio agasoa ase enyomba y’Omonene.
Agatoma Eliakimu, oria orenge omoteneneri bw’enyomba yaye, na Sebuna omoriki, na abakuani abagaaka, beboyetie chianga chie chigunia, bagende ase Isaya omobani, mosinto bw’Amosi.

Abanto abwo bakamotebia, “Aya naro Hezekia agoteba: Rituko ria rero neri’obororo, na egesusuro, na ogochaywa, buna ekero abana babeire ang’e baiborwe, korende chinguru chi’okobasukia basoke chiaborire.

Ande nabo erabe ng’a ekero omoruoti bw’Abaasuri atomete Rabi‐Sake korama Nyasae ore moyo, ere Omonene, Nyasae oino naigwete ayio. Ere nabae egesusuro ase amang’ana ayio. Ase ayio sabera abanto abwo batigarete bare moyo.”
Ekero abasomba ba Hezekia omoruoti baigete ase Isaya,
Isaya akabatebia, “Motebie omonene oino ng’a Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Tobaisa kwoboa ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio kwaigure abasomba b’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri batebire na kondama.
Rora, nimbeke omoika gete ime yaye, erio ekero araigwe chinkuma nairoke, airane gochia ase ense yaye; nimorue aitwe nomoro, agwo ase ense yaye omonyene.”
Rabi‐Sake akairana, ekiagera aigwete ng’a omoruoti bw’Abaasuri orure Lakisi, akamonyora okorwana na Libuna.
Na ekero omoruoti bw’Abaasuri aigwete amang’ana ng’a Tirihaka, omoruoti bw’Abaetiopia, ochire korwana esegi nere, agatoma abanto ase Hezekia naende, akabatebia,
“Aya naro moratebie Hezekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda: Tobaisa gwancha Nyasae oyio oo osemeretie akong’aine, erinde orengererie ng’a Yerusalemu tokobekwa ase okoboko kw’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.
Rora, aye kwaigure aya abaruoti b’Abaasuri bakoreire chinse chionsi, bachisaririe kegima. Inee! Aye bono notooreke?
Inee! Chinyasae chi’ebisaku chiatooririe ebisaku biria chisokoro chiane chiasiretie, ebisaku bia Gosani, na Harani, na Resefu, na abanto ba Edeni, baria barenge agwo Telasari?
Ng’ai omoruoti o Hamati are, gose omoruoti bw’Aripadi, na oyo bw’omochie o Sefarawaimu, na oyo o Hena, na oyo o Iwa?”
Hezekia akaegwa rirube korwa ase abanto baria batometwe, akarisoma, erio akagenda ase enyomba y’Omonene, akarirambora ase obosio bw’Omonene.
Hezekia agasaba Omonene, agateba,
“Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aye omenyete nobonene bwao igoro y’Abakerubi, aye naye Nyasae, aye bweka, igoro y’amarouti onsi ay’ense; naye gwatongete igoro na ense
Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe! Aye Omonene, rigereria orore! Oigwe amang’ana onsi a Senakeribu, aya atomire ase ogokorama aye Nyasae ore moyo.
Aye Omonene, ekeene, abaruoti b’Abaasuri basiririe abanto b’ebisaku ne chinse chiabo,
batugutire chinyasae chi’abanto abwo ase omorero, ekiagera chirochio tichiri Nyasae, korende nemeremo y’amaboko ’abanto, chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena, na ase ayio chigasarigwa.
Bono Omonene, Nyasae oito, totoorie korwa ase okoboko kwaye, erinde amaruoti onsi are ase ense anyare komanya ng’a aye naye bweka ore Omonene.”
Erio Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, agatoma amang’ana ase Hezekia, akomotebia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Aye gwansabire igoro ya Senakeribu, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.

Ase ayio, eri nario ring’ana Omonene akwanire: Aye Senakeribu, Sayoni, omochie ore buna omoiseke omwekungi, nigo agochayete na kogosekerera; omochie o Yerusalemu nigo okogosingiseria omotwe magega yao.
Aye ning’o gwasekereire na korama? Ning’o gwaakeire eriogi riao ase ’oboenenu na kweimokereria igoro namaiso ’oboenenu? Aye kwabeire mamincha y’Omonene bw’Abaisraeli.

Goetera ase abasomba bao gwachecheirie Omonene ekero gwatebire iga: Nase chigari chiane chinyinge nariinire goika ebichuria bi’ebitunwa, goika igoro kegima ya Lebanoni. Ngatema emecharake yaye yare emetambe goetania eyende, na emetarakwa yaye emiya mono. Ngasoa ase ebinunchi biaye ime, na ime ase rinani rinoru.
Ngakunya, nkanyora amache nkonywa, ngakamia chindooche chionsi chia Misiri ne chimbaratero chi’amagoro aane.

“Inee! Aye tikwana koigwa ng’a nigo nachigete ayio kare, ngakora emeroberio eyio ase amatuko a kare? Bono ngoikerania inde amang’ana ayio ng’a aye osarie emechie egiteire chindwaki ebe amaturi are chitui chi’amagena.
Abanto be chinse echio nigo barenge abareu batari na nguru, bakaondoka na gosookigwa, bakaba buna ebimeri bire mogondo, na buna obonyansi oborere bomerete kerama igoro bogosusana botarakina.
“Nimanyete ekero oikaransete na ekero ogosoka isiko, na ekero okoirana. Boigo nimanyete buna ore nekeririanda asende.

Ekiagera kwabeire na kerokio asende, na oboenenu bwao bwaikire ase amato aane, nimbeke ekegobanio ase chimioro chiao ime, na egento kiane ki’ogokoraa ase omonwa oo, ninkoiranie ogendere enchera eria gwacherete.

“Eke nakio ekemanyererio asore Hezekia: Omwaka oyo inamorie endagera ekwemeria yoka enyene, na omwaka o kabere boigo. Erio omwaka o gatato imobusure na kogesa, imosimeke emesabibu ase emegondo na morie okwama kwabo.
Na abatigari b’enyomba ya Yuda abaratooreke mbaame babe buna ebimeri biirete emeri inse mono na gokina gochia igoro, bikwama amatunda,
ekiagera abatigari mbache korwa Yerusalemu, na korwa ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, ekeombe ki’abanto baratooreke. Risemi ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda ndiikeranie amang’ana ayio.
“Ase igo, aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro y’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri: Ere tagocha ase omochie oyo, gose takoruta omogwe aroro; tagocha ase omochie oyo ne chinguba, gose takoagacha eburi bosio bwaye.
Naende nigo agoteba ng’a enchera eria acherete, eyio nero arairanere, gose takonyara gosoa ase omochie oyo.
Inche ning’egere omochie oyo na koyotooria ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one.”

Erio omomalaika bw’Omonene akagenda ase egetwori ki’Abaasuri agaita abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato na isano (185,000). Ekero abanto babogete mambia, bakarora emebere y’abanto bakwete ere aande onsi.
Senakeribu, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, akarua agwo, akagenda nka bwoye, akamenya Nineva.

Ekero arenge gosasima ime ase enyomba ya Nisiroki, enyasae yaye, Adarameleki na Sareseri, abamura baye, bakamoita nemioro, erio bagatama gochia ase ense y’Ararati. Ezara‐Hadoni, omomura oye, akaba omoruoti ribaga riaye.

Ase amatuko aria Hezekia akarwara, akaba ang’e nogokwa. Isaya omobani, mosinto bw’Amosi, agacha asare, akamotebia, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ebeke ang’e, amo nenyomba yao, ekiagera aye goika okwe, tokogwena.”
Hezekia akaonchora obosio bwaye gochia ase enyasi, agasaba Omonene,
akabora, “Bono Omonene nagosoroire, inyora buna nabeire ngokobwatia ase obwegenwa, na ase enkoro yane yonsi, naende nakorire ayare amaronge ase obosio bwao.” Erio. Hezekia akarera nobororo.
Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Isaya, rikamotebia,
“Irana otebie Hezekia ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae o Daudi sokoro yaye, nigo ngoteba iga: Naigure ogosaba kwao, narorire amariga ao. Rora, nakomentire emiaka ikomi na etano ase obogima bwao.
Ningotoorie aye amo nomochie oyo, korwa ase okoboko kw’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri; ning’egere omochie oyo.
“Eke nakio ekemanyererio asore korwa ase Omonene, ng’a naikeranie amang’ana ayio atebire:

Rora, ase ekerengero gie chinsa ki’Ahasi ninkore omorengari oria otambeire ekero erioba riereerire oirane gochia nyuma ebitambokero ikomi.” Ase ayio erioba rikairania omorengari oye ebitambokero ikomi ase ekerengero keria.
Nyuma Hezekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, kagwenire korwa ase oborwaire bwaye, akarika ogotera oko:
Nigo narengereretie ng’a ngochia gokwa inde ase emiaka y’oboke bwane; ningende ase ebiita bi’aase abakure, naurirwe emiaka yane yatigarete.
Ngateba, “Tinkorora Omonene naende ase ense y’abare moyo, gose korora monto onde bwensi ase aba bamenyete ase ense eye y’obosiru.

Obomenyo bwane bwatagoirwe na korusigwa asende buna eema y’omorisia, naringire obogima bwane buna omoroisia ebitambaa akobiringa; nabutoirwe korwa ase egekorero; ekero botaraira, aye nigo okoeria obogima bwane.
Nigo nkorera ase obotuko bwonsi ng’a nkonywe; Omonene obunire amauga aane buna endo ekobuna ebi yaitire; ekero botaraira ere nigo akoeria obogima bwane.
Nigo nkorera buna egesingororo gose ebarara; nigo nkweumia buna riruma. Amaiso aane arosire ase okorigereria gochia igoro. Aye Omonene, nigo inde nemechando emenene, indwanerere!”
Inki bono ngokwana? Omonene nere okwanire nainche, nere omonyene okorire amang’ana aya. Ase igo nintaare inde nobokanyeku ase emiaka yane yonsi, ase engencho y’obororo bwonsi bw’omoyo one.
Aye Omonene, ase okoba namang’ana buna ayio, abanto nigo bakoba moyo, na obogima bw’omoika one nao bore ase ayio, na bono ingwenie kegima na onkore imbe moyo.
Naama! Nigo narenge nobororo obonge, na obororo obwo bokandetera omorembe. Ase obwanchani bwao gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase engoro y’obosareku; gwatugutire ebibe biane bionsi gochia nyuma yao.
Abare aase abakure tibagokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, abwo bakure tibakogotogia; abwo bakogenda ase chimbeera ime tibagosemeria obwegenwa bwao.
Omonto ore moyo nere orakoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono, buna inche ngokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase rituko ria rero; ise abana nere agokora obwegenwa bwao bwamanyekana ase abana baye.
Omonene nantoorie; ase ayio ntobe togotera amatera, ase okobugia amakano aane, ase obogima bwaito bwonsi, agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene.
Bono Isaya konya otebire iga: “Tiga baimokie ribomba ri’amako, baribeke ase rigumba ria Hezekia, erinde agwene.”
Boigo Hezekia konya oboririe iga: “Nkemanyererio ki gekonyorokia ng’a ningende ase enyomba y’Omonene?”

Ase engaki eria omoruoti o Babeli Merodaki‐Baladani, mosinto o Baladani, agatoma abanto bakaira rirube na ebiegwa ase Hezekia, ekiagera aigwete ng’a Hezekia nabete omorwaire, naende ng’a konya ogwenire.

Hezekia akabaroisia buya, erio akaborokia chimonga chiaye chionsi, ne chifeta, ne chitahabu, na ebinsari, na amaguta e rigori rinene, na ebirwanero biaye bionsi, na ebinto bionsi biagachire ase chinyomba chiaye. Tatigete gento kende gionsi ase enyomba yaye, gose ase chikungo chi’oboruoti bwaye, ataborogetie.
Erio omobani Isaya agacha ase Hezekia, omoruoti akamoboria, “Ngento ki abanto aba bakwana? Ng’ai barwa bagacha asore?” Hezekia akamoiraneria, “Barabwo nigo barwa Babeli, ense y’aare, bagacha asende.”
Isaya akamoboria, “Ngento ki barora ase enyomba yao?” Hezekia akairaneria, “Nigo barora ebinto bionsi bire ase enyomba yane, tikeri nonya negento ekemo ase amagachero aane ntaborokia.”
Erio Isaya agatebia Hezekia, “Bono igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Eganda:

Naama! Amatuko ngocha are, ekero ebinto bionsi bire ase enyomba yao, na ebinto bionsi chisokoro chiao chiagachete goika rero iga nabiimokigwe biirwe Babeli. Nonya negento ekemo tikegotigara. Aya naro Omonene atebire.
Boigo abana bande bao abamura, abwo kwaiboreirwe, inabairwe, bachie koba abakoreri ase enyomba y’omoruoti o Babeli.”
Erio Hezekia agatebia Isaya, “Ring’ana ri’Omonene aye gwakwanire nerigiya.” Naende akamotebia, “Omorembe na okorendwa okuya nigo bigochia koba ase obogima bwane.”
Remia abanto baane! Ee, remia abanto baane! Nabo Nyasae oino atebire.

Kwana amang’ana ’obwororo ase Yerusalemu, moyorarerie ng’a emechando yaye yaerire, na ebibe biaye biabeirwe, naende ng’a Yerusalemu onyorire okwaberwa ara kabere korwa ase okoboko kw’Omonene ase ebibe biaye bionsi.
Igwa eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ogoteba: “Roisia enchera y’Omonene ase erooro; rongeyia enchera enene ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, agwo ase erooro.
Kera rigoko nditichwe rimokerere igoro, na kera egetunwa na ekegoro nabiiranigwe inse, aase atareng’aini nareng’anigwe, na aase are ebitunwa‐tunwa naaranigwe.
Obonene bw’Omonene mboorokigwe, na mwanyabanto bonsi mbaborore bare amo. Omonene nere okwanire amang’ana ayio.”
Eriogi rigoteba, “Raria amang’ana!” Na erinde rikoboria, “Mang’ana ki nkoraria?” “Raria ng’a mwanyabanto bonsi nigo banga buna obonyansi, obuya bwabo bwonsi nigo bonga egesicha kere mogondo.
Obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo, ekero Omonene abiuteire omoika oye; naboigo na mwanyabanto banga buna obonyansi.
Ee, obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo, korende ring’ana ria Nyasae oito nigo rirabeo goika kare na kare.”

Aye Sayoni, omoraria bw’amang’ana amaya, tiira gochia ase ebitunwa ebitambe igoro. Aye Yerusalemu, omoraria bw’amang’ana amaya, aka eriogi riao ne chinguru; ee, aka eriogi mono, toiroka; tebia emechie y’Abayuda iga: “Rora Nyasae oino!”
Rora, Omonene Nyasae ngocha are ore nokobua, okoboko kwaye nkobe gokogamba. Naama! Nigo agocha obwate eng’eria yaye, na ebiasakoire nigo bire ase obosio bwaye.

Narisie riicho riaye buna omorisia akorisia ching’ondi chiaye, nasangererie chimanwa chie ching’ondi achiagate, nachibogorie ase egekuba kiaye, na echi chire ne chimanwa ching’are nachiraae ng’ora ng’ora.

Ning’o orengire amache e chinyancha noroe rw’okoboko kwaye? Ning’o oramboire ebiara bi’amaboko aye korenga igoro? Ning’o obekire orotu rw’ense ase ekerengero, gose ning’o orengire ebitunwa na ebigoro nekerengero?
Ning’o okoraa Omoika bw’Omonene, gose ning’o okomosemia na komotebereria?
Ning’o Omonene akoboria amosemie amang’ana buya? Ning’o omworokereretie oboeto bw’oboronge, na komworokia okomanya, gose komworokia enchera y’okomanya?
Naama! Ebisaku nigo binga buna entonyi y’amache egotonya korwa ase enyongo. Nigo bireng’anirie norotu orosinini rore ase esani ekorengera; rora, nigo akoimokia ebisinka buna orotu orosinini.
Emete ye rinani ria Lebanoni tegoisana ebe chinko chigouterwa omorero, ne ching’iti chionsi chireo tichigoisana chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
Ebisaku bionsi nigo bire bosa ase obosio bwaye, nigo abibarete buna negento bosa, bitaisaini kende.
Nyasae, ning’o moramoreng’anie, gose mogwekano ki moramoreng’anie?
Omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa nigo okobombwa nomoroisia ebinto, erio omoturi oyooma netahabu, naende oyoroiseria ebinyuri bi’efeta.
Omonto ore omotaka otabwati ebinge akorua nigo agochora omote otari kogunda, origia omoroisia omong’aini omanyete kobaacha, ere omobaachera omogwekano otari gosuka.
Inee! Timwana komanya? Timwana koigwa? Timwana gotebigwa amang’ana ayio korwa omochakano? Timwana koyamanya korwa omochakano bw’oboroso bw’ense?

Ere nere oikaransete ase orosingo rw’ense, na abamenyete ase ense nigo banga buna ebisase; nere okorambora igoro chionsi buna egetambaa gekoramborwa, ee, nigo agochirambora buna eema ekomenywa ekoramborwa.
Omonene nigo agokeyia abagambi baba bosa, na abagambi ebina b’ense boigo baba bosa.
Abwo nigo banga buna ebimeri bisimekire masomberera, bitaireti emeri inse. Omonene nigo akobaguseria embeo, boma, na omoubera noro obairurukia buna okoirurukia obonyansi obwomo.
Oyore Omochenu nigo akoboria iga: “Ning’o rende moranyare kondeng’ania, ng’a imbe buna oyio?”

Rigereria gochia igoro morore! Ning’o otongete ebinto ebio bionsi? Nere oria okoraa emeganda y’ebitongwa ebio ase omobaro obo, na koroka kera ekemo erieta riaye. Okobua kwaye nokonene mono, ne chinguru chiaye nigo chire nokobua, ase ayio kende tikeremeti nonya nekemo.
Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, nase ki mogoteba ng’a Omonene tarochi chinchera chiaino, naende ng’a ere Nyasae obarinire oboronge bwaino?
Inee! Timwana komanya gose koigwa, ng’a Omonene nigo are Nyasae o kare na kare, na Omotongi bwe chinsinyo chi’ense? Ere tari kogoya gose korosa. Obong’aini bwaye tibokorigigwa bomanyekane buna bore.
Ere nigo akoa omonto oyo ogoyire chinguru, na oyo otari na nguru nigo akomomentera chinguru.
Abasae mbagoye na korosa, na abamura mbagochwe bagwe inse,
korende abwo baganyete na gosemeria Omonene mbaegwe chinguru chinyia, mbairuruke gochia igoro ne chimbaba buna echi’ebiongo; mbabe bakominyoka batari korosa, mbabe bagotaara batari kogoya.
“Inwe ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, mokire‐kiri, montegerere, tiga abanto b’ebisaku banyore chinguru chinyia, tiga basuke gocha ang’e, bakwane; toche amo, toike ang’e ase ekina.

“Ning’o orangeretie oyomo korwa moocha, oria oumeranete nobobui aande onsi ase agendete? Ere nigo akobeka abanto b’ebisaku inse y’okobua kwaye, erinde atachere abaruoti inse y’amagoro aye; oyio nigo agoita abanto b’ebisaku nomoro, obakora baba buna orotu, na ase obota bwaye nigo akobasiarera buna obonyansi obwomo.
Nigo akobabwatia, oeta na orendire buya, ase chinchera atana goeta rinde.
Ning’o okorete na goikerania aya? Ning’o orangeretie ebiaare bi’abanto korwa omochakano? Ninche Omonene, ninche oyo bw’omochakano; ninche oyo bw’omoerio, ninche Ere.”
Ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha chiarorire ayio chiamwoboire, chinsinyo chi’ense nigo chigotengechigwa; chiasukire gocha ang’e.
Kera omonto nigo agokonya omogisangio oye; oyomo otebia oyonde, “Kabe omoremu!”
Omosenia bwe chibao nigo akobeka omoturi bw’etahabu omokia, na omoturi ebioma obeka omoturagi chinguru, oteba, “Oborembo bw’okobwatania nobuya.” Erio babwatania omogwekano nemesumari tonyegera.
“Korende inwe Abaisraeli, abasomba baane, inwe nabanto ba Yakobo nachorete, inwe nigo more ab’ororeria rwa Ibrahimu, omosani one.
Nigo nabarusetie korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense, nkabarangeria korwa ase chinsinyo chi’aare mono, nkabatebia: Inwe nabasomba baane, nabachorire, timbaangeti.
Ase ayio timoiroka, inche nigo inde amo nainwe, timoichana, inche ninche Nyasae oino; nimbabeke chinguru, mbakonye, nimbasiire nokoboko gw’okorio kw’oboronge bwane.
“Rora, abwo bonsi babagechete mbasookigwe na gotantanigwa; abwo bakobaengereria mbabe bosa basirigwe.
Nigo morabarigie abwo bakobasoera, ko timokobanyora; abwo barenge kobarwania nigo barabe bosa kegima.
Ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nimbabwate amaboko aino a borio. Ninche nkobatebia inwe: Timoiroka, nimbakonye.
“Inwe ororeria rwa Yakobo ronga buna rikonde, inwe ekeombe egeke ki’Abaisraeli, timoiroka! Inche Omonene nimbakonye. Ninche Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli inde Omobooria oino.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
“Rora, nimbakore inwe mobe egekorero gi’okoora, kere ekiya na kere namaara amoge; inwe moore ebitunwa, mobisamunyore, imokore ebigoro bibe buna omoiriro.
Mobisiare, na omwaga obirurukie gochia aare, erio ekembugu‐mbugu kebisiarere. Inwe abanyene mogoke ase Omonene na komwetogeria oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
“Ekero abataka na abaremeire barabe bakorigia amache na tibayanyora, ekero chimeme chiabo chirabe chiabwatanire namang’ang’ura; inche Omonene nimbaigwe, inche Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tinkobatiga.
Nindete chindooche korwa ase ebigoro ebiomo, ne chinsoko nchituboke ase amagoko ime; ning’onchore erooro ebe ritibo ri’amache, na ense enyomo ebe ne chinsoko chire namache.
Nimerie emecharake ase erooro, boigo nimerie aroro emekonge, na emeadasi, na emezeituni. Ee, nimerie emetarakwa na emete

ende egwekaine emeuru, na emebeno amo, erinde abanto mbarore na komanya, naende mbarengererie bamanye bonsi amo, ng’a nokoboko kw’Omonene gwakorire ayio, ee, ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli nere otongete ebio bionsi.”
Omonene, Omoruoti bw’abanto ba Yakobo, nigo agoteba iga: “Renta amang’ana aino, renta oborori bwaino botoenekerie.
Tiga baborente bototebie aya agochia koba; tiga bototebie amang’ana a kare buna arenge, erinde tonyare koyarengereria na komanya buna aikeranetigwe, naende botoorokerie buna amang’ana agochia koba.
Totebie aya agochi‐gocha, erinde tomanye ng’a inwe ne chinyasae; kora amang’ana amaya, gose amabe erinde tokorora ayio tokumie.
Naama! Inwe nigo more bosa kegima, na emeremo yaino nero mbosa kegima; oyo obachorire inwe na kobasasima nigo are okogechia.

“Inarangeretie omonto korwa sugusu, ere ochire; ee, nigo namorusirie korwa moocha, ere narangerie erieta riane akonywe, natiringere abagambi inse buna esike egotiringwa, na buna omokori chinyongo agotiringa esike.
Ning’o obanete amang’ana ayio agwo kare, erinde tonyare komanya ng’a amang’ana oyio atebete nay’ekeene? Onde tari nonya noyomo oyaorogetie na koyararia; onde tari oigwete komokoyakwana.
Ninche Omonene nigo narenge omotang’ani gotebia Sayoni: Rigereria, morore abwo! Ninche narenterete Yerusalemu abwo bararetie amang’ana amaya.
Korende ekero narigereretie tinaroche monto onde, nonya nase egati yabo mosemia onde tarengeo; ekero naboretie, onde tarengeo ong’iraneretie.
Naama! Chinyasae echio chionsi mbosa. Emeremo eyio y’abanto nigo ere bosa kegima, ee, emegwekano eyio abanto babombete nigo enga embeo bosa.”
“Rora, omosomba one oyio inche nabekire chinguru ime yaye; omochore one omoyo one ogokirie nere. Namobekeire Omoika one, nere orarente oboronge ase abanto b’ebisaku.
Ere takorera, gose tagoaka eriogi rinene, gose takoritiga riigugwe ase chinchera.
Egetonto giatachetwe tagokebuna, gose orotambe rw’etaya rokoimoka erioki takororimia. Ase obwegenwa bwaye narente oboronge.
Ere takorosa gose gokwa omoyo; goika abe orentire oboronge ase ense na kobokong’ia, na ebisinka, ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha nchibe chiganyete amachiko aye.”
Omonene Nyasae, oyotongete igoro chionsi na gochirambora, oyo bwarete ense na bionsi ebikorwao, oyo oete abanto bareo obogima, na kobaa omoika abwo bagotaara aroro, nigo agoteba iga:
“Inche ninche Omonene, nakorangeirie ase oboronge; nakobwatire okoboko kwao nkorendete. Goetera asore ninkore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabanto, obe omobaso bw’abanto b’ebisaku.
Oramokie amaiso ’emeuko, osibore abasibwa korwa ase echela, na abwo bamenyete ase omosunte korwa ase obosibwa bwabo.
“Inche ninche Omonene, erio nario erieta riane; tindi koa omonto onde obonene bwane; tinkoa emegwekano egosasimwa ogotogigwa kwane.
Rora, amang’ana natebete agwo kare aikeranire, na bono nigo nkobarareria amang’ana amayia, nkobayamanyia atarakorekana.”

Moterere Omonene ogotera okoyia; motogie korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense! Inwe abaeti ase enyancha amo nebinto bionsi bire imeo, inwe abamomenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, motogie Omonene!
Tiga erooro na emechie ereo biake amariogi, na abamenyete ase emechie ya Kedari boigo. Abanto bamenyete ase omochie o Sela mbatere nomogoko, baake eriogi korwa ase ebichuria bi’ebitunwa igoro.
Abwo bonsi batogie Omonene na koraria obonene bwaye ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha.
Omonene naoroke buna etuoni y’esegi, na buna omorwani esegi abokie omokia oye; nigo agoaka eriogi ri’esegi na kwoga mono, nigo akweorokia ng’a nare nokobua igore y’ababisa baye.
“Inche nabeire nkirete‐kiri ase engaki entambe, nabeire ngendererete gwetanga na gokira; korende bono ning’ake eriogi buna eri’omokungu okobina aibore; ning’use omoika na goita egekoe.
Ninsarie kegima ebitunwa na ebigoro, ninyomie ebimeri biabo bionsi; ning’onchore chindooche chibe ense enyomo, ninkamie amatibo.”

“Nindaae abanto bare emeuko ase enchera batana komanya, nimbatang’ane ase oboeto batana komanya. Ning’onchore omosunte ore bosio bwabo obe oborabu, aase atareng’aini naaranigwe. Ayio naro ndabakorere, tingotiga goikerania amang’ana aane.
Korende abanto basemeretie emegwekano egosasimwa mbairanigwe nyuma, basookigwe, ekiagera nigo bagotebia emegwekano eyio ebombire; Inwe ninwe chinyasae chiaito.”
“Inwe abamore emetino, tegerera moigwe, nainwe abamore emeuko, rigereria monyare korora!
Ning’o ore omouko otatiga omosomba one? Ning’o ore omotino buna omonto one natomire? Ning’o ore omouko buna omwegenwa one, gose buna omosomba one inche Omonene?
Omosomba one nigo akorora ebinto ebinge, korende tari kobirengereria ng’a nebi’engencho enene; nigo atinogete amato aye, korende tari koigwa.”
Ase engencho y’oboronge bwaye Omonene nigo agogete koa amachiko aye okobua na ogosikwa.

Korende abanto aba baibirwe na gosakorwa, bonsi bategirwe na kogwa ase chiirima; nigo babisire ase chinyomba chi’obosibwa; bairirwe, onde tari orabatoorie, boosirwe, onde tari ogoteba: “Tiga bairanigwe.”
Ning’o asemore oranyare gotegerera amang’ana aya, erio ayarengererie na koyaigwera ase chingaki chigochi‐gocha.

Ning’o oruete abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo ase amaboko ’abasakori? Ning’o oruete Abaisraeli ase amaboko ’abauri? Inee! Tari Omonene oria twakorete ebibe asare? Tokaanga kobwatia chinchera chiaye, naende tokaanga koigwera amachiko aye.

Ase ayio Omonene akaumora ekeririanda kiaye ase abanto, akabaumorera endamwamu yaye egwoka, na esegi entindi. Abanto bakaba bagosambwa nomorero ase chinsemo chionsi, ko tibamanyete kende, ee, omorero oria okabasamba, korende tibarengereretie ayio ime ase chinkoro chiabo.
Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, aya naro Omonene oria obatongete na kobabomba agoteba; “Timoiroka, ekiagera inche nababooririe; nabarangeirie ase amarieta aino; inwe nabaane.
Ekero morabe mogoeta ase amache ime, nimbe amo nainwe; namoba mogoeta ase chindooche, tichikobamera. Namoete ase omorero, timogosambwa, gose omorero ekebemberi tokobasiria.
Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, ninche Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, ninche Omotooria oino. Nigo naruete Abamisiri bakaba embooria ase engencho yaino, nkarua Abaetiopia na Abaseba ribaga riaino.
Inwe nigo more ab’engencho enene ase amaiso aane, mwabeire mosikire, nainche nigo mbanchete; ase ayio nindue abanto b’ebisaku basirigwe ribaga riaino, erinde obogima bwaino botoorigwe.
Ase ayio, timoiroka, inche nigo inde amo nainwe. “Nindete abanto b’ororeria rwaino korwa moocha, na korwa bosongo nimbasangererie.
Nintebie chinse chia sugusu: Tiga abanto baane barue agwo, ne chinse chia irianyi: Timobatanga! Renta abamura baane korwa aare, na abaiseke baane korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense.
Kera omonto okorokwa ase erieta riane, oyio inche natongete anyore obonene bwane, kera oyomo oyio inche nabombete na komotonga, tiga ache.”
Renta abanto bonsi bare emeuko nonya babwate amaiso, na abare emetino nonya babwate amato.

Tiga abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bache amo, ee, tiga abanto bonsi basangererekane bache. Ning’o ore ase egati yabo oranyare koraria amang’ana aya? Ning’o oranyare gotworokia amang’ana ayabete kare? Tiga barente birori biabo, erinde baorokie oboronge bwabo, na ekero baraigwe batebe: “Nekeene mogoteba.”

Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Inwe nigo more birori baane, abasomba baane nachorire, erinde monyare komanya inche na konyegena, naende momanye ng’a inche ninche Ere. Enyasae ende teri yantang’anerete, ende teri erabombwe nyuma yane.”
“Inche ninche Omonene, ninche bweka inde Omotooria, naende onde tari.
Nigo narentete ogotooreka, nkabarareria ayio, nainwe mokayaigwa, na enyasae engeni tiyarenge ase egati yaino; inwe nigo more birori baane ng’a inche ninche Nyasae.” Naboigo Omonene atebire.
“Ee, inche ninche Nyasae; nigo ngendererete koba oyio oyio. Omonto tari oranyare gotooria omonto onde korwa ase okoboko kwane, nigo ngokora emeremo, na onde tari oranyare koyetanga.”

Aya naro Omonene, Omobooria oino oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: “Ase engencho yaino nintome abarwani esegi gochia Babeli baserie abanto b’aroro, erinde batame; ee, Abakalidayo abwo baserigwe gochia ase chimeeri chiabo echio bagokerete.
Inche ninche Omonene, Omochenu oino, ninche omotongi oino inwe Abaisraeli, ninche inde omoruoti oino.”
Omonene oroisetie enchera ase enyancha ime, ee, oboeto ase amache amange are ne chinguru,

akarenta aroro chigari chi’esegi ne chibarasi, na abarwani esegi amo ne chituoni chiabo, erio akabaiyeria inse, tibatenena naende; nigo basiretigwe bakarima buna orotambe rw’etaya. Aya naro Omonene oyio agoteba:
“Timobaisa koinyora amang’ana a kare, gose korengereria igoro y’ebinto biaetire.
Naama! Ninkore ring’ana riyia; ring’ana erio riachakire kooroka; Inee! Timorirochi? Nindoisie enchera ase erooro, nintubokie chindooche ase ense enyomo,
erinde ching’iti chi’orosana amo nebibwe ne chisagero chinywe chintogie. Ekero ekio nintubokie amache ase erooro, ne chindooche ase ense enyomo, ng’ee abanto baane, abwo nachorire, amache banywe,
abanto abwo netongeire, erinde bararie ogotogigwa kwane.”
“Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, timwandangeretie, ee, inwe Abaisraeli, timwanyechanderete.

Inwe timwandeterete ching’ondi chiaino chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose timwansigete ase okonduera ebing’wanso biaino. Inche timbaroseti ase okonduera okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose timbachandeti ase ogonsambera ubani.
Timwangorerete ebinto bigotioka buya ne chibesa chiaino. Timwang’isanegetie nebitinya bi’ebing’wanso biaino. Taibo! Korende nigo mwandosirie nebibe biaino; mwanchandire nogosaria kwaino.
“Inche ninche bweka ngotinyia ogosaria kwao, ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na tinkoinyora ebibe biao.
Ong’inyorie, tokwane komo, aye na inche; okwane amang’ana ao, erinde onyore oboronge bwao.
Sokoro yao bwe ritang’ani nigo akorete ebibe, na abarenge abakwani b’amang’ana ao bagasaria asende,
Ase ayio ngatiga abanene b’Aase Achenu bakaba abatachenegeti, nkarua abanto ba Yakobo bakaba okoragererigwa, ee, nkarua Abaisraeli ase ogochaywa.”
“Aye Yakobo, omosomba one, aye Israeli nagochorire, bono igwa!
Omonene, oria ogotongete ase enda ya nyoko, naende okogokonya, nigo agoteba iga: Aye Yakobo, omosomba one, aye Yerusalemu, omochore one, toiroka.
“Ning’umore amache ase abare nerang’o, nintubokie chindooche ase ense enyomo. Ning’umore Omoika one igoro ase abanto b’ororeria rwao, ninsesenie abana bao.
Abwo mbakine buna obonyansi, bakine buna emesobeti ere ase chindooche mbarabare.
Oyomo natebe ng’a noyo bw’Omonene are, na oyonde eroke erieta ria Yakobo, na oyonde arike ase okoboko kwaye ng’a ere noyo bw’Omonene, erio eroke Omoisraeli, erieta ri’ogosikwa.”
Aya naro Omonene, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli na Omobooria obo, oyore Omonene b’Emeganda, agoteba: “Ninche oyo bwe ritang’ani, na oyo bw’omoerio; onde tari, otatiga inche bweka inde Nyasae.

Ning’o oranyare kobana buna inche, buna nabanete korwa ekero keria nabegete abanto abwo ba kare? Tiga ararie amang’ana ayio na koyanyorokia. Oyio tiga atebie abanto amang’ana are bosio agochia gokoreka.

Timoiroka, gose kwoboa! Inee! Tinabatebetie amang’ana ayio korwa kare na kobayamanyia? Inwe nigo more birori baane. Inee! Nyasae onde nareo, otatiga inche? Getare kende tikeri. Nimanyete ng’a kende tikeri.”

Abanto abwo bonsi bakoroisia emegwekano y’ogosasimwa nigo bare bosa, na emegwekano eyio teri kobarentera buya bonde. Abwo bakoyebera birori tibakorora, gose tibakomanya gento kende; ase igo mbasookigwe.
Ning’o okwebaachera enyasae na kwebombera ogosasimwa bitari gokonya nonyang’ake?
Naama! Abatunyani bonsi b’emegwekano eyio mbasookigwe, na abakoyeroisia nigo bare mwanyabanto. Abwo bonsi tiga basangererekane amo, bache bosio; bonsi amo nigo baraondoke, basooke.

Omoturi ebioma nigo akobogoria enturago yaye otura ekioma. Nigo agokebeka igoro ase omorero bw’amakara, ogesamba, erio okebomba ase ogokebaraga nokoboko kwaye kore ne chinguru. Ekero agendererete koroisia omogwekano oyio, nigo akoba nenchara na erang’o ogoya.

Omosenia chibao nigo akorambora ekerengo, bwata omong’ororia nekaramu ase ebao. Erio oyesenia neranda, oyeng’ororia ekeringerera, naende oyebaacha yaba omogwekano bw’omonto omonyakieni, oyobeka nyomba ime.
Omonto nigo akogenda ase rinani ogecha emecharake, gose bwechorera emete ao ao enga buna emetontera, oyetiga egokina agwo ase rinani, gose bwesimekera omobunduki, embura yaba ekoyokinia.

Omote oria gokinire nigo okoba chinko chi’omonto oria; ere nigo akonyonacha ekeng’ese outera omorero agwota na korugera endagera, na ekeng’ese kende okebacha kiaba enyasae agosasima, nigo gekoba omogwekano ere oba okoyosasima.
Ase ekeng’ese kende omonto oria nigo agoutera omorero, osambera chinyama, ochiria na koigota, na ekero autire omorero oria nigo agoteba, “Ee, bono nabeire ne riberera; omorero oyo nomuya!”
Ekeng’ese egetigari ki’omote oria nigo agokebaacha ogekora enyasae, omogwekano agosasima; nigo agotung’ama bosio bwaye oyosasima oteba, “Ntoorie, ekiagera naye enyasae yane!”
Abanto bagokora ayio nabariri, tibamanyeti kende. Amaiso abo aukoire, tibakonyara korora, na ebirengererio biabo biasarigwe, tibakonyara komanya.

Monto onde tari ase abwo okorengereria mono, gose ore nobong’aini na okomanya erinde atebe, “Ekeng’ese ki’omote oyio nageutera omorero, nkayorugera endagera, boigo nkayosambera chinyama nkaria. Inee! Korwa ase ekio egetigari ningekore egento gi’okogechia? Ningekore enyasae ngosasima, eroisirie korwa ase omote?”
Oyio nigo asemeretie ayare buna ribu; enkoro yaye yang’ainekire, yamosiririe, takonyara gwetooria na goteba, “Egento eke mbwate koboko kwane gw’okorio neki’oborimo.”
“Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, inyora amang’ana aya, ekiagera inwe nabasomba baane. Inwe Abaisraeli, tinkobeeba.
Natinyirie ogosaria kwaino buna ngotinyia riire, na ebibe biaino buna ngotinyia ritaturi. Ing’iranere, ekiagera nababooririe.”

Inwe igoro chionsi, tera nomogoko, ekiagera Omonene oikeranirie ayio; naye ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omochengo! Inwe ebitunwa, na amanani, na kera omote ore aroro, tera nechinguru chinyinge, ekiagera Omonene obooririe abanto ba Yakobo, neorokie ase egati y’Abaisraeli ore nobonene.

Aya naro Omonene, Omobooria oo, oyogotongete ase enda ya nyoko, agoteba: “Ninche Omonene natongete ebinto bionsi; ninche bweka naramborete igoro chionsi, nkaara ense gochia chinsinyo chionsi, na onde tarengeo onkonyete.
Inche nigo ngosaria ebimanyererio bi’ababani b’oborimo na gokora abaringoria baba chiosi. Nigo nkoirania nyuma obong’aini bw’abang’aini na gokora okomanya kwabo kwaba oboriri.

Inche nigo ngokora ring’ana ri’omosomba one riaba ne chinguru na goikerania emeroberio y’abatomwa baane. Ninche ngoteba igoro ya Yerusalemu ng’a nomenywe, na igoro y’emechie y’Abayuda ng’a neagachwe naende; ninche ndatenenie amaagacho ayio agwete inse.
Ninche ngoteba igoro ye chindiba chie chinyancha ng’a chiome pa, ninche ndakamie chindooche chiaye.

Nigo ngoteba igoro ya Koresi ng’a namobekire abe omorisia bw’abanto baane; ere naikeranie ogwancha kwane gwonsi, na atebe igoro ya Yerusalemu ng’a oagachwe naende, naende atebe igoro ye Hekalu ng’a oboroso bwaye bobekwe naende.”
Omonene ochorire Koresi, omobwatire okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, amobuere ebisaku na aure abaruoti okobua kwabo. Amoigorere ebisieri, na ebiita tibisiekwa. Bono aya naro Omonene akomotebia:
“Inche nintang’ane bosio bwao, ninyaranie ebitunwa na ebigoro, nimbuna‐bune ebiita bie chitaai, nimbutorane emekorogoto y’ebioma.
Ninkoe chinibo chibisire ase omosunte, na obotenenku bore aase a bobisi, erinde onyare komanya ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ngokorangeria ase erieta riao.
Nigo ngokorangeria ase erieta riao ase engencho ya Yakobo, omosomba one, ee, ase engencho ya Israeli, omochore one. Nakoeire erieta ri’amasikani, nonya aye tomanyeti inche.”
“Inche ninche Omonene, onde tari; Nyasae onde tari otatiga inche bweka. Nigo nakoboyirie chinguru nonya aye tomanyeti inche.
Nigo ngokora ayio, erinde abanto bamenyete moocha na bosongo banyare komanya ng’a onde tari otatiga inche bweka. Inche ninche Omonene, na onde tari.
Ninche Omotongi bw’oborabu na omosunte, nigo nkorenta omorembe, narenta na amabe; Inche ninche Omonene, ngokora ayio onsi.
Inwe igoro chionsi, tonyia amatoima, oboronge tiga borwe igoro, botwe buna amare agotwa embura; ense tiga emaanoke, eichorwe nogotooreka na oboronge. Ninche Omonene natongire ayio.”

“Obobe nobw’oyio okoamererania n’Omotongi oye, oyio ore ekegonkorio ase egati y’ebinde. Inee! Esike neborie omoroisia iga: Ninki eke okoroisia? Gose ekeroisirie ngetebie omoroisia iga: Aye tobwati amaboko?
Obobe nobw’oyio okoboria ise: Inki aye okoibora? Gose koboria ng’ina: Inki eke obogoretie inda yao ogochia koibora?”
Aya naro Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli na Omotongi obo, agoteba: “Mborie inche igoro y’amang’ana agochia koba; ntige inyechandere abana baane, ekiagera abwo nemeremo y’amaboko aane.
Ninche natongete ense, ngatonga na abanto, nkababeka aroro; amaboko aane naro aramborete igoro, erio ngachika erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, kera ekemo kebeere aase aye.

Inche Omonene naimokirie Koresi ase oboronge, nindongeyie chinchera chiaye chionsi; ere naagache omochie one, nasibore abanto baane boosetwe barue ase obosomba, tagoakanwa kende, gose koegwa ng’eria ende.” Omonene bw’Emeganda nere otebire ayio.

Aya naro Omonene agoteba; “Abamisiri ne chinibo chiabo bechanderete, na Abaetiopia na oboonchoreria bwabo, na abanto ba Seba bare abatambe, bonsi mbache asore, babe abao amo ne chinibo chiabo. Barabwo mbagotunyane basibire chingataare, batung’ame asore, bagosabe, batebe: Ekeene, Nyasae nigo are ime yao, onde tari, Nyasae onde tari otatiga ere bweka.”
Aye Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aye Omotooria, ekeene, aye naye Nyasae ore bobisi.
Abanto bonsi bakoroisia emegwekano egosasimwa, mbasookigwe na gotantanigwa, ee, bonsi pi mbasookigwe na goichana mono.
Abaisraeli mbatoorigwe n’Omonene ase ogotoorigwa gwa kare na kare, inwe Abaisraeli timogosookigwa, gose gotantanigwa kare na kare.

Omonene oyio otongete igoro chionsi, nere Nyasae, nere otongete ense akayebeka oboroso obokong’u. Tayetongete ng’a ebe bosa, nigo ayetongete emenywe. Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Inche ninche Omonene, onde tari.

Inche Omonene tinakwanete aase a bobisi, gose ase ense y’omosunte; tinatebetie abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo ng’a bandigie bosa. Inche Omonene nigo ngokwana ayare ay’ekeene, na koraria ayare ay’oboronge.”

“Inwe abamore abatigari korwa ase ebisaku, sangererekana amo mosuke gocha ang’e! Abanto abwo bakobogoria emegwekano egosasimwa eroisirie korwa ase emete, abwo bagendererete gosaba chinyasae chitanyare kobatooria, tibari nokomanya.

Raria na morente amang’ana aino! Tiga bagambere amang’ana abo amo. Ning’o oyakwanete agwo kare? Ning’o oyararetie kare? Inee! Tari inche Omonene nayakwanete? Inche nigo inde Nyasae omonyene oboronge na Omotooria. Nyasae onde tari otatiga inche bweka.”
“Inwe abe chinsinyo chi’ense, ng’onchokere mbatoorie, ekiagera inche ninche Nyasae, onde tari otatiga inche bweka.
Netianirie inche omonyene; ring’ana riarure ase omonwa one ase oboronge, tirikoonchoka. Kera riru naribekwe inse ase obosio bwane, na kera oromeme ndotiane asende.”
“Kera omonto nakwane igoro yane na goteba: Oboronge ne chinguru nigo bire ase Omonene bweka; bonsi abamogechete mbache asare basookigwe.
Abanto bonsi b’ororeria rwa Israeli mbanyore oboronge na gwetogia ase Omonene.”
“Beli yagure inse, na Nebo yekumbire; emegwekano ye chinyasae chiria eberekire ne ching’iti ne chiombe; ebinto ebio bibogoirie nigo bire chigurube chindito ase ching’iti echio chiarosire.
Chinyasae echio nigo chiekumbete gochia inse amo, tichikonyara gotooria chigurube chiria, echio chinyene nigo chigwoswa chiairwa ase obosomba.

“Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, inwe abatigari bonsi b’Abaisraeli, inwe aba nabeire mbabogoretie korwa ekero mwarenge ase chinda chi’abanyoko, na korwa ekero mwaagatire ase amaboko ’abanyoko, inyigwere!
Ninche ndabe amo nainwe nonya ngoika engaki y’obogotu bwaino, ekero morabe mwagotire kegima ne chimbuche chiarabire se, nimbe nkobabogoria. Ninche nabatongete, nimbarende, nimbabogorie na kobatooria.
“Ning’o moranyare kondeng’ania ng’a imbe buna oyio? Ning’o moranyare kongwekania ng’a togwekane nere?

Abanto nigo bakoumora chitahabu korwa emebuko yabo na korenga chifeta nekerengero, erio baakanera omoturi bw’etahabu, nere oyeroisia yaba enyasae, na abanto abwo batung’ama bosio bw’enyasae eyio bayesasima.

Erio bayeimokia bayebeka ase amareko abo, bayebogoria, bayetereka aase aye, yabeera aroro; tekonyara gotigera korwa aase agwo. Omonto naisa korera ase enyasae eria, ero tekonyara komoigwa gose komotooria korwa ase emechando yaye.
“Inwe abasaria, inyora amang’ana ayio, moyarengererie mono.
Inyora amang’ana abete kare; inche ninche Nyasae, onde tari; ninche Nyasae, onde tari onga buna inche.
Korwa omochakano nigo nararetie aya agochia koba; agwo kare nigo nabanete aya ataraba, ngateba: Emeroberio yane goika eikerane, onsi aya nganetie ninyakore.
Nindangerie ensoti eche korwa moocha, na omonto okorwa ense y’aare nache akore aya naroberetie. Aya nakwanire, goika nyaikeranie, na aya narobeirie, goika nyakore.
“Inwe abamore abanyabigoti bikong’u, inwe abamore aare korwa ase oboronge, inyigwera!
Narentire oboronge bwane ang’e, tibori aare, na ogotooreka kwane tikogotebana; nimbeke ogotooreka ase Sayoni; ning’ee Abaisraeli obonene bwane.”
“Aye Babeli onga buna omoi seke omwekungi, aye omochie bw’Abakalidayo, ika korwa agwo, ikaransa ase amaroba otari nekerogo ki’obonene! Bono tokorokwa omwororo na omwereria nonya ng’ake.
Bono bogoria ensio osere obosie! Rusia egietubo otubete obosio bwao, ringa eganchwa yao eike ase amariagati, erio oete ase amache ime.
Obogetirianda bwao tibogotubwa, na obosooku bwao mbororekane. Nindusie egesiomba na tinkororera nonya noyomo amabera.”
Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli nere Omobooria oito; Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye.
“Aye Babeli, omochie bw’Abakalidayo, ikaransa ase omosunte okire‐kiri, tokorokwa eting’ana y’amaruoti naende.

Inche nigo nabete nendamwamu ase abanto baane, ngakora omwando one okaba oyo otachenegeti. Nkababeka ase okoboko kwao, aye tikwabete namabera asebare, korende nigo gwakorerete abanto abagotu bobe, okabaa chigurube chindito mono.
Aye nigo gwatebete ng’a nobe eting’ana kare na kare. Tikwarengereretie amang’ana ayio. Gose tikwainyorete buna omoerio bw’amang’ana ayio arabe.”

“Ase ayio, aye bwanchete kwegokia, igwa amang’ana aya! Aye oikaransete na kwegaara, gwateba ase enkoro yao; Inche ninche, onde tari otatiga inche bweka, tingotigwa imbe omoboraka, gose tingokwerwa abana.”
Amang’ana aya abere nagochere mobosokano ase rituko erimo; abana bao mbakwe, na omosacha oo akwe, obe omoboraka; ayio onsi nagochere, nonya oborogi bwao, na oboringoria bwao, bire ebinge mono.

“Nigo kwabete noboremu ase ogokora kwao okobe, ogateba:” “Onde tandochi.” “Obong’aini bwao, ne chisemi chiao, nigo biagosiretie, ogateba ase enkoro yao ime:” “Inche ninche, onde tari otatiga inche bweka.”
“Amabe nakonyore, ayio oborogi botanyare koyatanga, amaakwa nakonyore, ayio otanyore embooria ende ekoyarusiao. Ogosirigwa nkogochere mobosokano, amang’ana ayio otamanyete ng’a nabe bo.
Bwata bokong’u oboringoria bwao obonge na oborogi bwao, ebinto ebio gwechanderete korwa obwana bwao; ande nabo birabaise kogokonya, ande nabo birabaise goseria emechando yao.

Aye kwabeire gokwerosia ase okorigia abasemia abange, abwo bakoringoria ayare igoro, tiga bache kogotooria, na abakomongera ching’enang’eni chia igoro, abwo bagokobanera aya agochia gokonyora ekero omotienyi oorokire, bateba ng’a mang’ana gete nabe asore.

Rora, abanto abwo nigo banga amasakwe, omorero nigo okoyasamba ayia aera, tari konyara gwetooria korwa ase chinguru chi’omorero. Amasakwe ayio takoyia abe omorero bw’amakara, omonto araikaranseo aywote.
