Chinyimbo echio ochibwatanie amo chibe enyimbo eyemo ere ase okoboko kwao.
Ekero abanto bamino barakoborie iga: Inee! Nototebie engencho gwakorera iga?

Obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Rora, ninyimokie enyimbo y’enyomba ya Yusufu (eyio ere ase okoboko gwa Efraimu) amo nebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, ebio biabwatanire nero; erio inyebwateranie amo nenyimbo y’Abayuda, erinde chibe enyimbo eyemo ere ase okoboko kwane.
“Chinyimbo echio orabe kwarikire ochibwate ase okoboko kwao agwo ase amaiso ’abanto.
Erio obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Naama! Nindusie Abaisraeli korwa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku agwo ase bairetwe, mbasangererie korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, mbarente ase ense yabo.
Nimbakore babe egesaku ekemo ase ense eyio, agwo ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli. Omoruoti oyomo nabe okogambera bonsi. Tibakogenderera koba ebisaku bibere, gose gwatananeka babe amaruoti abere.

Tibakogenderera gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogosasima emegwekano yabo, gose ase ogokora kwabo gw’okogechia, gose ase ogosaria kwabo konde gwonsi. Nimbatoorie korwa ase obomenyo bwabo bwonsi agwo aase bakorerete ebibe, nimbachene. Erio mbabe abanto baane, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo.
Daudi, omosomba one, nere orabe omoruoti obo, na barabwo mbabe nomorisia oyomo, mbabwatie emeroberio yane echikire, naende babwate amachiko aane na koyakora.

Mbamenye ase ense eyio chisokoro chiabo chiamenyete, eyio naete Yakobo, omosomba one. Barabwo mbamenyeo, boigo na abana babo, na abachokoro, na abachokororia, goika kare na kare; na Daudi, omosomba one, nere orabe omogambi obo goika kare na kare.
Ninkore okobwatana kw’omorembe amo nabarabwo; okwo nigo korabe ogwa kare na kare. Nimbabeke aroro, mbamentekanie. Nimbeke Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bobe ase egati yabo kogenderera botambe.
Obomenyo bwane mbobe amo nabarabwo, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo, na barabwo mbabe abanto baane.
Ekero Obomenyo bwane Obochenu boragenderere kobeera amo n’Abaisraeli kogenderera botambe, erio abanto b’ebisaku mbamanye ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngochena Abaisraeli.”
Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
“Aye mwanyabanto, onchoka origererie Gogi bw’ense ya Magogi, oyore omogambi bw’ense ya Rosi, na eya Meseki, na eya Tubali, obane mamincha yaye,
omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye Gogi, omogambi omonene bw’ense ya Rosi, na eya Meseki, na eya Tubali, inche nigo inde mamincha yao.

Ninkoonchore gochia nyuma, ning’agie ebigobanio ase chintakunero chiao erinde nkorente aye amo nabarwani bao bonsi b’esegi, ne chibarasi, na abariini be chibarasi, bonsi ababogoretie ebirwanero bi’esegi; omoganda oyio omonene nigo orabe obogoretie ching’aya, ne chinguba, na emioro.
Abarwani b’Ayemi, na aba Etiopia, na aba Libia, mbabe amo nabarabwo; bonsi mbabe babogoretie chinguba na ebigogwa b’ebioma.
Gomeri amo nomoganda oye bwonsi bw’esegi, na egesaku gia Togarima kemenyete aare, ensemo ya sugusu, amo nemeganda yaye yonsi, ee, abanto abange mbache amo naye.
Eariganie, bwebeke ang’e, aye amo nomoganda oyio osangererekanire asore. Aye obe omoraai obo.

Nyuma y’amatuko amange noche korootwa naende. Ase emiaka egochi‐gocha nogende ase ense eria yarenge nesegi, korende bono nigo ere nobotoereru, ense eria ase abanto basangereretigwe korwa ase ebisaku ebinge, agwo ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli biarenge bigendererete koba bosa botambe. Abanto bonsi b’aroro nigo barentetwe korwa ase ebisaku ao ao, na bono nao bamenyete bare nomorembe.
Aye notiire, obachiere buna ekembugu‐mbugu, obe buna riire otube ense, aye na emeganda yao yonsi, na abanto abange bare amo naye.
“Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase engaki eyio aye nigo orabe nemeroberio ase ebirengererio biao, oraroberie gokora ayare amabe.

Aye nigo oratebe iga: Ngochiera inde ense ere nemechie etagiteiri chindwaki; ning’umokere abanto abwo begaarete bare nobotoereru; bonsi nigo bamenyeteo bategitereti chindwaki, tibabwati ebiita gose emekorogoto egosieka.

Norengererie gochia gosakora na kwenyorera ebinto ase okorambora okoboko kwao gochia aase arenge bosa na bono amenyirwe nabanto. Ee, norambore okoboko kwao gochia ase abanto basangereretigwe korwa ase ebisaku ao ao, na bono mbabwate chitugo na ebinto ebinge, agwo ase bamenyete egati‐gati y’ense.

Erio abanto ba Seba, na aba Dedani, na abaonchoreria ba Tarisisi, amo nabatang’ani babo bonsi banga chindo chinsae mbakoborie: Nigo gwachire gwosa na gosakora? Inee! Nigo gwasangereirie emeganda yao gocha koira ebisakorwa, buna chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitugo, na ebinto, erinde oire ebisakorwa ebinge?
“Ase ayio, aye mwanyabanto, bana otebie Gogi ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase engaki eyio Abaisraeli, abanto baane, mbabe bamenyete ase obotoereru, nario oramanye amang’ana ayio.
Erio noche korwa aase ao, agwo sugusu y’aare; nigo orache amo nabanto abange, bonsi bariinete chibarasi, bare omoganda omonene ore nabarwani esegi abange.

Aye Gogi, nochiche korwania Abaisraeli, abanto baane. Noche buna riire otube ense eyio. Ase amatuko agochigocha ninkorente orwanie ense yaane, erinde abanto b’ebisaku bamanye inche, ekero ndeorokie ase amaiso abo ng’a inche inde omochenu ase egati yaino.

Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye naye omonto oria nakwanete igoro yao ase chingaki chia kare goetera ase abasomba baane ababani b’Abaisraeli; barabwo bakaba bakobana emiaka ase emiaka ng’a ninkorente orwanie Abaisraeli.
“Korende ase rituko erio Gogi arache korwania ense y’Abaisraeli, endamwamu yane entindi inayoke buna omorero. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
Nakwanire inde nerisemi na ekeririanda kenga omorero ng’a ekeene ase rituko erio omotengecho omonene nobe ase ense y’Abaisraeli.

Erio chinswe chire nyancha, ne chinyoni chia igoro, ne ching’iti chire ase ense, na chionsi echikwagura ase riroba, nchitengechigwe ase obosio bwane, amo nabanto bare ase ense. Ebitunwa mbitegoke bigwe inse amo nebitare, na kera oboagacho mbogwe inse.
Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Nindete omoro orwanie Gogi agwo ase ebitunwa biane bionsi, erio kera omonto aite oyomwabo nomoro.

Nimonachere ekina goetera ase oborwaire bogoita, na ogoiteka kw’amanyinga; nindete igoro yaye, na igoro y’emeganda yaye y’esegi, na abanto abange bare amo nere, embura ere nomoubera, na amagena are nomorero mbibaite.
Ninyeorokie ng’a inche nomonene na omochenu; ninyemanyekanie ase amasio ’ebisaku ebinge. Erio abanto mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
“Aye mwanyabanto, bana igoro ya Gogi, omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye Gogi, rora, inche nigo inde mamincha yao, aye omogambi omonene bw’ense ya Rosi, na eya Meseki, na eya Tubali.
Ninkoonchore na gokoraa korwa sugusu y’aare mono, nkorente ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli.
Aroro agwo ning’ake obota bore ase okoboko kwao gw’okobee bogwe inse, ne chinsara chire ase okoboko kwao gw’okorio chigwe inse boigo.

Nokwere igoro ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, aye amo nemeganda yao yonsi y’esegi, na abanto abwo bare amo naye. Erio nindangerie chinyoni chia kera egesaku, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, chiche chirie chinyama chi’emebere yaino.
Inwe nigo morakwere ase egetii aarabu, ekiagera ninche Omonene Nyasae nakwanire ayio.
Nintome omorero osambe ense ya Magogi amo nabanto abwo begaarete bare nobotoereru, agwo ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.

Ase ayio nindigererie ng’a erieta riane richenu ndimanyekane ase egati y’Abaisraeli, abanto baane; tingotiga erieta riane rigenderere gokorwa eritachenegeti. Erio abanto b’ebisaku mbamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
“Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Rora, amang’ana ayio ngocha are, aikeranigwe ase rituko riria nakwanete ng’a ayio nabe.

Erio abanto abamenyete ase emechie y’Abaisraeli mbagende basangererie ebirwanero; chinguba, ne ching’aya, na amata, ne chinsara, ne chisimisi, na amatimo, babikore chinko bagoutera omorero ase engaki y’emiaka etano na ebere.

Ase engaki eyio Abaisraeli tibakogenda orosana gotenya chinko, gose gotema emete ase amanani. Ebirwanero ebio mbibe chinko chiabo bagoutera omorero. Barabwo mbasakore ebinto bi’abwo babasakorete, na baure abwo babaurete chinibo chiabo. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.

“Ase rituko erio nindue Rigoko ri’Abaeti rire moocha y’enyancha, agwo ase ense y’Abaisraeli, erinde Gogi amo nemeganda yaye yonsi batindekwe aroro. Ase ayio ase rigoko erio chimbeera nchitange abaeti. Nigo rirarokwe Rigoko ri’Emeganda ya Gogi.
Abaisraeli mbaire emetienyi etano na ebere ase okobatindeka, erinde bachene ense eyio.
Abanto bonsi b’ense eyio mbagenderere kobatindeka, na ayio abe ogotogigwa kwabo. Aya nigo arakoreke ase rituko riria ndaorokie obonene bwane. Nabo Omonene atebire.

Nyuma emetienyi etano na ebere koyaerire mbachore abanto barabe bakona‐goeta aase aande onsi ase ense eyio babe bakorigia abwo bakwete batigarete riroba igoro, na abande babe bakobatindeka ase ogochena ense eyio.

Ekero abwo bakorigia abakwete, barabe bagoeta ase ense eyio, kobaranyore riuga ri’omonto okwete, goika batenenie ekemanyererio aroro goika abwo bagotindeka bachie koritindeka ase Rigoko ri’Emeganda ya Gogi.
Boigo omochie orabeo norokwe Hamona. Ase enchera eyio mbachene ense eyio.

“Aye mwanyabanto, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Kwana na kera egesaku gie chinyoni na egie ching’iti chi’orosana, ochitebie: Esangererie, moche amo korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, mochiche ase omoyega omonene bw’ekeng’wanso nabaroiseirie. Oyio nigo orabe omoyega omonene bw’ekeng’wanso igoro ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli; inwe imorie chinyama, monywe na amanyinga.

Imorie chinyama chi’abarwani esegi bare ne chinguru, na monywe amanyinga ’abagambi b’ense, abwo banga buna chimingichi, ne chimanwa chie ching’ondi, ne chimbori, ne chieri, chionsi chire chinoru chia Basani.
Imorie ebitinya goika moigote kegima, naende monywe amanyinga goika motinde; ekiagera oyio nomoyega bw’ekeng’wanso nabaroiseirie.
Agwo ase emesa yane imorie chinyama chie chibarasi, na echi’abanto chituoni, na echi’abarwani bonsi b’esegi, erinde moigote kegima. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
“Inche ning’orokie obonene bwane ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, erinde abwo bonsi barore ekina nanachire, na buna okoboko kwane gokorua egesusuro ase ababisa baane.
Ase rituko erio na kogenderera botambe, Abaisraeli mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.

Abanto b’ebisaku mbamanye ng’a Abaisraeli nigo bairetwe ase obosomba ase engencho y’obobe bwabo, ekiagera tibabete abegenwa asende. Ase ayio inche nkabisa obosio bwane korwa asebare, erio nkabarua nkababeka ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na bonsi bagaitwa nemioro.
Nigo nabakorerete ayio koreng’ana nogotacheneka kwabo, na ogosaria kwabo, naende nkabisa obosio bwane korwa asebare.
“Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Bono ning’iranie abooswa ba Yakobo; nindorere egesaku gionsi ki’Abaisraeli amabera; nimbe ne risemi ase erieta riane richenu.
Ekero Abaisraeli baramenye ase ense eyio bare nobotoereru, na monto onde takoboboyia, erio mbabwatwe nobosooku ase engencho y’ogosaria gwonsi bakorete.
Ayio nigo arabe ekero ndabasangererie mbarusie korwa ase egati y’abanto, na korwa ase chinse chi’ababisa babo. Goetera asebare ninyeorokie ase amasio ’abanto b’ebisaku ng’a inche nomochenu inde.

Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene Nyasae obo, ekiagera ninche nabaruete bakairwa ase obosomba bamenye ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku; naende ninche ndabasangererie na kobairania ase ense yabo. Tingotiga nonya nomonto oyomo obo agenderere kobeera ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebio.
Bono tinkobisa obosio bwane naende korwa asebare. Ning’umore omoika one igoro y’Abaisraeli. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”

Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, na etano, bw’okong’anyigwa gwaito, ase omochakano bw’omwaka, ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi, ase omwaka o ikomi na kane nyuma omochie kobuirwe, ee, ase rituko riria riria okoboko kw’Omonene gokaba igoro yane gokang’ira aaria.
Erio ase okorora naetwe na Nyasae, ere akang’ira gochia ase ense y’Abaisraeli, akambeka igoro ase egetunwa egetambe mono. Aroro agwo nkarora egento kenga oboagacho bw’omochie ore ensemo ya irianyi.

Omonene akang’ira aase agwo, nkarora omonto, na okororekana kwaye nigo kwarenge buna ogw’etaai; omonto oyio nigo abwate engori y’egatani na emoti y’okorengera ase okoboko kwaye; ere nigo ateneine ang’e negeita.

Omonto oria agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, rigereria orore namaiso ao, na otegerere oigwe namato ao, naende orengererie mono igoro y’aya onsi ngochia gokworokia, ekiagera aye nigo kwarentirwe aase aiga, erinde nkworokie amang’ana ayio. Amang’ana ayio onsi orarore, oyatebie Abaisraeli.”

Nkarora orwaki rwaetanaine eraaro y’enyomba eria chinsemo chionsi. Emoti yarenge ase okoboko kw’omonto oria nigo yarenge nobotambe bw’amaboko atano na rimo, na kera ekerengo gi’okoboko gekamentwa eki’egesanyi ekemo. Omonto oria akarenga orwaki. Obogare bwaye bokaba emoti eyemo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro emoti eyemo.
Naende akagenda ase egeita kiarochie moocha, akariinera ekeriinero kiaye. Erio akarenga obogare bw’egesona inse agwo ase oboagacho bw’egeita, bokaba emoti eyemo.

Ebinyomba bi’oborendi mbiarengeo, kera akamo nigo karenge nobotambe bw’emoti eyemo, na obo gare bw’emoti eyemo boigo. Ribaga eriarenge gati‐gati y’ebinyomba ebio nigo riarenge ri’obotambe bw’amaboko atano, na ekerengo ki’egesona ki’oboagacho bw’egeita nigo kiarenge eki’emoti eyemo.
Boigo akarenga ensemo y’egesona ime, nero ekaba ey’ekerengo ki’emoti eyemo.

Boigo akarenga obogare bw’egesona keria, borobwo bokaba obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano na atato, ne chisiiro chiaye nigo chiarenge echi’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere. Egesona keria nigo kiarochie ase enyomba.

Oboagacho obwo bw’egeita kia moocha nigo bwarenge nebinyomba bi’oborendi, bitato ensemo eyemo, na bitato ensemo ende; bionsi nigo biarenge nekerengo ekemo, ne chisiiro chie chinsemo chionsi ibere nigo chiarenge echi’ekerengo ekemo.
Naende akarenga obogare bw’egeita kia ime, naborobwo bokaba obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obotambe bw’egesoero bokaba obw’amaboko ikomi na atato.

Orosenge ndwarenge bosio bw’ebinyomba biria bi’oborendi, na obogare bw’egesona keria nigo bwarenge obw’okoboko okomo. Ebisona bi’ebinyomba ebio bie chinsemo chionsi ibere nigo biareng’aine. Kera akanyomba nigo karenge nobogare bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano na rimo, na obotambe bwaye boigo.

Naende akarenga obotambe korwa ase akanyomba akamo goika ase akande karenge ensemo ende y’egesoero. Obotambe obwo bokaba obw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano. Ebisieri bi’ebinyomba ebio nigo biachikaine.
Akarenga chindwaro chie chisiiro chiarenge ase chinsemo ibere ime y’egesoero, na obotambe obwo nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na isiko goetanana chisiiro echio amabaga narengeo.
Obotambe korwa ase oboagacho bw’egeita gia isiko gochia ase obw’egeita kia ime nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano.

Ebibao biasiekeire ebitange nigo biarenge ase chinyasi chi’ebinyomba biria bi’oborendi, na ase emetobwa yabo, ne chinsemo chionsi chi’oboagacho obwo, ne chisiiro nigo chiachabeire nemegwekano y’emekendo.
Omonto oria akang’ira goika ase eraaro ya isiko yatichire inse namagena ase chinsemo chionsi, na aroro agwo nkarora ebinyomba emerongo etato biaagachire igoro y’amagena ayio.
Obogare bw’aase aria atichire nigo bwareng’aine nobwe rikere ri’amaagacho are biita. Aase aria atichire nigo arenge aase are inse.

Naende akarenga obotambe korwa ase oboagacho bw’egeita gia inse gochia ase obw’egeita ki’eraaro ya ime, naborobwo bokaba obw’amaboko rigana erimo. Ekerengo gi’ensemo ya moocha na eya sugusu nigo biareng’aine.
Naende akagenda ase oboagacho bware geita ki’eraaro ya isiko kiarochie sugusu, na akarenga obotambe na obogare bwaye.

Ebinyomba bi’oborendi ebiarenge ime y’oboagacho boria, bitato ase ensemo eyemo, na bitato ase ensemo ende, ne chisiiro, na egesona, nigo biareng’aine nebi’oboagacho bware geita kie ritang’ani. Obotambe bw’oboagacho boria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye nobw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano.

Ebibao biaye, na egesoero kiaye, na emegwekano eria y’emekendo, bionsi ebio nigo biareng’aine na biria bi’oboagacho bware geita kiarochie moocha. Ekeriinero kiare nebitambokero bitano na bibere nkiarengeo kiare koriinerwa gochiao, na egesona kiaye nigo kiarenge ime y’oboagacho obwo.

Kororia ase oboagacho obwo bwa geita gia sugusu, oboagacho bonde mbwarengeo bw’egeita kiare gosoerwa gochia ase eraaro ya ime. Obwo nabwo bwareng’aine noboagacho bw’egeita kiarochie moocha. Akarenga obotambe korwa ase oboagacho bonde goika ase obonde, bokaba obw’amaboko rigana erimo.
Omonto oria akang’ira gochia ase ensemo ya irianyi, na aroro nkarora oboagacho bware geita. Akarenga chisiiro chiaye na egesoero kiaye, na ebirengo ebio nigo biarenge buna ebi’ebinde.

Ebibao nigo biarenge ase oboagacho obwo ase chinsemo chionsi, na ase egesona kiaye, nabirobio nigo biareng’aine nebinde. Obotambe bw’oboagacho boria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye obw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano.

Ekeriinero kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na bibere nkiarengeo kiare koriinerwa gochiao; egesona kiaye nigo kiarenge ime y’oboagacho obwo. Emegwekano y’emekendo nigo yachabeire ase chisiiro chiaye chiarenge ase chinsemo ibere.
Agwo ase ensemo ya irianyi oboagacho mbwarengeo bware negeita kegosoerwa goika ase eraaro ya ime. Akarenga obotambe korwa ase oboagacho bonde goika ase obonde, bokaba obw’amaboko rigana erimo.
Omonto oria akang’ira ase eraaro ya ime goetera ase oboagacho bware geita ase ensemo ya irianyi, akaborenga, naborobwo nigo bwareng’aine nayande.

Ebinyomba biaye bi’oborendi, ne chisiiro, na egesona, nigo biareng’aine nebi’amaagacho ande. Boigo ebibao mbiarengeo ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, na ase egesona. Obotambe bw’oboagacho boria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye obw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano.
Ebisona nigo biarenge ase chinsemo chionsi; obotambe bwabo nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano, na obogare bwabo obw’amaboko atano.
Egesona kiaye kiarochie ase eraaro ya isiko, na emegwekano y’emekendo nigo yachabeire ase chisiiro chiaye, na ekeriinero kiaye nigo kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na bitato biare koriinerwa gochiao.
Naende akang’ira ase eraaro ya ime goetera ase oboagacho bware geita ensemo ya moocha, akaborenga, naborobwo nigo bwareng’aine nayande.

Ebinyomba biaye bi’oborendi, ne chisiiro, na egesona, nigo biareng’aine nebi’amaagacho ande. Boigo ebibao mbiarengeo ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, na ase egesona. Obotambe bw’oboagacho boria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye obw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano.

Egesona kiaye nigo kiarochie ase eraaro ya isiko, na emegwekano y’emekendo nigo yachabeire ase chisiiro chiaye chiarenge ase chinsemo ibere, na ekeriinero kiaye nigo kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na bitato biare koriinerwa gochiao.
Erio akang’ira ase oboagacho bware geita ase ensemo ya sugusu, akaborenga; naborobwo nigo bwareng’aine nayande.

Ebinyomba biaye bi’oborendi, ne chisiiro, na egesona, nigo biareng’aine nebi’amaagacho ande. Ebibao nigo biarenge ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi. Obotambe bw’oboagacho boria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye obw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano.

Chisiiro chiaye nigo chiarochie ase eraaro ya isiko, na emegwekano y’emekendo nigo yachabeire ase chisiiro chiria chiarenge ase chinsemo ibere, na ekeriinero kiaye nigo kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na bitato biare koriinerwa gochiao.
Ebinyomba mbiarengeo amo nebisieri biabo ang’e ne chisiiro agwo ase amaagacho onsi arenge nebiita; agwo nao ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa biarenge gosiberigwa.

Agwo ase rikere ri’oboagacho obwo ime, chimesa ibere nchiarengeo ase kera ensemo. Igoro ase chimesa echio nao ching’iti chi’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’ebibe, na ebi’okomocha, biarenge konyenyerwa.
Naende chimesa chinde ibere nchiarenge agwo isiko ase baare gotiirera gochia ase egeita kia ime ki’oboagacho bwarochie sugusu; boigo ase ensemo ende y’egesoero ekio nchiarengeo chimesa chinde ibere.
Chimesa echio chionsi ase ebing’wanso biarenge konyenyerwa nigo chiarenge isano na isato, inye nigo chiarenge ase rikere erimo ri’oboagacho, na inye ase rikere rinde.

Naende nchiarengeo chimesa inye ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa chiaroisirie korwa ase amagena abaachire. Igoro yabo nao ebinto biarenge gokorerwa emeremo ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde, biarenge kogachwa. Obotambe bwa kera emesa nigo bwarenge obw’okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, na obogare bw’okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese boigo, na obotambe gochia igoro nigo bwarenge obw’okoboko okomo.

Ase omogo o kera emesa ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, ebigobanio mbiarengeo; obotambe bwa kera ekemo nigo bwarenge buna obogare bw’egesanyi gi’okoboko; na igoro ye chimesa echio nao chinyama chi’ebing’wanso chiarenge kobekererwa.

Isiko y’oboagacho bw’egeita kia ime gochia ase eraaro ya ime, ebinyomba bibere bi’abateri mbiarengeo, akamo kaare ang’e negeita gia sugusu karochie irianyi, na akande ensemo y’egeita kia moocha karochie sugusu.
Omonto oria agantebia, “Akanyomba aka karochie irianyi nak’abakuani bagokora emeremo ase Hekalu,
na akwo karochie sugusu nak’abakuani bagokora emeremo ase egesasimero. Aba nab’ororeria rwa Zadoki, abwo boka korwa ase ororeria rwa Lawi bancheire gocha ang’e ase Omonene komokorera emeremo.”
Naende omonto oria akarenga eraaro ya ime; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko rigana erimo, na obogare bwaye boigo; egesasimero nigo kiarenge bosio bwe Hekalu.
Erio akang’ira ase egesona gie Hekalu, akarenga emetobwa yabekireo, na kera oyomo okaba obogare bw’amaboko atano. Obogare bw’egeita nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atato ensemo eyemo, na atato ensemo ende.

Obogare bw’egesona ekio nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo ebere, na obotambe bwaye gochia ime obw’amaboko ikomi na rimo. Nkiarengeo ekeriinero kiare koriinerwa gochiao. Ase kera ensemo bosio bw’emetobwa eria, chisiiro nchiarengeo.
Erio omonto oria akang’ira ase Hekalu, akarenga emetobwa; obogare bwabo bokaba obw’amaboko atano na rimo kera ensemo, koreng’ana nobogare bwe Hekalu.

Obogare bw’egesieri nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ikomi, na obwe chinyasi nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano kera ensemo. Boigo akarenga Aase Aachenu; obotambe bwaye bokaba obw’amaboko emerongo ene, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere.

Naende akagenda ase akanyomba kaime. Erio akarenga emetobwa y’egesieri, na obogare bwabo bokaba obw’amaboko abere. Akarenga na egesieri, gekaba ekerengo ki’amaboko atano na rimo, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano na abere.

Akarenga obotambe bw’akanyomba karia kare moino y’Aase Aachenu, bokaba obw’amaboko emerongo ebere, na obogare bwaye bokaba amaboko emerongo ebere boigo. Omonto oria agantebia, “Aiga nao Aase Aachenu Mono.”
Naende akarenga enyasi ye Hekalu; obonetu bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano na rimo, na obogare bw’ebinyomba biaetanaine Hekalu nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ane.

Ebinyomba ebio biaetanaine Hekalu nigo biarenge namarongo atato, kera rirongo nigo riabwate ebinyomba emerongo etato. Ebitambokero nigo biachomeranirie ase enyasi ye Hekalu, erinde emeriibo y’ebinyomba biria egatoorera aroro, tiyasoete ase enyasi eria ime.

Ebinyomba biria biaetanaine Hekalu nigo biaagachetwe iga: Ebia inse nigo biarenge ebinyerere, korende ebia gati‐gati na ebia igoro bikagareigwa kobwatia ebitambokero biria. Ase rikere rie Hekalu ebiriinero mbiarengeo ebiare koriinerwa gochia ase rirongo ria gatato goetera ase eria kabere.
Nkarora oboroso bwaetanaine Hekalu bwatichire; obotambe bw’oboroso boria bw’ebinyomba biria biaagachire amo, nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano na rimo gochia igoro.
Obonetu bw’enyasi ya isiko y’ebinyomba biria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano, na ensemo y’oboroso boria yasogete isiko yatigetwe nigo yarenge nobogare bw’obotambe bw’amaboko atano.
Gati‐gati y’oboroso boria bwatichire na ebinyomba biaagachire ao bioka, ribaga ndiarengeo eri’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere riaetanaine Hekalu.

Ebisieri biarenge gosoerwa ase ebinyomba biria; ekemo nigo kiarochie ase ensemo ya sugusu, na ekende ensemo ya irianyi. Obogare boria bwatigarete bosa botaagachiri nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano ase chinsemo chionsi.

Oboagacho obwarenge ao, ensemo ya bosongo, nigo bwarenge nobogare bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano na ebere. Obonetu bw’enyasi yonsi y’enyomba eria nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na obotambe bwaye amaboko emerongo kianda.
Naboigo omonto oria akarenga Hekalu eria; obotambe bwaye bokaba obw’amaboko rigana erimo, na obotambe bw’egoora na oboagacho bwarenge ao amo ne chindwaki chiaye bokaba amaboko rigana erimo.
Obogare bwa bosio bwe Hekalu ensemo ya moocha, amo neraaro nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo.

Akarenga obotambe bw’enyomba yaagachire magega amo nebisona biaye biarochie ase chinsemo ibere, bokaba nekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo. Boigo akarenga Aase Aachenu Mono, ne chinyomba chinde chiare ime y’eraaro.

Boigo omonto oria akarenga emeriibo ya inse y’ebisieri, na ebibao biasiekeire ebioma, na ebisona bi’amarongo atato bi’enyomba, na emeriibo y’ebisieri igoro yatubire ne chibao, na obotambe korwa inse goika ase ebibao. Ebibao ebio nigo biarenge bitubire.
Igoro y’ebisieri na ime y’enyomba, na isiko, ne chinyasi chionsi ime na isiko, mbiabwate ebirengo biabo.
Emegwekano y’abakerubi na ey’emekendo iyarengeo. Ase kera egati y’abakerubi, omokendo norengeo, na kera omokerubi nigo arenge namasio abere;
obosio bw’omonto bokarigereria omokendo ensemo eyemo, na obw’endo bokarigereria omokendo ensemo ende. Emegwekano eyio nigo yaroisirie ase enyomba yonsi.
Emegwekano eyio y’abakerubi na ey’emekendo nigo yachabeire korwa inse goika ase egesieri igoro ase enyasi ye Hekalu ime.
Emetobwa y’ebisieri nigo yareng’aine obogare na obotambe, boigo na bosio bw’Aase Aachenu Mono.

Egesasimero kiaroisirie korwa ase chibao nkiarengeo; obotambe bwaye gochia igoro nobw’amaboko atato, na obotambe bwaye amaboko abere. Nigo kiarenge ne chikoona ne chinterekerero, ne chinyasi, chionsi nigo chiaroisirie korwa ase chibao. Omonto oria agantebia: “Eye nemesa ere ase obosio bw’Omonene.”
Aase Aachenu amo n’Aase Aachenu Mono nigo abwate emerangwa ebere.
Kera egesieri nigo kiarenge nemerangwa ebere yare koigorwa korwa gati‐gati, yaringanigwa kera oyomo gochia ase ensemo yaye.
Ase omorangwa bw’Aase Aachenu emegwekano y’abakerubi na ey’emekendo nigo yachabeire aroro yagwekaine eria yarenge ase chinyasi. Ekerama gie chibao nigo kiarenge bosio bw’egesona isiko.
Agwo ase chinyasi chi’egesona, na echi’ebinyomba biaagachire ase amakere ensemo na ensemo, ebibao biasiekeire ebioma na emegwekano y’emekendo mbiarengeo.
Omonto oria akang’ira ase eraaro ya isiko erochie sugusu, na akang’ira ase enyomba rirondo yanachanire ebinyomba yarenge gati y’aase atigire ataagachire na oboagacho bwa sugusu.
Obotambe bw’enyomba eria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko rigana erimo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano, na egesoero nigo kiarochie sugusu.

Korwa aase atigire ataagachire arenge nobogare bw’amaboko emerongo ebere gochia ase eraaro ya isiko yatichire namagena, ebitambokero mbiarengeo biare gotirimbokerwa gochia ase amarongo atato ay’enyomba eria.

Bosio bw’ebinyomba biria aase arenge goeterwa narengeo; obogare bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obotambe bwaye amaboko rigana erimo. Ebisieri bi’ebinyomba biria nigo biarochie sugusu.
Ebinyomba bia igoro nigo biarenge ebieng’e gochia ime kobua biria binde, ebia gati na ebia inse.
Ebinyomba ebio biaagachetwe ase rirongo ria gatato tibiabwate chisiiro buna chigoora. Ase ayio ebinyomba bia igoro nigo biarenge ebieng’e gochia ime kobua ebia inse na ebia gati.
Orwaki ndwarenge mbarabare y’ebinyomba biria rwarochie gochia ase eraaro ya isiko. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano.
Obotambe bw’ebinyomba biarochie ase eraaro ya isiko nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obotambe bw’ebio biarenge ang’e ne Hekalu amaboko rigana erimo.
Inse y’ebinyomba ebio, ensemo ya moocha egesoero nkiarengeo ase omonto aranyare gosoera korwa ase eraaro ya isiko.
Enyomba eria rirondo yanachanire ebinyomba yarenge ang’e norwaki oronetu rwarenge irianyi, egati y’aase atigire ataagachire na oboagacho bwa irianyi.

Bosio bw’ebinyomba ebio aase arenge goeterwa narengeo. Ebinyomba ebio nigo biareng’aine na biria biarenge ensemo ya sugusu. Obotambe bwabo na obogare nigo bwarenge buna obw’ebio. Aase abo onsi arenge goeterwa nigo areng’aine buna aase aria aande, na emeroberio ende yonsi amo nebisieri nigo biarenge buna emeroberio eria ende.

Ebisieri biabo nigo biarenge buna ebi’ebinyomba bia sugusu. Egesieri nkiarenge ase omochakano bw’aase aria arenge goeterwa, engencho yaye aase arenge ensemo ya moocha ang’e norwaki ase omonto aranyare goetera.

Omonto oria agantebia, “Ebinyomba ebio bire ensemo ya sugusu, na ebia irianyi, kororia aase atigire ataagachiri, ebio nebichenu. Abakuani abwo bagotenena ase obosio bw’Omonene nao barabe bakoriera ebing’wanso bire ebichenu mono; agwo nao barabeke ebing’wanso bire ebichenu mono: okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, na ebi’okomocha, ekiagera aase agwo naachenu.

Ekero abakuani barabe bagosoa Aase Aachenu tibagosoka korwa agwo gocha ase eraaro ya isiko bataruseti chianga chi’obokoreri bwabo, bachitige ase ebinyomba, ebio, ekiagera nebichenu bire. Goika babeke chianga ching’ao ekero bagosoka gochia aase abanto bare.”
Ekero omonto oria konya akoorire korenga aase e Hekalu a ime, agansokia isiko goetera ase egeita kiarenge ensemo ya moocha, erio akarenga aase onsi aetanaine Hekalu.
Akaimokia emoti, akarengera ensemo ya moocha, ekaba chimoti amagana atano.
Erio akaonchoka, akarenga ensemo ya sugusu, ekaba chimoti amagana atano.
Akarenga ensemo ya irianyi, ekaba chimoti amagana atano.
Naende akaonchoka gochia ensemo ya bosongo, akayerenga ekaba chimoti amagana atano.

Naboigo akarenga chinsemo chionsi inye chi’aase aria. Orwaki nigo rwaetanaineo; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obwe chimoti amagana atano, na obogare bwaye boigo. Orwaki orwo nigo rwatananete aase aachenu korwa aase ataatananetwe abe aachenu.
Nyuma y’ayio akang’ira goika ase egeita kiarochie moocha.
Nkarora obonene bwa Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli bogocha korwa moocha; eriogi ri’ogocha kwaye nigo riarenge koeera buna eri’amache amange, na ense ekamorekwa nobonene bwaye.

Obonene obwo naroche ase okorora nigo bwarenge buna boria naroche ekero nachete gosaria omochie o Yerusalemu, na buna okorora koria konya narorire agwo ase orooche rwa Kebari. Erio ngatung’ama inse nkaumama.
Obonene bw’Omonene bogasoa Hekalu goetera ase egeita kia moocha.
Aroro agwo Omoika okany’imokereria igoro, okang’ira ase eraaro ya ime, na nkarora obonene bw’Omonene bwaichoire ase Hekalu eria yonsi.
Erio omonto agatenena mbarabare asende, na nkaigwa omonto onde ogokwana nainche korwa ime ye Hekalu eria,

agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, aase aiga nao ekerogo kiane ki’obonene kere, naende nao amagoro aane agotacha. Aiga nimenye ase egati y’Abaisraeli kogenderera botambe. Na Abaisraeli gose abaruoti babo tibakogenderera gokora erieta riane richenu ribe eritachenegeti, goetera ase obonyaka bwabo bw’ogosasima emegwekano, na emebere ekwete y’abaruoti babo, na aase abo aimokererete igoro.

Ekero barabwo babekire emeriibo yabo ya inse ang’e neyane, na emetobwa yabo ang’e neyane, batigire orwaki rwabo ase egati yabo na inche, nigo bakorire erieta riane richenu riabeire eritachenegeti, ekiagera bakorire ay’okogechia. Ase ayio nabasiririe inde nendamwamu.
Tiga barusie korwa asende obonyaka bwabo bw’ogosasima emegwekano, na emebere ekwete y’abaruoti babo, erio nario ndamenye ase egati yabo kogenderera botambe.
“Aye mwanyabanto, tebia Abaisraeli amang’ana ayio igoro y’enyomba eyio, erinde basookigwe ase engencho y’amabe abo. Tiga barenge oboagacho obwo obuya.

Onye bakoba nobosooku ase engencho y’amabe onsi bakorire, rirorio oborokie omogwekano bw’enyomba eyio buna erobeirie, na aase aye agosoerwa na aase agosokerwa, na okororekana kwaye, amo nemeroberio yaye yonsi, na amachiko aye. Oyarikere agwo ase amasio abo, erinde babwate emeroberio yaye yonsi na koyekora.
Oko nakwo ogochika gwe Hekalu: Igoro y’egetunwa, na aase onsi areo, nabe aachenu mono; ee, okwo nakwo ogochika gwe Hekalu.

“Ebi nabio ebirengo bi’egesasimero, ase ekerengo ki’amaboko amo neki’obogare bw’egesanyi: Enterekerero yaye nigo yarenge ey’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo korwa inse gochia igoro, na obogare gochia ase egesasimero ekenyene okoboko okomo. Orosingo roetanaine omogo bw’enterekerero eria nigo rwarenge orw’ekerengo gi’ekeng’ese gi’okoboko okomo gochia igoro. Eyio nigo yarenge enterekerero yaye.

Korwa enterekerero inse goika egetambokero kie ritang’ani ki’egesasimero ekenyene nigo kiarenge obotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere gochia igoro, na obogare gochia ime okoboko okomo; na korwa ase egetambokero keria egeke gochia ase ekere ekenene, nigo bwarenge obotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ane, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo.
Aase bagoutera omorero na gosambera ebing’wanso igoro y’egesasimero nigo arenge ay’ekerengo ki’amaboko ane gochia igoro, na korwa aroro emegwekano ene ye chingunchara yaroisirie yarochie igoro.
Na eriko riria nigo riarenge eri’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na abere, obotambe na obogare nigo biareng’aine.

Egetumo ki’egesasimero nigo kiarenge egi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na ane, obotambe na obogare nigo biareng’aine. Orosingo rwaetanaine omogo oye nigo rwarenge nobogare bw’ekerengo gi’ekerengo gi’ekeng’ese gi’okoboko okomo. Enterekerero y’egesasimero nigo yarenge ey’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo ase chinsemo chionsi na ekeriinero kiaye nigo kiarenge ensemo ya moocha.”

Naende omonto oria agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Eye nero emeroberio echikire erakorwe ase egesasimero ase rituko erio kerabe kiaagachirwe, erinde ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa biruerwe aroro, na amanyinga nabe akonyororokerigwa igoro yaye.
Ase rituko erio oe abakuani Abalawi b’ororeria rwa Zadoki eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Abwo nabwo baeirwe ribaga ri’okong’ika ang’e ase ogonkorera. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.

Erio oimokie amanyinga make ay’ekeng’wanso ekio, oyagindie ase emegwekano eria ene ye chingunchara ere ase egesasimero, na ase chikoona inye chi’egesasimero, na igoro ase orosingo rw’egesasimero chinsemo chionsi. Ase enchera eyio nochene egesasimero na kogekorera okobwatanigwa.
Naende oire eeri eria oyerue ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, oyesambere aase achikire, isiko y’Aase Aachenu.
Rituko ria kabere orue egoree ensae, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe; na egesasimero gechenwe buna giachenetwe nekeng’wanso ki’eeri eria.
Ekero gwakoorire kogechena igo, orente eeri ensae na emingichi korwa ase riicho, chionsi ibere chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
Erio ochirente ase obosio bw’Omonene, na abakuani bachinyororokerie omonyo na gochirua chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene.

Kera rituko ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere mobe mokorua egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe; boigo mobe mokorua eeri ensae na emingichi korwa ase riicho, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
Ase enchera eyio, ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, mobe mogokorera egesasimero okobwatanigwa na kogechena, mogiatanane kebe egechenu.

Ekero amatuko ayio atano na abere aerire, rituko ria gatano na gatato na kogenderera abakuani mbabe bakorua igoro ase egesasimero ekio ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe; erio nario inche ndabanchere. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
Erio omonto oria akang’ira gochia ase egeita gia isiko kiarenge ensemo ya moocha ye Hekalu; egeita ekio nigo giasiekire.

Omonene agantebia, “Egeita eke nigo keragenderere gosiekwa, tigekoigorwa rinde, na monto onde tagosoera aroro, ekiagera aiga nao Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, asoerete ime. Ase ayio goika kegenderere gosiekwa.
Omogambi bweka nere oraikaranseo ariere endagera ase obosio bw’Omonene. Nigo arasoere goetera gesona ki’oboagacho bore geita, naende asokere enchera eyio eyio.”
Naende akang’ira, akang’eteria ase egeita gia sugusu, bosio bwe Hekalu; nkarigereria nkarora obonene bw’Omonene bwaichoire ase enyomba y’Omonene. Agwo ngatung’ama inse nkaumama.

Erio Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, rengereria mono, origererie namaiso ao, na oigwe namato ao amang’ana onsi ngochia kogotebia igoro y’emeroberio echikire ase enyomba y’Omonene, na amachiko onsi igoro y’enyomba eye. Origererie mono buna abanto baranyare gosoa ase enyomba y’Omonene na buna baranyare gosoka.
“Otebie abanto b’egesaku ki’Abaisraeli, abwo bare abasaria, ng’a aya naro inche Omonene Nyasae ngoteba: Inwe Abaisraeli, tiga ogokora kwaino gw’okogechia goisanere agwo.

Inwe mwarentire ime ase enyomba yane enchenu abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni abatarogeti ase chinkoro chiabo, na ase emebere yabo, kobeera ime ase enyomba yane na mwayekorire yabeire eyetachenegeti, ekero mokorua asende okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebitinya, na amanyinga. Inwe mwasaririe okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, boigo mwakorire ogokora konde gwonsi gw’okogechia.
Inwe abanyene timobeti mogokorera ebinto biane ebichenu, korende mwabekire abanto abaao bakaba bakobikorera ase enyomba yane enchenu ribaga riaino.
“Ase ayio, aya naro inche Omonene Nyasae ngoteba: Omonto onde bwensi bw’egesaku ekegeni otarogeti ase enkoro, na ase omobere, ore ase egati y’Abaisraeli, tabaisa gosoa ase enyomba yane enchenu.
“Abalawi abwo baruete asende bagantiga, bakagenda gosasima emegwekano yabo, ekero Abaisraeli bande basaretie; egesusuro ki’ogosaria kwabo nkebairanere.

Nabo baranyare gokora emeremo ase enyomba yane enchenu, naende bagenderere korenda ebiita bi’enyomba yane na gokora emeremo ende ase enyomba eyio; mbabe bakonyenya ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde ase engencho y’abanto, mbabe bagotenena ase amasio abo kobakorera.

Ekiagera abakuani abwo batenenete ase amasio ’abanto gokorera emegwekano yabo bagosasima, na igo bakaba ekegocha ase Abaisraeli, bakagera barabwo bagakora ebibe, ase ayio inche Omonene Nyasae natianire ng’a egesusuro ki’ogosaria kwabo goika kebairanere.
Tibagocha ang’e ase ebinto biane ebichenu, gose ase ebio bire ebichenu mono. Goika berorere obosooku bw’ogokora kwabo gw’okogechia okwo babeire bagokora.
Korende nimbabeke babe abarendi be Hekalu, babe bagokora emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie aroro.

“Korende abakuani Abalawi, abwo b’ororeria rwa Zadoki, abwo bagendererete gonkorera ase enyomba yane enchenu, ekero Abaisraeli bande basaretie bagantiga, barabwo mbache ang’e nainche bankorere, mbabe bagotenena ase obosio bwane banduere ebitinya na amanyinga. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
Barabwo mbasoe ase enyomba yane enchenu, bache ang’e nemesa yane bankorere, naende bagenderere korenda amang’ana aane nachikire.

Ekero barabe bagosoa ase ebiita bigosoerwa ase eraaro ya ime, babeke chianga chiroisirie korwa ase egatani. Tibabaisa kobeka chianga chiroisirie korwa ase amarionya, ekero bagendererete gokora emeremo agwo ase amaagacho are egeita kegosoerwa ase eraaro ya ime, na ime ase enyomba.
Barabwo mbabeke ase emetwe yabo ebitambaa biroisirie korwa ase egatani, naende babeke chisirwari chi’egatani; tibakweboeria kende gionsi keragere bagiramore.

Ekero batarasoka gochia ase abanto bare ase eraaro ya isiko goika barusie chianga echio chi’obokoreri, bachitige agwo ase ebinyomba biria ebichenu, na babeke chianga ching’ao. Batakoreti bo, nigo barabaise gochena abanto ne chianga echio chiabo.
“Abakuani abwo tibagokigita chitukia chi’emetwe yabo, gose tibagochitiga chitambee, korende nigo barachinache chieng’ee.
Omokuani onde bwensi takonywa edivai ekero agochia gosoa ase eraaro ya ime.
Ere takonyuoma omokungu omoboraka, gose oyotiganire nomosacha oye, korende nanyare konyuoma omoiseke omwekungi bw’ororeria rw’Abaisraeli, gose nabo aranyare konyuoma omokungu omoboraka bw’omokuani.
“Barabwo mborokererie abanto baane bamanye gwatanana ebinto bire ebichenu na ebitaatananiri koba ebichenu, naende baborokererie bamanye gwatanana ebinto bichenegete na ebitachenegeti.

Ekero amariomana are ase abanto, abakuani mbabe abagambi b’ebina, mbabe bakogamba ebina ase okobwatia oboronge bwane. Mbarende emeroberio yane echikire, na amachiko aane ay’Amatuko Amanene. Boigo mbarende Chisabato chiane chibe chinchenu.

“Omokuani tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogokuna egetondo ki’omonto okure. Nare ne ribaga gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase abanto aba: ise, na ng’ina, na omwana oye, omomura gose omoiseke, na momura omwabo, na moiseke omwabo oyotaraba nomosacha.
Ekero omokuani oyio achenirwe nabarerwe amatuko atano na abere.
Ase rituko riria arasoe ase eraaro ya ime ase obokoreri bwaye agwo Aase Aachenu, goika arue ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ebibe. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
“Omwando obo nigo orabe iga: Ninche omonyene inde omwando obo. Timokobaa enibo ende yonsi, ekiagera ninche omonyene inde enibo yabo.
Barabwo mbabe bakoria okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, na ebi’okomocha, na kera egento keraatananwe na gokungwa asende korwa ase egati y’Abaisraeli nkebe eki’abakuani.
Moe abakuani okwama kwaino ogotang’ani gwa kera egento; boigo mobae okorua kwaino, na obosie bw’ogotongora kwaino. Erio nario ogosesenigwa koragenderere koba ase chinyomba chiaino.
Abakuani tibabaisa koria enyama ende yonsi y’enyoni gose ey’eng’iti ekwete yoka enyene, gose eitire ne ching’iti chinde.

“Ekero morabe mogoaka obomera ase ogwatera abanto ense yaino ebe emiando yabo, mwatananere na Omonene emonga yaye ebe enchenu. Obotambe bw’emonga eyio nigo borabe obw’ekerengo gie chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare bwaye chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000). Emonga eyio engima nigo erabe enchenu.

Korwa ase oboremo obwo mwatanane aase Hekalu eraagachwe. Obotambe bwaye nigo borabe obwe chimoti amagana atano (500), na obogare bwaye chimoti amagana atano (500) boigo. Eraaro eetanaineo nigo erabe nobogare bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano.
Ase oboremo obwo obochenu mwatanane ensemo ere nobotambe bwe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare bwe chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000), agwo nao moraagache Aase Aachenu Mono.

Oboremo obwo mbobe ensemo enchenu y’ense eye, bobe obw’abakuani abwo bare abakoreri b’Aase Aachenu bagotenena ase obosio bw’Omonene. Nao baraagache chinyomba chiabo, naende nao arabe aase aachenu ase Hekalu eraagachwe.

Ensemo ende eisaine obotambe bwe chimoti emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000), nebe ey’Abalawi, abwo bagokora emeremo ase Hekalu; eyio nebe omwando obo ase baraagache emechie bakomenya.

“Naende mwate ensemo ende eye ebebekaine noboremo obwo obochenu ebe nobogare bwe chimoti chilifu isano (5,000), na obotambe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000). Eyio nebe ase omochie omonene oraagachwe, ase Abaisraeli bande bonsi baranyare komenya.

“Ensemo ende yatwe eegwe omogambi. Eyio nigo erabe ase chinsinyo chionsi ibere chi’oboremo boria obochenu, na obw’omochie oria omonene, ensemo ya moocha na eya bosongo. Korwa ensinyo ya bosongo y’oboremo boria obochenu, na boria bw’omochie omonene, oboremo bw’omogambi bogaree gochia bosongo boreng’ane nobwa kera egesaku, na ensemo ya moocha boigo bogaree gochia moocha.
Ensemo eyio nebe ey’omogambi agwo ase ense y’Abaisraeli. Abagambi baane tibabaisa kogenderera gochanda abanto baane, korende batige kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli kemenye ase orogongo rwaye.

“Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Inwe abagambi b’Abaisraeli, amabe ayio mwakorire aisanire. Motige kegima ogokora okobe na okourereria; monache ebina bi’ekeene na oboronge; timoseria abanto baane korwa ase chinka chiabo. Nabo Omonene atebire.
“Goika motware ebirengero bi’ekeene mokorengera oborito na obonge bw’ebinto bionsi.

Ekerengero gia efa (gose egetonga) na ekia bati (gose ensiongo) bibe ekerengo ekemo. Kera ekemo getware ensemo eyemo ya ikomi y’ekerengero gekorokwa homeri. Ekerengero kiaino ekenene mokorengera kebe ekie homeri.
“Ase chibesa, esekeli eyemo nigo ebwate chigera emerongo ebere; emina eyemo nigo ebwate chisekeli emerongo etano nomo (emerongo ebere, na emerongo ebere na isano, na ikomi na isano).
“Oko nakwo okorua morarente: Ebimunu bibere korwa ase ebitonga ikomi bi’engano, na ebimunu bibere korwa ase ebitonga ikomi bi’esairi.
Morue amaguta ekerengo gechikire, ebituba bibere korwa ase ekori eyemo. (Ekori eyemo nigo ereng’aine ne homeri eyemo; nigo ebwate chibati ikomi).

“Korwa ase amaicho are ase amarisio ’Abaisraeli morue eng’ondi eyemo korwa ase ching’ondi amagana abere, ebe okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase abanto. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
“Abanto bonsi b’ense eye goika baire okoruegwa okwo ase omogambi ore ase Abaisraeli.

Nigo erabe emeremo y’omogambi arue ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa, ase Amatuko Amanene, na ase emeyega y’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ase Chisabato, engencho yaye Amatuko Amanene achikire ase Abaisraeli. Ere narue ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase Abaisraeli.”
“Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, moire eeri ensae etari na kemocho ase omobere oye ase ogochena Hekalu.
Omokuani aimokie amanyinga make ay’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’ebibe, agindie emetobwa y’egesieri gie Hekalu, ne chikoona inye chi’egesasimero, na emetobwa y’egesoero kegochia ase eraaro ya ime.

Okore boigo ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ri’omotienyi, ase engencho y’omonto onde bwensi okorire ebibe atancheti, gose ayakorete ase oboriri bwaye. Ase enchera eyio mokore okobwatanigwa ase Hekalu.
“Ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani mobe ne Rituko Rinene ri’Epasaka, na ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere naro moyabwate na mobe mokoria emegati etabekiri memera.
Ase rituko erio omogambi arue eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase engencho yaye omonyene, na ase engencho y’abanto bonsi b’ense eyio.

Ase kera rituko ase engaki y’amatuko ayio atano na abere, omogambi oria nabe okorua ase Omonene chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi isano na ibere, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, naende abe okorua egoree eyemo kera rituko ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
Naende arue okoruegwa kw’endagera, egetonga ekemo amo na kera eeri, na egetonga ekemo amo na kera emingichi, na amaguta ebituba bine amo na kera egetonga ekemo gi’okoruegwa kw’endagera.

“Gochakera rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, na kogenderera, ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere Aria Amanene, omogambi oria arue ebing’wanso bi’ebibe buna biria amo nebi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’amaguta.

“Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Egeita kia moocha kegosoerwa gochia ase eraaro ya ime, goika kegenderere gosiekwa ase engaki yonsi y’amatuko atano na rimo ay’ogokora emeremo, korende ase rituko ri’Esabato, na eri’Omotienyi Omoyia, goika keigorwe.

Omogambi asoe goetera ase egesona ki’oboagacho bore geita, atenene ase omotobwa bw’egesieri kere aroro. Omogambi oria abe ogosasimera agwo ase egesoero ekero abakuani bagendererete korua ebing’wanso biaye bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe. Erio omogambi asoke isiko, korende egeita keria tigesiekwa goika mogoroba.
Kera Esabato, na kera Omotienyi Omoyia, abanto b’ense eyio goika babe bagosasimera agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo ase egesoero ki’egeita ekio.
Ase rituko ri’Esabato omogambi arue ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene, chimanwa chie ching’ondi isano nemo, na emingichi eyemo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

Amo nemingichi eria arue okoruegwa kw’endagera egetonga ekemo, na amo ne chimanwa chiria chie ching’ondi arue okoruegwa kw’endagera ekerengo aranyare korua; boigo amo na kera egetonga gi’okoruegwa kw’endagera arue ebituba bine bi’amaguta.
Ase rituko ri’Omotienyi Omoyia arue eeri ensae eyemo, ne chimanwa chie ching’ondi isano nemo, na emingichi eyemo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

Amo neeri eria arue okoruegwa kw’endagera egetonga ekemo na amo nemingichi eria boigo, na amo ne chimanwa chiria chie ching’ondi arue okoruegwa kw’endagera ase ekerengo aranyare korua; boigo amo na kera egetonga gi’okoruegwa kw’endagera arue ebituba bine bi’amaguta.
Ekero omogambi oria arasoe aetere egesona ki’oboagacho bore geita, naende airanere enchera eyio eyio.

“Ekero abanto b’ense eyio barache ase obosio bw’Omonene gosasima ase Amatuko Amanene, abwo barasoere egeita gia sugusu gocha gosasima, goika basokere egeita kia irianyi; na abwo barasoere egeita kia irianyi goika basokere egia sugusu; monto onde tairanera ase asoerete, korende airanere egeita kerochie ase ekio asoerete.
Omogambi asoe ime amo nabanto, na ekero bagosoka, nere asoke amo nabarabwo.

Ase engaki y’emeyega, na ey’Amatuko Amanene achikire, morue okoruegwa kw’endagera egetonga ekemo amo na kera eeri eyemo, na okoruegwa kw’endagera egetonga ekemo amo na kera emingichi eyemo, na amo nechimanwa chie ching’ondi okoruegwa kw’endagera ekerengo moranyare korua, na amo na kera egetonga gi’okoruegwa kw’endagera ebituba bine bi’amaguta.

“Ekero omogambi ararente ase Omonene okorua kwaye kw’ogwancha, gakorabe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gose eki’omorembe, aigorerwe egeita kerochie moocha. Nigo ararue ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ogosambwa, na eki’omorembe, ase enchera buna eria agokora ase rituko ri’Esabato. Gasokire, egeita keria giasiekwa.
“Kera emambia, rituko ase rituko, obe gokorua ase Omonene emanwa y’eng’ondi yakoorire omwaka oyomo etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.

Boigo kera emambia orue ase Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera ebimunu bine, na egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese amaguta ochoganirie nobosie bw’okoruegwa koria kw’endagera. Oyo noro omoroberio ochikire orabe okogenderera botambe.
Ase enchera eyio emanwa y’eng’ondi, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na amaguta, mbibe bikoruegwa kera emambia, rituko ase rituko, bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa keragenderere koruegwa botambe.

“Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Omogambi karae oyomo bw’abana baye abamura oboremo bw’orogongo rwaye, oboremo obwo mbobe omwando bw’oyio oboegwa; ee, omwando oyio nigo orabe oyo bw’abana b’omomura oyio.

Korende onye okoa omosomba oye oboremo bw’orogongo rwaye, omosomba oria nigo aragenderere gotwara ekeegwa ekio goika engaki y’omwaka bw’obosibore eike, erio akeiranie ase omogambi oria. Omwando oyo nigo ore oyo bw’omogambi oria, na orachie koegwa abana baye.
Omogambi takoura abanto emiando yabo ayee abana baye, korende nigo arae abana baye emiando korwa ase omwando oye omonyene. Igo monto onde tari ase abanto baane oraurwe enibo yaye.”
Erio omonto oria akang’eteria ase egesoero kiarenge ang’e negeita, agansoyia ase ebinyomba ebichenu bi’abakuani biarenge sugusu, nkarora aase aria korwa nyuma, ensemo ya bosongo.

Naende agantebia, “Aase aiga nao abakuani baraiyekere ebing’wanso bi’okomocha, na ebi’ebibe, naende nao bararugere okoruegwa kw’endagera, erinde tibabaisa korenta ebinto ebio ase eraaro ya isiko, babaise gocha gochena abanto.”
Naende akang’ira ase eraaro ya isiko, akang’etia ase chikoona chiaye inye, na nkarora ase kera ekoona ekeooreri nkiarengeo.
Ebiooreri ebio bine biare ase chikoona chi’eraaro nigo biagiteire. Obotambe bwabo nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo ene, na obogare amaboko emerongo etato, bionsi nigo biareng’aine.
Orwaki nigo rwaetanaine kera ekemo ki’ebiooreri ebio bine. Inse ase orwaki mbarabare amariko akorugerwa naroisirieo.
Omonto oria agantebia: “Aya namariko ase abwo bagokora emeremo ye Hekalu bakoiyekera ebing’wanso abanto bakorua.”

Nyuma y’ayio omonto oria akang’ira gochia ase egesieri gie Hekalu. Nkarora amache akorwa inse y’egesona gie Hekalu, agotirimboka gochia moocha ase enyomba eria yarochie. Amache aria agaeta korwa inse y’ensemo ya moocha ye Hekalu agwo irianyi y’egesasimero.
Erio omonto oria agansokia isiko akang’eteria ase egeita gia isiko kiarochie sugusu, akang’etanania gochia ase egeita kiarochie moocha; aroro agwo nkarora amache akorwa ensemo ya irianyi y’egeita.

Omonto oria nigo abwate emoti y’okorengera, akagenda, akabwatia orooche gochia moocha, akarenga obotambe bw’amaboko elifu eyemo, na agwo akanyambokia ase amache, na amache aria akaang’ika ase ebitarenge bi’amagoro.

Naende akabwatia orooche roria, akarenga obotambe bw’amaboko ande elifu eyemo, akanyambokia ase amache aria, naro akang’ika ase amaru. Naende akarenga amaboko elifu eyemo ende, akanyambokia ase amache, naro akang’ika ase ekenema.
Naende akarenga amaboko elifu eyemo ende, bono konya rwabeire orooche oronene ntare konyara gotaara imeo. Amache aria konya aichoire mono, tinare konyara kwamboka otatiga ase ogoaka entimbu.
Omonto oria akamboria, “Aye mwanyabanto, kwarorire aya?” Erio akang’irania, akang’etia mbarabare ase engegu y’orooche orwo.
Ekero nare goeta ase engegu eyio nkarora emete emenge ase chingegu chi’orooche orwo ase chinsemo chionsi.
Omonto oria agantebia, “Amache aya nigo akogenda ase ensemo ya moocha gochia riranya ria Yorodan, na ekero arasoe ase enyancha ere namache are nomonyo nansie amache ayio abe amaya.

Aase aande onsi amache ayio aragende, kera egetongwa kere moyo kemenye ime yaye nkegenderere koba moyo, ne chinswe chinyinge mono nchibeo. Ee, ekero amache aria araike ase enyancha eria, amache ’enyancha eria nanse abe amaya, na kera egento nkenyore obogima.

Abarubi mbatenene ase engegu y’orooche orwo gochakera Eni‐Gedi na goikera Eni‐Egelaimu. Aase agwo nabe ase ebionga bikorutwa, na ebisaku ebinge bie chinswe mbibe aroro buna bire ase Enyancha eria Enene.
Korende amache are ase chitente chiaye, na amatibo aye, tagwansa abe amaya, korende nigo aragenderere koba nomonyo.

Ase chingegu chi’orooche orwo chinsemo chionsi ibere emete y’ebisaku ao ao ekwama amatunda akoriegwa nemereo. Amato ’emete eyio tagosusana, gose emete eyio tekomocha kwama amatunda. Kera omotienyi nigo erame amatunda amayia, ekiagera amache agocha ase emete eyio nigo arabe akorua ase Hekalu. Ase ayio amatunda ’emete eyio nabe endagera, na amato abo nabe eriogo rikogwenia abanto.”
Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Echi nachio chirabe chimbebe chi’ense egochia gwatananerwa ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli ebe emiando yabo. Ororeria rwa Yusufu rororwo roegwe ebitari bibere.
Mobaatere mobareng’anerie kera omonto ensemo yaye. Nigo netianetie koa chisokoro chiaino ense eye; ase ayio ense eyio nebe omwando oino.
“Eri nario rirabe ribebe riaino: Ribebe ria sugusu richakere korwa ase Enyancha Enene, rietere emechie ya Heteloni, na Sedadi,
na Hamati, na Berota, na Sibiraimu, eyio ere ase egati y’omochie o Damesiki, na oyo o Hamati. Naende rigenderere goika Haseri‐Atikoni ere ang’e ne ribebe ria Haurani.

Ase ayio ribebe erio richakere korwa ase enyancha rigenderere goika Hasari‐Enoni, omochie ore ase ribebe ria Damesiki, naende rigenderere gochia sugusu goika ase orogongo rwa Hamati. Nario rirabe ribebe ria sugusu.

“Ribebe ria moocha richakere korwa ase egati ya Haurani na Damesiki, ribwatie orooche rwa Yorodan, gati ya Gileadi na ense y’Abaisraeli, rigenderere kobwatia Enyancha y’Omonyo. Naboigo morariate. Erio nario rirabe ribebe ria moocha.

“Ribebe ria irianyi richakere korwa Tamari, rigenderere goikera ase amache a Kadeshi‐Meriba; korwa agwo rigenderere kobwatia akarooche ka Misiri, ritwomere Enyancha Enene. Erio nario rirabe ribebe ria irianyi.
“Enyancha Enene nero erabe ribebe ria bosongo goikera ase egesoero kia Hamati. Eyio nero erabe ribebe ria bosongo.
“Naboigo moraaterane ense eyio koreng’ana buna inwe ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli more.

Moyiaterane ase ogoaka obomera, ebe emiando yaino na ey’abamenyi bare ase egati yaino baiborerete abana ase egati yaino. Abwo babe asemore buna ababiare b’Abaisraeli, baegwe emiando ase egati y’ebisaku biaino inwe Abaisraeli.
Omomenyi goika aegwe omwando oye agwo ase egesaku ekio ase amenyete. Nabo inche Omonene natebire.

“Oyo noro omoroberio buna ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli biramenye: Egesaku kia Dani keegwe orogongo rwa sugusu. Ribebe riabo ribwatie enchera ya Heteloni agwo ase egesoero kia Hamati, rigenderere gochia Hasari‐Enoni, omochie ore ase ribebe ria sugusu ria Damesiki. Orogongo orwo rwa Dani nigo rorabe korwa ensinyo ya moocha y’ense eyio goika ensinyo ya bosongo.
Egesaku gi’Aseri keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Dani korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
Egesaku kia Nafutali keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norw’Aseri korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
Egesaku kia Manase keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Nafutali korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
Egesaku gia Efraimu keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Manase korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
Egesaku kia Reuben keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Efraimu korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
Egesaku kia Yuda keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Reuben korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.

“Orogongo robebekaine norwa Yuda korwa moocha goika bosongo, nigo roratigwe robe aase mokoruera okoruegwa ogochenu. Obogare bwaye nigo borabe obwe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obotambe bwaye nigo borabe buna obwa kera egesaku korwa moocha goika bosongo. Gati‐gati y’orogongo orwo aase aachenu nao arabe.
“Orogongo orwo morotige robe orw’Omonene; obotambe bwaye nigo borabe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000).

Abakuani mbanyore orogongo rwabo korwa ase orwo orochenu. Orogongo rwabo nigo rorabe nobotambe bwe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000) korwa moocha goika bosongo, na korwa sugusu goika irianyi robe chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000). Aase aachenu ay’Omonene nigo arabe gati‐gati y’oboremo obwo.
Orogongo orwo nigo rorabe orw’abakuani abwo bachenekire, abwo b’ororeria rwa Zadoki. Abwo nigo babete abegenwa asende, tibantigete buna Abalawi bande bakorete ekero Abaisraeli basaretie bagantiga.
Orogongo orwo nigo rorabe aase mokoruera okoruegwa ogochenu aatananire korwa ase ensemo eria ere enchenu. Nigo rorabe orochenu mono robebekane norw’Abalawi.

Abalawi baegwe orogongo robebekane norw’abakuani; nigo rorabe nobotambe bwe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000). Obotambe bwe chingongo chionsi nigo borabe chimoti chilifu, emerongo ebere na isano (25,000) na obogare chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000).
Orogongo orwo tirobaisa koonigwa gose koonchorerigwa; orogongo orwo rore oruya goetania echinde chionsi tiroegwa onde, ekiagera nigo rore orochenu ase Omonene.

“Orogongo roratigare rore nobogare bwe chimoti chilifu isano (5,000), na obotambe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), nigo rorabe orw’abanto bande bonsi, baraagache emechie yabo aroro, naende robe orw’oborisia. Agwo nao omochie omonene oraagachwe gati‐gati.

Ekerengo ki’omochie oyio nigo kerabe iga: Ensemo ya sugusu chimoti chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500), na ensemo ya irianyi chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500), na ensemo ya moocha chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500), na ensemo ya bosongo chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500).

Omochie oyio nigo orabe namarisio buna iga: Oborisia bwa sugusu nigo borabe obw’ekerengo gie chimoti amagana abere, na emerongo etano (250), na obwa irianyi amagana abere, na emerongo etano (250), na obwa moocha amagana abere, na emerongo etano (250), na obwa bosongo amagana abere, na emerongo etano (250).

Orogongo orwo roratigare robebekaine na roria orochenu, nigo rorabe orw’ekerengo gie chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000) gochia moocha, na chilifu ikomi (10,000) gochia bosongo. Endagera erame aroro nigo erabe ey’abwo barabe bagokora emeremo ase omochie oyio ime.
Abakori emeremo b’omochie oyio ab’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli mbabe bakorema orogongo orwo.

“Orogongo roria rwonsi orochenu nigo rorabe orw’ekerengo gie chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), chinsemo chionsi nigo chirabe chireng’aine. Oro narwo orogongo orochenu amo norw’omochie oyio.

“Orogongo roratigare robebekaine na roria orochenu amo norw’omochie ase kera ensemo nigo rorabe orw’omogambi. Chingongo echio nigo chirachakere iga: Oromo korwa ase orogongo roria orochenu rw’ekerengo gie chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere, na isano (25,000), rogenderere gochia moocha koreng’ana ne chingongo chiria chi’ebisaku, na oronde gochia bosongo koreng’ana ne chingongo chiria chi’ebisaku. Chingongo echio nigo chirabe echi’omogambi. Orogongo orwo orochenu ase Hekalu erabe nigo rorabe gati‐gati.
Chingongo chi’omogambi nigo chirabebekane norw’Abalawi na orw’omochie, naende chibe ase egati y’orw’Abayuda na orw’Ababenjamin.
“Ebisaku binde biratigare biegwe chingongo chiabo buna iga: Egesaku kia Benjamin keegwe orogongo rwaye korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
Egesaku gia Simeoni keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Benjamin, korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
Egesaku gia Isakaru keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Simeoni korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
Egesaku gia Sabuloni keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Isakaru, korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
Egesaku kia Gadi keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Sabuloni korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
“Ribebe ria irianyi nigo rirabebekane norongogo rwa Gadi. Nigo riragenderere korwa Tamari gochia ase amache a Kadeshi‐Meriba, na korwa aroro ribwatie akarooche ka Misiri ritwomere Enyancha Enene.
“Eye nero ense moraatanane ase ogoaka obomera, ebe emiando y’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli. Ebio nabio birabe ebitari biabo. Nabo inche Omonene Nyasae natebire.
“Ebi nabio birabe ebiita bi’omochie oyio orabe nekerengo gie chimoti chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500):
Ebiita bitato nigo birabe ensemo ya sugusu. Ebiita ebio nigo birarokwe iga: Egeita kia Reuben, na ekia Yuda, na ekia Lawi. Ebiita bionsi nigo birarokwe kobwatekana namarieta ’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.
Ensemo ya moocha eyerabe nekerengo gie chimoti chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500), ebiita bitato mbibeo: Egeita kia Yusufu, na ekia Benjamin, na ekia Dani.
Ensemo ya irianyi eyerabe nekerengo gie chimoti chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500), ebiita bitato mbibeo: Egeita gia Simeoni, na egia Isakaru, na egia Sabuloni.
Ensemo ya bosongo eyerabe nekerengo gie chimoti chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500), ebiita bitato mbibeo: Egeita kia Gadi, na egia Aseri, na ekia Nafutali.
Goetanana omochie bwonsi nigo orabe ekerengo gie chimoti chilifu ikomi na isano na isato (18,000). Korwa rituko erio omochie oyio nigo orarokwe Omonene Nao Are Aa.”
Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba kwa Yehoyakimu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, agacha Yerusalemu akayoboera.

Omonene akabeka Yehoyakimu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro. Boigo akaa Nebukadinesaro ribaga aire ebikorero binde bi’enyomba ya Nyasae, na ere akabiira ase ense ya Shinari, ase enyomba y’enyasae yaye, akabibeka ase ekungo y’enyomba eria.
Erio omoruoti agachika Asipenasi, omoteneneri bw’abasomba b’enyomba yaye, arente abamura korwa ase egati y’Abaisraeli, abare ab’enyomba y’omoruoti, na abande abarenge ab’amasikani.

Abamura abwo goika babe abatari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, naende babe abanyabieni, bare abang’aini abaranyare kweorokereria chisemi, barabe abaango b’okomanya, baraisanere gokorera omoruoti ase enyomba yaye. Asipenasi aborokererie bamanye amariko ’Abakalidayo, naende bamanye gokwana Egekalidayo.

Omoruoti agachika ng’a kera rituko babe bakoegwa endagera buna eria ere omonyene are koria, naende babe bakonywa edivai buna eria ere omonyene are konywa. Nigo barenge gochia kworokererigwa ase engaki y’emiaka etato; nyuma y’ayio barentwe ase obosio bw’omoruoti, babe bakomokorera.
Ase egati y’abwo bachoretwe, korwa ase Abayuda nabwo aba: Danieli, na Hanania, na Mishaeli, na Asaria.
Omoteneneri oria omonene akabaroka amarieta amayia, akaroka Danieli Beli‐Tesasari, na Hanania Sadaraka, na Mishaeli Meshaka, na Asaria Abedi‐Nego.

Korende Danieli akanacha ase ebirengererio biaye ng’a tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase okoria endagera buna eria omoruoti are koria, gose konywa edivai buna eria omoruoti are konywa. Ase ayio agasaba omoteneneri oria omonene amoe ribaga tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka.
Nyasae akaa Danieli ogwancherwa na obuya ase obosio bw’omoteneneri oria omonene.

Omoteneneri oria agatebia Danieli, “Nairokire ng’a omonene one omoruoti, oyio obachikerete endagera yaino, na ebinyugwa biaino, ekero arabarore ng’a amasio aino anyirire kobua ay’abamura bande b’ekegori kiaino, nigo arambutore omotwe.”
Erio Danieli agakwana nomorendi oria obegetwe nomoteneneri oria omonene bw’abasomba b’omoruoti ng’a arende Danieli, na Hanania, na Mishaeli, na Asaria, akamotebia,
“Koranche ototeeme intwe abasomba bao ase engaki y’amatuko ikomi, obe kogotoa chindagera chikwama korwa ase riroba tokoria, na amache tokonywa.
Nyuma y’ayio origererie amasio aito na ay’abamura abwo bakoria endagera ekorwa ase omoruoti, na korarore buna tokororekana, otokorere buna oranche.”
Omorendi oria akaigwera amang’ana aria abo, akabateema ase engaki y’amatuko ikomi.
Ekero amatuko aria ikomi aerete, amasio abo akarorekana are amaya, na emebere yabo ere emeterere kobua ey’abamura bande, baria barenge koria endagera eria yare korwa ase omoruoti.
Ase ayio omorendi oria akabatiga tibaria endagera eria, na tibanywa edivai eria, bachikeretwe, akaba okobaa chindagera chikwama korwa ase riroba.
Nyasae akaa abamura baria bane chisemi na obomanyi bw’okomanya amariko ao ao, na obong’aini bwonsi; naende akaa Danieli obong’aini bw’okomanya engencho y’amaroro ne chindoto.
Ekero engaki eria yachigetwe nomoruoti Nebukadinesaro ng’a abamura baria bonsi barentwe asare yaigete, omoteneneri oria omonene akabaira ase omoruoti oria.
Omoruoti agakwana nabarabwo, na ase abwo bonsi onde tanyorekanete omogogetie buna Danieli, na Hanania, na Mishaeli, na Asaria. Ase ayio abwo bane bakaba bakomokorera omoruoti.
Ase amang’ana ande onsi omoruoti ababoretie igoro y’obong’aini na obomanyi, akabanyora ng’a nigo bamanyete ara ikomi goetania abaringoria na abaragori barenge ase oboruoti bwaye bwonsi.
Danieli akagenderera kobeera ase enyomba y’omoruoti goika omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Koresi.
Ase omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro ere akarota chindoto; ase ayio agachandeka ase ebirengererio biaye, tarara chitoro.
Erio omoruoti agachika ng’a abaringoria na abaragori, na abarogi, amo n’Abakalidayo bamanyete oborogi, barentwe, erinde bamotebie chindoto chiaye. Ase ayio abanto abwo bonsi bagacha ase obosio bwaye.
Ere akabatebia, “Narotete chindoto, na ebirengererio biane nigo bichandegete, Ninganetie montebie chindoto chiria.”
Abakalidayo baria bagatebia omoruoti ase omonwa bw’Ekearamaik, “Aye omoruoti ochie kare! Totebie intwe abasomba bao chindoto echio, na intwe ntonyare kogotebia engencho yaye.”

Omoruoti akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Amang’ana aane tari koonchoka, na motantebeti chindoto chiane amo nengencho yaye, nigo morabutoranwe ekiimo ase ekiimo, ne chinyomba chiaino nchitagorwe chibe amatombe.
Korende komorantebie chindoto chiria amo nengencho yaye, rirorio nimbae ebiegwa, na eng’eria, na amasikani amanene. Bono ntebie chindoto chiria amo nengencho yaye.”
Bakairaneria omoruoti eria kabere, “Aye omoruoti, tobebie intwe abasomba bao chindoto chiria, na intwe ntogotebie engencho yaye.”
Omoruoti akairaneria, akabatebia, “Ekeene, namanyire ng’a nigo moganetie koegwa chingaki, ekiagera mwamanyire ng’a amang’ana aane tari koonchoka.

Korende motantebeti chindoto chiria, ogochika nkore okomo gwoka narure igoro yaino. Mwabeire mokobwatana ase ogontebia oborimo na amang’ana ’obong’ainereria, mosemeretie ng’a chingaki nchionchorwe. Ase ayio goika montebie aya narotete, erio nario ndamanye ng’a mwamanyire engencho yaye moyentebie.”

Abakalidayo baria bakairaneria omoruoti, bakamotebia, “Monto onde tari ase ense eye oranyare koorokia ring’ana erio aye omoruoti oganetie komanya, ekiagera omoruoti onde tari, nonya ore omonene mono, gose ore nokobua kore naki, oboririe egento kenga buna ekio korwa ase abaringoria, gose abaragori, gose korwa ase Abakalidayo bamanyete oborogi.
Egento eke aye omoruoti kwaboririe nigo kere egekong’u mono, na onde tari oranyare gokeorokia ase omoruoti otatiga chinyasae, na echio tichimenyeti amo na mwanyabanto.”
Ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio, omoruoti akaba nendamwamu na ekeririanda ekenene, agachika ng’a abang’aini bonsi ba Babeli basirigwe.
Ase ayio ogochika gokaruegwa ng’a abanto abwo bonsi baitwe, na Danieli amo na baria bamwabo barigigwe baitwe boigo.
Ekero Arioki, omochiki bw’abarendi b’omoruoti, agendete ng’a aite abanto abang’aini ba Babeli, Danieli agakwana nere ore nobong’aini na obomanyi bw’amasikani,
akamoboria, “Nase ki omoruoti arure ogochika ogotindi iga?” Erio Arioki agatebia Danieli amang’ana onsi.
Danieli akagenda ase obosio bw’omoruoti, akamosaba amoe engaki achiche komotebia engencho ye chindoto chiria.
Erio Danieli akairana gochia inka, agatebia Hanania, na Mishaeli, na Asaria, abamwabo, amang’ana aria,
akabatebia ng’a basabe Nyasae ore igoro abarorere amabera, aborokie obobisi boria, erinde ere omonyene na baria bamwabo tibasirigwa amo nabanto baria abang’aini bande ba Babeli.
Erio obobisi boria bokamaanorwa ase Danieli ase okorora kwa botuko. Ase ayio Danieli akamotogia Nyasae ore igoro, agateba:
“Erieta ria Nyasae ritogigwe goika kare na kare! Obong’aini na okobua nebiaye.
Ere nigo akoonchora ebiro ne chingaki; nigo akorusia abaruoti, naende obeka abande; nigo akoa abang’aini obong’aini bwabo, na abamanyi okomanya kwabo.
Nigo akoorokia ay’obobisi bwa ime, nigo amanyete ayare ime ase omosunte; na omobaso nigo ore amo nere.

Aye Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiane, nagoakeire ng’a mbuya mono na kogotogia, ekiagera aye kwang’eire obong’aini ne chinguru, bono kwamanyirie inche aya twagosabete, ekiagera gwatoorokeirie aya omoruoti aganetie komanya.”

Ase engencho eyio Danieli akagenda ase Arioki, oria omoruoti achorete ng’a aite abanto abang’aini ba Babeli, akamotebia, “Tobaisa goita abang’aini ba Babeli; ng’ire ase obosio bw’omoruoti, imotebie engencho ye chindoto chiria.”
Erio bwango Arioki akaira Danieli ase obosio bw’omoruoti, akamotebia, “Nanyorire omonto korwa ase egati y’abooswa baria b’Abayuda oranyare kogotebia aye omoruoti engencho ye chindoto chiao.”
Omoruoti akaboria Danieli, oria orogetwe Beli‐Tesasari, “Inee! Aye nonyare gontebia chindoto echio narotete na engencho yaye?”

Danieli akairaneria omoruoti, akamotebia, “Onde tari ase abanto abang’aini, gose abaragori, gose abaringoria, gose abanto bamanyete igoro ye ching’enang’eni oranyare koorokia obobisi obo aye omoruoti kwaboririe,

korende Nyasae ore igoro nere oranyare koorokia obobisi. Nere orakomanyie aye omoruoti Nebukadinesaro amang’ana agochia gokorekana ase amatuko agochi‐gocha. Chindoto chiao na okorora kwarora, ekero kwaraire borere, nachio echi:
“Aye omoruoti, ekero kwaraire borere bwao, okarengereria amang’ana agochia gokorekana ase amatuko agochi‐gocha, na ere oria okoorokia obobisi nigo agokomanyia amang’ana agochia gokorekana.

Bono obobisi obo bwamaanoirwe asende, tari ng’a inche nigo imbwate obong’aini goetania abanto bande bonsi bare moyo, korende ng’a aye omoruoti omanyigwe engencho ye chindoto chiria, naende onyare komanya ebirengererio bire ase omoyo oo.

“Aye omoruoti, ase okorora kwao okarora omogwekano omonene mono, oteneine ase obosio bwao. Omogwekano oyio nigo orenge omotambe, okomeka‐meka noborabu obonene, na okororekana kwaye nigo kwarenge gw’okoondokia.

Omotwe bw’omogwekano oria nigo oroisetigwe korwa ase etahabu engiya mono; egekuba kiaye na amaboko aye nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase chifeta, na enda yaye na amariagati aye nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase chitaai.
Amagoro aye nigo aroisetigwe korwa ase ebioma, na ebisanyi bi’amagoro nigo biarenge ekeng’ese ki’ebioma, na ekeng’ese ki’amaroba.
Ekero kwarigereretie okarora rigena rigotegoka ritakuniri namaboko a mwanyabanto, rigaaka amagoro ’omogwekano oria arenge ay’ebioma na amaroba, rikayasamunyora akaba ebisamunye.

Erio ebioma biria, na amaroba, ne chitaai, ne chifeta, ne chitahabu, bionsi ebio bigasamunyoranwa, bikaba buna omoiriro ore ase ekeooreri ekero ki’eguru‐gura. Omwaga okairurukia ebinto biria gochia aare nonya nokoba kwabo tikwarorekana aande. Korende rigena riria riagete omogwekano oria rigakina, rikaba egetunwa ekenene kegaichora ase ense engima.
“Oko nakwo okorota kwarotete, na bono intwe ntogotebie aye omoruoti engencho yaye.
Aye omoruoti nigo ore omonene goetania abaruoti bande. Nyasae ore igoro okoeire oboruoti, na okobua, ne chinguru, na obonene,
naende obekire mwanyabanto ase amaboko ao obagambere aande onsi ase bamenyete; okobekire ogambere boigo ching’iti chi’ense ne chinyoni chionsi; na omotwe oria bw’etahabu kwaroche noro aye.
Korwa nyuma yao oboruoti bonde bore oboke ase obwao mbooroke, na nyuma y’oboruoti obwo, obonde bwa gatato bore obw’etaai mbooroke, na borobwo mbogambere ense yonsi.
Naende oboruoti bwa kane mbooroke, bore obokong’u buna ekioma kegoaka na gosenyenta ebinto bionsi. Buna koreng’ana ekioma kegosenyenta ebinto, oboruoti boria nabo borasenyente na gosiria onsi.

Na buna kwaroche ebisanyi na ebiara bi’amagoro biarenge ekeng’ese ki’amaroba na ekeng’ese ki’ebioma, engencho yaye nero eye: Oboruoti obwo mbwatananekane. Korende chinsemo chinde chire chinkong’u buna ekioma nachibe ime ase oboruoti obwo, buna koreng’ana kwarora ekioma keburukaine namaroba.
Na buna ebiara bi’amagoro biarenge ekeng’ese ki’ebioma na ekeng’ese ki’amaroba, naboigo oboruoti boria borabe obokong’u ensemo eyemo, na ensemo ende obworo.
Buna kwarora ekioma keria keburukaine namaroba, naboigo abanto barasang’anane ase okonyuomerana, korende tibakonyara kobwatana amo buna koreng’ana ekioma getari kobwatana namaroba.

Ase amatuko ’abaruoti abwo Nyasae ore igoro narente oboruoti botanyare gosarigwa, gose okobua kw’oboruoti obwo tibokoegwa egesaku kende. Obwo mbosenyente amaruoti onsi na koyasiria, na borobwo obonyene mbogenderere kobao goika kare na kare,

buna koreng’ana kwaroche rigena rigotegoka rinyene korwa ase egetunwa, ritategoiri namaboko a mwanyabanto, ne rigena riria rigaaka na gosamunyora ekioma, na etaai, na amaroba, na efeta, na etahabu. Nyasae ore omonene okomanyirie aye omoruoti amang’ana agochi‐gocha. Chindoto chiao nechi’ekeene, na engencho yaye nagotebirie ney’ekeene.”
Erio Nebukadinesaro omoruoti agatung’ama inse akaumama, akaorokia amasikani ase Danieli, agachika ng’a ekeng’wanso na ubani biruegwe ase Danieli.

Omoruoti agatebia Danieli, “Ekeene, Nyasae oino nere Nyasae ore igoro ye chinyasae chionsi, na Omonene bw’abaruoti, naende nere okomaanora obobisi. Namanyire aya, ekiagera aye kwamaanoire obobisi obo.”

Erio omoruoti akaa Danieli amasikani amanene, na ebiegwa ebinene ebinge, naende akamobeka akaba omogambi igoro ase orogongo rwonsi rwa Babeli na omoteneneri omonene igoro y’abang’aini bonsi ba Babeli.
Danieli akaboria Nebukadinesaro, na ere akabeka Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, bakaba abanene igoro ase amang’ana ’orogongo rwa Babeli, korende Danieli akabeera ase enyomba y’omoruoti.

Nebukadinesaro omoruoti akaroisia omogwekano korwa ase etahabu; obotambe bw’omogwekanooria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na obogare bwaye obw’amaboko atano na rimo; akayotenenia ase ense omweya ya Dura, agwo ase orogongo rwa Babeli.

Erio omoruoti Nebukadinesaro agatoma abanto basangererie amo abagambi abanene b’oboruoti bwaye, na abagambi be chingongo chiaye, na abagavuna, na abasemia, na abagachi be chikungo, na abagambi ebina, na abamanyi b’amachiko, na abanene bande bonsi b’oboruoti bwaye. Abwo bonsi nigo barangereretigwe ase ogwatanana na gosesenia omogwekano oria Nebukadinesaro omoruoti konya atenenirie.

Erio abagambi baria abanene, na abagambi be chingongo, na abagavuna, na abasemia, na abagachi be chikungo, na abagambi ebina, na abamanyi b’amachiko, na abanene bande bonsi b’ense eria, bagacha gwatanana na gosesenia omogwekano oria omoruoti Nebukadinesaro konya atenenirie. Ekero bateneine bosio bw’omogwekano oria,
omoraria agaaka eriogi rinene, akabora, “Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, na ab’emenwa yonsi, mwachikirwe

ng’a ekero moraigwe eriogi ri’ebitureri, na ebiroria, na amakano ao ao, na amarandi, na amariogi a kera egento ki’amatera, goika motung’ame inse, mosasime omogwekano bw’etahabu, oria Nebukadinesaro omoruoti atenenirie.
Omonto onde bwensi otatung’ameti na koumama ase okoyosasima, erio agwo kegima oyio narutwe ase eriko ri’omorero ekebemberi.”

Ase ayio ekero abanto b’ebisaku bionsi na ab’emenwa yonsi baigwete eriogi ri’ebitureri, na ebiroria, na amakano ao ao, na amariogi a kera egento ki’amatera, bonsi bakaba bagatung’ama na gosasima omogwekano bw’etahabu, oria omoruoti konya atenenetie.
Bono abanto bande b’Abakalidayo bakagenda bagasoera Abayahudi.
Bagakwana, bagatebia Nebukadinesaro omoruoti, “Aye omoruoti, ochie kare!

Aye omoruoti nigo kwarua ogochika ng’a kera omonto okoigwa eriogi ri’ebitureri, na ebiroria, na amakano ao ao, na amarandi, na amariogi a kera egento ki’amatera, goika atung’ame inse na gosasima omogwekano oria bw’etahabu,
naende ng’a omonto onde bwensi otatung’ameti inse na koumama ase okoyosasima, oyio goika arutwe ase eriko ri’omorero ekebemberi.

Bono mbare aa abanto bande b’Abayahudi abwo gwachorete gotenenera amang’ana ’orogongo oro rwa Babeli: Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego. Aye omoruoti, abanto aba bachayire amachiko ao; barabwo tibari gokorera chinyasae chiao gose gotung’ama na koumama ase ogosasima omogwekano oria bw’etahabu aye gwatenenetie.”
Erio omoruoti Nebukadinesaro akaba nekeririanda egetindi, agachika ng’a Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, barentwe asare, na abamura baria batato bakarentwa ase obosio bwaye.
Nebukadinesaro akababoria, “Inwe Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, Inee, nekeene ng’a inwe timori gokorera chinyasae chiane, gose timori gosasima omogwekano oria bw’etahabu ntenenetie?

Bono mobe ang’e, ekero moraigwe eriogi ri’ebitureri, na ebiroria, na amakano ao ao, na amarandi, na amariogi a kera egento ki’amatera motung’ame inse moumame ase ogosasima omogwekano oria naroisirie, ayio naro arabe buya asemore; korende onye timokoyosasima, rirorio agwo kegima goika morutwe ase eriko ri’omorero ekebemberi. Inee! Nenyasae ereri eranyare kobatooria korwa ase amaboko aane?”
Erio Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, bakairaneria omoruoti oria, bakamotebia, “Aye Nebukadinesaro, titoganeti gokoiraneria igoro y’amang’ana aya.
Aye omoruoti, Nyasae oito, oria togokorera, nanyare gototooria korwa ase eriko ri’omorero ekebemberi, na korwa ase amaboko ao.
Korende nonya tagochia gototooria korwa asore aye omoruoti, goika omanye ng’a intwe titogwancha gokorera chinyasae chiao, gose gosasima omogwekano bw’etahabu, oyio gwatenenetie.”

Erio Nebukadinesaro agaichorwa nekeririanda, na obosio bwaye bokaonchoka igoro ya Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego. Agachika ng’a omorero bw’eriko riria omentwe obe omonene ara gatano na kabere kobua oyo o botambe.
Agachika abarwani esegi barenge ne chinguru basibe Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, babarute ime ase eriko riria ri’omorero ekebemberi.
Ase ayio abamura baria batato bagasibwa bare ne chisirwari chiabo, ne chiganchwa chiabo, na emiambaro yabo, ne chianga chinde, bakarutwa ase eriko riria ri’omorero ekebemberi.

Bono ekiagera ogochika kw’omoruoti kwarenge ogotindi, na ase ayio omorero bw’eriko riria konya omentirwe obeire omonene mono, chimeme chi’omorero oria chigasamba na goita abanto baria barutete Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, ase omorero oria.
Abanto baria batato: Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, bakagwa ase eriko riria ri’omorero ekebemberi basibire.

Erio Nebukadinesaro omoruoti agakumia na goichana, agatenena ase obwango, akaboria abasemia baye, “Inee! Titwarutete abanto batato boka ase omorero basibire?” Bakamoiraneria, “Ee, aye omoruoti, ayio namaene.”

Omoruoti akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Na bono nindoche abanto bane basiboire, bagotaara ime ase omorero, na barabwo tibayieti aande nonya ng’ake; omonto oria o kane nigo akororekana buna omwana bw’enyasae.”
