Ase ayio Nebukadinesaro akagenda ang’e nomonwa bw’eriko riria ri’omorero ekebemberi, agaaka eriogi, akarangeria, “Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, inwe abasomba ba Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, soka korwa ime agwo, moche aiga!” Erio Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, bagasoka korwa ase omorero oria.

Abagambi abanene b’oboruoti, na abagambi be chingongo, na abagavuna, na abasemia b’omoruoti bagasangererekana amo, bakarora ng’a omorero oria torenge nokobua konde gwonsi igoro ase emebere y’abanto baria; chitukia chi’emetwe yabo tichiarurogete, ne chianga chiabo tichiayiete, gose tibatiogete rimisu ri’omorero.

Erio Nebukadinesaro agaaka eriogi, agateba, “Atogigwe Nyasae o Sadaraka, na o Meshaka, na bw’Abedi‐Nego, oyio otomire omomalaika oye gotooria abasomba baye abwo bamosemeretie na bangete koigwera ogochika kwane inche omoruoti, bakarua emebere yabo esire kobua gokorera na gosasima enyasae ende yonsi, otatiga Nyasae obo bweka.

“Bono narure ogochika ng’a omonto onde bwensi bw’egesaku kende gionsi, gose bw’omonwa onde bwensi, orakwane mamincha ya Nyasae o Sadaraka, na o Meshaka, na bw’Abedi‐Nego, oyio nabutoranwe ekiimo ase ekiimo, na enyomba yaye netagorwe ebe rituuri, ekiagera enyasae ende teri eranyare gotooria ase enchera buna eye.”
Omoruoti akabeka Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, bakaba abanene ase orogongo rwa Babeli.
Omoruoti Nebukadinesaro agatoma amang’ana gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, na ab’emenwa yonsi, baria bamenyete ase ense yonsi, akabatebia: “Omorembe omentekane asemore!
Inche narorire ng’a mbuya ing’orokie ebimanyererio na amakumia Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono ankoreire.”
“Naki ebimanyererio biaye bire ebinene, na amakumia aye are nokobua okonene! Oboruoti bwaye nigo bore obwa kare na kare, na obogambi bwaye nigo bogendererete ekiaare ase ekiaare.
“Inche Nebukadinesaro nigo namenyete nomogoko ase enyomba yane, nkaba ngendererete goseseneka ase enyomba yane y’oboruoti.
Nkarota okorota kwang’ondogetie; ekero naraire borere bwane, nkarora okorora gokaba kogonchanda ase ebirengererio biane.
Ase ayio nkarua ogochika ng’a abanto abang’aini bonsi ba Babeli barentwe ase obosio bwane, erinde bantebie engencho ye chindoto chiria.
Erio abaringoria, na abaragori, na Abakalidayo bamanyete oborogi, na abamanyete igoro ye ching’enang’eni, bagacha asende. Inche nkabatebia chindoto chiria, korende tibanyarete gontebia engencho yaye.
Omoerio oye Danieli agacha ase obosio bwane, ere oria okorokwa Beli‐Tesasari, erieta ri’enyasae yane, na omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu nigo ore ime yaye. Nkamoorokeria chindoto chiria, nkamotebia:

Aye Beli‐Tesasari, omonene bw’abaringoria, namanyire ng’a omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu nigo ore ime yao, naende namanyire ng’a obobisi tibori bore obokong’u asore. Chindoto narotete nachio echi, na aye intebie engencho yaye.
“Oko nakwo okorora naroche ekero naraire borere bwane: Nkarora omote omonene orenge omotambe mono oteneine ase egati‐gati y’ense.
Omote oria nigo ogendererete gokina, okaba ne chinguru, ogatambea gochia igoro, okarorekana ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense.

Amato aye nigo arenge amaya, na amatunda aye nigo arenge amange; ase omote oria endagera nao yarenge goisanekia abanto bonsi. Ching’iti chi’orosana nao chiare konyora ekiriri chigokenderera inse yaye, ne chinyoni chikaba chikomenya ime ase chinsagia chiaye, na kera egetongwa kere moyo gekanyora endagera yaye korwao.
“Ekero naraire borere bwane, nkarora ase okorora kwane omorendi omochenu ogoika korwa igoro.

Ere agaaka eriogi rinene, agateba: Gecha omote oyio na onache chinsagia chiaye, osose amato aye na osiarere amatunda aye; ching’iti chi’orosana chitame korwa aroro, ne chinyoni chirue ase chinsagia chiaye.

Korende otige egesike kere nemeri yaye ase riroba, kebe gesibire nekenyuri gi’ekioma na etaai, agwo ase obonyansi oborere bw’orosana. “Egesike ekio tiga kenyirirerwe ne riime rikorwa igoro, na egetari ki’omoruoti oyio kebe amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana, agwo ase egati y’ebimeri bi’ense.
Enkoro yaye neonchorwe teba eya mwanyabanto naende; naegwe enkoro buna eye ching’iti ase ebiro bitano na bibere.

Okonachwa kw’amang’ana aya kwarurwe nabarendi baria abachenu, na ogochika oko nigo kwarurwe na baria abachenu. Ase igo abare moyo banyare komanya ng’a Oyore Igoro Mono nere okogambera oboruoti bwa mwanyabanto, naende nere okoa oboruoti obwo ase onde bwensi aranche, naende nigo akobeka oria ore omoke mono ase egati y’abanto agambe ase oboruoti obwo.

“Echio nachio chindoto inche Nebukadinesaro omoruoti narota. Aye Beli‐Tesasari, intebie engencho yaye, ekiagera abanto abang’aini bonsi bare ase oboruoti bwane basinyirwe gontebia engencho yaye, korende aye nonyare, ekiagera omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu nigo ore ime yao.”

Erio Danieli, oyo orenge korokwa Beli‐Tesasari, agaichanigwa ase ekero egeke ase engencho y’amang’ana aria, na ebirengererio biaye bikamoichania. Omoruoti akamotebia, “Beli‐Tesasari, chindoto echi na engencho yaye, tibigoichania.” Beli‐Tesasari akairaneria, akamotebia, “Omonene one, naki yare koba buya onye chindoto echi nchiaba igoro y’abwo bakogechete, na engencho yaye ebe igoro y’ababisa bao.
Omote oria kwaroche orenge omonene mono, na omotambe gochia igoro, naende okarorekana ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense;

amato aye arenge amaya, na amatunda aye namange, na ase omote oria endagera nao yarenge goisanekia abanto bonsi. Inse yaye ching’iti chi’orosana nao chiare konyora ekiriri chigokenderera, na ase chinsagia chiaye chinyoni chikaba chikomenyao.
“Aye omoruoti, omote oria naye omonyene. Aye gwakinire, kwabeire ne chinguru. Obonene bwao bwakinire, bwaikire igoro, na obogambi bwao bwaikire ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense.

Naende aye omoruoti, ekero kwarigereretie, okarora omorendi oria omochenu ogoika korwa igoro ogoteba: Gecha omote oyo oyosirie, korende otige egesike kiaye kere nemeri yaye ase riroba. Ogetige gesibire nekenyuri gi’ekioma na etaai, agwo ase obonyansi oborere bw’orosana, kenyirirerwe ne riime rikorwa igoro; egetari ki’omoruoti oyio kebe amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana ase ebiro bitano na bibere.
“Aye omoruoti, engencho ye chindoto chiria neye: Okonachwa kw’amang’ana aya nigo kwarurwe n’Oyore Igoro Mono gocha asore, aye omoruoti, omonene one.

Noserigwe gochia aare korwa ase mwanyabanto, na obomenyo bwao nigo borabe amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana. Nobetererigwe orisie obonyansi buna eng’ombe, na nonyirirerwe ne riime rikorwa igoro, ase ebiro bitano na bibere, goika onyare komanya ng’a Oyore Igoro Mono nere okogambera oboruoti bwa mwanyabanto, naende nere okoa oboruoti obwo ase onde bwensi aranche.
Na buna amang’ana achigetwe ng’a egesike ki’omote getigwe amo nemeri, oboruoti bwao nabokoiranere ekero keria oramanye ng’a Oyore Igoro Mono nere okogamba.

“Ase ayio, aye omoruoti, ancha ogosemia oko kwane. Tokora ebibe, na chaka gokora oboronge; tiga obobe bwao, na ororere abagokorerwa bobe amabera. Ande nabo oranyare komenterwa ogosesenigwa ase amatuko ao.”
Ayio onsi akamonyora Nebukadinesaro omoruoti.
Ekero emetienyi ikomi na ebere yachia koera, akariina kerama igoro ki’enyomba y’oboruoti agwo Babeli, agataara aroro,
agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Inee! Oyo tari Babeli omochie omonene, oyo inche naagachire ne chinguru chiane, na okobua kwane, obe obomenyo bw’omoruoti, erinde obe ogotogigwa kw’obonene bwane?”
Ekero agendererete gokwana, eriogi rikarwa igoro, rigoteba “Aye omoruoti Nebukadinesaro, aya naro ogotebigwa: Oboruoti bwarusigwe asore;

aye noserigwe korwa ase mwanyabanto, omenye amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana, nobe gokorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe. Okoore ebiro bitano na bibere goika ekero oramanye ng’a Oyore Igoro Mono nere okogambera oboruoti bwa mwanyabanto, na nere okoa oboruoti obwo ase onde bwensi aranche.”

Ase engaki eyio ring’ana riria rigaikeranigwa igoro ya Nebukadinesaro. Agaserigwa korwa ase mwanyabanto, akaba okorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe; omobere oye okaba okonyirirerwa ne riime rikorwa igoro, goika etukia yaye egakina ekaba entambe buna amarionya ’ensoti, ne chinchara chiaye chigakina chikaba buna echie chinyoni.

“Ekero engaki eyio yaerete, inche Nebukadinesaro nkarigereria gochia igoro, na obong’aini bwane bokang’iranera. Erio nkamotogia Oyore Igoro Mono, nkamobaka na komosika ere oyoreo goika kare na kare.” “Okogamba kwaye nigo kore ogwa kare na kare, na oboruoti bwaye nigo bogendererete ekiaare ase ekiaare.

Abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense nigo babarire ng’a nigo bare bosa. Ere nigo agokorera emeganda ya igoro buna anchete, akorera na mwanyabanto bare ase ense boigo. Onde tari oramotange, gose komoboria: Ngento ki ekio ogokora?”

Ase engaki eyio obong’aini bwane bokang’iranera, na obonene bw’oboruoti bwane, na obw’amasikani aane, bikang’iranera boigo. Abasemia baane, na abanto baane abanene bagacha kondigia, na inche nkairanerigwa oboruoti bwane, na nkamenterwa okobua okonene goetania.
Bono inche Nebukadinesaro nigo nkomotogia Omoruoti ore igoro na komobaka, ekiagera ogokora kwaye gwonsi nokwa boronge, ne chinchera chiaye boigo, na abwo bare abaenenu nigo akobakeyia.
Omoruoti Belisasari agakora omoyega omonene, akarangeria abanto abanene koreng’ana elifu eyemo b’oboruoti bwaye, akaba okonywa edivai amo nabanto abwo elifu.

Ekero anyure edivai atindire, agachika ng’a ebikorero biria bie chitahabu na ebie chifeta ebio Nebukadinesaro ise asakorete korwa ase Hekalu agwo Yerusalemu, birentwe, erinde ere, na abanene b’oboruoti bwaye, na abakungu baye, na abakungu baye ba sere‐sere, banywere ebikorero ebio edivai.

Erio bakarenta ebikorero biria bie chitahabu na ebie chifeta, ebio biasakoretwe korwa ase Hekalu, enyomba eria ya Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu; omoruoti, na abanene baria, na abakungu baye, na abakungu baye ba sere‐sere, bakabinywera.
Bakanywa edivai na bagatogia chinyasae chiroisirie korwa ase chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai, na ebioma, na emete, na amagena.
Mobosokano ebiara bi’okoboko kw’omonto bikaoroka, bikarika ase rioomo ri’enyasi y’enyomba y’omoruoti kororia ase ekebekerero gi’etaya, na omoruoti akarora okoboko koria gokorika.
Erio agwo obosio bw’omoruoti bokaonchoka bokarachoka, na ebirengererio biaye bikamochanda; ebiimo bi’omobere oye bikororoba, na amaru aye agaakana.

Omoruoti agaaka eriogi rinene, agachika ng’a abaragori na Abakalidayo bamanyete oborogi, na abamanyete igoro ye ching’enang’eni, barentwe, Agatebia abang’aini baria ba Babeli, “Omonto onde bwensi orasome amariko aya, naende antebie engencho yaye, ere nabekerwe eanga emonyinga, naende abekerwe chisonoi chie chitahabu igoti riaye, ere oyio nabekwe abe omogambi o gatato ase oboruoti obo.”
Erio abanto abang’aini bonsi b’omoruoti bagasoa ime, korende tibanyarete gosoma amariko aria, gose gotebia omoruoti engencho yaye.
Belisasari omoruoti agachandeka mono ore nomooondoko, na obosio bwaye bokaonchoka bokarachoka, na abanene b’oboruoti bwaye bakaondoka.

Eting’ana, ng’ina omoruoti, akaigwa amang’ana aya omoruoti na abanene baria barenge gokwana, erio agasoa ase enyomba eria y’omoyega agateba, “Aye omoruoti ochie kare! Tobaisa gochandeka ase ebirengererio biao, gose obosio bwao boonchoke borachoke.

Omonto oyomo nare aiga ase oboruoti bwao, omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu ore ime yaye. Ase engaki eria iso arenge kogamba, omonto oyio akarorekana ore noborabu, na okomanya, na obong’aini bore buna obwe chinyasae, ime yaye. Omoruoti Nebukadinesaro iso akamobeka akaba omonene bw’abaringoria, na abarogi, na Abakalidayo bamanyete oborogi, na abamanyete igoro ye ching’enang’eni, ee, nabo omoruoti iso akorete,

ekiagera omoika omuya mono, na okomanya, na obong’aini bw’okomanya engencho ye chindoto, na koorokia engencho y’emebayeno, na korongeyia obokong’u, biarenge ime ase omonto oria Danieli, oria omoruoti arogete Beli‐Tesasari. Bono tiga Danieli arangerigwe, nere oratebe engencho y’amariko aya.”

Erio Danieli akarentwa ase obosio bw’omoruoti, na omoruoti akamoboria: “Inee! Naye Danieli oria, oyomo bw’abanto baria boosetwe korwa ase ense y’Abayuda, oria omoruoti tata arentete korwa ase ense eria?
Naigure igoro yao ng’a omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu nigo ore ime yao, naende ng’a oborabu, na okomanya, na obong’aini obuya mono, nigo bikonyorekana ime yao
Bono abanto abang’aini na abarogi mbarentwa ase obosio bwane basome amariko aya, naende bantebie engencho yaye, korende tibanyarete gontebia engencho y’amang’ana aya.

Korende naigure ng’a aye nonyare koorokia engencho y’amang’ana, na korongeyia obokong’u. Bono koranyare gosoma amariko ayio na komanyia engencho yaye, rirorio nobekerwe eanga emonyinga, na obekerwe chisonoi chie chitahabu igoti riao, aye nobe omogambi o gatato ase oboruoti obo.”

Erio agwo Danieli akairaneria omoruoti, akamotebia, “Gacha ebiegwa biao, na kae omonto omoao ebio oganetie kong’a. Korende nonya naboigo, inche ningosomere aye omoruoti amariko aya, naende ngotebie engencho yaye.
“Aye omoruoti, Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono naete Nebukadinesaro iso oboruoti, na obonene, na ogotogigwa, na okobua okonene,

na ase engencho y’obonene obwo amoete, abanto bonsi, na ebisaku, na abanto b’emenwa ao ao, bakaba bagotengechigwa na koiroka ase obosio bwaye. Omonto onde bwensi ere aganetie goita, nigo arenge komoita, na oyo aganetie gotiga abe moyo, nigo arenge komotiga oba moyo; na oyo aganetie gokinia abe omonene, nigo arenge komokinia, na oyo aganetie gokeyia, nigo arenge komokeyia.
Korende ekero enkoro yaye yeimokereretie igoro, na omoika oye okong’ete na koenena, nigo aseretigwe korwa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti, akaurwa obonene bwaye.

Nigo aseretigwe korwa ase mwanyabanto, na enkoro yaye ekaonchorwa ekaba buna eye ching’iti, akabetererigwa komenya amo ne chitigere chi’orosana na korisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe; omobere oye okanyirirerwa ne riime rikorwa igoro, goika ekereo amanyete ng’a Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono nere okogambera oboruoti bwa mwanyabanto, na nere okobeka onde bwensi anchire abe omogambi.
“Aye Belisasari ore omwana oye, tibwekeeti ase enkoro yao nonya kwamanyete amang’ana ayio onsi,

korende kweimokereirie igoro mamincha y’Omonene ore igoro. Ebikorero bi’enyomba yaye biarentirwe ase obosio bwao; aye amo nabanto b’oboruoti bwao, na abakungu bao, na abakungu bao ba sere‐sere, babinywereire edivai. Aye kwabeire kogotogia chinyasae chiroisirie korwa ase chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai, na ebioma, na emete na amagena, echio chitari korora, gose koigwa, gose chitamanyeti gento, korende Nyasae oria obomoyo bwao bore ase okoboko kwaye, ne chinchera chiao chionsi chire ase okobua kwaye, tomotogeti.
Ayio naro agerete Nyasae agatoma okoboko koria gokarika amariko aya.
“Amariko arigetwe naro aya: MENE, MENE, TEKELI, NA‐PARISINI.
Engencho y’amang’ana ayio nero eye: MENE, engencho yaye: Nyasae obarire amatuko ’oboruoti bwao obokoorire;
TEKELI, engencho yaye: kwarengirwe ase ekerengero na kwanyorekanire noremeire;
PARISINI, engencho yaye: oboruoti bwao bwatananirwe, bwaeirwe Abamedi na Abaayemi.”
Erio Belisasari akarua ogochika ng’a Danieli abekerwe eanga emonyinga, ne chisonoi chie chitahabu igoti riaye, na ararigwe ng’a ere nomogambi o gatato ase obogambi obo.
Ase obotuko obwo obwo Belisasari, omoruoti bw’Abakalidayo, agaitwa agakwa,
na Dario Omomedi akaira oboruoti obwo. Ere nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etano nomo, na ebere.
Dario akarora ng’a mbuya abeke abagambi abanene b’oboruoti rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, babe bakogamba ase oboruoti bwaye bwonsi.
Naende akabeka abanene batato igoro ase abwo; Danieli nigo arenge oyomo obo. Abagambi baria abanene nigo barenge koba bakorua omobaro ase abwo batato, erinde omoruoti tabaisa gosirerwa nenibo.
Danieli akamanyekana kobua abanene baria bande, na kobua abagambi baria abanene, ekiagera abwate omoika omuya mono ime yaye; na omoruoti akarengereria komobeka igoro y’oboruoti bwonsi.

Erio abanene baria na abagambi baria abanene bakarigia banyore okomocha ase okogamba kwa Danieli, erinde bagende komosoera, korende tibanyorete kende gionsi ekebe, gose okomocha asare, ekiagera ere nigo arenge omwegenwa; okomocha gose gento kende ekebe tibianyorekanete asare.
Erio abanto abwo bagatebania, “Titokonyara konyora okomocha konde gwonsi ase Danieli okwo torabwatererie tomosoere, otatiga torarigie okomocha kobwatekana buna amoirogete Nyasae oye.”
Abanene baria bande, na abagambi baria abanene bakabwatana amo, bakagenda ase omoruoti, bakamotebia, “Aye omoruoti Dario, ochie kare!

Abanene bonsi b’oboruoti, na abagambi bonsi be chingongo, na abagambi baria abanene, na abasemia, na abagavuna, bancheranire ng’a aye omoruoti obeke richiko na okaane bokong’u ng’a monto onde bwensi tabaisa gosaba enyasae ende yonsi, gose omonto onde, otatiga aye bweka aye omoruoti, ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato. Aise gokora ayio, rirorio arutwe ase engoro ye chindo.
Bono aye omoruoti, beka richiko erio na orikong’ie, naende oribeke ekemanyererio kiao, erinde tiribaisa koonchorwa, koreng’ana buna amachio ’Abamedi na Abaayemi atari koonchorwa.”
Ase ayio Dario omoruoti akabeka ekemanyererio kiaye ase amariko e richiko riria.

Ekero Danieli amanyete ng’a amariko e richiko riria abekirwe ekemanyererio, akagenda nyomba mwaye, akariina gochia ase akanyomba ka irongo ase chitirisa chiaigoire kororia Yerusalemu, akaba ogotung’ama ara gatato ase kera rituko, akaba ogosaba na goakera Nyasae oye ng’a mbuya mono, buna anarete botambe.
Bono abanto baria bagatubokera Danieli amo, bakamonyora ogosaba okorangeria Nyasae oye amokonye.

Abanto baria bakagenda ase omoruoti, bakamoboria igoro ye richiko riria: “Aye omoruoti, Inee! Tikwabeka ekemanyererio kiao ase richiko riria, ogateba ng’a ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato monto onde bwensi orasasime enyasae ende eng’ao, gose omonto onde, otatiga aye bweka aye omoruoti, oyio arutwe ase engoro ye chindo?” Omoruoti akairaneria, “Ee, richiko erio nigo riteneine bokong’u ritaonchorwe, koreng’ana buna amachiko ’Abamedi na Abaayemi atari koonchorwa.”

Erio bakairaneria, bakamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, Danieli, oria oyomo bw’Abayuda baria boosetwe, ere tari gokoigwera, gose koigwera richiko riria kwabegete ekemanyererio kiao, korende nigo agokora ogosaba kwaye botambe ara gatato kera rituko.”
Ekero omoruoti aigwete amang’ana aria, agachandeka mono, akarigia enchera y’ogotooria Danieli. Goika ekero erioba korikogwa akaba ogendererete korigia enchera y’okomotooria.

Naende abanto baria bagatubokera omoruoti bare amo, bakamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, manya ng’a amachiko ’Abamedi na Abaayemi naya, ng’a ogochika konde gwonsi omoruoti abekire na kogokong’ia tigokoonchorwa nonya ng’ake.”
Erio omoruoti akarua ogochika ng’a Danieli arentwe. Danieli akarentwa, akarutwa ase engoro ye chindo. Omoruoti agatebia Danieli, “Nyasae oo, oria ogokorera botambe nagotoorie.”
Rigena rikarentwa rigakuneka ase omonwa bw’engoro eria, erio omoruoti akabeka ekemanyererio kiaye omonyene amo nebi’abanene b’oboruoti bwaye, erinde amang’ana ande onsi Danieli akoreretwe taonchorwa.
Erio omoruoti akairana, akagenda nyomba mwaye, akeng’ata ase obotuko boria bwonsi. Tancha chigosori na kogokerwa konde gwonsi bikorwe, ne chitoro chikamobora.
Mambia kobogokiamoka omoruoti akaimoka akaayerera gochia ase engoro eria ye chindo.

Ekero aigete ang’e nengoro eria ase Danieli arutetwe, akarangeria neriogi ri’omoichano, akaboria Danieli, “Aye Danieli, omosomba o Nyasae ore moyo, Inee, Nyasae oo, oria ogokorera botambe, ogotooririe korwa ase chindo?”
Erio Danieli akairaneria omoruoti, “Aye omoruoti, ochie kare!

Nyasae one natomete omomalaika oye, agasieka emenwa ye chindo, na chirochio tichiankorerete bobe bonde, ekiagera nigo nanyorekanete ng’a tindi na komocha ase obosio bwaye; naboigo nase obosio bwao, aye omoruoti, tinkoreti komocha konde.”

Omoruoti akaba nomogoko omonene mono, agachika ng’a Danieli arusigwe ase engoro eria. Ase ayio Danieli akarusigwa aroro na tanyorekanete oarire aande onsi ase omobere oye, ekiagera nigo amosemeretie Nyasae oye.

Erio omoruoti agachika ng’a abanto baria basoerete Danieli barentwe. Erio bakarutwa ase engoro eria ye chindo, barabwo amo nabana babo, na abakungu babo, na ekero bataragwa gochia inse y’engoro eria, chindo chiria chikabaumokera, chikabuna‐buna amauga onsi ay’emebere yabo.
Nyuma y’ayio Dario omoruoti akarika amang’ana, akayatoma ase abanto bonsi, na ebisaku, na abanto b’emenwa ao ao, bamenyete ase ense yonsi, akabatebia: “Omorembe omentekane asemore:

Bono narure ogochika ng’a abanto bonsi bare ase oboruoti bwane baiguswe na koiroka ase obosio bwa Nyasae o Danieli.” “Ere nere Nyasae ore moyo, nigo areo goika kare na kare; oboruoti bwaye tibogosirigwa nonya ng’ake, na okogamba kwaye nkogenderere gotari nomoerio.
Ere nigo agokonya na gotooria, nigo agokora ebikone na amakumia igoro na ase ense; ere otooririe Danieli korwa ase chinguru chie chindo.”
Bono Danieli oyio agasesenigwa akanyora okobua ase engaki y’okogamba kwa Dario na ey’ogwa Koresi Omoayemi.

Ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba kwa Belisasari, omoruoti o Babeli, Danieli akarota chindoto, akarora amaroro ekero araire borere bwaye. Erio akarika akaorokia amang’ana aroche ase chindoto chiria.
Aya naro amang’ana Danieli atebete: “Ase okorora kwane kwa botuko nkarora chimbeo inye chia igoro chigocha ne chinguru, chigaturubania enyancha enene.
Ching’iti chinene inye chigatiira korwa ase enyancha ime; okororekana kwabo nigo kwarenge ao ao.

Eng’iti entang’ani nigo yagwekaine endo, korende yabwate chimbaba buna echi’ensoti. Buna nabete ndigereretie, chimbaba chiaye nigo chiasimoire, ero ekaimokererigwa igoro korwa ase riroba, egatenenigwa namagoro abere buna omonto, ekaegwa enkoro ya mwanyabanto.

“Naende nkarora eng’iti ya kabere yagwekaine edubu ekaimokerera igoro na kogunkwaria rikere riaye erimo; nigo yabwate chimbaru isato ase omonwa oye, gati‐gati y’amaino aye. Eng’iti eria egatebigwa: Imoka, orie chinyama chinyinge!
“Nyuma y’ayio nkarora eng’iti ende yagwekaine engo, korende ase omogongo oye nigo yabwate chimbaba inye buna echie chinyoni. Eng’iti eyio nigo yabwate emetwe ene; nero ekaegwa okobua gw’okogamba.

“Naende nkarora ase amaroro aria a botuko eng’iti ya kane. Nigo yarenge ey’okoondokia na koirokia, boigo nigo yarenge ne chinguru chinyinge. Nigo yabwate amaino amanene ay’ebioma; ekaria na kobutorana, na eke yatigaretie ekagetindachera inse namagoro aye. Eyio nigo yarenge nogwatananekana korwa ase ching’iti chiria chiayetang’anerete; ero nigo yabwate chingunchara ikomi.

Buna narenge ndigereretie na korengereria igoro ye chingunchara chiria, nkarora orogunchara ronde oroke rokooroka korwa ase egati‐gati ye chingunchara chiria. Orogunchara roria oroke rogasimora chingunchara isato ase echio ikomi chiarotang’anerete, rogachisimora amo nememio‐mio. Nkarora orogunchara roria robwate amaiso buna ay’omonto, na omonwa orenge gokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu.

“Ekero narigereretie nkarora ebirogo bi’obonene bigoterekwa, na omonto omokoro bw’amatuko amange agaikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye. Chianga chiaye nigo chiarenge chindabu se se, na etukia y’omotwe oye nigo yarenge endabu buna amarionya ’eng’ondi endabu asibirie; ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nigo kiarenge chimeme chi’omorero ogwoka, na amagoro ’ekerogo ekio nigo arenge omorero ogwoka.
Orooche rw’omorero rogasoka korwa asare. Chilifu ne chilifu bakamokorera; ne chilifu ikomi ara chilifu ikomi bagatenena ase obosio bwaye. Ab’ekegambero bagaikaransa kogamba, ne chibuku chikamaanorwa.
“Ekero narigereretie ekaba ng’a orogunchara roria rwagendererete gokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu. Ase engencho eyio nkarora eng’iti eria egaitwa, na omobere oye ogasarigwa okarutwa ase omorero ogasambwa.
Ching’iti chiria chinde chiatigarete chikaurwa chinguru chiabo chi’okogamba, korende chigatigwa chigendendererete koba moyo goika ase ebiro ne chingaki chiachikeretwe.
“Naende nkarora ase amaroro aane a botuko oyomo onga buna omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ogocha amo namare a igoro, agaika ang’e ase omonto oria omokoro bw’amatuko amange, akarentwa ase obosio bwaye.

Ere oyio akaegwa okobua gw’okogamba, na obonene, na oboruoti, erinde abanto bonsi, na ebisaku, na abanto b’emenwa ao ao, bamokorere. Obogambi bwaye nobwa kare na kare, tibokoera, na oboruoti bwaye tibokobugwa.
“Inche Danieli ngachandeka ase omoika one, na amaroro aria naroche akang’ondokia.
Ngachiera oyomo bw’abanto baria bateneine aroro, nkamoboria antebie ekeene gionsi igoro y’amang’ana aria. Omonto oria agantebia na komanyia engencho y’amang’ana aria onsi iga:
Ching’iti echio chinene inye, abwo nabaruoti bane baraoroke ase ense.
Korende abachenu b’Oyore Igoro Mono nabanyore oboruoti boragenderere goika kare na kare, ee goika kare na kare.

“Erio nkagania komanya ekeene igoro y’eng’iti eria ya kane, eyarenge nogwatananekana korwa ase chiria chinde. Nigo yarenge ey’okooondokia mono, yabwate amaino ’ebioma ne chinchara chi’etaai; ekaria na kobutorana, na eke yatigaretie ekagetindachera inse namagoro aye.

Naende nkagania komanya igoro ye chingunchara chiria ikomi chiarenge ase omotwe oye, na igoro y’orogunchara roria ronde oroke rwamerete korwa nyuma, orwo bosio bwaye isato ase chiria ikomi chiagweteo. Orogunchara orwo nigo rwabwate amaiso, na omonwa orenge gokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu, naende rokarorekana nigo rore oronene kobua echinde chiamwabo.
“Buna nabete ndigereretie, nkarora orogunchara roria rokarwania abachenu esegi, rokababua,
goika omonto oria omokoro bw’amatuko amange agacha, na abachenu b’Oyore Igoro Mono bakaegwa oboronge bwabo, na engaki egaika ekero abachenu bairete oboruoti boria.

“Aya naro akwanete igoro y’eng’iti eria ya kane, agateba: Oboruoti bwa kane mbobe ase ense, borobwo nigo borabe nogwatananekana korwa ase amaruoti ande onsi. Nigo borarie ense yonsi na koyetindachera inse, naende boyebutorane ebe ebing’ese.
Chingunchara chiria ikomi, abwo nabaruoti ikomi baraoroke, na nyuma yabo omoruoti onde naoroke. Ere nigo arabe nogwatananekana korwa ase abwo bamotang’anerete, nabue abaruoti batato.

Ere nakwane amang’ana are mamincha y’Oyore Igoro Mono, naende narosie abachenu b’Oyore Igoro Mono na kobachanda; narengererie koonchora ebiro, na amachiko. Abachenu mbabekwe ase okoboko kwaye ase ekero ekemo, na ebiro bibere, na ekeng’ese gi’ekero.
Korende ab’ekegambero mbaikaranse bagambe, bamoure okobua kwaye, na obogambi bwaye mbosirigwe boere kegima.

Oboruoti, na okobua gw’okogamba, na obonene bw’amaruoti are inse y’erioba, mbiegwe abanto abachenu b’Oyore Igoro Mono. Oboruoti bwaye mbobe obwa kare na kare, na bonsi abaare kogamba mbamokorere na komoigwera.
“Oyo noro omoerio bw’amang’ana ayio. Inche Danieli nkaba ng’ondogete ase ebirengererio biane, na obosio bwane bokaonchoka bokarachoka; korende nkagacha amang’ana aria ase enkoro yane ime.”
Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba kwa Belisasari omoruoti, inche Danieli nkarora okorora konde nyuma ya koria kwe ritang’ani.
Ase okorora kwane nkarora ng’a nigo narenge ase eburi y’omochie o Susa, agwo ase orogongo rwa Elamu. Ekero narengeo ase okorora kwane, nkarora inde ang’e norooche rwa Ulai.

Nkarigereria nkarora emingichi yabwate chingunchara ibere eteneine ase engegu y’orooche. Chingunchara chionsi ibere nigo chiarenge chintambe, korende oromo nigo rwarenge orotambe kobua oronde, na orwo orotambe nigo rwamerete korwa nyuma y’orwo ronde.

Nkarora emingichi eria egotwoma gochia ensemo ya bosongo, na eya sugusu, na eya irianyi; eng’itiende tiyarenge konyara gotenena ase obosio bwaye, gose onde tarenge konyara gotooria korwa ase okobua kwaye. Nigo yarenge gokora buna yanchete, naende ekaba egokora amang’ana amanene.
Ekero narenge ndengereretie amang’ana ayio, nkarora egoree egocha korwa bosongo, egaeta ase ense engima etari gotacha inse. Nigo yabwate orogunchara rw’ogokumia gati‐gati y’amaiso aye.
Egachiera emingichi eria yabwate chingunchara ibere, eria naroche eteneine ase engegu y’orooche, ekarindokera emingichi eria ere nekeririanda ekenene.

Nkarora egosuka gochia ang’e ase emingichi eria; egatwoma emingichi eria, ere nekeririanda ekenene ekayeiyeria inse, ekabuna chingunchara chiaye ibere. Emingichi eria tiyarenge ne chinguru chi’okorwana negoree eria, korende ekaiyerigwa inse na gotiringwa negoree eria. Onde tarenge konyara gotooria emingichi eria korwa ase okobua kw’egoree eria.

Erio egoree eria egakora amang’ana amanene mono. Ekero yabete ne chinguru chinyinge, orogunchara rwaye oronene rokabuneka, na ase ribaga riaye chingunchara inye chi’ogokumia chikamerao chiarochie gochia ase chinsemo inye chia igoro.
Korwa ase oromo rw’echio orogunchara ronde rokamera korwao; orwo rogakina mono gochia irianyi, na gochia moocha, na gochia ase ense eria engiya mono.
Orogunchara orwo rogakina mono, rogaika ase emeganda ya igoro, rokaiyeria emeganda ende ne ching’enang’eni gocha inse aa, rogachitiringerao.
Ee, orogunchara roria rogekinia na gwetogia igoro y’Omogambi bw’emeganda eria, rokarusia korwa ase Omogambi oria ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, rogatagora Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu.

Omoganda oria amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko bikaruegwa na kobekwa ase okobua kw’orogunchara roria ase engencho y’ogosaria. Ekeene kegatugutwa inse, na orogunchara roria rokagenderera koba nokobua.

Erio nkaigwa omochenu oyomo ogokwana, na omochenu onde akaboria oria orenge gokwana, “Nengaki eng’ana naki okorora okwo igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko gokworokia? Nengaki eng’ana naki ogosaria kw’ogosiria korabe, na okoruegwa kw’Obomenyo Obochenu na okw’omoganda oria biratiringerwe inse korabe?”
Omochenu oria bwe ritang’ani akang’iraneria, “Nase engaki ye chimogoroba ne chimambia chilifu ibere, na amagana atato (2,300); nyuma y’ayio Obomenyo Obochenu mbochenwe.”
Ekero inche Danieli naroche okorora koria na nkarigia imanye engencho yaye, nkarora oyomo ogwekaine mwanyabanto oteneine ase obosio bwane.
Nkaigwa eriogi ri’omonto rikorangeria korwa gati‐gati y’orooche rwa Ulai, rigoteba, “Aye Gabirieli, momanyie omonto oyio engencho y’okorora okwo!”

Ase ayio agacha ang’e ase nateneine; ekero aigete asende nkaondoka, nkagwa inse maumama. Korende omonto oria agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, manya ng’a okorora koria nigo gokworokia chingaki chi’omoerio.”
Ekero agendererete gokwana nainche, chitoro chinene chikambwata gontung’aime inse ng’umaime, korende agankuna, agantenenia, na inche ngatenena boronge.
Nyuma y’ayio agantebia, “Rora, ningotebie aya agochia koba ase omoerio bw’endamwamu y’Omonene, ekiagera okorora okwo nigo gokworokia igoro y’engaki y’omoerio.
“Emingichi eria kwaroche yabwate chingunchara ibere, abwo nabaruoti b’Abamedi na Abaayemi,
na egoree eria yabwate amanya, oyio nomoruoti bw’Abagiriki, na orogunchara roria oronene rwarenge gati‐gati y’amaiso aye, oyio nomoruoti obo bwe ritang’ani.

Orogunchara roria rwabunegete na aase aye chingunchara inye chikamera aroro, engencho yaye nere eye: Amaruoti ane naoroke korwa ase egesaku ekio, korende takoba nokobua buna koria kwa roria rwe ritang’ani.
“Ase engaki y’omoerio bw’amagambi ayio, ekero abasaria barabe baikeire ekerengo kiabo ki’omoerio, omoruoti omotindi mono oichire nobong’ainereria naoroke.
Ere nabe nokobua okonene mono, korende tari ase chinguru chiaye ere omonyene. Narente ogosiria okonene gw’okoondokia, nabue ase kende gionsi arakore. Nasirie abanto bare nokobua amo nabanto abachenu.

Ase obong’aini bwaye bw’obong’ainereria nagenderere konyora okobua ase kende gionsi arakore, na ase ebirengererio biaye ere omonyene nekinie na koenena. Naite abanto abange mobosokano batakureiri. Naimokerere igoro koamererania n’Omogambi bw’abagambi. Erio nasenyentwe, korende tari nokoboko kwa mwanyabanto.
Okorora okwo igoro ye chimogoroba ne chimambia gwakwanetwe nogw’ekeene. Kogache okobise, ekiagera nigo koraire amatuko amange komanye goikeranigwa.”

Inche Danieli nkaborwa chinguru, nkaba omorwaire ase amatuko amake. Nyuma y’ayio nkaimoka gochia gokora emeremo ase omoruoti, korende ngaichanigwa ase engencho y’okorora okwo, na onde tarenge omanyete engencho yaye.
Ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba kwa Dario, mosinto bw’Ahaswero bw’ororeria rw’Abamedi, oyobegetwe akaba omoruoti kogambera Abakalidayo,

ee, ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba kwaye, inche Danieli nkamanya korwa ase Amariko Amachenu igoro y’omobaro bw’emiaka eria ring’ana ri’Omonene riatebetie Yeremia omobani, ng’a emiaka emerongo etano na ebere nigo yarenge gocha koera, Yerusalemu ogendererete koba rituuri.
Erio nkamorigereria Omonene Nyasae, nkamorigia nogosaba, na okoboria kw’oboitongo, na ase okweng’ata, nkeboyia chigunia na kweaka ribu.

Nkamosaba Omonene, Nyasae one, nkaorokia ebibe biaito, ngateba: “Aye Omonene, ore Nyasae omonene, naende ore bw’okoorokia, aye okorenda okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania na koorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera ase baria bagwanchete na kobwata amachiko ao.
“Intwe twakorire ebibe na ayare amabe, twakorire obokayayu na ogosaria; twaonchokire, twatigire amachiko ao, na emeroberio yao echikire.
Titwaigwerete abasomba bao ababani, baria barenge gokwana ase erieta riao ase abaruoti baito, na abanene baito, ne chisokoro chiaito, na ase abanto bonsi b’ense eye.

Aye Omonene, nigo ogokora oboronge botambe, korende intwe botambe nigo tokwerentera obosooku buna iga rero, intwe abanto ba Yakobo, na abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu, na Abaisraeli bonsi, baria bare ang’e na abare aare ase chinse chionsi ase kwabaseretie gochia, ekiagera titwabete abegenwa asore.
Aye Omonene, obosooku nigo bore asetore, na ase abaruoti baito, na ase abagambi baito, na ase chisokoro chiaito, ekiagera twakorire ebibe asore.
Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo obwate amabera, naende nigo ogotwabera, nonya twasaririe asore.
Titwaigwerete eriogi riao aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, ase okobwatia amachiko ao, ayio gwatochigete goetera ase abasomba bao ababani.

Abaisraeli bonsi basaririe amachiko ao, baonchokire tibari koigwera eriogi riao. Ase ayio okoragererigwa okwo gwatianete koumora igoro yaito, okwo korikire ase amachiko a Musa, omosomba oo, aye Nyasae, gwatocheire, ekiagera intwe twakorire ebibe asore.
Gwaikeranirie amang’ana ao, ayio gwakwanete asetore, na ase abagambi baria barenge gotogambera, ase ogotorentera amaakwa amanene. Inse y’erioba ayio akorekanire ase Yerusalemu tana gokorekana aande.

Koreng’ana buna arikire ase amachiko a Musa, amaakwa ayio onsi atocheire. Nonya nabo titwasabete Omonene, Nyasae oito, atororere amabera; titwaonchogete korwa ase amabe aito na titwaigwete ekeene kiao.

Ase ayio, aye Omonene nigo kwarenge nobomaene bw’ogotorentera amaakwa ayio, ekiagera aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo ore omonyene oboronge ase ogokora kwao gwonsi, korende intwe titwaigwerete eriogi riao.
“Na bono aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, aye kwarusetie abanto bao korwa ase ense ya Misiri nokoboko kwao kore nokobua, na kwemanyekanirie goika rituko ria rero. Intwe twakorire ebibe na ayare amabe.

Aye Omonene, koreng’ana nogokora kwao gwonsi kw’oboronge koranche orusie endamwamu yao, na ekeririanda kiao, korwa ase Yerusalemu, omochie oo, ee, korwa ase egetunwa kiao egechenu. Ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, na ebie chisokoro chiaito, Yerusalemu amo nabanto bao babeire bagokwanwa bobe, ase egati y’abanto baria bonsi batoetanaine.
Ase ayio bono, aye Nyasae oito, igwa ogosaba kwane inche omosomba oo, na ogosorora kwane, na ase engencho yao aye Omonene oraberie Obomenyo bwao Obochenu ase obosio bwao, Obomenyo obwo bore rituuri.

Aye Nyasae one, tegerera oigwe, rigereria orore ogosirigwa gwaito, na omochie oyo okorokwa ase erieta riao. Intwe titori korenta ogosaba gwaito asore ng’a nabanyaboronge tore, korende nase engencho y’amabera ao amange.

Aye Omonene, igwa! Aye Omonene, abera! Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe, na okore emeremo yao; ase engencho yao aye omonyene totebana! Aye Nyasae one, kora ayio, ekiagera omochie oo nigo okorokwa ase erieta riao, na abanto bao boigo.”

Erio agwo nkagenderera gokwana na gosaba, nkaorokia ebibe biane, na ebi’abanto baane Abaisraeli na korenta ogosorora kwane ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae one, ase engencho y’egetunwa egechenu kia Nyasae one.
Ekero nagendererete gosaba, Gabirieli, omonto oria konya narorire ase okorora koria kwe ritang’ani, aganchichera bwango okoiruruka. Nigo yarenge engaki y’okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba.
Akanyorokereria, agantebia, “Aye Danieli, bono nigo nachire nkoe obong’aini na okomanya.

Ekero gwachagete ogosorora kwao, ring’ana rikaruegwa, na bono inche nachire gokoritebia, ekiagera aye nigo bwanchire mono; ase ayio rengereria igoro ye ring’ana riria, na omanye engencho y’okorora koria.

“Chichuma emerongo etano na ebere nachio chiachikirwe ase abanto bao, na ase omochie oo omochenu, gokoora ogosaria na gosiria ebibe, na gokora okobwatanigwa ase engencho y’obobe, naende korenta oboronge bwa kare na kare na kobeka okorora koria na obobani boria ekemanyererio, boigo goaka Aase Aachenu Mono amaguta na koachena.

Ase ayio, omanye na korengereria ng’a korwa engaki eria ring’ana riaruetwe igoro ya Yerusalemu ng’a noagachwe naende, goika ase engaki y’ogocha kw’oyomo Omoakwa Amaguta, oyore omogambi, nachibe chichuma isano na ibere. Naende ase chichuma emerongo etano nomo, na ibere, omochie noagachwe amo ne chinchera chiaye ne chiburi chiaye, korende ase engaki y’emechando emenene.

Nyuma ye chichuma echio emerongo etano nomo, na ibere, Omoakwa Amaguta oria naitwe, tari ase engencho yaye ere omonyene. Abanto b’omogambi orache mbasirie omochie oyo amo n’Obomenyo Obochenu. Omoerio oye noche buna chiooro, na goika omoerio esegi nebeo, ekiagera nigo ochikeretwe ogosirigwa korwa kare.

Ere nakore okobwatana ogokong’u kw’ogotianania nabanto abange ase echuma eyemo; na ase egati‐gati y’echuma eyio nakoore ebing’wanso na okoruegwa gwonsi tibiruegwa naende. Oyokorenta obobe bw’okogechia nigo arache okoiruruka gosiria. Ayio nigo aragenderere goika egesusuro ki’ogosirigwa achikeretwe korwa kare geikeranigwe.”

Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba gwa Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, Danieli oria orogetwe Beli‐Tesasari akamaanorerwa komanya ring’ana, ne ring’ana erio nigo riarenge eri’ekeene, rikararia ng’a emechando emenene neche. Danieli akamanya engencho ye ring’ana riria, na ey’okorora koria.
Ase engaki eria inche Danieli nigo narenge nkona‐kweumia ase engaki ye chichuma isato.
Tinarenge koria endagera engiya, gose koria enyama, gose konywa edivai. Tinarenge kweaka amaguta nonya ng’ake ase chichuma chiria isato.
Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, ekero nateneine ase engegu y’orooche roria oronene rwa Tigirisi,
nkarigereria, nkarora omonto obegete eanga y’egatani, bweboeretie kenema kiaye norokini roroisirie korwa ase etahabu engiya ekorwa Ufasi.

Omobere oye nigo orenge komeka‐meka buna berulo, rigena rie rigori rinene; obosio bwaye nigo bwarenge kororekana buna okomesa kw’embura, na amaiso aye nigo arenge gwoka buna ebieri bi’omorero. Amaboko na amagoro aye nigo arenge komeka‐meka buna etaai yasenigwe. Eriogi ri’amang’ana aye nigo riarenge kwoga buna eri’omoganda omonene bw’abanto.
Ninche bweka Danieli naroche okorora koria abanto baria barenge amo nainche tibakoroche, korende obwoba obonene bokabasoa, erio bagatama bakebisa.
Ngatigara inche bweka ndigereretie okorora koria, ne chinguru chikang’erera, ekieni kiane gekaonchoka gekarachoka, ne chinguru chionsi chikarua asende.
Erio nkaigwa eriogi ri’amang’ana aye; ekero nariigwete, nkaba ne chitoro chinene, nkagwa inse nkaumama.
Nkarora okoboko kogonkuna, gokanyimokia, ngatung’ama namaru, ngasigamera inse nebisanyi bi’amaboko nkoiguswa.

Omonto oria agantebia, “Aye Danieli, omonto bwanchire mono, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aya ngokwana naye, imoka otenene boronge, ekiagera bono natomirwe asore.” Ekero agendererete gokwana ring’ana erio nainche, ngatenena boronge nkoiguswa.

Erio agantebia, “Aye Danieli, tibwoboa, ekiagera korwa rituko rie ritang’ani kwaruete enkoro yao ase okomanya, naende ogekeyia ase obosio bwa Nyasae oo, amang’ana ao nigo aigwetwe, na bono inche nachire ase engencho y’amang’ana aria ao.

Omogambi bw’oboruoti bw’Abaayemi akaamererania nainche ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ebere, na rimo, korende Mikaeli, oyomo bw’abagambi baria abanene, agacha gonkonya, ekiagera konya nabeire nteneine inche bweka koamererania nabaruoti b’Abaayemi.
Bono inche nachire gokworokia aya agochia konyora abanto bao ase amatuko agochi‐gocha, ekiagera okorora okwo nigo gokworokia ay’amatuko akare bosio.”
Ekero akoorete gokwana nainche amang’ana aya, ngetureka gochia inse, nkaba rimansu.

Erio oria ogwekaine mwanyabanto agakuna ebikoba biane, na inche nkamaanora omonwa one ngakwana. Ngatebia oria oteneine ase obosio bwane, “Aye Omonene one, okorora oko kwandeteire omoichano, ne chinguru chiarure asende.
Naki inche omosomba oo ndanyare gokwana naye, Omonene one? Chinguru chionsi chiarure asende, na tindi nomoika ime yane.”
Naende oria ogwekaine mwanyabanto agankuna, na akambeka chinguru,

agantebia, “Aye omonto bwanchire mono, tibwoboa, omorembe obe amo naye! Tenena bokong’u, naende obe omoremu!” Ekero arenge gokwana nainche, nkanyora chinguru, nkamotebia, “Aye Omonene one, kwana, ekiagera kwambekeire chinguru!”
Erio akamboria, “Inee, kwamanyire ekiagera nacha aa asore? Bono nkoirana inde ngende korwania omogambi bw’Abaayemi, na ekero ndabe namobuire, erio agwo omogambi bw’Abagiriki nachiche.
“Nonya nabo ninkworokie aya arikire ase Ebuku y’Ekeene. Onde tari oranyare gonkonya otatiga Mikaeli, omogambi oino,
“na inche nigo natenenete komokonya na komobeka chinguru ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba kwa Dario Omomedi.

“Bono nkogotebia inde ayare ay’ekeene. Naama! Abaruoti bande batato nabaoroke ase ense y’Ayemi. Naende omoruoti o kane naoroke, nigo arabe omonda kobua abwo batato bonsi. Ekero aranyore chinguru goetera ase obonda bwaye, naseegete bonsi bagende korwania oboruoti bw’Abagiriki.
“Erio omoruoti ore ne chinguru chinene naoroke, abe okogamba nokobua okonene na akore buna anchete ere omonyene.

Korende ekero omoruoti oyio aranyore chinguru chinene, oboruoti bwaye mbosareke bwatananeke ase chinsemo inye chi’ense, tibokoegwa abanto b’ororeria rwaye, tibokoba nokobua buna koria ere abwate. Oboruoti bwaye mbotegorwe boegwe abanto abaao.
“Omoruoti o irianyi nabe ne chinguru, korende oyomo bw’abagambi b’oboruoti bwaye nabe ne chinguru komobua, na oboruoti bwaye mbobe obonene mono.

Nyuma y’emiaka etari meke, omoruoti o irianyi nakore okobwatana nomoruoti o sugusu. Omoruoti o irianyi nasokie omoiseke oye ase omoruoti o sugusu ase ogokora okobwatana. Omokungu oyio takogenderera koba nokobua okwo araegwe, na omoruoti oria o sugusu takogenderera koba nokobua kwaye. Omokungu oria narusigweo aitwe, ere amo nabwo bamorentete, oyo omoiborete na oria omoete okobua ase engaki eria.
Erio omonto natoke korwa ase omori bw’omokungu oria, oyio nache arwanie abarwani esegi b’omoruoti o sugusu, asoe ase chiburi chiaye, akore ase abanto buna anchete na kobabua.

Ere nasakore chinyasae chiabo, na emegwekano yabo bagosasima ebombire, na ebikorero biabo ebiya biroisirie korwa ase chifeta ne chitahabu, abiire Misiri. Erio ase emiaka emeke natige korwania omoruoti o sugusu.
Nyuma y’ayio omoruoti o sugusu nache korwania omoruoti o irianyi, korende goika airane gochia ase ense yaye omonyene.

“Abamura b’omoruoti o sugusu mbebeke ang’e, basangererie abarwani esegi abange mono, oyomo agende aumokere ense eria nomoganda oye omonene oresiarere aande onsi, naende bairane eria kabere barwane gochia bosio bw’eburi yaye.

Erio omoruoti oyio o irianyi nabe nendamwamu enene, nache korwania omoruoti o sugusu, na oria o sugusu nasangererie omoganda omonene bw’abarwani esegi, korende barabwo nababekwe ase okoboko kw’omoruoti o irianyi.
Ekero omoruoti oyio o irianyi arabe osiririe omoganda oria, enkoro yaye inayeimokererie igoro, korende naisa goita chilifu chinyinge, takonyara kobua.
“Omoruoti o sugusu nasangererie omoganda omonene bw’abarwani esegi obuete oria bwe ritang’ani, erio nyuma y’emiaka emeke nairane ore nomoganda omonene na ebinto ebinge biganeirie ase esegi.

Ase engaki eyio eyio abanto bande abange mbaimokere omoruoti o irianyi, naende abanto abasaria b’egesaku kiao nabeimokererie igoro ase ogwetogia, erinde bai keranie okorora koria aye kwaroche, mbagochwe bagwe.

Erio omoruoti o Sugusu nache aagache chiburi, abue omochie ogiteire chindwaki. Abarwani esegi b’omoruoti o irianyi mbabugwe, nonya nabarwani baye abachore tibakonyara kobua, ekiagera mbaborwe chinguru.
Omoruoti oria o sugusu orachere oria o irianyi, nakore buna aranche; gose monto onde tari oramobue. Oyio natenene ase ense eria ere engiya mono, na ogosirigwa ngoche goetera ase okoboko kwaye.

“Omoruoti oyio o sugusu nakore omoroberio, ache nokobua kw’oboruoti bwaye bwonsi, Natoeme gokora okobwatana nomoruoti o irianyi ase okomoa omoiseke oye abe mokaye, erinde asarie oboruoti boria kegima, korende amang’ana ayio tagosesenigwa, gose komokonya ere omonyene.

Nyuma y’ayio naonchokere korwania ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, nabue ebisinka ebinge ne chinse boigo. Korende omochiki oyomo bw’abarwani esegi namobue asirie ogochaya kwaye, ee, namoiranerie ogochaya okwo.
Nairane agende ase chiburi chi’ense yaye omonyene, korende nagochwe agwe, takonyorekana naende.

“Naende naoroke omoruoti onde ase ribaga riaye, ere natome omobangi bw’ebango aete ase ense eria ere obonene bw’oboruoti bwaye, Ase engaki y’amatuko amake omoruoti oria naitwe, korende tari ase engencho y’endamwamu, gose ase esegi.
“Naende naoroke omoruoti onde omokorekanu ase ribaga ri’oria oitetwe. Oyio ere takoegwa amasikani ase oboruoti obwo. Nigo arache ng’ora ng’ora ase obong’ainereria bw’okweansia aire oboruoti.
Ere nasirie abarwani esegi abange baria baramochere; boigo nasirie omogambi oria arakore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nere.
Nyuma okobwatana kogwakorirwe nere, nakore ay’obong’ainereria, anyore okobua nonya obwate abanto abake boka.

Nigo arache ng’ora ng’ora, asoe ase chinsemo chintobu chi’ense eria; nigo arakore amang’ana chisokoro ne chisokororia chiaye chitakorete, nasiarere ase egati y’abanto baye ebinto aureretie, na ebi asakorete, ne chinibo. Nakore emeroberio y’okorwania chiburi chinkong’u, korende ase engaki enke yoka.

“Ere nabe noboremu, asangererie abarwani esegi abange mono gochia korwania omoruoti o irianyi, na omoruoti o irianyi nere nebeke ang’e korwana esegi nomoganda omonene mono ore ne chinguru, korende takobua, ekiagera nakorerwe emeroberio y’obong’ainereria.
Abanto baria bakoria endagera amo nere mbamosirie, na abarwani baye b’esegi mbaserebekane, na abange mbaitwe bakwe.
Abaruoti abwo babere mbabe bakoroberia ng’a bakore amabe, baikaranse ase emesa eyemo babe bagotebania oborimo, korende ayio tagosesenigwa, na omoerio nigo oraike ase engaki eria echikire.

Omoruoti oria o sugusu nairane gochia ase ense yaye, aire ebinto ebinge asakoire, na enkoro yaye neroberie mamincha y’okobwatana koria ogochenu, na ekero arabe oikeranirie ayio, nairane gochia ase ense yaye omonyene.
“Naende ase engaki echikire nairane gochia ase ense ya irianyi, korende ase engaki eyio amang’ana takoba buna aye ritang’ani.

Chimeeri chia Kitimu nchiche komorwania, nere noboe atame airane, naonchore ekeririanda kiaye mamincha y’okobwatana ogochenu. “Ekero arabe oiranire nabe ogotegerera na koigwera abwo batigire okobwatana okwo ogochenu.
Abarwani bande b’esegi batometwe nere mbakore Obomenyo Obochenu bobe botachenegeti, nabarusieo ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na agwo mbatenenie okogechia koria kogosiria.
Abwo bagokora amabe ase okobwatana okwo ere nabang’use namang’ana ay’okweansia goika bagotige kegima, korende abanto baria bamomanyete Nyasae obo mbatenene bokong’u bakore ayabagwenerete bakore.

Abwo bare nobong’aini ase egati y’abanto mborokererie abange babe nokomanya. Korende ase engaki enke abande babo nabaitwe nemioro, na abande basambwe nomorero, na abande bairwe ase obosomba, na abande basakorwe ebinto biabo.
Ekero emechando eyio erabachere, abanto ba Nyasae nabanyore ogokonywa ogoke. Abanto abange mbabwatane nabarabwo ase obong’ainereria bw’okweansia.
Abande b’abwo bare abang’aini nabanyorwe nemechando eyio, erinde ogocheneka kobe ase egati yabo, basibeke goika engaki y’omoerio oyo oraike ase engaki eria echikire.

“Omoruoti oria nigo arakore buna anchete. Ase obomwenu bwaye neimokererie igoro ase kera enyasae, nakwane amang’ana ’ogokumia mamincha ya Nyasae oyobuete chinyasae chionsi. Nagenderere konyora chinguru goika ekeririanda kia Nyasae geikeranigwe. Aria aroberetigwe ng’a nabe goika aikeranigwe.
Omoruoti oria tagosika chinyasae chie chisokoro chiaye, gose eye abakungu banchete, gose enyasae ende yonsi, ekiagera neimokererie igoro ase chionsi.
Ase ribaga riabo nasike enyasae ekorenda chiburi; enyasae eye chisokoro chiaye chitamanyete nigo arayesike ase okoyeruera chitahabu, ne chifeta, na amagena e rigori rinene, na ebiegwa ebiya mono.

Ase ogokonywa kw’enyasae engeni nekorere chiburi chinkong’u buna anchete. Abanto baria baranche ng’a nomogambi are, nabae obonene bw’ogosikwa. Nababeke babe abagambi igoro ase abanto abange na nabaatananere ense ebe eng’eria yabo.

“Ase engaki y’omoerio omoruoti o irianyi namoumokere, korende omoruoti oria o sugusu nigo aramorindokere buna ekembugu‐mbugu ore ne chigari, na abariini be chibarasi, ne chimeeri chinyinge. Nigo arasoe ase chinse ao ao nomoganda omonene, aichore aoorie goeterao.
“Boigo nasoe ase ense eria engiya, nasirie chinse chinyinge, korende Abaedomu na Abamoabu, na abanto abange b’Abaamoni, barabwo mbatoorigwe korwa ase okoboko kwaye.
Narambore okoboko kwaye asirie chinse chinyinge, na ense ya Misiri tegotooreka.
Nabe nokobua igoro ye chikungo chie chitahabu ne chifeta, na igoro y’ebinto bie rigori rinene bia Misiri. Abanto ba Libia na ab’Etiopia mbabe bakobwatia chimbaratero chiaye.
Korende amang’ana ararwe moocha na sugusu namoichanie, erio asoke ore nekeririanda ekenene aite abanto abange abasirie kegima.
Natenenie eema yaye y’oboruoti ebe ase egati y’enyancha na egetunwa keria egechenu ki’obonene. Korende nonya naboigo naikere omoerio oye, na monto onde tari oramokonye.

“Ase engaki eyio Mikaeli, omogambi oria omonene naoroke, atenenere abanto bao. Erio nebe engaki y’emechando emenene mono, eye etana koba rinde korwa ekero egesaku kia mwanyabanto giachagete kobao goika ase engaki eyio. Korende ase engaki eyio, abanto bao mbatoorigwe, kera oyomo oyo erieta riave riranyorekane ririkire ase ebuku eria.
Abange b’abwo baraire ase riroba ime mbaboke, abande banyore obogima bwa kare na kare, na abande banyore obosooku na ogochaywa gwa kare na kare.
Abwo bare abang’aini mbabe bakomeka‐meka buna amasase a igoro, na abwo baonchorete abange bakanyora oboronge mbameka‐meke buna ching’enang’eni goika kare na kare.

“Korende aye Danieli, mumekeria amang’ana aya, obeke ebuku eye ekemanyererio goika engaki y’omoerio. Ase engaki eyio abanto abange nabaminyoke gochia aaria na aaria koriga‐rigia, na okomanya kwabo nkomentekane.”
Erio inche Danieli nkarigereria nkarora abanto babere bateneine ase engegu y’orooche, oyomo ase engegu eyemo, na oyonde ase engegu ende.
Oyomo akaboria omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani oteneine ase amache a rooche igoro, “Nengaki eng’ana naki erabe goika omoerio oche, na amakumia aya abe?”

Omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani, oria oteneine ase amache a rooche igoro, akarambora okoboko kwaye gw’okorio na ogw’okobee gochia igoro; nkamoigwa ogotiana asare oyore moyo goika kare na kare ng’a aya nigo araikeranigwe ase ekero ekemo, na ebiro bibere, na ekeng’ese gi’ekero, na ekero okobua kw’abanto abachenu korabe gwasirigwe kegima.
Nkaigwa amang’ana aria, korende tinamanya engencho yaye. Ase ayio nkaboria, “Aye Omonene one, omoerio bw’amang’ana aya, naki orabe?”
Akairaneria agantebia, “Aye Danieli, karue aa ogende, ekiagera amang’ana aya amumekerigwe na kobekwa ekemanyererio goika engaki y’omoerio.
Abanto abange mbacheneke na koraba, babe basibekire, korende abakori amabe mbagenderere gokora amabe, onde tagotoka ase abakori amabe orabe nokomanya, korende abare nobong’aini mbamanye.
“Korwa ase engaki eyio ebing’wanso bia kera rituko mbirusigwe aroro, na okogechia kw’ogosaria ngotenenigweo, nabe amatuko elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo kianda (1,290).
Nasesenirie omonto oria oraganye aikere amatuko elifu eyemo, na amagana atato, na emerongo etato na atano (1,335).
“Korende aye Danieli, genda goika engaki eyio y’omoerio eike, ekero orabe gotimogete, noche koboka onyore egetari kiao ase engaki y’omoerio bw’amatuko ayio.”

Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riacherete Hosea, mosinto o Beeri, ase amatuko aria Usia, na Yotamu, na Ahasi, na Hezekia, barenge abaruoti b’Abayuda, na ekero Yeroboamu, mosinto o Yehoasi, arenge omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.

Agwo ekero Omonene achagete gokwana goetera ase Hosea, Omonene akamotebia iga: “Genda onyuome omokungu omotayayi, onyore abana b’obotayayi, ekiagera ense eye yantigire inche Omonene ase ogokora obotayayi obonene.”
Ase ayio Hosea akagenda, akanyuoma Gomeri, omoiseke o Dibulaimu, na omokungu oyio akaba morito, akamoiborera omwana omoisa.

Omonene agatebia Hosea, “Moroke Yesireeli, ekiagera engaki netigarete enke, ndarue egesusuro ase ororeria rwa Yehu, ndusie egesiomba ki’amanyinga aria abanto bamenyete Yesireeli baiterete. Ninsirie kegima oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
Ase rituko erio nimbune amata ’Abaisraeli agwo ase ense omweremo ya Yesireeli.”
Naende Gomeri akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoiseke. Erio Omonene agatebia Hosea, “Moroke Lo‐Ruhama, ekiagera tinkonyara kogenderera koba namabera ase Abaisraeli, gose tinkobaabera nonya ng’ake.
Korende nindorere Abayuda amabera. Inche Omonene, Nyasae obo, nimbatoorie ne chinguru chiane, gose tari ase okorwana namata, gose nemioro, gose ne chibarasi chi’esegi, gose nabariini be chibarasi.”
Ekero Gomeri atachire Lo‐Ruhama, akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana onde omoisia.
Omonene agatebia Hosea, “Moroke Lo‐Ami, ekiagera inwe timori abana baane, na inche tinkoba Nyasae oino.”

Korende nonya naboigo, Abaisraeli nigo barabuche mono, babe buna omokenye o nyancha, tibakorengeka gose kobareka. Nebe ng’a ase barenge gotebigwa: Inwe timori abana baane, bono mbatebigwe: Inwe nabana ba Nyasae ore moyo.
Abayuda na Abaisraeli mbasangererekane amo, bechorere oyomo abe omotwe obo okobaraa, barue ase ense eye. Ee, rituko erio ria Yesireeli nigo rirabe rinene.
“Mobaroke abamino abamura Ami, na abamino abasubati Ruhama.
“Mosorore nyoko, ee, momosorore, ekiagera ere tari omokungu one, na inche tindi omosacha oye. Tiga atige obonyaka borue ase obosio bwaye, na obotomani borue ase egekuba kiaye.
Atakoreti bo, nimochabore chianga chiaye, imotige getirianda abe bosa buna ase rituko riria aiboretwe. Nimokore abe buna erooro, na buna ense enyomo, nimotige akwe ase engencho y’erang’o.
Tinkororera abana baye amabera, ekiagera nigo bare abana b’omokungu omotayayi.

Ng’ina nigo arenge omotayayi, ee, oyo obaiborete nigo arenge gokora obonyaka. Nigo atebete: Nimbe ngotunyana abanchi baane, abwo bakong’a endagera nkoria, na amache, na amarionya e ching’ondi, na egatani, na amaguta, na edivai.
“Ase engencho eyio nintiche enchera yaye namagwa, ning’agache orwaki roramotange ase agoetera.

Nabe okobwatia abanchi baye, korende takobaikeera; nabarigie, korende takobanyora. Erio natebe: Bono nkoirana inde, ngende ase omosacha one bwe ritang’ani, ekiagera engaki eria narenge asare nigo narenge buya kobua bono.
“Omokungu oria tamanyete ng’a ninche narenge komoa endagera, na edivai, na amaguta, naende ninche narenge komoa chifeta ne chitahabu chinyinge, echio abanto beroiseretie enyasae Baali.
Ase ayio ning’iranie endagera yane, na edivai yane, ekero engaki eraikerane, boigo ning’ire amarionya aane e ching’ondi, na egatani, ebio namoete atube obogetirianda bwaye.
Bono nimochabore chianga chiaye ase amasio ’abanchi baye, imotige ore getirianda, gose monto onde tari oranyare komotooria korwa ase okoboko kwane.
Ninsirie kegima omogoko oye bwonsi, na Amatuko aye Amanene ay’Emetienyi Emeyia, ne Chisabato chiaye, na emeyega yaye echikire.
Ninsirie emesabibu yaye, na emeko yaye, ebio akwanete igoro yabo, agateba ng’a eyio nero eng’eria yaye abanchi baye bamoete. Inche ninsirie emete eyio ebe orosana, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chiyerie.

Ning’ee omokungu oyio egesusuro ase engencho y’amatuko ayio akorerete chinyasae chiria Baali emeyega, agachisambera ubani, naende agechabera ebigera bi’amato na ebinto binde bi’ogwechabera, ekero arenge gotunyana abanchi baye, korende akanyeba.” Nabo Omonene agoteba.
“Ase ayio nimoebererie, imoire ase erooro, erinde nkwane nere amang’ana amororo ay’obwanchani.
Ekero ararue agwo nimoiranerie emegondo yaye y’emesabibu, naende ninkore Ebate y’Akori ebe egesieri ki’ogosemeria. Aroro agwo natere buna ekero keria arenge omoke, ekero aruete ase ense ya Misiri.
Inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Ase rituko erio nondoke omosacha oo, gose tokogenderera kondoka Baali yao.
Nindusie amarieta e chinyasae Baali korwa ase omonwa bw’omokungu oyio, tichiatorwa nonya ng’ake ase amarieta abo.

“Ase rituko riria, ninkore okobwatana ne ching’iti chi’orosana, ne chinyoni, ne ching’iti chikwagura inse, ase engencho y’abanto baane. Ninsirie korwa ase ense eye amata, na emioro, na esegi, ntige batimoke bare nobotoereru.
“Ninkoriere boko nkonyuome obe oyone goika kare na kare; ee, ninkoriere boko ase oboronge na ekeene, na ase obwanchani botari koera, na ase amabera.
Ee, ninkoriere boko ase obwegenwa, naye omanye ng’a ninche Omonene.
Inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Ase rituko erio nebe ng’a ninyigwe ogosaba kwa igoro, na igoro nchiigwe ogosaba gw’ense.
Erio ense eiranerie erue endagera, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, na ebinto ebio mbiigwe ogosaba kwa Yesireeli.
Nimosimeke ase ense eye abe oyone. Nimororere amabera oyio otaroreretwe amabera, nintebie abwo batarenge abanto baane: Bono inwe nabanto baane, na barabwo mbatebe: Aye naye Nyasae oito.”

Omonene agantebia, “Genda omwanche naende omokungu oyio nonya ogokora obotomani nomwanchi oye, omwanche buna Omonene anchete Abaisraeli, nonya baonchokeire chinyasae ching’ao, naende banchire amasabibu amomo.”
Ase igo nkamogora chisekeli chie chifeta ikomi na isano, na esairi ebitonga ikomi na bitano.
Nkamotebia, “Ogenderere komenya nainche amatuko amange kore omweriti ase engencho yane. Tobaisa gokora obonyaka, gose koba oyo bw’omosacha onde omoao, na inche ningenderere kwerita ase engencho yao.”

Naboigo Abaisraeli baragenderere komenya ase amatuko amange batabwati omoruoti gose omogambi, batari korua ebing’wanso, gose gosasima amagena atenenirie, gose koba negesibao ki’obokuani, gose ebinyasae bibekire ase chinyomba.
Nyuma y’ayio Abaisraeli nabairane, barigie Omonene, Nyasae obo, na Daudi, omoruoti obo; mbamoiroke Omonene, barigie obuya bwaye ase amatuko ay’omoerio.
Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene, ekiagera obeeigwe nabamenyete ase ense eye: “Obwegenwa gose obwanchani tibori aroro, na abanto b’ense eye tibamomanyeti Nyasae.
Nigo bagotiana na gokwana oborimo; nigo bagoita na koiba, naende bakora obotomani. Nigo bagosaria amachiko onsi, na ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga nigo gokobwatigwa nokonde.
Ase engencho eyio ense nigo ekorera ase okweumia, na kera omonto omenyeteo nigo achandegete na kogoya; boigo ching’iti chi’orosana, ne chinyoni, ne chinswe ngokwa chire.
“Monto onde tabaisa koba omoengereria, gose monto onde tasoera onde. Nonya nabo inwe nigo mogosoera abakuani.
Aye nogochwa mobaso na botuko, na omobani agochwe amo naye. Inche ninsirie nyoko.

Abanto baane nigo bagosirigwa, ekiagera batari nokomanya. Ekiagera aye kwangire komanya inche, nainche ninkwange, toba omokuani one. Ekiagera kwangire koigwera amachiko aane inche Nyasae oo, boigo nainche ninyange abana bao.
“Buna abakuani bagendererete kobucha, naboigo bagendererete gokora ebibe asende. Ase ayio ning’onchore obonene bwabo bobe obosooku.
Nigo bakwerageria ebibe bi’abanto baane, nigo bakogania bakore obobe.
Buna erabe ase abanto, naboigo erabe nase omokuani. Nindue egesusuro asebare bonsi ase engencho ye chinchera chiabo, nimbaakane koreng’ana nogokora kwabo.
Mbaragere, korende tibakoigota; mbabe bagokora obonyaka, korende tibakomentekana, ekiagera bantigire inche Omonene, na baonchokeire chinyasae ching’ao.
“Obotomani, na edivai, na ekenyugwa kegotindia, nigo bikoura abanto okomanya kwabo.

Abanto baane nigo bakorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase ekeengwe ki’omote, na enyimbo yabo nigo ekobaorokeria aya baganetie komanya. Omoika bw’obotomani obasiririe, barabwo batigire Nyasae obo bachiire gotayaya.

Nigo bakoruera ebing’wanso ase ebitunwa igoro, na basambera ubani ase ebigoro, inse y’emete enga buna emetontera, na inse y’emesobeti, na inse y’ebirachuoki, ekiagera agwo nao ebiriri ebiya bire. “Ase ayio, abaiseke baino nigo bagokora obonyaka, na baka bamura baino nigo bagokora obotomani.

Ekero abaiseke baino barabe bagokora obonyaka na korua ebing’wanso, na baka bamura baino barabe bagokora obotomani, tinkobaa egesusuro, ekiagera abasacha abanyene nigo bakogenda ao bakora obonyaka nabatayayi be chihekalu, na abanto batari nokomanya goika basirigwe kegima.

“Inwe Abaisraeli, nonya mogokora obotomani, timobaisa gotiga Abayuda bakore ogosaria okwo. Timobaisa kogenda Giligali, gose gotiira gochia ase Beti‐Aveni, gose timobaisa gotiana mogoteba: Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo.
Abaisraeli babeire abaenenu buna ritororo rienenu ritari kogambereka. Inee! Omonene nanyare kobarisia buna chimanwa chie ching’ondi chikorisigwa ase egetii ekegare?
Egesaku gi’Efraimu kiabwatanire nemegwekano kegosasima, tiga getigweo.
Kobanyure batindire, nigo bakwerua kegima ase obotomani botambe; abwo bare chinguba chi’abanto nigo banchete ay’obosooku.
Ekembugu‐mbugu nkebaabuse ne chinguru chiaye, na barabwo mbasookigwe ase engencho y’ebing’wanso biabo.

“Inwe abakuani, igwa ring’ana eri! Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe! Inwe ab’enyomba y’omoruoti, tegerera moigwe! Ekina kianachirwe igoro yaino, ekiagera mwabeire oboreba agwo Misipa, na ekeonga getegire agwo ase Tabori igoro.
Abasaria nigo bagendererete komenta obobe bwabo, korende bonsi nimbae egesusuro.
Nimbamanyete Abaefraimu, na Abaisraeli tibakonyara kwebisa korwa asende. Inwe Abaefraimu mwakorire ay’obonyaka, ee, Abaisraeli besoirie ase ogotacheneka.
“Ogokora kwabo kwabatangire tibairanera Nyasae obo. Omoika bw’obotomani nigo ore ime yabo, tibamomanyeti Omonene.
Oboenenu bw’Abaisraeli nigo bobaberete kirori. Abaisraeli na Abaefraimu mbagochwe bagwe ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, na Abayuda mbagwe amo nabarabwo.
Mbaire amaicho e chitugo chiabo bagende korigia Omonene, korende tibakomonyora, ekiagera nabe bweatananirie korwa asebare.
Barabwo tibabete abegenwa ase Omonene. Nigo baiborete abana batari abaye. Ase ayio, emeyega y’Omotienyi Omoyia nebasirie amo nemeganda yabo.
“Bugia ebitureri bi’esegi agwo Gibea, na mobugie ebirombeta agwo Rama! Aka eriogi ri’ogotabobora agwo Beti‐Aveni! Inwe abanto ba Benjamin, ababisa nkobabwatia bare.
Abaefraimu mbasirigwe kegima ase rituko riria ri’egesusuro. Ase egati y’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli inche nararirie, ayarache goikeranigwa ekeene.
“Abagambi b’Abayuda nigo babeire buna abwo bagotumana chimbebe; ase ayio nimbaumorere ekeririanda kiane buna amache.
Abaefraimu baregirwe na gotiringerwa inse ase ekina, ekiagera beruete ase okobwatia emeroberio ya bosa.
Ase ayio nimbe buna ekegwankwa kegosaria ase Abaefraimu, na buna obogundo ase Abayuda.

“Abaefraimu mbaroche oborwaire bwabo, na Abayuda amagumba abo. Ase ayio Abaefraimu bakagenda ase Abaasuri, bakarangeria omoruoti Yarebu. Korende omoruoti oyio takonyara kobagwenia korwa ase oborwaire bwaino, gose amagumba aino,
Nimbe buna endo ase Abaefraimu, na buna endo ensae ase Abayuda. Inche omonyene nimbwate eke natwarire nkeire; ee, nkeire, na onde tari oragetoorie.
“Ning’irane ngende ase obomenyo bwane, goika babe bamanyire okomocha kwabo, erinde bache kondigia. Ee, ekero bare nemechando mbaayerere gocha kondigia.”
Abanto nigo bagotebania: “Inchuo, tomoiranere Omonene! Ekiagera nere ototaboranire, naende nere oratogwenie; nere otoakire chingoma, nere oratoboe chingoma chiaito.
Nyuma y’amatuko abere natokore tobe abayia. Ase rituko ria gatato natotenenie, na intwe ntogenderere koba moyo ase obosio bwaye.

Intwe tiga tomomanye Omonene, ee, tiga tokore omokia tomomanye. Okooroka kwaye nigo korabe ogw’ekeene buna ogosoka kw’erioba; natochere buna embura, ee, buna embura ekwamia endagera na konyiyia riroba.
“Inwe Abaefraimu, ngento ki ndabakorere? Inwe Abayuda, ngento ki ndabakorere? Obwanchani bwaino nigo bonga buna ritaturi, na buna riime ria mambia rigosira bwango.
Ase engencho eyio nabaakire goetera ase ababani baane, nabaitire namang’ana akorwa ase omonwa one; ebina biane nkobanachera nigo bikooroka buna omobaso.
Inche Omonene nigo nkogokigwa nobwanchani kobua kogokigwa nebing’wanso; nigo nkogokigwa ng’a imomanye inche Nyasae kobua kogokigwa nebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa.
“Abanto aba basaririe okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, buna Adamu agosaretie. Ase amang’ana ayio babeire abatari abegenwa asende.
Omochie o Gileadi nigo oichire nabanto abakori amabe, chimbaratero chiabo nigo chiichire amanyinga.
Abakuani nigo banga buna ekeombe ki’abauri keboerete abanto, nigo bagoitera abanto ase enchera ekogenda Sekemu. Ee, nigo bagokora ayare amabe mono.
Narorire ase Abaisraeli egento ekebe gi’okogechia; agwo nao Abaefraimu bagokorera obonyaka, ee, Abaisraeli besoirie ase ogotacheneka.
“Nainwe Abayuda boigo, mwarikeirwe engaki ye rigesa ri’ogokora kwaino, ekero ndasibore abooswa b’abanto baane.

“Ekero nganetie kogwenia Abaisraeli, ogosaria kw’Abaefraimu na ogokora okobe kw’Abasamaria nigo gokororekana maiso marore. Barabwo nigo bagokora ay’obong’ainereria; abaibi nigo bagotagora chinyomba basoa ime, na ebiombe bi’abauri nigo bikourereria isiko.
Barabwo tibari korengereria ng’a inche nigo ng’inyorete ogokora kwabo gwonsi okobe. Bono ogokora okwo kwabo okobe kwabaetananire onsi nigo kore ase obosio bwane.
“Nigo bakogokia omoruoti nogokora kwabo okobe, na kogokia abagambi nobong’ainereria bwabo.

Abwo bonsi nigo bare abatomani. Nigo banga buna eriko ri’okogekera emegati riutire omorero, na omoroisia bw’emegati nigo agotiga koigereria omorero goika abe okonyire ribomba ri’obosie na ememera ebe yaribotirie.
Ase rituko rinene ri’omoruoti oito abagambi bakanywa edivai endoro goika ekabarwaria, na ere omonyene akarambora okoboko kwaye, akabwatana nabanyacheche.
Chinkoro chiabo nigo chiare gwoka nokogania okobe buna eriko rigwoka omorero. Ase obotuko bwonsi, okogania okwo nigo gokorara, na mambia kobwakire kwaba kogwoka buna omorero ekebemberi.
“Abanto abwo bonsi nigo bagwoka buna omorero o riko, bagosiria abagambi babo b’ebina. Abaruoti babo bonsi bagure, na onde tari ase abwo okondangeria imokonye.
“Abaefraimu bochoganire nabanto b’ebisaku. Nigo banga buna omogati otaonchoiri kogekeire.
Abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni bakoorire chinguru chiaye, na ere tamanyeti amang’ana ayio; chimbuche chiamerire ase omotwe oye, nere tamanyeti ayio.
Oboenenu bw’Abaisraeli bwababereire kirori. Nonya naboigo, tibari komoiranera Omonene, Nyasae obo, gose komorigia.
Abaefraimu nigo banga buna riruma ririri, ritari nokomanya. Nigo bagosaba ogokonywa korwa Misiri, naende bagenda Asuri.
Ekero barabe bakogendao, nindambore ekeonga kiane mbabwatere imeo buna chinyoni chikobwatwa. Nimbae egesusuro ase okobarongeyia, koreng’ana buna omosangererekano obo bworokererigwe.
“Obobe nobwabo, ekiagera batamire korwa asende. Mbasirigwe, ekiagera basaririe asende bantigire. Nanga nabatooria, korende babeire bagokwana oborimo igoro yane.
Tibari korera asende korwa ase chinkoro chiabo, korende nigo bakona‐kwerera ase amarere abo. Nigo bagosangererekana amo bachandekerete endagera na edivai, ekero bagendererete gosaria asende.
Nonya naborokereretie na gokong’ia amaboko abo, nigo bagendererete koroberia amabe igoro yane.

Barabwo nigo bakoonchoka, korende tari gochia ase Oyore Igoro Mono. Nigo banga buna obota bootokanete. Abagambi babo mbaitwe nemioro ase engencho y’obotindi bwe chimeme chiabo. Ring’ana erio ndigere ense ya Misiri ebasekerere na kobachaya.
“Beka egetureri monwa mokebugie! Omobisa ngocha are igoro y’enyomba y’Omonene buna ekeongo, ekiagera abanto basaririe okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, na batigire amachiko aane.
Abaisraeli nigo bakorera asende, kera oyomo oteba: Aye Nyasae one, intwe Abaisraeli ntokomanyete.
Barabwo bangire amang’ana are amaya, ase ayio ababisa mbababwatie.
“Abaisraeli bebekeire abaruoti, batamboreti, bebekeire abagambi abwo ntamanyeti, na korwa ase chifeta ne chitahabu chiabo beroiseirie emegwekano bagosasima; ayio nigo arabarentere ogosirigwa.
Aye Samaria, omogwekano oria bw’emori ore ase egati yao yabeire okogechia asende. Endamwamu yane nigo egwoka igoro y’abanto abwo. Ngoika ririri baragenderere koba iga bataracheneka?
Omogwekano oyio nigo oruete ase Abaisraeli. Nigo oroisetigwe nomoroisia bw’ebinto, oyio tari oro Nyasae. Omogwekano oria bw’emori ore Samaria nosenyentwe obe ebisamunye.
Abanto abwo babusuire embeo, mbagese ekembugu‐mbugu. Ebimeri bigokina ase emegondo yabo tibigosomoria, ase ayio tibikwama chindagera. Biise kwama, abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni mbache bachigese.
Abaisraeli bamerirwe. Bono nigo bare ase egati y’ebisaku babarire koba buna egekorero getagwenereti kende.
Bagendire Asuri, babeire buna etigere y’orosana ere ao yoka; ee, Abaefraimu benyoreire abanchi.
Ee, nonya benyoreire abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao ng’a babakonye, nimbasangererie amo bwango, mbakeyie babe inse y’ogochandwa kw’omoruoti oria bw’abagambi.
“Ekiagera Abaefraimu beagacheire ebisasimero ebinge bikogera bakore ebibe, ebio biabeire ebibe asebare.
Nonya nare korika amachiko aane asebare ara chilifu ikomi, tibaare koyancha, korende bayabarire koba egento ekegeni asebare.

Nigo banchete korua ebing’wanso asende, erinde barie chinyama chi’ebing’wanso ebio, korende inche Omonene timbagokereti. Bono ning’inyore okomocha kwabo mbae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo; barabwo bairane gochia Misiri.

“Abaisraeli bebire Omotongi obo, baagachire chinyomba chi’obonene, na Abayuda baagachire emechie emenge egiteire chindwaki, korende nindete omorero ase emechie eyio, na oro nosambe amaagacho abo bagwekengera.”

Inwe Abaisraeli, timobaisa kogoka gose gochenga buna abanto b’ebisaku bagokora, ekiagera inwe mwakorire obotomani, mwatigire Nyasae oino. Mwagokeire eng’eria y’obotomani ase kera ekeooreri gi’okoorera.
Korende ebiooreri bi’okoorera na ebimitero bi’edivai tibigoisanekia abanto, na edivai enyia tekonyorekana asebare.
Barabwo tibakogenderera komenya ase ense y’Omonene; Abaefraimu mbairane gochia ase ense ya Misiri, na agwo Asuri babe bakoria endagera etachenegeti.

Tibakorua okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gi’edivai ase Omonene, ere takogokera ebing’wanso bararue asare. Okoruegwa okwo kw’endagera bararue asare nigo korabe buna endagera y’ebirero; na omonto onde bwensi orayerie nigo arabe oyo otachenegeti, ekiagera endagera eyio erabe egoisanekia oyore nenchara rioka, tekorentwa ase enyomba y’Omonene.
Ninki morakore ekero Rituko Rinene ri’omoyega bw’Omonene riraike?

Rora, abanto abwo batamire ng’a tibabaisa gosirigwa; ense ya Misiri nebasangererie amo, na omochie o Memifisi nobatindeke. Amasa namere aase babegete chinibo chiabo chie chifeta, chiria chianchire, na amagwa namere ase chinyomba chiabo ime.

Amatuko ’egesusuro aikire, ee, amatuko ay’ogoakanera ogokora kw’abanto aikire. Abaisraeli mbamanye ayio. Omobani obeire omoriri, na omonto ore nomoika obeire ebarimo, ekiagera obobe bwaino bwabeire obonge, na okogecha kwaino kwabeire okonene.
Abaefraimu nigo barenge abarendi ba Nyasae, korende bono babeire emeeto y’obotegi ase chinchera chiabo chionsi; obobisa bwabo nigo bore ime ase enyomba ya Nyasae obo.
Besaririe kegima buna yabete ase amatuko aria a kare agwo Gibea. Omonene nainyorete ebibe biabo, abae egesusuro.

“Inche Omonene nigo nanyorete Abaisraeli banga buna emesabibu ase erooro; nigo naroche chisokoro chiaino chinga buna okwama ogotang’ani kw’emeko. Korende bakagenda Baali‐Peori, bakerua abanyene gosasima enyasae eria y’obosooku, bakaba okogechia buna enyasae eria banchete ere.
Obonene bw’Abaefraimu mboiruruke buna enyoni bogende. Okoibora tigokoba asebare, gose abakungu tibakoba barito, bonsi mbagombae.
Baise gokinia abana, ning’ite abana abwo, onde tagotigara ore moyo nonya noyomo. Obobe nobwabo abanyene, ekero inche ndabatige.
“Nkarora Abaefraimu banga buna omogondo omuya buna Turo orenge, korende ase rituko erimo mbabe bakoira abana babo gochia goitwa.
Aye Omonene, bae eki ogwenerete kobaa, ogombayie chinda chiabo, ne chimbeere chiabo chiome pa.

“Obobe bwabo bwonsi nigo bore Giligali, agwo nao nachakerete kobagecha. Nimbaserie barue ase enyomba yane ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo okobe. Tinkogenderera kobancha; abagambi babo bonsi nigo bare abasaria.
Abaefraimu baakirwe, omori obo bwomire, tibakonyara kwama okwama. Nabaisa koibora, goika ing’ite abana abwo banchete.”
Nyasae one nabaange, ekiagera baangete komoigwera; mbabe bakonagotayaya ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku.

Abaisraeli nigo banga buna omosabibu okororekana ore omuya mono okwama amasabibu. Buna koreng’ana okwama kwabo kwamentekanete, naboigo bagendererete koagacha ebisasimero ebinge; na buna bagendererete gotenenka, naboigo bagendererete gotenenia chisiiro bagosasima.
Nigo bare abang’ainereria ase chinkoro chiabo; ase ayio goika baegwe egesusuro gi’okomocha kwabo. Omonene natagore ebisasimero biabo, atagore ne chisiiro chiabo bagosasima.
Erio abanto abwo mbatebe, “Titobwati omoruoti, ekiagera titomoirogeti Omonene. Inee! Toraba nomoruoti, ngento ki aratokorere?”
Nigo bagokwana amang’ana atari nengencho, naende betiania ase oborimo ekero bagokora okobwatana kw’ogotianania; ase igo ekina nigo gekobachera buna ekemeri kere nobosongo ase emetaro ya mogondo.
Abanto bamenyete Samaria mbatengechigwe ase engencho y’omogwekano bw’emori bagosasima agwo Beti‐Aveni. Abwo bakoyosasima mbarere, na abakuani baye mbeng’ererie, ekiagera obonene bwaye bwasirigwe.
Omogwekano oyio noirwe Asuri, oegwe omoruoti Yarebu buna ekeegwa. Abaefraimu mbabe nobosooku, na Abaisraeli mbasookigwe boigo ase engencho y’emeroberio yabo abanyene.
Omoruoti o Samaria nasirigwe arueo buna riuro rigosira korwa ase amache igoro.

Aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agwo Aveni, ase Abaisraeli bakoreire ebibe, nasirigwe. Amagwa na amageri mbimere ase ebisasimero biabo; erio abanto abwo batebie ebitunwa: “Totube”, na ebigoro: “Togwere”.

“Inwe Abaisraeli, nigo mwagendererete gokora ebibe korwa ase amatuko aria mwarenge Gibea, na goika bono nigo mogendererete gokora bo. Inee! Esegi y’okorusia egesiomba igoro y’abakori amabe tiyababuete agwo Gibea?
Ekero ndaganie, nimbae egesusuro gi’okobarongeyia, erio abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao mbasangererekane amo, babachere amo babae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bibere.

“Abaefraimu nigo barenge buna ritororo riorokereretigwe buya, rianchete koora, inche nigo nabegete rikorogoto ase ebigoti biabo ebiya. Bono nimbekere Abaefraimu rikorogoto, nonya n’Abayuda goika babe bakorema, na aba Yakobo goika babe bakobosa.
Ebusurere oboronge, mogese ayare ay’obwanchani, eremere chimbuna chiaino, ekiagera eye nero engaki y’okomorigia Omonene, erinde ache abatwerie oboronge buna embura egotwa.
Mwasimekire ayare amabe, mwagesire aya atari ay’oboronge, mwarire ayare okwama kw’oborimo. “Nigo mwasemeretie ogokora kwaino, na obonge bw’abarwani esegi baino chituoni.

Ase ayio eriomana rie chisegi ndibe ase egati y’abanto baino, ne chiburi chiaino chisarigwe, buna omoruoti Salimani asaretie Beti‐Aribeli ase rituko riria ri’esegi, abang’ina amo nabana babo banachanetwe bakaba ebing’ese.
Naboigo na abanto ba Beteli barabakore ase engencho y’obobe bwaino obonene. Kobogokiamoka omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli naitwe akwe.”
“Ekero Israeli arenge omwana, nigo namwanchete, na korwa Misiri nkarangeria omwana one.
Buna bagendererete korangerigwa, nabo bagendererete kona‐kwerusanania. Nigo babete bakorua ebing’wanso ase chinyasae Baali, na bagasamba ubani ase emegwekano barenge gosasima.
Ninche norokereretie Abaefraimu gotaara, nkababogoria namaboko aane, korende abanto abwo tibamanyete ng’a nigo naganetie kobagwenia.
Nigo nabang’usete ne chingori chinyororo, ee, ne chingori chi’obwanchani. Nigo nororobetie rikorogoto igoro ye chinsea chiabo, ngekumba gochia inse nkabarageria.”
“Barabwo mbairane gochia ase ense ya Misiri, na Abaasuri mbabagambere, ekiagera bangire koirana gocha asende.
Omoro nogwere emechie yabo nobotindi, nosarie emekorogoto y’ebiita biabo na gosaria kende gionsi ase engencho y’emeroberio yabo abanyene.
Abanto baane nigo banchete gontiga, nonya bakorangerigwa gochia ase Oyore Igoro Mono, onde tari okomotogia, nonya noyomo.”

“Inwe Abaefraimu, naki ndakore mbatige? Inwe Abaisraeli, naki ndakore mbatige morue asende? Naki ndakore mbatige buna natigete Adima? Naki ndakore mbakorere buna nakorerete Seboimu? Enkoro yane nigo egwoka, na amabera aane onsi abokire ime yane.

Tinkobaa egesusuro konde nendamwamu egwoka, gose tingosiria Abaefraimu naende, ekiagera inche nigo inde Nyasae, tindi mwanyabanto. Inche nigo inde Omochenu imenyete ase egati yaino, na tingocha asemore inde nekeririanda.
“Abanto abwo mbabwatie Omonene; ere narume buna endo, ee, narume, na abanto baye mbache korwa bosongo bakoiguswa.
Mbairuruke buna chinyoni korwa Misiri, bache bakoiguswa, na buna amaruma korwa ase ense y’Asuri. Nimbabeke bamenye ase chinka chiabo.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
Abaefraimu bang’etananire namang’ana ’oborimo, na Abaisraeli boigo namang’ana ’obong’ainereria; na Abayuda nigo bagendererete gosaria ase Nyasae, oria ore Omochenu na Omwegenwa.

Abaefraimu nigo bakwerageria embeo, babwatia embeo ya moocha. Kera rituko nigo bakomenta gokwana oborimo, na gokora ay’obotindi. Nigo bakobwatana n’Abaasuri, babe bakoira amaguta ’amazeituni ase ense ya Misiri.
Omonene nabwate amang’ana akwomania Abayuda, nae abanto ba Yakobo egesusuro koreng’ana ne chinchera chiabo, nabaakane koreng’ana nogokora kwabo.
Ekero Yakobo arenge inda ya ng’ina, nigo abwatete egetingiro kia momura omwabo, na ekero abete omonto omonene, agakinana na Nyasae.
Ee, nigo akinanete nomomalaika, akamobua; akarera, akamosorora ng’a amororere amabera. Agwo Beteli Yakobo akaumerana na Nyasae, na Ere agakwana naintwe.
Omonene nere Nyasae bw’Emeganda. Omonene nario erieta riaye.
Ase ayio, aye irana ase Nyasae oo. Obwatie obwanchani na oboronge, na obe komosemeretie Nyasae oo botambe.
Omoonchoreria nigo abwate ebirengero bi’obong’ainereria ase amaboko aye, nigo anchete gokora oborianania.

Abaefraimu nigo bagoteba, “Amaene twabeire abanda, twenyoreire obotenenku; ase emeremo yaito yonsi monto onde tari oranyare gotosoera ng’a nigo twanyorire obonda obo ase enchera y’ebibe bi’oborianania.”
Korende inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, korwa ekero keria mwarenge Misiri, nimbabeke momenye ase chiema naende, buna yarenge Amatuko Amanene aria achikire.
“Nigo narenge gokwana nababani, nkaba nkobaorokeria amaroro amange ao ao, na goetera ase ababani nkaba ngokwana nabarabwo ase emereng’anio.

Onye ebibe bire ime ya Gileadi, abanto b’aroro goika basire. Onye abanto ba Giligali bakoruera ebing’wanso bie chieri aroro ase ebisasimero biabo, birobio mbisarigwe bibe buna chitui chi’amagena ase emetaro y’emegondo.”
Yakobo nigo atamete gochia ase ense y’Aramu, ere Israeli agakora emeremo ase okonyora omokungu, ee, akarisia ching’ondi ase okonyora omokungu.
Goetera ase omobani Omonene akang’anyia Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri, na goetera ase omobani abanto abwo bakaba barendire.
Abaefraimu abwo bagechetie Omonene goika ere akaba nendamwamu enene mono; ase ayio Omonene obo nabeke okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga abo kobe igoro yabo; nabairanerie okogechia kwabo.
Ekero Abaefraimu barenge gokwana, abanto nigo barenge koiguswa; nigo beimokereretie igoro ase egati y’Abaisraeli; korende bakarenta okomocha ase ogosasima enyasae Baali, na ase ayio bagakwa.

Nigo bagendererete gokora ebibe goetania, bakaroisia emegwekano ye chifeta bagosasima, eyio babombete nobong’aini. Eyio yonsi nemeremo yaroisirie nabaroisia b’ebinto. Nigo bagoteba igoro y’abwo: “Abwo bakorua abanto baba ebing’wanso, nigo bakonyunyunta emegwekano eyio ye chimori.”
Ase ayio abanto abwo nabasire buna ritaturi ria mambia, gose buna riime rigosira bwango, na buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga korwa ase ekeooreri, gose buna erioki rigoetera ase ekebao riasira.
