“Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, korwa ekero mwarenge ase ense ya Misiri. Timwabete momanyete enyasae ende yonsi otatiga inche; omotooria onde tari otatiga inche.
Ninche nabarendete ase erooro, ense eria enyomo pa egosamba.
Korende ekero banyorete endagera eisaine, bakaria bakaigota, erio bakaenena na kweimokereria igoro; ase ayio bakanyeba.
Ase engencho eyio nkaba buna endo asebare, nkababoera ase chinchera chiabo buna engo ekoboera.
Nimbaumokere buna edubu yaurirwe chimanwa chiaye, mbatandore ebikuba biabo, erinde mbaite mbarie buna endo ekoria, ee, nimbe buna eng’iti y’orosana mbatandorane.
“Inwe Abaisraeli mwesiririe inwe abanyene ase okoba mamincha yane, inche oyo narenge ogokonyeka kwaino.
Bono ng’ai omoruoti oino are, erinde abatoorie ase emechie yaino yonsi? Ng’ai abagambi ebina baino bare, inwe abamwatebete: Toe omoruoti na abagambi batogambere?
Nkabaa omoruoti inde nendamwamu, naende namorusirie inde nekeririanda.
“Obobe bw’Abaefraimu nigo bosibire amo, na ebibe biabo nigo birikire bigachire.
Obororo bonga buna obw’omokungu okobina aibore mbobachere, nigo bonga buna omwana otari nokomanya osinyirwe gosoka korwa ase enda ya ng’ina ekero engaki yaye yaikire.

Nimbaboorie korwa ase okobua gw’aase abakure, na nimbatoorie korwa ase amakweri. Aye amakweri, amaako ao ng’ai are? Aye aase abakure, ng’ai ogosiria kwao kore? Ogweitia gwasirire korwa ase amaiso aane?

Abaefraimu nabaisa koibora babuche ase egati y’abamwabo, omwaga korwa moocha noche, ee, omwaga bw’Omonene noche korwa ase erooro. Erio ebisima biabo bi’amache biome, ne chinsoko chiabo chikame. Omwaga oyio nosirie kegima chinibo chiabo banchete.
Abanto ba Samaria mbaegwe egesusuro, ekiagera basaririe ase Nyasae obo, mbaitwe nemioro, na abana babo banachanwe ebing’ese. Abakungu babo bare barito mbatandorwe chinda.”
Inwe Abaisraeli, irana ase Omonene Nyasae oino, ekiagera ebibe biaino nabio biabagochire na kobaiyeria.

Irana ase Omonene, momotebie amang’ana aya: “Toruserie obobe bwaito bwonsi obwo twakorire, bwanchere ayare amaya, naintwe torue asore ogotogia kw’ebikoba biaito konga buna okoruegwa kw’ebing’wanso bie chieri.
Abaasuri tibakonyara gototooria; titokoriina chibarasi gose titokogenderera koroka emeremo y’amaboko aito Nyasae oito. Aye Omonene nigo okoorokia amabera ase oyore entakana.”
“Ningwenie abwo batigire obwegenwa bwabo. Nimbanche nenkoro yane yonsi, ekiagera endamwamu yane yabatigire.
Nimbe buna riime ase Abaisraeli, na barabwo mbasiche buna ebisicha ebiya, mbakinie emeri buna emete ya Lebanoni.
Ebisebo biabo mbirande, na obwari bwabo nabobe buna obw’emezeituni, ne rimisu riabo ndiesiarere buna eri’emete ya Lebanoni.
Abwo baramenye inse ase ekiriri kiabo bairane, bagenderere koreereta buna ebimeri bia mogondo mbasiche, na obonene bwabo bobe buna obw’emesabibu ya Lebanoni.

Inwe Abaefraimu, naki ngokora nemegwekano yaino mogosasima? Ninche omonyene naigure ogosaba kwaino inwe Abaefraimu, nimbairanerie, naende ninche mbarendete. Inche nigo inde buna omotarakwa omobese; na okwama kwaino nigo gokonyorekana ime yane.”

Oyore omong’aini, nere oramanye amang’ana aya; oyore nokomanya, nere orayarengererie. Chinchera chi’Omonene nigo chire chindonge, na abanyene oboronge nabwo baraetere aroro, korende abasaria nigo baragochwe bagwe ase chirochio.
Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riachete ase Yoeli, mosinto o Petueli.
Inwe abagaaka, igwa amang’ana aya! Inwe abanto bonsi abamomenyete ase ense eye, tegerera moigwe! Inee! Amang’ana buna aya anagokorekana ase amatuko aino, gose ase amatuko e chisokoro chiaino?
Yatebie abana baino, na abana baino bayatebie abana babo, na abana babo bayatebie ekegori kende.
Endagera chinyanchaba chiatigaretie, chingige chikayeria, na eye chingige chiatigaretie, ebisase bikayeria, na eye ebisase biatigaretie, chingeeti chikayeria.
Inwe abamwatindire nebinyugwa ebiroro, boka morere! Inwe mwensi aba mokonywa edivai, bokia amagombo, ase engencho y’edivai enyia, ekiagera yarusigwe korwa ase emenwa yaino.
Egesaku kere ne chinguru getari kobareka kiaumokeire ense yane nigo kebwate amaino anga buna ay’endo, na amagegu aye nigo anga buna ay’endo eaberi.
Giasaririe emesabibu yane, kiabunire emeko yane; kiayesaboire, na gotuguta amasabo inse, ne chinsagia chi’emete eyio chiarabire se.
Rera na kobokia amagombo buna omoiseke omwekungi obegete chianga chie chigunia, okwereirwe nomosacha bw’oboke bwaye.
Okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa biatangirwe, tibirentwa ase enyomba y’Omonene. Abakuani abare abakoreri b’Omonene nigo bakorera.
Emegondo yatigaire bosa; riroba nigo rikorera ekiagera endagera yasirigwe, edivai enyia tekobao na amaguta ’emezeituni akeeire kegima.
Inwe abaremi ichana na gosooka, nainwe abaroiseria b’emesabibu, rera, ekiagera engano na esairi biasirigwe amo nokwama gwonsi kw’emegondo.
Emesabibu yomire, na emeko boigo. Emekomomanga, na emekendo, na emete y’amapera, ee, emete ende yonsi y’emegondo yomire. Omogoko bw’abanto oerire.

Inwe abakuani, eboyie chigunia, morere, nainwe abakoreri b’egesasimero, bokia amagombo! Inwe abakoreri ba Nyasae one, eboyie chigunia, morere ase Hekalu ime ase obotuko bwonsi, ekiagera okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa biatangirwe, tibirentwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae oino.
Raria engaki y’okweng’ata ogochenu; rangeria omosangererekano bw’ogosasima! Sangereria abagaaka na abanto bonsi b’ense eye, bache ase enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, erinde morere ase Omonene.
Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene nigo rire ang’e, rirarente ogosirigwa korwa ase Omonguru.
Inee! Endagera tesiriri korwa ase amaiso aito na omogoko na omochengo korwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito?
Chimbusuro chiomeire ase riroba ime; ebiage biatigaire bosa na ebigancha biasarekire, ekiagera endagera yaborire.
Chitugo chirochio nigo chikonakwana, amaicho e chiombe achandekire, ekiagera obonyansi bwaborire chikorisia, nonya namaicho e ching’ondi achandekire.
Aye Omonene, inche nigo nkorera asore, ekiagera eguru‐gura enga buna omorero yomirie amarisio ’erooro, na eyio enga buna chimeme chi’omorero yasambire emete yonsi y’orosana.
Nonya ne ching’iti chi’orosana nigo chikorera asore, ekiagera chindooche chiakamire, amache taiyo, ee, omorero oria osambire amarisio ’erooro.
Bugia egetureri ase Sayoni, ee, bugia egetureri ki’ogotabobora ase egetunwa kiane egechenu. Tiga abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense baiguswe, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire; nigo rire ang’e.

Nigo rirabe rituko ri’omosunte na eri’amataturi, rituko ri’amare na omosunte ekerima. Omoganda omonene bwe chinguru nochiche, nigo orarande igoro ase ebitunwa buna ogokiamoka kwa mambia. Omogwekano bw’amang’ana ayio tana koba korwa kare, gose takoba nonya ng’ake ase ebigori bigochi‐gocha.

Bosio bwabo omorero nigo ogosamba, na magega yabo chimeme chi’omorero nigo chigosamba boigo. Bosio bwabo ense eyio yarenge buna omogondo o Edeni, korende magega yabo ekaba buna erooro yatigaire bosa, korwa ase chingige echio onde tari oratame atooreke.
Okororekana kwabo nigo konga buna ogwe chibarasi; nigo chikominyoka buna chibarasi chi’okorwana esegi.

Ekero chigoeta igoro ase ebitunwa, ebititiro biabo nigo binga buna ebie chigari, naende nigo binga buna ogotoreka kw’omorero ogosamba amasakwe; chirochio nigo chire buna abarwani esegi bare ne chinguru baroberigwe.
Ekero abanto bagochirora nigo bagoichana, amaiso ’abanto bonsi nigo akoonchoka arachoka.

Nigo chikominyoka gochia korwana esegi buna abarwani esegi chituoni; nigo chikoriina chindwaki igoro buna abarwani esegi. Kera eyemo nigo eragenderere gochia bosio, ende teri eragobere esire enchera ebwatetie.
Tichikomigererania, kera eyemo nigo egoeta omong’ororia oye; nigo chigoeta gati‐gati y’ebirwanero, tichigotangeka.
Nigo chikorindokera omochie, na kominyoka ase chindwaki igoro; nigo chikoriina ase chinyomba chisoa ime na chietera ase chitirisa buna abaibi.
Ense netengeche bosio bwabo, na igoro nchinyegerigwe. Erioba na omotienyi nabibekwe omosunte; ne ching’enang’eni tichikobara.

Eriogi ri’Omonene ndiigugwe bosio bw’omoganda oye bw’esegi, ekiagera omoganda oye bw’esegi nigo ore omonene mono; echio chigoikerania amang’ana aye, nigo chire ne chinguru. Rituko ri’Omonene nigo rire rinene na eri’okoirokia. Ning’o oranyare koriremereria?
Omonene otebire, “Nonya mbono ng’iranere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, ase okweng’ata, na okorera, na okweng’ereria.

Tandora chinkoro chiaino ase ogweitia, gose tari ogotandora chianga chiaino.” Irana gochia ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekiagera ere nomuya na omonyamabera; ere tari omwango ase okoba nendamwamu; obwanchani bwaye nobwa botambe, nigo akoonchoka otiga kobarentera amabe.
Ning’o omanyete, ande gose Omonene naonchoke atige kobarentera amabe, korende abatigere ogosesenigwa, erinde moruere Omonene, Nyasae oino, okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa?
Bugia egetureri ase Sayoni; raria engaki y’okweng’ata ogochenu, rangeria omosangererekano bw’ogosasima!
Sangereria abanto amo, ochene omosangererekano oyio; sangereria abagaaka, sangereria nabana, nonya nabakogonka. Tiga omonyuomi asoke korwa mwaye, na omoriakari korwa eero mwaye.

Abakuani abwo bakomokorera Omonene tiga barere ase egati y’egesona na egesasimero, bakwane iga, “Aye Omonene, rorera abanto bao amabera; totiga abanto abwo bare omwando oo bachecherigwe, bakwanwe bobe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku. Nase ki abanto baraborie: Ng’ai Nyasae obo are”?
Erio Omonene akaba ne risemi ase engencho y’ense yaye, akarorera abanto baye amabeebe.
Omonene akairaneria abanto baye, akabatebia, “Rora, nkobatomera nde endagera, na edivai, na amaguta, na inwe namoisaneke; tinkobatiga mogenderere gochaywa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku.

Ninserie omoganda okorwa sugusu orue asemore, obeere are, ninyoserie ogende ase ense enyomo ere bosa, ensemo etang’aine egende gochia ase Enyancha ya Moocha, na ensemo ekorwa nyuma egende gochia ase Enyancha ya Bosongo. Ogotioka kw’obogundo bwaye nkoimokerere igoro, ekiagera okorire ayare amanene mono.”
“Aye ense, toiroka! Aye orogongo, goka na gochenga, ekiagera Omonene okorire ayare amanene.
Inwe ching’iti chi’orosana, timoiroka, ekiagera amarisio are ase erooro amerire obonyansi; emete yamire amatunda, emeko na emesabibu yamire okwama kwabo okonene.”
“Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, goka, mochenge ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekiagera obaeire embura entang’ani ebaisaine; nere okobatweria embura botambe, eye ritang’ani na ey’okwamia endagera.
Ebiooreri bikoorerwa mbiichorwe ne chindagera; na ebimitero mbiichore nedivai na amaguta goika biiteke.
Nimbairanerie ebi’emiaka eria biasaretigwe ne chinyanchaba, ne chingige, na ebisase, ne chingeeti, omoganda oyio omonene natomete gocha ase egati yaino.
Monyore endagera enyinge mokoria moigote, erio motogie erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyio obakoreire amakumia. Abanto baane tibagochaywa naende.
Erio namomanye ng’a inche nigo inde ase egati y’Abaisraeli, naende ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, naende Nyasae onde omoao tari. Abanto baane tibagochaywa naende.”
“Nebe ase amatuko agochi‐gocha, nimbaiterere abanto bonsi Omoika one; abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, inababane, na abagaaka baino nabarote chindoto, na abamura baino nabarore amaroro.
Naboigo ase amatuko ayio nimbaiterere abasomba baane, abasacha na abakungu, Omoika one.
“Ning’orokie ebikone igoro na ase ense; amanyinga, na omorero, ne rikundesi ri’erioki.
Erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi nobe amanyiga, ekero rituko riria ri’Omonene, erire rinene, na eri’okoondokia, ritaracha.

Naende nebe ng’a kera oyorarangerie erieta ri’Omonene natoorigwe, ekiagera ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ime ya Yerusalemu, mbabe aroro abanto baratooreke, buna Omonene atebire, na ase egati y’abwo baratigare nigo barabe abwo Omonene arangeirie.”
“Rora, ase amatuko ayio, na ase engaki eyio, inche Omonene ning’iranerie Abayuda, na abanto ba Yerusalemu, bare ase obosomba, amaya abo.

Ninsangererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, mbatirimbokie gochia ase Rikura ria Yehosafati; aroro agwo nimbanachere ekina, ekiagera mbasiarerete Abaisraeli, abwo bare omwando one, gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, naende baatananire ense yane.
Baakeire abanto baane obomera, baoonirie abana abamura, erinde banyore abakungu abatayayi, na baoonirie abana abaiseke, erinde banyore edivai bakonywa.

“Inwe Turo na Sidoni, ne chingongo chionsi chi’Abafilisti, ngento ki mogonkorera? Inee! Nigo moganetie kong’iraneria egento? Moise korusia egesiomba igoro yane, nimbairanerie ogokora kwaino kobe igoro yaino bwango mono.
Inwe mwaimokirie chifeta ne chitahabu chiane, na mwairire ebinto biane ebiya bingwenerete gochia ase chihekalu chiaino.
Mwarusirie Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu korwa ase chingongo chiabo, mwabaoonirie ase Abagiriki.
Korende bono nimbarangerie barue aase aria mwabaoonetie gochia, erinde mbairanerie inwe ogokora kwaino kobe igoro yaino.
Inche Omonene, ning’oonie abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, ase Abayuda, na barabwo babaoonie ase abanto ba Seba, abwo bamenyete aare mono. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.”
Raria amang’ana aya ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku: Ebeke ang’e ase esegi! Seegeta abarwani chituoni! Tiga abarwani bonsi bachiche ang’e bachake esegi.
Tura amakombe aino abe emioro, na emeyio yaino chinkuro ebe amatimo! Tiga oyore omworo atebe, “Nainche nigo inde etuoni.”
Inwe abanto b’ebisaku momenyete ase chinsemo chionsi, ayerera bwango mooche, sangererekana amo. Aye Omonene, renta abarwani bao b’esegi bare chituoni!
“Tiga abanto b’ebisaku baseegetane, bache ase Rikura ria Yehosafati. “Aroro agwo nao ndanachere abanto b’ebisaku bionsi babaetanaine ekina.
Soyia emeyio chinkuro mogondo, mogese, ekiagera rigesa riaikire. Soa ime motindache, ekiagera ekemitero ki’edivai kiaichoire. Chinyongo chiaichoire na goiteka, ekiagera obobe bwabo bwabeire obonene.”
Emeganda na emeganda nigo ere ase Rikura ri’Ekina, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene ng’ang’e rire agwo ase Rikura ri’Ekina.
Erioba na omotienyi mbibekwe omosunte, ne ching’enang’eni tichikobara.
Omonene narume korwa Sayoni, aake eriogi riaye korwa Yerusalemu; igoro na ense nchitengechigwe. Korende Omonene nabe obotamero bw’abanto baye, na eburi enkong’u y’Abaisraeli.
“Erio namomanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, imenyete Sayoni, egetunwa kiane egechenu. Yerusalemu nobe omochie omochenu, na abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni tibagosoa aroro nonya ng’ake.

“Ase rituko erio ebitunwa mbitonyie edivai enyansu, na ebigoro mbiichore amabeere, ne chindooche chionsi chi’Abayuda nachiichorwe namache. Ensoko netuboke korwa ase enyomba y’Omonene, enyiyie ense omweya ya Sitimu.
“Ense ya Misiri nesarigwe ebe bosa, na Edomu nero nebe erooro ere bosa, ekiagera abanto b’aroro mbakorerete Abayuda amabe; nigo baiterete ase ense yabo amanyinga ’abanto batarenge na komocha.
Korende ense y’Abayuda nemenywe kare na kare, na Yerusalemu boigo, ekiaare ase ekiaare.
Ninsibie okomocha kwabo kw’ogoitera amanyinga, okwo ntasibetie ritang’ani. Inche Omonene nigo ngendererete komenya Sayoni.”

Aya naro amang’ana Amosi, oyomo bw’abarisia ba Tekoa, aroche. Ase amaroro nigo orogetigwe amang’ana ayio igoro y’Abaisraeli miaka ebere ekero omotengecho bw’ense konya otaracha. Ekero ekio Usia nere orenge omoruoti bw’Abayuda, na Yeroboamu, mosinto o Yehoasi, nere orenge omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
Amosi agateba, “Omonene natogonye korwa Sayoni, aake eriogi riaye korwa Yerusalemu. Amarisio ’abarisia naichane, obonyansi bw’egetunwa gia Karimeli igoro mbwome.”
Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Damesiki ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora, ekiagera barabwo baoorire Abagileadi nebioorero bi’ebioma.
Ase ayio nintome omorero ase enyomba ya Hasaeli; oro nosambe osirie kegima chinyomba chinkong’u chia Beni‐Hadadi.

Nimbune emekorogoto y’ebiita bia Damesiki; ninsirie abanto bamenyete ase ense omweya y’Aveni, na oyio obwate enyimbo y’omogambi agwo Beti‐Edeni. Abanto ba Siiria mbairwe ase obosomba gochia ase ense ya Kiri.” Nabo Omonene atebire.

Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Gasa ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo bairete abanto egesaku ekegima gochia ase ense ya Edomu, bakabakora abasomba.
Ase ayio nintome omorero ase chindwaki chia Gasa; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chi’aroro.

Ninsirie abanto bamenyete Asidodi, na oyo obwate enyimbo y’obogambi agwo Asikeloni. Ning’onchore okoboko kwane kobe mamincha ya Ekironi, na abatigari b’Abafilisti mbasirigwe.” Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.

Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Turo ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo bairete abanto egesaku ekegima ase ense ya Edomu, tibainyorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’obomwabo.
Ase ayio nintome omorero ase chindwaki chia Turo; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chi’aroro.”

Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Edomu ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo babwatetie abamwabo bare nemioro, tibabete namabera nonya ng’ake; nigo bagendererete koba nendamwamu na ekeririanda botambe.
Ase ayio nintome omorero ase omochie o Temani; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chia Bosira.”

Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’Abaamoni ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo boorete abakungu ba Gileadi barenge barito, ekero barenge kogareyia orogongo rwabo.
Ase ayio nintongie omorero ase chindwaki chia Raba; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chi’aroro. Ase rituko erio ebikuuro bi’esegi mbiigugwe, boigo ndibe rituko ri’omwaga na ekembugu‐mbugu.
Omoruoti amo nabagambi b’oboruoti bwaye mbooswe bairwe ase obosomba.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Moabu ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo basambete amauga ’omoruoti o Edomu akaba ribu.
Ase ayio nintome omorero ase ense ya Moabu; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chia Kerioti. Abamoabu mbakwe ase ebikuuro bi’esegi, na ase eriogi ri’ebitureri bi’esegi.
Ninsirie omogambi ebina korwa ase egati yabo, nimoite amo nabagambi b’aroro.” Nabo Omonene atebire.

Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’Abayuda ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo bachayete amachiko ’Omonene, gose tibabwatete emeroberio yaye echikire, korende amang’ana ’obong’ainereria bwabo, ayio chisokoro chiabo chiarenge kobwatia abasiririe.
Ase ayio nintome omorero ase ense y’Abayuda; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chia Yerusalemu.”

Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’Abaisraeli ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo baoonetie omonyene oboronge ase rigori ri’efeta, na omotaka bakamoonia ase rigori ri’ebikoroto bibere.

Abanto abwo nigo bagotiringera emetwe y’abataka ase orotu rw’ense, naende nigo bagokorekania amang’ana ’omonto omoitongo. Omomura na ise nigo bagokora obonyaka nomoiseke oyomo, na igo bakora erieta riane riaba eritachenegeti.
Mbarabare ase kera egesasimero barabwo nigo bakorara inse igoro ye chianga chikobekwa kebwaterero. Ase enyomba y’enyasae yabo banywa edivai y’abwo bagambetigwe bakarusigwa chibesa.

“Korende ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, inche Omonene ngasiria Abaamori abwo barenge abatambe buna emecharake, naende abakong’u buna omote onga buna omotontera. Nigo nasiretie amatunda abo, ngasimora nemeri yabo yonsi.
Ninche nabarusetie inwe korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erio nkabaraa ase erooro ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, na inwe mokaira ense y’Abaamori ekaba eyaino.
Erio ngachora abana baino bande bakaba ababani, na abamura bande nkabaatanana bakaba Aberwa baane. Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, amang’ana ayio tari bo are?” Nabo Omonene atebire.
“Korende inwe mokaa Aberwa abwo beritete edivai bakanywa, mogakania ababani tibabana.
Rora nimbaritoere gochia inse buna egari eichire chigurube ekoritoerwa.
Ekero ekio abanto bamanyete kominyoka chimbero, mbasinywe gotama, na abwo bare ne chinguru, mbaborwe chinguru, na abarwani esegi bare chituoni, tibagotooria obogima bwabo.
Omonto omanyete koruta chinsara, tagotenena arwane, gose oyomanyete kominyoka chimbero, tagwetooria, na omoriini ebarasi tagwetooria.
Ase rituko erio omonto ore omoremu mono ase egati y’abarwani chituoni, natame ore getirianda.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe amang’ana aya Omonene akwanire igoro yaino, ee, igoro y’egesaku eke gionsi narusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri:
“Ninwe mweka imanyete ase chiamate chionsi chi’ense. Ase ayio nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biaino bionsi.”
Inee! Abanto babere mbataarere amo onye tibabwataini?
Inee! Endo nerume ase rinani, onye teraita eke yare gotwara? Gose endo ensae nkoruma ere, onye terabwata kende ekoria?
Inee! Enyoni nebwatwe onye tetegeiri obosugunia? Gose omoeto notegoke onye tobwateti gento?
Inee! Egetureri gi’esegi nkebugigwe ase omochie, na abanto tibaba nobwoba? Amang’ana amabe nabe ase omochie, Omonene atayatometi?
Ekeene, Omonene Nyasae tagokora ring’ana rinde rionsi ritang’ani ataramaanora obobisi bwaye ase abasomba baye ababani.
Endo koyarumire, monto ki otari kwoboa? Omonene Nyasae gakwanire, ning’o otari koraria obobani obwo?

Raria amang’ana ayio ase chinyomba chinkong’u chi’Asidodi, na echi’ense ya Misiri, motebie abanto bare aroro: “Inchuo, mosangererekane amo igoro ase ebitunwa bia Samaria, morore eburu‐buru ere aroro, na buna abanto bachandire.”
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Abanto abwo tibamanyeti gokora ayare amaya. Nigo bagachete ebinto bi’obouri na ebi’oboibi ase chinyomba chiabo chinkong’u.”
Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Ababisa mbanaarie ense eye, baiyerie chindwaki chiaino inse, echio mwekengerete, ne chinyomba chiaino chinkong’u chisakorwe.”

Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Buna koreng’ana omorisia agotaboria korwa ase omonwa bw’endo amauga ’amagoro abere, gose egetabo ki’ogoto, naboigo n’Abaisraeli barataborigwe, abwo bamenyete Samaria baikaransete ase ebirogo ebiororo na ase emeito etubire nebitambaa bi’ariri.”
Omonene Nyasae, oyore Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nigo agoteba iga: “Tegerera moigwe amang’ana aya, erio moyararie ase ororeria rwa Yakobo.

Ase rituko erio ndarue egesusuro ase Abaisraeli ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, ninsarie na gotagora ebisasimero bia Beteli; nintagore na koiyeria inse emegwekano ye chingunchara ere ase ebisasimero biria.

Nintagore chinyomba ase mokobeera ekero ki’obokendu amo nechio mokobeera ekero ki’egurugura; boigo ninsarie chinyomba chichabeire amaino e chinchogu, ne chinyomba chinene nchisirigwe kegima.” Nabo Omonene atebire.

Igwa ring’ana eri inwe chiombe chia Basani, inwe abamomenyete ase Egetunwa gia Samaria, inwe abamochandete abataka na gokorera abaremeire bobe, inwe abamogotebia abasacha baino: “Torentere egento tonywe!”
Ase ayio Omonene Nyasae otianire ase obochenu bwaye, ogoteba: “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, ababisa baino barabang’use nebigobanio babarusie aiga, na abatigari baino bang’uswe ne chindobio.
Nigo moraeterigwe ase chinyasi chibochogete, kera omokungu oyomo ase oyomo, morutwe ase Harimoni.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
“Inchuo Beteli, mokorere ebibe aroro; boigo inchuo Giligali, momente gokora ebibe aroro. Kera emambia mobe mokorenta ebing’wanso biaino; na ase kera rituko ria gatato morente ensemo yaino ya ikomi.

Mosambe emegati ebekire ememera ebe okoruegwa gw’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, mochike na koraria igoro y’okoruegwa kwaino kw’ogwancha, ekiagera ayio naro inwe Abaisraeli mwanchete gokora.” Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
“Inche tinabaete gento kende mogotakuna ase emechie yaino yonsi, na endagera ekabora aase aino onsi. Korende nonya naboigo timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.

“Ekero emetienyi etato konya yatigaire endagera yame ngatanga embura tiyatwa. Nigo narenge gotoma embura yatwa ase omochie oyomo, korende nayetanga tegotwa ase emechie ende; nigo narenge koyerenta yatwa ase omogondo oyomo, korende nayetanga ase emegondo ende, ero yaba ekwoma.

Ekero ekio abanto b’emechie ebere, gose etato, bakaba bakona‐goetanana gochia ase omochie oyomo korigia amache banywe, korende tibanyora ayakobaisana. Nonya naboigo timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.

“Nkabarentera oborwaire bw’enyagetabo, na obw’okorigisia chindagera chiaino; emegondo yaino emenge, amo ney’emesabibu, na emeko yaino, na emezeituni yaino ekariegwa ne chingige. Korende nonya naboigo, timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.

“Nigo nabarenterete amaakwa anga buna aria narentete Misiri; naende ngaita abamura baino nemioro; nkabaura chibarasi chiaino, nkabatiokeria obogundo bw’abanto baino baitetwe, agwo ase ebitwori biaino. Korende nonya naboigo timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.

“Ngasiria abanto bande baino, buna inche Nyasae nasiretie Sodomu na Gomora, na inwe nigo mwarenge buna ekegenga giataboretigwe korwa riko. Korende nonya nabo, timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
“Inwe Abaisraeli, amang’ana ayio naro ndabakorere. Ase ayio, ekiagera ngocha kobakorera ayio, ebeke ang’e, moumerane nainche Nyasae oino.”

Rora, oria otongete ebitunwa na embeo, oria okoorokeria mwanyabanto ebirengererio biabo bamanya buna bire, oria okoonchora emambia yaba omosunte, oria ogoeta otacha ebitunwa bi’ense, Omonene Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nario erieta riaye.
Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa amang’ana ’okorera kwane gw’okobokia amagombo ase engencho yaino:
“Abaisraeli banga buna omoiseke omwekungi bagure, tibakonyara koboka naende; batigirwe bagwete ase ense yabo, monto onde tari orabagororokie batenene.”
Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Omochie bw’Abaisraeli otomete abarwani esegi elifu eyemo, bono nigo otigarete ne rigana erimo, na oyotomete rigana erimo, bono nigo otigarete na ikomi.”
Aya naro Omonene agotebia Abaisraeli: “Ndigie inche, erio nario morabe moyo.
Korende timogenda Beteli, gose timosoa Giligali, gose timogenda goika Beeri‐Seba, ekiagera abanto ba Giligali mbairwe ase obosomba, na Beteli nosirigwe kegima.”
Morigie Omonene, nario morabe moyo; motakoreti bo, Omonene nigo arachere ororeria rwa Yusufu arosirie buna omorero ogosiria, na onde tari orayorimie atoorie Beteli.
Inwe nigo mokoonchorana ayare amaronge aba ay’obororo, na mwatuguta oboronge inse ase riroba.

Oria otongete egetuse gie ching’enang’eni chiria isano na ibere, na ekio gekorokwa Orioni, oria okoonchora omosunte ekerima oba emambia, naende oonchora omobaso oba obotuko, oria okorangeria amache ’enyancha oyaumora igoro ase ense, Omonene, nario erieta riaye.
Ere nigo akorenta ogosiria kwa mobosokano ase abwo bare ne chinguru, boigo nagere ogosareka gochere chiburi chinkong’u.
Abanto nigo bagechete oria okorwanerera ekeene agwo ase ekegambero kere geita, na bagechigwa noyo ogokwana ay’ekeene.

Ase ayio, buna koreng’ana mwatindacheire abataka inse na kobaura engano yabo ebe ebango, nebe ekero moraagache chinyomba chi’amagena abaachire, timogochimenya, na ekero morasimeke emesabibu ase emegondo emiya, timokonywa edivai yaye.

Inche nimanyete ogosaria kwaino ng’a nokonene na ebibe biaino ng’a nebinene mono. Nigo mogochanda omonyaboronge, boigo mokoegwa riaaki, erio mwaseria abataka korwa ase ekegambero kere geita tibakonyora oboronge bwabo.
Ase engencho eyio, omonto ore omong’aini nakire‐kiri ase engaki buna eyio, ekiagera eyio nengaki embe.
Rigia ayare amaya, na tari ayare amabe, erio nario morabe moyo. Komorakore bo, Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nabe amo nainwe, buna inwe mwatebire.
Gecha ayare amabe, na mwanche ayare amaya. Motenenere oboronge agwo ase ekegambero kere geita. Komorakore bo, ande nabo Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ararorere abatigari ba Yusufu amabera.

Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, oyore Omonene, atebire: “Ebirero mbibe ase chiraaro chionsi chi’omochie, na ase chinchera chiaye chionsi abanto barere bakobuga: Obee! Obee! Mbarangerie abaremi bache korera, na abamanyete kobokia amagombo bache kweng’ereria.
Ebirero mbibe ase emegondo yonsi y’emesabibu. Ayio onsi nigo arabe, ekiagera inche Omonene ning’ete ase egati yaino mbaite.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
Obobe nobwaino inwe abamoganetie rituko ri’Omonene riike! Nase ki moganetie rituko riria ri’Omonene? Rituko erio nigo rirabe eri’omosunte, gose tirikoba eri’omobaso.
Nigo erabe buna ekero omonto agotama korwa ase endo, aumerane nedubu, gose ekero agosoa mwaye atoorera okoboko kwaye ase enyasi, na eng’iti emorome.
Rituko riria ri’Omonene nigo rirabe eri’omosunte, tirikoba eri’oborabu, ee, neri’omosunte ekerima, na omobaso tokobara nonya ng’ake.
“Inche nigo ngechete na gochaya Amatuko aino Amanene. Tingokiri nemesangererekano yaino y’ogosasima.

Namoisa kondetera ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, tinkobianchera; na tingwancha nonya nokorigereria ndigererie ching’iti chiaino chinoru chikoruegwa chibe ebing’wanso bi’omorembe.
Rusia korwa asende okwoga kwaino kw’amatera, tingwancha ntegerere amariogi ’amakano aino.
Korende tiga ekeene kegenderere buna amache amange, na oboronge bobe buna orooche amache aye atari koera nonya ng’ake.
“Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene mwarenge ase erooro, mwandeterete ebing’wanso amo nokoruegwa konde?
Inwe mobogorie Sikuti, omogwekano oyio mogosasima buna omoruoti oino, na Kiyuni, enyasae yaino ye ching’enang’eni mweroiseretie.
Ase engencho eyio inche nimbaire ase obosomba ase ense ere ng’umbu ya Damesiki.” Nabo Omonene atebire. Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nario erieta riaye.
Obobe nobwabo abwo bamenyete buya agwo Sayoni, na abwo batoererete ase ebitunwa bia Samaria, abwo bare abasike b’egesaku egetang’ani, eki Abaisraeli bagochiera.

Genda goika Kaline, moyorore, naende mogende goika Hamati, oyio ore omochie omonene, naende motirimboke gochia Gati bw’Abafilisti. Inee! Barabwo nigo bare buya kobua abanto b’amaruoti aya are aiga? Gose chingongo chiabo nechinene kobua orogongo rwaino?
Obobe nobwaino, inwe abamogoteba ng’a rituko ri’obobe ng’are rire, na mwanchera ogokora okobe kw’obotindi kobeera ase egati yaino.

Obobe nobwaino inwe aba mokorarera amarere achabeire amaino e chinchogu, naende mwaba mokwerambora ase ebirogo biaino bigwotota. Nigo mokoba mokoria chimanwa chie ching’ondi chichorire, ne chimori chinoru korwa ase ameeri.
Inwe nigo mogotera amatera ay’okwoga, na mweroiseria amakano ao ao, aya mokobugia, buna Daudi akorete.
Nigo mokonywa edivai korwa ase ebitaabo ebinene, naende mweaka amaguta e rigori rinene, korende timoichanereti ogosirigwa kw’ororeria rwa Yusufu.
Ase ayio, inwe mobe abe ritang’ani koirwa ase obosomba, na emegoko y’emeyega yaino neere.

Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nigo agoteba iga: “Inche Omonene netianirie ngoteba: Nigo ngechirie noboenenu bw’abanto ba Yakobo, na nigo ngechete chinyomba chiabo chinkong’u. Ase ayio nintige omochie osirigwe amo nebinto bionsi bireo.”
Nebe ng’a onye abasacha ikomi batigaire ase enyomba eyemo, nabarabwo goika bakwe.

Omoamate bw’omonto oyio okure nache kobogoria amauga amo noyo ogochia koyasamba. Omoamate oria narangerie onde bwensi otigarete ase enyomba eria ime, amoborie, “Onde nare aa motigarete komo?” Omonto oria nairanerie, akane, “Yaya.” Erio omoamate oria namotebie “Kira‐kiri! Twerende titobaisa gwatora erieta ri’Omonene.”
Ase ayio rora, Omonene narue ogochika ng’a chinyomba chire chinene na echire chinke chiiyerigwe inse chisamunyokane.

Inee! Chibarasi nchinyare kominyoka igoro ase egetare? Gose omonto nanyare korema egetare ne chiombe? Korende inwe mwaonchoire ayare ay’oboronge abeire obosongo, na okwama kw’oboronge kwabeire obororo buna chinkama.
Inwe nigo mokogokera egento kere bosa, mogoteba, “Inee! Titwenyorerete chingunchara goetera ase chinguru chiaito abanyene?”

Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, agoteba: “Inwe Abaisraeli rora, nimbarentere abanto b’egesaku gete; barabwo mbabachande gochakera ase egesoero kia Hamati goikera ase akarooche g’Ekerubo Ekiomo.”
Aya naro Omonene Nyasae anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkamorora ogotonga chingige ekero obonyansi bwachagete goseboka; okwo nogoseboka gwa kabere ekero obonyansi bw’omoruoti konya bwagekirwe.

Ekero chingige chiria chiakoorire koria ebimeri bionsi bi’ense, inche ngasaba, ngateba, “Aye Omonene Nyasae, nagosoroire bwabere! Naki abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo baranyare koba moyo, ekero bare abake iga?”
Ase ayio, Omonene akaonchora ebirengererio biaye, agateba, “Ayio bono takoba bo.”
Aya naro Omonene anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkarora Omonene Nyasae ogocha korua egesusuro goetera ase omorero; omorero oyio ogasamba chindiba chinene, naende ogachaka gosamba nense ekoremwa.
Erio nkamotebia, “Aye Omonene Nyasae, nagosoroire, tiga tobaisa gokora ayio. Naki abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo baranyare koba moyo ekero bare abake iga?”
Erio Omonene Nyasae akaonchora ebirengererio biaye, agateba, “Naya boigo takoba bo.”
Aya naro Omonene anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkamorora oteneine igoro y’orwaki rwaagachetwe ase okorengwa nekebiro, na ase okoboko kwaye nabwate ekebiro.
Omonene akamboria, “Amosi, ngento ki eke oroche?” Nkamoiraneria, nkamotebia, “Eke nekebiro.” Erio Omonene agantebia, “Rora, nindenge abanto baane Abaisraeli nekebiro eke. Tinkobaetania nonya ng’ake.
Aase aimokererete igoro, ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Isaka bagosasimera bosa, na aase ande onsi Abaisraeli bagosasimera natagorwe abe bosa. Ning’ite abanto b’enyomba ya Yeroboamu nemioro.”

Erio Amasia, omokuani o Beteli, agatoma amang’ana ase Yeroboamu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, komotebia, “Amosi oseegetire Abaisraeli bonsi babe mamincha yao; na ense eye tekonyara koremereria amang’ana aye onsi.
Amang’ana aya naro akwanire: Yeroboamu naitwe nemioro, na Abaisraeli mbarusigwe ase ense yabo bairwe ase obosomba.”
Naende Amasia agatebia Amosi, “Aye omorori, tama ogende ase ense y’Abayuda; aroro agwo nonyore endagera okoria, na obe gokobanera aroro.
Korende tobaisa kobanera aiga Beteli naende nonya ng’ake, ekiagera aiga naase aachenu a omoruoti, naende aa nao hekalu y’obogambi bwonsi.”
Erio Amosi akairaneria Amasia, akamotebia, “Inche tindi omobani, gose omwana bw’omobani bworokereretigwe obobani, nigo narenge omorisia, naende omorendi bw’emeko.
Korende Omonene akandusia korwa ase narenge korisia ching’ondi, agantebia: Genda obanere abanto baane Abaisraeli.
Ase ayio, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene. Aye nigo ogonkania ng’a timbaisa kobana mamincha y’Abaisraeli na tindandia mamincha y’ororeria rwa Isaka.

Ase ayio, aya naro amang’ana Omonene agoteba: Mokao nabe omotayayi, abe ogokora obonyaka ase omochie omonene, na abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, mbaitwe nemioro. Oboremo bwao mbwatananwe ase okorengwa nengori; aye omonyene nokwere ase ense etachenegeti. Abaisraeli goika barusigwe ase ense yabo, bairwe ase obosomba.”
Aya naro Omonene Nyasae anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkarora egetonga kere namatunda amatobu.

Omonene akamboria, “Amosi, ngento ki eke oroche?” Nkamoiraneria, nkamotebia, “Negetonga kere namatunda amatobu.” Erio Omonene agantebia, “Omoerio ocheire abanto baane Abaisraeli. Tinkobaetania nonya ng’ake.”

Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio amatera agoterwa ase chihekalu naonchoke abe okorera gw’okweumia. Emebere y’abanto bakwete nigo erabe emenge aande onsi; abanto nigo barabe bakoyetuguta bakirete‐kiri.”
Inwe aba mokourereria abaremeire na gosiria abataka bare ase ense, igwa amang’ana aya.

Inwe nigo mogoteba, “Ndiriri omoyega bw’Omotienyi Omoyia oraere, erinde toonie chimbusuro chiaito? Naende ndiriri Esabato eraere, erinde toonie engano? Erio toyerenge nekemunu egeke, na tokinie rigori ri’esekeli, naende tobe tokong’ainereria nebirengero bi’obourereria.
Boigo togore abataka ase rigori rie chifeta, na abaremerwa ase rigori ri’ebikoroto bibere, na toonie engano embe ere namakoyo buna eyere engiya.”
Omonene otianire ase Oyore Obonene bw’abanto ba Yakobo, ogoteba, “Ekeene, tinkweba ogokora kwabo nonya ng’ake.

Inee! Ense tegotengechigwa ase engencho eyio, na kera omonto omenyete imeo arere na kobokia amagombo. Ee, ense engima nenyegerigwe na koimokererigwa igoro buna orooche rwa Naili roichire, nigo egotwoma‐twomana, naende yairana inse, buna orooche roria rwa Misiri”
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio nintige erioba rigwe mobaso gati, na nindete omosunte ase ense ekero omobaso obarete.

Ning’onchore emeyega yaino ebe ebirero, na amatera aino abe okorera gw’okobokia amagombo. Nindete omoichano ase abanto bonsi, erio beboyie chigunia, na kera omonto akigite etukia y’omotwe oye. Mbatige mobe buna omonto okoreera omwana oye omomoima, na omoerio oye nobe rituko ri’obororo.”
Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, ndarente enchara ase ense, tari enchara y’endagera, gose tari erang’o y’amache, korende nenchara ye ringana ri’Omonene.
Abanto mbatayaye korwa ase enyancha goika ase enyancha ende, na korwa sugusu goika moocha; mbaminyoke gochia aaria na aaria, babe bakorigia ring’ana ri’Omonene, korende tibakorinyora.
Ase rituko erio abaiseke abekungi abanyabieni na abamura mbagoyane ase okoba nerang’o.

Abanto abwo bagotiana ase ebibe bi’Abasamaria, bagoteba: Aye Dani, ekeene, buna enyasae yao ere moyo, naende bateba: Ekeene, buna enchera egochia Beeri‐Seba egendererete kobao, abanto abwo goika bagwe, tibaboka rinde.”

Nkarora Omonene oteneine ang’e negesasimero, ere agateba, “Aka ebisure bie chisiiro goika emeriibo y’emetobwa y’egesieri inse etengeche; ebisure bibunanekane bigwere emetwe y’abanto bonsi. Abaratigare nimbaite nemioro. Onde tari oratame, gose oratooreke, nonya noyomo.
Nabaisa korema basoe inse agwo aase abakure, okoboko kwane nigo korabarusieo; nabaisa koriina baike igoro nimbatabokanie gochia inse aa.
Nabaisa kwebisa ase egechuria ki’egetunwa gia Karimeli, nimbarigie mbarusieo; nabaisa gosoa ase enkori y’enyancha inse bebise ng’a timbarora, aroro agwo ninchike eng’iti engenda inse ebarome.
Nabaisa koirwa ase obosomba nababisa babo, aroro agwo ninchike emioro ebaite. Nimbaonchorere amaiso aane mbakorere ayare amabe na tari ayare amaya.”

Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, karakune ense, ero nigo ekonyititoka, na ebitongwa bionsi bireo bibe bikorera. Ense engima neimokererigwe igoro, naende eiranigwe inse, buna orooche rwa Naili rore agwo Misiri.
Oria okoagacha chiero chiaye aaria igoro, na obeka obokumbe bwaye igoro y’ense na kobokong’ia, oria okorangeria amache ’enyancha, oyaumora igoro ase ense, Omonene nario erieta riaye.

“Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, timonga buna Abaetiopia asende? Inee! Tinabarusetie inwe Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri, na Abafilisti korwa ase ense ya Kafitori, na Abaasuri korwa Kiri?” Nabo Omonene atebire.

“Rora inche Omonene Nyasae nigo ndarigererie namaiso aane obogambi obwo bogokora ebibe. Nimbosirie borue ase obosio bw’ense, korende tingosiria kegima abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
“Naama! Ninchike ng’a Abaisraeli basongwe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, buna obori bogosongwa. Korende nonya nenyeke ensinini tekogwa inse.
Abanyabibe bonsi b’abanto baane, abwo bagoteba ng’a amabe takobanyora gose kobakorera kende, mbaitwe nemioro.
“Rituko ngochicha rire ekero ndatenenie esaiga eria ya Daudi yagwete, ning’agache naende aase agwo atagogete, ngororokie amatombe aye; ninyeagache naende, ebe buna yarenge agwo kare.
Abaisraeli mbaire ensemo entigari ya Edomu, boigo mbaire chinse chi’ebisaku ebio bikorokwa ase erieta riane.” Nabo Omonene, oyio orakore ayio, agoteba.

Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Rora amatuko ngocha are, ekero omoremi araikeere omogesi, na omomiti amasabibu araikeere omobusuri chimbusuro. Ebitunwa mbitonyie edivai enyansu, na ebigoro mbiichore edivai.

Ning’iranie abanto baane Abaisraeli korwa ase obosomba. Barabwo mbaagache naende emechie eyio yasiretigwe bamenyeo, mbasimeke emesabibu na konywa edivai yaye; boigo mbareme emegondo, basimeke chindagera na koria okwama kw’emegondo eyio.
Nimbairanie mbabeke bamenye ase ense yabo, tibagotegorwa korwa ase ense eyio nabaete.” Nabo Omonene, Nyasae oino, atebire.

Oko nokorora kw’Obadia. Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba igoro y’egesaku kia Edomu, ee, twaigure amang’ana korwa ase Omonene, na omotomwa otomirwe gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku, ogoteba: “Imoka, togende korwania Abaedomu esegi!”
“Rora, ningokore obe omoke ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, obe kogochaywa mono.
Oboenenu bw’enkoro yao bwakong’ainire, aye omenyete ime y’emienya y’ebitare; agwo ase omenyete aimokererete igoro. Nigo ogokwana ase enkoro yao ime, gweteba: Ning’o orang’iyerie gochia inse?”
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Noisa koagacha egeswa kiao aaria igoro buna ekeongo, ee, nokebeke ase egati‐gati ye ching’enang’eni, inche ninkoiyerie korwa aroro.”

“Abaibi gose abasakori baise kogochera botuko, aye nosirigwe kegima. Ekeene, nigo baraibe binde bionsi baganetie. Inee! Abasangereria b’amasabibu baare kogochera, tibarenge kogotigera nonya naria agotigara?
Naki abanto b’ororeria rwa Esau bakoriga‐rigigwa ne chinibo chiabo chibisire chiaorokigwe maiso marore!

Abanto baria bonsi kwabwatanete nabarabwo bagoseririe gochia ase orobebe, abanto baria gwakorete omorembe nabarabwo bakong’ainire na gokobua. Abasani bao mokoria komo bagotegeire oboreba, bagoteba: Ng’ai obong’aini bwao bore?”
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsirie abanto abang’aini ba Edomu, naende ninsirie okomanya gwonsi korwa ase Egetunwa gia Esau.
Inwe Abatemani, abarwani baino b’esegi bare chituoni mbaondoke, na kera oyomo ore ase Egetunwa gia Esau naitwe asirigwe kegima.”
“Ekiagera mwaureretie na goita abanto bamino b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, namosookigwe na gosirigwa goika kare na kare.
Inwe nigo mwatenenete ensemo ase rituko riria, ekero abanto b’ense engeni bairete chinibo chiabo, bagasoa ebiita bia Yerusalemu, bakayoakera obomera. Naboigo nainwe mwarenge buna barabwo.
Timobaisa kogoka ase rituko riria amabe arache ase abanto bamino. Gose timobaisa gochenga ase rituko ri’ogosirigwa kw’Abayuda, gose timobaisa gokwana noboenenu ase rituko ri’emechando yabo.

Inwe timosoa ase egeita ki’abanto baane ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo; gose timogokera emechando yabo ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo, gose timorambora amaboko aino koira chinibo chiabo ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo.
Inwe timobaisa gotenena ase amatabekania e chinchera goita abanto ba Edomu kobagotama, gose timobeka abatooregete babo bache gosirigwa ase rituko riria ri’emechando yabo.”
“Rituko ri’Omonene ng’ang’e rire gochera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi. Buna mwabeire mogokora, naboigo nainwe morakorerwe. Ogokora kwaino nkobairanere inwe abanyene.
Buna mwabeire mokonywera igoro ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, naboigo nabanto b’ebisaku bionsi baragenderere konywa botambe, ee, mbanywe bakoore nonya neturubo yonsi, na babe buna tibarengeo.”
“Korende ase egetunwa gia Sayoni mbabe aroro abaratooreke na aase agwo nabe aachenu. Abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo nabairanerigwe ense yabo.

Abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo mbabe omorero, na ab’enyomba ya Yusufu mbabe buna ekebemberi ki’omorero, na ab’enyomba ya Esau mbabe buna amasakwe amomo. Abanto ba Yakobo na aba Yusufu mbasambe abanto ba Esau babasirie. Onde tari oratigare ase enyomba yaye, ekiagera n’Omonene okwanire ayio.

Abanto b’ense ya Negebu mbaire Egetunwa gia Esau, na ab’ense omweya mbaire ense y’Abafilisti. Mbaire na ense y’Abaefraimu na ey’Abasamaria chibe echiabo; na abanto ba Benjamin mbaire Gileadi ebe eyabo.

Abarwani esegi b’Abaisraeli abwo bairetwe ase obosomba mbairane bamenye ase ense ya Kanani gochia ase omochie o Sarefata. Abanto ba Yerusalemu bairetwe ase obosomba, abwo bamenyete Sefaradi, mbaire emechie ya Negebu ebe eyabo.
Erio abatooria mbariine ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, bagambere Egetunwa gia Esau. Omonene omonyene nere orabe omoruoti.”
Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yona mosinto bw’Amitai, rikamotebia:
“Imoka ogende Nineva, omochie oria omonene, oake eriogi ri’okoyokurera, ekiagera ogokora kwaye okobe gwaikire ase obosio bwane.”

Korende Yona akaimoka, agatama gochia Tarisisi ng’a arue ase obosio bw’Omonene. Agatirimboka gochia Yopa, na agwo akanyora emeeri ekogenda Tarisisi. Erio agaakana chibesa chi’orogendo, agasoa ime, akagenda amo nabanto bande gotama gochia Tarisisi ng’a arue ase obosio bw’Omonene.
Korende Omonene akagusia omwaga omonene mono igoro ase enyancha, na ekembugu‐mbugu gie chinguru kegacha ase enyancha, na emeeri ekaba ang’e kobuneka.

Erio abagendia b’emeeri bakaondoka, na kera oyomo akarangeria enyasae yaye ng’a emokonye. Abanto abwo bakaimokia chigurube chiarenge ase emeeri ime, bagachituguta gochia ase enyancha ime, ng’a nario emeeri eragusue. Bono Yona ere konya otirimbokire gochia nyaro ime y’emeeri, na aroro nigo araire chitoro chinene mono.
Omochiki bw’emeeri akagenda asare akamoboria, “Naki oraire chitoro iga okirete‐kiri? Imoka orangerie Nyasae oo! Ande Nyasae oyio nabo arabaise gotorengereria atokonye titosira.”
Abanto baria bagatebania, “Tiga toake obomera tomanye gose ning’o ogerire amabe aya atocheire.” Erio bagaaka obomera, na obomera obwo bokagwera Yona.
Ase ayio abanto baria bakamoboria, “Totebie gose ning’o ogerire amabe aya atonyorire. Meremo ki ogokora aye? Ng’ai kwarure? Ense yao nereri? Ngesaku ki ore?”
Ere akabairaneria, “Inche n’Omoibirania inde, na nigo inyirogete Omonene, Nyasae o igoro, oyo otongete enyancha na ense enyomo.”

Erio abanto baria bakairoka mono, bakamoboria, “Mang’ana ki aya gwakorire?” Abanto baria nigo bamanyete ng’a Yona nigo arenge gotama korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera konya obatebirie amang’ana ayio.
Erio abanto baria bakamoboria, “Ngento ki tokogokorera, erinde enyancha etotoerere?” Ekembugu‐mbugu keria nigo kiagendererete kona‐koburukania enyancha mono goetania.
Ere akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Inyimokie, mondute ase enyancha ime; ero netoerere asemore, ekiagera namanyire ng’a ninche nagerire ekembugu‐mbugu kiabacheire.”
Nonya naboigo abanto baria bagateema ne chinguru gosukia emeeri eria gochia ase engegu, korende tibanyarete, ekiagera ekembugu‐mbugu keria nigo kiagendererete koburukania enyancha mono goetania.

Ase ayio abanto baria bakarera ase Omonene, bagateba, “Aye Omonene, twagosoroire, tototiga tosire ase engencho y’obogima bw’omonto oyo. Tobaisa gotobarera okomocha kw’ogokwa kw’omonto otari na komocha, ekiagera aye Omonene gwakorire buna bwanchete.”
Erio bakaimokia Yona, bakamoruta ase enyancha ime; ero ekaba nobotoereru.
Erio agwo abanto baria bakairoka Omonene mono, bakamoruera ekeng’wanso na komoriera chiira.
Bono Omonene agachika enswe enene ekamera Yona, na Yona akabeera ime ase enda y’enswe eria amatuko atato, omobaso na obotuko.
Ekero Yona arenge ime ase enda y’enswe eria, agasaba Omonene, Nyasae oye, agateba,
“Ekero narenge ase emechando, nigo nasabete Omonene, na ere akang’iraneria. Korwa ime ase enda y’aase abakure nigo narerete, aye Omonene okaigwa eriogi riane.
Aye nigo kwandutete gochia ase chindiba, inse kegima y’enyancha, ne chiooro chi’enyancha chiang’etananire. Na emerindo yao yonsi ekaimokerera igoro egantuba.
Ase ayio inche nkarengereria ng’a natugutirwe korwa ase obosio bwao, korende nindigererie naende gochia ase Hekalu yao Enchenu.
Nigo narimerete ase amache ime, na endiba ekang’etanana, enderema ya nyancha ekaranderera omotwe one.
Nigo narimerete ngaika inse kegima y’ebitunwa, ase ense eria emekorogoto yaye yansiekerete goika kare na kare. Nonya naboigo, aye Omonene, Nyasae one, nigo kwandusetie ase embeera inde moyo.
Ekero omoyo one ogiregete ime yane, nigo nakoinyorete aye Omonene, na ogosaba kwane gokagoikera agwo ase Hekalu yao Enchenu.
Abanto abwo bakoonchokera emegwekano egosasimwa ere bosa, abwo nigo bagweatanana korwa ase Oyore Amabera abo.
Korende inche nindue ekeng’wanso gi’okogoakera ng’a mbuya mono, eki nariete eira ng’a ninkerue, ing’ikeranie. Ogotooreka nigo gokorwa ase Omonene!”
Erio Omonene agakwana nenswe eria, akayechika; ero ekaroka Yona, ekamobeka ase engegu.
Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yona eria kabere, rikamotebia,
“Imoka ogende Nineva, omochie oria omonene, erio orarieo amang’ana ndagotebie.”
Ase ayio Yona akaimoka, akagenda Nineva buna Omonene amochigete. Omochie oria nigo orenge omonene mono, oisaine orogendo rw’amatuko atato ase okoyobutokania.
Yona agachaka goeta ase omochie oria, akaira rituko erimo, agaaka eriogi agateba, “Atigaire amatuko emerongo ene oka, erio Nineva oonchoranwe.”
Abanto ba Nineva bakegena amang’ana a Nyasae, bakararia okweng’ata, na abanto bonsi pi, korwa omonene goika omoke, bakeboyia chigunia.
Ekero amang’ana ayio aigete ase omoruoti, ere akaimoka korwa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, akarusia engobo yaye y’obonene, akeboyia chigunia, agaikaransa ase ribu igoro.

Erio amang’ana akararigwa ase Nineva bwonsi kobwatekana nogochika kw’omoruoti amo nabannene b’oboruoti bwaye, agateba: “Monto onde tabaisa koria kende; nonya neng’iti ende yonsi, gose eng’ombe, tichibaisa korisigwa, gose konyoisigwa.
Korende kera omonto eboyie egunia, ne ching’iti boigo chitubwe chigunia. Kera oyomo arere ne chinguru ase Nyasae aonchoke atige obobe bwaye na obourereria bore ase amaboko aye.
Ning’o omanyete, ande nabo Nyasae arabaise koonchora ebirengererio biaye, erinde atige endamwamu yaye entindi, intwe titosirigwa.”
Ekero Nyasae aroche aya bakorete, buna baonchogete bagatiga ogokora kwabo kw’ebibe, ere akaonchora ebirengererio biaye, tabakorera aria konya atebire ng’a abakorere.
Yona akagechigwa namang’ana ayio, akaba nendamwamu.

Erio agasaba Omonene, agateba, “Aye Omonene, Inee, amang’ana aya tari aro natebete ekero narenge ase ense yane? Naende nakio kiagerete ngatama gochia Tarisisi, ekiagera nigo namanyete ng’a aye nigo ore Nyasae oichire nobuya na amabera; tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, na obwanchani bwao obonene nigo bogendererete botambe, naende nigo okoonchora ebirengererio biao, tokobakorera amabe.
Ase ayio, aye Omonene, bono nagosoroire ng’a orusieo obogima bwane ontige inkwe, ekiagera nigo ere buya asende gokwa kobua kogenderera koba moyo.”
Erio Omonene akamoboria, “Inee! Igo mboronge ogokora ase okogechigwa igo?”
Bono Yona agasoka korwa ase omochie oria, agaikaransa ase ensemo ya moocha y’omochie. Agwo akeagachera ekegutu, agaikaransa imeo gokenderera koganya arore ayare gochia gokorekana ase omochie oria.
Erio Omonene Nyasae akameria omobono ogakina, na Yona agakenderera inse yaye, agatimoka korwa ase okorosa kwaye. Ase ayio akagokigwa mono nomobono oria.
Korende rituko ria kabere mambia, Nyasae agachika rikonde rikaria omobono oria, erinde ogasusana.

Ekero erioba riatiirire gocha igoro, Nyasae akarenta omwaga okagusa korwa moocha orenge nomobaso omororo se, na omobaso oria ogasamba Yona bobe ase omotwe goika akagireka. Erio akagania akwe, agateba, “Nigo ere buya asende gokwa kobua kogenderera koba moyo.”
Korende Nyasae akaboria Yona, “Inee! Mboronge igo aye okogechigwa ase engencho y’omobono oyio?” Yona akairaneria, akamotebia, “Ee, nigo inde noboronge kogechigwa, nonya ngoika ogokwa.”
Omonene akamotebia, “Aye kwaroreire omobono oyo amabera, nonya tikwaywechanderete ase ogokora emeremo asoro, gose ase okoyokinia; nigo omerete ase obotuko obomo, naende ogasira ase obotuko obomo.

Inee! Inche tingwenereti koba namabeebe ase Nineva, omochie oyio omonene, agwo ase abanto goetania chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere (120,000) bamenyeteo? Abanto abwo tibamanyete gwatanana ayare ensemo ya borio na ayare ase eya bomosi. Boigo omochie oyio nobwate ching’iti chinyinge mono chitugireo.”

Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riachete ase Mika, oyo omenyete agwo Moreseti, ekero Yotamu, na Ahasi, na Hezekia, barenge abaruoti b’Abayuda. Omonene akamomaanorera ayare gochia koba igoro ya Samaria na Yerusalemu.
Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, igwa amang’ana aya! Aye ense na ebinto bionsi bireo, tegerera moigwe amang’ana aya! Omonene Nyasae, oyore ase Hekalu yaye enchenu, tiga abe kirori igoro yaino.
Rora, Omonene ngosoka are korwa aase aye; ere ngoika are gocha aa, atache ebitunwa bi’ense.
Ebitunwa ebio mbinyititoke inse yaye, na amagoko nabwereke, binyititoke buna obochoe bokonyititoka ase omorero, na bibe buna amache akoba ekero aumoirwe ase egetirimboko.

Ayio nigo arabe ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Yakobo, na ebibe b’Abaisraeli. Inee! Ogosaria okwo kore ase abanto ba Yakobo nkoroki? Tari okwo gwa Samaria? Na ogosaria okwo kw’ogosasimera aase aimokererete igoro kore ase Abayuda nkoroki? Tari okwo kwa Yerusalemu?
“Ase ayio nintagore Samaria obe chitui chi’amagena, obe omogondo ase emesabibu erasimekwe. Ninturunkanie amagena ’omochie oyio gochia ase rigoko, nintubore amaroso aye atigwe maiso marore.

Emegwekano yaye yonsi egosasimwa nesamunyoranwe; ebiegwa bionsi biaruetwe ase obonyaka mbisambwe nomorero. Ninsirie emegwekano yaye yonsi egosasimwa, ekiagera ebinto ebio nebiegwa biaruetwe ase obonyaka, ebio mbiiranigwe bibe ebiegwa bi’obonyaka.”
Ase engencho eyio nimbokie amagombo na korera. Ninyechabore chianga imbe getirianda, nyeumie buna ekebwe, na korera buna esagero,
ekiagera chingoma chiaye tichikogwenigwa. Obobe buna obwo bwaikire ase Abayuda, bwaikire nase ebiita bia Yerusalemu ase abanto baane bamenyete.
Timobaisa koraria amang’ana ayio ase Gati, gose timobaisa korera nonya ng’ake. Mwegara‐garie ase orotu igoro, mweitie agwo Beti‐Le‐Afura.
Inwe abanto ba Safiri, eta mogende more getirianda, mobe nobosooku. Abanto ba Saanani tibasogete isiko. Okorera kwa Beti‐Hasaeli tigokobatiga mobeere aroro.
Abanto bamenyete Maroti nigo baganyete mono ng’a baremigwe; amaakwa arure ase Omonene, aikire ase egeita kia Yerusalemu.

Inwe abamomenyete Lakisi, sibera chibarasi chigari, ekiagera inwe abanto b’omochie oyio nigo mwarenge gokora ebibe, mokagera abanto ba Sayoni bagakora ebibe ebio. Ogosaria kw’Abaisraeli nigo kwanyorekanete ime yaino.
Ase ayio aye karue ebiegwa bi’ogotigana ase abanto bamenyete Mosereti‐Gati. Chinyomba chire agwo Akisibu nchibe buna chindooche chikong’aina abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
Inwe abamomenyete Maresa, nimbarentere oyorababue. Oyore Obonene bw’Abaisraeli naike Adulamu.
Mokigite chitukia chi’emetwe yaino ase okoreera abana baino mwanchete. Tiga emetwe yaino etigare bosa buna omotwe bw’ensoti, ekiagera abana baino mbairwe ase obosomba.
Obobe nobwabo abwo bagokora emeroberio y’ogokora amabe na bayebeka ang’e kobare ase amarere abo; mambia kobwakire baba bakoyaikerania, ekiagera nigo ere ase okobua kw’amaboko abo.
Abwo nigo bakoba ne ribero ri’okonyora emegondo, bayaire ne chinguru, bagania ne chinyomba bachiira. Nigo bakoura omonto enyomba yaye, ee, bamoura na omwando oyo.

Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteba: Rora, nkoroberia inde amabe igoro yaino inwe ab’egesaku eke, na timokonyara korusia amagoti aino korwa ase amabe ayio, gose timokonyara gotaara moeneno, ekiagera nigo erabe engaki embe.

Ase rituko erio abanto mbatonge omorabaaro igoro yaino, babe bakobabokeria amagombo ’omoichano bagotera: “Twasirigwe kegima, Omonene oeire abanto abaao egetari ki’abanto baane, ee, ekeene okerusirie korwa asende, ogabeire abasaria emegondo yaito.”
Ase engencho eyio onde tari orarambore engori y’okorengera egetari ase omosangererekano bw’Omonene.
Abanto abwo nigo bakobana iga: “Timobaisa kobana! Onde tagwenereti kobana igoro y’amang’ana buna ayio; ogochaywa tikogotonyora.

Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, Inee, amang’ana aya nagwenerete gokwanwa: Omoika bw’Omonene nigo ore omwango kogechigwa? Oko nakwo ogokora kwaye? Inee! Amang’ana aane tari korenta amaya ase omonto ore nenkoro endonge?
“Korende ase amatuko aya mwaimokeire abanto baane buna ababisa. Nigo mokwaboria ebiambaro bi’abwo bagotaara bare nomorembe bataganeti esegi.
Nigo mogoseria abakungu b’abanto baane korwa ase chinka chiabo echio bagokerete, mwaura abana babo obonene bokorwa asende tibabonyora nonya ng’ake.
Inwe imoka morue aa, ekiagera aase aino mogotimokera tari aa. Ase engencho y’ogotacheneka kwaino aase aa nasarigwe nogosaria okonene.
“Omonto omonyaborimo aise gokwana amang’ana a bosa na ay’obong’ainereria, atebe: Inche nigo nkobabanera igoro y’edivai na ebinyugwa binde bigotindia, omobani oyio nere abanto aba baranche.

“Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, nimbasangererie inwe mwensi, ee ekeene, ninsangererie abatigari b’Abaisraeli buna ching’ondi chigosangererigwa chiabekwa ase obweri obomo, na buna riicho rie ching’ondi rikorisia aase aamo, mbabe bakwoga, ekiagera bare abange.
“Oyo okobaatera enchera nabatang’ane; barabwo mbagareyie, baetere ase egeita, basoke isiko. Omoruoti obo nabaraae, ee, Omonene nabatang’ane bosio bwabo.”
Inche ngateba: “Inwe abatang’ani b’abanto ba Yakobo, inwe abagambi b’Abaisraeli, igwa! Inee! Tebagwenereti inwe momanye ayare ay’oboronge?
Inwe nigo mogechete ayare amaya, mwancha ayare amabe. Nigo mogosaabora amasankwa ’emebere y’abanto baane, na mwongoria chinyama korwa ase amauga abo.

Inwe nigo mokoria chinyama chi’emebere y’abanto baane. Nigo mogosaabora amasankwa abo, mwabuna amauga abo mwayakora ebing’ese. Naende mwanachana emebere yabo buna chinyama chikobekwa ase egetega chikonachanwa.
Erio mbarere ase Omonene, korende ere takobaigwa. Ase engaki eyio ere nababise obosio bwaye, ekiagera babeire bagokora ayare amabe.”

Aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro y’ababani abwo bakoraa abanto baane gochia ase obosiru, abwo bagoteba ng’a omorembe noreo, ekero baeirwe egento barire, korende bakora esegi ase abwo batabaeti egento bakobeka monwa.
Ase ayio obotuko mbobachere timorora amaroro, na omosunte nobachere timomanya igoro y’amang’ana agochi‐gocha. Erioba ndirimere tiribarera ababani, ne rituko ndionchoke ribe omosunte igoro asebare.
Abarori mbasookigwe, na abaringoria boigo. Abwo bonsi mbatube emenwa yabo, ekiagera Nyasae takobairaneria gento kende.
Korende inche naichoirwe ne chinguru chi’Omoika bw’Omonene, na oboronge, na oboremu, erinde ntebie abanto ba Yakobo ogosaria kwabo, na Abaisraeli ebibe biabo.
Inwe abatang’ani b’abanto ba Yakobo, abagambi b’Abaisraeli, igwa amang’ana aya! Inwe nigo mogechete ayare ay’ekeene, na mogokorekania onsi ayare amaronge;
inwe nigo mokoagacha Sayoni ase ogoitera amanyinga, na Yerusalemu ase ogokora okobe.

Abatang’ani b’omochie oyio nigo bakogamba ebina ase okoegwa riaaki, na abakuani baye nigo bakworokereria ase ogoakanerwa, na ababani baye nigo bagokora oboringoria ase okoegwa chibesa. Nonya naboigo nigo bakweegeka ase Omonene, bateba, “Inee! Omonene tari ase egati yaito? Amang’ana amabe tagotonyora.”
Ase ayio, ase engencho yaino Sayoni noremwe buna omogondo, na Yerusalemu nobe amaturi, na egetunwa gie Hekalu kebe egetunwa kere ne rinani.
Nebe ase amatuko ’omoerio ng’a egetunwa ki’enyomba y’Omonene ngekong’igwe, kebe ekenene goetania ebitunwa binde, nkeimokererigwe igoro goetania ebigoro binde; abanto abange mbaendoke gochiao.

Abanto b’ebisaku ebinge mbabe bakogendao bagoteba: “Inchuo totiire gochia ase egetunwa ki’Omonene, gochia ase enyomba ya Nyasae o Yakobo, erinde atworokererie chinchera chiaye, na intwe tochibwatie.” Amachiko narue Sayoni, ne ring’ana ri’Omonene ndiiche korwa Yerusalemu.

Erio Omonene nanache ekina ase egati y’abanto abange, nagambie boronge ebisaku bire ne chinguru bimenyete aare. Abanto mbature emioro yabo y’esegi ebe amakombe, na amatimo abo abe emeyio chinkuro. Egesaku ekemo tigekoimoka korwania ekende, gose abanto tibakweorokereria korwana esegi nonya ng’ake.
Kera omonto nigo araikaranse inse y’emesabibu yaye na ase emeko yaye, na onde takoboboyia, ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nere okwanire ayio.
Kera egesaku nigo kerabwatie erieta ri’enyasae yaye, korende intwe nigo torabwatie erieta ri’Omonene Nyasae oito goika kare na kare.
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsangererie ebirema, naende ninsangererie abwo naseretie, na bonsi abwo naete amaakwa.
Nintige abare ebirema babe abatigari, na abwo baseretigwe babe egesaku kere ne chinguru. Omonene nabagambere agwo ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, korwa bono na goika kare na kare.
“Naye Omorobiri bw’Oborendi, aye ekegoro ki’omochie o Sayoni, obogambi bwao obokoro mbokoiranere, ee, obogambi bw’omochie o Yerusalemu.”
Bono, ninki okorera neriogi rinene? Inee! Omoruoti tari ime yao? Abasemia bao mbasirigwe goika kwabeire nobororo buna obw’omokungu okobina aibore?

Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, bina moigwe obororo buna obw’omokungu okobina aibore; korwa bono karue ase omochie, momenye ase chinsana. Mogende Babeli, na aroro motoorigwe. Aroro agwo Omonene nabatoorie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baino.
Bono abanto b’ebisaku ebinge basangererekanire amo babarwanie esegi, bagoteba: “Tiga omochie oyio okorwe obe oyotachenegeti, naintwe tobe torigereretie Sayoni.”
Korende abanto abwo tibamanyeti ebirengererio bi’Omonene, gose tibamanyeti omoroberio oye ng’a obasangereirie amo buna emesaima ere ase ekeooreri gi’okoorera.

“Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, imoka moore, ekiagera ninkore chingunchara chiaino chibe echi’ebioma, na ebitaago biaino bibe ebi’etaai, erinde moake abanto abange, mobasamunyore.” Ebinto biabo morasakore mobiatanane bibe ebichenu ase Omonene, ne chinibo chiabo chibe echi’Omonene bw’ense engima.
Aye Omochie bw’emeganda, sangereria emeganda yao y’esegi. Ababisa banaaririe omochie oito bayorwanie esegi. Barabwo mbaake omogambi bw’Abaisraeli orosea rwaye nenyimbo.

“Korende aye Bethlehemu Efarata, aye ore omoke ase egati ye chiamate chi’egesaku ki’Abayuda, korwa asore nang’orokere oyomo orabe omogambi bw’Abaisraeli. Oyio nao arenge korwa agwo kare, ee, korwa kare na kare.”
Ase ayio Omonene natige abanto baye goika engaki eike, ekero oyio okobina araibore; erio nario abanto bamwabo abatigari barairane gocha ase Abaisraeli.

Ekero oyio oraiborwe arache, narisie riicho riaye ore ne chinguru chi’Omonene, ee, narisie nobonene bw’erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye. Riicho riaye ndibe rirendire buya, ekiagera bono ere nabe omonene goika chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense.

Omorisia oyio nabe omorembe oito. Ekero Abaasuri barache ase ense yaito gotorwania na basoe ase chinyomba chiaito chi’obonene, intwe ntosokie abarisia batano na babere, na abagambi batano na batato, babatange.
Barabwo mbasirie ense y’Abaasuri nemioro, na ense ya Nimurodi bayesirie nemeyio ya birende. Boigo mbatotoorie korwa ase Abaasuri ekero barasoe ase ense yaito goetera ase chimbebe chiaito.

Erio abatigari ba Yakobo mbabe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebinge, buna riime rigotonya korwa ase Omonene, na buna embura engiya egotwera obonyansi, embura eria tegotebana koganya monto gete, gose mwanyabanto onde bwensi.

Ee, abatigari abwo ba Yakobo mbabe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebinge, babe buna endo ere ase egati ye ching’iti chire ase rinani, na buna endo ensae ere ase egati ye riicho rie ching’ondi, eyio ekero yasoire ase riicho nigo egotachera inse na gotandorana eyaitire, na onde tari oranyare koyetooria.
Ase enchera eyio amaboko aino naimokererigwe igoro y’abachandi baino, na inwe mosirie kegima ababisa baino bonsi.
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsirie chibarasi chiaino, ne chigari chiaino chirue asemore kegima.
Ninsarie emechie yonsi ere ase ense yaino, naende nintagore chindwaki chiaino echio mogwekengera.
Ninsirie oborogi korwa ase amaboko aino, na abaringoria tibakonyorekana asemore nonya ng’ake.
Ninsirie emegwekano yaino yonsi amo, ne chisiiro chiaino, ebinto ebio mogosasima, na inwe timokogenderera gosasima emeremo y’amaboko aino.
Ninsimore emete y’Asera eyio mogosasima, ninyerusie korwa asemore, ninkore emechie yaino ebe bosa.
Ninyeruserie egesiomba ase abanto b’ebisaku, abwo batari koigwera, inde nendamwamu na ekeririanda.”
Bono inwe tegerera moigwe aya Omonene agoteba: Imoka, mwekwanere agwo bosio bw’ebitunwa, na motige ebigoro biigwe amariogi aino.
“Inwe ebitunwa, nainwe ebitare, ninwe more oboroso bw’ense, tegerera moigwe ogosoera kw’Omonene! Ere nabwate amang’ana nabanto baye, nare nekina n’Abaisraeli.
“Inwe abanto baane, ngento ki nabakoreire? Nase amang’ana ki nabarosirie? Ng’iranerie!
Nigo nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri; nkababooria korwa ase ense y’obosomba, inche ngatoma Musa, na Haroni, na Miriamu, bakaba bakobaraa.

Inwe abanto baane, inyora egento Balaki, omoruoti o Moabu, aroberetie gokora, na buna Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, amoiraneretie. Boigo inyora amang’ana akoregete ekero mwarenge ase orogendo korwa Sitimu gochia Giligali, erinde monyare komanya ogokora kw’oboronge kwane inche Omonene.”
“Ngento ki ndarentere Omonene, na ntung’ame ase obosio bwa Nyasae ore igoro? Inee! Nigo ndache ase obosio bwaye, ndetane ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, gose chimori chiakoorire omwaka oyomo?

Inee! Omonene nagokigwe ne chimingichi chilifu, gose ne chindooche chi’amaguta chilifu ikomi? Inee! Nindue omwana one omotangi ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane, omwana oyio ore okwama kw’obogima bwane, abe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase engencho y’omoyo one?”

Aye mwanyabanto, Omonene okworokirie ayare amaya. Ninki Omonene aganetie korwa asore otatiga okore ayare ay’oboronge, na bwanche gokora ayare ay’obwanchani, naende otaare ase oboitongo ase obosio bwa Nyasae oo.
Omonene nigo akorangeria abare ase omochie, na omonto oirogete erieta riaye nere omong’aini. Eriogi riaye nigo rigoteba: “Igwa igoro y’egesusuro na ning’o ogechikire.
Inee! Chinibo chi’obourereria nchigenderere kobeera ase chinyomba chi’abakori amabe? Na ebirengero bitaikeraneti biragereirie mbibeereo?
Ninyare gwanchera ebirengero bi’obourereria, gose amagena ’obong’ainereria ay’okorengera abeere ase chisaro ime?
Abanto abanda bare ase egati yaino baichire nobourereria, na abwo bamenyete agwo nigo bagokwana oborimo, ne chimeme chiabo nigo chire echi’obong’ainereria.
Ase engencho y’ebibe biaino nimbaake timogwena rinde, mbasirie kegima.
Ekero morabe mokoragera, timokoigota; nigo moragenderere koba nenchara. Mosangererie na kwegachera ebinto, korende ebio mwegacheire nimbirue bisirigwe nemioro.
Imosimeke chindagera, korende timogochigesa. Imomite amazeituni, korende timokweaka amaguta korwao; imomite amasabibu, korende timokonywa edivai ekorwao.

Inwe nigo mwabeire mokobwatia amachiko ’Omuri, na ogokora gwonsi kw’enyomba y’Ahabu, naende mwabeire mokoigwera ogosemia kwabo. Ase ayio nimbasirie kegima, na abamenyete ime yao babe bagochaywa, na igo mobogorie okoramwa okwo abanto baane barametwe.”

Obobe nobwane, ekiagera nabeire nkororekana buna ekero amatunda ’omorakera agosangererigwa, na ayatigaire ase emesabibu achorirwe. Ebisago bi’amasabibu bikoriegwa tibiyo, na amako amatang’ani, aya nganetie, taiyo.
Abanto bamoirogete Nyasae basirire korwa ase ense, na oyore nenkoro endonge tari ase egati y’abanto. Bonsi nigo bakoboera abanto baitere amanyinga abo. Kera omonto nigo akobwata, oyomwabo noboreba.

Abanto aba nigo bare nomokia gokora ayare amabe namaboko abo. Omogambi nigo anchete aegwe riaaki, na omogambi ebina boigo; omonto ore nokobua nigo agosaba aegwe ebi aganetie ase okogania kwaye okobe, na nigo babwateranete amo.

Oyore omuya goetania abande ase egati yabo nigo anga buna egetutu kere namagwa, na oyore nenkoro endonge nigo are nobobe kobua orobago rogiteire amagwa. Ekero rituko ri’abarendi bao, riria ri’egesusuro kiao riraike, abanto mbabe nomoichano.
Tobaisa kwegena omogisangio oo, gose gosemeria omosani oo. Orende amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa oo, nonya mokao tayamanya.
Omwana omomura nigo agochaya ise, na omwana omoiseke nigo akoamererania na ng’ina, na moka momura oamererania na ng’ina biara. Ababisa b’omonto nabanto b’enyomba yaye omonyene.
Korende inche omonyene nindigererie Omonene; ninganye inde nogosemeria ase Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane; Nyasae one nanyigwe.
Aye omobisa one, togokera okogwa kwane; ekero ndagwe, nintenene naende; ekero ndabe inde ase omosunte, Omonene nabe etaya yane.
Ekiagera nakorire ebibe ase Omonene, nindemererie endamwamu yaye, goika ere agambe amang’ana aane na ang’e oboronge bwane. Ere nandete ase omobaso, na inche ningokere oboronge bwaye.
Erio oria ore omobisa one arore ayio, na obosooku mbomotube oria omboretie, “Ng’ai Omonene, Nyasae oo, are?” Nimorigererie ngoke; ere natiringerwe inse buna esike ere inchera.
Rituko ndiche ekero chindwaki chiao chiraagachwe. Ase rituko erio chimbebe chiao nchigareeigwe.

Ase rituko erio abanto mbagochere korwa Asuri na korwa ase emechie ya Misiri, ee, korwa Misiri goika orooche rwa Eufarati, na korwa ase enyancha eyemo goika ase eyende, na korwa ase egetunwa ekemo goika ase ekende.
Korende ense netigwe ebe bosa ase engencho y’abanto bamenyeteo; okwo korabe okwama kw’ogokora kwabo okobe.
Risia abanto bao nenyimbo yao abanto abwo bare riicho ri’omwando oo, rimenyete ao rioka ase rinani ime agwo Karimeli. Oritige rikorisia agwo Basani na Gileadi, buna yarenge ase amatuko a kare.
“Nimborokie amakumia buna nakorete ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri.”
Ekero abanto b’ebisaku bararore ayio mbasooke, ekiagera chinguru chiabo chiabuirwe. Mbatube emenwa yabo namaboko abo, na amato abo natine.

Barabwo mbamene orotu rwe riroba buna ching’iti chingenda inse. Mbarue ase chinyomba chiabo chinkong’u bakoiguswa bekurure inse buna amakonde; mbakoonchokere aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, bare nobwoba obonene, ee, mbakoiroke aye.

Inee! Nyasae onde nare onga buna aye? Aye nigo okwabera abatigari abare omwando oo ebibe biabo, na kweba obobe bwabo. Aye tori kogenderera koba nendamwamu yao goika kare na kare, ekiagera bwanchete koorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera.
Aye notoiranere, otororere amabera naende; notiringere ebibe biaito inse y’amagoro ao, nobitugute bionsi ime ase chindiba chi’enyancha.
Aye noorokerie ororeria rwa Yakobo obwegenwa bwao, na orwa Ibrahimu obwanchani bwao botari koera, buna kwarierete chisokoro chiaito eira korwa ase amatuko a kare, ogatiana.
Aya naro amang’ana amakong’u igoro ya Nineva arikire ase ebuku y’okorora kwa Nahumu Omoelikosi.

Omonene nigo are Nyasae bwe risemi, ere nigo akweruseria egesiomba na koba nendamwamu enene. Omonene nigo akweruseria egesiomba ase abwo bakoamererania nere; nigo akobagachera ababisa baye ekeririanda.

Omonene tari omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, korende nigo are nokobua okonene; tari gotiga koa abamochi egesusuro. Enchera y’Omonene nigo ere ase omwaga na ekembugu‐mbugu; na amare nigo are orotu rw’amagoro aye.
Ere nigo agotogonyera enyancha, amache asira, nigo agosiria amache e chindooche chionsi. Ense ya Basani nigo egosusana, na egetunwa gia Karimeli boigo; oboseera bwa Lebanoni nigo bokogoyana.
Ebitunwa nigo bigotengechigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, ebigoro nigo bikonyititoka. Ense nigo ekonyegerigwa ase obosio bwaye, ee, ense amo nebitongwa bionsi bireo.

Ning’o oranyare gotenena ase ekeririanda kiaye tikemosiria? Gose ning’o oranyare koremereria obotindi bw’endamwamu yaye? Ekeririanda kiaye nigo kiaumoirwe buna omorero, na ebitare nigo bigotandoka ase obosio bwaye.
Omonene nomuya; ere neburi enkong’u ase engaki y’emechando, nigo abamanyete abwo bakomotamera.
Korende nasirie kegima aase omochie oria ore, narente eooro enene mono, nabwatie ababisa baye gochia ase omosunte.
Inki mokoroberia igoro y’Omonene? Ere nabasirie kegima, takorenta egesusuro eria kabere.
Nabaisa kobwatana buna amagwa akweringania, na gotinda nekenyugwa kegotindia, goika bayie baere buna obonyansi obwomo.
Omonto oyomo naruete asore, akaroberia amabe igoro y’Omonene, akarua ogosemia okobe kw’ogosiria.
Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Nabaisa koba abange bare ne chinguru, goika basirigwe tibabao naende. Nonya nabeire nkobachanda inwe, bono tinkogenderera kobachanda naende nonya ng’ake.
Bono nimbutore amakorogoto aria ababisa bababekerete, naende mbutorane chingataare babasiberete.”

Aya naro Omonene achikire igoro yao: “Ororeria tirogotoka roratorwe ase erieta riao. Ninsirie korwa ase enyomba ye chinyasae chiao emegwekano yao ogosasima, eyio ebaachire na eyio ebombire. Ninkoroiserie oboina bwao, ekiagera aye nigo ore omokayayu.”

Rigereria ase ebitunwa, orore amagoro ay’oyio okorenta amang’ana amaya ay’omogoko na koraria amang’ana ’omorembe! Inwe Abayuda, renda Amatuko aino Amanene, moikeranie chiira chiria mwariete. Abakori amabe tibagocha kobarwania naende, ekiagera basirigwe kegima.
Oyo ogosiria oimokire gocha kobarwania. Renda chiburi chiaino more nebirwanero, morende ne chinchera; eboyie ebinema biaino mokong’e, mobe ne chinguru chinyinge.

Omonene nkoirania are obonene bw’abanto ba Yakobo, ee, obwo bore obonene bw’Abaisraeli, ekiagera abasakori babasakoire na kobatiga bare bosa, babunire chinsagia chi’emesabibu yabo, bachitugutire inse.

Chinguba chi’ababisa babo bare chituoni nigo chiabeire chimbariri, abarwani babo b’esegi nigo babegete chianga chimbariri. Chigari chiabo nigo chikomesa buna omorero, ekero chiroberete gocha korwana. Amatimo abo achomeire chintanga chi’emetarakwa nigo agotimitigwa mono.
Chigari chi’esegi nigo chigotitiria ase chinchera; nigo chikobagachana ase chiraaro chi’omochie; nigo chikomesa buna ebieri bi’omorero, na kominyoka buna okomesa kw’embura.
Ere nigo ainyorete abarwani baye b’esegi abanene, korende ekero bagocha nigo barabe bakona‐kogochwa. Barabwo nigo bakoayerera gochia ase chindwaki, na gotenenia ebiekengero.
Ebiita bire ase chindooche biaigoirwe, enka y’omoruoti yaichoirwe nomoondoko.
Eting’ana goika echaborwe chianga eirwe; abaiseke baye abasomba nigo bakorera na kweumia buna amaruma, bagoaka‐aka ebikuba biabo.
Korwa kare Nineva nigo orenge buna ritibo riichire amache, korende bono abanto ngotama bare. Nigo bagotebigwa: “Tenena! Tenena!” Korende onde tari okorigereria nyuma.
Sakora chifeta! Sakora ne chitahabu! Obotenenku na obonge bwe chinibo bireo tibikoera.
Ogotigwa bosa, na okong’anywa, na ogosarigwa, biabeireo; chinkoro chiarianyekire, na amaru nigo agoaka‐akana. Chibachwa nigo chigwatigwa, na amasio a bonsi aonchokire arabire se ase omoondoko.
Amaraaro e chindo, ng’ai are? Ng’ai chindo chinsae chikoriera? Ng’ai chindo chituoni, ne chiaberi, ne chimanwa chiabo, chiarenge gotaara chitarenge kwoboigwa nonde?
Endo nigo yatandoranete eke yaitete kegaisana chimanwa chiaye; naende egaita ekaa chindo chiaye chiaberi. Nigo yaichoretie amakuruma aye nebi yaitete, ne chingoro chiaye nebi yasakorete.

Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Rora, inche nigo inde mamincha yao; ninsambe chigari chiao chiimoke erioki, ning’ite chindo chiao chinsae nomoro; ninsirie ebinto gwasakorete birue ase ense, na eriogi ri’abanto bao gwatomete tirikoigugwa nonya ng’ake.”
Obobe nobwaye omochie oyio oiteire amanyinga amange, oyio oichire noborimo na obouri, oyio otari gotiga gosakora na koira!
Igwa eriogi ri’emecharichi egoaka, na ogochura kw’amagoro e chigari, na ogw’okominyoka gwe chibarasi, na okorunda kw’amagoro e chigari.

Abariini be chibarasi nigo bakominyoka gochia bosio; emioro nigo ekomesigwa, na amatimo akobarigwa. Emeganda y’abanto yaitirwe, ebitondo nigo birorekanete aande onsi. Emebere y’abanto bakwete tekobareka, nigo ekogocha abanto aande onsi.

Ayio onsi nigo achete ase engencho y’obonyaka obonge bw’omochie oyo. Oyio orenge omotayayi omonyakieni bwenaretie oborogi; nigo asiretie abanto b’ebisaku nobonyaka bwaye, ne chiamate chinyinge noborogi bwaye.
Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Rora, nigo inde mamincha yao, ningwasiorie chianga chiao, na abanto b’ebisaku barore obogetirianga bwao, na amaruoti arore obosooku bwao.
“Ningosiarere eubi y’okogechia, ningotige ochaywe, nobe gokorigererigwa na gosekererigwa.
Kera omonto orabe ogokorora nigo aregose atenenere aare, atebe: Nineva otigirwe bosa, ning’o orayororere amabeebe? Ng’ai toranyore oyokoyoremia?”
Aye Nineva, Inee, nomuya ore kobua Tebesi, omochie ore ase orooche rwa Naili oetananire namache? Enyancha nero yarenge egekengero kiaye, na amache naro arenge orwaki rwaye.
Abaetiopia na Abamisiri batarenge korengeka nabwo barenge chinguru chiaye; Abaputi na Abalibia nabwo barenge koyokonya.

Korende nonya naboigo, abanto b’omochie oyio nigo bairetwe ase obosomba. Abana baye nigo basenyenteretwe agwo ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi. Abanto baye abasike nigo baakeretwe obomera, na abanto baye abanene bagasibwa nebinyuri.
Naye boigo notinde bwerusie moyo. Aye boigo norigie aase okwebisa korwa ase ababisa bao.
Chiburi chiao chionsi nigo chinga buna emeko ere nokwama kwe ritang’ani. Ekero egotengechigwa, amako abo nigo akoaroroka, agwa ase emenwa y’abanto baria bakoyaria.
Rora, abarwani bao b’esegi nigo banga abakungu, na ebiita bi’ense yao nigo biigoire biasie ase ababisa bao. Omorero osambire emekorogoto y’ebiita biao.
Buucha amache oyagache, ekiagera noche koboerwa, okong’ie chiburi chiao. Soa ase engoro, otiringe esike, bwebeke ang’e obombe amatabori.
Aroro agwo omorero nogosambe, na omoro nogoite okorie buna chingeeti chikoria. Aye menteka obuche buna chingeeti, na buna chingige.
Nigo kwamentete abaonchoreria bao bakaba abange goetania ching’enang’eni chia igoro, bakaba buna ebisase bie chingige, bakaria ense bakairuruka, bakagenda.

Abagambi bao nigo banga buna chingige, na abaraai bao nigo banga buna amasendo e chingige chigosoa ase chimbago ime ekero ki’obokendu; ekero omobaso obarire chiairuruka chiagenda, onde takomanya ase chiagenda.
Aye omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, abarisia bao nigo baraire, na abanto bao abasike nigo basundogete. Abanto bao baserebanigwe ase ebitunwa igoro; na onde tari okobasangereria.

Okogwenigwa tikori ase ogoakwa kwao, eriote riao riabeire riibe, tirikogwena. Abanto bonsi abaraigwe aya akonyorire nigo baraake chinkobi ase engencho y’okogwa kwao. Inee! Onde nare otanyoretwe nobobe bwao bwa botambe?
Aya naro amang’ana amakong’u omobani Habakuki aroche ase okorora.
Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri ndabe nkorera ng’a onkonye, naye tori konyigwa? Gose ngoika ririri ndabe ngokorangeria ase engencho y’obotindi, naye tori gontooria?
Naki gwantigire narorire amabe buna aya? Naki ondigereretie ing’etananire nemechando? Ogosirigwa na ogokorerwa bobe nigo bire ase obosio bwane; amariomana na ogotaigwana nigo bireo.
Ase engencho eyio amachiko tari ne chinguru, na oboronge tibori gokorwa. Abakori amabe nigo baetanaine abanyaboronge, na ebina nigo bikonachwa bobe.
“Rigereria morore ayare ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, mokumie na goichanigwa. Ngochia gokora inde ring’ana ase amatuko aino, eri motegene moise koritebigwa.
Naama! Nindete Abakalidayo, egesaku keria kere egetindi, naende kere ne chinkoro chigwoka, kegoeta ase chinse chionsi kemenye ase obomenyo botari obwabo.
Barabwo nabanto bakoondokia na kwoboyia; oboronge bwabo na okobua kwabo nigo bikorwa ase barabwo abanyene.

“Chibarasi chiabo nigo chikominyoka bwango kobua chingo, nigo chire chintindi kobua chisese chi’orosana chigotwara mogoroba; abariini babo be chibarasi nigo bagochararacharara. Ee, abariini babo be chibarasi nigo bakorwa aare, nigo bakoiruruka buna ekeongo kegochia kobwata eke gekoria.
“Abanto abwo bonsi nigo bagocha gokora ay’obotindi. Nigo bakorigereria gochia bosio bare nomokia buna omwaga okorwa moocha; nigo bagosangereria abasibwa abange buna omokenye.
Nigo bagochecheria abaruoti, na gosekerera abagambi. Nigo bagochaya kera eburi enkong’u, baagacha chiburi chiabo, babua bachiira.
Erio baeta bwango buna omwaga, bagenderera gochia bosio; abanto abwo bare abamochi, ne chinguru chiabo nachio enyasae yabo.”

Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, Omochenu one, tari aye oreo korwa kare na kare? Ase ayio titogokwa. Aye Omonene, egetare giaito, aye kwabachikire batogambie ekina, kwababekire batoe egesusuro ki’ogotorongeyia.

Aye ore namaiso amachenu mono atari korigereria amabe na aya atari ay’oboronge, naki orakore oremererie korora abanto batari abegenwa, na okire‐kiri ekero abakori amabe bagosiria abare abanyaboronge kobabua?
Aye gwakorire abanto babe buna chinswe chi’enyancha, na buna ebitongwa bikwagura bitabwati omogambi obo.
Barabwo nigo bakobabwata nebigobanio biabo babakurura nekeonga kiabo na kobasangereria ase ekeonga kiabo bakorubera; erio bagoka na gochenga.
Ase ayio nigo bakorua ebing’wanso ase ekeonga kiabo na kogesambera ubani, ekiagera ebinto ebio nabio bikobanyorera ebinoru na endagera enyinge.
Inee! Abwo nigo bagochia konakorusia abanto b’ebisaku ase ekeonga kiabo babasirie batari namabera?
Inche nintenene korenda, ee, nintenene igoro ase omorobiri bw’ogotengera, ndore aya Omonene arantebie, na buna ndairanerie igoro y’okorera kwane.
Omonene akang’iraneria, agantebia, “Rika okorora okwo ase ebao namariko amaya, erinde oyo okoyasoma ayasome buya.
Okorora okwo nigo koganyete engaki yaye eike. Nigo gokoayerera goikerane, tigokomocha goikerana. Nonya gokororekana ng’a gwatebanire, ekeene goika goikerane, tikogotebana.
Rora, oyo okweimokereria igoro, omoyo oye tori omoronge, korende omonyene oboronge nabe moyo goetera ase okwegena kwaye.

“Edivai nigo ere buna omoonchoreria omong’ainereria; omonto omwerori tari kogenderera koba nobotoereru.
