Okogania kwaye nigo gokogarea kwaba buna aase abakure; nigo konga buna amakweri atari goisaneka. Nigo agosangereria abanto b’ebisaku bionsi gocha asare na gokora abanto be chinse chionsi koba abaye.”

Abanto aba bonsi nigo baramokorere echeche baroisie engero y’okomochecheria batebe, “Obobe nobwaye oyo‐gosangereria amo ebinto bitari ebiaye, na bwetweka ebinto airete bibe ntenenera. Ngoika ririri aragenderere gokora igo?”
Inee! Abanto baria kwairete ebinto biabo tibakogochera mobosokano, na bagochande, bakobwate bakoire ase obosomba.
Ekiagera aye gwasakoire ebisaku ebinge, abanto b’ebisaku ebitigari mbagosakore aye; gwaiteire amanyinga ’abanto abange, na ogakora ayare amabe ase ense na ase emechie, na ase bonsi abamenyeteo.
Obobe nobwaye omonto oria okonyora ebitoki bi’obobe na kobirenta ase enyomba yaye, erinde bweagachera egeswa kiaye aase aimokererete igoro ng’a abe noborendi korwa ase okobua kw’amabe.
Aye kwarenteire enyomba yao obosooku ase ogoita abanto abange, na igo gwakorire ebibe bi’ogosiria obogima bwao aye omonyene.
Amagena ’enyasi naake eriogi na emiamba ye rirongo neyairanerie.
Obobe nobw’omonto oyio okoagacha omochie ase ogoitera amanyinga na kobeka oboroso bw’omochie ase ogokora ebibe.
Abanto nigo bakwerosia gokora emeremo eyio erasambwe nomorero, na abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakwerosia gokora emeremo ere bosa. Rora, ayio nigo arure ase Omonene.
Ense neichorigwe nokomanya kw’obonene bw’Omonene buna chinyancha chiichire namache.
Obobe nobw’omonto oria okoa omonto onde ekenyugwa giochoganirie nobosongo kiamotindia, erinde anyare korigereria obogetirianda bwaye.
Aye nigo gwaichoirwe nobosooku ribaga ri’ogosikwa. Aye kanywe, obe omonto otarogeti! Egekombe ki’egesusuro kere ase okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nakegochere; na oboosoku mbotube obonene bwao.

Obobe bwakoretwe ase Lebanoni mbogotube, na ogosirigwa gwe ching’iti koria gwachiondogetie; aye noegwe egesusuro, ekiagera gwaiterete amanyinga ’abanto, na ogakora amabe ase ense, na ase emechie, na ase abanto bamenyeteo.

Omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, mbitoki ki okorentera oyio okoyobomba? Oyio nomogwekano obombire ore omworokia omong’ainereria? Oyio oyoroisetie nigo asemeretie emeremo y’amaboko aye ere chinyasae chitari gokwana.

Obobe nobwaye omonto oria ogotebia egento kebaachire korwa ase omote: Boka! Na otebia rigena ritanyare gokwana: Imoka! Inee! Ebinto ebio mbinyare gokworokereria enchera? Rora, ebio nigo bioomire ne chitahabu ne chifeta, korende omoika tori ime yabo.
“Korende Omonene nao are ase Hekalu yaye Enchenu; tiga ense yonsi ekire‐kiri ase obosio bwaye.”
Oko nogosaba kw’omobani Habakuki.
Aye Omonene, naigure chinkuma chiao, nairokire. Omonene, ogokora kwao tiga kobe okoyia ase emiaka eye, tiga komanyekane ase emiaka eye. Ekero ore nendamwamu oinyore amabera.
Nyasae ngocha are korwa Temani ee, Ere oyore Omochenu ngocha are korwa ase egetunwa gia Parani. Obonene bwaye mbotube igoro chionsi, na ense neichorwe nogotogigwa kwaye.
Okobara kwaye nigo konga buna okw’erioba, gokomoreka korwa ase okoboko kwaye, aroro agwo obobui bwaye nao bobisire.
Amarwaire agoita nigo atang’aine bosio bwaye, na amaakwa nigo akobwatia chimbaratero chiaye.

Ekero agotenena, ense nigo agotengechigwa, na ekero akorigereria, abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakonyegerigwa. Ebitunwa biarengeo korwa kare nigo bikorimera gochia inse. Ere nigo agotaara ase chinchera chiaye chia kare.
Nkarora chinyomba chire Kusani chichandegete, ne chieema chi’ense ya Midiani chikanyegerigwa.

Inee! Aye Omonene nigo ogechirie ne chindooche, gose endamwamu yao nigo ere igoro ase chirochio? Inee! Nigo ore nekeririanda ase chinyancha, ekiagera nigo gwachete ne chibarasi chiao koriinete chigari chiao chi’obobui?
Obota bwao bwaorokigwe maiso marore amo nemegwe ye ring’ana riao kwarierete ebisaku eira. Nigo gwatandorete ense ne chindooche.
Ebitunwa nigo biakoroche, bikanyegerigwa, amache e chiooro agaeta; chindiba chigaaka amariogi, chikaimokia amaboko abo gochia igoro.
Ekero emegwe yao yarenge korunda na komesa, ne ritimo riao riarenge komekameka, na erioba na omotienyi bigatenena aase abo.
Aye nigo gwaetete ase ense kore nekeririanda, okamionogorera abanto b’ebisaku inse kore nendamwamu.
Aye nigo gwasogete ase ogotooria abanto bao, ee, okarentera omoakwa amaguta oo ogotooreka. Nigo gwasenyentete ekerama ki’enyomba y’omokori amabe, okayetagora korwa ase oboroso goika ase egechuria.
Aye nigo kwabetete emetwe y’abarwani esegi babo namatimo abo abanyene, ekero batocherete buna ekembugumbugu kegocha gotoserebania bare nomochengo gotosiria buna abataka bagosirigwa bobisi.
Nigo gwaetete ase enyancha ne chibarasi chiao, ogaetera ase emerindo yarenge koeera ne chinguru.

Ekero naigwete amang’ana ayio, enda yane egatengechigwa, ebikoba biane bikaiguswa ekero naigwete okoeera okwo, amauga ’omobere one akarwara na kogunda, ngatengechigwa aase nateneine. Nimbe ndemereretie ase rituko riria ri’emechando, ekero omobisa arache korwania egesaku giaito.
Emeko tegosicha, na emesabibu tekwama; emezeituni nigo erabe bosa tiyama, na emegondo tekwama chindagera. Amaicho e ching’ondi nasirigwe korwa ase ameri, na amaicho e chiombe takobao.
Nonya naboigo ningokere Omonene, ninchengere Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane.

Nyasae oyore Omonene, nere chinguru chiane; nigo agokora amagoro aane abe amaango buna ay’ensune, nigo agontaaria ase ebitunwa biane igoro. Ase omoteria. Ogotera kogoterwa ase okobugigwa kw’amakano aane.
Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riachete ase Sefania, mosinto o Kusi, o Gedalia bw’Amaria, bw’Hezekia, ekero Yosia, mosinto bw’Amoni, arenge omoruoti bw’Abayuda.
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ninsirie kegima kera egento kerue ase ense.
Ninsirie mwanyabanto, ne ching’iti, ne chinyoni chia igoro, ne chinswe chi’enyancha. Ninsirie nebikorenta okogocha amo nabakori amabe; ee, ninsirie mwanyabanto korwa ase ense.” Nabo Omonene atebire.

“Nindambore okoboko kwane igoro y’Abayuda, na igoro y’abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu. Ninsirie korwa aase aiga abatigari abwo bagosasima Baali, na amarieta ’ababani na ay’abakuani abagokorera emegwekano.

Ninsirie baria bakoriina kerama igoro gosasima erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni boigo ninsirie abanto baria bagonsasima inche Omonene na batiana asende, naende batiana nase enyasae eria Milikomu.
Ninsirie abairanire nyuma batigire kombwatia inche Omonene, na baria batari kondigia inche Omonene, gose komboria amang’ana.”
Tegerera okire‐kiri ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae! Rituko ri’Omonene nigo rire ang’e; Omonene bwariganirie ekeng’wanso, bwatananire abwo arangeirie ase ekegeni kiaye na abasesenie.
Nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko riria ri’ekeng’wanso kiane inche Omonene nindue egesusuro ase abagambi, na ase abamura b’omoruoti, na ase bonsi ababegete chianga chie chinse chingeni.
“Boigo rituko erio nindue egesusuro ase bonsi abwo bagotamboka ase omoriibo bw’egesieri inse, na ase baria baichoirie ase chinyomba chi’abanene nebinto bi’obourereria, na ebi’obong’ainereria.”
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio eriogi ri’okorera ndigugwe korwa ase Egeita gie Chinswe, na okweumia nkoigugwe korwa ase ensemo enyia y’omochie, na endumo enene korwa ase ebigoro.
Inwe abamomenyete ase ensemo eye ekorokwa Ekonu, rera, ekiagera abaonchoreria bonsi basirigwe, na abasangereria bonsi be chibesa basirigwe.

“Ase engaki eria nimbe nkorigarigia Yerusalemu ase okoyomoreka ne chitaya; nindue egesusuro ase abanto baria bamenyete bare nobotoereru, buna edivai ekirete ase eturubo, abwo bagwetebia ase chinkoro chiabo: Omonene takonyara gokora kende, amaya gose amabe.
Chinibo chiabo nchisakorwe, ne chinyomba chiabo nchisarigwe chitigwe bosa. Nabaisa koagacha chinyomba, tibagochimenya, nabaisa gosimeka emesabibu, tibakonywa edivai ekorwao.”
Rituko rinene ri’Omonene ng’ang’e rire, nigo rire ang’e mono rikoayerera. Tegerera oigwe, rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire! Abarwani esegi chituoni nigo bakorera bare nobororo.
Rituko riria nigo rire eri’endamwamu, ne rituko ri’emechando na obororo, ne rituko ri’ogosirigwa na ogotigara bosa, ne rituko ri’omosunte na omorumbe, ne rituko ri’amare na omosunte ekerima.
Rituko riria neri’okobugigwa kw’ebitureri na okorera gw’esegi igoro y’emechie egiteire chindwaki, na igoro y’emerobiri emetambe mono.

“Nindete emechando emenene igoro ya mwanyabanto goika babe bagotaba‐taba buna emeuko, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asende inche Omonene. Amanyinga abo naumorwe buna eogoto, na emebere yabo netugutwe buna esike.”

Ase rituko riria ri’endamwamu y’Omonene chifeta chiabo ne chitahabu chiabo tibikonyara kobatooria. Ense yonsi nesambwe esirigwe nomorero bwe risemi riaye. Mobosokano narente omoerio bw’okoondokia ase abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense.
Inwe abanto b’egesaku getari korora obosooku, esangererie inwe abanyene, mweborie,
ekero aya achigetwe ataraikeranigwa, ekero rituko riria rirairurwe buna omoiriro okoirurwa na endamwamu entindi y’Omonene etarabachera, ee, ekero rituko ri’endamwamu y’Omonene ritarabachera.

Inwe mwensi abamore abaitongo ase ense eye, inwe abamobwatete amachiko aye, morigie Omonene; rigia oboronge, rigia ay’obokanyeku. Ande nabo morabaise gokengerwa ase rituko riria ri’endamwamu y’Omonene.
Omochie o Gasa nong’anyigwe, na oyo bw’Asikeloni notigwe ore bosa; abanto b’Asidodi nabaserigwe, na omochie bw’Ekironi notagorwe.

Obobe nobwaino inwe abanto momenyete ase enyancha mbarabare inwe egesaku ki’Abakereti! Aye Kanani, ense y’Abafilisti, ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rire mamincha yao. “Ningosirie goika monto onde tatigara omenyete ime yao.”
Ense eyio ere mbarabare y’enyancha nebe amarisio aase abarisia barabe namakuruma abo na ameri ’amaicho abo.

Ense eyio nebe egetari ki’abatigari b’Abayuda, nao barabe bakorisia chitugo chiabo na korara ase chinyomba chire agwo Asikeloni chingaki chia mogoroba. Omonene, Nyasae obo, nabainyore, abarusie ase obosibwa bwabo.
“Naigure Abamoabu bagochecheria abanto baane na Abaamoni bakobarama na kobachecheria, naende buna bagwetogia ase ogotumana chimbebe chiabo, na gosoa ase ense yabo.”

Ase ayio Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo agoteba iga: “Ekeene, buna inde moyo, ense ya Moabu nebe buna Sodomu, na ense y’Abaamoni nebe buna Gomora, ense ere namasa ne chingoro chire nomonyo, aase agwo nabe agendererete gosareka botambe. Abatigari b’abanto baane mbasakore abanto abwo, na abatooregete b’egesaku kiane mbaboose babakore babe abasomba babo.”
Okwo nakwo korabe ogoakanwa kwabo ase engencho y’oboenenu bwabo, ekiagera bachecheretie na gwetogia igoro y’abanto b’Omonene bw’Emeganda.
Omonene nabaondokie. Nakore chinyasae chionsi chire ase ense eyio chibe bosa. Abanto be chinse chi’ebisaku mbamosasime, kera oyomo aase aye.
“Nainwe Abaetiopia boigo inche Omonene nimbaite nomoro one.”
Omonene narambore okoboko kwaye gochia sugusu asirie Abaasuri; nasirie na Nineva obe bosa, na ayuomie obe erooro.

Aase agwo nabe ase amaicho e chitugo akorara, ne ching’iti chi’orosana ao ao; chinsoti ne ching’iti chinke chinga buna ebirongo nchimenye ase ebisure bi’emetobwa yaye; chinyakweumia nachieumie ase chitirisa, na ogosareka goike ase emeriibo ya bisieri inse, ekiagera emecharake y’amaagacho abo nesareke.

Oyo noro omochie oria orenge nomogoko, omenyete nobotoereru, orenge gwetogia, oteba: “Inche ninche inde bweka, na onde tari onga buna inche.” Naki omochie oyio osarigwe otigaire bosa, obeire aase ching’iti chi’orosana chigotimokera! Kera omonto oraete ang’e noro nigo arabugie omororia ase ogokumia na gosamunsa amaboko aye.
Obobe nobwaye omochie oria osaririe na obeire oyo otachenegeti, oyio ochandire abanto baye!
Tori koigwera eriogi rinde rionsi, tori gwancha korongeigwa; tori komosemeria Omonene, gose komoika Nyasae oye ang’e.
Abagambi bare ime yaye nigo banga buna chindo chikoronya, na abagambi ebina baye nigo banga buna chisese chi’orosana chikoria mogoroba, tichiri gotigaria kende goika mambia.
Ababani baye nigo bagwetogia ase amang’ana abo abanyene; nigo bare abanto abang’ainereria; abakuani baye bakorire ekere egechenu koba egetachenegeti, na basaririe amachiko.

Omonene nigo agendererete gokora ayare ay’oboronge ime y’omochie oria, tari gokora ayare amabe; emambia ase emambia nigo akoorokia oboronge bwaye bwamoreka; ere tari komocha koboorokia, korende abwo batari abanyaboronge tibari korora obosooku.

“Nasiririe abanto b’ebisaku; chiburi chiabo chi’ogwekengera nachitagoire. Natigire chinchera chiabo chire bosa, onde tari ogoetera aroro; emechie yabo yatagoirwe yabeire amaturi, onde tamenyeti aroro.

Nigo natebetie abanto b’omochie oyo ng’a goika banyiroke na banche amorokererio ay’okobarongeyia, erinde tinsiria aase abo bamenyete, buna nabachikerete. Korende nigo bagendererete koba ababe goetania ase ogokora kwabo gwonsi.”

Bono Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase ayio monganye goika rituko riria riike ekero ndaimoke koira abooswa baane, ekiagera nanachire amang’ana aane ng’a nsangererie abanto b’ebisaku, na ab’amaruoti mbabeke amo, mbaumorere ekeririanda kiane na endamwamu yane yonsi entindi; ense yonsi esambwe nomorero bwe risemi riane.
“Ase engaki eyio ning’iranerie abanto enkwana y’emenwa echenegete, erinde bonsi babe bakorangeria erieta riane inche Omonene, na bagonkorera bare nomoyo oyomo.
Nonya nkorwa ng’umbu ye chindooche chi’Etiopia abanto baane abwo bagonsasima, abwo basiareretwe, mbandetere ebing’wanso.

Ase rituko erio inwe timogosookigwa ase engencho y’ogosaria gwonsi okwo mwakorete asende. Ekero ekio nindusie korwa ase egati yaino abanto baria abaenenu abeimokereria igoro, na inwe timokogenderera kweimokereria igoro mamincha y’egetunwa kiane egechenu.
Nintige ase egati yaino abanto abaitongo abagwekeyia. Abwo mbabe bagotamera erieta riane inche Omonene.
Abatigari b’Abaisraeli tibagokora ayare amabe, gose tibagokwana oborimo; chinkwana chi’obong’ainereria tichikorua ase emenwa yabo. Mbabe bakoragera na korara, na onde tari araboboyie.”
Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, tera neriogi rinene! Inwe Abaisraeli, aka eriogi! Inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, goka na gochenga ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi!
Omonene orusirie asemore ekina eke konya mwanacheirwe, oseririe ababisa baino. Omonene, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, nigo are ase egati yaino, timokoiroka bobe bonde.
Ase rituko riria amang’ana aya nakwanwe ase Yerusalemu: “Aye Sayoni, toiroka; totiga amaboko ao abe amoro.
Omonene, Nyasae oo, oyomenyete ase egati yao, nigo are omorwani etuoni okogotooria. Ere nigo akogokerete nomogoko omonene. Nabe okirete‐kiri ore nobwanchani bwaye; akogokere nogotera kw’omogoko.”
“Ninsangererie amo abwo baichanete, ekiagera berusananirie korwa ase omosangererekano bw’ogosasima. Barabwo nigo bare abao, betwekire chigurube chi’ogochaywa.
Rora, ase engaki eyio ning’ee abakogochanda bonsi egesusuro. Nintoorie ebirema, na nsangererie abwo baseretigwe. Abwo mbabe bagotogigwa na komanyekana buya, agwo ase kera ense babeire bachayire.

Ase engaki eyio nimbarente inka, ee, ase engaki eyio nimbasangererie. Nimbae erieta rinene rimanyekane, mobe mogotogigwa ase egati y’abanto bonsi b’ense, ekero ndabairanerie amaya aino moyarore.” Nabo Omonene akwanire.

Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi o gatano na rimo, omwaka o kabere, ekero Dario arenge omoruoti, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigatomwa goetera ase Hagai omobani, rigacha ase Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, oyorenge omogavuna bw’Abayuda, na ase Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki.
Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Abanto aba nigo bagokwana ng’a engaki teraika ekero enyomba y’Omonene egwenerete koagachwa naende.”
Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha goetera ase Hagai omobani, rikaboria:
“Inee! Eye nero engaki inwe mogwenerete komenya ase chinyomba chinyasi chiabo chitubire ne chibao chingiya, ekero enyomba eye egendererete koba ritombe?”
Ase ayio bono, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Inwe rengereria buna chinchera chiaino chiabeire.

Nigo mokobusura chimbusuro chinyinge, korende mwagesa chinke; nigo mokoragera, korende timori koigota; nkonywa more, korende timori goisaneka; nigo mokobeka chianga, korende timori koigwa riberera; oyo okonyora eng’eria, nigo akoyenyora erinde oyebeka ase omobuko obochogete.
Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Rengereria buna amang’ana aino abeire.
Tiira gochia ase ebitunwa igoro, morente emete moagachere enyomba eye, erio nario ndagokigwe nero, naende inyeorokie ng’a inche ninde nobonene.” Nabo Omonene atebire.

“Nigo mwasemeretie monyore ebinge, korende mokanyora ebike; na ekero mwabirentete inka, nkabirurukia bikagenda. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo nkobaboria: Nase ki yabete bo? Nekiagera enyomba yane yatigirwe egendererete koba ritombe, na kera oyomo oino nigo echanderete enyomba yaye omonyene.
Ase engencho eyio, riime rikorwa igoro riatangirwe na ense tekwama endagera.

Narentire eguru‐gura ase ense, na ase ebitunwa, na ase endagera, na ase emesabibu, na ase emezeituni, na ase kende gionsi kegokina ase riroba. Boigo nayerentire ase abanto, na ase emeremo yonsi abanto bagokora.”

Erio Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, amo nabatigari bonsi b’abanto bakaigwera eriogi ri’Omonene, Nyasae obo, na amang’ana ’omobani Hagai, oyio Omonene, Nyasae obo, atomete; abanto bakaba bakomoiroka Omonene.
Erio Hagai, omotomwa bw’Omonene, agakwana nabanto amang’ana ’Omonene, akabatebia, “Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Inche nigo inde amo nainwe.”

Erio Omonene agasukia omoika o Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, oyorenge omogavuna bw’Abayuda, na oyo o Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, na oyo bw’abatigari bonsi b’abanto. Bonsi amo bagacha bagakora emeremo ase enyomba y’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae obo.
Ayio nigo akorekanete ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o gatano na rimo, omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Dario.
Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na rimo, omotienyi o gatano na kabere, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha goetera ase Hagai omobani, rigateba:
“Kwana na Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, omogavuna bw’Abayuda, na Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, na abatigari bonsi b’abanto, obaborie:

Ning’o otigarete ase egati yaino oyo oroche obonene bw’enyomba eria entang’ani? Moise koreng’ania eye neria ya kare, naki eye ekororekana ase amaiso aino? Inee! Teri kororekana asemore ng’a negento bosa?

Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Aye Serubabeli, obe omokong’u na aye Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, obe omokong’u, nainwe abanto bonsi abamore ase ense eye, mobe abakong’u ase ogokora emeremo, ekiagera inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo inde amo nainwe.
Ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri nigo nabarierete eira ng’a botambe nigo ndabe amo nainwe; ase ayio Omoika one nigo ogendererete komenya ase egati yaino; timoiroka.
“Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Ara rimo naende, engaki enke yatigaire nintengechie igoro chionsi, na ense, na enyancha, amo nense enyomo.
Naende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Boigo nintengechie ebisaku bionsi, erinde ayaganeirie nabanto b’ebisaku bionsi aoroke, na inche ing’ichorie enyomba yane nobonene.
Chifeta nechiane, ne chitahabu nechiane. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.
Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba ng’a obonene bw’enyomba eye ya bono nabobe obonene goetania obw’eria ya kare. Aase aiga nindete omorembe obe okogambao. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.”
Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o kianda, omwaka o kabere, bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Dario, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Hagai omobani, rikamotebia:
“Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Boria abakuani naki amachiko agoteba.

Omonto aise kobogoria enyama enchenu ase omogo bw’eanga yaye akwambara, na akune nomogo bw’eanga eria omogati, gose endagera eiyekire, gose edivai, gose amaguta ’amazeituni, gose endagera ende yonsi, Inee, ekio giakunwa nkebe egechenu?” Abakuani bakairaneria, “Yaya.”

Naende Hagai akaboria, “Onye omonto obeire oyotachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo karakune ekemo ase ebinto ebio, Inee, ekio nakebe egetachenegeti?” Abakuani bakairaneria, bagateba, “Ee, nkebe egetachenegeti.”

“Erio Hagai akairaneria, agateba,” “Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Naboigo nabanto aba, na egesaku eke, bare ase obosio bwane, na kera omoremo bagokora namaboko abo nabo ore, na kende gionsi eke bakorua aroro nigo kere egetachenegeti.
“Ase ayio nigo nkobaboria ng’a korwa rituko ria rero mobe mokorengereria buna yarenge ekero keria rigena konya ritarabekwa igoro ase rigena rinde, ase okoagacha Hekalu y’Omonene.

Ninki kiabete ase amatuko aria? Ekero omonto arenge kogenda ase etui y’emesaima ng’a anyore emesaima emerongo ebere, onyora ikomi yoka, na ekero arenge kogenda ase amasabibu akomiterwa ng’a anyore ebibekerero emerongo etano biichire edivai, onyora emerongo ebere bioka.
Nigo nabaagete ase okobarentera oborwaire enyagetabo, na obw’okorigisia, na embura y’amagena ase chindagera chiaino mwakorerete emeremo. Nonya naboigo timwang’iranerete. Nabo Omonene atebire.
Korwa rituko ria rero, rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o kianda, ekero oboroso bwe Hekalu y’Omonene bwabegetwe, na kogenderera, morengererie buna arabe!
Inee! Chimbusuro nchire ase ebiage? Inee! Emesabibu, na emeko, na emekomomanga, na emezeituni tiyangeti kwama? Korende korwa rituko ria rero nimbasesenie.”
Ase rituko riria ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi oria o kianda, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Hagai naende, rikamotebia,
“Kwana na Serubabeli, omogavuna bw’Abayuda, omotebie ng’a inche nintengechie igoro chionsi amo nense.

Ning’onchorane ebirogo bi’obonene bw’abaruoti, ninsirie chinguru chi’amaruoti ’abanto b’ebisaku. Ning’onchorane chigari na abachiriini; chibarasi nchigwe amo nabachiriinete, kera omonto naite oyomwabo nomoro.

Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Ase rituko riria ninkoire aye Serubabeli omosomba one, mosinto o Sealitieli. Naende Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Ningokore obe buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio kiane, ekiagera nagochorire. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.”
Ase omotienyi o gatano na gatato, omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kwa Dario ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase omobani Zakaria, mosinto o Berekia o Ido, rikamotebia,
“Omonene nigo agechetigwe mono ne chisokoro chiaino.
Ase ayio tebia abanto: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Ing’iranere inche Omonene bw’Emeganda, nainche nimbairanere. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.

Timobaisa koba buna chisokoro chiaino, abwo ababani ba kare barerete asebare, bakabatebia: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Onchoka, motige chinchera chiaino chimbe, na ogokora kwaino okobe. Korende chisokoro chiaino tichiategererete chinyigwere. Nabo Omonene agoteba.
Bono chisokoro chiaino ng’ai chire? Na ababani baino, ng’ai bare? Inee! Mbagendererete koba moyo botambe?

Amang’ana aane na emeroberio yane echikire, ayio naruete goetera ase abasomba baane ababani nigo yasoete ase chinkoro chie chisokoro chiaino. Barabwo nigo beitetie bagateba: Buna Omonene bw’Emeganda arengereretie gotokorera ase engencho ye chinchera chiaito na ogokora gwaito, naboigo atokoreire.”

Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o ikomi nomo, noro okorokwa Sebati, omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kwa Dario, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende inche omobani Zakaria, mosinto o Berekia o Ido.

Nkarora ase okorora kwa botuko omonto oriinete ebarasi embariri. Omonto oyio nigo ateneine ase egati y’emete ekorokwa emehadasi yarenge ase rigoko. Na nyuma yaye nchiarengeo chibarasi chinde chimbariri, na echire chibarati, ne chindabu.
Erio nkaboria Omonene one, ninki engencho ye chibarasi echi? Omomalaika oria okwanete nainche, agantebia. “Ninkworokie engencho ye chibarasi echi.”
Ase ayio omonto oria oteneine ase egati y’emehadasi eria akang’iraneria, agantebia, “Chibarasi echio nachio Omonene atomire chietanane ase ense yonsi.”
Chibarasi chigatebia omomalaika bw’Omonene, oria oteneine ase egati y’emehadasi eria, “Twaetananire ase ense yonsi, twarorire ng’a ense yonsi nigo etoererete ekirete‐kiri.”

Erio omomalaika oria bw’Omonene akaboria, “Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, ngoika ririri orabe otari kororera Yerusalemu, na emechie y’Abayuda amabera, eyio kwabeire kogechirie mono nero ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere (70)?”
Omonene akairaneria amang’ana amaya na ay’okoremia ase omomalaika ori a okwanete nainche.
Ase ayio omomalaika oria agantebia, “Raria, otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Nigo inde ne risemi rinene ase engencho ya Yerusalemu na Sayoni.
Nigo ngechirie mono nabanto b’ebisaku ebio batoererete, bakirete‐kiri, ekiagera ekero nagechetigwe ake nabarabwo, nigo bamentete korenta emechando.

Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Inche nairanire Yerusalemu na koyororera amabera. Enyomba neagachwe imeo, na engori y’okorengera eramborwe igoro ya Yerusalemu. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.
“Raria naende, otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Emechie yane neichorigwe nogosesenigwa okonge, na inche Omonene nindemie Sayoni naende, na ninchore Yerusalemu obe oyone naende.”
Naende nkarigereria, nkarora chingunchara inye.

Erio nkaboria omomalaika oria konya okwanire nainche, “Ninki engencho ye chingunchara echi?” Ere akairaneria, agantebia, “Chingunchara echi nachio chiasiarerete Abayuda, na Abaisraeli, na abanto ba Yerusalemu.”
Erio Omonene akanyorokia abaturi b’ebioma bane.

Naende nkaboria, “Abanto aba, ninki bacha gokora aa?” Ere akairaneria, agantebia, “Chingunchara chiria chiasiarerete Abayuda gochia aaria na aaria, goika monto onde tanyarete koimokia omotwe oye igoro. Bono abanto aba bachire gochiondokia na kobutora chingunchara chi’abanto b’ebisaku, baria baimokereretie chingunchara chiabo igoro y’ense y’Abayuda, chigasiarera abamenyeteo.”
Naende nkarigereria, nkarora omonto obwate engori y’okorengera ase okoboko kwaye.
Erio nkamoboria, “Ng’ai okogenda?” Ere akairaneria agantebia, “Yerusalemu ngochia korenga, erinde imanye obogare bwaye, na obotambe bwaye.”
Erio nkarora omomalaika oria konya okwanire nainche ogocha, na omomalaika onde agacha koumerana nere,
akamotebia, “Minyoka, otebie omomura oria obwate engori y’okorengera ng’a Yerusalemu nomenywe buna emechie etagiteiri chindwaki, ekiagera nobe nabanto abange ne chitugo chinyinge.
Omonene otebire ng’a nere bweka omonyene orabe orwaki rw’omorero ase chinsemo chionsi chi’omochie oyio, ere neorokie imeo abe obonene bwaye.”
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Imoka! Imoka motame, morue ase ense ya sugusu, ekiagera ninche nabasiarerete buna ngosiarera chimbeo inye chia igoro.” Nabo Omonene agoteba.
“Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, inwe abamomenyete amo nabanto ba Babeli, imoka motame, mwetoorie!”
Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Ere oyontomire ase abanto b’ebisaku abwo babasakorete ing’orokie obonene bwaye, ekiagera oyo orabakune inwe, oyio nabe okunire endorero y’eriso riaye.
Rora, ninsamunse amaboko aane igoro yabo, barabwo mbabe abasomba b’abwo barenge kobakorera.” Erio nario moramanye ng’a Omonene bw’Emeganda ontomire.
“Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, goka na gochenga! Naama! Ngocha inde komenya ase egati yaino.” Nabo Omonene atebire.

“Ase ekero ekio abanto b’ebisaku ebinge mbabwatane nainche Omonene; barabwo mbabe abanto baane. Ee, inche nimenye ase egati yaino.” Erio nario moramanye ng’a Omonene bw’Emeganda nere ontomire gocha asemore.
Omonene naire Abayuda babe omwando oye ore ase ense eye enchenu, nachore Yerusalemu obe omochie oye naende.
Inwe abanto bonsi, tegerera mokire‐kiri ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera otenenire ngosoka are korwa ase Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu.
Naende Omonene akanyorokia Yoshua, omokuani omonene, oteneine ase obosio bw’omomalaika bw’Omonene, na Saitani oteneine ase ensemo ya borio ya Yoshua okomosoera.

Erio Omonene agatebia Saitani, “Aye Saitani, inche Omonene ningotogonyere! Ee, inche Omonene nachorire Yerusalemu, ningotogonyere! Inee! Omonto oyo tari ekegenga giataboretigwe korwa ase omorero ime?”
Bono Yoshua nigo ateneine ase obosio bw’omomalaika, obegete chianga chire ne riko.

Erio omomalaika oria agachika abwo bateneineo ase okomokorera, akabatebia, “Morusie chianga echio chire ne riko.” Nyuma y’ayio omomalaika oria agatebia Yoshua, “Naama! Narusirie ebibe biao korwa asore, ninkobekere chianga chingiya chi’omoyega.”
Erio inche ngateba, “Bono mobekere egetambaa ekerabu motwe.” Ase igo bakamobekera egetambaa ekerabu motwe na bakamobekera ne chianga chiria chingiya, ekero omomalaika oria bw’Omonene ateneineo.
Erio omomalaika oria bw’Omonene akamoenekeria Yoshua, akamotebia,

“Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Korabwatie chinchera chiane, na obwate aya nagochikeire, rirorio nogambere enyomba yane, na orende chiraaro chiane. Ninkoe ribaga ogochera asende amo nabwo bagonkorera aiga.

Aye Yoshua, omokuani omonene, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aya, aye amo nabagisangio bao, abwo baikaransete ase obosio bwao, ekiagera abwo nabanto bare ekemanyererio ki’amang’ana agochigocha: Naama! Inche nintome omosomba one okorokwa Omoseboka.

Rigereria, ase obosio bwa Yoshua nabekire rigena erimo; nareo amaiso atano na abere arigereretie rigena erio. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo ngoteba iga: Nimang’ere ase rigena erio ririko ririgwenerete, na nindusie ebibe bi’ense eye ase rituko erimo.
Ase rituko erio kera oyomo oino narangerie oyomwabo ache, baikaranse komo inse y’emesabibu na emeko yaye.” “Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.”
Omomalaika oria okwanete nainche ritang’ani agacha naende, agantura buna omonto oraire agoturwa korwa ase chitoro.

Ere akamboria, “Ninki oroche?” Nkairaneria, nkamotebia, “Nigo ndoche ekebekerero gie chitaya keroiseirie etahabu yoka, na igoro yaye egetaabo ki’amaguta ngeterekereireo, ne chitaya isano na ibere nchireo, na emebirangwa etano na ebere ekorenta amaguta nigo esoete ase kera etaya ebekire igoro yaye.
Mbarabare ase ekebekerero keria gie chitaya nereo emezeituni ebere, oyomo ensemo y’okorio na oyonde ensemo y’okobee.”
Erio nkaboria omomalaika oria okwanete nainche, “Omonene one, ninki engencho y’ebinto ebi?”
Erio akang’iraneria, akamboria, “Inee! Tomanyeti engencho y’ebinto ebi?” Nkamoiraneria, “Yaya, omonene one, timanyeti.”

Erio akairaneria, agantebia, “Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riachierete Serubabeli, rikamotebia: Ayio tagokoreka ase chinguru, gose ase okobua kw’omonto, korende nase Omoika one. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.

Aye egetunwa ekenene, ninki oisaine ase obosio bwa Serubabeli? Noiranigwe inse obe buna ense omweya. Serubabeli nabeke rigena ri’ogokoorera, abanto kobaakire eriogi, bagoteba: Obuya, obuya bobe igoro yaye!”
Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia,
“Serubabeli obekire oboroso bw’enyomba eye namaboko aye, boigo nere orayekoore namaboko aye. Erio nario oramanye ng’a Omonene bw’Emeganda nere ontomete asemore.

Ning’o orachaye rituko ri’amang’ana amake kagochaka, ekero amaiso aria atano na abere ararore ekebiro ase okoboko gwa Serubabeli, nagoke? “Ayio atano na abere namaiso ’Omonene arigereretie chinsemo chionsi chi’ense.”
Naende nkaboria omomalaika oria, “Emezeituni eye ebere, oyomo ore ensemo y’okorio na oyonde ensemo y’okobee y’ekebekerero keria gie chitaya, neya ki?”
Nkamoboria okoboria gwa kabere, “Ninki engencho ye chinsagia echio ibere chi’emezeituni chire mbarabare ase emebirangwa eyio ebere eroiseirie etahabu, eyio amaguta agoetera?”
Akairaneria, akamboria, “Inee! Tomanyeti engencho y’ebinto ebi?” Nkamokania, “Yaya, omonene one, timanyeti.”
Erio agantebia, “Aba nabwo abaakwa amaguta babere, abagotenena ase okomokorera Omonene bw’ense engima.”
Nkaimokia amaiso aane naende, nkarora ebuku eringanirie ekoiruruka.
Omomalaika oria akamboria, “Ninki oroche?” Nkairaneria, nkamotebia, “Nigo ndoche ebuku eringanirie ekoiruruka; obotambe bwaye nobw’amaboko emerongo ebere, na obogare bwaye amaboko ikomi.”

Erio agantebia, “Okwo nokoragererigwa gwachiereire ense yonsi. Kera oyokoiba narusigwe korwa aiga, buna koreng’ana arikire ase ebuku eyio, na kera oyogotiana narusigwe boigo korwa aiga, buna koreng’ana arikire ase ebuku eyio.

Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Nintome ebuku eyio ase enyomba y’omoibi, na ase enyomba y’oyo ogotiana ogotiana kw’oborimo ase erieta riane; ebuku eyio nebeere ase chinyomba chi’abanto abwo echisirie kegima, chibao chiabo amo namagena abo.”
Omomalaika oria orenge gokwana nainche agacha naende, agantebia, “Imokia amaiso ao, orore ngento ki keria kegocha.”
Nkamoboria, “Ngento ki keria?” Akang’iraneria agantebia, “Keria negetonga gi’okorenga kegocha; kerokio nigo getenenerete obobe bw’abanto b’ense yonsi.”
Nkarigereria, nkarora ekemumeko kiaroiseirie risasi gekomumoka, na omokungu oikaransete ase egetonga keria ime.
Omomalaika oria agateba, “Obo nabwo Obobe.” Erio akaigatera omokungu oria ime ase egetonga keria, agakong’ontera ekemumeko igoro ase omonwa bw’egetonga keria.

Erio nkaimokia amaiso aane, nkarora abakungu babere bakooroka. Embeo egasoa ase chimbaba chiabo chiarenge buna echie riagonga. Abakungu abwo bakaimokia egetonga keria, bakairuruka nakerokio gochia gati‐gati y’ense na igoro.
Nkaboria omomalaika oria orenge gokwana nainche, “Ng’ai bakoira egetonga keria?”
Akairaneria, agantebia, “Nigo bagokeira ase ense ya Sinari, na aroro agwo baagachere omokungu oria enyomba, erinde ekoera bamobekeo, abeere aase aye.”
Naende nkarigereria nkarora chigari inye chigosoka korwa ase egati y’ebitunwa bibere, na ebitunwa biria nigo biarenge ebi’etaai.
Egari ye ritang’ani nigo yarenge kong’uswa ne chibarasi chimbariri, na eya kabere ne chibarasi chimwamu,
na eya gatato ne chibarasi chindabu, na eya kane ne chibarasi chire matonto, chionsi nigo chiarenge ne chinguru mono.
Erio nkaboria omomalaika oria orenge gokwana nainche, “Omonene one, ninki engencho ye chibarasi echi?”
Ere akairaneria, agantebia, “Echi nechimbeo inye chia igoro chikogenda korwa ase konya chiteneine agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’ense yonsi.
“Egari eria ekong’uswa ne chibarasi chimwamu nigo ekogenda ase ense ya sugusu, na eria ye chibarasi chindabu eyebwatie, na eria ye chibarasi chire matonto nigo ekogenda gochia ase ense ya irianyi.”
Ekero chibarasi chiria chiarenge ne chinguru mono chiasogete chikagania kogenda goetanana ase ense yonsi. Omomalaika oria agachitebia, “Genda moetanane ase ense yonsi.” Nachirochio chigakora bo.
Erio omomalaika oria agaaka eriogi, agantebia, “Naama! Chibarasi echio chiagendete ase ense ya sugusu chiatoereirie omoika one ase ense eria.”
Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
“Oegwe ebiegwa korwa ase Helidai na Tobia, na Yedaya, abanto abwo bairane korwa Babeli ase barenge abasomba. Ase rituko erio erio ogende ase enyomba ya Yosia, mosinto o Sefania, ase basoete.
Ekero kwaeirwe chifeta ne chitahabu oroisie egutwa korwa ase ebinto ebio, oyebeke ase omotwe o Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki.
Okwane nere, omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Naama! Oyomo nachiche okorokwa Omoseboka, ere naseboke korwa aase aye, aagache Hekalu y’Omonene

Ee, ere naagache Hekalu y’Omonene, abe omoruoti osikire, aikaranse ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti. Naende nere orabe omokuani ase ekerogo kiaye; na abwo babere mbaigwane babe bakogamba amang’ana ay’omorembe.
Egutwa eyio negenderere kobeera ime ase Hekalu y’Omonene koba ekeinyorio kia Helidai, na Tobia, na Yedaya, na Heni, mosinto o Sefania.

“Abanto bamenyete aare mbachiche gokonya koagacha Hekalu y’Omonene. Erio nario moramanye ng’a Omonene bw’Emeganda nere ontomete asemore. Amang’ana ayio nigo araikerane koraigwe eriogi ri’Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
Ase rituko ria kane, omotienyi o kianda noro Kisilewi, omwaka o kane bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Dario, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende inche Zakaria.
Abanto ba Beteli konya batomire Sareseri, na Regemu‐Meleki, na abanto bande babo bagende gosaba Omonene, erinde banyore ogwancherwa korwa asare;
boigo baborie abakuani b’enyomba y’Omonene bw’Emeganda na ababani. “Inee! Ntogenderere korera na kweng’ata ase omotienyi o gatano, buna twabeire togokora ase engaki y’emiaka emenge?”
Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda rigacha asende, rigantebia,

“Kwana nabanto bonsi b’ense eye, na abakuani, obaborie: Ekero mwarenge kweng’ata na korera ase kera omotienyi o gatano, na oyo o gatano na kabere, ase chingaki echi chionsi chi’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere, Inee, nigo mwarenge kweng’ata ase engencho yane?
Na ekero mokoria na konywa, Inee, timori gokora ayio ase ogweisanekia inwe abanyene?

“Inee! Amang’ana ayio agwenerete mono tari aro Omonene orenge gokwana goetera ase ababani ba kare, ekero ekio Yerusalemu omenyire nabanto, na igo orenge osesenirie ore nemechie yaye yayoetanaine, naende abanto bamenyete ase ense ya irianyi na ase ense omweya?”
Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende inche Zakaria, rigantebia,
“Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Monache ebina bia boronge, na kera omonto abe nobwanchani na amabera ase oyomwabo.
Timokorera ababoraka bobe, gose chintakana, gose abamenyi bare ase egati yaino, gose abataka. Omonto tabaisa koroberia ase enkoro yaye akorere oyomwabo bobe.
“Korende abanto bakaba abamwenu, bakaanga koigwera, bagaticha amato abo ng’a tibabaisa koigwa.

Bagakong’ia chinkoro chiabo pa buna rigena rikorokwa elimasi ng’a tibabaisa koigwera amachiko na amang’ana ’Omonene bw’Emeganda atomete n’Omoika oye goetera ase ababani ba kare. Ase engencho eyio Omonene bw’Emeganda akaba nendamwamu enene.
Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Buna koreng’ana barabwo bataigwerete ekero nabarangeretie, bono nainche tinkoigwa ekero barandangerie.

Ase ayio nigo ndarente ekembugu‐mbugu mbasiarere gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku, abwo batabamanyeti. Ense eye egatigwa ere bosa, na omonto onde tarenge goeta ase egati yaye, gose koiranao, ekiagera ense eyio engiya nigo egotigwa ere bosa.”
Ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda rigacha asende, rigantebia:
“Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Inche nigo inde ne risemi rinene mono ase engencho ya Sayoni; ee, risemi erio riagerire nabeire nendamwamu enene ase engencho yaye.
Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ning’irane gocha ase Sayoni, imenye ase egati‐gati ya Yerusalemu, na Yerusalemu norokwe Omochie bw’Obwegenwa, na egetunwa ki’Omonene bw’Emeganda nakerokwe Egetunwa Egechenu.
Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Abagaaka na abang’ina nabanyorekane ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu naende, kera oyomo nabe nenyimbo yaye agwesiirera, ekiagera babeire abagotu mono.
Naende ase chinchera chi’omochie oyio abana abange, abamura na abaiseke, inababe bakogosoreria aroro.
“Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Onye amang’ana ayio are ay’ogokumia ase abatigari b’egesaku eke, Inee, nabe ay’ogokumia asende boigo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda?
Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Rora, nintoorie abanto baane, mbarente korwa ase chinse chia moocha na bosongo.
Ekero nabarentire, nabamenye ase egati‐gati ya Yerusalemu babe abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo ase obwegenwa na oboronge.

“Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Mobe abaremu! Inwe bono mwabeire mokoigwa amang’ana ayio ababani barenge gokwana, ekero oboroso bw’enyomba y’Omonene bw’Emeganda bware kobekwa, ng’a Hekalu neagachwe naende.

Agwo ritang’ani ase amatuko ayio, monto onde bwensi tarenge konyora eng’eria ende ase emeremo arenge gokora, gose ng’iti ende yonsi yarenge gokora emeremo tiyarenge goakanerwa. Ase engencho y’obobisa onde tarenge na morembe kagosoka gose gakoirana, ekiagera nigo naseegetete kera omonto kwomana noyomwabo.
Korende bono tingokorera abatigari b’abanto aba buna nakorerete ab’amatuko aria a kare. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.
Bono mbasimeke chimbusuro chiabo bare nomorembe; emesabibu inayame amasabibu, ne riroba narirente okwama kwaye, boigo na igoro nachirente riime. Nimbae abanto aba abatigari ebinto bionsi bibe ebiabo.

Inwe Abayuda na Abaisraeli, buna koreng’ana abanto b’ebisaku barenge koragereria ase erieta riaino, bono ekero ndabatoorie, abanto mbabe bagosesenia ase erieta riaino, Timoiroka, korende mobe abaremu!
“Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Buna koreng’ana naroberetie kobarentera amabe, ekero chisokoro chiaino chiakorete ebibe chikagera nkaba nendamwamu, gose tinaonchorete omoroberio oyio,
boigo ase amatuko aya narobeirie gokora amaya ase abanto ba Yerusalemu na ase Abayuda. Ase ayio timoiroka!
Amang’ana aya naro morakore: Kera omonto akwane ekeene noyomwabo; monache ebina bia boronge na ebi’omorembe agwo ase ebiita biaino.

Timobaisa gokora emeroberio emebe ase chinkoro chiaino ase ogokorerana bobe inwe ase inwe, gose timobaisa gwancha gotiana ogotiana kw’oborimo, ekiagera amang’ana ayio onsi nigo inyagechete. Nabo Omonene atebire.”
Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda rigacha asende, rigantebia:

“Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Chingaki chi’okweng’ata ase omotienyi o kane, na oyo o gatano, na oyo o gatano na kabere, na oyo o ikomi, nachibe ase Abayuda chingaki chi’omogoko na omochengo, na Amatuko Amanene ay’okwegokia. Ase ayio mwanche ekeene na omorembe.
“Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Engaki ngocha ere, ekero abanto abange bararue ase emechie emenge, bache aa.
Abanto b’omochie oyomo mbagende batebie ab’omochie onde: Inchuo togende bwango, torigie ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, ee, inchuo torigie Omonene bw’Emeganda! Nainche nkogenda inde.
Abanto abange, na abanto b’ebisaku ebinge bire ne chinguru, mbachiche Yerusalemu korigia Omonene bw’Emeganda, na korigia ogwancherwa ase obosio bwaye.

Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Ase amatuko ayio abanto ikomi ba kera egesaku bagokwana emenwa ao ao mbache babwate omokoba bw’omwambaro bw’Omoyahudi, batebe: Intwe ntorigetie kogenda amo nainwe, ekiagera twaigure ng’a Nyasae nigo are amo nainwe.”
Eri nering’ana rikong’u riakwanetwe n’Omonene igoro y’ense ya Hadaraki, riikere nonya nomochie o Damesiki. Amaiso ’abanto b’ebisaku amo nay’Abaisraeli nigo arigereretie Omonene.
Boigo ring’ana erio riikere ense ya Hamati esinyaine na Damesiki, riikere na Turo na Sidoni, nonya abanto b’aroro bare abang’aini mono.
Turo bweagacheire chiburi chinkong’u, naende osangereirie chindwenyi chie chifeta chinyinge buna orotu, ne chitahabu chinyinge buna eubi ere ase chinchera.
Korende rora, Omonene nayoure chinibo chiaye, na atugute okobua kwaye ase enyancha, na omochie oyio omonyene nosambwe nomorero.
Ekero Asikeloni orarore ayio, noiroke mono; Gasa boigo noro noiroke na goichana; naboigo n’Ekironi, ekiagera ogosemeria kwaye gwasirigwe. Omoruoti o Gasa nasirigwe, na abanto tibakomenya Asikeloni.
Asidodi nomenywe nabanto batarochi inchera, na inche Omonene ninsirie kegima oboenenu bw’Abafilisti.

Nindusie amanyinga ’ebing’wanso korwa ase emenwa yabo, na okogechia koria korwa ase amaino abo; na barabwo nababe abatigari ba Nyasae oito, nababe buna abagambi b’egesaku ki’Abayuda, abanto b’Ekironi nababe abatigari ba Nyasae oito, nababe buna abagambi b’egesaku ki’Abayuda, abanto b’Ekironi nababe buna Abayebusi.
Erio inche Omonene nindende enyomba yane, erinde abarwani b’esegi tibabaisa goeterao gose koiranerao; na abachandi b’abanto baane tibabaisa gochao, ekiagera bono inche ninyerigererie namaiso aane.

Inwe abanto ba Sayoni goka mono! Ee, inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, aka eriogi ri’omochengo! Rora, omoruoti oino nkobachera are; ere nomonyene oboronge na omobui. Nigo are omokanyeku oriinete etigere, ee, oriinete emori y’etigere, akamori g’etigere.

Ninsirie chigari chi’esegi korwa ase abanto ba Efraimu, ne chibarasi chi’esegi korwa Yerusalemu. Ninsirie na amata ’esegi. Omoruoti oyio nararerie abanto b’ebisaku omorembe. Obogambi bwaye nabobe korwa enyancha eyemo goika eyende, na korwa ase Orooche rwa Eufarati goika ase chinsinyo chi’ense.
“Ase engencho y’amanyinga ’okobwatana okwo nakorire naye ninsibore abasibwa bao, mbarusie ase engoro etari namache.
Inwe abasibwa more nogosemeria, irana ase eburi yaino. Ase rituko ria rero nigo nkobarareria inwe ng’a nimbae amaya ara kabere.

Nakumbire Abayuda buna nkumbete obota bwane, naagirie Abaefraimu buna ensara ng’agetie ase obota bwane. Aye Sayoni, ninkore abana bao abamura babe buna amatimo, barwanerie abamura b’Abagiriki; ningokore obe buna omoro bw’omorwani esegi etuoni.”
Omonene naoroke igoro y’abanto baye, ne chinsara chiaye chisoke buna okomesa gw’enkoba. Omonene Nyasae nabugie egetureri, achiche nekembugu‐mbugu gekorwa sugusu.

Omonene bw’Emeganda nakengere abanto baye, barabwo mbasirie ababisa babo, batiringe amagena e chinduruche chiabo. Mbanywe batinde, baake amariogi, babe buna abanto batindire edivai. Mbaichorigwe buna ebitaabo bi’amanyinga ’ebing’wanso, na babe buna chikoona chi’egesasimero chiichire amanyinga.
Ase rituko riria Omonene, Nyasae obo, nabatoorie, ekiagera nigo bare abanto be riicho riaye. Barabwo nigo bare buna amagena e rigori rinene abekire ase egutwa, akomeka‐meka na komoreka ase ense yaye.
Ee, naki obuya bwaye na obosiani bwaye bore bw’ogokumia! Endagera yaye nenorie abamura baye bagirigente, na edivai yaye enyia nenorie abaiseke baye bagirigente.
Inwe saba Omonene abatwerie embura y’okwamia endagera ase engaki yaye. Omonene natonge amare akomesa, na atwerie abanto embura na koa kera oyomo endagera korwa mogondo.

Ebinyasae bire ase chinyomba nigo bigokwana amang’ana are bosa, na amaroro ’abaringoria nay’oborimo. Abaroti chindoto nigo bagokwana chindoto chi’obong’ainereria, na baremia abande ase okoremia kwa bosa. Ase engencho eyio abanto nigo bagotayaya buna riicho rie ching’ondi, bachandegete, ekiagera tibabwati omorisia.

“Endamwamu yane nigo egwoka igoro y’abarisia, ning’ee chigoree chiria egesusuro, ekiagera inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo ndendete riicho riane nabwo abanto b’enyomba ya Yuda; nindikore ribe ebarasi yane engiya y’esegi.
Rigena ri’ekoona narinyorekane korwa ase abanto abwo. Boigo korwa asebare ekerochi ki’eema na obota bw’esegi mbinyorekane, naende kera omogambi nanyorekane korwa asebare.
Barabwo mbabe buna chituoni chi’esegi, batiringere ababisa babo inse buna eubi ere ase chinchera. Mbarwane, ekiagera inche Omonene nigo inde amo nabarabwo, basookie abariini be chibarasi.”

“Ning’ee Abayuda chinguru, ee, nintoorie abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu. Nimbairanie bamenye inka, ekiagera nabaroreire amabera; barabwo mbarorekane buna inche konya timbaangeti, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo, ninyigwe ogosaba kwabo.
Abanto ba Efraimu mbabe buna chituoni chi’esegi, bagoke ase chinkoro chiabo buna abanyure edivai. Abana babo mbarore ayio, bagoke, mbagokere Omonene ase chinkoro chiabo ime.
“Nimbasime, mbasangererie amo, ekiagera nababooririe, na barabwo mbamentekane babe abange buna barenge kare.
Nonya nabasiarerete gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, mbabe bakong’inyora ase chinse chiria chi’aare. Barabwo mbabe moyo amo nabana babo, naende bairane inka.
Nimbairanie inka korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nimbasangererie korwa ase ense y’Asuri; mbabeke ase ense ya Gileadi na ase Lebanoni, mbaichore aroro goika baborwe aase bakomenya.

Ekero baraete ase egati y’enyancha y’emechando, inche Omonene ning’ake emerindo yaye, ne chindiba chionsi chi’orooche rwa Naili nchikame; na igo oboenenu bw’Abaasuri mbotiringerwe inse, na enyimbo y’obogambi ya Misiri nesirigwe.
Inche nimbeke abanto baane chinguru ime yane inche Omonene, barabwo mbabe bagotaara ase erieta riane.” Omonene okwanire ayio.
Aye Lebanoni, igora ebisieri biao, erinde omorero osambe emecharake yao.
Aye omotarakwa, rera, ekiagera omocharake oiyerigwe inse. Emete ere nobonene yasirigwe. Inwe emete enga emetontera ere Basani, rera, ekiagera rinani rinoru riaiyerigwe inse.
Tegerera moigwe buna abarisia bakorera bono ekero obonene na obuya bwabo bwasirigwe! Tegerera moigwe buna chindo chinsae chikoruma bono ekero rinani rinoru ria Yorodan riasirigwe!
Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae one, agoteba: “Risia riicho rie ching’ondi echio chiachikeirwe konyenywa.

Abanto bagochigora nigo bagochinyenya, tibari korora ng’a mbare nokomocha, na abwo bagochioonia nigo bagoteba: Omonene atogigwe, ekiagera twenyoreire obonda obonge. Nonya nabarisia babo abanyene tibari gochirorera amabera.

“Bono tinkogenderera kororera abanto b’ense eye amabera. Naama! Nindue kera oyomo agwe ase okoboko kw’oyomwabo, na ase okoboko kw’omoruoti oye; abaruoti babo mbasarie ense, na inche tingotooria nonya nomonto oyomo korwa ase amaboko abo.” Nabo Omonene agoteba.

Ase ayio nkaba nkorisia riicho rie ching’ondi chiria chiarenge gochia konyenywa, ee, ching’ondi chiria chiachandegete. Nkaimokia chinyimbo ibere, eyemo nkayeroka “Ogwancherwa” na eyende “Obomo”. Erio nkaba nkorisia ching’ondi chiria.
Ngasiria abarisia batato ase omotienyi oyomo. Erio nkagechigwa ne ching’ondi chiane, nachirochio chikangecha.
Erio ngateba: “Inche tinkobarisia inwe rinde. Oyo ogokwa, tiga akwe, na oyo ogosirigwa, tiga asirigwe, na abatigari babe bakorianana.”
Erio nkaimokia enyimbo eria yane yarenge korokwa “Ogwancherwa”, nkayebuna, na igo ngasaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania okwo konya nakorire nabanto bonsi.
Ase ayio okobwatana koria kogasarigwa ase rituko riria, ne ching’ondi chiria chiachandegete, chiria chiansemeretie chikamanya ng’a ring’ana riria riakoretwe nigo riarwete ase Omonene.
Erio ngatebia abanto baria: “Onye moroche ng’a mbuya, ing’a eng’eria yane; onye taibo, yegache.” Barabwo bakarenga chibesa chie chifeta emerongo etato chikaba eng’eria yane.

Omonene agantebia “Chirute ase omokori chinyongo.” (Rigori eri rinene nakoreretwe nabanto baria.) Erio nkaimokia chibesa chiria chie chifeta emerongo etato, ngachiruta ase enyomba y’Omonene, ase omokori chinyongo oria.
Nyuma y’ayio nkabuna enyimbo eria ya kabere yarenge korokwa “Obomo,” na igo ngasaria okoigwana kwarenge ase egati y’Abayuda na Abaisraeli.
Erio Omonene agantebia, “Bono imokia ebikorero bi’omorisia oyio otagwenereti kende.

Rora, nkorenta nde omorisia ase ense eye oyio otari gwechandera ching’ondi echio chigochia gokwa, gose korigia chinsiru, gose korwaria echiabunekire, gose korageria echire buya, korende nigo ararie chinyama chi’echire chinoru na achimiora‐miorie nonya nebitaago biabo.

Obobe nobwaye omorisia oyio otagwenereti, oyio ogotiga riicho rie ching’ondi! Tiga omoro oake okoboko kwaye na eriso riaye ria borio. Tiga okoboko kwaye kwome pa, na eriso riaye ria borio riukore kegima!”
Eri ne ring’ana rikong’u ri’Omonene igoro y’Abaisraeli: Aya naro Omonene agoteba, oyio oramborete igoro chionsi na akabeka oboroso bw’ense, oyio otongete omoika ime ase omonto:

“Rora, inche nigo inde ang’e gokora Yerusalemu obe buna egekombe kere nekenyugwa kegotindia ase abanto bonsi bamenyete ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, boigo nkebanyore Abayuda ekero Yerusalemu orache koboerwa.

Ekero engaki eyio eraike, ninkore Yerusalemu obe buna rigena ririto ase abanto bonsi; bonsi abarateeme korietweka mbateke chingoma abanyene. Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bi’ense nabasangererekane amo bayoumokere.

Ase engaki eyio nindutere kera ebarasi omoondoko, na omonto oyeriinete abe ebarimo. Korende nimbe ndigereretie na korenda Abayuda, ekero ndaukorie chibarasi chi’abanto b’ebisaku.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
Erio abagambi b’egesaku ki’Abayuda mbetebie ase chinkoro chiabo ime: “Abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu nigo babwate chinguru goetera ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae obo.

“Ase engaki eria ninkore abagambi b’egesaku ki’Abayuda babe buna orogio rore nomorero ogosamba chinko, naende buna ekieri ki’omorero ogosamba emesaima y’amasakwe. Barabwo mbasambe abanto bonsi bamenyete ase chinsemo chiabo chionsi, basirie aande onsi, ensemo ya borio na eya bomosi, korende Yerusalemu nogenderere kobeera ase ore bono.
“Inche Omonene nintoorie obomenyo bw’Abayuda ritang’ani, erinde abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, na aba Yerusalemu, tibabaisa gwetogia ng’a mbare nobonene igoro y’Abayuda.

Ase engaki eyio Omonene nakengere abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu, erinde oyore omworo mono ase egati yabo abe buna Daudi, na abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi babe buna Nyasae, ee, buna omomalaika bw’Omonene oyo obatang’aine.
Ase engaki eyio ninganie gosiria abanto b’ebisaku bionsi barache korwania Yerusalemu.

“Ning’umorere abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, na aba Yerusalemu, omoika bw’amabera na ogosaba. Ekero barandigererie mbarore oyo babetete babe bakondeera, buna omonto okoreera omwana oye omomoima; mbandeere bare nobororo buna obw’omonto okoreera omwana oye omotangi.
Ase engaki eyio, ebirero ebirabe ime ya Yerusalemu mbibe ebinene buna ebio biabete igoro ya Hadadi‐Rimoni agwo ase ense omweya ya Megido.
Abanto b’ense eye mbeumie, kera eamate ase ensemo yaye; eamate y’enyomba ya Daudi ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo; eamate y’enyomba ya Nathani ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo;
eamate y’enyomba ya Lawi ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo; eamate ya Simei ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo;
chiamate chionsi chiatigaire chieumie, kera eyemo ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo.
“Ekero engaki eyio eraike, ensoko netuboke ase abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, erinde basibigwe korwa ase ebibe biabo, na ogotacheneka kwabo.

Ase engaki eyio ninsirie amarieta ’emegwekano egosasimwa ase ense eye, tagwatorwa naende nonya ng’ake. Boigo nindusie ababani amo nomoika bw’ogotacheneka korwa aiga.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.

Nigo erabe ng’a omonto aise kooroka kobana, ng’ina na ise abwo bamoiborete bamotebie, “Aye tokonyara koba moyo, ekiagera nigo okobana oborimo ase erieta ri’Omonene.” Ekero omonto oyio agendererete kobana, abaibori abwo baye mbamobete ritimo.
Ase engaki eyio kera omobani nabe nobosooku ase amaroro aye ekero akobana; gose onde takobeka eganchwa eroiseirie amarionya ase okong’aina abanto.
Kera oyomo obo nigo arakane atebe: “Inche tindi omobani, korende nigo inde omoremi, ekiagera korwa obwana bwane nigo nagoretwe ngakorwa omosomba.
Omonto karamoborie,” “Ng’ai kwanyorete ebimanyererio ebi bie chingoma bire ase amaboko ao?” Ere nairanerie, “Ebi nigo nabinyorete korwa ase enyomba y’abwo inyanchete.”

Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Aye omoro, imoka orwanie omorisia one, oyio ore oyomo nainche. Aka omorisia oyio, erinde ching’ondi chiserebekane; erio inche ing’onchore okoboko kwane igoro ya chiria chire chindeu.”
Ee, inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: “Nigo erabe ng’a chinsemo ibere ase isato chi’abwo bamenyete ase ense eria mbaitwe basirigwe, korende ensemo eyemo y’abwo netigare ere moyo.

Abanto b’ensemo eyio eyemo ya isato nimbaetie ase omorero ime, mbasibie buna efeta egosibigwa, na mbateeme buna etahabu egoteemwa. Barabwo mbarangerie erieta riane ng’a batoorigwe, na inche nimbaigwe. Inche nintebe: Abanto abwo nabaane. Barabwo mbairanerie: Omonene nere Nyasae oito.”
Rora, rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire, ekero ebinto biaino birasakorwe biatananerwe agwo ase egati yaino.

Inche Omonene ninsangererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bache korwania Yerusalemu. Omochie oyio nobugwe, ne chinyomba chisakorwe, na abakungu bakorerwe ay’obosooku. Ekeng’ese ki’abanto b’omochie oyio mbairwe ase obosomba, korende abaratigare tibagosirigwa korwa ase omochie oyio.
Erio Omonene nasoke arwanie ebisaku ebio, buna arwanete kare ase rituko ri’esegi.

Ase rituko erio Omonene natenene ase Egetunwa ki’Emezeituni kerochie Yerusalemu ensemo ya moocha. Egetunwa ekio ngetandoke ase chinsemo ibere korwa moocha goika bosongo, ne rikura rigare naribe ase egati‐gati; agwo ekeng’ese ekemo ki’egetunwa ekio ngesuke gochia sugusu, na ekende gochia irianyi.

Inwe imotame moetere ase rikura riria rire ase egati y’ebitunwa biane, ekiagera nigo riraikere Aseli, ee, nabo moratame buna mwatamete ekero omotengecho bw’ense obete ekero Uzia arenge omoruoti bw’Abayuda. Ase engaki eyio Omonene, Nyasae one, nachiche amo nabachenu bonsi.
Ase rituko erio omobaso tokobara, obokendu mbobeo.
Naribe rituko ritari buna amatuko ande, rimanyekanete n’Omonene, tirikoba omobaso gose obotuko. Ase rituko erio oborabu nabobe ekero kia mogoroba.

Ase rituko erio amache are moyo nasoke korwa Yerusalemu. Ekeng’ese ki’amache ayio agende gochia ase Enyancha ya Moocha, na ekeng’ese kende gochia ase Enyancha ya Bosongo. Nagenderere goeta ase chingaki chie riberera na echi’obokendu.
Omonene nabe omoruoti bw’ense engima. Ase engaki eyio Omonene nere orabe ere bweka, na erieta riaye ribe rirorio rioka.

Ekero ekio ense eye yonsi neonchorwe ebe ense omweya korwa Geba goika Rimoni, irianyi ya Yerusalemu. Korende Yerusalemu oro nogenderere kobeera igoro agwo aase aye, korwa ase Egeita kia Benjamin goika ase Egeita kie Ritang’ani, na goika ase Egeita gi’Ekoona, na korwa ase Omorobiri bwa Hananeli goika ase ebimitero bi’edivai bi’omoruoti.
Abanto mbamenye Yerusalemu, okoragererigwa tigokobao, ekiagera omochie oyio nigo orabe nobotoereru.

Amaakwa aya naro Omonene ararue ase abanto abwo bonsi barache korwania abanto ba Yerusalemu: Chinyama chi’emebere yabo nchigunde ekero bagendererete gotenena namagoro abo, na amaiso abo nagunde ekero are ase chinyongo chiabo ime, ne chimeme chiabo inachigunde ase emenwa yabo ime.
Ase engaki eyio Omonene nabarentere obotantanu, abanto mbaonchokerane, baitane kera oyomo noyomwabo.
Nonya n’Abayuda mbarwanie abanto ba Yerusalemu. Obotenenku obonge bwe chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chianga, mbosangererigwe korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bamenyete ase chinsemo chionsi.
Amaakwa amabe buna ayio nache boigo ase chibarasi, ne chiyombo, ne chingamia, ne chitigere, ne ching’iti chinde chionsi chire ase ebitwori biabo.

Erio omonto onde bwensi oratigare ore moyo korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku abwo bachete korwania abanto ba Yerusalemu nabe ogotiira omwaka ase omwaka gochia gosasima Omoruoti, nere Omonene bw’Emeganda, naende narende Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu.
Onye abanto b’egesaku kende gionsi kere ase ense bakwanga kogenda Yerusalemu gosasima Omoruoti, nere Omonene bw’Emeganda, rirorio embura tegotwa ase ense yabo.
Onye abanto ba Misiri tibagotiira gochia aroro gosasima, nabarabwo nababorwe embura. Ayio naro amaakwa Omonene arae abanto bonsi abatari gotiira gochia korenda Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu.
Ekio nakio kerabe egesusuro ase Abamisiri na ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, abwo baraange gotiira gochia korenda Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu.

Ase engaki eyio chindege chisungeire chibarasi nchirikwe amang’ana aya: “Chinchenu, chiatananirwe ase Omonene,” ne chinyongo chire ase enyomba y’Omonene nchibe chinchenu buna ebitaabo bire ase egesasimero.

Kera enyongo ere Yerusalemu, na ase ense y’Abayuda, nebe enchenu ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, erinde kera oyomo okorua ekeng’wanso achiche gochioyia aiyekere chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso. Ase engaki eyio omoonchoreria takogenderera koba ase enyomba y’Omonene bw’Emeganda.
Aya naro amang’ana amakong’u Omonene atomerete Abaisraeli goetera ase Malaki.
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Inche nimbanchete inwe.” Korende inwe nigo mokoboria: “Naki otwanchete?” Omonene nigo akoiraneria, “Inee! Esau tarenge oyomwabo Yakobo? Inche nigo namwanchete Yakobo,
na nkaba ngechete Esau na ngasaria ense yaye y’ebitunwa ekaba erooro, na omwando oye nkaa chisese chi’orosana chikamenyao.”

Abaedomu kobaratebe: “Nonya twaakirwe, ngochia tore koagacha naende aase aria asaretigwe agatigara bosa.” Korende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Nabo baranyare koagacha naende, korende inche goika ntagore amaagacho ayio, erinde ense eyio erokwe ey’abakori amabe, abwo inche Omonene inde nendamwamu asebare kogenderera botambe.”
Namwerorere amang’ana ayio namaiso aino; erio motebe: “Omonene nigo are omonene nonya nisiko y’ense y’Abaisraeli.”

Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Omwana nigo asigete ise, na omosomba osigete omonene oye. Onye inche inde iso, amasikani aino asende, ng’ai are? Na onye inde omonene, okonyiroka kwaino, ng’ai kore? Inwe abakuani nigo mochayete erieta riane, naende nigo mokoboria: Nase enchera ki tochayete erieta riao?

Nimbatebie: Nigo mokorenta ase egesasimero kiane okoruegwa kw’endagera gotari ogochenu. Erio mwaboria: Nase inchera ki twagokorire oyotachenegeti. Nimbairanerie: Nase okorengereria ng’a emesa yane inche Omonene ney’ogochaywa.

Inee! Ekero mokorua eng’iti eukorete koba ekeng’wanso, ayio tari bobe? Gose ekero mokorua eye eremarete, gose endwaire, ayio tari bobe? Moraisa korua eng’iti buna eyio ase omogavuna oino, Inee, nagokigwe nainwe, gose abanchere?” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda akoboria.
“Inwe abakuani, sorora Nyasae, erinde atororere amabera. Inee! Naroreire onde bwensi oino amabera, ekero mokorua okoruegwa konga buna okwo korwa ase amaboko aino?” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda akoboria.

Naende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Onye ndiria arenge gotoka omonto nonya noyomo korwa asemore asieke ebisieri bie Hekalu, erinde timobaisa kogenderera gouta omorero ase egesasimero kiane bosa, ekiagera tingokiri nainwe, gose tingwanchera ebing’wanso korwa ase amaboko aino.

Korwa ekero erioba rigosoka goika ekero rikorimera, erieta riane nigo rigendererete koba rinene ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, na ase kera aase ubani nigo egosamberwa ase erieta riane, na okoruegwa gochenegete nigo gokorentwa. Ee, erieta riane nigo rigendererete koba rinene ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
“Korende inwe nigo mokorikora ribe eritachenegeti ekero mogoteba ng’a emesa yane yakorirwe koba eyetachenegeti na gochaya okoruegwa gokorentwa aroro.

Inwe nigo mogoteba: Amang’ana aya atorosirie, naende mwagenderera gonchaya inche Omonene bw’Emeganda. Nigo mokondetera eng’iti eurereirie, gose eye eremarete, gose erwarete, ebe ekeng’wanso. Inee! Ninyare gwanchera ebinto buna ebio korwa ase amaboko aino?” Nabo Omonene akoboria.

“Oragererigwe omonto oria omong’ainereria obwate emingichi ase riicho riaye, eyio ariete eira ng’a ayerue, korende orenta asende inche Omonene eng’iti eng’ao ere na kemocho ase omobere oye. Inche nigo inde omoruoti omonene, na erieta riane nigo rire eri’okoirokwa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
“Bono inwe abakuani, amang’ana aya nigo achikirwe asemore.

Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Onye timogotegerera amang’ana ayio na koyabeka ase chinkoro chiaino ime, erinde mosike erieta riane, rirorio nindete okoragererigwa asemore, ndagererie ogosesenigwa kwaino. Ee, naikire koragereria ogosesenigwa okwo, ekiagera timori kobeka amang’ana ayio ase chinkoro chiaino.
Nintogonyere ororeria rwaino, nintube amaiso aino nesike ye ching’iti echio mokorua chibe ebing’wanso. Abanto mbabarente bababeke ase esike eyio.
Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche nabachikerete amang’ana ayio, erinde okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nakorete na Lawi kogenderere kobao botambe. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
“Okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete nere nokw’obogima na omorembe. Okwo nigo namoete, erinde anyiroke. Ere akanyiroka, akaba okoiguswa ase engencho y’erieta riane.
Amorokererio amaronge nigo arenge ase omonwa oye, na obobe tibwanyorekanete ase ebikoba biaye. Nigo abete ogotaara nainche ase omorembe na oboronge, na akaonchora abanto abange korwa ase ebibe.
Ebikoba bi’omokuani goika birende chisemi, na abanto barigie okworokererigwa korwa ase omonwa oye, ekiagera nigo are omotomwa one inche Omonene bw’Emeganda.

“Korende inwe mwagobeire korwa ase enchera, mwagerire abanto abange bagochirwe ase engencho y’amorokererio aino; ase igo mwasaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania okwo nakorete na Lawi. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
Inwe mwangire kobwatia chinchera chiane; nigo mogwanchereria abanto ekero mokworokereria amachiko. Ase ayio nimbatige mochaywe na gokeeigwa ase amasio ’abanto bonsi.”

Inee! Intwe twensi titobwati Tata oyomo? Tari ere Nyasae oyomo ototongete? Nase ki rende totari abegenwa intwe ase intwe? Nase ki togosaria okobwatana kw’ogotianania okwo Nyasae akorete ne chisokoro chiaito?

Abayuda bakorire aya atari ay’obwegenwa, na ay’okogechia akorirwe ase egati y’Abaisraeli, na ase Yerusalemu, ekiagera Abayuda bakorire Obomenyo Obochenu obwo Omonene anchete bwabeire obotachenegeti, banyuomire abaiseke b’abanto bagosasima enyasae engeni.
Omonene nasirie korwa ase chinyomba chia Yakobo onde bwensi ogokora amang’ana ayio karabe omworokia gose omworokigwa, nonya noyokorenta ekeng’wanso ase Omonene bw’Emeganda.

Amang’ana ande mogokora naya: Nigo mogotuba egesasimero ki’Omonene namariga aino, mwaba mokorera na kweumia, na ase ayio Omonene tagwanchera ebing’wanso biaino nonya ng’ake, gose takogokigwa nabirobio korwa ase amaboko aino.

Inwe nigo mokoboria: “Nase ki atari kobianchera?” Nekiagera Omonene arenge kirori ase egati yao na omokungu bw’oboke bwao, oyio aye otari omwegenwa asare, nonya ore omokiare oo, na omokungu oo ase okobwatana kw’ogotianania.

Omonto oyomo takorete bo, oria omoika ogendererete gotigara ime yaye. Ninki oria oyomo aganetie? Nigo aganetie ororeria rwatananwe robe orwa Nyasae. Ase engencho eyio, mwerende mono, erinde onde tabaisa koba oyo otari omwegenwa ase omokungu bw’oboke bwaye.

Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo agoteba iga: “Inche nigo ngechete ogotigana, naende nigo ngechete ng’a omonto nigo agwetuba obotindi buna agwetuba eanga.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba. Ase engencho eyio mwerende timobasia koba abatari abegenwa.

Inwe mwarosirie Omonene namang’ana aino. Nigo mokoboria: “Naki twamorosirie?” Nekiagera mogoteba ng’a kera omonto ogokora ebibe nigo are omuya ase obosio bw’Omonene, naende ng’a Omonene nigo akogokigwa noyio. Naende mwaboria; “Ng’ai Nyasae oyo okonacha ebina are?”

Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Rora, nintome omotomwa one andoiserie enchera, na Omonene oyio mokorigia nache mobosokano ase Hekalu yaye; nere omotomwa bw’okobwatana kw’ogotianania oyio moganetie. Ee, ngocha are.”

Korende ning’o oranyare gotenena koremereria rituko ri’Omonene, na ning’o oranyare gotenena ase ogwekengera ekero akooroka? Ere nigo anga buna omorero bw’omoturi ebioma, na buna esabuni y’omosibia chianga.
Ere naikaranse buna oyo ogosamba na gosibia chifeta. Ere nachene Abalawi, abasibie buna chitahabu ne chifeta chigosibigwa, erinde banyare korua ebing’wanso bi’oboronge ase Omonene.
Erio ebing’wanso bi’Abayuda, na ebi’abanto ba Yerusalemu, bigokie Omonene, buna ase amatuko aria a kare, na ase emiaka ya kare.

Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Nimbaike ang’e ase okonacha ekina. Nimbe kirori omwango igoro y’abarogi na abatomani, na abagotiana oborimo, na abagokorera abarikwa emeremo bobe ase okobarina ching’eria chiabo, na abagokorera ababoraka ne chintakana bobe, na abakoonchorana oboronge bw’abamenyi, korende tibanyirogeti.
“Inche Omonene tindi koonchoka, na ase engencho eyio, inwe ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo timwasiretigwe.

Korwa ase amatuko e chisokoro chiaino inwe mwagoberete mogatiga emeroberio yane echikire, timwayebwatete. Bono inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo ngoteba iga: Ing’iranera, nainche nimbairanere. Korende inwe nigo mokoboria: Tokoiranere ase inchera ki?
Inee! Omonto nanyare konyibera inche Nyasae ebiane? Korende inwe mwanyibeire ebiane. Inwe nigo mokoboria: Ninki twakoibeire? Mwanyibeire ensemo ya ikomi na okoruegwa konde.
Mwaragererigwe nokoragererigwa, ekiagera inwe egesaku eke gionsi mwanyibeire ebiane.

Inwe renta ensemo ya ikomi eng’ikeranu ase ekungo y’enyomba yane, erinde endagera ebe ase enyomba yane. Ase enchera eyio inwe monteeme gose tinkobaigorera ebibao bia igoro mbaumorere ogosesenigwa okonge mono gotari korengeka. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteba.
Nintogonyere ebigosaria okwama kwe riroba riaino, tibigosaria, gose amasabibu aino takoaroroka kare amarere. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteba.
Erio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi inababaroke abasesenirie, ekiagera ense yaino nebe y’okogokia. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteba.”
Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Inwe mwakwanire amang’ana amakong’u igoro yane. Korende nigo mokoboria: Mang’ana ki amakong’u twakwanire igoro yao?
Inwe mwatebire: Okomokorera Nyasae, ayio namang’ana a bosa. Mbuya ki twanyorire ase okobwata amachiko aye, gose ase ogotaara ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’Emeganda tore nomoichano?
Bono nigo tokoroka abwo bare abaenenu ng’a mbasesenirie. Abakori amabe nabwo bagendererete konyora amaya; tari ayio oka, korende nonya nekero bagoteema Nyasae nigo bagokonywa.”

Erio abanto abwo bamoirogete Omonene bakaba bagokwana barabwo ase barabwo; Omonene agategerera, akaigwa amang’ana abo, na ebuku y’ekeinyorio ekarikwa ase obosio bwaye ase okoinyora abwo bamoirogete na barengereretie igoro y’erieta riaye.
Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Abanto aba mbabe abanto baane bori ase rituko erio ndakore ring’ana, nimbarorere amabera buna omonto akorora amabera ase omwana oye okomokorera.
Erio imorore ogwatananeka ase egati y’omonyaboronge na omokori amabe, na ase egati y’oyogonkorera inche Nyasae na oria otari gonkorera.”

Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Rora, rituko ngocha rire rigosamba buna omorero o riko ogosamba. Erio abanto abaenenu bonsi, na abakori amabe bonsi, mbabe buna obonyansi obwomo, ne rituko erio rigocha nigo rirabasambe kegima, tirigotiga omori gose orosagia.
Korende asemore inwe abamoirogete erieta riane, erioba ri’oboronge ndioroke rire nokogwenia inse ye chimbaba chiaye. Inwe imosoke mobe mogotiratiria buna chimori ekero chigosokigwa korwa ase obweri.
Ase rituko erio ndakore ring’ana erio, inwe imotiringe abakori amabe namagoro aino, na barabwo mbabe buna ribu.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
“Inwe inyora amachiko a Musa, omosomba one, na emeroberio yonsi namochigete agwo ase egetunwa kia Horebu, orokererie Abaisraeli bonsi.
“Rora, nimbatomere Elija omobani atang’anere rituko riria rinene ri’Omonene ri’okoondokia ritaracha.
Ere nairanie chinkoro chi’abaise gochia ase abana babo, na echi’abana gochia ase abaise, erinde ekero ndache timbaisa goaka ense eye nokoragererigwa.”
Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeria rwaye Yeso Kristo, omwana o Daudi, omwana o Ibrahimu.
Ibrahimu akaibora Isaka, na Isaka akaibora Yakobo, na Yakobo akaibora Yuda na abamwabo,
na Yuda akaibora Peresu na Zera ase Tamari, na Peresu akaibora Hezironi, na Hezironi akaibora Aramu,
na Aramu akaibora Aminadabu, na Aminadabu akaibora Nashoni, na Nashoni akaibora Salimoni,
na Salimoni akaibora Boazi ase Rahabu, na Boazi akaibora Obedi ase Rutu, na Obedi akaibora Yese,
na Yese akaibora omoruoti Daudi. Na Daudi akaibora Sulemani ase oyio orenge omokungu o Uria,
na Sulemani akaibora Rehoboamu, na Rehoboamu akaibora Abiya, na Abiya akaibora Asa,
na Asa akaibora Yehosafati, na Yehosafati akaibora Yoramu, na Yoramu akaibora Usia,
na Usia akaibora Yotamu na Yotamu akaibora Ahasi, na Ahasi akaibora Hezekia,
na Hezekia akaibora Manase, na Manase akaibora Amoni, na Amoni akaibora Yosia,
na Yosia akaibora Yekonia na abamwabo ekero ki’ogosakorwa na okong’anyigwa gochia Babeli.
Na nyuma y’ogosakorwa na okong’anyigwa gochia Babeli Yekonia akaibora Salatieli, na Salatieli akaibora Serubabeli,
na Serubabeli akaibora Abihudi, na Abihudi akaibora Eliakimu, na Eliakimu akaibora Azoro,
na Azoro akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Akimu, na Akimu akaibora Eliudi,
na Eliudi akaibora Eleazari, na Eleazari akaibora Matani, na Matani akaibora Yakobo,
na Yakobo akaibora Yusufu, omosacha o Mariamu oyo oiborete Yeso, oyokorokwa Kristo.

Na ebigori bionsi korwa Ibrahimu goika Daudi nigo biarenge ebigori ikomi na bine: na korwa Daudi goika ogosakorwa na okong’anyigwa gochia Babeli nebigori ikomi na bine: na korwa ogosakorwa na okong’anyigwa gochia Babeli goika Kristo nebigori ikomi na bine.
Okoiborwa kwa Yeso Kristo nigo kwarenge iga: Ekero Mariamu ng’ina ariereire boko na Yusufu, bataraikana ang’e, akarorekana ore morito ase Omoika Omochenu.
Na omosacha oye Yusufu nigo arenge omonto omoronge, tarigetie komoa obosooku, akarengereria komotiga bobisi.

Korende ekero arenge orengereretie aya, rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akamochiera ase chindoto akamotebia. “Aye Yusufu, omwana o Daudi, toiroka koira Mariamu abe mokao, ekiagera oborito obwo bwatongirwe inda yaye nobw’Omoika Omochenu.
Ere naibore omwana omoisia, nomoroke erieta riaye Yeso, ekiagera nere oratoorie abanto baye korwa ase ebibe biabo.”
Aya onsi nigo abeire, erinde riikerane eriakwanetwe n’Omonene ase omonwa bw’omobani,
“Rigereria, omoiseke omwekungi nabe morito, erio naibore omwana omoisia, na erieta riaye narokwe Imanueli” (engencho yaye: Nyasae amo naintwe).
Na Yusufu agachia koboka korwa ase chitoro, agakora buna achigetwe nomomalaika bw’Omonene; akaira mokaye,
korende tiriaba komo goika kaiboire omwana omoisia; Yusufu akamoroka erieta riaye Yeso.
Ekero Yeso aiboretwe aria Bethlehemu ya Boyahudi ase amatuko ’omoruoti Herode, rora, abanto abang’aini bakarwa ensemo ya moocha, bagacha Yerusalemu, bakaboria,
“Ng’ai are oria oiborwa omoruoti bw’Abayahudi? Ekiagera eng’enang’eni yaye ntwayeroche moocha; nigo twachire komosasima.”
Ekero omoruoti Herode achia koigwa aya agaichanigwa, na Yerusalemu yonsi amo nere.
Erio kabasangereirie abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko, akababoria, “Ng’ai Kristo agocha koiborerwa?”
Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Nase Bethlehemu ya Boyahudi, ekiagera nabo yarigetwe nomobani,
“Naye Bethlehemu, ase ense ya Yuda, tori moke ase egati y’abanene ba Yuda, naki korwa asore aye nache omogambi orache koba Omorisia bw’abanto baane Abaisraeli.”
Erio Herode akarangeria abanto baria abang’aini bobisi, akarigia asebare ekeene nkero ki eng’enang’eni eria yarorekanete.
Akabatoma goika Bethlehemu, akabatebia “Genda morigie mono omwana oyio; kamoramonyore moche gontebia, nainche boigo ngende komosasima.”
Bagachia koigwa amang’ana ’omoruoti, bakagenda; na rora, eng’enang’eni eria baroche moocha ekabatang’ana, goika egatenena igoro aase omwana oria arenge.
Ekero barora eng’enang’eni eria, bagaichorwa nomogoko omonene mono.
Bagachia gosoa nyomba bakarora omwana amo na Mariamu ng’ina, bagatung’ama inse, bakamosasima; bagakunora chinibo chiabo, bakamokwaneria ebinto ebiya, etahabu, na ubani, na manemane.
Erio kabakureirwe na Nyasae ase chindoto, tibairanera ase Herode, bakabwatia enchera eng’ao, bakagenda sobo.

Ekero abanto baria bamanoire kogenda, rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akaorokera Yusufu ase chindoto, akamotebia, “Imoka korwa aa, oire omwana na ng’ina, otame gochia Misiri, omenye aroro goika ngotebie, ekiagera Herode narigie omwana oyo anyare komoita.”
Ere akaimoka botuko, akaira omwana oria na ng’ina, akagenda Misiri,
akamenya aroro goika Herode agakwa, erinde rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe n’Omonene ase omonwa bw’omobani, “Korwa Misiri nkarangeria omwana one.”

Ekero Herode achia korora ng’a ochayirwe nabanto baria abang’ani, akaba nekeririanda ekenene mono, agatoma abanto goita abana abaisia bonsi abarenge Bethlehemu ne chinsemo chiaye chionsi, abakoorire emiaka ebere na abatarakoora emiaka ebere, koreng’ana nekero keria atebetigwe nabanto baria abang’aini.
Ekero ekio rigaikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Yeremia,
“Eriogi riaigurwe Rama, okorera na okweumia. Raeli nkoreera are abana baye, tancheti akirigwe, ekiagera tibaiyo.”
Ekero Herode akure, rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akaorokera Yusufu aria Misiri ase chindoto, akamotebia,
“Imoka, oire omwana na ng’ina, mogende ase ense ya Israeli, ekiagera baria barenge korigia obogima bw’omwana bakure.”
Akaimoka, akaira omwana amo na ng’ina, akagenda ase ense ya Israeli.

Korende agachia koigwa ng’a Arikelau obekirwe oboruoti Boyahudi ase ribaga ria Herode ise, akaba nokoiroka ase okogenda aroro, korende erio gakureirwe na Nyasae ase okorota, akagenda ensemo ya Galili.
Akagenda, akamenya omochie oyomo okorokwa Nazareti, rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nababani, “Igo ararokwe Omonazareti.”
Ase amatuko aria Yohana Omobatisi akaoroka. Nkorandia arenge ase erooro ya Boyahudi, ogoteba,
“Onchoka, ekiagera oboruoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e!”
Naki oyio nere otebetwe nomobani Isaya, ekero atebete, “Eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro: Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye.”
Ere Yohana nigo arenge kobeka chianga chi’amarionya ’engamia na kweboeria orokini rwe riiyo kenema kiaye, na endagera yaye nigo yarenge chingige na obooke bw’orosana.
Engaki eyio abanto ba Yerusalemu, na Boyahudi yonsi, ne chinsemo chionsi chia Yorodan bakamochiera.
Barabwo bakabatiswa nere ase orooche rwa Yorodan, bakoorokia ebibe biabo.
Agachia korora abanto abange ase Abafarisai na Abasadukai bakomochiera ase ebatiso, akabatebia, “Inwe oroiboro rwe ching’iti, ning’o obakureire ng’a motame korwa ase endamwamu egochi‐gocha?
Gaki, ama okwama kogwenerete okoonchoka;
gose timona goteba ase emioyo yaino ime: Ntore na sokoro yaito Ibrahimu, ekiagera nabatebirie, ng’a Nyasae nare nokobua ase amagena aya gokorera Ibrahimu abana.
Nonya mbono egesire kiabekirwe ase emeri y’emete; nabo kera omote otameti okwama okuya nonachwe, otugutwe ase omorero.
“Inche nase amache nkobabatisera ase okoonchoka, korende ere, oyorache nyuma yane, nare ne chinguru kombua. Tinyisaini koimokia ebikoroto biaye. Nere orababatise ase Omoika Omochenu na ase omorero.
Oroteru rwaye nigo rore koboko kwaye, ere naabuse ekeooreri kiaye, nasangererie engano ase ekiage kiaye, korende omoiriro nayosambe ase omorero otakorimeka.”
Ekero ekio Yeso akarua Galili, akagenda ase Yohana ase orooche rwa Yorodan abatiswe nere.
Korende Yohana akarigia kwanga, agateba, “Inche ndigetie kobatiswa naye, na aye kogocha asende?”
Korende Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ancha iga bono, ekiagera naboigo etogwenerete goikerania oboronge bwonsi.” Erio agwo akamwanchera.
Na Yeso, ekero abatisirwe, erio kegima agatiira korwa ase amache; na rora, igoro akamaanoka, na ere akarora Omoika o Nyasae ogoika buna riruma, ogocha igoro asare.
Na rora, eriogi rikorwa igoro rigateba, “Oyo nere Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie nere.”
Erio Yeso akairwa n’Omoika ase erooro gochia goteemwa na Saitani.
Akeng’ata amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko. Nyuma ase aya enchara ekamoria.
Omoteemi agacha, akamotebia, “Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, tebia amagena aya abe omogati.”
Korende ere akairaneria, “Nerikire: Omonto takoba moyo ase omogati bwoka, korende ase kera ring’ana rikorwa ase omonwa o Nyasae.”
Erio Saitani akamoira goika omochie omochenu, akamobeka igoro ase egechuria gie Hekalu egetambe mono.

Akamotebia, “Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, etugute gochia inse, ekiagera nerikire: “Ere nagochikere abamalaika baye bakorende, na barabwo nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde togochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Naende nerikire: Toteema Omonene, Nyasae oo.”
Naende Saitani akamoira ase ekegoro egetambe mono, akamworokia amaruoti onsi ay’ense, na obonene bwabo,
akamotebia, “Ebi bionsi ninkoe, koratung’ame na gonsasima.”
Erio Yeso akamotebia, “Karue aa, Saitani! Ekiagera nerikire: “Osasime Omonene, Nyasae oo, omokorere ere bweka.”
Erio Saitani akamotiga, na rora, abamalaika bagacha, bakamokorera.
Ekero Yeso achia koigwa ng’a Yohana osibirwe echela, akaimoka, akagenda Galili.
Akaimoka korwa Nazareti, akagenda, akamenya Kapernaumu, omochie ore ang’e nenyancha ase chimbebe chia Sabuloni na Nafutali,
rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya,
“Ense ya Sabuloni na ense ya Nafutali, enchera egochia enyancha ng’umbu ya Yorodan, Galili, ense y’abanto b’Ebisaku,
abanto abamenyete omosunte ime, barorire omobaso omonene, na abamenyete ensemo y’ekiriri ki’amakweri, omobaso obabareire.”
Korwa ekero ekio Yeso agachaka korandia, ogoteba, “Onchoka, ekiagera oboruoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e.”
Ekero arenge gotaara ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akarora abamura babere ba ise omo, Simion oyokorokwa Petero, na Anderea omwabo, bakoruta ekeonga enyancha ime, ekiagera nabarubi barenge.
Akabatebia, “Inchuo montunyane na inche nimbakore mobe abarubi b’abanto.”
Erio kegima bagatiga ebionga biabo, bakamotunyana.

Naende gakogenda korwa aroro, akarora abamura babere bande ba ise omo, Yakobo omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana omwabo, barenge obwato ime amo na Zebedi ise bakoroisia ebionga biabo, nabarabwo akabarangeria.
Erio kegima bagatiga obwato boria, bagatiga na ise, bakamotunyana.

Erio Yeso nigo arenge konagoetanana ase ense engima ya Galili, okworokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, okorandia amang’ana amaya ay’oboruoti, okogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi obwarenge ase abanto.

Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ya Siiria; bakamorentera abarwaire bonsi ababwatire namarwaire ao ao, na obororo, na ababwatire nebirecha, na abaare ne chindurume, na abarenge amagata, akabagwenia.
Emeganda emenge ekamotunyana korwa Galili, na Dekapoli, na Yerusalemu, na Boyahudi, na ng’umbu ya Yorodan.
Yeso agachia korora emeganda eria, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro; na ekero aikaransire, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera.
Agachaka koborokereria, ogoteba,
“Mbasesenirie abare abataka ase omoika, ekiagera oboruoti bwa igoro nobwabo.
“Mbasesenirie abaichanete, ekiagera nabache koremigwa.
“Mbasesenirie abare noboitongo, ekiagera barabwo nabaire omwando bw’ense.
