Inwe nigo mogoteba: Onde bwensi kararie emuma ase egesasimero tari gento; korende onde bwensi kararie emuma ase ekeng’wanso kere igoro ase egesasimero bwesibire nemuma yaye.
Inwe emeuko! Nkere ki kere ekenene kobua: nesadaka, gose negesasimero kegokora esadaka ebe enchenu?
Gaki, oyorarie emuma ase egesasimero nigo ararie ase ekio, na ase ebinto bionsi ebire igoro yaye.
Na oyo orarie emuma ase Hekalu, nigo ararie ase eyio na ase oyo omenyete imeo.
Na oyo orarie emuma ase igoro, nigo ararie ase ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae na ase oyo ogeikaranserete.

“Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mokorua ensemo ya ikomi ye chiarare, na ebinsari, ne chinyeni chinde, na mwatiga amang’ana ayare amanene ay’ogochika na oboronge, na amabera, na okwegena. Naro ayio nabagwenerete moyakore, amo na gotatiga ayande.
Inwe abaraai emeuko, mwakenonora egechuni, mwamera engamia!
“Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogosibia egekombe na esani korwa isiko, korende ime biaichoire nobouri na okogania gotari nekerengo.
Aye Omofarisai omouko! Sibia ritang’ani egekombe na esani ime, erio nonya nisiko binyare koba ebirabu.

“Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogwekaine nechimbeera chiakire echooka; na chirochio isiko chirorekana ng’a nechingiya, korende ime nigo chiichire namauga ’ebitondo, na euramba yonsi.
Nainwe nabo more, isiko mwarorekana ase abanto ng’a nabaronge more, korende ime yaino mwaichoirwe nobong’ainereria na ebibe ebinge.
“Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mokoagacha chimbeera chi’ababani, na koroisia chimbeera chi’abaronge,
mogoteba: Onye ntwarengeo kare ase amatuko e chisokoro chiaito, anga titwabwatanete nabarabwo ase ogoitera amanyinga ’ababani.
Igo mwetebire inwe abanyene, ng’a inwe nabana babo more, baria baitete ababani.
Gaki bono, ichoria ekerengo gie chisokoro chiaino.
Inwe ching’iti, oroiboro rw’amarubi, naki morakore motame ekina ki’omorero o kare na kare.

Ase ayio natomire ababani asemore, na abanto abang’aini, na aborokia b’amariko; abande babo inamobaite na kobabamba, na abande babo inamobang’wanie emecharichi ase chisinagogi chiaino, na kobachanda omochie ase omochie.

Erio nario arabachere amanyinga onsi ayaboronge ayaitegete ase ense, korwa amanyinga ’Abeli, oria omonyene oboronge, goika amanyinga a Zakaria, omwana o Barakia, oria mwaiterete gati ye Hekalu na egesasimero.
Ekeene nabatebirie ng’a amang’ana aya onsi nache igoro ase ekegori eke.

“Aye Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, aye ogoita ababani na kobaaka amagena abatomirwe asore! Ng’ara karenga narigirie gosangereria abana bao, buna engoko egosangereria ebionuchu biaye ase chimbaba chiaye ime, korende timwancha!
Rora, enyomba yaino mwatigeirwe ritombe.
Na inche nabatebirie, timokondora naende nonya ng’ake goika ekero keria morache goteba: Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene.”
Yeso agatiga Hekalu, akaba nkogenda are, na aborokigwa baye bakamochiera komworokia amaagacho e Hekalu.
Korende akabairaneria, “Inee! Mwarorire aya onsi? Nekeene nabatebirie: Aiga tirigotigara rigena erimo igoro ase erinde, eritatagorwe.”
Gaikaransire ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera bobisi, bakamoboria, “Totebie, aya indi arabe? Naende ninki ekemanyererio ki’ogocha kwao, na ay’omoerio bw’ense?”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Mwerende, monto onde tabang’aina.
Naki abange nabache ase erieta riane, babore: Inche ninche Kristo; baraae abange na kobasiria.
Na inwe inamoigwe esegi, na ebirage, bi’esegi; rigereria timoichanigwa, ekiagera bori, aya onsi nabe; korende omoerio toracha.
Naki egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oboruoti naborwane noboruoti bonde; enchara na emetengecho y’ense nabibe ase chinsemo ne chinsemo.
Ayio onsi naro omochakano bw’obororo.
“Erio inababarue monyare gochandwa na goitwa, na inwe inamogechwe nebisaku bionsi ase engencho y’erieta riane.
Na ekero ekio abanto abange inabagwe korwa ase okwegena kwabo, inabasigaanane na kobekana ase ababisa babo, naende nabagechane,
na ababani b’oborimo abange mbaimoke, baraae abange na kobasiria.
Nase engencho y’okomenteka kw’ebibe, obwanchani bw’abange nabokende.
Korende oyoraremererie goika omoerio, oyio natooreke.
Naende, amang’ana aya amaya ay’oboruoti narandigwe ase ense yonsi koba kirori ase ebisaku bionsi; erio omoerio ochiche.
“Gaki, naboigo kamogocha korora okogechia kw’ogosaria gwatebetwe nomobani Danieli, kogotenena aase aachenu (oyogosoma amanye),
erio abare Boyahudi batame gochia ase ebitunwa.
Ere oyore kerama igoro taika kogenda kobogoria gento ekere nyomba mwaye,
na ere oyore mogondo tairana nyomba kobogoria eanga yaye.
Korende nabe aakong’u ase abare barito na abakogonkia ase amatuko aria.
Korende saba ng’a ogotama kwaino tikoba ekero ki’obokendu, gose ase rituko ri’Esabato,
ekiagera agwo nebe emechando emenene, etana koba korwa omochakano bw’ense goika bono, gose tekoba bo naende nonya ng’ake.
Naende onye amatuko ayio atanachetwe, anga monto onde bwensi tatooregete; korende ase engencho y’abachore amatuko ayio nanachwe.
Na ekero ekio omonto karabatebie: Rora, Kristo naa are! Gose: Naaria! Timwancha.
Naki nabaoroke amakristo ’oborimo, na ababani b’oborimo, nabaorokie ebikone ebinene na amakumia, goika keranyarekane, nabang’aine nonya nabachore.
Rora, nabatebirie aya ritang’ani.
Gaki, kobarabatebie: Rora, oyo ore ase erooro, timosoka isiko; kobarabatebie: Oyo ore ebinunchi bia bobisi, timwancha.
Naki buna okomesa gokorwa moocha kwabara gochia bosongo, naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto korache koba.
Naki aase ribego rire, nao chinsoti chigosangererekana.
“Korende bwango nyuma y’emechando y’amatuko aria, erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi tokobara, ne ching’enang’eni nachigwe korwa igoro, ne chinguru chia igoro nachitengechigwe.

Erio nario ekemanyererio ki’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto kerache kororekana igoro, na ebisaku bionsi bi’ense nario birarere; naende nabarore mwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ogocha ase amare a igoro ne chinguru, na obonene obonge.
Erio natome abamalaika baye na egeturi ekenene ki’egetureri, na barabwo mbasangererie abachore baye korwa ase chinsinyo inye, korwa ensinyo eyemo ya igoro goika eyende.
“Korwa ase omoko eorokererie omoreng’anio oyo: Orosagia rwaye korwachakire koorokia amato aye, mwamanyire ng’a nekero ki’ogoseboka, etoigo ng’ang’e ere.
Naboigo nainwe komokorora aya aorokire, momanye ng’a omoerio obeire ang’e na gesieri.
Nekeene nabatebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng’ake goika aya onsi anyare koba.
Igoro na ense nabiete, korende amang’ana aane takonyara goeta nonya ng’ake.
“Korende amang’ana e rituko riria, na ensa eria onde tari omanyete, nonya nabamalaika ba igoro, nonya n’Omwana, otatiga Tata bweka.
Korende buna amatuko aria a Nuhu abete, naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto korache koba.
Naki buna barenge ase amatuko aria etoigo etaracha, baare koria, bakonywa, bakonyuoma, bakonyuomerigwa, goika rituko riria Nuhu asoete ase obwato,
na barabwo tibamanya goika etoigo egacha, egasiria bonsi; naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto korache koba.
Engaki eyio abanto babere nababe mogondo; oyomo nairwe, na oyomo natigwe.
Abakungu babere nababe bagosera orogena oromo; oyomo nairwe, na oyomo natigwe.
Ase ayio, renda, ekiagera timomanyeti ituko ki Omonene oino agocha.
Korende manya aya, onye omonyene enyomba namanyete nkero ki ase obotuko omoibi agocha, anga narendete taiberwa.
Ase ayio nainwe, kabe ang’e; naki nase ensa motakagereti nero Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto arache.
“Ning’o rende ore omosomba omwegenwa, naende ore omong’aini, obegetwe nomonene oye igoro ase enyomba yaye, ae abanto endagera ase ekero ekeronge?
Nasesenirie omosomba oria, ekero omonene oye arache amonyore ogokora bo.
Nekeene nabatebirie ng’a namobeke igoro ase ebi abwate bionsi.
Korende omosomba oria omobe, karatebe ase omoyo oye ime: Omonene one otebanire gocha,
achake goaka abasomba b’omonene oye, na koria na konywa amo nabagotinda,
omonene bw’omosomba oria nigo arache rituko atakagereti, na ensa atamanyeti;
ere namonachane abe ebing’ese namobeke amo nabang’ainereria. Aroro abanto mbabe nekerero na okoriania amaino.
“Oboruoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekanirie nabaiseke ikomi ababogoretie chitaya chiabo, bagasoka gochia korotota omonyuomi.
Batano ase barabwo nigo barenge abariri, na batano abang’aini.
Na ekero baria abariri baimogetie chitaya chiabo, tibachiimokia namaguta;
korende baria abang’aini bakaimokia amaguta ase ebinto biabo amo ne chitaya chiabo.
Ekero omonyuomi atebana gocha, bagasundoka bonsi, bakarara.
Korende botuko gati gekaba egeturi: Rigereria, omonyuomi oyo! Soka momorotote!
Erio abaiseke baria bonsi bakaimoka koroisia chitaya chiabo.
Baria abariri bagatebia baria abang’aini: Twatanere amaguta aino, ekiagera chitaya chiaito chiarimire.
Korende baria abang’aini bakabairaneria: Taibo. Takonyara gotoisana intwe nainwe twensi, mbuya mogende mwegorere ase abakoonia.
Na ekero bachia kogenda kogora, omonyuomi agacha, na baria bebegete ang’e bagasoa amo nere ase omoyega bw’enyangi; na egesieri kegasiekwa.
Naende nyuma yaye abaiseke baria bande bagacha, bakabora: Omonene, Omonene, toigorere!
Korende akabairaneria: Nekeene nabatebirie: Timbamanyeti inwe.
Ase igo renda, ekiagera timomanyeti rituko, nonya nensa.
“Igo enga buna omonto ore kogenda orogendo, akarangeria abasomba baye, akabeka enibo yaye asebare.
Akaa oyomo chitalanta isano, na oyonde ibere, na oyonde eyemo, kera omonto koreng’ana nokonyara kwaye. Erio akagenda.
Oria oetwe chitalanta isano akagenda ara rimo, agachionchoreria, akanyora ebitoki, chitalanta chinde isano.
Naboigo noria oetwe chitalanta ibere akanyora ebitoki, chitalanta chinde ibere.
Korende oria oetwe etalanta eyemo akagenda, agakunya inse, akabisa ebesa y’omonene oye.
Nyuma y’amatuko amange omonene bw’abasomba baria agacha, akarigia gokora omobaro nabarabwo.
Oria oetwe chitalanta isano agacha ne chitalanta chinde isano, akabora: Omonene, nkwang’ete chitalanta isano, rora nanyorire ebitoki, chitalanta chinde isano.
Omonene oye akamotebia: Gwakorire buya aye, omosomba omuya naende omwegenwa; kwabeire omwegenwa ase ebire ebike, ninkobeke igoro ase ebire ebinge. Soa ase omogoko bw’omonene oo.
Naende oria oetwe chitalanta ibere agacha, akabora: Omonene, nkwang’ete chitalanta ibere, rora, nanyorire ebitoki, chitalanta chinde ibere.
Omonene oye akamotebia: Gwakorire buya aye, omosomba omuya naende omwegenwa; kwabeire omwegenwa ase ebire ebike, ninkobeke igoro ase ebire ebinge. Soa ase omogoko bw’omonene oo.
Na oria oetwe etalanta eyemo agacha, akabora: Omonene, nakomanyete ng’a nigo ore omonto omokong’u, okogesa aase otasimegete, na gosangereria aase otabusurete;
erio nkoboa, nkagenda nkabisa etalanta yao inse. Nero eye.
Korende omonene oye akamoiraneria: Aye omosomba omobe naende omworo! Nkwamanyete ng’a nigo nkogesa aase ntasimegete, naende nigo ngosangereria aase ntabusurete?
Gaki nkwagwenerete kobeka chibesa chiane ase abakorua ebitoki, na inche ngocha, anga nanyora echiane amo nebitoki biane.
Gaki, moure etalanta yaye, moe oria obwate chitalanta ikomi.
Naki kera oyore negento naegwe, naende amenteranigwe; korende ere oyotari negento, nonya nkeria abwate naurwe.
Na omosomba oria otagwenereti, motugute isiko ase omosunte. Aroro abanto inababe nekerero na okoriania amaino.
“Ekero Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto agochi‐gocha ase obonene bwaye, na abamalaika bonsi amo nere, erio naikaranse ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.
Ebisaku bionsi nabisangererie ase obosio bwaye; ere naatanane abaiga na aba buna omorisia agwatanana ching’ondi ne chimbori.
Ching’ondi nachibeke ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, korende chimbori ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.
Erio Omoruoti natebie abare ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio: Inchuo inwe abamwasesenetigwe na Tata one, soa ase omwando bw’oboruoti mwaroiseretigwe korwa ogotongwa gw’ense,
ekiagera inarenge nenchara, mokang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, mokang’a nkanywa; inarenge omogeni, mokandoisia;
inarenge getirianda, mokamboyia; inarwarete, mogacha kondora; inasibetwe echela, moanchichera.
Erio abanyene oboronge nabamoiranerie: A! Omonene, indi twakoroche kore nenchara, togakorageria? Gose indi twakoroche kore nerang’o, togakoa okanywa?
Indi twakoroche kore omogeni, togakoroisia, gose getirianda, togakoboyia?
Naende indi twakoroche kore omorwaire, gose gosibire echela, togacha gokorora?
Na Omoruoti nabairanerie: Nekeene nabatebirie: Koreng’ana buna mware gokorera oyomo bw’aba abaminto abare abake, ninche mwakorerete.
Erio natebie abare ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee: Karue asende inwe abamwaragereretigwe, mogende ase omorero o kare na kare, oyoroiseretigwe Saitani na abamalaika baye,
ekiagera inarenge nenchara, timwang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, timwang’a inywe.
Inarenge omogeni, timwandoisia; inarenge getirianda, timwamboyia; inarwarete, narenge echela ime, timwacha kondora.
Erio barabwo nabamoiranerie: Omonene, indi twakoroche aye kore nenchara, gose kore nerang’o, gose kore omogeni, gose kore getirianda, gose kore omorwaire, gose kore echela ime, na titwagokorera?
Erio nabairanerie: Nekeene nabatebirie: Koreng’ana buna motare gokorera oyomo bw’aba abare abake, timwankorerete inche.
Na abanto aba nabagende ase egesusuro gia kare na kare, korende abanyene oboronge nabagende ase obogima bwa kare na kare.”
Ekero Yeso akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya onsi, agatebia aborokigwa baye,
“Mwamanyire ng’a nyuma y’amatuko abere nebe Epasaka, na Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto naruegwe kobambwa.”
Erio abakuani abanene na abagaaka b’abanto bagasangererekana ase egoora y’omokuani omonene oyore korokwa Kayafa;
bagakora ekina barabwo ase barabwo, banyare komobwata Yeso nobong’ainereria, na komoita.
Korende bakabora, “Taba ase rituko rinene, tiribaisa gocha koba riroroche ase abanto.”
Na Yeso, ekero arenge Bethania ase enyomba ya Simion, oyorenge noborwaire bwa ukoma,
agacherwa nomokungu orenge nechuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta e rimisu rigiya aye rigori rinene; gaikaransete ase endagera, akamonyororokeria ase omotwe oye.
Korende ekero aborokigwa baye bachia korora aya, bakagechigwa, bakabora, “Nobwa ki obosiru obo?
Naki amaguta aya anga naoonigwa ase chisiringi chinyinge na chiegwe abataka.”
Yeso, konya omanyire aya, akabatebia, “Nase ki mokorosia omokungu oyo? Ere onkoreire emeremo emiya,
ekiagera amatuko onsi nigo more nabataka amo nainwe, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.
Buna anyororokeria amaguta aya ase omobere one, onkoreire aya ase okombeka ang’e ase ogotindekwa kwane.
Nekeene nabatebirie: Kera aase enchili eye erarandigwe ase ense yonsi, neri akora oyo nariatorwe ase okomoinyora.”
Na ekero ekio oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, nere, oyokorokwa Yudas Iskariota, agachiera abakuani abanene,
akababoria, “Inki morang’e onye nkomorua asemore?” Bakamoa chibesa chie chifeta emerongo etato.
Korwa ekero ekio akaba nkorigia are ribaga ri’okomorua.
Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’Emegati etabekiri memera aborokigwa bagachiera Yeso, bakamoboria, “Ng’ai origetie tokoroiserie oriere Epasaka?”
Akabairaneria, “Genda ase omochie ase omonto gete, momotebie: Omworokia otebire: Engaki yane yaikire ang’e; nyomba mwao nao ndariere Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane.”
Aborokigwa bagakora buna bachigetwe na Yeso, bakaarigania Epasaka.
Riachia koba mogoroba, agaikaransa ase endagera, amo naborokigwa baria ikomi na babere.
Kobaikaransire koragera, akabora, “Nekeene nabatebirie: oyomo oino nandue.”
Bagaichana mono, bagachaka kera oyomo komoboria, “Inee! Omonene, ninche?”
Akairaneria, “Oyo ogotobeka okoboko kwaye amo nainche ase esani, oyio nere orandue.
Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nkogenda are buna arikeretwe, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto arurwe nere! Nanga mbuya kobua asare omonto oria, nonya ataiboretwe.”
Yudas, nere oyokomorua, akamoboria, “Inee! Omonene, ninche? Akamoiraneria: Naboigo. Aye gwatebire.”
Kobakoragera, Yeso akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akaa aborokigwa, akabora, “Bogoria, morie; oyo noro omobere one.”
Akabogoria na egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabaa, akabora, “Kanywe aya inwe mwensi,
naki aya naro amanyinga aane ay’okobwatana okoyia, aitekire ase engencho y’abange ase okwaberwa kw’ebibe.
Nabatebirie, tinkonywa naende okwama oko kw’emesabibu goika rituko riria ndache gokonywa okoyia amo nainwe ase oboruoti bwa Tata.”
Kobakoorire gotera Ogotera, bagasoka kogenda egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.
Erio Yeso akabatebia, “Ase obotuko bwa rero inwe mwensi inamogochwe na gontiga ase engencho yane; naki narikire: Ning’ake omorisia, ne ching’ondi chie riicho inachiserebekane.
Korende nyuma y’okoboka kwane nimbatang’anere kogenda Galili.”
Petero akamotebia, “Neba inabagochwe bonsi na bagotige ase engencho yao, inche tinkogochwa na kogotiga nonya ng’ake.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Ase obotuko obo, ekero etuoni etarabuga, nonkane ara gatato.”
Petero akamotebia, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng’ake.” Na aborokigwa bonsi bagateba boigo.
Naende Yeso akagenda nabarabwo goika aase akorokwa Gethisemane, agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Ikaransa aa ekero nkogenda aria gosaba.”
Akaira Petero na abana baria ba Zebedi babere, agachaka goichana na gwechanda mono.
Erio akabatebia, “Omoyo one nore nobororo obonge, nonya ngoika ogokwa; ikaransa aa, morende amo nainche.”
Akagenderera ake, akagwa maumama, agasaba, “Tata one, onye ekonyarekana, tiga egekombe eke kerusigwe asende; korende taba buna nyanchete inche, korende buna bwanchete aye.”
Agachiera aborokigwa baria, akabanyora bararire, agatebia Petero, “Inee! Iga timokonyara korenda amo nainche nonya nensa eyemo?
Renda, mosabe, timobaisa gosoa ase ogoteemwa; omoika oro nore nogwancha, korende omobere tori ne chinguru.”
Naende akagenda eria kabere, agasaba, “Tata one, onye tekonyarekana egekombe eke keng’etere ntakenywereti, abe buna bwanchete aye.”
Agacha naende, akabanyora bararire; ekiagera amaiso abo abeire amarito.
Akabatiga naende, akagenda, agasaba eria gatato agakwana amang’ana aria amatang’ani.
Erio agachiera aborokigwa baria, akabatebia, “Nonya mbono moraire na gotimoka? Rora ensa yaikire, na Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto obekirwe ase amaboko ’abanyene ebibe.
Imoka, togende, rora, ere oyokondua oikire ang’e.”
Ekero arenge gokwana, Yudas, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, agacha, na omoganda omonene amo nere bare nemioro ne chinungu, bakorwa ase abakuani abanene na abagaaka b’abanto.
Ere oyokomorua, konya obaeire ekemanyererio, agateba, “Oyo ndanyunyunte, oyio nere, momobwate.”
Erio kegima agachiera Yeso, agateba, “Masoge, Omonene!” Akamonyunyunta.
Yeso akamotebia, “Mosani, nase ki gwacha aa?” Erio bagacha, bakamobwata Yeso, bakamoira.
Na rora, oyomo obo bw’abarenge amo na Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akang’usa omoyio oye o birende, agaaka omosomba bw’omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto.
Erio Yeso akamotebia, “Irania omoyio oo o birende aase aye, ekiagera bonsi abakoimokia omoyio o birende inabasire ase omoyio o birende.
Gose tomanyeti ng’a ninyare gosaba Tata, na ere nantomere abamalaika kobua emeganda ikomi na ebere?
Korende naki rende nanga amariko aikeranigwa, ng’a nabo egwenerete koba?”

Ensa eria Yeso agatebia emeganda y’abanto, “Inee! Igo mwachire buna mokoimokera omouri nemioro ne chinungu gocha kong’ira? Kera rituko nigo narenge amo nainwe ase Hekalu ime kworokereria, ko timwambwata.
Korende aya onsi abeire, erinde amariko ’ababani aikeranigwe.” Erio aborokigwa bonsi bakamotiga, bagatama.
Baria babwatete Yeso bakamoira ase Kayafa omokuani omonene, aase aborokia b’amariko na abagaaka basangererekanete.
Na Petero akamotunyana korwa nyuma ore egeka, goika ase egoora y’omokuani omonene, agasoa ime, agaikaransa amo nabasomba, erinde arore omoerio.
Erio abakuani abanene na ab’ekegambero bonsi bakarigia amang’ana ’oborimo ay’ogosoera Yeso, banyare komoita;
korende nonya abarori abange b’oborimo bachete, tibayanyora. Omoerio abarori babere bagacha,
bakabora, “Oyo nigo atebete: Ninyare gotagora Hekalu ya Nyasae, na koyeagacha ase amatuko atato.”
Erio omokuani omonene agatenena akamoboria, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Inki aba bakogosoera?”
Korende Yeso agakira. Na omokuani omonene akamotebia, “Nagotianirie ase Nyasae ore moyo, ototebie gose naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Naboigo. Aye gwatebire, korende nabatebirie inwe, korwa bono inamorore Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto oikaransete ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’Oyore nokobua, ogocha ase amare a igoro.”
Erio omokuani omonene agatandora chianga chiaye, akabora, “Oramire Nyasae; abarori naba ki tokorigia? Mwaigure emerumi yaye akorama.
Naki moroche?” Bakairaneria, “Omonto oyo nigo agwenerete akwe.”
Erio agwo bakamotwera amate obosio, bakamoaka chinkundi; abande bakamoaka chindoe,
bakobora, “Kristo, tobanere! Ning’o ogoaka?”
Bono Petero nigo aikaransete egoora isiko. Omoiseke oyomo akamochiera, akabora, “Aye naye kwarenge amo na Yeso Omogalili.”
Korende ere agakana ase amasio abo bonsi, akabora “Timanyeti ayio ogokwana.”
Ekero achia gosoka gesieri, omoiseke onde akamorora, agatebia abarengeo, “Omonto oyo nigo arenge amo na Yeso, Omonazareti.”
Agakana naende, na gotiana, “Inche timomanyeti omonto oyio.”
Nyuma ase egeka egeke abateneine aroro bagacha, bagatebia Petero, “Ekeene bori, naye noyomo obo ore, ekiagera ogokwana kwao gwakoorokirie.”
Erio agachaka kweragereria na gotiana, okobora, “Inche timomanyeti omonto oyio.” Erio kegima etuoni ekabuga.
Erio Petero akainyora ring’ana riria Yeso atebete, “Ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga, nonkane ara gatato.” Agasoka isiko, akarera nobororo.
Bogachia gokia mambia, abakuani abanene bonsi na abagaaka b’abanto bagakora ekina ase Yeso, bamoite.
Bakamosiba, bakamoira, bakamomoa Pilato, oyorenge gavuna.
Ekero Yudas, oria omoruete achia korora ng’a onacheirwe ekina, ageitia, akairania chibesa chiria chie chifeta emerongo etato ase abakuani abanene na abagaaka,
okobora, “Namochire ase okorua amanyinga atari na bobe bonde.” Barabwo bakabora, “Ninki aya are asetore? Mbwerorere aye!”
Agatuguta chibesa chiria chie chifeta ase Hekalu ime, akaimoka, akagenda akeng’enta.
Korende abakuani abanene bakaimokia chibesa chiria chie chifeta bakabora, “Tari boronge gochibeka ase ekungo y’esadaka ya Nyasae, ekiagera chirochio nechie rigori ri’amanyinga.”
Bagakora ekina, bakagora oboremo bw’omokori chinyongo, bobe aase bagotindeka abageni.
Ase ayio oboremo obo nigo bokorokwa Oboremo bw’Amanyinga goika rero.
Erio rigaikeranigwa eriatebetwe nomobani Yeremia, ogoteba, “Bakaimokia chibesa chiria chie chifeta emerongo etato, rigori riaye oria obegetwe rigori nabanto bande b’Abaisraeli,
bagachiira ase okogora oboremo bw’omokori chinyongo, buna Omonene anchigete.”
Nere Yeso agatenena ase gavuna; na gavuna akamoboria, “Naye Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi?” Yeso akamotebia, “Naboigo. Aye gwatebire.”
Korende ochia gosoerwa nabakuaani abanene na abagaaka, tairaneria ing’ana rinde.
Erio Pilato akamotebia, “Toigweti amang’ana aya amange bakona‐goteba igoro yao?”
Korende ere tairaneria rinde, nonya nase ring’ana erimo, na gavuna agakumia mono.
Bono ekero kie rituko rinene nigo yarenge engencho ya gavuna kobasiborera omosibwa oyomo oyo barigetie.
Mbabwate omosibwa oyomo omanyekanete, okorokwa Baraba.
Erio kobasangererekanire, Pilato akababoria, “Norori morigetie mbasiborere, Baraba gose Yeso, oyo okorokwa Kristo?”
Ekiagera konya omanyire ng’a nigo bamorure ase obogechi.

Ekero Pilato aikaransire ase ekerogo gi’ekina, akarenterwa amang’ana na mokaye, ogoteba, “Oyio nomonto omonyene oboronge, tobaisa kwebwatia asare, ekiagera rero inachandetwe namange ase okorota ase engencho yaye.”
Bono abakuani abanene na abagaaka bakagenka emeganda ng’a baborie baegwe Baraba, na Yeso bamoite.
Gavuna akababoria naende, “Ase abanto aba babere, norori morigetie mbasiborere?” Bakamotebia, “Baraba.”
Pilato akababoria, “Imokore naki Yeso, oyo okorokwa Kristo?” Bakamotebia bonsi, “Tiga abambwe!”
Akababoria, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete?” Barabwo bakamenta goaka egeturi, bakobora, “Tiga abambwe!”

Ekero Pilato achia korora ng’a gento tikenyarekaneti asare, ne riroroche rioka rikona‐kobucha, akaimokia amache, agaisaba amaboko aye ase obosio bw’omoganda, ogoteba, “Inche tindi na komocha ase amanyinga ’omonto oyo omonyene oboronge. Nigoro yaino abanyene.”
Abanto bonsi bakairaneria, “Amanyinga aye, tiga abe igoro asetore, na ase abana baito!”
Erio akabasiborera Baraba, na nyuma gaakire Yeso emecharichi, akabamotigera anyare kobambwa.
Erio abarwani ba gavuna bakaira Yeso ime ase enyomba y’ekegambero, bakamosangererekera omoganda omogima bw’abarwani.
Bakamorusia chianga chiaye, bakamobekera eanga embariri.
Bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera motwe, na egetonto bakamobekera ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio; bagatung’ama asare, bakamochecheria na kobora, “Masoge, Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi!”
Erio bakamotwera amate, bakaimokia egetonto keria, bakamoaka ase omotwe.
Kobamochecheirie, bakamorusia eanga eria embariri, bakamobekera chianga chiaye omonyene, bakamoira isiko abambwe.
Kobagosoka korwa ase omochie, bakarora omonto oyomo, Omokurene, okorokwa Simion; bakabetereria omonto oyio abogorerie Yeso omosalaba.
Bagachia goika aase akorokwa Gologotha (engencho yaye: Aase Ekeore),
bakamoa edivai esang’anirie nendorwe, anywe. Agachia koyeigwa, tancha konywa.
Kobamobambire bagaatanana chianga chiaye, bagakora obomera.
Erio bagaikaransa komorigereria aria.
Igoro ase omotwe oye bakabeka ogosoerwa kwaye, korikire, “OYO NERE YESO, OMORUOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI”.
Erio abauri babere bakabambwa amo nere, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.
Na barabwo abaare goeta, bakamorama, bagosinga‐singisia emetwe yabo, bakobora,
“Aye oyogotagora Hekalu na koyeagacha ase amatuko atato, etoorie! Onye naye Omwana o Nyasae, ika korwa ase omosalaba.”
Na baria abakuani abanene bagakora boigo, bakamokorera echeche amo naborokia b’amariko na abagaaka, bakobora,
“Natooretie abande, ere omonyene takonyara gwetooria. Ere n’Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, tiga aike bono korwa ase omosalaba, na intwe rirorio ntomwegene.
Nigo asemeretie Nyasae, tiga Nyasae amotoorie bono, onye omoganetie, ekiagera natebete: Inche n’Omwana o Nyasae.”
Na baria abauri, ababambetwe amo nere, bakamorama boigo.
Bono korwa chinsa isano nemo omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda.
Chiachia koba ang’e chinsa kianda, Yeso, akarera neriogi rinene, okobora, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakitani?” Okoonchorwa kwaye, “Nyasae one, Nyasae one, naki gwantigire?”
Na abande b’abwo bateneine aroro, bakayaigwa, bakabora, “Omonto oyo n’Elija akorangeria.”
Erio kegima oyomo obo akaimokia esifunchi, akayeichoria chinkama, akayebeka ase egetonto, akamoa anywe.
Korende baria abande bakabora, “Tiga torore gose Elija ngocha are komotooria.”
Yeso akarera naende neriogi rinene, erio agatweka mo.
Na rora, egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatandoka korwa igoro goika inse, gekaba bibere, ense egatengecha, ebitare bigatandoka.
Chimbeera chikamaanoka chigaasama, na emebere emenge y’abanto abachenu konya bakure ekabokigwa.
Kabarure ase chimbeera, nyuma y’okoboka kwa Yeso bagasoa ase omochie omochenu bakaorokera abange.
Na ekero omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana, na abwo barenge amo nere korenda Yeso, bachia korora omotengecho bw’ense na ebiakorekire, bakairoka mono, bakabora, “Ekeene, oyo nigo arenge Omwana o Nyasae!”
Mbarengeo boigo abakungu abange, barigereretie korwa are, abatunyanete Yeso korwa Galili, bakomokorera.
Ase abwo nigo barenge Mariamu Magidalena, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo na Yusufu, na ng’ina ’abana ba Zebedi.
Riachia koba mogoroba, omonto omonda bw’Arimathaya, okorokwa Yusufu, agacha; ere nomworokigwa o Yeso orenge.
Oyio akagenda ase Pilato, akarigia omobere o Yeso. Erio Pilato agachika ayoegwe.
Yusufu akaimokia omobere, akayoboyia egetambaa ekiya ki’egatani,
akayobeka ase oboina bwaye oboyia, obwabachete ase egetare; naende agaturunkania rigena rinene gochia ase egesieri ki’oboina, akagenda.
Mbarengeo Mariamu Magidalena na Mariamu onde, baikaransete bosio bw’oboina.
Rituko ria kabere, nario riare rigotunya rituko ri’Okwearigania, abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagasangererekana ase Pilato,
bakabora, “Omonene, twainyoire ng’a omonyaborimo oria natebete ekero arenge moyo: Nyuma ase amatuko atato nimboke.
Gaki, chika oboina borendwe buya goika rituko ria gatato, aborokigwa baye tibabaisa gocha komoiba, batebie abanto ng’a obokire korwa ase abakure; okong’aina kw’omoerio nakobue koria kwe ritang’ani.”
Pilato akabatebia, “More nabarendi; genda morende mono oboina buna moranyare.” Bakagenda bakaborenda mono, bakabeka rigena riria ekemanyererio, naende bakabeka abarendi.
Esabato egachia koera, kobogokiamoka rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, Mariamu Magidalena na oria Mariamu onde bakagenda korora oboina.
Na rora, norengeo omotengecho omonene, ekiagera omomalaika bw’Omonene aigete korwa igoro, agachia agatigeria rigena riria, akariikaransera.
Ekieni kiaye nigo kiarenge buna okomesa kw’embura, na eanga yaye nendabu buna amagena ’embura.
Ase okomoiroka ere abarendi bakaiguswa, bakaba buna abanto bakure.
Korende omomalaika agatebia abakungu baria, “Timoiroka inwe, ekiagera namanyire ng’a Yeso mokorigia, oria obambetwe.
Tari aiga, ekiagera obokire, buna atebete. Inchuo, morigererie aase Omonene araire.
Na genda bwango, motebie aborokigwa baye ng’a obokire korwa ase abakure; na rora, obatang’aneire kogenda Galili; agwo nao moramorore. Rora, inche nabatebirie ayio.”
Bakaimoka korwa ase oboina bwango, bare nokoiroka na omogoko omonene, bakaminyoka, bakairera aborokigwa baye amang’ana.
Na rora, Yeso akaumerana nabarabwo, akabakwania, “Masoge!” Na barabwo bagacha, bakamobwata amagoro, bakamosasima.
Erio Yeso akabatebia, “Timoiroka! Genda motebie abaminto bagende Galili, nao barandore.”
Kobakogenda, rora, abande b’abarendi baria bagasoa ase omochie, bagatebia abakuani abanene amang’ana onsi ayakoregete.
Na ekero basangererekanire amo nabagaaka, na kobaroisirie amang’ana, bakaa abarendi baria chibesa chinyinge,
bakabora, “Motebie abanto: Aborokigwa baye bachete botuko, bakamoiba ekero twararire.
Ring’ana eri koriraigweke ase gavuna, intwe natoche tokwane nere, tomoebererie, na korusia inwe ase emechando.”
Bakabogoria chibesa chiria, bagakora buna batebetigwe, na omogano oyo okumire ase Abayahudi goika rero iga.
Aborokigwa baria ikomi nomo bakagenda Galili, bagaika egetunwa keria Yeso abachigete.
Ekero bachia komorora, bakamosasima; korende abande mbabete nogosiereria.
Yeso agacha, akabatebia, “Naeirwe okobua gwonsi igoro na ense.
Gaki genda mokore ebisaku bionsi koba aborokigwa, mokobabatisa ase erieta ria Tata, neri’Omwana, neri’Omoika Omochenu,
mokoborokereria kobwata aya onsi nabachigete; na rora, inche nigo inde amo nainwe amatuko onsi goika omoerio bw’ense.”
Oyo noro omochakano bw’enchili ya Yesu Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae,
buna erikire ase ebuku y’omobani Isaya. “Rora, natomire omotomwa one agotang’anere, oyo oraroisie enchera yao;
eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro: Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye!”
Erio Yohana Omobatisi akaoroka ase erooro, okorandia, okobatebia, “Onchoka, mobatiswe, monyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe.”
Abanto b’ense yonsi ya Boyahudi, na bonsi aba Yerusalemu bakamochiera, bakabatiswa nere ase orooche rwa Yorodan, bakoorokia ebibe biabo.
Na Yohana nigo arenge kobeka chianga chi’amarionya ’engamia, na kweboeria orokini rwe riiyo kenema kiaye. Nigo arenge koria chingige na obooke bw’orosana.
Akarandia, okobora, “Nache korwa nyuma yane oyore ne chinguru kombua, omonto inche ntaisaini gotung’ama na gosibora chinuga chi’ebikoroto biaye.
Inche nigo nkobabatisa ase amache, korende ere nababatise ase Omoika Omochenu.”
Ase amatuko aria Yeso agacha korwa Nazareti ya Galili, akabatiswa na Yohana ase orooche rwa Yorodan.
Erio kegima, kagotiira korwa ase amache, akarora igoro amaanokire, na Omoika buna riruma ogoika igoro asare,
na eriogi rikarwa igoro, rigateba, “Aye naye Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie naye.”
Erio kegima Omoika okamoira ase erooro.
Akaba ase erooro amatuko emerongo ene, ogoteemwa na Saitani; ere nigo arenge amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana; na abamalaika bakaba nkomokorera bare.
Goika nyuma Yohana kabekirwe echela ime, Yeso akagenda Galili, akarandia enchili ya Nyasae,
okobora, “Engaki yaikeranire, na oboruoti bwa Nyasae bwaikire ang’e; onchoka na mwegene enchili.”
Ere ekero are goeta ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akarora Simion na Anderea, momura omwabo Simion, bakoruta ekeonga enyancha ime, ekiagera nabarubi barenge.
Yeso akabatebia, “Inchuo montunyane, na inche nimbakore mobe abarubi b’abanto.”
Erio kegima bagatiga ebionga biabo, bakamotunyana.
Akagenderera bosio ake, akarora Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana momura omwabo; barabwo nigo barenge obwato ime bakoroisia ebionga biabo.
Erio kegima akabarangeria; barabwo bagatiga Zebedi ise ime ase obwato amo nabanto b’eng’eria, bakamotunyana.
Bakabwatia enchera goika Kapernaumu, na erio kegima ase rituko ri’Esabato Yeso agasoa ase esinagogi akorokereria.
Bagakumia ase okworokereria kwaye, ekiagera arenge koborokereria buna oyore nokobua, gose tari buna aborokia b’amariko.
Erio kegima narengeo ase esinagogi yabo omonto obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi. Ere agaaka eriogi,
akabora, “Inki tore naye, Yeso o Nazareti? Inee! Nigo gwachire gotosiria? Nakomanyire aye, Omochenu o Nyasae.”
Yeso akagetogonyera, akabora, “Kira, omorwe!”
Ekerecha keria ki’eubi gekamogaragaria, gekarera ase eriogi rinene, gekamorwa.
Bagaichana bonsi, goika bakaborania, bakobora, “Inki eke? Nokworokereria okoyia! Omonto oyo nigo abwate okobua kw’ogochika nonya nebirecha bi’eubi, na birobio bikomoigwera.”
Erio chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ensemo ya Galili.
Erio agwo kobasokire korwa ase esinagogi, bagasoa nyomba mwa Simion na Anderea, amo na Yakobo na Yohana.
Ng’ina biara Simion oraire, orwarete esosera. Erio kegima bakamotebia amang’ana igoro yaye.
Akamoika ang’e, akamoimokia ase okomobwata okoboko. Erio esosera ekamotiga na ere akabakorera.
Riachia koba mogoroba, erioba korikogwa, bakamorentera bonsi abarenge abarwaire, na ababwatetwe nebirecha.
Na omochie bwonsi okaba ngosangererekana ore gesieri.
Akagwenia abange abarenge namarwaire ao ao, agaseria ebirecha ebinge; tatiga ebirecha bikwane, ekiagera biamomanyete.
Mambia, botarakiamoka, akaimoka, agasoka, akagenda aase atari nabanto, agasabera aroro.
Simion na abarenge amo nere bakamotunyana,
bakamonyora, bakamotebia, “Abanto bonsi ngokorigia bare.”
Akabatebia, “Togende aase aande goika ebichie bire ang’e, ninyare korandia na aroro boigo, ekiagera ase ayio naro nachicheire.”
Agasoa ase chisinagogi chiabo ase ense yonsi ya Galili, okorandia na goseria ebirecha.
Omonto oyomo orenge noborwaire bwa ukoma agacha asare, akamosorora na komotung’amera, akamotebia, “Onye ngwancha, nonyare gonsibia.”
Yeso akamororera amabera, akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamotebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.”
Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bokamotiga, agasibeka.
Akamokania bokong’u, akamosokia agende,
akamotebia, “Rigereria, totebia monto onde bwensi amang’ana aya; korende genda bweorokie ase omokuani, orue ekeng’wanso egiachigetwe na Musa ase ogosibeka kwao, erinde kebe kirori ase abanto.”

Korende agasoka, agachaka korandia amang’ana aya na gosareria ring’ana riria, goika Yeso tanyara naende gosoa ase omochie ime maiso marore, korende akabeera isiko aase atari nabanto; na abanto bakamochiera korwa kera aase.
Agasoa Kapernaumu naende nyuma y’amatuko amake; ekaigugwa ng’a nao are nyomba.
Erio abanto abange bagasangererekana amo, tiriatigara ribaga asebare, nonya ngoika gesieri; na Yeso akaba ogokwana ring’ana asebare.
Abanto bagacha; bakamorentera omonto orenge rigata obogoirie nabanto bane.
Ekiagera batanyarete komoika ang’e ase engencho y’omoganda, bakabochora ekerama aase aaria arenge. Kobakoorire kogetagora, bagaikia oborere boria oria orenge rigata araire.
Yeso agachia korora okwegena kwabo agatebia oria orenge rigata, “Omwana one, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”
Abande ase aborokia b’amariko baikaransete aroro, bakeboria ase chinkoro chiabo,
“Naki oyo agoteba iga? Nkorama are! Ning’o oranyare kwabera ebibe, otatiga oyomo, nere Nyasae?”
Erio Yeso namanyete ase omoika oye ime buna baare korengereria ase chinkoro chiabo, akabatebia, “Naki mokorengereria iga ase chinkoro chiaino?
Ndiriri rire eriango, gotebia oyore rigata: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteba: Imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende?
Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agatebia oria orenge rigata,
“Nagotebirie, imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende bwoo.”
Erio kegima akaimoka, agetweka oborere bwaye, akarua ase amasio abo bonsi; goika bagakumia bonsi, bagatogia Nyasae, bakobora, “Ayare buna aya, titwana koyarora rinde nonya ng’ake!”
Agasoka naende, akagenda ensemo y’enyancha. Omoganda bwonsi okamochiera, ere akaborokereria.
Ekero achia goeta, akarora Lawi, omwana bw’Alufayo, oikaransete aase bakobangerwa ebango, akamotebia, “Ntunyana!” Akaimoka, akamotunyana.
Ekaba ekero Yeso aikaransete nyomba mw’omonto oria, okoria endagera, abarusia ebango abange na abanyene ebibe bagaikaransa amo na Yeso na aborokigwa baye; naki barenge abange bamotunyanete.
Aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai bagachia komorora okoria amo nabanyene ebibe na abarusia ebango, bagatebia aborokigwa baye, “Nase ki akoria na konywa amo nabarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe?”
Yeso agachia koigwa aya, akabatebia, “Abare buya tibari korigia omorwaria, otatiga abarwarete; tincheti korangeria ababoronge, korende abanyene ebibe.”

Aborokigwa ba Yohana na Abafarisai nigo barenge kweng’ata. Abanto bande bagacha, bakamoboria, “Nase ki aborokigwa ba Yohana na aborokigwa b’Abafarisai bakweng’ata, ko aborokigwa bao tibari kweng’ata?”
Yeso akabatebia, “Inee! Abarangerigwa b’enyangi inabanyare kweng’ata ekero omonyuomi are amo nabarabwo? Ekero omonyuomi are amo na barabwo, tibakonyara kweng’ata.
Korende amatuko nache barache kourwa omonyuomi, erio nario barache kweng’ata ase rituko riria.
Gose tari monto onde okobareera ekeraka ki’egetambaa ekeyia ase eanga engotu ekiagera keria kiabekwa nigo kegotandora eanga eria, keria ekeyia giachierereria eanga eria engotu etandoke kobua.

Gose onde tari okobeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose edivai eria nebiate ebirandi, edivai eiteke, na ebirandi bitandoke; korende edivai enyia nigo ekobekwa ase ebirandi ebiyia.”
Yeso agachia koba ngoeta arenge ase emegondo y’engano ase rituko ri’Esabato; aborokigwa baye bagachaka kobutora ebigara kobakogenda.
Abafarisai bakamobcria, “Rora, naki bagokora eritari boronge gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato?”
Akabairaneria, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete ekero aremeretwe endagera, akaba nenchara, ere na abwo barenge amo nere,
buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, ekero Abiatari arenge omokuani omonene, akaria emegati yarenge korugwa ase Nyasae, etare boronge koriegwa nonde otatiga nabakuani, naende akaa abarenge amo nere?”
Akabatebia, “Esabato nigo yakoretwe ase engencho ya mwanyabanto, tari mwanyabanto ase engencho y’Esabato;
naki Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nere omonene bw’Esabato.”
Agasoa naende ase esinagogi. Narengeo omonto agwo, okoboko kwaye kwagataete.
Bakamotega Yeso, barore gose nagwenie omonto oria ase rituko ri’Esabato, banyare komosoera.
Agatebia omonto oria okoboko kwaye kwagataete, “Tenena gati aa!”
Akababoria, “Mboronge ase rituko ri’Esabato gokora amaya, gose gokora amabe, gotooria obogima, gose koboita?” Bagakira.

Akabamogoreria amaiso chinsemo chionsi ase okobea, akaigwa obororo ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiabo, agatebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao!” Agakorambora, na okoboko kwaye gokagwena.
Erio kegima Abafarisai baria bagasoka, bakagamba amo n’Abaherodiani buna barakore baite Yeso.
Erio Yeso ageatanana amo naborokigwa baye, bakagenda nyancha. Omoganda omonene korwa Galili okabatunyana, naboigo korwa ase Boyahudi,
na Yerusalemu, na Idumea, na ng’umbu ya Yorodan, ne chinsemo chia Turo na Sidoni. Omoganda oyo omonene, ochia koigwa ebirage bi’amang’ana onsi arenge gokora, okamochiera.
Agatebia aborokigwa baye bamobekere obwato ang’e ase engencho y’abanto; erio omoganda tomomiga.
Ekiagera agwenetie abanto, bonsi abarenge nemechando bakamosongerera, banyare komokuna.
Na ebirecha bi’eubi bigachia komorora, bikagwa ase obosio bwaye, bikarera bigateba, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.”
Akabikania mono tibimoorokia.
Agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, akarangeria abwo arigetie ere omonyene; na barabwo bakamochiera.
Agachora ikomi na babere, banyare, koba amo nere, erinde anyare kobatoma bagende korandia,
na babe nokobua kw’ogoseria ebirecha.
Baria ikomi na babere achorete nabwo aba: Simion nere arogete erieta rinde Petero,
na Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana, momura omwabo Yakobo, akabaroka erieta Boanergi, engencho yaye: Abana b’enkoba;
Anderea na Filipo, na Baritholomayo, na Matayo, na Tomas, na Yakobo bw’Alufayo, na Tadayo, na Simion, oyomo bw’Abazelote,
na Yudas Iskariota, nere oyomoruete. Erio agasoa nyomba.
Na omoganda ogasangerereka naende; barabwo abanyene tibanyara nonya nokoria.
Abaamate baye bagachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bagasoka kogenda komobwata, ekiagera batebete, “Obakirwe neosi.”
Na aborokia b’amariko, abarwete Yerusalemu, bakabora, “Nabwatire na Beelizebuli, na ase okobua kw’omonene bw’ebirecha agoseria ebirecha.”
Akabarangeria bache asare, akabatebia ase emereng’anio, “Naki Saitani aranyare goseria Saitani?
Na oboruoti kaboraatananeke ase borobwo obonyene, oboruoti boria tibokonyara gotenena.
Na enyomba keraatananeke enyene, enyomba eria tekonyara gotenena.
Na onye Saitani bweimokeire ere omonyene, na gweatanana, takonyara gotenena, korende nabe nomoerio.
Omonto takonyara gosoa ase enyomba y’omonto omonyene chinguru na gosakora ebinto biaye, atamosibeti ritang’ani oria omonyene chinguru; nario aranyare gosakora enyomba yaye.
“Ekeene nabatebirie: Ebibe bionsi mwanyabanto nabaaberwe, na okorama gwonsi bararame,
korende monto onde bwensi orarame Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa nonya ng’ake, korende nigo arabe nebibe goika kare na kare.”
Nigo abatebetie ayio ekiagera batebete, “Nabwatire nekerecha ki’eubi.”
Ng’ina na bamura bamwabo Yeso bagacha, bagatenena isiko, bagatoma omonto komorangeria.
Na omoganda nigo orenge oikaransete omoetanaine, okamotebia, “Rora nyoko na bamura bamino isiko bare, mbakorigetie.”
Akabairaneria, “Baba na bamura baminto mbarabi?”
Akarigereria abwo baikaransete bamoetanaine, akabora, “Rora baba na bamura baminto!
Naki oyorakore ogwancha kwa Nyasae, oyio nere momura ominto, na mosubati ominto, na baba.”

Agachaka kworokereria naende ase enyancha mbarabare, na omoganda omonene okamosangererekanera, goika ere akariina obwato, agaikaransa imeo igoro y’enyancha. Omoganda bwonsi nao orenge ase ense enyomo enyancha mbarabare.
Akaborokereria amang’ana amange ase emereng’anio, akabatebia ase okworokereria kwaye,
“Tegerera! Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura.
Agachia koba nkobusura are, chimbusuro chinde chikagwa ase enchera ensemo, chinyoni chigacha chigachiria.
Na echinde chikagwa aase egetare kere, aase amaroba are amake; chikamera bwango, ekiagera amaroba arenge amake.
Omobaso ogachia kobara, chigasusana, na ekiagera chitarenge nemeri, chikoma.
Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakina, agachimiga, tichiama amatunda.
Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikama endagera, chikamera na gokina, na kwama; echinde emerongo etato, na echinde emerongo etano nomo, naende echinde rigana.”
Akabora, “Oyore namato akoigwera tiga aigwe.”
Ekero arenge bweka, abanto baria bamoetanaine amo nabaria ikomi na babere bakamoboria amang’ana ’emereng’anio eria.
Akabatebia, “Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oboruoti bwa Nyasae, korende ase abanto bare isiko, amang’ana onsi nigo are emereng’anio asebare,
erio okorigereria nabarigererie, ko tibakorora, na okoigwa nabaigwe, ko tibakomanya; tibacha koonchoka, baaberwe ebibe biabo.”
Akabatebia, “Timomanyeti omoreng’anio oyo? Gaki emereng’anio yonsi naki morayemanye?
Omobusuri nering’ana akobusura.
Abwo nabwo bare enchera ensemo; aase ring’ana rikobusurwa, na barabwo kobaikire koriigwa, bwango Saitani ocha orusia ring’ana riria riabusuirwe ase emioyo yabo ime.
Naboigo koreng’ana nabwo babusuirwe ase egetare, ekiagera kobaigure ring’ana riria, erio kegima baribwata nomogoko;
na abwo tibari nemeri ime yabo abanyene, korende bagenderera ekero egeke, na ekero emechando gose okorosigwa bikooroka ase engencho ye ring’ana riria, bwango bagwa.
Naende abande nabwo baria babusuirwe ase amagwa, aba nabwo bakoigwa ring’ana,
naende okorengereria gw’ense na obong’ainereria bw’enibo, na okogania kw’amang’ana ande kogosoa, biamiga ring’ana riria, riaba tirikwama.
Naende aba nabwo babusuirwe ase amaroba amaya, abwo nabanto baria bakoigwa ring’ana riria, na koribwata, na kwama okwama, oyomo emerongo etato, oyomo emerongo etano nomo, na oyonde rigana.”
Yeso akabatebia, “Inee! Etaya nigo ekorentwa erinde yamumekwa negetonga gose yabekwa nyaro y’oborere? Teri kobekwa igoro ase ekebekerero?
Naki ring’ana tiriri ribisegete ritache koorokigwa, gose eria bobisi ritache koorokigwa maiso marore.
Omonto kare namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”
Akabatebia, “Rigereria aya mokoigwa; na ekerengo keria mokorengera nakio morache korengerwa inwe, naende namomenterwe.
Naki oyobwate naegwe; korende oyotabwati naurwe nonya neyio abwate.”
Erio akabora, “Oboruoti bwa Nyasae nigo bogwekaine nomonto obusurete embusuro ase riroba.
Akaba okorara na koboka, botuko na mobaso, na embusuro eyio ekamera na gokina, ere atamanyeti buna egokoreka.
Naki ense nigo ekwama enyene, ritang’ani rinyansi, naende ekegara, erio enyeke ase ekegara.
Na endagera koyamire, bwango nigo akoira omoyio okogesa, ekiagera rigesa riaikire ang’e.”
Akagenderera kobora, “Ninki torabogwekanie oboruoti bwa Nyasae? Gose tobobeke ase moreng’anio ki?
Nigo bonga entetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi, ekero egosimekwa ase amaroba nenke kobua chimbusuro chionsi ase ense,
korende koyasimekirwe, ekiina, eba enene kobua emete yonsi ye chinyeni, ekoba ne chinsagia chinene; goika chinyoni chia igoro chinyare gokenderera ase ekiriri kiaye.”
Ase emereng’anio emenge ere buna eye nigo arenge gokwana ring’ana asebare, koreng’ana buna baare konyara koigwa,
gose tare kobatebia ring’ana otatiga ase omoreng’anio, korende agatebereria aborokigwa baye amang’ana onsi bobisi.
Ase rituko riria, rigachia koba mogoroba, akabatebia, “Twamboke gochia ng’umbu.”
Bagatiga omoganda, bakamoira amo nabarabwo, buna arenge, ase obwato boria. Na amaato ande narenge amo nere
Ekembugu‐mbugu ekenene ki’omwaga gekaoroka, emerindo egaaka‐aka obwato goika amache agachaka goichora obwato ime.
Ere omonyene nigo arenge ase obwato ime magega oraire igoro ase omoito. Bakamotura, bakamotebia, “Omworokia, tari gento asore gatogosira?”
Akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga, agatebia enyancha, “Kira, otoerere!” Omwaga okaera; gokaba ogotoerera okonene.
Akabatebia, “Naki mokwoboa inwe? Timori nokwegena?”
Bagasogwa nomoondoko omonene, bagatebania, “Ning’o oyo rende, goika nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?”
Bagaika ng’umbu y’enyancha, goika ense y’Abageraseni.
Yeso agachia goika korwa obwato; agwo akaumerana nomonto okorwa ase chimbeera obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi.
Obomenyo bwaye nigo bwarenge aria ase chimbeera. Monto onde tarenge ore konyara komosiba nonya nase ebinyuri,
ekiagera nigo arenge konya osibirwe ara aange ne chingataare na ebinyuri, abutora ebinyuri biria, na kobuna‐buna chingataare chiria, na onde tarenge ore ne chinguru chi’okomobua.
Na botambe, botuko na mobaso, nao arenge ase chimbeera na ebitunwa, okona‐korera na gwekeba‐keba namagena.
Agachia korora Yeso korwa are, akaminyoka chimbero, akamosasima;
agaaka eriogi, okobora, “Inaki inde naye Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae ore Igoro Mono? Nagotianirie ase Nyasae ng’a tonchanda”,
ekiagera Yeso konya ogetebirie, “Aye ekerecha ki’eubi, karwe ase omonto oyo!”
Yeso akamoboria, “Erieta riao naki okorokwa?” Akairaneria, “Erieta riane n’Elegioni, ekiagera nabange tore.”
Akamosorora mono tabiira isiko y’ense eria.
Aria ase egetunwa ndiarengeo riicho rinene rie chimbeche riare korisia.
Ebirecha bionsi bikamosorora, bikabora, “Toire ase chimbeche, tonyare gosoa chirochio.”

Akabia ribaga. Ebirecha biria bi’eubi bigasoka, bigasoa ase chimbeche chiria; riicho riria rigatirimboka bwango gochia ase egeturunkano, goika chikagwa enyancha ime. Igo chiarenge koreng’ana chilifu ibere, chikarimera nyancha ime.
Abarisia bagatama, bakararia amang’ana aya ase omochie na ebichie. Abanto bagasoka barore amang’ana aorokire.
Bagachiera Yeso, bakarora omonto oria obwatire nomoganda bw’ebirecha oikaransete, bweboyetie chianga, ore nebirengererio ebironge bakairoka.
Na baria abayaroche bakaorokia amang’ana amonyorire oria obwatire nebirecha, na amang’ana e chimbeche.
Bagachaka gosorora Yeso arue ase chimbebe chiabo.
Agachia koriina obwato ime, oria obwatire nebirecha akamosorora ng’a abe amo nere.
Yeso tamwanchera, korende akamotebia, “Genda nka bwoo ase abamino, obatebie amang’ana amanene aya Omonene agokoreire, naende buna akororeire amabera.”
Akagenda bwoye, agachaka koraria ase Dekapoli amang’ana aya Yeso amokoreire. Abanto bonsi bagakumia.
Yeso kambokire naende koirana ng’umbu nobwato boria, omoganda omonene okamosangererekanera; ere nigo arenge ensemo y’enyancha.
Omonto oyomo bw’abanene b’esinagogi agacha, erieta riaye Yairo. Agachia komorora, akagwa ase amagoro aye,
akamosorora mono, akabora, “Omonene, omoiseke one omoke oisire gokwa. Nagosabire, oche obeke okoboko kwao igoro yaye, anyare kogwena, abe moyo.”
Akagenda amo nere. Omoganda omonene okamotunyana, okamomiga‐miga.
Narengeo omokungu oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere.
Ere nigo achandegete mono ase amaboko ’abarwaria abange. Ere konya osiareire ebinto bionsi arenge nabio, tagwenigwa nonya ng’ake, korende obogima bwaye bokamentekana koba obobe kobua.
Erio agachia koigwa amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, agaeta ase omoganda korwa nyuma, agakuna eanga yaye,
ekiagera nigo atebete, “Kondakune chianga chiaye chioka, ningwene.”
Erio kegima ensoko y’amanyinga aye egakama: akaigwa omobere oye ng’a ogwenire korwa ase oborwaire bwaye.
Erio agwo Yeso akamanya ase omoyo oye ng’a chinguru chiarure asare, akeonchora gati ase omoganda, akabora, “Ning’o okuna chianga chiane?”
Aborokigwa baye bakamotebia, “Kwarorire omoganda buna okomigete, na aye gokoboria: Ning’o onkuna?”
Akarigereria chinsemo chionsi, erinde arore oria okora ring’ana erio.
Na omokungu oria agasogwa nomoondoko na okoiguswa, akamanya eriamonyorire, agacha akamogwera, akamoorokeria ekeene gionsi.
Yeso akamotebia, “Omoiseke one, okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie, genda nomorembe, ogwene korwa ase oborwaire bwao.”
Ekero arenge gokwana, abanto korwa ase enyomba y’omotang’ani bw’esinagogi bagacha, bakabora, “Enyaroka yao yakure. Inki okona‐koroseria Omworokia rende?”
Korende Yeso tancha gotegerera ring’ana riria rigotebwa, agatebia omotang’ani oria bw’esinagogi, “Toiroka, egene rioka.”
Gose tanchete monto onde amotunyane, otatiga Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo.
Bagaika enyomba y’omonene oria bw’esinagogi; akarora riroroche, na abanto bakorera nokweumia okonge.
Agachia gosoa, akabatebia, “Naki mogokora riroroche na korera? Omwana takweti, korende nigo araire.”
Bakamosekerera. Korende gaikire kobasokia isiko bonsi, akaira ise omwana, na ng’ina, na baria barenge amo nere, agasoa ime ase omwana oria arenge.
Akamobwata okoboko omoiseke oria omoke, akamotebia, “Talitha kumi”, okoonchorwa kwaye, “Omoiseke, nagotebirie, imoka.”
Erio agwo omoiseke oria omoke agatenena akagenda, ere konya okoorire emiaka ikomi na ebere. Erio bagakumia ogokumia okonene.
Yeso akabakurera ng’a monto onde tamanya amang’ana ayio, akabachika bae omoiseke oria endagera arie.
Akarua agwo, agaika ase ense yaye omonyene; aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.

Na ekero gi’Esabato agachaka kworokereria ase esinagogi; abange abamoigwete bagakumia, bagatebania, “Oyo ng’ai anyorire aya? Mbong’aini ki obo aeirwe oyo? Ogokora gwe chinguru ki oko okonene kogokoreka ase amaboko aye?
Oyo tari oria omobaachi, omwana o Mariamu, momura omwabo Yakobo, na Yose, na Yuda, na Simion, na basubati bamwabo tibari aiga seito?” Bakagechigwa nere.
Yeso akabatebia, “Omobani takomocha gosikwa, otatiga ase ense yaye, na ase eamate yaye, na ase enyomba yaye.”
Gose tanyara gokora ogokora gwe chinguru aroro, otatiga abegete amaboko aye igoro ase abarwaire bake, akabagwenia.
Agakumia ase engencho y’ogotegena kwabo. Agaetanana ase ebichie biaetanaineo okworokereria.
Akarangeria baria ikomi na babere, agachaka kobatoma babere babere, akabaa okobua igoro ase ebirecha bi’eubi;
akabakania tibaira gento ase orogendo rwabo, otatiga cnyimbo yoka. Tibaira nonya nomogati, nonya nesaro, nonya nechibesa ase ebimoya biabo.
Korende babeke ebikoroto, go tibeboyia chianga ibere.
Akabatebia, “Enyomba ende yonsi ase morasoe, mobeere aroro goika ekero moraimoke korwa aase aria.
Na kera aase abanto batabaroiseti inwe, gose kobaigwa, komokorua aroro, mokong’onte orotu rore inse ase amagoro aino, robe kirori asebare.”
Bagasoka, bakarandia ng’a abanto baonchoke.
Bagaseria ebirecha ebinge, bagaaka abanto abange amaguta, abwo barenge abarwaire, bakabagwenia.
Omoruoti Herode akaigwa amang’ana, ekiagera erieta ria Yeso konya riakumire, akabora, “Yohana Omobatisi obokire korwa ase abakure, nakio gekogera chinguru echi chigokora emeremo ime asare.”
Korende abande bakabora, “N’Elija.” Na abande bakabora, “Oyo nomobani, gose nigo anga buna oyomo bw’ababani.”
Korende Herode agachia koyaigwa, akabora, “Oyo nere Yohana oria nanachete omotwe, obokire.”
Naki Herode omonyene nigo atomete abanto kobwata Yohana, akamosiba echela ase engencho ya Herodia moka Filipo momura omwabo, oria Herode amotwarete,
ekiagera Yohana amokanetie Herode, “Tai boronge asore komenyana na moka momura omino.”
Nabo oria Herodia akaba nokogecha asare, akarigia komoita, korende tanyara,
ekiagera Herode nairogete Yohana, konya omanyire ng’a nomonto omoronge, omochenu, akamorenda. Gachia komoigwa, agaichana mono; nonya nabo nigo arenge komoigwa nomogoko.
Rituko rigwenerete rigachia goika ekero Herode ase rituko ri’okoinyora okoiborwa kwaye agachia gokora omoyega ase abatang’ani bare inse yaye, na abatang’ani b’esegi, na abanto abanene ba Galili.
Ekero omoiseke bwe Herodia asoa gotenga, akagokia Herode amo nabwo baikaransete nere ase omoyega. Omoruoti agatebia omoiseke oria, “Nsabe kende gionsi ekio origetie, na inche ninkoe.”
Akamoriera eira, “Kende gionsi ekiorarigie korwa asende ninkoe, nonya nekeng’ese ki’oboruoti bwane.”
Omoiseke oria agasoka, akaboria ng’ina, “Inki ndasabe?” Ng’ina akamoiraneria, “Omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi.”
Erio kegima agasoa nomoayerero ase obosio bw’omoruoti, agasaba, akabora, “Nindigetie ong’e omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi bono iga ase esani.”
Omoruoti akaba nomoichano mono, korende ase engencho ye chiira chiaye, na ase engencho y’abwo baikaransete ase omoyega, tarigetie kwanga.
Erio kegima omoruoti agatoma omorwani oyomo, agachika ng’a omotwe o Yohana orentwe. Omorwani oria akagenda akamonacha omotwe aria echela ime,
akayorenta ore ase esani, akayoa omoiseke oria, na omoiseke oria akayoa ng’ina.
Aborokigwa baye bagachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bakagenda bakabogoria egetondo, bakagetindeka.
Abatomwa bakairana ase Yeso, bakamotebia onsi ayabakorete, na amang’ana onsi ayaborokereretie.
Akabatebia, “Inchuo inwe mweka, togende aase abanto batari, motimoke ake.” Naki abanto abange mbarengeo, bagocha na bakogenda; nonya neribaga tiriarenge ri’okoria.
Bakagenda ase obwato, aase abobisi, atari nabanto.
Abanto bakabarora bakogenda, abange ase abwo bakabamanya, bakaminyoka bwango korwa ase emechie yonsi, batang’ane goika asare.
Yeso agachia goika korwa ase obwato, akarora omoganda omonene, akabarorera amabera, ekiagera barenge buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia: agachaka koborokereria amang’ana amange.
Goika chinsa chinyinge chi’omobaso chigaeta, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakabora, “Aase aa negesomo, na bono riagorobire.
Kae abanto aba ribaga, erinde bagende emechie na ebichie, aria na aaria, begorere endagera.”
Akabairaneria, “Inwe bae endagera.” Bakamoboria “Inee! Togende togore emegati ye chidinari amagana abere, tobae barie?”
Akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate? Genda morore!” Bagachia komanya bakabora, “Netano, ne chinswe ibere.”
Akabachika babaikaransie bonsi, ebiombe, ebiombe, ase obonyansi obobese.
Bagaikaransa ase chindwaro, echinde rigana erimo na echinde emerongo etano.

Akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, agasamunyora emegati eria, akaa aborokigwa baye babiterekere abanto, ne chinswe chiria ibere, akabagabera bonsi.
Bonsi bakaria, bakaigota.
Bagasangereria ebisamunye biasamunyogete, na ebio bigaichoria ebitonga ikomi na bibere, naboigo nebisamunye bie chinswe.
Na abasacha abariete emegati eria nigo barenge chilifu isano.
Erio Yeso akabetereria aborokigwa baye bariine obwato, bamotang’anere kogenda ng’umbu goika Bethisaida ekero are koa omoganda ribaga ogende.
Goika agachia gokoora gokwana nabarabwo, akagenda egetunwa gosaba.
Riachia koba mogoroba, obwato bokaba enyancha gati, na ere bweka ase ense enyomo.
Akabarora bagwechanda bagoata amache nemegango, ekiagera omwaga nigo obatangete. Koreng’ana ekero ki’oborendi bwa kane bwa botuko agacha asebare, ogotaara igoro ase enyancha, akarigia kobaetania.
Barabwo bagachia komorora ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, bagakaga ng’a nerirengari, bagaaka eriogi,
ekiagera bonsi abamoroche mbaondogete. Bwango agakwana nabarabwo, akabatebia, “Remia chinkoro! Ninche. Timoiroka!”
Akariina ime ase obwato asebare; omwaga ogakira. Bagaichana mono,
ekiagera tibamanyete amang’ana ’emegati eria, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chiarenge chinkong’u.
Ekero bambokire bagaika ense ya Genesareti, bakabeka ekerochi.
Bagachia gosoka korwa ase obwato, abanto bakamomanya bwango,
bakaminyoka, bagaetanana ense eria yonsi, bagachaka kobogoria abarwaire bare ase amarere abo, bakagenda kera aase baigwete ng’a nao are.

Kera aase are kogenda ase ebichie, gose emechie, gose emegondo, bakabeka abarwaire ase chichiiro, bakamosorora ng’a abae ribaga bakune nonya nomokoba bw’eanga yaye; na abwo bonsi abamokunete bakagwena.
Erio Abafarisai na abande ase aborokia b’amariko barwete Yerusalemu, bagasangerereka asare.
Bakarora abande b’aborokigwa baye bakoragera namaboko are neriko, engencho yaye ataisabiri.
(Naki Abafarisai na Abayahudi bonsi tibakoragera ritang’ani bataraisaba amaboko. Igo babwatetie engencho y’abagaaka babo.
Naende kobakorwa echiiro, tibakoria batesibeti. Naende nchire chingencho chinde babwate buna ogosibia ebikombe ne chinyongo, na ebinto bie chitaai.)
Nabo Abafarisai baria na aborokia b’amariko bakamoboria, “Nase ki aborokigwa bao batari kobwata chingencho chi’abagaaka, korende bakoragera namaboko are neriko?”
Yeso akabatebia “Isaya nigo abanete buya igoro yaino, inwe abang’ainereria, buna erikire; “Abanto aba nigo bansigete ase ebikoba biabo igoro, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare korwa asende.
Abwo nigo bagonsasima ogosasima kwa bosa, bakworokereria amorokererio ayare amachiko a mwanyabanto oka.
“Igo mogotiga richiko ria Nyasae, mwabwata chingencho chia mwanyabanto.”
Akabatebia, “Mwangire richiko ria Nyasae ng’a monyare kobwata chingencho chiaino.
Naki Musa nigo atebete: Sika iso na nyoko, na: Oyorakwane bobe ase ise, gose ase ng’ina, ogokwa nakwe.
Korende inwe moteba: Omonto karatebie ise gose ng’ina: Bionsi ebi anga kwanyora korwa asende nakio Korbani (engencho yaye: Ebiarurwe ase Nyasae) —
timori komotiga naende amokorere ise gose ng’ina ring’ana rinde.
Igo mogosaria ring’ana ria Nyasae ase chingencho chiaino chia kare. Naende amange mwakorire mware koenana omogwekano bw’ayio.”
Akarangeria omoganda naende, akayotebia, “Nyigwe mwensi, naende manya:
Tari egento kere isiko y’omonto, na gekomosoa, keranyare komobekera ogotacheneka, korende ebikorwa ase omonto nabio bikomobekera ogotacheneka. [
Omonto kare namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.]”
Goika agachia gosoa nyomba, gatigire omoganda, aborokigwa baye bakamoboria amang’ana ’omoreng’anio oria.
Akabatebia, “Nonya ninwe timori nobong’aini? Timomanyeti ng’a kera egento kere isiko y’omonto gokeramosoe, tigekonyara komobekera ogotacheneka,
ekiagera tigekomosoa enkoro, otatiga ase enda yoka, erio kiagwa kebaara?” (Ase ogoteba igo, osibirie chindagera chionsi.)
Akabora “Ekegosoka korwa ase omonto nakio gekomobekera ogotacheneka.
Ekiagera ime ase chinkoro chi’abanto nigo bikorwao ebirengererio ebibe, obonyaka, oboibi, oboiti, obotomani,
okogania okobe, obobe, obong’ainereria, oboenenu, ribero, oborami, obwerori, oboriri.
Aya onsi amabe nigo akorwa ime, naro akobekera omonto ogotacheneka.”
Akaimoka korwa aria, akagenda goika chimbebe chia Turo na Sidoni. Agasoa ase enyomba, akarigia tamanyekana na monto, korende tanyara kobiseka.
Erio agwo omokungu oyomo, omwana oye enyaroka obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi, akaigwa amang’ana aye, agacha akamogwera ase amagoro aye.
Omokungu oria n’Omogiriki orenge, egesaku kiaye n’Omosurofenisa. Akamosaba amosererie ekerecha korwa ase enyaroka yaye.
Akamotebia, “Tiga abana baigote ritang’ani, ekiagera tari buya kobogoria obokima bw’abana, gotugutera chisese.”
Korende ere akamoiraneria, “Nabo Omonene, nonya nechisese nyaro ye chimesa nigo chikoria amatori ’abana.”
Akamotebia, “Ase engencho ye ring’ana eri, genda bwoo, ekerecha kiarure ase enyaroka yao.”
Akagenda mwaye, akanyora omwana oria bwareirie borere, na ekerecha keria kiamorure.
Akarua naende ensemo ya Turo, agaeta gati‐gati ya Sidoni, akagenda goika enyancha ya Galili, egati y’ensemo ya Dekapoli.
Bakamorentera omonto ore omotino, naende nigo are gotutura kagokwana; bagasorora Yeso abeke okoboko kwaye igoro asare.
Yeso akamwatanana korwa ase omoganda bobisi, akabeka ebiara biaye ase amato aye, agatwa amate, akamokuna oromeme.
Erio akarigereria gochia igoro, agaita egekoe, akamotebia, “Efatha,” engencho yaye, “Igoreka.”
Bwango amato aye agatinoka, egesibo ki’oromeme rwaye gekororoba, agakwana buya.
Yeso akabachika tibatebia monto, korende buna amentete kobakania, naboigo bamentete koraria amang’ana aya.
Bagakumia mono kobua, bakabora, “Okorire onsi buya. Abarenge emetino obatinoire, na abarenge amamama bakwane.”
Ase amatuko aria ekero omoganda omonene osangererekanete, na barabwo tibarenge na gento bakoria, Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye, akabatebia,
“Naroreire omoganda amabera, ekiagera abwo babeire amatuko atato baikaransete amo nainche batari na gento bakoria;
ninsa koa abanto aba ribaga bagende chinsobo nenchara, nabagoye inchera, na abande ase egati yabo ng’are barwete.”
Aborokigwa baye bakamoiraneria, “Naki omonto aranyare koigotia abanto aba, na aiga nerooro?”
Akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate?” Bakamoiraneria, “Netano na ebere.”
Agachika omoganda oikaranse inse, akabogoria emegati eria etano na ebere. Kayesesenirie, akayesamunyora, akaa aborokigwa baye bayetereke, na barabwo bakayeterekera omoganda.
Igo barenge ne chinswe chinsinini nke igo. Gachisesenirie, akabora, “Nechi baterekere”!
Bakaria, bakaigota; bagasangereria ebisamunye ebiatigarete, ebitonga bitano na bibere.
Na barabwo nigo barenge ang’e chilifu inye.
Akabaa ribaga bagende, na erio bwango akariina obwato amo naborokigwa baye, akagenda chinsemo chia Dalumanuta.
Abafarisai bakaoroka, bagachaka koamererania na Yeso, bakarigia aborokie egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa igoro, bakomoteema.
Agaichana ase omoika oye, akabora, “Naki ekegori eke gekorigia egekone? Ekeene nabatebirie: Ekegori eke tigekoegwa egekone buna eke.”
Akabatiga, akariina obwato naende, akamboka ng’umbu.
Aborokigwa bakeeba koirana emegati; nonya nase obwato tibarenge na gento, otatiga omogati oyomo bwoka.
Yeso akabachika, akabora, “Rigereria, mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai na ememera ya Herode.”
Bakaamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakobora, “Titori nemegati.”
Yeso akamanya aya, akabatebia, “Naki mokoborania, ekiagera motari nemegati? Timokoinyora gose timekomanya? Chinkoro chiaino nigo chire chinkong’u goika bono?
More namaiso, ko timori korora? More namato, ko timori koigwa? Gose timoinyoreti?
Ekero nasamunyorete emegati eria etano nkaa baria chilifu isano, ebitonga mbirenga mwasangererete biichire ebisamunye?” Bakamotebia, “Ikomi na bibere.”
“Na eria etano na ebere nkaa baria chilifu inye, ebitonga mbirenga mwasangereretie biichire ebisamunye?” Bakamotebia, “Mbitano na bibere.”
Akabatebia, “Naki motaramanya?”
Bagaika Bethisaida. Bakamorentera omonto omouko, bakamosorora amokune.
Akabwata omouko oria okoboko, akamoira isiko y’agachie, Kamotwereire amate ase amaiso, akabeka amaboko aye igoro asare, akamoboria, “Kwarorire gento?”
Akarigereria igoro, akabora, “Narorire abanto, ko nigo banga buna emete bakogenda.”
Erio naende akabeka amaboko aye igoro ase amaiso aye. Omouko oria akarigereria mono, akagwena, akarora ebinto bionsi buya.
Yeso akamotebia, “Genda bwoo, tosoa nonya nagachie!”
Yeso agasoka amo naborokigwa baye, bakagenda ebichie bia Kaisaria Filipi. Ekero baare nchera akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a ninche ng’o?”
Bakamoiraneria, “Yohana Omobatisi; na abande: Elija; na abande: Oyomo ase ababani.”
Akababoria, “Nainwe nigo mokobora ng’a ninche ng’o?” Petero akamoiraneria, “Aye naye Kristo.”
Akabakania tibatebia monto amang’ana aye.

Agachaka koborokereria, ng’a negwenerete Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto anyore ogochandeka ase chinchera chinyinge, na kwangwa nabagaaka na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariko, na goitwa, na nyuma y’amatuko atato naboke.
Agakwana amang’ana aya maiso marore. Petero akamoira ensemo, agachaka komokania.
Yeso akeonchora, akarigereria aborokigwa baye, agatogonyera Petero, akabora, “Irana nyuma yane, Saitani, ekiagera tori ase ensemo ya Nyasae, korende nase mwanyabanto.”
Akarangeria omoganda na aborokigwa baye, akabatebia, “Oyorigetie gontunyana, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye, antunyane.
Naki onde bwensi orarigie koegera obogima bwaye, oyio nabosirie; na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho yane, na ase engencho y’enchili, oyio naboegere.
Ninki eragwenere omonto konyora ense yonsi, ko asirie omoyo oye?
Gose inki omonto ararue ribaga ri’omoyo oye?

Naki oyio oranyare kondorera obosooku inche, na amang’ana aane, ase ekegori eke ki’obotomani na ebibe, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto namororere obosooku ere, ekero agocha nobonene bwa Ise amo nabamalaika abachenu.”
Akabatebia, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Mbare abanto bande ase aba bateneine aiga, abataigwe amakweri goika barore oboruoti bwa Nyasae bogocha ne chinguru.”
Na nyuma ase amatuko atano na rimo Yeso akaira Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana, ase egetunwa egetambe barabwo boka, akaonchoka ekieni kiaye asebare.
Chianga chiaye chikameka‐meka, chikaba chindabu mono, buna omoroisia bw’ense atanyare gochikora chibe chindabu.
Bakaorokerwa na Elija amo na Musa; na barabwo nigo barenge gokwana na Yeso.
Petero agatebia Yesu, “Omonene, mbuya intwe koba aiga, tiga tokore ebigutu bitato: ekemo ekiao, ekemo ekia Musa, na ekemo eki’Elija.”
Naki tamanyete eki agokwana, ekiagera babete nomoondoko omonene.
Korende riire rigacha rikababisia; eriogi rikarwa ase riire riria, rigateba, “Oyo n’Omwana one, omwanchwa, moigwere ere!”
Erio bwango kobarigereirie aria na aaria, tibarora monto onde, otatiga Yeso bweka amo nabarabwo.
Kabagotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa akabakania tibatebia monto ayabaroche, goika Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto kabokire korwa ase abakure.
Bakabwata ring’ana riria, bakaborania barabwo ase barabwo, ng’a okoboka korwa ase abakure, engencho yaye ninki.
Bakamoboria, “Nase ki aborokia b’amariko bagoteba ng’a negwenerete Elija ache ritang’ani?”
Akabatebia, “Nekeene n’Elija ore gocha ritang’ani, na koroisia onsi; korende amo naya, ekiagera arikire ng’a Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nachandwe namange na gochaywa?
Korende nabatebirie: Elija oikire gocha, na barabwo bakamokorera onsi aya barigetie, buna arikeretwe.”
Kobaikire ase aborokigwa bande, bakarora omoganda omonene obaetanaine; aborokia b’amariko bakaengererania nabarabwo.
Erio omoganda bwonsi, ogachia komorora, ogakumia mono; abwo bakamochiera bwango, bakamokwania.
Akababoria, “Ninki mokoengererania nabarabwo?”
Omonto oyomo ase omoganda akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, namorenta omomura one asore, obwatire nekerecha kemokorete rimama;
ekero kiamobokire nigo gekomogaragaria inse, asokia risombogoku, na koriania amaino; ase ayio chinguru chiaye chisira. Ngakwana naborokigwa bao bageserie, tibanyara.”
Akabairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, nimbe nainwe goika ririri? Nindemererie nainwe goika ririri? Mondetere aa!”
Bakamorenta asare. Ekero kiarora Yeso, bwango ekerecha keria gekaigusia omomura oria, na ere akagwa inse akegaragaria, agasokia risombogoku.
Yeso akaboria ise, “Nkorwa kero ki anyoretwe naya?” Agateba, “Nkorwa obwana bwaye.
Ara aange kemoruta ase omorero na ase amache, erinde kemosirie, korende koranyare gokora ring’ana, tororere amabera, otokonye.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Koranyare! Onsi nigo akonyarekana asare ere oyobwegenire.”
Bwango ise omwana oria agaaka eriogi, akarera, akabora, “Negenire, nkonya ase ogotegena kwane!”
Yeso agachia korora ng’a omoganda ngosangererekana ore bwango, agakania ekerecha keria ki’eubi, akagetebia, “Aye ekerecha rimama na egetino, inche nagochikire, morwe, tomoiranera naende!”
Erio gekarera, gekamogaragaria mono gekamorwa. Omwana oria akaba buna oyokure, goika abange bakabora, “Okure.”
Korende Yeso akamobwata okoboko, akamoimokia, na ere agatenena.
Gasoire ase enyomba, aborokigwa baye bakamoboria bobisi, “Naki intwe totanyara kogeseria?”
Akabatebia, “Ekerecha kenga buna eke tigekonyara korwa ase ring’ana rinde rionsi, otatiga ase ogosaba na okweng’ata.”
Bakarua aria, bagaeta gati‐gati ya Galili; Yeso tancha omonto amanye,
ekiagera arenge kworokereria aborokigwa baye, akabatebia ng’a, “Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nkogenda are kobekwa ase amaboko ’abanto, na barabwo nabamoite, na ekero aitirwe naboke nyuma y’amatuko atato.”
Korende tibamanya ring’ana riria, bakairoka komoboria.
Bagaika Kapernaumu. Ekero arenge nyomba ime, akababoria, “Ninki mware koamererania inchera?”
Bagakira, ekiagera ekero barenge inchera baare koamererania barabwo ase barabwo ning’o ore omonene kobua abande.
Agaikaransa inse, akarangeria baria ikomi na babere, akabatebia, “Omonto origetie koba oyo bwe ritang’ani nabe oyo bw’omoerio kobua bonsi, omosomba o bonsi.”
Akabogoria omwana, akamobeka gati‐gati yabo, akamoagata, akabatebia,
“Onde bwensi oramwanche omwana oyomo buna oyo ase erieta riane, oyio onyanchire inche; na oyoranyanche inche, tanyancheti inche, korende ere oyontomete.”
Yohana akamotebia, “Omworokia, ntwarora omonto ogoseria ebirecha ase erieta riao; tokamokania, ekiagera tare gototunyana intwe.”
Yeso agateba, “Timomokania, ekiagera monto onde tari oranyare gokora ebikone ase erieta riane, anyare erio bwango gonteba bobe,
ekiagera oyo otari mamincha yaito, oyio nensemo yaito are.
Naki onde bwensi orabae inwe amache negekombe ase erieta riane, ekiagera inwe more abanto ba Kristo, nekeene nabatebirie: Tagosiria eng’eria yaye nonya ng’ake.
“Onde bwensi oragere oyomo bw’aba abake abanyegenete akore ebibe, anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, na gotugutwa nyancha ime.
Na onye okoboko kwao gokogera okore ebibe, bonache; mbuya gosoa ase obogima kore ekerema, kobua koba namaboko abere, na kogenda ase omorero o kare na kare oyotakorimeka, [
aase amakonde abo atagokwa, na omorero otakorimeka].
Na onye okogoro kwao gokogera okore ebibe, konache; mbuya gosoa ase obogima kore egesegora, kobua koba namagoro abere, na gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare [
aase amakonde abo atagokwa, na omorero otakorimeka].
Na onye neriso riao rikogera okore ebibe, orirusie oritugute; mbuya gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae kore egetong’o, kobua koba namaiso abere, na gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare,
aase amakonde abo atagokwa na omorero otakorimeka.
“Naki kera omonto nabekwe omonyo ase omorero.
Omonyo nomuya, korende omonyo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki morayobeke bwanse? Mobe nomonyo ime asemore, momenye ase omorembe inwe ase inwe.”
Akaimoka korwa agwo, agaika chimbebe chia Boyahudi, ng’umbu ya Yorodan. Abanto abange bakamosangererekera naende; akaborokereria aroro, buna anarete botambe.
Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamoboria, “Inee! Mboronge omonto gotiga mokaye?” Bakamoteema.
Ere akabairaneria, “Inki Musa abachigete?”
Bagateba, “Musa nigo aruete ribaga korika rirube ri’ogotigana, na komotiga.”
Yeso akabatebia, “Ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiaino nakio kiagerete abarikerete ogochika oko.
Korende korwa omochakano bw’ogotongwa gw’ense Nyasae nigo atongete omosacha na omokungu.
Ase engencho eyio omonto natige ise na ng’ina, abwatane na mokaye,
na abwo babere nigo barabe omobere oyomo. Ase igo tibakoba babere naende, korende omobere oyomo.
Naboigo ebi Nyasae abwatanirie, mwanyabanto tabiatanana.”
Naende nyomba ime aborokigwa bakamoboria engencho ye ring’ana erio.
Akabatebia, “Kera omonto oratige mokaye, na kunyuoma oyonde, otomanire igoro asare:
na omokungu karatige omosacha oye, na konyuomwa nomonto onde, nere otomanire.”
Bakamorentera abana abake, erinde anyare kobakuna; aborokigwa baye bakabatanga.
Korende Yeso agachia korora, akabea mono, akabatebia, “Batige abana abake bache asende, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oboruoti bwa Nyasae nobwabo
Ekeene nabatebirie: Onde bwensi otancheti oboruoti bwa Nyasae buna omwana omoke, takobosoa nonya ng’ake.”
Akabaimokia, akabaagata ase amaboko aye, akabasesenia, okobeka amaboko aye igoro asebare.
Goika agachia koba ogosoka kogenda enchera, omonto oyomo agacha bwango, akamotung’amera, akamoboria, “Omworokia omuya, inki ndakore inyare koba nomwando bw’obogima bwa kare na kare?”
Yeso akamotebia, “Naki okondoka omuya? Onde tari omuya otatiga Nyasae bweka.
Kwamanyire amachiko: Toita, Totomana, Toiba, Toteba oborimo, Tong’aina, Sika iso na nyoko.”
Akamotebia, “Omworokia, ayio onsi ninyabwatete korwa obwana bwane.”
Yeso akamobeta amaiso, akamwancha, akamotebia, “Egento ekemo ngekoremerete; genda, oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi, oe abataka, na aye nobe nenibo igoro; erio oche ontunyane.”
Korende ere abanyiria obosio ase ring’ana riria, akagenda nobororo, ekiagera arenge nenibo enyinge.
Yeso akarigereria chinsemo chionsi, agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Nabe aakong’u ase abare abanda gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
Aborokigwa bagaichana ase amang’ana aya. Yeso akairaneria naende, akabatebia, “Abana, nabe aakong’u ase abasemeretie enibo gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae!
Naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esindani kobua omonda gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
Barabwo bagaichana mono, bakaborania, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”
Yeso akabarigereria, akabora, “Ase mwanyabanto takonyarekana, korende ase Nyasae taibo, ekiagera onsi nigo akonyarekana ase Nyasae.”
Petero agachaka komotebia, “Rora, intwe twatigire bionsi, twagotunyanire.”

Yeso akabora, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Monto onde tari otigire enyomba, gose bamura bamwabo, gose basubati bamwabo, gose ng’ina, gose ise, gose abana, gose emegondo ase engencho yane, gose ase engencho y’enchili,
otatiga aegwe ara rigana ase ekero kia bono, chinyomba, na bamura bamwabo, na basubati bamwabo, na abang’ina, na abana, na emegondo, ase emechando, na ase ense egochigocha obogima bwa kare na kare.
Korende abange abare abe ritang’ani, nababe abanyuma; na abanyuma babe abe ritang’ani.”

Bakaba inchera, bagotiira kogenda Yerusalemu. Yeso nigo arenge obatang’aine, na barabwo bagaichana, na abamotunyanete bakairoka. Akaira naende baria ikomi na babere, agachaka kobatebia ebirage bi’amang’ana agochia komonyora,

akabora, “Rigereria, ngotiira tore kogenda Yerusalemu, na Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nabekwe ase amaboko ’abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko. Abwo nabamogambie akwe, na bamobeke ase amaboko abanto b’Ebisaku,
na barabwo nabamochecherie, na komo aka chinkini, na komotwera amate, na komoita; nyuma y’amatuko atato naboke.”
Yakobo na Yohana, abana ba Zebedi, bakamochiera, bakamotebia, “Omworokia, ntorigetie otokorere rinde rionsi toragosabe.”
Akababoria, “Inki morigetie mbakorere?”
Bakamoiraneria, “Otwanchere intwe toikaranse, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio, na oyonde ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okobee, ase obonene bwao.”
Yeso akabatebia, “Timomanyeti eki mogosaba. Inee! Namonyare konywera egekombe nkonywera inche, na kobatiswa ebatiso mbatisire inche?”
Bakamoiraneria, “Natonyare.” Yeso akabatebia, “Egekombe nkonywera inche namokenywere, na ebatiso mbatisire inche namobatiswe,
korende ribaga ri’ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio na okoboko kwane gw’okobee tinkonyara kobaa, otatiga abwo bagacheire barariegwe.”
Ekero baria ikomi bachia koigwa aya, bagachaka kobea Yakobo na Yohana.
Yeso akabarangeria, akabatebia, “Mwamanyire ng’a baria babarirwe koba abagambi b’abanto b’Ebisaku nigo bakobagambera ne chinguru, na abanene babo nigo bakobachika.
Korende takoba bo asemore. Omonto origetie koba omonene asemore, nabe omokoreri oino.
Na omonto orarigie koba oyo bwe ritang’ani asemore, nabe omosomba o bonsi.
Naki Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto tachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y’abange.”

Bagaika Yeriko. Goika agachia koba okobwatia enchera korwa Yeriko amo naborokigwa baye na omoganda omonene, omwana o Timayo, Baritimayo, oria orenge omouko, nigo arenge oikaransete enchera ensemo, ogosaba ebiegwa.
Agachia koigwa ng’a nere Yeso Omonazareti, agachaka goaka eriogi, na goteba, “Yeso, omwana o Daudi, indorera amabera!”
Abanto abange bakamotogonyera, bakamotebia ng’a anyare gokira, korende akamenta goaka eriogi kobua, ogoteba “Omwana o Daudi, indorera amabera!”
Yeso agatenena, akabora, “Morangerie!” Bakarangeria omouko oria, bakamotebia, “Remia enkoro yao, imoka, okorangeirie.”
Ere agatuguta eanga yaye, agacharoka, agachiera Yeso.
Yeso akamoboria, “Ninki origetie ngokorere?” Omonto oria orenge omouko akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, inyare korora.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Genda! Okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.” Erio kegima akaba nkorora are, agatunyana Yeso gochia inchera.
Ekero bachia goika ang’e na Yerusalemu, bagaika Betifage na Bethania, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, agatoma babere b’aborokigwa baye,
akabatebia, “Genda ase agachie karia mokoorokera, erio kamogosoa aroro, namorore emori y’etigere esibire, etana koriinwa na monto; moyendetere.
Na omonto karababorie: Naki mogokora iga? Momotebie: Omonene nayeganetie, na bwango nayeiranie naende aa.”
Bakagenda, bakarora emori y’etigere esibire geita isiko ase enchera enene; bakayesibora.
Abanto bande bateneine aroro, bakababoria, “Inki ekio mogokora, mogosibora emori y’etigere?”
Bakabatebia buna Yeso abachigete; na abwo bakabatiga bagende.
Bakarentera Yeso emori eria y’etigere, bakaara chianga igoro asero, na Yeso akayeriina.
Abanto abange bakaara chianga chiabo inchera; abande bakanacha chinsagia chi’emete na gochiaara inchera.
Abanto abatang’aine na baria baare komotunyana bagaaka eriogi, bakabora, “Hosana! Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene!
Mbosesenirie oboruoti bogocha, oboruoti bwa sokoro yaito Daudi! Hosana aye ore igoro!”
Yeso agasoa Yerusalemu agaika ase Hekalu ime; gachia korigereria chinsemo chionsi, ekiagera nigo kiarenge ekero kia mogoroba, agasoka, akagenda Bethania amo na baria ikomi na babere.
Goika mambia yaye kobakorwa Bethania Yeso akaigwa enchara.
Akarora korwa are omoko ore namato, akagenda arore gose amako nareo. Agachia goika aroro tarora gento otatiga amato, ekiagera tikiarenge ekero ki’amako.
Yeso akayotebia, “Korwa bono monto taria amatunda ao nonya ndinde.” Aborokigwa baye bakaigwa aya.
Bagaika Yerusalemu. Yeso agasoa ase Hekalu ime, agachaka goseria abanto abarenge koonia na kogora aroro, akaonchorana chimesa chi’abaare koonchoreria chibesa, na ebirogo bi’abaare koonia amaruma;
tatiga monto abogorie gento ase egati ye Hekalu.
Akorokereria, okobatebia, “Inee! Terikiri iga: Enyomba yane nerokwe enyomba y’ogosaba ase ebisaku bionsi? Korende inwe mwayekorire koba ribwago ri’abauri.”
Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko bakanyora amang’ana, bakarigia enchera y’okomosiria, ekiagera bamoirogete; naki emeganda yonsi egakumia ase okworokereria kwaye.
Koriaba mogoroba akarua ase omochie.
Na mambia kobagoeta, bakarora omoko oria bwomire bwonsi korwa ase emeri yaye.
