Petero akainyora amang’ana aria, akamotebia, “Rabii, rora, omoko oria kwaragereretie bwomire.”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Mobe nokwegena ase Nyasae.
Ekeene nabatebirie: Onde bwensi oratebie egetunwa eke: Tegoka, otugutwe enyancha ime; oyo atabeti nogosiereria ase enkoro yaye, korende egene ng’a ayio ateba nabe, ayio nakoreke.
Ase ayio nabatebirie, ebinto bionsi morasabe, egene ng’a mwabinyorire, na‐birobio nabibe ebiaino.
Na inwe, ekero mogotenena na gosaba, onye more ne ring’ana ase omonto, mwabere, erinde na Iso oino ore igoro abaabere nainwe amamocho aino. [
Onye inwe timokwabera, nonya n’Iso oino ore igoro takobaabera inwe amamocho aino.]”
Bagaika Yerusalemu naende. Ekero are gotaara Hekalu ime, abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariko, na abagaaka bakamochiera,
bakamoboria, “Nase okobua ki ogokorera aya?”
Yeso akabatebia, “Nainche nimbaborie ring’ana erimo, nainwe mong’iranerie, erio nimbatebie ase okobua ki ngokorera aya.
Ebatiso ya Yohana, nigoro yarwete, gose nase mwanyabanto? Ng’iranerie.”
Bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakabora, “Toise goteba: Nigoro yarwete, nigo aratoborie: Naki rende motamwegenete?
Gose toise goteba: Nase mwanyabanto yarwete?” — Bakairoka abanto, ekiagera abanto bonsi mbaroche ng’a Yohana nomobani bw’ekeene.
Ase ayio bakairaneria Yeso, “Titomanyeti.” Na Yeso akabatebia “Nonya ninche tinkobatebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.”

Agachaka gokwana nabarabwo ase emereng’anio. “Omonto naremete omogondo, agasimeka emesabibu imeo, agaetanania orobago, agakunya egetera akomitera amasabibu, akaagacha orwaki, akaywatananera abaremi, akamanora akagenda orogendo.
Ekero kie rigesa agatoma omosomba ase abaremi baria, erinde anyore korwa ase abaremi ensemo y’amatunda ’emesabibu.
Barabwo bakamobwata, bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.
Agatoma naende asebare omosomba onde, na oyio bakamoaka chingoma ase omotwe, bakamosokia bakamokora bobe.
Naende agatoma oyonde, na oyio bakamoita. Naboigo babakorerete abande abange; bagaaka abande, na abande bakabaita.
Narenge nomwana oyomo konya ataratoma, omwanchwa oye; oyo nere akamotoma asebare nyuma, akabora: Nabasike omwana one.
Abaremi baria bagatebania: Oyo nomonyamwando; gaki tomoite, omwando oye obe oyoito.
Bakamobwata, bakamoita, bakamotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu.
Bono inki rende omonene oria bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu arakore? Nachiche asirie abaremi baria, na omogondo oria bw’emesabibu nayoe abande.
Nonya neririko eri timorarisoma: “Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona.
Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?”
Bakarigia komobwata, korende bakairoka omoganda, ekiagera bamanyete ng’a omoreng’anio oria nabwo ogoteba; bakamotiga, bakagenda.
Bagatoma asare abande b’Abafarisai na Abaherodiani, erinde bamotege a se amang’ana.

Bagachia goika bakamotebia, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a aye nigo ore omonto bw’ekeene, gose tori koyiera monto, naki torengerereti obonene bw’abanto, korende ase ekeene nigo okworokereria enchera ya Nyasae. Inee! Mboronge koa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo?
Tomoe, gose titomoa?” Ere konya omanyire obong’ainereria bwabo, akabatebia: “Nase ki mogonteema? Yendetere ebesa inyerore!”
Bakayerenta. Ere akababoria, “Ekieni eke na amariko aya nebiang’o?” Bakamoiraneria, “Nebia Kaisari.”
Yeso akabatebia, “Ebire bia Kaisari, moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae, moe Nyasae.” Bakamokumia mono.
Na Abasadukai bakamochiera, baria bakobora ng’a okobokigwa tikori, bakamoboria,
“Omworokia, Musa natorikerete ng’a momura omwabo omonto karakwe atige omokungu oye; onye tari nomwana, momura omwabo atware omokungu oria, atenenerie momura omwabo egesaku.
Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise omo batano na babere. Oyo bwe ritang’ani akanyuoma omokungu, agakwa, tatiga abana.
Na oyo o kabere akamotwara, agakwa; nonya nere tatiga abana; nonya noyo o gatato boigo.
Bonsi batano na babere bakamotwara, tibatiga abana. Omoerio o bonsi omokungu oria nere agakwa.
Inee! Ase okobokigwa mokang’o arabe ase aba? Ekiagera bonsi batano na babere mbamotwarete.”
Yeso akabatebia, “Inee! Timori gosira ase aya, ekiagera timomanyeti amariko, nonya nokobua kwa Nyasae?
Naki kobaraboke korwa ase abakure, tibakonyuoma, korende nigo barabe buna abamalaika bare igoro.

Nase amang’ana ’abakure, buna bakobokigwa, timwana gosoma ase ebuku ya Musa, ase ring’ana ri’egetutu, buna Nyasae amotebetie, akabora: Inche ninche Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo?
Ere tari Nyasae bw’abakure, korende bw’abare moyo; ase ayio nigo mogosira mono.”
Oyomo ase aborokia b’amariko agacha akabaigwa bakoamererania nere, akamanya ng’a obairaneirie buya, akamoboria, “Ase amachiko onsi ndiriri rire rie ritang’ani?”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Erie ritang’ani nario eri: Igwa, Abaisraeli, Omonene Nyasae oito, Omonene noyomo;
naye mwanche Omonene Nyasae oo nenkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi, na obong’aini bwao bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi.
Na ogwa kabere nakwo oko: Mwanche omogisangio oo buna bweanchete. Amachiko ande tari amanene kobua aya.”
Omworokia oria bw’amariko akamotebia, “Ekeene, Omworokia, gwatebire buya ng’a Nyasae noyomo, na onde tari otatiga ere;
na komwancha nenkoro yonsi, na okomanya gwonsi, ne chinguru chionsi, na gwancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete, nkogwenerete kobua omosango bw’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde.”
Yeso agachia korora ng’a nigo airaneria ase obong’aini, akamotebia, “Aye tori are korwa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.” Korwa erio monto onde tanyara komoboria ring’ana naende.
Yeso akabora gakworokereria ime ase Hekalu, “Naki aborokia b’amariko bakobora ng’a Kristo nomwana o Daudi?
Daudi omonyene nigo atebete, buna arenge koraagwa n’Omoika Omochenu: “Omonene agatebia Omonene one: Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao.
Daudi omonyene nigo akomoroka Omonene; naki rende aba omwana oye?” Na omoganda oria omonene nigo orenge komoigwa ase omogoko.
Akabatebia ase okworokereria kwaye, “Mwerende korwa ase aborokia b’amariko, abwo banchete gotaara beboyetie chianga chintambe, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro,
na goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na aase e ritang’ani ase emeyega.
Abwo bakourereria chinyomba chi’ababoraka, na ase obong’ainereria basaba ogosaba ogotambe; aba nabanyore ekina ekere ekenene kobua.”
Yeso agaikaransa korigereria ekebekerero gi’esadaka, akarigereria buna omoganda okobeka chibesa ase ekebekerero. Abande abarenge abanda bakabeka chinyinge.
Omokungu oyomo agacha, oyorenge omoboraka na omotaka, akabeka ebisabwa bibere bie chitaai, rigori ri’ekeng’ese ki’ebesa eyemo.
Akarangeria aborokigwa baye, akabatebia, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Oyo omoboraka omotaka obekire chinyinge kobua bonsi ababeka ase ekebekerero gi’esadaka,
ekiagera aba bonsi nigo babeka korwa ase obonge bw’enibo yabo; korende oyo ase obotaka bwaye obekire bionsi ebiarenge nabio, nonya nenibo y’obogima bwaye bwonsi.”
Goika agachia gosoka korwa Hekalu, oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye akamotebia, “Omworokia, rora buna amagena na amaagacho aya are amaya!”
Yeso akamotebia, “Noroche amaagacho aya amanene? Gee, aiga tirigotigara rigena erimo igoro ase erinde, eritanyare gotagorwa.”
Erio gaikaransire ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni korigereria Hekalu, Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana, na Anderea, bakamoboria bobisi,
“Totebie, aya indi arabe? Ninki ekemanyererio kiaye ekero aya onsi arabe ang’e goikerana?”
Yeso agachaka kobatebia, “Mwerende, monto onde tabang’aina na kobasiria,
ekiagera abange nabache ase erieta riane, babore: Inche ninche ere; naraae abange na kobasiria.
Naende komoraigwe esegi, na ebirage bi’esegi, timoichanigwa, ekiagera bori, aya onsi nabe, ko moerio toracha.
Naki egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oboruoti naborwane noboruoti bonde. Emetengecho y’ense nebe chinsemo ne chinsemo, na enchara. Noyio noro omochakano bw’obororo.
“Mwerende inwe abanyene, ekiagera nababaire ase amatongo, na ase chisinagogi, namoakwe. Naende namoirwe gotenena ase amasio ’abagavuna na ase abaruoti ase engencho yane, koba kirori asebare.
Naende negwenerete enchili erandigwe ritang’ani ase ebisaku bionsi.

Ekero bakobaira ase ekina, na kobabeka ase amaboko ’abanto, timochaka gwechanda korengereria ayamorigetie gokwana; korende rinde rionsi moraegwe ase ensa eria, morikwane, ekiagera tari inwe morakwane, korende n’Omoika Omochenu.
Na momura omwabo omonto narue oyomwabo, erinde aitwe, na ise narue omwana oye; na abana nabaimokere abaibori babo kobaita.
Nainwe namogechwe nabanto bonsi ase engencho y’erieta riane, korende oyoraremererie goika omoerio, oyio natooreke.
“Korende komorakorore okogechia kw’ogosaria kogotenena aase atagwenereti, (oyogosoma amanye), erio abare Boyahudi batame gochia ase ebitunwa;
na ere oyore kerama igoro taika gosoa nyomba ime, gose tasoa kobogoria egento korwa mwaye;
na ere oyore mogondo tairana nyomba kobogoria eanga yaye.
Nabe aakong’u ase abare barito na barabwo abakogonkia ase amatuko aria.
Saba ng’a ogotama kwaino tikoba ekero ki’obokendu,
ekiagera amatuko aria nebe emechando, buna etana koba korwa omochakano bw’ogotonga oko Nyasae atongete, goika bono, gose tekoba bo naende nonya ng’ake.
Naende onye Omonene atanachete amatuko aria, anga monto onde bwensi tatooregete, korende ase engencho y’abachore, abachorete, onachire amatuko aria.
Ekero ekio omonto karabatebie: Rora, oyo nere Kristo, gose: Oria aaria, timwegena,
ekiagera amakristo ’oborimo, na ababani b’oborimo nabaorokie ebikone na amakumia, banyare gosiria nonya nabachore.
Korende inwe mwerende! Rora, nakoorire koborokia onsi ritang’ani.
“Korende amatuko aria, nyuma y’emechando eria, erioba naribekwe omosunte, na omotienyi tokobara,
ne ching’enang’eni nachigwe korwa igoro, ne chinguru chire igoro nachitengechigwe.
Erio nario bararore Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ogocha ase amare ime amo ne chinguru chinyinge na obonene.
Erio natome abamalaika baye basangererie abachore baye korwa chinsemo chie chinsinyo inye, na korwa chinsinyo chi’ense goika chinsinyo chia igoro.
“Korwa ase omoko eorokererie omoreng’anio oye. Orosagia rwaye korwachakire koorokia amato aye, mwamanyire ng’a nekero ki’ogoseboka, etoigo ng’ang’e ere.
Naboigo nainwe, komorarore aya aorokire, momanye ng’a obeire ang’e na gesieri.
Nekeene nabatebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng’ake goika aya onsi anyare koba.
Igoro na ense nabiete, korende amang’ana aane takonyara goeta nonya ng’ake.
“Korende amang’ana e rituko riria na ensa eria onde tari omanyete, nonya nabamalaika bare igoro, nonya n’Omwana, otatiga Tata.
Rigereria, renda, saba, ekiagera timomanyeti engaki eria indi eranyare koba.
Igo enga buna omonto ore kogenda ense eng’ao konya otigire enyomba yaye, oeire abasomba baye okobua, na kera omonto emeremo yaye; agachika omorendi bw’egesieri arende.
Renda boigo, ekiagera timomanyeti ekero omonene bw’enyomba agochi‐gocha, gose mogoroba, gose mbotuko gati, gose etuoni gekobuga, gose mambia,
tacha ababosokane, abanyore mwararire.
Na erio nabatebirie inwe, nabatebirie bonsi: Renda!”

Konya atigaire amatuko abere ne rituko rinene ri’Epasaka ribe, na eri ’Emegati etabekiri memera. Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko bakarigia enchera bakomobwatera nobong’ainereria, banyare komoita,
ekiagera batebete, “Tari ekero kie rituko rinene, tiribaisa gocha koba riroroche ase abanto.”

Yeso ekero arenge Bethania ase enyomba ya Simion oyorenge noborwaire bwa ukoma, gaikaransete ase endagera, agacha omokungu orenge nechuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta agotioka buya, aye rigori rinene, agaata echuba eria, akamonyororokeria omotwe oye.
Mbarengeo abanto bagechetigwe ase emioyo yabo, bakabora, “Nase ki ogosiria amaguta engencho buna eye?
Naki amaguta aya anga naoonigwa chidinari amagana atato na kobua, abataka baegwe.” Bakamwemurunganeria omokungu oria mono.
Yeso agateba, “Motige! Nase ki mokomorosia? Ere onkoreire emeremo emiya.
Naki amatuko onsi nigo more nabataka amo nainwe, na kero kende gionsi mwanchete, namonyare kobakorera amaya, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.
Okorire eki anyarete, goaka omobere one ase ogotindekwa kwane.
Nekeene nabatebirie: Kera aase enchili erarandigwe ase ense yonsi, neri akora oyo nariatorwe ase okomoinyora.”
Yudas Iskariota, ere noyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, akagenda ase abakuani abanene, anyare komorua asebare.
Na barabwo bagachia koyaigwa bakagoka, bakamoriera eira komoa chibesa. Akarigia enchera akomoruera ekero aranyore ribaga rigiya.
Goika rituko rie ritang’ani ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, ekero gi’okonyenya emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka, aborokigwa baye bakamoboria, “Ng’ai origetie togende tokoroiserie oriere Epasaka?”
Agatoma babere b’aborokigwa baye akabatebia, “Genda ase omochie na moumerane nomosacha obogoretie enyongo ere namache; momotunyane,
na aande onsi arasoe motebie omonyene enyomba: Omworokia otebire: Ng’ai ere enyomba y’abageni ndiere Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane?
Na ere omonyene naborokie akanyomba akanene ka irongo igoro, karoisigwe kabeire ang’e; agwo motoroiserie.”
Aborokigwa bagasoka, bakagenda omochie, bakarora buna abatebetie, bakaroisia Epasaka.
Riachia koba mogoroba agacha amo na baria ikomi na babere.
Na barabwo kobaikaransire ase endagera bakoria, Yeso akabora, “Nekeene, nabatebirie: Oyomo oino oyokoria amo nainche nandue.”
Bagachaka goichana, bakamoboria oyomo oyomo “Inee! Ninche?”
Akabatebia, “Noyomo bw’aba ikomi na babere, ere oyogotobeka amo nainche ase esani.
Naki Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nkogenda are buna arikeretwe korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria orure Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto. Nanga mbuya asare omonto oria, nonya ataiboretwe.”
Barabwo bakaba nkoria bare, akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akabaa, akabora, “Bogoria! Oyo noro omobere one.”
Akabogoria egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabaa. Bagakenywera bonsi.
Akabatebia, “Aya naro amanyinga aane, ay’okobwatana okoyia, aitekire ase engencho y’abange.
Ekeene nabatebirie: Tinkonywa naende nonya ng’ake okwama kw’emesabibu goika rituko riria ndache gokonywa okoyia ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
Kobakoorire gotera Ogotera, bagasoka kogenda egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.
Na Yeso akabatebia, “Inwe mwensi inamogochwe na gontiga, naki arikire: Ning’ake omorisia, ne ching’ondi nachiserebekane.
Korende nyuma y’okoboka kwane, nimbatang’anere kogenda Galili.”
Petero akamotebia, “Neba inabagochwe bonsi na kogotiga, korende tai inche.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Rero, ase obotuko obo, ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga ara kabere, nonkane ara gatato.”
Na ere akamenta gokwana mono, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng’ake.” Na bonsi bagateba boigo.
Naende bagaika aase akorokwa Gethisemane: agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Ikaransa aa, ekero ngosaba.”
Akaira Petero na Yakobo na Yohana amo nere, agachaka goichana na gwechanda mono.
Akabatebia, “Omoyo one nore nobororo obonge, goika ogokwa; ikaransa aiga, morende.”
Akagenderera bosio ake, akagwa maumama, ogosaba ng’a onye ekonyarekana, ensa eye emoetere.
Agateba, “Abba!” Engencho yaye “Tata”, “Onsi nigo akonyarekana asore, onduserie egekombe eke, korende tari buna nyanchete inche, korende buna bwanchete aye.”
Agacha, akabanyora bararire, agatebia Petero, “Simion, nkwararire? Tokonyara korenda nonya nensa eyemo?
Renda, saba, timobaisa gosoa ase ogoteemwa; omoika nore nogwancha, korende omobere tori ne chinguru.”
Akagenda naende, agasaba, ogokwana amang’ana aria amatang’ani.
Naende akagenda akabanyora bararire, ekiagera amaiso abo abeire amarito, gose tibamanya eri bakomoiraneria.
Agacha eria gatato, akabatebia, “Nonya mbono moraire, na gotimoka? Aisanire. Engaki yaikire. Rora, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto obekirwe ase amaboko ’abanyene ebibe.
Imoka, togende; rora, ere oyokondua oikire ang’e.”
Erio kegima, kagokwana, Yudas, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, agaika, na omoganda ore amo nere nemioro ne chinungu, bakorwa ase abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariko, na abagaaka.
Ere oyokomorua konya obaeire ekemanyererio, ogoteba, “Oyo ndanyunyunte, oyio nere, momobwate, momoire buya.”
Agachia gocha bwango, akamochiera, akabora, “Rabii!” Akamonyunyunta.
Erio bakamobwata, bakamoira.
Na oyomo ase baria bateneine ang’e akang’usa omoyio oye o birende, agaaka omosomba bw’omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto.
Yeso akabatebia, “Inee! Igo mwachire buna mokoimokera omouri nemioro ne chinungu, gocha kong’ira?
Kera rituko nigo narenge amo nainwe ase Hekalu ime kworokereria, ko timwambwata. Korende aya akorirwe, erinde amariko anyare goikerana.”
Erio aborokigwa bonsi bakamotiga, bagatama.
Omomura oyomo akamotunyana, bweboyetie egetambaa ki’egatani gioka. Bakamobwata,
korende ere agatiga egetambaa keria ki’egatani, agatama ore getirianda.
Bakaira Yeso ase omokuani omonene; bakamosangererekera bonsi, abakuani abanene na abagaaka, na aborokia b’amariko.
Na Petero akamotunyana korwa nyuma ore egeka, goika ime ase egoora y’omokuani omonene, agaikaransa amo nabasomba gwota omorero.
Abakuani abanene na ab’ekegambero bonsi bakarigia oborori igoro ase Yeso banyare komoita, korende tibabonyora,
ekiagera abange bakamotebera oborimo, na oborori bwabo tibwabwatana.
Na abande bagatenena bakamotebera oborimo, bakabora,
“Ntwamoigwete ogoteba: Inche nintagore Hekalu eye yakoregete namaboko, na ase amatuko atato ning’agache eyende etakoregeti namaboko.”
Nonya nabo oborori bwabo tibwabwatana.
Omokuani omonene agatenena gati‐gati, akaboria Yeso, okobora, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Inki aba bakogosoera?”
Korende agakira, tairaneria ing’ana. Omokuani omonene akamoboria naende, akamotebia, “Aye naye Kristo, Omwana bw’Omosesenigwa?”
Yeso agateba, “Ee, ninche ere; na inwe namorore Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’Oyore nokobua, ogocha namare a igoro.”
Omokuani omonene agatandora chianga chiaye, akabora, “Ninki tokorigeria abarori bande?
Mwaigure okorama kwaye. Naki moroche?” Bonsi bakamonachera ekina ng’a nagwenerete akwe.
Abande bagachaka komotwera amate, na komotuba obosio, na komoaka chinkundi, na komotebia, “Bana!” Abarendi nabarabwo bakamoaka chindoe.
Na Petero nigo arenge egoora inse, na oyomo bw’abaiseke abasomba b’omokuani omonene agacha,
akarora Petero ogwota omorero, akamorigereria, agateba, “Aye naye kwarenge amo noria Omonazareti, Yeso.”
Agakana, akabora, “Timanyeti, gose tinyigweti eki ogokwana.” Agasoka gesieri; etuoni ekabuga.
Omoiseke oria omosomba akamorora naende, agachaka gotebia abateneine ang’e, “Oyo noyomo obo.”
Agakana naende. Nyuma y’egeka egeke naende, baria bateneine ang’e bagatebia Petero, “Ekeene bori, naye noyomo obo ore, ekiagera nigo ore Omogalili.”
Agachaka kweragereria na gotiana, “Timanyeti omonto oyio mogoteba.”
Erio etuoni ekabuga eria kabere. Petero akainyora ring’ana riria atebetigwe na Yeso, “Ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga ara kabere, nonkane ara gatato.” Agachia agetugutana, akarera.
Erio kobwachia gokia mambia, abakuani abanene bagakora ekina amo nabagaaka na aborokia b’amariko, na ekegambero ekegima. Bagasiba Yeso, bakamoira, bakamomoa Pilato.
Pilato akamoboria, “Aye naye Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi?” Akamoiraneria, “Naboigo, aye gwatebire.”
Abakuani abanene bakamosoera ase amang’ana amange.
Pilato akamoboria naende, akabora, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Rora amang’ana aya amange bagosoeire.”
Korende Yeso tairaneria ing’ana rinde naende, goika Pilato agakumia.
Nabo ase rituko rinene nigo anarete kobasiborera omosibwa oyomo, oyobarigetie.
Narengeo omonto ore korokwa Baraba, osibetwe amo nabanto abakorete eriomana, na gokora oboiti ase eriomana.
Omoganda ogotiira gochiao, na barabwo bagachaka gosaba Pilato abakorere buna anarete kobakorera.
Pilato akababoria, “Morigetie mbasiborere Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi?”
Ekiagera amanyete ng’a abakuani abanene nigo bamorure ase obogechi.
Abakuani abanene bakagenka abanto b’omoganda, erinde anche kobasiborera Baraba.
Pilato akairaneria naende, akabatebia, “Imokore naki oyo mogoteba ng’a n’Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi?”
Bagaaka eriogi naende, “Mobambe!”
Pilato akababoria, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete?” Bakamenta mono goaka eriogi, “Mobambe!”
Pilato agancha gokora ayaragwenere omoganda, akabasiborera Baraba, na ekero aakire Yeso chinkini, akamorua abambwe.
Abarwani bakamoira ime ase enyomba y’ekegambero (nero Praitorio), bagasangererekana amo ekeombe ekegima.
Bakamoboyia eanga emonyinga, bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera motwe,
bagachaka komokwania, “Masoge, Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi!”
Bakamoaka omotwe negetonto, bakamotwera amate, bakabeka amaru inse, bakamosasima.
Kobamochecheirie, bakamorusia eanga eria emonyinga, bakamoboyia chianga chiaye omonyene. Bakamoira isiko komobamba.
Bakabetereria omonto orenge goeta, Simion Omokurene, ore korwa borabu, ise Aleksanderi na Rufo, abogorie omosalaba o Yeso.
Bakamoira aase akorokwa Gologotha (engencho yaye: Aase Ekeore).
Bakamoa edivai yochoganirie na manemane anywe, ko tancha konywa.
Bakamobamba, bagaatanana chianga chiaye, bagachiakera obomera eye kera omonto araire.
Nigo chiare chinsa isato ekero bamobambete.
Na amariko ’ogosoerwa kwaye nigo arikire igoro, “OMORUOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”
Amo nere bakabamba abauri babere, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee. [
Nabo ririko rigaikerana, erigoteba, “Obareranigwe amo nabasaria.”]
Na abanto abaare goeta bakamorama, bagosinga‐singisia emetwe yabo, bagoteba, “A! Aye oyogotagora Hekalu na koyeagacha ase amatuko atato,
etoorie, ika korwa ase omosalaba!”
Naboigo nabakuani abanene bakamosekereria barabwo ase barabwo, amo naborokia b’amariko, bagateba, “Natooretie abande, ere omonyene takonyara gwetooria.
Tiga Kristo, Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, aike bono korwa ase omosalaba, tonyare korora na kwegena.” Na barabwo ababambetwe amo nere bakamorama.
Ekero chinsa isano nemo chiaika omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda.
Ne chinsa kianda Yeso akarera ase eriogi rinene, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakitani?” Okoonchorwa kwaye: “Nyasae one, Nyasae one, naki gwantigire?”
Na abande b’abwo bateneine ang’e koyaigwa bakabora, “Rora, nkorangeria are Elija.”
Omonto akaminyoka bwango, akaimokia esifunchi, akayeichoria chinkama, akayebeka igoro ase egetonto, akamoa anywe, okobora, “Tiga torore gose Elija ngocha are komoikia.”
Yeso agaaka eriogi rinene, agatweka mo.
Egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatondoka korwa igoro goika inse, gekaba bibere.
Na ekero omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana ateneine amorigereretie, agachia korora ng’a otwekire mo, akabora, “Ekeene, omonto oyo nigo arenge Omwana o Nyasae.”
Mbarengeo abakungu barigereretie korwa are. Ase abwo nigo barenge Mariamu Magidalena na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo omoke na Yose, na Salome.
Aba nabwo bamotunyanete ekero arenge Galili na komokorera, amo nabande abange abakungu abatiirete amo nere goika Yerusalemu.
Riachia koba mogoroba, ekiagera nerituko ri’okwebeka ang’e, nario rituko ri’ogotang’anera eri’Esabato,
Yusufu omonto bw’Arimathaya agacha, oyorenge omosike, omonto bw’ekegambero. Ere omonyene nigo aganyete oboruoti bwa Nyasae; agasoa noboremu ase obosio bwa Pilato, agasaba aegwe omobere o Yeso.
Pilato agakumia, ekiagera aikire gokwa, akarangeria omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, akamoboria gose nkare akwete.
Goika agachia konyora ekeene ng’a okure, akaa Yusufu omobere.
Yusufu akagora egetambaa ki’egatani, akamoikia, akamoboyia egetambaa keria, akamobeka ase oboina bwabaachetwe ase egetare. Naende agaturunkania rigena gochia ase egesieri ki’oboina.
Mariamu Magidalena na Mariamu ng’ina Yose bakarigereria aase abegetwe.
Goika Esabato koyaerire, Mariamu Magidalena, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo, na Salome, bakagora amaguta amanukato, banyare kogenda komoaka.
Goika mambia chuni, rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, bakagenda ase oboina, erioba korikooroka.
Bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Ning’o oranyare gototigereria rigena riria korwa ase egesieri ki’oboina?”
Goika bagachia korigereria bakarora ng’a rigena riria riatigerigwe, na rirorio nigo riarenge rinene mono.
Bagasoa oboina ime, bakarora omomura oikaransete ensemo y’okorio, bweboyetie eanga endabu, bagaichana.
Ere akabatebia, “Timoichana; Yeso Omonazareti mokorigia, oria obambetwe. Ere obokire, tari aiga. Rigereria aase bamobegete!
Korende genda, motebie aborokigwa baye, na Petero, ng’a obatang’aneire kogenda Galili. Agwo nao moramorore, buna abatebetie.”
Bakarua agwo, bagatama korwa ase oboina, ekiagera basoetwe nokoiguswa na ogokumia. Tibatebetie monto ing’ana, ekiagera bairogete.
Yeso ekero abokire, mambia rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma akaorokera ritang’ani Mariamu Magidalena, ere oria arusetie ebirecha bitano na bibere.
Oyo akagenda agatebia baria barenge amo nere korwa kare, baare kweumia na korera.
Na barabwo, bagachia koigwa ng’a moyo are, na ororirwe nere, tibegena.
Nyuma ase aya akaorokera abanto babere ase barabwo, ore nekieni kende ekeao, ekero barenge gotaara kogenda borabu.
Nabarabwo bakagenda bagatebia abande amang’ana aria, korende abwo tibabegena.
Naende akaorokera baria ikomi nomo, ekero barenge koragera; akabatogonyera ase ogotegena kwabo na obokong’u bw’emioyo yabo, ekiagera bategenete abamoroche kabokire.
Akabatebia, “Genda ase ense yonsi, morandie enchili ase kera egetongwa.
Oyoregene na kobatiswa, natooreke, ko oyotegeneti, nagambigwe.
Na ebimanyererio ebi bie chinguru nabibatunyane abwo begenire: Ase erieta riane nabaserie ebirecha, nabakwane ase emenwa emeyia,
nababwata ching’iti, gose nabanywa egento kegoita, ko tigekobaita nonya ng’ake; nababeke amaboko abo igoro ase abarwaire, na barabwo nabagwene.”
Nabo Omonene Yeso, gakwanire nabarabwo, akabogorigwa gochia igoro, agaikaransa ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.
Na barabwo bakaimoka, bakarandia chinsemo chionsi. Omonene akaba ogokora emeremo amo nabarabwo, na goikerania ring’ana ase ebimanyererio bie chinguru ebiatunyanete. Amina.
Abanto abange beruete korika ebirage bi’amang’ana aria aikeranetigwe egati yaito.
Nigo barigete buna abwo barenge abarori korwa omochakano na abakori emeremo be ring’ana batorenteire.
Naboigo nainche narorire buya, konaikire kwenyorera amang’ana onsi boronge korwa ritang’ani, gokorikera aye Theofilo bw’amasikani,
erinde onyare komanya oboene bw’amang’ana aria kworokereretigwe.
Ekero Herode arenge omoruoti o Boyahudi, narenge omokuani oyomo, erieta riaye Zakaria, oyo bw’ensemo y’Abiya. Mokaye nomoiseke bw’ororeria rwa Haroni orenge, erieta riaye Elisabeti.
Na bonsi babere nabanyene oboronge baare ase obosio bwa Nyasae; nigo bagendererete ase amachiko ne chinchera chionsi chi’Omonene batari na komocha.
Barabwo tibarenge nomwana, ekiagera Elisabeti nigo arenge omogomba, na barabwo bonsi babere konya bagotire mono.
Na ekero rika ria Zakaria ri’ogokora emeremo y’obokuani ase obosio bwa Nyasae riarenge,
kobwatekana nengencho y’obokuani, obomera bokamogwera asoe ase Hekalu y’Omonene asambe ubani.
Na omoganda bwonsi bw’abanto nigo orenge isiko gosaba ekero ki’ogosamba ubani.
Zakaria akaorokerwa nomomalaika bw’Omonene, oteneine ensemo ya borio y’egesasimero ki’ogosambera ubani.
Ere agaichana gachia komorora, na omoondoko okamobwata.
Korende omomalaika oria akamotebia, “Toiroka, Zakaria, ekiagera ogosaba kwao kwaigurwe, na mokao Elisabeti nakoiborere omwana omoisia, na erieta riaye nomoroke Yohana.
“Aye nobe nomogoko na ogosasoka, na abanto abange nabagokere okoiborwa kwaye,
ekiagera nabe omonene ase obosio bw’Omonene. Takonywa edivai gose ekenyugwa kegotindia; ere naichorwe n’Omoika Omochenu, nonya nkorwa enda ya ng’ina.
Naonchore abange b’Abaisraeli gocha ase Omonene, Nyasae obo.

Ere natang’ane bosio bwaye ase omoika ne chinguru chi’Elija, aonchore chinkoro chi’abaise ase abana babo, na aonchore abamochi ase obong’aini bw’abanyene oboronge, abekere ang’e Omonene abanto baroisigwe.”
Zakaria agatebia omomalaika, “Naki ndakore imanye ayio? Ekiagera inche nomogotu, na mokane nomong’ina.”
Omomalaika akamoiraneria, “Ninche Gabirieli, ngotenena ase obosio bwa Nyasae; ninche natomwa nkwane naye, ngotebie amang’ana aya amaya.
Rora, aye nobe rimama, tonyara gokwana goika rituko riria ayio agocha kooroka, ekiagera otegena amang’ana aane; ayio naikeranigwe ekero kiaye.”
Na abanto baria baganyete Zakaria, bagakumia ase ogotebana kwaye aroro Hekalu ime.
Goika ekero achia gosoka, tanyara gokwana nabarabwo; bakamanya ng’a nigo arora okorora aria Hekalu ime. Ere nigo arenge kobateberia nokoboko, akagenderera koba rimama.
Naende amatuko aye ay’ogokora emeremo agachia koera, akagenda bwoye.
Nyuma y’amatuko aria mokaye Elisabeti akaba morito, akebisa emetienyi etano, ogoteba,
“Igo nabo Omonene ankoreire ase amatuko aya andigereretie, na konduseria obosooku bwane ase amasio ’abanto.”
Omotienyi bw’etano nomo omomalaika Gabirieli agatomwa na Nyasae kogenda omochie o Galili, okorokwa Nazareti,
ase omoiseke omwekungi oriereire boko nomosacha, erieta riaye Yusufu, bw’eamate ya Daudi, na erieta ri’omoiseke oria Mariamu.
Agacha asare, akabora, “Mbuya ore aye, oyokwaeirwe obuya. Omonene nigo are amo naye.”
Mariamu agaichana mono ase ring’ana eri, akarota‐rotia omoyo oye ime, “Ngokwania ki oko?”
Omomalaika akamotebia, “Toiroka Mariamu, ekiagera kwanyorire obuya ase Nyasae.
Rora, nobe morito, noibore omwana omoisia, nomoroke erieta riaye Yeso.
“Oyio nabe omonene, narokwe Omwana bw’Oyore Igoro Mono; na Omonene Nyasae namoe ekerogo ki’obonene gia Daudi sokoro yaye;
nagambere enyomba ya Yakobo goika kare na kare; nonya noboruoti bwaye tibokoba nomoerio.”
Mariamu akaboria omomalaika oria, “Naki rirabe ring’ana eri, ekiagera tindaba nomosacha?”
Omomalaika akamotebia, “Omoika Omochenu nogochere, ne chinguru chiaye Oyore Igoro Mono nachikobekere ekiriri. Ase ayio, oyoraiborwe narokwe Omochenu, Omwana o Nyasae.
Rora, Elisabeti omoamate oo, nere boigo nare noborito bw’omwana omoisia ase obogotu bwaye; na omotienyi oyo noyo bw’etano nomo asare ere oyorogetwe omogomba.
Naki ing’ana tiriri ritanyarekane ase Nyasae.”
Mariamu akabora, “Rora, inche nomoiseke omosomba bw’Omonene; abe asende buna ring’ana riao.” Omomalaika akaimoka akarua asare.
Mariamu akaimoka ase amatuko ayio, akagenda bwango ase ebitunwa goika omochie oyomo o Yuda,
agasoa nyomba mwa Zakaria, agakwania Elisabeti.
Ekaba Elisabeti agachia koigwa ogokwania kwa Mariamu, omwana omoke agatuma ase enda yaye ime; Elisabeti agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu,
agaaka eriogi ase chinguru, agakwana, “Gwasesenigwe aye ase abakungu, na oroiboro rw’enda yao rwasesenigwe.
Ng’ai ring’ana eri riarure, ng’ina Omonene one anchicheire inche?
Ekiagera rora, eriogi ri’ogokwania kwao riachia gosoa ase amato aane, omwana omoke otuma ase omosasoko ase enda yane ime.
Nasesenirie oyobwegenete ng’a amang’ana ayio atebigwe n’Omonene naikeranigwe.”
Mariamu agateba, “Omoyo one otogirie Omonene,
omoika one ogokeire Nyasae, Omotooria one,
ekiagera origereirie obwororo bw’omoiseke omosomba oye. Naki ekeene, korwa rero ebigori bionsi nabindoke omosesenigwa,
ekiagera ere oyore ne chinguru onkoreire amanene, na erieta riaye nerichenu.
Amabera aye nigo are ase abwo bamoirogete korwa ebigori goika ebigori.
Okorire ogokora gwe chinguru, oserebanirie abaenenu ase ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo.
Okeeirie abanene korwa ase ebirogo biabo bi’obonene, oimokereirie igoro abaitongo.
Abare nenchara obaigotirie amaya; abanyene enibo obaseririe bare namaboko amasa.
Okonyire Israeli, omosomba oye, ase okoinyora amabera aye,
buna atebetie chisokoro chiaito, Ibrahimu na oroiboro rwaye, goika kare na kare.”
Mariamu akamenya nere emetienyi etato, akairana sobo.
Kegaika ekero gi’okoibora kwa Elisabeti, akaibora omwana omoisia.
Abatureti baye na eamate yaye bakaigwa ng’a Omonene omororeire amabera amange, bakagoka amo nere.
Rituko ria gatano na gatato bakaira omwana komosara, bakarigia bamoroke erieta ria ise, Zakaria,
korende ng’ina akairaneria, akabora, “Taibo; nigo ararokwe Yohana.”
Bakamotebia, “Tari nonya noyomo ase eamate yao okorokwa erieta erio.”
Bakorokia ise ase ogokwana kw’ebimanyererio bi’amaboko, komoboria buna arigetie arokwe.
Agasaba ebao y’okorika, akarika “Yohana, nario erieta riaye.” Bagakumia bonsi.
Erio kegima agasiborwa omonwa na oromeme rwaye, agakwana, ogotogia Nyasae.
Obwoba bogasoa ase abatureti babo bonsi. Amang’ana aya onsi agasarera ase ense yonsi y’ebitunwa bia Boyahudi.
Na bonsi abayaigwete bakayabeka ase chinkoro chiabo ime, bakabora, “Mwana ki rende arabe oyo?” Naki okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nere.
Zakaria ise agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, akabana, okobora,
“Omonene, Nyasae o Israeli, atogigwe, ekiagera obacheire abanto baye na kobabooria.
Naende ototeneneirie Omotooria bw’okobua ase eamate ya Daudi, omosomba oye.
Buna atebete korwa omochakano goetera ase emenwa y’ababani baye abachenu,
ng’a natotoorigwe korwa ase ababisa baito, na korwa ase amaboko abo bonsi abatogechete,
erinde abakorere amabera chisokoro chiaito, na koinyora okobwatana kwaye ogochenu.
Emuma eria arierete sokoro yaito Ibrahimu,
ng’a natoe ribaga ri’okomosasima totari nobwoba, gatoratoorigwe korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baito,
ase obochenu na ase oboronge ase obosio bwaye amatuko aito onsi.
Naye, Omwana, norokwe omobani bw’Oyore Igoro Mono, ekiagera notang’ane ase obosio bw’Omonene. Oroisie chinchera chiaye,
omanyie abanto baye ogotooreka ase okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo.
Ase amabera aye Nyasae oito, ekero amasase a igoro aratochere,
abarere abamenyete ase omosunte na ase ekiriri ki’amakweri, na koraa amagoro aito ase enchera y’omorembe.”
Omwana oria agakina, akamenteka chinguru ase omoika, akaba ase erooro goika rituko riria aorogete ase Abaisraeli.
Ase amatuko aria, ogochika gokarua ase Kaisari Augusto, ng’a omobaro bw’abanto orikwe ase ense yonsi.
Oyo noro orenge omobaro bwe ritang’ani origetwe ekero Kurenio arenge gavuna o Siiria.
Abanto bonsi bakagenda korikwa, kera omonto ase omochie oye.
Na Yusufu nere akaimoka korwa Galili korwa ase omochie o Nazareti, agatiira kogenda Boyahudi, goika omochie o Daudi, okorokwa Bethlehemu, ekiagera nigo arenge oyo bw’enyomba na eamate ya Daudi,
erinde arikwe amo na Mariamu, ekiagera omoriereire boko, na Mariamu nigo arenge morito.
Ekero barenge aroro engaki yaye y’okoibora egaika.
Akaibora omwana oye omoisia omotangi, akamobekera chianga chi’obwana, akamwareria ase orotuba chiombe chiare koriera, ekiagera batanyorete ribaga ase enyomba y’abageni.
Ase ense eyio mbarengeo abarisia baikaransete ase ebitii, bakorenda amaicho abo botuko.
Omomalaika bw’Omonene akabaorokera, obonene bw’Omonene bokababarera; bagasogwa nomoondoko omonge.
Omomalaika akabatebia, “Timoiroka, ekiagera nabarenteire amang’ana amaya ay’omogoko omonene, orabe ase abanto bonsi,
naki rero ase omochie o Daudi oiboirwe Omotooria ase engencho yaino, nere Kristo Omonene.
Na eke nekemanyererio asemore: Namonyore omwana ekeng’werere obekeire chianga chi’obwana, bwareirie ase orotuba.”
Bwango igo mbarengeo amo nomomalaika oria omoganda o igoro, bagotogia Nyasae, bakobora,
“Obonene ase Nyasae ore Igoro Mono, na ase ense omorembe, ase abanto bagweneirwe nere.”
Ekero abamalaika abwo bachia koimoka kogenda igoro, abarisia baria bagatebania, “Gaki togende goika Bethlehemu, torore ring’ana eri riakorekire, eri Omonene atomanyirie.”
Bakagenda nomoayerero, bakanyora Mariamu na Yusufu, na omwana oria ekeng’werere bwareirie ase orotuba.
Bagachia komorora, bakaorokia ring’ana batebetigwe igoro y’omwana oyio.
Bonsi abaigwete bagakumia ase aria batebetigwe nabarisia.
Korende Mariamu akagacha amang’ana aya onsi, okoyarengereria ase enkoro yaye.
Abarisia bakairana, bagotogia Nyasae na komobaka ase amang’ana onsi baigwete, na ayabaroche, buna batebetigwe.
Rigachia goika rituko ria gatano na gatato, rituko ri’okomosara, akarokwa erieta riaye Yeso, riria riatoretwe nomomalaika ritang’ani atarabogorigwa oborito.
Na ekero amatuko ’ogwesibia kwabo achia goika, ayachikire ase amachiko a Musa, bakamoira Yerusalemu, bamobeke ase Omonene
(buna arikire ase amachiko ’Omonene, “Kera omoisia omotangi okoigora enda ya ng’ina narokwe omochenu ase Omonene”),
barue ekeng’wanso buna yaboretwe ase amachiko ’Omonene, “Amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere.”
Rora narengeo omonto Yerusalemu, erieta riaye Simeoni. Oyio nomonto omoronge orenge, osigete Nyasae, oganyete ogosemeria kw’Abaisraeli; na Omoika Omochenu nigo orenge igoro asare.
Ere nigo aorokereretigwe n’Omoika Omochenu, ng’a takorora amakweri atararora Kristo bw’Omonene.
Nabo akaraagwa n’Omoika gocha ase Hekalu ime; na ekero abaibori bachia korenta omwana Yeso, bamokorere buna yarenge engencho y’amachiko,
Simeoni akamonyora, akamoagata ase amaboko aye, agatogia Nyasae, akabora,
“Omonene, bono otige omosomba oo agende nomorembe, koreng’ana nering’ana riao.
Ekiagera amaiso aane arorire ogotooreka kwao,
oko kwabekire ase amaiso ’abanto bonsi,
omobaso okomorekera abanto b’Ebisaku, na obonene bw’abanto bao Abaisraeli.”
Ise na ng’ina bagakumia ase aria akwanwa igoro asare.
Simeoni akabasesenia, agatebia Mariamu ng’ina, “Rora, Omwana oyo obekirwe ase okogwa na ogotenena ase abange b’Abaisraeli, abe ekiorokererio kerabe kegokwanwa mamincha,
erinde ebirengererio bie chinkoro chinyinge biorokigwe. Boigo omoro nokobete omoyo oo.”
Narengeo omokungu omobani, Anna, omoiseke o Fanueli, bw’egesaku ki’Asheri. Ere nomong’ina bw’amatuko amange, obete nomosacha oye emiaka etano na ebere nyuma y’okoera kw’oboiseke bwaye.
Ere nigo arenge omoboraka bw’emiaka emerongo etano na etato na ene, atana korua ase Hekalu ime, korende akaba okweng’ata, na ogosaba, na ogosasima obotuko na omobaso.
Ase ekero keria ere akaoroka, agatogia Nyasae, agatebia abanto bonsi abarenge baganyete okoboorigwa kwa Yerusalemu amang’ana igoro y’Omwana oria.
Barabwo bagachia gokoora goikerania onsi koreng’ana namachiko ’Omonene, bakairana Galili goika omochie obo Nazareti.
Omwana oria agakina, akamenteka chinguru, agaichorwa nobong’aini ne chisemi; na obuya bwa Nyasae bokaba amo nere.
Nabo abaibori baye barenge kogenda Yerusalemu kera omwaka ase rituko rinene ri’Epasaka.
Goika agachia koba nemiaka ikomi na ebere, bagatiira kogenda aroro, buna yarenge engencho ye Rituko Rinene.
Ekero Epasaka yaera, ekero barenge koirana, omwana Yeso agatigara nyuma agwo Yerusalemu, na abaibori baye tibamanya.
Barabwo bagakaga ng’a nigo are ase omoganda obo, bakagenda orogendo rw’omobaso oyomo, bakamorigia ase eamate yabo na ase abairi.
Ekero batamonyorete, bakairana Yerusalemu, bakamorigia.
Nyuma y’amatuko atato bakamonyora Hekalu ime, oikaransete gati ase aborokia, okobaigwa na kobaboria amaborio.
Na bonsi abamoigwete bagakumia ase okomanya kwaye na okoiraneria kwaye.
Abaibori baye bagachia komorora bagaichana mono. Ng’ina akamotebia, “Omwana one, naki gwatokorire iga? Rora, iso na inche twarenge gokorigia nomoichano.”
Akabatebia, “Naki mokondigia? Timomanyeti ng’a nengwenerete koba ase enyomba ya Tata one?”
Tibamanya ring’ana riria abatebia.
Agatirimboka amo nabarabwo, agaika Nazareti, akaba nkobaigwera are. Ng’ina akagacha amang’ana aya onsi ase enkoro yaye ime.
Yeso akamenteka gokina ase obong’aini ne chisemi, na ase omobere, akagwenera Nyasae na mwanyabanto.

Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano bw’okogamba gwa Kaisari Tiberio, Pontio Pilato orenge gavuna o Boyahudi, na Herode omoruoti o Galili, na Filipo momura omwabo omoruoti o Iturea na ense ya Tarakoniti, na Lusania omoruoti o Abileni,
ekero ki’obokuani obonene bw’Anasi na Kayafa, ring’ana ria Nyasae rigaikera Yohana, omwana o Zakaria, ase erooro.
Akagenda chinse chionsi chi’ensemo ya Yorodan, okorandia ebatiso y’okoonchoka ekorenta okwaberwa kw’ebibe.
Buna erikire ase ebuku y’amang’ana ’omobani Isaya, “Eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro, Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye.
Kera rigooko nariichorigwe, na kera ekegoro na egetunwa nabikeeigwe; aare bogeka inarongeigwe, na enchera ere ebitunwa‐tunwa nereng’anigwe;
na abanto bonsi nabarore ogotooreka gokorwa ase Nyasae.”
Nabo agatebia emeganda eyachete, erinde ebatiswe nere, “Inwe oroiboro rwe ching’iti, ning’o obakureire ng’a motame korwa ase endamwamu egochi‐gocha?

Gaki, ama okwama kogwenerete okoonchoka, gose timochaka kobora emioyo yaino ime: Ntore na sokoro yaito, nere Ibrahimu. Naki nabatebirie ng’a Nyasae nare nokobua ase amagena aya gokorera Ibrahimu abana.
Nonya mbono egesire kiabekirwe ase emeri y’emete; nabo kera omote otameti okwama okuya nonachwe, otugutwe ase omorero.”
Emeganda eria ekamoboria, “Ninki rende torakore?”
Akabairaneria, “Oyore ne chianga ibere ae ere oyotari nero; na oyore nendagera akore boigo.”
Abarusia ebango bagacha erinde babatiswe, bakamoboria, “Omworokia, inki rende naintwe torakore?”
Akabairaneria, “Timorusia kobua ebi mwachigetwe.”
Abarwani nabarabwo bakamoboria, “Naintwe inki torakore?” Akabairaneria, “Timourereria monto onde ase chinguru gose ase obosoeri bw’oborimo; naende moisaneke neng’eria yaino.”
Ekero abanto baganyete na konakorengereria, bonsi bakeboria igoro ya Yohana ng’a, gose nere Kristo.

Yohana akairaneria abwo bonsi, “Inche nigo nkobabatisa ase amache, korende oyore ne chinguru kombua ngocha are, tinyisaini gosibora chinuga chi’ebikoroto biaye; oyio nere orababatise ase Omoika Omochenu na ase omorero.
Oroteru rwaye nigo rore koboko kwaye, ere naabuse ekeooreri kiaye, nasangererie engano ase ekiage kiaye, korende omoiriro nayosambe ase omorero otakorimeka.”
Nabo ase ogokurera okonge Yohana akaranderia abanto amang’ana amaya.
Korende Herode omoruoti, oyo okanetigwe nere ase engencho ya Herodia, moka momura omwabo, na ase engencho y’amabe onsi Herode akorire,
akamenta neri igoro ase onsi, agasiba Yohana echela.
Egachia koba abanto bonsi kobabatisirwe, na Yeso boigo kabatisirwe, na ekero agosaba, igoro akamaanoka.
Omoika Omochenu ogaika igoro asare ase omogwekano bwe riruma, eriogi rikarwa igoro, rigoteba, “Aye naye Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie naye.”
Yeso nere ekero achagete kworokereria, emiaka yaye iga yarenge ang’e emerongo etato, agakagwa ng’a mosinto o Yusufu, o Eli,
o Mathati, o Lawi, o Meliki, o Yana, o Yusufu,
o Matathia, o Amos, o Nahum, o Esili, o Nagai,
o Maathi, o Matathia, o Semei, o Yoseki, o Yuda,
o Yohana, o Resa, o Serubabeli, o Salatieli, o Neri,
o Meliki, o Adi, o Kosamu, o Elimadamu, o Eri,
o Yoshua, o Eliezeri, o Yorimu, o Mathati, o Lawi,
o Simeoni, o Yuda, o Yusufu, o Yonam, o Eliakimu,
o Melea, o Mainani, o Mattatha, o Nathani, o Daudi,
o Yese, o Obedi, o Boazi, o Salimoni, o Nashoni,
o Aminadabu, o Admin, o Aramu, o Hezironi, o Peresu, o Yuda,
o Yakobo, o Isaka, o Ibrahimu, o Tera, o Nahori,
o Serugi, o Ragau, o Pelegi, o Eberi, o Sala,
o Kainani, o Arifaksadi, o Shemu, o Nuhu, o Lameki,
o Metusela, o Enoku, o Yaredi, o Malaleeli, o Kainani,
o Enosu, o Seti, o Adamu, o Nyasae.
Na Yeso oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akairana korwa Yorodan, agatang’anwa n’Omoika kogenda ase erooro,
agateemwa na Saitani ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene. Na amatuko aria tariete gento. Goika agachia koera, akaigwa enchara.
Saitani akamotebia, “Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, tebia rigena eri ribe omogati.”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Nerikire. Omonto takoba moyo ase omogati bwoka.”
Saitani akamoira aase aimokererete igoro, akamworokia amaruoti onsi ay’ense ase egeka ekemo,
akamotebia, “Ninkoe okobua oko gwonsi, na obonene bwaye, ekiagera nabieirwe, na inche iga nkoa oyo ngwancha.
Nabo koransasime, bionsi nabibe ebiao.”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Nerikire: Mosasime Omonene Nyasae oo, omokorere ere bweka.”
Saitani akamoira goika Yerusalemu, akamotenenia igoro ase egechuria gie Hekalu egetambe mono, akamotebia, “Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, etugute gochia inse korwa aa,
ekiagera nerikire, “Ere nagochikere abamalaika baye bakorende,”
naende, “Nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde tobaisa kogochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Netebire, Toteema Omonene Nyasae oo.”
Saitani agachia gokoora ogoteema kwaye gwonsi, akaimoka korwa asare, akamotiga ase egeka.
Yeso akairana gochia Galili ne chinguru chi’Omoika, chinkuma chigasarera ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense eria.
Ere akorokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, ogotogigwa nabanto bonsi.
Akagenda Nazareti, aria ase arereretwe; na ase rituko ri’Esabato agasoa ase esinagogi yabo, buna engencho yaye yarenge, agatenena gosoma.
Akaegwa ebuku y’omobani Isaya. Nabo akaigora ebuku eyio, akanyora aase arikire,

“Omoika bw’Omonene nigo ore igoro yane, ekiagera ong’akire amaguta koranderia abataka amang’ana amaya. Ontomire koranderia abasibwa ogosiborwa, na koa abare emeuko banyare korora naende, na gosibora abasionoirwe,
“na korandia omwaka bw’Omonene bwancheretwe.”
Akamumekeria ebuku eria akayea omokori emeremo bw’esinagogi, agaikaransa. Abanto bonsi abarenge ase esinagogi bakamobeta amaiso.
Agachaka kobatebia, “Rero ririko eri riaikeranigwe ase amato aino.”
Bonsi bakamokwana buya bagakumia amang’ana ’obuya aruete ase omonwa oye, bagatebania, “Oyo tari ere omwana o Yusufu?”
Akabatebia, “Ekeene, namontebie omoreng’anio oyo: Omogwenia, egwenie aye omonyene; amang’ana onsi twaigure akorekire Kapernaumu, yakore aiga ase ense yao.”
Akabatebia, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Omobani tari oranyare gwanchwa ase ense yaye omonyene.
Korende ekeene nabatebirie ng’a mbarenge ababoraka abange ase Israeli ase amatuko ’Elija, ekero igoro yasiegetwe emiaka etato na emetienyi etano nomo, ekero enchara enene yasoete ase ense yonsi;
na Elija tatometwe ase oyomo obo, otatiga ase omokungu oyorenge omoboraka agwo Sarepata, ase ense ya Sidoni.
Naende mbarenge ase Abaisraeli abanto abange abaare noborwaire bwa ukoma ase ekero ki’omobani Elisha; onde tari osibegete otatiga Naamani, omonto o Siiria.”
Bagachia koigwa aya, bonsi ase esinagogi bagaichorwa nendamwamu.
Bakaimoka bakamosokia isiko y’omochie, bakamoira goika egemi y’egetunwa keria omochie obo oagachire igoro yaye, banyare komoturunkania.
Korende ere agaeta egati‐gati yabo, akagenda.
Agatirimboka goika Kapernaumu, omochie o Galili. Akaba nkoborokereria are rituko ri’Esabato.
Bagakumia mono ase okworokereria kwaye, ekiagera ring’ana riaye riarenge nokobua.
Naende ase esinagogi narengeo omonto obwatire nomoika bw’ekerecha ki’eubi. Ere agaaka eriogi ase chinguru, akabora,
“A! Inki tore naye, Yeso o Nazareti? Ngwachire gotosiria? Nakomanyire aye, Omochenu o Nyasae.”
Yeso akagetogonyera, akabora, “Kira, omorwe!” Ekerecha keria gekamoiyeria agwo gati‐gati, gekamorwa, tikiamokorera gento.
Bagakumia bonsi, bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Ing’ana ki eri? Naki ase chinguru na okobua agochika ebirecha bi’eubi, na birobio biasoka.”
Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense eria.
Akaimoka korwa ase esinagogi, agasoa ase enyomba ya Simion. Nabo ng’ina biara Simion konya orwarire esosera; bakamosaba ase engencho yaye.
Agatenena ang’e nere, agatogonyera esosera eria; ekamotiga. Bwango ere akaimoka akabakorera.
Goika erioba rigachia kogwa bakarenta asare abanto bonsi abarenge nabarwaire bare namarwaire ao ao, na ere akabeka amaboko aye igoro ase kera oyomo, akabagwenia.
Ebirecha bigasoka korwa ase abange, bigaaka eriogi, bikabora, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.” Akabitogonyera, tabitiga bikwane, ekiagera biamanyete ng’a nere Kristo.
Goika ekaba mobaso, agasoka, akagenda aase atari nabanto. Na abanto bakamoriga‐rigia, bakamoikera, bakarigia komotanga taimoka korwa asebare.
Akabatebia, “Nengwenerete korandia amang’ana amaya ay’oboruoti bwa Nyasae ase emechie ende boigo, ekiagera natometwe ase engencho eyio.”
Akaba nkorandia are ase chisinagogi chia Galili.
Ekaba abanto nkomomiga baare, erinde baigwe ring’ana ria Nyasae, agatenena ase engegu y’enyancha ya Genesareti,
Akarora amaato abere ateneine engegu y’enyancha, na abarubi basokire korwa aroro, ngosibia bare ebionga biabo.
Akariina obwato obomo obwarenge bwa Simion akamoboria abotigerie are ake korwa ase engegu. Agaikaransa, akorokereria omoganda korwa ase obwato.
Goika agachia gokoora ogokwana kwaye, agatebia Simion, “Sukia obwato goika endiba, moikie ebionga biaino ase okoruba.”
Simion akamoiraneria, “Omonene, nabo twakorire emeremo obotuko obogima, titonyoreti gento, korende ase ring’ana riao natoikie ebionga.”
Kobakorire iga, bakanyora chinswe chinyinge mono, na ekero ebionga biabo biachaka gotandoka,
bagasima abagisangio babo, abarenge ase obwato bwa kabere, bache kobakonya. Bagacha, bagaichoria amaato onsi abere, goika agachaka korimera.
Korende Simion Petero, agachia korora aya, akagwa ase amaru a Yeso, akabora, “Omonene, karue asende, ekiagera inche nomonto omonyene ebibe!”
Naki igo akumetie, ere na bonsi abarenge amo nere, ase oborubi bwe chinswe barubete;
naboigo Yakobo na Yohana, abana ba Zebedi, abarenge ababwatani ba Simion. Yeso agatebia Simion, “Toiroka; korwa bono nobe omorubi bw’abanto.”
Naende kobarentire amaato abo gochia engegu, bagatiga bionsi, bakamotunyana.

Ekero arenge ase omochie oyomo, rora, narengeo omonto omosacha oichire noborwaire bwa ukoma. Ere agachia korora Yeso, akagwa maumama, akamosorora, okomotebia, “Omonene, onye ngwancha, nonyare gonsibia.”
Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamotebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.” Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bokamorua.
Akamotebia, “Totebia monto onde ing’ana, korende genda, bweorokie ase omokuani, orue ekeng’wanso ase ogosibeka kwao buna Musa achigete, kebe kirori ase abanto.”
Korende chinkuma chiaye chikamenteka gokuma. Emeganda emenge egasangererekana gocha komoigwa, na kogwenigwa amarwaire abo.
Korende ere akerusanania, akagenda aase atari nabanto, agasaba.

Rituko erimo ri’amatuko aria ekero arenge kworokereria, Abafarisai na aborokia b’amachiko barenge aroro baikaransete. Abwo baruete ase kera omochie o Galili na Boyahudi, na korwa Yerusalemu. Na okobua kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nere anyare kogwenia.
Na rigereria, abanto mbabogoretie noborere omonto orenge rigata, bakarigia komoira nyomba ime na komobeka ase obosio bwaye.
Ekiagera batanyorete ribaga ri’okomoira ime ase engencho y’omoganda oria bw’abanto, bakariina kerama igoro, bakamoikia korwa kerama noborere bwaye goika gati‐gati ase obosio bwa Yeso.
Agachia korora okwegena kwabo, akamotebia, “Omonto oyo, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”
Aborokia baria b’amariko na Abafarisai bagachaka korengereria, bakobora, “Ning’o oyo ogokwana okorama? Ning’o oranyare kwabera ebibe, otatiga oyomo, nere Nyasae?”
Yeso namanyete ebirengererio biabo, akairaneria, “Naki mokorengereria ase chinkoro chiaino?
Ndiriri rire eriango, goteba: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteba: Imoka, ogende?
Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agatebia oria rigata, “Nagotebirie: Imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende bwoo.”
Erio kegima agatenena ase obosio bwabo, akabogoria ekerarero kiaye arenge korarera, akagenda bwoye, ogotogia Nyasae.
Ogokumia gokabwata bonsi, bagatogia Nyasae; bagaichorwa nokoiroka, bakabora, “Twarorire amakumia rero.”
Nyuma ase aya akaimoka, akarora omobangi ebango, erieta riaye Lawi, oikaransete aase bakobangerwa ebango, akamotebia, “Ntunyana!”
Agatiga bionsi, akaimoka, akamotunyana.
Nere Lawi akamokorera omoyega omonene nyomba mwaye, naende mbarengeo omoganda bw’abarusia ebango na abanto bande baikaransete amo nabarabwo ase endagera.
Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariko babo bakemurunganeria aborokigwa baye, bakabora, “Nase ki mokoria na konywa amo nabarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe?”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Abare buya tibari korigia omorwaria, otatiga abarwarete.
Tincheti korangeria ababoronge korende abanyene ebibe baonchoke.”
Bakamotebia, “Aborokigwa ba Yohana nigo bakweng’ata ebiro ebinge na gosaba, na aborokigwa b’Abafarisai nabo bagokora, korende abao nigo bakoria na konywa.”
Yeso akabatebia, “Inee! Inamonyare gotiga abarangerigwa b’enyangi beng’ate ekero omonyuomi are amo nabarabwo?
Korende amatuko nache, barache kourwa omonyuomi, erio nario barache kweng’ata ase amatuko aria.”

Akabatebia omoreng’anio: “Onde tari ogotandora ekeraka ki’eanga enyia na gokebeka ase eanga engotu; aise gokora bo, natandore eria enyia, na ekeraka keria ki’eanga enyia tigekobwatana neanga eria engotu.
Gose onde tari okobeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose edivai eria enyia nayaate ebirandi biria; edivai enyene eiteke, na ebirandi bitandoke.
Korende edivai enyia negwenerete ebekwe ase ebirandi ebiya.
Gose omonto tari onyure edivai yaroisetigwe kare, naende arigie edivai enyia, ekiagera nigo agoteba: Eria ya kare nengiya kobua.”
Rituko ri’Esabato Yeso ngoeta arenge ase emegondo y’engano; aborokigwa baye bakabutora ebigara, bakabibunga namaboko abo, bakabiria.
Korende abande ase Abafarisai bakababoria, “Naki mogokora eritari borongo gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato?”
Yeso akairaneria, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete, ekero arenge nenchara, ere na abarenge amo nere,
buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, akabogoria na koria emegati yarenge koruegwa ase Nyasae, etare boronge koriegwa nonde otatiga nabakuani boka, naende akaa abwo barenge amo nere?”
Akabatebia, “Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nere Omonene bw’Esabato.”
Esabato ende agasoa ase esinagogi, akorokereria. Narengeo omonto agwo, okoboko kwaye gw’okorio kwagataete.
Aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai bakamotega korora gose namogwenie ase rituko ri’Esabato, banyare komosoera.
Korende akamanya ebirengererio biabo, agatebia omonto oria okoboko kwaye kwagataete, “Imoka, otenene gati aa!” Akaimoka agatenena.
Yeso akabatebia, “Nkobaboria nde ring’ana erimo: Mboronge rituko ri’Esabato gokora amaya gose amabe, gotooria obogima gose kobosiria?”
Akabarigereria bonsi, agatebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao!” Agakora bo; okoboko kwaye gokagwenigwa.
Na barabwo bagaichorwa nokobea, bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, buna baramokore Yeso.
Ase amatuko aria akaimoka akagenda ase egetunwa gosaba; akabao obotuko bwonsi ase ogosaba Nyasae.
Bogachia gokia mambia akarangeria aborokigwa baye, agachora korwa asebare ikomi na babere, na abwo arogete abatomwa.
Simion nere arogete Petero, na Anderea momura omwabo; Yakobo na Yohana, Filipo na Baritholomayo,
na Matayo na Tomas, Yakobo bw’Alufayo, na Simion oyomo bw’Abazelote,
na Yuda o Yakobo, na Yudas Iskariota, nere oyo omoruete.

Agatirimboka amo nabarabwo, agatenena aase aateremu, amo nomoganda bw’aborokigwa baye; na omoganda bw’abanto abaruete Boyahudi yonsi, na Yerusalemu, na engegu ya Turo na Sidoni, bagacha komoigwa na kogwenigwa amarwaire abo.
Na abwo bachandire nebirecha bi’eubi bakagwenigwa.
Omoganda bwonsi okarigia komokuna, ekiagera chinguru chiare korua asare, chikabagwenia bonsi.
Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye ase aborokigwa baye, akabora, “Imosesenirie inwe abamore abataka, ekiagera oboruoti bwa Nyasae nobwaino.”
“Imosesenirie inwe abamore nenchara bono, ekiagera namoigotigwe.” “Imosesenirie inwe abamokorera bono, ekiagera namoseke.”
“Imosesenirie inwe ekero mwanyabanto bakobagecha, na kobarusanania, na kobachaya, na gosaria amarieta aino buna nababe more, ase engencho y’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto.
Goka ase rituko riria, na gochenga, ekiagera ekeene eng’eria yaino nenene igoro; naki chisokoro chiabo nabo chiakorerete ababani engencho eyio eyio.
“Korende obobe nobwaino inwe abanda, ekiagera mwanyorire omogoko oino.
“Obobe nobwaino inwe abamoigotete bono, ekiagera namoche koba nenchara. “Obobe nobwaino inwe abamogoseka bono, ekiagera namoche goichana na korera.
“Obobe nobwaino inwe, ekero abanto bakobatogia, ekiagera chisokoro chiabo nabo chiakorerete ababani b’oborimo engencho eyio eyio.
“Korende nabatebirie inwe abamokoigwa: Ancha ababisa baino, bakorere amaya abwo babagechete,
basesenie abwo bakobaragereria, basabere abwo bakobakorera bobe.
Oyo okogoaka orosea oromo, moonchorere noronde, na ere oyogokoura eanga ya isiko, tomorina neya ime.
Moe kera oyokogosaba; na oyogokoura ebinto biao tomoboria naende.
Naende buna morigetie abanto babakorere inwe, nainwe mobakorere bo.
“Komoranche ababanchete inwe, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nigo banchete abwo babanchete.
Komorabakorere amaya abwo abakobakorera inwe amaya, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nabo bagokora.

Naende komorarue singo ase abanto mosemeretie konyora egento korwa asebare naende, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nigo bakorua singo ase abanyene ebibe, erinde banyore koreng’ana.

Korende mwanche ababisa baino, bakorere amaya, na korua singo, motari korengereria konyora egento gi’okoiranerigwa, eng’eria yaino nebe enene, na inwe namobe abana b’Oyore Igoro Mono, ekiagera ere nomuya ase abanto batari nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, nonya nase abang’iti.
Mobe namabera, buna Iso oino are namabera.
“Timogambia, nainwe timokogambigwa; timonachera, nainwe timokonacherwa; abera, nainwe namwaberwe;
karue, nainwe namoegwe. Ekerengo ekiya keigateire, keinyageire, geichire, nakio abanto barabae inwe ase amaboko aino, ekiagera ekerengo keria mokorengera, nakio morache korengerwa nainwe.”
Akabatebia omoreng’anio, “Inee! Omouko nonyare koraa omouko onde? Tibakogwa bonsi babere ase engoro?
Omworokigwa tari omonene kobua omworokia oye, korende kera oyomo gakoorire kworokererigwa nabe buna omworokia oye.
Inaki okorigereria ekeogoto kere ase eriso ri’oyomino, na omoribo ore ase eriso riao ime toyorochi?

Gose naki oratebie oyomino: Oyominto, ntige nkorusie ekeogoto kere ase eriso riao ime, na aye omonyene torochi omoribo ore ase eriso riao? Aye omong’ainereria, rusia ritang’ani omoribo ore ase eriso riao, nario orarore buya omanye korusia ekeogoto kere ase eriso ri’oyomino.
“Naki tori omote omuya okwama amatunda amabe, gose omote omobe okwama amatunda amaya.
Kera omote nigo okomanyekana ase amatunda aye. Naki ase emetobo abanto tibari gotwa amako, gose ase emenyenya tibari gotwa amasabibu.
Omonto omuya ase emonga engiya y’enkoro yaye nigo akorua ayare amaya; na omonto omobe ase emonga yaye embe nigo akorua ayare amabe, ekiagera ebiichire ase enkoro, nabio omonwa ogokwana.
“Nase ki mokondoka Omonene, Omonene, na inwe timori gokora aya ngoteba?
Kera omonto ogocha asende, na koigwa amang’ana aane, na koyakora, nimborokie buna are:

Nigo agwekaine nomonto oagachete enyomba, agakunya gochia inse mono, akabeka oboroso bwaye igoro ase egetare. Ekero etoigo yachia gocha, eooro egaaka enyomba eria ne chinguru, tiyanyara koyenyegeria, ekiagera oboroso bwaye bwaagachetwe igoro ase egetare.

Nere oyokoigwa otari gokora iga, nigo agwekaine nomonto oagachete enyomba igoro ase amaroba, etabegetwe oboroso. Nabo eooro ekayeaka ne chinguru, ekagwa bwango, na okogwa kw’enyomba eria gokaba okonene.”
Agachia gokoora amang’ana aye onsi ekero abanto bamoigwete, agasoa Kapernaumu.
Omosomba oyomo bw’omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana konya onyarekire ang’e nogokwa; ere nomonto anchete mono.
Agachia koigwa amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, agatoma asare abagaaka b’Abayahudi komoboria ache agwenie omosomba oye.
Na barabwo bagachia goika ase Yeso, bakamosorora, bakabora, “Nagwenerete omokorere ring’ana eri,
ekiagera nanchete egesaku giaito, naende natoagacherete esinagogi yaito.”

Yeso akagenda amo nabarabwo. Goika agachia koba tari are ase enyomba yaye, oria omotang’ani bw’abarwani agatoma abasani asare, okomotebia, “Omonene, tibwerosia, ekiagera inche tinyisaini aye orasoe inse y’ekerama kiane.
Ase ayio nigo neroche ng’a tinyisaini gocha asore; korende kwana ring’ana rioka, na omosomba one nagwene.
Naki inche nomonto mbekire inse ase okobua, naende ninde nabarwani inse yane. Kondatebie oyo: Genda, ogenda, na oyonde: Inchuo, ocha; na omosomba one: Kora iga, okora.”
Yeso agachia koigwa aya, agakumia asare, akeonchorera omoganda orenge komotunyana, akabora, “Nabatebirie: Nonya nase Abaisraeli tindanyora okwegena okore buna oko.”
Nabo baria batometwe bagachia koirana nyomba mwaye, bakanyora omosomba oria otimokire.
Nyuma ase aya akagenda omochie okorokwa Naini; aborokigwa baye bakagenda amo nere, na abanto abange.

Nabo, agachia goika ang’e ase egeita ki’omochie, rora, agwo nkiarengeo egetondo kebogoirie gocha isiko, omwana omomoima ase ng’ina, na ng’ina nomoboraka orenge, na abanto abange b’omochie mbarenge amo nere.
Na ekero Omonene achia komorora akamororera amabera, akamotebia, “Torera!”
Akagenda ang’e, agakuna ekige; ababogoria ekige bagatenena. Erio agakwana, “Omomura, nagotebirie, imoka!”
Omonto oria egetondo akaboka, agaikaransa, agachaka gokwana. Yeso akamomoa ng’ina.
Omoondoko okabwata bonsi, bagatogia, Nyasae, bakabora, “Omobani omonene oorokire ase egati yaito!” Na “Nyasae ocheire abanto baye!”
Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ya Boyahudi, na ense yonsi yaetanaine.
Aborokigwa ba Yohana bakamotebia aya onsi.
Yohana akarangeria babere ase aborokigwa baye, akabatoma ase Omonene komoboria, “Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”
Ekero abanto abwo baikire asare, bakamotebia, “Yohana Omobatisi ototomire asore, okobora: Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”
Ase engaki eria akagwenia abanto abange abarenge namarwaire, na emechando, na babwatire nebirecha ebibe; na abange abarenge emeuko akabaramokia amaiso abo, bakarora.

Akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Genda motebie Yohana ayamwarora na ayamwaigwa: Abarenge emeuko nkorora bare, abarenge amagata ngotaara bare, abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma basibekire, abarenge emetino nkoigwa bare, abare ebitondo nkobokigwa bare, na abataka nkoranderigwa bare amang’ana amaya.
Nasesenirie onde bwensi otagochiri nainche.”
Na abatomwa baria ba Yohana bachia kogenda, agachaka gotebia omoganda igoro ya Yohana, “Inki mwachiete korora aria ase erooro? Egetonto gekonyegerigwa nembeo?
Ninki mwachiete korora? Nomonto oboyirie chianga chinterere? Rigereria, abakweboyia chianga chingiya mono, na koria obwansu bw’omogoko, nigo bare ase chinyomba chi’abaruoti.
Ninki mwachiete korora? Omobani? Ee, nabatebirie: Oyore omonene kobua omobani,
ekiagera oyio nere amang’ana aya arikire igoro yaye,” “Rigereria, inche natomire omotomwa one ase obosio bwao, oyo oratang’ane koroisia enchera yao.
Nigo nkobatebia: Ase baria baiboire nabakungu, mobani onde taratoka ore omonene kobua Yohana, korende oyore omoke ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae nomonene komobua.”
(Abanto bonsi na abarusia ebango bagachia koigwa aya, bakaorokia oboronge bwa Nyasae, ekiagera babatisetwe ase ebatiso ya Yohana;
korende Abafarisai na abanto b’amachiko bagakana omoroberio o Nyasae asebare abanyene, ekiagera tibabatisetwe na Yohana.)
Omonene akabora, “Ninki ndagwekanie abanto b’ekegori eke? Barabwo ninki bagwekaine?
Nigo bagwekaine nabana baikaransete ase echiiro, bakorangerania, bakobora,” “Twababugeirie ebiroria, na inwe timotengeti; tweumirie, na inwe timorereti.
Naki Yohana Omobatisi nigo achete, tare koria omogati, gose tare konywa edivai; na inwe mogoteba: Nabwatire nekerecha.
Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ochire, okoria na konywa, na inwe mogoteba: Rora, nomonto omoribobe, ogotinda edivai, omosani bw’ababangi ebango na abanyene ebibe!
Korende obong’aini bwa Nyasae bwamanyekanire koba oboronge ase abana baye bonsi.”
Omonto oyomo bw’Abafarisai akamogania ache koria endagera amo nere. Agasoa ase enyomba y’Omofarisai oria, agaikaransa ase endagera.

Na rora, omokungu oyomo ase omochie oria, oyorenge omonyene ebibe, agachia konyora amang’ana ng’a oikaransire ase enyomba y’Omofarisai oria, akarenta echuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta e rimisu rigiya,
agatenena korwa nyuma, ang’e namagoro aye, okorera. Agachaka komoiyereria amariga aye ase amagoro aye, na koyatinyia netukia y’omotwe oye, okonyunyunta amagoro aye, na koyaaka amaguta aria.

Omofarisai, oria omorangeretie, agachia koyarora akeboria ase omoyo oye ime, ogoteba, “Omonto oyo, onye nomobani orenge, anga namomanya oyo ng’a nere ng’o, gose mokungu ki oyo okomokuna, ng’a nomonyene ebibe.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Simion, ninde ne ring’ana nkogotebia.” Akabora, “Omworokia, kwana.”
“Omonto oyomo omorua singo orenge nabasira babere; oyomo omoriete esira ye chidinari amagana atano, na oyo o kabere emerongo etano.
Barabwo tibarenge na gento bagoakana. Akabaabera bonsi babere. Gaki, ase abwo, ning’o oramwanche kobua?”
Simion akairaneria, “Igo ndabore ng’a, noria bwaberetwe ebinge.” Yeso akamotebia, “Kwanachire boronge.”

Akeonchorera omokungu oria, agatebia Simion, “Kwarorire omokungu oyo? Inasoa mwao, tikwang’a amache ay’ogwesibia amagoro, korende oyo osibirie amagoro aane namariga aye, na koyatinyia netukia y’omotwe oye.
Tonyunyunteti, korende ere korwa ekero nasoete aa tatigete konyunyunta amagoro aane.
Tong’ageti omotwe one amaguta, korende ere ong’akire amagoro aane amaguta agotioka buya.
Ase engencho eyio nagotebirie, obwanchani bwaye bworokirie ng’a ebibe biaye ebinge biabeirwe; ere oyokwaberwa ebike nigo anchete ake.”
Agatebia omokungu oria, “Kwabeirwe ebibe biao.”
Na baria baikaransete amo nere bagachaka goteba ase emioyo yabo ime, “Nere ng’o oyo oranyare kwabera ebibe?”
Agatebia omokungu oria, “Okwegena kwao kwagotooririe; genda nomorembe.”
Nyuma ase aya, akaba ngoetanana are ase emechie na ebichie, okorandia na kobatebia amang’ana amaya ay’oboruoti bwa Nyasae. Na baria ikomi na babere nigo barenge amo nere,
na abakungu bande ababwatire nebirecha ebibe bakagwenigwa nere: Mariamu ore korokwa Magidalena, oria orusetigwe ebirecha bitano na bibere,
na Yoana moka Kusa, omorendi bwe Herode, na Susana, na abande abange. Abwo nigo barenge kobakorera ne chinibo chiabo.
Ekero omoganda omonene osangererekanete, na abanto ba kera omochie bakamochiera, agakwana ase omoreng’anio:
“Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura embusuro yaye: Ekero akobusura, echinde chikagwa enchera ensemo, chigatiringwa namagoro, chinyoni chia igoro chigachiria.
Na echinde chikagwa ase egetare, chikamera, chikoma ase okomocha amache.
Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakina amo na chirochio, agachimiga.
Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikamera, chikama rigana.” Ekero are kobatebia aya, agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”
Aborokigwa baye bakamoboria, “Omoreng’anio oyio ninki ogoteba?”
Agateba, “Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oboruoti bwa Nyasae; korende abande nabatebigwe ase emereng’anio, erinde okorora barore, korende tibarora, naende okoigwa baigwe, korende tibamanya.
Omoreng’anio noro oyo: Embusuro nering’ana ria Nyasae.
Baria b’enchera ensemo, nabwo baikire koriigwa; erio Saitani ochicha, na korusia ring’ana riria ase chinkoro chiabo, erinde tibacha kwegena batooreke.
Na baria bare ase egetare nabwo baria bakoigwa ring’ana, baribwata nomogoko, korende barabwo tibari nemeri, begena ase ekero egeke, na ekero ki’ogoteemwa beatanana.
Na echio chiagwete ase amagwa, aba nabwo bakoriigwa, na barabwo kobakogenderera bamigwa nokorengereria kw’enibo, na omogoko bw’ense eye, tibakwama ase ogoikerania.
Na echinde chire ase amaroba amaya; aba nabwo bare ne chinkoro chingiya naende echi’ekeene, bakoigwa ring’ana, baribwata, bama okwama noboremereria.
“Omonto onde tari ogotongia etaya na koyemumeka negento, gose koyebeka nyaro y’oborere; korende nigo akoyebeka igoro ase ekebekerero kiaye, erinde abagosoa barore oborabu.
Ekiagera ring’ana tiriri ribisegete, ritache koorokigwa, gose eria bobisi ritache komanyekana maiso marore.
Mwerende gaki inwe buna mokoigwa, ekiagera ere oyobwate naegwe, korende oyotabwati, naurwe nonya nkeria arengereretie abwate.”
Ng’ina na bamura bamwabo bakamochiera, korende tibanyara komoika ang’e ase engencho y’omoganda.
Akairerwa amang’ana agatebigwa, “Nyoko na bamura bamino mbateneine isiko, baganetie kororana naye.”
Korende akabatebia, “Baba na bamura baminto nabwo aba abakoigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae na korikora.”
Rituko erimo akariina obwato, ere na aborokigwa baye, akabatebia, “Twamboke gochia ng’umbu y’enyancha.” Bakamanora.
Kobachia kogenda, akarara chitoro; omwaga ogacha, na emerindo ase enyancha, obwato bogachaka goichorwa namache, bakaba ase emechando.
Bakamochiera, bakamotura, bakabora, “Omonene, Omonene, ngosira tore.” Akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga na emerindo y’amache, na birobio bigakira, gokaba ogotoerera.
Akabatebia, “Okwegena kwaino, ng’ai kore?” Bakairoka, bagakumia bagatebania, “Oyo nere ng’o, ogochika nonya nomwaga na enyancha, bikomoigwera?”
Bagaika engegu y’ense y’Abageraseni, erigereretie Galili.
Agachia goika engegu, akaumerana nomonto oyomo bw’omochie oria, obwatire nebirecha; na ase amatuko amange tarenge kweboyia chianga, tarenge komenya nyomba, otatiga ase chimbeera.
Agachia korora Yeso, agaaka egeturi, akagwa ase obosio bwaye, agakwana neriogi rinene, okobora, “Inaki inde naye, Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae ore Igoro Mono? Nagosabire, tonchanda.”

Naki konya ochikire ekerecha keria ki’eubi gesoke korwa ase omonto oria. (Ekiagera ebiro ebinge nigo kiare komobwata; nonya orenge gosibwa nebinyuri ne chingataare na korendwa, nigo arenge kobutora ebisibo biria oirwa nekerecha keria goika ase erooro.)
Yeso akamoboria, “Naki okorokwa?” Akairaneria, “Elegioni”, ekiagera ebirecha ebinge biamosoete.
Bikamosorora tabichika bigende goika ase eora entambe.
Ndiarengeo riicho rinene rie chimbeche, chiare korisia ase egetunwa, bikamosorora abie ribaga bichisoe. Akabia ribaga.
Ebirecha biria bigasoka korwa ase omonto oria, bigasoa chimbeche. Riicho riria rigatirimboka bwango gochia ase egeturunkano goika chikagwa enyancha ime, chikarimera.
Abarisia bagachia korora ayio, bagatama, bakararia amang’ana ase omochie na ebichie.
Abanto bagasoka barore amang’ana aorokire; bagachiera Yeso, bakarora omonto oria orusetigwe ebirecha biria oikaransete ase amagoro a Yeso obegete chianga, ore nebirengererio ebironge, bakairoka.
Na baria bayaroche bakabatebia buna oria obwatire nebirecha agwenetigwe.
Naboigo abanto bonsi b’ense y’Abageraseni bakamoboria arue asebare, ekiagera basoetwe nokoiroka okonene. Erio akariina obwato, akairana.
Na omonto oria orusetigwe ebirecha akamosorora abe amo nere, korende Yeso akamokania, akabora,
“Irana nka bwoo orarie amang’ana amanene aya Nyasae agokoreire.” Akagenda bwoye, akararia ase omochie omogima amang’ana amanene aya Yeso amokoreire.
Yeso agachia koirana, omosangererekano okamogokera, ekiagera abanto bonsi bamoganyete.
Omonto oyomo, erieta riaye Yairo, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, agacha, akagwa ase amagoro a Yeso, akamosorora asoe nyomba mwaye,
ekiagera narenge nomoiseke, omwana omomoima, konya okoorire emiaka ikomi na ebere, na ere nigo arenge ang’e nogokwa. Ekero Yeso arenge kogenda abanto bakaba bakomomiga‐miga.
Naende omokungu oyomo oyorenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, osiareire ebinto bionsi ebiarenge nabio ase abarwaria, tanyara kogwenigwa nonde.
Ere agatunyana Yeso korwa nyuma, agakuna omokoba bw’eanga yaye; erio kegima amanyinga aye agakama.
Yeso akaboria, “Ning’o onkuna?” Ekero abanto bonsi bagakana, Petero na baria barenge amo nere bakamotebia, “Omonene, omoganda nigo ogoetanaine na gokomiga.”
Yeso agateba, “Omonto onkunire, ekiagera naigure ng’a chinguru chiandure.”
Omokungu oria ekero achia korora ng’a tabisekaneti, agacha okoiguswa, akamogwera, na ase amasio ’abanto bonsi akamworokia engencho yagera omokuna, naende buna agwenetigwe ara rimo.
Akamotebia, “Omoiseke one, okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie; genda nomorembe.”
Erio kagokwana, omonto agacha korwa ase enyomba y’oria omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, akamotebia, “Enyaroka yao yakure, torosia omworokia naende.”
Yeso agachia koigwa aya, erio akamoiraneria, “Toiroka; egene rioka, ere nagwenigwe.”
Agachia goika nyomba, tancha monto onde asoe amo nere otatiga Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo, na ise na ng’ina b’omwana oria.
Na abanto bonsi nigo barenge komoreera, bakweng’ereria, korende Yeso akabora, “Timoreera, ekiagera takweti, korende nigo araire.”
Bakamosekerera, bamanyete ng’a okure.
Ere agasokia bonsi gochia isiko, akamobwata okoboko kwaye, agateba, “Omwana, imoka!”
Omoika oye okairana, agatenena erio kegima. Yeso akabachika bamoe endagera arie.
Abaibori baye bagakumia, mono, korende akabachika tibatebia monto ayakoreka.
Akarangeria baria ikomi na babere akabaa chinguru na okobua igoro ase ebirecha bionsi na ase okogwenia amarwaire.
Akabatoma korandia oboruoti bwa Nyasae na kogwenia abarwaire.
Akabatebia, “Timobogoria gento ase orogendo rwaino, nonya nenyimbo, gose esaro, gose omogati, gose chibesa; naende timoba ne chianga ibere.
Naende enyomba ende yonsi morasoe, mobeere aroro goika moruo.
Naende abatabaroiseti, komogosoka korwa omochie oria, mokong’onte orotu rw’amagoro aino, erinde robe kirori asebare.”
Bakagenda, bagaetanana ase emechie, bakorandia enchili, na kogwenia abanto chinsemo chionsi.
Bono Herode omoruoti akaigwa onsi ayakorekire, agaichanigwa mono, ekiagera abande baare goteba ng’a Yohana obokigwe korwa ase abakure,
na abande ng’a n’Elija oorokire, na abande ng’a noyomo bw’ababani abakoro obokire.
Herode agateba, “Yohana inamonachete omotwe, korende ning’o oyo rende naigure amang’ana are buna aya?” Akarigia komorora.
Abatomwa baria ekero bachia koirana bagatebia Yeso amang’ana onsi ayabakorire. Erio akabaira, akagenda amo nabarabwo bobisi gochia ase omochie okorokwa Bethisaida.
Emeganda egachia korora, ekamotunyana, na ere akabaroisia, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana ’oboruoti bwa Nyasae, akagwenia abarenge nokogania gw’okogwenigwa.

Rigachaka kogoroba, na baria ikomi na babere bakamochiera, bakamotebia, “Tiga omoganda ogende goika ase ebichie ne chinsemo chietanaine, banyore aase bakorara amo nendagera, ekiagera aiga nigo tore aase egesomo.”
Akabatebia, “Inwe bae endagera!” Bakabora, “Titobwati kende kobua emegati etano ne chinswe ibere. Gose togende kogorera abanto aba bonsi endagera?”
Naki mbarengeo abasacha chilifu isano iga. Agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Baikaransie abanto aba ase ebiombe, na kera ekeombe koreng’ana emerongo etano.”
Bagakora boigo, bakabaikaransia bonsi.
Akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, akabisamunyora, akaa aborokigwa babiterekere abanto.
Bonsi bakaria, bakaigota. Na ebisamunye biria biatigarete bigasangererigwa, bigaichora ebitonga ikomi na bibere.
Agachia koba ngosaba are ere bweka, aborokigwa baye nigo barenge amo nere, akababoria, “Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a ninche ng’o?”
Bakairaneria, “Yohana Omobatisi; abande Elija, na abande ng’a oyomo ase ababani abakoro obokire.”
Akababoria, “Nainwe nigo mokobora ng’a ninche ng’o?” Petero akairaneria, “Kristo o Nyasae.”
Akabachika na kobakania tibatebia monto ring’ana eri,

ogoteba, “Negwenerete Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto anyore ogochandeka ase chinchera chinyinge, na kwangwa nabagaaka, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariko, naende aitwe, na ase rituko ria gatato naboke.”
Agatebia bonsi, “Oyorigetie gontunyana, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye kera rituko antunyane.
Naki onde bwensi orarigie koegera obogima bwaye oyio nabosirie; na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho yane, oyio naboegere.
Ekiagera inki keragwenere omonto karanyore ense yonsi, ko esirie gose gwesaria ere omonyene?
Naki kera omonto orandorere obosooku inche na amang’ana aane, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto kagocha ase obonene bwaye, namororere obosooku ase Ise na ase abamalaika abachenu.
Korende nabatebirie ekeene, mbare abanto ase aba bateneine aa, abataigwe amakweri nonya ng’ake, goika barore oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
Agachia koba amatuko ang’e atano na atato nyuma ase amang’ana aya, akaira Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro gosaba.
Ekaba kagosaba, ekieni ki’obosio bwaye gekaonchoka, ne chianga chiaye chikaba chindabu, chikameka‐meka.
Naende rora, abanto babere bagakwana nere, nabwo Musa na Elija.
Abwo barorekanete ase obonene, na gokwana amang’ana ay’ogokwa kwaye, aya agwenerete goikerania Yerusalemu.
Petero na baria barenge amo nere, konya babwatirwe ne chitoro, korende nigo batagesetie, bakarora obonene bwaye, na abanto baria babere bateneine amo nere.
Ekero abanto aba baare korua asare, Petero agatebia Yeso, “Omonene, imbuya intwe koba aiga; tokore ebigutu bitato, ekemo ekiao, na ekemo ekia Musa, na ekemo eki’Elija”; tamanyete aya agokwana.
Ekero agokwana amang’ana aya riire rigacha rikababisia, bakairoka kobachia gosoa ase riire.
Eriogi rigasoka korwa ase riire riria rigoteba, “Oyo n’Omwana one, Omochorwa one; moigwere ere!”
Ekero eriogi riakwanire, Yeso akarorekana ore bweka. Na barabwo bagakira, tibatebia monto ase amatuko aria ring’ana rinde rionsi ri’ayio baroche.
Rituko ria kabere ekero baare gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa, omoganda omonene okaumerana nere.
Naende rora, omonto oyomo ase omoganda oria agaaka egeturi, okobora, “Omworokia, nagosabire, origererie omomura one, ekiagera ere nomwana one omomoima.
Na rora ekerecha nigo gekomobwata, na ere bwango nigo akorera, naende kemogaragaria, erinde asokia amasombogoku, korende tikeri komorua otatiga ase okomosionora mono.
Nasaba aborokigwa bao bageserie, korende tibanyara.”
Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, naende ekebe, nimbe amo nainwe goika ririri, na koremereria nainwe? Renta omwana oo aiga.”
Agachia koba nkomochiera are ekerecha keria gekamoigusia na komoiyeria. Yeso agakania ekerecha keria, akagwenia omwana oria, akamoirania ase ise.
Abanto bonsi bagakumia ase okobua kwa Nyasae. Korende ekero bonsi babete nogokumia ase amang’ana onsi akorete, agatebia aborokigwa baye,
“Tiga amang’ana aya asoe ase amato aino, ekiagera Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ngochia are kobekwa ase amaboko ’abanto.”
Korende tibamanya ring’ana riria, rikaba ndiabiseka asebare, erinde tibarimanya. Bakaba nobwoba komoboria engencho ye ring’ana riria.
Okoengererania kogatuboka ase egati yabo ng’a ning’o asebare ore omonene kobua abande.
Korende ekero Yeso achia komanya ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo, akabogoria omwana, akamobeka ang’e asare,
akabatebia, “Onde bwensi oramwanche omwana oyo ase erieta riane, onyanchire inche; na oyoranyanche inche, omwanchire ere oyontomete. Ekiagera ere oyore omoke ase egati yaino, oyio nere omonene.”
Yohana akairaneria, “Omworokia, ntwarora omonto ogoseria ebirecha ase erieta riao, tokamokania, ekiagera tabwataini naintwe.”
Korende Yeso akamotebia, “Timomokania, ekiagera oyo otari mamincha yaino nigo are ensemo yaino.”
Ekero amatuko aye aika ang’e kogenda igoro, akamanora kogenda Yerusalemu.
Agatoma abatomwa komotang’anera, bagende na gosoa ase agachie k’Abasamaria, bamoroiserie aase.
Abanto b’omochie oria tibamoroisia, ekiagera arenge kogenda Yerusalemu.
Aborokigwa baye Yakobo na Yohana bagachia korora, aya, bakabora, “Omonene, norigetie toborie omorero oike korwa igoro obasirie [buna Elija akorete]?”
Akeonchora, akabakania. [Akabora, “Timomanyeti nomoika ore naki more noro.
Ekiagera Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto tachete gosiria obogima bw’abana ba mwanyabanto, korende kobotooria.”] Bakagenda ase agachie kande.
Ekero baare kogenda nchera omonto oyomo akamotebia, “Ningotunyane aande onsi ase okogenda.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Ebibwe mbire namakuruma, ne chinyoni chia igoro nchire nebiswa, korende Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto tari naase akobeka omotwe oye.”
Agatebia oyonde, “Ntunyana!” Ere akabora, “Omonene, ritang’ani ing’a ribaga ngende gotindeka tata.”
Akamotebia, “Tiga abakure batindeke abakure babo, korende aye genda orandie oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
Naende oyonde nere akabora, “Omonene, ningotunyane, korende ritang’ani ing’a ribaga mbaakere ng’a batigare buya abanto b’enyomba yane.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Omonto tari orabeke okoboko kwaye ase obokombe bwe chieri, naende arigererie nyuma, oragwenere ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
Nyuma ase aya Omonene agachora abande emerongo etano na ebere, akabatoma babere babere bamotang’anere kogenda kera omochie na kera aase arengereretie kogenda ere omonyene.
Akabatebia, “Rigesa nerinene, korende abakori emeremo nabake; gaki mosabe Omonene bwe rigesa atome abakori emeremo ase rigesa riaye.
Bwatia enchera; rigereria, nabatomire inwe buna chimanwa chie ching’ondi gati‐gati ye chisese chi’orosana.
Timobogoria ekemoya, gose esaro, gose ebikoroto; gose timokwania monto nchera.
Na enyomba ende yonsi morasoe, ritang’ani mobore: Omorembe obe ase enyomba eye.
Onye omonto bw’omorembe oreo, omorembe oino noikaranse asare; korende onye taibo, nobairanere inwe.
Mobeere ase enyomba eyio, morie na konywa ebi bakobaa, ekiagera omokori emeremo nagwenerete aegwe eng’eria yaye. Timoetanana enyomba ase enyomba.
Na omochie onde bwonsi morasoe, kobarabaroisie, karie eki barabae.
Mogwenie abarwaire abareo, batebie: Oboruoti bwa Nyasae bwabaikeire ang’e.
Kero kende gionsi mogosoa omochie, na barabwo batabaroiseti, soka korwa aroro, eta ase chinchera chiaye, motebe:
Nonya norotu rw’omochie oino rwabwatereire amagoro aito twarwabusire asemore, korende manya aya, ng’a oboruoti bwa Nyasae bwaikire ang’e.
Nabatebirie, nabe aororo ase Sodomu ase rituko riria kobua omochie oria.”
