“Obobe nobwao, Korasin! Obobe nobwao, Bethisaida! Ekiagera onye mbiakoregete ase Turo na Sidoni ebikone bie chinguru ebiakoregete asemore, abanto b’aroro anga mbaonchogete kare na goikaransa babegete chianga chie chigunia na beagete ribu.
Korende nebe aororo ase Turo na Sidoni ase rituko riria ri’ekina kobua asemore.
Naye Kapernaumu, noimokererigwe igoro? Noche goikigwa goika Eora y’amakweri.
“Oyorabaigwere inwe, nanyigwere nainche, na ere oyorabaange inwe, onyangire nainche, na ere oyoranyange inche, omwangire ere oyontomete.”
Baria emerongo etano na ebere bakairana nomogoko, bagateba, “Omonene, nonya nebirecha biatoigwereire ase erieta riao.”
Akabatebia, “Naroche Saitani okogwa korwa igoro buna okomesa.
Rora, nabaeire okobua gotindacha ching’iti chionsi, na ebiuge, ne chinguru chionsi chi’oria omobisa; gose gento kende tikeri kerabaite.
Nonya nabo timogoka ase aya, ng’a ebirecha biabaigwereire, korende goka ekiagera amarieta aino arikirwe igoro.”

Ase ekero keria Yeso agasasoka ase Omoika Omochenu, akabora, “Nakobakire aye Tata, Omonene o igoro na ense, ng’a kwabisire amang’ana aya ase abare nobong’aini ne chisemi, na koyamaanora ase abana abake. Ee, Tata, oko nakwo kwarenge ogwancha kwao okuya.
Naeirwe ebinto bionsi na Tata one; monto onde tari omomanyete Omwana gose nere ng’o, otatiga Tata, gose Tata nere ng’o, otatiga Omwana, na onde bwensi Omwana anchire komoorokeria.”
Akeonchorera aborokigwa baye, akabatebia bobisi, “Nasesenirie amaiso aya arorire aya mwarorire inwe!
Naki nabatebirie, ababani abange na abaruoti bakarigia korora aya mwarorire inwe, tibayarora, na koigwa aya mwaigure, tibayaigwa.”
Na rora, omworokia bw’amachiko agatenena okomoteema, okobora, “Omworokia, inki ndakore nyore obogima bwa kare na kare?”
Ere akamoboria, “Ase amachiko inki kerikire? Naki ogosoma?”
Akairaneria, “Mwanche Omonene Nyasae oo nenkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi, na obong’aini bwao bwonsi, na omogisangio oo buna bweanchete.”
Akamotebia, “Kwairaneirie buya. Kora iga, nario orachie kare.”
Omonto oria akarigia gwekora omonyene oboronge, akaboria Yeso, “Omogisangio one nere ng’o?”

Yeso akairaneria, “Narenge omonto ore gotirimboka korwa Yerusalemu kogenda Yeriko. Ere akaumera abauri, na barabwo bakamoumokera, bakamorusia chianga, bakamoaka chingoma, bakagenda, bakamotiga oisire gokwa.
Ekaba agwo omokuani oyomo akaoroka, ogoeta ase enchera eria, akamorora, agaeta ensemo.
Na Omolawi boigo agachia goika aase aria, akamorora; nere agaeta ensemo.
Korende Omosamaria oyomo, kagoeta, agacha aase arenge; ere agachia komorora, akamororera amabera.
Nabo akamoika ang’e, akamoboa chingoma chiaye, akamoaka amaguta na edivai; akamoriinia ase etigere yaye igoro, akamoira ase enyomba y’abageni, akamorwaria.
Goika mambia yaye akarua chisiringi ibere, akaa omonyene enyomba, akamotebia: Morende buya; na kende gionsi orarue kobua, kondairane naende, ningoakane.
Naki rende oroche ase abaiga batato, norori orenge omogisangio oye ere oyogwete ase amaboko ’abauri?”
Akabora, “Noria omororerete amabera.” Yeso akamotebia, “Genda naye okore boigo.”
Bagachia koba nkogenda bare, agasoa ase agachie akamo, na omokungu oyomo, erieta riaye Martha, akamoroisia nyomba mwaye.
Ere narenge nomosubati omwabo ore korokwa Mariamu. Mariamu nigo aikaransete ase amagoro a Yeso, okoigwa amang’ana aye.
Korende Martha nigo arenge gochandeka ase ogokora okonge, akamochiera, akabora, “Omonene, torochi aye buna oyominto antigire ngokora kera egento inche bweka? Motebie ankonye.”
Omonene akamoiraneria, “Martha, Martha, nigo okwerosia na gweichania ase engencho y’ebinto ebinge,
korende egento ekemo gioka keganeirie. Mariamu ochorire ensemo ere engiya, eye ataurwe nonde.”
Ngosaba arenge aase gete. Gakoorire, oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye akamotebia, “Omonene, tworokie ogosaba buna Yohana orokereretie aborokigwa baye.”
Akabatebia, “Komogosaba, teba iga:” “Tata [oito ore igoro], Erieta riao risikwe, Oboruoti bwao boche,
Otoe kera rituko endagera yaito.
Otwabere ebibe biaito, ekiagera intwe tokwabera kera oyomo otokorire bobe. Totoira ase ogoteemwa, [Korende ototoorie korwa ase oria omobe.”]
Akabatebia, “Ning’o asemore ore nomosani oramochiere botuko gati amotebie: Mosani, ing’a singo emegati etato,
ekiagera omosani one ochire asende korwa orogendo, na inche tindi na gento nkomoa;
na oria ore ime namoiranerie, na goteba: Tondosia, egesieri giasiekirwe, na inche amo nabana baane twararire borere, tinkonyara koimoka nkoe?
Nabatebirie, nataimoka amoe ekiagera nomosani oye, korende ekiagera oria tari gotiga ogosaba, naimoke na komoa ebio bionsi arigetie.
Na inche nkobatebia nde inwe: Saba, namoegwe; rigia, namonyore; tura, namoigorerwe.
Ekiagera kera oyogosaba, nigo akoegwa, na ere oyokorigia, nigo akonyora, na ere oyogotura, nigo akoigorerwa.
Naki monto onde nare asemore oyore ise, na omwana oye amosabe omogati, Inee, namoe rigena? Gose karamosabe enswe, ase ribaga ri’enswe namoe eng’iti?
Gose karamosabe rigena ri’engoko namoe ekeuge?
Onye inwe, abamore ababe, momanyete koa abana baino ebiegwa ebiya, Inee, Iso oino ore igoro takomenta mono kobaa bonsi, abakomosaba, Omoika Omochenu?”
Bono ngoseria arenge ekerecha rimama. Ekero ekerecha keria giasokire, omonto oria rimama agakwana; abanto bagakumia.
Abande babo bagateba, “Nase Beelizebuli, omonene bw’ebirecha, akorusia ebirecha.”
Abande ase okomoteema bakarigia aborokie egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa igoro.
Ere konya omanyire ebirengererio biabo, akabatebia, “Kera oboruoti kobwatananekanire borobwo obonyene nigo bogosareka, na enyomba yaatananekire ero enyene nigo ekogwa.
Naboigo Saitani karaatananeke ere omonyene, oboruoti bwaye naki boratenene? Naki inwe iga mogoteba ng’a nigo ngoseria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli.
Na inche onye ngoseria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli, Inee, abana baino nase ng’o bakobiseria? Ase engencho eyio, barabwo nababe abagambi baino.
Korende kondaserie ebirecha ase ekiara kia Nyasae, nabo oboruoti bwa Nyasae bwabacheire.
Omonto bwe chinguru ore nebinto bi’esegi, gakorenda enyomba yaye, enibo yaye nigo ekoba ase omorembe,
korende oyore ne chinguru kobua, ere karamochiere na komobua, nigo akomoura ebinto biaye bi’esegi bionsi ebiegenerete, na ebisakorwa biaye obiatanana.
Omonto otari amo nainche nigo are mamincha asende, na ere oyotari gosangereria amo nainche nigo agoserebania.
“Ekero ekerecha ki’eubi kiarure ase omonto, nigo kegoeta gati aase atari namache, gekorigia aase kegotimokera; getanyoreti kiabora: Ning’irane ase enyomba yane ase narwete.
Gakegocha, kiayenyora yaabusirwe, yaroisigwe.
Erio kiagenda, kiarentana ebirecha bitano na bibere binde ebire ebibe gokebua kerokio ekenyene. Birobio bigosoa na komenya aroro; okoba kw’omoerio kw’omonto oyio kwaba okobe kobua okwe ritang’ani.”
Ekero agokwana aya, omokungu oyomo ase omoganda agaaka eriogi, akamotebia, “Nesesenirie enda yakobogoretie, ne chimbeere kwagongete!”
Korende Yeso akabora, “Mbuya kobua, basesenirie abakoigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae na koribwata!”
Ekero emeganda yamentekanete, agachaka gokwana, “Ekegori eke nekegori ekebe, gekorigia egekone buna ekemanyererio, korende tigekoegwa egekone otatiga eki’omobani Yona.
Naki buna Yona abete ekemanyererio ase abanto ba Nineva, naboigo Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto arache koba ase ekegori eke.

Eting’ana ya Irianyi netenene ase rituko ri’ekina amo nabanto b’ekegori eke; ere nabanachere ekina, ekiagera nigo arwete ase chinsinyo chi’ense anyare koigwa obong’aini bwa Sulemani; na rora, oyobuete Sulemani naiga are.
Abanto ba Nineva nabatenene ase rituko ri’ekina amo nabanto b’ekegori eke, na barabwo nabakenachere ekina, ekiagera baonchogete ase okorandia kwa Yona; na rora, oyobuete Yona naiga are.
“Omonto gatongirie etaya tari koyebeka ase ekenunchi gose ayemumeke negetonga, korende nigo akoyebeka igoro ase ekebekerero, erinde abagosoa barore oborabu.
Etaya y’omobere oo neriso riao; ekero eriso riao rire rigiya, omobere oo bwonsi nigo oichire noborabu; korende ekero eriso riao rire riibe, omobere oo bwonsi nigo oichire nomosunte.
Gaki renda, oborabu obwo bore ime yao tibocha koba omosunte.
Nabo omobere oo bwonsi korabe noborabu, ensemo ende teba omosunte, omobere oo noichore noborabu kegima, buna etaya ase amasase aye egwoka oborabu.”
Ekero arenge gokwana, Omofarisai oyomo akamorangeria aragere amo nere. Agasoa, agaikaransa koragera.
Omofarisai oria agachia korora, agakumia ekiagera ataisabete ritang’ani atararagera.
Omonene akamotebia, “Bono inwe Abafarisai iga mogosibia egekombe na esani korwa isiko, korende ime yaino nigo moichire obouri na obobe.
Inwe abariri, ere oyokorete egia isiko, tari ere okorete nekia ime nakerokio?
Korende karue esadaka y’ebire ime; naende rora, ebinto bionsi nebichenu asemore.

“Korende obobe nobwaino Abafarisai, ekiagera mokorua ensemo ya ikomi ye chiarare, na kera egesaku gie chinyeni, mogotiga oboronge na obwanchani bwa Nyasae. Naro aya nabagwenerete moyakore, motari gotiga ayande.
Obobe nobwaino, Abafarisai! Ekiagera mwanchete goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro.
Obobe nobwaino! Ekiagera mogwekaine chimbeera chitari kororekana, na abanto baeta igoro yaye batamanyeti.”
Omonto oyomo bw’amachiko akairaneria, akamotebia, “Omworokia, kogoteba aya, nigo ogotochaya naintwe.”
Agateba, “Nainwe abanto b’amachiko, obobe nobwaino! Ekiagera mogotweka abanto chigurube chindito, na inwe abanyene timori gokuna chigurube echio nonya nase ekemo ki’ebiara biaino.
Obobe nobwaino! Ekiagera mokoagacha chimbeera chi’ababani, abwo chisokoro chiaino chiaitete.
Naboigo inwe mwabeire abarori na gwanchera ogokora gwe chisokoro chiaino, ekiagera nabwo babaitete, na inwe mokoagacha chimbeera chiabo.
Nase ayio Obong’aini bwa Nyasae nigo bwatebete: Nintome asebare ababani na abatomwa; baite abande babo na kobachanda,
erinde amanyinga ’ababani bonsi, ayaitegete korwa omochakano bw’ense naganigwe ase ekegori eke,
korwa amanyinga ’Abeli goika amanyinga a Zakaria; oria oiteretwe gati y’egesasimero ne Hekalu. Ee, nabatebirie, narigigwe ase ekegori eke.
Obobe nobwaino, inwe abanto b’amachiko! Ekiagera mwarusirie ekeigorero gie chisemi; inwe abanyene timwasoa, na baria abaare gosoa mwabatangire.”
Agachia gosoka korwa aroro, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai bagachaka komomiga namaborio amakong’u, na komochegia akwane igoro y’ebinto ebinge;
bakomotega, banyore ring’ana korwa ase omonwa oye, erinde banyare komosoera.

Ekero ekio omosangererekano bw’abanto chilifu chinyinge bagachia gosangerereka goika bagatachana. Yeso agachaka gotebia aborokigwa baye ritang’ani, “Mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai, engencho yaye nobong’ainereria.
Korende ing’ana rinde tiriri rimumekeirie, ritache koorokigwa, gose eribisekanete ritache komanyekana.
Nabo onsi aya mogokwana ase omosunte, naigugwe ase omobaso; naro aya mokomonyererana ase ebinyomba ime nararigwe igoro ase ebirama.
“Nabatebirie inwe abasani baane, timoiroka abwo bagoita omobere, na nyuma ase ayio tibari negento baranyare gokora kobua.
Korende nimbakurere oyo morairoke: Moiroke oria ore nokobua, nyuma ase ogoita omonto omoruta ase omorero o kare na kare. Ee, nabatebirie, moiroke oria!
Inee! Chinchiro isano tichiri koonigwa ase chibesa ibere? Naende nonya nakamo kabo tikari kwebwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
Nonya nechitukia chi’emetwe yaino chiabarirwe chionsi. Timoiroka; inwe imobuete rigori rie chinchiro chinyinge.
“Inche nigo nkobatebia, kera oyomo oranyatore ase mwanyabanto, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nere namwatore ase abamalaika ba Nyasae;
korende oyorankane ase mwanyabanto, nere nakanwe ase abamalaika ba Nyasae.
Na kera oyomo orakwane ring’ana riibe igoro ase Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto, naaberwe; korende ere oyorarame Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa.
Naende kobakobaira ase chisinagogi, na ase abagambi, na ase abare nokobua, timochandeka buna morachie koiraneria gose buna morakwane,
ekiagera Omoika Omochenu noborokererie ensa eyio eyio ayamogwenerete gokwana.”
Omonto oyomo ase omoganda akamotebia, “Omworokia, tebia momura ominto anyatanere omwando oito.”
Akamoboria, “Omonto oyo, ning’o ombekire koba omogambi gose omwatanani igoro asemore?”
Akabatebia, “Rigereria, erende korwa ase okogania okobe, ekiagera obogima bw’omonto tibori ase obonge bw’enibo yaye abwate.”
Akabatebia omoreng’anio, akabora, “Omogondo bw’omonto omonda okama mono.
Agachaka korengereria ase omoyo oye ime: Inki ngokora, ekiagera tindi naase nkobeka okwama kwane?
Akabora: Ninkore iga: Nintagore ebiage biane, mbiaagache ebinene kobua, na aroro ningache endagera yane yonsi, na ebinto biane.
Erio nintebie omoyo one: Aye omoyo, nore nenibo enyinge kwegacheire emonga y’emiaka emenge; timoka, orie, onywe, ogoke.
Korende Nyasae akamotebia: Omoriri oyo, obotuko obo omoyo oo oraganigwa, na enibo kwegacheire ang’e, neya ng’o erabe?
Naboigo are ere oyokwegachera emonga omonyene, na ere tari omonda ase Nyasae.”
Agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Ase aya nabatebirie, timochandeka igoro y’obogima bwaino, eki morarie; gose ase emebere yaino, eki morabeke.
Ekiagera obogima nobonene kobua endagera, na omobere nomonene kobua chianga.
Rigereria ebigonkoru, tibiri gosimeka, tibiri kogesa, tibiri nemonga gose ekiage, korende Nyasae nigo akobirageria. Na inwe imobuete rigori rie chinyoni!
Ning’o ore asemore oranyare gwechanda komenta ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo ase obotambe bwaye?
Ase ayio, onye timori konyara gokora nonya ne ring’ana erire rike buna eri, nase ki mogwechandera amang’ana ande?
Rigereria ebisicha buna bigokina; tibiri gokora emeremo gose gwesisa, korende nabatebirie, nonya n’Sulemani ase obonene bwaye bwonsi tabegete chianga buna ekemo ki’ebi.
Onye Nyasae okoboyia obonyansi bw’egetii oboreo rero, na ankio botugutwe ase omorero, Inee, takomenta kobaboyia inwe abamore nokwegena ogoke?
Inwe, timorigia eki morarie, gose eki moranywe; gose timoba nomoyo bw’ogwechanda.
Naki abanto b’ebisaku bi’ense nigo bakorigia ebinto ebio bionsi, korende Iso oino omanyire ng’a moganetie ebio bionsi,
Korende rigia oboruoti bwa Nyasae, na ebinto ebio namomenterwe inwe.
“Timoiroka inwe abamore omoganda omoke, ekiagera Iso oino ororire buya kobaa oboruoti.
Oonia ebio more nabio, morue ebiegwa; mwekorere ebimoya bitari kogota amo nenibo etari gokea igoro, aase omoibi atagoika, gose ebigwankwa gosaria.
Ekiagera aase chinibo chiaino chire nao chinkoro chiaino chikoba.
“Tiga ebinema biaino biboyigwe, ne chitaya chiaino chioke;
na inwe mobe buna abanto baganyete omonene obo, gakoirana korwa ase omoyega bw’enyangi, erinde kagocha na gotura, erio kegima bamoigorere.
Mbasesenirie abasomba baria ekero omonene obo agocha abanyore barendete. Ekeene nabatebirie: Neboyie, abaikaransie ase endagera, ache abakorere.
Naende karache ase oborendi bwa kabere gose oborendi bwa gatato, abanyore barendete, mbasesenirie abasomba baria.
Korende manya aya, onye omonyene enyomba namanyete ensa omoibi agocha, anga narendete, taiberwa.
Nainwe nabo, mobe ang’e, ekiagera ensa motakagereti, nero Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto arache.”
Petero akamoboria, “Omonene, nintwe ogotebia omoreng’anio oyo, gose nase abanto bonsi?”
Omonene akabora, “Ning’o rende ore omosomba omwegenwa, naende ore omong’aini, omonene oye arabeke igoro ase enyomba yaye yonsi, ae abanto endagera ekerengo kiabo ase ekero kegwenerete?
Nasesenirie omosomba oria ekero omonene oye arache amonyore ogokora bo.
Ekeene nabatebirie, namobeke igoro ase ebi abwate bionsi.
Korende omosomba oria karatebe ase omoyo oye ime: Omonene one otebanire gocha, naende achake goaka abasomba bande, abasacha na abakungu, na koria, na konywa, na gotinda,
omonene bw’omosomba oria nachiche rituko atakagereti, na ensa atamanyeti, nigo aramonachane abe ebing’ese, namoe ensemo yaye amo nabategeneti.
Naende omosomba oria omanyete ogwancha kw’omonene oye, na tebeka ang’e, gose gokora ogwancha kwaye, naakwe ebiranya ebiroro,

korende oria otamanyeti, ko ere okorire ayagwenerete ogoakwa, naakwe ebiranya ebiororo. Kera oyoeirwe ebinge, korwa asare ere nabiganigwe ebinge; na ere oyoeirwe ebinge kobua, korwa asare nabiganigwe ebinge kobua.
“Nigo nachire gotongia omorero ase ense; onye ngwoka ore, anga ninki ndigetie naende?
Ninde nebatiso nkobatiswa, naende ninchandeke mono goika eikeranigwe!
Inee! Mokagete ng’a nigo nachire ng’ee ense omorembe? Nabatebirie, taibo, korende nogwatanana.
Naki korwa bono ase enyomba nababe abanto batano baatananeke, batato ase babere, naende babere ase batato.
Mbaatananeke, ise na omwana omomura, na omwana omomura na ise, ng’ina na omwana omoiseke, na omwana omoiseke na ng’ina; ng’ina biara, na moka momura oye, moka momura oye na ng’ina biara.”
Naende agatebia emeganda, “Ekero mokorora riire rikoimoka bosongo, erio mwateba bwango: Embura netwe; yaba bo.
Naende ekero mokorora embeo ekorwa irianyi mwabora. Nebe eguru‐gura; yaba bo.
Inwe abang’ainereria! Imomanyete ense na erioba, buna bikororekana, korende naki rende, motamanyeti ekero eke?
“Naende naki ase emioyo yaino motari gwatanana ayare boronge?

Nabo ekero okogenda nomogosoeri oo ase omogambi, kora omokia kobwatana nere komore inchera, tachicha kogokurura ase omogambi, na omogambi oria akobeke ase amaboko ’omorendi bw’echela, na omorendi oria akorute echela.
Nagotebirie, tokorwa agwo nonya ng’ake goika oakane kegima ebesa y’omoerio.”
Ekero ekio mbachete aroro abanto bamotebetie amang’ana igoro y’Abagalili, baria Pilato asang’ananetie amanyinga abo nebing’wanso biabo.
Akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Mokagete ng’a Abagalili abwo nigo barenge abanyene ebibe kobua Abagalili bande bonsi, ekiagera banyorete emechando buna eyio?
Nabatebirie, taibo; korende motaonchogeti mwensi namosire boigo.
Gose baria ikomi na batano na batato bagweretwe norwaki orotambe ase Siloam, rokabaita, mokagete ng’a nigo barenge abasaria kobua abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu?
Nabatebirie, taibo; korende motaonchogeti mwensi, namosire boigo.”
Agakwana omoreng’anio oyo, “Omonto oyomo narenge nomoko osimekire ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu; akagenda korigia amatunda ase omoko oria, korende tanyora gento.
Agatebia omoroiseria bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu: Rora, emiaka eye etato nachire korigia amatunda ase omoko oyo, na tindanyora gento. Yonache! Nase ki ogosaria riroba?
Akamoiraneria: Omonene, yotige omwaka oyo naende, goika nyoburugere na koyobekera obwoyo.
Noro korame amatunda, mbuya; onye taibo, erio oyonache.”
Akaba okworokereria ase esinagogi eyemo ase rituko ri’Esabato.
Naende rora, narengeo omokungu obwatire nekerecha ki’oboreu ase emiaka ikomi na etano na etato, na ere konya okogotaire, tare konyara kwerambora nonya ng’ake.
Ekero Yeso achia komorora, akamorangeria, akamotebia, “Aye omokungu, gwasiboirwe korwa ase oboreu bwao.”
Akabeka amaboko aye igoro asare, na ere akaramboka erio kegima, akamotogia Nyasae.

Korende omotang’ani bw’esinagogi eria akabea, ekiagera Yeso agwenia omonto ase rituko ri’Esabato, agatebia abanto, “Nare amatuko atano na rimo agwenerete mwanyabanto bakore emeremo; ase ayio, inchuo ase amatuko ayio mogwenigwe, korende tari ase rituko ri’Esabato.”
Korende Omonene akamoiraneria, “Inwe abang’ainereria, Inee, kera oyomo oino tari gosibora eng’ombe yaye gose etigere yaye korwa bweri ase rituko ri’Esabato, ogenda nero koyenyoisia?
Oyo nenyaroka ya Ibrahimu; ekiagera Saitani omosibire emiaka eye ikomi na etano na etato, temogwenereti asiborwe korwa ase egesibo eke ase rituko ri’Esabato?”
Naende ekero are gokwana aya, abanto bonsi abare koamererania nere bagasookigwa. Abanto bonsi bakagoka ase engencho y’amang’ana onsi amanene akorire.
Naende akabora, “Oboruoti bwa Nyasae nigo boreng’anirie naki? Ninki nkoboreng’ania?
Mboreng’anie nentetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi omonto abogoretie, akayesimeka ase omogondo oye; egakina, ekaba omote. Chinyoni chia igoro chikaroisia ebiswa ase chinsagia chiaye.”
Agakwana eria kabere, “Ninki nkoreng’ania oboruoti bwa Nyasae?
Igo boreng’anirie nememera omokungu abogoretie, akayebeka ase ebirengo bitato bi’obosie, goika bionsi bikabota.”
Ekero arenge kogenda Yerusalemu, agaeta ase emechie na ebichie okworokereria.
Omonto oyomo akamoboria, “Omonene, barabwo abaratoorigwe nabake?” Akabatebia,
“Teema mono gosoa ase egesieri kere ekegote, ekiagera nabatebirie: Abanto abange nabarigie gosoa, na barabwo tibakonyara.
Ekero omonyene enyomba araimoke na gosieka egesieri, inwe namochake gotenena isiko na gotura gesieri, mokobora, Omonene, toigorere, na ere nabairanerie: Timbamanyeti aase mokorwa.
Erio namochake goteba: Nigo tware koria na konywa ase obosio bwao, naye nkworokereria kwarenge ase chinchera chiaito.
Korende ere natebe: Nabatebirie, timbamanyeti aase mokorwa; karue asende, inwe mwensi abakori amabe.
Erio namobe nokorera na okoriania amaino, ekero morarore Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, na ababani bonsi ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae, na inwe abanyene namotugutwe isiko.
Naende mbache abanto korwa moocha na bosongo, na korwa sugusu na irianyi, na barabwo mbaikaranse ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
Na rora, mbare ab’omoerio barache koba abe ritang’ani, naende mbare abe ritang’ani barache koba ab’omoerio.”
Ekero keria abande b’Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamotebia, “Imoka korwa aa, ogende, ekiagera Herode narigetie kogoita.”
Akabatebia, “Genda motebie ekebwe ekio: Rora ngoseria nde ebirecha, ngokora nde emeremo y’okogwenia abanto rero na ankio, ne rituko ria gatato ninkoore emeremo yane.
Korende ningwenerete kobwatia enchera yane rero, na ankio, na ankio ende, naki temogwenereti omobani asirere isiko ya Yerusalemu.

“Aye Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, ogoita ababani na kobaaka amagena abatomirwe asore! Ng’ara karenga narigirie gosangereria abana bao buna engoko egosangereria ebichuchu biaye aase chimbaba chiaye ime, korende timwancha!
Rora, enyomba yaino mwatigeirwe ere ritombe; na inche nabatebirie ng’a timokondora nonya ng’ake, goika ekero keria morache goteba: Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri ’Omonene.”
Rituko erimo ri’Esabato, ekero asoete ase enyomba y’omonto oyomo, omonene bw’Abafarisai, arie endagera, nigo barenge bamorigereretie.
Na rora, ase obosio bwaye narengeo omonto oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okobimbia omobere.
Yeso agatebia abanto b’amachiko na Abafarisai, akababoria, “Inee! Mboronge kogwenia ase rituko ri’Esabato, gose taibo?”
Bagakira. Akamobwata, akamogwenia, akamoa ribaga agende.
Akababoria, “Ning’o asemore ore netigere gose eng’ombe yagure ase engoro, otari koyerusia erio kegima ase rituko ri’Esabato?”
Barabwo tibanyara komoiraneria ase amang’ana aria.
Agatebia baria barangeretigwe omoreng’anio, gachia korora buna bachorire ebirogo bie ritang’ani, akabatebia,
“Gokorangerigwa nomonto ase omoyega bw’enyangi, toikaransa ase ekerogo kie ritang’ani; onye omonto bw’amasikani kobua aye orangeretigwe nere,
oria obarangeretie inwe babere nache kogotebia aye: Motigerere oyo ekerogo eke; erio nochake koba nobosooku gokoiranigwa goikaransa nyuma.
Korende gokorangerigwa, genda oikaranse nyuma, erinde kagocha oyokorangeretie, agotebie: Mosani, tigera gocha aa aase e ritang’ani. Erio nobe nogosikwa ase amasio abo bonsi abaikaransete amo naye.
Ekiagera kera oyokweimokereria igoro nairanigwe inse, na ere oyokweirania inse naimokererigwe igoro.”

Agatebia oria omorangeretie, “Kogokora endagera ya mambia gose eya mogoroba, torangeria abasani bao, gose abamino, gose eamate yao, gose abagisangio bao abanda; babaise gokorangeria banyare gokoakana.
Korende kogokora omoyega, barangerie abataka, na ebirema, na amagata, na emeuko;
aye nosesenigwe, ekiagera tibari na gento bagokoakana. Naki aye noche goakanwa ase okobokigwa kw’abanyene oboronge.”
Ekero oyomo ase abwo baikaransete ase endagera amo nere achia koyaigwa akamotebia, “Nasesenirie oyoranyare koria omogati ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae!”
Yeso akamotebia, “Omonto oyomo okorete omoyega omonene; akarangeria abanto abange.
Ekero ki’omoyega agatoma omosomba oye kogenda gotebia baria konya barangerigwe: Inchuo, ekiagera ebinto bionsi biabeire ang’e.
Bagachaka bonsi korigia chintamero. Oyo bwe ritang’ani akamotebia: Nagorire omogondo, nindigetie kogenda koyorora; nagosabire, onyabere.
Oyonde akabora: Nagorire chintang’ana amachoki atano, nkogenda nde gochiteema; nagosabire, onyabere.
Oyonde akabora: Nanyuomire omokungu, na ase engencho eye tinkonyara gocha.

Omosomba oria agacha, akorokia omonene oye amang’ana aya. Erio oria omonyene enyomba akabea, agatebia omosomba oye: Soka bwango, ogende ase chinchera na ebinchera bi’emechie, orente abataka, na ebirema, na emeuko, na amagata.
Na omosomba oria akabora: Omonene, ayio gwachika aikire gokoreka, ko nonya mbono ribaga ndireo.
Omonene oria agatebia omosomba oye: Genda ase chinchera ne chimbebe, obabetererie basoe, erinde enyomba yane enyare goichora.
Ekiagera nagotebirie ng’a ase abanto baria barangeretigwe onde tari nonya noyomo oranyare koigwa omoyega one.”
Emeganda emenge nigo yarenge amo na Yeso; ere akeonchora, akabatebia,
“Omonto kagocha asende, nere atagecheti ise na ng’ina, na mokaye, na abana baye, na abamura bamwabo, na abasubati bamwabo, ee, nonya nobogima bwaye, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.
Naende monto onde bwensi otabogoreti omosalaba oye na gontunyana, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.
Naki ning’o asemore, onye origetie koagacha oboagacho, otaikaranse ritang’ani kobara rigori ri’oboagacho obo, gose nabwate ebinto biisaine kobokoora?
Aise gosinywa gokoora oboagacho boria kabekire oboroso, abanto bonsi bachake komosekerera,
bagokwana: Omonto oyo nigo achagete oboagacho, korende tabokoora.
Gose moruoti ki, gakogenda korwana nomoruoti onde, otaikaranse ritang’ani na korengereria onye ere amo nabanto chilifu ikomi nanyare koumerana nere oyokomochera nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere?
Onye taibo, nigo agotoma abanto korigia enchera y’omorembe, omonto oria gakare aare.
Nabo kera oyomo oino otatigeti ebinto bionsi are nabio, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.
“Omonyo nomuya, korende omonyo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki orabekwe bwanse?
Togwenereti riroba gose etui; abanto nigo bakoyotuguta isiko. Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”
Nabo abarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe bonsi nigo baare komoika Yeso ang’e komotegerera.
Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariko bakemurungania, bakabora, “Oyo nigo akoroisia abanyene ebibe, na koria amo nabarabwo.”
Erio akabatebia omoreng’anio oyo:
“Monto ki oino oyore ne ching’ondi rigana erimo, na eyemo esire, tagotiga chiria emerongo kianda na kianda ase erooro, na gochia korigia eria yasirire, goika ayenyore?
Nabo kayenyorire ayebeka amareko aye nomogoko.
Na ekero akoirana inka, narangerie abasani baye na abagisangio baye, abatebie: Goka amo nainche, ekiagera nanyorire eng’ondi yane eria yasirete.
Naboigo nabatebirie, nobe omogoko igoro ase omonyene ebibe oyomo oonchokire, kobua ase abanyene oboronge emerongo kianda na kianda, abatarigeti okoonchoka.
“Gose mokungu ki ore ne chisiringi ikomi, na eyemo esire, tagotongia etaya na kwabusa enyomba, arigie nomokia goika ayenyore?
Kayenyorire, narangerie abasani baye na abagisangio baye, abatebie: Goka amo nainche, ekiagera nanyorire esiringi eria nasiria.
Naboigo, nabatebirie, nore omogoko ase abamalaika ba Nyasae ase omonyene ebibe oyomo oonchokire.”
Naende agateba, “Omonto oyomo narenge nabamura babere.
Oria omoke agatebia ise: Tata, ing’a ensemo y’enibo entungetie. Ise akabaatanera ebinto biaye.
Nyuma y’amatuko atai mange oria omoke agasangereria ebinto biaye bionsi, akaimoka akagenda orogendo gochia ense y’aare; agasiarera agwo enibo yaye ase ogokora kw’obokayayu.
Gakoorire bionsi, enchara enene egasoa ase ense eria, ere akaremerwa.
Akagenda akabwatana nomonto oyomo bw’abanyene ense eria; ere akamoira ebitii biaye korageria chimbeche.
Akaba nkogania are koigotia enda yaye ase amasabo aria chimbeche chiarenge koria; monto onde tarenge komoa gento.
Goika agachia kweirana kweboria ere omonyene, akabora: Abasomba b’eng’eria ba tata mbarenga bakare koria endagera na gotigaria, na inche aiga ngokwa nenchara!
Ninyimoke, ngende ase tata, imotebie: Tata, namochire ase oyore igoro na ase obosio bwao,
tingwenereti naende ndokwe omwana oo, tiga imbe buna oyomo bw’abasomba bao b’eng’eria.
Akaimoka, akagenda ase ise. Agachia koba okare are, ise akamorora, akamororera amabera, akaminyoka, akamoboania rigoti, akamonyunyunta mono.
Omwana oria akamotebia: Tata, namochire ase oyore igoro na ase obosio bwao, tingwenereti naende ndokwe omwana oo.
Korende ise agatebia abasomba baye: Renta bwango eganchwa ere engiya, momobekere; mobekere nebonyi ase ekiara kiaye, na ebikoroto ase amagoro aye.
Nyerente emori eria ere enoru, moyenyenye, torie na kogoka,
ekiagera oyo omwana one konya okure, naende moyo are; konya osirire, korende bono ororekanire. Bagachaka gochenga.
“Nabo oria omomura oye omonene nigo arenge mogondo; agachia goika ang’e nenyomba, akaigwa egeturi ki’ogotera na ogotenga.
Akarangeria oyomo bw’abasomba, akamoboria amang’ana ayio, engencho yaye inki.
Ere akamoiraneria: Momura omino ochire, na iso omonyenyeire emori enoru, ekiagera amonyora ore omogima.
Korende akabea, tarigia gosoa. Erio ise agasoka, akamosorora,
korende ere akamoiraneria: Rora, inche nagokoreire emiaka eye emenge, tinsareti ogochika kwao kero kende gionsi; korende tikwana kong’a emanwa y’embori, erinde ingoke amo nabasani baane.
Korende ochia gocha omwana oo oyo, orire ebinto biao nabakungu abatayayi, kwamonyenyeire emori enoru.
Ise akamotebia: Omwana one, aye amatuko onsi nigo ore amo nainche, na ebinto bionsi inde nabirobio nebiao.
Mboronge gokora omogoko na gochenga, ekiagera oyo momura omino konya okure, na bono moyo are; konya osirire, na bono ororekanire.”
Naende agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Narenge omonto omonda, orenge nomorendi. Oyio agasoerwa asare ng’a osiareire enibo yaye.
Akamorangeria, akamotebia: Ninki eke naigure asore? Orokia amang’ana ay’oborendi bwao, ekiagera tokonyara kogenderera koba omorendi.
Omorendi oria akabora ase omoyo oye: Ninki ndakore, ekiagera omonene one ondusirie ase oborendi bwane? Tindi ne chinguru chi’okorema; ogosaba nobosooku asende.
Namanyire eke ndakore, erinde abanto bandoisie ase chinyomba chiabo, ekero nkorusigwa ase oborendi.
Erio akarangeria abasira b’omonene oye, oyomo ase oyomo, akaboria oyo bwe ritang’ani: Ninki oriete ki’omonene one?
Akairaneria: Ebirengo rigana erimo bi’amaguta. Akamotebia: Bogoria ekaratasi yao, ikaransa bwango, orike emerongo etano.
Naende akaboria oyonde: Naye ninki oriete? Akairaneria: Ebirengo rigana erimo bi’engano. Akamotebia: Bogoria ekaratasi yao, orike emerongo etano na etato.
Omonene oria agatogia omorendi otarenge omoronge, ekiagera akorete ase obong’aini. Naki abana b’ense eye nabang’aini kobua abana b’omobaso, ase ekegori kiabo abanyene.
“Nkobatebia nde inwe: Ekorere abasani nenibo y’ense eye etari boronge, erinde ekero egochia gokea, babaroisie inwe ase obomenyo bwa kare na kare.
“Oyore omwegenwa ase ekere egeke, nabo are omwegenwa ase ekere ekenene; na oyotari omoronge ase ekere egeke, naboigo tari omoronge ase ekere ekenene.
Onye timobeti abegenwa ase enibo y’ense eye etari boronge, ning’o oranyare kobegena koba nenibo y’ekeene?
Onye timobeti abegenwa ase ekio ki’omonto onde, ning’o oranyare kobaa ekio ekere kiaino abanyene?
Mosomba onde tari oranyare gokorera abanene babere, ekiagera nageche oyomo, na anche oyonde, gose nabwatane noyomo, na achaye oyonde. Timokonyara gokorera Nyasae na enibo.”
Abafarisai abarenge abanchi enibo bakaigwa amang’ana aya onsi, bakamosekereria.

Akabatebia, “Inwe nabanto mogwetogia ng’a nigo more abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa mwanyabanto, korende Nyasae omanyire chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ekeimokererete igoro ase mwanyabanto, Nyasae nigo akegechete.
“Amachiko narengeo, na ababani boigo, goika ekero kia Yohana. Korwa ekero keria amang’ana amaya ay’oboruoti bwa Nyasae nkorandigwa are, na kera omonto nigo akobosoa ne chinguru.
Korende naango kobua igoro na ense goeta, kobua enuguta eyemo y’amachiko korua aroro.
“Kera oyogotiga mokaye na konyuoma oyonde otomanire, nere oyokonyuoma oyotigirwe nomosacha oye, noyio otomanire.
“Narenge omonto gete omonda, orenge kweboyia chianga chimonyinga na echi’egatani engiya, na kwegokia kera rituko ase okoria.
Na ase egesieri kiaye narengeo omonto oyomo omotaka, erieta riaye Lazaro, orenge namaote amange.
Ere nigo arenge kogania kweigotia namatori are kogwa korwa ase emesa y’omonda oria, ne chisese nachirochio chicha chiamomena amaote aye.
Omotaka oria agakwa, akabogorigwa nabamalaika, akabekwa ase egekuba kia Ibrahimu. Na oria omonda agakwa boigo, agatindekwa,
na ekero aare agwo aase abakure akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora Ibrahimu okare aare, na Lazaro ore ase egekuba kiaye.
Akarera, akabora: Tata Ibrahimu, indorera amabera, toma Lazaro atobeke ekiara kiaye mesia ase amache, akendie oromeme rwane, ekiagera nachandekire ase omorero oyo.
Ibrahimu akabora: Omwana one, inyora buna kwanyorete amaya ao ase obogima bwao, na Lazaro boigo akanyora amabe, korende ere bono aiga oremigwe, na aye ngochandeka ore.
Na kobua aya onsi, egati yaito na inwe eoromomo nereo yabekirwe, erinde abanto abarigetie korua aiga bamboke gocha asore tibanyara, gose baria bare agwo tibanyara kwamboka gocha asetore.
Akabora: Nagosabire tata, omotome ase enyomba ya tata,
ekiagera ninkare nabamura baminto batano; tiga agende abakurere, erinde barabwo tibacha aa ase emechando.
Ibrahimu akabora: Mbare na Musa na ababani; tiga baigwere barabwo.
Akabora: Yaya, tata Ibrahimu, korende oyomo korwa ase abakure aise kobachiera, inabaonchoke.
Akamotebia: Bataigwereti Musa na ababani, naisa koboka omonto korwa ase abakure, tibakoebererigwa banche.”
Yeso agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Amang’ana ’okogocha takomocha kooroka, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria okoyarenta!
Anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe enyancha ime, kobua aragere oyomo bw’aba abake akore ebibe.
Erende; oyomino karakore ebibe, mokanie; karaonchoke, mwabere.
Naende karakore ebibe asore ara gatano na kabere ase rituko erimo, karakoiranere ara gatano na kabere na goteba: Naonchokire, mwabere.”
Abatomwa bakamotebia, “Omonene, tomentere okwegena gwaito.”
Omonene akabora, “Onye mwarenge nokwegena koreng’aine buna entetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi, anga mwatebia omokenene oyo: Simoka, bwesimeke nyancha, noro anga nobaigwera.
“Korende ning’o asemore oyore nomosomba okorema, gose okorisia ching’ondi, oramotebie ekero akorwa mogondo agosoa nyomba: Inchuo bwango oikaranse, orie endagera?
Inee! Takomotebia: Ebeke ang’e, ondoiserie endagera goika indie inywe, na nyuma yaye, naye orie na konywa?
Gose nkomotebia are omosomba oria ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera akora eki achikwa?
Naboigo nainwe, komorakore onsi aya mwachikirwe, teba: Intwe nabasomba bataisaneti; twakorire aya atogwenerete gokora.”
Ase enchera ekogenda Yerusalemu Yeso ngoeta arenge egati ya Samaria na Galili.
Ekero are gosoa omochie oyomo, akaumerana nabanto ikomi abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma, bateneine are;
na barabwo bagaaka eriogi bakabora, “Yeso, Omonene, tororere amabera!”
Agachia kobarora, akabatebia, “Genda mweorokie ase abakuani.” Kobakogenda bagasibeka.
Oyomo obo agachia korora ng’a osibekire, akairana okomobaka Nyasae ase eriogi rinene,
akagwa ase amagoro a Yeso, okomoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, na ere n’Omosamaria orenge.
Yeso akabora, “Tari bonsi ikomi basibeka? Baria kianda, ng’ai bare?
Onde tanyorekanete oiranete komotogia Nyasae, otatiga omogeni oyo?”
Akamotebia, “Tenena, ogende; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.”
Yeso agachia koborigwa n’Abafarisai, “Oboruoti bwa Nyasae indi borache?” Akabairaneria, “Oboruoti bwa Nyasae tibori gocha ase ebimanyererio bikororekana,
gose tibakobora: Rora naiga bore, gose: Naaria! Rora, oboruoti bwa Nyasae nigo bore ime asemore.”
Agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Amatuko nache morarigie korora rituko erimo ri’amatuko ’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto, korende timokorirora.
Naende nababatebie: Rora aaria, gose: Rora aiga! Timogenda, gose timobatunyana.
Naki buna okomesa gokomesa korwa ensemo eyemo goika ensemo ende, nabo Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto arache koba ase rituko riaye.
Korende ritang’ani nagwenerete konyora ogochandwa okonge, na kwangwa nekegori eke.
Naende buna yabete ase amatuko a Nuhu, naboigo erabe nase amatuko ’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto.
Barenge koria, bakonywa, bakonyuoma, bakonyuomerigwa, goika rituko riria Nuhu asoete ase obwato; etoigo egacha, egasiria bonsi.
Naboigo buna yabete ase amatuko a Loti: Barenge koria na konywa, bakogora, bakoonia, bagosimeka, bakoagacha.
Korende ase rituko riria Loti aruete Sodomu omorero na ekebiriti bigatwa korwa igoro, bigasiria bonsi.
Naboigo erache koba ase rituko riria Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto araoroke.
Ase rituko riria oyore kerama igoro, na ebinto biaye bire nyomba ime, taika abibogorie; nere oyore mogondo naboigo tairana inka.
Moinyore moka Loti.
Oyorarigie koegera obogima bwaye nabosirie, korende oyorasirie obogima bwaye nabonyore.
Nabatebirie, obotuko boria abanto babere nababe ase oborere obomo, oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe.
Abakungu babere nababe bagosera ase orogena oromo; oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe. [
Abanto babere nababe mogondo, oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe.]”
Bakamoboria, “Ng’ai Omonene?” Akabairaneria, “Ase ribego rire nao chinsoti chigosangererekana.”
Yeso akabatebia omoreng’anio ng’a nebagwenerete komosaba Nyasae botambe, tibakwa emioyo,
akabora, “Narenge omogambi ase omochie gete, otasigete Nyasae, gose taare koyiera monto.
Na ase omochie oyio narengeo omoboraka orenge komochiera botambe, ogoteba: Ngambera boronge ase omosira one.
Omogambi oria ase ekero egeke tancha; nyuma agateba ase omoyo oye: Nonya inche tinsigeti Nyasae, gose tindi koyiera monto,
korende ekiagera omoboraka oyo andosirie, nimogambere boronge, tacha kondosia ase ogonchichera botambe.”
Omonene akabora, “Igwa aya omogambi otari omoronge agoteba.
Inee! Nyasae takobanyorera oboronge abachore baye, abakomorera omobaso na obotuko? Na ere takoba omoremereria asebare?
Nabatebirie nabanyorere oboronge ase obwango. Korende Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto kagocha, Inee, nanyore okwegena ase ense?”
Akabatebia omoreng’anio oyo ase abanto baare gwekaga ng’a nabanyene oboronge, bagochaya abande bonsi,
“Abanto babere bagatiira gochia Hekalu gosaba; oyomo n’Omofarisai na oyonde omorusia ebango.
Oria Omofarisai agatenena, agasaba iga ase omoyo oye: Nyasae, nakoiraneirie ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera inche tindi buna abanto bande, abauri, abatari boronge, abatomani, gose buna oyo omorusia ebango.
Igo nkweng’ata ara kabere ase echuma; ndua ensemo ya ikomi y’okonyora kwane gwonsi.
Na oria omorusia ebango agatenena are, tarigia nonya nkoimokia amaiso aye igoro, korende ageaka‐aka egekuba kiaye, okobora: Nyasae, indorera amabera inche omonyene ebibe!
Nabatebirie inwe: Omonto oria nigo aigete bwoye konya obareirwe oboronge kobua oria onde, ekiagera oyokweimokereria igoro nairanigwe inse, na ere oyokweirania inse naimokererigwe igoro.”
Bakamorentera abana ebing’werere, erinde abakune; korende aborokigwa baye bagachia kobarora, bakabatanga.
Korende Yeso akabarangeria bache asare, ogoteba, “Batige abana bache asende, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oboruotibwa Nyasae nobwabo.
Ekeene nabatebirie: Onde bwensi otancheti oboruoti bwa Nyasae buna omwana omoke, takobosoa nonya ng’ake.”
Na omogambi gete akamoboria, “Omworokia omuya, ninki ndakore inyare koba nomwando bw’obogima bwa kare na kare?”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Naki okondoka omuya? Onde tari omuya otatiga Nyasae bweka.
Kwamanyire amachiko; Totomana, Toita, Toiba, Toteba oborimo, sika iso na nyoko.”
Akabora, “Ayio onsi ninyabwatete korwa obwana bwane.”
Ekero Yeso achia koigwa aya, akamotebia, “Egento ekemo ngekoremete; oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi ogabere abataka, na aye nobe nenibo igoro. Erio ochiche ontunyane.”
Korende ekero achia koigwa aya akaba nomoichano, ekiagera arenge omonda mono.
Nabo Yeso akamorigereria, akabora, “Nabe aakong’u ase abare abanda gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae!
Naki naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esindani, kobua omonda gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
Na abwo abayaigwete bakabora, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”
Akabora, “Aya takonyarekana ase mwanyabanto, nigo akonyarekana ase Nyasae.”
Petero akabora, “Rora, intwe twatigire chinka chiaito, twagotunyanire aye.”
Akabatebia, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Monto onde tari otigire enyomba, gose mokaye, gose abamwabo, gose abaibori, gose abana, ase engencho y’oboruoti bwa Nyasae,
otanyore kobua ara aange bono, naende ase ense egochi‐gocha obogima bwa kare na kare.”
Erio Yeso akaira baria ikomi na babere, akabatebia, “Rora, ngotiira tore kogenda Yerusalemu, naende amang’ana onsi ayarikeretwe Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nababani naikeranigwe.
Naki nabekwe ase amaboko ’abanto b’Ebisaku, nakorerwe echeche, na gokorerwa bobe, na gotwerwa amate;
naende inabamoake emecharichi na komoita, na ase rituko ria gatato naboke.”
Korende tibamanya nonya nering’ana erimo ase aya. Ring’ana eri rikabiseka asebare, na tibamanya ayatebetwe.
Ekero achia goika ang’e na Yeriko omonto oyomo omouko naikaransete enchera ensemo ogosaba ebiegwa.
Agachia koigwa omoganda ogoeta, akaboria, “Inki ekio?”
Bakamoiraneria, “Yeso o Nazareti ogoeta.”
Agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Yeso, omwana o Daudi, indorera amabera!”
Nabwo batang’aine bakamokania, bakamotebia akire, korende ere akamenta mono goaka eriogi, “Omwana o Daudi, indorera amabera!”
Yeso agatenena, agachika arentwe asare. Agachia komoika ang’e, akamoboria,
“Ninki origetie ngokorere?” Akamoiraneria, “Omonene, inyare korora.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Oegwe okorora; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.”
Erio kegima akaba nkorora are, akamotunyana, okomotogia Nyasae; na abanto bonsi bagachia korora aya, bakamotogia Nyasae.
Yeso agasoa Yeriko, akaba ngoeta are egati‐gati yaye.
Narenge aroro omonto oyomo ore korokwa Zakayo, omonene bw’abarusia ebango; ere nomonda orenge.
Akarigia korora Yeso, gose monto ki; ko tanyara ase engencho y’omoganda, ekiagera arenge omweng’e.
Agatang’ana bwango, akariina igoro ase omoko anyare komorora, ekiagera ngoetera arenge ase enchera eria.
Ekero Yeso achia goika aase aria, akarigereria igoro, akamotebia, “Zakayo, ika bwango, ekiagera rero ningwenerete goikaransa nyomba mwao.”
Agaika bwango, akamoroisia nomogoko.
Ekero abanto bachia korora aya, bakemurungania bonsi, bakobora, “Osoire koba omogeni bw’omonyene ebibe.”
Zakayo agatenena, agatebia Omonene, “Rora, Omonene, ekeng’ese ki’enibo yane ning’ee abataka; naende onye naureretie omonto egento nimoiranerie ara kane.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Rero ogotooreka gwaikire enyomba eye, ekiagera oyo boigo nomwana o Ibrahimu.
Naki Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nigo achete korigia egiasirete na kogetooria.”
Abanto baria bagachia koigwa aya, Yeso akamenta kobatebia omoreng’anio, ekiagera konya oikire ang’e na Yerusalemu, na barabwo bagakaga ng’a oboruoti bwa Nyasae nigo borarorekane ekero ekio kegima.
Nabo akabora, “Omonto oyomo omosike akagenda ense y’aare, erinde anyare kwenyorera oboruoti, naende airane.
Akarangeria abanto ikomi korwa ase abasomba baye, akabaa ebirengo ikomi bie chiropia, akabatebia: Biire mobionchorerie goika ekero nkoirana.
Abanto b’ense yaye bakamogecha, bagatoma abatomwa komotunyana na komotebia, Titorigeti omonto oyo atogambere.
“Ekero achia koirana, kanyorire oboruoti, agachika abasomba baria aete chiropia barangerigwe, erinde anyare komanya ebitoki banyorire ase okoonchoreria kwabo.
Oyo bwe ritang’ani agacha, okobora: Omonene, ekerengo kiao kiarentire ebirengo ikomi binde.
Akamotebia: Gwakorire buya, aye omosomba omuya! Ekiagera kwabeire omwegenwa ase egento kere egeke, nabo nobe nokobua igoro ase emechie ikomi.
Na oyo o kabere agacha, akabora: Omonene, ekerengo kiao kiarentire ebirengo bitano.
Akamotebia nere boigo: Aye nobe igoro ase emechie etano.
Naende oyonde agacha, akabora: Omonene, eke nakio ekerengo kiao nagachete ase egetambaa;
nigo nakoirogete, ekiagera aye nigo ore omonto omokong’u. Nigo okobogoria eki otagachete, na kogesa eki otasimegete.
Akamotebia: Ase enkwana y’omonwa oo ninkogambie, aye omosomba omobe. Nkwamanyete ng’a inche nomonto omokong’u, nkobogoria eki ntagachete, na kogesa eki ntasimegete.
Naki rende otabegete chibesa chiane ase aba bakorua ebitoki, ninche ngocha anga nachinyora amo nebitoki?
Agatebia abarengeo: Moure ekerengo kiaye, moe oria oyore nebirengo ikomi.
(Bakamotebia: Omonene, oyo nare nebirengo ikomi).
Nabatebirie: Kera oyore negento naegwe, korende ere oyotari negento, nonya nkeria abwate naurwe.
Korende baria ababisa baane batarigeti mbagambere, barente aiga, mobaite ase obosio bwane.”
Gakoorire gokwana amang’ana aya, agatang’ana gotiira kogenda Yerusalemu.
Agachia goika Betifage na Bethania, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, agatoma babere b’aborokigwa baye,
akabatebia, “Genda goika agachie karia mokoorokera; kamwasoire ime, inamorore emori y’etigere esibire, etana koriinwa na monto; moyesibore moyendetere.
Naende omonto karababorie: Naki, mokoyesibora? Momotebie iga, Omonene nayeganetie.”
Nabo baria batometwe bakagenda, bakayenyora buna abatebetie.
Ekero baare gosibora emori eria y’etigere, abanyene bakababoria, “Nase ki mogosibora emori?”
Bakabora, “Omonene nayeganetie.”
Bakayerenta ase Yeso; bakaara chianga chiabo igoro ase emori eria, bakariinia Yeso igoro asero.
Ere gakogenda, bakaara chianga chiabo inchera.
Agachia goika egetirimboko ki’egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, omoganda bwonsi bw’aborokigwa baye bagachaka kogoka na komobaka Nyasae ase eriogi rinene ase ebikone bie chinguru bionsi barorire,
bakobora, “Nasesenirie Omoruoti oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene! Omorembe igoro, na obonene bore igoro mono!”
Abande ase Abafarisai abarenge ase omosangererekano bakamotebia, “Omworokia, togonyera aborokigwa bao!”
Akairaneria, “Nabatebirie: Aba nabaisa gokira, amagena aya naake eriogi.”
Ere agachia goika ang’e akarora omochie, akayoiyereria amariga,
okobora, “Onye nkwamanya rero ayare korenta omorembe! Korende bono abisekire ase amaiso ao!
Naki amatuko nagochere, ababisa bao barakoagachere orwaki bagoetanane, bagotange ase chinsemo chionsi,
na bakoiyerie inse, na abana bao ime asore. Tibagotiga ime asore rigena erimo igoro ase erinde, ekiagera otamanyeti engaki y’ogocherwa kwao.”
Agasoa Hekalu ime, agachaka gosokia baria barenge koonia aroro,
akabatebia, “Nerikire: Enyomba yane nebe enyomba y’ogosaba, korende inwe mwayekorire koba ribwago ri’abauri.”
Akaba okworokereria kera rituko ase Hekalu. Abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariko, na abanene b’abanto bakarigia komoita;
na barabwo tibanyora eki bagokora, ekiagera abanto bonsi bamotegererete.
Rituko erimo ekero Yeso arenge kworokereria abanto Hekalu ime, na korandia enchili, abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko amo nabagaaka bakamoorokera,
bakamotebia, “Totebie nase okobua ki ogokora aya? Ning’o okoete okobua oko?”
Akabatebia, “Nainche nkobaboria nde inwe ring’ana erimo, montebie:
Ebatiso ya Yohana, nigoro yarwete, gose nase mwanyabanto?”
Bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakobora, “Toise goteba: Nigoro yarwete, nigo aratoborie: Naki motamwegenete rende?
Korende toise goteba: Nase mwanyabanto yarwete, abanto bonsi nabatoake amagena; ekiagera banchire ng’a Yohana nomobani orenge.”
Bakairaneria, “Titomanyeti aase yarwete.”
Yeso akabatebia, “Nonya ninche tinkobatebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.”
Agachaka gotebia abanto omoreng’anio oyo: “Omonto akarema omogondo, agasimeka emesabibu imeo, akaywatananera abaremi, akagenda orogendo ase engaki entambe.
Ekero kie rigesa agatoma omosomba ase abaremi baria, erinde bamoe ensemo yaye y’amatunda ’emesabibu. Abaremi bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.
Naende agatoma omosomba onde; bakamoaka oyio boigo, bakamokora bobe, bakamoseria atari na gento.
Agatoma naende oyo o gatato, bakamoaka chingoma, bakamotuguta isiko.
Oria omonyene omogondo bw’emesabibu akabora: Inki ndakore? Nintome omwana one, omwanchwa one, aande ere inabamosike.
Korende abaremi baria bagachia komorora, bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo: Oyo nere omonyamwando, tomoite gaki, omwando onyare koba oyoito.
Bakamotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu, bakamoita. Naki rende oria omonyene omogondo bw’emesabibu arabakore?
Nachiche asirie abaremi baria, na omogondo oria bw’emesabibu nayoe abande.” Bagachia koigwa aya, bakabora, “Taba bo.”
Akabarigereria, akabora, “Engencho yaye ninki, ring’ana eri ririkeire: “Rigena abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona?”
“Kera omonto oragwe igoro ase rigena erio nabunanekane, na ere oyo riragwere narimosenyente.”
Aborokia b’amariko na abakuani abanene bakarigia komobwata ensa eyio eyio, ekiagera bamanyete ng’a omoreng’anio oria nabwo agoteba, korende bakairoka abanto.
Erio bakamoboera Yeso, bagatoma chirooti, na barabwo bagekora buna nabanyene oboronge, erinde bamobwate ase ogokwana kwaye, bamobeke ase okobua kwa gavuna na obogambi bwaye.
Bakamoboria, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a nigo ogokwana na kworokereria ayare boronge, gose tori koyiera monto, korende ase ekeene nigo okworokereria enchera ya Nyasae.
Inee! Mboronge koa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo?”
Korende akamanya obong’ainereria bwabo, akabatebia,
“Inyorokia ebesa! Ekieni eke na amariko aya nebiang’o?” Bakabora, “Nebia Kaisari.”
Akabatebia, “Nabo, ebia Kaisari moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae moe Nyasae.”
Tibanyara komobwata ase ring’ana riaye ase obosio bw’abanto; bagakumia ase okoiraneria kwaye, bagakira.
Erio abande ase Abasadukai bakamochiera, baria bakobora ng’a okobokigwa tikori,

bakamoboria, “Omworokia, Musa natorikerete ng’a momura omwabo omonto karakwe, na ere nare nomokungu, korende tari nabana, nagwenerete momura omwabo atware omokungu oria, atenenerie momura omwabo egesaku.
Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise omo batano na babere. Oyo bwe ritang’ani akanyuoma omokungu, agakwa, tatiga abana;
na oyio o kabere akamotwara, na ere agakwa, tatiga bana;
nonya noyo o gatato akamotwara. Naboigo bonsi batano na babere bagakwa, tibatiga abana.
Nyuma y’ayio omokungu oria nere agakwa.
Inee! Ase okobokigwa mokang’o arabe? Ekiagera bonsi batano na babere mbamotwarete.”
Yeso akabatebia, “Abana b’ense eye nigo bakonyuoma na konyuomwa;
korende barabwo ababarirwe bagwenerete konyora ense eria, na kobokigwa korwa ase abakure, tibakonyuoma, gose tibakonyuomwa.
Naende tibagokwa, ekiagera nigo barabe koreng’ana buna abamalaika, na abana ba Nyasae bare, ekiagera nabana b’okobokigwa.
Nonya Musa norokereretie ng’a abakure nkobokigwa bare. Ayio nabo atebete agwo ase ring’ana ri’egetutu, ekero agwatora Omonene ng’a nere Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo.
Nabo ere tari Nyasae bw’abakure, korende Nyasae bw’abare moyo, ekiagera bonsi nigo bare moyo asare.”
Abande ase aborokia b’amariko bakairaneria, “Omworokia, gwakwanire buya.”
Naki monto onde taba okomoboria ring’ana nyuma ase aya.
Akabatebia, “Naki abanto bagoteba ng’a Kristo nomwana o Daudi?
Naki Daudi nigo agoteba ase ebuku ya Zaburi, “Omonene agatebia Omonene one, Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio,
goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao.
“Daudi nigo akomoroka Omonene, naki rende aba omwana oye?”
Ekero abanto bonsi bamotegererete agatebia aborokigwa baye,
“Mwerende korwa ase aborokia b’amariko, abanchete gotaara beboyetie chianga chintambe, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro, na goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na aase e ritang’ani ase emeyega,
abakourereria chinyomba chi’ababoraka, na ase obong’ainereria basaba ogosaba ogotambe. Abwo nabanyore ekina kere ekenene kobua.”
Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora abanto abanda bakobeka ebiegwa biabo ase ekebekerero gi’esadaka.
Akarora omoboraka oyomo omotaka, okobeka ebisabwa bibere bie chitaai.
Erio akabora, “Ekeene nabatebirie, Omoboraka oyo omotaka obekire ebinge kobua bonsi,
ekiagera aba bonsi babekire korwa ase obonge bwe chinibo chiabo, korende oyo ase obotaka bwaye obekire ebinto bionsi ebiarenge nabio.”
Ekero abanto bande barenge gokwana amang’ana igoro ye Hekalu, buna echabeire namagena amaya na ebiegwa, agateba.
“Aya moroche; amatuko nache ritatigare rigena erimo igoro ase erinde eritatagorwe.”
Erio bakamoboria, “Omworokia, aya indi arabe rende? Naende ninki ekemanyererio kiaye ekero aya onsi arabe ang’e goikerana?”
Akabora, “Mwerende, timong’ainwa, ekiagera abange nabache ase erieta riane babore: Ninche ere! Nengaki yaikire! Nabo, timobabwatia abwo.
Na inwe ekero moraigwe amang’ana ’esegi na eburu‐buru, timogoswa, ekiagera aya bori nache kooroka ritang’ani, korende omoerio toraba ang’e.”
Erio akabatebia, “Egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oboruoti naborwane noboruoti bonde;
emetengecho emenene y’ense nebe chinsemo ne chinsemo, na enchara, na emechando emenene; nabe namang’ana ’ogoichania, na ebimanyererio ebinene bikorwa igoro.
Korende ritang’ani ase aya onsi nabababwate na kobachanda, nababaire ase chisinagogi, na ase chichela, namoirwe ase abaruoti na ase abagavuna ase engencho y’erieta riane.
Eke nekero kiaino koba kirori.
Manya gaki ase emioyo yaino, ng’a timorengereria ritang’ani eki morairanerie,
ekiagera inche nimbae chinkwana na obong’aini, abachandi baino batanyare gokana gose koamererania nabio.
Na inwe namoruegwe nabaibori baino, na bamura bamino, na eamate yaino, na abasani baino, na barabwo nababeke abande baino ase ogoitwa.
Inamogechwe nabanto bonsi ase engencho y’erieta riane.
Korende nonya nagatukia akamo k’emetwe yaino tikagosira.
Na ase okoremereria kwaino namonyore obogima bwaino.
“Korende, komorarore Yerusalemu oetananirwe nemeganda y’abarwani b’esegi, erio momanye ng’a ogosareka kwaye gwaikire ang’e.
Erio abare Boyahudi tiga batame gochia ase ebitunwa, na abare ime ase omochie basoke isiko, na abare isiko tibasoa aroro,
ekiagera aya namatuko ’egesiomba, onsi ayarigetwe anyare goikerana.
Nabe aakong’u ase abare barito na abakogonkia ase amatuko aria, ekiagera nebe emechando emenene igoro ase ense, na endamwamu ase egesaku eke.
Barabwo nabagwe ase chinsonga chi’emioro, nabooswe bairwe ase ebisaku bionsi, na Yerusalemu notachwe nabanto b’Ebisaku, goika ebiro biabo biikeranigwe.
“Naende nabibe ebimanyererio ase erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, na ase ense emechando ase ebisaku, nabatang’ang’e ase okoeera kw’enyancha na emerindo yaye.
Abanto mbakwe ekeondogo na okoiroka kobaganyete ayagochera ense, ekiagera chinguru chia igoro nachitengechigwe.
Erio nabanyare korora Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ogocha‐ase riire ase chinguru na obonene obonge.
Nabo karachake koba ayio, rigereria igoro, ekiagera okoboorigwa kwaino gwaikire ang’e.”
Akabatebia omoreng’anio, “Rigereria omoko na emete ende yonsi;
ekero egochaka goseboka mwarora na komanya ase emioyo yaino ng’a embura yaisire gotwa.
Nainwe boigo komorarore ayio agokoreka, momanye ng’a oboruoti bwa Nyasae ng’ang’e bore.
Ekeene nabatebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng’ake goika aya onsi aikeranire.
Igoro na ense nabiete, korende amang’ana aane takonyara goeta nonya ng’ake.
“Nabo mwerende chinkoro chiaino tichicha koengerwa nokoria bobe na ogotinda, na okwerosia kw’obogima obo, rituko riria ribachere mobosokano, buna omoeto okobwata.
Naki naboigo eranyare gochera abanto bonsi abamenyete igoro ase ense yonsi.
Ase ayio, renda kera ekero na gosaba, monyore chinguru chi’ogoeta ase aya onsi arache koba, naende gotenena ase obosio bw’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto.”
Na kera rituko nigo arenge kworokereria Hekalu ime, korende botuko ogenda isiko obeera ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.
Abanto bonsi bakamochiera mambia chuni aria Hekalu ime, erinde banyare komoigwa.
Rituko Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, rikorokwa Epasaka, rigaika.
Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko bakarigia enchera y’okomoita, ekiagera nigo bairogete abanto.
Saitani agasoa Yudas okorokwa Iskariota. Yudas nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere.
Akagenda agakwana nabakuani abanene na abatang’ani b’abarendi buna aranyare komobeka ase amaboko abo.
Bakagoka bakabwatana nere komoa chiropia.
Agancha, akarigia ribaga akomoruera asebare emeganda etaiyo.
Rituko ri’Emegati etabekiri memera rigaika, eri’emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka egwenerete konyenywa.
Erio Yeso agatoma Petero na Yohana, akabora, “Genda motoroiserie Epasaka, erinde toyerie.”
Bakamoboria, “Ng’ai origetie toyeroiserie?”
Akabatebia, “Rora, ekero mwasoire omochie, namoumerane nomosacha obogoretie enyongo ere namache; momotunyane goika enyomba agosoa,
motebie omonyene enyomba: Omworokia nkoboria are: Ng’ai enyomba y’abageni ere, inyare koriera Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane?
Omonto oria naborokie akanyomba akanene ka irongo karoisirie; agwo mwariganie.”
Bakagenda, bakanyora buna abatebetie, bakaarigania Epasaka.
Erio ensa egachia goika ang’e, agaikaransa amo nabatomwa.
Akabatebia, “Ninganetie mono mono koria Epasaka eye amo nainwe ritang’ani ntarachandwa,
ekiagera nabatebirie, tinkoyeria naende goika yaikeranigwe ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
Akabogoria egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabora, “Bogoria eke, mwatanane inwe ase inwe;
naki nabatebirie, korwa bono tinkonywa okwama kw’omosabibu goika oboruoti bwa Nyasae boche.”
Akabogoria omogati, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akayosamunyora, akabaa, akabora, “Oyo nomobere one orurwe ase engencho yaino. [Kora iga ase okong’inyora.”
Naboigo akabogoria egekombe nyuma ase okoria, akabora, “Egekombe eke nokobwatana okoyia ase amanyinga aane, aitekire ase engencho yaino.]
Korende rigereria, okoboko kwaye ere oyokondua nigo kore amo nainche ase emesa.
Ekiagera Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nkogenda are buna yachigetwe; korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria okomorua!”
Na barabwo bagachaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, gose ning’o asebare orakore ring’ana eri.
Gokaba okoamererania ase egati yabo, gose ning’o asebare obarirwe koba omonene kobua abande.
Yeso akabatebia, “Abaruoti b’abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakogambera abanto; naende abare nokobua igoro asebare barokwa Abakori Abaya.
Korende asemore inwe taibo, otatiga oyore omonene oino nabe buna oyore omoke; na ere oyokobatang’ana nabe buna omokoreri abande.
Inee! Ning’o ore omonene, noyoikaransete ase endagera, gose noyogokorera? Tari ere oyogoikaransa ase endagera? Korende inche nigo inde ase egati yaino buna omobakoreri.
“Inwe ninwe mwabeire mogendererete amo nainche ase ogoteemwa kwane,
na inche nabaeire inwe oboruoti buna Tata ang’ete,
monyare koria na konywa ase emesa yane ase oboruoti bwane, na goikaransa ase ebirogo bi’obonene, na kogambia abanto b’ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli.”
Akabora, “Simion, Simion, rora Saitani nabarigetie abaire anyare kobasoonga buna engano,
korende nagosabeire, erinde okwegena kwao tikoera, na aye gokwaonchokire, obeke abamino chinguru.”
Akamotebia, “Omonene nigo inde ang’e kogenda amo naye echela, nonya nase ogokwa.”
Akabora, “Nagotebirie Petero, rero etuoni etarabuga nonkane ara gatato ng’a tomanyeti.”
Akababoria, “Inee! Ekero nabatomete motari nebimoya, ne chisaro, na ebikoroto, imwaremeretwe na gento?” Bakamoiraneria, “Yaya”.
Akabatebia, “Korende bono oyore nekemoya akebogorie, na esaro boigo, na ere oyotari nomoyio o birende aoonie eganchwa yaye, agore oyomo.
Naki nabatebirie, eriarigetwe ndigwenerete goikeranigwa asende. Ere nigo abareranetigwe amo nabasaria, ekiagera ayarigetwe igoro asende aikeranigwe.”
Bagateba, “Omonene, rora ntore nemeyio ya birende ebere aa.” Akabatebia, “Nabo aisanire.”
Agasoka, akagenda goika egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, buna engencho yaye yarenge, na aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.
Agachia goika aase aria akabatebia, “Saba, erinde timosoa ase ogoteemwa.”
Ageatanana korwa asebare, ekerengo gi’okoruta rigena, akabeka amaru inse, agasaba,
ogoteba, “Tata, koranche, onduserie egekombe eke, korende tari buna ndigetie inche, korende buna origetie aye, bikoreke.”
Omomalaika akamoorokera korwa, igoro, akamobeka chinguru.
Na ere ekiagera arenge nomoichano mono, akamenta ogosaba nomokia; ebigeri biaye bikaba buna amatoima ’amanyinga agoiteka inse.
Agachia koimoka korwa ase ogosaba agachiera aborokigwa baye, akabanyora bararire ase ogoichana.
Akabatebia, “Inaki mwararire? Boka, mosabe, erinde timosoa ase ogoteemwa.”
Ekero arenge gokwana, rora, omoganda ogacha, na oria okorokwa Yudas, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, obatang’aine. Ere akamoika Yeso ang’e komonyunyunta.
Yeso akamotebia, “Yudas, nkomorua ore Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ase okomonyunyunta?”
Na abwo barenge amo nere bagachia korora ayakorigia koba, bakabora, “Omonene, inatorwane nomoyio o birende?”
Oyomo obo agaaka omosomba bw’omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto gw’okorio.
Yeso akabora, “Tiga tokora igo.” Akamokuna ogoto, akamogwenia.
Yeso agatebia abakuani abanene, na abanene b’abarendi, na abagaaka, baria bamocherete, “Iga mwachire nemeyio ya birende ne chinungu buna mogochiera omouri.
Ekero narenge amo nainwe ase Hekalu kera rituko timwaramborete amaboko mombwate, korende bono ensa eye neyaino, ekero omosunte okogamba.”
Bakamobwata, bakamoira, bakagenda nere nyomba ime ase omokuani omonene. Na Petero akamotunyana korwa nyuma ore egeka.
Bagachia gouta omorero egati y’egoora, bagaikaransa amo, na Petero agaikaransa ase egati yabo.
Erio omoiseke oyomo akamorora oikaransete ang’e nomorero, akamobeta amaiso akabora, “Oyo nere igo arenge amo nere.”
Agakana, akabora, “Omokungu, timomanyeti.”
Naende ake omonto onde akamorora, akabora, “Aye noyomo obo ore.” Petero akabora, “Omonto oyo, tai inche.”
Na nyuma y’ensa eyemo, omonto onde akabetereria mono, akabora, “Ekeene, oyo nigo arenge amo nere, ekiagera nere n’Omogalili.”
Petero akabora, “Omonto oyo, timanyeti eri ogokwana.” Erio kegima kagokwana, etuoni ekabuga.
Omonene akeonchora, akarigereria Petero. Petero akainyora ring’ana ri’Omonene, buna amotebetie, “Rero, ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga nonkane ara gatato.”
Agasoka isiko, akarera nobororo.
Abanto baria babwatete Yeso, bakamosekereria, na komoaka.
Bakamotuba amaiso, bakamoboria, “Bana! Ning’o ogoaka?”
Bakamokwana bobe amang’ana ande amange ay’okomorama.
Ekero bwachia gokia, abagaaka b’abanto, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariko bagasangererekana amo, bakamorenta ase ekegambero kiabo, bakobora,
“Onye aye naye Kristo, totebie.” Korende akabatebia, “Ninsa kobatebia, timokonyara gwancha;
naende nimbaboria, timokong’iraneria.
Korende korwa bono Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto naikaranse ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’obonene bwa Nyasae.”
Bakabora bonsi, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.” Akabatebia, “Inwe mwatebire ng’a ninche ere.”
Bakabora, “Mborori ki torigetie goetania obo? Naki intwe abanyene twaigure amang’ana korwa ase omonwa oye.”
Bakaimoka bonsi, bakaira Yeso ase Pilato.
Bagachaka komosoera, bakobora, “Twanyorire omonto oyo oonchoire egesaku giaito, otokanirie titoa Kaisari ebango, okobora ng’a ere omonyene nere Kristo omoruoti.”
Pilato akamoboria, “Naye Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi?” Akairaneria, “Naboigo. Aye gwatebire.”
Pilato agatebia abakuani abanene na emeganda, “Inche tindochi bobe bonde ase omonto oyo.”
Barabwo bakamobetereria, bakabora, “Oburukanirie abanto, okoborokereria ase Boyahudi yonsi, gochakera Galili goika aiga.”
Pilato agachia koigwa ring’ana eri, akaboria, “Omonto oyo n’Omogalili?”
Agachia komanya ng’a nigo are inse ase obogambi bwa Herode, akamotoma gochia ase Herode. Na Herode omonyene nigo arenge Yerusalemu ase amatuko aria.
Ekero Herode achia korora Yeso akagokigwa mono, ekiagera korwa kare nigo arigetie komorora, ekiagera aigwete chinkuma chiaye, naende nigo asemeretie korora egekone kegokorwa nere.
Akamoboria amang’ana amange, korende ere tamoiraneria rinde rionsi.
Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko bagatenena, bakomosoera ne chinguru.
Herode na abarwani baye bakamochaya, bakamosekereria, bakamobekera chianga chingiya mono, akamoirania ase Pilato.
Erio Herode na Pilato bakabwatana obwanchi ase rituko riria; naki ritang’ani nigo barenge nobobisa barabwo ase barabwo.
Pilato akarangeria amo abakuani abanene, na abagambi, na abanto,
akabatebia, “Mwandeterete omonto oyo, buna oyobaonchoire abanto; naunirie amang’ana aye ase amasio aino, na tindochi bobe ase omonto oyo ase aria mwamosoerete,
nonya n’Herode tarochi, ekiagera omoiranirie gocha asetore. Rora, ere takorete gento kemogwenerete akwe.
Erio konamoakire, nimosibore.”
Bono igo yamogwenerete kobasiborera omonto oyomo ekero kie rituko rinene.
Bagaaka eriogi bonsi amo, bakabora, “Morusie oyo, tosiborere Baraba!”
(Ere nomonto obegetwe ase echela ase engencho y’eriomana riakoregete ase omochie ime, na ase oboiti.)
Nabo eria kabere Pilato agakwana nabarabwo, akarigia gosibora Yeso.
Korende barabwo bagaaka eriogi, bakabora, “Mobambe, mobambe!”
Ere akabatebia eria gatato, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete oyo? Tindochi nonya ne ring’ana erimo asare rigwenerete akwe. Ase igo, nanchire komoaka na komosibora.”
Korende bakagenderera kobora ase eriogi rinene ng’a goika abambwe. Eriogi riabo rikabua.
Pilato akanacha amang’ana akoreke buna barigetie.
Agasibora ere oyobegetwe echela ase eriomana na oboiti, oyobarigetie; akarua Yeso asebare buna ogwancha kwabo kwarenge.
Bagachia komoira, bakabwata Simion Omokurene, oyorenge korwa borabu, bakamotweka omosalaba, ayobogorie nyuma ya Yeso.
Omoganda bw’abanto okamotunyana, na abakungu baare kweaka‐aka, na komweng’erereria.
Yeso akabeonchorera, akabora, “Abaiseke ba Yerusalemu, timondeera inche, korende ereere inwe abanyene, na abana baino.
Naki amatuko nache ekero abanto baratebe: Mbasesenirie abare abagomba, ne chinda chitaiboreti, ne chimbeere chitana kogonkwa!
Erio nabachake gotebia ebitunwa: Togwere, na ebigoro: Totube.
Onye bagokora aya ekero omote ore omobese, naki erabe ekero bwomire?”
Abande babere abasaria bakairwa, baitwe amo nere.
Bagachia goika aase akorokwa Ekeore, bakamobamba aroro, na baria abasaria, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio, na oyonde ensemo y’okoboko gw’okobee.
Yeso akabora, “Tata, baabere, ekiagera tibamanyeti eke bagokora.” Bakagabana chianga chiaye, bagachiakera obomera.
Abanto bagatenena, bakarigereria. Na barabwo abanyene bakamokorera echeche, bakabora, “Natooretie abande, tiga etoorie ere omonyene, onye oyo nere Kristo o Nyasae, Omochore oye.”
Abarwani boigo bakamosekereria, bakamochiera, bakamoa chinkama,
bakabora, “Onye aye naye Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi, etoorie.”
Igoro asare nkiarengeo ekemanyererio kerikire ase omonwa bw’Ekegiriki, na Ekerumi, na Ekeibirania “OYO NERE OMORUOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”
Oyomo bwa baria abasaria babambetwe akamorama, akabora, “Inee! Tari aye Kristo? Etoorie aye omonyene, naintwe ototoorie.”
Oyo o kabere akamokania, akabora, “Aye tori komoiroka nonya Nyasae, aye kore ase ekina keria keria?
Intwe ekeene mboronge; ekiagera twaeirwe eng’eria ya boronge y’ogokora gwaito, korende oyo takoreti gento kende kebe.”
Erio agatebia Yeso, “Yeso, ong’inyore ekero ogocha ase oboruoti bwao!”
Yeso akamotebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Rero nobe amo nainche Paradiso.”
Bono nigo chiarenge ang’e chinsa isano nemo, omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda,
ekero omobaso orimire. Na egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatandoka gati‐gati.
Yeso akarera ase eriogi rinene, akabora, “Tata, ase amaboko ao nabekire omoika one!” Nyuma gakwanire aya agatweka mo.
Omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana agachia korora aya, agatogia Nyasae, akabora, “Ekeene, omonto oyo nigo arenge omonyene oboronge.”
Naende emeganda yonsi, abasangererekanete korora aya, kobachia korora ayakoreka, bakairana chinka chiabo, bakweaka ebikuba.
Abasani baye bonsi na abakungu abamotunyanete korwa Galili, bagatenenera are, bakarora ayio.
Rora, narengeo omonto oyomo, erieta riaye Yusufu, omonto bw’Arimathaya, omochie o Boyahudi, ere nomonto bw’ekegambero kiabo, omonto omuya, naende omoronge.
Ere tanchete amang’ana abo, nonya nogokora kwabo, nigo aganyete oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
Omonto oyo agachiera Pilato, akamosaba aegwe omobere o Yeso.
Akayoikia, akayoboyia egetambaa ki’egatani, akayobeka ase oboina bwabaachetwe ase egetare, aase monto onde atana kobekwa.
Nigo riarenge rituko ri’Okwearigania, na Esabato egachaka gosoa.
Abakungu abachete amo nere korwa Galili, nigo batunyanete korwa nyuma, bakarigereria oboina na buna omobere oye bwareretigwe.
Bakairana, bakaroisia amanukato na amaguta e rimisu rigiya. Ne rituko ri’Esabato bagatimoka buna yachigetwe.
Korende rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, kobogokiamoka, abakungu baria bakagenda ase oboina, bakaira amanukato aria, ayababegete ang’e.
Bakanyora rigena riria riatigerigwe korwa ase oboina,
korende ekero basoa, tibanyora omobere bw’Omonene Yeso.
Ekero baichanete ase aya, rora, abanto babere bagatenena ang’e asebare, beboyetie chianga chikomeka‐meka.
Abakungu baria bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagatung’ama inse. Abanto baria bakabatebia, “Nase ki mokorigia oyore moyo ase ebitondo? [Tari aa, korende obokire.]
Inyora buna abatebetie ekero arenge Galili,
ng’a nemogwenerete Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto abekwe ase amaboko ’abanto abanyene ebibe, na kobambwa, na ase rituko ria gatato naboke.”
Bakainyora amang’ana aye.
Bakairana korwa ase oboina, bagatebia baria ikomi nomo na baria abande bonsi amang’ana ayio onsi.
Na baria batebetie abatomwa amang’ana aya nabwo aba: Mariamu Magidalena, na Yoana, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo na abakungu bande abarenge amo nabarabwo.
Amang’ana abo akarorekana koba ng’a naya bosa asebare, gose tibayancha. [
Korende Petero akaimoka, akagenda bwango ase oboina, agatung’ama, akarigereria ime, akarora ebitambaa biria bireo bioka, akairana bwoye, okumetie ase aya akorekire.]
Rituko riria babere asebare nkogenda baare ase omochie okorokwa Emau, orenge oboare korwa Yerusalemu ang’e chimaeli isano na isato.
Na barabwo ngokwana baare barabwo ase barabwo igoro ase aya onsi akorekire.
Kabagokwana na koborania, Yeso omonyene agaika ang’e, akagenda amo nabarabwo.
Amaiso abo agatubwa, tibanyara komomanya.
Akababoria, “Mang’ana ki aya mokoborania ase orogendo rwaino?” Bagatenena, baichanete.
Oyomo obo, erieta riaye Kiliopa, akamoiraneria, “Inee! Naye bweka ore omogeni ase Yerusalemu, otamanyeti ayare ime yaye amatuko aya?”
Akababoria, “Mang’ana ki?” Bakamotebia, “Amang’ana a Yeso Omonazareti, oyorenge omobani, omonyene chinguru ase ogokora na ase ring’ana, ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase abanto bonsi;
na buna abakuani na abanene baito bamoruete ase ekina ki’ogokwa, bakamobamba.
Korende intwe iga twasemeretie ng’a nere oraboorie Abaisraeli. Kobua aya onsi, rero nerituko ria gatato korwa ekero ayio akorekanete.
Naende abakungu bande ba seito nigo batoichanetie. Abwo barenge ase oboina mambia,
na ekero batanyorete omobere oye, bakairana, bakabora ng’a baorokeirwe nabamalaika ababatebetie ng’a moyo are.
Naende abande abarenge amo naintwe bakagenda ase oboina, bakarora buna abakungu batebete, korende ere tibamorora.”
Ere akabatebia, “Inwe abanto abariri, nabanyene chinkoro chinyoro ase okwegena onsi aya ababani batebete.
Inee! Tiyamogwenerete Kristo konyora emechando eye ritang’ani atarasoa ase obonene bwaye?”
Agachakera korwa Musa na ababani bonsi akabatebereria korwa ase amariko onsi amang’ana arikire igoro yaye.
Bagaika omochie oria ase baare kogenda, na ere agekora buna nigo arigetie kobaetania.
Bakamosorora, bakabora, “Kabe amo naintwe, ekiagera bwairire, na omobaso oerire bono.” Agasoa koba amo nabarabwo.
Ekero aikaransire amo nabarabwo koragera, akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akabaa.
Erio amaiso abo akaramokigwa, bakamomanya; na agwo kegima agasira, tarorekana asebare.
Bakaborania, “Inee! Emioyo yaito tiyarenge gwoka ekero aba ngokwana are naintwe inchera na gotworokereria amariko?”
Bakaimoka ensa eria eria, bakairana Yerusalemu, bakanyora baria ikomi nomo basangererekanete, na baria abarenge amo nabarabwo,
bakabora, “Ekeene, Omonene obokire, oorokeire Simion.”
Na barabwo bakabatebia aya akoreka inchera, buna emanyekania asebare ase ogosamunyora omogati.
Ekero baare gokwana iga, Yeso omonyene agatenena egati yabo, akabatebia, “Omorembe obe asemore!”
Bakegosa, bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagakaga ng’a nerirengari barorire.
Akabatebia, “Inaki mogoichana? Naende inaki ogosiereria kwaimokire ase chinkoro chiaino?
Rora amaboko aane na amagoro aane, ng’a ninche omonyene; mbwata‐bwate, morore, ekiagera rirengari tiriri nomobere na amauga buna mondoche inche inde naro.” [
Ekero akoorire gokwana aya akaborokia amaboko aye na amagoro aye.]
Ekero bataregena ase engencho y’omogoko, na ogokumia, akababoria, “More na gento mokoria aa?”
Bakamoa egesamunye gi’enswe gesambire na obooke boke.
Akabibogoria, akabiria ase amaiso abo.
Akabatebia, “Aya naro amang’ana aane nare kona‐kobatebia ekero narenge amo nainwe, buna onsi agwenerete goikeranigwa, ayarigetwe igoro yane ase amachiko a Musa, na ase ababani, na ase Zaburi.”
Erio akaigora chinkoro chiabo, banyare komanya amariko.
Akabatebia, “Naboigo yarigetwe ng’a nemogwenerete Kristo gochandwa, na koboka korwa ase abakure ase rituko ria gatato;
na ebisaku bionsi mbiranderigwe ase erieta riaye okoonchoka na okorusigwa kw’ebibe, gochakera Yerusalemu.
Inwe mbirori b’amang’ana aya.
Rigereria, nintome asemore aya Tata abarierete eira, korende ikaransa ase omochie oyo Yerusalemu goika mobekwe chinguru chikorwa igoro.”
Akabatang’ana gochia isiko goika Bethania; akaimokia amaboko aye, akabasesenia.
Kabasesenirie ageatanana korwa asebare akabogorigwa gochia igoro.
Na barabwo bakamosasima, bakairana Yerusalemu nomogoko omonene;
bakaba botambe ime ase Hekalu, bakomotogia Nyasae.
Agwo omochakano ndiarengeo Ring’ana, ne Ring’ana nigo riarenge amo na Nyasae, na rirorio Ring’ana nigo riarenge Nyasae.
Oyio agwo omochakano nigo arenge amo na Nyasae.
Bionsi bigakoreka ase oyio; gose onye tari ere, anga tigiakoregete kende gionsi egiakoregete.
Ime yaye nao bwarenge obogima; na obogima obwo nigo bwarenge omobaso ase abanto.
Noro omobaso obarire ase omosunte, erio omosunte toyorimia.
Akaoroka omonto, otometwe korwa ase Nyasae, erieta riaye Yohana.
Oyo nigo achete abe kirori, erinde aorokie omobaso, bonsi banyare kwegena goetera asere.
Oyio tarenge omobaso oria, korende nigo achete aorokie omobaso.
Omobaso bw’ekeene, oria okobarera kera omonto, ngocha orenge ase ense.
Nao arenge ase ense ime, ense egatongwa goetera asere, na abanto b’ense tibamomanya.
Agacha ase abaye, na barabwo abare abaye tibamwancha.
Korende bonsi abamwanchete, akabaa okobua babe abana ba Nyasae, nabwo bariegenire erieta riaye.
Abwo baiboirwe, tari korwa ase amanyinga a mwanyabanto, gose tari ase ogwancha kw’omobere, gose tari ase ogwancha kw’omonto, korende nigo baiboirwe na Nyasae.
Na rirorio Ring’ana rigakoreka koba omobere, akamenya ase egati yaito. Tokarora obonene bwaye, obonene buna obw’Omwana omomoima orure ase Tata, oichire nobuya na ekeene.
Yohana akamwatora, agaaka egeturi, akabora, “Oyo nere natebete igoro yaye ng’a: Oyorache nyuma yane nigo are omonene kombua, ekiagera nao arenge ritang’ani asende.”
Na ase oboikeranu bwaye intwe twensi twanyorire obuya igoro ase obuya.
Naki amachiko arwerete ase amaboko a Musa, obuya na ekeene nigo biachete goetera ase Yeso Kristo.
Monto onde tari ororire Nyasae kero kende gionsi; Omwana omomoima ore ase egekuba gia Tata, nere omoorokirie.
Naende obo nabwo oborori bwa Yohana, ekero Abayahudi batomete abakuani na Abalawi korwa Yerusalemu bamoborie, “Aye naye ng’o?”
Ere akaorokia, takana, agateba, “Inche tari Kristo.”
Bakamoboria, “Naki rende? Naye Elija?” Akabora, “Inche tindi ere.” “Aye naye omobani oria?” Akairaneria, “Yaya.”
Nabo bakamoboria, “Naye ng’o rende? Toe abatotomete okoiraneria. Naki ogweteba?”
Akabora, “Inche neriogi ri’oyo ogoaka eriogi ase erooro: Rongeyia enchera y’Omonene, buna omobani Isaya atebete.”
Na barabwo abatometwe nigo barwete ase Abafarisai.
Bakaboria Yohana, “Naki rende okobatisa, onye aye tori Kristo, gose Elija, gose omobani oria?”
Yohana akabairaneria, “Inche nigo nkobatisa ase amache, korende egati yaino nateneineo oyomotamanyeti inwe.
Nere oyorache nyuma yane, inche tinyisaini nyesibore enuga y’egekoroto kiaye.”
Aya nigo akoregete Bethania ng’umbu ya Yorodan, aase Yohana arenge kobatisera.
Rituko ria kabere Yohana akarora Yeso ogocha asare, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae, oyokorusia ebibe bi’ense!
Oyo nere naare goteba igoro yaye: Ngocha are omonto nyuma yane oyore omonene kombua, ekiagera nao arenge ritang’ani asende.
Inche tinamomanyete; korende aorokigwe ase Abaisraeli, nabo ase ayio ngacha na kobatisa ase amache.”
Naende Yohana akaorokia, “Narorire Omoika ogoika korwa igoro buna riruma, okobeera igoro asare.
Na inche tinamomanya, korende ere oyontomete kobatisa ase amache, oyio nere ontebetie: Ere oyo oranyare korora Omoika ogoika na goikaransa igoro yaye, oyio nere okobatisa n’Omoika Omochenu.
Na inche narorire, naende naorokirie ng’a oyo nere Omwana o Nyasae.”
Naende rituko ria kabere Yohana nigo arenge oteneine amo na babere b’aborokigwa baye.
Akarigereria Yesu ogotaara, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae!”
Aborokigwa baria babere bakamoigwa ogoteba aya, bagatunyana Yeso.
Yeso akeonchora, akabarora bakomotunyana, akababoria, “Ninki mokorigia?” Bakamotebia, “Rabii” (okoonchorwa kwaye Omworokia), “nga’i omenyete?”
Akabatebia, “Inchuo morore.” Bagacha, bakarora aase amenyete, bakaba nere rituko riria; nigo chiarenge ang’e chinsa ikomi.
Anderea, momura omwabo Simion Petero, nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria babere baigwete Yohana, na gotunyana Yeso.
Oyo akanyora ritang’ani Simion momura omwabo omonyene, akamotebia, “Twanyorire Masihi” (okoonchorwa kwaye Kristo).
Akamoira ase Yeso. Yeso akamorigereria, akabora, “Aye Simion, omwana o Yohana, norokwe Kefa” (okoonchorwa kwaye Petero, gose egetare).
Rituko ria kabere Yeso akarigia koimoka kogenda Galili. Akanyora Filipo, akamotebia, “Ntunyana.”
Nere Filipo nigo arenge omonto o Bethisaida, omochie bw’Anderea na Petero.
Filipo akanyora Natanaeli, akamotebia, “Twanyorire ere oyo amang’ana aye arigetwe na Musa ase amachiko, naende nababani, Yeso omwana o Yusufu, omonto o Nazareti.”
Natanaeli akamoboria, “Egento ekiya nakenyare korwa Nazareti?” Filipo akamotebia, “Inchuo orore.”
Yeso akarora Natanaeli ogocha asare, agakwana igoro yaye, “Rora oyo n’Omoisraeli ekeene, otari nobong’ainereria ime yaye!”
Natanaeli akamoboria, “Ing’ai kwamanyera?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ritang’ani Filipo atarakorangeria, ekero kwarenge inse ase omoko, konya nakororire.”
Natanaeli akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, aye n’Omwana o Nyasae, naye Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inee! Kwegenire ekiagera nagotebia ng’a nakoroche inse ase omoko? Norore amang’ana amanene kobua aya.”
Abamotebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Inamorore igoro akoigoka, na abamalaika ba Nyasae bakoriina na goika igoro ase Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto.”
Naende rituko ria gatato yarenge enyangi agwo Kana ya Galili, na ng’ina Yeso nao arenge.
Yeso nere konya orangerigwe amo naborokigwa baye ase enyangi.
Goika edivai egachia kobaremera, ng’ina Yeso akamotebia, “Tibari nedivai.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Omong’ina, inki inche nde naye? Ensa yane teraika.”
Ng’ina agatebia abasomba, “Rinde rionsi arabatebie, morikore.”
Nchiarenge aroro chinsiongo isano nemo chi’amagena, chiabekire aroro ase engencho y’ogwesiberia kw’Abayahudi; kera eyemo nigo yarenge ekerengo gie chigalani emerongo ebere gose etato.
Yeso akabatebia, “Ichoria chinsiongo echi amache.” Bagachiichoria goika igoro.
Akabatebia, Bono taa, “moirere omonene bw’omoyega.” Bakamoirera.
Omonene bw’omoyega agachia koigwa amache aria aonchoretwe koba edivai, tamanya aase yarwa, (korende abasomba ababuuchete amache mbamanyete). Omonene oria bw’omoyega akarangeria omonyuomi,
akamotebia, “Kera omonto ritang’ani nigo agochaka nedivai ere engiya, goika abanto kobanyure mono, erio orenta eyetari engiya; aye gese nigo ogachete edivai engiya goika bono.”
Oyio noro omochakano bw’ebikone Yeso akorete, agwo Kana ya Galili, akaorokia obonene bwaye; aborokigwa baye bakamwegena.
Nyuma ase aya akagenda goika Kapernaumu, ere, na ng’ina, na abamwabo, na aborokigwa baye; bakamenya aroro amatuko amake.
Naende Epasaka y’Abayahudi nigo yarenge ang’e, na Yeso agatiira goika Yerusalemu.
Akarora ase Hekalu ime abanto barenge koonia chiombe, ne ching’ondi, na amaruma, na abaare koonchora chifeta, baikaransete.
Agakora omocharichi bwe chingori, agasokia bonsi korwa ase Hekalu, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe; agaitera chibesa chiabo abaare koonchora chibesa, akaonchorana chimesa chiabo.
Naende akabatebia baria barenge koonia amaruma, “Rusia ebinto ebi aa timokora enyomba ya Tata one koba enyomba y’okoonchoreria.”
Aborokigwa baye bakainyora ng’a nerikire, “Risemi ri’enyomba yao riandire.”
Nabo Abayahudi bakamoboria, “Ngekone ki ogotworokia, ng’a nore noboronge bw’ogokora aya?”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Tagora Hekalu eye, na inche ase amatuko atato ninyetenenie.”
Abayahudi bakabora, “Hekalu eye yaagachetwe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene na etano nomo, na aye oyetenenie ase amatuko atato?”
