Korende ere nigo akwanete igoro ye Hekalu y’omobere oye.
Nabo ekero abogetigwe korwa ase abakure aborokigwa baye bakainyora ng’a nigo atebete ring’ana eri, bakegena ririko riria, ne ring’ana riria Yeso atebete.
Goika agachia kobao Yerusalemu ekero ki’Epasaka ase Rituko Rinene, abanto abange bakariegena erieta riaye, kobarorire ebikone arenge gokora.
Korende Yeso tegenete asebare, ekiagera nabamanyete bonsi,
naende ekiagera tarigetie onde amobere kirori igoro ya mwanyabanto; naki ere omonyene amanyete ayare ime ya mwanyabanto.
Narengeo omonto oyomo bw’Abafarisai, erieta riaye Nikodemo, omonene bw’Abayahudi.
Oyo igo achete ase Yeso botuko, akamotebia, “Rabii twamanyire ng’a nomworokia ore, kwarure ase Nyasae, ekiagera omonto onde tari oranyare gokora ebikone ebi ogokora aye, otatiga Nyasae abe amo nere.”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Omonto ataiboiri eria kabere, takonyara korora oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
Nikodemo akamoboria, “Naki omonto aranyare koiborwa kabeire omogaaka? Nanyare gosoa enda ya ng’ina eria kabere aiborwe?”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Omonto ataiboiri ase amache na Omoika, takonyara gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
Ekeiboire ase omobere nomobere; na ekeiboire ase Omoika nomoika.
Tokumia ekiagera nagotebia: Goika oiborwe naende.
Embeo nigo ekogusa aase erigetie, na egeturi kiaye nigo ogokeigwa, korende tomanyeti aase ekorwa gose aase ekogenda; naboigo na kera omonto oiboirwe ase Omoika.”
Nikodemo akamoboria, “Naki aranyare koba aya?”
Yeso akamoiraneria, akamotebia, “Inee! Aye nomworokia bw’Abaisraeli, na aya toyamanyeti?
Ekeene, nagotebirie: Eri tomanyete nario togokwana, na eri toroche twariorokia; na oborori bwaito timori kobwancha.
Onye nkobatebia amang’ana ’ense, na inwe timokoyegena, naki moregene kondabatebie amang’ana a igoro?
Naende monto onde tari ogendete igoro, otatiga ere oyoigete korwa igoro, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto.
Naende buna Musa aimokereretie eng’iti ase erooro, naboigo na Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto goika aimokererigwe igoro;
erinde monto onde bwensi oyomwegenire tasira, korende abe nobogima bwa kare na kare.”
“Naki Nyasae ayianchete ense, goika akarua Omwana oye omomoima, erinde monto onde bwensi oyomwegenire tasira, korende abe nobogima bwa kare na kare.
Naki Nyasae tatomete Omwana oye ase ense agambie ense, korende ense etoorigwe nere.
Oyomwegenire takogambigwa oyotegeneti oikire kogambigwa, ekiagera atariegeneti erieta ri’Omwana omomoima o Nyasae.
Na eke nakio ekina ng’a omobaso ochire ase ense, korende abanto bagancha omosunte kobua omobaso, ekiagera ogokora kwabo kwarenge okobe.
Naki kera oyogokora amabe nigo agechete omobaso, gose tagocha ase omobaso, ogokora kwaye tikobaisa koorokigwa.
Korende oyogokora ekeene nigo agocha ase omobaso, ogokora kwaye kororekane ng’a nigo gwakorirwe ase Nyasae.”
Nyuma ase aya Yeso na aborokigwa baye bakagenda goika ense ya Boyahudi. Akabeera aroro amo nabarabwo, akabatisa.
Yohana nere nigo arenge kobatisera aria Ainon, ang’e na Salimu, ekiagera amache amange narengeo. Abanto bakamochiera bakabatiswa.
Naki Yohana konya tarabekwa echela.
Nabo okoamererania gokaoroka ase egati y’aborokigwa ba Yohana na Omoyahudi oyomo ase amang’ana ogwesibia.
Bagachiera Yohana, bakamotebia, “Omworokia, ere oyorenge amo naye ng’umbu ya Yorodan, oyio kwaorogetie aye, oyio nao are akobatisa, na abanto bonsi nkomochiera bare.”
Yohana akairaneria, “Omonto takonyara konyora ring’ana rinde rionsi otatiga aegwe korwa igoro.
Inwe abanyene mwambereire kirori ng’a natebete: Inche tari Kristo, korende natomirwe imotang’anere.
Oyore nomoriakari nere omonyuomi, korende omong’wansi oye nigo agotenena na komoigwa, ogokera eriogi ri’omonyuomi; naboigo omogoko one oikeranire bono.”
Ere goika amenteke, korende inche nkee.
“Oyochire korwa igoro, oyio nigo are igoro ase onsi; oyore bw’ense noyo bw’ense, nigo agokwana amang’ana ’ense; ere oyochire korwa igoro nigo are igoro ase onsi.
Nigo akoba kirori ase aya arorire na koyaigwa; gose onde tari oyobwanchire oborori bwaye.
Oyobwanchire oborori bwaye oorokirie Nyasae maiso marore, ng’a noyo bw’ekeene.
Naki ere oyotometwe na Nyasae nigo agokwana amang’ana a Nyasae; naki Nyasae tari komoa Omoika ase ekerengo.
Tata omwanchire Omwana, omoeire bionsi ase amaboko aye.
Oyoramwegene Omwana nare nobogima bwa kare na kare; oyotaigwereti Omwana takorora obogima, korende endamwamu ya Nyasae nigo emoikaranserete.”
Nabo Omonene agachia komanya ng’a Abafarisai baigure ng’a Yeso okorire aborokigwa abange kobua Yohana, na kobatisa,
(nonya Yeso omonyene tare kobatisa, otatiga aborokigwa baye),
akarua Boyahudi, akagenda Galili naende.
Naende yamogwenerete goika aete Samaria.
Igo agaika omochie o Samaria, okorokwa Sikari, ang’e nomogondo oria Yakobo aete Yusufu omwana oye;
agwo yarengeo ensoko ya Yakobo. Nabo Yeso, konya orosire ase orogendo rwaye, agaikaransa iga ase ensoko. Konya chiabeire ang’e chinsa isano nemo.
Omokungu o Samaria agacha kobuucha amache. Yeso akamotebia, “Ing’a amache inywe.”
Naki aborokigwa baye konya bachiire omochie kogora endagera.
Nabo omokungu oria bw’Abasamaria akamoboria, “Naki yaba aye Omoyahudi ogonsaba amache, na inche nomokungu bw’Abasamaria?” (Abayahudi tibari gosanga n’Abasamaria).
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Onye nkwamanya ekeegwa kia Nyasae, naende nere ng’o okogosaba amache anywe, anga nkwamosaba ere, na ere anga nakoa amache are moyo.”
Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Omonene, tori negento gi’okobuuchera, na ensoko yachiire inse mono; ng’ai kwanyorire amache aya are moyo?
Inee! Aye nomonene ore kobua sokoro yaito Yakobo, oyotoete ensoko eye, nere omonyene akanywa amache aya, na abana baye bonsi, na etugo yaye?”
Yeso akamotebia, “Kera oyokonywa amache aya naigwe erang’o naende;
korende onde bwensi oyoranywe amache aria ndamoe inche, takorang’a nonya ng’ake; korende amache aria ndanyare komoa, nabe ime yaye ensoko y’amache agosoka na komoa obogima bwa kare na kare.”
Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Omonene, ing’a amache ayio tindang’a, gose timbaisa gocha aiga kobuucha.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Genda, orangerie omosacha oo, oche nere aiga.”
Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Tindi nomosacha.” Yeso akamotebia, “Gwakwanire boronge ng’a tori nomosacha,
ekiagera kwabeire nabasacha batano, na ere oyore nere bono tari omosacha oo, ase ayio gwakwanire ekeene.”
Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Omonene, narorire ng’a nomobani ore.
Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiarenge gosasima ase egetunwa eke, na inwe nigo mogoteba ng’a Yerusalemu nao aase atogwenerete togosasimera.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Aye omokungu, inyegene, ensa neche, motamosasime Tata ase egetunwa eke, nonya nase Yerusalemu.
Inwe nigo mogosasima eki motamanyeti; intwe nigo togosasima eki tomanyete, ekiagera ogotooreka nigo gokorwa ase Abayahudi.
Korende ensa neche, na bono nere, ekero abasasimi b’ekeene barasasime Tata ase omoika na ekeene, ekiagera Tata nigo akorigia abanto buna abwo bamosasime.
Nyasae n’Omoika, na abwo bakomosasima nebagwenerete komosasima ase omoika na ekeene.”
Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Namanyire ng’a ngocha are Masihi (oyokorokwa Kristo); karache ere, natoorokerie onsi.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Inche, oyo ngokwana naye, nere.”
Erio kegima aborokigwa baye bagacha. Bagakumia ekiagera arenge gokwana nomokungu; korende onde tamoboretie, “Inki okorigia?” Gose, “Naki ogokwana nere?”
Nabo omokungu oria agatiga enyongo yaye, akagenda omochie, agatebia abanto,
“Inchuo, morore omonto ontebirie amang’ana onsi aya nakorire! Inee! Oyio tari ere Kristo?”
Bakaimoka korwa omochie, bakamochiera.
Agwo ekero bataracha, aborokigwa bakamosorora bakabora, “Rabii, ragera?”
Akabatebia, “Inche ninde nendagera nkoria, eye motamanyeti inwe.”
Aborokigwa baye bakaborania, “Inee! Nomonto omorentera endagera?”
Yeso akabatebia, “Endagera yane neye: ogokora ogwancha kwaye oyontomete na goikerania emeremo yaye.
Inwe timori goteba: Yatigaire emetienyi ene, erio rigesa riche? Rora nabatebirie: Imokia amaiso aino, morigererie emegondo, ng’a yaikire koba emerabu ang’e ase rigesa.
Oyo okogesa nkonyora are eng’eria na gosangereria amatunda ase obogima bwa kare na kare, erinde oyo okobusura na ere oyokogesa bagoke amo.
Naki ring’ana riria: Oyomo obusura, na oyonde okogesa, nigo rire ekeene.
Inche nabatomete mogese aya motakorerete emeremo; abande bakorire emeremo, na inwe mwasoire ase emeremo yabo.”
Naende ase omochie oria Abasamaria abange bakamwegena ase engencho y’oborori bw’omokungu oria ekero abatebetie ng’a, “Ontebirie amang’ana onsi aya nakorire.”
Nabo ekero Abasamaria baria bachia komochiera, bakamosorora aikaranse amo nabarabwo; akabeera aroro amatuko abere.
Abanto abange kobua bakeegena ase engencho ye ring’ana riaye;
bagatebia omokungu oria, “Bono twegenire, tari ase engencho y’amang’ana ao, korende ekiagera tweigwereire intwe abanyene, naende twamanyire ekeene ng’a oyo n’Omotooria bw’ense.”
Nyuma y’amatuko abere akaimoka akagenda Galili.
Naki Yeso omonyene aorogetie ng’a omobani tari gosikwa ase ense yaye omonyene.
Nabo ekero achia goika Galili, Abagalili bakamoroisia, ekiagera baroche amang’ana onsi ayakorete Yerusalemu ekero kie rituko rinene; naki nabarabwo boigo mbagendete ase rituko rinene.
Agaika naende Kana ya Galili, agwo ase aonchorete amache koba edivai. Narengeo omonto omosike ase Kapernaumu, oyorenge nomwana omorwaire.
Oyio agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ochire korwa Boyahundi goika Galili, akamochiera, akamosorora achiche agwenie omwana oye, ekiagera konya oisire gokwa.
Nabo Yeso akamotebia, “Motarochi ebikone na amakumia, timori kwegena nonya ng’ake.”
Omosike oria akamotebia, “Omonene, tirimboka ritang’ani omwana one atarakwa.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Genda, omwana oo nabe moyo.” Omonto oria akegena ring’ana riria atebetigwe na Yeso, akabwatia enchera yaye.
Ekero arenge gotirimboka abasomba baye bagacha komorotota, bakamotebia, “Omwana oo moyo are.”
Erio akababoria amang’ana ensa achagete koba buya. Bakamotebia, “Nigoro, chinsa isano na ibere esosera yamotigete.”
Erio ise akamanya ng’a nensa eria eria atebetigwe na Yeso, “Omwana oo nabe moyo!” Akeegena ere, na enyomba yaye yonsi.
Eke nakio egekone gia kabere Yeso akorete korwa ekero arwete Boyahudi kogenda Galili.
Nyuma ase aya ndiarenge Rituko Rinene ri’Abayahudi; Yeso agatiira kogenda Yerusalemu.
Naende aaria Yerusalemu ase Egeita gie Ching’ondi ndiarengeo ritibo rikorokwa ase Ekeibirania Betiseda, na rirorio ndiabwate ebisoero bitano.
Ime ase ebio mbarenge abanto abange abarwaire baare korara, emeuko, ebirema, na amagata, [baganyete amache aturubanigwe.

Naki ekero gete omomalaika ngoika arenge asoa ase ritibo riria, oturubania amache. Nabo ere oyorenge gosoa ritang’ani nyuma ase amache gaturubanigwe, nigo arenge kogwena oborwaire bonde bwonsi obwamonyorete.]
Narenge aroro omonto gete oyorenge noborwaire bw’emiaka emerongo etato, na etano na etato.
Yeso agachia komorora oraire, konya omanyire ng’a obeire engencho eye amatuko amange, akamoboria, “Norigetie koba omogima?”
Omorwaire oria akamoiraneria, “Omonene, tindi nomonto okombeka ase ritibo, ekero amache agoturubanigwa; korende ekero ngochicha inche, omonto onde asoa ritang’ani asende.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Tenena, etweke egesero kiao, ogende.”
Erio kegima omonto oria akaba omogima, agetweka egesero kiaye, akagenda. Nabo yarenge Esabato rituko riria.
Abayahudi bagatebia omonto oria ogwenetigwe, “Rero n’Esabato, tari boronge asore gwetweka egesero kiao.”
Akabairaneria, “Ere oyonkora koba omogima nere ontebia: Etweke egesero kiao, ogende.”
Bakamoboria, “Oria ogotebia: Etweke egesero kiao ogende, nere ng’o?”
Korende oria ogwenetigwe tamomanyete gose ning’o. Yeso nigo erusananetie, ekiagera abanto abange barenge aase aria.
Nyuma ase aya Yeso akamonyora ore Hekalu ime, akamotebia. “Rora, kwabeire omogima; tokora ebibe naende, ring’ana rire riibe kobua tiricha gokonyora.”
Omonto oria akagenda, agatebia Abayahudi amang’ana, ng’a Yeso nere omokorete koba omogima.
Ase ayio Abayahudi bagachaka gochanda Yeso, bakarigia komoita, ekiagera akora aya ase rituko ri’Esabato.
Yeso akabairaneria, “Tata ngokora are emeremo nonya ngoika bono, na inche ngokora nde emeremo.”
Nabo ekiagera ase aya Abayahudi bakamenta korigia komoita, ekiagera tasaretie Esabato yoka, korende amo naya narogete Nyasae ng’a n’Ise, ogwekora koreng’ana buna Nyasae.
Yeso akabatebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Omwana takonyara gokora ring’ana ere bweka, otatiga riria aroche Ise agokora; naki onsi aya agokora ere, ayio naro n’Omwana agokora.
Tata nigo amwanchete Omwana, na komworokia onsi ayagokora omonyene; na emeremo emenene kobua eye iga namworokie, erinde inwe monyare gokumia.
Na buna Tata akobokia ebitondo obia obogima, naboigo n’Omwana akobaa obogima aba arigetie.
Naki Tata tari kogambia monto onde bwensi, korende oeire Omwana obogambi bwonsi,
erinde bonsi basike Omwana buna basigete Tata. Oyotasigeti Omwana tasigeti Tata oyo omotomete.
Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Oyokoigwa ring’ana riane, na komwegena ere oyontomete nare nobogima bwa kare na kare, gose tagoika ase ekina, korende oetire korwa ase amakweri, oikire ase obogima.
“Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Ensa ngocha ere, na bono nereo, ebitondo biraigwe eriogi ri’Omwana o Nyasae, na baria barariigwe nababe moyo.
Naki buna Tata are nobogima ime yaye omonyene; naboigo oeire na Omwana koba nobogima ime yaye omonyene.
Omoeire okobua kw’ogokora ekina, ekiagera ere n’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto.
Timokumia ase aya! Naki ensa ngocha ere, ekero abanto bonsi bare ase chimbeera ime baraigwe eriogi riaye,
na barabwo nabasoke, baria abaare gokora amaya ase okobokigwa kw’obogima, na baria abaare gokora amabe ase okobokigwa gw’ekina.
“Inche omonyene tinkonyara gokora kende gionsi. Buna nkoigwa nabo nkogamba, na ekina kiane nigo kere boronge, ekiagera tindi korigia ogwancha kwane, korende nogwancha gwa Tata oyontomete.
Inche kondeorokie omonyene, oborori bwane tibori obw’ekeene.
Nare oyonde oyokombera kirori; na inche namanyire ng’a oborori bwaye agonteba nobw’ekeene.
Inwe mwatomete abanto ase Yohana, na oborori bwaye nobw’ekeene.
Korende inche tindi konyora oborori korwa ase abanto; korende nigo ngokwana aya, erinde inwe motooreke.
Ere nigo arenge etaya egwoka na komoreka, na inwe mwanchire gosasokera omobaso oye ase ekero egeke.
Korende oborori inde nabwo nobonene kobua boria bwa Yohana, naki emeremo eria naetwe na Tata inyekoore. Emeremo eyio ngokora, yambereire kirori, ng’a Tata nere ontomete.
Nere Tata oyontomete obeire kirori asende. Eriogi riaye timwana koriigwa kero kende gionsi, gose ekieni kiaye timwana gokerora
naende ring’ana riaye timori narirorio ime yaino, ekiagera timomwegeneti ere oyotomirwe nere.
Igo mokorigarigia mono amariko, ekiagera mokagete ng’a nigo more nobogima bwa kare na kare ime y’aro; na ayio naro are kirori asende,
ko mwangire gocha asende monyare koba nobogima.
Tindi konyora obonene korwa ase abanto.
Korende nabamanyire inwe ng’a timori nobwanchani bwa Nyasae ime yaino.
Inche nachire ase erieta ria Tata one, na inwe timori konyancha; oyonde karache ase erieta riaye omonyene, oyio namomwanche.
Naki moranyare kwegena, inwe abamokoenana obonene inwe ase inwe, na obonene boria bokorwa ase Nyasae ore bweka, timori koborigia?
Timokaga ng’a inche nimbasoere ase Tata; nare oyo okobasoera, nere Musa, oyomosemeretie inwe.
Naki onye mwamwegenete Musa anga mwanyegena nainche, ekiagera nere origete amang’ana igoro yane.
Korende onye timwegeneti amariko aye, naki moregene amang’ana aane?”
Nyuma ase aya Yeso akagenda ng’umbu y’enyancha ya Galili, nero enyancha ya Tiberia.
Omoganda omonene okamotunyana, ekiagera baroche ebikone abakorerete abarwaire.
Yeso agatiira gochia egetuawa, agaikaransa aroro amo naborokigwa baye.
Na Epasaka, rituko rinene ri’Abayahudi, nigo yarenge ang’e.
Nabo Yeso agachia koimokia amaiso aye, akarora omoganda omonene ogocha asare, akaboria Filipo, “Ng’ai togochia kogora emegati, aba banyare koria?”
Igo amoboretie aya, erinde amoteeme, ekiagera namanyete ere omonyene eki arakore.
Filipo akamoiraneria, “Emegati ye chidinari amagana abere tekobaisana, kera oyomo anyore moke igo.”
Oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye, Anderea, momura omwabo Simion Petero, akamotebia,
“Nare aa omosae, obwate emegati etano y’engano ne chinswe ibere, korende ebi inki biraisane ase abanto abange buna aba?”
Yeso akabora, “Ikaransia abanto.” Mbwarenge aroro obonyansi obonge aase aria. Igo abasacha bagaikaransa, barabwo nigo barenge chilifu isano.
Yeso akabogoria emegati; kayesesenirie, akagabera abaikaransete; naboigo ne chinswe chiria, koreng’ana buna barigetie.
Kobachia koigota, agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Sangereria ebisamunye biatigaire, gento tigesira.”
Nabo bakabisangereria, bagaichoria ebitonga ikomi na bibere ase ebisamunye bi’emegati etano y’engano, ebiatigaretigwe na baria bariete.
Ekero abanto baria bachia korora egekone keria Yeso akorete, bakabora, “Oyo ekeene nomobani oria orenge gocha ase ense!”
Nabo Yeso namanyete ng’a mbarigetie gocha komoira, erinde bamobeke abe omoruoti. Ase ayio akerusanania, akagenda naende egetunwa ere bweka.
Rigachia koba mogoroba, aborokigwa baye bagatirimboka gochia nyancha,
bakariina obwato ime, bagachaka kwamboka enyancha kogenda Kapernaumu. Naende omosunte konya obeire, na Yeso konya taracha asebare.
Enyancha egachaka koimoka ase engencho y’omwaga omonge orenge kogusa.
Nabo kabang’usire obwato chimaeli isato gose inye bakarora Yeso ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, ogoika ang’e ase obwato. Erio bakairoka,
korende Yeso akabatebia, “Ninche. Timoiroka!”
Bagancha komosoyia obwato ime, erio kegima obwato bogaika ase barenge kogenda.

Inkio yaye omoganda oteneine ng’umbu y’enyancha bakarora ng’a obwato bonde tibwarenge aroro, otatiga boria obomo bwoka, naende ng’a Yeso tasoete ase obwato boria amo naborokigwa baye, korende naborokigwa baye bagendete boka.
Korende amaato ande agacha korwa Tiberia ang’e naase aria bariete emegati ekero Omonene ayesesenetie.
Ekero omoganda ochia korora ng’a Yeso tari aroro, nonya naborokigwa baye, barabwo abanyene bagasoa amaato ime, bakagenda Kapernaumu, bakorigia Yeso.
Goika bagachia komorora ng’umbu y’enyancha bakamoboria, “Omworokia, indi gwachete aa?”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Iga mokondigia, tari ekiagera mwaroche ebikone, korende nekiagera mwariete emegati eria, mokaigota.
Timokorera endagera egosareka korende, endagera ekobao goika obogima bwa kare na kare, eye Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto aranyare kobaa, ekiagera Nyasae Tata obekire ekemanyererio kiaye asare.”
Nabo bakamoboria, “Ninki togokora tonyare gokora emeremo ya Nyasae?”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Eye nero emeremo ya Nyasae, ng’a momwegene ere oyotomirwe nere.”
Bakamotebia, “Mbikone ki ogokora, erinde torore tokwegene? Meremo ki ogokora?
Chisokoro chiaito nchiariete mana ase erooro, buna yarigetwe: Nabaete omogati korwa igoro bakaria.”
Yeso akabatebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Tari Musa obaete omogati oria orwete igoro, korende n’Tata one ore kobaa omogati bw’ekeene okorwa igoro.
Naki omogati o Nyasae noria ogoika korwa igoro na koa ense obogima.”
Nabo bakamotebia, “Omonene, amatuko onsi otoe omogati oyio.”
Yeso akabatebia, “Inche nomogati bw’obogima; ere oyogocha asende takoigwa enchara nonya ng’ake, na ere oyoranyegene takorang’a nonya ng’ake.
Korende nabatebirie ng’a mwandorire, ko timonyegeneti.
Bonsi aba Tata akong’a nabache asende, na ere oyogocha asende tinkomotuguta isiko nonya ng’ake.
Naki naikire korwa igoro, tari ase ogokora ogwancha kwane omonyene, korende ogwancha kwaye oyontomete.
Naende ogwancha kwaye Tata oyontomete nakwo oko, ng’a ase bonsi ang’eire tinsiria nonya noyomo, korende mbabokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.
Nogwancha kwaye oyontomete nakwo oko, ng’a kera oyokorigereria Omwana na komwegena, nabe nobogima bwa kare na kare, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.”
Abayahudi bakamwemurunganeria, ekiagera atebete, “Inche nomogati oigete korwa igoro.”
Bakabora, “Oyo tari Yeso, omwana o Yusufu? Ntomanyete ise na ng’ina. Naki rende akobora: Naikire korwa igoro?”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Timwemurunganerania inwe ase inwe.
Omonto onde tari oranyare gocha asende, atang’usiri na Tata oyontomete, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.
Nerikire nababani: Bonsi naborokererigwe na Nyasae. Kera oyoigure na kworokererigwa na Tata, nigo agocha asende.
Tari ng’a monto ororire Tata, otatiga ere oyorure ase Nyasae, oyio nere ororire Tata.
Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Ere oyonyegenete inche nare nobogima bwa kare na kare.
Inche nomogati bw’obogima.
Chisokoro chiaino nchiariete mana ase erooro, na barabwo bagakwa.
Oyo noro omogati oikire korwa igoro ng’a monto onde bwensi orayorie, tagokwa.
Inche nomogati bw’obogima oyoigete korwa igoro; omonto kararie omogati oyio, nabe moyo goika kare na kare; na omogati ndarue inche, ase engencho y’obogima bw’ense, nomobere one.”
Erio Abayahudi bakaamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakabora, “Naki omonto oyo aranyare gotoa omobere oye toyorie?”
Yeso akabatebia, “Ekeene, ekeene nabatebirie: Motarieti omobere oye Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto na konywa amanyinga aye, timori nobogima ime yaino.
Oyokoria omobere one na konywa amanyinga aane nare nobogima bwa kare na kare, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio,
ekiagera omobere one nendagera y’ekeene, na amanyinga aane nekenyugwa gi’ekeene.
Oyokoria omobere one na konywa amanyinga aane nigo akomenya ime yane, na inche ime yaye.
Buna Tata are moyo antomete, na inche inde moyo ase engencho ya Tata, naboigo oyokondia, nabe moyo ase engencho yane.
Oyio nomogati oigete korwa igoro, tari buna chisokoro chiaino chiariete mana, bagakwa; oyorarie omogati oyio nabe moyo goika kare na kare.”
Amang’ana aya nigo ayakwanete ase esinagogi, kaare kworokereria aria Kapernaumu.
Abange ase aborokigwa baye ekero bariigwa, bakabora, “Ring’ana eri nerikong’u, ning’o oranyare koritegerera?”
Ko Yeso akamanya ase omoyo oye ng’a aborokigwa baye bemurunganeirie ring’ana eri, akababoria, “Ring’ana eri ndiabagochire?
Naki erabe rende, komorarore Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto okogenda aaria aase arenge ritang’ani?
Omoika noro okobeka obogima, omobere togwenereti gento; amang’ana nabatebirie nomoika, naende nobogima.
Korende mbare abande ase egati yaino bategeneti.” Naki Yeso amanyete korwa omochakano mbarabi abategeneti, naende ning’o orache komorua.
Akabora, “Eke nakio gekogera nabatebia, ng’a omonto onde tari oranyare gocha asende, otatiga oeirwe na Tata one.”
Nyuma y’ayio abange ase aborokigwa baye bakairana nyuma, tibamotunyana naende.
Erio Yeso akaboria baria ikomi na babere, “Nainwe boigo morigetie kogenda?”
Simion Petero akamoiraneria, “Omonene! Togende ase ng’o? Aye nore namang’ana ’obogima bwa kare na kare.
Na intwe twegenire na komanya ng’a aye naye Omochenu o Nyasae.”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Inee! Tinabachorete inwe ikomi na babere, na oyomo oino nekerecha?”
Nigo akwanete igoro ya Yudas, omwana o Simion Iskariota, ekiagera oyo nere orache komorua; na ere noyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere.
Nyuma ase aya Yeso akaba ogotaara ase Galili; naki tarigetie gotaara ase Boyahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi nigo barenge korigia komoita.
Naende rituko rinene ri’Ebigutu ri’Abayahudi nigo riarenge ang’e.
Bamura bamwabo bakamotebia, “Imoka korwa aiga, ogende Boyahudi, erinde aborokigwa bao banyare korora emeremo yao ogokora.
Naki monto onde tari ogokora ring’ana bobisi onye ere omonyene origetie komanyekana. Kogokora aya eorokie ase ense.”
Naki nonya mbamura bamwabo tibamwegenete.
Yeso akabatebia, “Ekero kiane tikeraika, korende ekero kiaino botambe nkereo.
Ense tekonyara kobagecha inwe, korende nigo engechete inche, ekiagera inche nkoyeorokia ng’a emeremo yaye nemebe.
Genda inwe abanyene ase rituko rinene; tindi gotiira gochia ase Rituko Rinene, ekiagera ekero kiane tikeraika.”
Agachia gokoora kobatebia aya, agatigara Galili.
Goika ekero abamwabo bachia gotiira, nere boigo agatiira gochia ase Rituko Rinene, tari maiso marore, korende ase bobisi.
Nabo Abayahudi bakamorigia ase rituko erio bakobora, “Ng’ai are oyio?”
Okwemurungania okonene gokaba ase egati y’omoganda ase engencho yaye. Abande bakabora, “Nigo are omonto omuya,” na abande bakabora, “Taibo, korende nigo agotantania omoganda.”
Korende omonto tari omwatorete maiso marore ase engencho y’okoiroka Abayahudi.
Goika egachia koba gati‐gati ye Rituko Rinene Yeso agatiira, agasoa Hekalu ime akorokereria.
Abayahudi bagakumia ase aya, bakabora, “Naki amanyete chisemi, na ere tasometigwe?”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Okworokereria kwane tari okwane, korende nokwaye ere oyontomete.
Omonto karanche gokora ogwancha kwaye, namanye gose okworokereria oko nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae, gose nigo ngokwana ase okobua kwane omonyene.
Ere oyogokwana ase okobua kwaye omonyene nigo akorigia obonene bwaye omonyene; korende ere oyokorigia obonene bw’oria omotomete, nigo are oyo bw’ekeene, na asare obong’ainereria tiboiyo.
Inee! Musa tabaete amachiko? Korende onde oino tari oyobwatete amachiko. Nase ki mokorigia kong’ita?”
Omoganda okairaneria, “Nore nekerecha! Ning’o okorigia kogoita?”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Nakorete ogokora okomo, na inwe mwensi nigo mogokumetie.
Musa akabaa okwaroka (tari ng’a nigo korwete ase Musa, korende ase chisokoro chiaino), na inwe nigo mogosara omonto ase rituko ri’Esabato.
Gaki onye omonto ogosarwa rituko ri’Esabato, erinde amachiko a Musa tasareka; naki mokombea ekiagera nakora omobere bwonsi bw’omonto koba omogima kegima rituko ri’Esabato?
Timogamba ekina ase engencho y’ekieni, korende nacha ekina ase oboronge.”
Abande ase abanto ba Yerusalemu bakabora, “Oyo tari ere omonto oria bakorigia goita?
Nao are aa gokwana maiso marore gose tibari komotebia ing’ana? Aande gose abanene bamanyire bori ng’a nere Kristo?
Na oyo twamomanyire aase arure, korende Kristo karache, onde tari oramanye aase akorwa.”

Erio Yeso agaaka eriogi riaye ase Hekalu ime, okworokereria, okobora, “Inche momanyete, na aase narure mwaamanyire, naende tinyerenteti inche omonyene, korende ere oyontomete noyo bw’ekeene, oyio motamanyeti inwe.
Korende inche nimomanyete, ekiagera naruete asare, nere ontomire.”
Igo bakarigia komobwata, korende onde tari oramborete okoboko kwaye, erinde amobwate, ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika.
Abanto abange ase omoganda bakamwegena, bakabora, “Inee! Kristo ekero arachiche nakore ebikone ebinge mono kobua ebi iga oyo akorire?”
Abafarisai bakaigwa omoganda okwemurungania igoro yaye. Erio abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagatoma abarendi erinde bamobwate.
Erio Yeso akabora, “Nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe, erio ningende asare ere oyontomete.
Namondigie, korende timokoonyara; na aase ndabe inche, timokonyara gochao.”
Nabo Abayahudi bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Oyo ng’ai aragende goika intwe titomonyora? Nigo aragende ase Abagiriki abwo abaatananekire na kworokereria Abagiriki abwo?
Ing’ana ki erio akwana: Namondigie, korende timokoonyora, na aase ndabe inche, timokonyara gochao?”
Nase rituko ri’omoerio, Rituko riria Rinene, Yeso agatenena, agakwana neriogi rinene akabora, “Onye omonto ore nerang’o, tiga ache asende anywe!
Oyonyegenire inche, buna amariko agoteba, chindooche chi’amache are moyo nachirue ase enkoro yaye.”
Ring’ana eri nigo arikwanete igoro y’Omoika, ekiagera baria bamwegenire nabayonyore nyuma, ekiagera Omoika Omochenu konya toraruegwa, ekiagera Yeso konya taraegwa obonene.
Nabo abanto bande ase omoganda bagachia koigwa amang’ana ayio, bakabora, “Oyo ase ekeene nomobani oria.”
Abande bakabora, “Oyo nere Kristo.” Korende abande bakabora, “Inee! Kristo nigo ararwe Galili?
Ririko tiriri goteba ng’a Kristo nigo ararwe ase oroiboro rwa Daudi, naende ase Bethlehemu, agachie karia Daudi amenyete?”
Erio ogwatananekana kogasoa ase omoganda ase engencho yaye.
Abande ase barabwo bakarigia komobwata; korende monto onde taramborete okoboko kwaye erinde amobwate.
Abarendi baria bakairana ase abakuani abanene na Abafarisai, na barabwo bakababoria, “Naki motamorenta?”
Abarendi baria bakairaneria, “Tana gokwana monto onde bwensi buna oyo agokwana!”
Erio Abafarisai bakabairaneria, “Inee! Nainwe boigo mwatantanigwe?
“Ning’o ase abanene baito omwegenire, gose ase Abafarisai?
Korende omoganda oyio, otamanyeti amachiko, oragererigwe.”
Nikodemo, oria omochierete botuko, oyorenge oyomo asebare, akababoria,
“Inee! Ogochika gwaito nkonachera kore omonto ekina ritang’ani totaramoigwa na komanya egiakora?”
Bakairaneria, “Inee! Naye boigo n’Galili kwarwa? Rigia, orore ng’a mobani takorwa Galili.” [Bakagenda kera omonto bwoye.
Korende Yeso akagenda ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.
Mambia chuni agasoa naende Hekalu ime. Abanto bonsi bakamochiera, na ere agaikaransa, akaborokereria.
Aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai bakarenta omokungu obwatetwe ase obotomani. Kabamobekire gati‐gati,
bakamotebia, “Omworokia, omokungu oyo nigo abwatwa kagokora obotomani.
Nabo ase amachiko Musa atochigete kobaaka amagena abakungu banga buna oyo, naki aye ogoteba igoro asare?”
Bagateba ring’ana eri ase okomoteema, banyore enchera bakomosoera. Korende Yeso agekumba, akarika nekiara kiaye inse.
Barabwo kobamentire komoboria, akagororoka, akabatebia, “Ere oyotari nebibe ase egati yaino abe oyo bwe ritang’ani komoruta rigena.”
Agekumba naende, akarika nekiara kiaye inse.
Barabwo bagachia koyaigwa, bagasoka oyomo oyomo, abagaaka nabwo bachagete. Yeso bweka agatigara, na omokungu oria oteneine gati‐gati.
Yeso akagororoka tarora monto onde otatiga omokungu oria, akamoboria, “Omokungu, ng’ai abagosoeri bao bare? Onde tari ogokogambia?”
Akamoiraneria, “Onde tari, Omonene.” Yeso akamotebia, “Na inche tingokogambia. Genda, korende tokora ebibe naende.”]
Yeso agakwana nabarabwo naende, akabora, “Inche nomobaso bw’ense; oyogontunyana takogenda ase omosunte, korende nabe nomobaso bw’obogima.”
Erio Abafarisai bakamotebia, “Aye nigo okwebera kirori omonyene, na oborori bwao tibori obw’ekeene.”
Yeso akairaneria, “Nonya ngwekwana inche omonyene, oborori bwane nobw’ekeene, ekiagera namanyire aase narure, na aase nkogenda; korende inwe timomanyeti aase narure, gose aase ngochia.
Inwe nigo mokogambia ase okobwatia amang’ana a mwanyabanto; inche tindi kogambia omonto.
Naende ninsa kogamba, okogamba kwane nogw’ekeene, ekiagera tari inche bweka nkogamba, korende ninche na Tata oyontomete.
Naende ase amachiko aino nigo arikire ng’a oborori bw’abanto babere nobw’ekeene,
Inche ninche nkweorokia omonyene, nere Tata oyontomete nigo akong’orokia.”
Erio bakamoboria, “Ng’ai Iso are?” Yeso akairaneria, “Timokomanya inche, nonya n’Tata timokomomanya, onye momanyete inche, anga mwamomanyire na Tata one.”
Amang’ana aya Yeso nigo ayakwanete, gakworokereria ase Hekalu, ase enyomba y’ekebekerero gi’esadaka; omonto tari omobwatete, ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika.
Yeso akabatebia naende, “Inche nkogenda nde, na inwe namondigie, namokwe ase ebibe biaino; aase nkogenda inche, timokonyara gochao.”
Abayahudi bakabora, “Inee! Nigo areite, ekiagera akobora: Aase nkogenda inche, timokonyara gochao?”
Akabatebia, “Inwe naba inse; inche noyo o igoro; inwe nab’ense eye; inche tindi oyo bw’ense eye.
Ase ayio nabatebia ng’a namokwe ase ebibe biaino. Onye timokwegena ng’a inche nere, namokwe ase ebibe biaino.”
Nabo bakamoboria, “Naye ng’o?” Yeso akabairaneria, “Nonya nayio nabatebirie inwe korwa omochakano.
Ninde namange ngokwana na kogamba ase engencho yaino, korende ere oyontomete noyo bw’ekeene; na inche aya naigwete korwa asare, naro nkoorokia ase ense.”
Tibamanya ng’a nigo are gokwana asebare aya Ise.

Erio Yeso akabatebia, “Ekero mwakoorire koimokereria igoro Omwana‐o‐mwanya‐banto, erio namomanye ng’a ninche ere, naende tindi gokora kende ase okobua kwane omonyene, korende buna Tata anyorokereretie, nabo ngokwana.
Ere oyontomete nigo are amo nainche, tantigeti inche bweka, ekiagera botambe nigo ngokora ayakomogwenera.”
Gakwanire aya, abange bakamwegena.
Nabo Yeso agatebia Abayahudi baria bamwegenete, “Komoramenye ase ring’ana riane, nigo more aborokigwa baane b’ekeene,
naende namomanye ekeene, na kerokio nakebasibore.”
Bakamoiraneria, “Igo tore oroiboro rwa Ibrahimu, na titoraba abasomba b’omonto kero kende gionsi, naki rende ogoteba: Namokorwe abasibore?”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Onde bwensi ogokora ebibe, oyio nomosomba bw’ebibe,
naende omosomba tari komenya nyomba botambe, korende omobiare nigo akomenya botambe.
Gaki Omwana karabasibore, namobe abasibore kegima.
Namanyire ng’a nigo more oroiboro rwa Ibrahimu; korerende nigo mokorigia kong’ita, ekiagera ring’ana riane tirinyoreti ibaga ime yaino.
Aya narorire ase Tata naro ngokwana; nainwe naboigo ayamwarorire ase iso oino, naro mogokora.”
Bakamoiraneria, “Tata oito nere Ibrahimu.” Yeso akabatebia, “Onye nabana ba Ibrahimu mware, anga mwakora emeremo ya Ibrahimu.
Korende bono morigetie kong’ita, ninche oyo nabatebirie ekeene keria naigure korwa ase Nyasae. Ibrahimu takorete igo.
Inwe nigo mogokora emeremo ya iso oino.” Bakamotebia, “Intwe titoiboiri ase obonyaka; nigo tore na Tata oyomo, nere Nyasae.”
Yeso akabatebia, “Onye Nyasae n’Iso oino are, anga monyanchete inche; naki narure ase Nyasae, na igo nachire; gose tinyerenteti inche omonyene, korende nere ontomire.
Naki motamanyeti amang’ana aane aya ngokwana? Nekiagera motancheti koigwa ring’ana riane.

Inwe naba iso oino Saitani, na ogwancha kwaino nogokora okogania gwa iso. Ere nigo arenge omoiti korwa omochakano, gose tatenenete ase ekeene, ekiagera ekeene tikeri ime yaye. Kagokwana oborimo, nigo agokwana ayare ayaye omonyene, ekiagera nomonyaborimo, na ise bw’oborimo.
Ekiagera inche ngokwana ekeene, timori konyegena.
Ning’o ase egati yaino okong’orokia ng’a ninde nebibe? Kongokwana ekeene, naki inwe motakonyegena?
Oyore o Nyasae nigo akoigwa amang’ana a Nyasae; nakio gekogera inwe motari koyaigwa: nekiagera motari aba Nyasae.”
Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titori gokwana boronge ng’a aye nigo ore Omosamaria, naende nigo obwatire nekerecha?”
Yeso akairaneria, “Inche timbwatiri nekerecha, korende nigo nsigete Tata one, na inwe timonsigeti.
Inche tindi korigia obonene bwane; nare oyomo oyokoborigia, nere orabe omogambi.
Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Omonto karabwate ring’ana riane, takorora amakweri nonya ng’ake.”
Nabo Abayahudi bakamotebia, “Bono twamanyire ng’a nigo obwatire nekerecha, Ibrahimu okure, na ababani, na aye nigo ogoteba: Omonto karabwate ring’ana riane, takoigwa amakweri nonya ng’ake.
Aye nomonene kobua sokoro yaito Ibrahimu, oyokure? Naende nababani bakure. Naye kogwekora obe ng’o?”
Yeso akairaneria, “Kondetogie inche omonyene, obonene bwane tibori gento; oyogontogia n’Tata one, oyo mogoteba ng’a nere Nyasae oino.
Na inwe timomomanyeti, korende inche nimomanyete. Kondatebe ng’a timomanyeti nimbe omonyaborimo buna inwe, korende nimomanyete, naende ring’ana riaye nindibwatete.
Ibrahimu sokoro yaino nigo agogete ng’a nanyare korora rituko riane; akarirora, akagoka.”
Erio Abayahudi bakamotebia, “Torakoora emiaka emerongo etano, na Ibrahimu kwamororire?”
Yeso akabatebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Ritang’ani Ibrahimu atarabao, inche nao naare.”
Erio bakaimokia amagena bamorute, korende Yeso akebisa, agasoka korwa ase Hekalu.
Yeso agachia goeta akarora omonto orenge omouko korwa okoiborwa kwaye.
Aborokigwa baye bakamoboria, “Rabii, ning’o okorete ebibe, nomonto oyo, gose nabaibori baye, goika akaiborwa ore omouko?”
Yeso akairaneria, “Oyo takorete ebibe, nonya nabaibori baye, korende aya akorekire, erinde emeremo ya Nyasae eorokigwe asare.
Netogwenerete tokore emeremo yaye oyontomete ekero rire mobaso; obotuko ngocha bore, omonto atanyare gokora emeremo.
Ekero inde ase ense, inche nomobaso bw’ense.”
Agachia gokoora gokwana aya, agatwera amate inse, agakora etintira ase amate aria, agaaka omouko oria amaiso netintira eria,
akamotebia, “Genda bwesibie ase ritibo ria Siloamu” (okoonchorwa kwaye, oyotomirwe). Erio akagenda agesibia, akairana okorora.
Nabo abagisangio baye, na baria bamoroche ekero arenge omosabereri bakabora, “Inee! Oyo tari ere oria orenge oikaransete gosaba?”
Abande bakabora, “Nere”; abande bakabora, “Yaya, nigo agwekaine nere.” Ere omonyene akabora, “Ninche ere.”
Nabo bakamoboria, “Amaiso ao naki rende aramogetigwe?”
Ere akairaneria, “Omonto okorokwa Yeso okorete etintira, akang’aka amaiso aane, agantebia: Genda ase ritibo ria Siloamu, bwesibie; nabo nkagenda ngesibia, nkanyara korora.”
Bakamoboria, “Ng’ai are oyio?” Akabora, “Timanyeti.”
Bakamoira oria orenge omouko ritang’ani ase Abafarisai.
Nigo riarenge rituko ri’Esabato ekero Yeso akorete etintira na komoramokia amaiso.
Erio Abafarisai nabarabwo bakamoboria naende buna anyorete okorora. Akabatebia, “Nigo abegete etintira igoro ase amaiso aane, ngesibia, na bono nkorora nde.”

Erio abande b’Abafarisai bakabora, “Omonto oyo tarwete ase Nyasae, ekiagera tabwateti Esabato.” Abande bakabora, “Naki omonto omonyene ebibe aranyare gokora ebikone buna ebi?” Ogwatananekana gokaba ase egati yabo.
Bakaboria omouko oria eria kabere, “Aye naki okobora asare, ekiagera akoramokia amaiso?” Akabora, “Nigo are omobani.”
Erio Abayahudi tibeegena amang’ana aye, ng’a nigo arenge omouko, naende anyarete korora, goika bakarangeria abaibori baye oria onyorete okorora,
bakababoria, “Oyo nere omwana oino mogoteba ng’a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko? Naki akora orora bono?”
Abaibori baye bakairaneria, “Twamanyire ng’a oyo nomwana oito, naende ng’a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko;
korende buna anyara korora bono, titomanyeti, gose ning’o omoramokia amaiso, titomanyeti. Ere nomonto omogima, moborie omonyene, nekwanere.”
Abaibori baye nigo bakwanete aya ase okoiroka Abayahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi konya babwatanire, ng’a monto onde bwensi oramoorokie ng’a nere Kristo aserigwe korwa ase esinagogi.
Nero engencho yagerete abaibori baye bakabora, “Ere nomonto omogima, moborie.”
Erio eria kabere bakarangeria omonto oria orenge omouko, bakamotebia, “Moe Nyasae ogotogia; intwe twamanyire ng’a omonto oyio nomonyene ebibe.”
Erio omonto oria akairaneria, “Onye ere nomonyene ebibe, timanyeti; ring’ana erimo namanyire, inche nigo narenge omouko, korende bono nkorora nde.”
Bakamoboria, “Naki agokorerete? Naki akoramogetie amaiso?”
Akabairaneria, “Naikire kobatebia, ko timontegerereti. Naki morigetie koyaigwa eria kabere? Inwe boigo morigetie koba aborokigwa baye?”
Erio bakamorama, bakabora, “Naye ore omworokigwa oye, korerende intwe nigo tore aborokigwa ba Musa.
Intwe twamanyire ng’a Nyasae nigo arenge gokwana na Musa, korende oyo titomanyeti aase arure.”
Omonto oria akairaneria, “Ring’ana eri neri’ogokumia, ng’a inwe timomanyeti aase arure, na ere ondamokirie amaiso.
Twamanyire ng’a Nyasae tari koigwa abanyene ebibe; korende omonto karabe omosasimi Nyasae, na gokora ogwancha kwaye, oyio nere Nyasae akoigwa.
Korwa omochakano teraigugwa ng’a omonto oramokirie amaiso ’omouko oiboretwe engencho eye.
Onye oyo tarwete ase Nyasae, anga takonyara gokora gento.”
Bakamoiraneria, “Aye nigo kwaiboretwe ase ebibe ebinene, na intwe ngotworokereria ore?” Bakamosokia isiko.
Yeso akaigwa ng’a bamosokirie isiko, akamorora, akamoboria, “Aye kwamwegenire Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto?”
Ere akairaneria, “Ning’o oyio, Omonene, nyare komwegena?”
Yeso akamotebia, “Kwamororire, naende nere oyogokwana naye nere oyio.”
Akabora, “Omonene, negenire”; akamosasima.
Yeso akabora, “Inche nigo nachire ase ense eye ase ekina, erinde abatari korora barore, na barabwo abakorora babe emeuko.”
Abande ase Abafarisai abarenge amo nere bakaigwa aya, bakamoboria, “Inee! Naintwe nigo tore emeuko?”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Onye mwarenge emeuko, anga timori nebibe; korende bono nigo mogoteba: Nkorora tore; gaki ebibe biaino biagendereire kobao.
“Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Oyotasoereti egesieri ki’eero ye ching’ondi, korende aetere aao, oyio nomoibi naende nomokurumi.
Korende oyogosoera gesieri oyio nomorisia bwe ching’ondi.
Omorendi bw’egesieri nigo akomoigorera, ne ching’ondi nigo chikoigwa eriogi riaye; ere nigo akorangeria ching’ondi chiaye ase amarieta abo na gochiira isiko.
Gakorusia isiko ching’ondi echire echiaye, nigo agochitang’ana, ne ching’ondi nigo chikomotunyana, ekiagera nchimanyete eriogi riaye.
Omonto omoao tichikomotunyana nonya ng’ake, korende nigo chiramotame, ekiagera tichimanyeti eriogi ri’abanto abaao.”
Omoreng’anio oyo Yeso akabatebia, korende barabwo tibamanyete amang’ana ayio abatebetie.
Erio Yeso akabatebia naende, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Ninche inde egesieri gie ching’ondi.
Bonsi abantang’anerete nabaibi na abakurumi, korende ching’ondi tichiabaigwete.
Ninche inde egesieri; omonto karasoe goetera asende, natooreke, nasoe na gosoka, na konyora oborisia.
Omoibi tagocha, otatiga aibe, na konyenya, na gosaria; inche nigo nachete erio babe nobogima, naende babe naborobwo obonge.
Inche ninche Omorisia omuya; omorisia omuya nigo akorua obogima bwaye ase engencho ye ching’ondi.
Omonto orikire, tari ere omorisia, gose ching’ondi tichiri echiaye; gakorora esese y’orosana egocha, nigo agotiga ching’ondi, otama, na esese y’orosana yachisakora, na gochiserebania.
Ere nigo agotama ekiagera nomorikwa, gose tarengerereti amang’ana e ching’ondi.
Inche ninche omorisia omuya, na echire echiane ninchimanyete, na echire echiane nchimanyete,
buna Tata amanyete inche, na inche nimomanyete Tata, na obogima bwane naborure ase engencho ye ching’ondi.
Naende ching’ondi chinde mbwate, chitari chie riicho eri, na chirochio nabo engwenerete gochirenta, na eriogi riane nachiriigwe. Igo nachibe riicho erimo na omorisia oyomo.
Ase ayio Tata nanyanchete, ekiagera narure obogima bwane, erinde inyare koboirania naende.
Tari omonto okobonduera, korende ninche omonyene naborure. Ninde nokobua koborua; naende ninde nokobua koboirania. Ogochika oko nigo nakonyorire ase Tata one.”
Erio gokaba naende ogwatananekana ase Abayahudi ase engencho y’amang’ana aya.
Abange babo bakabora, “Nigo abwatire nekerecha, naende nigo are ebarimo; nase ki mokomotegerera?”
Abande bakabora “Amang’ana aya tari ay’omonto obwatire nekerecha. Inee! Ekerecha nkenyare koramokia amaiso ’emeuko?”
Ndiarenge Rituko Rinene ri’okoinyora okoigorwa na ogosaberwa gwe Hekalu aria Yerusalemu.
Nigo kiarenge ekero ki’obokendu, na Yeso nigo arenge gotaara ase Hekalu ime, ase egoora ya Sulemani.
Erio Abayahudi bakamoetanana, bakamoboria, “Ngoika ririri oratoichanie emioyo yaito? Onye naye Kristo, totebia maiso marore.”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Nabatebirie, na inwe timori kwegena; emeremo eye ngokora ase erieta ria Tata one, nero ekombera kirori.
Korende inwe timori kwegena, ekiagera timori abamo ase ching’ondi chiane.
Ching’ondi chiane nigo chikoigwa eriogi riane, na inche ninchimanyete, na chirochio nigo chigontunyana;
inche nachieire obogima bwa kare na kare, na chirochio tichigosira nonya ng’ake, nonya nomonto tagochitaboria korwa ase okoboko kwane.
Tata one oching’eire nomonene kobua bonsi, na onde takonyara gochitaboria korwa ase okoboko gwa Tata.
Inche na Tata nigo tore oyomo.”
Erio Abayahudi bakaimokia amagena naende, erinde bamoake.
Yeso akabairaneria, “Naborokirie emeremo emiya emenge erwete ase Tata; nereri ase emeremo eyio mokong’akera amagena?”
Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titogokoaka amagena ase emeremo emiya, korende nase okorama, ekiagera aye nomonto ogwekora omonyene ng’a naye Nyasae.”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Tarikiri ase amachiko aino ng’a: Inche natebete ng’a inwe nigo more chinyasae?
Onye orogete baria chinyasae, abacheretwe ne ring’ana ria Nyasae (na amariko takonyara gosareka),
inee, nigo mogoteba igoro yaye, ere oyo Tata aatananete akamotoma ase ense: Nkorama are, ekiagera nateba: Inche n’Omwana o Nyasae?
Onye tindi gokora emeremo ya Tata one, timonyegena.
Korende konda yekore, nonya timonyegeneti inche, egene emeremo eria, monyare komanya na kwegena ng’a Tata nigo are ime yane, na inche ime ase Tata.”
Bakarigia eria kabere komobwata, korende akarua ase amaboko abo.
Akagenda naende ng’umbu ya Yorodan goika aase aria Yohana arenge kobatisera ritang’ani, akabeera aroro.
Abanto abange bakamochiera, bakabora, “Yohana takorete egekone kende gionsi, korende onsi aya Yohana atebete igoro y’omonto oyo nigo are ay’ekeene.”
Abange bakamwegena aroro.
Nabo omonto gete narenge omorwaire, erieta riaye Lazaro o Bethania, omonto bw’omochie o Mariamu na Martha mosubati omwabo.
Mariamu nere oyo oagete Omonene amaguta na komotinyia amagoro aye netukia yaye. Bono Lazaro momura omwabo nigo arenge omorwaire.
Nabo baria basubati bamwabo bagatoma amang’ana asare, bakabora, “Omonene, ere oyobwanchete orwarire.”
Yeso agachia koyaigwa, akabora, “Oborwaire obwo tari obw’amakweri, korende ase okoorokia obonene bwa Nyasae, erinde Omwana o Nyasae abakwe ase obwo.”
Na Yeso nigo anchete Martha, na mosubati omwabo, na Lazaro.
Ekero achia koigwa ng’a nomorwaire, agatebana amatuko abere aase aria arenge.
Erio nyuma ase aya agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Togende Boyahudi naende.”
Aborokigwa bakamotebia, “Rabii, moisonde Abayahudi nigo barenge gokorigia gokoaka amagena, na aye gokogenda aroro naende?”
Yeso akairaneria, “Chinsa chi’omobaso tichiri ikomi na ibere? Omonto karagende mobaso takogochwa, ekiagera aroche omobaso bw’ense eye.
Korende omonto karagende botuko, igo akogochwa, ekiagera omobaso tori ime yaye.”
Agakwana aya; erio nyuma ase aya akabatebia, “Lazaro omosani oito orarire, korende nkogenda nde inyare komotura.”
Aborokigwa baye bakamotebia, “Omonene, onye orarire, nagwene.”
Korende Yeso nigo akwanete amang’ana ’amakweri aye; na barabwo bagakaga ng’a nigo agokwana amang’ana ’okorara chitoro.
Erio agwo Yeso akabatebia maiso marore, “Lazaro okure.
Na inche nagokire ase engencho yaino, ekiagera ntarenge aroro, erinde monyare kwegena. Korende bono togende asare.”
Nabo Tomas, ore korokwa Barongo, agatebia aborokigwa bamwabo, “Togende naintwe, tokwe amo nere.”
Erio Yeso agachia goika aroro akanyora Lazaro ng’a oikire koba ase embeera amatuko ane.
Bethania nigo orenge ang’e na Yerusalemu, koreng’ana chimaeli ibere.
Na abanto abange ase Abayahudi bagacha ase Martha na Mariamu, erinde babaremie ase engencho y’ogokwa kw’oyomwabo.
Nabo Martha agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ngocha are, akagenda komorotota, korende Mariamu nigo aikaransete nyomba ime.
Erio Martha agatebia Yeso, “Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete.
Korende nonya mbono namanyire ng’a kende gionsi orasabe Nyasae, Nyasae nakoe.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Momura omino naboke.”
Martha akamotebia, “Namanyire ng’a nache kobokigwa ase okobokigwa rituko ri’omoerio.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Inche ninche okobokigwa na obogima; oyonyegenire inche, naisa gokwa, nabe moyo.
Na onde bwensi ore moyo na onyegenire, tagokwa nonya ng’ake. Inee! Kwegenire aya?”
Akamotebia, “Ee, Omonene; inche negenire ng’a aye naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae, oria ogocha ase ense.”
Naende gakwanire aya, akagenda, akarangeria Mariamu mosubati omwabo, agakwana ng’ora igo, “Omworokia ochire, ngokorangeria are.”
Mariamu agachia koigwa, akaimoka bwango, akamochiera.
Na Yeso konya taraika omochie ime, korende nigo arenge aase aria arototeretwe na Martha.
Erio Abayahudi baria barenge amo nere nyomba ime bakomoremia, bagachia korora Mariamu buna aimoka bwango na gosoka, bakamotunyana, bakagete ng’a nigo akogenda embeera erinde arere aroro.
Erio Mariamu agachia goika aase aria Yeso arenge, akamorora, akagwa ase amagoro aye, akamotebia, “Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete.”
Erio Yeso agachia komorora okorera, na Abayahudi baria bachete amo nere bakorera; agasogwa nobororo ase omoyo oye, agaichana.
Akababoria, “Ng’ai mwamobeka?” Bakamotebia, “Omonene, inchuo orore!”
Yeso akaiyeria amariga.
Erio Abayahudi bakabora, “Rora buna amwanchete.”
Korende abande bakabora, “Inee! Oyo oramogetie amaiso ’omouko oria, tare konyara kogwenia oyo takwa?”
Nabo Yeso oichanete naende ase omoyo oye, agaika ase embeera. Ero nigo yarenge rikuruma, naende rigena ndiabegetwe igoro yaye.
Yeso akabora, “Tigeria rigena.” Martha, mosubati omwabo bw’oria okwete, akamotebia, “Omonene, otiokire bono, ekiagera obeire egetondo ase amatuko ane.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Tinagotebia ng’a koregene norore obonene bwa Nyasae?”
Nabo bakarusia rigena riria. Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye igoro, akabora, “Tata, nakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera okonyigwa.
Na inche nimanyete ng’a nigo okonyigwa amatuko onsi; korende ase engencho y’omoganda oyo ong’etanaine konya nakwanire aya, banyare gwancha ng’a naye gwantomete.”
Ekero akwanire igo, agaaka eriogi rinene, “Lazaro, soka isiko!”
Oria okwete agasoka, oboyirie egetambaa amagoro na amaboko; obosio bwaye boboyirie egetambaa. Yeso akabatebia, “Mosansore, momotige agende.”
Nabo abange ase Abayahudi abachete amo na Mariamu na korora aya Yeso akorete, bakamwegena.
Korende abande babo bakagenda ase Abafarisai, bakabatebia aya Yeso akorete.
Abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagasangererekana ase ekegambero, bakabora, “Ninki togokora? Ekiagera omonto oyo nigo agokora ebikone ebinge.
Toise komotiga iga, abanto bonsi mbamwegene; na Abarumi mbache, batoure aase aito aachenu na egesaku giaito.”
Omonto oyomo asebare, Kayafa, oyorenge omokuani omonene ase omwaka oria, akabatebia, “Inwe timomanyeti kende gionsi.
Gose timorengerereti ng’a mbuya omonto oyomo akwe ase engencho y’abanto, erinde egesaku ekegima tigesira.”
Naende eri takwanete ase omoyo oye omonyene, korende ekiagera arenge omokuani omonene ase omwaka oria, akabana ng’a Yeso nakwe ase engencho y’egesaku keria;
gose tari ase engencho y’egesaku keria gioka, korende amo naya asangererie abana ba Nyasae baria baatananekire, babe abamo.
Nabo korwa rituko riria bakarengereria buna baranyare komoita.
Yeso tataarete naende maiso marore ase egati y’Abayahudi, korende akarua aria akagenda aase ang’e nerooro, goika omochie okorokwa Efraimu; akamenya aroro amo naborokigwa baye.
Naende Epasaka y’Abayahudi nigo yarenge ang’e; abange bagatiira korwa chinka chiabo kogenda Yerusalemu gotang’anera Epasaka, erinde besibie.
Nabo bakarigia Yeso, bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, bagotenena ase Hekalu, “Naki moroche? Tagocha‐gocha ase rituko rinene nonya ng’ake?”
Bono abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bakarua ogochika ng’a onye monto onde omanyete aase are, arente amang’ana, banyare komobwata.
Nabo amatuko atano na rimo ritang’ani ri’Epasaka Yeso agaika Bethania, agwo aase Lazaro arenge, oria okwete, akabokigwa na Yeso.
Bakamoroiseria endagera aria. Martha ere agakora emeremo eyio, korende Lazaro nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria baikaransete ase endagera amo nere.
Erio Mariamu akabogoria ekerengo ki’eratili eyemo y’amanukato e rigori rinene, agaaka Yeso amagoro, akayatinyia netukia yaye; enyomba egaichora rimisu ri’amaguta aria.
Korende Yudas Iskariota mosinto o Simion, oyomo bw’aborokigwa ba Yeso oyoramorue, akabora,
“Nase ki amaguta aya ataoonigwa chidinari amagana atato, na echio chiegwe abataka?”
Aya igo akwanete, tari ng’a arorerete abataka amabera, korende nekiagera arenge omoibi, naende abwate esanduku ye chisiringi, na igo anarete korusia echiabekire aroro.
Erio Yeso agateba, “Motige, agache aya goika rituko ri’ogotindekwa kwane.
Naki igo more nabataka amo nainwe amatuko onsi, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.”
Nabo omoganda omonene bw’Abayahudi bakamanya ng’a ere nao are aria; bagacha, tari ase engencho ya Yeso yoka, korende barore Lazaro, oyio Yeso abogetie korwa ase abakure.
Abakuani abanene bagakora ekina baite Lazaro boigo,
ekiagera ase engencho yaye abange b’Abayahudi bakagenda bakamwegena Yeso.
Rituko ria kabere abanto abange abachete ase Rituko Rinene, kobachie koigwa ng’a Yeso ngocha are Yerusalemu,
bakabogoria chinsagia chi’emekendo, bagasoka isiko kogenda komorotota, bagaaka eriogi, bagateba, “Hosana! Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene, Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.”
Yeso akanyora emori y’etigere, akayeriina, buna yarigetwe,
“Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, timoiroka! Rigereria, Omoruoti oino ngocha are, igo ariinete emori y’etigere.”
Amang’ana aya aborokigwa baye tibayamanyete agwo ritang’ani, korende nyuma Yeso gatogigwe, erio bakainyora ng’a narikeire aya, naende ng’a mbamokorete aya.
Nabo omoganda bw’abanto abwo barenge amo nere ekero arangeretie Lazaro korwa ase embeera ime, na komobokia, bakaba bakomoorokia.
Ekio nakio kiagerete omoganda okagenda komorotota, ekiagera baigwete ng’a okorire egekone eke.
Erio Abafarisai bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mwarorire ng’a timokonyara gokora gento; ense yagendire komotunyana.”
Naende mbarenge Abagiriki bande ase abanto abwo batiirete kogenda gosasima ase ekero kie Rituko Rinene.
Barabwo bagachiera Filipo o Bethisaida bw’ensemo ya Galili, bakamosaba, bakobora, “Omosike, ntorigetie korora Yeso.”
Filipo akagenda, agatebia Anderea; erio Anderea na Filipo bagatebia Yeso.
Yeso akabairaneria, akabora, “Ensa yaikire, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto abakwe.
Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie; Enyeke y’engano etagweti esoe inse ase riroba ekwe, nigo ekobao yoka; korende kerakwe, nigo ekwama okwama okonge.
Oyoranche obogima bwaye, nabosirie; oyorageche obogima bwaye ase ense eye, nabogache goika obogima bwa kare na kare.
Omonto karankorere, antunyane; na aase inde inche, nomosomba one nao arabe; naende omonto karankorere, Tata namosike.
“Bono omoyo one oichanire; ninki ngokwana? Tata, ontoorie korwa ase ense eye! Yaya, korende ase engencho y’ayio naikeire ensa eye.
Tata, obake erieta riao!” Erio eriogi rigacha korwa igoro, rigateba, “Naribakire, na inche nindibake naende.”
Nabo abanto abateneine ang’e bakaigwa, bakabora ng’a kwabeire okogukura; abande bakabora, “Nomomalaika ogokwana nere.”
Yeso akairaneria, akabora, “Eriogi eri tiricheti ase engencho yane, korende nase engencho yaino.
Bono ekina gi’ense eye nkere; bono omogambi bw’ense eye natugutwe isiko.
Na inche kondaimokererigwe igoro korwa ase ense, nimbang’use bonsi asende.”
Agakwana aya, erinde aorokie imakweri ki aranyare gokwa.

Erio omoganda okamoiraneria, “Nigo tokoigwa ase amachiko ng’a Kristo nigo arabeo goika kare na kare, na aye naki okobora ng’a nemogwenerete Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto aimokererigwe igoro? Oyo Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nere ng’o?”
Yeso akabatebia, “Omobaso nigo ore amo nainwe egeka egeke bosio. Genda ekero more nomobaso oria, omosunte tocha kobabua; ere oyokogenda ase omosunte ime tamanyeti aase akogenda.
Ekero more nomobaso yuegene, erinde monyare koba abana b’omobaso.” Ekero Yeso akwanete ayio akagenda akebisa korwa asebare.
Nonya okorete ebikone ebinge ase amasio abo, tibamwegenete,
erinde riikeranigwe ring’ana riria omobani Isaya atebete, “Omonene, ning’o bwegenire amang’ana aito? Naende ning’o okoboko kw’Omonene kwamaanoreirwe?”
Nakio kiagerete tibanyara kwegena. Naki Isaya nigo atebete naende,
“Obaukoirie amaiso, okorire chinkoro chiabo chiakong’ire, tibacha korora namaiso abo, na komanya ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke na inche mbagwenie.”
Amang’ana ayio Isaya nigo ayakwanete, ekiagera aroche obonene bwaye; agaatora amang’ana aye.
Korende abange nonya nabanene bakamwegena, korende ase engencho y’Abafarisai tibamoorogetie, tibacha korusigwa ase esinagogi,
ekiagera mbanchete ogotogia kw’abanto kobua ogotogia kwa Nyasae.
Yeso agaaka eriogi akabora, “Oyonyegenire inche, tanyegeneti inche, korende ere oyontomete.
Na ere oyondoche inche nigo aroche ere oyontomete.
Inche nachire imbe omobaso ase ense, erinde kera oyonyegenire, tamenya ase omosunte ime.
Naende omonto karaigwe amang’ana aane, ko tayabwata, inche tinkomogambia, ekiagera tincheti kogambia ense, korende nyetoorie.
Oyo oranyange na otancheti amang’ana aane, nare noyo oramogambie. Ring’ana riria nakwanete, nario riranyare komogambia ase rituko ri’omoerio.
Naki tinakwanete ase okobua kwane omonyene, korende Tata oyontomete onchikire aya ngokwana.
Na inche namanyire ng’a ogochika kwaye nobogima bwa kare na kare. Ase ayio nigo ngokwana buna Tata antebetie.”
Ekero rituko rinene ri’Epasaka ritaraba, Yeso akamanya ng’a ensa yaye yaikire akorua ase ense eye na kogenda ase Ise, akaba nanchete abanto baye abarenge ase ense, naboigo akabancha goika omoerio.
Ekero ki’endagera ya mogoroba, Saitani gaikire kobeka Yudas omwana o Simion Iskariota enkoro y’okomorua,
Yeso omanyete ng’a Ise omoeire bionsi ase amaboko aye, naende ng’a nigo arwete ase Nyasae, naende nkoirana are ase Nyasae.
Akaimoka korwa ase endagera, akabeka chianga chiaye ensemo, akabogoria egetambaa, akeboyia.
Erio akabeka amache ase esani, agachaka gosibia aborokigwa baye amagoro abo, na koyatinyia negetambaa keria eboyetie.
Nabo agaika ase Simion Petero, Oyo akamotebia, “Omonene! Aye ngosibia ore amagoro aane?”
Yeso akairaneria, akamotebia, “Aya ngokora inche, tokoyamanya bono, korende noyamanye nyuma.”
Petero akamokania, “Togonsibia amagoro aane nonya ng’ake.” Yeso akamotebia, “Ntagosibeti, tori nobomo amo nainche.”
Erio Simion Petero akamotebia, “Omonene, tari amagoro aane oka, korende nonya namaboko na omotwe one.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Oyoikire gwesibia tagwenereti gwesibia naende, otatiga amagoro oka, korende obeire omochenu omobere bwonsi; na inwe mwabeire abachenu, korende tai mwensi.”
Naki amomanyete oyogocha komorua; ase ayio agateba, “Timori abachenu mwensi.”
Nabo agachia gokoora kobasibia amagoro abo na kobogoria chianga chiaye, agaikaransa naende, akabatebia, “Mwamanyire eki nabakorera?
Inwe iga mokondoka Omworokia, naende Omonene; na igo mbuya mokobora, naki naboigo inde.
Nabo onye inche, inde Omonene naende Omworokia, nabasibirie amagoro aino, nebagwenerete gosibania amagoro inwe ase inwe.
Naki nabaeire ekiorokererio ekiya, erinde ayio nabakorera inwe, nainwe moyakore.
Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye, gose omotomwa tari omonene kobua ere oyomotomete.
Komoramanye ayio, mosesenirie komorayakore.
Tindi gokwana asemore mwensi; nabamanyire aba nachorire, erinde amariko anyare goikeranigwa, ayagoteba: Oyokoria omogati amo nainche oimokereirie egotingiro kiaye igoro asende.
Nabatebirie aya korwa bono ritang’ani ataraba, erio ekero arache koba monyare kwegena ng’a ninche ere.
Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Ere oyoramwanche onde bwensi oyo ndatome, onyanchire inche; nere oyoranyanche inche omwanchire ere oyontomete.”
Agachia gokoora gokwana aya, Yeso agaichana ase omoika oye, akaorokia, agakwana, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Oyomo oino nandue.”
Aborokigwa baye bakarigererania, bagasinywa komanya gose ning’o atora.
Narenge aroro oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye, oyobweegegete Yeso egekuba kiaye, oyo Yeso anchete.
Nabo Simion Petero akamosima, akamoboria, “Moborie ning’o atora?”
Ere oria akamweegeka buna arenge ase egekuba kia Yeso, akamoboria, “Omonene, ning’o?”
Erio Yeso akairaneria, “Nomonto oria ngotongereria egesamunye ki’omogati na komoa.” Agatongereria Yudas, mosinto o Simion Iskariota, egesamunye, agakemoa.
Naende nyuma kanyorire egesamunye keria, Saitani akamosoa. Erio Yeso akamotebia, “Aya ogokora, yakore bwango.”
Onde tarenge ase baria baikaransete ase emesa omanyete engencho yagerete amotebetie iga.
Ekiagera Yudas arenge kobogoria esanduku ye chibesa, baria bande bagakaga ng’a Yeso nigo are komotebia, “Gora ebitorigetie ase Rituko Rinene”, gose ng’a abae abataka egento.
Nabo oyo, kanyorire egesamunye keria agasoka bwango; na igo bwarenge botuko.
Erio oyio gasokire, Yeso akabora, “Bono Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto obakirwe, na Nyasae obakirwe ime yaye.
Onye Nyasae okobakwa ime yaye, Nyasae boigo namobake ime yaye omonyene, na komobaka erio kegima.
Abana abake, nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe. Namondigie; korende buna natebetie Abayahudi, ng’a aase ngochia inche, inwe timokonyara gochao, bono nabatebirie nainwe.
Ogochika okoyia nabaeire nakwo oko, mwanchane. Buna nabanchete inwe, nainwe mwanchane boigo.
Igo abanto bonsi nabamanye ng’a naborokigwa baane more, komorabe nobwanchani inwe ase inwe.”
Simion Petero akamoboria, “Omonene, ng’ai okogenda?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Aase ngochia tokonyara gontunyana bono, korende nontunyane nyuma.”
Petero akamotebia, “Omonene, nase ki ntanyare kogotunyana bono? Nindue obogima bwane ase engencho yao.”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inee! Obogima bwao noborue ase engencho yane? Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Etuoni tekobuga goika gwankanire ara gatato.
“Timoichana ase chinkoro chiaino; momwegene Nyasae, nainche monyegene.
Ase enyomba ya Tata nere nobomenyo obonge; onye taibo, anga nabatebia. Nkogenda nde kobaroiseria aase.
Kondagende kobaroiseria aase, ninchiche naende, nimbaroisie asende, erinde asende inche, nainwe mobeo.
Naase nkogenda inche, mwamanyire enchera.”
Tomas akamoboria, “Omonene, titomanyeti aase ogochia, naki toramanye enchera?”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inche ninche enchera, na ekeene, na obogima; monto onde tagocha ase Tata otatiga goetera asende.
Onye imwamanyete inche, anga imwamomanyete Tata boigo; korwa bono mwamomanyire, naende mwamororire.”
Filipo akamotebia, “Omonene, tworokie Tata, toisaneke.”
Yeso akamotebia, “Nabeire amo nainwe amatuko aya onsi, na aye tomanyeti, Filipo? Oyondorire inche, ororire na Tata; naki aye ogoteba: Tworokie Tata?
Tibwegeneti ng’a inche nigo inde ime ya Tata, na Tata ime yane? Amang’ana aya inche nkobatebia, tindi gokwana ase okobua kwane, korende n’Tata ore ime yane nigo agokora emeremo yaye.
Inyegene ng’a inche nigo inde ime ya Tata, na Tata ime yane; gose inyegene ase engencho y’emeremo emenyene.
“Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Oyoranyegene inche, emeremo ngokora inche, nere nayekore; nakore naende emenene kobua eye, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata.
Kende gionsi morasabe ase erieta riane, ekio nangekore, erinde Tata abakwe ime ase Omwana.
Komorasabe kende gionsi ase erieta riane, ekio ningekore.
“Komoranyanche namobwate amachiko aane.
Naende inche ninsabe Tata, na ere nabae Omokonyi onde oyoramenye amo nainwe goika kare na kare,
Omoika bw’ekeene. Ense etanyare komwancha, ekiagera temorochi, nonya nkomomanya. Korende inwe mwamomanyire, ekiagera namenyete amo nainwe, naende nabe ime yaino.
“Tinkobatiga inwe buna chintakana; ninchiche asemore.
Nkere ekero egeke, ense etandore naende; korende inwe namondore, ekiagera inche moyo inde, na inwe namobe moyo.
Ase rituko riria namomanye ng’a inche nigo inde ime ase Tata, na inwe ime yane, na inche ime yaino.
Oyore namachiko aane, na koyabwata, oyio nere onyanchete; ere oyonyanchete nanchwe na Tata one, na inche nimwanche na kweorokia asare.”
Yudas (tari oria o Iskariota) akamoboria, “Omonene, naki yaba ng’a norigetie kweorokia asetore, gose tari ase ense?”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Omonto karanyanche, abwate ring’ana riane, naende Tata one namwanche, na intwe natoche asare, tokore obomenyo bwaito amo nere.
Oyotanyancheti, tabwateti amang’ana aane; naende ring’ana mwaigure tari eriane, korende neria Tata oyontomete.
“Aya nabatebirie ekero inde asemore.
Korende Omokonyi, Omoika Omochenu, oyo Tata aratome ase erieta riane, ere naborokererie onsi, na kobainyoria onsi aya nabatebirie.
Omorembe nabatigeire; omorembe one nabaeire; tinkoyobaa buna ense ekoyobaa. Timoichana ase chinkoro chiaino, gose timoba nobwoba.
Mwaigwete inche nkobatebia: Nkogenda nde, na ninchiche naende asemore. Onye mwanyanchete, anga mwagogete, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata, ekiagera Tata nomonene kombua.
Na bono nabatebirie ritang’ani ataraba, erinde ekero akoba, mwegene.
Tingokwana nainwe amana’ana amange naende, ekiagera omonene bw’ense ngocha are. Tari nokobua asende;
korende nigo ngokora buna Tata anchigete, erinde ense emanye ng’a nimwanchete Tata. Imoka, torue aa!
“Inche ninche omosabibu bw’ekeene, na Tata one nomoroiseria.
Kera orosagia ime asende orotameti, nigo akoronacha, na kera orokwama nigo akorososa, erinde romente kwama.
Inwe mwaikire koba abachenu ase engencho ye ring’ana nabatebirie.
Menya ime yane, na inche ime yaino. Buna orosagia rotanyare kwama rwoka oronyene, rotabeti ime ase omosabibu, naboigo nainwe motamenyeti ime yane.
Inche nomosabibu, na inwe nechinsagia. Oyo omenyete ime yane, na inche ime yaye, oyio name mono, ekiagera ntaiyo inche, timokonyara gokora kende gionsi.
Omonto otamenyeti ime yane, nigo aratugutwe isiko buna orosagia rwomete. Chinsagia chiomete nigo chigosangererigwa, na korutwa ase omorero, na koyia.
Komoramenye ime yane, na amang’ana aane karabe ime yaino, saba kera ekemoganetie na inwe namokorerwe.
Ase ayio Tata abakwe ekero mwamire mono; na inwe namobe aborokigwa baane.
Buna Tata anyanchete inche, na inche nabanchire inwe, menya ase obwanchani bwane.
Komorabwate amachiko aane, namomenye ase obwanchani bwane, buna inche nabwatete amachiko a Tata one na komenya ase obwanchani bwaye.
Aya nabatebirie, erinde omogoko one obe ime yaino, naende ng’a omogoko oino oikeranigwe.
“Richiko riane nario eri: Mwanchane buna nabanchete inwe.
Onde tari ore nobwanchani obonene kobua obo, obw’omonto akorua obogima bwaye ase engencho y’abasani baye.
Inwe nigo more abasani baane, komorakore aya nabachikire.
Tinkobaroka naende abasomba, ekiagera omosomba tamanyeti eki omonene oye agokora; korende inwe nabarokire abasani, ekiagera onsi aya naigwete korwa ase Tata nabaorokeirie.
Tari inwe mwanchorire inche, korende ninche nabachorire inwe, nababekire mogende kwama, okwama kwaino goikaranse; erio rinde rionsi mogosaba Tata ase erieta riane, nigo arabae.
“Aya nabachikire naro aya: mwanchane.
Ense kerabageche, momanyete ng’a yangechire inche etarabagecha inwe.
Onye nab’ense mware, anga ense iyancha abare abaye, korende ekiagera inwe timori ab’ense, otatiga inche nabachorire korwa ase ense, ase ayio ense yabagechire.
Inyora ring’ana riria nabatebetie: Omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye. Onye banchandete inche, nababachande nainwe; onye babwatete ring’ana riane nabwate neriaino.
Korende aya onsi nababakorere ase engencho y’erieta riane, ekiagera tibamomanyeti oyontomete.
Onye ntachete gokwana nabarabwo, anga tibarenge nebibe, korende bono tibari nogwekengera ase ebibe biabo.
Oyongechete inche, nigo amogechete na Tata one.
Onye ntakorete emeremo asebare eye monto onde atakoreti, anga tibabete nebibe, korende bono barorire, naende batogechire inche na Tata.
Korende igo riikerane ring’ana eriarigetwe ase amachiko abo: Nigo bangechete bosa.
Korende karache Omokonyi, oyo ndabatomere korwa ase Tata, Omoika bw’Ekeene okorwa ase Tata, ere nambere kirori.
Na inwe boigo mwambereire birori, ekiagera korwa omochakano mwarenge amo nainche.
“Amang’ana aya nabatebirie timocha kogochwa.
Nababaserie korwa ase chisinagogi; nabo engaki neche ekero onde bwensi arabaite akage ng’a okoreire Nyasae emeremo.
Naende ayio nababakorere, ekiagera tibamomanyeti Tata, nonya ninche.
Korende nabatebirie aya, erio engaki eria egocha, moyainyore ng’a inche nabatebetie. “Tinabatebetie aya korwa omochakano, ekiagera narenge amo nainwe.
Korende bono nkogenda nde asare ere oyontomete; gose onde tari asemore okomboria: Ing’ai ogochia?
Korende ekiagera nabatebirie aya, omoichano oichoire chinkoro chiaino.
Korende inche nabatebirie erire ri’ekeene: Nebe buya asemore inche ngende, ekiagera ntagendeti, Omokonyi oria tagocha asemore; korende kondagende, nimotome asemore.
Naende ekero arache ere, naenekerie ense ase amang’ana ’ebibe, naende oboronge, naende ekina;
ase amang’ana ’ebibe, ekiagera tibanyegeneti inche;
ase amang’ana ’oboronge, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata, gose timokondora naende;
ase amang’ana ’ekina, ekiagera omonene bw’ense eye okoorire kogambigwa.
“Ninde nayande amange atigarete nkobatebia, korende timokonyara koyaremereria bono.

Korende ekero arache ere, Omoika bw’Ekeene, nobaraae ase onsi ayare ay’ekeene, ere tagokwana ayare ayaye, korende onsi ayaranyare koigwa nayakwane, naende amang’ana agochi‐gocha nabatebie engencho yaye.
Ere nambake inche, ekiagera nabogorie ayare ayane, nabayaorokerie.
Onsi ayare aya Tata nayane; ase ayio ngateba ng’a nabogorie ayare ayane, nabayaorokerie.
“Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore; naende nkere ekero egeke morandore, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata.”
Nabo abande b’aborokigwa baye bagatebania, “Ing’ana ki eri agoteba: Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore; naende nkere ekero egeke morandore; na: Nkogenda nde ase Tata?”
Nabo bagateba, “Ing’ana ki eri agoteba, ng’a nkere ekero egeke? Titomanyeti eri agokwana.”
Yeso akamanya ng’a mbarigetie komoboria, akabatebia, “Inee! Nigo mokoborania inwe ase inwe ase erio natebire: Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore, naende nkere ekero egeke morandore?
Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Inwe namorere na kweng’ereria, korende ense negoke; inwe namoichanigwe, korende ogoichana kwaino nakoonchoke koba omogoko.

Omokungu gakobina ase okoibora, nigo are nomoichano, ekiagera ensa yaye yaikire; korende gaikire koibora omwana, tari koinyora obororo bwaye naende, ase engencho y’omogoko bw’okoiborwa kw’omonto ase ense.
Nabo nainwe bono nigo more nomoichano; korende nimbarore naende, ne chinkoro chiaino nachigoke, na omogoko oino onde tari orabaure.
Ase rituko riria timokomboria ring’ana. Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Komorasabe Tata kende gionsi ase erieta riane nabae.
Goika rero timorasaba gento ase erieta riane; saba, namonyore, erinde omogoko oino obe omoikeranu.
“Aya nakwanire nainwe ase emereng’anio; engaki neche ntakwane naende ase emereng’anio, korende nimborokie maiso marore amang’ana a Tata.
Ase rituko riria namosabe ase erieta riane; tinkobatebia ng’a nimbasabere ase Tata,
ekiagera Tata omonyene nigo abanchete inwe, ekiagera inwe mwanyanchire inche, na mwegenire ng’a inche nigo narwete ase Tata.
Narwete ase Tata, ngacha ase ense; naende ngotiga nde ense na nkoirana nde ase Tata.”
Aborokigwa baye bakabora, “Rora, bono ngokwana ore maiso marore, gose tori gokwana omoreng’anio onde bwonsi.
Bono twamanyire ng’a kwamanyire onsi, torigeti omonto akoborie. Ase ayio twegenire ng’a nigo kwarwete ase Nyasae.”
Yeso akabairaneria, “Inee! Igo bono mwegenire?
Rora engaki neche, ee nabo yaikire gocha, namwatananeke, kera oyomo ase mwaye, namontige inche bweka, korende tindi inche bweka, ekiagera Tata nigo are amo nainche.
Aya nabatebirie, erinde monyare koba nomorembe ime yane. Ase ense namonyore emechando, korende remia emioyo; inche nabuire ense.”
Ekero Yeso akwanete amang’ana ayio akaimokia amaiso aye, akarigereria igoro, akabora, “Tata, ensa yaikire. Mobake Omwana oo, erinde Omwana nere akobake aye,
buna kwamoete okobua igoro ase mwanyabanto bonsi, erinde bonsi aba kwamoeire, abae obogima bwa kare na kare.
Na obogima bwa kare na kare nabwo obo: bakomanye aye Nyasae bw’ekeene bweka, naende Yeso Kristo gwatomete.
Inche nakobakire ase ense, emeremo eria kwang’ete gokora nayekoorire.
Na bono Tata, ombake inche amo naye, ase obonene boria narenge nabwo amo naye ritang’ani ense etaratongwa.
“Erieta riao nariorokeirie abanto baria kwang’ete korwa ase ense. Barabwo nigo barenge abao, okabang’a inche, ne ring’ana riao baribwatire.
Bono bamanyire ng’a onsi aya kwang’ete nigo akorwa asore.
Naki amang’ana kwang’ete nabayaeire, na barabwo bayabwatire, mbamanyete ekeene ng’a nigo narure asore, bakeegena ng’a naye gwantomete.
Inche nabasabeire barabwo; tindi gosabera ense, korende barabwo aba kwang’eire ekiagera barabwo nabao.
Na bonsi abare abaane nabao, na abare abao nabaane, na inche nabakirwe ime yabo.
Inche tinkoba ase ense ime naende, korende aba nao bare ase ense ime, na inche ngocha nde asore. Tata Omochenu, obarende ase okobua kw’erieta riao baria kwang’ete, babe abamo buna intwe tore oyomo.

Ekero narenge amo nabarabwo ase ense, nigo nabarendete ase okobua kw’erieta riao baria kwang’ete. Igo nabaritete, gose tari nonya noyomo obo osirire, otatiga oria omwana bw’obosiru, erinde ririko rinyare goikeranigwa.
Na bono ngocha nde asore, na aya nkoyakwana, inde ase ense ime, erinde omogoko one obe oikeranigwe ime yabo.
Inche nabaeire ring’ana riao; ense yabagechire, ekiagera barabwo tibari abanto b’ense, buna inche ntari oyo bw’ense.
Tinsabeti ng’a obarusie korwa ase ense, korende obarende korwa ase oria omobe.
Barabwo tibari ab’ense, buna inche ntari oyo bw’ense.
Obachene ase ekeene; ring’ana riao nario ekeene.
Buna gwantomete inche ime ase ense, na inche naboigo nabatomire barabwo ase ense ime.
Na ase engencho yabo nechenire, erinde nabarabwo bachenwe ase ekeene.
“Gose tari barabwo boka nasabeire, korende na baria baranyegene ase engencho ye ring’ana riabo,
bonsi babe abamo, buna aye Tata ore ime asende, na inche ime yao, erinde na aba babe abamo ime yaito; ense enyare kwengena ng’a naye gwantomete.
Na obonene boria kwang’ete nabaeire, babe abamo, buna intwe tore oyomo;
inche ime yabo, na aye ime yane, banyare goikerana babe abamo. Igo ense emanye ng’a naye gwantomete, okabancha barabwo, buna kwanyanchete inche.
Tata, abwo kwang’ete, ninganetie babe amo nainche aase aande onsi inde, banyare korigereria obonene bwane kwang’ete, ekiagera nigo kwanyanchete ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso.
Tata omonyene oboronge, ense tiyakomanyete, korende inche nakomanyete; na aba bamanyire ng’a naye gwantomete.
Nabamanyetie erieta riao, naende nimbarimanyie, erinde obwanchani boria kwanyanchete inche bobe ime yabo, na inche imbe ime yabo.”
Yeso gakwanire amang’ana aya, akaimoka amo naborokigwa baye kogenda ng’umbu y’akarooche Kedron, aase omogondo orenge. Ere na aborokigwa baye bagasoa aroro.
Na Yudas, oria omoruete naamanyete aase aria, ekiagera Yeso are kogenda aroro ekero ase ekero amo naborokigwa baye.
Nabo Yudas gaikire konyora omoganda bw’abarwani, na abarendi baruete ase abakuani abanene na Abafarisai, akagenda aroro ne chitaya na ebieri, na ebinto bi’esegi.
Nabo Yeso, kamanyete onsi ayagochia komonyora, akaoroka, akababoria, “Ning’o mokorigia?”
Bakamoiraneria, “Yeso Omonazareti.” Yeso akabatebia, “Ninche ere.” Yudas nere oyomoruete nigo ateneine amo nabarabwo.
Nabo ekero Yeso achia kobatebia, “Ninche ere,” bakairana nyuma, bagaaka inse.
Akababoria eria kabere, “Ning’o mokorigia?” Bakabora, “Yeso Omonazareti.”
Yeso akairaneria, “Naikire kobatebia ng’a ninche ere; nabo onye mokondigia inche, batige aba bagende.”
Erio riikeranigwe ring’ana riria akwanete, “Aba kwang’ete tinsireti nonya noyomo obo.”
Nabo Simion Petero narenge nomoyio o birende, akayong’usa, agaaka omosomba bw’omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto kwaye gw’okorio. Na omosomba oria erieta riaye nigo are korokwa Maliko.
Erio Yeso agatebia Petero, “Irania omoyio oo ase ekerende kiaye. Inee! Egekombe eke Tata ang’eire, tinkenywera?”
Abarwani b’esegi amo nomotang’ani obo, na abarendi baria b’Abayahudi bakabwata Yeso, bakamosiba.
Erio bakamoira ritang’ani ase Anasi oyorenge ise biara Kayafa, oria orenge omokuani omonene omwaka oria.
Na Kayafa nere oete Abayahudi amang’ana ng’a negwenerete omonto oyomo akwe ase engencho y’abanto.
Simion Petero na omworokigwa onde bagatunyana Yeso. Omworokigwa oria onde nigo amanyekanete nomokuani omonene, agasoa amo na Yeso ase egoora y’omokuani omonene,
korende Petero agatenena gesieri isiko. Nabo omworokigwa oria onde, oyomanyekanete nomokuani omonene agasoka agakwana nomoiseke orenge korenda gesieri, akarenta Petero ime.
Erio omoiseke oria orenge korenda gesieri akaboria Petero, “Aye tori oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye omonto oyo?” Ere agakana, “Tari inche.”
Abasomba baria na abarwani nigo barenge bateneine, bautete omorero bw’amakara, ekiagera obokendu mbwarenge, bakaba ngwota bare omorero. Petero nere nigo arenge amo nabarabwo, ogwota omorero.
Erio omokuani omonene akaboria Yeso amang’ana igoro y’aborokigwa baye, na amang’ana ’okworokereria kwaye.

Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inche nakwanire nense maiso marore. Amatuko onsi nigo narenge kworokereria ase chisinagogi na ase Hekalu, aase Abayahudi bonsi baare gosangererekana, gose tintebeti ing’ana bobisi.
Nase ki okomboria? Boria baria baigwete aya nakwanete nabarabwo; barabwo mbamanyete aya nabatebetie.”
Gachia gokwana amang’ana aya, oyomo bw’abarendi baria oteneine ang’e, agaaka Yeso oroe, akabora, “Naboigo okoiraneria omokuani omonene?”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Onye nakwana bobe, orokia obobe boria, korende onye nakwana buya, ninki okong’akera?”
Nabo Anasi akamoira osibire ase Kayafa, omokuani omonene.
Na Simion Petero nigo arenge oteneine ogwota omorero. Bakamotebia, “Aye boigo tori oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye?” Ere agakana, akabora, “Tari inche.”
Oyomo bw’abasomba b’omokuani, omoamate bw’oria onachetwe ogoto na Petero, akabora, “Inche tinakoroche ime ase omogondo amo nere?”
Petero agakana naende. Erio kegima etuoni ekabuga.
Erio bakaira Yeso korwa ase Kayafa goika enyomba enene y’ekegambero. Bokaba bogokiamoka, na barabwo abanyene tibasoa ime ase ekegambero, tibabaisa gocha kobekwa ogotacheneka korende bararia Epasaka.
Erio Pilato akabachiera isiko, akababoria, “Ngosoera ki mobwate ase omonto oyo?”
Bakairaneria, “Onye oyo atarenge omokori amabe, anga titwamorenta asore.”
Erio Pilato akabatebia, “Moire inwe, momogambie ase ogochika kwaino.” Abayahudi bakamotebia, “Intwe titori ne ribaga goita omonto.”
Erio ring’ana ria Yeso riikeranigwe, eri akwanete ase okoorokia imakweri ki aranyare gokwa.
Erio Pilato agasoa ekegambero naende, akarangeria Yeso, akamoboria, “Inee! Naye omoruoti bw’Abayahudi?”
Yeso akairaneria, “Naye gwatebire ayio aye omonyene, gose nabanto bande bagotebirie amang’ana aya igoro yane?”
Pilato akairaneria, “Inee! Inche n’Omoyahudi nde? Abanto b’egesaku kiao na abakuani abanene bakorentire asende. Inki gwakorete?”

Yeso akairaneria, “Oboruoti bwane tibori obw’ense eye. Onye oboruoti bwane mbwarenge obw’ense eye, abasomba baane anga mbandwanerera, tinyara kobekwa ase amaboko ’Abayahudi, korende bono oboruoti bwane ti bori obw’aa.”

Erio Pilato akamoboria, “Aye nomoruoti rende?” Yeso akairaneria, “Aye gwatebete ng’a inche nomoruoti. Inche nigo naiboretwe ase engencho y’aya, na ase engencho y’aya, ngacha ase ense, erinde imbe kirori ase ekeene. Kera oyore oyo bw’ekeene nigo akoigwa eriogi riane.”
Pilato akamoboria, “Ekeene ngento ki?” Gakwanire ring’ana eri agachiera Abayahudi isiko eria kabere, akabatebia, “Inche tindochi bobe bonde asare.
Korende inwe more nengencho ng’a nabasiborera omonto oyomo ase ekero ki’Epasaka; nabo morigetie mbasiborere Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi?”
Erio bagaaka eriogi naende, bakabora, “Tari oyo, korende Baraba!” Baraba ere nigo arenge omouri.
Erio Pilato akaira Yeso, akamoaka emecharichi.
Abarwani bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera ase omotwe, bakamobekera na eanga embariri,
bakamochiera, bakabora, “Masoge, Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi!” Bakamoaka chindoe.
Pilato akaoroka naende isiko, akabatebia, “Rora, inche namorentire asemore, monyare komanya ng’a tindochi komocha konde asare.”
Erio Yeso agasoka isiko, obekeire egutwa eria y’amagwa na eanga eria y’oboruoti embariri. Pilato akabatebia, “Rora omonto oyo!”
Erio abakuani abanene na abarendi bagachia komorora, bagaaka eriogi, bakobora, “Mobambe! Mobambe!” Pilato akabatebia, “Moire inwe, momobambe, ekiagera inche tindochi okomocha asare.”
Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Intwe ntore nogochika, naende ase ogochika okwo nagwenerete akwe, ekiagera agwekora koba Omwana o Nyasae.”
Erio Pilato agachia koigwa ring’ana erio, akaba nobwoba kobua.
Agasoa ase ekegambero, akaboria Yeso naende, “Ing’ai kwarure aye?” Korende Yeso tamoiraneria.
Erio Pilato akamoboria, “Togokwana nainche? Tomanyeti ng’a ninde nokobua gokobamba, naende ninde nokobua kogosibora?”
Yeso akamoiraneria, “Anga tori nokobua konde gwonsi, onye otaeiri korwa igoro; ase ayio ere oyombegete ase amaboko ao nare nebibe ebinene kobua.”
Korwa agwo Pilato akarigia komosibora, korende Abayahudi bagaaka eriogi, bakabora, “Koramosibore, aye tori omosani o Kaisari; kera oyogwekora koba omoruoti nigo are mamincha ase Kaisari.”
Erio ekero Pilato achia koigwa amang’ana aya, akarenta Yeso isiko, agaikaransa igoro ase ekerogo gi’ekina, aase akorokwa Atichire n’Amagena, naende ase Ekeibirania, Gabata.
Nigo yarenge Okwearigania kw’Epasaka; naende nigo yarenge koreng’ana chinsa isano nemo. Agatebia Abayahudi, “Rora omoruoti oino!”
Korende barabwo bagaaka eriogi, “Morusie, morusie, mobambe!” Pilato akababoria, “Imobambe omoruoti oino?” Abakuani abanene bakairaneria, “Titori nomoruoti otatiga Kaisari.”
Erio agwo akamobeka ase amaboko abo abambwe. Barabwo bakabwata Yeso.
Ere agasoka bwebogoreretie omosalaba oye, goika aase akorokwa Ekeore; ase Ekeibirania akorokwa Gologotha.
Bakamobamba aroro amo nabanto bande babere, oyonde ensemo, na oyonde ensemo, na Yeso gati‐gati.
Pilato akarika ekemanyererio, agakebeka igoro ase omosalaba. Igo kiarigetwe, “YESO OMONAZARETI, OMORUOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”
Nabo amariko ayio abange b’Abayahudi mbayasomete, ekiagera aase aria Yeso abamberetwe nigo arenge ang’e nomochie; naro nigo arigetwe ase Ekeibirania, na Ekerumi, na Ekegiriki.
Erio abakuani abanene na Abayahudi bagatebia Pilato, “Torika ng’a, n’Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi, korende ng’a nigo arenge kobora: Inche nomoruoti bw’Abayahudi.”
Pilato akairaneria, “Aya narikire, narikire.”
