Naki Yeso nigo abarirwe ng’a nemogwenerete abe nobonene mono kobua Musa, buna omoagachi enyomba are nogosikwa kobua enyomba enyene.
(Kera enyomba nigo ekoagachwa nomonto, korende Nyasae nere omoagachi bw’ebinto bionsi.)
Na Musa nigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae buna omokoreri, erinde abe kirori ase amang’ana arache gokwanwa,
korende Kristo nigo are omwegenwa buna Omwana igoro ase enyomba ya Nyasae. Intwe nenyomba yaye gatorabwate bokong’u oboremu na ogwetogia kw’ogosemeria goika omoerio.
Ase ayio, buna Omoika Omochenu ogokwana, “Rero, komoraigwe eriogi riaye,
timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino, buna ekero keria gi’okogechia, ase rituko riria ri’ogoteemwa agwo ase erooro.
Agwo chisokoro chiaino nchianteemete ase okondenga, naende nchiaroche ogokora kwane ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
Ase ayio, nkagechigwa nekegori keria, ngateba: Botambe abanto aba nigo basirete ase chinkoro chiabo, ne chinchera chiane tibachimanyeti,
buna natianire ase endamwamu yane: Tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane nonya ng’ake.”
Rigereria baminto, taba onde omo oino oyore nenkoro embe y’ogotegena, abaise kweatanana korwa ase Nyasae ore moyo.
Korende moremanie inwe ase inwe kera rituko, ekero gekorokwa ekia Rero, erinde ase, more onde takorwa koba omokong’u ase obong’ainereria bw’ebibe.
Naki twabeire ababwatani na Kristo, gatorabwate bokong’u ogosemeria gwaito kwe ritang’ani goika omoerio.
Agwo igo egokwanwa, “Rero, komoraigwe eriogi riaye, timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino’ buna ekero keria gi’okogechia.”
Naki mbarabi baria bamogechetie ekero baigwete? Tari baria bonsi barwete Misiri, baare koraagwa na Musa?
Naende mbarabi abwo are agechetigwe nabarabwo ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene? Tari baria bakorete ebibe, abwo emebere yabo yagwete ase erooro?
Naende nase barabi atianete ng’a tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwaye? Tari ase baria bangete koigwera?
Na igo twarorire ng’a tibanyarete gosoa ase engencho y’ogotegena kwabo.
Gaki, onye eira eria y’ogosoa ase ogotimoka kwaye ereo, tiga toiroke ng’a onde omo oino tabaisa konyorekana ng’a omochire gokonyora.
Naki ekeene, intwe twaranderigwe amang’ana amaya buna barabwo. Korende ring’ana riria baigwete tiriabakonyete, ekiagera ekero baare koriigwa tiriasang’ananete nabarabwo ase okwegena.

Naki intwe, abatwegenire, nigo torasoe ase ogotimoka okwo agoteba, “Buna natianire ase endamwamu yane, Tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane nonya ng’ake”, nonya emeremo yaye yaerete korwa omochakano, ekero oboroso bw’ense bwabegetwe.
Naki nigo atebete aase gete igoro ye rituko ria gatano na kabere, “Nyasae nigo atimogete rituko ria gatano na kabere, agatiga emeremo yaye yonsi.”
Naende aiga nigo agoteba, “Tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane nonya ng’ake.”
Gaki, ase ayio ring’ana ndireo, ng’a mbare abanto barache gosoa. Abwo baranderetigwe amang’ana amaya ritang’ani bakamocha gosoa ase engencho y’ogotaigwera kwabo.
Naende obekire rituko gete, neri nario ria Rero. Aya nigo akwanete goetera ase Daudi nyuma y’engaki entambe, buna konya aikire gokwana, “Rero, komoraigwe eriogi riaye, timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino.”
Naki onye Yoshua nabaete ogotimoka, anga Nyasae nyuma yaye tare gokwana igoro ye rituko rinde.
Ase igo, ogotimoka gw’esabato gwatigaire ase abanto ba Nyasae.
Naki ere oyosoire ase ogotimoka kwa Nyasae, ere omonyene otimokire korwa ase emeremo yaye, buna Nyasae atimogete korwa ase eyaye.
Gaki, tokore omokia gosoa ase ogotimoka koria, erinde onde tacha kogwa ase ogotaigwera kogwekaine koria koria.

Naki ring’ana ria Nyasae nigo rire moyo, naende ndire ne chinguru, nigo rire nobwoge kobua omoyio o birende ore nobwoge chinsemo ibere. Nigo rikobeta ime na gwatanana omoyo na omoika, chinengo na emeseto, naende ndinyare komanya ebirengererio na okogania bire ime ase enkoro.
Naki getongwa kende tikeri getari maiso marore asare, korende ebinto bionsi nigo bire aarabu naende bimaanoire ase amaiso aye, ere oyo torache koa omobaro.
Gaki, ekiagera tore n’Omokuani Omonene mono, oyosoete igoro, Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae, tobwate mono okoorokia gwaito.
Naki titori n’Omokuani Omonene oyotanyare gotobogoreria oboreu bwaito, korende oyoteemetwe koreng’ana buna intwe ase amang’ana onsi, atakoreti ebibe.
Gaki, toike ang’e ase ekerogo ki’obonene aase obuya bore, erinde tonyore amabera na obuya bw’ogotokonya ase engaki y’okoremerwa.
Naki kera omokuani omonene ore gochorwa korwa ase mwanyabanto nigo are kobekwa ase engencho ya mwanyabanto, kobatenenera ase ogokorera Nyasae, arue ebiegwa na ebing’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe.
Na ere oranyare kobabogoreria ase obwororo abwo batamanyeti gento na batantanire, ekiagera nere omonyene nigo abuire noboreu.
Ase engencho eyio yamogwenerete arue ekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe biaye ere omonyene, buna are korua ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abanto.
Monto onde tari bwenyoreire amasikani ayio ere omonyene, korende abe orangerigwe na Nyasae, buna Haroni arangeretigwe.
Naboigo na Kristo, ere teimokereretie igoro ere omonyene koba Omokuani Omonene, korende nigo abegetwe nere oyomotebetie, “Aye naye Omwana one, rero nakoiboire.”
Naboigo akwanete aase aande, “Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”

Ase amatuko ayio, ekero arenge ase omobere o mwanyabanto, Yeso agasaba na gosorora amo nokorera okonene, na amariga, asere oyorenge nokobua gw’okomotooria korwa ase amakweri, na akaigugwa ekiagera asigete Nyasae.
Nonya orenge Omwana akeorokereria okoigwera ase emechando eyio yamonyorete,
na gaikeranigwe akaba engencho y’ogotooreka gwa kare na kare ase abanto bonsi abamoigwerete,
bwatoirwe na Nyasae ng’a n’Omokuani Omonene, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.
Igoro yaye ntore namang’ana amange tware gokwana korende naakong’u koyorokereria, ekiagera mwabeire aboro ase okoigwa.

Naki ekeene, inwe anga mwabeire aborokia, ekiagera ebiro ebinge biaetire, korende nebagwenerete oyonde aborokererie amorokererio e ritang’ani ay’amang’ana a Nyasae. Inwe nebagwenerete moegwe amabeere, gose tari endagera enkong’u.
Naki oyokonyora amabeere oka tamanyeti mono ring’ana ri’oboronge, ekiagera nomwana omoke.
Korende endagera enkong’u ney’abanto abanene, ekiagera barabwo mbanaretie ebirengererio biabo, na igo mbamanye ogwatanana amaya na amabe.
Ase ayio, totige okworokereria kwe ritang’ani gwa Kristo, togenderere toikere oboikeranu. Titobeka naende oboroso bw’okoonchoka korwa ase ogokora gotari nobogima, na obw’okomwegena Nyasae,
na okworokereria gwe chibatiso, na okobekerwa kw’amaboko, na okobokigwa kw’abakure, na okogambigwa gwa kare na kare.
Natokore ayio, Nyasae karatwanchere.
Abwo baikire konyora omobaso, na koigwa ekeegwa gekorwa igoro, na babeire ababwatani b’Omoika Omochenu,
na koigwa obuya bwe ring’ana ria Nyasae amo nogokora gwe chinguru gw’ekero kegochi‐gocha,
na nyuma y’ayio kobeatananire, tekonyarekana abwo bakorwe abayia naende ase okoonchorwa, ekiagera bamobambire naende Omwana o Nyasae barabwo abanyene, na komosookia maiso marore.
Naki omogondo oyokonywa embura egotwa engaki ase engaki, na gokinia chinyeni, chigokonya abwo bakoyorema, nigo okonyora ogosesenigwa gokorwa ase Nyasae.
Korende korakinie amagwa na amageri, nigo oraangwe na koba ang’e nokorangererigwa, na omoerio oye nogosambwa.
Korende abanchani, nonya togokwana ayio, ntore nobomaene igoro yaino, ng’a mwanyorire amang’ana amaya kobua, ayakorenta ogotooreka.
Naki Nyasae tari buna oyotari omoronge, goika eebe emeremo yaino, na obwachani boria mwaorogetie ase engencho y’erieta riaye ekero mwakorerete abachenu, na nonya mbono nkobakorera more.
Na intwe ntoganetie mono kera oyomo oino aorokie omokia oria goika omoerio, na igo amanye obomaene oboikeranu bw’ogosemeria kwaino.
Timoba aboro, korende mobe abegi b’abaraire ayabarieretwe chiira, buna omwando, goetera ase okwegena na oboremereria.
Naki ekero Nyasae arierete Ibrahimu eira agatiana; na ekiagera atarenge nonde omonene komobua asare ere aranyare gotiana, agetiania ere omonyene,
agateba, “Ekeene, ogosesenia ningosesenie, na okomenta ninkomentekie.”
Naboigo ase okoremereria Ibrahimu akanyora ayarieretwe eira.
Naki abanto nigo bagotiana ase oyore omonene kobabua, na omoerio bw’okoamererania nemuma egokoora.
Ase ayio, ekero Nyasae arigetie koborokia mono kegima abaraire omwando oria abarierete eira buna atanyare koonchora ayaroberetie, akabeka emuma gati.

Ase igo, ase ebinto bibere bitanyare koonchorwa, ime ase ebio Nyasae takonyara gokwana oborimo, intwe, abatwatameire obotamero, tonyore okoremigwa ogokong’u kobwata ogosemeria koria kwabekirwe bosio bwaito.
Ogosemeria okwo tore nakorokwo buna ekerochi ki’omoyo, okore ne chinguru, na gotari koonchoka, kogosoa aase are ime moino y’etoto.
Aase aria Yeso asoete buna omotang’ani oito, na ase engencho yaito, ekero abeire Omokuani Omonene o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.
Naki Melkizedeki oyio nigo arenge omoruoti o Salemu, omokuani o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono. Ekero Ibrahimu are koirana korwa ase ogoita abaruoti, Melkizedeki akaumerana nere, akamosesenia.

Na Ibrahimu akamwatanera ensemo ya ikomi y’ebinto bionsi. Ritang’ani engencho y’erieta ria Melkizedeki nigo ere iga: “Omoruoti bw’Oboronge”, naende nigo are omoruoti o Salemu, engencho yaye: “Omoruoti bw’Omorembe”.

Ere tarenge na ise, gose na ng’ina, gose ne chisokoro chiaye; tarenge nomochakano bw’amatuko aye, gose nomoerio bw’obogima bwaye, korende ogwekanigwe n’Omwana o Nyasae. Igo agendererete koba omokuani o kare na kare.
Gaki, rigereria buna omonto oyo arenge omonene! Ibrahimu, omogaaka oito o kare, akamoa ensemo ya ikomi y’ebinto asakorete.
Na ase abana b’ororeria rwa Lawi, baria baare konyora obokuani, mbaare nogochika korwa ase amachiko koira ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase abanto bamwabo, nonya barabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Ibrahimu.
Korende Melkizedeki, nonya tarenge bw’ororeria rwabo, akaira ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase Ibrahimu, na akamosesenia ere oyorenge ne chiira.
Okoamererania tikoiyo nonya ng’ake ng’a oria omoke osesenigwa noria omonene.
Na ase ororeria rwa Lawi mwanyabanto, abakonyorekana namakweri, nkonyora bare ensemo ya ikomi, korende aiga ere oyogwatorwa ng’a moyo are nkoyenyora are.
Igo nenyare gotebwa, ng’a goetera ase Ibrahimu nonya Lawi, oyore konyora ensemo ya ikomi, nere naruete ensemo ya ikomi,
ekiagera arenge ase ekebono gia sokororia yaye, ekero Melkizedeki aumeranete na Ibrahimu.

Gaki, onye oboikeranu bware konyorekana ase obokuani bwa Lawi, naki ase obwo abanto banyorete amachiko, inki kiagerete omokuani onde abekwe, oyore koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki, na tatoretwe koreng’ana buna Haroni?
Naki obokuani koboraonchorwe, goika okoonchorwa kw’amachiko boigo kobeo.
Naki omonene oito, amang’ana aya akwanetwe igoro yaye, nigo arenge bw’ororeria ronde oroao, na onde tarenge korwa ase ororeria orwo ore gokorera ase egesasimero.
Naki igo are maiso marore ng’a ere nigo arwete ase ororeria rwa Yuda. Na ekero Musa akwanete igoro y’ororeria orwo takwanete ing’ana rinde igoro y’abakuani.
Kerabe omokuani onde oorokire oyore koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki amang’ana ayio nigo are maiso marore mono kobua.
Ere igo obeire omokuani, tari ase ogochika kw’omoroberio bw’ogotunyana ororeria, korende nase chinguru chi’obogima botari nomoerio.
Naki obereirwe kirori ng’a. “Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”
Naki chinguru chi’ogochika koria kwe ritang’ani nigo chiasiretigwe ase engencho y’oboreu bwaye na ogotaisanera kwaye.
Naki rinde tiriri riaikeranetigwe namachiko. Ribaga ri’ayio ogosemeria okore okuya mono kobua gokarentwa, na ase okwo twamoikire Nyasae ang’e.
Kobua mono obokuani obo tibwarenge gokoreka botari nemuma.

Naki abwo baare kobekwa ase obokuani tibare kobekwa amo nemuma, korende Yeso akabonyora amo nemuma goetera asare oyo omotebetie, “Omonene otianire, gose takoonchora ebirengererio biaye, Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare.”
Gaki, ase ekerengo eke Yeso obeire oyo bw’obomaene bw’okobwatana kore okuya kobua.
Baria barenge abakuani be ritang’ani barenge abange, ekiagera batangetwe namakweri, tibagendererete,
korende ere, ekiagera agendererete kare na kare, nare nobokuani botari koonchoka.
Ase ayio, nare nokobua gw’okobatooria kegima abwo bagocha ase Nyasae goetera asare, ekiagera nigo are moyo botambe ase okobasabera.
Naki nigo etogwenerete intwe tobe n’Omokuani Omonene buna oyo, oyore omochenu, otari na komocha, otari na kemoa, bwatananetwe korwa ase abanyene ebibe, oimokereretigwe igoro ya igoro.

Ere tagwenerete korua ebing’wanso kera rituko, buna abakuani bande abanene, ritang’ani ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene, naende ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abanto, ekiagera ayio nigo ayakorete ara rimo rioka ekero eruete ere omonyene.
Naki amachiko nigo are kobeka abanto abare noboreu babe abakuani abanene, korende ring’ana ri’emuma, eriachete nyuma y’amachiko, riabekire Omwana, oyoikeranetigwe kare na kare.
Gaki, ring’ana rinene ri’ayio togokwana nario eri: Ntore n’Omokuani Omonene buna iga, oikaransete ensemo ya borio y’ekerogo ki’Obonene aria igoro,
omokoreri bw’aase aachenu na obw’Eema y’ekeene, eye Omonene aagachete, gose tari mwanyabanto.
Naki kera omokuani omonene nigo are kobekwa ase okorua ebiegwa na ebing’wanso. Ase ayio yamogwenerete omokuani oyo boigo abe negento akorua.
Onye nabete ase ense, anga tabeti omokuani, ekiagera mbareo abare korua ebiegwa buna amachiko achigete.

Abwo baare gokorera ayare omogwekano bw’amang’ana are igoro, na ekiriri ki’ayio. Naki ekero Musa arenge koroisia Eema eria, Nyasae akamotebia, “Rigereria, okore ebinto bionsi ase omogwekano bw’oria kworogetigwe ase egetunwa.”
Korende bono Kristo onyorire obokuani bore obuya kobua, koreng’ana buna ere are omobwatania bw’okobwatana okuya kobua, okwo kwagachetwe ase chiira chingiya kobua.
Naki onye okobwatana koria kwe ritang’ani kwarenge tikori na komocha, anga ribaga tiriarigetigwe ase koria gwa kabere.
Naki Nyasae nigo akonyora okomocha ime yabo ekero agoteba “Omonene otebire iga: Rora, amatuko ngocha are ekero ndakorere abanto b’enyomba ya Israeli na ab’enyomba ya Yuda okobwatana okoyia.

Okobwatana oko tigokoba buna koria nakorete ne chisokoro chiabo, ase rituko riria nababwatete amaboko abo ase okobarusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Ekiagera tibagendererete ase okobwatana kwane, inche tinabechanderete, Omonene otebire.

Naende Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Oko nakwo okobwatana ndakore n’Abaisraeli nyuma y’amatuko aria: Nimbeke amachiko aane ase ebirengererio biabo, ninyarike ase chinkoro chiabo ime; inche nimbe Nyasae obo, na barabwo mbabe abanto baane.
Barabwo tibakworokererania kera omonto nomogisangio oye, gose kera omonto noyomwabo, ogoteba: Momanye omonene, ekiagera bonsi pi mbamanye inche, korwa omoke mono goika omonene mono.
Naki nimbaabere obobe bwabo, na ebibe biabo tinkobiinyora naende.”
Ase ogokwana igoro y’okobwatana okoyia nigo akorire koria kwe ritang’ani kobe ogokoro, na koria kwabeire ogokoro na kogota, ng’ang’e kore gosira.
Gaki, nonya okobwatana kwe ritang’ani kwarenge nemeroberio ase okomosasima Nyasae, naende kwarenge naase aachenu ase ense eye.
Naki eema eria ye ritang’ani yaroisetigwe. Ime ase eema eria mbiarengeo ekebekerero gie chitaya, na emesa amo nemegati yarenge koruegwa ase Nyasae. Aase aria are korokwa Aase Aachenu.
Na moino y’etoto eria ya kabere yarengeo eema ende yare korokwa Aase Aachenu Mono.

Ime aroro mbiarengeo egesasimero gi’etahabu ki’ogosambera ubani, na esanduku y’okobwatana yaoomire netahabu chinsemo chionsi. Ime ase esanduku eria mbiarengeo: Egetaabo gi’etahabu aase biabegetwe endagera yare korokwa mana, na enyimbo ya Haroni yasebogete, ne chibao chi’amagena aase amang’ana ’okobwatana kw’ogotianania arikire.
Igoro yaye yarengeo emegwekano y’abakerubi y’obonene yare kobekera egeikaransero ki’amabera ekiriri. Bono titokonyara goteba amang’ana ’ebinto ebi ekemo ekemo.
Ebinto ebi kobiaroisigwe igo, abakuani baare gosoa ase Eema ye ritang’ani ase amatuko onsi na goikerania obokoreri bwabo,
korende Eema ya kabere Omokuani Omonene ore gosoa bweka ara rimo kera omwaka, na tare konyara gosoa atari namanyinga, ayare korua ase engencho yaye ere omonyene na ase engencho y’amamocho ’abanto.
Omoika Omochenu nigo okworokereria ring’ana eri, ng’a enchera y’ogosoa Aase Aachenu konya teraorokigwa ekero Eema ye ritang’ani ereo eteneine.
Eyio nekiorokererio ase engaki eye ya bono, ekero ebiegwa na ebing’wanso bikorugwa, ebitanyare komoikerania oyokobirua erinde enkoro yaye temogambia.
Ebinto ebi nigo biare ase okoria na okonywa, na ogosibigwa ao ao, amachiko ase omobere ayabekire goika engaki y’okoroisigwa okoyia eike.
Korende Kristo oikire gocha, oyore Omokuani Omonene bw’amang’ana amaya agochi‐gocha. Agaeta ase eema ere enene na eng’ikeranu kobua, etakoretwe namaboko, engencho yaye etari egetongwa gi’ense eye.
Ere tasoete namanyinga e chimbori na eye chimori, korende namanyinga aye omonyene, agasoa ara rimo rioka Aase Aachenu, na agatonyorera okoboorigwa gwa kare na kare.
Naki onye amanyinga e chimbori na aye chieri, ne ribu ri’amatororo biare konyororokerigwa ase abatachenegeti mbinyare gochena ase ogosibigwa kw’omobere,

tari mono kobua amanyinga a Kristo, ere ase Omoika o kare na kare akerua ere omonyene ase Nyasae koba ekeng’wanso getari na komocha, anyare gochena okomanya gwe chinkoro chiaito ime korwa ase emeremo ekwete, erinde tokorere Nyasae ore moyo?

Ase engencho eye ere nomobwatania bw’okobwatana okoyia, erinde abwo barangerigwe banyore omwando oria o kare na kare, oyo barieretwe eira, ekiagera amakweri aikire gokoreka ase okobabooria barabwo korwa ase ogosaria koria bakorete ase okobwatana kwe ritang’ani.
Naki aase okoriera kw’omwando kore, goika amakweri aye, oyoriete, abeo.
Naki okoriera kw’omwando nigo kogoikeranigwa ekero ki’amakweri, ekiagera onye oria oyoriete ore moyo, rirorio tikori na nguru.
Ase ayio, okobwatana koria kwe ritang’ani tigwachagete gotare namanyinga,

naki ekero kera richiko riaikire gokwanwa na Musa ase abanto bonsi, buna yachigetwe ase amachiko, akabogoria amanyinga e chimori na aye chimbori amo namache na amarionya amabariri, ne chinsagia chia hisopo, akanyororokeria ebuku enyene, na abanto bonsi,
ogoteba, “Aya namanyinga ’okobwatana oko Nyasae abachikerete inwe.”
Eema amo nebinto bionsi biare gokorerwa ase ogosasima naboigo are kobinyororokeria amanyinga.
Amachiko nigo are goteba ng’a ang’e ebinto bionsi bichenwe namanyinga, na amanyinga ataiteiri, okwaberwa kw’ebibe tigokobao.
Gaki, yagwenerete emegwekano y’ebinto bire igoro bichenwe ase ebing’wanso buna ebio, korende ebinto bia igoro ebinyene bichenwe nebing’wanso bire ebiya kobua ebi.
Naki Kristo tasoete Aase Aachenu akoretwe namaboko, naro omogwekano bw’Aachenu a ekeene, korende agasoa igoro aanyene, na bono nao akororekana ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase engencho yaito intwe.
Ere terua omonyene ekero ase ekero, buna omokuani omonene are gosoa Aase Aachenu kera omwaka amo namanyinga atari ayaye.

Onye nabo, anga yamogwenerete achandwe ekero ase ekero korwa omochakano, ekero oboroso bw’ense bwabegetwe. Korende bono, ase amatuko ’omoerio bw’ense akaoroka ara rimo rioka ase okorusia ebibe ase okong’wanswa kwaye ere omonyene.
Buna abanto bagacheirwe ogokwa ara rimo, na nyuma y’ogokwa ekina,

naboigo Kristo nere, gakoorire koruegwa abe ekeng’wanso ara rimo ase okorusia ebibe bi’abanto abange, narorekane eria kabere, tari ase okobogoria ebibe, korende ase okonyorera abamoganyete ogotooreka.

Naki ayare ime y’amachiko nekiriri gioka ki’amang’ana agochi‐gocha, gose tari ekieni ekenyene. Ase ayio, ebing’wanso biria biria biare koruegwa kera omwaka botambe tibiarenge konyara kobaikerania abwo baare kobirua.
Onye mbianyarete, Inee, anga tibiatigetwe, tibikoruegwa? Naki onye abwo baare kobirua bakoorire gochenwa ara rimo, anga tibare kwerora ng’a mbare nebibe naende.
Korende ebing’wanso ebio nigo bikobainyoria igoro y’ebibe kera omwaka.
Naki amanyinga e chieeri na aye chimbori takonyara korusia ebibe.
Ase ayio, Kristo kagosoa ase ense nigo agoteba, “Ebing’wanso na ebiruegwa tikwabiganetie, korende omobere kwandoiseirie.
Ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, tikwagogetigwe nabirobio.
Erio ngakwana: Nachire gokora ogwancha kwao, Nyasae, buna erikire igoro yane ase ebuku.”

Agwo ritang’ani nigo agoteba, “Ebing’wanso, na ebirugwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe tikwabiganetie, gose tikwagogetigwe nabirobio”, nonya birobio biare korentwa buna amachiko are goteba.
Erio akabora, “Rora, nachire gokora ogwancha kwao.” Igo akarusia ebie ritang’ani, erinde abeke egia kabere.
Ase ogwancha okwo twanyorire ogochenwa ase okoruegwa kw’omobere o Yeso Kristo ara rimo rioka.
Kera omokuani nigo are gotenena rituko ase rituko ase obokoreri bwaye na korua ebing’wanso biria, na birobio tibiare konyara korusia ebibe nonya ng’ake.
Korende ekero Kristo aruete ekeng’wanso ekemo gioka ase ebibe kerabe goika kare na kare, nigo aikaransete ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.
Erio oganyete goika ababisa baye babekwe inse y’amagoro aye.
Naki ase okoruegwa okomo obaikeranirie ase amatuko onsi abwo bachenirwe.
Naki Omoika Omochenu noro otobereire kirori. Naki ritang’ani nigo agoteba iga:
“Oko nakwo okobwatana ndache kobwatana nabarabwo nyuma y’amatuko ayio, Omonene otebire: Nimbeke amachiko aane ase chinkoro chiabo ime, ninyarike ase ebirengererio biabo.”
Naende nigo agoteba, “Ebibe biabo, na ogosaria kwabo tinkobiinyora naende nonya ng’ake.”
Gaki, okorusigwa kw’ebibe gokorabeo, rirorio ekerugwa ase engencho y’ebibe tigekobao naende.
Ase ayio, baminto, ntore noboremu bw’ogosoa Aase Aachenu goetera ase amanyinga a Yeso,
ase enchera enyia ere moyo, eye atoigorerete, egoetera ase etoto, engencho yaye omobere oye.
Naende ntore n’Omokuani Omonene igoro y’enyomba ya Nyasae.
Ase ayio, toike ang’e ne chinkoro chire nekeene, tobe nobomaene oboikeranu ase okwegena, ne chinkoro chiaito chianyororokerigwe oborabu, tichigotogambia, twasibigwe ase emebere yaito namache amaya.
Tiga tobwate mono okoorokia kw’ogosemeria gwaito, totari konyegerigwa; ekiagera ere oyoriete eira nomwegenwa.
Naende twechanderane intwe ase intwe, na kobekana chinguru ase obwanchani, na ase ogokora okuya.
Titotiga gosangererekana amo, buna engencho y’abande ere, korende toremanie intwe ase intwe, kobua mono ekiagera moroche ng’a Rituko riria riaikire ang’e.
Naki onye togokora ebibe moeneno nyuma gotwaikire komanya ekeene, keng’wanso kende tikeri ase engencho y’ebibe.
Korende eke totigaretie nobwoba bw’okoganya ekina, na omorero omotindi ogwoka, ogocha gosiria abwo bakoengereria.
Omonto oyorenge gochaya amachiko a Musa nigo arenge goitwa okwa, atari konyora amabera, ase okoberwa kirori nabanto babere gose batato.

Inee! Naki moroche? Omonto oria otachete Omwana o Nyasae, na kobara amanyinga ’okobwatana, achenetwe naro, koba egento kia bosa, oria okoreire Omoika bw’amabera obogechi, tiyamogwenerete ere anyore egesusuro ekenene kobua?
Naki ntomanyete ere oyokwanete, “Egesiomba nekiane, inche ning’akane,” naende, “Omonene nere oragambie abanto baye.”
Okogwa ase amaboko a Nyasae ore moyo, eri nering’ana ri’okondokia.
Korende moinyore amatuko e ritang’ani, nyuma komwabarerigwe omobaso igo mwaremereretie okoamererania okonene kw’ogochandwa.
Engaki ende mokarorerigwa ase okoramwa na ogochandwa maiso marore, na engaki ende mokabwatana nabwo bakoreretwe ayio.
Naki mwabarorerete amabera baria barenge ase ebisibo, mogancha nomogoko kourwa chinibo chiaino, ekiagera mwamanyete ng’a inwe abanyene more nenibo eyere engiya kobua, erabeo kare na kare.
Ase ayio, timotuguta oboremu bwaino, ekiagera mbore neng’eria enene.
Naki igo ebagwenerete mobe noboremereria, erinde komwaikire gokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae monyore aya mwarieretwe eira.
“Naki nkere ekero egeke mono, ere oyore gocha nachiche, gose tagotebana gocha,
korende omonyene oboronge one nabe moyo ase okwegena, na, karasukwane, omoyo one tokogokigwa nere.”
Korende intwe titori ase abwo bagosukwana na gosira, korende ase abwo bare nokwegena ase okoegera emioyo yaito.
Gaki, okwegena nakwo okoba nobomaene ase amang’ana ayio asemeirie, nonya nekeene ki’ayio atari kororekana.
Naki ase okwo abagaaka abakoro mbaberetwe kirori.
Ase okwegena twamanyire ng’a ense nigo yatongetwe ase chinguru chie ring’ana ria Nyasae, na igo ebinto bikororekana tibiakoretwe nebinto bire maiso marore.

Ase okwegena Abeli akaa Nyasae ekeng’wanso ekere ekiya kobua egia Kaini. Ase okwo akaberwa kirori ng’a ere nomonyene oboronge. Nyasae akamobera kirori ase ogwancha ebiegwa biaye. Abeli okure, korende ase okwegena ngokwana are nonya ngoika bono.
Ase okwegena Enoku akang’anyigwa, tacha korora amakweri. Tarorekanete, ekiagera Nyasae namong’anyetie. Naki ritang’ani atarang’anyigwa konya obereirwe kirori ng’a namogwenerete Nyasae.
Korende omonto atari nokwegena takonyara komogwenera Nyasae. Naki oyogocha asare nagwenerete gwancha ng’a nareo, naende nigo akobaa eng’eria baria bakomorigia.

Ase okwegena Nuhu, gaikire gokurerwa na Nyasae ase amang’ana atararorekana, ase okoba namasikani amaya asare akaroisia obwato, erinde atoorie abanto b’enyomba yaye. Ase ayio, akagambia ense ekina, na akaba omonyamwando bw’oboronge bokonyorekana ase okwegena.
Ase okwegena Ibrahimu akaigwera Nyasae ekero arangeretigwe kogenda goika aase aria achiete konyora abe omwando oye, akaimoka akagenda, tamanya aase agochia.
Ase okwegena akamenya ase ense eria engeni arieretwe eira, akamenya buna omomenyi ase chiema amo na Isaka na Yakobo, abarenge abanyamwando amo nere ase eira eria eria.
Naki igo aganyete omochie ore namaroso, oyo Nyasae arosete na koagacha.
Ase okwegena Sara omonyene akanyora chinguru koba morito, nonya konya oeteire emiaka yaye, ekiagera amoroche ere oyomorierete eira, ng’a nomwegenwa are.
Ase ayio, korwa ase omonto oria oyomo, nonya konya obeire buna oyokure, abanto bakaiborwa abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro, na buna omokenye ore ase engegu y’enyancha, otanyare kobareka.
Aba bonsi bagakwa bare nokwegena, bataranyora ayabarieretwe eira, korende bakayarora korwa are, na koyakwania, bakaorokia ng’a nigo bare abamenyi na abaeti ase ense.
Naki abagokwana amang’ana buna ayio nkoorokia bare maiso marore, ng’a nkorigia bare ense yabo abanyene.
Onye barabwo mbainyorete ense eria ase baruete, anga mbanyorete ribaga koirana aroro.
Korende bono mbaganetie ense ere engiya kobua, engencho yaye ense ya igoro. Ase ayio Nyasae takorora obosooku korokwa Nyasae obo, ekiagera obaroiseirie omochie.
Ase okwegena Ibrahimu, gachia goteemwa, akarua Isaka abe ekeng’wanso. Nere oyorieretwe chiira akarua omwana oye omomoima.
Ere natebetigwe, “Ase Isaka oroiboro rwao narwatorwe.”
Akarengereria ng’a Nyasae nanyare komobokia korwa ase abakure. Ase ayio akamonyora agwo agwo, buna omogwekano.
Ase okwegena Isaka agasesenia Yakobo na Esau ase amang’ana agochi‐gocha.
Ase okwegena Yakobo, ekero arenge ang’e nogokwa, agasesenia kera oyomo bw’abana ba Yusufu, agasasima bwesiirerete enyimbo yaye.
Ase okwegena Yusufu, ekero abeire ang’e nomoerio bw’obogima bwaye, agakwana igoro y’okong’anyigwa kw’Abaisraeli, akabachikera amang’ana igoro y’amauga aye.
Ase okwegena Musa, ekero aiboretwe, akabiswa ase engaki y’emetienyi etato nabaibori baye, ekiagera baroche ng’a nomwana omuya, gose tibairogete ogochika kw’omoruoti.
Ase okwegena Musa, kabeire omonto omonene, akaanga tarokwa omwana bw’omoiseke o Farao,
agachora ng’a mbuya konyora emechando amo nabanto ba Nyasae kobua kwegokia ase ebibe ase ekero egeke.
Ere nigo abarete ogochaywa ase engencho ya Kristo ng’a nobonda kobua chinibo chia Misiri, ekiagera arigereretie eng’eria ere bosio.
Ase okwegena akarua Misiri, tairoka endamwamu y’omoruoti, ekiagera aremereretie buna oyororire ere oyotari kororekana.
Ase okwegena akaroisia Epasaka na kogindia amanyinga, erinde oyorache goita abana abatangi tabakuna, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo.
Ase okwegena Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’Enyancha Embariri buna ase ense enyomo. Korende Abamisiri barabwo bagachia goteema gokora bo, bakamerwa nenyancha.
Ase okwegena chindwaki chia Yeriko chikagwa gachiaetananirwe ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
Ase okwegena Rahabu, oria omotayayi, taitetwe amo nabwo bataigwerete, ekiagera aroisetie abanto baria chirooti nomorembe.
Naende inki ndakwane? Naki engaki tekong’isana gokwana igoro ya Gidioni, na Baraki, na Samson, na Yefita, na Daudi, na Samweli, na ababani.
Abwo ase okwegena bakabua amaruoti, bagakora oboronge, bakanyora ayabarieretwe chiira, bagasieka emenwa ye chindo.
Naende barabwo bakarimia chinguru chi’omorero, bagetooria korwa ase obwoge bw’omoro, bakabekwa chinguru nyuma y’oboreu bwabo, bakaba abakong’u ase esegi, bagaseria emeganda y’abarwani y’ababisa.
Abakungu bakanyora naende abakwete babo ase okobokigwa. Abande bagaitwa bobe goika bagakwa, tibancha gosiborwa, erinde banyore okobokigwa okore okuya kobua.
Abande bagachandeka ase ogochecherigwa na goakwa chinkini, naende bagasibwa nebinyuri na kobekwa chichela ime.

Bagaakwa amagena, bagateemwa, bakanachwa ne chinseke, bagaitwa nemeyio ya birende. Naende bagaetanana beboetie chingobo chie ching’ondi na echie chimbori, bakaba abaremerwa, bagachandwa na gokorwa bobe,
abanto ense etagwenere koba nabarabwo. Barabwo nigo barenge goetanana ase chirooro na ase ebitunwa, ase amabwago na amakuruma.
Abanto aba bonsi babereirwe kirori goetera ase okwegena kwabo, korende tibanyora ayabarieretwe eira,
ekiagera Nyasae natang’anete gotogachera intwe egento kere ekiya kobua, naki barabwo tibaikeranetigwe intwe totaiyo.

Ase ayio, ekiagera intwe tore nabarori abange buna igo, batoetanaine buna riire, totugute are kera egurube, na ebibe biria bitobwatete. Tominyoke noboremereria ase okoamererania koria kobekire bosio bwaito,

na korigereria Yeso, omochaki na omoikerania bw’okwegena gwaito. Ribaga ri’omogoko oyobegetwe bosio bwaye, akaremereria omosalaba na gochaya obosooku, ere nigo aikaransete ensemo ya borio y’ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae.
Gaki, morengererie mono ere oyoremereretie oboengereria buna obwo bokorwa ase abanyene ebibe igoro yaye ere omonyene, timocha kwebutokania na gokwa emioyo yaino.
Timorarwana esegi goika mwaiteire amanyinga aino ase okoamererania nebibe,
naende mwebire ogosorora koria kogokwana nainwe buna abana, “Omwana one, tochaya ogoakwa kw’Omonene kw’ogokorongeyia, gose tokwa omoyo karakoe egesusuro.
Naki ere oyo Omonene anchete nigo akomorongeyia, na kong’wania bororo omwana oyo obeire oyoye.”
Ekero mokorongeigwa moremererie Nyasae nigo akobakorera buna abana baye. Naki, mwana ki otari korongeigwa na ise?
Korende onye mokoba motari nokorongeigwa oko bonsi babwataine nakorokwo, rirorio nigo more abana ebimeru gose tari abana ba boronge.
Amo nayio ntwarenge nabatata baito b’ense eye, baare gotorongeyia, na barabwo ntwabasigete. Inee! Tari buya mono kobua kwebeka inse ya Tata bw’emeika yaito, na koba moyo?
Naki ekeene, abatata baito b’ense nigo batorongeetie ase amatuko amake buna baroche buya, korende ere nigo agotorongeyia ase ogotokonya, erinde tobe ababwatani b’obochenu bwaye.
Kera okorongeigwa ase engaki yaye gokororekana ng’a tikori egento ki’omogoko, korende neki’omoichano. Korende nyuma yaye abakonarire banyore okwama kw’omorembe na okw’oboronge.
Ase ayio, mobeke chinguru amaboko ayio ororobire, na amaru ayagataire.
Mokorere amagoro aino chinchera chindonge, erinde ekere ekerema tikeotoranwa, korende kobua mono kegwenigwe.
Kora omokia koba nomorembe nabanto bonsi, na rigia obochenu, ekiagera onde tari orarore Omonene, atari naborobwo.
Morigererie mono ng’a onde taremerwa obuya bwa Nyasae, “omori bw’obororo” tocha gokumbaria na kobachanda, na abanto abange batambokerigwe ogotacheneka ase oyio.
Morigererie ng’a onde taba omotomani, gose oyotamosigeti Nyasae, buna Esau, oyoonetie omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi ase endagera eyemo.
Naki mwamanyire buya ng’a ekero achiete korigia omwando bw’ogosesenigwa korwa nyuma, agakanigwa, naki tanyora ribaga ri’okoonchoka nonya oririgetie mono namariga.
Naki timoraika ase egetunwa keranyare gokunwa, kegwoka omorero, gose omosunte, ne riire rimwamu, na ekembobe,
na egeturi ki’egetureri, na eriogi ri’amang’ana. Abwo bayaigwete bagasorora tibatebigwa ing’ana rinde naende.
Naki tibanyarete koremereria ring’ana riria riachigetwe, “Nonya neng’iti eise gokuna egetunwa nabo eraakwe amagena.”
Aya arorekanete igo arenge ay’okwoboyia, goika Musa agateba, “Nabwatirwe nomoondoko na okoiguswa.”
Korende inwe mwaikire egetunwa gekorokwa Sayoni, na omochie o Nyasae ore moyo, Yerusalemu ya igoro, na abamalaika abange batari kobareka,

na omosangererekano bw’omoyega, na omosangererekano bw’abaiborwa be ritang’ani, abwo amarieta abo arikire igoro, na Nyasae oyore omogambi bw’abanto bonsi, na emeika y’abanto abanyene oboronge abaikeranigwe,
na Yeso oyore omobwatania bw’okobwatana okoyia, na amanyinga akonyororokerigwa ayagokwana buya kobua aria ay’Abeli.
Rigereria, timomwanga ere oyogokwana. Naki onye baria tibetooretie baria bamwangete ere oyobakurerete ase ense, kobua mono intwe titogwetooria onye tokomwanga ere oyogotokurera korwa igoro.
Na eriogi riaye ndiatengechetie ense ekero keria, korende bono orire eira, ogoteba, “Ara rimo naende nintengechie ense, gose tari ense yoka, korende na igoro boigo.”
Korende ring’ana eri, “Ara rimo naende”, nigo rikoorokia, ng’a ebinto biria bigotengechigwa nigo birang’anyigwe ekiagera biatongetwe, erinde ebitanyare gotengechigwa bibeo.
Gaki, ekiagera twanyorire oboruoti obotanyare gotengechigwa, tiga toiranerie ng’a mbuya mono na komokorera Nyasae ase okomogokia amo namasikani na okoiroka.
Naki Nyasae oito nomorero okoria na gosiria.
Mogenderere nobwanchani inwe ase inwe.
Timweba koroisia abageni, naki ase enchera eye abande mbaroisetie abamalaika, batamanyete.
Inyora abwo basibire ase echela, buna nainwe mosibire amo nabarabwo, naende barabwo mbakoreretwe bobe, ekiagera naboigo nainwe more nomobere.
Okonyuomana gosikwe nabanto bonsi, na ebirarero bibe bitari nobosooku, naki abanyaka na abatomani Nyasae nabagambie ekina.
Timoba abanchi chibesa, moisaneke nebi more nabio, ekiagera ere omonyene otebire, “Tinkogotiga nonya ng’ake, gose tingokoremera.”
Ase ayio, ntonyare goteba noboremu, “Omonene nere omokonyi one, tinkwoboa. Mwanyabanto, inki arankorere?”
Inyora abwo baare kobatang’ana, ababatebetie ring’ana ria Nyasae. Naende morengererie mono omoerio bw’obogima bwabo, mobe abegi b’okwegena kwabo.
Yeso Kristo buna arenge igoro, na buna are rero, nabo arabe goika kare na kare.

Timoirwa bogeka namorokererio ao ao, ayare ay’ekegeni, ekiagera mbuya chinkoro chibekwe chinguru ase obuya, gose tari ase emeroberio y’okoria endagera ase eyio barabwo bagendererete neyio tibanyora gokonywa konde.
Ntore negesasimero aase baria bagokorera Eema batari ne ribaga koria ebinto bikoruegwa aroro.
Naki emebere ye ching’iti chiria amanyinga abo are korentwa ime Aase Aachenu nomokuani omonene ase engencho y’ebibe, nigo yare gosamberwa isiko y’omochie.
Ase ayio, Yeso nere agachanderwa isiko y’egeita, erinde achene abanto namanyinga aye ere omonyene.
Ase ayio, togende asare isiko y’omochie, tobwatane nere ase okoramwa kwaye,
ekiagera aiga titori nomochie oragenderere, korende nigo tokorigia oria orache gocha.
Gaki, goetera asare togenderere koa Nyasae ekeng’wanso gi’okomotogia, engencho yaye okwama kw’emenwa yaito eyekoorokia erieta riaye.
Timweba gokora amaya, na gosanga nabande, naki ebing’wanso binga buna ebi nabio bikomogwenera Nyasae.

Moigwere abwo bakobatang’ana, na mobasike, ekiagera barabwo nigo barendete emioyo yaino buna abanto barache korua omobaro, erinde banyare gokora ayio ase omogoko. Onye bagocha koyakora ase okweumia anga taba na gokonywa konde asemore.
Tosabere, naki ntore nobomaene ng’a chinkoro chiaito tichigotogambia, ntorigetie koba norogendo oruya ase amang’ana onsi.
Na inche nabasoroire mono kobua gokora ayio, erinde ng’iranigwe asemore bwango.
Bono Nyasae bw’omorembe oyomorentete naende korwa ase amakweri Omonene oito Yeso, oyore omorisia omonene bwe ching’ondi goetera ase amanyinga ’okobwatana gwa kare na kare,

ere abakore mobe abaikeranu ase kera ogokora okuya, monyare gokora obwanchani bwaye, naende akore ime yaino ayagwenerete ase obosio bwaye goetera ase Yeso Kristo. Asare ere obonene bwa kare na kare. Amina.
Abaminto, nababoririe, moremererie ring’ana eri ri’ogosorora, ekiagera nabarikeire ase amang’ana amake.
Manya ng’a oyominto Timotheo oikire gosiborwa. Amo nere ntoche kobarora karache bwango.
Nkwanerie abwo bonsi bakobatang’ana, na abachenu bonsi. Abwo baruete Italia babakwanirie.
Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.
Inche Yakobo, omosomba o Nyasae na obw’Omonene Yeso Kristo, nabakwanirie inwe ab’ebisaku ikomi na bibere, abamwatananekire gochia chinse chire ao ao.
Abaminto, bara ng’a nomogoko bwoka komorasoe ase amateemwa are ao ao,
ekiagera momanyete ng’a ekero okwegena kwaino kogoteemwa nigo mokweorokereria oboremereria.
Tiga oboremereria obwo bobe nemeremo emeikeranu, erinde monyare koba abaikeranu, na abagima, motaremeiri na ing’ana rinde rionsi.
Korende onye monto onde oino oremeire obong’aini, tiga asabe Nyasae, ere nabomoe, ekiagera nigo akoa abanto bonsi ase obonge, gose tari gotogonyera onde.
Korende oyogosaba, tiga asabe ase okwegena, taba na tang’u‐tang’u, ekiagera oyore ne chitang’u‐tang’u nigo are buna emerindo y’enyancha ekona‐koirwa nomwaga gochia aaria na aaria.
Naki omonto oria takaga ng’a nanyore egento korwa ase Omonene;
ere nigo are nemioyo ebere, na gotiting’ara ase chinchera chiaye chionsi.
Korende oyomino otari nobonene agoke, ekiagera aimokererigwe igoro,
na oyore omonda, nere agoke kairanigwe inse, ekiagera nigo arasire buna egesicha ki’obonyansi.
Naki erioba korikooroka nomobaso omororo, nigo rigosamba na kwomia obonyansi. Egesicha ki’obonyansi kiaroroka, na obuya bw’ekieni kiaye bwasira. Naboigo nomonda nere arasire kagendererete kwerigeria.
Nasesenirie omonto oria oremereretie ogoteemwa, ekiagera ekero aikire gwancherwa nanyore obogima buna egutwa y’obobui, obogima obwo Nyasae abarierete eira abwo bamwanchete.
Omonto karateemwe, tateba, “Nateemirwe na Nyasae,” ekiagera Nyasae tagoteemwa namabe, gose tagoteema omonto.
Korende kera omonto nigo agoteemwa ekero akong’uswa na kong’ainwa nokogania kwaye omonyene.
Na okogania koria okobe gokwabogoirie oborito kwaibora ebibe, na ebibe biria kobiakinire, biarenta amakweri.
Abaminto abanchani, timong’aineka.
Kera ekerugwa ekiya, na kera ekeegwa geikeranete nigo gekorwa ase Ise bw’emebaso. Asare koonchoka tikoiyo, gose ekiriri kende gekooncha‐onchoka.
Ase ogwancha kwaye ere omonyene agatoibora ase ring’ana riaye ri’ekeene, erinde tobe buna ogotongorwa konde kw’ebitongwa biaye.
Abaminto abanchani, momanye ring’ana eri: Kera omonto abe omwango ase okoigwa, korende abe bwe ng’ora ase ogokwana, na bwe ng’ora ase okoba nendamwamu,
ekiagera endamwamu ya mwanyabanto teri gokora ayare boronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
Ase ayio, beka aare ogotacheneka gwonsi, na obonge bw’amabe, na ase obwororo mwanche ring’ana erio riasimekirwe ime yaino, eriranyare gotooria emioyo yaino.
Mobe abakori be ring’ana; timoba abakoigwa rioka, na kweng’aina inwe abanyene.
Naki omonto karabe omoigwa bwe ring’ana, gose tari omorikori, oyio nigo anga buna omonto oyokwerigereria obosio bwaye omonyene ase ekerore.
Igo akwerigereria, naende ogenda ase agochia, erio kegima bweba buna erora arenge.
Korende oyorigereretie amachiko amaikeranu ay’obosibore, na goikaransa aroro, na taba oyokoigwa na kweba, korende abe omokori okoyakora, oyio nabe oyosesenirie ase ogokora kwaye.
Omonto karekage ng’a nkomokorera are Nyasae, na ere tagambereti oromeme rwaye, korende nenkoro yaye akong’aina, igo okomokorera Nyasae kwaye nigo kore okwa bosa.

Okomokorera Nyasae okore ogochenu, gotari na komocha ase obosio bwa Nyasae Tata noko: Gochia korora chintakana na ababoraka ase obokong’u bwabo, na kwerenda ere omonyene, na igo taba na kemoa gi’ense.
Abaminto, komorabe mwegenete Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, Omonene bw’obonene, timoba mogwanchereria abanto.
Naki karasoe ase omosangererekano oino omonto obegete ebonyi y’etahabu ase ekiara kiaye, na bweboetie chianga chingiya, naende omonto onde asoe, oyore omotaka na bweboetie chianga chire ne riko,
na inwe mwasika oria bweboetie chianga chingiya, na komotebia, “Ikaransa aye aiga aase aagiya”, na gotebia oria omotaka, “Tenena aaria”, gose, “Ikaransa inse aa ase amagoro aane”,
Inee, timokoreti ogwatananeka ase egati yaino inwe abanyene, na mwabeire abagambi, more nebirengererio ebibe?
Abaminto abanchani, tegerera! Inee! Nyasae tachorete abataka b’ense eye babe abanda ase okwegena, naende babe abanyamwando b’oboruoti obo abarierete eira, abwo bamwanchete?
Korende inwe mwachayire oria omotaka. Inee! Baria abanda, tari barabwo babaregete inwe, na kobakurura gochia ase ebigambero?
Tari barabwo abwo bakorama erieta erio rigiya mwarokirwe inwe?
Komoraikeranie ogochika gokorwa ase oboruoti buna korikire ase amariko, “Ancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete”, namokore buya.
Korende onye more mogwanchereria abanto, mwakorire ebibe, na mwaenekigwe namachiko ng’a nabasaria more.
Naki monto onde bwensi obwatete amachiko onsi, korende asarie erimo rioka, obeire omomochi ase onsi.
Naki ere oyotebete, “Totomana”, nere boigo agateba, “Toita”. Gaki, onye totomaneti, korende gwaitire, igo kwabeire omosaria amachiko.
Kwana bo, na kora boigo, buna abanto barache kogambigwa ase amachiko ’obosibore.
Naki ekina tikeri namabera asere oyotari namabera. Amabera nigo agochenga igoro y’ekina.
Abaminto, ngokonywa ki omonto aranyore onye ogoteba ng’a nare nokwegena, na ere tari nogokora? Inee! Okwegena koria nkonyare komotooria?
Onye oyomino, omosacha gose omokungu, ore bosa, na oremeire endagera ya kera rituko,
na omonto onde oino amotebie, “Genda nomorembe, bwote omorero, oigote”, korende tamoa ebiaganetie ase omobere oye, naki aramokonye?
Naboigo nokwegena gwoka gotari nogokora, nigo gokwete.
Aande gose omonto natebe, “Aye nore nokwegena, na inche ninde nogokora.” Nimoiranerie, “Nyorokia okwegena kwao gotari nogokora, na inche nkworokie okwegena kwane ase ogokora kwane.”
Aye mbwegenete ng’a Nyasae noyomo; gwakorire buya. Nonya nebirecha mbiegenete boigo na koiguswa.
Korende aye, omonto otaisaini gento, norigetie komanya ng’a okwegena gotari nogokora nokogomba?
Inee! Sokoro yaito Ibrahimu taetwe oboronge ase ogokora, ekero aruete Isaka, omwana oye, igoro ase egesasimero?
Kwarorire ng’a okwegena kwaye amo nogokora mbiakorete emeremo, na okwegena koria kogaikeranigwa ase ogokora.
Amariko agaikeranigwa, aria agoteba, “Ibrahimu nigo amwegenete Nyasae, na ase engencho eyio akabarwa koba omonyene oboronge.” Igo akarokwa omosani o Nyasae.
Mwarorire ng’a mwanyabanto nigo akoegwa oboronge ase ogokora, gose tari ase okwegena gwoka.
Naboigo na Rahabu, oria omotayayi, Inee, taetwe oboronge ase ogokora, ekero aroisetie baria batometwe, akabasokia isiko ase enchera ende eng’ao?
Naki buna omobere otari nomoika nigo okwete, naboigo nokwegena gotari nogokora nigo gokwete.
Abaminto, tegwenereti abange asemore babe aborokia, ekiagera momanyete ng’a intwe aborokia inatogambigwe ekina egekong’u kobua.
Naki intwe twensi nigo tokomocha ase chinchera chinyinge. Onye omonto takomocha ase ogokwana, oyio nomonto omoikeranu, oranyare kogambera omobere oye bwonsi boigo.
Onye tokobekera chibarasi ebinto emenwa, ebi’ogochiraa, erinde chitoigwere, nigo tokoraa emebere yabo yonsi.
Morigererie chimeeri boigo, nonya chire chinene mono, na chikoirwa nomwaga omotindi, nigo chikoonchorwa nekeonchori egeke mono, aande onsi omogendia aganetie kogenda.
Naboigo na oromeme nekiimo egeke, na rororwo nigo rokweenenia ase amang’ana amanene. Rigereria buna ensase enke egosamba rinani rinene mono.

Oromeme narwo omorero, na ense y’obobe. Ase ebiimo biaito bionsi oromeme narwo rokobeka omobere bwonsi ebimoa, na gotongia omorero egesingo ki’obogima bwaito, na orwo oronyene nigo rwatongetwe nomorero o kare na kare.
Naki kera egesaku gie ching’iti, ne chinyoni, ne ching’iti chigwekurura, na ebitongwa ebire amache ime, nigo bitugire, na birobio nigo biatugire na mwanyabanto.
Korende oromeme, onde tari ase mwanyabanto oranyare korotuga. Rororwo nobobe, rotari kogamberwa, roichire nobosongo bokorenta amakweri.
Ase orwo twatogia Omonene Tata, na ase orwo twaragereria mwanyabanto abatongetwe ase omogwekano o Nyasae.
Omonwa oria oria orua ogosesenia na okoragereria. Abaminto, amang’ana aya tagwenereti koba bo.
Inee! Ensoko nenyare ase entuboka eyemo korenta amache amaya, na amache amaroro?
Abaminto, Inee, omoko nonyare kwama amazeituni, gose omosabibu bwame amako? Naboigo nensoko y’amache are nomonyo tekonyara korenta amache atari nomonyo.
Ning’o asemore ore omong’aini na omomanyi? Ere aorokie ogokora kwaye ase orogendo rwaye oruya, ase obwororo bokorwa ase obong’aini.
Korende onye more ne ribero rire nobororo, na okweancha ase chinkoro chiaino ime, timwetogia na gokwana oborimo igoro y’ekeene.
Obong’aini obo tari boria bogocha korwa igoro, korende nobw’ense, na obwe chingencho chia mwanyabanto, na echi’ebirecha,
ekiagera agwo ase ribero rire, na okweancha, agwo moroberio toiyo, korende kera ogokora okobe.
Korende obong’aini bokorwa igoro ritang’ani nigo bore obochenu, naende obw’omorembe, na obwororo, na obokanyeku. Igo boichire namabera na okwama okuya, botari na gosiereria gose na bong’ainereria.
Okwama kw’oboronge nigo kogosimekwa ase omorembe na baria bagokora omorembe.
Esegi na okorwana ebire ase egati yaino, ng’ai bikorwa? Inee! Tibiri korwa agwo ase okogania kwaino okobe, ogokorwana nebiimo biaino?
Nigo mokogania, korende timori na gento; moita na koba ne ribero, korende timokonyora gento. Nigo mogokora esegi na korwana, korende timori na gento, ekiagera timori gosaba.
Ngosaba more, ko timori koegwa, ekiagera nigo mogosaba bobe. Ayio mogosaba nigo moganetie gokorera ase okogania kwaino okobe.
Inwe abamotari abegenwa, timomanyeti ng’a obosani bw’ense nobobisa ase Nyasae? Gaki, oyorigetie koba omosani bw’ense bwekorire koba omobisa o Nyasae.
Gose nigo mokagete ng’a namang’ana a bosa, ekero amariko agoteba iga, “Omoika oyomenyete ime yaito nigo okogania ore ne risemi.”
Korende obuya obo, ere atoeire, nobonge kobua. Naki amariko nigo agoteba, “Nyasae nigo akwanga abare abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo nigo akobaa obuya.”
Gaki, mwebeke inse ase Nyasae; korende mwange Saitani, na ere nabatame.
Moike Nyasae ang’e, na ere nabaike ang’e inwe. Inwe abanyene ebibe, mochene amaboko aino; inwe abanyene emioyo ebere, mochene chinkoro chiaino.
Eichanie na kweng’ereria, na korera. Ogoseka kwaino koonchorwe kobe okweng’ereria, na omogoko oino obe omoichano.
Mwekeyie ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ere nabaimokererie igoro.
Abaminto, timong’achana. Oyokong’acha oyomwabo, gose komogambia nigo akong’acha amachiko na koyagambia, korende onye gokogambia amachiko, rirorio tori omokori amachiko, korende omogambia amachiko.
Omorua amachiko na omogambia noyomo bweka, nere oranyare gotooria na gosiria. Korende aye naye ng’o okogambia omogisangio oo?
Igwa bono inwe abamogoteba, “Rero gose ankio inatogende omochie gete, na tobeere aroro omwaka omogima na kogora, na koonia, na konyora ebitoki.”
Inwe timomanyeti ayarache abe ankio. Obogima bwaino ninki? Naki inwe neritaturi, rikororekana ase egeka egeke, naende riasira.
Ayamogwenerete goteba naya, “Omonene karanche, natobe moyo, naende tokore iga gose iga”.
Korende bono iga mogwetogia ase oboenenu bwaino. Ogwetogia gwonsi konga buna okwo nokobe.
Ase ayio, oyomanyete gokora amaya, ko tayakora, asare ere nebibe.
Igwa bono, abamore abanda, rera na goaka egeturi ase engencho y’emechando yaino eyekobachera.
Chinibo chiaino chiagundire, ne chianga chiaino chiarirwe nebigwankwa.
Chitahabu ne chifeta chiaino chiasoirwe noboboosu, na oboboosu obwo bwabeire kirori igoro yaino, na borobwo naborie emebere yaino buna omorero okoria. Mwegacheire emonga amatuko aya ay’omoerio.
Rigereria, mwabarinire abakoreri, abagesire emegondo yaino, eng’eria yabo. Bono eng’eria eria ekorera, na okorera kw’abagesi baria gwaikire ase amato ’Omonene bw’Emeganda.
Igo momenyete ase ense eye ase okwegokia, na timwetangeti ase okogania kwaino. Mwenoririe ase chinkoro chiaino goika rituko ri’okonyenya.
Mwagambirie omonyene oboronge na komoita, na ere tabaamerereti inwe.

Ase ayio, baminto, remereria goika Omonene achiche. Rigereria, omoremi nigo akoganya okwama kw’omogondo okore ne rigori. Igo akoremereria ase ayio, goika anyore embura ye ritang’ani na ey’okwamia endagera.
Naboigo, nainwe remereria, kong’ia chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ogocha kw’Omonene kwabeire ang’e.
Abaminto, timwemurunganerania, timocha kogambigwa. Rigereria, Omogambi nigo ateneine gesieri.
Abaminto, bwatia ababani baria bakwanete ase erieta ri’Omonene, babe ekiorokererio gi’okobogoria obokong’u, na eki’oboremereria.
Rigereria, abwo baremereretie twababarire ng’a mbasesenirie. Mwaigwete amang’ana ’Ayubu buna aremereretie, na buna Omonene amokorerete ase omoerio. Naki Omonene nomonyene amabeebe amange na amabera.
Korende abaminto, kobua ase onsi timotiana, ase igoro, gose ase ense, gose koria muma ende yonsi, korende “ee” yaino ebe “ee”, na “yaya” yaino ebe “yaya”, timocha kobekwa inse y’okogambigwa.
Omonto onde oino karanyorekane nemechando, tiga asabe. Onde omo oino, onye ore nomoyo bw’ogosasoka, tiga atogie ase ogotera.
Onye omonto onde oino obeire omorwaire, tiga arangerie abagaaka b’ekanisa bamosabere na bamoake amaguta ase erieta ri’Omonene.
Na ogosaba koria gw’okwegena nagotoorie omorwaire oria, na Omonene namogwenie. Onye omonto oria okorire ebibe naaberwe.
Orokerania ebibe biaino inwe ase inwe, na gosaberana, monyore okogwenigwa. Ogosaba kw’omonyene oboronge nigo kore nengencho enene mono gokorasabwe nomokia.
Elija nigo arenge omonto bwe chingencho echimo naintwe, agasaba nomokia ng’a embura tetwa. Na embura tiyatwa igoro ase ense ase engaki y’emiaka etato na emetienyi etano nomo.
Agasaba naende, igoro ekarenta embura, na ense ekama okwama kwaye.
Abaminto, onye omonto onde oino oteanire korwa ase ekeene, na monto onde amoiranie,
tiga ere amanye ng’a oyokoirania omonyene ebibe korwa ase enchera y’ogosira, ere natoorie omoyo oye korwa ase amakweri na atube obonge bw’ebibe.
Inche Petero, omotomwa o Yeso Kristo, nkobarikera nde inwe abachore, abamwatananekire gochia komenya buna abamenyi ase Ponto, na Galatia, na Kapadokia, na Asia, na Bitinia.
Inwe nigo mwachoretwe koreng’ana buna Nyasae Tata amanyete korwa kare, na mogachenwa n’Omoika, monyare koigwera Yeso Kristo, na konyororokerigwa namanyinga aye. Obuya na omorembe bimenteke asemore.
Nyasae, Ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, abakwe! Ase amabera aye amange atoiboire eria kabere, erinde tonyore ogosemeria kore moyo goetera ase okobokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo korwa ase abakure,
naende tonyore omwando otagosareka, otari na komocha, otari gosiria obonene bwaye. Omwando oyo ogachire igoro ase engencho yaino,
inwe abamorendire nokobua kwa Nyasae ase enchera y’okwegena, monyore ogotooreka kore ang’e koorokigwa ase ekero ki’omoerio.
Ase engencho y’ayio monyare kogoka mono, nonya mbono ase ekero egeke inamochandeke ase amateemwa a kera engencho, onye egwenerete.

Igo okwegena kwaino, gakoratenene ase ogoteemwa, kore kwe rigori rinene kobua etahabu egosira (nonya egoteemwa ase omorero) naende konyorekane kogwenerete ogotogigwa, na obonene, na ogosikwa ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.
Ere oyo mwamwanchire, nonya timomorochi, mwamwegenire, nonya timoramorora, na igo moragoke ase omogoko otari gotebeka oichire nobonene,
ekero moranyore oboikeranu bw’okwegena kwaino, engencho yaye ogotooreka kw’emioyo yaino.
Igoro ase amang’ana ’ogotooreka okwo ababani, baria babanete obuya obo borache kobachera, bakariga‐rigia na kouna‐unia.

Bakarigia nkero ki, naende nkero kenga buna kere ki, Omoika o Kristo, oyorenge ime yabo, oorogetie, ekero otang’anete koba kirori igoro y’ogochandwa gwa Kristo, na obonene obwo borache koba nyuma y’ayio.

Barabwo nigo bamaanoreretwe ng’a babakorere inwe ase amang’ana ayio, gose tari barabwo abanyene. Ayio bono araretigwe asemore nabaria babaranderetie inwe enchili ase Omoika Omochenu, oyotometwe korwa igoro. Amang’ana ayio abamalaika bare namaiga kona‐koyasiomeria.
Ase ayio, eboyie bokong’u ebinema bi’ebirengererio biaino, mobe aberiti, mobe nogosemeria ogoikeranu ase obuya boria morarenterwe ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.
Buna abana abaigweri timwereng’ania nokogania kwaino okobe kwe ritang’ani, ekero mware motamanyete gento,
korende buna ere, oyobarangeirie, are omochenu, naboigo nainwe mobe abachenu ase orogendo rwaino rwonsi,
ekiagera nigo erikire, “Nebagwenerete mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche nomochenu.”
Onye mokomoroka Tata, ere oyoragambie kera omonto koreng’ana nogokora kwaye atari nogwanchereria, mogenderere nokoiroka ase ekero kiaino gi’okomenya aiga buna abaeti.
Momanye ng’a nigo mwaboorigwe korwa ase orogendo rwaino rotagwenereti, orwo mwanyorete korwa ase chisokoro chiaino, tari ase ebinto bigosareka, buna chifeta gose chitahabu,
korende ase amanyinga e rigori rinene, buna ay’emanwa y’eng’ondi etari na komocha, gose na kemoa, engencho yaye amanyinga a Kristo.
Ere igo amanyekanete korwa kare, ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso, korende oorokigwe ase amatuko aya ay’omoerio ase engencho yaino.
Goetera asare ere mwamwegenire Nyasae, oyomobogetie korwa ase abakure na akamoa obonene, erinde okwegena kwaino na ogosemeria kwaino kobe ase Nyasae.
Komwaikire gwechena emioyo yaino ase okoigwera ekeene, goikera obwanchani bw’abamino botari nobong’ainereria, gaki bono mogenderere nobwanchani inwe ase inwe bokorwa ase enkoro y’ekeene,
ekiagera mwaiboirwe eria kabere, tari ase embusuro egosareka, korende ase eyetari gosareka, goetera ase ring’ana ria Nyasae rinyene obogima, erikobao goika kare na kare.
Naki igo erikire, “Mwanyabanto bonsi nigo banga buna obonyansi, na obonene bwabo nigo bonga buna ebisicha bire mogondo. Obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo,
korende ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rirabeo goika kare na kare.” Ne ring’ana eri nario enchili eye mwaranderetigwe.
Gaki, beka are obobe bwonsi, na obong’ainereria bwonsi, na oborianania, na emoko, na oboitania bwonsi.
Buna abana ebing’werere baiborwa rero iga, moganie amabeere ’ekeene ay’omoika, erinde monyare gokina ase aro, na goikera ogotooreka,
onye mwateemire Omonene ng’a nomuya.
Mochiere ere, oyore rigena rire moyo, riangetwe na mwanyabanto, korende ase obosio bwa Nyasae nerichore, rire rie rigori rinene.
Inwe abamore buna amagena are moyo moagachwe, mobe enyomba y’Omoika mobe abakuani abachenu, morue ebing’wanso bi’omoika ebirancherwe ase Nyasae goetera ase Yeso Kristo.
Ekiagera erikire ase amariko, “Rigereria, nabekire ase Sayoni rigena richore, rigena rinene ri’ekoona, naende nigo rire rie rigori rinene, na onde bwensi oyoramwegene takorora obosooku.”
Naki ogosika oko nokwaino, inwe abamwegenire. Korende ase abwo bategeneti nigo erikire, “Rigena erio abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona,”
naende, “Rigena erio nigo riragoche abanto, naende nigo rire egetare gekobaiyeria inse.” Nigo bakwegocha ase ring’ana, ekiagera tibari koriigwera. Naki naro ayio barageretwe.

Korende inwe nababiare abachore, abakuani b’Omoruoti, egesaku egechenu, abanto ba Nyasae omonyene, monyare koraria ogokora kwaye kw’obonene, oyobarangeretie korwa ase omosunte, gochia ase omobaso oye bw’ogokumia.
Inwe agwo kare timwarenge abanto ba Nyasae, korende bono mwabeire abanto baye; ritang’ani timwanyorete amabera, korende bono mwanyorire amabera.
Abanchani, nabasoroire inwe, ekiagera more abaeti ase ense engeni eatanane korwa ase okogania okobe kw’omobere okwo gokorwana nomoyo.
Mobe norogendo oruya ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde nonya bakobang’acha ng’a nabakori amabe more, banyare korora ogokora kwaino okuya na gotogia Nyasae rituko riria agocha kobachera.
Ase engencho y’Omonene mwebeke inse ya kera ekegochikwa na mwanyabanto, onye nomoruoti oyore omonene,
gose abagavuna, abatomirwe nere, erinde bae abakori amabe egesusuro, na gotogia abakori amaya,
ekiagera oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ng’a ase ogokora kwaino okuya mokirie abanto abariri ase ogotamanya kwabo.
Mobe abanto abasibore, korende timokorera obosibore bwaino ase okobiserera obobe, korende mobe norogendo rogwenerete abasomba ba Nyasae.
Mosike abanto bonsi. Mwanche abamino. Moiroke Nyasae. Mosike omoruoti.
Inwe abasomba, moigwere abanene baino ase okoiroka gwonsi, tari abwo boka abare abaya gose abororo, korende na abwo bare abatindi boigo.
Naki aya namaya mono omonto kararemererie ogoichana ase okoinyora Nyasae, na kobogoria ogochandwa gotari kwa boronge.
Naki ngotogigwa ki more nakwo komoraremererie ase ogoakwa chinkundi ekero mogokora ebibe? Korende komoraremererie ogochandwa ekero mogokora amaya, oko nakwo ogwancherwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
Ase ayio naro mwarangereretigwe, ekiagera Kristo nere nigo achandetwe ase engencho yaino, obatigeire ekiorokererio, erinde mobwatie chimbaratero chiaye.
Ere takorete ebibe, gose obong’ainereria tibwaruete ase omonwa oye.
Ere ekero arenge koramwa tairaneretie okoramwa okwo, ekero arenge gochandwa tatogonyete, korende akebeka asare ere oyokogamba ase oboronge.
Ere omonyene akabogoria ebibe biaito ase omobere oye igoro ase omote, erinde intwe tokwe korwa ase amang’ana ’ebibe, tobe moyo ase amang’ana ’oboronge. Ase amaote aye inwe mwagwenigwe.
Naki nigo mware buna ching’ondi chiasirire, korende bono mwairanire ase Omorisia na Omorendi bw’emioyo yaino.
Naboigo, inwe abakungu, moigwere abasacha baino, erinde onye abande bare aroro, abategeneti ring’ana, bang’uswe ase orogendo rw’abakungu babo, batatebiri ring’ana,
kobakorora orogendo rwaino oruya rore nokoiroka.
Ogwechabera kwaino tikoba ogwa isiko ase okomina chitukia, na kobeka ebigera bie chitahabu, gose chianga chinterere,
korende kobe ogw’enkoro y’omonto o ime otari kororekana, ogwechabera okwo gotari gosareka, ase omoika bw’obwororo na obokanyeku. Oko nakwo kore kwe rigori rinene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
Naki oko nakwo kware ogwechabera kw’abakungu abachenu ba kare, abamosemeretie Nyasae, abwo baigwerete abasacha babo,
buna Sara aigwerete Ibrahimu, akamoroka omonene. Na inwe bono mwabeire abana baye komorakore amaya, gose timokwoboigwa ase kogoswa konde gwonsi.

Naboigo nainwe abasacha, momenye nabakungu baino ase chisemi. Moe omokungu ogosika buna oyo otari ne chinguru, ekiagera nigo more abanyamwando amo ase okonyora obuya obokorenta obogima. Erio ogosaba kwaino tigotangwa.
Ring’ana ri’omoerio neri: Mobe nomoyo oyomo, mobogoreranie, mwanchane buna abamino, mororerane amabeebe, mobe nomoyo bw’obokanyeku.
Timoakanana amabe ase amabe, gose okorama ase okorama, korende ribaga ri’ayio mobe abamogosesenania, ekiagera ayio naro mwarangererigwe, ng’a monyore omwando bw’ogosesenigwa.
Naki nigo erikire “Oyorigetie gwancha obogima na korora amatuko amaya, tiga atange oromeme rwaye tirokwana amabe, na ebikoba biaye tibikwana obong’ainereria.
Tiga atige amabe, akore amaya, arigie omorembe na koyotunyana mono.
Naki amaiso ’Omonene nigo arigereretie abanyene oboronge, na amato aye nigo akoigwa ogosaba kwabo. Korende obosio bw’Omonene nigo bore igoro ase abwo bagokora amabe.”
Ning’o orabakorere amabe, komorabe nomokia ase ayare amaya?
Korende onye mogochandwa ase engencho y’oboronge, more negesio. Timoiroka okoirokia kwabo, gose timoichana.
Tiga Omonene Kristo acheneke ase chinkoro chiaino ime. Botambe mobe ang’e koiraneria kera omonto oyokobaboria amang’ana ’ogosemeria okore ime yaino, korende kora ayio ase obwororo na ase okoiroka.
Na inwe renda chinkoro chiaino tichibagambia, erinde ekero mogokwanwa bobe, abwo bakobarama ase orogendo rwaino oruya ase Kristo, basookigwe.
Naki mbuya gochandwa ase ogokora amaya kobua gochandwa ase ogokora amabe, onye gokoba ogwancha kwa Nyasae.

Ekiagera Kristo nere agakwa ara rimo ase engencho y’ebibe. Ere oyorenge omonyene oboronge agachandwa ase engencho y’abatari abaronge, erinde atorente ase Nyasae. Omobere oye ogaitwa, korende omoika oye ogakorwa koba moyo.
Ase omoika oyo agachiera emeika eria yarenge ase obosibwa, akayeranderia.

Emeika eyio ney’abwo bataigwerete agwo kare, ekero Nyasae aganyete ase oboremereria ase amatuko aria Nuhu are koroisia obwato. Ime ase abwo abanto abake, engencho yaye abanto batano na batato, batooregete goetera ase amache.
Omogwekano bw’amang’ana aya nebatiso, eyekobatooria inwe bono, tari ase okobeka aare riko ri’omobere, korende ase okoiraneria Nyasae enkoro etari kobagambia, goetera ase okobokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo,
oyosoete igoro, na bono nao are ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae. Abamalaika, na okobua, ne chinguru nigo bibekire inse yaye.
Gaki, ekiagera Kristo achandetwe ase omobere, nainwe boigo eboyie ebirwanero bi’ebirengererio ebio ebio, ekiagera ere oyochandetwe ase omobere bweatananire korwa ase ebibe.
Korwa bono ase amatuko aya atigarete more moyo, timogenderera koreng’ana nokogania okobe kwa mwanyabanto, korende koreng’ana nogwancha kwa Nyasae.

Naki engaki yaino eye yaetire yaisanire ase ogokora aya abanto b’Ebisaku banchete gokora. Igo mwagendererete ase obonyaka, na okogania okobe, na okonywa, na emeyega y’okoria bobe na gotinda, na mware gosasima emegwekano, ogosasima gotarenge okoronge.
Ase ayio, barabwo nigo bakorora ng’a nay’ogokumia, ekiagera inwe motari koayerera amo nabarabwo gochia ase obonyaka botari nekerengo, na nigo bakobarama.
Korende barabwo nigo barache korua omobaro asare ere oyore ang’e kogambia abare moyo na abakure.
Nakio kiagerete abakure bakaranderigwa enchili, erinde bagambigwe ase omobere koreng’ana buna mwanyabanto bakogambigwa, na babe moyo ase omoika, koreng’ana buna Nyasae are moyo.
Bono omoerio bw’amang’ana onsi oikire ang’e. Ase ayio, mobe nobong’aini na kwerita ase ogosaba.
Kobua ase onsi mobe nomokia ase ogwanchana, ekiagera obwanchani nigo bogotuba obonge bw’ebibe.
Mobe abamokoroisania inwe ase inwe motari kwemurungania.
Mokorerane inwe ase inwe, kera oyomo nekeegwa eke anyorete, buna abarendi abaya b’obuya bwa Nyasae, obore ne chingencho chinyinge.

Omonto karakwane, tiga akwane amang’ana a Nyasae. Omonto karabe omokoreri, tiga akorere ne chinguru echio Nyasae amoeire, erinde Nyasae atogigwe ase amang’ana onsi goetera ase Yeso Kristo. Asare ere obonene na okobua kare na kare. Amina.
Abanchani, timokumia ase obokong’u obore buna omorero, obwo bwabaikeire ase okobateema, buna namang’ana amageni abanyorire.
Korende ekiagera mwabwatanire nemechando ya Kristo, goka, erinde ase okomaanorwa kw’obonene bwaye monyare kogoka boigo, na gochenga.
Komorachaywe ase engencho y’erieta ria Kristo, imosesenirie ekiagera Omoika bw’obonene noyo o Nyasae nigo oikaransete igoro yaino.
Korende onde omo oino taba omoiti, gose omoibi, gose omokori amabe, gose oyokwerosia ase amang’ana ’abanto bande, erinde abaise gochandwa.
Korende onye omonto ogochandwa ekiagera are Omokristo tarora obosooku, korende atogie Nyasae ase erieta eri.
Naki engaki yaikire ekina gechakere ase enyomba ya Nyasae na gakerachake asetore, omoerio obo abwo bataigwereti enchili ya Nyasae, naki orabe?
Na, buna erikire, “Onye ekoba aakong’u omonyene oboronge gotooreka, oria otamoirogeti Nyasae na omonyene ebibe, naki rende kerabe asare?”
Ase ayio, abwo bagochandwa koreng’ana nogwancha kwa Nyasae, tiga bakore amaya na babeke emioyo yabo asare ere oyore Omotongi omwegenwa.
Nasoroire abagaaka abare ase egati yaino, inche buna omogaaka omogisangio obo, na kirori bw’ogochandwa gwa Kristo, na omobwatani bw’obonene boria borache koorokigwa:
Risia riicho ria Nyasae eriabekirwe asemore, tari ase okobetererigwa korende ase ogwancha buna Nyasae anchete, tari ase okonyora kw’oborianania, korende ase omoyo bw’okwerwa.
Timoba abagwekora abanene igoro ase abwo mwaeirwe, korende mobe ekiorokererio ekiya ase riicho riria.
Na Omorisia omonene karaoroke namonyore egutwa y’obonene etari gosareka.

Naboigo nainwe abamore abake, mwebeke inse ase abagaaka. Na inwe mwensi eboyie oboitongo buna orokini, monyare gokorerana, ekiagera nigo erikire, “Nyasae nigo akwanga abare abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo nigo akobaa obuya.”
Ase ayio, ekeyie inse y’okoboko kwa Nyasae okore nokobua, erinde ere abaimokererie igoro ase ekero kiaye.
Motweke ogwechanda kwaino gwonsi, ekiagera ere nigo agwechanda mono ase engencho yaino.
Mobe aberiti na korenda! Naki omosoeri oino Saitani nigo agoetanana na koruma buna endo ekoruma, ekorigia omonto erie.
Mwange ere, na motenene bokong’u ase okwegena, momanye ng’a ogochandwa okwo okwo gwaikeranigwe ase abamino abare ase ense engima.

Na Nyasae bw’obuya bwonsi, oyo obarangeirie mosoe ase obonene bwaye bwa kare na kare ase Kristo, komwaikire gochandwa ase ekero egeke, ere omonyene nabaroisie, na abakong’ie, ababeke chinguru na kobabeka ase oboroso obuya.
Okobua nokwaye goika kare na kare. Amina
Ase okoboko gwa Silivano, oyominto omwegenwa buna ndoche, nabarikeire ase amang’ana amake, kobasorora na koorokia ng’a obo nabwo obuya bw’ekeene bwa Nyasae. Tenena bokong’u ase obwo.
Ekanisa ya Babeli eyachorirwe amo nainwe yabakwanirie. Nonya Mariko, omwana one, obakwanirie.
Kwanania ase okonyunyuntana ase obwanchani. Omorembe obe amo nainwe mwensi, abamore ase Kristo Yeso.

Inche Simion Petero, omosomba na omotomwa o Yeso Kristo, nkobarikera nde inwe abamwanyorire okwegena okomo naintwe, okore kwe rigori rinene, goetera ase oboronge bwa Nyasae na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo.
Obuya na omorembe bimenteke asemore ase okomomanya Nyasae na Yeso, Omonene oito.
Okobua kw’obonyasae bwaye gwatoeire ebinto bionsi ebire nobogima na ebie chingencho chi’obonyasae ase okomomanya ere oyotorangeretie ase obonene bwaye obonyene, na okobua kwaye.
Ase ebinto ebio otoeire chiira chinene mono, echie rigori rinene, erinde ase echio monyare koba ababwatani be chingencho chia Nyasae, na gotama ogosaria gw’okogania okobe kore ase ense eye.
Naki ase engencho eyio eyio kora omokia mono, erinde ase okwegena kwaino momente obuya, na ase obuya chisemi,
na ase chisemi obweriti, na ase obweriti oboremereria, na ase oboremereria chingencho chi’obonyasae,
na ase chingencho chi’obonyasae obwanchani bw’obomino, na ase obwanchani bw’obomino mwanche bonsi.
Naki amang’ana aya karabe ime yaino na komenteka, nabakore timoba aboro gose abanto motari nokwama, ase okomomanya Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
Naki ere oyotari namang’ana ayio nomouko, takonyara korora amang’ana are bosio, na bwebire ogosibigwa kw’ebibe biaye bia kare.
Ase ayio, abaminto, kora omokia kobua gokora okorangerigwa kwaino na ogochorwa kwaino kobe goteneine bokong’u, naki komorakore ayio, timokogwa nonya ng’ake.
Naki nigo moraegwe ribaga rinene mono ri’ogosoa ase oboruoti bwa kare na kare bw’Omonene na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo.
Ase ayio, tinkomocha kobainyoria amang’ana ayio botambe, nonya moyamanyete na mwabekirwe chinguru ase ekeene ekio mwanyorire.
Inche narorire ng’a mboronge kobatura ase okobainyoria ayio ekero imenyete ase obomenyo obo bw’omobere.
Nimanyete ng’a amatuko ng’ang’e are ndarue ase obomenyo obo. Aya naro Omonene oito Yeso Kristo anyorogetie.
Na inche ninkore omokia ng’a botambe nyuma y’ogokwa kwane monyare koinyora amang’ana aya.

Naki titokobwatia emegano yarengereretigwe ne chisemi chi’obong’ainereria, ekero twabamanyetie okobua kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo na ogocha kwaye, korende intwe abanyene nigo twarenge abarori b’obonene bwaye.
Naki ere nigo anyorete ogosikwa na obonene korwa ase Nyasae Tata, na eriogi riachete asare korwa ase obonene bw’Obonene, rigoteba, “Oyo nere Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie nere.”
Na eriogi eri nario twaigwete rikorwa igoro, ekero twarenge amo nere ase egetunwa egechenu.

Intwe ntore ne ring’ana riria ri’obobani riteneine bokong’u kobua, na inwe inamokore buya komorategerere na koribwata buna etaya ekomoreka aase omosunte ore, goika ekero bogokia, na eng’enang’eni ya mambia eoroke ase chinkoro chiaino ime.
Ritang’ani momanye ring’ana eri, ng’a obobani bonde tibori ime ase amariko bwaorogetigwe koreng’ana buna omonto anchete omonyene,
ekiagera obobani tibwarentetwe engaki ende yonsi ase ogwancha kwa mwanyabanto, korende abanto abachenu ba Nyasae nigo baare gokwana batang’anire n’Omoika Omochenu.

Korende ababani b’oborimo mbaorogete ase egati y’abanto, buna aborokia b’oborimo barache kooroka ase egati yaino. Abwo barache gosoyia amorokererio ’ogosareka bobisi, na bagokana Omonene oyo obagorete, bakwerentera ogosareka gotari gotebana.
Abange nabatunyane ogokora kwabo kw’obonyaka, na ase engencho y’abwo enchera y’ekeene neramwe.
Ase obwegimeria na amang’ana ’obong’ainereria nabenyorere abanyene ebitoki korwa asemore. Korende ekina kiabo, egiachikire korwa kare, tikegotebana, gose ogosira kwabo tigokorara.
Naki Nyasae tabarorerete amabera abamalaika baria bakorete ebibe, korende akabaruta ase eoromomo y’omosunte aase barendire goika ekina geche.

Tabarorerete amabera abanto b’ense eria ya kare, korende akarenda Nuhu, oyorenge omoraria bw’oboronge, amo nabanto bande batano na babere, ekere arentete etoigo igoro ase ense y’abanto abatamoirogete Nyasae.
Ase ogosamba emechie eria yare korokwa Sodomu na Gomora ekaba ribu, akayegambia esarigwe, akayekora ekaba ekiorokererio ki’ogokurera abanto abatarengereretie komoiroka Nyasae.
Korende agatooria Loti, omonyene oboronge, oyorenge goichanigwa ase orogendo rw’obonyaka rwa baria abasaria amachiko.
Omonto oyo omonyene oboronge, oyomenyete ase egati yabo, nigo arenge gwechanda ase omoyo oye omoronge rituko ase rituko ase aya onsi arenge korora na koigwa ase ogokora kwabo kw’ogosaria amachiko.
Omonene nanyare kobatooria abwo bamoirogete korwa ase ogoteemwa, na kogacha abatari noboronge inse y’egesusuro goika rituko ri’ekina,
na kobua mono baria bakobwatia okogania okobe kw’omobere na gochaya okobua. Barabwo nigo bare abeanchi, bare noboremu, na tibari koiguswa ase okorama abwo b’obonene.
Abamalaika, nonya bare abanene kobua ase chinguru na okobua, tibakorenta ekina gi’okorama barabwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.

Korende abanto abwo nigo banga buna ching’iti chiatongetwe chitari nobong’aini, chiaiboretwe ase okobwatwa na gosirigwa. Barabwo nigo bakorama ase amang’ana batamanyeti. Ase ayio inabasirigwe ase ogosirigwa kwabo abanyene.

Bakonyorwa nobobe buna eng’eria y’ogokora okobe. Barabwo nigo bagokaga ng’a ogotinda na okwegokia ekero kia mobaso nobwansu. Babeire ebimoa bi’obosooku na amamocho, bakwegokia ase obong’ainereria bwabo kobagokora emeyega amo nainwe.

Amaiso abo nigo aichire nobotomani, na tibagotiga gokora ebibe. Nigo bakogenka abare nemioyo etari ne chinguru, na bare ne chinkoro chianarigwe ase obwegimeria. Barabwo nigo bare abanto baragereretigwe.
Basirire ekiagera batigire enchera erambogete na kobwatia enchera ya Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, oyobwanchete eng’eria y’ogokora okobe.
Ere nigo atogonyeretwe ase ogosaria kwaye omonyene, ekero etigere etari gokwana egakwana ase eriogi ria mwanyabanto, egatanga obobarimo bw’omobani oria.
Abanto aba nechinsoko chitari namache na amare akoirwa nomwaga, bagacheirwe obomwamu bw’omosunte.
Nigo bagokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu atari nengencho, na ase okogania okobe kw’omobere na obonyaka bakogenka abwo bachakire gotama baria bagendererete gochia gosira.
Bakobariera eira y’obosibore, korende barabwo abanyene nigo bare abasomba b’ogosareka. Naki omonto kabuirwe nomonto onde nigo akoba omosomba bw’omonto oria.

Naki baria baikire gotama ogotacheneka gw’ense ase okomomanya Omonene na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo, korende kobakobwatwa naende na kobugwa nero, okoba kwabo kw’omoerio nkobe okobe kobua koria kwe ritang’ani.
Naki anga nigo yabete buya onye tibamanyete enchera y’oboronge, kobua koyemanya naende koirana nyuma korwa ase ogochika ogochenu okwo baetwe.
Barabwo omoreng’anio oria bw’ekeene obaikeire, oria ogoteba, “Esese yairaneire amaroki aye enyene,” na “Embeche eyasibigwe ekwegara‐garia ase etintira ime.”
Abanchani, rirube eri neria kabere nabarikeire inwe. Ase onsi abere nabokirie ebirengererio biaino ebiya ase okobainyoria,
monyare koinyora amang’ana aria akwanetwe kare nababani abachenu, na ogochika oko Omonene na Omotooria abarenterete goetera ase abatomwa baino.
Ritang’ani momanye ring’ana eri, ng’a ase amatuko ’omoerio abanto abanyacheche b’ogosekereria inabache, baria bagotunyana okogania kwabo abanyene,

bagoteba, “Ng’ai bore oboikeranu bw’eira eria y’ogocha kwaye? Naki korwa agwo chisokoro chiaito chiararete ebinto bionsi nabo bigendererete engencho eyio eyio, buna biarenge korwa omochakano bw’ogotongwa.”
Naki nigo bamiametie amaiso abo tibarora ng’a igoro nao yarenge korwa kare, na ense egatongwa korwa ase amache, na goetera ase amache, ase chinguru chie ring’ana ria Nyasae.
Ase ayio, ense eria y’ekero keria egasira ase etoigo ime.
Korende igoro ya bono amo na ense eye biagacheirwe omorero ase ring’ana erio erio, birendwe goika rituko ri’ogosirigwa kw’abanto abatamoirogeti Nyasae.
Korende abanchani, timweba ring’ana eri, ng’a ase Omonene rituko erimo nigo rire buna emiaka elifu, na emiaka elifu buna rituko erimo.
Omonene tagotebana goikerania, eira yaye, buna abande bakagete ng’a otebanire, korende nigo aremereretie ase engencho yaino, tancheti monto onde bwensi asire, korende bonsi baikere okoonchoka.
Korende rituko ri’Omonene nigo rirache buna omoibi agocha. Ase rituko erio igoro neruo negeturi ekenene, na ebitongwa bia igoro inabisire nomorero ogotetenya, na ense na ebinto ebire aroro inabiyie.
Naboigo, ekiagera ebinto ebi bionsi nabisire, nebagwenerete inwe mobe abanto b’orogendo orochenu na abe chingencho chi’obonyasae.
Nebagwenerete gotengera na koayereria rituko ria Nyasae riche bwango. Ase rituko riria igoro nesirigwe na koyia, na ebitongwa bia igoro inabinyititoke nomorero omonene.
Korende buna atorierete eira ntotengerete igoro enyia na ense enyia, ase ebio oboronge mboreo ime yabo.
Ase ayio abanchani, ekiagera motengerete ebio, kora omokia, erio moche kororekana asare more nomorembe, motari na kemoa gose na komocha.
Na bara okoremereria kw’Omonene oito ng’a nogotooreka. Naboigo noyominto omwanchwa, Paulo, abarikerete koreng’ana nobong’aini aetwe.

Igoro y’amang’ana ayio arikire ase amarube aye onsi. Imeo nare amang’ana ande ayare amakong’u koyamanya, ayio abanto batorokereretigwe buya na batateneini bokong’u bakoonchorana, buna bakoonchorana amariko ande, na igo bakwerentera ogosira.
Gaki, abanchani, komwatang’anire komanya aya, erende timobaisa gotantanigwa nogosira kw’abwo bagosaria amachiko, na igo mobaise kogwa korwa ase ogwetenenera kwaino.
Korende mokine ase obuya na ase okomomanya Omonene na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo. Obonene nobwaye bono na goika kare na kare. Amina.
Eri riarengeo korwa omochakano, eri twaigwete, eri twaroche namaiso aito, eri twarigereretie, nonya namaboko aito akaribwata, eri nario Ring’ana ri’obogima togokwana.
Obogima obwo bokaorokigwa, na intwe tokaborora na kobobera kirori; na intwe igo tokabarareria inwe obogima obwo bwa kare na kare, obwo bwarenge ase Tata na koorokigwa asetore.
Eri twarorire na koigwa, eri naboigo tokobarareria inwe, erinde nainwe monyare kobwatana naintwe. Okobwatana gwaito nigo kore amo na Tata na Omwana oye Yeso Kristo.
Nkobarikera tore aya, erinde omogoko oito oikeranigwe.
Aya naro amang’ana twaigwete korwa asare, na tokobarareria inwe, ng’a Nyasae nomobaso, gose mosunte onde bwonsi tori ime asare.
Onye togoteba ng’a twabwatanire nere, naende togendererete ase omosunte, igo twatebire oborimo, gose ayare ay’ekeene titori koyakora.
Korende onye tokogenda ase omobaso, buna ere are ase omobaso, rirorio twabwatanire intwe ase intwe, na amanyinga a Yeso, Omwana oye, nigo agotosibia ebibe biaito bionsi.
Onye togoteba ng’a titori na bibe, iga tokweng’aina, gose ekeene tikeri ime yaito.
Gatorabiorokie ebibe biaito, ere nomwegenwa na omonyene oboronge, natwabere ebibe biaito, na atosibie korwa ase ogotaba boronge gwonsi.
Onye togoteba ng’a titokoreti ebibe, twakorire Nyasae koba omonyaborimo, gose ring’ana riaye tiriri ime yaito.
Abana baane abake, nkobarikera nde aya, erinde timokora ebibe. Korende onye omonto okorire ebibe, ntore n’Omosaberi ase Tata, nere Yeso Kristo, Omonyene Oboronge.
Ere nekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe biaito, gose tari ase ebibe biaito bioka, korende nase ebibe bi’ense yonsi.
Onye tobwatete amachiko aye, ntore nobomaene ng’a ntomomanyete.
Ere oyogoteba, “Nimomanyete,” na tabwateti amachiko aye, oyio nomonyaborimo, gose ekeene tikeri ime yaye.
Korende ere oyobwatete ring’ana riaye, ime ase oyio obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaikeranigwe ekeene ekeene. Ase eri ntore nobomaene ng’a nigo tore ime asare:
Ere oyogoteba ng’a nigo amenyete ime asare, nagwenerete kogenda ere omonyene buna Yeso arenge kogenda.
Abanchani, timbarikereti ogochika okoyia, korende nkoria gwa kare mwarenge na korokwo korwa ritang’ani. Na ogochika koria gwa kare nakwo ring’ana riria mwaigwete.
Naende nkobarikera nde ogochika okoyia, okore ogw’ekeene ime yaye, na ime yaino, ekiagera omosunte ngoeta ore, na omobaso bw’ekeene oikire kobara.
Ere oyogoteba ng’a nigo are ase omobaso ime, naende ogechete oyomwabo, nigo are ase omosunte ime nonya mbono,
na ere oyobwanchete oyomwabo nigo amenyete ase omobaso, na ime asare gento tikeiyo keragere agochwe.
Korende ere oyogechete oyomwabo nigo are ase omosunte ime, naende nigo akogenda ase omosunte, na tamanyeti nonya naase agochia, ekiagera omosunte omoukoirie amaiso aye.
Nkobarikera nde inwe, abana baane, ekiagera ebibe biaino biaabeirwe ase engencho y’erieta riaye.

Nkobarikera nde inwe abaise, ekiagera momomanyete ere oyorengeo korwa omochakano. Nkobarikera nde inwe, abamura, ekiagera mwamobuire oria omobe. Nabarikerete inwe, abana abake, ekiagera momomanyete Tata.
Nabarikerete inwe, abaise, ekiagera momomanyete ere oyorenge korwa omochakano. Nabarikerete inwe, abamura, ekiagera more ne chinguru, ne ring’ana ria Nyasae ndire ime yaino, na mwabuire oria omobe.
Timwancha ense eye, nonya nebinto bireo ase ense. Omonto karanche ense eye, obwanchani bwa Tata tibori ime yaye.
Naki bionsi ebire ase ense eye, okogania okobe kw’omobere, na okogania okobe kw’amaiso, na oboenenu bw’obogima obo, tibiri korua ase Tata, korende nigo bikorua ase ense.
Na ense eye nigo egoeta, na okogania kwaye, korende ere oyogokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae nigo akoba moyo goika kare na kare.
Abana baane abake, engaki eye ney’omoerio. Na buna mwaigwete ng’a omobisa o Kristo ngocha are, nonya mbono ababisa ba Kristo nabange baimokire. Ase ayio twamanyire ng’a engaki eye ney’omoerio.
Abwo basokire korwa asetore, korende tibarenge abaito. Naki onye nabaito baare, anga mbabete amo naintwe. Korende barureo, erinde emanyekane ng’a tari bonsi barenge abaito.
Na inwe mwaakirwe amaguta nere oyore Omochenu, na mwamanyire onsi.
Tinabarikerete inwe, ekiagera motamanyeti ekeene, korende nekiagera mokemanyete, naende momanyete ng’a borimo bonde tibori bokorwa ase ekeene.
Ning’o ore omonyaborimo otatiga ere oyogokana ng’a Yeso tari ere Kristo? Oyogokana Ise na Omwana, oyio nere omobisa o Kristo.
Onde bwensi ogokana Omwana tari na Ise. Ere oyokomobera Omwana kirori nigo are na Ise boigo.
Amang’ana aria mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani, tiga aikaranse ime yaino. Onye amang’ana aria mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani aikaransete ime yaino, erio nainwe namomenye ime ase Omwana, na ime ase Ise.
Eye nero eira atorierete intwe, ng’a tonyore obogima bwa kare na kare.
Nabarikeire amang’ana aya igoro y’abwo bakorigia kobasiria.

Korende ogoakwa kw’amaguta okwo mwanyorete korwa ase Kristo nigo goikaransete ime yaino, na inwe timogwenereti monto onde aborokererie, ekiagera ogoakwa kw’amaguta okwo mwanyorire nkoborokererie amang’ana onsi, naende kore ogw’ekeene, gose tari oborimo. Na buna aborokereretie, menya ime ya Kristo.
Na bono inwe abana baane, menya ime asare, erinde ekero akoorokigwa tobe noboremu, titoba nobosooku ase obosio bwaye ekero arachiche.
Onye mwamanyire ng’a ere nomonyene oboronge, naboigo mobe nobomaene ng’a kera oyogokora boronge, oyio oiboirwe nere.
Rora, nobwanchani bore naki, obwo Tata atoeire, ng’a torokwe abana ba Nyasae, na naboigo tore! Naki ekegerete ense etatomanyeti neke, ng’a temomanyeti ere.
Abanchani, bono nabana ba Nyasae tore, korende teraorokigwa buna torache koba. Naki twamanyire ng’a ekero araorokigwe natogwekane nere, ekiagera natomorore buna are.
Na monto onde bwensi omosemeretie nigo agwechena buna Kristo are omochenu.
Onde bwensi ogokora ebibe, nigo agosaria amachiko, ekiagera ebibe nogosaria kw’amachiko.
Na inwe mwamanyire ng’a Kristo nigo aorogetigwe erinde arusie ebibe biaito, na bibe tibiri ime yaye.
Onde bwensi omenyete ime asare tagokora ebibe; onde bwensi ogokora ebibe tamorochi, nonya nkomomanya tamomanyeti.
